papers.title: AdvFD: Boosting Visual Generation via Adversarial Fr'echet Distance Loss
papers.abstract_en: Fréchet distance has recently emerged as an effective distribution-level objective for generator post-training, complementing the conventional sample-level diffusion and flow-matching losses. However, directly optimizing Fréchet objectives can cause Fréchet hacking. The target metrics keep improving, but visual quality and Fréchet alignment in other feature spaces may stagnate or deteriorate. We attribute this failure to the static pretrained feature spaces used by existing Fréchet losses. These feature spaces provide incomplete and fixed views of the differences between real and generated distributions. To address this limitation, we propose Adversarial Fréchet Distance (AdvFD), which complements the static representation targets in FD-Loss with a calibrated adversarially learned representation. AdvFD augments the original static Fréchet objective with a learnable representation that adversarially maximizes the Fréchet discrepancy between real and generated samples, while the generator minimizes the same discrepancy in the resulting adaptive feature space. To prevent the adversarial representation from trivially increasing the objective through feature amplification, we further introduce real-feature whitening, which normalizes its scale and covariance geometry and stabilizes the min--max optimization. Extensive experiments show that AdvFD consistently improves one-step generator post-training across both JiT and pMF backbones and across different model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出对抗式 Fréchet 距离 (Adversarial Fréchet Distance, AdvFD)，用于生成器后训练 (post-training) 的分布级目标。作者指出直接优化 Fréchet 目标会出现 Fréchet hacking，即目标指标持续改善但视觉质量和其它特征空间中的 Fréchet 对齐停滞或退化，原因是现有 Fréchet 损失依赖静态预训练特征空间。AdvFD 在原有静态 Fréchet 目标上加入校准的对抗学习表示，并引入真实特征白化 (real-feature whitening) 稳定 min-max 优化。实验表明 AdvFD 在 JiT 和 pMF 骨干以及不同模型规模上稳定提升一步生成器后训练。
Motivation: 现有 Fréchet 距离损失作为分布级后训练目标会遭遇 Fréchet hacking，静态预训练特征空间对真实分布与生成分布差异的刻画不完整且固定，导致目标指标提升而视觉质量或其它特征空间对齐恶化。
Method: 提出 AdvFD，在静态 Fréchet 目标上叠加一个可学习的对抗表示，该表示通过最大化真实与生成样本间的 Fréchet 差异来学习，而生成器在自适应特征空间中最小化同一差异；同时引入真实特征白化以归一化尺度和协方差几何，防止对抗表示通过特征放大使目标平凡增大，从而稳定 min-max 优化。
Result: 大量实验表明，AdvFD 在 JiT 与 pMF 两种骨干以及不同模型规模上均一致地改善一步生成器后训练效果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过对抗学习校准特征表示并配合白化，可以缓解 Fréchet hacking，使分布级后训练目标更可靠地提升视觉生成质量。
Relevance: 8

papers.title: Surgical WAM: A World-Action Model for Data-Efficient Surgical Robot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Learning reliable surgical manipulation policies is bottlenecked by the scarcity of action-labeled demonstrations: teleoperated surgical robot (e.g., dVRK) trajectories with synchronized kinematics are costly to collect, while surgical tasks demand precise contact handling, long-horizon reasoning, and bimanual coordination. Endoscopic video is comparatively inexpensive and abundant relative to synchronized video--kinematics trajectories, and a natural way to exploit it is to learn world models of surgical scenes. However, existing surgical world models use video primarily for simulation or policy evaluation, and rarely translate the learned dynamics into closed-loop control. This gap raises our central question: under a fixed budget of action-labeled demonstrations, does action-free video pretraining improve closed-loop surgical manipulation? To answer it, we introduce the Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM), a unified generative model built on Cosmos Policy that jointly predicts future endoscopic observations and executable surgical robot action chunks. Surgical WAM first learns surgical visual dynamics from action-free video and is then fine-tuned on the fixed action-labeled budget; at deployment, it acts as a closed-loop, receding-horizon controller that executes a short prefix of each predicted action chunk and replans from the resulting observation. On a suite of four simulated surgical manipulation tasks, video pretraining improves the average success rate from 63.5% to 77.8%, including an absolute gain of 20 percentage points on PegTransfer, with the largest improvements on contact-rich and bimanual tasks. These results demonstrate that action-free video provides transferable visual dynamics priors for learning surgical robot control with limited action supervision, positioning data-efficient video pretraining as a practical path toward scaling up surgical robot learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Surgical WAM，一个基于 Cosmos Policy 的生成式世界-动作模型，先用无动作内窥镜视频预训练学习手术视觉动态，再在固定规模的动作标注数据上微调；部署时作为闭环、滚动时域控制器，执行每个预测动作块的短前缀并从新观测重规划。在四个模拟手术操作任务上，视频预训练把平均成功率从 63.5% 提升到 77.8%，其中 PegTransfer 获得 20 个百分点的绝对增益。
Motivation: 动作标注的手术演示（如 dVRK 遥操作轨迹）采集昂贵且稀缺，而内窥镜视频相对丰富；现有手术世界模型主要把视频用于模拟或策略评估，很少把学到的动态转化为闭环控制。作者的核心问题是在固定动作标注预算下，无动作视频预训练能否改善闭环手术操作。
Method: 构建 Surgical World-Action Model (Surgical WAM)，在 Cosmos Policy 基础上联合预测未来内窥镜观测和可执行的手术机器人动作块 (action chunks)。模型先在无动作视频上学习手术视觉动态，再在固定的动作标注预算上微调；部署时以闭环滚动时域方式执行动作块前缀并不断重规划。
Result: 在四个模拟手术操作任务套件上，视频预训练将平均成功率从 63.5% 提高到 77.8%，包括 PegTransfer 任务上 20 个百分点的绝对提升；最大的改进出现在接触密集和双手协调任务上。
Conclusion: 摘要认为无动作视频提供了可迁移的视觉动态先验，能在有限动作监督下学习手术机器人控制，为数据高效的视频预训练扩展手术机器人学习提供了一条可行路径。

papers.title: Capturing Uncertainty in Human Motion for Representation Learning in Soccer
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a self-supervised representation learning framework for understanding 3D skeleton-based human motion in soccer, using future motion prediction as the learning objective. Since human motion is inherently uncertain, accounting for multiple plausible futures is essential for capturing the underlying motion dynamics and learning effective representations. To this end, we introduce a conditioning module for motion prediction that models a probabilistic distribution over discretized future motions in 3D Euclidean space, learning multimodality with explicit supervision from future trajectories. Experiments on large-scale soccer player tracking data show that our approach substantially improves motion prediction accuracy. Moreover, the learned representations effectively transfer to multiple soccer downstream applications, demonstrating strong cross-task generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自监督表示学习框架，用于理解足球场景中基于3D骨骼的人体运动，以未来运动预测为学习目标。针对人体运动的固有不确定性，引入条件模块对离散化的未来运动在3D欧氏空间中建模概率分布，并通过未来轨迹的显式监督学习多模态。在大规模足球运动员跟踪数据上，该方法显著提升运动预测精度，且学到的表示可有效迁移到多个足球下游任务，展现跨任务泛化能力。
Motivation: 人体运动本质上具有不确定性，单一的未来预测无法充分捕捉运动动态；要学习有效的运动表示，需要显式地对多个合理未来进行建模。
Method: 提出以未来运动预测为学习目标的自监督框架，并引入一个条件模块，在3D欧氏空间中对离散化的未来运动建模概率分布，利用未来轨迹提供显式监督来学习多模态。
Result: 在大规模足球运动员跟踪数据上，运动预测精度得到大幅提升；学到的表示在多个足球下游应用中表现出较强的跨任务迁移能力。
Conclusion: 摘要指出对不确定未来运动进行概率建模有助于学到可迁移的3D骨骼运动表示，但未提及方法的具体局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: VidForensics-M1: Meta-Detection Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Temporal Grounding for AI-Generated Video Forensics
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in video generation models have significantly improved the realism of synthetic videos, blurring the boundary between generated and authentic content and raising concerns about misinformation. Existing MLLM-based detectors mainly rely on supervised fine-tuning or label-level reinforcement learning, where coarse supervision limits generalization to unseen scenarios and emerging video generators. To overcome these limitations, we are the first to introduce \textbf{meta-detection} into AI-generated video detection, enabling reliable forgery detection by jointly optimizing predicted labels and supporting evidence within reinforcement learning. This paradigm requires reliable evidence signals and effective mechanisms to integrate them into label-level optimization. Textual rationales provide semantic descriptions of forgery artifacts, but their generation and verification depend on external models, making supervision vulnerable to hallucinations and semantic biases. In contrast, temporal grounding provides more objective and verifiable evidence, as manipulated intervals can be precisely controlled during forgery construction. Based on this insight, we propose an automated data construction pipeline that generates paired real-fake videos by replacing temporal segments with boundary-frame-conditioned video generation models. Furthermore, we introduce \textbf{Evidence-Guided Reward Redistribution}, which performs evidence-aware credit assignment by redistributing rewards among label-correct responses according to evidence quality. This preserves reliable label supervision while encouraging detectors to acquire fine-grained and verifiable forgery localization capabilities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textbf{VidForensics-M1} effectively leverages verifiable temporal evidence to achieve robust and generalizable AI-generated video detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将 meta-detection 引入 AI 生成视频检测，提出 VidForensics-M1，在强化学习框架中联合优化预测标签与可验证的时间定位证据，以提升对未见场景和新兴视频生成器的泛化能力。作者通过自动化数据构建流程生成成对的真实/伪造视频，并设计 Evidence-Guided Reward Redistribution 机制，依据证据质量在标签正确的响应间重新分配奖励。实验表明该方法能利用可验证的时间证据实现鲁棒且可泛化的检测。
Motivation: 现有基于 MLLM 的检测器主要依赖监督微调或标签级强化学习，粗粒度监督限制了模型对未见场景和新兴视频生成器的泛化能力，需要更可靠的证据信号与将其融入标签级优化的机制。
Method: 提出自动化数据构建流程，用边界帧条件视频生成模型替换时间片段来构造配对真实/伪造视频；并提出 Evidence-Guided Reward Redistribution，按证据质量在标签正确的响应中重新分配奖励，保留可靠标签监督的同时鼓励模型获得细粒度的可验证伪造定位能力。
Result: 大量实验表明 VidForensics-M1 有效利用可验证的时间证据，取得鲁棒且可泛化的 AI 生成视频检测性能；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调可验证的时间定位证据比易受幻觉和语义偏差影响的文本 rationale 更客观可靠，是将证据纳入标签级强化学习优化的有效途径。

papers.title: ConVAWG: A Retrieval-Grounded Framework for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation in Violence Against Women and Girls
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic dialogue generation offers a way to study conversational dynamics in sensitive domains where real data are difficult to access, release, or annotate. The underlying abuse may occur online or offline: threats and coercion can appear directly in messages, while behaviours such as surveillance, isolation, stalking, and physical violence may be planned, disclosed, or referred to conversationally. Privacy and legal constraints make it difficult the release of large-scale real conversation datasets; existing work has mostly focused on sentence-level toxicity of online abuses, leaving a gap in modelling abuse as a relational and temporally unfolding phenomenon. In this work, we focus on modelling Violence Against Women and Girls (VAWG) scenarios as multi-turn dialogues. We introduce ConVAWG, a retrieval-grounded framework for generating CPS-aligned synthetic VAWG chat dialogues. ConVAWG builds scenarios from persona seeds, demographic patterns reported by the UK Office for National Statistics, official crime definitions, and retrieved Domestic Homicide Review cases; converts them into hierarchical event timelines; generates multi-scene role-play dialogues; and applies targeted activation-steered toxicity control to appropriate utterances. We release over 6,000 multi-turn dialogue events across 200 scenarios with rich scenario-, event-, and turn-level metadata. Extensive human evaluation, LLM-as-Judge assessment, ablations, and downstream tasks show strong dialogue quality and domain fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConVAWG，一个面向暴力侵害妇女和女童（Violence Against Women and Girls, VAWG）场景的检索增强（retrieval-grounded）合成多轮对话生成框架。框架从人设种子、英国国家统计局的人口统计模式、官方犯罪定义以及检索到的 Domestic Homicide Review 案例构建场景，转换为分层事件时间线，生成多场景角色扮演对话，并用激活引导（activation-steered）的毒性控制调整话语。作者发布 200 个场景、超过 6,000 个多轮对话事件，并附有场景、事件和轮次层面的元数据。
Motivation: 真实 VAWG 会话数据因隐私和法律限制难以大规模发布，而现有工作多聚焦于在线虐待的句子级毒性分类，缺少将虐待建模为关系性、随时间展开的多轮对话现象。
Method: ConVAWG 以检索增强的方式组合人设种子、ONS 人口统计模式、官方犯罪定义与检索到的 Domestic Homicide Review 案件，构建分层事件时间线，生成多场景角色扮演对话，并对相应话语施加激活引导的毒性控制。
Result: 摘要报告发布了超过 6,000 个多轮对话事件、覆盖 200 个场景，且带有丰富的场景级、事件级和轮次级元数据；人工评估、LLM-as-Judge 评估、消融实验和下游任务均显示较强的对话质量和领域保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作填补了在敏感领域以可控合成方式研究多轮对话动态的空白，并将 VAWG 视为在对话中逐步展开的虐待现象来建模。

papers.title: Beyond a Bag of Features: Set-Level Instability in Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Shani et al. (2026) show that LLM representations broadly recover human category boundaries, while failing to reflect fine-grained typicality structure. Their analysis uses cosine similarity over dense model representations. We revisit their approach using overlap over active sparse autoencoder (SAE) latent sets as a more interpretable similarity measure. We first verify that this set-level measure is meaningful: SAE latent sets can recover union-like compositional structure in controlled toy models and induce semantically coherent neighborhoods in natural text. Extending the human-concepts analysis to SAE set similarities, we find that SAE activation sets do not recover human category boundaries or within-category typicality more faithfully than dense embeddings or residual-stream states, but instead track model-internal similarity structure. To probe this gap further, we study active latent sets under well-controlled semantic modifications, revealing a substantial mismatch between human judgements of conceptual change and change in the SAE active set. We interpret this as evidence that, outside idealised settings, SAE features do not compose via simple bag-of-features semantics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新检验 Shani et al. (2026) 关于 LLM 表征与人类概念边界关系的结论，改用稀疏自编码器（SAE）激活潜在集合的重叠度作为更可解释的相似度度量。作者先在受控玩具模型和自然文本上验证该集合级度量有意义，随后发现 SAE 激活集合在人类概念分析中并不比稠密嵌入或残差流状态更忠实地恢复人类类别边界与内部典型性，而是追踪模型内部的相似性结构。进一步在受控语义修改下发现人类对概念变化的判断与 SAE 激活集合的变化存在显著失配，据此认为在理想化场景之外 SAE 特征并不按简单特征袋（bag-of-features）语义组合。
Motivation: 现有分析多用稠密表征的余弦相似度，缺乏可解释性；作者希望用 SAE 激活潜在集合的重叠度作为更可解释的相似度度量，检验 SAE 特征集是否比稠密表征更忠实地反映人类概念结构。
Method: 将 SAE 激活潜在集合的重叠度作为相似度度量，在玩具模型上验证其能恢复类似并集的组合结构，在自然文本上验证语义邻域；随后将该度量用于人类概念分析，并在受控语义修改下比较人类判断与 SAE 激活集合的变化。
Result: 摘要报告 SAE 激活集合并未比稠密嵌入或残差流状态更忠实地恢复人类类别边界或类别内典型性，而是反映模型内部相似性结构；受控语义修改下人类概念变化判断与 SAE 激活集合变化存在显著失配。
Conclusion: 作者认为这表明在理想化设定之外，SAE 特征不通过简单的特征袋语义进行组合。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Long-Horizon AI Research for Grothendieck Constant: A Case Study in Human-AI Mathematical Collaboration
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly used in mathematics research, but it is often unclear how to use them effectively. Towards this, we present an extensive case study of how AI was used to improve bounds on the Grothendieck constant $K_G$, which captures the hardness between combinatorial problems and their continuous relaxations. Specifically, while the precise value of $K_G$ is not known, we recently tightened the best known bounds to \[ \frac{6π}{11} \;\le\; K_G \;\le\; \fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt2)} - 10^{-4}. \] Crucially, these improvements were achieved using an AI research system that could arrive at insights deemed novel by domain experts. We give a detailed discussion of our experience using AI for mathematics research, particularly touching upon its strengths and weaknesses, as well as our experience with creating ideal conditions for AI to arrive at breakthrough insights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 AI 参与数学研究的一次深入案例研究，目标是用 AI 改进 Grothendieck 常数 $K_G$ 的已知界。作者报告将最佳已知界收紧为 $\frac{6\pi}{11} \le K_G \le \frac{\pi}{2\log(1+\sqrt2)} - 10^{-4}$，并强调该改进由能够产生领域专家认可的新颖见解的 AI 研究系统完成。文中详细讨论了使用 AI 进行数学研究的经验、其优劣，以及为 AI 产生突破性见解创造理想条件的体会。
Motivation: AI 智能体正越来越多地被用于数学研究，但如何有效使用它们仍不清楚；本文试图通过一个具体案例来阐明这一问题。
Method: 采用大规模案例研究方式，描述一个 AI 研究系统如何辅助改进 Grothendieck 常数的界，并围绕系统的使用经验、优势与不足，以及创造理想协作条件展开详细讨论。
Result: 摘要报告将 Grothendieck 常数的最佳已知界收紧为 $\frac{6\pi}{11} \le K_G \le \frac{\pi}{2\log(1+\sqrt2)} - 10^{-4}$，且称 AI 系统能得出被领域专家视为新颖的见解。
Conclusion: 作者强调其贡献在于分享人机协作进行数学研究的经验教训，特别是如何为 AI 产生突破性见解创造条件，并坦诚讨论这一范式的优点与局限。

papers.title: Test-Time Self-Evolving GUI Visual Grounding via Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract_en: GUI Visual Grounding is a fundamental capability for GUI agents. Existing models typically freeze their parameters after deployment, limiting their ability to adapt to unseen interfaces. Although recent methods attempt to adapt models via test-time reinforcement learning, they cannot reflect upon failed exploration. To overcome this, we propose a Test-Time Self-Evolving framework that enables models to improve after deployment without human-annotated ground truth. It constructs a closed-loop of Exploration, Evaluation, Reflection, and Internalization. Specifically, the agent first explores unseen interfaces by predicting grounding coordinates for given instructions. To evaluate these explorations, we introduce an MLLM-based Reflector to assess the generated results and provide the corresponding reasoning reflections. To internalize reflection knowledge into the model weights, we propose Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, which translates high-level reasoning into dense token-level supervision via a conditioned self-teacher. Furthermore, we design a Contrastive Calibration method to prevent incorrect auto-regressive prefixes from corrupting the supervisory signals during failed explorations. Extensive experiments across six benchmarks demonstrate our framework's effectiveness, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 7.4% over the base model. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to successfully exploit on-policy self-distillation for test-time adaptation in GUI visual grounding. By filling the gap in post-deployment adaptation, our framework completes the self-evolving capability of GUI agents. The code will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个测试时自演化框架（Test-Time Self-Evolving framework），让 GUI 视觉定位模型在部署后无需人工标注即可持续改进。框架构建了探索（Exploration）、评估（Evaluation）、反思（Reflection）与内化（Internalization）的闭环：先由模型预测坐标探索未见界面，再用基于 MLLM 的 Reflector 评估结果并提供推理反思，最后通过 Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation 把高层推理转化为密集的 token 级监督，并引入 Contrastive Calibration 防止失败探索中的错误自回归前缀污染监督信号。在六个基准上的平均准确率相较基础模型提升 7.4%。
Motivation: 现有的 GUI 视觉定位模型在部署后参数冻结，难以适应未见过的界面；近期方法虽尝试测试时强化学习，但无法对失败的探索进行反思，缺乏闭环自适应能力。
Method: 提出测试时自演化框架，包含探索-评估-反思-内化闭环；用 MLLM-based Reflector 生成评估与反思，用 Reflection-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation 将推理反思转化为 token 级监督，并用 Contrastive Calibration 防止错误前缀损坏监督信号。
Result: 在六个基准上平均准确率较基础模型提升 7.4%，作者称这是首个将 on-policy self-distillation 成功用于 GUI 视觉定位测试时自适应的工作。
Conclusion: 该框架填补了部署后自适应（post-deployment adaptation）的空白，完善了 GUI 代理的自演化能力；代码将公开发布。

papers.title: How to Verify Consistency of Probabilistic Claims
papers.abstract_en: When a probabilistic predictor answers many conditional-probability queries, are its answers self-consistent, and can this be verified in polynomial time? This problem is of interest for AI safety, where safety is derived from honesty about probabilistic predictions of unwanted outcomes potentially caused by an AI action. We construct an interactive PCP as follows. Let a predictive model be specified by a probability circuit P and a circuit Q which outputs confidence in predictions. Together, P and Q implicitly specify exponentially many probabilistic claims. We show a protocol in which a polynomial-time verifier can verify the approximate consistency of (P,Q). The verifier is given the pair of circuits (P,Q), which it evaluates at only a few points; alongside them it is given a proof oracle, an encoding of a witnessing probability distribution allegedly consistent with the predictions of (P,Q), which it reads at a few locations while interacting with a single untrusted prover. En route, we must ensure the existence of a sparse witnessing distribution consistent with the model's predictions. To do so, we first consider witness distributions for the consistency of explicit probabilistic claims, rather than claims specified by a predictor: say m claims, each of the form Pr[Y = 1 | X = x] = p, over n Boolean variables. Building on work initiated by Nilsson (Artif. Intell., 1986), we place l_2-approximate probabilistic consistency of explicit claims in NP, with certificates of length O(mn + log B) in the input bit-precision B; we further show how a small additive completeness-soundness gap removes the dependence on B. Together these results provide a complexity-theoretic foundation for certifying the self-consistency of probabilistic predictors. We view our interactive PCP as a first step toward training predictive models to prove their own consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究概率预测器在回答大量条件概率查询时其答案是否自洽，以及能否在多项式时间内验证。作者构造了一个交互式PCP（interactive PCP）协议，让多项式时间验证者仅通过少量点评估电路并读取证明预言机的少量位置，即可与单个不可信证明者交互，验证由概率电路 P 和置信电路 Q 隐式指定的指数多个概率声称的近似一致性。文章还证明显式概率声称的 l2 近似一致性属于 NP，证书长度为 O(mn + log B)，并指出小的加性完备-健全（completeness-soundness）间隙可消除对输入位精度 B 的依赖。
Motivation: AI 安全中的安全保证依赖于对 AI 行为可能导致的非预期结果进行诚实的概率预测；因此需要验证预测器大量条件概率回答的自洽性，但目前缺少复杂性理论基础。
Method: 先处理显式概率声称的一致性：对 m 个形如 Pr[Y=1|X=x]=p、涉及 n 个布尔变量的声称，基于 Nilsson 的早期工作构建 l2 近似一致性的 NP 证明和稀疏见证分布；再将该方法扩展到由电路 (P,Q) 隐式指定的指数多个声称，构造交互式 PCP 协议。
Result: 摘要未报告实验数值；主要结果包括：存在多项式时间验证协议可验证 (P,Q) 的近似一致性，显式声称一致性的证书长度为 O(mn + log B)，且小加性完备-健全间隙可去除对 B 的依赖。
Conclusion: 该工作为认证概率预测器的自洽性提供了复杂性理论基础，并被视为训练预测模型证明自身一致性的第一步。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Quantum Roadmap for Softmax Attention: Exact Born-Rule Analogs for Softmax Attention on the Probability Simplex
papers.abstract_en: The attention mechanism forms the foundation of many modern AI models such as the Transformer. In one subclass of problems where attention is used, inputs and outputs are bound to the probability simplex so that all outputs sum to one. In this setting, softmax attention admits an exact, component-by-component quantum realization. Attention scores are Hadamard-test statistics on block-encoded projections of amplitude-encoded inputs. The exponential softmax is the interior of a cosine-squared family generated by Born-rule measurement under an exact bijection, whose boundary expresses sparse attention with exact zeros at finite parameter values. The softmax temperature is a repetition count where post-selected measurement rounds realize discretized inverse temperature exactly. Value aggregation is a deterministic column-loading channel that dilates the column-stochastic value matrix. The gated residual is the preparation angle of a single ancilla, with the additive identity at a mixing angle of π/2. Every learnable parameter is a rotation-gate angle. The composed layer is exact in the infinite-shot limit with one measure-and-reload step per attention score; a fully-coherent variant is ε-approximate via quantum singular value transformation in the infinite depth limit. The algebraic core is machine-checked in Lean 4.

papers.title: From Interpretability to Control: Insights from Six Years of the TrustNLP Workshop
papers.abstract_en: The Workshop on Trustworthy Natural Language Processing (TrustNLP), co-located with major ACL conferences since 2021, has grown from 8 proceedings papers to 41 over six editions, documenting a field-wide transition from post-hoc interpretability of static models to mechanistic understanding and proactive control of generative systems. We synthesize insights from all 144 proceedings papers, classifying them along six trust dimensions grounded in established frameworks (TrustLLM, DecodingTrust). We observe co-occurrences with capability emergence. The release of the first high-impact chat models activated all trust dimensions simultaneously, while subsequent model generations shifted focus toward truthfulness and safety alignment. Analysis from the classification study reveals that truthfulness is the fastest-growing dimension (absent in 2021-2022, comprising 37% of papers by 2025-2026), fairness remains the most consistent theme, and explainability exhibits a U-shaped trajectory; declining as post-hoc methods lost relevance but resurging in 2026 through mechanistic interpretability. A cross-venue comparison with ACL, NAACL, EACL, and EMNLP (~2K papers) in the same period shows that TrustNLP's topical distribution closely follows the field average. We identify four structural insights and conclude with actionable directions for the research community.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ACL ARR August 2026 cycle (EACL 2027)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文综合 TrustNLP 研讨会六届（2021-2026）共 144 篇论文，依据 TrustLLM 与 DecodingTrust 等既有框架将其划分为六个信任维度，刻画了可信 NLP 领域从静态模型事后可解释性转向生成式系统机制理解与主动控制的整体演变。摘要报告了各维度的时序趋势，并与同期 ACL、NAACL、EACL、EMNLP 约 2000 篇论文做了跨会议主题分布对比。
Motivation: 可信 NLP 领域六年内快速扩张且研究焦点发生明显转移，但缺少对全部论文的系统性回顾；作者希望识别领域结构性变化，并为研究社区提炼可行动的方向。
Method: 对 TrustNLP 六届全部 144 篇论文进行综合与分类，采用基于 TrustLLM、DecodingTrust 的六个信任维度框架，并加入跨会议对比以判断 TrustNLP 主题分布是否偏离领域整体水平。
Result: 真值性（truthfulness）是增长最快的维度，2021-2022 年缺席，到 2025-2026 年已占论文的 37%；公平性（fairness）是最持续的主题；可解释性呈 U 型轨迹，先随事后方法失去相关性而下降，后在 2026 年通过机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability）回升。跨会议对比显示 TrustNLP 的主题分布与领域平均水平接近。
Conclusion: 作者识别出四个结构性洞见，并给出面向研究社区的可行动建议，强调可信 NLP 的研究热点与模型能力涌现（capability emergence）同步变化。

papers.title: MultiModal Code-Switching: Interleaving Visual Objects into Language for Explicit Object-Level Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) predominantly rely on image-text pairs for modality alignment pretraining, mapping global image representations to long textual descriptions. However, this image-level alignment suffers from referential ambiguity: models struggle to infer the correspondences between multiple visual objects and textual entities from the global representation, leading to data inefficiency and suboptimal semantic grounding. To address this, we propose MultiModal Code-Switching (MMCS), a novel pretraining paradigm that provides explicit object-level supervision. Inspired by the linguistic phenomenon of code-switching, MMCS interleaves vision and language by replacing textual entities with their corresponding visual objects, enforcing local vision-language grounding. We further develop a scalable data synthesis pipeline to generate a pretraining dataset of 773K samples with accurate object-entity correspondences. Experiments show that MMCS is highly data-efficient: with only 50K samples, it matches or surpasses models trained on 600K image-text pairs. Furthermore, MMCS consistently improves visual grounding and perception capabilities across varying model scales.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiModal Code-Switching (MMCS)，一种为多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 设计的新颖预训练范式，通过将文本实体替换为对应的视觉对象，在局部执行显式的 object-level 视觉-语言对齐。作者设计了可扩展的数据合成流水线，生成含精确对象-实体对应关系的 773K 预训练样本。摘要报告 MMCS 数据效率高：仅用 50K 样本即可匹配或超越用 600K 图像-文本对训练的模型，并在不同模型规模上稳定提升视觉 grounding 与感知能力。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 的模态对齐预训练主要依赖图像-文本对，将全局图像表示映射到长文本描述；这种 image-level 对齐存在指称歧义 (referential ambiguity)，模型难以从全局表示推断多个视觉对象与文本实体之间的对应关系，导致数据效率低且语义 grounding 欠佳。
Method: 提出 MMCS 预训练范式，借鉴语言学中的语码转换 (code-switching) 现象，将文本实体替换为其对应的视觉对象，使视觉与语言在序列中交错出现，从而强制进行局部视觉-语言 grounding；同时构建可扩展的数据合成流水线，生成含精确对象-实体对应关系的 773K 预训练数据集。
Result: 实验显示 MMCS 数据效率高：仅用 50K 样本即可匹配或超越使用 600K 图像-文本对训练的模型；并且在不同模型规模上一致提升视觉 grounding 和感知能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，用视觉对象替换文本实体进行局部显式对齐是一种数据高效的预训练方式，可缓解 image-level 对齐带来的指称歧义，并跨模型规模改善 MLLM 的视觉 grounding 与感知能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hierarchical Empirical-Bayes Naive Bayes: Minimax Smoothing and Calibration with AODE Extension
papers.abstract_en: The Naive Bayes (NB) classifier remains a standard choice for categorical data, yet its widely used smoothing rules, such as Laplace, Lidstone, Krichevsky-Trofimov, and the $m$-estimate, all prescribe a fixed smoothing strength that ignores feature cardinality, sample size, and class imbalance, inducing a non-vanishing bias on modern high-cardinality tabular data. We propose hierarchical empirical-Bayes Naive Bayes (HEB-NB), in which each class-feature conditional probability is smoothed by a Dirichlet prior whose concentration is learned data-adaptively via Type-II maximum likelihood, enabling principled information sharing across classes while retaining closed-form inference. We further introduce HEB average one-dependence estimators (HEB-AODE), showing that the adaptive smoothing transfers cleanly to structural relaxations of NB. Theoretically, we establish a non-asymptotic $\ell_1$ error bound for HEB-NB matching the empirical-distribution minimax rate plus a vanishing data-adaptive bias, together with a matching Laplace-tight lower bound that yields a finite-sample, risk-level strict separation from Laplace. We further derive a plug-in excess Bayes-risk bound via total-variation tensorization and a population top-1 expected calibration error (ECE) corollary. Empirically, across 31 UCI and OpenML benchmarks, HEB-NB attains the best average Friedman rank on probabilistic metrics, with up to 22.1% log-loss reductions on high-cardinality datasets and consistent improvements of HEB-AODE over vanilla AODE. Combining HEB-NB with mutual-information weighting reduces top-1 ECE by 41%-70%, demonstrating substantial gains in probabilistic accuracy and calibration.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been submitted to the Knowledge-Based Systems
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对朴素贝叶斯 (Naive Bayes, NB) 在分类数据上的固定平滑强度问题，提出分层经验贝叶斯朴素贝叶斯 (HEB-NB)：每个类-特征条件概率用 Dirichlet 先验平滑，先验浓度通过 Type-II 最大似然数据自适应地学习，并进一步给出 HEB-AODE 扩展。理论部分建立了匹配经验分布极小极大速率的非渐近 ℓ1 误差界和 Laplace 紧下界，经验上在 31 个 UCI/OpenML 基准上取得最佳平均 Friedman 排名，高基数数据集上 log-loss 最高降低 22.1%。
Motivation: 现有平滑规则（Laplace、Lidstone、Krichevsky-Trofimov、m-estimate）都预设固定平滑强度，忽略特征基数、样本量和类别不平衡，导致高基数表格数据上出现不消失的偏差。
Method: 提出 HEB-NB，将每个类-特征条件概率建模为带 Dirichlet 先验的平滑估计，先验浓度由 Type-II 最大似然数据自适应学习，在跨类别信息共享的同时保持闭式推理；随后引入 HEB-AODE，把自适应平滑扩展到 NB 的平均一依赖估计器 (AODE) 结构松弛。
Result: 理论上证明 HEB-NB 的非渐近 ℓ1 误差界与经验分布极小极大速率匹配并外加可消失的数据自适应偏差，且有匹配的 Laplace 紧下界，给出有限样本风险层面的严格分离；另导出基于 total-variation tensorization 的 plug-in 超额贝叶斯风险界和 top-1 期望校准误差 (ECE) 推论。经验上 HEB-NB 在 31 个基准上取得最佳平均 Friedman 排名，高基数数据集 log-loss 降低最高 22.1%，HEB-AODE 一致优于 vanilla AODE，加互信息加权后 top-1 ECE 降低 41%-70%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调数据自适应的 Dirichlet 平滑能显著改善概率准确性与校准，并且能干净地迁移到 NB 的结构松弛（AODE）上，与互信息加权结合可大幅降低 top-1 ECE。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Conditional Independence Tests for Constraint-Based Causal Discovery: A Survey
papers.abstract_en: Conditional Independence (CI) tests are the statistical engine of constraint-based causal discovery: in algorithms such as PC (Peter-Clark) and FCI (Fast Causal Inference), skeleton pruning and key orientations follow directly from CI decisions. This survey reviews CI testing with emphasis on assumptions, robustness, and scalability in high-dimensional and mixed-type settings common in biomedical domains. The survey organizes widely used CI methods into six families: partial-correlation, contingency-table, regression, nearest-neighbor, kernel, and machine-learning-based. Special emphasis is provided on the robustness layers that address the limitations of these families. For each family, the survey examines when CI decisions reflect the data-generating distribution and when they fail. By this, we link test-level properties, including power decay with conditioning set size and asymmetric type I/II error consequences, to graph-level errors in skeleton recovery and v-structure orientation. The survey also compares adoption across major R and Python libraries and summarizes open challenges, including mixed-type CI testing without discretization, small-sample error control, and strategies for improving scalability of CI-testing.
papers.comment: 33 pages. Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (07/2026). https://openreview.net/forum?id=3jzafJK8Tz
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这篇综述系统梳理基于约束的因果发现（constraint-based causal discovery）中的条件独立性检验（CI tests），重点考察其在生物医学高维和混合类型数据下的假设、鲁棒性与可扩展性。作者将常用方法分为偏相关、列联表、回归、最近邻、核方法和基于机器学习六类，并讨论各类方法何时能反映数据生成分布、何时失效。
Motivation: 约束式因果发现算法如 PC 和 FCI 依赖 CI 检验完成骨架剪枝与关键方向判定，但现有文献缺少对 CI 方法在假设、鲁棒性和高维可扩展性方面的系统对比。
Method: 以综述方式组织六类 CI 方法族，分析检验层面性质（如条件集增大时的功效衰减、I/II 类错误的不对称后果）如何传导至骨架恢复和 v-structure 定向的图层面错误，并比较主要 R 与 Python 因果推断库对各类方法的采纳情况。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；主要产出是对六类 CI 检验族及其鲁棒性层次的系统分类，以及混合类型检验、小样本误差控制和可扩展性等开放挑战的归纳。
Conclusion: 作者将无需离散化的混合类型 CI 检验、小样本误差控制以及提升 CI 检验可扩展性的策略列为当前开放问题。

papers.title: DACRI: Decision-Aware Causal Intervention Ranking for Critical Supply Chains
papers.abstract_en: Detecting or attributing a supply-chain disruption is not the same as selecting the intervention that maximizes recoverable net value. We present CriticalSCM-Bench v1, a controlled synthetic benchmark with causal ground truth, paired factual/counterfactual rollouts, and an explicit net-value objective. Relative to a full-information train-selected static benchmark, LambdaMART improves median normalized net value by 5.7--16.2\%, with paired statistical support on the semiconductor and critical-material archetypes but not on digital infrastructure. On digital infrastructure, a domain-informed constant-buffer policy remains stronger, showing that greater model complexity is not uniformly justified. Across partial and delayed settings, LambdaMART retains 33--75\% of full-clamp value. Stress tests further show that intervention fidelity, timing, cost, and held-out disruptions can alter policy ordering. Critical materials show the weakest out-of-distribution retention. Separately, a guarded explanation study over 540 generations preserves every fixed intervention decision after deterministic validation and template fallback, although exact wording remains unstable. Within this controlled setting, the results identify regimes in which adaptive ranking adds value and those in which simpler structural policies remain preferable.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026), 15--17 October 2026, Bali, Indonesia. 5 tables; no figures. Benchmark and code: https://github.com/dyshang/dacri-criticalscm-bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CriticalSCM-Bench v1，一个带因果真值、事实/反事实轨迹和显式净价值目标的受控合成供应链基准，并研究决策感知的干预排序。摘要报告 LambdaMART 在半导体和关键材料原型上将中位归一化净价值相对全信息静态基准提升 5.7–16.2%，但在数字基础设施上不如简单的常数缓冲策略；受控说明研究在 540 次生成中保留所有固定干预决策。
Motivation: 检测或归因供应链中断并不等同于选择能最大化可恢复净价值的干预；现有基准缺少因果真值和以净价值为目标的干预选择评估。
Method: 构建受控合成基准 CriticalSCM-Bench v1，提供因果真值、配对的事实/反事实 rollout 和显式净价值目标，并比较 LambdaMART 自适应排序与全信息静态基准、领域信息常数缓冲策略等；同时进行受保护的解释研究和压力测试。
Result: LambdaMART 在中位归一化净价值上相对全信息训练选择的静态基准提升 5.7–16.2%，在半导体和关键材料原型上有配对统计支持，数字基础设施上不显著；部分和延迟观测下保留 33–75% 的全信息价值。压力测试表明干预保真度、时机、成本和未见中断可改变策略排序，关键材料的外分布保留最弱。
Conclusion: 在受控设置下，自适应排序仅在部分场景增加价值，数字基础设施上更简单的结构性策略仍更优，说明更高的模型复杂度并非普遍合理。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Scheduling Mixed RL Rollouts Beyond Prefix Locality
papers.abstract_en: Modern reinforcement learning (RL) post-training pipelines for large language models (LLMs) increasingly combine rollout workloads across multiple domains and feedback paradigms. Prefix-aware routing improves inference efficiency through cache reuse and load balancing, but it does not control how heterogeneous rollout sessions compete for KV-cache capacity. When reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), and agentic rollouts share an asynchronous inference service, their distinct sequence structures, interaction patterns, and KV-residency times create substantially different serving demands. Rollout scheduling must account for this heterogeneity without distorting the workload mixture specified by the trainer. We present MISA-T, a routing-layer admission policy for mixed rollout serving. MISA-T combines adaptive session admission, workload-aware KV-capacity allocation, and residency-time-aware KV accounting. In rollout-only ablations on Step3.7 and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MISA-T improves rollout throughput over a sweep-tuned cache-aware vLLM Router by 53.3% and 43.6%, respectively, while maintaining high prefix-cache hit rates. In a matched 50-iteration Step3.7 experiment, it increases rollout throughput by 35.6% and reduces mean iteration time by 22.8%, while keeping the consumed workload mixture close to the trainer target and achieving comparable task scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM 强化学习后训练中混合 rollout 工作负载的调度问题，提出路由层准入策略 MISA-T。该方法将自适应会话准入、负载感知的 KV 容量分配和驻留时间感知的 KV 记账相结合，在不扭曲训练器指定混合比例的前提下处理 RLVR、RLHF 与 agentic rollout 的异构服务需求。在 Step3.7 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 上的 rollout-only 消融中，相对调优后的缓存感知 vLLM Router，吞吐分别提升 53.3% 和 43.6%；在 50 次迭代实验中吞吐提升 35.6%、平均迭代时间降低 22.8%，且保持混合比例接近训练目标、任务分数相当。
Motivation: 现有前缀感知路由通过缓存复用和负载均衡提升推理效率，但未控制异构 rollout 会话如何竞争 KV 缓存容量。当 RLVR、RLHF 与 agentic rollout 共享异步推理服务时，其序列结构、交互模式和 KV 驻留时间差异显著，需要在不扭曲训练器指定工作负载混合的前提下进行调度。
Method: 提出 MISA-T，一种面向混合 rollout 服务的路由层准入策略，包含自适应会话准入、负载感知的 KV 容量分配，以及驻留时间感知的 KV 记账三部分。
Result: 在 Step3.7 和 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 rollout-only 消融中，MISA-T 相对 sweep-tuned 的缓存感知 vLLM Router 将 rollout 吞吐分别提升 53.3% 和 43.6%，同时维持高前缀缓存命中率；在匹配的 50 次迭代 Step3.7 实验中，吞吐提升 35.6%，平均迭代时间降低 22.8%，消费的工作负载混合接近训练目标，任务分数相当。
Conclusion: MISA-T 表明路由层准入控制能够在混合 rollout 场景下显著提升吞吐和迭代效率，同时保持训练器指定的工作负载比例与任务性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CausalSplat: Towards Comprehensive Hierarchical Reasoning in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced open vocabulary scene understanding, existing methods remain confined to explicit queries. They struggle to interpret implicit intents, complex spatial constraints, and commonsense reasoning required for practical embodied interactions. To address this gap, we introduce the task of reasoning 3D Gaussian segmentation and construct two benchmarks, Causal-LERF and Causal-ScanNet. These benchmarks systematically evaluate commonsense, spatial, affordance, and counterfactual reasoning. Evaluations reveal that current state of the art methods perform poorly on these reasoning challenges. Therefore, we propose CausalSplat, a framework that integrates vision-language models with 3D scene graphs to disentangle explicit structural perception from implicit logical inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CausalSplat achieves state of the art performance on our reasoning benchmarks while showing strong generalizability on standard referring and open vocabulary 3D segmentation tasks. Project Page: https://jiayuding031020.github.io/CausalSplat
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出推理式3D高斯分割（reasoning 3D Gaussian segmentation）任务，并构建Causal-LERF与Causal-ScanNet两个基准，系统评估常识、空间、affordance与反事实推理。作者提出CausalSplat框架，将视觉语言模型与3D场景图结合，解耦显式结构感知与隐式逻辑推理，在推理基准上达到当前最优，并在标准指称与开放词汇3D分割任务上表现出强泛化性。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）开放词汇理解局限于显式查询，难以解释隐式意图、复杂空间约束及常识推理，而这对于实际具身交互至关重要。
Method: 提出CausalSplat框架，集成视觉语言模型（vision-language models）与3D场景图（3D scene graphs），将显式结构感知与隐式逻辑推理分离，以应对推理型分割任务。
Result: 摘要报告CausalSplat在constructed的推理基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，并在标准referring与open-vocabulary 3D分割任务上表现强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者强调解耦显式感知与隐式推理的框架能有效解决常识、空间、affordance和反事实推理挑战，同时保持对标准任务的可迁移性。

papers.title: PRMU: A Corpus-Free Benchmark for Person-Centric Knowledge Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in storing and recalling rich person-related knowledge, raising increasing concerns about reliable knowledge removal. However, existing machine unlearning approaches for MLLMs typically assume access to original forget and retain corpora, which are often unavailable in realistic deletion scenarios. To address this limitation, we introduce PRMU, a benchmark for evaluating corpus-free multimodal unlearning under realistic person-centric deletion requests. PRMU focuses on naturally acquired person-related knowledge and evaluates whether models can remove target knowledge while preserving related knowledge through diverse textual and visual probes, including adversarial evaluation and fine-grained locality analysis. To facilitate research in this setting, we further introduce Similarity-Gated Projection Editing (SGPE), a lightweight corpus-free unlearning baseline with knowledge displacement, protected parameter-space editing, and locality-aware multimodal control. Extensive experiments on representative MLLMs reveal that existing unlearning methods often suffer from unfavorable forgetting-locality trade-offs, with significant locality degradation under aggressive forgetting settings, and remain vulnerable to multimodal knowledge reactivation. Meanwhile, SGPE provides a competitive trade-off between target forgetting, locality preservation, and general multimodal utility. We hope PRMU can facilitate future research toward realistic and scalable multimodal machine unlearning. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/2231122/PRMU.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PRMU，一个用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在人中心删除请求下进行无语料（corpus-free）遗忘的基准。PRMU 聚焦自然习得的人物相关知识，通过文本与视觉探针、对抗评估和细粒度局部性分析来检验模型能否移除目标知识同时保留相关知识。作者还提出轻量级无语料基线 SGPE，并在代表性 MLLM 上实验，发现现有遗忘方法在激进遗忘设置下局部性退化明显且易受多模态知识重激活影响。
Motivation: 现有针对 MLLM 的机器遗忘方法通常假设可以访问原始遗忘语料和保留语料，但现实删除场景中这些语料常常不可得，限制了方法的实用性。人物相关知识的可靠移除是隐私保护中的关键问题。
Method: PRMU 基准包含多样化的文本和视觉探针，并引入对抗评估与细粒度局部性分析。SGPE（Similarity-Gated Projection Editing）基线结合知识位移、受保护参数空间编辑和局部性感知多模态控制，实现无语料遗忘。
Result: 实验表明现有遗忘方法常面临不利的遗忘-局部性权衡，在激进遗忘设置下局部性显著下降，并且难以抵抗多模态知识重激活；SGPE 则在目标遗忘、局部性保留和通用多模态效用之间提供了有竞争力的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者希望 PRMU 能推动更现实、可扩展的多模态机器遗忘研究，并计划发布代码和数据集。

papers.title: A Recommendation System Approach for Interference-Robust Sensor Subset Selection
papers.abstract_en: This paper develops a method for sensor-subset selection for tracking. Prior work showed that low-cost acoustic Received Signal Strength Indicator (RSSI) measurements can be used to recommend subsets of sensor nodes whose expensive sensing modalities, such as cameras, can achieve high tracking accuracy. While efficient, RSSI-based approaches are challenged by acoustic interference. We propose a recommendation-system-inspired framework that instead leverages frequency-band acoustic features and a Two-Tower Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) architecture to efficiently score candidate sensor subsets. Experimental results on outdoor vehicle-tracking deployments show that the proposed method can improve accuracy by around 20\% over the RSSI baseline while maintaining the low computational overhead required for real-time selective sensing.

TL;DR: 本文针对追踪任务中的传感器子集选择问题，提出一种受推荐系统启发的框架，利用频带声学特征和双塔多层感知机（Two-Tower MLP）架构来高效评分候选传感器子集。户外车辆追踪部署实验表明，相比RSSI基线，该方法可将精度提升约20%，同时保持实时选择性传感所需的低计算开销。

Method: 提出推荐系统启发的传感器子集选择框架，使用频带声学特征替代RSSI，并采用Two-Tower MLP架构对候选传感器子集进行高效评分。
Result: 户外车辆追踪部署实验显示，所提方法相比RSSI基线可将精度提升约20%，同时维持实时选择性传感所需的低计算开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在抗声学干扰与计算效率之间取得平衡，适合实时选择性传感场景。

papers.title: SAR2Agri: Learning SAR Intensity Representations for Agricultural Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Agricultural monitoring faces unique challenges, arising from the landscape's complex temporal, phenological, and climate dynamics, yet monitoring them is critical for ensuring food security. Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellites offer all-weather day-night imaging capability supporting key monitoring tasks including crop type mapping, yield prediction and phenological event detection. Existing multimodal remote sensing foundation models including TerraMind and CopernicusFM learn SAR representations by grounding them in optical imagery using joint encoding and contrastive learning techniques, while SAR-specific foundation models such as SAR-JEPA, SARMAE, and SAR-W-MixMAE primarily focus on target detection, flood mapping, and land cover classification applications. Recent work has introduced phenology inspired temporal pretext tasks with optical imagery which has shown strong performance on agricultural downstream tasks. In this work, we propose the first self-supervised learning pipeline focused on using only SAR intensity imagery for agricultural applications. We improve the temporal pretext tasks through masking and curriculum learning to enhance the pretraining pipeline's ability to capture phenological features from SAR. On the SICKLE benchmark, our final model achieves 84.9% IoU on crop type mapping, outperforming optical baselines (by 15.3 pt) and existing SAR baselines (by 2.2 pt), demonstrating the effectiveness of our proposed pipeline for pretraining SAR intensity encoders for agricultural monitoring.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个专门使用SAR强度图像的自监督学习流程用于农业监测，通过掩蔽和课程学习改进时间预文本任务，以从SAR中捕捉物候特征。在SICKLE基准上，作物类型映射达到84.9% IoU，超过光学基线15.3个百分点、现有SAR基线2.2个百分点。
Motivation: 农业监测受复杂时空、物候和气候动态影响，现有SAR表示学习要么依赖光学图像锚定（如多模态基础模型），要么聚焦于目标检测、洪水制图等非农业任务，缺乏专门针对农业应用的SAR强度自监督方法。
Method: 提出仅使用SAR强度图像的自监督预训练流水线，通过掩蔽（masking）与课程学习（curriculum learning）改进受物候启发的时间预文本任务（temporal pretext tasks），增强预训练对SAR物候特征的学习。
Result: 在SICKLE基准上，最终模型在作物类型映射上取得84.9% IoU，比光学基线高15.3个百分点，比现有SAR基线高2.2个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该自监督预训练流程能让SAR强度编码器有效捕捉物候特征，从而支持农业监测任务。

papers.title: Goodness-of-Fit Tests and Calibration Machine-Learning Algorithms for Logistic Regression with Sparse Data
papers.abstract_en: Assessing the goodness-of-fit of a logistic regression model is a critical prerequisite before the model is used for inference. However, goodness-of-fit (GOF) tests such as the chi-square and deviance tests often give invalid results when the data are "sparse" -- a common issue with continuous predictors like age or weight, where the asymptotic distributional assumptions are not satisfied. This thesis studies classical GOF tests for binary logistic regression under both grouped and sparse data, comparing about 30 statistical tests and machine-learning calibration algorithms. These span the classical chi-square and Hosmer-Lemeshow variants, standardized Pearson statistics, covariate-space partitioning, smoothing-based methods, and contemporary calibration machine-learning and bootstrap procedures. At a fixed size, the GiViTI calibration test (2016), McCullagh (1989), Osius-Rojek (1992), le Cessie (1995) and Stute-Zhu (2002) proved empirically powerful, balancing correct identification of bad models (high empirical power) against not raising false alarms on good models (correct empirical Type I error). Relying on formal methods alone is insufficient: visual diagnostics such as calibration plots are a vital exploratory step for detecting model deficiencies that formal tests often overlook. An application to real data (the Low Birth Weight dataset) shows that many of these tests fail to give valid conclusions when exposed to the complexities of actual datasets. The main conclusion is that model assessment requires a combination of several powerful statistical tests alongside careful visual inspection of model calibration.
papers.comment: M.Sc. thesis, Alexandria University, 2026. 176 pages. Supervisors: Prof. Osama Abd El-Aziz Hussein and Dr. Ahmed El-Kotory. Tests implemented in the open-source R package ebrahim.gof (CRAN)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是亚历山大大学的硕士论文，系统研究二值 logistic 回归在稀疏数据 (sparse data) 下的拟合优度检验问题。作者比较了约 30 种经典统计检验与机器学习校准算法，包括卡方、Hosmer-Lemeshow 变体、标准化 Pearson 统计量、协变量空间划分、平滑方法以及校准机器学习与 bootstrap 程序。摘要报告 GiViTI 校准检验 (2016)、McCullagh (1989)、Osius-Rojek (1992)、le Cessie (1995) 和 Stute-Zhu (2002) 在固定显著性水平下经验功效最高，并强调单独依赖正式检验不够，校准图等可视化诊断不可或缺。
Motivation: logistic 回归用于推断前必须先评估拟合优度，但卡方和偏差检验等经典 GOF 检验在数据稀疏（如连续预测变量年龄、体重）时渐近分布假设不成立，常给出无效结果。
Method: 在分组数据和稀疏数据两种场景下，对经典 GOF 检验与机器学习校准算法进行系统的经验比较，覆盖约 30 种方法，并将相关检验实现于开源 R 包 ebrahim.gof (CRAN)。
Result: 在固定检验水平下，GiViTI 校准检验、McCullagh、Osius-Rojek、le Cessie 和 Stute-Zhu 检验同时具备较高的经验功效和正确的经验第一类错误率；对 Low Birth Weight 真实数据的应用显示，许多检验在真实数据复杂度下无法给出有效结论，可视化校准图能发现正式检验遗漏的模型缺陷。
Conclusion: 作者强调模型评估需要组合多种有功效的统计检验，并配合对模型校准的仔细视觉检查，单一正式方法不足以可靠评估稀疏数据下的 logistic 回归。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Attention-Path Fragility as an Uncertainty Signal in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: We propose that a model's uncertainty about a token is reflected not only in the breadth of its output distribution but also in whether a confident prediction is \emph{fragile} under perturbation of its attention pathways. We instantiate this as ASMI (Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information), a training-free estimator that masks attention heads and measures the BALD mutual information among the resulting subnetworks, with a semantic-agreement kernel to discount surface-form disagreement. The signal is not a restatement of output confidence: on grounded QA an out-of-fold test shows it adds error-predictive information beyond single-pass confidence and entropy, concentrated in \emph{confident-but-fragile} predictions, where acting on it roughly halves the retained error of a confidence filter. The distinctness is regime-graded, so ASMI predicts its own domain of applicability, strong where answers are routed through provided context and bounded by design where they are recalled from parametric knowledge. Sem-ASMI reads the signal from a single greedy response, without the stochastic generations the strongest baselines require, and ties or beats Semantic Entropy on ten of the twelve grounded benchmark-backbone settings. Across the same twelve settings, the best ASMI variant, typically the adaptive one reusing the ten samples already drawn for the baselines, ties or leads the strongest baseline in eight, significantly in three under a paired test. On parametric QA all variants revert to or below the zero-cost MSP baseline, exactly as predicted, and the estimates are near-deterministic across reruns. A head-level analysis shows that what tracks this boundary is not the presence of head-level fragility but whether that fragility couples to errors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将模型对某个 token 的不确定性不仅看作输出分布的宽窄，也看作其自信预测在注意力通路扰动下是否脆弱。作者实例化为 ASMI（Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information），一种无需训练的估计器：对注意力头做掩码，并度量所得子网络间的 BALD 互信息，同时用语义一致性核（semantic-agreement kernel）淡化表面形式分歧。在 grounded QA 上，该信号在单次置信度与熵之外提供额外错误预测信息，集中于自信但脆弱（confident-but-fragile）的预测，并在此类预测上大致将置信度过滤器的保留错误减半。
Motivation: 现有不确定性估计主要依赖输出分布的统计量，但模型可能以高置信度产生错误预测，这种置信度本身并未暴露其脆弱性；本文试图用注意力通路扰动来捕捉这类置信度之外的不确定信号。
Method: 提出 ASMI：随机掩码注意力头形成若干子网络，计算这些子网络输出之间的 BALD 互信息，并用语义一致性核来忽略表面形式差异；Sem-ASMI 变体则从单次贪心解码响应中读取该信号，无需多轮随机生成。
Result: 在 grounded QA 的 out-of-fold 测试中，ASMI 在单次置信度和熵之外增加错误预测信息，集中作用于 confident-but-fragile 预测，并使置信度过滤器的保留错误大致减半；Sem-ASMI 在十二个 grounded 基准-骨干设置中的十个上持平或超过 Semantic Entropy，最佳 ASMI 变体在八个设置上持平或领先最强基线、其中三个显著领先；在 parametric QA 上所有变体如预期回落到零成本的 MSP 基线之下或持平。
Conclusion: 该信号的适用性随机制呈现分级：在答案依赖给定上下文路由时表现强，在答案来自参数化知识回忆时受设计限制，因此 ASMI 能预测自身适用域；头部级分析显示真正关联误差边界的是脆弱性是否与错误耦合，而非头部级脆弱性本身的存在。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: sLTN: Structural Logic Tensor Networks
papers.abstract_en: Logic Tensor Networks (LTN) provide a neurosymbolic framework in which first-order logic is interpreted through tensor operations, enabling logical constraints to be integrated with differentiable learning. However, the original formulation of LTN is primarily suited to data represented as flat collections of individuals, and does not explicitly capture structural organization such as temporal order, sequential position, or graph connectivity. We introduce sLTN, an extension of LTN that makes structural dimensions first-class elements of the language. Structural dimensions represent named tensor axes associated with domain-specific organization, such as time steps, sequence positions, or graph nodes. They can be quantified explicitly, related through structural relations, and used to express temporal, sequential, and relational constraints directly at the logical level. We formalize the syntax and fuzzy tensor semantics of sLTN and show that, in the absence of structural dimensions, the framework recovers the original LTN semantics as a special case. We further describe a PyTorch implementation based on a declarative signature, formula parsing, and tensorial interpretation. The framework is illustrated on representative temporal and sequential reasoning examples. This paper serves as a companion to the sltn library, available at https://github.com/logictensornetworks/sltn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 sLTN（structural Logic Tensor Networks），扩展逻辑张量网络（LTN）使结构维度成为语言中的一等公民。结构维度是命名张量轴，可表示时间步、序列位置或图节点，并能在逻辑层直接表达时序、序列与关系约束。作者形式化了 sLTN 的语法与模糊张量语义，证明无结构维度时退化为原始 LTN，并给出基于 PyTorch 的声明式实现与示例。
Motivation: 原始 LTN 将数据表示为扁平个体集合，无法显式刻画时间顺序、序列位置或图连接等结构组织，限制了其在时序、序列和关系推理上的表达能力。
Method: sLTN 引入结构维度作为命名张量轴，支持显式量化、结构关系以及逻辑层的时序/序列/关系约束；同时形式化其语法和模糊张量语义，并基于声明式 signature、公式解析与张量解释实现 PyTorch 版本。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验结果；其主要形式化结果是：在不存在结构维度时，sLTN 语义可恢复为原始 LTN 语义的特例，并通过代表性的时序与序列推理示例进行说明。
Conclusion: 本文是 sltn 开源库的配套论文，主张将结构维度纳入逻辑层可直接表达时序、序列和关系约束；其范围限于框架形式化与示例演示，未涉及大规模实验评估。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文是 sltn 开源库的配套论文，主张将结构维度纳入逻辑层可直接表达时序、序列和关系约束；其范围限于框架形式化与示例演示，未涉及大规模实验评估。

papers.title: Is There Really a Camouflaged Object? Towards Realistic Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that are visually concealed in their surroundings and has attracted increasing attention in recent years. However, most existing COD methods are developed under a closed-world assumption, where each input image is assumed to contain a camouflaged object. This assumption ignores realistic scenarios with pure backgrounds or non-camouflaged objects, causing existing models to produce severe false positives when deployed in open-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose OPC16K, a large-scale benchmark for realistic COD. OPC16K contains 16,245 images from 14 sources and is carefully organized into camouflaged-object images, pure background images, and non-camouflaged-object images, enabling comprehensive evaluation of both segmentation quality and negative-sample rejection. Based on this benchmark, we further propose OPCNet, a presence-aware camouflage network that reformulates COD from a pure segmentation task into a joint problem of object localization and camouflage existence reasoning. Specifically, OPCNet introduces hierarchical existence reasoning to distinguish CO, BG, and NOCOD scenarios, similarity-aware camouflage relation modeling to capture foreground-background camouflage cues, and existence-aware feature refinement to regulate segmentation features with existence predictions. Extensive experiments on OPC16K demonstrate that OPCNet achieves superior performance under the proposed realistic COD evaluation protocol, significantly reducing false positives on negative samples while maintaining accurate camouflaged-object segmentation. Code and dataset will be released at https://github.com/2231122/OPCOD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对伪装目标检测（COD）中的封闭世界假设问题，提出大规模真实场景基准 OPC16K，包含 16,245 张来自 14 个来源的图像，并划分为伪装目标、纯背景和非伪装目标三类，用于同时评估分割质量与负样本拒绝能力。作者进一步提出 OPCNet，将 COD 从纯分割任务重构为目标定位与伪装存在性推理的联合问题，引入分层存在性推理、相似性感知伪装关系建模和存在性感知特征细化。实验表明 OPCNet 在 OPC16K 上显著降低负样本上的误检，同时保持准确的伪装目标分割。
Motivation: 现有 COD 方法多基于封闭世界假设，默认每张输入图像都含有伪装目标，忽略了真实场景中可能存在纯背景或非伪装目标，导致开放环境下部署时产生严重误检（false positives）。
Method: 提出 OPC16K 基准和 OPCNet 网络。OPCNet 将 COD 重构为联合目标定位与伪装存在性推理问题，包含分层存在性推理以区分 CO、BG 和 NOCOD 场景，相似性感知伪装关系建模以捕捉前景-背景伪装线索，以及存在性感知特征细化以用存在性预测调节分割特征。
Result: 在 OPC16K 上的大量实验表明，OPCNet 在提出的真实 COD 评估协议下取得优越性能，显著减少负样本上的误检，同时保持准确的伪装目标分割。
Conclusion: 作者强调基准与代码将公开（https://github.com/2231122/OPCOD），并认为该工作推动 COD 向真实开放场景评估迈进。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Posterior contraction rates in Sobolev norms and Bayesian derivative estimation for infinite-dimensional exponential families
papers.abstract_en: We study posterior contraction in positive-order Sobolev norms and Bayesian derivative estimation for infinite-dimensional exponential families. We embed the natural parameter in a Hilbert scale and model it via a standard Gaussian series prior expanded in the eigenbasis generating the scale. Under a two-sided link condition on the Fisher information and suitable local regularity assumptions, we show that smoothness-matching priors achieve minimax-optimal posterior contraction rates in any Hilbert scale norm up to the regularity of the ground truth. Our analysis builds on the novel approach to posterior contraction based on the Wasserstein distance recently introduced by Dolera et al. (2024). It combines refined Laplace-type estimates for infinite-dimensional integrals associated to the posterior kernels with a mixed-geometry estimate controlling their stability under fluctuations in the data, itself resting on a tailored Poincaré inequality for posterior distributions conditioned on neighbourhoods of the truth. We apply the general theory to density estimation with a logistic parametrisation, Poisson intensity estimation with an exponential link, and the Gaussian white-noise model, yielding minimax contraction rates in Sobolev norms across all three settings. In particular, these yield optimal recovery of density score functions and derivatives of Poisson intensities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究无限维指数族 (infinite-dimensional exponential families) 中正阶 Sobolev 范数下的后验收缩 (posterior contraction) 与贝叶斯导数估计。作者将自然参数嵌入 Hilbert 尺度 (Hilbert scale)，用该尺度特征基展开的高斯级数先验建模，并在 Fisher 信息的双侧链接条件与局部正则性假设下证明光滑度匹配先验可在任意不超过真值正则性的 Hilbert 尺度范数中获得极小极大最优后验收缩率。理论被应用于逻辑斯蒂参数化的密度估计、指数链接的 Poisson 强度估计和高斯白噪声模型，得到 Sobolev 范数下的极小极大收缩率。
Motivation: 标准后验收缩结果常局限于预测或较弱范数，而密度得分函数、Poisson 强度导数等目标要求在更强范数下估计；本文填补了无限维指数族中正阶 Sobolev 范数及导数估计后验理论的研究空白。
Method: 将自然参数嵌入 Hilbert 尺度并用生成该尺度的特征基展开的高斯级数先验建模；分析基于 Dolera et al. (2024) 引入的 Wasserstein 距离后验收缩框架，结合后验核相关无限维积分的 Laplace 型估计，以及控制数据波动下稳定性的混合几何估计，后者依赖对真值邻域上条件后验分布的 Poincaré 不等式。
Result: 在 Fisher 信息双侧链接条件与局部正则假设下，光滑度匹配先验在任意不超过真值正则性的 Hilbert 尺度范数中获得极小极大最优后验收缩率；在逻辑斯蒂密度估计、指数链接 Poisson 强度估计和高斯白噪声模型三种设定下均得到 Sobolev 范数极小极大收缩率，包括密度得分函数与 Poisson 强度导数的最优恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为该理论框架能够在多种指数族模型中得到强 Sobolev 范数下最优后验收缩及导数估计，其有效性依赖 Fisher 信息的双侧链接条件与局部正则性假设。

papers.title: AlbumentationsX: One Augmentation Pipeline for Images and Related Annotations
papers.abstract_en: Augmentation can corrupt a training example when an image and its annotations receive different random changes. A crop must use the same coordinates for the image, mask, boxes, keypoints, stereo views, video frames, or volume. Code paths that choose these values separately can silently misalign the data. AlbumentationsX keeps the transform list, probabilities, annotation settings, and random seed in one Compose object. Each call chooses random values once and applies them to every supported part of the training example. The library keeps each object's mask, box, and label together and lets projects add their own transforms. It can also save the pipeline definition, show what happened in one call, and run that call again. The examples place Compose after files have been decoded into arrays and before PyTorch groups examples into a batch. AlbumentationsX executes the declared transforms. Practitioners still decide whether a flip, crop, color change, or other operation preserves the correct label for their task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AlbumentationsX，一个为图像及其多种注释（mask、box、keypoint、立体视图、视频帧、体积）提供统一增强管线的库。其核心设计是将变换列表、概率、注释设置和随机种子放在同一个 Compose 对象中，使每次调用只生成一次随机值并统一应用于所有数据部分，避免因图像与注释分别随机变换导致的错位。库还支持保存管线定义、可视化单次调用并复现该次调用。
Motivation: 图像增强时若图像与注释分别应用不同的随机变换，会导致裁剪等操作中的坐标不一致，进而静默破坏训练数据；现有代码路径可能分开选择这些值，增加隐性错位风险。
Method: AlbumentationsX 将变换列表、概率、注释设置和随机种子统一封装在单个 Compose 对象中；每次调用只随机选择一次并将结果应用于训练示例的所有支持部分，同时保持每个对象的 mask、box 和 label 绑定，并允许项目自定义变换。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准评测，主要描述库的功能特性：统一随机值、支持多种注释类型、可保存管线定义、可视化单次调用并复现。
Conclusion: AlbumentationsX 负责执行声明的变换，但变换（如翻转、裁剪、颜色变化）是否保留正确标签仍由实践者根据任务自行判断。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Two-stage Odd Residual Flows for Mean-Preserving Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic forecasting plays an essential role in risk-sensitive decision-making, particularly in long-horizon settings. However, existing approaches often face a fundamental trade-off between distributional flexibility and accurate mean prediction. Traditional parametric methods, such as Mean Variance Estimation (MVE), can suffer from degraded point accuracy when trained under joint Negative Log-Likelihood (NLL) objectives, while modern-flexible generative models, including Normalizing Flows and Diffusion Models, typically rely on costly Monte Carlo sampling and may yield suboptimal mean estimates. To address this limitation, we propose Two-stage Odd Residual Flows (TORF), a framework that decouples mean forecasting from uncertainty estimation. In the first stage, a pre-trained deterministic model is used to produce an accurate mean prediction. In the second stage, a Restricted Normalizing Flow, with strictly odd functions learns flexible residual distributions around the point forecast, guaranteeing mean preservation from the first stage without sampling. Experiments show that TORF achieves state-of-the-art deterministic accuracy (NMAE) while providing strong density estimation performance (CRPS) on short and long-horizon forecasting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Two-stage Odd Residual Flows (TORF)，一种将均值预测与不确定性估计解耦的概率时间序列预测框架。第一阶段用预训练的确定性模型生成准确点预测，第二阶段用由严格奇函数构成的受限规范化流 (Restricted Normalizing Flow) 学习点预测周围的残差分布，在无需采样的前提下保证均值保持。实验表明 TORF 在短时域和长时域预测上同时取得先进的确定性精度 (NMAE) 和较强的密度估计性能 (CRPS)。
Motivation: 现有概率预测方法在分布灵活性与均值准确度之间存在权衡：MVE 等参数方法在联合 NLL 训练下点预测精度会下降，而 Normalizing Flows、Diffusion Models 等生成式方法依赖昂贵的 Monte Carlo 采样且均值估计次优。
Method: 提出两阶段框架 TORF：第一阶段使用预训练的确定性模型获得准确均值预测；第二阶段使用由严格奇函数构建的受限规范化流，对点预测周围的残差分布建模，从结构上保证均值保持，且无需采样。
Result: 摘要报告 TORF 在短时域与长时域预测上实现了 state-of-the-art 的确定性精度 (NMAE)，同时在密度估计 (CRPS) 上表现强；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将均值预测与不确定性估计解耦、并用奇函数约束的流模型，可以在避免采样开销的同时获得准确点预测与灵活残差分布；摘要未明确讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 28

papers.title: Every Packet Counts: Dispersing Information for Loss-Resilient Learned Image Compression
authors: Guo Lu (1) ((1) Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.abstract_en: Learned image compression (LIC) has achieved impressive rate-distortion performance. However, existing methods remain highly vulnerable to packet loss, a common challenge in satellite and emergency communications. This vulnerability stems from non-uniform information distribution at the packetization stage and sequential decoding dependencies at the entropy coding stage. We propose an end-to-end loss-resilient image compression scheme that addresses both. Before packetization, we introduce an Inter-Channel Redistribution (ICR) mechanism to redistribute channel energy, preventing critical information concentrating in a small subset of channels. Then, an Interleaved Channel Grouping (ICG) strategy partitions latent channels in a strided manner to disperse information across packets, with each packet kept within constrained sizes. To limit cascading errors from lost packets, we adopt a two-layer dual-branch autoregressive structure to shorten the dependency chain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing approaches in both reconstruction quality and stability. At 20% packet loss, it achieves an average PSNR gain of 1.84 dB over LossResilientLIC while reducing PSNR variance by an order of magnitude. Notably, trained under uniform random loss only, our model generalizes to bursty loss modeled by the Gilbert-Elliott channel, outperforming methods explicitly trained for such conditions.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 12 figures, 8 tables. Joint first authors: Yuhang Wei and Chuqin Zhou. Corresponding author: Guo Lu. To appear in Proceedings of the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM '26), November 10-14, 2026, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对学习图像压缩（LIC）在卫星和应急通信中易受数据包丢失影响的问题，提出端到端的抗丢包压缩方案。方法包括打包前的通道间重分布（ICR）、跨通道分组的交错分组（ICG）策略，以及两层双分支自回归结构来缩短解码依赖链。实验显示在20%丢包率下平均PSNR比LossResilientLIC高1.84 dB，PSNR方差降低一个数量级，并且仅在均匀随机丢包下训练的模型能泛化到Gilbert-Elliott信道建模的突发丢包。
Motivation: 现有学习图像压缩方法在丢包场景下性能脆弱，原因是打包阶段信息分布不均匀和熵编码阶段的顺序解码依赖；这在卫星与应急通信中是常见问题。
Method: 提出端到端抗丢包图像压缩方案：打包前用Inter-Channel Redistribution (ICR)重分配通道能量，避免关键信息集中于少数通道；用Interleaved Channel Grouping (ICG)以跨步方式划分潜在通道并将信息分散到多个受限大小的数据包中；采用两层双分支自回归结构缩短依赖链以限制丢包引起的级联错误。
Result: 在20%丢包率下，方法相对LossResilientLIC取得平均1.84 dB的PSNR增益，并将PSNR方差降低约一个数量级；仅在均匀随机丢包下训练即可泛化到Gilbert-Elliott信道突发丢包，且优于专门针对该条件训练的方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过信息分散和缩短解码依赖链可以同时提升丢包下的重建质量与稳定性，并展现出对突发丢包的泛化能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Why Does CLAUDE.md Keep Growing? Catastrophic Remembering in Agentic Coding
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding READMEs like CLAUDE.md grow without bound in real repositories, stopping only when the repository retires or someone rewrites the file wholesale. We trace this to imperfect recall: appending an instruction is always cheap, but once an instruction's rationale is gone, deleting it without risking a correctness regression costs O(2^|D|) in a prompt of |D| instructions. We name the resulting divergence catastrophic remembering, the inverse of catastrophic forgetting around which continual learning is organized. First, we characterize this phenomenon across 247,694 instruction lifetimes in 1,867 repositories: agentic prompts grow without bound, more than tripling over their lifetime (+226%), gaining +4.9 net instructions every commit; further, the older an instruction gets, the less likely it is to be deleted (log-hazard -0.032/commit). Then, we show that prompt comments can halt the growth: inverting IFEval yields verifiable worlds whose optimal prompts are known, and there comments encoding latent reasoning remove 99.3% of excess instructions (+211.3% to +1.4%). Finally, applying the same inversion to WildIFEval, we show that prompt comments can improve real-world agentic instruction-following by up to 23.1%. If English is the new code, why don't we have comments yet?
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 agentic coding 中提示文件（如 CLAUDE.md）的无界增长现象，并将其命名为“灾难性记住”(catastrophic remembering)。基于 1,867 个仓库中的 247,694 条指令生命周期，作者发现提示会随生命周期增长超过两倍（+226%），每次提交净增 4.9 条指令，且旧指令越来越难被删除。作者进一步证明，在提示中加入编码潜在推理的注释可以阻止增长，并在真实 agentic 指令跟随任务上带来最高 23.1% 的改进。
Motivation: 追加一条指令总是廉价，但一旦指令背后的 rationale 丢失，删除它需要检查 O(2^|D|) 种组合，导致指令不断累积；这种与持续学习中灾难性遗忘相反的发散现象缺乏系统性刻画。
Method: 先对指令生命周期做大规模统计刻画；随后通过反转 IFEval 构造“可验证世界”，在其中加入编码潜在推理 (latent reasoning) 的注释来移除多余指令；再将同一反转方法用于 WildIFEval 验证真实场景效果。
Result: 摘要报告 agentic prompts 无界增长，生命周期内平均 +226%，每 commit 净增 4.9 条指令，删除 hazard 的 log-hazard 为 -0.032/commit；注释将多余指令减少 99.3%（从 +211.3% 降至 +1.4%），并在 WildIFEval 上提升真实指令跟随最多 23.1%。
Conclusion: 作者认为提示文件需要像代码注释一样的抽象机制来阻止无界增长，并反问“如果英语是新的代码，为什么还没有注释？”强调保留指令 rationale 的注释是缓解灾难性记住的关键。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-View Feature Matching: Survey, Benchmarking, and Foundation-Model Perspectives
papers.abstract_en: Cross-view feature matching aims to establish reliable correspondences across images with large viewpoint variations. Over the past decade, the field has evolved from task-specific models toward increasingly unified and generalizable correspondence models, with recent progress further driven by the emergence of vision foundation models (VFMs). Despite these advances, existing studies remain highly diverse in their problem formulations, model architectures, training paradigms, and evaluation protocols, making it difficult to obtain a unified understanding of the field. In this survey, we present a unified review of cross-view feature matching. We first introduce a structured taxonomy covering feature extraction, single-type feature matcher, multi-type feature matcher, VFMs based methods, training strategy and robust estimation, providing a coherent framework for analysis and comparison. We further examine recent advances, distilling key design principles and highlighting the shift toward unified and generalizable correspondence models. We also provide a unified experimental benchmarking of representative state-of-the-art methods under consistent protocols, enabling fair and comprehensive performance comparisons. In addition, we discuss open challenges and future directions, including efficiency, robustness under extreme conditions, and cross-domain generalization. This survey aims to provide a comprehensive and structured reference for understanding the evolution, current landscape, and future development of cross-view feature matching in the era of vision foundation models.
papers.comment: This manuscript goes beyond a conventional survey. It proposes a new taxonomy for cross-view feature matching, provides extensive benchmarking under unified datasets and protocols, and offers original analysis from the perspective of vision foundation models. These contributions provide substantive methodological synthesis, empirical findings, and new research insights
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于跨视角特征匹配 (cross-view feature matching) 的综述，提出新的分类体系，并在统一数据集与协议下对代表性方法进行基准测试，同时从视觉基础模型 (VFM) 视角给出原创分析。文章梳理了从任务特定模型向统一、可泛化对应模型的转变，并总结了关键设计原则与开放挑战。
Motivation: 跨视角特征匹配领域在问题定义、模型架构、训练范式和评估协议上高度分散，导致难以形成对该领域的统一理解。作者希望弥合这一差距，提供一个连贯的分析与比较框架。
Method: 提出结构化分类法，覆盖特征提取、单一类型特征匹配器、多类型特征匹配器、基于视觉基础模型的方法、训练策略和鲁棒估计；并在一致协议下对代表性最先进方法进行统一实验基准测试，同时提炼关键设计原则。
Result: 在统一基准下给出了代表性方法的公平、全面性能比较，并指出领域正转向统一且可泛化的对应模型；开放挑战包括效率、极端条件下的鲁棒性以及跨域泛化。
Conclusion: 该综述旨在为视觉基础模型时代的跨视角特征匹配提供涵盖演进、现状与未来发展的结构化参考，内容超出常规综述，包含方法综合、实证发现与新的研究见解。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Systematic Sample Size Analysis of ML-Based Path Loss Prediction for LPWAN
papers.abstract_en: Low Power Wide Area Networks like LoRa are increasingly deployed for smart city applications, requiring accurate path loss prediction for effective network planning. Traditional (empirical) propagation models often exhibit limited accuracy in these scenarios. We investigate machine learning models for LoRa path loss prediction, systematically analyzing how prediction accuracy scales with training set size using real-world measurements from an urban deployment. Our approach employs a Random Forest with LiDAR-derived terrain features and k-Nearest Neighbors with coordinate data, comparing their performance against established empirical models and specialized LPWAN models. Under random pooled splits, both ML models consistently outperform the considered baseline models across the evaluated training-set sizes. At maximum training size, they achieve RMSE values below 6.5 dB compared to 9.7 dB for the best baseline, indicating accurate within-deployment interpolation. A leave-one-gateway-out check qualifies this result: RF shows placement-dependent transfer to held-out gateways, with moderate degradation for several gateways but larger errors for others, whereas coordinate-only k-NN degrades substantially when the gateway location is unseen
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Conference on Local Computer Networks (LCN)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LPWAN（如 LoRa）网络规划中的路径损耗预测问题，基于城市真实测量数据，系统分析了机器学习模型的预测精度如何随训练集规模变化。研究采用基于 LiDAR 地形特征的 Random Forest 和基于坐标数据的 k-Nearest Neighbors，与经验模型及专门 LPWAN 模型对比，并在随机池化划分和留一网关两种评估下检验性能。摘要报告 ML 模型在最大训练规模下 RMSE 低于 6.5 dB，优于最佳基线（9.7 dB），但留一网关检验显示 RF 存在与位置相关的迁移差异，纯坐标 k-NN 在网关位置未见时显著退化。
Motivation: LoRa 等低功耗广域网在智慧城市中部署日益增多，网络规划需要准确的路径损耗预测，而传统经验传播模型在此类场景中精度有限，因此需要探索机器学习方法并理解训练数据规模对预测能力的影响。
Method: 采用 Random Forest 结合 LiDAR 衍生的地形特征，以及 k-Nearest Neighbors 使用坐标数据，在真实城市部署测量数据上系统比较不同训练集规模下的预测精度，并以随机池化划分和 leave-one-gateway-out 两种评估协议检验模型性能。
Result: 在随机池化划分下，两种 ML 模型在所有训练规模上均优于所考虑的经验基线模型；最大训练规模时 ML 模型 RMSE 低于 6.5 dB，而最佳基线为 9.7 dB，表明能精确进行部署内插值。留一网关检验显示 Random Forest 对未见网关的迁移具有位置依赖性，部分网关中等退化、部分误差更大，而仅含坐标的 k-NN 在网关位置未见时大幅退化。
Conclusion: 机器学习模型能在训练数据覆盖范围内显著优于传统经验模型，但对外推至未见过网关的能力有限，尤其是仅依赖坐标的模型，说明路径损耗预测的泛化性受部署环境影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RTSKG: Building a Rail Transit Station Knowledge Graph Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Rail transit systems play a vital role in urban mobility and economic development. As key components of such systems, rail transit stations function as critical transport hubs that enhance urban accessibility and stimulate development in surrounding areas. City-level rail transit station related tasks (e.g., ridership prediction) require large-scale urban data, but current studies often neglect complex interactions among various urban entities in terms of data organization. In this paper, to address the above issue, we build a Rail Transit Station Knowledge Graph (RTSKG) dataset which explicitly models the spatial and semantic interactions among different kinds of urban entities, to benefit city-level rail transit station related tasks. RTSKG integrates heterogeneous urban entities, such as rail transit stations, road segments, and points of interest, with a specially designed unified schema, and is accessible as Linked Data at https://w3id.org/rtskg/. Evaluations on station-area store recommendation and knowledge-enhanced ridership prediction demonstrate the effectiveness of RTSKG, highlighting its potential to support city-level rail transit station analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个轨道交通站点知识图谱数据集 RTSKG，显式建模城市实体（如轨道交通站点、道路段、兴趣点）之间的空间与语义交互，并以 Linked Data 形式发布。作者在站点周边商店推荐和知识增强的客流预测任务上评估了该数据集的有效性，表明其可支持城市级轨道交通站点分析。
Motivation: 城市级轨道交通站点相关任务（如客流预测）需要大规模城市数据，但现有研究在数据组织上往往忽略多种城市实体之间复杂的交互关系。
Method: 设计统一 schema 整合异构城市实体（轨道交通站点、道路段、兴趣点等），构建知识图谱 RTSKG 并以 Linked Data 形式在 https://w3id.org/rtskg/ 公开发布。
Result: 在站点周边商店推荐和知识增强的客流预测两项评估中验证了 RTSKG 的有效性，显示其支持城市级轨道交通站点分析的潜力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 RTSKG 通过显式建模实体交互，能为城市级轨道交通站点相关任务提供数据基础。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 在站点周边商店推荐和知识增强的客流预测两项评估中验证了 RTSKG 的有效性，显示其支持城市级轨道交通站点分析的潜力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调 RTSKG 通过显式建模实体交互，能为城市级轨道交通站点相关任务提供数据基础。

papers.title: SkillZip: Evaluation-Free Skill Compression for Self-Evolving Agents by Discovering Reusable Structure
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving agents accumulate reusable skills by appending successful procedures and failure fixes. Over time, the same requirement is often restated in several branches, examples, and warnings, while common action sequences are copied rather than reused. The resulting skill becomes expensive to inject and difficult to maintain. Generic prompt compression is ill-suited to this setting because a skill is not a flat passage: its name and description define when it applies, its workflow controls execution, its tool and output contracts constrain validity, and rare exceptions may remain essential even when no sampled task activates them. Evaluation-guided compression can test these behaviors, but it introduces rollouts, cost, and dependence on the compression-time evaluation set. We present SkillZip, an evaluation-free method that compresses a skill by finding its shortest faithful structural explanation. The intuition is explain once, reference many: state a repeated rule once at the scope where it applies, factor a repeated action sequence into a shared procedure, and keep only the differences as explicit exceptions. We formalize this intuition as a typed minimum description-length objective over a skill contract and a residual, subject to a hard coverage constraint for every extracted trigger, workflow edge, tool requirement, obligation, and output field. The formulation provides simple sharing thresholds, preserves unique rare rules by construction, and supports efficient local updates. SkillZip has a one-shot mode with one structured extraction call and deterministic optimization, and a continual Zip-on-Write mode that integrates each self-evolution patch without replaying tasks or reparsing the full history. Through comprehensive experimental evaluations, we demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of SkillZip in compression performance, generalizability, and cost overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SkillZip 提出一种免评估 (evaluation-free) 的技能压缩方法，针对自进化智能体 (self-evolving agents) 因不断追加成功流程和失败修复而积累大量重复规则、复制序列的技能冗余问题。该方法将压缩形式化为带类型的最小描述长度目标，在技能契约 (skill contract) 与残差 (residual) 之间寻找最短的忠实结构解释，并提供 one-shot 与持续的 Zip-on-Write 两种模式。综合实验显示 SkillZip 在压缩性能、泛化性和成本开销上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 自进化智能体反复追加成功过程和失败修复后，同一需求常在多个分支、示例和警告中重复表述，公共动作序列被复制而非复用，使技能注入昂贵且难以维护。通用提示压缩不适用，因为技能并非平铺文本；评估引导压缩虽可测试行为，却引入 rollout、成本和压缩时评估集的依赖。
Method: 将技能压缩问题建模为带类型的 minimum description-length 目标，包含技能契约和残差两部分，并对每个抽取的触发条件、工作流边、工具需求、义务和输出字段施加硬覆盖约束。该方法提供 one-shot 模式（一次结构化抽取调用加确定性优化）和 continual Zip-on-Write 模式（无需重放任务或重新解析完整历史即可整合自进化补丁）。
Result: 摘要报告通过全面实验评估，SkillZip 在压缩性能、泛化性 (generalizability) 和成本开销方面表现出有效性和优越性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过“一次解释、多次引用”的结构发现，可以在不依赖评估集的情况下实现技能压缩，同时按构造保留稀有独特规则并支持高效的局部更新。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Gaussian Structure: Intervention-Guided Density Control for Feed-Forward Driving Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction has recently emerged as an efficient approach for driving scene reconstruction. However, prevailing LiDAR-based methods preserve the initial correspondence between observed points and Gaussian primitives, treating the initialized primitive set as the final representation. Unlike optimization-based 3DGS, these methods cannot accumulate gradients during training to determine how the scenes representation should be densified. Meanwhile, the shared sparse backbone only fuses observations from different timestamps implicitly, without explicitly aggregating cross-time evidence for individual primitives. In this paper, we present Learning Gaussian Structure (LGS), a framework that enhances both Gaussian structure and primitive attributes. Our key observation is that changes in local gradient responses induced by a prune or add intervention reveal whether the corresponding structural adjustment benefits reconstruction. Based on this observation, our Gaussian Densify Policy learns a Densify Map comprising Prune and Addition Scores from controlled interventions, and directly adjusts the Gaussian structure during inference. We further develop a compact Cross-Time Point Query that explicitly retrieves and aggregates neighboring features from Gaussian primitives at other timestamps for reliable attribute prediction. Extensive experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and PandaSet demonstrate that LGS consistently outperforms existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Learning Gaussian Structure (LGS) 框架，用于前馈驾驶场景重建 (feed-forward driving reconstruction)。其核心观察是，由剪枝或添加干预引起的局部梯度响应变化可以揭示相应结构调整是否有益，据此训练 Gaussian Densify Policy 以学习由 Prune 与 Addition Scores 构成的 Densify Map，并在推理时直接调整高斯结构。同时引入紧凑的 Cross-Time Point Query，显式检索并聚合其他时间戳上高斯原语的邻近特征以提升属性预测。在 Waymo Open Dataset 与 PandaSet 上的实验显示 LGS 持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有基于 LiDAR 的前馈高斯重建方法保留观测点与高斯原语 (Gaussian primitives) 的初始对应关系，把初始化原语集合当作最终表示，无法像优化式 3DGS 那样在训练中累积梯度来决定场景表示应当如何稠密化；此外共享稀疏主干只能隐式融合不同时间戳的观测，缺少对单个原语的跨时间证据显式聚合。
Method: 提出 LGS 框架：Gaussian Densify Policy 从受控的剪枝/添加干预中学习一张包含 Prune 和 Addition Scores 的 Densify Map，并在推理时直接调整高斯结构；另设计紧凑的 Cross-Time Point Query 模块，显式从其他时间戳的高斯原语中检索并聚合邻近特征，用于更可靠的属性预测。
Result: 摘要在 Waymo Open Dataset 与 PandaSet 上开展的大量实验表明，LGS 在重建质量上持续优于现有方法；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过干预引导的密度控制同时增强高斯结构与原语属性，能够改善前馈驾驶场景重建的效果。
