papers.title: Foundation Model-Enabled Efficient Data Sampling (FEEDS): A label-efficient training strategy for pan-cancer, multi-tracer PET/CT datasets
papers.abstract_en: Automated lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT imaging can assist clinicians with cancer detection, staging, and treatment planning across radiotracers and cancer types. However, training lesion segmentation models that capture variations in lesion size, distribution, and appearance requires large annotated datasets, whose creation is both time- and expertise-intensive. As a result, models trained on limited labeled PET/CT data often lack the accuracy and generalizability needed for clinical use. We present FEEDS (Foundation model-Enabled Efficient Data Sampling), a label- and compute-efficient learning strategy that uses vision foundation model embeddings to select the most informative and diverse unlabeled cases for expert annotation. Unlike unsupervised, semi-supervised, and active learning approaches, FEEDS is a one-step training paradigm requiring only a limited, representative training set, making it label- and compute-efficient. We train and validate FEEDS using the AutoPET-III dataset. We test its accuracy and generalizability on three held-out sets: AutoPET-III, DeepPSMA, and an internal Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center dataset. We evaluate clinical utility at the voxel, lesion, and anatomic region level to assess performance in high-risk areas and treatment planning utility. FEEDS outperforms random-sampling-based labeling, pseudolabel-based semi-supervised learning, and training with limited labeled data alone. It generalizes across all three test sets, FDG and PSMA tracers, and multiple diseases, matching fully-labeled (100\%) training performance with 70\% less annotation burden. FEEDS addresses the challenge of label scarcity in an automatic lesion segmentation framework by providing a practical approach for constructing representative and diverse annotation queues from large, unannotated clinical repositories.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FEEDS（Foundation model-Enabled Efficient Data Sampling），一种利用视觉基础模型嵌入从大型未标注 PET/CT 数据池中选择信息量最大且多样性最高的病例供专家标注的训练策略，用于泛癌、多示踪剂的全身病变分割。该方法在 AutoPET-III 上训练，并在 AutoPET-III、DeepPSMA 和内部 Dartmouth-Hitchcock 数据集上验证，声称相比随机采样、伪标签半监督等方法，能以 70% 更少的标注负担匹配全标注（100%）训练性能。
Motivation: 全身 PET/CT 病变分割模型的训练需要大量标注数据，而标注过程耗时且依赖专业知识，导致仅用有限标注训练的模型在准确性和泛化性上不足以支持临床使用。
Method: FEEDS 使用视觉基础模型嵌入来选择最具代表性和多样性的未标注病例用于专家标注，是一种一步式训练范式，不需要主动学习或半监督学习那样的迭代流程，因此标签和计算效率更高。
Result: 在三个保留测试集（AutoPET-III、DeepPSMA 和内部 Dartmouth-Hitchcock 数据集）上，FEEDS 优于随机采样标注、伪标签半监督方法以及仅用有限标注数据训练的方式，并在 FDG 和 PSMA 示踪剂及多种疾病上泛化，以 70% 更少的标注负担达到与全标注训练相当的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FEEDS 解决了自动病变分割中的标签稀缺问题，提供了一种从大型未标注临床数据存储库中构建代表性且多样化标注队列的实用方法。

papers.title: Static in Frames, Dynamic in Events: Rethinking Features in Event Cameras as Motion Cues
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras capture intensity changes asynchronously with high temporal resolution, requiring novel preprocessing methods for downstream tasks. Unlike static intensity snapshots, event data inherently encode information about scene dynamics and object motion, meaning that features derived from events can exhibit behaviors with no direct analogue in frame-based vision. In this paper, we analyze two features used in event-based corner detection---the eigenvalues of the structure tensor and the spatiotemporal density values---and show that they are \emph{motion cues}. We hypothesize that these features, combined with local geometric information, can enhance motion estimation tasks. To validate this, we first theoretically analyze how the eigenvalues of the structure tensor at moving corner points relate to the direction of motion. We then design controlled experiments on a synthetic dataset, confirming that extending local geometric features with eigenvalues and density values provides complementary motion information and is robust to texture and shot noise. Finally, we integrate the proposed features into a state-of-the-art event-based optical flow network and evaluate on the real-world DSEC benchmark, where the added features consistently improve accuracy, with the largest gains in data-scarce scenarios and for lower-capacity models. The code for this paper can be found at: \href{https://github.com/hesamaraghi/static-in-frames-dynamic-in-events}{https://github.com/hesamaraghi/static-in-frames-dynamic-in-events}.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视事件相机角点检测中的两个特征——结构张量的特征值和时空密度值，并论证它们本质上是运动线索（motion cues）而非纯粹的几何特征。作者先理论分析运动角点处特征值与运动方向的关系，再用合成数据实验验证这些特征与局部几何信息结合能提供互补的运动信息且对纹理和散粒噪声鲁棒。最后将特征集成到先进的事件光流网络中，在真实 DSEC 基准上持续提升精度，最大增益出现在数据稀缺和低容量模型场景。
Motivation: 事件相机异步捕捉强度变化并天然编码场景动态与物体运动，因此事件特征可能表现出帧基视觉中没有直接对应的行为。现有角点检测特征常被视为几何特征，作者认为需要将其重新理解为运动线索，以改善运动估计任务。
Method: 首先从理论上分析运动角点处结构张量特征值与运动方向的关系；然后在合成数据集上设计受控实验，验证将特征值和密度值扩展进局部几何特征的互补性与鲁棒性；最后将这些特征集成到当前最优的事件光流网络中，并在真实 DSEC 基准上进行评估。
Result: 合成实验确认扩展局部几何特征能够提供互补的运动信息，并对纹理和散粒噪声鲁棒；在 DSEC 基准上，加入特征一致地提高了光流估计精度，最大的提升出现在数据稀缺场景和较低容量模型中。
Conclusion: 作者主张事件特征应被当作运动线索使用，补充局部几何信息可增强运动估计任务；代码已公开发布。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CapProbe: Evaluating Detailed Image Captions via Full-Scene Dense Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Evaluating detailed image captions from Vision-Language Models (VLMs) requires going beyond surface-level semantic similarity. Reference-based metrics (e.g., CIDEr and SPICE) and LLM-as-scorer protocols struggle to verify dense factual claims, while existing QA-based alternatives generally offer lower probe density, narrower domain coverage, or no explicit alignment between individual questions and segmented image regions. We introduce CapProbe, a full-scene dense QA benchmark that turns detailed caption evaluation into region-aligned factual checking. Each image is decomposed into coarse semantic regions covering both foreground and background elements; for every retained region, we generate multiple-choice questions spanning 10 semantic categories, forming a dense checklist of probed visual facts. Guided by a two-tier taxonomy of 37 L1 domains and 219 L2 sub-domains, CapProbe comprises 346 images, 1,868 regions, and 25,650 questions, averaging 74 QA pairs per image. A language judge answers from the caption alone; an Uncertain option and Effective Accuracy provide a judge-dependent proxy for distinguishing unanswered probes from incorrectly resolved ones, while density-based metrics penalize verbose yet uninformative captions. The protocol is cost-effective: by converting unconstrained scalar scoring into structured MCQ reading, it reduces open-ended scoring bias while remaining judge-conditioned and yields relatively stable model rankings under a fixed reader. Experiments on 13 VLMs show large Coverage gaps across models, a clear competency-efficiency trade-off, and failure modes that sparse or overlap-based evaluation often misses. The benchmark data, annotations, and evaluation code will be released soon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CapProbe，一个全场景密集问答基准，用于评估视觉语言模型 (VLM) 生成的详细图像描述。它把图像分解为前景和背景的粗粒度语义区域，为每个区域生成覆盖 10 个语义类别的多选题，形成区域对齐的事实检查清单。基准由 346 张图像、1,868 个区域和 25,650 个问题组成，平均每张图像 74 个 QA 对，并采用语言裁判仅基于描述作答，配合 Uncertain 选项和 Effective Accuracy 来区分未作答与答错。
Motivation: 现有参考型指标 (如 CIDEr、SPICE) 和 LLM-as-scorer 协议难以验证密集事实主张，而基于 QA 的备选方案通常探针密度较低、领域覆盖较窄，且问题与图像区域之间没有显式对齐。
Method: CapProbe 将详细描述评估转化为区域对齐的事实核查：先将图像分解为语义区域，再基于 37 个 L1 域和 219 个 L2 子域的两级分类法生成多选题；语言裁判仅依据描述文本作答，并提供 Uncertain 选项，同时用密度相关指标惩罚冗长但无信息的描述。
Result: 在 13 个 VLM 上的实验显示模型间存在较大的 Coverage 差距、明显的能力-效率权衡，以及稀疏或基于重叠的评估常遗漏的失败模式。
Conclusion: 该协议将无约束的标量评分转换为结构化多选题阅读，降低了开放式评分偏差，同时保持裁判条件化，并在固定裁判下产生相对稳定的模型排名；基准数据、标注和评估代码将发布。

papers.title: Quantum Coordination Advantages in AI State-Tracking Tasks: Semantic Compilation and Latent Memory
papers.abstract_en: We prove inference-time quantum coordination advantages for specified AI state-tracking tasks. A solver compresses semantic history into a future-accessible boundary state and later answers a query. We count communication $B$, persistent instance-dependent memory $M$, and local work $D$; classical recurrence, caches, tools, and recomputation are allowed and charged. The central result is a boundary-preserving semantic-compilation theorem. It maps a finite one-way, streaming, or adaptive causal task into a semantic AI interface while preserving event order and access to past input. Classical boundary-state lower bounds and quantum-memory upper bounds transfer up to explicit compiler overhead, independently of the finite-precision recurrent architecture. Two applications have classical semantics. Matched-entity synopsis QA inherits the hidden-matching separation between $O(\log N)$ qubits and $Ω(\sqrt{N})$ classical boundary bits. Continual requirements auditing inherits a Max-$k$SAT streaming separation: a recurrent solver uses $O(\log^5 n\log(1/δ))$ qubits and polylogarithmic classical workspace to obtain a $0.7172$-approximation, whereas every classical one-pass finite-information solver attaining that ratio requires $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ coordination width. As a quantum-native compiler test, a stabilizer latent-state dialogue uses $n$ qubits, while every exact finite-state classical causal online realization satisfies $B+M \ge \frac{1}{2}n^2+(\frac{3}{2}-\log_2 3)n+O(1)$. The source protocols, streaming algorithms, and stabilizer witness are imported; the new result is their architecture-independent semantic transfer. These are memory and coordination separations, not runtime or empirical advantages for present-day language models. The stabilizer result assumes exact simulation and ideal noiseless quantum memory.
papers.comment: Comments and suggestions are welcome on alphaXiv
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出边界保持语义编译定理 (boundary-preserving semantic-compilation theorem)，把有限的一向、流式或自适应因果任务映射为语义 AI 接口，从而将经典边界态下界与量子记忆上界以显式编译开销迁移到 AI 状态跟踪任务上。三个实例中，匹配实体摘要问答继承 O(log N) 量子比特对 Ω(√N) 经典边界比特的隐藏匹配分离；持续需求审计继承 Max-kSAT 流式分离；稳定子隐态对话用 n 量子比特，而任何精确有限态经典因果在线实现的 B+M 有二次下界。作者强调这是记忆与协调的分离，而非现今日语言模型的运行时或经验优势，且稳定子结果依赖精确模拟和无噪声量子记忆。
Motivation: 现有量子优势结果多绑定特定协议或流算法，缺乏与具体有限精度循环架构无关的、面向 AI 状态跟踪任务的统一证明框架。
Method: 引入边界保持语义编译定理，将有限的一向、流式或自适应因果任务保序地编译为语义 AI 接口，保留对过去输入的访问，并使经典边界态下界和量子记忆上界按显式编译开销迁移。
Result: 摘要报告两个经典语义应用：匹配实体摘要问答继承 O(log N) 量子比特对 Ω(√N) 经典边界比特的分离；持续需求审计中循环求解器用 O(log^5 n log(1/δ)) 量子比特和多项式对数经典工作空间达到 0.7172 近似，而任何达到该比率的经典单遍有限信息求解器需要 Ω(√n) 协调宽度。稳定子隐态对话用 n 量子比特，经典精确实现的 B+M ≥ (1/2)n^2 + (3/2 − log_2 3)n + O(1)。
Conclusion: 作者把这些结果定位为与架构无关的语义迁移，属于记忆与协调分离而非运行时或经验优势；稳定子结果假设精确模拟与理想无噪声量子记忆。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Entropy-Centric Explainable AI for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) has become a powerful approach to solving complex problems in critical domains. Many concerns arise regarding the decision-making process of its models, mainly due to deep neural networks outperforming their peers at the cost of ambiguity in feature extraction and prediction. Consequently, in critical domains such as remote sensing, where high-resolution imagery must be analyzed using black-box models, the lack of transparency limits trust in these models and, thus, their adoption. In light of this reality, explaining and understanding the complex decision-making process of AI models has become essential. Explainable AI (XAI) aims to bridge this gap by providing insights into how and why certain decisions are made. While significant progress has been achieved in explaining image classification tasks, image segmentation still offers considerable room for improvement. In this context, this paper proposes an entropy-centric XAI method for semantic segmentation. Moreover, a new XAI evaluation methodology is proposed to efficiently measure the relevance of the regions highlighted by the proposed XAI method. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed XAI method compared with recently adapted XAI methods for semantic segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向遥感图像语义分割的可解释性，提出一种以熵为中心 (entropy-centric) 的 XAI 方法，并配套提出新的评估方法来度量该方法高亮区域的相关性。实验结果表明，该方法的性能优于近期被适配到语义分割任务的其他 XAI 方法。
Motivation: 遥感等关键领域使用黑盒深度模型分析高分辨率图像，其决策过程不透明，限制了信任与应用；图像分类的 XAI 已有较多进展，但图像分割的可解释性仍存在明显改进空间。
Method: 提出以熵为中心的 XAI 方法用于语义分割，并设计一套新的 XAI 评估方法来高效衡量被高亮区域的相关性 (relevance)。
Result: 摘要报告，与近期适配到语义分割的 XAI 方法相比，所提方法在实验上表现更优。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，所提以熵为中心的 XAI 方法及配套评估方法能够有效提升语义分割模型的可解释性，并优于现有适配方法。

papers.title: Batch Size or Negatives? A Selection Rule for Memory-Constrained Recommender Training
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale neural recommender systems are typically trained with a softmax cross-entropy objective over the full item vocabulary. For a typical large number of possible items $K$, the final classification layer dominates memory, requiring $O(nK)$ logits and gradients to materialize for a batch of $n$ examples. Sampled softmax reduces this cost by restricting the objective to only $k \ll K$ candidate negative items, resulting in an $O(nk)$ memory. However, for a fixed budget $B = n k$, it remains unclear whether one should prioritize larger batches or the inclusion of more negative items. We address this question by analyzing sampled-softmax training under a fixed memory constraint. Under standard smoothness and variance assumptions, our theoretical evidence suggests that the fastest convergence arises from an $ n \sim B, k \sim 1$ allocation. So, an actionable rule is to include as many objects as possible given computational constraints. Our theory is supported by controlled synthetic and synthetic and four real sequential recommendation benchmarks, including MovieLens-20M. The suggested configuration achieve faster convergence and better final recommendation quality than imbalanced alternatives within the same memory constraint. These findings provide a theoretical and empirical foundation for configuring memory during the training of recommender systems. Code, reproducibility materials, and all scripts for generating figures are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/LimitedMemoryRule-BBFB
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在固定显存约束下训练大规模神经推荐系统时，batch size 与负样本数量之间的配置权衡。作者分析 sampled softmax 训练在内存预算 B = nk 下的收敛行为，指出最优配置是尽可能扩大 batch size（n ~ B, k ~ 1），即在计算约束内包含尽量多的样本。理论分析在平滑性和方差假设下给出该结论，并用合成数据与四个真实序列推荐基准（含 MovieLens-20M）验证，发现该配置收敛更快且最终推荐质量更好。
Motivation: 大规模神经推荐系统常用基于全量物品词表的 softmax 交叉熵训练，最后的分类层主导显存开销（O(nK)）。Sampled softmax 通过只选取 k 个负样本将开销降到 O(nk)，但在固定预算 B = nk 下，应优先增大 batch 还是增加负样本数量尚不明确，该问题缺乏理论指导。
Method: 作者在固定内存约束 B = nk 下分析 sampled-softmax 训练的收敛性，基于标准平滑性和方差假设推导 batch size 与负样本数量的最优分配比例。理论结果建议采用 n ~ B, k ~ 1 的分配方式，并在合成数据和真实序列推荐基准上做受控实验验证。
Result: 理论表明最快收敛来自 n ~ B, k ~ 1 的分配，即尽量扩大 batch size。合成数据与四个真实序列推荐基准（包括 MovieLens-20M）上的实验显示，该配置在相同内存约束下比不平衡的替代配置收敛更快、最终推荐质量更好。
Conclusion: 作者给出的可操作规则是：在计算约束下尽可能加入更多样本（大 batch、少量负样本）。这些发现为推荐系统训练中的内存配置提供了理论和实证基础，但结论基于 sampled softmax 与标准平滑性假设，适用范围限于该目标与约束设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Deep Learning for Genomics Applications: Insights from an Empirical Study
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models have emerged as the standard computational tool for a wide range of applications in genomics. Yet, uncertainty quantification (UQ) -- and more specifically, the reliability of different uncertainty estimates in this domain -- has received little systematic attention. This work presents an empirical analysis of UQ in deep learning models, focusing on genomics applications. In a series of experiments, we contrast Deep Ensembles, Bayesian Neural Networks, and Monte Carlo-dropout methods. We assess their ability to quantify uncertainty in different scenarios, accounting for common dataset characteristics in two genomic application areas and modalities: sequence-to-activity models, and single-cell expression analysis. Our systematic comparison framework provides guidelines for the applicability and reliability of UQ methods in genomics, highlighting their strengths and limitations in different scenarios. We show that Bayesian Neural Networks are better at capturing uncertainty caused by strong class imbalance and out-of-distribution data in genomics, despite their computational disadvantages. Moreover, we show how uncertainty scores can be used to select high-quality predictions in protein-RNA interactions.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对基因组学深度学习模型中的不确定性量化 (uncertainty quantification, UQ) 方法进行了系统的实证比较，涵盖 Deep Ensembles、贝叶斯神经网络 (Bayesian Neural Networks) 和 Monte Carlo dropout 三类方法。研究在序列到活性 (sequence-to-activity) 模型和单细胞表达分析两个基因组学应用场景中评估这些方法的可靠性，并给出适用性指南。结果表明贝叶斯神经网络在类别不平衡和分布外 (out-of-distribution) 数据场景中表现更好，尽管计算代价更高。
Motivation: 深度学习已成为基因组学应用的标准计算工具，但不确定性量化在该领域受到的关注很少，不同不确定性估计方法的可靠性缺乏系统评估。
Method: 通过一系列实验构建系统性比较框架，在两类基因组学应用和模态中，结合常见数据集特征，对比 Deep Ensembles、贝叶斯神经网络和 Monte Carlo dropout 三种 UQ 方法的量化能力。
Result: 摘要报告贝叶斯神经网络能更好地捕捉由强烈类别不平衡和分布外数据引起的不确定性，尽管存在计算劣势；同时不确定性分数可被用来筛选蛋白质-RNA 交互中的高质量预测。
Conclusion: 该工作为 UQ 方法在基因组学中的适用性和可靠性提供了指南，并指出各方法在不同场景下的优势与局限。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告贝叶斯神经网络能更好地捕捉由强烈类别不平衡和分布外数据引起的不确定性，尽管存在计算劣势；同时不确定性分数可被用来筛选蛋白质-RNA 交互中的高质量预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作为 UQ 方法在基因组学中的适用性和可靠性提供了指南，并指出各方法在不同场景下的优势与局限。

papers.title: A Comparative Evaluation of Deep Learning Object Detection Models on a Real-World Multi-Plant Dataset from Africa
papers.abstract_en: The application of computer vision in agriculture has shown significant potential for improving crop monitoring and precision farming. However, many existing approaches rely on controlled datasets that do not adequately represent realworld farming conditions, particularly in underrepresented regions such as Africa. This study presents a comparative evaluation of six object detection models YOLOv5, YOLOv8, YOLO11, YOLO26, Faster R-CNN, and RT-DETR using a real-world dataset, AgriAISeg 1 , collected manually from Nigerian farms. AgriAISeg comprises 3,382 images of sesame, cabbage, and tomato crops captured under varying environmental conditions, including changes in illumination, occlusion, and viewing perspectives. Models were trained, and performance was assessed using precision, recall, mAP@0.5, and mAP@0.5:0.95. The results show that RT-DETR achieved the highest overall performance with a precision of 0.768 and mAP@0.5:0.95 of 0.624, while YOLOv8 and YOLO11 also demonstrated strong and consistent performance. In contrast, Faster R-CNN recorded significantly lower accuracy, with an overall mAP@0.5 of 0.466, indicating reduced effectiveness under complex field conditions. In addition, YOLO-based models exhibited superior training efficiency compared to Faster R-CNN.These findings demonstrate that modern one-stage and transformer-based detectors provide more reliable and efficient solutions for plant detection in realworld agricultural environments.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有农业计算机视觉方法多依赖受控数据集，不能充分代表真实农场条件，尤其是非洲等代表性不足的地区，因此需要基于真实世界多作物数据评估检测模型的适用性。

Result: RT-DETR 取得最高整体性能，precision 为 0.768，mAP@0.5:0.95 为 0.624；YOLOv8 和 YOLO11 表现强且稳定；Faster R-CNN 整体 mAP@0.5 仅 0.466，精度显著较低；YOLO 系列模型训练效率优于 Faster R-CNN。
Conclusion: 摘要认为现代单阶段和基于 Transformer 的检测器在真实农业环境中提供更可靠、更高效的植物检测方案。

papers.title: Efficient Hypergradient Descent for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) aims to recover a reward function under which the resulting policy reproduces the behavior observed in expert demonstrations. A natural approach is to formulate IRL as a bilevel optimization problem, in which the inner level corresponds to policy optimization under the learned reward and the outer level measures the discrepancy between the induced policy and expert data. However, this formulation is computationally challenging in practice because the outer update requires a hypergradient involving an inverse-Hessian-vector product for the inner objective. We address this challenge by showing that, at the inner optimum, the Hessian of the inner objective is proportional to the Fisher information matrix of the policy, yielding a structured Fisher-based hypergradient closely related to Natural Hypergradient Descent. To address the resulting scalability bottleneck associated with large Fisher matrices, we approximate the required inverse-Fisher-vector product using a streaming spectral sketch, avoiding explicit construction of the Fisher matrix. We evaluate our approach against a first-order stochastic bilevel baseline across discrete- and continuous-control environments. The results demonstrate competitive policy performance and strong reward-ranking quality, while Fisher sketching reduces curvature-storage complexity and can improve computational efficiency relative to an explicit Fisher solver.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究逆强化学习（IRL）的效率问题，将 IRL 建模为双层优化（bilevel optimization），其中内层为给定奖励下的策略优化，外层衡量诱导策略与专家演示的差异。作者证明在内层最优处，内层目标的 Hessian 与策略的 Fisher 信息矩阵成比例，从而得到结构化的 Fisher 型超梯度（hypergradient），并进一步用流式谱草图（streaming spectral sketch）近似逆 Fisher 向量积，避免显式构造 Fisher 矩阵。实验在离散与连续控制环境中对比一阶随机双层 baseline，显示策略性能有竞争力、奖励排序质量强，同时 Fisher 草图降低了曲率存储复杂度并可提升计算效率。
Motivation: IRL 的自然双层优化形式在外层更新时需要计算涉及内层目标逆 Hessian 向量积的超梯度，计算上极具挑战；大规模 Fisher 矩阵又带来可扩展性瓶颈。
Method: 证明内层最优处 Hessian 与策略 Fisher 信息矩阵成比例，导出自然超梯度下降（Natural Hypergradient Descent）形式的 Fisher 型超梯度；为避免大 Fisher 矩阵的显式构造，用流式谱草图近似逆 Fisher 向量积。
Result: 与一阶随机双层 baseline 相比，在离散和连续控制环境中获得有竞争力的策略性能和强奖励排序质量；Fisher 草图降低了曲率存储复杂度，并相对显式 Fisher 求解器提升了计算效率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该 Fisher 型超梯度与谱草图近似能够在不显式构造 Fisher 矩阵的情况下有效求解双层 IRL，缓解计算与存储瓶颈。

papers.title: HUI360: A 360° Egocentric Dataset and Baselines for Human-Robot Interaction Anticipation
papers.abstract_en: As robots increasingly operate in human-populated environments, anticipating human intentions is essential for enabling proactive and socially aware behavior. Automatic anticipation of human-robot interactions is thus emerging as a crucial perception challenge for embodied agents. To this end, we introduce HUI360, the largest dataset for human-robot interaction anticipation in the wild and its set of baselines. The dataset was collected from a mobile robot, in the wild, over multiple days within a 3-month period, and in several environments, capturing natural, spontaneous behaviors from both passersby and users, and encompassing a diverse range of individuals. This variety enables evaluating and improving the generalization capabilities of interaction anticipation models. We designed a pipeline and share code for automatic interaction annotation in arbitrary 360-degree equirectangular videos, along with interfaces for manual refinement. Using this pipeline, we release the HUI360 open set of 1M pre-processed annotations, including detailed 2D poses, facial keypoints, and segmentation masks, obtained using state-of-the-art computer vision methods and manually curated to ensure high-quality tracking and interaction annotation. Additionally, we release the raw panoptic 360-degree images captured from the robot's egocentric viewpoint (on demand, for research purpose only in compliance with GDPR). Finally, we establish benchmark baselines for interaction anticipation, including the first cross-dataset evaluations for this task: to this end, we also release 6M annotations for another existing in-the-wild outdoor dataset collected from a mobile robot (SSUP-HRI). Dataset and code can be found at https://hucebot.github.io/hui360.
papers.journal_ref: 2026 IEEE International Conference on Automatic Face and Gesture Recognition (FG)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HUI360，目前最大的野外人类-机器人交互预期数据集，并配套基准模型。数据由移动机器人在 3 个月内于多个环境中以 360° 自我中心视角采集，覆盖路人和使用者的自然自发行为，并释放 100 万条预处理标注（含 2D 姿态、面部关键点和分割掩码）以及另一野外数据集 SSUP-HRI 的 600 万条标注。作者还提供自动交互标注流水线与代码，并建立包括首次跨数据集评估在内的交互预期基准。
Motivation: 机器人在人类环境中运行时需要预判人类意图以实现主动且具有社会意识的交互，而自动预期人-机交互 (human-robot interaction anticipation) 正成为具身智能体的关键感知挑战，现有数据在规模和泛化评估上不足。
Method: 从移动机器人采集野外 360° 等距柱状投影视频，设计自动交互标注流水线并辅以人工精修界面；使用 SOTA 视觉方法生成 2D 姿态、面部关键点和分割掩码并人工筛选，最终发布 HUI360 开放集及 SSUP-HRI 的 6M 标注，建立交互预期基准。
Result: 摘要报告 HUI360 为该任务最大的野外数据集，并建立包含首次跨数据集评估的基准基线；标注经人工整理以保证跟踪和交互标注质量。
Conclusion: 该数据集和流水线旨在支撑交互预期模型的泛化能力评估与改进；原始全景图像按需提供，仅限研究用途并遵循 GDPR。

papers.title: 3D Weighted Geometric Graph Neural Networks for Sheep Facial Pain Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning systems perform mainly within the 2D for a single image domain and take the face as a single-dimension representation, losing sight of the 3D anatomy of sheep and cross-landmark spatial relationships that are intrinsic to the clinically proven Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES). This paper presents the \textbf{3D Sheep Pain Facial Expression System (3D-SPFES)}, a novel, monocular depth-aware geometric graph neural network system that integrates each SPFES facial landmark, such as the ears, eyes, and nose, into 3D Euclidean space estimated from a single RGB camera by using VideoDepthAnything, thus preventing the need for specialized depth hardware. Each landmark node includes a feature vector containing its 3D spatial coordinates, estimated surface normal, and facial attribute class embedding. Edges linked to nodes are assigned weights based on an aggregate metric that combines both Euclidean distance and surface co-planarity in a 3D space. A Weighted Geometric Graph Neural Network (WG-GNN) studies this graph using $\mathcal{K} = 3$ geometry-aware message-passing layers enhanced by a scaled dot-product attention method that selectively enhances anatomically relevant inter-landmark messages. The resultant node embeddings are combined into $\mathcal{O} = 3$ pain-level clusters and integrated into a Normalized Pain Score (NPS) within the range of $[0, 100%]$ a confidence-weighted, SPFES-derived scoring method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 3D-SPFES，一种基于单目 RGB 相机估计深度、面向绵羊面部疼痛评估的几何图神经网络系统。系统将 Sheep Pain Facial Expression Scale (SPFES) 的面部关键点映射到 3D 欧氏空间，并用加权几何图神经网络 (WG-GNN) 建模关键点间的空间关系，最终输出归一化疼痛评分 (NPS)。摘要未报告具体实验数值。
Motivation: 现有深度学习系统主要在 2D 单图像域中工作，把面部当作单一维度表示，忽略了绵羊 3D 解剖结构以及关键点之间的跨空间关系，而这些关系是临床验证的 SPFES 评分的内在依据。
Method: 利用 VideoDepthAnything 从单个 RGB 相机估计每个 SPFES 面部关键点（如耳、眼、鼻）的 3D 坐标，节点特征包含 3D 空间坐标、估计表面法线和面部属性类别嵌入；边权重由欧氏距离与表面共面性聚合度量决定。WG-GNN 使用 K=3 层几何感知消息传递，并加入缩放点积注意力以增强解剖相关的关键点间消息；节点嵌入聚成 O=3 个疼痛等级，并整合为 [0, 100%] 范围的置信度加权 NPS。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验数据，主要贡献是构建了无需专用深度硬件的单目深度感知 3D 疼痛评估系统，并定义了基于 SPFES 的归一化疼痛评分方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该系统的核心价值是将空间几何信息引入绵羊面部疼痛评估，避免对专用深度设备的依赖，并产出与 SPFES 对应的连续疼痛分数。

papers.title: Multiclass Sentiment Analysis for Identifying Political Viewpoints
papers.abstract_en: The rapid growth of social media has created vast amounts of political discourse, which provides valuable opportunities to analyze public opinions and identify different political perspectives. Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a core task in Natural Language Processing (NLP) that allows the computational study of attitudes and opinions in textual data, and has become increasingly important for understanding political discourse. In this work, we investigate multiclass sentiment analysis of political view- points on social media, that is to automatically discriminate multiple sentiment classes over political issues and figures. To solve this task we design and evaluate two machine-learning approaches based on XGBoost and BERT. We train and evaluate the models on a labeled dataset of political social media posts using standard classification metrics. The experimental results show that the XGBoost model reaches an F1-score of 0.2835 and the BERT- based model reaches an F1-score of 0.2806 on the test set. These results demonstrate the challenge of classifying complex and contextualized political discourse sentiment and provide a baseline for future research in multiclass political sentiment analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究社交媒体上政治观点的多类情感分析 (multiclass sentiment analysis)，设计并评估基于 XGBoost 与 BERT 的两种机器学习方法。在标注的政治社交媒体帖子数据集上，XGBoost 测试集 F1 为 0.2835，BERT 为 0.2806，显示该任务难度大，并为未来研究提供基线。
Motivation: 社交媒体中的大量政治话语为分析公众意见和识别不同政治视角提供了机会，而情感分析 (SA) 作为 NLP 核心任务可用于计算性研究文本中的态度与观点，但自动判别政治议题和人物的多类情感仍具挑战。
Method: 将政治观点识别建模为多类情感分类任务，设计并比较两种方法：基于 XGBoost 的传统机器学习方法与基于 BERT 的深度学习方法，并使用标准分类指标在标注的政治社交媒体帖子数据集上训练和评估。
Result: 实验结果显示 XGBoost 模型在测试集上达到 F1 分数 0.2835，BERT 模型达到 0.2806，表明复杂且依赖上下文的政治话语情感分类具有较大难度。

papers.title: V-FiLLM: Verified Financial LLM Reasoning Benchmark
papers.abstract_en: While existing benchmarks have made substantial progress in evaluating LLMs across STEM domains, financial reasoning over structured data remains comparatively less explored. We introduce V-FiLLM, a framework that generates financial reasoning benchmarks from executable computation trees grounded in real tables, yielding items whose answers are correct by construction. Trees are evaluated symbolically to obtain ground truth and rendered into natural-language questions, removing any model from the labeling loop, so items can be generated at arbitrary scale without annotation cost and without inheriting a generator's error rate. V-FiLLM exposes four independently controllable axes of difficulty including computation depth, expression breadth, financial concept complexity, and context size. By evaluating on open-source models, we find that accuracy falls up to 51% as reasoning depth increases, and up to 47% points under adversarial numerical perturbations, highlighting remaining challenges in robust financial reasoning over tables. We further show that lightweight LoRA fine-tuning on verified chain-of-thought traces improves accuracy from 81.1% to 85.6% on held-out problems and outperforms the base model by 5% points on FinQA (Chen et al., 2022a), s), suggesting that targeted, low-cost adaptation is a promising direction for compositional reasoning in financial QA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 V-FiLLM，一个从可执行计算树生成金融推理基准的框架，基于真实表格，答案通过符号求值获得真值，无需人工标注也不继承生成模型的错误率。基准暴露计算深度、表达式广度、金融概念复杂度和上下文大小四个可控难度轴；实验显示开源模型准确率随推理深度增加最高下降 51%，在对抗性数值扰动下最高下降 47 个百分点。轻量 LoRA 微调在验证思维链上可将保留问题准确率从 81.1% 提升到 85.6%，并在 FinQA 上比基础模型高 5 个百分点。

papers.title: ReRound: Reconstructive Rounding to Resolve Midpoint Ambiguity in Calibration-Free LLM Quantization
papers.abstract_en: ReRound (Reconstructive Rounding) is a post-training quantization method that addresses the midpoint ambiguity inherent in standard round-to-nearest (RTN) schemes when quantizing weights near the centers of quantization intervals. Starting from a pretrained LLM, ReRound trains a conditional diffusion model to produce continuous reconstructions of low-bit weights for the LLM. These reconstructed weights act as a guidance signal to disambiguate the rounding direction of weights located close to interval midpoints. To integrate this reconstruction-guided rounding with conventional RTN, ReRound introduces a tolerance metric measuring how far the quantized weight (not the final quantized integer) is away from the midpoint: quantized weights within a tolerance region around midpoints are quantized using diffusion-based reconstructions, whereas weights closer to quantization boundaries are quantized with RTN. By sweeping the tolerance parameter, ReRound generates multiple candidate quantized integer weight matrices and selects the de-quantized weight matrix candidate whose leading singular values most closely match those of the original full-precision weights. This selected candidate determines the tolerance parameter ReRound uses. ReRound is particularly effective for smaller LLMs. Across a range of such models, it consistently outperforms standard RTN for 3-bit and 4-bit weight quantization. ReRound achieves superior accuracy compared to an extensive set of calibration-free methods, remains competitive with calibration-dependent approaches, and operates entirely offline, introducing no additional overhead during low-bit inference. The ReRound strategy represents a new approach for low-bit quantization. The method applies to AI models beyond LLMs. This paper focuses on its applications to small LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReRound 是一种面向 LLM 的后训练量化方法，针对标准 round-to-nearest (RTN) 在量化权重靠近量化区间中点时固有的歧义问题。该方法从预训练 LLM 出发，训练一个条件扩散模型 (conditional diffusion model) 生成低比特权重的连续重建，并用该重建信号引导位于区间中点附近的权重选择舍入方向。通过扫描容差参数生成多个候选量化整数矩阵，并选择反量化后前导奇异值与原全精度权重最接近的候选。论文报告该方法在多个小规模 LLM 上一致优于标准 RTN 的 3-bit 和 4-bit 权重量化。
Motivation: 标准 RTN 在权重值位于量化区间中点附近时舍入方向存在歧义，这种歧义在低比特（如 3-bit、4-bit）权重量化中会损害精度，且对较小的 LLM 影响尤为明显。
Method: ReRound 训练条件扩散模型生成低比特权重的连续重建，将其作为舍入方向的引导信号；对处于中点附近容差区域内的权重使用基于扩散重建的量化，而靠近量化边界的权重仍用 RTN。通过扫描容差参数生成多个候选量化整数矩阵，选取反量化权重的前导奇异值与原全精度权重最匹配的候选，从而确定容差参数。
Result: 在一系列较小 LLM 上，ReRound 在 3-bit 和 4-bit 权重量化上一致优于标准 RTN；与大量无校准 (calibration-free) 方法相比精度更优，与依赖校准的方法相比具有竞争力；该方法完全离线运行，低比特推理阶段不引入额外开销。
Conclusion: ReRound 代表了低比特量化的一种新策略，不仅适用于 LLM，也可推广到其他 AI 模型；论文聚焦其在小规模 LLM 上的应用，强调离线操作和推理零额外开销。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Multi-Level Evidence Aggregation for Robust Facial Phenotype Retrieval in Rare Genetic Disorder Prioritization
papers.abstract_en: AI-assisted facial phenotyping supports rare genetic disorder prioritization by retrieving visually similar diagnosed cases from facial image reference databases such as the GestaltMatcher Database (GMDB). Existing GestaltMatcher-based retrieval frameworks compare each test image with individual gallery images in a facial phenotype embedding space. However, this pointwise formulation does not fully exploit available evidence, because patients may have multiple images and disorders may be represented by multiple diagnosed gallery patients. We propose an inference-time multi-level evidence aggregation framework that improves facial phenotype retrieval without modifying the underlying GestaltMatcher-Arc encoder. The framework combines embedding-level patient aggregation of multiple images from the same individual, patient-weighted disorder centroids, and hybrid individual-centroid scoring to integrate test-patient observations, disorder-level gallery evidence, and local nearest-neighbor evidence. We evaluated the approach on GMDB v1.1.4 across disorders represented during training (GMDB-Freq), unseen disorders (GMDB-Rare), and multi-image patient subsets, using a unified gallery containing both GMDB-Freq and GMDB-Rare disorders. Multi-level evidence aggregation improved mean per-disorder top-$N$ retrieval accuracy across all evaluation subsets. Top-1 accuracy increased from 38.52% to 48.82% on GMDB-Freq and from 19.38% to 23.79% on GMDB-Rare. On multi-image subsets, top-1 accuracy increased from 46.12% to 60.94% on GMDB-Multi-Freq and from 18.54% to 26.71% on GMDB-Multi-Rare. These findings show that inference-time aggregation can improve next-generation facial phenotype retrieval without retraining the encoder, supporting a shift from isolated single-image matching toward multi-level aggregation of patient and disorder evidence for rare-disorder prioritization.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种推理时的多层级证据聚合 (multi-level evidence aggregation) 框架，用于改善罕见遗传病面部表型检索，不修改底层的 GestaltMatcher-Arc 编码器。框架融合同患者多张图像的嵌入级聚合、患者加权的疾病质心 (patient-weighted disorder centroids) 以及混合个体-质心评分。在 GMDB v1.1.4 上，该方法在训练时见过的疾病、未见过的疾病和多图像子集上均提升了平均每疾病 top-N 检索准确率，其中 GMDB-Freq 的 top-1 准确率从 38.52% 提升到 48.82%。
Motivation: 现有 GestaltMatcher 类检索框架采用逐点 (pointwise) 方式，将每张测试图像与图库中单张图像比较，未充分利用患者可能有多张图像、一种疾病可能由多名确诊图库患者表示这一多层证据。
Method: 提出无需重训练编码器的推理时框架：先对同一患者的多个图像进行嵌入级聚合，再利用患者加权构造疾病质心，最后用混合个体-质心评分整合测试患者观测、疾病级图库证据和局部近邻证据。
Result: 在包含 GMDB-Freq 与 GMDB-Rare 的统一图库上，所有评测子集的平均每疾病 top-N 检索准确率均提升；top-1 准确率在 GMDB-Freq 上从 38.52% 升至 48.82%，在 GMDB-Rare 上从 19.38% 升至 23.79%，在多图像子集 GMDB-Multi-Freq 与 GMDB-Multi-Rare 上分别从 46.12% 升至 60.94%、从 18.54% 升至 26.71%。
Conclusion: 作者认为推理时聚合可以在不重训编码器的情况下改进下一代面部表型检索，支持从孤立单图像匹配转向患者与疾病证据的多层级聚合，以辅助罕见病优先级排序。

papers.title: SCOUT: Symmetric Consensus Outlier Detection for Failure Localization in LLM Pre-Training
papers.abstract_en: In LLM pre-training, synchronization propagates rank-local stalls, slowdowns, and numerical errors into job-wide symptoms, obscuring their origin. Existing diagnosis often relies on in-process monitors that cannot report after the trainer blocks or terminates, or on post-mortem logs that preserve only synchronized symptoms; offline health tests lose the workload and operating conditions that triggered the failure. We present SCOUT, a unified runtime failure-localization framework built on one design principle: identify outliers through strict-majority consensus among equivalent replicas. SCOUT aligns replica progress, timing, and numerical evidence, then uses its Consensus Collective Communication (C3) abstraction to identify ranks whose compact signatures disagree with their peers. An out-of-band CPU observer remains responsive when training hangs, whereas in-situ replay exercises recurring stragglers and silent data corruption (SDC) beside the live job with its model state, kernels, allocations, communication path, and thermal and memory pressure present. Collective fingerprints expose rank-local protocol divergence. Clean replay coverage certifies checkpoint numerical integrity, preventing recovery from selecting state corrupted by SDC. SCOUT integrates with PyTorch, TorchTitan, Megatron-Core, and DeepSpeed without training-loop or framework-source modifications. SCOUT is open source at https://github.com/LMResiliency/lm-resiliency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SCOUT，一个面向大语言模型预训练的运行时故障定位框架，核心设计原则是在等价副本之间通过严格多数共识识别异常秩 (rank)。SCOUT 对齐副本的进度、时序与数值证据，并利用 Consensus Collective Communication (C3) 抽象找出签名与同伴不一致的秩；带外 CPU observer 在训练挂起时仍可响应，原位回放 (in-situ replay) 则在真实负载条件下复现反复出现的 straggler 与静默数据损坏 (SDC)。工具无需修改训练循环或框架源码即可集成 PyTorch、TorchTitan、Megatron-Core 与 DeepSpeed，并已开源。
Motivation: 在 LLM 预训练中，同步机制会把单秩级别的停滞、慢速和数值错误传播为整个任务的症状，掩盖故障根源；现有进程内监控在 trainer 阻塞或终止后无法上报，事后日志只能保留同步后的症状，离线健康测试又丢失了触发故障的工作负载与运行条件。
Method: SCOUT 通过三方面证据的对齐来定位异常秩：进度、时序和数值；核心是 C3 抽象，用严格多数共识识别签名与同伴不一致的秩。带外 CPU observer 负责在训练挂起时保持响应，原位回放则在实时作业旁以模型状态、kernel、显存分配、通信路径及热/内存压力复现 straggler 与 SDC；collective fingerprints 暴露秩本地协议分歧，干净回放覆盖用于认证检查点数值完整性。
Result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；声称的能力包括在训练挂起时仍能通过带外 observer 响应，通过原位回放复现反复出现的性能异常与 SDC，以及用干净回放覆盖防止恢复时选中被污染状态的检查点。
Conclusion: 作者强调统一运行时框架加上严格多数共识的异常检测原则即可在不改动训练循环和框架源码的情况下覆盖多种故障定位场景；该工作以开源项目形式发布。

summary_sections.motivation: 在 LLM 预训练中，同步机制会把单秩级别的停滞、慢速和数值错误传播为整个任务的症状，掩盖故障根源；现有进程内监控在 trainer 阻塞或终止后无法上报，事后日志只能保留同步后的症状，离线健康测试又丢失了触发故障的工作负载与运行条件。
summary_sections.method: SCOUT 通过三方面证据的对齐来定位异常秩：进度、时序和数值；核心是 C3 抽象，用严格多数共识识别签名与同伴不一致的秩。带外 CPU observer 负责在训练挂起时保持响应，原位回放则在实时作业旁以模型状态、kernel、显存分配、通信路径及热/内存压力复现 straggler 与 SDC；collective fingerprints 暴露秩本地协议分歧，干净回放覆盖用于认证检查点数值完整性。
summary_sections.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果；声称的能力包括在训练挂起时仍能通过带外 observer 响应，通过原位回放复现反复出现的性能异常与 SDC，以及用干净回放覆盖防止恢复时选中被污染状态的检查点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调统一运行时框架加上严格多数共识的异常检测原则即可在不改动训练循环和框架源码的情况下覆盖多种故障定位场景；该工作以开源项目形式发布。

papers.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Benchmark leaderboards summarize how well a language model performs, but not how its behavior relates to that of other models or changes across generations. We characterize the output behavior of 32 models from six families using their responses to a shared bank of 10{,}000 prompts. After embedding each response, we construct three complementary sentence-level dissimilarities: an aligned mean per-prompt distance, which is a pseudometric on observed model responses; a PCA-compressed summary of prompt-wise disagreement; and an alignment-free Gromov--Wasserstein discrepancy between models' internal response geometries. We use these constructions to study static organization and temporal change on a release-date axis through behavioral maps, family-wise drift, hierarchical clustering, cross-family convergence, and response-cloud dispersion. Across the three constructions, model families form coherent clusters, with \texttt{gpt-2} as a global outlier; cross-family distances decrease over time; and several recent reasoning-oriented models have comparatively compact response clouds. A token-level cross-check based on per-prompt Maximum Mean Discrepancy closely agrees with the sentence-level mean distance (Spearman $ρ=0.98$) and recovers the same qualitative findings. We organize these comparisons through a measure-theoretic lens making their alignment and invariance assumptions explicit. We also establish an architecture-agnostic sufficient condition linking behavioral similarity to inference-prompt coverage, small excess population log-loss, and similar effective target distributions---a possible training-side account rather than an empirical explanation of the observed trends. Our pipeline is label-free, and re-encoding every response with three further encoders---down to one $73\times$ smaller---preserves the rank geometry, the outliers, and the sign of the time trend.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出用模型对同一组 10,000 个提示的响应来刻画大型语言模型的行为，构造三种互补的句级不相似度（对齐的逐提示平均距离、PCA 压缩的逐提示不一致性、无对齐的 Gromov–Wasserstein 几何差异），对 6 个家族共 32 个模型做静态组织与时间演化分析。摘要报告模型家族形成连贯簇、gpt-2 为全局离群点、跨家族距离随时间下降，且近期若干推理导向模型的响应云更紧凑。token 级 MMD 交叉检验与句级平均距离高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.98），并恢复了相同的定性结论。
Motivation: 基准排行榜只概括模型的性能好坏，不揭示其行为与其他模型的关系或跨代变化；需要一种无标签的、系统的行为度量方式来刻画模型之间的静态组织和时间演化。
Method: 将 32 个模型对共享 10,000 个提示的响应嵌入后，构造三种句级不相似度：对齐的逐提示平均距离（一种伪度量）、PCA 压缩的逐提示不一致性、以及无对齐的 Gromov–Wasserstein 响应几何差异。作者沿发布日期轴通过行为图谱、家族漂移、层次聚类、跨家族收敛和响应云离散度进行分析，并用测度论视角明确对齐与不变性假设。
Result: 摘要称模型家族形成连贯聚类，gpt-2 为全局离群点；跨家族距离随时间减小；若干近期推理导向模型的响应云较紧凑。基于逐提示最大均值差异 (MMD) 的 token 级交叉检验与句级平均距离高度一致（Spearman ρ=0.98）；用另外三种编码器重编码（最小者缩小 73 倍）仍保持排序几何、离群点与时间趋势方向。
Conclusion: 摘要还给出一个与架构无关的充分条件：行为相似性可由推理提示覆盖、较小的超额总体 log-loss 与相似的有效目标分布共同保证，作者认为这更像是训练侧的说明而非对观测趋势的经验解释。

papers.title: When Visual Signals Mislead: A Mechanistic Study of Attribute Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Attribute hallucination---where vision-language models (VLMs) correctly identify an object but mischaracterize its properties---is prevalent yet mechanistically poorly understood. The dominant explanation, language-prior dominance, has motivated prior-suppression methods, but this explanation has not been directly tested at the attribute level. We present VISOR (Visual-Operational Remediation), a unified framework that couples null-image-based diagnosis with routed remediation. Its VSNR diagnostic decomposes each prediction into a visual logit signal and a language-prior signal. Across 10,791 negative-ground-truth samples from three VLM families and three attribute types, the visual signal strongly predicts false positives, whereas the language-prior signal is near chance. VISOR uses this diagnosis to separate two failure modes: low-margin but directionally correct visual signals in color/state attributes, and low-SNR or misaligned visual signals in material attributes. The same diagnosis routes each query to the appropriate operator: calibration for threshold-placement errors, abstention for training-free low-SNR handling, or targeted visual adaptation for material failures that prior suppression cannot correct. Across Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA, VISOR reduces attribute false positives without relying on the prior-dominance assumption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中的属性幻觉 (attribute hallucination) 机制，并提出统一框架 VISOR (Visual-Operational Remediation)，其 VSNR 诊断利用空图像 (null-image) 将预测分解为视觉 logit 信号与语言先验信号。作者在 10,791 个负例样本上发现视觉信号能强预测假阳性，而语言先验信号接近随机水平；据此把失败模式分为颜色/状态属性的低间隔但方向正确的视觉信号，以及材质属性的低信噪比或错位视觉信号，并路由到校准、弃权或视觉适配等算子。
Motivation: 属性幻觉的常见解释是语言先验主导 (language-prior dominance)，并据此发展出抑制先验的方法，但这一解释从未在属性层面被直接检验。作者希望通过机制层面的诊断来理解并更精确地干预 VLM 的属性幻觉。
Method: 提出 VISOR 框架，先通过 VSNR 诊断将每个预测分解为视觉信号与语言先验信号；再根据诊断结果把查询路由到不同算子，分别为处理阈值放置误差的校准 (calibration)、免训练低信噪比场景的弃权 (abstention)、以及针对材质失败且无法用先验抑制纠正的视觉适配 (targeted visual adaptation)。
Result: 在来自 Qwen、InternVL、LLaVA 三个 VLM 家族、三种属性类型的 10,791 个负例上，视觉信号强烈预测假阳性，而语言先验信号接近随机水平；VISOR 在不依赖语言先验主导假设的情况下降低了属性假阳性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调属性幻觉不能简单归因于语言先验主导，颜色/状态与材质两类失效模式需要不同的处理机制；VISOR 提供了统一诊断与路由修复的思路，并明确不依赖 prior-dominance 假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Workflow Cards: Structured Summaries of Workflow Executions Using Provenance Data
papers.abstract_en: Model Cards and Data Cards have demonstrated the value of structured, human-readable documentation for machine learning artifacts, capturing their context, parameters, limitations, and intended use. However, these practices remain focused on static artifacts (the datasets and trained models themselves) while overlooking the workflow executions that produce, transform, and evaluate them. Such executions hold critical details about data preparation, parameter choice, runtime behavior, resource use, and intermediate transformations, precisely where bias, performance variation, and reproducibility gaps tend to originate. To close this gap, we introduce Workflow Cards: structured summaries that condense the machine-readable provenance data of a workflow execution into a form both humans and large language models (LLMs) can read and analyze. This paper has two main parts. First, it defines a Workflow Card template informed by a representative set of provenance questions that surface from the execution-level data missing from Model and Data Cards. Second, it evaluates how effectively LLMs use Workflow Cards to understand workflow executions compared with querying provenance databases through a schema-based interface. Results show that Workflow Cards provide execution-level information absent from existing card types, such as Model Cards and Data Cards, thereby filling an important documentation gap; and that Workflow Cards nearly double answer quality compared with schema-based querying, consistently across LLM-as-a-Judge and human assessments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Workflow Cards，一种将工作流执行的机器可读 provenance 数据压缩为结构化摘要的文档形式，供人类和 LLM 阅读分析。作者先基于代表性 provenance 问题定义模板，再比较 LLM 通过 Workflow Cards 理解工作流执行与通过 schema 接口查询 provenance 数据库的效果。结果显示 Workflow Cards 提供了 Model Cards 和 Data Cards 所缺失的执行级信息，并将答案质量提升近一倍。
Motivation: 现有文档实践（如 Model Cards 和 Data Cards）聚焦于静态工件（数据集和训练模型），忽略了产生、转化和评估这些工件的工作流执行过程；而数据准备、参数选择、运行时行为、资源使用和中间变换恰恰是偏差、性能变化和可复现性缺口的主要来源。
Method: 首先定义 Workflow Card 模板，模板由从执行级数据中提炼出的一组代表性 provenance 问题所驱动；随后评估 LLM 使用 Workflow Cards 理解工作流执行的回答质量，并与通过基于 schema 的接口直接查询 provenance 数据库的方式进行比较。
Result: Workflow Cards 提供了 Model Cards 和 Data Cards 中缺失的执行级信息；与 schema 查询相比，在 LLM-as-a-Judge 和人工评估两种方式下，Workflow Cards 几乎将回答质量翻倍。
Conclusion: Workflow Cards 能够填补现有文档类型对工作流执行细节的记录空白，并且 LLM 可以有效地阅读和分析这种结构化摘要；该工作面向一般科学工作流，并未限定于气候或降水领域。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Derivative Computation in PINNs: Automatic Differentiation, Finite Differences and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: We systematically investigate finite-difference (FD) derivative computation in Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) as an alternative to automatic differentiation (AD). On three benchmark PDEs we show that, with a properly calibrated step size, FD matches AD in accuracy on every problem while running faster across the full tested batch-size range and using substantially less GPU memory, and that a stochastic variant we propose outperforms AD on a stationary problem. We further show that for neural architectures with inter-sample dependencies (e.g. BatchNorm, self-attention) the standard PyTorch autograd idiom is silently incorrect; the correct per-sample alternative is computationally infeasible at PINN-relevant batch sizes, while FD provides a forward-only approximation that is empirically an order of magnitude closer to the true per-sample derivative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了物理学信息神经网络 (PINNs) 中用有限差分 (FD) 替代自动微分 (AD) 计算导数的问题。在三个基准 PDE 上，只要步长校准得当，FD 在每个问题上的精度都与 AD 相当，并在全部测试批量范围内运行更快且显著降低 GPU 内存占用；作者提出的随机变体在一个平稳问题上优于 AD。此外，对于含样本间依赖的架构（如 BatchNorm、self-attention），标准 PyTorch autograd 用法会静默出错，而逐样本正确计算在 PINN 相关批量下不可行，FD 提供的前向近似在经验上比标准做法更接近真实逐样本导数。
Motivation: PINNs 通常依赖 AD 求导，但其在计算成本和内存上存在瓶颈；有限差分作为替代方案及其在样本间依赖架构下的行为尚未被系统研究。
Method: 在 PINNs 中系统考察 FD 导数计算，对标定步长进行校准，并提出一个随机 FD 变体；同时分析了 PyTorch autograd 标准写法在含 inter-sample dependencies 的架构中的错误来源，以及 FD 作为 forward-only 近似的可行性。
Result: 在三个基准 PDE 上，FD 与 AD 精度持平，但速度更快、GPU 内存占用更少；随机变体在一个平稳问题上超过 AD；在 BatchNorm/self-attention 类架构上，FD 近似的逐样本导数的误差比标准 autograd 约低一个数量级。
Conclusion: 作者认为 FD 是 PINNs 中 AD 的一种可行且往往更优的替代方案，并指出对含样本间依赖的架构，标准 autograd 会静默不正确，而 FD 提供了实用的前向近似。
Relevance: 7

summary_sections.method: 在 PINNs 中系统考察 FD 导数计算，对标定步长进行校准，并提出一个随机 FD 变体；同时分析了 PyTorch autograd 标准写法在含 inter-sample dependencies 的架构中的错误来源，以及 FD 作为 forward-only 近似的可行性。
summary_sections.result: 在三个基准 PDE 上，FD 与 AD 精度持平，但速度更快、GPU 内存占用更少；随机变体在一个平稳问题上超过 AD；在 BatchNorm/self-attention 类架构上，FD 近似的逐样本导数的误差比标准 autograd 约低一个数量级。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 FD 是 PINNs 中 AD 的一种可行且往往更优的替代方案，并指出对含样本间依赖的架构，标准 autograd 会静默不正确，而 FD 提供了实用的前向近似。

papers.title: DEFT: Data-Efficient Frequency-domain Top-k Sampling via Inverse Discrete Fourier Transform for Spatiotemporal Dynamical Systems Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Modeling spatiotemporal dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) poses two major challenges: it either requires expensive physics-based simulators that entail iterative numerical solving at high computational cost, or it depends on abundant training data, yet purely data-driven models often generalize poorly to downstream dynamic operating conditions. We propose DEFT, a frequency-domain data sampling method that identifies the dominant Fourier modes of a physical system and systematically varies the corresponding amplitudes and phases to generate physically consistent training data via the inverse discrete Fourier transform. In addition, we derive a generalization bound of this method. We note that it also provides a theoretically principled criterion for selecting $K$. We evaluate the proposed method through three sets of experiments, each targeting a distinct aspect of its utility. First, we validate the framework on canonical PDEs solving demonstrating that it outperforms traditional methods when the system is dominated by a few prominent frequency components. Second, we employ DEFT as a data-value filter on the diffusion--sorption and Burgers equations of PDEBench, showing that it reduces data requirements by $40\%$ while sacrificing less than $2\%$ in predictive accuracy. Third, to evaluate DEFT for more challenging and practically relevant problems, we validate it in the battery degradation PDE system, achieving consistently high predictive accuracy across various test datasets with $R^2$ values exceeding $0.99$. Moreover, the learned frequency-domain features transfer to other battery chemistries with only $20\%$ of the fine-tuning data. These results demonstrate that DEFT is an effective data-sampling method for efficient operator learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DEFT，一种面向 PDE 控制的时空动力系统的频域数据采样方法。它识别物理系统的主导 Fourier 模式，系统性地变化对应幅值和相位，并通过逆离散傅里叶变换生成物理一致性的训练数据；作者还导出了该方法的泛化界，并给出理论上选择截断阶数 K 的准则。实验覆盖典型 PDE、PDEBench 的 diffusion–sorption 与 Burgers 方程以及电池退化 PDE 系统，结果显示该方法是高效的算子学习数据采样手段。
Motivation: 建模受 PDE 控制的时空动力系统面临两难：基于物理的模拟器计算昂贵，而纯数据驱动模型需要大量训练数据且对下游动态工况泛化差。因此需要一种低数据成本、能生成物理一致性训练样本的方法。
Method: DEFT 在频域中识别系统中的主导 Fourier 模式，对相应振幅和相位进行系统扰动，再经逆离散傅里叶变换重构为物理一致的时空样本。作者同时推导了一个泛化界，并将该界作为选择主导模式数量 K 的理论依据。
Result: 在由少数显著频率成分主导的典型 PDE 求解上，DEFT 优于传统方法；作为数据价值过滤器用于 PDEBench 的 diffusion–sorption 与 Burgers 方程时，可在减少 40% 数据需求的同时使预测精度损失低于 2%；在电池退化 PDE 系统上，各测试集 R² 均超过 0.99，且学到的频域特征只需 20% 微调数据即可迁移到其他电池化学体系。
Conclusion: 作者认为 DEFT 是一种面向高效算子学习的有效数据采样方法，其优势在系统由少数主导频率分量控制时尤为明显，且理论泛化界为参数 K 的选取提供了原则性依据。

papers.title: R4DSG: Relative 4D Scene Graph Memory for Object-Centric Question Answering in Long Egocentric Video
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon egocentric video is a rich substrate for wearable AI assistants, but object-centric questions such as where an item was moved, when it last changed state, or why it was relocated remain difficult because caption- and transcript-based memories rarely preserve persistent object identity or structured spatial change. Existing long-video QA methods mainly emphasize temporal grounding and clip retrieval, while prior 3D scene-graph methods typically assume stronger geometry than free-motion wearable RGB video provides, including point clouds, RGB-D input, posed views, sparse reconstruction, or reconstructed scenes. R4DSG introduces a relative 4D scene graph memory for long egocentric video. Instead of storing raw graph sequences, R4DSG converts video into compact queryable memory entries indexed by time, place, persistent objects, anchor-relative change, and local interaction context. The main idea is to separate stable anchors from dynamic objects, maintain persistent object identity across frames, and represent object state through anchor-relative transitions rather than a globally aligned world model. Built on recent RGB-only advances in promptable video segmentation, temporal propagation, and relative 3D lifting, the method produces a retrieval-ready memory directly usable for long-horizon question answering. Evaluation on a 255-question object-related subset from EgoLifeQA shows, under question-only retrieval, a 6.7-point overall gain over EgoRAG-Text and a 12.5-point gain on when questions, which highlights the value of temporally organized object memory. These results position relative 4D scene graphs as a practical memory substrate for wearable assistants, AR systems, and embodied multimedia agents. GitHub Page: https://dualtransparency.github.io/R4DSG/.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, ACM Multimedia 2026, egocentric video; 3D scene graph; temporal memory; graph retrieval; object-state reasoning; multimodal question answering
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 R4DSG，一种用于长时程第一人称视频的"相对 4D 场景图记忆"（relative 4D scene graph memory），面向物体中心问答。作者将视频压缩为按时间、地点、持久物体、锚点相对变化和局部交互上下文索引的紧凑可查询记忆，分离稳定锚点与动态物体，通过锚点相对转换而非全局对齐世界模型表示物体状态变化。在 EgoLifeQA 的 255 个物体相关问题上，question-only 检索下整体比 EgoRAG-Text 高 6.7 分，"when"类问题高 12.5 分。
Motivation: 长时序第一人称视频中物体中心问答（如物品被移动到哪里、何时改变状态、为何被移动）难以用字幕和转录类记忆处理，因为它们难以保留持续物体身份和结构化空间变化。现有长视频 QA 方法偏重时间定位和片段检索，而先前的 3D 场景图方法需要点云、RGB-D、姿态视图、稀疏重建或重建场景等更强几何输入，不适用于自由运动的穿戴式 RGB 视频。
Method: R4DSG 将视频转换为紧凑且可查询的记忆条目，以时间、地点、持久物体、锚点相对变化和局部交互上下文为索引。核心思路是分离稳定锚点与动态物体、跨帧保持物体身份一致性，并用锚点相对转移（anchor-relative transitions）表示物体状态，而非依赖全局对齐的世界模型；方法构建于可提示视频分割、时间传播和相对 3D 抬升（relative 3D lifting）等 RGB-only 进展之上，直接产出可用于长时程问答的检索就绪记忆。
Result: 在 EgoLifeQA 的 255 个物体相关问题子集上，question-only 检索设置下整体较 EgoRAG-Text 提升 6.7 分，其中"when"类问题提升 12.5 分。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果说明相对 4D 场景图可作为可穿戴助手、AR 系统和具身多媒体智能体的实用记忆载体。

papers.title: Gromov-Wasserstein Quantization and Clustering: Structure, Rates, and Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Clustering is a fundamental class of data analysis techniques with the most important representatives being centroid-based methods like $k$-means. Such methods are strongly connected to quantization problems, which aim to approximate general probability measures with discrete ones. For example, $k$-means corresponds to quantization with respect to the Wasserstein distance. While Wasserstein quantization clusters points within a fixed space, this paper studies Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) quantization, which additionally aims at clustering the ambient geometry of the space. We show existence of solutions to the GW quantization problem and give a characterization that justifies an analogue to the $k$-means algorithm (Lloyd's algorithm) to approximate them numerically. We further calculate the quantization rate for usual Euclidean geometries that are used in the GW context, and relate it to standard Wasserstein quantization rates. Finally, numerical experiments show that GW quantization opens up many modeling possibilities beyond normal clustering methods (e.g., for geodesic distances of 3D shapes or structured pruning of neural networks) and that the introduced algorithm leads to useful numerical solutions with approximation quality often in line with theoretically optimal rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) 量化问题，目标是用离散测度近似一般概率测度，同时聚类空间本身的几何结构。作者证明 GW 量化问题解的存在性，给出可类比 k-means (Lloyd 算法) 的数值近似刻画，并计算常用欧氏几何下的量化率。数值实验表明 GW 量化可用于 3D 形状测地距离、神经网络结构化剪枝等建模场景，算法近似质量常与理论最优速率一致。
Motivation: 经典聚类方法如 k-means 与 Wasserstein 量化紧密相关，但只能在固定空间内聚类点。本文针对的是 GW 量化，它能同时聚类空间的几何结构，现有理论保证和算法尚不充分。
Method: 证明 GW 量化问题最优解的存在性，并给出一个刻画，以此论证与 k-means 算法 (Lloyd 算法) 类似的迭代算法可用于数值近似；同时推导通常用于 GW 场景的欧氏几何下的量化率，并与标准 Wasserstein 量化率建立联系。
Result: 摘要报告了 GW 量化问题解的存在性、Lloyd 型算法的合理性以及欧氏几何下的量化率结果；数值实验展示该方法在 3D 形状测地距离和神经网络结构化剪枝等场景中的建模能力，近似质量常与理论最优速率一致。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GW 量化开辟了超越常规聚类方法的建模可能性，且提出的 Lloyd 型算法能产生有用的数值解。摘要未提及具体数值指标或局限性。

papers.title: Watching Synthetic Videos: Aligning Cross-modal Representations with Visual Synthesis for Zero-shot Video Captioning
papers.abstract_en: Text-only training is a popular paradigm in zero-shot video captioning, where the video distribution is not available to the model during training, leading to a cross-modal gap between the training (text-only) and the inference (video-only). Previous works attempt to bridge the gap through simple linear transformations. However, the inherent gap between text and video makes cross-modal representation space alignment insufficient, resulting in inaccurate sentences. To address this issue, we propose a novel zero-shot video captioning framework (WSV) consisting of two training stages, which first generates corresponding synthetic video latent representations via a pretrained text-to-video generation model. To strengthen the fidelity of the latent representations, we propose a polisher capable of bridging the gap between real and synthetic video distributions. Subsequently, we design a prompter that conditions GPT-2 on the polished latent representations to generate the captions in the second training stage. During inference, an input video is encoded by a pretrained 3D Causal VAE and then fed directly into the prompter, which in turn guides GPT-2 to produce the final caption. Experimental results conducted on MSVD, MSR-VTT, and VATEX datasets demonstrate that our proposed method achieves scores of 52 and 95.7 on the B@4 and CIDEr metrics, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个零样本视频字幕生成框架 WSV，针对纯文本训练与视频推理之间的跨模态差距。框架分两阶段训练：先用预训练的文本到视频生成模型合成对应的视频潜在表示，再设计 polisher 缩小真实与合成视频分布间的差距，随后用 prompter 将精化后的潜在表示条件化到 GPT-2 生成字幕。推理时输入视频由预训练 3D Causal VAE 编码后直接送入 prompter 引导 GPT-2 输出。在 MSVD、MSR-VTT 和 VATEX 上，B@4 与 CIDEr 分别达到 52 和 95.7。
Motivation: 零样本视频字幕的文本-only 训练范式在训练时看不到视频分布，导致文本与视频之间存在跨模态差距；现有工作仅用简单线性变换桥接该差距，跨模态表示空间对齐不充分，生成句子不准确。
Method: 提出两阶段训练的 WSV 框架：第一阶段用预训练文本到视频生成模型生成合成视频潜在表示，并引入 polisher 弥合真实与合成视频分布；第二阶段设计 prompter，将精化后的潜在表示作为条件输入 GPT-2 生成字幕。推理时输入视频由预训练 3D Causal VAE 编码后直接送入 prompter。
Result: 在 MSVD、MSR-VTT 与 VATEX 数据集上的实验显示，所提方法在 B@4 上达到 52，在 CIDEr 上达到 95.7。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过合成视频潜在表示与 polisher 对齐跨模态表示空间，能有效改善零样本视频字幕生成的准确性。

papers.title: Policy Convergence and Divergence Across National and Within Regional AI Strategies: A Policy Design Element Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Governments worldwide have responded to the rapid expansion of AI by publishing national and regional AI strategies. Comparing national and regional AI strategies to identify their convergences and divergences can uncover their common practices, understand regional variations, and provide policy designers a comprehensive set of policy design elements for their ongoing AI strategy developments. Yet, existing work has not examined their underlying policy design elements or assessed whether those elements are horizontally (country-to-country) or vertical (region-to-country) converging or diverging over time. This paper addresses that gap by coding and analyzing 74 national and 3 regional AI strategies drawn from a global scan of all 205 UN member and non-member states. The coding used a latent-inductive approach organized around three functional policy design elements: goals, approaches, and principles. Two research questions guided the analysis: to what degree are national AI strategies becoming horizontally convergent or divergent over time; and to what degree are national strategies becoming vertically convergent or divergent with those countries' regional AI strategy. Results indicate strong horizontal convergence around economic competitiveness, research support, and ethical AI use, alongside persistent divergence in human rights goals, participatory governance approaches, and human-centric principles. Across the three regions, the AU exhibits the highest vertical convergence, the EU demonstrated strong alignment on regulatory and economic priorities but diverges on human-centric values, and the Nordic-Baltic Region displays mixed vertical convergence. These findings offer policy designers a comprehensive evidence base for identifying emerging AI policy design choice norms as AI strategies are developed and updated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过编码分析74个国家和3个区域AI战略，考察国家与区域AI战略在政策设计元素上的水平（国与国）与垂直（区域与国）收敛与发散趋势。摘要报告发现国家战略在经济增长、研究支持和伦理AI使用上呈现强水平收敛，而在人权目标、参与式治理和人本原则上持续发散；非洲联盟垂直收敛最高，欧盟在监管和经济优先项上强对齐但在人本价值上发散，北欧波罗的海地区呈混合垂直收敛。
Motivation: 现有工作未系统地比较国家和区域AI战略背后的政策设计元素，也未评估这些元素是否随时间发生水平或垂直收敛/发散；作者希望填补这一空白，为政策设计者提供全面的设计元素证据基础。
Method: 研究者对全球205个联合国会员国和非会员国进行扫描，选取74个国家和3个区域AI战略进行编码，采用潜在归纳（latent-inductive）方法，围绕目标（goals）、路径（approaches）和原则（principles）三类功能性政策设计元素展开分析，并围绕水平和垂直收敛/发散两个研究问题评估。
Result: 结果显示国家层面围绕经济竞争力、研究支持和伦理AI使用存在强水平收敛，而人权目标、参与式治理方法和人本中心原则方面持续发散；区域层面非洲联盟（AU）垂直收敛最高，欧盟（EU）在监管与经济优先项上强对齐但在人本价值上发散，北欧波罗的海地区为混合垂直收敛。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些发现为政策设计者在制定和更新AI战略时识别新兴政策设计选择规范提供了全面证据基础，但未超出该政策分析范围提出通用结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Information Bottleneck under Perfect Privacy
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study the information bottleneck under perfect privacy, with particular emphasis on the active-rate regime, where the representation-rate constraint is binding and directly limits the achievable utility. The goal is to construct a representation that preserves utility-relevant information while remaining statistically independent of a sensitive variable. This exact independence requirement introduces an additional constraint beyond the classical rate-relevance tradeoff and must be explicitly incorporated into the optimization. To this end, we develop an alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-based method tailored to the resulting problem structure. Under suitable regularity conditions, we establish global convergence of the generated sequence, characterize its convergence rate through the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz exponent, and extend the analysis to inexact block updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究完美隐私约束下的信息瓶颈 (information bottleneck) 问题，重点分析表示率约束起作用的 active-rate 区间，要求构造的表示在保持效用相关信息的同时与敏感变量统计独立。作者提出一种基于交替方向乘子法 (ADMM) 的求解算法，并在适当正则性条件下证明生成序列的全局收敛性，给出基于 Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz 指数的收敛速率刻画，且扩展到非精确块更新。
Motivation: 经典率-相关性折衷之外，完美隐私要求表示与敏感变量精确独立，这一硬约束必须显式纳入优化，且现有方法难以处理 active-rate 区间下约束绑定的问题。
Method: 针对带精确独立性约束的信息瓶颈优化结构，设计定制的 ADMM 算法，并分析其全局收敛性与收敛速率；通过 Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz 指数刻画收敛速度，同时将分析推广到非精确块更新情形。
Result: 在适当正则性条件下，摘要报告该方法生成的序列具有全局收敛性，并给出了收敛速率的理论刻画。
Conclusion: 摘要强调把完美隐私作为显式独立约束纳入优化是可行的，ADMM 类方法能够为该问题提供带收敛保证的求解途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: On the Limitations of Cross-Lingual Consistency in Multilingual Text-to-image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) generation has achieved remarkable progress in recent years. However, existing research has largely focused on English-only settings, leaving cross-lingual performance gaps and language-specific effects insufficiently explored. To fill this gap, we introduce LingT2I, a benchmark covering 10 widely used languages with 33K prompts, designed to evaluate cross-lingual effects in both content generation and text rendering. Building on this benchmark, we conduct a comprehensive cross-lingual analysis, uncovering linguistic inequality and language-dependent trade-offs across evaluation dimensions. Beyond quantitative evaluation, we further reveal a range of language-dependent generation patterns, highlighting how linguistic factors and their corresponding cultural contexts systematically impact model outputs. Our benchmark and analysis provide a foundation for studying cross-lingual behavior in T2I generation and facilitate the development of more robust and inclusive models. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/RISys-Lab/LingT2I.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多语言文本到图像生成（T2I）中跨语言一致性问题，提出一个覆盖10种常用语言、含33K提示词的基准LingT2I，用于评估内容生成与文本渲染的跨语言效果。基于该基准的综合性分析揭示了语言不平等性和各评估维度上的语言依赖权衡，并展示了语言因素及其文化背景对模型输出的系统性影响。
Motivation: 现有T2I研究大多局限于英语环境，跨语言性能差距和语言特有影响未被充分探索，缺乏系统的跨语言评测基准与分析。
Method: 构建LingT2I基准，覆盖10种语言和33K提示词，分别从内容生成与文本渲染两个维度评估跨语言效果，并在此基础上开展跨语言分析与生成模式观察。
Result: 分析发现模型存在语言不平等性，评估维度间出现语言依赖的权衡，且语言因素及相应文化背景会系统性地影响模型输出模式。
Conclusion: 该基准与分析为研究T2I模型的跨语言行为提供了基础，有助于推动更鲁棒、更包容的多语言模型开发；代码与数据集已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HNDiff: Haze-Noise Diffusion for Image Dehazing
papers.abstract_en: Existing diffusion-based methods have recently made significant progress in image dehazing. However, they typically neglect the physics of haze formation and reconstruct clean images from pure Gaussian noise, thereby limiting their restoration potential. To address this issue, we propose Haze-Noise Diffusion (HNDiff), a novel diffusion framework that embeds the atmospheric scattering model as an inductive bias. By grounding diffusion in physical principles, HNDiff ensures that the restoration aligns more closely with underlying mechanisms of haze formation. In its forward process, we introduce joint haze-noise diffusion with a haze-aware noise scheduler, which progressively adds both haze and noise to an image. Essentially, the scheduler adapts noise levels according to haze density, meaning that regions with heavier haze receive stronger noise injection to encourage content generation, while clearer regions receive lighter noise to better preserve details, which directly links the forward degradation process with the physics of haze. In the reverse process, we then derive a physically consistent dehazing-denoising process that simultaneously removes haze and noise to restore a clean image in a manner aligned with the forward degradation process. To further enhance practicality, we propose Latent HNDiff, which compiles clean latent priors that can be seamlessly integrated into existing dehazing networks to boost performance. Extensive experiments show that our work significantly improves leading dehazing backbones and achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmark datasets. The project page is available at https://jin-ting-he.github.io/HNDiff .
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://jin-ting-he.github.io/HNDiff
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HNDiff (Haze-Noise Diffusion)，一种把大气散射模型作为归纳偏置嵌入的图像去雾扩散框架。前向过程引入 haze-aware noise scheduler，按雾浓度自适应注入噪声；反向过程推导出物理一致的去雾-去噪流程。作者还提出 Latent HNDiff，编译干净潜在先验以增强现有去雾网络，并在基准数据集上报告了 SOTA 结果。
Motivation: 现有扩散式去雾方法通常忽略雾形成的物理机制，直接由纯高斯噪声重建干净图像，因而限制了对含雾图像的恢复潜力。
Method: 将大气散射模型作为归纳偏置嵌入扩散过程；前向过程采用联合 haze-noise 扩散与 haze-aware noise scheduler，对雾更重的区域注入更强噪声以鼓励内容生成，对较清晰区域注入较轻噪声以保留细节；反向过程推导同时去除雾和噪声的物理一致过程；此外提出 Latent HNDiff，提供可无缝集成到现有去雾网络中的干净潜在先验。
Result: 摘要报告该方法显著提升了领先去雾 backbone 的性能，并在基准数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 结果，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将雾形成物理嵌入扩散前向/反向过程能更好地对齐真实退化机制，并指出 Latent HNDiff 可作为即插即用模块提升现有去雾网络；工作范围限于图像去雾，未涉及气象预报类任务。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Putting Registers to Work: Task Registers for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Token-pruning policies are usually designed for a single recognition pipeline, but pretrained Vision Transformers are reused across tasks with different spatial demands. We ask which parts of a pruning policy transfer across image classification, semantic segmentation, and object detection. For each pipeline, controlled probes freeze the no-pruning checkpoint and apply a series of parameter-free reduction criteria at one eligible layer at a time without retraining. The probes reveal three differences: segmentation and detection rank the criteria differently, classification is especially sensitive to attention-based pruning in the earliest layers, and the dense tasks prefer opposite recovery endpoints. These findings motivate Task-Adaptive Pruning (TAP). Existing register tokens serve as task-agnostic storage for feature artifacts. TAP instead introduces one task register per task and activates only the current one. Its evolving state ranks tokens, distributes an exact removal budget over depth, and sets the recovery scale for dense features. At a final keep rate of $ρ=0.5$, our jointly adapted model, TAP-J, reaches $47.0$ mIoU at $1.30\times$ encoder throughput on ADE20K and $53.7$ box AP at $1.32\times$ encoder throughput on COCO while remaining competitive on ImageNet-1K.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究预训练 Vision Transformer 在不同下游任务（图像分类、语义分割、目标检测）中 token 剪枝策略的可迁移性。通过冻结无剪枝检查点并在单一层进行无参数缩减准则的受控探针实验，作者发现分割与检测对剪枝准则的排序不同、分类对最早层的基于注意力的剪枝特别敏感，且密集任务偏好相反的恢复端点。基于这些发现提出 Task-Adaptive Pruning (TAP)，为每个任务引入一个任务寄存器（task register）来对 token 排序、按深度分配精确的移除预算并设置密集特征的恢复尺度，联合适配版本 TAP-J 在 ADE20K 和 COCO 上以 1.30×/1.32× 编码器吞吐达到 47.0 mIoU 和 53.7 box AP，同时保持 ImageNet-1K 竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 token 剪枝策略通常针对单一识别管道设计，但预训练 Vision Transformer 会被复用于空间需求不同的多种任务，关于剪枝策略中哪些部分可以跨任务迁移的问题尚未被系统回答。
Method: 首先对分类、分割、检测三种管道进行受控探针实验：冻结无剪枝检查点，在单个可剪枝层上应用一系列无参数缩减准则且不重训练，以识别跨任务差异。随后提出 TAP，用每个任务一个的任务寄存器替代现有任务无关的寄存器 token，激活当前任务的寄存器，由其演化状态完成 token 排序、深度维度的精确移除预算分配和密集特征恢复尺度设定。
Result: 在保持率 ρ=0.5 下，联合适配模型 TAP-J 在 ADE20K 上达到 47.0 mIoU 且编码器吞吐提升 1.30×，在 COCO 上达到 53.7 box AP 且编码器吞吐提升 1.32×，同时在 ImageNet-1K 上保持竞争力。
Conclusion: 论文主张剪枝策略的跨任务迁移存在结构性差异，任务级自适应而非单一策略更适用于多任务复用场景；摘要未给出在极端低保持率下的行为或更多任务泛化的讨论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 首先对分类、分割、检测三种管道进行受控探针实验：冻结无剪枝检查点，在单个可剪枝层上应用一系列无参数缩减准则且不重训练，以识别跨任务差异。随后提出 TAP，用每个任务一个的任务寄存器替代现有任务无关的寄存器 token，激活当前任务的寄存器，由其演化状态完成 token 排序、深度维度的精确移除预算分配和密集特征恢复尺度设定。
summary_sections.result: 在保持率 ρ=0.5 下，联合适配模型 TAP-J 在 ADE20K 上达到 47.0 mIoU 且编码器吞吐提升 1.30×，在 COCO 上达到 53.7 box AP 且编码器吞吐提升 1.32×，同时在 ImageNet-1K 上保持竞争力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 论文主张剪枝策略的跨任务迁移存在结构性差异，任务级自适应而非单一策略更适用于多任务复用场景；摘要未给出在极端低保持率下的行为或更多任务泛化的讨论。

papers.title: PEAK: Precise and Persistent Concept Erasure via k-Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Erasing concepts from large-scale text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models has become increasingly crucial due to the growing concerns over copyright infringement, privacy violations, and offensive content. Existing approaches struggle to achieve both precise and persistent concept erasure: inaccurate localization of concept-related representations may cause unintended semantic interference, while incomplete removal of the underlying concept knowledge allows adversarial recovery. To address this dilemma, we propose PEAK, a \textbf{\textit{precise}} and \textbf{\textit{persistent}} concept erasure framework via k-Sparse Autoencoders (kSAEs). PEAK first trains a kSAE on internal activations of the diffusion denoising network to decompose dense representations into interpretable sparse features. By contrasting sparse activations induced by target and non-target prompts, PEAK identifies a compact set of target-specific features according to both activation strength and frequency. These localized features are then used for parameter optimization, where PEAK selectively suppresses target-related activations while preserving complementary non-target ones towards the original model. This feature-guided optimization embeds concept erasure directly into diffusion parameters, eliminating the need for additional inference-time intervention and facilitating effective persistence against adversarial attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PEAK achieves effective and robust concept erasure. On the I2P benchmark, PEAK reduces NudeNet detections from 582 to 6, lowers the average attack success rate (ASR) from 96.52\% to 5.63\%, and preserves general generation quality on MS-COCO with a near-zero KID. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/manmanTAT/PEAK
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PEAK，一个基于 k-Sparse Autoencoders (kSAE) 的文本到图像扩散模型概念擦除框架，旨在同时实现精确且持久的概念移除。方法先训练 kSAE 将去噪网络的内部激活分解为可解释的稀疏特征，再通过目标与非目标提示的对比定位目标特定特征，并利用这些特征进行参数优化，将擦除直接嵌入模型参数。实验显示在 I2P 基准上将 NudeNet 检测从 582 降至 6，平均攻击成功率从 96.52% 降至 5.63%，并在 MS-COCO 上保持近零 KID。
Motivation: 现有概念擦除方法难以兼顾精确性和持久性：对概念相关表征的定位不准确会导致非目标语义干扰，而底层概念知识移除不完整又使对抗性恢复成为可能。
Method: PEAK 首先在扩散去噪网络的内部激活上训练 kSAE，将密集表征分解为稀疏可解释特征；通过对比目标与非目标提示诱发的稀疏激活，依据激活强度与频率筛选出紧凑的目标特定特征集。随后基于这些特征进行参数优化，选择性抑制目标相关激活并保留互补的非目标激活，使擦除效应固化在扩散模型参数中，无需推理期额外干预。
Result: 在 I2P 基准上，PEAK 将 NudeNet 检测数量从 582 降到 6；在对抗攻击下平均攻击成功率从 96.52% 降至 5.63%；在 MS-COCO 上生成质量保持良好，KID 接近零。
Conclusion: 作者总结 PEAK 实现了有效且鲁棒的概念擦除，将概念擦除嵌入参数避免了推理时干预，并有助于抵御对抗性恢复；代码与模型已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TimeRoute: Time-Aware Modality Routing and Diffusion for Multi-Modal Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal recommenders fuse collaborative signals with item modalities such as text, images, and audio, but the usefulness of each drifts over time and at different rates. For example, chocolate purchases typically guided by textual ingredient cues can shift toward visual packaging and ambient audio around Valentine's Day. This modality time-scale mismatch gives rise to two coupled challenges: (1) users require different modality proportions across temporal contexts, and (2) less relevant modalities are more likely to introduce outdated or misleading signals into the recommender. We address both challenges within a unified diffusion-based recommender, TimeRoute. A temporal-aware modal router maps each user's aggregated behavioral features to a personalized modality distribution, replacing the globally shared fusion weights used in prior work. The diffusion-based graph reconstructor is then conditioned on the same temporal profile through Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) with dual-stream long- and short-term denoising heads, suppressing outdated modality edges before they enter the propagation graph. Experiments on TikTok, Amazon-Baby, and Amazon-Sports demonstrate consistent improvements of up to 9.8\% in Recall@K, Precision@K, and NDCG@K over strong baselines across 10-seed paired tests. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TimeRoute.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出统一扩散框架的时序感知多模态推荐模型 TimeRoute，针对不同模态在时间尺度上漂移速率不一致的问题，用时序感知模态路由器（temporal-aware modal router）替代全局共享融合权重，并让扩散图重构器（diffusion-based graph reconstructor）通过 FiLM 条件化同一时序画像，配合长短双流去噪头抑制过时模态边进入传播图。摘要报告在 TikTok、Amazon-Baby、Amazon-Sports 数据集上相较强基线在 Recall@K、Precision@K、NDCG@K 上稳定提升最高 9.8%，并基于 10 次随机种子配对检验。
Motivation: 多模态推荐中，各模态（文本、图像、音频）的有效性会随时间以不同速率漂移，例如情人节期间巧克力购买线索从文本成分转向视觉包装与环境音频；全局共享的融合权重无法捕捉这种模态时间尺度错配，且低相关模态更容易引入过时或误导信号。
Method: TimeRoute 包含两个核心组件：一是将用户聚合行为特征映射为个性化模态分布的时序感知模态路由器；二是以同一时序画像为条件、采用 Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) 的扩散图重构器，并用长短期双流去噪头在传播图构建前抑制过时模态边。
Result: 在 TikTok、Amazon-Baby、Amazon-Sports 三个数据集上，与强基线进行 10 种子配对检验，Recall@K、Precision@K 和 NDCG@K 一致提升，最高达 9.8%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将模态路由与扩散重构统一在同一时序条件下，能够同时解决不同时序上下文中用户对模态比例的需求变化，以及低相关模态引入过时信号的问题。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ThinkAfford: Affordance-Centric Reasoning for Fine-Grained 3D Grounding in Cluttered Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Task-driven 3D affordance grounding aims to localize the functional region in a cluttered 3D scene that enables an action specified by a natural-language instruction. Existing methods either predict 3D masks directly or construct them by selecting and fusing intermediate 2D/3D regions. However, they remain vulnerable to two intertwined failure modes: the predicted or selected regions may miss the target interaction area or have unsuitable granularity, while language grounding may confuse visually similar alternatives under relational instructions. To this end, we introduce ThinkAfford, which decouples high-recall affordance proposal generation from instruction-grounded reasoning. Specifically, the Affordance Proposal Generation module first uses learnable affordance prompts and multi-level visual features to predict interaction-conditioned heatmaps, extracting a variable number of fine-grained proposals without parsed object or part names as segmentation prompts. Visual-Prompted Affordance Reasoning then reasons over labeled proposal overlays using the full instruction, returning identifiers in a structured "think-then-answer" response. Moreover, Group Relative Policy Optimization uses proposal-level rewards from lifted 3D overlap to align VPAR selection with final 3D grounding. On the SceneFun3D validation split, ThinkAfford achieves 10.69% AP50 and 25.46% AP25 under the official evaluator, outperforming comparable 3D open-vocabulary and vision-language-model-based 2D-to-3D baselines. Module-level diagnostics further show that APG attains 77.5% recall at 25% intersection-over-union, while GRPO-trained VPAR achieves 72.1% selection accuracy on APG-covered queries, compared with 63.4% under supervised fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对杂乱3D场景中的任务驱动细粒度功能区域定位（affordance grounding）提出ThinkAfford，将高召回率的功能提议生成与基于指令的视觉提示推理解耦。Affordance Proposal Generation模块用可学习提示和多层视觉特征生成交互条件热图与候选提议，Visual-Prompted Affordance Reasoning模块按完整指令对提议叠加图做结构化“think-then-answer”推理。在SceneFun3D验证集上，ThinkAfford在官方评估下取得10.69% AP50和25.46% AP25，优于3D开放词汇和基于VLM的2D-3D基线。
Motivation: 现有方法直接预测3D掩码或通过选择、融合中间2D/3D区域来构建结果，但面对两个相互交织的失效模式：预测或选择的区域可能漏掉目标交互区或粒度不适配，且语言接地在关系型指令下容易混淆视觉相似的候选对象。
Method: 提出两个解耦模块：Affordance Proposal Generation（APG）使用可学习功能提示和多层视觉特征预测交互条件热图，无需类别或部件名作为分割提示即可提取可变数量的细粒度提议；Visual-Prompted Affordance Reasoning（VPAR）基于标注的提议叠加图和完整指令进行推理，输出结构化标识符。训练上采用Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO），以提升后的3D重叠度构造提议级奖励，使VPAR的选择与最终3D定位对齐。
Result: 在SceneFun3D验证集上，ThinkAfford以官方评估器达到10.69% AP50和25.46% AP25，优于可比的3D开放词汇与基于视觉语言模型的2D-3D基线。模块诊断显示APG在25% IoU下召回率为77.5%；经GRPO训练的VPAR在APG覆盖的查询上选择准确率为72.1%，高于有监督微调的63.4%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将高召回率提议生成与基于完整指令的“think-then-answer”推理解耦，并用GRPO做提议级对齐，能缓解杂乱场景中粒度不适配和关系指令下的视觉混淆问题。
Relevance: 1

papers.title: A Dataset and Benchmark for Optical Music Recognition of String Quartet Scores
papers.abstract_en: Optical music recognition (OMR) transcribes music scores into digital formats. While the field has advanced significantly on monophonic and piano-form scores, multi-part score transcription remains underexplored, largely due to the absence of a suitable dataset. We introduce OpenScore String Quartet for Optical Music Recognition (OSSQ-OMR), the first dataset dedicated to multi-part OMR. Built on the OpenScore String Quartet corpus, OSSQ-OMR pairs digitally encoded scores with their original scanned editions from IMSLP, with all images visually aligned to their transcriptions. The dataset is released with score images at system and staff levels, and paired transcriptions in three encoding formats: Extended Linearized MusicXML (LMXE), **kern, and ABC. In total, OSSQ-OMR contains 24,544 system images and 98,172 staff images drawn from 116 string quartet scores. We accompany the dataset with a benchmark protocol and baseline results from two representative OMR models, evaluated across four random score-level splits with mutually exclusive test sets. Baselines reach OMR-NED as low as 3.6% on synthetic and 5.9% on scanned inputs; results reveal substantial effects of encoding and segmentation choices, with the LSTM-based baseline degrading on scanned inputs roughly 2.6 times less than the Transformer-based baseline.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the ISMIR 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 OSSQ-OMR，这是第一个面向多声部光学音乐识别 (OMR) 的数据集与基准。数据集基于 OpenScore String Quartet 语料，将数字编码乐谱与 IMSLP 上的原始扫描版本配对并做视觉对齐，提供 system 与 staff 级别的图像以及 LMXE、**kern、ABC 三种转写格式，共 116 首弦乐四重奏、24,544 张 system 图像和 98,172 张 staff 图像。作者还给出基准协议和两种代表性 OMR 模型的基线结果，并分析了编码与切分选择对性能的影响。
Motivation: OMR 在单声部与钢琴乐谱上已有显著进展，但多声部乐谱转写由于缺乏合适数据集而研究不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 构建 OSSQ-OMR 数据集，将编码乐谱与扫描图像对齐，按 system 和 staff 级别发布图像并配套三种编码格式的转写；同时设计基准协议，以四个随机 score-level 划分（测试集互斥）评估两个代表性 OMR 模型。
Result: 基线在合成输入上最低达到 OMR-NED 3.6%，在扫描输入上达到 5.9%；结果显示编码与切分选择影响显著，且 LSTM 基线在扫描输入上的退化程度约为 Transformer 基线的 1/2.6（即退化少约 2.6 倍）。
Conclusion: 作者认为该数据集与基准可用于推动多声部 OMR 研究，并指出编码格式和切分策略是影响性能的重要因素，同时不同模型架构对扫描输入的鲁棒性存在明显差异。
