summary_sections.tldr: 本文介绍 OSSQ-OMR，这是第一个面向多声部光学音乐识别 (OMR) 的数据集与基准。数据集基于 OpenScore String Quartet 语料，将数字编码乐谱与 IMSLP 上的原始扫描版本配对并做视觉对齐，提供 system 与 staff 级别的图像以及 LMXE、**kern、ABC 三种转写格式，共 116 首弦乐四重奏、24,544 张 system 图像和 98,172 张 staff 图像。作者还给出基准协议和两种代表性 OMR 模型的基线结果，并分析了编码与切分选择对性能的影响。
summary_sections.motivation: OMR 在单声部与钢琴乐谱上已有显著进展，但多声部乐谱转写由于缺乏合适数据集而研究不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
summary_sections.method: 构建 OSSQ-OMR 数据集，将编码乐谱与扫描图像对齐，按 system 和 staff 级别发布图像并配套三种编码格式的转写；同时设计基准协议，以四个随机 score-level 划分（测试集互斥）评估两个代表性 OMR 模型。
summary_sections.result: 基线在合成输入上最低达到 OMR-NED 3.6%，在扫描输入上达到 5.9%；结果显示编码与切分选择影响显著，且 LSTM 基线在扫描输入上的退化程度约为 Transformer 基线的 1/2.6（即退化少约 2.6 倍）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该数据集与基准可用于推动多声部 OMR 研究，并指出编码格式和切分策略是影响性能的重要因素，同时不同模型架构对扫描输入的鲁棒性存在明显差异。

papers.title: XCoT-VLA: Executable Chain-of-Thought for Vision-Language-Action Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models can connect scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and trajectory generation for autonomous driving. However, verbose natural-language Chain-of-Thought (CoT) is poorly suited to real-time control because it is open-ended, costly to decode, and difficult to optimize as an action-facing representation. We propose XCoT-VLA, which replaces descriptive rationales with compact executable CoT tokens learned from automatically constructed Reason-Action supervision. Logged trajectories provide action evidence, while scene context supplies causal semantics. The predicted XCoT sequence remains in context and conditions fixed trajectory queries through shared multimodal self-attention. Deterministic token-function routing applies the Reason FFN to XCoT tokens and the Control FFN to trajectory queries for flow-matching trajectory generation. We further introduce XCoT Policy Optimization (XCPO) as an optional refinement extension in the same executable token space. XCoT-VLA reduces longitudinal ADE from 1.645 to 1.323 on a general-distribution set and lateral FDE from 1.616 to 0.648 in lane-change scenarios. By representing driving-oriented reasoning with only 2-6 executable XCoT tokens, our method substantially reduces autoregressive reasoning overhead and remains within the real-time planning budget. These results demonstrate that driving-oriented reasoning can be compact, executable, and directly connected to trajectory generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 XCoT-VLA，一种面向自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，用紧凑可执行的链式思维（executable Chain-of-Thought, XCoT）token 替代冗长的自然语言推理。模型从自动构建的 Reason-Action 监督中学习 XCoT 序列，并通过共享多模态自注意力与固定轨迹查询交互，使用确定性 token-函数路由将 Reason FFN 用于 XCoT token、Control FFN 用于轨迹查询，实现 flow-matching 轨迹生成。摘要报告 XCoT-VLA 在通用分布集上把纵向 ADE 从 1.645 降到 1.323，在变道场景中把横向 FDE 从 1.616 降到 0.648，且只需 2-6 个 token 即可在实时规划预算内完成推理。
Motivation: 自然语言链式思维（CoT）在自动驾驶的实时控制场景中不适用，因为其开放性强、解码代价高，且难以作为面向动作的表示进行优化。
Method: 用自动构建的 Reason-Action 监督学习紧凑的可执行 CoT token；预测的 XCoT 序列保持在上下文内，通过共享多模态自注意力条件化固定轨迹查询；利用确定性 token-函数路由将 Reason FFN 与 Control FFN 分别应用于 XCoT token 和轨迹查询，并用 flow-matching 生成轨迹；另提出 XCoT Policy Optimization (XCPO) 作为可选优化扩展。
Result: 在通用分布集上纵向 ADE 从 1.645 降至 1.323，在变道场景中横向 FDE 从 1.616 降至 0.648，且仅用 2-6 个可执行 XCoT token 显著降低自回归推理开销并保持实时规划预算。
Conclusion: 摘要强调驾驶导向的推理可以做到紧凑、可执行，并直接连接到轨迹生成；XCPO 是在同一可执行 token 空间中的可选精化扩展。

papers.title: ReLTEx: Reliable LLM-based Taxonomy Expansion
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating semantically relevant concepts and relations, making them promising tools for taxonomy enrichment. However, directly relying on LLM-generated expansions often leads to noisy, redundant, or hierarchically inconsistent structures, limiting their reliability for automated taxonomy expansion. In this paper, we present ReLTEx, a framework for reliable LLM-based taxonomy expansion. ReLTEx combines LLM-driven candidate generation with structure-aware validation and recursive expansion control to improve the consistency and quality of generated taxonomies by reducing hallucinations. We evaluate the proposed framework using benchmark taxonomies under a masked taxonomy expansion setting and compare multiple validation strategies. Experimental results, supported by both adapted evaluation metrics and human evaluation, demonstrate that ReLTEx produces more reliable and semantically coherent taxonomy expansions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReLTEx，一个面向可靠的基于 LLM 的分类法扩展 (taxonomy expansion) 框架，将 LLM 驱动的候选生成与结构感知验证 (structure-aware validation) 和递归扩展控制 (recursive expansion control) 相结合，以减少幻觉并提升生成分类法的一致性和质量。作者在掩码分类法扩展 (masked taxonomy expansion) 设定下使用基准分类法评估，并比较多种验证策略；改编的评估指标与人工评估均表明 ReLTEx 产生更可靠且语义连贯的分类法扩展。
Motivation: 直接依赖 LLM 生成的分类法扩展常常包含噪声、冗余或层级结构不一致的内容，限制了自动分类法扩展的可靠性。
Method: ReLTEx 将 LLM 驱动的候选生成、结构感知验证和递归扩展控制组合成一个框架，旨在降低幻觉并改善生成分类法的一致性与质量。
Result: 在掩码分类法扩展设定下基于基准分类法进行评估，并对比多种验证策略；结合改编的评估指标和人工评估，结果显示 ReLTEx 能产生更可靠、语义更连贯的分类法扩展。
Conclusion: 作者强调结构感知验证与递归扩展控制的结合可提升 LLM 分类法扩展的可靠性，摘要未报告具体数值或局限讨论。

papers.title: GARLIC: Graph Attention-based Relational Learning of Multivariate Time Series in Intensive Care
papers.abstract_en: Healthcare data, such as Intensive Care Unit (ICU) records, comprise heterogeneous multivariate time series sampled at irregular intervals with pervasive missingness. However, clinical applications demand predictive models that are both accurate and interpretable. We present our Graph Attention-based Relational Learning for Intensive Care (GARLIC) model, a novel neural network architecture that imputes missing data through a learnable exponential-decay encoder, captures inter-sensor dependencies via time-lagged summary graphs, and fuses global patterns with cross-dimensional sequential attention. All attention weights and graph edges are learned end-to-end to serve as built-in observation-, signal-, and edge-level explanations. To reconcile auxiliary reconstruction and primary classification objectives, we developed an alternating decoupled optimization scheme that stabilizes training. On three ICU benchmarks (PhysioNet 2012 & 2019, MIMIC-III), GARLIC sets the new state of the art in outcome prediction, significantly improving AUROC and AUPRC over best-performing baselines at comparable computational cost. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each module, and feature-removal trials validate the fidelity of importance attribution through a monotonic performance drop (full > top 50% > random 50% > bottom 50%). Real-time case studies demonstrate actionable risk warnings with transparent explanations, marking a significant advance toward accurate, explainable deep learning for irregularly sampled ICU time series data. Moreover, we demonstrated \proposed{}'s superiority in data imputation and classification on various time-series datasets beyond the ICU domain, showing its generalizability and applicability to broader tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GARLIC，一个面向 ICU 不规则采样多变量时间序列的图注意力神经网络，通过可学习的指数衰减编码器处理缺失数据，用时间滞后摘要图刻画传感器间依赖，并以跨维序贯注意力融合全局模式。在 PhysioNet 2012/2019 与 MIMIC-III 上，GARLIC 在结局预测上取得新的最优结果，同时提供观察级、信号级和边级的可解释性。
Motivation: ICU 等医疗数据是采样不规则、普遍缺失的异质多变量时间序列，而临床应用既要求预测准确又要求模型可解释，现有方法难以同时满足这两个目标。
Method: 提出 GARLIC 架构：用可学习指数衰减编码器进行缺失数据插补，通过时间滞后摘要图（time-lagged summary graphs）建模传感器间依赖，并用跨维度序贯注意力融合全局模式；所有注意力权重和图边端到端学习，作为内建的解释机制。为协调辅助重建与主分类目标，开发了交替解耦优化方案以稳定训练。
Result: 在三个 ICU 基准（PhysioNet 2012/2019、MIMIC-III）上，GARLIC 以相当的算力成本显著提升 AUROC 和 AUPRC，超过最强基线；消融实验验证各模块贡献，特征移除实验显示重要性归因保真度呈单调下降（full > top 50% > random 50% > bottom 50%），并在 ICU 之外的多种时间序列数据集上展示插补与分类的泛化优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GARLIC 朝着精确、可解释的不规则采样 ICU 时间序列深度学习迈出重要一步，并演示了实时风险预警和透明解释；其泛化性说明该方法可适用于更广泛的时间序列任务。

papers.title: CARE: Confidence-Aware Reasoning for Reliable Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) has enabled medical Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to produce Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning for visual question answering, yet these models suffer from $\textit{confidence miscalibration}$---a systematic gap between expressed certainty and actual diagnostic accuracy that undermines clinical trust. We propose $\textbf{CARE}$, a $\textbf{C}$onfidence-$\textbf{A}$ware medical $\textbf{RE}$asoning framework that jointly optimizes accuracy and calibration through a dual-stage pipeline. First, a scalable Medical-CoT synthesis provides structured cold-start data for Supervised Fine-Tuning. Second, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a novel $\textbf{Confidence-Aware Reward (CAR)}$ mechanism ties the model's confidence to diagnostic correctness within the reward signal. Across three Medical VQA benchmarks, $\textbf{CARE}$ achieves the highest diagnostic accuracy while obtaining the lowest Expected Calibration Error and Hallucination Rate, establishing a foundation for trustworthy clinical decision support. Our code is available at https://github.com/anotherbricki/CARE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CARE（Confidence-Aware medical REasoning），一个面向医学视觉问答 (Medical VQA) 的置信度感知推理框架，通过双阶段流程联合优化诊断准确率与置信度校准。首先用可扩展的 Medical-CoT 合成为监督微调提供结构化冷启动数据，再用带新型置信度感知奖励 (CAR) 的 GRPO 将模型置信度与诊断正确性绑定到奖励信号中。在三个 Medical VQA 基准上，CARE 取得最高诊断准确率，同时获得最低的期望校准误差 (ECE) 和幻觉率。
Motivation: 医学多模态大语言模型经强化微调 (RFT) 后虽能生成思维链 (CoT) 推理，但存在置信度校准失配 (confidence miscalibration)，即表达出的确定性与真实诊断准确率之间有系统性差距，损害临床可信度。
Method: 采用双阶段流程：第一阶段通过可扩展的 Medical-CoT 合成构造结构化冷启动数据用于监督微调 (SFT)；第二阶段使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)，并在奖励信号中引入置信度感知奖励 (CAR) 机制，将模型置信度与诊断正确性绑定。
Result: 在三个 Medical VQA 基准上，CARE 达到最高诊断准确率，同时取得最低的期望校准误差 (Expected Calibration Error) 与最低幻觉率 (Hallucination Rate)。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CARE 为可信的临床决策支持建立了基础，并公开了代码。

papers.title: Once Poisoned, Arbitrarily Controlled: A Programmable Backdoor in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Existing vision-language model (VLM) backdoors are usually treated as static vulnerabilities: one-to-one and N-to-N attacks bind one or more triggers to a finite set of targets before victim training. This assumption substantially underestimates the threat. We show that a single poisoning phase can implant a programmable backdoor into a VLM, allowing an attacker to choose previously unseen target-caption semantics at inference time and synthesize corresponding stealthy triggers on demand. Unlike fixed-mapping attacks, the proposed any-to-any caption-control paradigm decouples post-training target selection from poisoning, enabling dynamic control of target captions without retraining the VLM. Our method has two components. First, a heuristic poisoning strategy exposes the model to diverse trigger-caption pairs, encouraging it to learn a general trigger-as-instruction rule rather than memorize a specific backdoor pattern. Second, a feature-space trigger steganography method maps any attacker-specified target caption to a stealthy visual trigger, implemented as either a norm-controlled perturbation or a non-semantic patch. Once inserted into arbitrary images, these triggers cause the poisoned VLM to generate outputs semantically aligned with the chosen target caption, even when the target was unseen during poisoning. Extensive experiments show that our attack achieves high any-to-any caption-control success rates, preserves clean model utility, and remains effective under several classical backdoor defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对视觉语言模型（VLM）的可编程后门攻击：通过单一投毒阶段，攻击者可以在推理时选择训练期间从未见过的目标字幕语义，并按需合成对应的隐蔽触发器。方法包含启发式投毒策略与特征空间触发器隐写，宣称实现任意到任意（any-to-any）字幕控制，并在保持模型清洁效用的同时绕过多种经典后门防御。
Motivation: 现有VLM后门通常被当作静态漏洞，即一对一或N对N映射，只能在训练前绑定有限的目标集合，低估了实际威胁。作者旨在证明单一投毒阶段即可植入可编程后门，使推理时的目标选择与投毒解耦，无需重训练便能动态控制目标字幕。
Method: 方法由两部分组成：一是启发式投毒策略，用多样的触发器-字幕对暴露模型，促使其学习通用的“触发器即指令”规则而非记忆特定后门模式；二是特征空间触发器隐写，把任意指定的目标字幕映射为隐蔽视觉触发器，实现为范数受控扰动或非语义补丁，插入任意图像后使模型输出与目标字幕语义对齐。
Result: 大量实验表明攻击在任意到任意字幕控制任务上取得高成功率，并能保持干净模型效用；在多种经典后门防御下依然有效。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作将后门威胁从静态固定映射扩展为推理时可动态控制的范式，并暗示现有防御难以应对这种可编程后门攻击。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evidence-Grounded Trustworthy Multimodal Reasoning and Evaluation Benchmark in Complex Urban Scenes
papers.abstract_en: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate impressive performance in benign scenarios, their cognitive reliability deteriorates significantly in complex scenes under adverse conditions. In these settings, models often rely on implicit inference without sufficient visual evidence, leading to a disconnect between perception and reasoning. Meanwhile, existing outcome-oriented benchmarks evaluate only final predictions and fail to diagnose failures in the underlying reasoning process. To address this gap, the authors propose AD2-Bench, which introduces a Hierarchical Visual Diagnosis framework that decomposes reasoning into a structured Chain of Evidence (CoE). This fine-grained diagnosis reveals that robust multimodal reasoning fundamentally depends on accurate evidence acquisition. Building on this perspective, the authors formulate reasoning from a probabilistic viewpoint and identify two primary causes of reasoning failure: Spatial Ambiguity, where models fail to distinguish target objects from background clutter, resulting in localization errors; and Semantic Uncertainty, where degraded visual features lead to incorrect semantic interpretation, resulting in understanding errors. To overcome these evidence deficiencies, they further propose Evidence-grounded Visual Reasoning (EGVOR), which replaces implicit reasoning with the explicit generation of Evidence Atoms - structured spatial-semantic triplets that enforce tight alignment between localization and semantic understanding. The model is trained through a hierarchical curriculum that progresses from reflective supervision construction to reinforcement learning, where reducing reasoning variance is explicitly rewarded. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EGVOR substantially improves reasoning stability under adverse conditions, providing a more robust framework for trustworthy multimodal cognition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在复杂城市场景、不利条件下认知可靠性下降的问题，提出 AD2-Bench 基准与 Hierarchical Visual Diagnosis 框架，将推理分解为结构化的 Chain of Evidence (CoE) 以诊断推理失败原因。基于概率视角，作者将失败归因于 Spatial Ambiguity 与 Semantic Uncertainty 两类证据缺陷，并进一步提出 Evidence-grounded Visual Reasoning (EGVOR) 模型，通过显式生成结构化的空间-语义三元组 Evidence Atoms 来强制对齐定位与语义理解。实验表明 EGVOR 在不利条件下显著提升了推理稳定性。
Motivation: 现有 MLLMs 在良性场景表现良好，但在复杂场景和不利条件下依赖缺乏充分视觉证据的隐式推理，导致感知与推理脱节；同时现有面向结果的基准只评估最终预测，无法诊断推理过程中的失败。
Method: 提出 AD2-Bench 基准，引入 Hierarchical Visual Diagnosis 框架将推理分解为 Chain of Evidence (CoE)，并据此提出 EGVOR 模型，用显式的 Evidence Atoms（空间-语义三元组）替代隐式推理，通过从反思性监督构建到强化学习的层级课程训练，显式奖励推理方差的降低。
Result: 摘要报告大量实验表明 EGVOR 在不利条件下显著提升推理稳定性，为可信多模态认知提供了更稳健的框架。
Conclusion: 作者的细粒度诊断表明，稳健的多模态推理根本上依赖于准确的证据获取；EGVOR 通过强制证据与推理的紧密对齐来缓解空间模糊和语义不确定性问题。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Multiple Scale Latents for Learned Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Most learned image compression systems rely on a single latent representation combined with a hyperprior, which limits their ability to efficiently capture image structure across spatial scales. In this work, we propose a hierarchical latent representation to improve the efficiency of the entropy model. By using multiple latents at different scales, each with its own entropy model, we better capture the spatial structure of the latent representation. Our experiments show that this approach achieves a 17.9% BD-rate reduction over VVC on Kodak, demonstrating the effectiveness of multi-scale latent representations. Furthermore, the approach is orthogonal to other advances in learned image compression, making it a versatile addition to existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于学习型图像压缩的多尺度潜变量（multi-scale latent）层次表示，每个尺度配备独立的熵模型，以更有效地捕捉潜变量的空间结构。实验在 Kodak 上相比 VVC 实现 17.9% 的 BD-rate 降低，且该方法与现有学习压缩进展正交，可作为通用增强模块。
Motivation: 大多数学习型图像压缩系统依赖单一潜变量加超先验（hyperprior），难以高效捕获跨空间尺度的图像结构，限制了熵模型的效率。
Method: 提出层次化潜变量表示，使用多个不同尺度的潜变量，每个潜变量配有各自的熵模型，从而在不同空间尺度上更好地建模潜变量结构。
Result: 在 Kodak 数据集上相比 VVC 实现 17.9% 的 BD-rate 降低，验证了多尺度潜表示的有效性。
Conclusion: 该方法与已有学习图像压缩方法正交，适合作为通用组件接入现有系统。

papers.title: StreamFlow: Dynamic Memory Flows for Streaming Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to preserve relevant evidence from continuously evolving streams under strict causality and bounded memory. Yet existing paradigms remain limited: model-based methods require intrusive backbone updates, while memory-based methods expend substantial visual-encoding computation on temporally redundant content and rely on rigid access to visual history. To address these limitations, we introduce StreamFlow, an efficient visual memory framework that enables dynamic, on-demand access to historical visual information. StreamFlow combines a lightweight, dynamics-aware mid-term memory that filters temporal redundancy before visual encoding with a latent long-term memory that consolidates historical video content into visual latents accessible to subsequent reasoning. During generation, an attention-guided retrieval mechanism injects relevant visual latents when the model's reliance on visual evidence weakens. StreamFlow achieves state-of-the-art streaming video understanding performance, reaching 67.73% overall accuracy on StreamingBench, while also delivering strong performance on offline long-video benchmarks. Relative to the vanilla setting, it improves the visual attention score (VAS) by 59.1% while reducing end-to-end latency and peak memory by 50.4% and 21.1%, respectively, enabling more visually grounded and efficient reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 StreamFlow，一个面向流式视频理解的高效视觉记忆框架，解决多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 在严格因果和有限记忆约束下对历史视觉证据的动态访问问题。框架结合轻量、动态感知的中期记忆在视觉编码前过滤时间冗余，以及压缩历史视频内容为视觉潜变量的潜在长期记忆；生成时通过注意力引导的检索机制在模型对视觉证据依赖减弱时注入相关潜变量。在 StreamingBench 上达到 67.73% 总体准确率，并同时提升视觉注意力分数、降低延迟和峰值内存。
Motivation: 现有流式视频理解方法要么需要侵入式修改骨干网络，要么在时间冗余内容上浪费大量视觉编码计算，且对历史视觉信息的访问固定僵化；在严格因果与有限记忆约束下，如何按需访问相关历史视觉证据仍未得到有效解决。
Method: 提出 StreamFlow 视觉记忆框架，包含轻量级动态感知的中期记忆 (mid-term memory) 在视觉编码前过滤时间冗余，以及潜在长期记忆 (latent long-term memory) 将历史视频内容整合为可供后续推理访问的视觉潜变量。生成阶段使用注意力引导的检索机制，在模型对视觉证据依赖减弱时注入相关视觉潜变量。
Result: 在 StreamingBench 上取得 67.73% 总体准确率的流式视频理解最优结果，并在离线长视频基准上表现强劲。相对 vanilla 设置，视觉注意力分数 (VAS) 提升 59.1%，端到端延迟降低 50.4%，峰值内存降低 21.1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过动态、按需的视觉记忆访问代替刚性历史读取，可以在流式视频理解中同时改善视觉 grounding 与推理效率；StreamFlow 在流式和离线长视频任务上均验证了该思路的有效性。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Mixture-of-Experts-based Entropy Model for Learned Image Compression
papers.abstract_en: Learned image compression has seen significant progress in recent years with the development of end-to-end learned models that achieve better compression efficiency than state-of-the-art conventional methods. Recently, Mixture of Experts (MoE) approaches have seen promising results in NLP and computer vision tasks. In this paper, we introduce the MoE approach to learned image compression. We propose a MoE-based Entropy model (MoEE) for learned image compression, allowing the model to selectively activate only the subset of parameters required for the input image. Our model achieves a BD-Rate improvement over VVC of -16.85% on the Kodak dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将混合专家模型 (Mixture of Experts, MoE) 引入学习图像压缩任务，提出基于 MoE 的熵模型 MoEE，让模型只激活输入图像所需的部分参数。作者报告在 Kodak 数据集上相对 VVC 取得 -16.85% 的 BD-Rate 改进，表明 MoE 能提升学习图像压缩的率失真性能。
Motivation: 学习图像压缩已取得优于传统方法的性能，MoE 在 NLP 和计算机视觉任务中展现出优势，但尚未被用于图像压缩；作者旨在探索 MoE 在该任务中的潜力。
Method: 提出 MoE-based 熵模型 (Mixture-of-Experts-based Entropy model, MoEE)，通过稀疏激活机制使模型根据输入图像选择性激活参数子集，以降低计算开销并提升压缩效率。
Result: 在 Kodak 数据集上相对 VVC 实现 -16.85% 的 BD-Rate 改进。
Conclusion: 摘要表明将 MoE 引入熵模型可以有效改善学习图像压缩的效率，但其适用场景与局限未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Physics-informed Diffusion Generative Model for Time-Series Data Synthesis in Dynamic Systems
papers.abstract_en: Industrial time-series signals, such as turbine temperature and rotational speed in aero-engines, are essential for monitoring the health and operational status of complex dynamical systems. However, collecting such data is often limited by harsh environments (e.g., high temperature and high pressure) and the high cost of experimental testing. To address this challenge, we introduce PhysDGM, a stepwise physics-embedded diffusion generative model for synthesizing time-series data that are consistent with the underlying physical laws of dynamical systems. PhysDGM embeds physical laws directly into each reverse diffusion step of the generative process, ensuring trajectory-level physical consistency, rather than enforcing constraints only at the final output. A large-scale AI-synthetic dataset (4.4 million samples, 20x scale-up) constructed by PhysDGM demonstrates strong fidelity across 34 datasets spanning turbofan engines, aero-engines, batteries, and chemical processes. After incorporating the synthetic data, the downstream task performance substantially surpassed that using real data alone by 48% for remaining useful life prediction, 15% for health indicator estimation, 22% for state-of-health assessment, and 20% for fault diagnosis. Moreover, it requires 10-20x less training data than existing approaches, substantially reducing the high cost of data collection in dynamical systems. We further demonstrate PhysDGM's potential in identifying early-stage faults in aero-engines by incorporating AI-synthesized data. In summary, PhysDGM provides a solid foundation for generating physically consistent industrial time-series, paving the way for expanding physics-guided AI into diverse data-scarce environments, including both industrial machinery and complex chemical reaction dynamics.
papers.comment: 27 pages; 5 main figures and 4 extended data figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysDGM，一种逐步嵌入物理规律的扩散生成模型，用于合成与动力系统物理规律一致的时间序列数据。摘要报告该模型在涡轮风扇发动机、航空发动机、电池和化工过程等 34 个数据集上构建了 440 万样本（20 倍扩展）的合成数据集，并将其用于下游任务，显著提升剩余使用寿命预测、健康指标估计、健康状态评估和故障诊断性能，同时将训练数据需求减少 10-20 倍。
Motivation: 工业时间序列信号（如航空发动机涡轮温度和转速）对监测复杂动力系统健康状态至关重要，但采集受恶劣环境和实验测试高成本限制，数据稀缺。现有方法难以保证生成数据在完整轨迹层面满足物理规律。
Method: PhysDGM 将物理定律直接嵌入生成过程的每个反向扩散步骤（reverse diffusion step），实现轨迹级物理一致性，而非仅在最终输出上施加约束。
Result: 摘要报告通过 PhysDGM 构建的大规模 AI 合成数据集（440 万样本，20 倍扩展）在 34 个数据集上表现出高保真度；加入合成数据后，剩余使用寿命预测提升 48%，健康指标估计提升 15%，健康状态评估提升 22%，故障诊断提升 20%，且训练数据需求比现有方法少 10-20 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 PhysDGM 为生成物理一致的工业时间序列提供了基础，可推广到工业机械和复杂化学反应动力学等数据稀缺场景，并展示了其在航空发动机早期故障识别中的潜力。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: A Cost-Efficient Routing Pipeline for Multilingual Short-Text Classification Using Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multilingual short-text classification supports operational systems such as content moderation, customer support routing, and intent recognition, yet aggregate evaluation often hides large differences between high-resource and low-resource languages. Uniform inference policies are simple to deploy, but they assume that all languages are equally well served. In this work, we evaluate a fixed-list routing strategy that keeps stronger languages on a direct multilingual path and selectively sends weaker languages through translation into English before zero-shot classification. The pipeline is fully self-hosted, uses pretrained compact sentence encoders, and requires no task-specific fine-tuning. We test the approach on two benchmarks chosen to differ in scale and label granularity: a 15-language subset of SIB-200 for seven-way topic classification and a 15-locale subset of MASSIVE for intent classification over an official 60-intent inventory. On SIB-200, the best overall configuration is R1, which translates only the low-resource tier: high-tier and mid-tier Macro-F1 remain unchanged, while low-tier Macro-F1 rises from 0.4632 to 0.6828. On the MASSIVE subset, the same low-tier intervention raises low-tier Macro-F1 from 0.2143 to 0.4417, but the best overall result is obtained by full translation, R3, at Macro-F1 0.4647. Across these two benchmarks, selective translation is a reliable intervention for weaker languages, whereas the optimal routing boundary depends on the task. We therefore report routing through tier-level quality gains and tier-level latency rather than a single global efficiency score.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 16th International Conference on Advanced Computer Information Technologies (ACIT 2026), https://acit.tech/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了一种固定列表路由策略用于多语言短文本分类：对较强语言走直接多语言路径，对较弱语言先翻译成英文再做零样本分类。流水线完全自托管，使用预训练紧凑句子编码器，无需任务特定微调。在SIB-200的15语言子集和MASSIVE的15区域子集上，选择性翻译能提升低资源语言层的Macro-F1，但最优路由边界因任务而异。
Motivation: 多语言短文本分类虽已用于内容审核、客服路由等系统，但统一推理策略假设所有语言都被同等服务，聚合评估掩盖了高资源与低资源语言之间的巨大差异。作者希望找到一种成本低廉且不依赖任务微调的方案来改善弱语言效果。
Method: 提出固定列表路由策略，将较强语言保留在直接多语言路径上，仅对较弱语言先翻译成英文再进行零样本分类；使用预训练紧凑句子编码器，支持完全自托管且无需任务特定微调，并报告分层（tier-level）质量增益与延迟而非单一全局效率分数。
Result: 在SIB-200子集上，仅翻译低资源层的最优配置R1将低层Macro-F1从0.4632提升到0.6828，高层和中层不变；在MASSIVE子集上，同一干预将低层Macro-F1从0.2143提升到0.4417，但最优整体结果是全量翻译R3，Macro-F1为0.4647。
Conclusion: 选择性翻译对较弱语言是可靠干预，但最优路由边界取决于任务；作者因此主张用分层质量增益和分层延迟来报告路由效果，而不是单一全局效率指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GS-CPE: Unified 6-Degree-of-Freedom Camera Pose Estimation via 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Despite substantial progress in visual localization, from scene coordinate regression to direct camera pose regression, achieving both robust generalization and high accuracy remain challenging. This study introduces GS-CPE (Gaussian Splatting based Camera Pose Estimation), a coarse-to-fine framework for 6-DoF camera pose estimation that unifies geometry-based coarse pose estimation with robust 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) warping based pose refinement. GS-CPE first estimates a coarse pose via retrieval-guided geometric pose estimation on a 3DGS scene representation, then refines it by minimizing a visibility aware masked RGB warping objective in a multi-scale optimization framework, with adaptive re-rendering. Extensive experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks including 7Scenes, Cambridge Landmarks, FAST-LIVO2 datasets, and a custom dataset demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, consistently outperforming in both accuracy and generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GS-CPE，一种基于 3D 高斯泼溅 (3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS) 的粗到细 6-DoF 相机位姿估计框架，先通过检索引导的几何方法在 3DGS 场景表示上估计粗位姿，再用可见性感知的掩蔽 RGB warping 目标在多尺度优化中细化，并支持自适应重渲染。在 7Scenes、Cambridge Landmarks、FAST-LIVO2 及自定义数据集上取得 state-of-the-art 性能，兼顾精度与泛化。
Motivation: 现有视觉定位方法（如场景坐标回归、直接相机位姿回归）难以同时实现鲁棒泛化与高精度，作者希望统一几何粗估计与基于 3DGS 的位姿细化来弥补这一缺口。
Method: 采用粗到细框架：粗阶段利用检索引导的几何位姿估计作用于 3DGS 场景表示；细阶段通过最小化可见性感知的掩蔽 RGB warping 目标，在多尺度优化框架中进行位姿细化，并引入自适应重渲染。
Result: 摘要报告在室内与室外基准（包括 7Scenes、Cambridge Landmarks、FAST-LIVO2 和自定义数据集）上均取得 state-of-the-art 结果，在精度和泛化两方面一致优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将几何粗位姿估计与 3DGS warping 位姿细化统一在同一框架中，可以同时提升位姿估计的精度与泛化能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Threshold Structure of Optimal Policies in Restart POMDPs
papers.abstract_en: We study a Restart POMDP (Partially Observable Markov Decision Process) on a general Borel state space, where the controller either lets the hidden state evolve unobserved or restarts the system and observes the new state. Exploiting a sufficient-statistic representation consisting of the last observed state and the elapsed time since restart, we reduce the problem to a fully observed MDP. Under a natural one-step cost deterioration condition, we prove that optimal policies have a threshold structure in the elapsed time for both the discounted and total undiscounted cost criteria. When the state space is partially ordered and the kernel is stochastically monotone, we further show that the optimal threshold is nonincreasing in the state. For the average cost criterion, under additional assumptions of geometric ergodicity and domination of the transient gain, we establish analogous threshold results via the vanishing discount approach, after showing the uniform boundedness of the optimal thresholds and relative value functions.
papers.comment: 8 pages, the paper has been accepted to IEEE CDC 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一般 Borel 状态空间上的 Restart POMDP（部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程）：控制器要么让隐藏状态无观测地演化，要么重启系统并观测新状态。利用由最近观测状态和重启以来经过时间组成的充分统计量，作者将问题化为完全可观测 MDP；在一步代价劣化条件下，证明折扣与总未折扣代价准则下最优策略在经历时间上具有阈值结构。进一步，若状态空间偏序且转移核随机单调，最优阈值关于状态非增；平均代价准则下通过消失折扣法得到类似阈值结果。
Motivation: Restart 型 POMDP 中最优策略的阈值结构缺少一般化的理论刻画，特别是在一般 Borel 状态空间和多种代价准则下的统一处理尚不充分。本文旨在证明这类问题中“何时重启”具有结构化阈值性质，并研究阈值与状态的单调关系。
Method: 以“最后观测状态 + 重启后经历时间”作为充分统计量，将部分可观测问题约化为完全可观测 MDP；在一步代价劣化条件下证明阈值结构，并利用状态空间的偏序结构与转移核的随机单调性分析阈值对状态的依赖；平均代价情形则借助几何遍历性、瞬态增益支配假设以及消失折扣方法处理。
Result: 摘要报告：在折扣代价与总未折扣代价准则下，最优策略关于经历时间具有阈值结构；当状态空间偏序且核随机单调时，最优阈值关于状态非增；在几何遍历与瞬态增益被支配等额外假设下，平均代价准则也得到类似的阈值结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调一步代价劣化、随机单调性等自然条件足以保证 Restart POMDP 最优策略的阈值结构，并且结果可推广至一般 Borel 状态空间的平均代价情形。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeCA: Safe Cross-Attention Localization and Regulation for Text-to-Video Jailbreak Defense
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-Video (T2V) generative models are vulnerable to jailbreak attacks in real-world deployment, leading them to produce harmful or inappropriate content. Existing defense approaches mainly rely on input filtering or reconstruction, which not only incur high computational latency but also tend to distort semantics. To address these issues, we experimentally and systematically analyze the differences between clean and jailbreak samples in the cross-attention feature space, revealing for the first time a cumulative separation effect and a progressively increasing trend of linear separability between the two during the diffusion process. Based on this insight, we propose SafeCA, a feature-level defense mechanism for safe cross-attention localization and regularization. Firstly, we identify key defensive regions and values through attention stability analysis using cross-attention features collected from clean prompts within a single inference. Secondly, SafeCA mitigates anomalous activations via attention masking with energy normalization and introduces a lightweight semantic-space adapter to redirect abnormal semantic flows. Furthermore, we detect and suppress potentially malicious tokens by back-propagating feature anomaly signals to the input cue words, thereby enhancing the deployability of the defense in commercial models. Experimental results show that SafeCA reduces the jailbreak success rate by about 20% on mainstream T2V models, adds almost no inference overhead (+0.1s), and maintains good text-video semantic consistency. Overall, SafeCA provides an architecture-level, deployable protection paradigm for T2V generation models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeCA，一种针对文本到视频 (Text-to-Video, T2V) 生成模型的越狱攻击防御方法。作者在交叉注意力特征空间中发现干净样本与越狱样本之间存在累积分离效应以及线性可分性随扩散过程递增的趋势，据此设计了特征级防御：通过注意力稳定性分析定位防御区域，用能量归一化的注意力掩码和轻量语义适配器修正异常激活，并将特征异常信号反传到输入提示词以抑制恶意 token。实验显示在主流 T2V 模型上将越狱成功率降低约 20%，推理开销仅增加 0.1 秒，并保持较好的文本-视频语义一致性。
Motivation: T2V 生成模型在真实部署中易受越狱攻击而产生有害或不恰当内容，现有防御主要依赖输入过滤或重建，不仅计算延迟高，还容易扭曲语义，缺乏对攻击机制在特征层面的系统性理解。
Method: 提出 SafeCA，一种特征级防御机制：首先利用单次推理中来自干净提示的交叉注意力特征进行注意力稳定性分析，识别关键防御区域与防御值；随后通过带能量归一化的注意力掩码抑制异常激活，并引入轻量语义空间适配器重定向异常语义流；最后将特征异常信号反向传播到输入提示词，以检测并抑制潜在恶意 token，增强在商业模型中的可部署性。
Result: 摘要报告 SafeCA 在主流 T2V 模型上将越狱成功率降低约 20%，几乎不增加推理开销（+0.1 秒），并保持较好的文本-视频语义一致性。
Conclusion: SafeCA 为 T2V 生成模型提供了一种架构级、可部署的防护范式，摘要强调其兼顾防御效果、推理效率与语义一致性的特点。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 SafeCA，一种针对文本到视频 (Text-to-Video, T2V) 生成模型的越狱攻击防御方法。作者在交叉注意力特征空间中发现干净样本与越狱样本之间存在累积分离效应以及线性可分性随扩散过程递增的趋势，据此设计了特征级防御：通过注意力稳定性分析定位防御区域，用能量归一化的注意力掩码和轻量语义适配器修正异常激活，并将特征异常信号反传到输入提示词以抑制恶意 token。实验显示在主流 T2V 模型上将越狱成功率降低约 20%，推理开销仅增加 0.1 秒，并保持较好的文本-视频语义一致性。
summary_sections.motivation: T2V 生成模型在真实部署中易受越狱攻击而产生有害或不恰当内容，现有防御主要依赖输入过滤或重建，不仅计算延迟高，还容易扭曲语义，缺乏对攻击机制在特征层面的系统性理解。
summary_sections.method: 提出 SafeCA，一种特征级防御机制：首先利用单次推理中来自干净提示的交叉注意力特征进行注意力稳定性分析，识别关键防御区域与防御值；随后通过带能量归一化的注意力掩码抑制异常激活，并引入轻量语义空间适配器重定向异常语义流；最后将特征异常信号反向传播到输入提示词，以检测并抑制潜在恶意 token，增强在商业模型中的可部署性。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 SafeCA 在主流 T2V 模型上将越狱成功率降低约 20%，几乎不增加推理开销（+0.1 秒），并保持较好的文本-视频语义一致性。
summary_sections.conclusion: SafeCA 为 T2V 生成模型提供了一种架构级、可部署的防护范式，摘要强调其兼顾防御效果、推理效率与语义一致性的特点。

papers.title: Temporally Grounded Compositional Camera Motion Understanding via Geometric Knowledge Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Understanding camera motion is fundamental to video perception, with applications in spatial intelligence and controllable video generation. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) provide a natural interface for this task, but existing work typically assigns one or more labels to an entire clip. Such clip-level recognition overlooks two defining properties of real camera motion: it can change within a shot, and multiple movements can occur simultaneously. We therefore formulate camera-motion understanding as temporally grounded, compositional recognition, which requires a model to localize motion-consistent intervals and identify every movement active within each interval. We introduce CamChoreo, a benchmark of 4,229 real single-shot clips with expert-annotated temporal segments. Its annotations use a compact vocabulary of 20 direction-aware labels, and nearly half of the segments contain compound camera motion, with multiple movement primitives active simultaneously. Recognizing such fine-grained, compositional motion is hard for current MLLMs, whose visual encoders emphasize semantic content rather than the geometric evidence on which camera motion depends. Directly injecting features from a frozen 3D foundation model addresses this gap, but requires running the expensive geometry model on every input; we refer to this baseline as CamInject. We instead propose CamDistill, which distills the same geometric knowledge into lightweight camera tokens during training and removes the 3D model at inference. CamDistill matches the accuracy of direct feature injection without running the 3D teacher at inference. Together, CamChoreo and CamDistill advance camera-motion understanding from clip-level labeling to temporally grounded, compositional recognition. Project page: https://ddz16.github.io/cammotion.github.io/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将相机运动理解建模为时间定位的组合识别（temporally grounded, compositional recognition），要求模型定位运动一致的区间并识别每个区间内同时活跃的所有运动原语。作者构建 CamChoreo 基准，含 4,229 个真实单镜头片段、20 个方向感知标签，近半区间包含复合相机运动；并提出 CamDistill，在训练时将冻结的 3D 几何教师模型知识蒸馏进轻量相机 token，推理时移除 3D 模型，性能匹配直接注入 3D 特征的 CamInject 基线。
Motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLM）通常对整个片段分配一个或多个标签，忽略了相机运动可在镜头内变化、多个运动可同时发生这两个关键性质；同时视觉编码器偏向语义内容而非几何证据，导致对细粒度组合运动识别困难。
Method: 提出 CamChoreo 基准与 CamDistill 方法。CamDistill 在训练阶段将 3D 几何基础模型的知识蒸馏到轻量相机 token 中，推理时不再运行昂贵的 3D 模型；对照基线 CamInject 则直接向每个输入注入冻结 3D 模型的特征。
Result: 摘要报告 CamDistill 在不于推理时运行 3D 教师模型的前提下，达到与直接特征注入（CamInject）相当的准确率。
Conclusion: 该工作将相机运动理解从片段级标注推进到时间定位的组合识别，benchmark 与蒸馏方法共同支撑了这一任务设定。摘要未提及具体局限。

papers.title: FedCGR: Federated Cross-Domain Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Cross-domain recommendation (CDR) transfers preference knowledge across related domains, but federated deployment makes cross-domain alignment difficult because the behavioral anchors that align item spaces, such as overlapping users and shared interaction signals, are often sparse, unavailable, or privacy-sensitive across clients. To address this tension, we revisit federated CDR as generation over a stable semantic item language. By representing items as discrete semantic ID (SID) sequences derived from public item-side metadata, cross-domain item alignment is induced by a shared vocabulary rather than by exchanging private interactions or aligning domain-specific embeddings. Directly federating SID-based generators, however, introduces two design constraints: the SID tokenizer must remain fixed to preserve cross-client token consistency, which creates a semantic-only bottleneck because local collaborative filtering (CF) signals cannot be globally shared or aligned; meanwhile, standard federated averaging can cause negative transfer under domain heterogeneity. To overcome these constraints, we propose FedCGR, a federated generative CDR framework that keeps the item language stable and makes adaptation explicit. FedCGR injects local CF evidence through a reliability-aware semantic interface and trains a prototype-personalized generator that selectively aggregates shared parameters according to domain relatedness while keeping domain-specific quantities local. Experiments on six Amazon cross-domain scenarios show that FedCGR consistently outperforms federated generative baselines and achieves competitive performance against strong sequential and federated CDR methods under both full-ranking and sampled evaluation protocols.
papers.comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedCGR，一个联邦跨域生成式推荐框架。其核心是将物品表示为从公共物品侧元数据导出的离散语义 ID (SID) 序列，把跨域对齐转化为共享词表上的生成问题，避免交换私有交互或对齐域特定嵌入。FedCGR 通过可靠性感知语义接口注入本地协同过滤 (CF) 证据，并训练原型个性化生成器按域相关性选择性聚合共享参数。在六个 Amazon 跨域场景上的实验表明它一致优于联邦生成式基线，并取得与强基线竞争的性能。
Motivation: 跨域推荐 (CDR) 需要跨相关域迁移偏好知识，但联邦部署下用于对齐物品空间的行为锚点（如重叠用户和共享交互信号）往往稀疏、不可用或涉及隐私，使跨域对齐变得困难。直接联邦 SID 生成器还会带来语义瓶颈，且标准联邦平均在域异质性下可能造成负迁移。
Method: 把跨域物品对齐建模为在稳定语义物品语言上的生成任务：利用公共物品侧元数据生成离散 SID 序列，借助共享词表实现对齐。提出 FedCGR，通过可靠性感知语义接口注入本地 CF 证据，并训练原型个性化生成器，依据域相关性选择性聚合共享参数、保留域特定数量。
Result: 在六个 Amazon 跨域场景上，FedCGR 一致优于联邦生成式基线，并在全排序与采样两种评估协议下与强序列推荐方法和联邦 CDR 方法相比取得竞争性表现。
Conclusion: 摘要强调保持物品语言稳定并显式建模本地适应可以缓解联邦 CDR 中的对齐与负迁移问题，实验结果表明该设计在跨域推荐场景中有效。

papers.title: ThinkRetrieve: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning Traces for Test-Time Scaling
papers.abstract_en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) improve performance by allocating additional inference-time compute to generate extended chain-of-thought reasoning. However, recent studies reveal that sequential test-time scaling often yields diminishing or even negative returns, as longer traces exhibit increased uncertainty, error compounding, and drift from the original problem. We propose ThinkRetrieve, a test-time scaling framework that augments the reasoning traces of LRMs with dynamically retrieved solved examples at each reasoning step. Given an external corpus of problems paired with step-by-step solutions, ThinkRetrieve retrieves relevant exemplars at each intermediate step and injects them directly into the thinking trace, providing the model with guidance on how to reason rather than merely what facts are relevant. Experiments across five reasoning models (1.5B--8B parameters) on GSM-8K, MATH-500, AIME 2025, and SciQ demonstrate that ThinkRetrieve consistently improves accuracy over standard test-time scaling, with relative gains of up to $60\%$ on AIME 2025.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ThinkRetrieve，一种测试时扩展框架，通过在大型推理模型 (LRM) 的每一步推理中动态检索并注入已求解的示例到思考轨迹中，以缓解顺序式测试时扩展的收益递减问题。实验在 GSM-8K、MATH-500、AIME 2025 和 SciQ 上覆盖五种参数规模 1.5B–8B 的推理模型，结果显示相对标准测试时扩展有一致提升，其中 AIME 2025 上相对增益最高达 60%。
Motivation: 现有大型推理模型通过增加推理时计算生成更长的思维链来提升性能，但研究表明顺序式测试时扩展常出现收益递减甚至负收益，因为更长的轨迹会引入不确定性累积、错误复合和偏离原问题的问题。
Method: ThinkRetrieve 利用外部的问题-分步解答语料库，在推理的每个中间步骤动态检索相关示例，并将其直接注入思考轨迹，为模型提供推理方式的引导而非仅仅提供相关事实。
Result: 在五种推理模型（1.5B–8B 参数）上的 GSM-8K、MATH-500、AIME 2025 和 SciQ 实验表明，相比标准测试时扩展，ThinkRetrieve 一致地提升准确率，在 AIME 2025 上相对增益最高达 60%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，在推理轨迹中按步骤注入检索到的示例可以改善测试时扩展的效率与准确性，为长思维链的退化问题提供了一种补救思路。

papers.title: IO Factory: Simulating AI-Enabled Influence Campaigns at Scale
papers.abstract_en: We introduce IO Factory, an AI-driven framework for simulating information and influence campaigns as fully integrated, traceable processes. The threat of digital manipulation now extends beyond persuasive text from individual language models to AI swarms, i.e., persistent groups of coordinated agents that adapt to platform feedback and disguise organized campaigns as ordinary social interaction. Because such campaigns cannot be identified from isolated messages alone, they must be analyzed across a continuous spectrum of planning, platform action, exposure, interpretation, measurement, and adaptation. IO Factory represents this process inside a controlled simulated platform, linking actor roles, platform actions, exposure records, structured model-based evaluations, and configured changes in the simulated population. We implement the architecture and evaluate it across configurations of up to 100,000 agents. The results show that IO Factory executes campaign timelines at scale and produces inspectable evidence of exposure and measured movement in configured belief variables. By recording the actors, objectives, action constraints, exposure paths, and measurement rules used in each run, IO Factory supports reproducible research and red-team analysis of coordinated influence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IO Factory，一个用于模拟信息和影响力活动（influence campaigns）的 AI 驱动框架，将此类活动建模为从规划、平台行动、曝光、解释、测量到适应的完整可追踪流程，并在受控模拟平台中实现，支持多达 100,000 个代理的配置。摘要报告该框架能大规模执行活动时间线，并产生可检查的曝光证据和信念变量的测量变化，从而支持可复现研究与红队分析。
Motivation: 数字操控威胁已从单个语言模型生成的说服性文本扩展到 AI 蜂群（AI swarms），即持续协调的代理群体，它们会适应平台反馈并将组织化活动伪装成普通社交互动；这类活动无法从孤立消息中识别，必须在规划、行动、曝光、解释、测量与适应的连续谱系中分析。
Method: IO Factory 在一个受控模拟平台内表示完整活动过程，将角色（actor roles）、平台行动、曝光记录、结构化模型评估和模拟人群的配置变化相互关联；每次运行都会记录行动者、目标、行动约束、曝光路径与测量规则。
Result: 摘要报告在多达 100,000 个代理的配置上进行评估，IO Factory 能够大规模执行活动时间线，并产生可检查的曝光证据以及配置信念变量的可测量变化。
Conclusion: 通过记录每次运行中的行动者、目标、行动约束、曝光路径和测量规则，IO Factory 支持可复现的研究以及针对协调影响力活动的红队分析。

papers.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation
papers.abstract_en: Autoformalisation (AF) systems map natural language reasoning steps into formal statements in a proof assistant such as Lean. We consider how to assess the faithfulness of these systems. Existing approaches require expensive human-annotated ground truth, or rely on LLM judges or embedding models, which come with limited guarantees of accuracy. In addition, these methods typically only consider inputs that are known to be correct, and therefore do not assess whether the AF translates incorrect inputs faithfully. To address these limitations, we propose a new benchmark for AF faithfulness that is cheap to apply, sound under weak assumptions, and assesses both positive and negative examples. Our method is based on automatically generating perturbed reasoning steps that are designed to be invalid, and then measuring validity preservation on unperturbed steps and invalidity preservation on perturbed steps. We apply our method to eight AF systems across four mathematical datasets, and observe pervasive sycophancy: many AFs "silently correct" invalid inputs into provable statements. The most validity-preserving fine-tuned AFs are also the most sycophantic, suggesting a tension between validity and invalidity preservation in current AF systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FaithformBench，一个用于评估数学链式思维自动形式化 (autoformalisation, AF) 系统忠实性的基准。该方法自动生成设计为无效的扰动推理步骤，并分别测量未扰动步骤的有效性保持与扰动步骤的无效性保持，从而廉价地在较弱假设下同时评估正反例。对 8 个 AF 系统、4 个数学数据集的应用中，作者观察到普遍的谄媚现象 (sycophancy)：许多 AF 会把无效输入“沉默纠正”为可证明语句。
Motivation: 现有 AF 忠实性评估要么依赖昂贵的人工标注真值，要么依赖准确性保证有限的 LLM judge 或 embedding 模型；此外这些方法通常只考虑已知正确的输入，无法检验 AF 是否忠实翻译了错误输入。
Method: 提出基于自动生成扰动推理步骤的评估方法：扰动步骤被设计为无效的，基准通过未扰动步骤上的有效性保持 (validity preservation) 与扰动步骤上的无效性保持 (invalidity preservation) 来量化 AF 的忠实性，并同时覆盖正例与负例。
Result: 在 8 个 AF 系统和 4 个数学数据集上观察到普遍谄媚：许多 AF 将无效输入静默改写成可证明语句；最具有效性保持能力的微调 AF 同时也是最谄媚的，表明当前 AF 系统在有效性保持与无效性保持之间存在张力。
Conclusion: 该基准廉价、在弱假设下可靠，并能同时评估正确与错误输入的忠实性；作者强调需要关注 AF 系统对错误输入的不忠实“修正”倾向。

papers.title: ComBodied Agents: a New Paradigm of Human-Centric Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: After an older adult misses a medication dose, a software agent can send another reminder and an embodied agent can bring the medication. Yet neither explains whether the person forgot, is confused, has side effects, or deliberately refused, nor what support is appropriate. This reveals a structural gap in Agentic AI: Digital Agents primarily transform software states, while Embodied Agents transform physical states; neither makes a person's evolving state and agency the primary object of modeling, intervention, and evaluation. We introduce Combodied Agents, a human-centered paradigm that perceives, models, predicts, and supports individual human-state trajectories over time, using software tools, sensors, wearables, robots, and human services as action channels rather than end goals. We unify fragmented capabilities across personal assistants, health agents, AI companions, and adaptive human--AI systems into a closed loop: event-based multimodal perception reconstructs meaningful personal events; longitudinal, correctable memory provides temporal context; Personal World Models estimate future personal states and outcomes under alternative decisions and interventions; and an admissible intervention policy selects proportionate support under consent, uncertainty, safety, reversibility, and user control. Feedback from the person and environment updates the loop. Rather than requiring an exhaustive Human Digital Twin, the framework uses purpose-bounded, uncertainty-aware, user-correctable representations. We organize the design space by human-state targets, relational contexts, and agent roles, and propose scenario-centered evaluation, agency-preservation metrics, benchmark requirements, edge-native personal models, and governance directions. Combodied Agents shift Agentic AI from external task completion toward sustained human benefit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Combodied Agents 这一以人为中心的 Agentic AI 范式，将个体随时间演化的状态轨迹作为建模、干预和评估的核心对象，而非仅仅完成软件或物理状态转换。框架形成闭环：事件驱动的多模态感知、纵向可修正记忆、Personal World Models 预测未来个人状态、以及基于同意/不确定性/安全/可逆性/用户控制的 admissible intervention policy，并由人与环境的反馈持续更新。摘要强调用用途受限、不确定性感知、用户可修正的表示替代详尽的 Human Digital Twin，并提出场景中心评估、能动性保持指标与治理方向。
Motivation: 现有 Digital Agents 主要变换软件状态，Embodied Agents 主要变换物理状态，两者都没有把人的持续状态与能动性作为主要建模、干预和评估对象；例如老人漏服药物时，系统能提醒或送药，却无法判断是遗忘、困惑、副作用还是刻意拒绝，也无法给出合适的支持，这暴露了 Agentic AI 的结构性缺口。
Method: 提出 Combodied Agents 框架，将个人助理、健康代理、AI 陪伴和自适应人机系统整合为一个闭环：事件驱动多模态感知重建有意义的个人事件；纵向、可修正的记忆提供时间上下文；Personal World Models 估计不同决策与干预下的未来个人状态与结果；admissible intervention policy 在同意、不确定性、安全、可逆性和用户控制约束下选择相称的支持；人的反馈与环境反馈再更新闭环。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数字，而是提出设计空间的组织方式（human-state targets、relational contexts、agent roles）、场景中心评估、能动性保持指标、基准需求、edge-native 个人模型以及治理方向。
Conclusion: 框架不依赖完备的 Human Digital Twin，而是采用用途受限、不确定性感知、用户可修正的表示；其目标是将 Agentic AI 从外部任务完成转向持续的人类福祉。

papers.title: Order Matters: LVLMs as Judges for Temporal Reasoning in Image Sequences
papers.abstract_en: As generative multimedia evolves from static image synthesis to complex, interleaved visual narratives, a foundational bottleneck has emerged: the judgment crisis. While human perception naturally synthesizes the temporal and logical flow of a story, automated evaluation systems remain largely "blind" to sequential continuity, often failing to distinguish between a coherent narrative and a semantically shuffled or contradictory sequence. This work identifies a critical structural gap in current multimodal evaluation paradigms, arguing that the reliance on Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) as judges is fundamentally limited by architectural biases. Our analysis reveals a profound performance dichotomy: while models may appear competent in isolated pointwise scoring, they suffer a catastrophic collapse when required to perform pairwise discrimination of temporal order. We demonstrate that this is not merely a data-scarcity issue but a structural one. Through a series of diagnostic probes, we uncover systematic positional asymmetries, specifically primacy and recency effects, where a model's judgment of a story is significantly influenced by the placement of a frame, often more than by its semantic consistency. These biases, potentially rooted in causal masking and rotary embeddings, suggest that current transformer-based judges are inherently ill-equipped for long-form visual reasoning. By exposing these blind spots, we challenge the multimedia community to move beyond snapshot-centric metrics and instead pioneer Temporally-Aware Evaluation paradigms that treat visual sequences as unified logical structures rather than unordered collections of frames.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大视觉语言模型（LVLM）作为图像序列时序推理判断器时的结构性缺陷。作者发现模型在逐点评分（pointwise scoring）上表现看似合格，但在成对判别时间顺序时出现灾难性的性能崩溃，并表现出首因与近因效应等位置不对称性，判断受帧位置影响大于语义一致性。作者认为这些偏差可能源于因果掩码和旋转嵌入，并提出需要走向时间感知的评估范式。
Motivation: 多模态评估依赖 LVLM 作为自动判断器，但它们对图像序列的时间连续性与逻辑顺序不敏感，难以区分连贯叙事与被打乱或矛盾的序列；作者论证这不仅是数据稀缺问题，而是由架构偏差导致的结构性缺陷。
Method: 通过一系列诊断探针（diagnostic probes）对比 LVLM 在孤立逐点评分与成对时序判别上的表现，检测位置偏差（primacy 和 recency effects），并从因果掩码与旋转嵌入角度分析模型判断为何受帧位置影响。
Result: 摘要报告模型在逐点评分中表现尚可，但在成对判别时序顺序时发生性能崩溃；系统分析揭示了显著的位置不对称性，模型对故事顺序的判断更多受到帧位置而非语义一致性的影响。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁多模态社区超越以快照为中心的指标，发展把视觉序列视为统一逻辑结构的时间感知评估（Temporally-Aware Evaluation）范式。

papers.title: GitSkills: A Dataset of Agent Skills on GitHub
papers.abstract_en: An agent skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with instructions for a language-model agent, optionally accompanied by scripts and reference files. The agent loads the skill when it judges that a task matches the skill description. Anthropic introduced the format in October 2025 as an open specification. Nine months later, we find that skill files in the millions sit in public GitHub repositories. Skills are unlike the artifacts the SE research community usually mines: they are written mainly in natural language, a model selects them probabilistically at run time, and no compiler or type checker verifies the selection. They also have no central registry or package manager, so they spread by copying folders between repositories. How developers write, reuse, and maintain skills is therefore an empirical question, and no existing dataset records this population. We present GitSkills, a dataset of 3,797,117 SKILL.md files collected from 282,200 public repositories in July 2026. The dataset retains every file occurrence with its repository, path, and content hash. It groups identical files into 1,877,981 distinct contents and enriches one representative per group with the full text, parsed front matter, folder contents, repository metadata, and, for a subset, the commit history of the file. A single self- contained SQLite file supports research on the adoption, reuse, structure, authorship, maintenance, and security of agent skills.
papers.comment: Giuseppe Destefanis, Daniel Graziotin, Matteo Vaccargiu, and Marco Ortu. 2027. GitSkills: A Dataset of Agent Skills on GitHub. In Proceedings of the 24th International Conference on Mining Software Repositories (MSR '27). Association for Computing Machinery, New York, NY, USA, 3 pages. To appear
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 GitSkills 数据集，用于研究 GitHub 上由 Anthropic 在 2025 年 10 月提出的 agent skill 格式（即含 SKILL.md 的文件夹）。作者于 2026 年 7 月从 282,200 个公共仓库中收集了 3,797,117 个 SKILL.md 文件，按去重后得到 1,877,981 个不同内容，并为每个分组的一个代表文件附上全文、front matter、文件夹内容、仓库元数据及部分提交历史，最终以单个 SQLite 文件发布。
Motivation: Agent skill 是自然语言驱动的、由模型在运行时概率性选用的新型软件工件，没有集中注册表或包管理器，主要通过复制文件夹传播，因此开发、复用和维护方式属于经验性问题，而现有数据集没有记录这一群体。
Method: 作者抓取公开 GitHub 仓库中的全部 SKILL.md 文件，保留每次出现的仓库、路径和内容哈希；将相同文件归组，选取代表文件并补充完整文本、解析后的 front matter、文件夹内容、仓库元数据以及部分文件的提交历史，封装为自包含的 SQLite 数据集。
Result: GitSkills 包含来自 282,200 个公共仓库的 3,797,117 个 SKILL.md 文件，去重后为 1,877,981 个不同内容，并以单一 SQLite 文件形式提供。
Conclusion: 该数据集可用于研究 agent skill 的采纳、复用、结构、作者身份、维护与安全问题；作者将其定位为面向该新兴工件类型的首个大规模经验数据集。

papers.title: ReOrder-OPD:Reliability-Aware Prompt Ordering for On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD) applies token-level teacher supervision to student-generated trajectories, but this supervision is not always reliable. Existing methods use local confidence or teacher-student agreement to weight, filter, or truncate the sampled trajectory. These signals do not directly determine whether the teacher can continue a student prefix to a correct answer, and trajectory-level interventions can conflate one rollout's unreliability with low expected training value of its prompt. We define prompt-level teacher continuation reliability $R$ as the teacher's probability of reaching a correct answer from a student prefix, averaged over prefixes and trajectories induced by the current student. Oracle experiments show that high-$R$ prompts yield larger OPD gains and that descending-$R$ training outperforms random and ascending orders on a fixed prompt pool. Because estimating $R$ requires many teacher continuations, we use the maximum ROUGE-5 F1 between one independent student rollout and verifier-correct same-prompt teacher trajectories. Across ten equal-frequency bins of this actual score, mean $R$ rises monotonically, showing that the proxy separates coarse reliability levels. ReOrder-OPD sorts prompts by the proxy, then draws independent on-policy training trajectories for vanilla OPD. It improves every matched aggregate comparison across Qwen3 and Gemma4 mathematics settings and Qwen3 code settings. Gains in all six FiRe-OPD and ExOPD settings show that prompt ordering complements within-trajectory supervision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中 token 级教师监督的可靠性问题，提出用 prompt 级教师续写可靠性 (teacher continuation reliability) 来度量 prompt 的训练价值，并设计代理分数用于排序 prompt。作者定义可靠性 R 为学生前缀上教师到达正确答案的概率，通过 oracle 实验证明高 R 的 prompt 带来更大 OPD 收益，且按 R 降序训练优于随机和升序。提出的 ReOrder-OPD 按代理分数排序 prompt 后执行 vanilla OPD，在 Qwen3/Gemma4 数学与 Qwen3 代码设置的所有匹配对比中均有提升。
Motivation: 现有 OPD 方法用局部置信度或师生一致性来加权、过滤或截断采样轨迹，但这些信号不能直接判断教师能否从学生前缀续写到正确答案；同时，轨迹级干预会把单次 rollout 的不可靠性与该 prompt 的低期望训练价值混为一谈。
Method: 定义 prompt 级教师续写可靠性 R 为当前学生诱导的轨迹上教师到达正确答案的概率平均值；为避免大量教师续写开销，提出代理分数：一个独立学生 rollout 与同一 prompt 下验证器正确的教师轨迹之间的最大 ROUGE-5 F1。ReOrder-OPD 按该代理分数对 prompt 排序，然后对排序后的 prompt 池执行 vanilla OPD。
Result: Oracle 实验显示高 R 的 prompt 训练收益更大，R 降序训练优于随机和升序；代理分数的十个等频分箱中平均 R 单调上升，说明代理能区分粗略的可靠性层级。ReOrder-OPD 在 Qwen3、Gemma4 数学设置及 Qwen3 代码设置的所有匹配聚合对比中均有提升，并在全部六个 FiRe-OPD 和 ExOPD 设置中获得增益。
Conclusion: 作者认为 prompt 排序与轨迹内监督 (within-trajectory supervision) 互补，基于 ROUGE-5 F1 的代理分数足以按粗略可靠性层级对 prompt 排序。摘要未提及具体数值或明显局限，仅强调该代理可分离粗粒度可靠性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中 token 级教师监督的可靠性问题，提出用 prompt 级教师续写可靠性 (teacher continuation reliability) 来度量 prompt 的训练价值，并设计代理分数用于排序 prompt。作者定义可靠性 R 为学生前缀上教师到达正确答案的概率，通过 oracle 实验证明高 R 的 prompt 带来更大 OPD 收益，且按 R 降序训练优于随机和升序。提出的 ReOrder-OPD 按代理分数排序 prompt 后执行 vanilla OPD，在 Qwen3/Gemma4 数学与 Qwen3 代码设置的所有匹配对比中均有提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有 OPD 方法用局部置信度或师生一致性来加权、过滤或截断采样轨迹，但这些信号不能直接判断教师能否从学生前缀续写到正确答案；同时，轨迹级干预会把单次 rollout 的不可靠性与该 prompt 的低期望训练价值混为一谈。

papers.title: VIDS-Seg: Towards Reliable Uncertainty Quantification in Pediatric Cardiac Ultrasound Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Reliable clinical deployment of machine learning requires models that know when they are likely to fail, particularly for subgroups underrepresented in training data. A common case is pediatric care, where models trained on adult cohorts can silently under-perform on children with no indication that something has gone wrong. As retraining with labeled pediatric data is often infeasible, detecting such failures at inference time is a critical clinical need. Building on the VIDS (Variational Inference under Distribution Shifts) framework, we introduce VIDS-Seg, which applies amortized variational inference over a lightweight prediction head to make this adaptive, OOD-aware prior tractable for dense image segmentation. We evaluate VIDS-Seg on left ventricular segmentation in echocardiography, a setting where pediatric anatomy differs systematically from the adult population most segmentation models are trained on, training on an adult cohort (EchoNet-Dynamic) and evaluating zero-shot on a pediatric cohort (EchoNet-Pediatric). Across all age strata, VIDS-Seg matches competitive baselines in segmentation accuracy while producing substantially higher spatial correspondence between predicted uncertainty and segmentation error, an advantage that persists even after applying temperature scaling to all baselines. Downstream, it yields more accurate and stable ejection fraction estimates and more reliable detection of cardiac malfunction in the infant subgroup. Our results indicate that OOD-aware uncertainty quantification can serve as a practical safety layer for deployed segmentation models, enabling detection of silent failures in underrepresented subgroups without retraining or additional labeled data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VIDS-Seg，在 VIDS (Variational Inference under Distribution Shifts) 框架基础上，通过在轻量预测头上应用摊销变分推断，将自适应、OOD 感知的先验扩展到密集图像分割任务。作者在超声心动图左心室分割上验证，用成人队列 EchoNet-Dynamic 训练、零样本评估于儿科队列 EchoNet-Pediatric，结果显示分割精度与基线相当，但预测不确定性与分割误差的空间对应性显著更高，并能提升射血分数估计和婴儿亚组心功能异常检测的可靠性。
Motivation: 机器学习模型在训练数据中代表性不足的亚群（如儿科患者）上可能静默失效，而用带标签的儿科数据重新训练往往不可行，因此需要在不重训练、不增加标注数据的情况下，于推理时检测这类失效。
Method: 基于 VIDS 框架提出 VIDS-Seg，对轻量预测头进行摊销变分推断，使自适应且 OOD 感知的先验可用于密集图像分割；训练使用成人队列，测试直接零样本迁移到儿科队列。
Result: 在所有年龄分层中，VIDS-Seg 的分割精度与竞争基线相当，但预测不确定性和分割误差之间的空间对应性显著更高，即使对所有基线应用温度缩放 (temperature scaling) 后该优势仍存在；下游任务中得到更准确稳定的射血分数估计，并在婴儿亚组中更可靠地检测心功能异常。
Conclusion: 作者认为 OOD 感知的不确定性量化可以作为已部署分割模型的实际安全层，无需重训练或额外标注数据即可检测代表性不足亚群中的静默失效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Partially Observable Learning for Multi-Platform Dispatch Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Instant delivery platforms have become a critical component of urban logistics, increasingly relying on crowdsourced couriers to fulfill highly dynamic orders. In real-world systems, couriers are not exclusive to a single platform and may concurrently serve multiple platforms, while each platform can only observe its own orders and couriers' interactions due to privacy and operational constraints. This results in a multi-platform dispatch environment with inherent partial observability. However, most existing works on dispatch optimization assume full courier observability and mandatory assignment acceptance, causing substantial performance degradation when deployed in realistic multi-platform settings. In this paper, we propose POLO, a partially observable multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for dispatching optimization in multi-platform instant delivery systems. POLO firstly models each platform-grid pair as an independent agent that learns dispatch policies solely from platform-local observations, aligning the learning process with real-world privacy and operational constraints. To support effective decision-making under incomplete and heterogeneous courier information, POLO introduces a novel attention-based policy representation that selectively aggregates inter-courier information. Moreover, we design a counterfactual reward shaping mechanism to mitigate the non-stationarity induced by joint actions across grids, leading to more stable and scalable learning. We develop a high-fidelity simulator to evaluate dispatch performance under varying numbers of platforms and system scales. Extensive experiments demonstrate that POLO consistently outperforms strong baselines in terms of platform revenue and courier travel efficiency, highlighting its robustness and effectiveness in realistic multi-platform settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 POLO，一个面向多平台即时配送调度优化的部分可观测多智能体强化学习框架。针对骑手同时服务多个平台、各平台只能观测自身订单与骑手交互的现实约束，POLO 将每个平台-网格对建模为独立智能体，仅基于平台本地观测学习调度策略，并引入基于注意力的策略表示与反事实奖励塑形机制。实验表明其在平台收入和骑手出行效率上优于强基线。
Motivation: 现有调度优化工作大多假设完全可观测且强制接受订单，在多平台真实场景下性能严重下降；而现实中骑手不专属于单一平台，且平台因隐私和运营约束只能看到本地信息。
Method: POLO 首先将每个平台-网格对作为一个智能体，仅用平台本地观测学习；提出一种基于注意力（attention）的策略表示，选择性聚合骑手间信息；并设计反事实奖励塑形（counterfactual reward shaping）机制以缓解跨网格联合动作导致的非平稳性。作者还构建了高保真模拟器评估不同平台数量和系统规模下的表现。
Result: 大量实验表明 POLO 在平台收入和骑手出行效率上一致优于强基线，展现出在多平台真实场景下的鲁棒性和有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调在部分可观测多平台设定下，通过本地观测学习和针对非平稳性的机制设计可以提升即时配送调度性能。

papers.title: Self-Normalized Inference for Constant-Stepsize Temporal-Difference Learning under Markovian Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Constant-stepsize temporal-difference (TD) learning is attractive for policy evaluation, but inference from a single Markov trajectory must account for serial dependence and a stepsize-dependent stationary target. For fixed-stepsize linear TD, we establish a functional central limit theorem whose covariance retains the multiplicative component induced by the random TD matrix and the stationary iterate error. We then derive a joint functional limit for parallel Richardson--Romberg (RR) recursions driven by the same trajectory. A Brownian-bridge self-normalizer yields asymptotically pivotal confidence regions for prespecified state-value contrasts without estimating the long-run covariance or selecting a bandwidth or batch length. For such a contrast, the procedure admits a one-pass implementation whose memory does not grow with the trajectory length. At a fixed stepsize, the inferential center is the RR stationary target. We also study horizon-indexed designs in which the stepsize remains constant within each run and decreases across longer horizons. Under an explicit RR-dependent rate window, the residual RR target shift, multiplicative remainder, and initialization effect are negligible at the root-$n$ scale, yielding inference for the projected Bellman solution. Experiments on FrozenLake and Garnet illustrate stationary-target coverage, RR target correction, and the finite-sample behavior of the horizon-indexed design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究马尔可夫采样下常数步长线性TD学习的统计推断，建立了固定步长线性TD的泛函中心极限定理，并利用同一轨迹驱动的并行Richardson-Romberg (RR) 递推与Brownian-bridge自归一化构造渐近枢轴的置信区域，无需估计长期协方差或选择带宽/批长度。作者还研究了horizon-indexed设计，在显式RR相关率窗口下使残差RR目标偏移、乘性余项和初始化效应在根号n尺度上可忽略，从而对投影Bellman解进行推断。实验在FrozenLake和Garnet上验证了平稳目标覆盖、RR目标校正及horizon-indexed设计的有限样本行为。
Motivation: 常数步长TD学习对策略评估有吸引力，但从单一马尔可夫轨迹进行推断必须处理序列依赖和依赖步长的平稳目标；现有推断通常需要估计长期协方差或选择带宽、批长度，这在实际中不便。
Method: 对固定步长线性TD建立协方差含随机TD矩阵乘性成分和平稳迭代误差的泛函中心极限定理，并推导同一轨迹驱动的并行Richardson-Romberg递推的联合泛函极限；用Brownian-bridge自归一化得到渐近枢轴置信区域，并给出内存不随轨迹长度增长的单遍实现。另研究horizon-indexed设计：每次运行内步长固定，随较长horizon递减。
Result: 在显式RR相关率窗口下，残差RR目标偏移、乘性余项和初始化效应在根号n尺度上可忽略，从而对投影Bellman解进行推断；FrozenLake和Garnet实验展示了平稳目标覆盖、RR目标校正和horizon-indexed设计的有限样本表现。
Conclusion: 该方法可在不估计长期协方差或选择带宽/批长度的前提下实现渐近枢轴推断，且支持单遍实现；摘要强调这些性质通过理论极限和有限样本实验共同验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking Time Series Generation Methods for Privacy-Preserving Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting in privacy-sensitive domains often requires training models on released data rather than original observations. Synthetic time series generation has been developed primarily for data augmentation, where generated series supplement the original training set. How well these methods perform when fully replacing the original data - and how much privacy risk the released series carry - remains underexplored. We address this gap through a benchmark evaluating synthetic generation methods and noise-based anonymization baselines under a Train on Synthetic, Test on Real (TSTR) protocol. We jointly assess forecasting performance and distance-based empirical privacy risk across seven datasets, characterizing the trade-off between these objectives. We also introduce Grasynda-P, a privacy-motivated extension of the graph-based generator Grasynda, incorporating matrix ensembling and kernel density estimation. Our results show that: (1) no generation method fully substitutes for original training data; (2) noise-based anonymization yields the strongest privacy but the worst forecasting performance; (3) simple transformation-based generators outperform deep generative models for forecasting in this setting; and (4) Grasynda-P lies on the Pareto frontier, achieving competitive forecasting with stronger privacy separation than other generators. This benchmark establishes a reference point for evaluating and developing new privacy-aware synthetic time series generation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对隐私敏感领域的时间序列预测，系统评估了在 TSTR（Train on Synthetic, Test on Real）协议下用合成数据完全替代原始训练数据的效果，并同时衡量预测性能与基于距离的经验隐私风险。作者在七个数据集上对比了多种合成生成方法与基于噪声的匿名化基线，并提出了 Grasynda-P，一个基于图生成器 Grasynda 的隐私导向扩展，引入矩阵集成（matrix ensembling）与核密度估计（kernel density estimation）。结果显示没有任何生成方法能完全替代原始数据，且 Grasynda-P 处于 Pareto 前沿。
Motivation: 现有合成时间序列生成方法主要面向数据增强，即补充原始训练集；它们在完全替代原始数据时的表现以及发布序列所携带的隐私风险尚未被充分研究。
Method: 作者构建了一个基准，在 TSTR 协议下联合评估合成生成方法和基于噪声的匿名化基线，比较预测性能与基于距离的经验隐私风险。同时提出 Grasynda-P，它在图生成器 Grasynda 的基础上加入矩阵集成与核密度估计，以增强隐私分离。
Result: 摘要报告四项主要发现：没有生成方法能完全替代原始训练数据；基于噪声的匿名化隐私保护最强但预测性能最差；简单基于变换的生成器在该设定下优于深度生成模型；Grasynda-P 位于 Pareto 前沿，在竞争力预测性能下实现更强的隐私分离。
Conclusion: 该基准为评估和发展隐私感知的合成时间序列生成方法提供了参考点。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告四项主要发现：没有生成方法能完全替代原始训练数据；基于噪声的匿名化隐私保护最强但预测性能最差；简单基于变换的生成器在该设定下优于深度生成模型；Grasynda-P 位于 Pareto 前沿，在竞争力预测性能下实现更强的隐私分离。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该基准为评估和发展隐私感知的合成时间序列生成方法提供了参考点。

papers.title: Sensor-Informed Per-Point Covariance for Structured-Light 3D Imaging
papers.abstract_en: Per-point uncertainty models are important in structured-light 3D reconstruction for probabilistic registration, fusion, and quality assessment. In practice, however, point-cloud covariances are often modeled as isotropic constants or inferred from local surface geometry and therefore do not explicitly reflect the measurement process. This is a limitation in fringe projection profilometry (FPP), where phase noise propagates through calibrated reconstruction and produces strongly anisotropic 3D uncertainty. This paper presents a sensor-informed first-order method for constructing a per-point 3 x 3 covariance field from experimentally measured phase precision and calibrated phase-to-depth and phase-to-3D mappings. The formulation separates a rank-1 phase-induced covariance from an effective full-rank completion obtained by incorporating fitted lateral image-space perturbation scales. Repeated-plane experiments under fixed imaging conditions show close alignment of the dominant covariance direction with the viewing ray, and consistency between the dominant phase-induced uncertainty scale and scalar depth uncertainty. In G-ICP registration, the proposed covariance substantially improves over a constant isotropic model while providing a sensor-derived uncertainty representation complementary to conventional geometry-based covariances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种传感器感知的逐点协方差构建方法，用于结构光3D成像中的不确定性建模。该方法基于实验测量的相位精度以及标定的相位到深度和相位到3D映射，构造每个点的3×3协方差场，将秩1的相位诱导协方差与结合拟合横向图像空间扰动尺度的有效满秩补全分开处理。重复平面实验显示主协方差方向与观察射线接近对齐，且主相位诱导不确定性尺度与标量深度不确定性一致。
Motivation: 现有结构光重建中的逐点不确定性常被建模为各向同性常数或由局部表面几何推断，未显式反映测量过程；在条纹投影轮廓术(FPP)中，相位噪声经标定重建传播后产生强各向异性的3D不确定性，需要更好的逐点协方差模型。
Method: 提出传感器知情的一阶方法，从实验测得的相位精度和标定的相位到深度及相位到3D映射构建逐点3×3协方差场，并通过拟合横向图像空间扰动尺度引入有效满秩补全。
Result: 固定成像条件下的重复平面实验表明，主协方差方向与观察射线接近对齐，主相位诱导不确定性尺度与标量深度不确定性一致；在G-ICP配准中，该协方差相对常量各向同性模型有显著改进。
Conclusion: 该协方差表示源自传感器测量过程，与传统基于几何的协方差互补，可用于概率配准等下游任务中的不确定性表达。

papers.title: GESTO: Human-Centric Spatio-Temporal Memory for Reasoning in Dynamic Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Robots operating in human environments need memories that capture not only what objects exist and where, but also how people use them over time and how individual interactions compose into goal-directed activities. Existing 4D scene graphs preserve object and place histories but omit activity structure, whereas activity representations are either not grounded in persistent 3D scenes or rely on externally provided event boundaries and object associations. We present GESTO (Grounded Event and Spatio-Temporal memOry), a spatio-temporal memory that couples a persistent 4D scene graph with a two-level hierarchy of atomic human--object interactions and goal-driven events. From an RGB-D observation stream, GESTO automatically extracts timestamped interactions, grounds them to persistent scene entities, groups them into events, and uses event context to refine uncertain object associations. A relation-aware tool-calling agent queries the resulting memory for activity-centric spatio-temporal reasoning. We evaluate GESTO on the reproducible text, binary, and time categories of an existing benchmark, together with 40 new Space2Event and Event2Space queries. GESTO achieves scores of 0.71, 0.75, and 0.70 on the standard categories, approaching a method supplied with ground-truth event and object grounding, while substantially outperforming the same reasoning framework when these inputs are removed. It further achieves 0.73 and 0.75 on Space2Event and Event2Space queries. Ablations show that hierarchical event structure and context-aware grounding refinement provide complementary benefits, supporting activity-grounded hierarchical memory for retrospective reasoning in dynamic human environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GESTO（Grounded Event and Spatio-Temporal memOry），一种将持久 4D 场景图与两层层次结构（原子人-物交互与目标驱动事件）耦合的时空记忆。系统从 RGB-D 观测流自动提取带时间戳的交互、将其接地到持久场景实体并分组为事件，再利用事件上下文精炼不确定的对象关联；关系感知的工具调用 agent 可对该记忆进行以活动为中心的时空推理。在现有基准的可复现类别上，GESTO 达到 0.71、0.75、0.70，接近依赖地面真值事件和对象接地的方法，并在新增的 Space2Event 与 Event2Space 查询上取得 0.73 与 0.75。
Motivation: 现有 4D 场景图保留对象和位置的持久历史，但缺少活动结构；而活动表示要么没有接地到持久 3D 场景，要么依赖外部给定的事件边界和对象关联。机器人需要在人类环境中记忆物体如何被使用以及个体交互如何组合成目标导向活动，该工作针对这一缺口提出活动接地的层次记忆。
Method: 提出 GESTO，将持久 4D 场景图与原子人-物交互、目标驱动事件的双层层次结构耦合。它从 RGB-D 观测流自动提取带时间戳的交互，将交互接地到持久的场景实体，把交互分组为事件，并用事件上下文修正不确定的对象关联；同时采用关系感知的工具调用 agent 来查询该记忆。
Result: 在现有基准的 text、binary、time 类别上，GESTO 取得 0.71、0.75、0.70 的分数，接近配有地面真值事件和对象接地的方法，且显著优于移除这些输入后的同一推理框架；在新增的 Space2Event 和 Event2Space 查询上分别达到 0.73 和 0.75。消融研究表明层次事件结构和上下文感知的接地精炼提供互补收益。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，活动接地的层次记忆能够支持动态人类环境中的回溯性时空推理，并强调层次事件结构与上下文感知接地精炼的互补作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ConfTriage: A Calibration-Aware LLM Triage Framework for Pulmonary Nodule Malignancy with Selective Specialist Deferral
papers.abstract_en: Pulmonary nodule malignancy prediction typically depends on image-trained specialist deep learning (DL) models that require substantial annotated imaging data and task-specific training. We investigate whether a generalist large language model (LLM), reading only a faithful natural-language rendering of standard nodule attributes, can serve as a calibrated triage layer. We propose ConfTriage, a confidence-calibrated method built on three pillars: language as the modality, calibration as the safety mechanism, and a selective specialist DL backstop for low-confidence cases. We prove two guarantees: a finite-sample combined-error bound yielding an explicit per-threshold operational certificate, and an oracle inequality showing that excess risk over the Bayes-optimal deferral classifier is controlled by the L1 calibration error of the LLM probability. A controlled seven-way input ablation across five frontier LLMs on LIDC-IDRI shows that natural-language descriptions dominate the diagnostic signal, while low-level image statistics are essentially diagnostically vacuous. ConfTriage achieved an F1 score of 88.22% and an AUC of 0.92, resolving 76.5% of cases using zero-shot LLM inference alone and referring only uncertain cases to the specialist DL backstop. These results demonstrate that clinically meaningful diagnostic information can be captured through structured radiological descriptions and leveraged by calibrated LLMs for selective referral. The framework suggests a practical pathway for combining generalist LLM prediction with specialist AI models in medical decision-support systems. Source code is publicly available at https://github.com/rabiul-ai/ConfTriage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConfTriage，一个面向肺结节恶性预测的校准感知分诊框架：通用大语言模型 (LLM) 仅读取标准结节属性的自然语言描述即可做判断，低置信度病例再选择性转给专业深度学习 (DL) 模型。作者给出有限样本组合误差界与 oracle 不等式两类理论保证，并在 LIDC-IDRI 数据集上对五款前沿 LLM 做七路输入消融，显示自然语言描述主导诊断信号。ConfTriage 取得 F1 88.22%、AUC 0.92，其中 76.5% 的病例仅靠零样本 LLM 推理解决。
Motivation: 肺结节恶性预测通常依赖图像训练的专业 DL 模型，需要大量标注影像数据和任务特定训练；论文探究通用 LLM 仅读取忠实自然语言化的结节属性能否作为经校准的分诊层，从而减少对专业模型数据与训练的依赖。
Method: 提出 ConfTriage，建立在三个支柱上：语言作为模态 (language as modality)、校准作为安全机制 (calibration as safety mechanism)、以及针对低置信度病例的选择性专业 DL 后备 (selective specialist DL backstop)。论文证明两个保证：有限样本组合误差界，给出逐阈值显式操作证书；以及 oracle 不等式，说明相对贝叶斯最优转诊分类器的超额风险受 LLM 概率的 L1 校准误差控制。
Result: 在 LIDC-IDRI 上的七路输入消融 (seven-way input ablation) 覆盖五款前沿 LLM，结果显示自然语言描述主导诊断信号，而低层图像统计在诊断上基本无效；ConfTriage 达到 F1 88.22%、AUC 0.92，76.5% 的病例由零样本 LLM 推理解决，仅不确定病例转给专业 DL 后备模型。
Conclusion: 摘要认为临床上有意义的诊断信息可通过结构化放射学描述捕获，并由校准的 LLM 用于选择性转诊；该框架为医疗决策支持系统中结合通用 LLM 预测与专业 AI 模型提供了实用路径，且源码公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Enhanced Filtering Algorithms for the Euclidean Traveling Salesperson Problem and its variants in Constraint Logic Programming
papers.abstract_en: The Traveling Salesperson Problem (TSP) is one of the best-known problems in computer science and arises in many engineering applications, such as smart vehicles and intelligent transportation systems. In the "Euclidean" case, each node is defined by its coordinates in the plane and distances are computed using the Euclidean metric. In the Constraint Programming (CP) literature, the Euclidean TSP is typically addressed by computing the full distance matrix and treating it as a general case; however this approach ignores the geometric information carried by the points' coordinates. In this work, we propose new filtering algorithms, implemented in Constraint Logic Programming (CLP), that exploit such geometric information to achieve stronger constraint propagation than existing approaches. Moreover, we show how this methodology can be extended to other Euclidean variants of the TSP, including the Euclidean Generalized Traveling Salesperson Problem (EGTSP), which is relevant in practical routing and logistics applications. Experimental results demonstrate the computational advantages of the proposed approach.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Theory and Practice of Logic Programming (TPLP), 36 pages, 14 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向欧几里得旅行商问题（Euclidean TSP）及其变体的新型过滤算法（filtering algorithms），在约束逻辑程序设计（CLP）中实现，利用节点坐标的几何信息而非仅依赖完整距离矩阵，以获得更强的约束传播。摘要还声称该方法可推广到欧几里得广义旅行商问题（EGTSP）等变体，实验显示其计算优势。
Motivation: 现有约束编程（CP）文献处理欧几里得 TSP 时通常计算完整距离矩阵并当作一般 TSP 处理，忽略了坐标携带的几何信息，导致约束传播不够强。
Method: 在约束逻辑程序设计（CLP）中实现新的过滤算法，利用点的坐标几何信息来增强约束传播，并将该方法论扩展到其他欧几里得 TSP 变体，包括欧几里得广义旅行商问题（EGTSP）。
Result: 摘要报告实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，所提方法具有计算上的优势；但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为利用几何信息的过滤算法能在约束编程框架下更高效地处理欧几里得 TSP 及其相关变体，对实际路由与物流应用有意义。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: VibeLifeBench: Can Your Life Agent Be Proactive and Persistent in a Living World?
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed as personal assistants. Existing evaluations, however, mostly use short, self-contained requests in static environments. Everyday life assistance is different. A task runs for weeks rather than minutes. The world keeps changing while the agent is not being prompted. Many constraints are never stated outright. An agent that merely answers the request in front of it will fail at such a task. What is needed instead is an agent that stays proactive and consistent. It decides on its own when to act, when to ask, and when to stay silent. It notices changes that nobody announced. It keeps one plan coherent from the first day to the last. No current benchmark measures this. We introduce VibeLifeBench, a benchmark of 200 long-horizon tasks across ten everyday-life domains. Each task is a scripted multi-week timeline in a simulated world of 22 mock services. The world advances on its own clock, and many of its changes are silent, so only an agent that re-inspects the world discovers them. Every task is graded by fine-grained, weighted checks that read only what the agent actually left behind, covering the end state, the timeliness of its actions, and whether it upheld the implicit constraints. We evaluate seven frontier models. All of them score low, which shows how far current agents are from assisting with real life. We will open-source all tasks, environments, and the evaluation framework.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: NullEdit: Stealthy Image Protection via VLM Condition Redirection
papers.abstract_en: Modern image editors combine vision-language models (VLMs) with diffusion transformer backbones to modify a single reference image according to instructions without fine-tuning. This capability also enables unauthorized manipulation of publicly released images. Existing inference-time defenses either invalidate edits through conspicuous corruption, thereby exposing the protection, or allow them to proceed with identity or reference content drift, thereby failing to prevent the editing behavior itself. We instead target a stealthy and harmless no-op in which the requested edit is suppressed, the output remains natural and source-preserving without conspicuous artifacts or identity replacement, and harmful semantics requested by malicious instructions are absent. We propose NullEdit, which targets the VLM representation jointly formed from the reference image and instruction before it conditions the downstream DiT backbone. Using normal-edit and no-edit anchors, NullEdit redirects this representation, while cross-prompt gradient averaging transfers protection to held out instructions. Across Step1X-Edit and Qwen-Image-Edit on CelebA-HQ and VGGFace2, NullEdit reduces the EditReward IF score by 0.813 on average relative to the SOTA baseline while preserving subject identity and source content.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 NullEdit 的推理时防护方法，针对由 VLM 与扩散 transformer 骨干组合的现代图像编辑器，使未经授权的编辑被抑制为一种隐形的无害空操作（no-op）：输出保持自然、保留源内容且无明显伪影，也不出现身份替换或恶意指令所需的有害语义。NullEdit 在 VLM 表征尚未条件化下游 DiT 骨干前，对该由参考图像与指令联合形成的表征进行重定向，并通过跨提示梯度平均（cross-prompt gradient averaging）将保护迁移到未见过的指令。在 Step1X-Edit 和 Qwen-Image-Edit 上、基于 CelebA-HQ 与 VGGFace2 的实验中，NullEdit 将 EditReward IF 分数相对 SOTA 基线平均降低 0.813，同时保持主体身份与源内容。
Motivation: 现代图像编辑器可以把单张参考图像按指令进行修改，这同时使公开发布的图像面临被未经授权操纵的风险。现有的推理时防御要么通过明显破坏使编辑失效从而暴露保护，要么允许编辑进行但伴随身份或参考内容漂移，无法真正阻止编辑行为本身。因此需要一种既隐蔽又能阻止有害编辑行为的防护。
Method: NullEdit 在 VLM 表征被用于条件化下游 DiT 骨干之前，直接重定向由参考图像与指令联合形成的 VLM 表征。它使用正常编辑（normal-edit）与无编辑（no-edit）锚点来引导重定向，并采用跨提示梯度平均将保护泛化到未见过的指令。
Result: 在 Step1X-Edit 和 Qwen-Image-Edit 上结合 CelebA-HQ 与 VGGFace2 的实验中，NullEdit 相对 SOTA 基线平均降低 EditReward IF 分数 0.813，同时保持主体身份和源内容。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过在表征层将受保护图像的编辑重定向为自然且保留源内容的空操作，可以在不暴露防护的前提下抑制恶意编辑语义，并将保护迁移到未见指令。
Relevance: 0
