papers.title: Optimistic Rates for Multiclass PAC Learning
papers.abstract_en: Worst-case multiclass bounds do not become smaller when the best classifier is already nearly correct: what is missing is an optimistic rate, a guarantee whose fluctuation scales with the oracle risk itself. For a class of Natarajan dimension $d_N$ and Daniely-Shalev-Shwartz dimension $d_{DS}$, the optimal excess risk is known at the two endpoints ($d_{DS}/n$ realizable, $\sqrt{d_N/n}+d_{DS}/n$ agnostic [HMZ24, CEH+26, Pab26]) and open in between. We close the gap: at every fixed oracle risk $L^\star$, the optimal excess risk is $\widetildeΘ(\sqrt{L^\star d_N/n}+d_{DS}/n)$, uniformly in the alphabet size, attained by a learner that knows neither $L^\star$ nor the confidence level. The upper bound composes the cover-menu-compression architecture of [CEH+26], at the realizable rate of [Pab26], with a new comparator-facing relative compression theorem: a size-$k$ compression rule that empirically dominates a comparator $h$ has population risk at most $L(h)+O(\sqrt{L(h)Γ}+Γ)$ with $Γ=(k\log n+\log(1/δ))/n$, without stability; this transfers the comparison principle of the sharp binary theory [MQZ26] while discarding its Boolean-cube geometry, which does not lift to multiclass labels. The lower bound forces both terms using one class and one distribution at every fixed $L^\star$, by a pair-Assouad scheme calibrated to $L^\star$ and a fiber argument on the pseudo-cubes underlying the Natarajan-versus-DS separation of [BCD+22]. Both theorems extend to list learning: against the best $r$-tuple of hypotheses, the same architecture and the same two engines yield an optimistic rate and a lower bound of the same shape, forcing the fluctuation term that [Pab26] expected to be necessary against list comparators, and removing the factor $r$ from the known realizable list lower bound.
papers.comment: The main theorems are machine-checked in Lean 4; Section D records what is verified and in which form, and the development is available at https://github.com/xiaoyulics/multiclass-pac-learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出多类 PAC 学习的乐观速率 (optimistic rate)：在固定 oracle 风险 L* 下，最优超额风险为 Θ̃(√(L* d_N/n)+d_DS/n)，其中 d_N 为 Natarajan 维数、d_DS 为 Daniely-Shalev-Shwartz 维数，该界对字母表大小一致，并可由不知道 L* 与置信水平的学习器达到。摘要声称这填补了可实现端点 (d_DS/n) 与不可知端点 (√(d_N/n)+d_DS/n) 之间的空白，并将结果推广到 list learning。
Motivation: 最坏情况多类界在最优分类器已经近乎正确时不会变小，缺少随 oracle 风险本身缩放的乐观保证；此前仅知道可实现与不可知两个端点的最优超额风险，中间风险区间是开放的。
Method: 上界组合了 cover-menu-compression 架构、[Pab26] 的可实现速率，以及一个新的面向比较器 (comparator) 的相对压缩定理，该定理不依赖稳定性；下界使用一个校准到 L* 的 pair-Assouad 方案，并在 Natarajan-versus-DS 分离背后的伪立方体上做 fiber 论证，以在固定 L* 下同时迫使两个误差项出现。
Result: 对每个固定 oracle 风险 L*，最优超额风险为 Θ̃(√(L* d_N/n)+d_DS/n)，统一于字母表大小，且上界由不知道 L* 或置信水平的学习器达到；两个定理均推广到 list learning，对最优 r 元组假设给出相同形状的乐观界与下界，并移除已知可实现 list 下界中的因子 r。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该工作将尖锐二值理论中的比较原理迁移到多类标签，而无需其布尔立方体几何；两个主要定理已在 Lean 4 中机器验证，验证形式记录在论文 Section D，代码公开于 GitHub。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Can Bayesian Optimization Efficiently Find a Strong Single Expert in Neural Thickets?
papers.abstract_en: Gradient-free post-training has emerged as a compelling alternative to gradient-based optimization for large language models (LLMs), but existing approaches remain costly. We ask whether structured search can identify a strong single expert under a modest evaluation budget. Motivated by evidence that useful weight updates lie in low-dimensional subspaces, we apply Bayesian optimization within a random linear embedding of weight space. Our method requires no backpropagation and uses a Gaussian process surrogate to guide candidate evaluations efficiently. Across several reasoning benchmarks with Qwen2.5-Instruct models from 0.5B to 3B parameters, Bayesian optimization using five times less candidate evaluations matches or exceeds RandOpt. These results show that surrogate-guided search can substantially reduce the evaluation cost of gradient-free post-training while producing stronger deployable single experts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在大语言模型的无梯度后训练中，能否用贝叶斯优化在有限的评估预算下找到强单一专家。作者假设有用的权重更新位于低维子空间，因此在权重空间的随机线性嵌入中应用贝叶斯优化，以高斯过程代理引导候选评估，全程不需要反向传播。在 Qwen2.5-Instruct（0.5B 到 3B）的多个推理基准上，用少五倍的候选评估即可达到或超过 RandOpt。
Motivation: 现有的无梯度后训练方法虽然避免了梯度计算，但评估代价仍然高昂。作者希望验证结构化搜索能否在适度评估预算下识别出强单一专家，从而降低后训练成本。
Method: 方法基于权重更新落在低维子空间的证据，将贝叶斯优化应用于权重空间的随机线性嵌入（random linear embedding），使用高斯过程（Gaussian process）代理模型来高效选择候选评估点，且无需反向传播。
Result: 在多个推理基准和 Qwen2.5-Instruct 模型系列（0.5B 至 3B）上，贝叶斯优化使用五分之一于 RandOpt 的候选评估次数，即可达到或超过 RandOpt 的表现。
Conclusion: 摘要表明代理引导搜索（surrogate-guided search）能显著降低无梯度后训练的评估成本，并产出更强的可部署单一专家。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multi-View Relational Distillation for Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong image and video understanding, yet their visual-spatial representations remain geometrically fragile, leading to failures in spatial reasoning needed for embodied AI, robotics, and autonomous driving. Prior approaches to geometry grounding either fine-tune VLMs on spatial question answering, which can perpetuate spurious visual representations, or fuse features from large geometry-grounded vision models, which substantially increases model size at inference. Knowledge distillation from geometry-grounded vision models offers an alternative, but directly matching multi-view teacher features can disrupt the pretrained alignment between visual and textual representations, degrading object- and language-semantic capabilities. We propose multi-view relational distillation (MVRD), which distills patch-wise cosine similarities across views instead of the teacher features themselves. These relations encode geometric correspondences adequate for spatial understanding, while leaving the student representation underdetermined, allowing it to remain close to its pretrained vision- language space. Across representative VLMs, MVRD improves visual-spatial reasoning, outperforming supervised fine-tuning and feature distillation while approaching feature fusion methods with considerably fewer added parameters and lower latency. We show that MVRD makes visual representations more geometric while retaining language alignment, and generalizes to 3D scene understanding tasks such as object grounding, dense captioning, and question answering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视角关系蒸馏 (multi-view relational distillation, MVRD)，用于增强视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的空间推理能力。与直接匹配教师特征不同，MVRD 蒸馏跨视角的 patch-wise 余弦相似度关系，从而在保持学生模型与预训练视觉-语言空间对齐的同时，使视觉表示更具几何性。在代表性 VLM 上，MVRD 优于监督微调和特征蒸馏，并以更少的参数量和更低延迟接近特征融合方法，且可泛化到 3D 场景理解任务。
Motivation: VLM 的视觉空间表示在几何上脆弱，导致空间推理失败，而现有方案要么微调 VLM 可能固化虚假视觉表示，要么融合大模型特征导致推理时模型规模显著增加。
Method: 提出多视角关系蒸馏 (MVRD)，蒸馏跨视角的 patch-wise 余弦相似度而非教师特征本身；这些关系编码几何对应，但留给学生表示欠定约束，使其保持接近预训练的视觉-语言空间。
Result: 在多个代表性 VLM 上，MVRD 提升视觉空间推理，优于监督微调和特征蒸馏，并以更少的额外参数和更低延迟接近特征融合方法；还显示其使视觉表示更几何且保持语言对齐，并泛化到 3D 场景理解（物体定位、密集描述、问答）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过关系而非特征进行蒸馏，可以在增强几何能力的同时避免破坏预训练视觉-语言对齐，为空间推理提供一种参数高效的途径。

summary_sections.motivation: VLM 的视觉空间表示在几何上脆弱，导致空间推理失败，而现有方案要么微调 VLM 可能固化虚假视觉表示，要么融合大模型特征导致推理时模型规模显著增加。
summary_sections.method: 提出多视角关系蒸馏 (MVRD)，蒸馏跨视角的 patch-wise 余弦相似度而非教师特征本身；这些关系编码几何对应，但留给学生表示欠定约束，使其保持接近预训练的视觉-语言空间。
summary_sections.result: 在多个代表性 VLM 上，MVRD 提升视觉空间推理，优于监督微调和特征蒸馏，并以更少的额外参数和更低延迟接近特征融合方法；还显示其使视觉表示更几何且保持语言对齐，并泛化到 3D 场景理解（物体定位、密集描述、问答）。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调通过关系而非特征进行蒸馏，可以在增强几何能力的同时避免破坏预训练视觉-语言对齐，为空间推理提供一种参数高效的途径。

papers.title: Flex-$π$: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility
papers.abstract_en: World-action models (WAMs) predict the future to act better, but nearly all of them predict only RGB latents, trained purely for pixel reconstruction, with no explicit signal for the 3D geometry or object semantics manipulation needs. We find a surprising free lunch: the same frozen video-generation VAE that encodes RGB also encodes 3D pointmaps almost losslessly, with no pointmap-specific training at all. This lets us supervise Flex-$π$, a 6B-parameter WAM, on 3D geometry and object-centric DINO semantics alongside RGB, at no cost in new sensors, new pre-training, or inference latency. Every visual signal is projected into this shared latent space and denoised jointly with actions inside a Mixture-of-Transformers backbone; per-stream dropout with cross-modality forcing then lets a single trained checkpoint run on any subset of these streams, from a fast action-only mode to full joint generation. The result is a policy that is exceptionally demonstration-efficient and generalizes well, beating the strongest baselines by up to 2-7$\times$ on dexterous, precise, real-world bimanual manipulation tasks both in and out of distribution, all while running faster than $π_{0.5}$. Our project website: https://flex-pi.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Flex-π，一个 6B 参数的流式世界-动作模型 (world-action model)，在已有的视频生成 VAE 潜空间中同时监督 RGB、3D pointmap 和物体中心 DINO 语义，而无需新的传感器、预训练或推理延迟开销。模型用 Mixture-of-Transformers 主干联合去噪视觉信号与动作，并通过逐流 dropout 与跨模态强制训练，使单个检查点能在任意流子集上运行。摘要报告其在真实世界灵巧双手操作任务上比最强基线提升最高 2-7×，且推理快于 π0.5。
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型几乎只预测 RGB 潜变量，并仅以像素重建为目标训练，缺乏对操作任务所需的 3D 几何或物体语义的显式监督信号。
Method: 作者发现冻结的视频生成 VAE 在编码 RGB 的同时也几乎无损地编码 3D pointmap，无需 pointmap 专门训练；基于此，Flex-π 将每种视觉信号投影到该共享潜空间，并在 Mixture-of-Transformers 主干中与动作联合去噪，配合逐流 dropout 和跨模态强迫，实现从仅动作模式到完整联合生成的可切换推理。
Result: 摘要报告该策略非常演示高效且泛化良好，在分布内外、真实世界的灵巧精确双手操作任务上以最高 2-7× 的优势超过最强基线，同时运行速度快于 π0.5。
Conclusion: 共享潜空间中的多流监督可以在不增加传感器、预训练或推理延迟的前提下为世界-动作模型引入 3D 几何与语义信号，逐流 dropout 则让单个模型具备计算灵活性。

papers.title: FiGuRO: Intrinsic Dimension Estimation for Multi-Modal Data
papers.abstract_en: Determining the complexity, or Intrinsic Dimension (ID), of data is fundamental to efficient and interpretable representation learning. This is particularly challenging in multi-modal settings when trying to learn disentangled representations for shared and private information. Existing techniques leave a critical gap: they are often static, uni-modal, or in the case of contrastive methods, adapt only to the shared ID implicitly. We introduce Fidelity-Guided Rank Optimization (FiGuRO), a framework for approximating the ID of uni- and multi-modal data under constraints of model capacity and hyperparameters. FiGuRO learns the dimensions of low-rank projections using truncated singular value decomposition and an algorithm that determines when to reduce or increase dimension and in which latent space. Disentanglement of shared and private information arises as an emergent property of this optimization, eliminating the need for complex auxiliary loss functions. We demonstrate that FiGuRO outperforms existing ID estimation techniques and is more robust to hyperparameter changes. Across simulations and real-world data, FiGuRO captures distinct ID scales and varying subspace ratios, and decomposes shared and private information successfully. Furthermore, we show that FiGuRO can be applied to modern uni-modal pretrained models, enabling efficient, post-hoc disentanglement of multi-modal representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fidelity-Guided Rank Optimization (FiGuRO)，一个在模型容量与超参数约束下估计单模态和多模态数据内在维度 (Intrinsic Dimension, ID) 的框架。FiGuRO 通过截断奇异值分解学习低秩投影的维度，并用算法决定在哪个潜空间中何时增大或减小维度；共享与私有信息的解耦作为该优化的涌现属性出现，无需复杂辅助损失。摘要报告 FiGuRO 在模拟和真实数据上优于现有 ID 估计方法，对超参数变化更稳健，并能对现代单模态预训练模型进行后验的多模态表示解耦。
Motivation: 确定数据的内在维度是高效且可解释表示学习的基础，但在多模态场景中学习共享与私有信息的解耦表示时尤为困难。现有技术存在关键空白：它们通常是静态的、单模态的，而对比方法 (contrastive methods) 只能隐式地适应共享内在维度。
Method: FiGuRO 利用截断奇异值分解 (truncated singular value decomposition) 学习低秩投影的维度，并结合一个算法来决定在哪个潜空间中减少或增加维度，从而在模型容量和超参数约束下逼近单模态与多模态数据的 ID。
Result: 摘要表明 FiGuRO 优于现有 ID 估计技术，且对超参数变化更稳健；在模拟与真实数据中能捕获不同的 ID 尺度与变化的子空间比例，并成功分解共享和私有信息。此外，该方法可应用于现代单模态预训练模型，实现高效的后验多模态表示解耦。
Conclusion: 作者强调共享与私有信息的解耦是 FiGuRO 优化的涌现属性，消除了复杂辅助损失函数的必要，并展示了其对预训练模型的后验适用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Diffract: Spectral View of LLM Domain Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: We study continual pre-training (CPT) as a mechanism for adapting general-purpose large language models to specialized domains: mathematics, instruction, code, and natural text. Using singular value decomposition of weight matrices, we find that CPT leaves singular value spectra largely invariant, with adaptation driven mainly by changes in singular vectors. An analysis of attention-head projection matrices reveals strong, domain-dependent head heterogeneity, which we exploit to define a head importance criterion: up to 60% of head updates can be removed without measurable quality loss. Selectively rewinding low-importance heads to their pre-trained state improves benchmark accuracy by up to 4% versus the fully trained baseline. Finally, we identify domain connectivity - linear interpolation between CPT checkpoints yields smooth domain-quality interpolation without notable degradation on either domain - and release Diffract, an open-source toolkit for scalable spectral analysis of billion-parameter models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究持续预训练 (continual pre-training, CPT) 如何将通用大语言模型适应到数学、指令、代码和自然文本等专业领域。通过对权重矩阵做奇异值分解 (SVD)，作者发现 CPT 几乎不改变奇异值谱，适应主要来自奇异向量的变化；并基于注意力头投影矩阵的领域异质性提出头重要性准则。选择性回滚低重要性头可带来最多 4% 的基准准确率提升，同时 CPT 检查点之间的线性插值表现出平滑的领域质量插值。论文还发布了开源工具 Diffract，用于十亿参数模型的谱分析。
Motivation: 通用大语言模型需要高效地适应专业领域，但 CPT 过程中模型内部表示的哪些部分发生变化、哪些部分可以裁剪仍不清楚；理解这种适应机制有助于减少不必要的更新并提升领域适应质量。
Method: 使用权重矩阵的奇异值分解分析 CPT 前后的谱变化，并利用注意力头投影矩阵的强领域依赖异质性定义头重要性准则。该方法允许移除最多 60% 的头更新而不损害质量，并可选择性地将低重要性头重绕回预训练状态。
Result: 摘要报告：(1) CPT 基本保持奇异值谱不变，适应主要由奇异向量驱动；(2) 基于头重要性的选择性重绕在基准上比完全训练基线提升最多 4% 准确率；(3) CPT 检查点间的线性插值产生平滑的领域质量插值，无明显退化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CPT 的领域适应主要发生在奇异向量而非奇异值上，且注意力头存在可被利用的稀疏性；领域连通性表明不同领域检查点之间可以线性插值。该结论基于谱分析与头重绕实验，并配套开源工具 Diffract。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Spectral Embeddings of Degree-$α$ Laplacians in Random Dot Product Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Spectral clustering methods for network data are commonly based on a few matrix representations, such as the adjacency matrix and the symmetric Laplacian. We study a continuum of degree-normalized spectral embeddings that includes these commonly used choices as special cases. Under a random dot product graph model, we establish a row-wise central limit theorem for this family of embeddings. The result provides an explicit description of how degree normalization affects both population geometry and the local uncertainty of embedded nodes. We use the limiting distributions to compare different normalizations in two-community stochastic block models through a projected-Gaussian Bayes-error diagnostic. These comparisons show that no single normalization is uniformly preferred. Instead, the favored normalization depends on network density, community imbalance, and block-probability structure. Typically, stronger normalization is favored in lower-density or more imbalanced settings. These results provide a unified distributional understanding of when and why alternative normalizations may improve spectral clustering.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机点积图 (random dot product graph) 下度归一化谱嵌入的连续族，该族以邻接矩阵和对称拉普拉斯为特例。作者建立了这一族嵌入的行向中心极限定理，明确刻画度归一化如何影响总体几何与节点局部不确定性，并在两社区随机块模型中用投影高斯贝叶斯误差诊断比较不同归一化。
Motivation: 谱聚类通常依赖邻接矩阵或对称拉普拉斯等少数矩阵表示，缺乏对度归一化如何影响嵌入性质的统一理解，实际中不同归一化的优劣条件不明确。
Method: 在随机点积图模型下对一族度归一化谱嵌入建立行向中心极限定理，并利用极限分布构造投影高斯贝叶斯误差诊断，用于比较两社区随机块模型中的不同归一化方案。
Result: 比较显示不存在统一最优的归一化；更优的归一化取决于网络密度、社区不平衡程度和块概率结构，通常在低密度或更不平衡的设置中更强的归一化更受青睐。
Conclusion: 该结果提供了关于何时以及为何不同归一化可能改善谱聚类的统一分布性理解。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Hypothesis Frontier: Verifier Guided LLM and Symbolic Search for First-Order Induction
papers.abstract_en: First-order concept synthesis asks a system to infer one formula that classifies labeled objects consistently across several finite relational structures. Every candidate can be evaluated exactly, but quantified first-order formulas form a vast search space, and LLM outputs are often semantically promising without being fully correct. We introduce Hypothesis Frontier, a verifier-guided neurosymbolic framework that evaluates each LLM formula on every training object, retains the strongest verified hypothesis across rounds, and uses its remaining errors to guide subsequent generation. Symbolic processing repairs invalid formulas while remaining anchored to the LLM-generated hypothesis, and simplifies train-valid formulas without changing any training prediction. Under matched models, problem sets, and LLM-round budgets, Hypothesis Frontier solves substantially more problems than repeated original-prompt generation. After the final formulas are selected, exact simplification shortens many train-valid formulas while preserving every training prediction. Exact symbolic reasoning therefore helps both to solve more induction problems and to compress many of the resulting formulas.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hypothesis Frontier，一个验证器引导的神经符号框架，用于解决一阶概念合成（first-order concept synthesis）问题：系统需从有限关系结构中推断出一个能一致分类标记对象的一阶公式。框架对每个 LLM 生成的候选公式在所有训练对象上做精确验证，跨轮次保留最强的已验证假设，并利用剩余错误引导后续生成，同时用符号处理修复非法公式并对训练-验证公式做保持预测的化简。摘要报告在匹配的模型、问题集和 LLM 轮次预算下，该方法比重复原始提示生成解决更多问题，且最终公式的精确化简能缩短许多训练-验证公式并保持每个训练预测不变。
Motivation: 一阶概念合成的候选公式量化搜索空间巨大，LLM 输出往往在语义上有前景但并非完全正确，需要精确验证与引导机制来提升成功率。
Method: 提出验证器引导的神经符号框架：逐对象评估 LLM 公式、保留跨轮次最强已验证假设、用剩余错误指导后续生成；符号处理负责修复非法公式，并在不改变训练预测的前提下化简训练-验证公式。
Result: 在匹配的模型、问题集和 LLM 轮次预算下，比重复原始提示生成解决显著更多的问题；最终公式选择后的精确化简缩短了许多训练-验证公式，同时保留全部训练预测。
Conclusion: 精确符号推理既能帮助解决更多归纳问题，也能压缩许多最终公式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The GENEA Challenge 2026: A Large-Scale Disentangled Evaluation of Speech-Driven Gesture Generation on the Seamless Interaction Dataset
papers.abstract_en: This preprint presents the results of the fourth GENEA Challenge, a large-scale human evaluation of five speech-driven gesture-generation systems trained by participating teams on the Seamless Interaction dataset of dyadic conversations. As in the 2023 GENEA Challenge, we used a disentangled evaluation methodology to assess motion quality and speech alignment without confounding between the two, and performed a dyadic mismatching study to isolate the effect of listening and reacting to the interlocutor. We additionally introduce a new semantic gesture-generation task and a text-mismatching evaluation methodology using the Grounded Gestures subset of the data. In total, we ran four large-scale user studies, collecting over 23,000 votes from 869 test-takers. In the motion-realism study, the dataset's filtered segments had substantially higher motion quality than all challenge submissions (68-95% pairwise winrate). In the speech-alignment study, the motion-capture segments provided a conceptual ceiling at 62% alignment score, with the top submission significantly behind at 32% and the rest only slightly above the 0% expected of an input-independent system. In the dyadic study, motion capture again set the ceiling at 65% appropriateness score, but no submission scored substantially above chance, indicating that the systems could not yet respond to the interlocutor. Finally, the semantic mismatching evaluation found highly expressive gestures in the dataset (test-takers identified the matching transcript 79% of the time), yet almost all submissions failed to generate semantically expressive motion, with the best achieving only an 8% appropriateness score. The collected votes and outputs will be made publicly available at https://genea-workshop.github.io/2026/challenge/ to facilitate reproducibility and further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是第四届 GENEA Challenge 的成果报告，对五个参赛团队在 Seamless Interaction 双人对话数据集上训练的语言驱动手势生成系统进行了大规模人工评估。作者采用 2023 年挑战赛的去混淆评估方法分离运动质量与语音对齐，并新增了语义手势生成任务和基于 Grounded Gestures 子集的文本失配评估方法。共开展四项大规模用户研究，收集了 869 名测试者的 23,000 余票。结果显示数据集的过滤片段在运动真实感上远超所有提交系统（68-95% 成对胜率），而语音对齐、双人交互响应和语义表达方面各提交系统均明显落后于动作捕捉上限。
Motivation: 语言驱动手势生成需要可靠的评估方法，既要分别评测运动质量和语音对齐，也要考察系统能否对对话者做出反应以及是否产生语义上可辨识的手势。
Method: 提出第四届 GENEA Challenge 的评估框架：对五个系统采用去混淆（disentangled）的用户研究分别评测运动质量和语音对齐，通过双人失配（dyadic mismatching）研究分离倾听与回应对话者的效果，并引入新的语义手势生成任务和文本失配（text-mismatching）评估方法，使用 Seamless Interaction 数据集的 Grounded Gestures 子集。
Result: 在运动真实感研究中，数据集的过滤片段对所有提交系统达到 68-95% 成对胜率；语音对齐研究中动作捕捉片段给出 62% 的概念上限，最佳提交仅 32%，其余系统略高于输入无关系统预期的 0%；双人研究中动作捕捉上限为 65%，但没有提交系统明显高于随机水平；语义失配评估中测试者能在 79% 的情况下识别数据集中匹配的文本，而最佳提交的语义适当性仅 8%。共收集 23,000 余票。
Conclusion: 摘要强调现有系统与动作捕捉数据在语音对齐、对话者响应和语义表达上仍有巨大差距，并指出投票和输出将公开以促进可复现性和后续研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: PolyLayout: Hierarchical VLM-Guided Layout Generation Beyond Rectangular Rooms
papers.abstract_en: Generating physically plausible 3D room layouts is essential for home furnishing retail, enabling customers to visualize products in their own homes and confidently make purchasing decisions. However, a gap exists between academic research and real-world application: existing solutions primarily focus on algorithmic strategies for furniture placement, largely neglecting the non-rectangular geometries and strict door/window constraints prevalent in real homes. To bridge the gap, we introduce a hybrid, hierarchical framework tailored for retail, specifically designed to support scalable spatial planning applications. Our system decouples generation into three stages: (1) functional furniture clustering and fine-grained intra-zone placement; (2) macro-routing guided by a vision-language model (VLM) to anchor both these clustered zones and any remaining standalone furniture within diverse polygonal boundaries; and (3) rule-based optimization for collision-free micro-arrangements that respect architectural constraints. We evaluate our system on production-scale catalogs and a representative set of irregular real-world topologies. Our results show that our approach attains the highest perceptual plausibility while maintaining good geometric compliance at relatively low latency, and extends to irregular boundaries that existing methods do not natively support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyLayout，一个面向家居零售的混合分层框架，用于在非矩形房间中生成物理上合理的 3D 室内布局。系统将生成过程解耦为三个层次：功能区家具聚类与区域内细粒度摆放、由视觉语言模型（VLM）引导的宏路径规划以在多变多边形边界内锚定区域和孤立家具、以及遵守建筑约束的无碰撞规则优化。作者在生产规模目录和代表性不规则真实拓扑上评估，声称达到最高感知合理性，同时保持良好几何合规性和较低延迟，并支持现有方法原生不支持的不规则边界。
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注家具放置的算法策略，忽略了真实住宅中普遍存在的非矩形几何以及严格的门窗约束，导致学术研究与实际零售应用之间存在差距。
Method: 提出一种混合分层系统，将布局生成分解为三阶段：先进行功能性家具聚类和区域内细粒度摆放；再用 VLM 引导的宏观路由（macro-routing）在多样化多边形边界内锚定聚类区域和剩余独立家具；最后通过基于规则的优化实现满足建筑约束的无碰撞微观排列。
Result: 系统在生产规模目录和代表性不规则真实拓扑上评估，相比现有方法获得最高的感知合理性，同时保持较好的几何合规性并具有较低延迟，且能扩展到现有方法原生不支持的不规则边界。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法弥合了学术研究与零售落地之间的差距，支持可扩展的空间规划，尤其适用于非矩形房间和门窗约束等真实场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TACTICL: Task-Aware Compression of Tabular ICL Models
papers.abstract_en: The strong performance of foundation models for tabular tasks comes at substantial inference costs. Distilling models into task-specific architectures reduces model size and computational demands but also sacrifices in-context adaptability. Here we introduce TACTICL, an automated task-aware compression framework for tabular in-context learning models that jointly prunes transformer layers and replaces them with lightweight adapters trained on downstream tasks, thus blending in-context with in-weight learning. We study TACTICL on 47 benchmark datasets and show that we can substitute up to 85% of layers without substantial performance drop on a given downstream task. We further show that TACTICL maintains robustness to data shifts, leaving its in-context ability intact. Overall, TACTICL provides a robust framework for exploiting the depth-wise redundancy of tabular foundation models by combining task-specific adaptation and structured compression. We provide the code at: https://github.com/Hebog/tfm_compression
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TACTICL，一个面向表格上下文学习模型 (tabular in-context learning models) 的自动化任务感知压缩框架，通过联合剪枝 Transformer 层并用轻量适配器替换，在保留部分上下文学习能力的同时降低推理成本。在 47 个基准数据集上，方法可以替换最多 85% 的层而不会造成显著性能下降，并保持对数据偏移的鲁棒性。作者将代码开源在 GitHub。
Motivation: 表格基础模型虽然性能强，但推理成本高；蒸馏到任务特定架构虽能减小模型和算力需求，却牺牲了上下文自适应 (in-context adaptability) 能力。
Method: TACTICL 自动化地对表格上下文学习模型进行任务感知压缩，联合地剪枝 Transformer 层并将被剪枝层替换为在下游任务上训练的轻量适配器，从而混合上下文学习 (in-context learning) 与权重内学习 (in-weight learning)。
Result: 在 47 个基准数据集上，TACTICL 可以替换最多 85% 的层而不出现明显的下游任务性能下降；作者还表明压缩后模型对数据偏移的鲁棒性保持不变。
Conclusion: TACTICL 通过结合任务特定适配与结构化压缩，提供了一种利用表格基础模型深度冗余的稳健压缩框架。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Whisper-Aware LLM: Self-Supervised Uncertainty Learning for Robust Whispered Speech Recognition
papers.abstract_en: The signal ambiguity of whispered speech drives ASR systems toward two opposing failure modes: failing to capture whispered speech or hallucinatory transcription of noise. This paper introduces the Whisper-Aware LLM, a framework that teaches an Audio-LLM to perceive and react to this uncertainty. Our model develops an intrinsic self-awareness by learning to quantify the physical deficiencies of acoustic signals through targeted self-supervised tasks. This learned uncertainty is then operationalized via a novel Confidence-Fused Decoding mechanism, which provides both high-level instructions and frame-level attention modulation to the LLM decoder. Our experiments confirm the effectiveness of this approach. The model sets a new state-of-the-art on whispered speech with a 17% relative CER reduction on AISHELL6-Whisper. At the same time, it directly addresses the reliability trade-off, with hallucination rates dropping from over 25% to 4.5%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Whisper-Aware LLM，面向耳语音 (whispered speech) 识别中的信号模糊性问题，通过自监督任务让 Audio-LLM 学习量化声学信号的物理缺陷，从而获得内在的不确定性感知。该不确定性通过新颖的 Confidence-Fused Decoding 机制作用于 LLM 解码器，同时提供高层指令和帧级注意力调制。实验表明该方法在 AISHELL6-Whisper 上取得新的最先进结果，相对 CER 降低 17%，并将幻觉率从超过 25% 降至 4.5%。
Motivation: 耳语音的信号模糊性会使 ASR 系统走向两种对立的失败模式：要么无法捕捉耳语音，要么把噪声幻觉式地转写为语音。现有系统缺乏对这种不确定性的显式感知，因此需要让 Audio-LLM 学会感知并应对不确定性。
Method: 提出 Whisper-Aware LLM 框架：通过针对性的自监督任务学习量化声学信号的物理缺陷，形成模型的内在自我感知；再利用 Confidence-Fused Decoding 机制，将学习到的不确定性转化为高层指令与帧级注意力调制，引导 LLM 解码器。
Result: 在 AISHELL6-Whisper 上取得新的最先进结果，相对 CER 降低 17%；同时幻觉率从超过 25% 下降到 4.5%，说明该方法直接改善了识别可靠性。
Conclusion: 本文表明，让 Audio-LLM 显式学习并利用不确定性，可以在提升耳语音识别精度的同时显著降低幻觉率，缓解可靠性与识别性能之间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 耳语音的信号模糊性会使 ASR 系统走向两种对立的失败模式：要么无法捕捉耳语音，要么把噪声幻觉式地转写为语音。现有系统缺乏对这种不确定性的显式感知，因此需要让 Audio-LLM 学会感知并应对不确定性。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Whisper-Aware LLM 框架：通过针对性的自监督任务学习量化声学信号的物理缺陷，形成模型的内在自我感知；再利用 Confidence-Fused Decoding 机制，将学习到的不确定性转化为高层指令与帧级注意力调制，引导 LLM 解码器。
summary_sections.result: 在 AISHELL6-Whisper 上取得新的最先进结果，相对 CER 降低 17%；同时幻觉率从超过 25% 下降到 4.5%，说明该方法直接改善了识别可靠性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文表明，让 Audio-LLM 显式学习并利用不确定性，可以在提升耳语音识别精度的同时显著降低幻觉率，缓解可靠性与识别性能之间的权衡。

papers.title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) achieve impressive visual reasoning and dialogue capabilities, yet frequently hallucinate content unsupported by the visual input. Effective mitigation requires token-level localization, enabling targeted intervention without discarding the entire response. Existing detectors require expensive full-model fine-tuning, rely on external verifiers that ignore the model's generation process, or reduce internal signals to isolated features and hand-crafted statistics, discarding spatial, sequential, and relational structure. We introduce \textbf{UniProbe}, a lightweight, unified, learnable detector that models a frozen LVLM's heterogeneous computational trace from a single forward pass. UniProbe constructs a directed graph over image patches, query tokens, and generated tokens, with attention weights encoding their relations. It processes this trace with alternating structure-aware modules: a GNN for relational evidence, a ViT for 2-D visual geometry, and a GRU for response order. Interleaving them allows spatial, relational, and sequential evidence to interact throughout the detector. We further develop a streaming variant for hallucination-aware decoding, which detects and resamples hallucinated tokens during generation, and a self-adaptation strategy aligning the detector with the LVLM's own generations. Across diverse LVLM backbones, UniProbe achieves state-of-the-art token-level and object-hallucination detection. During decoding, it reduces object hallucinations by up to 55\% at $1.06\times$ the latency of standard generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniProbe，一种轻量级、可学习的 token 级幻觉检测器，它利用冻结的大型视觉-语言模型 (LVLM) 在单次前向传播中的计算痕迹，构建以图像块、查询 token 和生成 token 为节点、注意力权重为边的有向图。检测器交替使用 GNN、ViT 和 GRU 三种结构感知模块来融合关系、二维视觉几何与响应顺序信息。作者报告该方法在多种 LVLM 主干上取得 token 级和 object-hallucination 检测的最新结果，并在解码时以约 1.06 倍标准生成延迟将 object hallucination 最高降低 55%。
Motivation: LVLM 经常生成视觉输入不支持的幻觉内容，有效缓解需要 token 级定位以便进行定向干预。已有检测器要么需要昂贵的全模型微调，要么依赖忽略模型生成过程的外部验证器，要么将内部信号简化为孤立特征和手工统计，丢失了空间、序列和关系结构。
Method: UniProbe 从单次前向传播中提取冻结 LVLM 的异构计算痕迹，将其建模为有向图，并用交替的结构感知模块处理：GNN 捕捉关系证据、ViT 处理二维视觉几何、GRU 建模响应顺序。此外还提出用于幻觉感知解码的流式变体，在生成过程中检测并重采样幻觉 token，以及一种让检测器与 LVLM 自身生成对齐的自适应策略。
Result: 在多种 LVLM 主干上，UniProbe 在 token 级和 object-hallucination 检测上达到最先进水平；在解码阶段，它以标准生成约 1.06 倍延迟将 object hallucination 最多降低 55%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，建模冻结 LVLM 单次前向传播的完整计算痕迹并让空间、关系和顺序证据交互，可得到轻量且统一的幻觉检测器；流式变体进一步使其可用于幻觉感知解码。

papers.title: MIRA: Medical Image Reflection for Agentic Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Medical visual agents can use tools to inspect images and retrieve external knowledge, but indiscriminate tool use may introduce noisy or misleading evidence. Reliable diagnosis therefore requires not only acquiring additional observations, but also verifying whether tool actions are necessary and whether the resulting evidence supports the current hypothesis. We introduce MIRA (Medical Image Reflection for Agentic Diagnosis), a medical visual diagnostic framework for autonomous evidence search and reflective verification. MIRA dynamically invokes image-processing operations, including zooming, grounding, pointing, rotation, and measurement, as well as web search, while evaluating the relevance and consistency of the acquired evidence. We develop MIRA through a two-stage training strategy. First, a tool-augmented Monte Carlo Tree Search data engine explores diverse diagnostic hypotheses and jointly verifies visual grounding accuracy and semantic consistency to construct supervised fine-tuning trajectories. Second, reinforcement learning further improves decision-making through online reflective principle evolution: failure cases are distilled into candidate principles, and only principles that improve held-out rollout rewards are retained. Across nine medical visual reasoning benchmarks, MIRA achieves an average score of 64.73, improving its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone by 7.44 points. It also increases useful tool-use judgments from 56.2% to 73.8% and reduces harmful judgments from 8.9% to 1.6%. Qualitative analyses show that MIRA can re-examine evidence, correct premature conclusions, and adapt its tool-use strategy. Project page: https://MIRA-VL.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIRA (Medical Image Reflection for Agentic Diagnosis)，一个面向医学图像的自主诊断框架，通过动态调用图像处理工具（缩放、定位、指向、旋转、测量）和网络搜索来获取证据，并对证据的相关性与一致性进行反思性验证。摘要报告其在九个医学视觉推理基准上平均得分 64.73，比 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干提升 7.44 分，并将有用的工具使用判断从 56.2% 提高到 73.8%。
Motivation: 医学视觉智能体可以借助工具检查图像和检索外部知识，但不加区分地使用工具可能引入噪声或误导性证据；可靠诊断不仅需要获取额外观测，还需要验证工具动作是否必要以及证据是否支持当前假设。
Method: 提出两阶段训练策略：先用工具增强的蒙特卡洛树搜索（Monte Carlo Tree Search, MCTS）数据引擎探索多样诊断假设，并联合验证视觉定位准确性与语义一致性以构造监督微调轨迹；再用强化学习通过在线反思性原理进化（reflective principle evolution）改进决策，从失败案例中提炼候选原理，仅保留能提升留出 rollout 奖励的原理。
Result: 在九个医学视觉推理基准上，MIRA 平均得分 64.73，较 Qwen3-VL-8B 骨干提升 7.44 分；有用工具使用判断从 56.2% 升至 73.8%，有害判断从 8.9% 降至 1.6%。定性分析显示 MIRA 能重新检查证据、纠正过早结论并调整工具使用策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将工具使用与反思性验证相结合，并利用 MCTS 数据引擎和在线原理进化进行训练，可以有效提升医学视觉智能体诊断的可靠性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Neural Introspection Gating for Adaptive KV-Cache Reuse in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action(VLA) models map camera images and language instructions directly to motor commands through a single autoregressive transformer. In real-time control, they still spend substantial compute recomputing key-value(KV) representations for visual tokens that barely change across neighboring frames. Recent work such as VLA-Cache reduces that cost by reusing KV states for visually static patches, but its policy relies only on observation-space heuristics and does not account for the model's own uncertainty. We propose Gated VLA-Cache, a lightweight, training-free extension that augments visual-similarity caching with neural introspection. The method monitors the logit margin between the top two predicted action tokens, a zero-cost confidence signal available during decoding. When the margin drops below a threshold, the cache is invalidated and a full recompute is triggered. Evaluated on four LIBERO benchmark suites with both OpenVLA and OpenVLA-OFT, Gated VLA-Cache improves reliability when blind caching hurts. On LIBERO-Goal and LIBERO-Long, it recovers over 100% of the lost accuracy while retaining 80% of the compute savings.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, Accepted in IROS 2026. Project Page: https://zjw4321.github.io/neural-introspection-gating-page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gated VLA-Cache，一种无需训练（training-free）的轻量扩展，旨在为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的 KV 缓存复用加入神经自省（neural introspection）机制。方法在解码时监测前两个预测动作 token 之间的 logit margin，当该置信度信号低于阈值时使缓存失效并触发完整重算。在四个 LIBERO 基准套件上结合 OpenVLA 与 OpenVLA-OFT 评估，结果表明该方法能在纯视觉相似性缓存失效时提升可靠性，并在 LIBERO-Goal 和 LIBERO-Long 上恢复超过 100% 的精度损失且保留 80% 的计算节省。
Motivation: 现有 KV 缓存复用方法（如 VLA-Cache）仅依赖观测空间的视觉相似性启发式来决定复用哪些 token，没有考虑模型自身对当前预测的不确定性，因此在视觉看似静态但模型并不确定的场景下，盲目缓存会损害可靠性。
Method: 在既有视觉相似性缓存之上，监测解码过程中前两个预测动作 token 的 logit margin 作为零成本的置信度信号；当 margin 低于阈值时使缓存失效并触发对该部分的完整重算，从而实现缓存复用与模型不确定性的联动。
Result: 在四个 LIBERO 基准套件上使用 OpenVLA 与 OpenVLA-OFT 评估，Gated VLA-Cache 在盲目缓存造成损害时提升了可靠性；具体在 LIBERO-Goal 和 LIBERO-Long 上恢复了超过 100% 的精度损失，同时保留 80% 的计算节省。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将模型自身的解码不确定性作为缓存失效信号，是一种无需训练即可提升 KV 缓存复用可靠性的有效方法；结论基于 LIBERO 基准与 OpenVLA 系列模型的评估场景。

papers.title: MoE Proxy Models for Low-Cost Failure Reproduction and Diagnosis in LLM RL Post-Training
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training of large language models (LLMs) is computationally intensive and involves complex system pipelines with substantial debugging overhead. In practice, factors such as framework adaptation, numerical precision, and operator implementation can cause failures, including gradient overflow and loss divergence. Reproducing such failures directly on large models requires considerable time and computational resources. This paper systematically analyzes failures encountered during large-scale RL training on the Huawei Ascend platform, summarizes representative failure types, and identifies three model-side factors relevant to fault reproduction. Based on these factors, we propose a proxy-model construction method for low-cost fault investigation and auxiliary diagnosis. It employs structure-preserving, clustering-based expert pruning to select representative experts while retaining the model's backbone architecture, routing mechanism, and basic task capabilities. Our experimental results show that the proxy models reduce accelerator requirements by 50%-87.5% and achieve up to a 33.3x reduction in per-step NPU-hour cost, while preserving major training dynamics and reproducing fault responses consistent with the original models. Overall, the proxy models can serve as low-cost surrogates for fault reproduction, targeted validation, and auxiliary diagnosis in RL post-training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）强化学习（RL）后训练中故障复现成本高的问题，系统分析了华为昇腾平台上大规模 RL 训练中遇到的故障类型，并提出一种代理模型（proxy model）构建方法，通过结构保持的、基于聚类的专家剪枝来选择代表性专家，同时保留模型主干架构、路由机制和基础任务能力。实验表明代理模型可将加速器需求降低 50%-87.5%，每步 NPU 小时成本最多降低 33.3 倍，同时保持主要训练动态并复现与原模型一致的故障响应。
Motivation: LLM 的 RL 后训练计算密集且系统流水线复杂，框架适配、数值精度和算子实现等因素可能导致梯度溢出或损失发散等故障；直接在大模型上复现这类故障需要大量时间和计算资源，调试开销高昂。
Method: 作者识别了与故障复现相关的三个模型侧因素，提出一种代理模型构建方法：采用结构保持的、基于聚类的专家剪枝（clustering-based expert pruning）选择代表性专家，保留模型的骨干网络结构、路由机制和基本任务能力，从而在低成本下复现训练动态与故障行为。
Result: 在华为昇腾平台上，代理模型将加速器需求减少 50%-87.5%，每步 NPU 小时成本最多降低 33.3 倍，并且能够保持主要训练动态、复现与原模型一致的故障响应。
Conclusion: 代理模型可以作为 RL 后训练中故障复现、定向验证和辅助诊断的低成本替代方案，降低调试所需的时间和计算开销。

summary_sections.conclusion: 代理模型可以作为 RL 后训练中故障复现、定向验证和辅助诊断的低成本替代方案，降低调试所需的时间和计算开销。

papers.title: Reference-Free Post-Training of Open Large Language Models for Multilingual Machine Translation
papers.abstract_en: We study reference-free post-training for multilingual machine translation with open large language models. Starting from the supervised-finetuned MiLMMT-46-v0.1 models, we apply Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a reward that averages two reference-free quality estimation models and is gated by language identification. We then linearly interpolate the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) model checkpoints to obtain MiLMMT-46-v1.0. Across 46 languages, the resulting models consistently improve translation quality over their SFT counterparts, outperform strong recent open baselines, including Seed-X, HY-MT2, and TranslateGemma, and achieve leading reference-free scores against evaluated proprietary systems such as Google Translate, Gemini 3 Pro, and GPT-5. We further investigate on-policy distillation and find that it reaches, but does not surpass, the quality frontier achieved by RL with checkpoint interpolation. We release the models and code to facilitate future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究开放大语言模型（LLM）在多语种机器翻译上的无参考后训练（reference-free post-training）。作者从监督微调（SFT）的 MiLMMT-46-v0.1 出发，使用 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization），奖励由两个无参考质量评估模型平均并受语言识别门控，再对 SFT 与强化学习（RL）检查点做线性插值得到 MiLMMT-46-v1.0。在 46 种语言上，模型一致超过 SFT 版本，并优于 Seed-X、HY-MT2、TranslateGemma 等近期开源基线，在无参考评估得分上领先 Google Translate、Gemini 3 Pro、GPT-5 等专有系统。作者还发现在线策略蒸馏能达到但未超越 RL 加检查点插值所获得的质量前沿，并公开了模型与代码。
Motivation: 多语种机器翻译的 RL 后训练通常依赖参考译文或人工反馈，成本高且难以扩展；作者希望验证仅使用无参考质量评估模型作为奖励信号，能否稳定提升开放 LLM 的翻译质量。
Method: 以 SFT 模型 MiLMMT-46-v0.1 为起点，用 GRPO 进行强化学习，奖励为两个无参考质量评估模型的平均值并经语言识别（language identification）门控；随后对 SFT 与 RL 检查点做线性插值得到 MiLMMT-46-v1.0，并额外对比在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）。
Result: 在 46 种语言上，MiLMMT-46-v1.0 一致优于对应的 SFT 模型，超过 Seed-X、HY-MT2、TranslateGemma 等开放基线，并在无参考评估分数上领先 Google Translate、Gemini 3 Pro、GPT-5 等专有系统；在线策略蒸馏达到但未超过 RL 加检查点插值的质量前沿。
Conclusion: 作者认为无参考奖励驱动的 RL 后训练结合检查点插值是一种有效的缩放路径，而在线策略蒸馏并未带来额外增益；论文开放模型与代码以促进后续研究。

papers.title: Surfacing the Unsaid: CUE-Bench for Affective Stance in Chinese Discourse
papers.abstract_en: Emotion understanding in discourse requires reasoning beyond surface sentiment because speakers often convey affect through indirect, implicit, polite, ironic, or deliberately mismatched expressions. Existing emotion benchmarks mainly annotate surface polarity or final emotion categories, while lacking a structured account of how explicit expression, implicit affect, pragmatic intent, and fine grained emotion interact. This limitation makes current evaluations insensitive to cases where affective meaning is concealed, weakened, inverted, or pragmatically reshaped, thereby obscuring model failures in deeper emotion understanding. To address this gap, we introduce CUE Bench, a Chinese Unsaid Emotion benchmark that centers on Affective Stance and covers diverse communicative scenarios. CUE Bench constructs nine human interpretable affective stances from explicit implicit polarity interaction and further provides intent and fine grained emotion annotations for structured affective inference. Experiments show that incorporating Affective Stance improves fine grained emotion recognition by 3.5 percentage points and pragmatic intent detection by 7.8 percentage points over strong baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CUE-Bench，一个面向中文语篇中“未言明情感”（Unsaid Emotion）的基准，核心标注为情感立场（Affective Stance），覆盖多种交际场景。基准从显式-隐式极性交互中构建九种人类可解释的情感立场，并提供意图与细粒度情感标注以支持结构化情感推断。摘要报告，加入 Affective Stance 后，细粒度情感识别提升 3.5 个百分点，语用意图检测提升 7.8 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有情感基准多标注表面极性或最终情感类别，缺少对显式表达、隐式情感、语用意图与细粒度情感之间交互的结构化刻画，因此对情感被隐藏、削弱、反转或经语用重塑的案例不敏感，掩盖了模型在深层情感理解上的失败。
Method: 提出 CUE-Bench，一个以 Affective Stance 为核心的中文未言明情感基准；通过显式与隐式极性交互构建九种人类可解释的情感立场，并补充意图（intent）与细粒度情感（fine-grained emotion）标注，用于结构化情感推断。
Result: 在强基线之上加入 Affective Stance 后，细粒度情感识别提升 3.5 个百分点，语用意图检测提升 7.8 个百分点。
Conclusion: 作者强调，以显式-隐式极性交互构造的 Affective Stance 可以作为结构化的情感推断目标，提升模型在中文语篇中识别未言明情感与语用意图的能力。

papers.title: Modelling Geographic Atrophy Progression using Implicit Neural Representations
papers.abstract_en: Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD) is the major cause of blindness in the Western world. Its late dry phase is characterised by irreversible atrophic areas, namely Geographic Atrophy (GA). Longitudinal Fundus Autofluorescence (FAF) image acquisitions are currently the main tool for assessing lesion growth over time at the image level. However, due to its highly individualised progression, the evolution of late AMD remains poorly understood. In this work, we propose using Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) to model GA progression at the individual level in a low-data setting. Our approach generates both FAF and GA segmentation at both past and future time points. Among the comparison models, our method achieves competitive segmentation quality across different scenarios, yielding the lowest Mean Absolute Error (MAE) for the GA lesion area and the highest DICE score, without sacrificing FAF image quality. The code is available at https://github.com/SimoneSarrocco/ga-progression-with-inrs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用隐式神经表示（Implicit Neural Representations, INR）在低数据条件下对年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）晚期干性阶段的地理萎缩（GA）进展进行个体层面建模。方法同时生成过去和未来时间点的眼底自发荧光（FAF）图像及GA分割结果；在与对比模型的比较中，GA病灶面积的MAE最低、DICE最高，且不牺牲FAF图像质量。代码已公开。
Motivation: AMD是西方世界主要致盲原因，其晚期干性阶段表现为不可逆萎缩区域（GA）。由于GA进展高度个体化，病变随时间的演变仍未被充分理解，而现有纵向FAF图像获取主要停留在图像层面的病灶增长评估。
Method: 提出使用隐式神经表示（INR）对个体层面GA进展进行建模，适用于低数据设置，能够同时生成过去和未来时间点的FAF图像与GA分割图。
Result: 在与对比模型的比较中，方法在多种场景下取得有竞争力的分割质量，GA病灶面积的MAE最低、DICE最高，且未牺牲FAF图像质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调INR能在低数据场景下实现个体化的GA进展建模，并公开了代码；摘要未说明具体的局限性。

papers.title: Fast and Memory-Efficient Wavelet Convolutions via I/O-Aware Reformulation
papers.abstract_en: Wavelet convolution (WTConv) has emerged as an increasingly popular drop-in replacement for standard convolutions, expanding a network's receptive field exponentially with the number of decomposition levels while keeping the parameter count linear. However, its reference implementation is severely memory-bound due to excessive data movement through high-bandwidth memory (HBM). We develop an I/O model of WTConv to characterize this bottleneck and use it to guide three algebraic reformulations: (1) recomputing the inexpensive Haar analysis butterfly on chip, (2) collapsing the multi-level synthesis cascade into a single closed-form pass indexed by output-coordinate bits, and (3) folding learned per-channel scales into the convolution weights. Together, these reformulations enable an I/O-aware fused implementation that substantially reduces HBM traffic. We evaluate the WTConvNeXt configuration across decomposition levels and a broad range of tensor shapes. Despite performing comparable arithmetic, the reference WTConv is substantially slower than the depthwise convolution it replaces. Our reformulation reduces modeled HBM traffic by approximately $2.55\times$, yielding up to a $4.35\times$ training speedup over the reference while roughly halving peak memory usage. Thus, our reformulation preserves the benefits of WTConv while substantially reducing its execution time and memory footprint, removing the systems overhead that previously limited its practical efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对小波卷积 (WTConv) 参考实现因高带宽内存 (HBM) 数据移动过多而严重内存受限的问题，提出 I/O 感知的代数重构与融合实现。通过片上重计算廉价的 Haar 分析蝶形、将多级合成级联压缩为按输出坐标比特索引的单一闭式流程、以及将学习到的逐通道尺度折叠进卷积权重，建模的 HBM 流量降低约 2.55 倍，相对参考实现最高获得 4.35 倍训练加速并大约减半峰值内存。
Motivation: WTConv 作为标准卷积的即插即用替代能随分解层级指数级扩大感受野、同时保持参数线性增长，但参考实现的执行受内存带宽限制，实际速度明显慢于其替换的深度可分离卷积，系统开销限制了其实用效率。
Method: 建立 WTConv 的 I/O 模型来刻画 HBM 流量瓶颈，并据此提出三个代数重构：在芯片上重算低成本的 Haar 分析蝴蝶、把多级合成级联合并为按输出坐标比特索引的闭式单遍流程、把逐通道可学习尺度折入卷积权重；三者共同构成 I/O 感知的融合实现以减少 HBM 通信。
Result: 在 WTConvNeXt 配置、不同分解层级及多种张量形状下，尽管算术量相当，该重构将模型化 HBM 流量降低约 2.55 倍，相对参考实现带来最高 4.35 倍训练加速，峰值内存大约减半。
Conclusion: 该重构在保留 WTConv 原有收益的同时显著缩短执行时间并降低内存占用，消除了此前限制其实际效率的系统开销。

papers.title: BPG: Balancing Plasticity and Generalization for Domain Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks excel in various tasks but struggle to generalize across evolving data distributions, leading to significant performance degradation under domain shifts. Domain incremental learning (DIL) addresses this challenge by enabling models to continuously adapt while retaining prior knowledge. Among existing DIL approaches, the parameter-isolation paradigm achieves state-of-the-art performance. However, these methods often adopt a one-size-fits-all approach to adapt to new domains, resulting in either insufficient learning capacity or redundant parameters. In this work, we propose BPG, a unified framework that addresses both challenges through two complementary components: BPG-Adapter, which dynamically determines each domain's adapter hidden dimension based on domain-specific feature separability, and BPG-Inference, a soft domain mixture strategy that integrates multiple domain-specific models at test time, mitigating domain ID misselection. Experimental results on DomainNet, CDDB, and CORe50 demonstrate that BPG consistently outperforms uniform adapter-based approaches and hard domain selection strategies, achieving state-of-the-art average accuracy while reducing forgetting to as low as 0.22% on DomainNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BPG，一个面向领域增量学习 (Domain Incremental Learning, DIL) 的统一框架，针对参数隔离 (parameter-isolation) 范式下“一刀切”适配新领域导致的容量不足或参数冗余问题。BPG 包含两个组件：BPG-Adapter 根据领域特征可分离性动态决定各领域适配器的隐藏维度，BPG-Inference 在测试时通过软领域混合策略整合多个领域专属模型，缓解领域 ID 误选。在 DomainNet、CDDB 和 CORe50 上，BPG 一致优于均匀适配器方法和硬领域选择策略，取得平均准确率 SOTA，并将 DomainNet 上的遗忘率降至 0.22%。
Motivation: 现有参数隔离类 DIL 方法常对所有新领域采用相同适配策略，导致学习能力不足或参数冗余，且测试时领域 ID 误选会损害泛化。
Method: 提出 BPG 框架，包含 BPG-Adapter 动态确定每个领域适配器的隐藏维度，以及 BPG-Inference 在推理时用软领域混合策略整合多个领域模型。
Result: 在 DomainNet、CDDB、CORe50 上，BPG 相比均匀适配器与硬领域选择策略均取得更优平均准确率，并在 DomainNet 上实现低至 0.22% 的遗忘率。
Conclusion: 摘要表明动态适配容量与软领域混合相结合能同时改善 DIL 的适应能力与泛化，且优于现有均匀和硬选择方案。

papers.title: Evaluating Semantic and Spatial Guidance for Foundation Model Segmentation of Small-Scale PV in Remote Sensing Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Spatio-temporal PV data are essential for understanding adoption processes in off-grid regions, yet such data remain largely unavailable. Automated segmentation of remote sensing (RS) imagery offers a promising solution; yet, residential PV systems remain challenging targets because of their small size and sparse distribution, resulting in severe target-background imbalance. Vision-language foundation models (FMs) provide a data-efficient paradigm through prompt-based semantic and spatial guidance, but the relative contribution of different prompt types remains unclear. We systematically evaluate SAM3 for small-scale PV segmentation in RS imagery by comparing textual, geometric, and hybrid prompting, under varying supervision levels, training strategies, spatial resolutions, and imaging conditions. Multi-temporal aerial imagery from a large off-grid rural region serves as a study site, with findings validated across three additional datasets. Prompting strategy emerged as the dominant factor governing model behavior. Textual prompting consistently produced the lowest performance and showed the greatest sensitivity to supervision and imaging conditions. In contrast, spatial guidance substantially improved both segmentation accuracy and robustness. Hybrid prompting achieved the highest accuracy and stability, indicating that semantic and spatial guidance provide complementary information. Most performance gains were achieved with only a few hundred annotated samples, demonstrating strong data efficiency. Transfer learning had limited overall impact, with only modest improvements observed for textual prompting under limited supervision. Overall, our findings establish prompting strategy as a key determinant of SAM3 adaptation, robustness, and generalization, highlighting the potential of promptable FMs for scalable PV mapping in data-constrained off-grid regions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估 SAM3 在遥感影像中对小规模屋顶光伏 (PV) 分割的表现，比较文本、几何和混合提示 (prompting) 在多种监督程度、训练策略、空间分辨率和成像条件下的效果。研究基于离网农村区域的多时相航空影像，并在三个额外数据集上验证。结果显示提示策略是主导因素，混合提示取得最高准确率和稳定性，文本提示表现最差且对监督和成像条件最敏感。
Motivation: 离网区域的光伏时空数据缺乏，自动化分割小规模住宅光伏因目标尺寸小、分布稀疏而面临严重的背景-目标不平衡；视觉-语言基础模型通过提示提供数据高效的语义和空间引导，但不同提示类型的相对贡献尚不明确。
Method: 系统评估 SAM3 用于小规模光伏分割，比较文本提示、几何提示和混合提示，并控制监督水平、训练策略、空间分辨率和成像条件；研究区域为大面积离网农村地区的多时相航空影像，并在三个额外数据集上验证结果。
Result: 提示策略是主导因素：文本提示性能最低且对监督与成像条件最敏感，空间引导显著提升分割精度和鲁棒性，混合提示实现最高准确率和稳定性。仅几百个标注样本即可获得大部分性能提升，迁移学习总体影响有限。
Conclusion: 摘要强调提示策略是 SAM3 适应、鲁棒性和泛化的关键决定因素，凸显可提示基础模型在数据受限的离网区域实现可扩展光伏测绘的潜力。

papers.title: Beyond Fixed Luminance: Towards Panchromatic and Orthochromatic Image Colorization
papers.abstract_en: Most image colorization systems operate in $Lab$ space by predicting chroma ($ab$) while preserving an input-derived luminance channel ($L$). While effective on standard benchmarks, this fixed-luminance design restricts brightness changes and becomes unreliable when grayscale formation deviates from natural-image luminance, as in historical orthochromatic photography. We propose a luminance-agnostic colorization framework that formulates colorization as full-RGB image editing using a foundation image-editing model. To bridge modern panchromatic and historical orthochromatic conditions, we introduce a mixed grayscale objective that trains the model under both standard luminance grayscale and a red-insensitive grayscale formation. Experiments on COCO, ImageNet, and a multi-instance benchmark show that our method is competitive on standard grayscale inputs and substantially more robust under orthochromatic inputs, with qualitative comparisons and a human study indicating fewer visible color artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种与亮度无关（luminance-agnostic）的图像着色框架，将着色问题重新表述为基于基础图像编辑模型（foundation image-editing model）的完整 RGB 图像编辑任务，并引入混合灰度目标（mixed grayscale objective）来同时适配现代全色（panchromatic）与历史正色（orthochromatic）摄影的灰度形成方式。实验在 COCO、ImageNet 和多实例基准上表明，该方法在标准灰度输入下与现有方法相当，而在 orthochromatic 输入下明显更鲁棒，定性对比与人工研究显示可见颜色伪影更少。
Motivation: 现有大多数着色系统在 Lab 空间中固定输入来源的亮度通道 L 并只预测色度 ab，这种固定亮度设计限制了亮度变化，并在灰度形成偏离自然图像亮度（如历史 orthochromatic 摄影）时变得不可靠。
Method: 提出 luminance-agnostic 着色框架，将着色视为使用基础图像编辑模型的完整 RGB 图像编辑问题；为桥接现代 panchromatic 与历史 orthochromatic 条件，引入混合灰度目标，使模型同时接受标准亮度灰度和对红色不敏感（red-insensitive）的灰度形成作为训练输入。
Result: 在 COCO、ImageNet 和一个多实例基准上的实验显示，该方法在标准灰度输入下具有竞争力，在 orthochromatic 输入下显著更鲁棒；定性比较和人工研究均表明其产生的可见颜色伪影更少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调固定亮度（fixed-luminance）设计是现有着色方法的限制来源，并表明亮度无关的 RGB 级着色能够在现代与历史两类灰度条件下都保持较好表现。

papers.title: E$^3$mo-Bench: A Scalable Benchmark for Multimodal Evoked and Expressed Emotion Understanding via Bayesian Pairwise Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Understanding both expressed and evoked emotions is critical for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to achieve comprehensive affect-aware interactions. However, existing benchmarks typically examine expressed and evoked emotions in isolation or are constrained to coarse-grained and incomplete affective characterizations. To bridge this gap, we introduce E$^3$mo-Bench, a scalable benchmark comprising $12{,}314$ question-answer pairs across $2{,}524$ videos with predefined affective perspectives. It evaluates evoked and expressed emotion understanding via $3$ complementary tasks: emotion perception, open-vocabulary recognition, and valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) assessment. To efficiently scale reliable continuous annotations, we propose Bayesian Pairwise Alignment, which aggregates sparse, low-burden pairwise judgments into anchor-referenced VAD estimates. Furthermore, we develop E$^3$mo-Score, a training-free agent that aggregates complementary judgments from a five-model committee to improve VAD estimation. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our framework and expose a pronounced performance skew between evoked and expressed emotion paradigms. These findings, coupled with MLLMs' persistent deficits in fine-grained recognition and dimensional assessment, chart a clear course for advancing multimodal emotional intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E$^3$mo-Bench，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的可扩展情感理解基准，包含 2,524 个视频上的 12,314 个问答对，并明确区分诱发情感 (evoked emotion) 与表达情感 (expressed emotion)。基准通过情感感知、开放词汇识别和效价-唤醒-支配 (VAD) 评估三个互补任务进行评测，并配套提出 Bayesian Pairwise Alignment 来扩展连续标注。实验验证了框架有效性，并揭示 MLLM 在两种情感范式间存在显著性能偏差。
Motivation: 现有基准要么孤立地考察表达情感或诱发情感，要么局限于粗粒度、不完整的情感刻画，难以支撑 MLLM 全面、情感感知的交互能力评估。
Method: 构建包含预定义情感视角的 E$^3$mo-Bench 数据集，提出 Bayesian Pairwise Alignment 将稀疏、低负担的成对判断聚合为锚定参考的 VAD 连续估计；另开发无训练的 E$^3$mo-Score 智能体，聚合五模型委员会的互补判断以改进 VAD 估计。
Result: 大量实验验证了框架的有效性，并显示 MLLM 在诱发情感与表达情感范式之间存在明显的性能偏差，且在细粒度识别和维度评估上持续存在不足。
Conclusion: 作者认为该基准和发现为推进多模态情感智能指明了方向，尤其需要弥合诱发与表达情感之间的差距，并加强细粒度识别与维度评估能力。

papers.title: EvoMem: Memory-Augmented Evolution for Code Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Successful mutation strategies in evolutionary code search may contain reusable knowledge that is useful beyond a single run, and in some cases may transfer across related tasks and domains. However, existing LLM-driven evolutionary frameworks largely discard such knowledge, repeatedly rediscovering similar ideas and limiting opportunities for cross-run and cross-task learning. We introduce EvoMem, a persistent memory architecture for LLM-based evolutionary program search that captures and reuses candidate mutation knowledge. EvoMem converts successful mutation events into structured, task-aware advice for future runs. It operates in two phases: after each run, it extracts and stores promising ideas with provenance, and during subsequent evolution, it retrieves a small set of relevant instructions based on the current task and program context to guide mutation. Across geometric optimization, multi-hop question answering, GPU kernel optimization, and related benchmarks, our experiments show positive average improvements in target metrics or search speed for most evaluated settings, while also revealing variability across tasks. Overall, EvoMem provides evidence that persistent memory can reduce some redundant exploration and improve the reuse and adaptation of successful strategies in LLM-driven evolutionary search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoMem，一种面向 LLM 驱动的进化程序搜索 (evolutionary program search) 的持久记忆架构，用于捕获并复用候选变异 (mutation) 知识。与现有框架在每次运行后丢弃变异经验不同，EvoMem 将成功的变异事件转化为带来源信息的结构化建议，并在后续进化中按任务与程序上下文检索少量指令来指导变异。实验覆盖几何优化、多跳问答、GPU kernel 优化等基准，多数设定下目标指标或搜索速度有平均改进，但也显示出任务间的差异性。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 驱动的进化搜索框架大多在单次运行后丢弃变异策略中可能存在的可复用知识，导致相似思路被反复重新发现，限制了跨运行和跨任务的学习机会。
Method: EvoMem 采用两阶段机制：每次运行结束后，从成功变异事件中提取并存储带有来源 (provenance) 的有前景想法；在后续进化过程中，根据当前任务与程序上下文检索一小部分相关指令来引导变异。
Result: 在几何优化、多跳问答、GPU kernel 优化及相关基准上的实验显示，大多数评估设定下目标指标或搜索速度取得平均改进，但结果在不同任务间存在波动。
Conclusion: 作者认为持久记忆有助于减少部分冗余探索，改善 LLM 驱动进化搜索中成功策略的复用与适配；摘要同时承认任务间存在变异性。

papers.title: ChemWorld: Programmable Chemical Worlds for Controlled and Replayable Agent Experimentation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous chemistry increasingly depends on environments in which agents can repeatedly act, observe, and adapt.Physical laboratories provide essential real-material evidence but are costly to repeat and difficult to use for tightly matched interventions, whereas most digital environments keep the underlying experimental world largely fixed. We introduce ChemWorld, a programmable chemical environment in which reusable process and observation components are compiled into executable worlds. ChemWorld separates the public experimental contract available to an agent from evaluator-owned chemical and material laws. Researchers can therefore vary world composition and operating conditions, or change a single hidden law while holding the public task and interaction conditions fixed. Transactional execution records operations, failures, resource changes, and state transitions, allowing complete environment-action trajectories to be replayed exactly and audited. Full-census qualification covered the reference registry, 52 generated compositions, and module, interface, compilation, and invalid-action tests. Eight deterministic experimental cases demonstrated shared lifecycle semantics, failure recovery, and exact replay, while six parent-child world-fork pairs isolated the effects of single private-law interventions under matched public conditions. An independent agent also completed a full lifecycle in a non-reference world through the same public interface. Within the declared component and model domain, ChemWorld provides a controlled and replayable substrate for studying experimentation across systematically varied chemical worlds, complementary to physical-laboratory evidence and calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChemWorld，一个可编程化学环境，将可复用的过程与观察组件编译为可执行世界，用于自主化学智能体的反复行动、观察与适应。系统将智能体可见的公共实验契约与评估者拥有的化学/材料法则分离，并支持通过事务性执行记录操作、失败、资源变化和状态转变，从而实现完整环境-动作轨迹的精确重放与审计。摘要报告了全量资格测试、八个确定性实验案例、六个父子世界分叉对以及独立智能体在非参考世界中的完整生命周期测试。
Motivation: 物理实验室提供真实材料证据但重复成本高且难以进行严格匹配的干预，而大多数数字环境让底层实验世界基本保持固定，限制了系统化可控实验。
Method: ChemWorld 将可复用的过程与观察组件编译为可执行世界，分离公开实验契约与评估者拥有的化学和材料法则，允许改变单一隐藏法则而保持公共任务和交互条件不变；事务性执行机制记录全部状态转变，支持环境-动作轨迹的精确重放与审计，并通过世界分叉 (world-fork) 隔离单一私有法则干预的影响。
Result: 全量资格测试覆盖参考注册表、52 个生成组合以及模块、接口、编译和无效动作测试；八个确定性实验案例展示了共享生命周期语义、失败恢复与精确重放；六个父-子世界分叉对在匹配公共条件下隔离了单一私有法则干预的效果；独立智能体还通过同一公共接口在非参考世界中完成了完整生命周期。
Conclusion: 在声明的组件与模型领域内，ChemWorld 为系统化变化的化学世界中的智能体实验提供了可控且可重放的基底，与物理实验室证据和校准互补。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MVTrack: Ultrafast Appearance-Free Moving Object Tracking from Compressed Bitstreams
papers.abstract_en: Deploying modern video trackers at scale is bottlenecked by the computational cost of RGB-based object detectors. To this end, we present MVTrack, an ultrafast tracker for moving objects that operates directly on H.264 bitstreams. MVTrack combines MVDet, a lightweight detector for motion vector fields, with MVLink, a minimalist kinematic association module. On VIRAT, MVTrack outperforms YOLO26n while using 60$\times$ fewer parameters, requiring 40$\times$ fewer FLOPs, and reducing CPU latency by 8.6$\times$. These results demonstrate that compressed video data alone can enable accurate and scalable surveillance tracking, thereby bypassing the need for pixel reconstruction.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted to the 2nd workshop on Low-Level Vision Frontiers with Generative AI, Preference Optimization, Agentic Systems and World Models (LoViF) at ECCV2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MVTrack 是一种直接作用于 H.264 压缩码流的运动目标跟踪器，由基于运动矢量场 (motion vector fields) 的轻量检测器 MVDet 和极简运动学关联模块 MVLink 组成。在 VIRAT 数据集上，它以 60 倍更少的参数量、40 倍更少的 FLOPs 和 8.6 倍更低的 CPU 延迟超越 YOLO26n。作者认为压缩视频数据本身即可支持准确且可扩展的监控跟踪，无需像素重建。
Motivation: 大规模部署现代视频跟踪器受限于基于 RGB 的目标检测器的高计算成本，论文旨在绕开像素解码与重建这一瓶颈。
Method: 提出直接对 H.264 码流中的运动矢量进行操作：MVDet 作为运动矢量场上的轻量检测器，MVLink 作为极简的运动学关联模块，两者结合实现无 RGB 像素的端到端跟踪。
Result: 在 VIRAT 基准上，MVTrack 相比 YOLO26n 使用 60 倍更少的参数、40 倍更少的 FLOPs，并将 CPU 延迟降低 8.6 倍，同时跟踪性能更优。
Conclusion: 摘要强调压缩视频数据本身足以支撑准确且可扩展的监控跟踪，从而可以完全绕过像素重建过程。

papers.title: Path Integral Value Matching for Linear Quadratic Stochastic Optimal Control
papers.abstract_en: Linear Quadratic Stochastic Optimal Control (LQ-SOC) establishes a fundamental framework for steering noisy dynamical systems and has recently gained renewed interest in the machine learning community. However, current state-of-the-art policy-based methods suffer from prohibitive computational costs and instability due to their heavy reliance on full-trajectory simulation. To overcome these limitations, we propose a paradigm shift toward a value-based approach by revisiting Path Integral Control (PIC). Although standard PIC suffers from the same high-variance bottleneck as policy-based methods, we discover that by truncating and marginalizing the original path integral formulation, we can derive a temporal recursive form of the value function. Building upon this theoretical foundation, we propose the Path Integral Value Matching (PI-VM) algorithm. Specifically, we employ temporal-difference learning to approximate the recursive value dynamics, and further integrate the Girsanov theorem with experience replay to enable off-policy training. We benchmark PI-VM against SOTA policy-based methods across various SOC benchmarks and sampling tasks. Empirical results demonstrate that PI-VM matches SOTA precision with an order-of-magnitude efficiency gain in low-dimensional settings, while effectively mitigating mode collapse in high-dimensional scenarios. Consequently, PI-VM offers a scalable solution for solving complex SOC problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出路径积分值匹配（PI-VM）算法，用于求解线性二次随机最优控制（LQ-SOC）。作者通过截断并边缘化原始路径积分公式，推导出值函数的时间递归形式，并采用时间差分学习逼近该递归动态，同时结合Girsanov定理与经验回放实现off-policy训练。实验表明，在低维SOC基准和采样任务中，PI-VM以比SOTA基于策略的方法低一个数量级的计算代价达到同等精度，并在高维场景下有效缓解模式坍缩。
Motivation: 现有基于策略的LQ-SOC方法严重依赖全轨迹仿真，导致计算成本高昂且训练不稳定；标准路径积分控制（PIC）本身也面临高方差瓶颈。作者认为需要转向基于值的方法来突破这些限制。
Method: 重新审视路径积分控制，从理论上将原始路径积分公式截断并边缘化，得到值函数的时序递归形式；在此基础上提出PI-VM算法，用时间差分学习近似递归值动态，并整合Girsanov定理与经验回放以支持off-policy训练。
Result: 在多个随机最优控制基准和采样任务上，PI-VM在低维设置下匹配SOTA精度且效率提升一个数量级，在高维场景中有效缓解模式坍缩。
Conclusion: 摘要强调从基于策略到基于值的范式转变，并指出PI-VM为求解复杂SOC问题提供了可扩展的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SkillLens: Visual Skill Cards for Retrieval-Augmented GUI Action Prediction and On-Policy Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Computer-using agents can perceive rich software interfaces, yet their decisions often lack visual procedural memory: they may recognize individual controls without identifying which familiar workflow is active, which control matters next, or what evidence would confirm progress. Raw interaction traces preserve such information but are long and noisy to condition on, whereas text-only skills often omit the visual state that makes a procedure applicable. We introduce Visual Skill Cards (VSCs), a state-conditioned memory representation that binds reusable procedures with applicability cues, visual evidence, and verification signals. SkillLens constructs VSCs from heterogeneous interaction experience through Trace-to-Visual-Skill-Card and, at inference time, retrieves relevant cards and selectively expands only the evidence needed by a fixed visual-language model executor for grounded GUI action prediction. The same representation also supports CardDistill, which uses VSC evidence as privileged teacher context to train a student that acts without runtime card retrieval. Across Multimodal-Mind2Web and WebLINX-BrowserGym, SkillLens improves the frozen GPT-5.4-mini executor by +11.6 points in Step SR and +2.9 points in Overall, respectively; CardDistill further improves the corresponding student-only Qwen3-VL-2B metrics by +12.0 and +3.2 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出视觉技能卡片（Visual Skill Cards, VSCs），一种状态条件化的记忆表示，将可复用的 GUI 操作流程与适用性线索、视觉证据和验证信号绑定，用于检索增强的 GUI 动作预测。SkillLens 通过 Trace-to-Visual-Skill-Card 从异构交互经验构建 VSCs，推理时检索相关卡片并仅扩展固定视觉语言模型执行器所需的证据；同一表示还支持 CardDistill，以 VSC 证据作为特权教师上下文训练无运行时检索的学生模型。在 Multimodal-Mind2Web 和 WebLINX-BrowserGym 上，SkillLens 分别将冻结的 GPT-5.4-mini 执行器 Step SR 提升 +11.6 点、Overall 提升 +2.9 点，CardDistill 对 Qwen3-VL-2B 学生模型相应提升 +12.0 和 +3.2 点。
Motivation: 计算机操作代理能感知丰富的软件界面，但其决策缺乏视觉程序性记忆：可能识别单个控件，却不知道当前激活的是哪个熟悉工作流、下一步哪个控件重要、或什么证据能确认进展。原始交互轨迹冗长嘈杂难以直接条件化，而纯文本技能常忽略决定流程适用性的视觉状态。
Method: 引入视觉技能卡片（VSCs），一种状态条件化记忆表示，绑定可复用流程与适用性线索、视觉证据和验证信号。SkillLens 通过 Trace-to-Visual-Skill-Card 从异构交互经验构建 VSCs，推理时检索相关卡片并有选择地展开固定视觉语言模型执行器所需的证据；CardDistill 利用 VSC 证据作为特权教师上下文训练无需运行时卡片检索的学生模型。
Result: 在 Multimodal-Mind2Web 和 WebLINX-BrowserGym 上，SkillLens 使冻结的 GPT-5.4-mini 执行器在 Step SR 上提升 +11.6 点、Overall 上提升 +2.9 点；CardDistill 进一步使仅学生模型的 Qwen3-VL-2B 在相应指标上提升 +12.0 和 +3.2 点。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将可复用流程与视觉证据绑定并选择性展开，可以提升检索增强的 GUI 动作预测，并可通过特权蒸馏让学生模型无需运行时检索即可行动。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The GenAI Catch-22: Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Norwegian Newsrooms During the 2025 Parliamentary Election
papers.abstract_en: The increasing use of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in journalism raises concerns about possible detrimental effects both on journalism and its democratic function. We explore these risks through a case study of GenAI in Norwegian Newsrooms during the 2025 parliamentary election campaign. Based on interviews with managers and journalists over a ten-month period, we analyse how ambitious visions fared in the face of technological and practical challenges. We highlight the risk of an internal threat stemming from the journalists' own use of AI, contrasting the dominant focus on external disinformation threats. We show how newsroom managers shared sociotechnical imaginaries resulting in unrealistically optimistic beliefs about the capabilities of the technology and the pace of development, leading to plans for audience-facing GenAI services collapsing and giving way to more mundane uses of GenAI tools internally in the newsrooms. Furthermore, we identify a vulnerability in the newsroom's resilience against GenAI influence: a GenAI Catch-22. In order to monitor the GenAI tools and prevent errors and undue influence, newsrooms rely on human expertise. But by using GenAI extensively, the newsrooms risk a deterioration of human expertise, preventing them from monitoring the GenAI systems adequately.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对挪威新闻编辑室在2025年议会选举期间使用生成式AI（GenAI）的案例研究。基于对管理者和记者为期十个月的访谈，作者分析了宏大愿景如何遭遇技术和实际挑战，指出新闻编辑室存在来自记者自身使用AI的内部威胁，这与主导的外部虚假信息威胁形成对比。研究发现管理层的共同社会技术想象（sociotechnical imaginaries）导致对AI能力和发展速度不切实际的乐观，面向受众的GenAI服务计划最终崩溃，转而退化为新闻编辑室内部的日常工具使用。作者还识别出新闻编辑室对GenAI影响的脆弱性：即所谓GenAI Catch-22——监控GenAI需要人类专业知识，但广泛使用GenAI又可能使这种专业知识退化，从而无法充分监控AI系统。
Motivation: 生成式AI在新闻业中的使用日益增多，可能对新闻业及其民主功能产生不利影响。本文旨在通过案例研究探索这些风险，尤其关注被忽视的内部威胁，即新闻从业者自身使用AI所带来的危害。
Method: 采用案例研究方法，对挪威新闻编辑室的管理者和记者进行为期十个月的访谈，分析其在2025年议会选举期间使用GenAI的愿景、实施过程及面临的挑战，并对比内部威胁与外部虚假信息威胁。
Result: 研究发现新闻编辑室管理层共享的社会技术想象导致对GenAI能力和采用速度的过度乐观，致使面向受众的GenAI服务计划失败并转向内部日常用途。同时识别出新闻编辑室对GenAI影响的脆弱性：依赖人类专业知识监控GenAI，而广泛使用GenAI可能导致人类专业知识退化，形成GenAI Catch-22困境。
Conclusion: 作者强调新闻编辑室广泛使用GenAI可能削弱其监控和防范AI错误及不当影响的能力，主要威胁来自内部而非外部虚假信息。这一结论揭示了新闻业在采用生成式AI时面临的两难处境，提示需要重新审视人类专业知识的维护与AI依赖之间的平衡。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文是对挪威新闻编辑室在2025年议会选举期间使用生成式AI（GenAI）的案例研究。基于对管理者和记者为期十个月的访谈，作者分析了宏大愿景如何遭遇技术和实际挑战，指出新闻编辑室存在来自记者自身使用AI的内部威胁，这与主导的外部虚假信息威胁形成对比。研究发现管理层的共同社会技术想象（sociotechnical imaginaries）导致对AI能力和发展速度不切实际的乐观，面向受众的GenAI服务计划最终崩溃，转而退化为新闻编辑室内部的日常工具使用。作者还识别出新闻编辑室对GenAI影响的脆弱性：即所谓GenAI Catch-22——监控GenAI需要人类专业知识，但广泛使用GenAI又可能使这种专业知识退化，从而无法充分监控AI系统。

papers.title: Rule of Thumb: Explaining Artificial Intelligence Systems using Partial Information
papers.abstract_en: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) seeks to explain how an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system arrived at a particular decision. We propose ''Rule of Thumb'' (RoT) explanations, a new approach to XAI based upon a novel formulation that identifies the most relevant features for predicting the behaviour of an AI system, for a particular datapoint. We show how RoT is well-suited to enable XAI in: (a) zero-shot classification using large language models (LLMs), (b) auditing of opaque AI systems without model access, and (c) the use of AI in scientific discovery. Additionally, RoT meets specific requirements from leading AI regulations, provides a familiar interface and visualisations for XAI practitioners, is model-agnostic, and is substantially faster than alternatives. Code available at: https://github.com/KaiRawal/Rule-of-Thumb-Explaining-Artificial-Intelligence-Systems-using-Partial-Information
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的 XAI 方法“Rule of Thumb”（RoT），基于部分信息识别对于预测 AI 系统行为最相关的特征，用于解释特定数据点的决策。摘要称该方法适用于大语言模型的零样本分类、无模型访问场景下的黑盒 AI 审计以及科学发现，并且模型无关、速度快。
Motivation: 可解释人工智能（XAI）旨在解释 AI 系统如何做出决策，但现有方法在无模型访问、零样本 LLM 等场景下适用性有限，且可能速度较慢。
Method: 提出 RoT 解释方法，基于一种新的公式，针对特定数据点找出预测 AI 系统行为最相关的特征集合，以部分信息的方式生成解释。
Result: 摘要声称 RoT 在零样本分类、黑盒审计和科学发现三类场景中适用，满足主要 AI 法规要求，提供面向 XAI 从业者的熟悉界面和可视化，且比替代方法显著更快。
Conclusion: RoT 为 XAI 提供了一种模型无关且高效的解释途径，重点强调其在无模型访问场景和对法规要求的支持。

papers.title: Compositional Benchmark Synthesis for Hierarchical Human Action Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Recognizing human behavior across levels of abstraction, from atomic actions to long-horizon intentions, requires data annotated along a semantic hierarchy. Large corpora provide isolated, atomically labeled clips without temporal composition, whereas recorded composite-activity corpora offer shallow, domain-narrow, fixedhierarchies. A benchmark-generation and evaluation frameworkis proposed that synthesizes a four-level hierarchical-intention benchmark, spanning actions, activities, low-level intentions (LLIs), and high-level intentions (HLIs), from a flat single-label action corpus while retaining real pre-extracted features at the action level. Episodes are assembled by a transition model under a subject-consistency constraint, and a coverage-aware sampler reduces the subject usage Gini from 0.566 to 0.248. Synthesizing such a benchmark raises a circular-supervision risk that recorded datasets avoid: if the rules generating the episodes also govern the evaluation, models can succeed by recovering the generator rather than through genuine reasoning. Validity is addressed by design, holding sequence-generation rules disjoint from the first-order-logic rules used at evaluation. The instantiation yields 15,002 episodes. Four reference baselines from different model families characterize difficulty, not as recognition methods. A compositional held-out gap of 0.13 to 0.17 macro-F1 appears across all baselines, including a graph-aware model that recognizes best yet does not close the gap, indicating a structural property of the benchmark rather than a model artifact. A logic-free baseline still violates the held-out semantic rules above their intrinsic data rate, and the order-destroying control changes macro-F1 within seed variation, serving as a generator-consistency check. Theontology, transition model, and generator are released so the benchmark can beregenerated and extended.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基准生成与评估框架，可从扁平单标签动作语料合成四层层次意图基准（动作、活动、低层意图 LLI、高层意图 HLI），并保留动作层的真实预提取特征。片段由转移模型在主体一致性约束下组装，覆盖率感知采样器将主体使用 Gini 从 0.566 降至 0.248。针对合成基准的循环监督风险，作者将序列生成规则与评估用的一阶逻辑规则保持不相交。实例化生成 15,002 个片段，四个参考基线的组合留出差距为 0.13–0.17 macro-F1，表明这是基准的结构属性而非模型伪影。
Motivation: 现有大规模语料只提供孤立的、原子标签的片段，缺乏时间组合；而录制的复合活动语料层次浅、领域窄且层次固定。需要一种能生成覆盖多级语义层次、可控且可扩展的基准的方法。
Method: 提出组合基准生成与评估框架：从扁平单标签动作语料出发，通过转移模型在主体一致性约束下组装片段，利用覆盖率感知采样器平衡主体使用；并通过将生成片段的序列规则与评估时使用的一阶逻辑规则保持不相交，从设计上规避循环监督风险。
Result: 覆盖率感知采样器将主体使用 Gini 从 0.566 降至 0.248；基准实例化包含 15,002 个片段；所有参考基线（包括图感知模型）均表现出 0.13–0.17 macro-F1 的组合留出差距，图感知模型识别最好但未缩小差距；无逻辑基线仍以高于内在数据率的方式违反保留语义规则，破坏顺序的控制在种子变异范围内改变 macro-F1，作为生成器一致性检查。
Conclusion: 该框架能够生成可再生成和扩展的四层层次意图基准，并通过设计分离生成与评估规则来处理合成基准的循环监督问题；作者发布了本体、转移模型和生成器以便复现与扩展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FADE: From Passive Verification to Active Discovery in Counterfactual Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Counterfactual video understanding evaluates whether models grasp physical and commonsense regularities. However, existing multiple-choice question (MCQ) benchmarks inadvertently leak target events through their questions and candidate options. This reduces the core challenge from active discovery to text-guided verification. In this paper, we present FADE, an effective training framework for counterfactual discovery and explanation. Our method is built on an evidence-first, two-stage training paradigm. First, evidence-internalized supervised fine-tuning grounds the model's predictions in decisive visual anomalies. Second, we apply a fading-anchor reinforcement learning strategy that progressively removes textual guidance, compelling the model to independently discover and explain evidence. To rigorously evaluate this capability, we also introduce an effective pipeline that converts existing MCQ datasets into aligned MCQ, open-ended question answering (OQA), and captioning tasks without requiring additional data curation. Our simple approach yields strong results. Using Qwen3-VL-8B as the baseline, FADE achieves state-of-the-art strict paired scores across all three tasks on DualityVidQA-test and IPV-Bench, outperforming GPT-5.6. In specific, when transitioning from constrained MCQs to unconstrained OQA and captioning, our model demonstrates remarkable robustness. Its performance retention is 90.4% and 67.4% on DualityVidQA-test-substantially higher than the 48.1% and 30.7% retained by GPT-5.6. We hope this simple framework can serve as a solid baseline for future research in unconstrained counterfactual video understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FADE，一个针对反事实视频理解与解释的训练框架。核心是证据优先的两阶段训练：先做证据内化的监督微调，再用渐隐锚定强化学习逐步移除文本引导，迫使模型独立发现并解释证据。此外提出将对齐流程将现有 MCQ 数据集转换为 MCQ、开放式问答 (OQA) 和字幕生成三类任务，无需额外数据整理。基于 Qwen3-VL-8B，FADE 在 DualityVidQA-test 和 IPV-Bench 上取得严格配对分数 SOTA，超过 GPT-5.6。
Motivation: 现有反事实视频理解的多选题基准会通过问题和候选选项泄露目标事件，使任务从主动发现退化为文本引导的验证，无法真实衡量模型对物理与常识规律的理解。
Method: 提出两阶段训练范式：先进行证据内化的监督微调，使模型预测锚定在决定性视觉异常上；再采用渐隐锚定强化学习 (fading-anchor reinforcement learning)，逐步去掉文本引导，迫使模型独立发现并解释证据。同时设计转换流程，在无需额外数据整理的情况下将现有 MCQ 数据集对齐为 MCQ、OQA 和字幕任务。
Result: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B 为基座，FADE 在 DualityVidQA-test 和 IPV-Bench 的全部三项任务上取得 state-of-the-art 严格配对分数并超过 GPT-5.6；从受限 MCQ 转向无约束 OQA 和字幕时，DualityVidQA-test 上的性能保持率分别为 90.4% 和 67.4%，显著高于 GPT-5.6 的 48.1% 和 30.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这一简单框架可作为未来无约束反事实视频理解研究的稳健基线；摘要未额外讨论方法局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Gateway Architecture for Enterprise MCP Authentication: Unifying Heterogeneous Auth, Identity Delegation, and the User / Non-User Persona Problem
papers.abstract_en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de-facto interface for connecting LLM agents to enterprise tools, and adoption has been explosive: within a year, large organizations went from zero to dozens of internally built MCP servers. That speed created a governance crisis. Each team implemented authentication independently -- some with no auth, some with API keys, some with full OAuth -- producing a fragmented landscape with no consistent way to authorize callers, track who did what, or offboard a departing employee across the fleet. This paper reports an industry deployment that resolves the crisis with a centralized MCP gateway: a single aggregation, governance, and authentication layer that fronts every downstream MCP server. We make four contributions grounded in production experience. First, a two-axis authentication model crossing persona (interactive user vs. automated non-user) with credential type (no-auth, static/dynamic API key, PKCE, client credentials, platform app-context). Second, a gateway authentication layer supporting three enterprise SSO grants and three token-provisioning models: Bring-Your-Own-Token, Generate-Your-Own-Token, and delegated OAuth via RFC 8693 token exchange. Third, three end-to-end identity flows -- User-to-OAuth2, Non-user-to-Service-Account, and User-to-Service-Account -- composing client, gateway, and server. Fourth, the deployment evolution from CDN/WAF/edge perimeter to private MCP tunnels and enterprise-wide connectors. The architecture is in production, fronting dozens of MCP servers across web, desktop, custom-SDK, and low-code clients.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了一个企业级 MCP（Model Context Protocol）网关的工业部署，用于统一管理接入 LLM 代理的下游 MCP 服务器的认证、授权与治理。作者提出双轴认证模型（persona × credential type）、网关认证层（支持三种 SSO grant 与三种 token 提供模式）、三条端到端身份流（User-to-OAuth2、Non-user-to-Service-Account、User-to-Service-Account），并描述了从 CDN/WAF/边缘防护演进到私有 MCP 隧道与企业级连接器的部署过程。该架构已在前端数十个 MCP 服务器的生产环境中运行。
Motivation: MCP 在企业内被快速采用，但各团队独立实现认证，导致无认证、API key、OAuth 并存的无序局面，缺乏统一的调用方授权、操作审计和离职人员权限回收机制，形成治理危机。
Method: 提出一个集中式 MCP 网关作为所有下游 MCP 服务器的统一聚合、治理与认证层；其认证层支持三种企业 SSO grant，以及三种 token 供应模式：自带 token（Bring-Your-Own-Token）、生成 token（Generate-Your-Own-Token）和基于 RFC 8693 token exchange 的委托 OAuth；并组合出三条端到端身份流。
Result: 摘要报告该架构已在生产中部署，前端数十个 MCP 服务器，覆盖 web、桌面、自定义 SDK 与低代码客户端。
Conclusion: 作者强调基于生产经验的四个贡献，包括双轴认证模型、网关认证层、三条身份流以及部署演进路径，表明集中式网关可解决 MCP 生态快速扩张带来的认证与治理碎片化问题。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调基于生产经验的四个贡献，包括双轴认证模型、网关认证层、三条身份流以及部署演进路径，表明集中式网关可解决 MCP 生态快速扩张带来的认证与治理碎片化问题。

papers.title: Where To Look? : Causal Tracing of Vision Encoders in VLM
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models can describe an image with remarkable accuracy, yet a more fundamental question remains unanswered: what visual information actually drives their answers? In this work, we investigate this question through causal tracing, and we observe that highly causal vision tokens often lie outside the target region. Extending the analysis to larger vision-language models reveals a similar pattern across models and corruption settings, suggesting that strong multimodal performance does not necessarily imply spatially localized causal representations. We further investigate: can these models preserve visual structure when appearance cues are removed? and find that visual cues are exploited to understand visual structures. Together, our experiments expose a gap between seeing, using, and reasoning over visual structure, and provide a causal framework for studying how visual information is transformed, preserved, and ultimately used by modern vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过因果追踪 (causal tracing) 研究视觉-语言模型 (VLM) 中哪些视觉信息真正驱动回答，发现高因果性的视觉 token 往往位于目标区域之外，且该现象在更大模型和不同损坏设置下保持一致。作者还考察了去除外观线索后模型能否保留视觉结构，发现模型会利用视觉线索理解结构。实验揭示“看到、使用与推理视觉结构”之间存在差距，并提供了一个研究视觉信息如何被转换、保留并最终被使用的因果框架。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 能高度准确地描述图像，但底层问题——究竟哪些视觉信息驱动其回答——仍不清楚；论文希望检验强多模态性能是否意味着空间局部化的因果表示。
Method: 采用因果追踪方法定位 VLM 视觉编码器中的高因果视觉 token，并在更大模型、多种损坏设置下对比分析；同时通过在去除外观线索 (appearance cues) 的条件下考察视觉结构是否被保留。
Result: 高因果性视觉 token 常落在目标区域之外，且该模式在不同模型与损坏设置下一致；去除外观线索后，模型仍利用视觉线索理解结构，暴露了看到 (seeing)、使用 (using) 与推理 (reasoning) 视觉结构之间的差距。
Conclusion: 作者提供了一个研究视觉信息如何被转换、保留并最终被现代 VLM 使用的因果框架，并指出强多模态性能并不必然意味着空间局部化的因果表示。

papers.title: Embodied Multimodal Grounding for Open-Vocabulary Mobile Manipulation via Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Embodied mobile manipulation requires language, visual observations, three-dimensional scene structure, and action feasibility to be aligned before execution. We study open-vocabulary target grounding with few-shot manipulation in local household workspaces and present an embodied multimodal grounding framework that integrates active multi-view Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (Semantic-3DGS), reachability-aware base positioning, and a diffusion-based vision-language-action policy. A task-driven local Semantic-3DGS serves as a shared interface across active sensing, language-conditioned 3D localization, obstacle-aware scene reasoning, base preparation, and semantic conditioning of the action model. To preserve pretrained action priors, the 3D semantic cues are injected only into the late action-expert blocks. In expanded 50-trial real-robot evaluations against representative vision-language-action (VLA) approaches, the full system achieves 60% long-horizon success compared with 40% for PointVLA and 28% for DexVLA, and reaches 74% success in heavily cluttered manipulation compared with 52% for the single-view variant and 46% for PointVLA. It also maintains 75% success under a 75 cm height shift and eliminates photo-induced false grasps. These results indicate that explicit, refreshable 3D semantic grounding can improve robustness under clutter, occlusion, viewpoint variation, and embodiment constraints.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 11 figures. Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个具身多模态接地框架，用于开放词汇移动操作中的目标定位，整合主动多视角语义 3D 高斯溅射 (Semantic-3DGS)、可达性感知的基座定位以及基于扩散的视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 策略。任务驱动的局部 Semantic-3DGS 作为主动感知、语言条件 3D 定位、场景推理、基座准备和动作模型语义条件化的共享接口。在 50 次真实机器人评估中，完整系统在长时程任务上达到 60% 成功率，高于 PointVLA 的 40% 和 DexVLA 的 28%，并在严重杂乱操作中达到 74% 成功率。
Motivation: 移动操作在执行前需要将语言、视觉观测、三维场景结构和动作可行性对齐，而开放词汇目标接地与少样本操作在局部家庭工作空间中仍具挑战。
Method: 提出端到端框架，将主动多视图 Semantic-3DGS、可达性感知基座定位和扩散式 VLA 策略结合；为保留预训练动作先验，仅将 3D 语义线索注入动作专家模块的后段。
Result: 真实机器人 50 次试验中，长时程成功率 60%，优于 PointVLA (40%) 和 DexVLA (28%)；重度杂乱操作成功率 74%，优于单视图变体 (52%) 和 PointVLA (46%)；在 75 cm 高度偏移下保持 75% 成功率，并消除了照片诱发的错误抓取。
Conclusion: 显式且可刷新的 3D 语义接地能提升在杂乱、遮挡、视角变化和具身约束下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0
