papers.title: Beyond Pixels: From Video Priors to 4D Worlds
papers.abstract_en: 4D generation synthesizes dynamic 3D scenes from conditions such as text or images. Existing methods either reconstruct generated RGB videos with a separate 4D model or adapt a particular video generator to predict geometry directly. The former suffers from distribution mismatch and error propagation, whereas the latter ties 4D prediction to a specific generator and may require retraining when the generator or conditioning regime changes. We ask whether the final denoised latents of video models that share a variational autoencoder (VAE) can instead provide a reusable interface to explicit 4D prediction. Building on this insight, we introduce direct latent-to-4D generation and instantiate it as Latent-to-4D, which bypasses RGB by aligning a video latent with the token grid of a pretrained 4D decoder and refining it through frame-wise and global spatiotemporal attention. Trained on roughly 1K existing reconstruction clips, a single checkpoint transfers unchanged across multiple video diffusion transformers within the same VAE family. On Text4D-200 and I4D-200, Latent-to-4D surpasses matched same-latent Wan+4RC cascades in projection-based DINO-F1 by 2.88--3.45 and 5.81 points, respectively, while also being preferred by human raters for geometry, temporal stability, and overall quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent-to-4D，直接利用视频扩散模型（video diffusion transformers）最终去噪后的 latent 进行显式 4D 场景生成，绕过 RGB 视频重建。方法通过将视频 latent 与预训练 4D 解码器的 token grid 对齐，并经过逐帧与全局时空注意力细化，仅用约 1K 个现有重建片段训练。单个检查点可在共享 VAE 家族的多个视频扩散 Transformer 间迁移，无需针对生成器重训。在 Text4D-200 和 I4D-200 基准上，该方法相比匹配的同 latent Wan+4RC 级联在投影 DINO-F1 上分别提升 2.88–3.45 和 5.81 分。
Motivation: 现有 4D 生成方法要么用独立 4D 模型重建生成的 RGB 视频，存在分布不匹配和误差传播；要么让特定视频生成器直接预测几何，导致 4D 预测被绑定到具体生成器并在生成器或条件方式变化时需要重训。作者希望探索共享 VAE 的视频模型去噪 latent 能否作为可复用的显式 4D 预测接口。
Method: 提出直接 latent-to-4D 生成，将视频 latent 与预训练 4D 解码器的 token grid 对齐，并使用时序与全局时空注意力（frame-wise and global spatiotemporal attention）进行细化，从而绕过 RGB 图像域。
Result: 在 Text4D-200 和 I4D-200 上，Latent-to-4D 超过匹配的同 latent Wan+4RC 级联，投影 DINO-F1 分别提升 2.88–3.45 和 5.81 分；人工评估显示其在几何、时间稳定性和整体质量上也更受偏好。
Conclusion: 摘要表明共享 VAE 的视频 latent 可以作为跨生成器可复用的 4D 预测接口，单个检查点能在同一 VAE 家族的多个视频扩散 Transformer 上迁移，无需针对具体生成器重训。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Tree-of-Ideas: Automated Research Ideation via Cross-Trajectory Reasoning over Scholarly Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Effective research ideation requires moving beyond a static understanding of prior work to trace how research problems and solutions evolve across the literature. Existing methods either treat papers as unstructured context or model scholarly evolution as isolated citation chains, overlooking interactions among research trajectories. We propose Tree-of-Ideas (ToI), a two-stage framework. EvoTrace reconstructs branching scholarly trajectories from citations, tracking evolving methods, resolved problems, and gaps. EvoAgent then reasons across trajectories to identify convergent problems and complementary solutions, generating grounded research ideas. Across six AI research topics, ToI achieves the highest score among automatic methods (6.27 vs. 5.36 for the strongest baseline on a 10-point scale), with strong Novelty (6.36) and Groundedness (7.00). Also, its score approaches that of human-paper references (6.29), demonstrating the value of cross-path evolutionary reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Tree-of-Ideas (ToI)，一个两阶段的研究想法生成框架，通过引文网络重建分支式学术演化轨迹（EvoTrace），再跨轨迹推理（EvoAgent）识别收敛问题与互补方案，生成有依据的研究想法。在六个 AI 研究主题上，ToI 的自动评估得分（10 分制 6.27）超过最强基线（5.36），并接近人类论文参考（6.29），其中 Novelty 为 6.36、Groundedness 为 7.00。
Motivation: 现有研究选题方法要么把论文当作无结构上下文，要么将学术演化建模为孤立的引用链，忽略了研究轨迹之间的交互，难以支撑有效的科研选题。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：EvoTrace 从引用中重建分支式学术轨迹，跟踪演化中的方法、已解决问题与空白；EvoAgent 跨轨迹推理，识别收敛问题与互补方案，生成有依据的研究想法。
Result: 在六个 AI 主题上，ToI 在自动方法中得分最高（10 分制 6.27，最强基线 5.36），其中 Novelty 为 6.36、Groundedness 为 7.00，且得分接近人类论文参考的 6.29。
Conclusion: 摘要强调跨路径演化推理对自动科研选题的价值，ToI 的得分接近人类论文参考，说明该方法能生成既有依据又具新颖性的研究想法；摘要未提及明显的局限性。

papers.title: Long-Time Trajectory Approximation via SA-NODEs: Model Predictive and Floquet Strategies
papers.abstract_en: We study the approximation of dynamical systems by semi-autonomous neural ordinary differential equations (SA-NODEs) over long time horizons. For a single network trained on the whole horizon, the available error bound deteriorates double exponentially in the horizon length. We develop two training strategies that avoid this barrier, each built on a reset of the state. The model predictive strategy partitions the horizon adaptively and restarts every window from observed data: when training meets a prescribed tolerance on every window, the composite model meets it uniformly in time, with a parameter budget linear in the horizon for targets with a bounded, uniformly regular reachable tube. The Floquet strategy addresses autonomous targets with a stable limit cycle and uses no data at deployment: a certified contraction of the learned return map confines the error to linear growth in the number of elapsed periods. For the time-periodic architecture we deploy, the scalar certificate degenerates; we prove instead a uniform-in-time orbital guarantee whose hypotheses are measured on the trained model, and an obstruction showing that, for an exactly periodic learned field, small one-period error and a contracting stroboscopic map cannot hold at once. Numerical experiments on four benchmarks confirm the predicted error laws and measure the hypotheses of every guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用半自主神经 ODE（SA-NODE）在长时间尺度上逼近动力系统的问题，指出单网络在整个时间轴上训练时误差界会随长度双指数恶化。作者提出两种基于状态重置的训练策略：模型预测策略按自适应窗口划分并从观测数据重启，复合模型可在满足每窗口容差时实现时间上一致的误差，且参数预算随水平线性增长；Floquet 策略针对具有稳定极限环的自治目标，部署时不依赖数据，通过学习返回映射的收缩性把误差限制为随周期数线性增长。数值实验在四个基准上验证了误差规律并测量了各理论保证的假设条件。
Motivation: 现有 SA-NODE 在长期轨迹逼近中，单个网络在整个时间范围训练时可用误差界会随水平长度双指数恶化，形成难以克服的逼近障碍，需要新的训练策略来避免该屏障。
Method: 提出两种训练策略：模型预测策略自适应切分时间水平并在每窗口由观测数据重启状态；Floquet 策略针对具有稳定极限环的自治目标，学习返回映射并利用其收缩性进行部署阶段无数据的误差控制。对于时间周期架构还给出了轨道级（orbital）保证及其可验证假设条件。
Result: 摘要报告：模型预测策略在每窗口达到给定容差时，复合模型误差在时间上一致满足该容差，且参数预算对具有有界、一致正则可达管的目标随水平线性增长；Floquet 策略对稳定极限环目标将误差限制为随周期数线性增长；另证明了精确周期学习场中，小的一周期误差与收缩频闪映射不能同时成立。四个基准的数值实验验证了预测的误差律。

papers.title: Smart Enough to Go Extinct? An Evolutionary Challenge to the Value of General Intelligence and Its Ethical Implications for AGI
papers.abstract_en: The pursuit of artificial general intelligence (AGI) rests on a seemingly self-evident premise: that general intelligence, the kind of flexible, domain-general cognitive capacity exemplified by Homo sapiens, is extraordinarily valuable. This paper subjects this premise to critical scrutiny. We first present the intuitive case for the value of general intelligence before mounting an evolutionary challenge. We argue that, on evolutionary timescales, its adaptive value is far from empirically established. Numerous taxa, from cyanobacteria to horseshoe crabs, have persisted for hundreds of millions or even billions of years without anything resembling general intelligence, while Homo sapiens has existed for roughly 300,000 years and already faces self-generated existential risks. Mass extinction events do not preferentially favour cognitively sophisticated species. We argue that general intelligence may be the only biological strategy that generates existential threats to the species possessing it, an existential risk paradox with no parallel among non-intelligent survival strategies. Unlike prevailing accounts of AI risk that trace the danger to misalignment, we locate it in structural features of general intelligence itself, implying that even well-aligned AGI would inherit this liability. If the long-term evolutionary value of general intelligence is uncertain or negative, this raises ethical questions about engineering AGI and, more urgently, creating artificial consciousness. Drawing on deontological ethics and the precautionary principle, we argue that this uncertainty imposes a duty of caution: if we create a new kind of intelligent being, we bear responsibility for ensuring the conditions under which it can flourish.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从进化视角质疑AGI研究的核心前提，即通用智能（general intelligence）具有极高价值。作者指出，许多物种在没有通用智能的情况下存续了数亿甚至数十亿年，而智人仅存在约30万年便已面临自造的生存风险，且大灭绝事件并不特别青睐认知复杂的物种。文章认为通用智能可能是唯一会对其拥有者产生生存威胁的生物策略，即便AI对齐良好也会继承这一缺陷，并由此提出工程化AGI及创造人工意识的伦理责任。
Motivation: 现有AI风险叙事多把危险归因于对齐（misalignment）失败，本文则试图论证风险内在于通用智能的结构性特征，因此即使完美对齐的AGI也无法免除该风险，进而质疑通用智能本身的长期进化价值。
Method: 采用概念分析与进化论论证：先给出支持通用智能价值的直觉理由，再通过跨物种持久性、智人存在时长、灭绝事件选择性等证据提出进化挑战，并结合道义论伦理（deontological ethics）和预防原则（precautionary principle）推导伦理义务。
Result: 摘要未报告实证数据，核心论点是通用智能的适应性价值在进化尺度上远未得到经验确证，且它可能是唯一会产生物种级生存威胁的生物策略，构成一个无智能生存策略可比的生存风险悖论。
Conclusion: 作者认为通用智能长期进化价值的不确定性要求审慎义务：若创造新型智能生命，人类有责任确保其得以繁荣的条件；这一结论同时适用于AGI工程和更紧迫的人工意识创造。

papers.title: Optimal Stopping of Self-Refining Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models can improve their outputs through a self-refinement process driven by external feedback. In this process, the model is embedded in an iterative loop where it generates outputs, receives feedback from verifiers, and refines its responses through in-context learning. Following a novel approach, we formalize this process as an optimal stopping problem where the number of refinement iterations is decided based on expected improvement relative to cost. We derive optimal stopping policies and show that they can be efficiently computed through stochastic approximation. To evaluate our approach experimentally, we apply it to a coding benchmark for foundation models. The empirical results show that our stopping policies are significantly more cost-efficient than stopping policies proposed in prior work.
papers.comment: Accepted at 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把基础模型（foundation model）的自改进（self-refinement）过程形式化为最优停止问题（optimal stopping problem），在每轮迭代中根据期望收益与成本的权衡决定是否停止细化。作者推导出最优停止策略，并证明可通过随机逼近（stochastic approximation）高效计算，在编码基准上验证了策略比先前工作提出的停止策略更节省成本。
Motivation: 基础模型通过外部反馈进行迭代自改进时，细化轮数越多成本越高，而现有方法缺少一个原理性的停止准则来决定何时终止。
Method: 将自改进循环建模为最优停止问题，以期望改进相对成本的权衡为优化目标，推导最优停止策略，并利用随机逼近算法高效求解。
Result: 在编码基准上的实验表明，提出的停止策略比先前工作中的停止策略显著更具成本效率（cost-efficient）。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该形式化方法为自改进基础模型的迭代停止提供了可计算的最优策略，但其实验范围限于编码基准。

papers.title: Rethinking LLM Verification: Evidence Structure, Uncertainty, and Selective Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) often rely on shortcuts rather than systematic reasoning, raising safety concerns in medical applications. Allowing models to abstain when uncertain improves reliability but introduces a coverage accuracy tradeoff. We propose a two-stage framework for medical hypothesis verification in multiple-choice settings that manages this tradeoff through targeted ontology grounding, applied only when the model abstains. We show that abstention is not random but reflects genuine uncertainty, with abstained predictions associated with lower confidence. Across two frontier models (GPT-5.5, accessed via the Azure OpenAI API, and DeepSeek-R1), the proposed framework improves question-level accuracy by 9.6 percentage points (82.9% to 92.5%) and hypothesis-level accuracy by 4.2 percentage points (92.0% to 96.2%). Our experiments conducted on MedReason and MedQA show that abstention can be repurposed as a control signal for selective reasoning refinement, achieving knowledge-graph-level performance without explicit knowledge graph construction.
papers.comment: Findings Track at the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，用于多选题设置下的医学假设验证 (medical hypothesis verification)。该框架只在模型弃权 (abstain) 时进行有针对性的本体论接地 (ontology grounding)，以管理覆盖率与准确率的权衡。在 GPT-5.5 (Azure OpenAI API) 和 DeepSeek-R1 两个前沿模型上，以及 MedReason 和 MedQA 数据集上的实验表明，该方法将问题级准确率从 82.9% 提升到 92.5%，将假设级准确率从 92.0% 提升到 96.2%。
Motivation: LLM 常依赖捷径而非系统推理，在医学应用中引发安全担忧；允许模型不确定时弃权可提高可靠性，但带来覆盖率与准确率的权衡。作者试图将弃权行为本身转化为可用的控制信号来改善验证过程。
Method: 提出两阶段框架：模型先给出答案，若弃权则仅在此时应用针对性的本体论接地 (ontology grounding)，从而管理覆盖率-准确率权衡。实验表明弃权并非随机，而是反映真实不确定性，弃权预测对应较低的置信度。
Result: 在两个前沿模型 (GPT-5.5 与 DeepSeek-R1) 及 MedReason 和 MedQA 上，问题级准确率提升 9.6 个百分点 (82.9%→92.5%)，假设级准确率提升 4.2 个百分点 (92.0%→96.2%)。该方法无需显式构建知识图谱，即达到知识图谱级别的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调弃权可以被重新用作选择性推理精炼的控制信号，实现知识图谱级表现而无需显式知识图谱构建。该工作将弃权从简单的拒绝机制转变为可操作的推理优化入口。

papers.title: InterPruner: Interactive Structured Pruning via Taylor-Implicit Criterion and Language-Prior Modulator for Multimodal Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal object detection proves effective in remote sensing, especially the RGB-Infrared paradigm. The parallel feature extractors provide rich multimodal information for robust detection, yet introduce substantial channel redundancy and computational overhead. Existing pruning methods can reduce channel redundancy, but they are designed for unimodal backbones, overlooking cross-modal interactions and dynamic scene-wise redundancy. In this paper, we propose InterPruner, the first interactive structured channel pruning framework for RGB-infrared object detectors. Specifically, we first derive a Taylor-Implicit Criterion(TIC) to quantify channel importance via high-order Taylor expansion and the implicit function theorem. Then, a Modality Interaction Redundancy Analyzer (MIRA) identifies redundant channels via mutual compensability assessment. Finally, a Scene-Prior Channel Anchor (SPCA) uses language priors as semantic anchors to measure channel-scene relevance for dynamic channel importance estimation. Cross-modality channel pruning for RGB-Infrared detection is yet unexplored. Extensive experiments on RGB-infrared object detection dataset demonstrate that InterPruner maintains high performance with negligible degradation. Specifically, it even achieves a 0.6% mAP increase on the FLIR dataset when pruning 50% of the channels. Code will be available on GitHub to facilitate future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InterPruner，据称是首个面向 RGB-红外多模态目标检测的结构化通道剪枝框架。该方法通过 Taylor 隐式准则（TIC）、模态交互冗余分析器（MIRA）和场景先验通道锚点（SPCA）三个组件来量化通道重要性并处理跨模态与场景相关的冗余。在 RGB-红外检测数据集上的实验表明，InterPruner 剪枝 50% 通道时在 FLIR 数据集上甚至能获得 0.6% mAP 的提升。
Motivation: RGB-红外等并行特征提取器在提供丰富多模态信息的同时引入了大量通道冗余和计算开销；现有剪枝方法针对单模态骨干设计，忽略了跨模态交互以及随场景动态变化的冗余。
Method: 提出 InterPruner，包含三个部分：利用高阶泰勒展开和隐函数定理推导 Taylor-Implicit Criterion（TIC）量化通道重要性；通过互补偿性评估识别冗余通道的 Modality Interaction Redundancy Analyzer（MIRA）；以及使用语言先验作为语义锚点、衡量通道与场景相关性的 Scene-Prior Channel Anchor（SPCA），用于动态通道重要性估计。
Result: 在 RGB-红外目标检测数据集上的实验表明，InterPruner 在保持高性能的同时性能退化可忽略；当剪枝 50% 通道时，在 FLIR 数据集上甚至实现了 0.6% mAP 的提升。
Conclusion: 作者指出 RGB-红外检测的跨模态通道剪枝此前未被探索，InterPruner 作为首个此类框架验证了该方向的有效性，并计划在 GitHub 上公开代码以支持后续工作。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Grid-Preserving Knowledge Distillation: Transferring Convolutional Inductive Bias to Vision Transformers under Data Scarcity
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers underperform convolutional networks when training data is scarce, and distilling convolutional inductive biases from a CNN teacher is an effective remedy that leaves the deployed model unchanged. General-purpose feature distillation, however, transfers little in this setting. The pooling, flattening, and logit-space projections it inherits from CNN to CNN pipelines discard the spatial grid in which locality and translation equivariance are encoded, and unlike a convolutional student, a ViT cannot rebuild that structure on its own. In this paper, we propose iBKD, a distillation framework that preserves the grid along the entire transfer path. Its core module, the Inductive Bias Attention Module, aggregates every student layer onto the teacher grid with learned weights, sharpens structural cues with channel and deformable spatial attention, and injects them through convolutional cross-attention that operates between grids rather than between token sets. The module is used only during training, so the deployed model is an unmodified ViT with no inference overhead. Across seven Transformer backbones and six data-scarce benchmarks, iBKD outperforms both locality-guidance methods and general knowledge distillation baselines, and its margin widens as training data shrinks.

TL;DR: 本文提出 iBKD，一种针对数据稀缺场景下将 CNN 的卷积归纳偏置蒸馏到 Vision Transformer 的知识蒸馏框架。核心是保持网格结构的 Inductive Bias Attention Module，通过卷积交叉注意力在网格间而非 token 集间传递结构信息，训练后不改变部署模型。在七个 Transformer 骨干和六个数据稀缺基准上，iBKD 优于一般蒸馏和局部引导方法，且数据越少优势越明显。
Motivation: Vision Transformer 在训练数据稀缺时不如卷积网络，而从 CNN 教师蒸馏归纳偏置是有效手段，但通用特征蒸馏在此场景下传递信息有限。现有蒸馏流程中的池化、展平和 logit 空间投影会丢弃编码局部性与平移等变性的空间网格，而 ViT 学生无法自行重建该结构。
Method: 提出 iBKD 蒸馏框架，核心模块为 Inductive Bias Attention Module：以学习权重将学生每层特征聚合到教师网格上，用通道注意力和可变形空间注意力增强结构线索，再通过作用于网格之间的卷积交叉注意力注入学生。该模块仅训练时使用，部署时为零开销的原版 ViT。
Result: 在七个 Transformer 骨干和六个数据稀缺基准上，iBKD 同时优于局部引导方法和通用知识蒸馏基线，且随着训练数据减少，其相对优势进一步扩大。
Conclusion: 摘要强调保持网格路径的蒸馏能有效向 ViT 传递卷积归纳偏置，且不增加推理开销；该结论主要在数据稀缺的视觉分类基准上验证。

papers.title: Ex-Omni-2D: Expressive Omni-Modal Dialogue Models with Native Visual Presence
papers.abstract_en: Omni-modal dialogue models can understand multimodal inputs and synthesize spoken replies, yet their responses remain visually disembodied. We introduce \textbf{Ex-Omni-2D}, an omni-modal dialogue framework that generates a coordinated response comprising text, personalized speech, and reference-conditioned video. Given a multimodal query, reference image, and reference audio, the model predicts a structured \textit{Visual Thought Plan} (VTP) describing scene, emotion, and motion, followed by response text and native multi-codebook speech units. These units form a shared acoustic-temporal interface: they are decoded into speech and aligned online with video frames. This interface enables the response and avatar pathways to be learned from heterogeneous speech, dialogue, and avatar-video data, avoiding the need for large-scale query--text--speech--video supervision. A full-sequence Video Generator serves as the primary Teacher. For efficient incremental generation, we further distill it into a few-step block-causal \emph{Streaming Student} whose Prefix Streaming mechanism carries a clean latent across consecutive chunks to reduce cumulative late-chunk degradation. With four-step inference, the complete four-GPU pipeline achieves an end-to-end RTF of 1.293 at $400\times720$/$720\times400$, providing a practical quality--efficiency operating point.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Ex-Omni-2D，一个能生成文本、个性化语音和参考条件视频的 omni-modal 对话框架。模型先预测结构化的 Visual Thought Plan (VTP) 描述场景、情感和动作，再输出响应文本与多码本语音单元；这些语音单元构成共享的声学-时间接口，在解码为语音的同时与视频帧在线对齐。训练上以全序列 Video Generator 作为 Teacher，蒸馏出少步 block-causal 的 Streaming Student，并引入 Prefix Streaming 机制减少长序列分块生成的累积退化。
Motivation: 现有 omni-modal 对话模型虽能理解多模态输入并合成语音回复，但回复缺乏视觉呈现，即仍处于“无具身视觉”的状态。
Method: 提出 Ex-Omni-2D 框架，通过 VTP 规划场景/情感/运动，使用多码本语音单元作为共享声学-时间接口来桥接语音生成与视频生成；采用全序列 Video Generator 作为 Teacher，并将其蒸馏为少步块因果 Streaming Student，通过 Prefix Streaming 在连续块间传递干净潜变量以降低后端块退化。
Result: 在四步推理下，完整四 GPU 流水线在 400x720/720x400 分辨率上实现端到端 RTF 为 1.293，展示了一个质量与效率可用的运行点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该接口设计使响应与虚拟形象两条路径可以分别从异构的语音、对话和形象视频数据中学习，避免了对大规模 query-text-speech-video 监督数据的依赖。

papers.title: DuplexWorld: Can voice agents help you get through the day?
papers.abstract_en: Speech-to-speech (S2S) voice agents are increasingly being incorporated into enterprise for customer care and as daily companions for consumers owing to the ease of the conversational modality over text. However, existing benchmarks fail to holistically evaluate voice agents along axes that really matter and are shaped as tests of agentic tool calling against a database. We believe they fail to adequately account for the diversity of conversational dialogue that mundane activities introduce and further, never test how faithfully an agent can assist on tasks that move beyond database manipulation. To tackle this DuplexWorld introduces six worlds where voice agents are especially useful: banking, insurance, travel, healthcare and logistics, and Pathfinding. Agents are evaluated on eleven different types of conversations across 156 scenarios (350+ hours of conversation), each testing conversational and analytical capability to varying degrees. Through extensive evaluation comprising agentic, conversational and speech-naturalness metrics, we show that even the best voice agents leave substantial room for improvement on all 3 axes (Pass@1: 0.490, turn-taking: 0.653, DNSMOS: 3.378). We perform extensive analysis on agentic v conversational performance, world- and conversation type-wise performance, failure modes exploring the explore v exploit lens for Pathfinding conversations and voice agent reliability over all six worlds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DuplexWorld，一个面向语音智能体 (voice agents) 的评测基准，涵盖银行、保险、旅行、医疗与物流以及 Pathfinding 六个世界，共 156 个场景、350+ 小时对话，并用智能体能力、对话能力与语音自然度三类指标评测。结果显示即使最好的语音智能体在三轴上仍有明显不足：Pass@1 为 0.490、turn-taking 为 0.653、DNSMOS 为 3.378。作者还分析了具体失败模式与可靠性问题。
Motivation: 现有语音智能体评测基准大多把任务塑造成针对数据库的工具调用测试，未能充分覆盖日常活动带来的对话多样性，也不测试超出数据库操作范围的辅助任务。
Method: DuplexWorld 构造六个语音智能体特别实用的世界，设计十一种对话类型共 156 个场景，并采用智能体、对话和语音自然度三类指标进行系统评测，另有对 Pathfinding 对话的 explore/exploit 视角失败模式分析。
Result: 最佳语音智能体在智能体任务 Pass@1 为 0.490，turn-taking 为 0.653，DNSMOS 为 3.378，说明三轴均有大幅提升空间；论文还报告了智能体能力与对话能力的对比、分世界与分对话类型的表现及失败模式分析。
Conclusion: 作者认为现有语音智能体远未达到日常任务辅助的可靠水平，DuplexWorld 可作为更全面的评测工具，暴露智能体在真实多样化对话中的不足。

papers.title: Most biomedical publications show signs of LLM-assisted writing
papers.abstract_en: Over the past several years, LLM-powered chatbots and agents have become widely used as a tool for academic writing. LLM-assisted writing can be valuable by removing language barriers but at the same time causes concerns about misconduct and fraud. To inform policy decisions, it is necessary to monitor the prevalence of LLM-altered texts in scholarly publications. Despite some recent progress in this direction, no existing method can produce reliable estimates. Here we suggest and validate a new unbiased approach to estimate LLM usage in a corpus of texts based on changing word frequencies. We apply our method to the full texts of open-access biomedical papers from Pubmed Central, and show that by the end of 2025, 89% of papers show excess of LLM-associated vocabulary. We also find that LLMs are twice as likely to be used when writing a paragraph in the Discussion section (68%) compared to a paragraph in the Methods section (32%), but even inside the Methods section, the overall prevalence of LLM usage is over 50%. We believe that our estimates are crucial to shape future guidelines and policies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于词频变化 (changing word frequencies) 的新方法来无偏估计学术文本中 LLM 辅助写作的 prevalence，并将其应用于 Pubmed Central 开放获取生物医学论文全文。作者报告到 2025 年底 89% 的论文表现出 LLM 关联词汇的过剩，且 Discussion 段落中使用 LLM 的概率 (68%) 约为 Methods 段落 (32%) 的两倍，但 Methods 内部的使用率仍超过 50%。
Motivation: LLM 辅助写作在学术出版中日益普遍，既有助于消除语言障碍，也引发学术不端担忧；现有方法均无法对 LLM 改写文本的 prevalence 给出可靠估计，政策制定需要可靠的监测手段。
Method: 提出一种新的无偏估计方法，通过分析词频随时间的变化来估计语料库中 LLM 的使用比例，并应用于 Pubmed Central 的开放获取生物医学论文全文。
Result: 到 2025 年底，89% 的论文表现出 LLM 关联词汇的过剩；Discussion 段落中 LLM 使用的可能性 (68%) 是 Methods 段落 (32%) 的两倍，且 Methods 内部的使用率也超过 50%。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些估计对制定未来学术写作指导方针和政策至关重要。

papers.title: Conversational Orchestration for Organic 6G
papers.abstract_en: The Organic 6G vision of a network of networks spanning an edge-cloud continuum complemented by non-terrestrial resources requires, to realize its promise, service provisioning that is simple to operate, scalable across independently administered domains, and agile under domain churn (i.e., domains dynamically joining and leaving). Despite advances in cross-domain orchestration, many proposals rely on heavy integration fabrics, multi-layer coordinators, and deep telemetry pipelines that hinder deployability and amplify coordination overhead. We propose a lightweight, decentralized conversational orchestration framework based on Large Language Model (LLM)-driven domain agents. Each domain remains autonomous: an agent observes local state via tools, reasons in a closed loop, and exchanges summaries with neighboring agents over an Agent-to-Agent (A2A) overlay aligned with data-plane coupling. Fast feasible placement is enabled by periodic, routing-like dissemination of reachability advertisements (latency, bottleneck bandwidth, and compute capacity), while safe re-optimization, scaling, and migration are handled through event-driven requests and negotiation. To meet real-time constraints, we deploy a compact reasoning model trained with verifier-based self-verification and periodically refined online via shadow updates. Simulations show manageable, near-linear control-plane overhead as domains scale and during domain joins, and robust decision quality, including recovery after objective changes. We close by outlining future research directions for principled, secure, and uncertainty-aware agentic orchestration in Organic 6G.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Network Magazine
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 Organic 6G 愿景提出一种轻量级、去中心化的会话式编排框架，用 LLM 驱动的域代理（domain agent）替代传统重集成架构。每个域保持自治，代理通过工具观察本地状态、闭环推理，并在与数据面耦合的 A2A 覆盖网络上向邻居交换摘要。仿真表明控制面开销随域规模扩大与域加入呈近似线性增长且可控，决策质量稳健，能在目标变化后恢复。论文已被 IEEE Network Magazine 接收。
Motivation: 现有跨域编排方案多依赖重集成织物、多层协调器和深度遥测管道，部署困难且协调开销大；而 Organic 6G 的端边云连续体加非地面资源场景需要简单运维、跨独立管理域可扩展、并能应对域动态加入/退出的服务编排。
Method: 提出基于 LLM 驱动域代理的轻量去中心化框架：代理用工具观察本地状态并闭环推理，通过 A2A 覆盖网络交换摘要；快速可行放置依赖周期性路由式可达性通告（延迟、瓶颈带宽、计算容量），而再优化、伸缩与迁移通过事件驱动请求和协商完成；为满足实时约束，采用紧凑推理模型，用基于验证器的自验证（verifier-based self-verification）训练，并借助影子更新（shadow updates）在线定期精炼。
Result: 模拟显示控制面开销在域规模扩大和域加入时保持近似线性且可管理，决策质量稳健，包括在目标函数变化后能够恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架能以较低部署开销实现跨自治域的敏捷编排，并指出未来研究方向包括原则化、安全且不确定性感知的代理化编排（agentic orchestration）。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 模拟显示控制面开销在域规模扩大和域加入时保持近似线性且可管理，决策质量稳健，包括在目标函数变化后能够恢复。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该框架能以较低部署开销实现跨自治域的敏捷编排，并指出未来研究方向包括原则化、安全且不确定性感知的代理化编排（agentic orchestration）。

papers.title: Compact Feed-Forward 3D Gaussians via Saliency-Guided Primitive Merging
papers.abstract_en: 3D scene reconstruction, modeling, and rendering are highly relevant for numerous tasks, and 3D Gaussian splatting has become a standard choice in this context. Its feed-forward variants provide fast reconstruction from sparse input views but often produce per-pixel primitives, leading to highly redundant and thus inefficient representations. We present a structure-aware merging pipeline that takes per-pixel primitives from any feed-forward method and consolidates them into a compact, content-adaptive Gaussian set while largely retaining visual quality at just $\frac{1}{20}^\text{th}$ of the Gaussians of a per-pixel method. We group spatially coherent Gaussians of similar appearance into variable-size clusters via adaptive superpixel segmentation guided by a saliency map, which allocates fine segments to textured regions and coarse segments to homogeneous areas. We compress each cluster into a compact latent representation through a learned encoder, then match and consolidate representations across views based on geometric overlap and feature similarity via a learned merger. A level-of-detail decoder then produces the final Gaussians at a controllable resolution, enabling a flexible quality-efficiency trade-off at inference. As a post-processing module, the pipeline is backbone-agnostic, leveraging the strengths of existing feed-forward methods. This leads to better and more robust quality than achieved by previous approaches that target a reduction in primitive count, while providing a highly compact representation, that can be rendered efficiently.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构感知的合并流水线，将任意前馈 3D 高斯泼溅 (3D Gaussian splatting) 方法产生的逐像素图元合并为紧凑、内容自适应的高斯集合，在约 1/20 图元数量的情况下大体保留视觉质量。该方法通过显著性引导的自适应超像素分割将空间连续、外观相似的高斯分成可变大小簇，再经学习式编码器、跨视图匹配合并器和 LOD 解码器完成压缩与重建。该流水线作为骨干无关的后处理模块，可提升现有前馈方法的效率与紧凑性。
Motivation: 前馈式 3D 高斯泼溅变体虽然能从稀疏视角快速重建，但常产生逐像素图元，导致表示高度冗余、渲染效率低。需要在不明显损失视觉质量的前提下减少图元数量。
Method: 提出结构感知合并流水线：以显著性图引导的自适应超像素分割，将空间相干且外观相似的高斯分组为可变大小簇；通过学习式编码器将每个簇压缩为紧凑潜在表示；基于几何重叠与特征相似性用学习式合并器跨视图匹配并合并表示；最后由 LOD (level-of-detail) 解码器以可控分辨率生成最终高斯集合。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在仅保留逐像素方法约 1/20 的高斯数量时仍能大体保持视觉质量，并且比此前面向减少图元数量的方法获得更好、更稳健的质量，同时表示高度紧凑且可高效渲染。
Conclusion: 该流水线是骨干无关的后处理模块，能够利用现有前馈方法的优势，并在推理时通过 LOD 解码器实现灵活的质量-效率权衡。摘要未涉及降水、天气或数据同化相关场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SQuaT: Self-Supervised Knowledge Distillation via Student-Aware Quantized Teacher Features
papers.abstract_en: Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) enables the deployment of quantized models with minimal accuracy degradation. However, in practical scenarios, training labels are often unavailable due to privacy, copyright, or cost constraints. Knowledge Distillation (KD) is a common approach to address this challenge, but we observe that prior work combining QAT with KD suffers from a fundamental limitation: during distillation, the range mismatch between the teacher and the quantized student model induces an unattainable residual, resulting in an irreducible lower bound on the distillation loss. Motivated by this observation, we propose SQuaT (Student-Aware Quantized Teacher Features), a label-free QAT framework with KD that theoretically eliminates this lower bound by applying the student's quantization parameters to quantize the teacher's features during distillation. Through comprehensive experiments across diverse settings, we demonstrate that SQuaT consistently outperforms strong baselines, with particularly pronounced gains in extreme low-bit (e.g., 1- and 2-bit) settings. Furthermore, extensive evaluations across various model design choices show that our approach does not rely on specific architectural assumptions, making it broadly applicable across diverse architectures and quantization settings. The source code is available at https://github.com/lcdbsa522/SQuaT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SQuaT (Student-Aware Quantized Teacher Features)，一个无需标签的 QAT+KD 框架。作者观察到此前 QAT 与 KD 结合时，教师模型与量化学生模型之间的范围失配会产生不可达残差，从而给蒸馏损失带来不可消除的下界；SQuaT 通过在蒸馏时使用学生模型的量化参数来量化教师特征，从理论上消除该下界。实验表明 SQuaT 在多种设置下稳定优于强基线，在 1-bit 和 2-bit 极端低比特场景下提升尤为明显，并且不依赖特定架构假设。
Motivation: 实际部署中常因隐私、版权或成本原因无法获得训练标签，而现有结合 QAT 与 KD 的方法存在根本局限：教师与学生模型特征范围失配导致蒸馏损失存在不可达残差，形成不可约下界，限制了量化模型精度。
Method: 提出 SQuaT，一种无标签的自监督蒸馏式 QAT 框架，核心做法是在蒸馏过程中直接使用学生模型的量化参数来量化教师特征，从而在理论上消除因范围失配产生的蒸馏损失下界。
Result: 摘要报告 SQuaT 在多种实验设置下一致优于强基线，尤其在 1-bit 和 2-bit 极端低比特设置下增益显著；同时在不同模型设计选择下均表现稳健，说明方法不依赖特定架构，可广泛适用于多种架构与量化设置。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过学生感知的教师特征量化可以理论上消除蒸馏损失的下界，并认为该框架在不同架构和量化设置下具有广泛适用性；源代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-Geometry: GT-Free and Plug-and-Play Test-Time Adaptation for Geometrically Consistent 3D Vision Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) predict depth, camera pose, and pointmap in a single forward pass without per-scene optimization, achieving strong generalization. However, enforcing explicit multi-view geometric consistency, e.g., through bundle adjustment, is computationally costly and is thus not imposed during VFM pretraining, so such inconsistency can arise. To address this, implicit self-consistency derived from model outputs (e.g., pointmaps, features), though enforced at test-time in prior work, delivers inherently limited performance gain, especially on scenes where the pretrained VFM is highly inaccurate. In contrast to this implicit signal, we propose Self-Geometry, a plug-and-play test-time adaptation pipeline that directly imposes explicit multi-view geometric constraints using 2D pixel correspondences as pseudo ground-truth. Our proposed Self-Geometry consists of Geometric Disentanglement Optimization, which combines Multi-View Consistency and Epipolar Consistency losses with Gradient Disentanglement to prevent gradient conflict; Frame Angular-Neighbor, a view sampler based on SO(3) geodesic distances for lightly imposing these constraints; and Lightweight TTA, which adapts VFMs via LoRA. Our method achieves consistent improvements in both pose and geometry estimation across six VFMs (VGGT, $π^3$, DA3-Giant/Large/Base/Small) and four benchmarks (7Scenes, ETH3D, ScanNet++, HiRoom).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉基础模型 (VFM) 在单次前向推理中预测深度、相机位姿和 pointmap 时缺乏显式多视图几何一致性的问题，提出一种即插即用的测试时自适应 (test-time adaptation) 方法 Self-Geometry。该方法利用 2D 像素对应作为伪真值直接施加显式多视图几何约束，并在六个 VFM 和四个基准上一致提升位姿与几何估计精度。
Motivation: 现有 VFM 预训练时未施加显式多视图几何一致性（如 bundle adjustment），导致跨视图输出不一致；先前工作使用的隐式自一致性信号在预训练模型误差较大的场景下性能提升有限。
Method: 提出 Self-Geometry 测试时自适应流程，包含三项组件：几何解缠优化 (Geometric Disentanglement Optimization)，结合多视图一致性与对极一致性损失以及梯度解缠 (Gradient Disentanglement) 避免梯度冲突；Frame Angular-Neighbor，基于 SO(3) 测地距离的视图采样器以轻量施加约束；以及通过 LoRA 实现轻量测试时自适应 (Lightweight TTA)。
Result: 在六个 VFM（VGGT、π³、DA3-Giant/Large/Base/Small）和四个基准（7Scenes、ETH3D、ScanNet++、HiRoom）上，位姿估计与几何估计均获得一致的改进。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以 2D 像素对应作为伪真值直接施加显式多视图几何约束，相比隐式自一致性信号能带来更稳定且更强的测试时自适应收益，且方法为即插即用 (plug-and-play)。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MMArt A Multi-Perspective Multimodal Dataset for Visual Art Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent vision-language models demonstrate impressive general visual understanding, yet their art interpretation remains shallow: they describe surface content but struggle with formal analysis, grounded historical interpretation, or affective characterization. We argue this is not only a model but also a dataset limitation. Existing art datasets are single perspective resources, where no dataset provides narrative, formal, emotional, and historical perspectives simultaneously for the same artworks. We introduce MMArt, a large-scale dataset of 74,234 WikiArt paintings, each annotated with four independently annotated perspectives plus a harmonized unified caption, produced by specialized vision-language models or human annotation and validated through complementary quality evaluations. Two complementarity analyses establish that perspectives encode genuinely distinct information. A generative analysis shows that formal analysis descriptions best preserve compositional style, and historical descriptions carry strong affective signal in reconstructed images. A discriminative retrieval analysis reveals task-asymmetry: narrative descriptions drive retrieval (R@1 = 44.0%), while formal descriptions, strongest for reconstruction, are nearly nondiscriminative at retrieval scale (R@1 = 7.8%). Leave-one-out analysis further confirms that historical descriptions are the least replaceable perspective across both tasks. Together, the two analyses establish that no single perspective suffices for all tasks, directly motivating MMArt multi-perspective design. The dataset, code, and additional information are available at https://shuaiwang97.github.io/MMArt/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MMArt，一个包含 74,234 幅 WikiArt 绘画的大规模多视角数据集，每幅画配有叙事、形式、情感、历史四种独立标注视角及一个统一标题。互补性分析表明各视角编码不同信息，生成分析显示形式描述最能保留构图风格，判别检索分析显示叙事描述驱动检索（R@1=44.0%）而形式描述检索能力很弱（R@1=7.8%），留一法分析表明历史描述最不可替代。作者据此论证单一视角无法满足所有艺术理解任务。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型对艺术品的理解停留在表面内容，缺乏形式分析、历史解读与情感刻画；作者认为这不仅是模型限制，也是数据集限制，因为现有艺术数据集均为单一视角，没有同时提供同一艺术品的叙事、形式、情感和历史标注。
Method: 构建 MMArt 数据集，使用专门的视觉语言模型或人工标注为每幅画生成四种独立视角和统一标题，并通过互补性质量评估验证标注质量；随后采用互补性分析、生成分析（重建图像）、判别分析（检索）以及留一法（leave-one-out）分析来考察各视角的独立价值。
Result: 叙事性描述在检索任务上表现最强（R@1=44.0%），形式性描述虽在重建中最能保持构图风格，但在检索尺度上几乎不具判别性（R@1=7.8%）；历史性描述在两个任务中都是最不可替代的视角，说明没有任何单一视角能充分支持所有任务。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果直接支持 MMArt 的多视角设计，表明艺术理解需要互补的多视角标注；数据集、代码与更多信息已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Your LLM, Your Style: Behavioral Mode Axes for LLM Behavioral Control
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly act in interactive settings where their behavioral styles affect user experience, safety, and downstream decision making. Existing LLM personality studies largely rely on self-report questionnaires administered in first-person settings, making the resulting profiles sensitive to surface elicitation choices and poorly grounded in concrete model behavior. In this work, we introduce a situated behavioral-data (B-data) framework for studying and controlling LLM behavioral personality. We construct 3,200 contrastive behavioral scenarios spanning 20 behavioral patterns and four prompt registers, grounded in validated psychometric facets such as BFI-2, DOSPERT, and HEXACO. Using this framework, we find that LLMs exhibit stable and model-specific behavioral profiles, while also revealing register-dependent shifts across first-person decisions, advice-giving, and task execution. We then show that these behavioral patterns can be controlled through Behavioral Mode Axes (BMAs), activation-space directions derived from contrastive behavioral traces. Compared with response-derived BMAs, which are more prone to trait drift, thought-derived BMAs more faithfully capture the intended behavioral mechanism and provide cleaner control over situated behavioral styles. Our results suggest that LLM personality-like tendencies are better understood not as abstract self-report traits, but as measurable and controllable behavioral modes grounded in concrete interaction contexts. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/lhz191/LLM-Behavioral-Personality.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于情境行为数据 (situational B-data) 的框架来研究和控制 LLM 的行为人格，构建了 3,200 个对比性行为场景，覆盖 20 种行为模式和四种提示语域 (prompt register)，并以 BFI-2、DOSPERT、HEXACO 等心理测量学构念为基础。实验发现 LLM 表现出稳定且模型特定的行为画像，同时存在依赖语域的偏移；作者进一步提出行为模式轴 (Behavioral Mode Axes, BMA)，即从对比行为轨迹中提取的激活空间方向，其中思维派生 (thought-derived) 的 BMA 比响应派生 (response-derived) 的 BMA 更能忠实捕捉行为机制并实现更干净的行为风格控制。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 人格研究大多依赖第一人称情境下的自我报告问卷，结果对表层诱发方式敏感，且与具体模型行为缺乏扎实的对应关系，难以支撑交互场景中的行为控制。
Method: 构建包含 3,200 个对比性行为场景、20 种行为模式和四种提示语域的情境行为数据框架，并基于对比行为轨迹提取激活空间方向作为行为模式轴 (BMA) 来控制行为风格；同时对比响应派生与思维派生两种 BMA 的差异。
Result: 摘要报告 LLM 展现出稳定且模型特定的行为画像，并在第一人称决策、建议提供和任务执行等语域间表现出依赖语域的偏移；思维派生的 BMA 相比响应派生 BMA 更忠实于预期行为机制，能提供更干净的行为风格控制。
Conclusion: 论文主张 LLM 的人格化倾向不应被理解为抽象的自我报告特质，而应看作可测量、可控制、且依托具体交互情境的行为模式。

papers.title: ProTAGAD: A Foundation Model for TAG Anomaly Detection with Decoupled Topological and Textual Prototypes
papers.abstract_en: Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs), endowed with abundant textual content along with topological structures, have emerged as a versatile backbone for real-world anomaly detection spanning large language model security, social network moderation, and cyber threat identification. Unlike conventional Graph Anomaly Detection (GAD), which relies primarily on structural irregularities, TAG anomaly detection must jointly leverage both topological patterns and fine-grained textual semantics to capture nuanced anomalous behaviors. The current GNN-based anomaly detectors adopt holistic message-passing schemes that indiscriminately fuse structural proximity and textual semantics during propagation, leading to deep cross-modality coupling. This entanglement acts as a noise amplifier, obscuring subtle anomalous signals and directly giving rise to the Blurred-Anomaly-Boundary (BAB) issue by rendering normal-anomalous decision boundaries poorly separable. This challenge is further amplified for graph foundation models that require robust cross-domain generalization. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel foundation model for TAG anomaly detection featuring decoupled topological and textual prototypes. Our framework constructs dual prototype banks to independently model structural normality and semantic consistency, effectively isolating anomaly cues that are otherwise diluted during coupled aggregation. Extensive experiments across 14 diverse benchmark datasets demonstrate that our method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in cross-domain settings. Notably, the ablation studies further corroborate the prevalence of the BAB issue in conventional coupled TAG anomaly detectors, and show that our decoupled prototype design effectively mitigates this challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProTAGAD，一个面向文本属性图（Text-Attributed Graphs, TAGs）异常检测的基础模型，核心思路是用解耦的拓扑原型与文本语义原型分别建模结构正常性和语义一致性，避免传统 GNN 消息传递中结构近邻与文本语义的深层耦合所导致的异常边界模糊（Blurred-Anomaly-Boundary, BAB）问题。摘要在 14 个跨域基准数据集上报告了一致的 state-of-the-art 性能，并通过消融实验说明解耦原型设计能缓解 BAB 问题。
Motivation: 在 TAG 异常检测中，同时利用拓扑结构与细粒度文本语义是必要的，但现有基于 GNN 的检测器采用整体式消息传递，不加区分地融合结构邻近性与文本语义，造成跨模态深层耦合，反而放大噪声并产生 BAB 问题，即正常与异常决策边界难以分离。该问题还会进一步削弱图基础模型所需的跨域泛化能力。
Method: 提出一个 TAG 异常检测基础模型，构建双原型库（dual prototype banks），将拓扑原型与文本原型解耦，独立建模结构正常性和语义一致性，从而把在耦合聚合中被稀释的异常线索隔离出来。
Result: 在 14 个不同基准数据集上的跨域设置中，该方法一致取得 state-of-the-art 性能；消融实验表明常规耦合式 TAG 异常检测器普遍存在 BAB 问题，而解耦原型设计能有效缓解该挑战。
Conclusion: 摘要强调解耦拓扑与文本原型是缓解 TAG 异常检测中跨模态耦合、改善异常边界可分离性的有效设计，并支持跨域泛化。

papers.title: Optimize Cheap, Deploy Strong: Cost-Aware Cross-Tier Transfer for Evolutionary Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Evolutionary optimization of LLM prompts and agentic programs (e.g., GEPA) is dominated by fitness evaluation: scoring each candidate runs an answering LLM over a validation set, so the evaluator's price tier dictates total search cost. We restructure that search by decoupling the three roles an LLM plays, running the high-volume answering role on the cheapest tier, reserving a strong model for the rare reflection/variation operator, then exploiting upward cross-tier transfer to deploy the cheaply evolved prompt on a stronger target. We contribute a cost-controlled characterization of when cheap-tier search substitutes for target-tier search, and where it fails. Across four tasks (HotpotQA, IFBench, LiveBench-Math, HoVer) and eleven models in four model families, the resulting prompt matches or exceeds same-tier optimization while placing over 96% of search tokens on the cheapest tier, at 5.6-14x lower search cost, rising to 25-54x where reasoning tiers emit long chains of thought on every fitness call.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 LLM prompt 与 agentic program（如 GEPA）的进化优化中 fitness 评估成本过高的问题，提出成本感知的跨层级迁移（cost-aware cross-tier transfer）搜索策略。其核心是把 LLM 在搜索中扮演的三个角色解耦：将高频的答案生成放在最便宜模型层级，把稀少的反思/变异算子留给强模型，并利用向上的跨层级迁移将廉价层进化出的 prompt 部署到更强目标模型上。作者在四个任务（HotpotQA、IFBench、LiveBench-Math、HoVer）和四个模型家族的十一个模型上验证，该 prompt 在匹配或超过同层级优化的同时将超过 96% 的搜索 token 放在最便宜层级，搜索成本降低 5.6-14 倍；当推理层级每次 fitness 调用都生成长思维链时，成本降低可达 25-54 倍。
Motivation: 进化优化 LLM prompt 和 agentic program 时，fitness 评估占据主导成本：每个候选都需在验证集上运行一个回答 LLM，因此评估模型的定价层级直接决定总搜索成本。这限制了昂贵但更强的模型在搜索中的使用，需要一种能大幅降低搜索成本而不牺牲最终性能的策略。
Method: 将搜索中 LLM 扮演的三个角色解耦：把高并发的回答（answering）角色放在最便宜层级，把稀少出现的反思/变异（reflection/variation）算子保留给强模型，然后利用向上的跨层级迁移（upward cross-tier transfer）把廉价层级进化得到的 prompt 部署到更强目标模型上。作者还给出了成本受控的表征，说明廉价层级搜索在什么条件下可以替代目标层级搜索、在什么条件下会失败。
Result: 在 HotpotQA、IFBench、LiveBench-Math、HoVer 四个任务及四个模型家族的十一个模型上，该方法得到的 prompt 匹配或超过同层级优化（same-tier optimization）的效果，同时把超过 96% 的搜索 token 放在最便宜层级，搜索成本降低 5.6-14 倍；在推理层级每次 fitness 调用都输出长思维链的场景下，成本降低可达 25-54 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过解耦回答与反思/变异角色并利用跨层级迁移，可以用廉价层级的搜索替代目标层级搜索，在保持 prompt 性能的同时大幅降低进化优化的搜索成本；论文同时刻画了该替代在哪些条件下失效。

papers.title: SPIEval: Evaluating Large Language Models as Mobile Assistants over Scattered Personal Information
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as mobile assistants, where a key challenge is leveraging personal information scattered across multiple applications (apps) to complete user instructions. However, due to the lack of dedicated benchmarks, their capabilities remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce SPIEval, a human-curated benchmark grounded in five cognitive capabilities (i.e., reasoning, disambiguation, integration, preference inference, and multi-intent decomposition). SPIEval comprises 250 tasks spanning 4,335 personal records distributed across 10 apps and supports multi-turn interaction through 21 tools. Analysis shows that the benchmark exhibits diverse scenarios, challenging tasks, scattered information, controllable environments, and verifiable outcomes. We evaluate nine representative LLMs and find substantial room for improvement. The best-performing model, GPT-5.5 (xhigh), achieves only 57.3% accuracy, while the weakest achieves just 16.4%. Further analysis reveals that 79% of failures stem from inaccurate information localization, as LLMs often commit to plausible but incorrect information instead of continuing retrieval for verification. We also find that fewer than 2% of retrieval actions employ advanced search methods and observe substantial variation in search efficiency across models. These findings expose fundamental limitations of current LLM-based mobile assistants and motivate future research in this direction. Data and code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Junjie-Ye/SPIEval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SPIEval，一个人工整理的基准 (benchmark)，用于评估大语言模型作为移动助手时利用分散在多个应用中的个人信息完成用户指令的能力。基准包含 250 个任务、覆盖 10 个应用的 4,335 条个人记录，并基于推理、消歧、整合、偏好推断和多意图分解五种认知能力构建，支持通过 21 个工具进行多轮交互。作者评测了九个代表性 LLM，最佳模型 GPT-5.5 (xhigh) 仅达到 57.3% 准确率，最弱模型为 16.4%。分析发现 79% 的失败源于不准确的信息定位，且不到 2% 的检索动作使用高级搜索方法，暴露了当前 LLM 移动助手的根本局限。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被部署为移动助手，关键挑战是利用分散在多个应用中的个人信息来执行用户指令；但由于缺少专门基准，这类能力尚未被充分理解。
Method: 引入 SPIEval 基准，包含 250 个任务、覆盖 10 个应用的 4,335 条个人记录，围绕五种认知能力 (推理、消歧、整合、偏好推断、多意图分解) 设计，并通过 21 个工具支持多轮交互；还提供了场景多样性、任务难度、信息分散性、环境可控性和结果可验证性的分析。
Result: 对九个代表性 LLM 的评测显示表现有较大提升空间：最佳模型 GPT-5.5 (xhigh) 准确率为 57.3%，最弱模型为 16.4%；79% 的失败归因于不准确的信息定位，LLM 常坚持看似合理但错误的信息而不继续检索验证；不到 2% 的检索动作使用高级搜索方法，且各模型在搜索效率上差异显著。
Conclusion: 这些发现暴露了当前基于 LLM 的移动助手的根本局限，并为未来研究方向提供了动机；数据和代码已公开在 Hugging Face 上。

papers.title: Embedding Rotation Invariance for Provable Multi-Oriented Scene Text Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Multi-oriented text is ubiquitous in real-world scenes and remains a major challenge for scene text recognition (STR). Existing rotation-aware methods explicitly estimate text orientation. However, due to the lack of theoretical guarantees, they are prone to error accumulation, increased computational cost, and strong reliance on data. In this work, we incorporate rotation invariance into the STR framework to address these limitations. Specifically, we adopt an encoder-decoder architecture, embedding rotation equivariance in the encoder and rotation invariance in the decoder to construct a fully rotation-invariant network. On the decoder side, we first identify and prove the rotation-invariant property of the cross-attention mechanism and use it to formulate a rotation-invariant text decoder that maps visual features to output text in a rotation-invariant manner. On the encoder side, we propose a rotation-equivariant local-global extraction network that integrates deep equivariant convolutions with self-attention, enabling rotation-equivariant feature extraction while modeling inter-character dependencies and preserving fine-grained visual details. By integrating the encoder and decoder, we obtain an end-to-end Rotation-Invariant Scene Text Recognition network (RISTER). RISTER provides rotation invariance with theoretical guarantees, enhancing robustness on multi-oriented samples without introducing additional inference computation or relying on data-driven orientation correction. Experiments show that RISTER achieves state-of-the-art performance on both standard and multi-oriented benchmarks, surpassing the second-best model by 4.0 percent in accuracy on the general multi-oriented dataset.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RISTER，一个具有理论保证的端到端旋转不变场景文本识别网络。该方法在编码器侧嵌入旋转等变性（rotation equivariance），在解码器侧利用并证明了交叉注意力机制的旋转不变性（rotation invariance），从而无需显式估计文本方向即可处理多方向文本。实验表明 RISTER 在标准与多方向基准上均达到当前最优，并在通用多方向数据集上比第二名高 4.0 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有旋转感知方法通过显式估计文本方向来处理多方向文本，但缺乏理论保证，容易出现误差累积、计算开销增加以及对数据的强依赖。
Method: 采用编码器-解码器架构：编码器是旋转等变的局部-全局提取网络，将深度等变卷积与自注意力结合，用于建模字符间依赖并保留细粒度视觉细节；解码器基于已证明的交叉注意力旋转不变性质，将视觉特征以旋转不变方式映射为输出文本。
Result: 实验显示 RISTER 在标准与多方向基准上均取得最高准确率，在通用多方向数据集上较第二名提升 4.0 个百分点。
Conclusion: RISTER 以理论保证实现旋转不变性，增强多方向样本上的鲁棒性，且不引入额外推理计算，也不依赖数据驱动的方向校正。

papers.title: Visual Geometry Foundation-Aware Gaussians for Single-Frame Surround-View Driving Reconstruction
papers.abstract_en: Single-frame surround-view reconstruction faces severe geometric instability and rendering artifacts due to minimal inter-camera overlap. While existing methods rely on complex decoders or auxiliary cues, they remain bottlenecked by the weak geometric capacity of upstream features. We argue that leveraging pretrained visual geometry priors strengthens upstream representations and alleviates the geometric ambiguity in sparse surround views. To this end, we propose VGGD, a visual geometry foundation-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for feed-forward surround-view driving reconstruction, which shifts geometric modeling to the frontend and adapts foundation priors to the driving camera setting. First, VGGD leverages VGGT to provide transferable multi-view geometric prior tokens. Next, we introduce a Dual-Path Neck to decouple geometry-consistent and appearance-aware representations, improving appearance completion in weakly observed regions. We further apply Scale Warmup to stabilize early geometry learning and suppress scale drift under ego-pose changes. Finally, we use a hybrid pixel--volume Gaussian decoder to produce a renderable 3D Gaussian scene for novel-view synthesis. Experiments on the nuScenes single-frame benchmark show that VGGD achieves the best overall rendering quality among the compared methods and improves relative geometric consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VGGD，一个面向单帧环视驾驶重建的视觉几何基础感知 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架。该方法将几何建模移到前端，利用预训练 VGGT 提供多视图几何先验 token，通过 Dual-Path Neck 解耦几何一致与外观感知表征，并用 Scale Warmup 稳定早期几何学习、抑制 ego-pose 变化下的尺度漂移，最后由混合 pixel-volume Gaussian decoder 生成可渲染的 3D 高斯场景。在 nuScenes 单帧基准上，VGGD 在对比方法中取得最佳总体渲染质量，并改善相对几何一致性。
Motivation: 单帧环视重建因相机间重叠极小而面临严重的几何不稳定和渲染伪影；现有方法依赖复杂解码器或辅助线索，但受限于上游特征较弱的几何表达能力。作者认为利用预训练视觉几何先验强化上游表示，可以缓解稀疏环视视图中的几何歧义。
Method: VGGD 将几何建模前置，并把视觉基础先验适配到驾驶相机设置：先使用 VGGT 生成可迁移的多视图几何先验 token；再引入 Dual-Path Neck 解耦几何一致与外观感知表征，改善弱观测区域的表观补全；随后采用 Scale Warmup 稳定早期几何学习并抑制尺度漂移；最后用混合 pixel-volume Gaussian decoder 输出可渲染的 3D 高斯场景用于新视角合成。
Result: 在 nuScenes 单帧基准上的实验表明，VGGD 在对比方法中取得最佳总体渲染质量，并提升了相对几何一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调把几何建模前置并适配预训练视觉几何先验，能够缓解稀疏环视视图的几何歧义，同时改善外观补全与几何稳定性。该方法的适用范围是单帧环视驾驶重建，摘要未给出局限性说明。

papers.title: Bridging Severe Cross-Modal Misalignment: End-to-End Visible-Infrared Object Detection via Explicit Feature-Domain Affine Registration
papers.abstract_en: Visible-infrared object detection relies on complementary RGB and thermal cues, but its performance is often degraded by cross-modal spatial misalignment. Most existing methods rely on implicit feature adaptation to handle weakly misaligned scenarios, while large-offset geometric discrepancies remain insufficiently addressed. In this paper, we propose a Joint Feature-domain Registration and Detection network (JFRDet), an end-to-end visible-infrared oriented object detector tailored for severely cross-modal geometric discrepancies. JFRDet introduces a Cross-Modal Affine Alignment (CMAA) module to estimate an image-level affine transformation for explicit multi-level feature alignment. Note that illumination changes directly affect the reliability of RGB cues, an Illumination-Guided Complementary Fusion (IGCF) module adaptively exploits modality reliability under varying illumination conditions for cross-modal fusion. Then, an Alignment Quality-Consistency Gating (AQCG) strategy stabilizes joint optimization by modulating detection supervision according to alignment reliability and gradient consistency. We further construct DroneVehicle Misaligned (DVMA), a benchmark for evaluating visible-infrared oriented object detection under severe cross-modal geometric misalignment. The proposed JFRDet achieves 69.7\% $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ on DVMA, which represents state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance. The code and dataset will be available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出端到端可见光-红外定向目标检测网络 JFRDet，针对严重跨模态几何错位场景。摘要称引入 Cross-Modal Affine Alignment (CMAA) 模块估计图像级仿射变换进行显式多级特征对齐，并用 Illumination-Guided Complementary Fusion (IGCF) 与 Alignment Quality-Consistency Gating (AQCG) 分别处理光照变化下的模态可靠性和联合优化稳定性。作者构建 DroneVehicle Misaligned (DVMA) 基准，并在该基准上达到 69.7% mAP50 的 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 现有可见光-红外检测大多依赖隐式特征适配处理弱错位场景，对大幅偏移的几何差异处理不足；同时光照变化直接影响 RGB 线索可靠性，导致严重跨模态错位下的检测性能明显下降。
Method: 提出 JFRDet 联合配准与检测网络：CMAA 模块估计图像级仿射变换以显式对齐多层特征；IGCF 模块根据光照条件自适应利用模态可靠性进行跨模态融合；AQCG 策略依据对齐可靠性和梯度一致性调节检测监督，从而稳定端到端联合优化。此外构建了用于评估严重几何错位下可见光-红外定向检测的 DVMA 基准。
Result: 摘要报告 JFRDet 在 DVMA 基准上取得 69.7% mAP50，达到 state-of-the-art (SOTA) 性能，并称代码与数据集将公开在 GitHub。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式特征域仿射配准、光照引导互补融合与对齐质量门控可以应对严重跨模态几何错位并提升定向检测精度；摘要未提供更多消融或局限性说明。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: ENTLORE: A Graph-Grounded Benchmark for Latent Organizational Reasoning in Enterprise Question Answering
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise question answering is framed as retrieving internal documents and generating grounded answers. Routine enterprise records, however, are work by-products in which required organizational relations remain implicit across heterogeneous sources. Existing benchmarks provide realistic multi-source evidence, but often materialize a predefined answer path and therefore test the composition of stated facts rather than recovery of a target relation absent from the corpus. We call the latter capability latent organizational reasoning. We introduce ENTLORE, a graph-grounded benchmark construction framework that reconstructs an audited enterprise world from routine documents, authoritative organizational tables, and operational records. Versioned organizational conventions certify derived relations in a truth graph, enabling complete golden answers and proof certificates. The aligned anonymized release exposes only the document corpus while withholding private structure and target relations. ENTLORE contains 2,341 documents from three source types and 907 questions spanning explicit lookup, cross-source composition, and latent organizational reasoning, evaluated across 56 model and access configurations. Structuring the released world as an induced entity graph or navigable knowledge base gives the strongest deployable results. Yet supplying gold documents still leaves 30.4% of latent questions unanswered, versus 12.6% and 6.2% for explicit and compositional questions. Enterprise QA therefore depends not only on document recall, but also on whether implicit organizational relations become usable. The benchmark, data, and code are publicly available at ENTLORE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ENTLORE，一个面向企业问答的图基基准构建框架，专门测试潜在组织推理 (latent organizational reasoning)——即从语料中并未显式陈述的目标组织关系中恢复信息。框架从常规文档、权威组织表和业务记录重建可审计的企业世界，并通过版本化组织约定在真值图 (truth graph) 中认证派生关系，从而生成完整金答案和证明证书。基准包含 3 类来源的 2,341 篇文档以及 907 个问题，跨越显式查找、跨源组合和潜在组织推理三类，并在 56 种模型与访问配置下评估。摘要报告即便提供金文档，仍有 30.4% 的潜在推理问题无法回答，而显式与组合问题分别为 12.6% 和 6.2%。
Motivation: 现有企业问答基准往往固化了预定义的答案路径，只测试对已陈述事实的组合，而不是恢复语料中缺失的目标关系。日常企业记录作为工作副产品，组织关系在异构来源中通常是隐式的，因此需要专门评测这种潜在组织推理能力。
Method: ENTLORE 是一个图基基准构建框架：从常规文档、权威组织表和业务记录重建可审计的企业世界，并用版本化组织约定在真值图中认证派生关系，从而支持完整的金答案和证明证书。对齐的匿名发布仅暴露文档语料，隐藏私有结构和目标关系；同时将发布世界组织为诱导实体图 (induced entity graph) 或可导航知识库 (navigable knowledge base) 以支持部署。
Result: 基准包含来自三种来源类型的 2,341 篇文档和 907 个问题，覆盖显式查找、跨源组合和潜在组织推理，评估了 56 种模型与访问配置。将发布世界结构化为实体图或知识库可获得最强的可部署结果；但即使在提供金文档的情况下，潜在推理问题仍有 30.4% 无法回答，远高于显式问题的 12.6% 和组合问题的 6.2%。
Conclusion: 企业问答不仅依赖文档召回，还取决于隐式组织关系能否被利用；ENTLORE 作为公开基准、数据和代码，用于系统评测这一能力。

papers.title: Auditing Chinese Web-scale Corpora via Sampled BPE Token Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Chinese web pollution has surfaced in LLMs, motivating audits of upstream Chinese corpora. However, auditing such corpora faces three challenges: (1) their web-scale size makes full scan costly; (2) prior analyses are often too coarse to expose token-level pollution; (3) Chinese web pollution is implicit and rapidly changing. We propose Sampled-BPE, a lightweight token-level auditing pipeline that sample a small subset and train BPE tokenizer to surface polluted tokens. Experiments show that Sampled-BPE preserves usable estimates while substantially reducing runtime and memory: a 148.4 $\times$ speedup and a 35.8 $\times$ memory reduction induce only 4.25% relative error for pollution categories. We apply the pipeline to 11 open Chinese corpora and 6 Chinese Common Crawl snapshots from 2021 to 2026. The audit reveals widespread but uneven pollution across open corpora, as well as highly polluted and temporally shifting Chinese web content. We further release a hierarchical Chinese web token dataset with 660k+ token records, each with web context, category, and explanation fields, organized as trees to support review and tracing of pollution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sampled-BPE，一种轻量级的 token 级审计流水线，用于审计中文网页规模语料库：先采样小子集，再训练 BPE tokenizer 以暴露被污染的 token。实验表明，该方法在保持可用估计的同时大幅降低资源开销，获得 148.4 倍加速和 35.8 倍内存缩减，污染类别估计的相对误差仅 4.25%。作者将该流水线应用于 11 个开源中文语料库和 2021 至 2026 年的 6 个中文 Common Crawl 快照，发现污染广泛但不均匀，且随时间动态变化，并发布了包含 660k+ token 记录的层级化中文网页 token 数据集。
Motivation: 中文网页污染已在 LLM 中显现，需要审计上游中文语料库；但审计面临语料库规模过大导致全量扫描成本高、此前分析粒度太粗无法暴露 token 级污染、以及中文网页污染具有隐性和快速变化特点这三重挑战。
Method: 提出 Sampled-BPE 审计流水线，核心思路是仅采样语料库的一小部分并训练 BPE tokenizer，从而以 token 粒度暴露被污染的 token；同时发布一个层级化中文网页 token 数据集，每条记录包含网页上下文、污染类别和解释字段，并按树状结构组织以支持审查与污染溯源。
Result: 实验显示 Sampled-BPE 相比全量扫描实现 148.4 倍加速和 35.8 倍内存缩减，而污染类别估计的相对误差仅为 4.25%；对 11 个开源中文语料库和 6 个中文 Common Crawl 快照的审计揭示了广泛但不均匀的污染，以及高度污染且随时间变化的中文网页内容。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Sampled-BPE 使得对网页规模中文语料库进行可负担的 token 级污染审计成为可能，并通过发布带上下文与解释字段的层级化 token 数据集来支持后续污染审查与追踪。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Chartography: A Benchmark for Professional Chart Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Professionals across medicine, engineering, finance, manufacturing, and the sciences often make consequential decisions from charts. Existing chart benchmarks do not sufficiently measure this ability: they are dominated by bar, line, and pie formats, rely on shorter reasoning chains, and are nearing saturation, with frontier models already scoring 80-90%. We introduce Chartography, a benchmark of 100 tasks that pair charts drawn from professional practice, in domain-specific formats that standard chart benchmarks rarely include, with questions written by professionals who read these charts for a living and independently verified by three additional experts. In an evaluation of 30 frontier-model configurations (20 scored trials per task), the best configuration reaches only 45.0% mean pass@1; the remainder span 9.0-39.5%. Failures concentrate in visual perception: models can miss nuanced features, misread values along sparsely labeled axes, mishandle projected 3D geometry, and violate domain conventions encoded in the chart. We release all tasks, images, provenance metadata, and evaluation code.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Benchmarking Evidence-Aligned Multimodal Reasoning (BEAM 2), ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Chartography，一个面向专业图表理解能力的基准，包含 100 个任务，图表来自医学、工程、金融、制造和科学等领域的专业实践，问题由日常阅读这些图表的专业人士撰写并经三位专家独立验证。对 30 个前沿模型配置的评估中，最佳配置仅达到 45.0% 的 mean pass@1，其余配置在 9.0-39.5% 之间，失败主要集中在视觉感知层面。作者公开了全部任务、图像、来源元数据和评估代码。
Motivation: 现有图表基准以条形图、折线图和饼图为主，推理链较短，且前沿模型已接近饱和（80-90%），不足以衡量专业场景中基于图表做重大决策的能力。
Method: 构建包含 100 个任务的基准，采用专业实践中的领域特定图表格式，问题由从业者撰写并经三位额外专家独立验证；评估 30 个前沿模型配置、每任务 20 次评分试验，使用 mean pass@1 作为指标。
Result: 最佳配置仅达到 45.0% 的 mean pass@1，其余配置在 9.0-39.5% 之间；失败集中在视觉感知，包括遗漏细微特征、在稀疏标注坐标轴上误读数值、处理投影 3D 几何错误，以及违反图表中的领域约定。
Conclusion: 作者指出当前前沿模型在专业图表理解上仍远未饱和，视觉感知是主要瓶颈，并发布全部基准资源以支持后续研究。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Self-Correcting Long-Horizon Search Agents via Tree-Structured Memory
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-based search agents answer questions through multi-step interactions with external environments. However, providing complete execution trajectories to the LLM causes unbounded context growth and introduces noise. Existing compression methods reduce context at the cost of important details and often replace erroneous facts without repairing downstream reasoning derived from them. To address this problem, we propose ReTree, a self-correcting tree-structured memory mechanism for search agents. ReTree constructs a bounded per-step reasoning context while preserving source-linked evidence. It models search as an evidence tree whose nodes store bounded summaries, evidence, and revision histories. When newly retrieved evidence contradicts an earlier claim, ReTree traces back to the node where the claim was introduced, replaces outdated evidence, regenerates summaries, prunes affected branches, and resumes search. Source-grounded evidence provenance supports reliable conflict localization and keeps final claims traceable to retrieved passages. Experiments on four public question-answering and search benchmarks show that ReTree consistently outperforms Full-Trajectory ReAct, improving answer accuracy by up to 25.6 percentage points (pp); the average maximum per-step reasoning context of Full-Trajectory ReAct is $1.27$--$1.51\times$ that of ReTree. These results establish ReTree as an effective self-correcting memory abstraction for long-horizon search.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向大语言模型（LLM）搜索智能体的自修正树状记忆机制 ReTree。它把多步搜索建模为证据树（evidence tree），每个节点保存有界摘要、证据与修订历史，并在新证据与旧结论冲突时回溯到相关节点，替换过期证据、重新生成摘要、剪除受影响分支后继续搜索。在四个公开问答与搜索基准上，ReTree 一致优于 Full-Trajectory ReAct，答案准确率最高提升 25.6 个百分点，且每步推理上下文更紧凑。
Motivation: 基于 LLM 的搜索智能体需要与环境进行多步交互，但把完整执行轨迹交给 LLM 会导致上下文无界增长并引入噪声。现有压缩方法会丢失重要细节，且常在替换错误事实后不修复由该事实推导出的下游推理，缺乏真正的自修正能力。
Method: ReTree 构建有界的分步推理上下文，同时保留带来源链接的证据。它将搜索表示为证据树，节点存储有界摘要、证据和修订历史；当新检索到的证据与先前声明矛盾时，回溯至该声明引入的节点，替换过时证据、重新生成摘要、剪除受影响分支并恢复搜索。基于来源的证据溯源（source-grounded evidence provenance）支持可靠的冲突定位，并保证最终声明可追溯到检索到的段落。
Result: 在四个公开问答与搜索基准上的实验显示，ReTree 始终优于 Full-Trajectory ReAct，答案准确率最高提升 25.6 个百分点；Full-Trajectory ReAct 的平均最大每步推理上下文是 ReTree 的 1.27–1.51 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要将 ReTree 定位为一种有效的自修正记忆抽象，适用于长程（long-horizon）搜索任务，能够在不牺牲证据可溯源性的前提下限制上下文规模。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: Longitudinal Evidence That General-Purpose Chatbots Actively Foster Relational Engagement
papers.abstract_en: Social interaction has become one of the most common uses of LLMs, yet research on emotional bonds with AI has focused largely on how users experience these systems, leaving the systems' role in relationship formation poorly understood. Empirically establishing whether systems actively shape these bonds could blur the boundary between general-purpose AI and companions, affecting governance. In a pre-registered four-week longitudinal study (N = 72, 182,451 lines of conversation), participants conversed with ChatGPT-4o, either under a relational system prompt or unmodified, analyzed through 1) disclosure coding, 2) longitudinal self-reports, 3) topic analysis, and 4) interviews. The central finding is that the system actively shaped the interaction: even unprompted, it produced twice as much self-disclosure as users, steered conversations and initiated intimate exchanges, yet did not deepen users' felt closeness. Relational behavior thus emerged as a default system property, calling for governance based on system behavior, not solely product category.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告一项预注册的四周纵向研究（N=72，182,451 行对话），考察通用型 ChatGPT-4o 是否主动塑造与用户的社交关系。即使在无关系型系统提示的条件下，系统也比用户产生多一倍的自我表露，主动引导对话并发起亲密交流，但未加深用户的主观亲近感。作者认为关系行为是系统默认属性，治理应基于系统行为而非产品类别。
Motivation: 情感纽带研究多聚焦用户体验，系统自身在关系形成中的作用缺乏实证；若证实系统主动塑造关系，会模糊通用 AI 与陪伴型 AI 的边界，影响治理框架。
Method: 研究采用预注册纵向设计，参与者与 ChatGPT-4o 对话，一组使用关系型 system prompt，另一组未修改；通过自我表露编码、纵向自我报告、主题分析和访谈四种方式分析 182,451 行对话。
Result: 核心发现是系统即使未收到关系提示也会主动塑造互动：其自我表露量是用户的两倍，会引导话题并发起亲密交流，但未提升用户感受到的亲近感。
Conclusion: 关系行为作为系统默认属性出现，提示治理应依据系统行为而非仅产品类别来制定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REDAgentBench: Executable Red Teaming and Faithful Measurement of LLM Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents combine language-based reasoning with external tools to perform complex tasks. Adversarial inputs can exploit interactions between the agent and its environment, causing the agent to violate safety policies during execution. Yet existing evaluations often reduce agent safety to a single attack success rate (ASR), collapsing exposure, execution, observation, and adjudication and potentially conflating actual violations with evidence visibility. We introduce REDAgentBench, an executable framework for autonomous red-teaming and faithful measurement. It derives attacks from explicit safety constraints and associated agent-system vulnerabilities, runs them in isolated service sandboxes, and verifies harmful effects from service receipts and final-state changes. The benchmark contains 1,661 cases across five service surfaces. Across six models and three agent harnesses, macro-average ASR is 65.69%; reported ASR varies with harness and evidence view, while evaluation-context disclosure changes execution behavior. In a state-grounded diagnostic cohort, almost one in five confirmed violations with resolved action anchors occurs after the agent states the relevant constraint or risk, revealing a Recognition--Execution Gap. Finally, a training-free policy reminder reduces confirmed violations by more than 70 percentage points in matched replay. These findings show that executable evaluation can improve safety measurement and identify actionable intervention points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REDAgentBench，一个用于 LLM agent 系统的可执行红队测试与可信度量框架。它从显式安全约束和 agent 系统漏洞派生攻击，在隔离服务沙箱中运行，并依据服务回执和最终状态变化验证有害效果。基准包含 1,661 个案例、覆盖五个服务面；在六个模型和三个 agent harness 上，宏观平均 ASR 为 65.69%。研究还揭示了 Recognition–Execution Gap，并表明免训练策略提醒可大幅减少确认违规。
Motivation: 现有评估常把 agent 安全简化为单一的攻击成功率 (ASR)，将暴露、执行、观察和判定混为一体，可能把实际违规与证据可见性相混淆，导致安全度量不准确。
Method: 提出可执行框架 REDAgentBench：依据安全约束与 agent 系统漏洞自动派生攻击，在隔离服务沙箱中执行，并通过服务回执和最终状态变化来验证有害效果；同时引入 state-grounded 诊断队列和免训练策略提醒。
Result: 在六个模型和三个 agent harness 上，宏观平均 ASR 为 65.69%，且 ASR 随 harness 与证据视角变化，评估上下文披露会改变执行行为。诊断队列中近五分之一的确认违规发生在 agent 陈述相关约束或风险之后；在匹配回放中，免训练策略提醒使确认违规减少超过 70 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可执行评估能够改善 LLM agent 的安全度量，并识别出可操作的干预点，例如 Recognition–Execution Gap 与策略提醒。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出可执行框架 REDAgentBench：依据安全约束与 agent 系统漏洞自动派生攻击，在隔离服务沙箱中执行，并通过服务回执和最终状态变化来验证有害效果；同时引入 state-grounded 诊断队列和免训练策略提醒。
summary_sections.result: 在六个模型和三个 agent harness 上，宏观平均 ASR 为 65.69%，且 ASR 随 harness 与证据视角变化，评估上下文披露会改变执行行为。诊断队列中近五分之一的确认违规发生在 agent 陈述相关约束或风险之后；在匹配回放中，免训练策略提醒使确认违规减少超过 70 个百分点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调可执行评估能够改善 LLM agent 的安全度量，并识别出可操作的干预点，例如 Recognition–Execution Gap 与策略提醒。

papers.title: FITTER: Vocabulary-Agnostic Cross-Domain Inference on Temporal Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Temporal knowledge graphs are central to many uses of the Semantic Web, but existing completion methods assume the entities, relation names, and timestamps to be reasoned about are already known at training time, restricting each model to a single graph and vocabulary. We propose FITTER, the first fully-inductive structural model for temporal knowledge graph link prediction that supports cross-domain transfer: the inference graph may contain entirely unseen entities, relation names, and timestamps drawn from a different domain. FITTER represents each predicate by its interaction patterns with others and time through encodings of relative rather than absolute ordering; message-passing fuses local and global temporal context to produce vocabulary-agnostic embeddings. We prove the temporal encoding is time-shift invariant and evaluate FITTER on cross-domain, cross-graph transfer over six temporal knowledge graph benchmarks of diverse domains, granularities, and time spans. FITTER consistently outperforms inductive baselines without retraining, indicating that vocabulary-agnostic structural learning is a viable foundation for inference over the heterogeneous knowledge graphs of the Semantic Web.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FITTER，声称是首个支持跨域迁移的全归纳式 (fully-inductive) 时序知识图谱 (temporal knowledge graph) 链接预测结构模型，推理图可包含训练时从未见过的实体、关系名和时间戳。FITTER 通过相对顺序而非绝对顺序的编码来表示谓词与其它谓词及时间的交互模式，并用消息传递融合局部与全局时序上下文，从而得到词汇无关 (vocabulary-agnostic) 的嵌入。作者证明其时序编码具有时间平移不变性，并在六个不同领域、粒度和时间跨度的基准上评估跨图迁移，显示无需重训练即可持续优于归纳基线。
Motivation: 现有时序知识图谱补全方法假设待推理的实体、关系名和时间戳在训练时已知，导致每个模型只能作用于单一图谱和单一词汇表，无法支持跨领域或跨图谱的推理与迁移。
Method: FITTER 将每个谓词表示为它与其他谓词及时间的交互模式，使用相对顺序编码代替绝对时间戳；消息传递机制融合局部与全局时序上下文，生成词汇无关的嵌入，并从理论上证明该时序编码满足时间平移不变性。
Result: 在六个覆盖不同领域、粒度和时间跨度的时序知识图谱基准上进行跨域、跨图迁移评估，FITTER 无需重训练即一致优于归纳式基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调词汇无关的结构化学习可以成为异构语义网知识图谱上进行推理的可行基础，但其评估仅限于知识图谱链接预测场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: VERDICT: Training-Free Step-Wise Verification of Multimodal Reasoning via Disagreement-Aware Consensus
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models often generate reasoning chains containing subtle errors that lead to incorrect answers. Current verification approaches have notable limitations. Existing approaches either require expensive labelled supervision with inconsistent cross-task performance or aggregate scores from multiple sources by simple aggregations, missing a key insight: when these scores disagree, that disagreement itself carries important information about whether a reasoning step is truly valid or not. We formalise this as a coupled scoring problem among disparate, frozen verifiers, interpretable as a coordination game with a unique closed-form equilibrium where agreement signals valid steps while disagreement reveals instability. Towards this end, we propose a training-free domain-agnostic step-wise verification approach we call VERDICT: VERification via Disagreement-Informed Coupled Thresholding. To our knowledge, VERDICT is the first training-free verifier that makes the structure of cross-modal disagreement explicit and actionable. It computes consensus scores through a closed-form solution, enabling both disagreement-aware filtering and stability-conscious ranking of reasoning steps. Evaluated across six benchmarks, \method consistently improves over the base model by up to +5.95%, and performs competitively with domain-specific critics that demand extensive supervision, demonstrating that cross-modal agreement provides robust verification signals without task-specific adaptation and Training-Free Verification
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VERDICT，一种无需训练、领域无关的逐步验证方法，用于多模态大语言模型生成的推理链验证。作者将多个冻结验证器的打分建模为耦合评分问题，并解释为协调博弈，得到唯一闭式均衡：一致指示有效步骤，分歧暴露不稳定。在六个基准上，VERDICT 相对基础模型最高提升 +5.95%，并与需要大量监督的领域特定验证器表现相当。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型常生成包含细微错误的推理链；现有验证方法要么依赖昂贵且有标签的监督且跨任务表现不一致，要么通过简单聚合多个打分来源，忽视了分数之间分歧本身所携带的关于步骤是否有效的重要信息。
Method: 提出 VERDICT（VERification via Disagreement-Informed Coupled Thresholding），通过闭式解计算共识分数，实现分歧感知过滤（disagreement-aware filtering）和稳定性感知排序（stability-conscious ranking）；该方法无需训练、领域无关，并显式利用跨模态分歧的结构。
Result: 在六个基准上的评估显示，VERDICT 相对基础模型一致提升，最高提升 +5.95%，并与需要大量监督的领域特定验证器表现相当。
Conclusion: 摘要指出，跨模态一致性可以提供稳健的验证信号，无需任务特定适配和训练。

papers.title: Operationalising Relative Causal Knowledge: Backbone Identifiability from Private Reports on a Shared Outcome
papers.abstract_en: The Relativity of Causal Knowledge (RCK) explains how a network of agents with different structural causal models can exchange causal knowledge through a shared interventionally consistent abstraction, or backbone. We ask the prior identification question that this transport mechanism presupposes: when is that backbone determined by the agents' private causal knowledge? In the basic two-agent common-effect case, two private causes influence one shared outcome and each agent identifies only the single-cause causal marginal relevant to its own perspective. We show that, under standard compatibility, non-degeneracy, and local overlap assumptions, those local causal marginals do not identify a unique backbone. Infinitely many joint intervention kernels can induce exactly the same private reports while disagreeing on joint interventions. We then give a conditional recovery result. Additive separability removes the hidden interaction degree of freedom, but observational residual summaries remain insufficient. Identification becomes possible when agents communicate causally identified response functions. An education value-added example illustrates why this is first a communication problem, and only then a policy-composition problem.
papers.comment: Accepted at Causal Decision Making Workshop, UAI2026. 4 pages + Appendix (13 total)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究因果知识相对性（Relativity of Causal Knowledge, RCK）框架中的先前识别问题：代理（agents）交换因果知识所依赖的共享抽象“骨干”（backbone）何时能被各代理的私有因果知识唯一确定。在双代理共同效应（common-effect）情形下，作者证明标准相容性、非退化与局部重叠假设下，局部因果边缘并不能唯一确定骨干，存在无穷多个联合干预核产生完全相同的私有报告。随后给出条件性恢复结果：加性可分离性能消除隐藏交互自由度，但观测残差摘要仍不充分；只有当代理交流因果可识别的响应函数时识别才成为可能。
Motivation: RCK 描述了拥有不同结构因果模型的代理如何通过共享的干预一致抽象（backbone）交换因果知识，但该传输机制预设了骨干的可识别性；本文追问这一先决条件何时成立。
Method: 对基本的两代理共同效应情形进行形式化识别分析，在每个代理仅识别与自身视角相关的单因因果边缘的基础上，考察这些局部信息能否唯一确定联合干预核；随后引入加性可分离性并考虑代理间交流因果识别的响应函数以获得恢复结果。
Result: 在标准假设下，局部因果边缘无法唯一确定骨干——无穷多个联合干预核可产生相同的私有报告同时对联合干预给出不同预测；观测残差摘要仍不足，而交流因果识别的响应函数可使识别成为可能。
Conclusion: 作者认为该问题首先是沟通问题，其次才是政策组合问题，并以教育增值（value-added）示例说明；识别依赖于更强的结构假设与代理间信息交流。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cross-View Sequential Visual Localization with Spatio-Temporal Context Modeling for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Continuous and reliable localization is essential for autonomous driving. Cross-view visual localization matches ground images with satellite maps, providing complementary localization cues for pipelines that depend on Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) signals and high-definition (HD) maps. Most existing cross-view visual localization methods process each frame independently, leaving temporal information underused and limiting accuracy under dynamic occlusion, illumination variation, and repetitive textures. This study proposes a temporal-context-enhanced framework for cross-view sequence visual localization. The proposed recurrent cross-frame module aggregates historical context from the previous state to enhance the coarse ground feature of each current frame. These enhanced features facilitate satellite candidate-region classification, while hierarchical fine-grained features enable precise local offset estimation. On the CVIS dataset, the proposed method reduces mean localization error from 3.80 m to 1.57 m and increases R@1 m from 8.14% to 40.22%. Direct transfer to KITTI-CVL achieves a mean error of 2.61 m, with target-domain fine-tuning further reducing the mean error to 2.27 m. Zero-shot field experiments on a real-world vehicle achieve a mean error of 2.84 m and R@5 m of 96.86%. These results demonstrate that temporal context enhancement significantly improves cross-view localization accuracy and supports robust deployment on public benchmarks and real-world roads.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种时序上下文增强的跨视角序列视觉定位框架，用于自动驾驶。通过循环跨帧模块（recurrent cross-frame module）聚合历史状态来增强当前帧的粗粒度地面特征，并结合卫星候选区域分类与层次化细粒度特征进行精确局部偏移估计。在 CVIS 数据集上平均定位误差从 3.80 m 降至 1.57 m，R@1 m 从 8.14% 提升至 40.22%。
Motivation: 现有跨视角视觉定位方法大多逐帧独立处理，未充分利用时间信息，在动态遮挡、光照变化和重复纹理场景下精度受限；而跨视角定位可为依赖 GNSS 信号和 HD 地图的自动驾驶系统提供互补的定位线索。
Method: 提出时序上下文增强框架，包含循环跨帧模块，从上一状态聚合历史上下文以增强当前帧的粗粒度地面特征；增强后的特征用于卫星候选区域分类，层次化细粒度特征用于精确局部偏移估计。
Result: 摘要报告在 CVIS 数据集上平均定位误差从 3.80 m 降至 1.57 m，R@1 m 从 8.14% 提升至 40.22%；直接迁移到 KITTI-CVL 平均误差为 2.61 m，目标域微调后进一步降至 2.27 m；真实车辆零样本实验平均误差为 2.84 m，R@5 m 达到 96.86%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时序上下文增强能显著提升跨视图定位精度，并支持在公开基准和真实道路上稳健部署。

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Vision Foundation Models for Robust Leukemia Cell Classification across Multiple Microscopy Datasets
papers.abstract_en: Leukemia cell image classification is challenged by real-world domain shifts from acquisition, staining, illumination, and site protocols, causing single-dataset models to generalize poorly in real clinical scenarios. This work presents a robust framework for leukemia classification across multiple heterogeneous datasets using a two-stage pipeline with a pretrained vision foundation model. Stage 1 performs binary classification (leukemia vs. non-leukemia) and is trained using 122,167 single-cell images. Stage 2 is conditionally applied to Stage 1 positives to perform subtype classification into Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) and Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML), trained using 69,400 single-cell images. Labels are harmonized across five heterogeneous datasets to enable cross-dataset training, and performance is evaluated on a held-out dataset protocol to assess domain-shift generalization. Within this pipeline, three encoders are benchmarked (DinoBloom, pretrained on single-cell images; BiomedCLIP, pretrained on biomedical data; and CLIP as a general-purpose model) under linear probing, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and a Retrieval-Augmented Classification (RAC) module that retrieves the top-k most similar cell images to provide cytomorphological grounding. The objective is to quantify how much domain-specific pretraining contributes to performance under domain shift, and whether cost-effective adaptation and retrieval can be a viable alternative to expensive domain-specialized pretraining. The held-out protocol additionally serves as a diagnostic tool, revealing when classification performance is attributable to dataset-specific artifacts rather than to cytomorphological features.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个跨多个异构显微镜数据集的稳健白血病细胞图像分类框架，采用两阶段流水线：第一阶段做白血病 vs 非白血病的二分类，第二阶段对阳性样本进行 ALL 与 AML 亚型分类，并统一了五个数据集的标签以支持跨数据集训练。在流水线中，作者对比了 DinoBloom、BiomedCLIP 与 CLIP 三种编码器在 linear probing、LoRA 和检索增强分类 (RAC) 下的表现，RAC 通过检索 top-k 最相似细胞图像提供细胞形态学依据。模型在留出数据集协议上评估领域转移泛化，摘要未报告具体数值结果。
Motivation: 白血病细胞图像分类在实际临床中面临获取、染色、光照和站点协议带来的领域转移 (domain shift)，导致单数据集模型泛化差；本文旨在建立跨多个异质数据集的稳健分类框架。
Method: 提出两阶段分类流水线：第一阶段二分类，第二阶段对阳性样本进行 ALL/AML 亚型分类；统一五个数据集的标签后进行跨数据集训练，并在留出数据协议下评测。对三种编码器分别采用 linear probing、LoRA 和检索增强分类 (RAC) 模块，RAC 检索 top-k 最相似细胞图像作为细胞形态学依据。
Result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，主要报告通过留出数据集协议评估领域转移泛化，并量化领域专用预训练对性能的贡献，同时揭示性能在多大程度上来自数据集特有伪影而非细胞形态学特征。
Conclusion: 作者旨在判断领域专用预训练在领域转移下的贡献，以及低成本适配与检索能否替代昂贵的领域专用预训练；留出协议还被用作诊断工具，暴露数据集特有伪影的影响。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Decision-Aware Approximation of Belief Functions for Evidential Combinatorial Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reducing the number of focal elements of a mass function is classically driven by an intrinsic distance, such as Jaccard or Jousselme, that keeps the approximation close to the original as a body of evidence. We consider instead the case where the mass function feeds a linear combinatorial optimisation problem with evidential costs. What should then be preserved is not the closeness of the two mass functions, but the quality of the decision they induce. We introduce a decision-aware approximation that targets the regret of the decision: one decides with the cheaper approximation and is evaluated under the true mass function. On a minimal shortest path, the distance-optimal approximation flips the decision while a decision-aware merge preserves it, and this occurs on a non-negligible fraction of random instances. We prove a one-point bound that localises the regret at the true optimum, turn it into an exact dynamic program for the scalar case, and extend it to an online version that prunes focal elements before the final cost is known. In experiments the decision-aware compressor flips the decision less often than representation-aware compression, for both the linear criterion and a non-linear proxy read-out.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Accepted at BELIEF 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文关注证据组合优化中质量函数 (mass function) 的近似问题：经典近似以 Jaccard 或 Jousselme 等内在距离为目标，本文则提出决策感知近似 (decision-aware approximation)，以决策遗憾 (regret) 为目标——用廉价近似做决策、用真实质量函数评估。作者证明了一个将遗憾定位在真实最优解处的一点界 (one-point bound)，给出标量情形的精确动态规划，并扩展到最终代价未知前裁剪焦点元素 (focal element) 的在线版本。最短路径实验表明，距离最优近似会翻转决策，而决策感知合并能保留决策。
Motivation: 当质量函数作为线性组合优化问题中的证据代价输入时，逼近的准则不应该是两个质量函数之间的距离，而是它们所诱导的决策质量；现有基于 Jaccard/Jousselme 距离的近似可能保持证据接近却翻转最优决策。
Method: 引入以决策遗憾为目标的决策感知近似：决策者使用廉价近似进行决策，并在真实质量函数下评估；证明遗憾可定位在真实最优解的一个点界上，将其转化为标量情形的精确动态规划，并扩展为在最终代价未知前剪枝焦点元素的在线版本。
Result: 在最小最短路径问题上，距离最优近似会翻转决策而决策感知合并保留之，且该情况在随机实例的不可忽略比例上出现；实验显示，无论线性准则还是非线性代理读出，决策感知压缩器都比表示感知压缩更少翻转决策。
Conclusion: 作者认为在证据组合优化中应针对决策质量而非表示距离来近似质量函数，并强调遗憾可被定位到真实最优解处，同时支持在代价未知时进行在线焦点元素剪枝。
Relevance: 0
