papers.title: PolypVision: A Three-Stage Hierarchical Deep Learning Framework for Classification and Segmentation of Colorectal Polyps
papers.abstract_en: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related mortality worldwide, predominantly arising from precancerous polyps. Accurate detection, segmentation, and endoscopic and histological classification of colorectal polyps are crucial for timely clinical intervention. In this study, we present PolypVision, a three-stage hierarchical deep learning framework that sequentially performs: (Stage 1) binary classification of polyps as adenomatous or hyperplastic, with simultaneous Paris and JNet classification, using EfficientNetV2-M with Focal Loss; (Stage 2) polyp segmentation with recommended resection method using a UNet++ decoder with the Stage 1 backbone as encoder, optimized with Dice and BCE losses; and (Stage 3) adenoma subtype classification (tubular, tubulovillous, villous) using EfficientNetV2-M with transfer learning from Stage 2. Evaluated on three public datasets -- PolypGen, Kvasir-SEG, and CVC-ClinicDB -- PolypVision achieves an AUC of approximately 0.99 for frame classification and a detection mAP@50 of 94.4% on Kvasir-SEG, outperforming or matching state-of-the-art methods. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Maps (Grad-CAM) confirm that the model attends to clinically relevant lesion features. The framework is device-independent, operating across diverse endoscopic imaging systems without hardware-specific adaptation. These results demonstrate that a hierarchical, transfer-learning-driven pipeline with task-specific loss functions offers a robust, device-independent, and clinically meaningful approach to automated colorectal polyp analysis. PolypVision is freely available as a web application at https://polypvision.com, a DataBioX initiative, with a free usage tier open to all users.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolypVision，一个用于结直肠息肉分析的三阶段层级深度学习框架，依次完成息肉良恶性二分类与巴黎/JNet 分类、息肉分割及切除方法推荐、腺瘤亚型分类。系统在 PolypGen、Kvasir-SEG 和 CVC-ClinicDB 三个公开数据集上评估，帧分类 AUC 约 0.99，Kvasir-SEG 上检测 mAP@50 达 94.4%，并声称跨内镜设备无需硬件适配。
Motivation: 结直肠癌是全球主要癌症死因之一，多由癌前息肉发展而来；对息肉的准确检测、分割以及内镜和组织学分类对及时临床干预至关重要，而现有方法在统一流程和设备无关性上存在不足。
Method: 框架分三阶段：阶段一用 EfficientNetV2-M 加 Focal Loss 做息肉腺瘤性/增生性二分类并同时输出巴黎和 JNet 分类；阶段二用阶段一主干作为编码器、UNet++ 作为解码器，以 Dice 和 BCE 损失优化息肉分割与推荐切除方式；阶段三利用阶段二迁移学习，用 EfficientNetV2-M 做腺瘤亚型（管状、绒毛管状、绒毛状）分类。
Result: 在三个公开数据集上，帧分类 AUC 约为 0.99，Kvasir-SEG 上检测 mAP@50 为 94.4%，优于或持平现有最先进方法；Grad-CAM 显示模型关注临床相关病灶特征，且框架具有设备无关性。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种带任务特定损失函数的层级式、迁移学习驱动流水线为自动化结直肠息肉分析提供了稳健、设备无关且具临床意义的方法，并已以免费网页应用形式开放使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Precise Top-Layer Fabric Segmentation for Fabric Destacking with Edge- and Shape-Aware Deep Networks
papers.abstract_en: Fabric destacking requires precise segmentation of the topmost fabric layer, a task complicated by subtle fabric boundaries and high visual similarity between fabric layers. Existing semantic and edge-based segmentation approaches often struggle with these complexities, limiting the performance of robotic manipulation for different tasks. In this work, a novel segmentation training architecture tailored for top-layer fabric segmentation in stacked fabrics is proposed. The method extends the classical encoder-decoder framework by introducing two specialized branches - an edge-aware branch and a shape-aware branch - that are used to supervise the backbone network for better tuning. The edge-aware branch enhances boundary delineation, while the shape-aware branch guides the network to capture and align the overall fabric shape with reference masks derived from Computer Aided Design (CAD) models. Experiments on a real-world fabric dataset demonstrate that the training approach outperforms established baselines, verifying the effectiveness of the multi-branch design through both quantitative results and ablation studies.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures. Published in IEEE ICMA 2025. Author's accepted manuscript. Code: https://github.com/bhattner143/top-layer-fab-seg
papers.journal_ref: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA), Beijing, China, Aug. 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对织物拆垛（fabric destacking）中顶层织物分割困难的问题，提出一种面向顶层织物分割的新型训练架构。该方法在经典编码器-解码器框架上引入边缘感知分支（edge-aware branch）和形状感知分支（shape-aware branch），分别用于强化边界刻画和利用CAD模型参考掩码对齐整体形状。在真实织物数据集上的实验表明该方法优于已有基线，并通过定量结果和消融研究验证了多分支设计的有效性。
Motivation: 织物拆垛需要精确分割最上层织物，但织物边界细微、层间视觉相似度高，现有语义分割和边缘分割方法难以处理这些复杂性，限制了机器人操作性能。
Method: 提出一种分割训练架构，扩展经典编码器-解码器框架，加入两个专用分支：边缘感知分支用于增强边界描绘，形状感知分支引导网络捕捉并对齐整体织物形状，后者使用来自计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型的参考掩码进行监督。
Result: 在真实织物数据集上的实验表明，该训练方法优于已有基线，消融研究验证了多分支设计的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的多分支训练架构能有效提升顶层织物分割精度，并已通过定量结果和消融研究证实其作用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Curate Before You Connect: Identity and Ontology Tagging in a Production Knowledge Graph
papers.abstract_en: Extraction produces candidate entities and relationships; writing them into a graph is where identity is decided, and identity decisions are destructive in a way extraction errors are not. A wrong type can be corrected later, but two records merged under one identity cannot be separated once their properties have been combined, and the merge leaves no error behind. This paper describes the ingestion and ontology-tagging layer that turns a validated extraction stream into a knowledge graph of 537,157 entities and 2,198,567 relationships drawn from 98,795 government documents. We describe a record-identity ladder that decides sameness from identifier columns, name columns, display names and type-scoped position rather than from name similarity. The ladder governs de-duplication within parsed tables, while the graph write applies a coarser canonical-name key, so records sharing a canonical name merge automatically on exact equality. We argue rather than demonstrate that this is where the automation line belongs: no identity benchmark is reported, and the over-merges the key permits are undetectable by construction. That policy, under which entity resolution only ever flags candidates, followed an incident in which two surface forms of one name were merged, corrupting a correct record and deleting eight entities from an unrelated document. We then describe multi-class ontology tagging and an evidence asymmetry we did not anticipate: an entity name is an instance label rather than a type assertion, so matching name fragments against a class index invents classifications. Requiring anchored evidence cut role assignments on an enriched sample from 36 to 4, all confirmed correct. We quantify the graph's conformance debt, show secondary classifications compensating for a mis-parented primary class, and describe a curation queue grown to 48,403 pending proposals against 775 human decisions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述一个生产环境知识图谱的摄取与本体标注层：将经过验证的抽取流转换为包含537,157个实体和2,198,567条关系、来自98,795份政府文档的知识图谱。作者提出一个记录身份阶梯 (record-identity ladder)，依据标识列、名称列、显示名和类型限定位置决定同一性，而非名称相似度。论文明确表示不报告身份基准，并论证自动化线应停留在仅标记候选实体这一层。
Motivation: 身份决策具有破坏性：两个记录被合并到同一身份后无法分离，且合并不会留下错误痕迹，这比抽取错误更严重。作者想要说明在何处划定自动化边界，避免不可逆的过度合并。
Method: 使用记录身份阶梯在解析表内进行去重，图写入时采用更粗粒度的规范名键 (canonical-name key)，精确相等即自动合并。本体标注采用多类标注，并要求锚定证据 (anchored evidence) 来避免仅凭名称片段匹配造成错误分类。
Result: 图谱包含537,157个实体和2,198,567条关系；在富化样本上要求锚定证据后，角色分配从36个降至4个且全部确认正确。还量化了图的顺延债务 (conformance debt) 并描述了一个增长到48,403条待处理提议、对应775条人工决策的策展队列。

papers.title: DistilVDR: A Compact End-to-End Visual Document Retriever via Dual-Student Distillation
papers.abstract_en: Visual document retrieval (VDR) is dominated by multi-billion-parameter models that are slow to index at full corpus scale and expensive to serve. Prior compression routes either train a smaller multi-vector encoder from scratch or distil only the query side; neither yields a compact single-vector retriever end-to-end. We present DistilVDR, a 524M end-to-end VDR system distilled bilaterally from a single 8B vision-language teacher under a pointwise cosine alignment loss. All supervision comes from the frozen teacher's embedding space, which was itself trained with relevance supervision, so the student objective needs no relevance labels, negative sampling, or contrastive term. We match VDR's text-query and image-document input asymmetry with an asymmetric encoder-only student that concentrates visual capacity on the document side and keeps the query side at 70M parameters. We release two variants that share the same encoders and training and differ only in the document encoder's visual-tile budget: DistilVDR-HiRes attains 61.74 average NDCG@5 on ViDoRe v1+v2+v3 (86.9% of the 8B teacher) and leads every reproduced sub-1B baseline on the high-resolution-sensitive v3 benchmark, while DistilVDR-Fast attains 59.98 at a 3 times smaller visual-token budget. Both variants store one million documents in a 15.6 times smaller index than the strongest sub-1B multi-vector baseline and index the corpus an order of magnitude faster. The code is available at https://github.com/Ryenhails/NanoVDR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DistilVDR 是一个 524M 参数的端到端视觉文档检索（VDR）系统，通过 pointwise cosine alignment loss 从单个 8B 视觉语言教师模型进行双向蒸馏得到。作者发布两个共享编码器与训练流程、仅文档编码器视觉 tile 预算不同的变体：DistilVDR-HiRes 在 ViDoRe v1+v2+v3 上达到 61.74 平均 NDCG@5（相当于 8B 教师的 86.9%），DistilVDR-Fast 以 3 倍更小的 visual-token 预算达到 59.98。两个变体在索引大小与速度上较现有 sub-1B 基线有明显优势。
Motivation: 现有 VDR 被数十亿参数模型主导，全语料库索引慢且部署成本高；先前的压缩路线要么从零训练较小的多向量编码器，要么只蒸馏查询侧，均无法得到端到端的紧凑单向量检索器。
Method: 该方法从单个 8B 视觉语言教师模型进行双边蒸馏，学生目标只用冻结教师 embedding 空间的 pointwise cosine alignment loss，因此无需相关性标签、负采样或对比项。学生采用非对称 encoder-only 结构，查询侧仅 70M 参数，视觉容量集中在文档侧，并用不同视觉 tile 预算区分 HiRes 与 Fast 两个变体。
Result: 摘要报告 DistilVDR-HiRes 在 ViDoRe v1+v2+v3 上平均 NDCG@5 为 61.74，达到 8B 教师的 86.9%，并在高分辨率敏感的 v3 基准上领先所有复现的 sub-1B 基线；DistilVDR-Fast 取得 59.98。两者存储一百万文档时索引比最强 sub-1B 多向量基线小 15.6 倍，语料索引速度快约一个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过双学生蒸馏可以在不使用相关性标注的情况下获得紧凑的单向量端到端 VDR，并以 HiRes/Fast 两个变体在精度与视觉 token 开销之间提供取舍。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: MedUP: Awakening Unified Understanding and Perception in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) excel at verbalizing visual content, yet precise visual perception, segmentation, and grounding remain challenging. Existing approaches either verbalize regions as coordinate strings or rely on external modules that decouple perception from understanding, creating representation gaps for region-language alignment. We present MedUP, a Med-VLM that natively unifies perception and understanding within a shared token space. At its core lies UniMedTok, a region tokenizer that encodes masks as discrete tokens in the LLM vocabulary, enabling the model to seamlessly interleave mask tokens with text. We curate UniMed-Train, a 1.84M-instance corpus spanning text-guided segmentation, region-grounded understanding, medical VQA and CoT-based segmentation, and introduce UniMed-Bench for unified evaluation. Extensive experiments show that MedUP outperforms native, agentic, and dual-decoder Med-VLMs across all tasks while remaining competitive with specialist segmentors, demonstrating the strong potential of unified understanding and perception modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedUP，一种将视觉感知与语言理解统一到共享 token 空间的医学视觉语言模型。核心组件 UniMedTok 将掩码编码为 LLM 词表中的离散 token，使模型能无缝混合掩码 token 与文本；作者还构建了包含 184 万实例的 UniMed-Train 语料和统一的 UniMed-Bench 评测基准。实验表明 MedUP 在文本引导分割、区域接地理解、医学 VQA 及 CoT 分割等任务上优于原生、agentic 和双解码器 Med-VLM，并与专用分割器保持竞争力。
Motivation: 现有 Med-VLM 擅长用语言描述视觉内容，但精确的视觉感知、分割和 grounding 仍是难点；既有方法要么把区域表示为坐标字符串，要么依赖外部模块将感知与理解解耦，造成区域-语言对齐的表示鸿沟。
Method: 提出 MedUP，在共享 token 空间内原生统一感知与理解；核心是 UniMedTok 区域分词器，将掩码编码为 LLM 词表中的离散 token，使得模型能够把掩码 token 与文本交错生成。同时构建 UniMed-Train（184 万实例，涵盖文本引导分割、区域接地理解、医学 VQA 和基于 CoT 的分割）以及统一评测基准 UniMed-Bench。
Result: 大量实验显示，MedUP 在全部任务上优于原生、agentic 和双解码器的 Med-VLM，并与专用分割器（specialist segmentors）表现相当。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一理解与感知建模具有很大潜力，能够避免感知与理解解耦带来的表示问题；摘要未提及明显的局限性。

papers.title: IADD-TR: Intervention-Aware Dynamics Decoupling with Targeted Regularization for Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL), which learns environment dynamics to generate synthetic experience, is a promising approach to sample-efficient decision making. Numerous methods have been developed to improve dynamics prediction and policy optimization for MBRL through uncertainty estimation, model regularization, and conservative value learning. However, these methods typically treat the transition model and critic as monolithic predictors, overlooking the policy-induced data bias. Consequently, action can become entangled with environmental evolution, while uneven action coverage may distort the counterfactual value estimates used for policy improvement. To address this, we propose IADD-TR, a unified framework combining Intervention-Aware Dynamics Decoupling (IADD) and Targeted Regularization (TR). IADD factorizes transitions into an action-intervention stage and an action-free natural evolution stage, using a zero-action anchor to resolve the non-uniqueness of this two-stage factorization for robust generalization. Its latent and state-aligned components are identifiable up to an invertible within-block transformation and pointwise, respectively. For policy learning, we derive TR from the efficient influence function of a replay-state policy-gradient functional. TR augments the critic with an action-density-scaled residual correction and optimizes a targeted loss, yielding doubly robust policy-gradient estimation when either the critic or the replay action density is consistently specified. Extensive experiments on five MuJoCo tasks show that IADD-TR achieves competitive returns with improved sample efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IADD-TR，一个面向基于模型的强化学习 (MBRL) 的统一框架，将转移 (transition) 分解为动作干预阶段和无关动作的自然演化阶段，并用零动作锚点 (zero-action anchor) 解决分解非唯一性问题。作者从 replay-state 策略梯度泛函的效率影响函数 (efficient influence function) 推导出 Targeted Regularization (TR)，得到在 critic 或 replay 动作密度之一一致指定时具有双重鲁棒性的策略梯度估计。在五个 MuJoCo 任务上的实验显示，IADD-TR 在样本效率上有所提升并取得有竞争力的回报。
Motivation: 现有 MBRL 方法通常把转移模型和 critic 当作整体预测器，忽略了策略导致的数据偏差，使得动作与环境演化相互纠缠，且不均匀的动作覆盖会扭曲用于策略改进的反事实价值估计。
Method: IADD 将转移分解为动作干预阶段与无动作自然演化阶段，利用零动作锚点消除两阶段分解的非唯一性，其潜在组件和状态对齐组件分别具有可辨识性 (identifiability) 保证。TR 从 replay-state 策略梯度泛函的效率影响函数导出，通过动作密度缩放的残差校正增强 critic，并优化一个针对性损失 (targeted loss)，使策略梯度估计在 critic 或 replay 动作密度一致指定时满足双重鲁棒性 (doubly robust)。
Result: 在五个 MuJoCo 任务上的大量实验显示，IADD-TR 在获得有竞争力回报的同时提高了样本效率。
Conclusion: 摘要主张通过将动力学解耦为干预与自然演化两个阶段并引入目标化正则化，可以缓解策略诱导的数据偏差，提升 MBRL 的样本效率。实验范围限于 MuJoCo 连续控制任务，可辨识性结论针对特定组件成立。

papers.title: InSight-doc: Agentic Visual Perception for Long-Document Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Long-document understanding often requires reasoning over many visually rich pages, making inference costly and prone to context rot. In this work, we propose InSight-doc, an agentic visual perception framework that treats visual resolution as an adaptive reasoning-time resource. InSight-doc starts from low resolution and selectively zooms into high-resolution regions for finer evidence, without relying on any external retriever. To train such an agent, we construct an active-perception corpus of 17.9K high-quality SFT examples with region-level zoom-in trajectories, accompanied by 19.2K hard RL examples. Through SFT+RL, InSight-doc-8B improves the baseline by 4.3--16.4 accuracy points over document VQA benchmarks. On long documents, it reduces hallucination by more than 40% and inference latency by 41%--68% while maintaining an accuracy lead. Our code, datasets, and model are released at https://github.com/m-Just/InSight-doc .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InSight-doc，一个面向长文档理解的智能体视觉感知框架（agentic visual perception framework），把视觉分辨率当作自适应的推理期资源。它从低分辨率开始，无需外部检索器即可选择性放大到高分辨率区域寻找证据，并通过 SFT+RL 训练。摘要报告 InSight-doc-8B 在文档 VQA 基准上相比基线提升 4.3–16.4 个准确率点，在长文档上将幻觉降低 40% 以上、推理延迟降低 41%–68%，同时保持准确率领先。
Motivation: 长文档理解常需要对大量视觉丰富的页面进行推理，导致推理成本高并易出现上下文腐烂（context rot）。论文针对这一问题，提出将视觉分辨率视为可动态分配的资源，避免固定高分辨率带来的开销。
Method: 提出 InSight-doc 框架：从低分辨率输入开始，由智能体选择性地放大到高分辨率区域以获取更细粒度的证据，全程不依赖外部检索器。为训练该智能体，构建了包含 17.9K 高质量 SFT 样本（带区域级放大轨迹）和 19.2K 困难 RL 样本的主动感知语料，并采用 SFT+RL 训练。
Result: 在文档 VQA 基准上，InSight-doc-8B 相对基线提升 4.3–16.4 个准确率点；在长文档任务中，幻觉减少超过 40%，推理延迟降低 41%–68%，同时保持准确率领先。
Conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明自适应分辨率策略可以高效处理长文档视觉理解。代码、数据集和模型已开源。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出 InSight-doc 框架：从低分辨率输入开始，由智能体选择性地放大到高分辨率区域以获取更细粒度的证据，全程不依赖外部检索器。为训练该智能体，构建了包含 17.9K 高质量 SFT 样本（带区域级放大轨迹）和 19.2K 困难 RL 样本的主动感知语料，并采用 SFT+RL 训练。
summary_sections.result: 在文档 VQA 基准上，InSight-doc-8B 相对基线提升 4.3–16.4 个准确率点；在长文档任务中，幻觉减少超过 40%，推理延迟降低 41%–68%，同时保持准确率领先。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为该结果表明自适应分辨率策略可以高效处理长文档视觉理解。代码、数据集和模型已开源。

papers.title: ProbGuard: Calibrated Safety Risk Estimation from LLM Output Distributions
papers.abstract_en: Recent research on Large Language Model (LLM) safety has widely adopted guardrails to identify unsafe LLM outputs. Existing guardrails typically formulate safety assessment as a deterministic classification task, mapping a discrete token sequence to a discrete safety label. However, this paradigm has two limitations: First, safety assessment is inherently an uncertain problem, particularly during the early generation state. Second, relying solely on discrete token sequences discards the rich probabilistic information embedded in the LLM output distribution. To address these limitations, we propose the first completely probabilistic architecture-agnostic guardrail \textsc{ProbGuard} to leverage the LLM early output distributional signals for estimating and calibrating the safety probability, thereby enabling early stopping of unsafe ongoing outputs. Specifically, given an LLM's generated prefix distribution, we formulate the safety risk as the unsafe probability of its continued generation dynamics and estimate this risk by Monte-Carlo sampling. Through post-training on the distributional signals and calibrated safety risk, \textsc{ProbGuard} achieves the best calibration performance across all nine model--dataset combination settings, reducing the average Brier score and ECE by 79.6\% and 71.9\%, respectively, over the best baseline. \textsc{ProbGuard} further limits the attack success rate to at most 1\% across six representative jailbreak attacks after observing the LLM early output distributions from only the first ten decoding steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProbGuard，一种完全概率化且架构无关的 LLM 安全护栏（guardrail），利用 LLM 早期输出分布的信号来估计并校准生成内容的安全概率，从而在早期阶段停止不安全的持续生成。该方法通过蒙特卡洛采样来估计继续生成动态的不安全概率，并在九个模型-数据集组合设置上取得最佳校准性能，将平均 Brier score 和 ECE 分别降低 79.6% 和 71.9%，且仅观察前十个解码步即可将六种代表性 jailbreak 攻击的成功率限制在 1% 以内。
Motivation: 现有 guardrail 通常把安全评估当作确定性分类任务，将离散 token 序列映射为离散安全标签，这有两个局限：安全评估本身具有不确定性，尤其在早期生成阶段；只依赖离散 token 序列会丢弃 LLM 输出分布中的丰富概率信息。
Method: 提出首个完全概率化且架构无关的 guardrail ProbGuard。给定 LLM 生成的前缀分布，将安全风险形式化为其继续生成动态的不安全概率，并通过蒙特卡洛采样估计该风险；随后在分布信号与校准后的安全风险上进行后训练（post-training），实现安全概率的估计与校准。
Result: 在所有九个模型-数据集组合设置中获得最佳校准性能，平均 Brier score 和 ECE 相对最优基线分别降低 79.6% 和 71.9%；在仅观察前十个解码步的早期输出分布后，可将六种代表性 jailbreak 攻击的攻击成功率限制在至多 1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调利用 LLM 输出分布中的概率信息可以显著改善安全风险评估的校准与早期检测能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pair-Centric Graph Rewiring for Over-Squashing via Optimal Transport-Guided Communication Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) often struggle when task-relevant information is distributed across distant regions of a graph, since local propagation must compress remote signals through limited structural interfaces. Graph rewiring provides a structural response to over-squashing. Most existing methods rely on edge-level bottleneck scores or graph-level connectivity surrogates. With a limited rewiring budget, the key question is which pairwise communications most need structural support. This paper proposes PairAlign, a pair-centric graph rewiring framework that makes this question explicit through demand-support shortage. Specifically, PairAlign combines original-graph structural demand with current-graph finite-hop propagation support; their ratio highlights interactions whose communication demand is poorly supported by topology, and our theory shows that this score provides a computable proxy for the corresponding Jacobian-based shortage with a pair-level interpretation of over-squashing. Our theory reveals a two-sided effect of edge insertion: a new edge can create useful walks and simultaneously dilute existing normalized transition mass. Guided by this observation, PairAlign optimizes shortage to favor edge additions that alleviate over-squashing. Beyond selecting useful additions, PairAlign further introduces an Optimal Transport-guided rewiring mechanism to coordinate the finite edge budget for pair-level structural compatibility and shortage-target coverage. It formulates communication alignment between the candidate edge budget and the shortage targets, and the theory shows that this allocation covers shortage targets more broadly and effectively than a greedy-local assignment. Experiments on standard graph benchmarks show PairAlign's improvement across message-passing backbones, validating pair-level repair as an effective route for alleviating over-squashing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对消息传递神经网络（MPNN）中远距离信息传播受限导致的过压缩（over-squashing）问题，提出PairAlign，一种以节点对为中心的图重连（graph rewiring）框架。该方法通过原始图结构需求与当前图有限跳传播支持的比值定义需求-支持短缺（demand-support shortage），并证明该分数可作为Jacobian短缺的可计算代理。PairAlign还引入基于最优传输（Optimal Transport）的重连机制来协调有限连边预算，实验显示其在标准图基准上对多种消息传递骨干网络均有提升。
Motivation: MPNN在任务相关信息分布于图远端区域时表现不佳，因为局部传播需要通过有限的结构接口压缩远程信号；现有图重连方法多依赖边级瓶颈分数或图级连通性替代指标，而在有限重连预算下，缺少对哪些成对通信最需要结构支持的明确判断。
Method: 提出PairAlign框架：结合原始图的结构需求与当前图的有限跳传播支持，以两者比值刻画通信需求未被拓扑充分支持的程度，并从理论上说明该指标是可计算的Jacobian短缺代理；理论同时揭示加边的双向效应（既产生有用游走又稀释归一化转移质量），据此优化短缺指标；最后用最优传输引导的重连机制在候选边预算与短缺目标之间做通信对齐，以协调有限边预算的分配。
Result: 在标准图基准上的实验表明，PairAlign在多种消息传递骨干网络上均带来性能改进，验证了成对级别修复（pair-level repair）是缓解过压缩的有效途径。
Conclusion: 作者强调从成对通信需求出发的重连能够更直接地缓解过压缩，且理论上最优传输引导的分配比贪心局部分配更广泛有效地覆盖短缺目标。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Compute-Optimal Is Not Cluster-Optimal: Systems-Aware Scaling for Sparse Mixture-of-Experts
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale pretraining, the algorithm, architecture, and systems decisions are conventionally made in disconnected stages. A scaling law stage selects an architecture and training recipe, optimizing loss under compute constraints, and a separate systems stage then optimizes the implementation for hardware efficiency. In this work, we develop MOSAIC, which formulates model architecture and systems co-design as an optimization problem. MOSAIC couples a predictive scaling law with a calibrated performance model that estimates Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU), communication cost, memory footprint, and the best parallel layout. We instantiate the framework for sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models, where expert count, routing sparsity, and other MoE layer dimensions affect both the loss and systems efficiency. We fit a scaling law on sparse MoE models trained on text data, whose scaling dimensions include the sparsity factor, which is the fraction of model parameters inactive per token in a forward pass. The scaling law sweeps in our work span active parameters from $104$ million to $2.7$ billion and total model sizes reaching $79$ billion parameters. We show that, within the calibrated sparsity range, an efficiency-agnostic model-FLOPs budget admits no interior optimal sparsity. The fitted loss decreases monotonically with sparser models and the compute optimum lies at the upper boundary of the data support. An optimal sparsity in MoE models instead emerges under the cluster's systems constraints, as captured by MOSAIC. Our results argue for a shift towards unified architecture and systems co-design for frontier language model training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MOSAIC，将大规模预训练中的模型架构与系统实现协同设计建模为优化问题，耦合预测性缩放定律 (scaling law) 与校准的性能模型，用于估计 Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU)、通信成本、内存占用和最优并行布局。作者在稀疏 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 语言模型上实例化该框架，指出在效率无关的模型 FLOPs 预算下不存在内点最优稀疏度，而最优点在集群系统约束下才会出现。
Motivation: 传统大规模预训练中，算法、架构与系统决策分阶段独立进行，先选架构与训练配方，再针对硬件优化实现，导致两者脱节。论文针对这一割裂，主张架构与系统联合设计。
Method: 以 MOSAIC 框架把架构与系统协同设计形式化为优化问题：用拟合的缩放定律建模稀疏 MoE 的损失，用标定的性能模型建模 MFU、通信成本、内存占用和最优并行布局。缩放定律在文本数据上拟合，维度包含稀疏度因子（每 token 前向中不活跃参数比例），覆盖活跃参数 1.04 亿至 27 亿、总模型规模最高 790 亿参数。
Result: 在标定的稀疏度范围内，忽略效率的模型 FLOPs 预算下不存在内部最优稀疏度：拟合损失随模型更稀疏而单调下降，计算最优位于数据支持的上边界；只有纳入集群系统约束后，MoE 模型才出现最优稀疏度。
Conclusion: 研究结果主张前沿语言模型训练应转向统一的架构与系统协同设计，而非分阶段独立优化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gaussian Sculpting: End-to-End Controllable Surface Reconstruction via Field Optimization
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has recently enabled real-time novel view synthesis with impressive quality. However, it struggles to recover accurate surfaces under limited viewpoints and due to the inherent irregularity of Gaussian primitives. The resulting geometric errors are notoriously difficult to correct manually. To address these issues, we propose Gaussian Sculpting, a fully differentiable end-to-end framework for high-quality surface reconstruction. Our key insight is to anchor Gaussians onto an evolving differentiable surface, allowing them to guide signed distance field (SDF) optimization instead of extracting the surface only during post-processing. To enable stable gradient isolation during joint optimization, we design a bi-level training strategy in which the outer loop optimizes the geometry represented by the SDF, while the inner loop updates the Gaussians with the geometry fixed. We further impose constraints on Gaussian parameters to ensure consistency with the underlying surface, thereby improving both geometric and appearance fidelity during optimization. In addition, we introduce a multi-resolution subdivision scheme based on octree-like partitioning to preserve fine details while reducing memory consumption. Experiments on object-level scenes demonstrate that our method effectively removes redundant surfaces, recovers missing structures caused by limited viewpoints, and achieves strong reconstruction quality even at relatively low resolutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Gaussian Sculpting，一个用于高质量表面重建的端到端可微框架，将 3DGS 的高斯原语锚定在演化中的可微表面上，使其引导符号距离场 (SDF) 优化，而非仅在后期处理中提取表面。作者设计了双层训练策略，外层优化 SDF 几何，内层在几何固定时更新高斯参数，并对高斯参数施加约束以保证与底层表面一致；同时引入基于八叉树式划分的多分辨率细分方案。实验表明该方法能去除冗余表面、恢复有限视角下缺失的结构，并在较低分辨率下仍保持较好的重建质量。
Motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 在实时新视角合成上表现出色，但在有限视角下难以恢复精确表面，且高斯原语固有的不规则性导致几何误差难以手动修正。
Method: 提出一种完全可微的端到端框架，将高斯原语锚定在演化中的可微表面上以引导 SDF 优化；采用双层 (bi-level) 训练策略，外层优化 SDF 几何、内层在几何固定时更新高斯参数；对高斯参数施加与底层表面一致的约束，并引入基于八叉树式划分的多分辨率细分方案以保留细节并降低内存开销。
Result: 在物体级场景上的实验表明，该方法能有效去除冗余表面、恢复由有限视角导致的缺失结构，并即使在相对较低分辨率下也能实现较强的重建质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将高斯原语与可微表面锚定并联合优化的方式可以稳定梯度隔离，从而在优化过程中同时提升几何与外观保真度。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在物体级场景上的实验表明，该方法能有效去除冗余表面、恢复由有限视角导致的缺失结构，并即使在相对较低分辨率下也能实现较强的重建质量。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调将高斯原语与可微表面锚定并联合优化的方式可以稳定梯度隔离，从而在优化过程中同时提升几何与外观保真度。

papers.title: Inferential Capability Does Not Determine Legal Scope
papers.abstract_en: Two instruments of EU digital law place inference at their centre and mean different things by it. Article 3(1) of the AI Act uses the capability to infer constitutively: it is the central feature separating the regulated category from conventional software. The GDPR never defines inference, yet governs it protectively: the consequences follow from the processing of personal data and from what the inference says about, or does to, a person, whether or not the technology that produced it qualifies as an AI system. The two perimeters are not concentric. Their non-coincidence remained invisible in single-shot systems; agentic architectures make it operationally acute. The thesis: inferential capability does not determine legal scope, and its absence does not create immunity. The framework is two-level. Inference performs two legal functions, constitutive and protective; the protective function operates through three pathways - identificatory, attributive and decisional. Composition is not a fourth pathway but a cross-cutting architectural dimension which, with reach, persistence and reviewability, is what agentic architectures modify. Three concepts support it: the inferential threshold, the inferential reach and the inferential chain, mapped onto the chain of imputation. Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 left the constitutive criterion untouched and inserted a provision contemplating outputs that influence the inputs of future operations, without supplying any rule of aggregation. The article proposes an interpretive rule, a compositional-effects test identifying the decision unit under Article 22 GDPR together with the allocation of the burden of establishing it, and documentation duties calibrated to inference chains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析欧盟两部数字法律——AI法案与GDPR——对“推理”(inference)的不同使用，指出推理能力并非法律适用范围的判定标准。作者提出一个两级框架：推理具有构成性(constitutive)与保护性(protective)两种法律功能，保护性功能经由识别性、归因性与决定性三条路径运作；代理型架构(agentic architectures)使两套法律范围的错位变得操作上尖锐。文章提出解释性规则与组合效应测试，以处理推理链上的责任分配。
Motivation: 欧盟AI法案第3(1)条将推理能力作为区分监管对象与常规软件的构成性特征，而GDPR虽未定义推理却以保护性方式对其加以规制；两套法律范围并不重合。在单次性系统中这种不一致不显眼，但代理型架构使其在操作层面变得尖锐，法律亟需澄清推理在法律上的作用边界。
Method: 提出两级框架：推理承担构成性与保护性两种法律功能，保护功能经由识别性(identificatory)、归因性(attributive)与决定性(decisional)三条路径运作；组合(composition)不是第四条路径，而是跨架构维度。引入推论阈值、推论范围与推论链三个概念，映射到归责链(chain of imputation)；并提出组合效应测试(compositional-effects test)以确定GDPR第22条下的决策单位，同时规定举证责任分配与按推理链调整的文档义务。
Result: 摘要为理论性分析，未提供实证数据。论文指出Regulation (EU) 2026/1744保留了构成性标准，仅新增关于输出影响未来操作输入的条款，但未给出聚合规则；作者以此为基础提出解释性规则与测试。
Conclusion: 核心论点是：推论能力不决定法律适用范围，其缺失也不构成豁免。法律需要针对代理型架构调整其概念工具，通过组合效应测试和文档义务来处理推理链上的责任归属。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: BooST: Bridging Semantics and Motions for Efficient Skill Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Skill abstraction---the process of learning reusable and temporally extended behaviors---has emerged as a key paradigm for improving sample efficiency and generalization in robot learning. For efficient skill transfer to real robots, learned skills must generalize across tasks and domains, remain robust to visual and dynamic perturbations, and be efficient enough for practical deployment. However, existing methods typically satisfy only a subset of these properties, as they capture either high-level semantic intent (what) or low-level motion dynamics (how). This incomplete skill transfer yields weak priors for policy learning, thereby demanding substantial in-domain data for downstream adaptation. To address these challenges, we introduce BooST, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges semantics and motions to satisfy all three desiderata. BooST first leverages a cross-modal VQ-VAE to capture both semantic intent and motion dynamics, yielding a unified skill representation. It then distills this representation into a lightweight policy for efficient downstream adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments across simulation and real-robot settings demonstrate that BooST achieves superior few-shot adaptation, cross-domain skill transfer, and robustness to dynamic visual distractors, while maintaining a lightweight yet expressive design suitable for real-world deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BooST，一种两阶段机器人技能转移框架，通过跨模态 VQ-VAE 将语义意图与运动动力学统一为单一技能表示，再蒸馏为轻量策略用于下游适应。仿真与真实机器人实验表明，该方法在少样本适应、跨域技能转移和对动态视觉干扰的鲁棒性上均优于现有方法，同时保持适合实际部署的轻量设计。
Motivation: 现有技能抽象方法通常只捕获高层语义意图（what）或低层运动动力学（how）中的一种，无法同时满足跨任务泛化、对视觉与动态扰动的鲁棒性以及部署效率这三项要求，导致下游策略学习先验较弱，需要大量域内数据。
Method: BooST 采用两阶段框架：首先利用跨模态 VQ-VAE 同时建模语义意图和运动动力学，得到统一技能表示；随后将该表示蒸馏为轻量策略，以支持新任务的高效少样本适应。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在仿真和真实机器人上取得优越的少样本适应、跨域技能转移以及对动态视觉干扰物的鲁棒性，并保持轻量且具有表达力的设计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式桥接语义和运动可同时满足技能泛化、鲁棒性和部署效率三个期望属性，从而支持向真实机器人的高效技能转移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $β$-VAEs as Effective Theories: Tolerance-Dependent Dimension
papers.abstract_en: In a $β$-VAE, increasing the regularization strength acts as a spectral cutoff by collapsing low-utility latent coordinates. In the linear Gaussian VAE, the collapse order matches the ranking of reconstruction utilities exactly, because both are set by the PCA spectrum. We ask which parts of this picture survive in fully connected nonlinear VAEs trained on WorldClim. We find that nonlinear interactions shift and broaden collapse onsets, so thresholds no longer coincide exactly with utilities. However, the common ordering is preserved over the resolved ranks, so the spectral cutoff still acts as a utility cutoff and the effective-description logic carries through. The resulting effective-dimension curves reveal a head--tail tradeoff: increasing depth concentrates utility into the first few coordinates but worsens tail fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 $\beta$-VAE 中正则化强度如何作为谱截断 (spectral cutoff) 起作用，使低效用潜变量坐标坍塌。作者在线性高斯 VAE 中证明坍塌顺序与 PCA 重建效用排序完全一致，并在 WorldClim 数据上训练的全连接非线性 VAE 中检验该图景。结果发现非线性相互作用会使坍塌起始点偏移并展宽，但解决后的秩 (resolved ranks) 上共同排序仍被保持，从而有效描述逻辑依然成立；有效维度曲线还揭示头部-尾部权衡。
Motivation: 在线性高斯 VAE 中，增大 $\beta$ 会使潜变量按重建效用顺序坍塌，且该顺序由 PCA 谱精确决定；作者想探究这一结论在非线性 VAE 中是否仍然成立，因为非线性相互作用可能破坏效用与截断阈值的精确对应。
Method: 将 $\beta$-VAE 的正则化增强视为一种谱截断，比较线性高斯情形与在 WorldClim 气候数据上训练的全连接非线性 VAE 中潜变量坐标的坍塌行为，并分析有效维度曲线的变化。
Result: 非线性相互作用使坍塌起始点相对效用阈值发生偏移和展宽，但常见排序在已分辨的秩上得以保持，因此谱截断仍等价于效用截断；有效维度曲线显示增加网络深度会把效用集中到前几个坐标，但会恶化尾部保真度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调非线性 $\beta$-VAE 仍保留有效的谱截断逻辑，有效维度可作为描述模型容量的工具；深度增加带来头部-尾部权衡。论文未涉及具体预测或同化实验。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: DegradeQuery: Counterfactual Tuple Pretraining for Context-Aware PROTAC Degradation Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) induce protein degradation by recruiting a target protein to an E3 ubiquitin ligase, making degradation a joint outcome of the degrader molecule and its biological context. Although public databases contain thousands of structured molecule-target-E3 records, degradation measurements are available for only a small fraction of them. Existing supervised approaches therefore leave most recorded chemical-biological relationships unused. We introduce DegradeQuery, a context-aware prediction framework that converts these label-missing records into a pretraining signal. Its counterfactual tuple pretraining objective contrasts recorded tuples with alternatives formed by replacing the target, the E3 ligase, or both, enabling the model to learn contextual associations without assigning activity pseudo-labels. The resulting representation is then fine-tuned to predict degradation from the complete molecule-target-E3 context. On the official PROTAC-8K benchmark, DegradeQuery achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of 0.9065 and an accuracy of 0.8500, outperforming the compared methods. Controlled analyses further show that the improvement is primarily attributable to tuple-level pretraining, can be recovered using only label-missing records, and remains complementary to protein language model representations. These findings demonstrate that incompletely labeled PROTAC databases contain useful relational supervision and provide a practical route for learning context-aware degradation predictors from scarce experimental labels.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DegradeQuery，一个面向 PROTAC 降解预测的上下文感知框架。它把数据库中大量缺少降解标签的 molecule-target-E3 记录转化为预训练信号，通过反事实三元组 (counterfactual tuple) 预训练目标对比真实记录与替换 target、E3 或两者后的候选，从而学习上下文关联而不分配活性伪标签；预训练表示再在完整 molecule-target-E3 上下文上微调预测降解。在官方 PROTAC-8K 基准上达到 AUC 0.9065、准确率 0.8500，优于对比方法。
Motivation: 公开数据库虽包含数千条结构化的分子-靶点-E3 记录，但其中仅有小部分具有降解测量值，现有监督方法无法利用大多数无标签记录。作者希望把这些缺失标签的关系记录转化为可用的预训练信号，缓解实验标签稀缺的问题。
Method: 提出反事实三元组预训练目标：将已记录的三元组与通过替换 target、E3 或两者形成的替代三元组进行对比学习，使模型学习上下文关联且不分配活性伪标签；得到的表示随后在完整 molecule-target-E3 上下文上微调，用于预测降解。
Result: 在 PROTAC-8K 基准上，该方法取得 AUC 0.9065 和准确率 0.8500，优于所比较的方法。受控分析显示，性能提升主要来自三元组级预训练，仅使用缺失标签记录即可恢复该提升，并且该表示与蛋白语言模型 (protein language model) 表征互补。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，标注不完整的 PROTAC 数据库蕴含着有用的关系监督，为在稀缺实验标签条件下学习上下文感知的降解预测器提供了可行途径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Rethinking Data Efficiency in Industrial Dense Prediction: Pretraining Coherence, Not Inductive Bias, Determines ViTs Low-Data Advantage
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) are widely believed to require more labeled data than CNNs for industrial dense prediction. Through controlled experiments on four industrial datasets, we show that the data-efficiency gap stems from pretraining incoherence, which refers to the statistical mismatch between ImageNet-pretrained ViT backbones and COCO-pretrained CNN necks, rather than from inherent self-attention deficits. We characterize the cross-architecture feature gap and propose a lightweight AlignBlock family for pyramid-level feature recalibration. Our core finding empirically identifies a data-efficiency frontier: for domain-proximal scenes with >= 200 samples, Swin-Graft surpasses YOLOv11x (terminal 703-shot: 0.973 vs 0.956 mAP@50); for domain-distant scenes, CNNs retain advantage (hook 141-shot: 0.900 vs 0.600 mAP@50). Grafted neck weights yield up to 2.5x the mAP of a randomly initialized neck.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables. This paper targets industrial defect detection via vision transformer and CNN alignment grafting
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视工业密集预测中 ViT 与 CNN 的数据效率差异，通过四个工业数据集的受控实验指出差距并非源于自注意力的固有缺陷，而是来自预训练不一致性 (pretraining incoherence)，即 ImageNet 预训练的 ViT 主干与 COCO 预训练的 CNN 颈部之间的统计失配。作者刻画了跨架构特征差距，并提出轻量级 AlignBlock 系列进行金字塔级特征重校准。核心经验结论是：在域接近场景且样本量 >=200 时，Swin-Graft 超过 YOLOv11x（703-shot 时 0.973 vs 0.956 mAP@50）；在域偏离场景中 CNN 仍有优势（hook 141-shot 时 0.900 vs 0.600 mAP@50）。
Motivation: 当前普遍认为 ViT 在工业密集预测中比 CNN 需要更多标注数据，论文瞄准这一数据效率差距，试图证明其根源并非自注意力的归纳偏置缺陷，而是跨架构预训练不一致，从而为低数据工业场景下的 ViT 应用提供新解释。
Method: 在四个工业数据集上进行受控实验，比较 ViT 主干与 CNN 颈部的组合；系统刻画跨架构特征差距，并提出轻量级 AlignBlock 系列用于金字塔级特征重校准，以对齐 ImageNet 预训练 ViT 主干和 COCO 预训练 CNN 颈部的特征空间。
Result: 摘要报告：域接近场景中样本量达到 200 以上时，Swin-Graft 在 703-shot 下 mAP@50 达 0.973，高于 YOLOv11x 的 0.956；域偏离场景中 CNN 胜出，hook 141-shot 下 0.900 对 0.600。嫁接的颈部权重相比随机初始化的颈部最高可带来 2.5 倍的 mAP 提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为决定 ViT 低数据优势的是预训练一致性而非归纳偏置；在域接近的工业场景中，通过特征校准与预训练对齐可以释放 ViT 的数据效率，而在域偏离场景中 CNN 仍然保持优势。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: $π$-SUB: A Physics-Informed Synthetic Underwater Benchmark Dataset for Underwater Image Enhancement
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents $π$-SUB, a physics-informed framework for generating synthetic underwater benchmark datasets that bridges the synthetic-to-real gap for Underwater Image Enhancement (UIE). The proposed framework extends the classical underwater image formation model by incorporating depth-dependent downwelling irradiance, biologically resolved absorption, and environmental scattering across all ten Jerlov water types, together with independently controllable residual phenomena. Using this framework, the $π$-SUB dataset consists of paired synthetic underwater-reference images spanning shallow-to-deep and coastal-to-oceanic environments. Extensive simulation studies have been carried out to evaluate $π$-SUB along two criteria namely hyper-realism and generalizability. For hyper-realism, $π$-SUB attains a global Frechet Inception Distance (FID) that is 46% lower than Syrea. For generalizability, four state-of-the-art UIE architectures (FUnIE-GAN, Pix2Pix, PUIE-Net, and Phaseformer) are used for comparative evaluation of $π$-SUB. These models were independently trained on six datasets including one real and five synthetic datasets and tested on six real-world benchmarks datasets. Across four UIE architectures and six real benchmark datasets, $π$-SUB improves UIQM by 4.18% over PHISWID (next best) and 9.46% over Syrea (next best), while reducing NIQE by 48.78% and 23.98%, respectively. These results establish $π$-SUB as a hyper-realistic and generalizable benchmark for developing the next generation of underwater image enhancement methods. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/airl-iisc/pi-SUB
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 π-SUB，一个基于物理信息的水下合成基准数据集生成框架，旨在缩小水下图像增强（Underwater Image Enhancement, UIE）中合成数据与真实数据的差距。框架扩展了经典水下图像形成模型，引入随深度变化的下行辐照度、生物分辨吸收和环境散射，并覆盖全部十种 Jerlov 水类型，同时支持独立可控的残余现象。基于该框架生成的 π-SUB 数据集包含从浅海到深海、从近岸到大洋的配对合成水下参考图像，并通过超现实性和泛化性两个维度进行验证。
Motivation: 现有合成水下数据集与真实水下环境之间存在明显的合成-真实差距，导致以此训练的 UIE 模型在真实基准上泛化不佳。需要一个物理上更真实、能覆盖多样化水体环境的合成基准数据集，以支撑下一代水下图像增强方法的发展。
Method: 提出物理信息合成框架 π-SUB，扩展经典水下图像形成模型，纳入随深度变化的下行辐照度（downwelling irradiance）、生物学分辨的吸收（biologically resolved absorption）和环境散射（environmental scattering），覆盖所有十种 Jerlov 水类型，并引入独立可控的残余现象来生成配对合成水下参考图像。
Result: 在超现实性方面，π-SUB 的全局 Frechet Inception Distance (FID) 比 Syrea 低 46%。在泛化性方面，使用四种 UIE 架构（FUnIE-GAN, Pix2Pix, PUIE-Net, Phaseformer）在六个数据集上训练、六个真实基准上测试，π-SUB 相比次优的 PHISWID 将 UIQM 提升 4.18%，相比 Syrea 提升 9.46%，同时将 NIQE 分别降低 48.78% 和 23.98%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 π-SUB 是一个超现实且可泛化的基准数据集，可用于开发下一代水下图像增强方法，并公开了代码和数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A HamNoSys-Guided Dataset and Baselines for Fine-Grained Isolated Handshape Recognition in Sign Language
papers.abstract_en: Purpose: Fine-grained handshape recognition supports computational sign-language transcription, recognition, and translation, but broad, phonetically defined visual inventories with signer-aware evaluation remain limited. This work introduces a benchmark grounded in the language-independent Hamburg Notation System (HamNoSys). Methods: A balanced dataset of 144,000 RGB images was collected from 15 participants for 160 handshape classes defined by the official HamNoSys 4 Handshapes Chart. ResNet-18 and ViT-B/16 were evaluated as appearance-based models, while a graph convolutional network and XGBoost were evaluated from hand landmarks. Both a class-stratified subject-dependent split and a 15-fold leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocol were used. The same model families were additionally assessed on LSWH100 and ASL Fingerspelling Dataset A for external context. Results: The subject-dependent benchmarks established reproducible reference performance across all four model families, whereas LOSO evaluation exposed a substantial reduction when recognition was required to generalise to unseen participants. On ASL Fingerspelling Dataset A, mean LOSO top-1 accuracy ranged from 82.20% to 87.40%. Conclusion: The documented acquisition, curation, and complementary evaluation protocols pro-vide a reproducible resource for fine-grained isolated-handshape research and for developing more accessible sign-language technologies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 HamNoSys 4 手型图的细粒度孤立手形识别基准，包含 15 名参与者的 144,000 张 RGB 图像、160 个手形类别。作者在类分层 subject-dependent 划分和 15 折 LOSO 协议下评估了 ResNet-18、ViT-B/16、图卷积网络和 XGBoost，并在 LSWH100 与 ASL Fingerspelling Dataset A 上提供外部参照。结果显示 LOSO 泛化性能显著下降，ASL Fingerspelling Dataset A 的平均 LOSO top-1 准确率为 82.20% 至 87.40%。
Motivation: 细粒度手形识别是手语转写、识别与翻译的关键，但缺少基于音系学定义的大规模视觉清单及考虑不同手语者差异的评测协议，限制了该方向的可复现研究。
Method: 采集并整理了一个基于官方 HamNoSys 4 Handshapes Chart 的均衡数据集，包含 144,000 张 RGB 图像、15 名参与者、160 个手形类别；同时采用 subject-dependent 与 15 折 LOSO 两种评估协议，并对比基于外观的 ResNet-18/ViT-B/16 与基于关键点的图卷积网络/XGBoost。
Result: Subject-dependent 基准为四类模型提供了可复现的参考性能，而 LOSO 评估显示对未见参与者的识别准确率大幅下降；在 ASL Fingerspelling Dataset A 上，平均 LOSO top-1 准确率介于 82.20% 和 87.40% 之间。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了完整的数据采集、整理和互补评估协议，可作为细粒度孤立手形识别研究及更易用的手语技术的可复现资源。

papers.title: BREAD: Baseline-Referenced Explanations for Anomaly Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based prospective anomaly detection methods are increasingly deployed in high-dimensional and nonlinear settings. Among these approaches, AI-based statistical process monitoring (SPM) is widely used, providing a structured framework for prospective monitoring. Once an anomaly is detected, a diagnosis method is needed to identify the features driving the flagged observation away from normal behaviour. Traditional SPM diagnosis methods are typically designed for specific detection models and cannot be directly applied to AI-based methods. Model-agnostic explainable AI (XAI) offers a general framework for feature relevance explanation. However, existing methods suffer from scalability limitations or assign relevance to noise features, reducing diagnosis accuracy. We propose a scalable, baseline-referenced diagnosis method that uses both the anomalous observation and normal baseline information. We provide mathematical guarantees that under a mean-shift anomaly setting, the proposed method achieves higher faithfulness in detecting the features causing the anomaly compared to LIME. Simulation studies and a real-world case study validate the effectiveness of the proposed method and show that it generates more faithful and accurate diagnosis results for AI-based prospective anomaly detection methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于 AI 的前瞻性异常检测（如统计过程监控 SPM）提出一种可扩展的基线参照诊断方法，同时利用异常观测与正常基线信息进行特征相关性解释。作者给出数学保证：在均值漂移异常设置下，其忠实度高于 LIME。模拟研究与真实案例表明该方法能生成更忠实、准确的诊断结果。
Motivation: 传统 SPM 诊断方法通常针对特定检测模型设计，无法直接用于 AI 方法；而现有模型无关 XAI 方法要么可扩展性受限，要么将相关性分配给噪声特征，导致诊断准确性下降。
Method: 提出一种可扩展的、基于基线参照（baseline-referenced）的诊断方法，同时使用异常观测与正常基线信息，并在均值漂移（mean-shift）异常设置下给出理论分析。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在均值漂移异常设置下识别致因特征的忠实度高于 LIME，并通过模拟研究和真实案例验证了诊断结果的忠实性与准确性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法能为 AI 驱动的预测性异常检测提供更忠实、准确的异常诊断结果，弥补现有模型无关解释方法在该场景下的不足。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: HexEval: An Evidence-Driven Hexagonal Framework for Multidimensional Scholar Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Scholar assessment plays a fundamental role in faculty recruitment, funding allocation, academic promotion, and talent discovery. Existing scholar assessment methods predominantly rely on bibliometric indicators and reputation proxies, while recent large language model (LLM)-based approaches mainly focus on evaluating individual research papers rather than comprehensively assessing scholars. We argue that scholar assessment should be formulated as an evidence-driven reasoning problem that jointly considers intrinsic research quality and externally verifiable scholarly behavior. To this end, we propose HexEval, an evidence-driven hexagonal framework for multidimensional scholar assessment. HexEval explicitly organizes scholar assessment into two complementary evidence layers. The intrinsic layer evaluates anonymized representative works along three dimensions, namely research rigor, methodological innovation, and scientific contribution, whereas the external layer characterizes scholars through knowledge translation, research coherence, and academic impact using heterogeneous evidence collected from GitHub, Lens, OpenAlex, and other publicly verifiable sources. Instead of producing opaque aggregate scores, HexEval preserves intermediate evidence, dimension-specific rationales, and verification signals throughout the evaluation process, enabling interpretable and auditable scholar profiles. Experiments across all six dimensions show dimension-dependent agreement with human or external reference criteria: structured calibration improves absolute agreement for intrinsic quality, while the external modules recover broad trajectory and ordinal impact signals. These results support evidence-driven reasoning over heterogeneous scholarly evidence as a promising paradigm for auditable AI-assisted scholar assessment, while exposing the coverage and attribution limitations of public scholarly data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HexEval，一个基于证据驱动的六边形框架，用于多维度学者评估。内在层评价匿名代表作品的研究严谨性、方法创新性与科学贡献；外在层利用 GitHub、Lens、OpenAlex 等公开可验证来源刻画知识转化、研究连贯性与学术影响。摘要称实验显示各维度与人类或外部参考标准呈维度相关的共识，并支持可解释、可审计的学者画像。
Motivation: 现有学者评估主要依赖文献计量指标和声誉代理，而近期基于大语言模型的评估方法多聚焦于单篇论文而非学者整体。作者主张将学者评估重构为同时考虑内在研究质量与外部可验证学术行为的证据驱动推理问题。
Method: 提出 HexEval 框架，将学者评估组织为两层互补证据：内在层基于匿名代表作评估研究严谨性、方法创新性和科学贡献；外在层利用来自 GitHub、Lens、OpenAlex 等的异构证据刻画知识转化、研究连贯性与学术影响，并全程保留中间证据、维度级理由与验证信号。
Result: 六个维度的实验显示与人类或外部参考标准存在维度相关的共识；结构化校准改善内在质量的绝对一致性，外部模块能恢复总体轨迹与序数影响信号。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于证据驱动推理的异构学术证据评估是可审计 AI 辅助学者评估的有前景范式，同时强调公共学术数据存在覆盖与归因方面的局限。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有学者评估主要依赖文献计量指标和声誉代理，而近期基于大语言模型的评估方法多聚焦于单篇论文而非学者整体。作者主张将学者评估重构为同时考虑内在研究质量与外部可验证学术行为的证据驱动推理问题。
summary_sections.method: 提出 HexEval 框架，将学者评估组织为两层互补证据：内在层基于匿名代表作评估研究严谨性、方法创新性和科学贡献；外在层利用来自 GitHub、Lens、OpenAlex 等的异构证据刻画知识转化、研究连贯性与学术影响，并全程保留中间证据、维度级理由与验证信号。
summary_sections.result: 六个维度的实验显示与人类或外部参考标准存在维度相关的共识；结构化校准改善内在质量的绝对一致性，外部模块能恢复总体轨迹与序数影响信号。

papers.title: Agentic Instruction Data Selection: Let DataMaster Interpret Your Intent
papers.abstract_en: Although existing instruction data selection methods have introduced various metrics, the inherent complexity of real-world datasets makes it impractical for any single metric to generalize across all scenarios. Developers are thus often forced to manually inspect data and craft heuristic rules for each new application---a tedious and error-prone process. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift from manual configuration to automated orchestration via the Instruction Data Selection Agent (DataMaster), which interprets user intent and autonomously composes optimal selection strategies. By allowing users to specify data needs through natural language descriptions, DataMaster simplifies data curation and removes the burden of manual strategy design. Extensive experiments across the math, medical, and code domains show that DataMaster outperforms static baselines in most settings and surpasses full-pool training in a substantial number of cases. The implementation of DataMaster and the scripts needed to reproduce the reported pipeline are publicly available at https://github.com/nju-websoft/DataMaster.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出指令数据选择智能体 (Instruction Data Selection Agent, DataMaster)，让用户用自然语言描述数据需求，由智能体解释意图并自动编排最优选择策略，取代人工设计启发式规则。实验覆盖数学、医疗和代码领域，结果显示 DataMaster 在多数设置下优于静态基线，并在相当一部分情况下超越全量池训练。代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有指令数据选择方法依赖各种指标，但真实数据集的复杂性使单一指标难以在所有场景通用；开发者被迫为每个新应用手动检查数据并设计启发式规则，过程繁琐且易错。
Method: 提出从手动配置转向自动编排的范式：DataMaster 作为指令数据选择智能体，基于用户的自然语言描述理解意图，并自主组合最优选择策略，从而简化数据整理流程。
Result: 在数学、医疗和代码领域的广泛实验中，DataMaster 在大多数设置下优于静态基线，并在相当数量的案例中超过使用完整训练池的效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作实现了从人工配置到自动编排的范式转变，并通过公开实现与复现脚本支持后续研究。

papers.title: DashArena: Benchmarking LLMs on Interactive Analytic Dashboard Generation
papers.abstract_en: Analytic dashboards combine coordinated views and interactions for data exploration and decision-making. Recent models can generate them from data and natural-language goals, but evaluating their usefulness remains difficult. Dashboard generation is open-ended, and neither static appearance nor successful execution alone captures analytical support and interaction quality. We introduce DashArena, to our knowledge the first benchmark for open-ended, task-grounded generation of interactive analytic dashboards. Its key innovation is to require each system to generate both a dashboard and a replayable interaction trajectory. A browser executor replays the trajectory and turns the system's intended analytical workflow into reproducible visual and execution evidence. A VLM judge compares candidates using this evidence, and Bradley--Terry aggregation produces the leaderboard. We further distill the judge into the open-weight DashJudge-8B. Human evaluations show that DashJudge-8B effectively reproduces human judgments and ablations show that interaction evidence improves judge agreement. Experiments with frontier models reveal persistent rendering, analytical, and interaction failures. Together, these results show that realistic dashboard generation remains challenging and that interaction-aware evaluation captures failures missed by static or execution-only checks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DashArena，据作者称是第一个面向开放式、任务导向的交互式分析仪表盘生成的基准。该基准要求系统同时生成仪表盘和可回放的交互轨迹，由浏览器执行器将轨迹转化为可复现的视觉与执行证据，再通过 VLM 裁判结合 Bradley-Terry 聚合生成排行榜，并将裁判蒸馏为开放权重的 DashJudge-8B。摘要报告人工评估显示 DashJudge-8B 能有效复现人类判断，消融表明交互证据提升裁判一致性，前沿模型仍存在渲染、分析与交互失败。
Motivation: 分析仪表盘的自动生成缺乏有效评估方式；生成是开放式的，仅看静态外观或执行成功都无法反映分析支持能力和交互质量。
Method: 引入 DashArena 基准，要求系统输出仪表盘与可回放的交互轨迹；浏览器执行器回放轨迹以生成证据，VLM 裁判基于证据比较候选结果，并用 Bradley-Terry 聚合排序；此外将裁判蒸馏为开放权重模型 DashJudge-8B。
Result: 人工评估表明 DashJudge-8B 能有效复现人类判断；消融实验显示加入交互证据可提高裁判与人类判断的一致性；对前沿模型的实验暴露出持续的渲染、分析与交互失败。
Conclusion: 摘要强调真实场景的仪表盘生成仍具挑战，交互感知的评估能捕获静态检查或仅执行检查遗漏的失败。

papers.title: Iterative Erasure Count Is Not an Affine-Invariant Concept Dimension
papers.abstract_en: How many directions does a neural representation use to encode a concept? A common answer repeatedly erases probe directions and reports the stopping count or cumulative removed rank. We show that both quantities can change under an information-preserving invertible reparameterization, so neither is intrinsically a concept dimension. We distinguish model-defined population quantities (generating dimension, sufficient linear dimension, and minimum guarding rank) from procedure-defined quantities such as stopping count and cumulative edit rank. In a population Gaussian construction, an invertible shear preserves the prediction problem and all three quantities, yet changes the cumulative Euclidean erasure count from one to two. The separation holds for Moore--Penrose ordinary least squares and every finite nonnegative ridge weight. For a two-output full-QR procedure matching our motivating video analysis, cumulative edit rank similarly changes from two to the ambient dimension four. Conversely, the complete cumulative metric-QR trajectory is affine-equivariant when its positive-definite metric, probe, regularizer, and tie-breaking are transported consistently; exact covariance is one corollary, not a canonical semantic metric. In a known-rank finite-sample Adam/QR calibration, identity mixing stops after one accepted update in all 20 large-sample runs, whereas each tested shear $a\in\{.5,.75,1,1.25,2\}$ accepts at least two updates in all 20 runs. Controlled reparameterizations of frozen V-JEPA2 features preserve rank-zero predictions yet alter later Euclidean trajectories under practical optimization. These visual contact experiments are stress tests, not estimates of contact dimension. Iterative erasure therefore returns a procedure-relative estimand jointly determined by representation geometry and the full measurement procedure, not a semantic dimension by itself.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Code and results included as ancillary files. Tingan Jin, Shuhang Dong, and Haosong Li contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文论证迭代擦除次数（iterative erasure count）并非仿射不变的概念维度。作者指出，在保持信息不丢失的可逆重参数化下，停止计数（stopping count）和累计移除秩（cumulative removed rank）都会改变，因而两者都不是内在的概念维度。通过总体高斯构造、有限样本校准以及冻结 V-JEPA2 特征的可控重参数化实验，作者表明迭代擦除返回的是由表示几何与完整测量程序共同决定的过程相关估计量（procedure-relative estimand），而非语义维度。
Motivation: 常见做法是反复擦除探针方向并报告停止计数或累计移除秩，以此度量神经网络表示编码某个概念所用的方向数。作者指出这些量在信息保持的可逆重参数化下会改变，因此不能被视为内在的概念维度，这一混淆会影响可解释性结论的可靠性。
Method: 作者区分模型定义的总体量（生成维度、充分线性维度、最小守卫秩）与过程定义量（停止计数、累计编辑秩）。他们构造总体高斯模型，在保护预测问题的可逆剪切（invertible shear）下检验 Moore–Penrose 普通最小二乘与任意有限非负岭权重；并分析两输出 full-QR 过程、累积 metric-QR 轨迹的仿射等变性，以及有限样本 Adam/QR 校准和冻结 V-JEPA2 特征的重参数化作为压力测试。
Result: 在总体高斯构造中，可逆剪切保持预测问题及三个总体量不变，却把累积欧氏擦除计数从 1 变为 2；对两输出 full-QR 过程，累计编辑秩从 2 变为环境维度 4。在已知秩的有限样本 Adam/QR 校准中，恒等混合在全部 20 次大样本运行中只接受一次更新，而每个测试剪切 a∈{.5,.75,1,1.25,2} 在全部 20 次运行中都至少接受两次更新。
Conclusion: 作者认为迭代擦除返回的是过程相对估计量，由表示几何和完整测量程序共同决定，本身不能作为语义维度；视觉接触实验是压力测试而非接触维度的估计。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MARCO: Click-Intent Decomposition for Calibrated Ads Conversion Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Not all clicks are equal. Industrial ads ranking decouples conversion probability into click-through rate (CTR) and post-click conversion rate (CVR), yet treats every click as the same event. In reality, users provide a free, self-generated signal of intent through their physical UI interactions. Different click types on the same ad exhibit a 4-fold difference in actual conversion rates. By conflating these signals, the standard CVR model under-predicts high-intent clicks and over-predicts low-intent ones, which is a bias masked by near-perfect aggregate calibration. We propose MARCO (Multi-intent Ads Ranking Composition Optimization), a framework that resolves this bias by decomposing each click by intent. Using the logged click type as a free behavioral label, MARCO trains per-intent CVR heads on homogeneous populations, and at serving time composes their per-intent CVR estimates under a predicted distribution over intents. Theoretically, we prove that decomposition never raises population risk, give the exact headroom under squared loss and non-negativity under the deployed loss, and show through a routing-efficiency dial how much of it reaches serving. Because the population-optimal score is unchanged, any gain is a finite-capacity estimation and calibration effect that we validated both offline and online. For deployment at scale, we further cast multi-impression, multi-click attribution as credit assignment with a bias-variance tradeoff analogous to RL return estimation, showing last-impression, first-click attribution is the low-bias, low-variance, deterministic choice under production constraints, and derive three consistency conditions enforced end-to-end at scale. Deployed at binary intent granularity, MARCO corrects per-intent calibration to approximately 100%, lifts conversions per click by +2.80%, and drives +0.98% cumulative improvement in topline metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MARCO（Multi-intent Ads Ranking Composition Optimization）框架，用于校准广告转化率预测。作者指出不同点击类型在同一广告上的实际转化率可相差4倍，而标准 CVR 模型将所有点击视为同一事件，因此对高意图点击欠预测、对低意图点击过预测，这种偏差被近乎完美的总体校准所掩盖。MARCO 利用日志中的点击类型作为免费行为标签，为每种意图训练独立的 CVR 头，并在服务时按预测的意图分布组合估计；理论证明分解不增加总体风险，离线与线上验证表明其收益来自有限容量下的估计与校准效应。
Motivation: 工业广告排序将转化概率解耦为 CTR 与 CVR，但把所有点击视为相同事件，忽略了用户通过物理 UI 交互提供的自由意图信号。不同点击类型的实际转化率存在4倍差异，导致标准 CVR 模型在意图维度上出现系统性偏差，且总体校准良好掩盖了这一问题。
Method: 提出 MARCO 框架，将每次点击按意图分解：以日志中的点击类型作为行为标签，在同质人群上训练每个意图的 CVR 预测头，服务时在预测的意图分布下组合各意图的 CVR 估计。还将多展示、多点击归因建模为具有偏差-方差权衡的信用分配问题，类似于强化学习中的回报估计，并推导出端到端执行需满足的三个一致性条件。
Result: 理论部分证明分解永远不会提高总体风险，并给出平方损失下的精确 headroom 以及部署损失下的非负性。部署采用二值意图粒度时，MARCO 将每意图校准修正至约100%，每次点击转化率提升 +2.80%，topline 指标累计提升 +0.98%。
Conclusion: 由于总体最优分数不变，任何收益都源于有限容量下的估计与校准效应；在生产约束下，last-impression、first-click 归因是低偏差、低方差的确定性选择，并通过一致性条件在大规模端到端部署中保证有效性。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 由于总体最优分数不变，任何收益都源于有限容量下的估计与校准效应；在生产约束下，last-impression、first-click 归因是低偏差、低方差的确定性选择，并通过一致性条件在大规模端到端部署中保证有效性。

papers.title: Retrieval-Corrected Conformal Prediction for Time Series
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free prediction intervals for fixed forecasters, but its standard calibration procedure is often inefficient for time series data, where forecast errors are temporally dependent and change across time and operating conditions. Recent time series CP methods improve local calibration using recent, weighted, or localized residuals. Yet local calibration can remain indirect, since broad residual weighting or additional adaptation procedures may dilute the evidence most relevant to the current prediction. This motivates a simple retrieval and correction strategy that selects similar past residuals as local evidence and then corrects the coverage error left by retrieval. In this paper, we propose Retrieval--Corrected Conformal Prediction (RCCP), a retrieval-augmented calibration method for time series prediction intervals. RCCP builds an asymmetric interval from retrieved one-sided residuals and calibrates its normalized retrieval error with a scalar conformal correction. Thus, retrieval provides local residual evidence, while conformal correction determines the final scale needed for coverage. We provide a coverage-gap bound based on the stability of the normalized retrieval error distribution. Across standard benchmarks and backbone forecasters, RCCP attains the target coverage in every setting and achieves the lowest Winkler scores, with fewer severe misses. RCCP also achieves low calibration and inference overhead, showing that retrieval-corrected calibration is an effective and scalable approach to uncertainty quantification in time series forecasting. Code is available at https://github.com/jinsaaang/rccp.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), Rome, Italy
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Retrieval-Corrected Conformal Prediction (RCCP)，一种面向时间序列预测区间的检索增强校准方法。RCCP 从历史残差中检索相似样本作为局部证据，构建非对称区间，并用一个标量保形校正 (conformal correction) 校正检索后的覆盖率误差。摘要报告该方法在标准基准和多种骨干预测器上均达到目标覆盖率，并取得最低的 Winkler 分数，同时校准与推断开销较低。
Motivation: 标准保形预测 (conformal prediction) 的校准过程对时间序列数据效率低，因为预测误差在时间上相关且随时间和运行条件变化。现有的局部校准方法（如加权或局部化残差）仍可能因加权过于宽泛或额外适应过程而稀释与当前预测最相关的证据。
Method: 提出 RCCP，先检索与当前预测相似的历史残差作为局部证据，基于检索到的单侧残差构建非对称区间，再用一个标量保形校正对归一化的检索误差进行校准，从而用检索提供局部证据、用保形校正决定最终覆盖尺度。
Result: 摘要报告在标准基准和多种骨干预测器上，RCCP 在所有设置中都达到目标覆盖率，并取得最低的 Winkler 分数，严重漏检 (severe misses) 更少。同时校准和推断开销较低。论文还给出了基于归一化检索误差分布稳定性的覆盖差距界 (coverage-gap bound)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调检索校正的校准是时间序列预测不确定性量化中有效且可扩展的方法，代码已开源。本文方法面向通用时间序列预测，而非专门针对天气或降水预报。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Laser Cutting Machine Parameter Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Achieving high accuracy in laser-based cutting of optical films requires careful tuning of parameters such as focal length and laser power beam, adjusted according to the specific properties of each film type. Trial-and-error based traditional methods are used to find the most suitable cutting parameters for various films, but they are slow and inaccurate. To address this issue, this paper presents the Reinforcement Learning for Laser Cutting (RL$^{2}$C) algorithm, which uses Q-learning with an epsilon-greedy policy to dynamically optimize cutting parameters, significantly reducing taper size and film wastage. Additionally, RL$^{2}$C incorporates a dynamic environment space adaptability mechanism to allow it to adapt to new states encountered during the learning process over multiple batches of experiments. Experimental results demonstrate that RL$^{2}$C requires fewer steps and less time to find optimal cutting parameters compared to various RL-based optimization methods. Specifically, RL$^{2}$C reduces the number of optimization steps by up to 12.5\% and processing time by up to 81.8\% compared to existing methods. This study demonstrates the potential of RL in industrial laser-cutting processes by improving cut quality, reducing time and film wastage, and minimizing manual interventions.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 8 figures. Accepted manuscript published in Journal of Intelligent Manufacturing (2025). DOI: 10.1007/s10845-025-02619-z
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向激光切割参数优化的强化学习算法 RL²C（Reinforcement Learning for Laser Cutting），采用 Q-learning 与 epsilon-greedy 策略动态调整焦距和激光功率等切割参数，以减少锥度尺寸和薄膜浪费。算法还引入动态环境空间自适应机制，使模型能在多批次实验中适应新状态。实验表明 RL²C 相比其他基于强化学习的优化方法，优化步骤最多减少 12.5%，处理时间最多减少 81.8%。
Motivation: 传统试错法在寻找光学薄膜最佳切割参数时速度慢且精度低，而不同薄膜类型对焦距和激光功率等参数的要求不同，需要更高效的自动调参方法。
Method: 提出 RL²C 算法，基于 Q-learning 和 epsilon-greedy 策略动态优化切割参数，并设计动态环境空间自适应机制，使算法在连续多批次实验中能够处理新出现的状态。
Result: 实验结果显示，与多种基于强化学习的优化方法相比，RL²C 将优化步骤最多减少 12.5%，处理时间最多减少 81.8%，同时改善切割质量并减少薄膜浪费。
Conclusion: 研究证明了强化学习在工业激光切割过程中的潜力，可提高切割质量、减少时间和薄膜浪费，并降低人工干预需求。

papers.title: ImpactHO: Importance-Aware KV Cache Transfer for Multi-User Edge LLM Handover
papers.abstract_en: Edge LLMs must preserve inference continuity when a user hands over between edge nodes, requiring key-value (KV) cache transfer to the target node. However, simultaneous handovers saturate the backhaul, preventing full cache delivery within the mobility-imposed transfer window. Rather than allocating bandwidth as if all cache entries were equally valuable, we order each user's KV cache by importance and transmit only its most informative fraction, turning token-level sparsity into communication savings. We cast the transfer as a multi-user backhaul allocation problem that maximizes average accuracy across users. Each user's partial-cache accuracy serves as its utility: a sigmoid that fits measurements on the RULER benchmark with $R^2>0.99$ across models and context lengths. Because importance ordering front-loads the high-value entries, the concave region of the accuracy curve spans nearly the entire cache. Our proposed allocator keeps served users within this region, making each per-slot allocation problem convex. The optimum is derived via a closed-form weighted water-filling solution that generalizes information-theoretic water-filling and enables online scheduling. The proposed allocator attains over 93.7% average accuracy in a 500ms transfer window, within 0.5pp of the full-cache ceiling, and reaches 98.2-99.5% of a clairvoyant upper bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究边缘 LLM 在用户跨边缘节点切换（handover）时的推理连续性问题，提出基于重要性的 KV 缓存传输方案。作者按重要性对每个用户的 KV 缓存排序，只传输信息量最高的部分，将 token 级稀疏性转化为通信开销的节省，并把多用户回程带宽分配建模为最大化平均精度的优化问题。该分配器在 500ms 传输窗口内达到 93.7% 的平均精度，距全缓存上限仅差 0.5pp，并达到理想先知上界的 98.2-99.5%。
Motivation: 多用户同时切换会饱和回程链路，导致在移动性限定的传输窗口内无法完成完整 KV 缓存交付，从而破坏边缘 LLM 的推理连续性。
Method: 对每个用户的 KV 缓存按重要性排序并只传输最有信息量的部分；将传输建模为多用户回程分配问题，以用户的部分缓存精度作为效用函数（在 RULER 基准上拟合为 sigmoid，R^2>0.99）。由于重要性排序使高价值条目前置，精度曲线的凹区域几乎覆盖整个缓存，使每时隙分配问题凸化，并通过封闭形式的加权 water-filling 求解，支持在线调度。
Result: 摘要报告该分配器在 500ms 传输窗口内达到超过 93.7% 的平均精度，与全缓存上限仅差 0.5pp，并达到理想先知上界的 98.2-99.5%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将 KV 缓存传输视为多用户回程分配问题并用重要性排序驱动部分传输，可以在切换窗口内逼近全缓存精度，同时通过凸化与封闭形式的 water-filling 方案实现高效的在线调度。

papers.title: Flow Straight to Reality: Perceptually Consistent Flow Matching for Efficient Image Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration is fundamentally constrained by the tradeoff between distortion and perception: minimizing pixel-wise error yields over-smoothed results, whereas optimizing for perceptual realism often introduces structural deviations. Recent approaches attempt to balance this tradeoff via posterior sampling or multi-stage generative pipelines, yet remain computationally expensive and architecturally complex. To overcome these limitations, we propose PCFlow (Perceptually Consistent Flow Matching), a unified framework that directly parameterizes a continuous transport from degraded observations to clean targets, jointly optimizing distortion and perceptual quality. While its latent consistency flow objective drives stable and efficient few-step inference, a Latent Consistency Perceptual Loss (LCPL) imposes semantic constraints directly on the guiding velocity field, steering the dynamics toward visually sharp data manifolds. Furthermore, recognizing the inherent conflict between structural and perceptual consistencies, we integrate a conflict-free gradient projection strategy to stabilize the multi-objective optimization landscape. Combined with lightweight, convolution-only backbone, PCFlow achieves competitive performance across diverse restoration tasks at a fraction of traditional computational costs.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/aiimaginglab/PCFlow
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PCFlow (Perceptually Consistent Flow Matching)，一个统一的图像修复框架，直接从退化观测到干净目标参数化连续传输，联合优化失真与感知质量。摘要称其通过 latent consistency flow objective 实现稳定高效的少步推理，并引入 Latent Consistency Perceptual Loss (LCPL) 对引导速度场施加语义约束，同时用 conflict-free gradient projection 稳定多目标优化。结合轻量卷积骨干，在多种修复任务上取得有竞争力的性能，计算成本远低于传统方案。
Motivation: 图像修复面临失真与感知之间的固有权衡：最小化像素误差导致过平滑，而优化感知真实感会引入结构偏差。现有方法通过后验采样或多阶段生成管线平衡该权衡，但计算昂贵且架构复杂。
Method: 提出 PCFlow，直接参数化从退化观测到干净目标的连续传输，并联合优化失真与感知质量。核心组件包括 latent consistency flow objective 用于稳定高效的少步推理，Latent Consistency Perceptual Loss (LCPL) 在引导速度场上施加语义约束，以及 conflict-free gradient projection 策略以稳定多目标优化景观。骨干为轻量、仅卷积的结构。
Result: 摘要报告 PCFlow 在多种图像修复任务上达到有竞争力的性能，同时计算成本仅为传统方法的很小一部分。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一流匹配框架配合一致性感知损失与梯度投影，能够在不依赖复杂多阶段管线的情况下缓解失真-感知权衡。摘要未给出具体局限。

papers.title: SKILLER: Language-Level Reinforcement Learning for Reusable Skill Extraction in Small Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills represent a standardized format for packaging procedural knowledge and domain expertise, serving within agent harness systems as an essential mechanism to continually constrain a language model's behavior space for repeatable, high-quality task execution. However, because strong closed-source models entail high inference costs, current popular agent harnesses, such as Codex and OpenClaw, remain prohibitively expensive when deploying these skills to accomplish real-world tasks. The rapid capability enhancement of open-source models deployable on consumer-grade GPUs presents a compelling opportunity to drastically reduce these costs by leveraging skill-based behavioral constraints. Nevertheless, automatically generating effective skills tailored specifically for such compact models remains a significant practical challenge. To address this, we propose SKILLER, a natural-language-driven reinforcement learning framework designed to automatically generate executor-specific skills for small models, which employs a strong model as the actor and critic, treats the small-model agent system as the environment, and propagates all reinforcement learning signals entirely via natural language. Extensive experimental evaluations across five relevant benchmarks using Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.5-4B demonstrate that SKILLER outperforms three open-source and one closed-source skill generation or evolution methods, achieving absolute gains ranging from 4.3 to 20.4 percentage points for the 9B model and 1.8 to 13.3 points for the 4B model, while remarkably matching the performance of strong closed-source models on single-skill tasks in SkillsBench. The project is available at https://github.com/DANG-ai/SKILLER.
papers.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, and 8 tables. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Project and code: https://github.com/DANG-ai/SKILLER
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SKILLER，一个自然语言驱动的强化学习框架，用于为小型语言模型自动生成执行器特定（executor-specific）的技能。框架以强模型作为演员和评论家，将小模型智能体系统视为环境，并完全通过自然语言传播强化学习信号。在五个基准测试上使用 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 的评估显示，SKILLER 优于三种开源和一种闭源的技能生成或进化方法，绝对提升幅度为 9B 模型 4.3–20.4 个百分点、4B 模型 1.8–13.3 个百分点，并在 SkillsBench 的单技能任务上匹配了强闭源模型的性能。
Motivation: 当前主流智能体框架（如 Codex 和 OpenClaw）依赖强闭源模型部署技能，推理成本高昂，难以用于真实任务。开源模型在消费级 GPU 上能力快速增强，提供了降低成本的契机，但为紧凑型模型自动生成有效技能仍是一项重大挑战。
Method: 提出 SKILLER，一种自然语言驱动的强化学习框架：使用强模型同时充当演员（actor）和评论家（critic），将小模型智能体系统作为环境，所有强化学习信号完全通过自然语言传播，从而生成针对具体执行器的技能。
Result: 在五个相关基准上，使用 Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.5-4B 的实验中，SKILLER 相比三种开源和一种闭源的技能生成或进化方法取得绝对提升：9B 模型提升 4.3 至 20.4 个百分点，4B 模型提升 1.8 至 13.3 个百分点，并在 SkillsBench 的单技能任务上匹配了强闭源模型的性能。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，SKILLER 能够以小模型低成本生成执行器特定技能，并在单技能任务上达到强闭源模型水平；但评估仅限于论文列出的基准和模型规模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring Semantic Abstractness of SAE Features via Nonlocality
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have helped uncover mechanistic explanations for LLM behaviours such as reasoning, jailbreaking etc., via understanding the corresponding task-relevant and causally effective features. To evaluate such mechanistic explanations, downstream studies must distinguish surface lexical features from genuinely high-level ones. However, neither an autointerp-based semantic description nor causal steering utility fully resolves the abstraction level of a feature. To this end, we introduce \emph{Feature Nonlocality} (FNL), defined as the entropy of the normalized per-position influence on an SAE feature's activation. We report that FNL correlates with existing LLM-based proxy metrics of feature semantic abstractness, and successfully distinguishes context-dependent reasoning features from token-driven ones, correctly assigning the higher FNL to the contextual feature in $73$--$84\%$ of randomly drawn pairs that consist of one contextual and one token-level feature. We demonstrate two downstream applications. We audit SAE-based features used for jailbreak mitigation and find surprisingly that most effective features are positional features with low FNL rather than genuinely recognizing harmful intents. We report that steering high-FNL features in DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B improves MATH-500 accuracy by $4.6$ points over the unsteered model and outperforms steering low-FNL features, though the gains are model-specific. We conclude that FNL provides an LLM-independent, label-free, correlational witness of the abstraction level of an SAE feature, with applications in evaluating mechanistic explanations as well as selecting features for downstream interventions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出特征非局域性 (Feature Nonlocality, FNL)，定义为 SAE 特征激活在逐位置归一化影响上的熵，用以度量 SAE 特征的语义抽象程度。摘要报告 FNL 与现有基于 LLM 的抽象度代理指标相关，并能在 73%–84% 的随机配对中正确将更高 FNL 分配给上下文相关特征而非 token 级特征。下游应用中，对越狱缓解特征的审计发现多数有效特征是低 FNL 的位置特征；在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上引导高 FNL 特征使 MATH-500 相对未引导模型提升 4.6 分。
Motivation: 评估 SAE 特征的机制解释需要区分表面词汇特征与真正的高层特征，但自动解释 (autointerp) 的语义描述和因果干预效用都无法完全确定特征的抽象层级。
Method: 引入 FNL，定义为 SAE 特征激活上逐位置归一化影响的熵，作为一种与 LLM 无关、无需标注的抽象层级相关性度量。
Result: FNL 与现有 LLM 代理指标相关，并在随机配对中以 73%–84% 的准确率将更高 FNL 分配给上下文特征；审计发现多数有效的越狱缓解特征是低 FNL 位置特征；在 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 上引导高 FNL 特征使 MATH-500 提升 4.6 分且优于低 FNL 引导，但收益具有模型特异性。
Conclusion: FNL 提供了与 LLM 无关、无标签的 SAE 特征抽象层级相关性证据，可应用于评估机制解释和选择下游干预特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Benchmarking LLM-Guided Control-Plane Policies for Backend Fault Isolation in HAProxy
papers.abstract_en: Static load balancers cannot mitigate a backend that is degraded rather than down: round-robin and least-connections keep routing traffic to a server returning HTTP 500s until an operator intervenes. We ask whether a Large Language Model can replace the static routing policy itself, reading HAProxy and Prometheus telemetry every 10 seconds and isolating faulty servers through guardrailed calls to the HAProxy Data Plane API. On a reproducible benchmark with a persistent structural fault built into roughly one-third of a heterogeneous fleet, we sweep 15 open-weight models across five families (0.35B to 35B total parameters; dense, mixture-of-experts, and efficient-sparse architectures), reasoning modes, fleet scales of 3 to 9 backends, and two routing algorithms, totaling 240 runs. We find a capability threshold near 3B active parameters. Below it, LLM policies are typically unreliable and sometimes worse than no policy; above it, every model, regardless of architecture, saturates near an 88% reduction in client-perceived 5xx errors over the static baseline. The threshold is approximate: Gemma 4 E2B clears it with 2B active parameters, while the dense 3B Granite 4.0 Micro does not. The availability gain has costs. Draining concentrates load onto surviving servers, inflating tail latency 2.6 to 2.8 times, and enabling reasoning multiplies token spend roughly tenfold, overrunning the control interval and degrading effectiveness. The efficient operating point is a supra-threshold model in its cheapest non-reasoning mode, wrapped inside deterministic guardrails.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Submitted to Journal of Network and Computer Applications (Elsevier)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否用大语言模型 (LLM) 替代静态负载均衡路由策略：模型每 10 秒读取 HAProxy 和 Prometheus 遥测数据，通过带护栏的 HAProxy Data Plane API 调用隔离故障后端。作者在含约三分之一持久结构性故障服务器的异构集群上，对 5 个家族共 15 个开放权重模型、两种路由算法、不同推理模式和 3 到 9 台后端规模做了 240 次基准测试，发现约 3B 激活参数的能力阈值：之上所有模型都能相对静态基线将客户端感知的 5xx 错误降低约 88%，但会以尾部延迟放大 2.6 至 2.8 倍和推理 token 开销约 10 倍为代价。
Motivation: 静态负载均衡器无法处理处于降级而非宕机状态的后端：轮询和最少连接策略会持续把流量路由到返回 HTTP 500 的服务器，直到运维人员介入。作者想验证 LLM 能否直接取代静态路由策略本身，自动隔离故障服务器。
Method: 提出以 LLM 作为控制面路由策略的框架：每 10 秒读取 HAProxy 与 Prometheus 遥测，通过带确定性护栏 (guardrails) 的 HAProxy Data Plane API 调用隔离故障后端。基准涵盖 0.35B 到 35B 总参数、稠密/混合专家/高效稀疏等多种架构的 15 个开放权重模型，以及推理模式、后端规模和路由算法的不同组合。
Result: 摘要报告在约 3B 激活参数处存在能力阈值：低于该阈值时 LLM 策略通常不可靠，有时比无策略更差；高于阈值时所有模型（无论架构）都饱和在相对静态基线约 88% 的 5xx 错误削减。该阈值是近似的，Gemma 4 E2B 以 2B 激活参数越过，而稠密 3B 的 Granite 4.0 Micro 未能越过。可用性提升伴随代价：排空 (draining) 使尾部延迟放大 2.6 至 2.8 倍，启用推理使 token 花费约增十倍并超过控制间隔、降低有效性。
Conclusion: 作者指出高效运行点是选择高于阈值、处于最便宜非推理模式的模型，并包裹在确定性护栏内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Understanding, Identifying, and Mitigating Vulnerabilities in Agentic Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have undergone a shift from stateless conversational interfaces to autonomous agents capable of multi-step planning, tool invocation, code execution, and maintaining persistent memory. When these agents operate with real-world privileges---calling APIs, modifying files, and querying databases---a compromised reasoning step can trigger unauthorized data access, irreversible state changes, or cascading failures, yet the security research community has not kept pace. To quantify the state of the field, we conducted a systematic literature review under PRISMA 2020 guidelines across six databases, screening 743 records and retaining 85 papers (2023--2025) on agentic LLM security. Attack research outpaces defense work by 3.9:1. Perception-layer vulnerabilities (prompt injection, jailbreaking, adversarial perturbations) dominate, accounting for 66\% of papers, while action-layer vulnerabilities (tool misuse, code injection, sandbox escape) appear in only 4.7\%, misaligned with real-world risk. Code execution security accounts for 3.5\%, and tool-augmented agents 12\%. We contribute a four-layer taxonomy mapping 13 vulnerability types across perception, brain, action, and interaction layers, and identify seven open problems centered on containment. Agentic LLM insecurity stems from architectural coupling, where weak isolation allows vulnerabilities to propagate across layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对智能体大语言模型（agentic LLM）安全性的系统性文献综述，遵循 PRISMA 2020 指南对六个数据库的 743 条记录进行筛选，保留 2023–2025 年间 85 篇论文。综述发现攻击研究数量是防御研究的 3.9 倍，感知层（perception-layer）漏洞（提示注入、越狱、对抗扰动）占论文的 66%，而动作层（action-layer）漏洞仅占 4.7%。作者提出一个四层分类法，覆盖感知、大脑、动作与交互层的 13 类漏洞，并指出七个围绕遏制（containment）的开放问题。
Motivation: LLM 已从无状态对话接口演变为具备多步规划、工具调用、代码执行和持久记忆的自主智能体，一旦以真实权限调用 API、修改文件或查询数据库，受攻击的推理步骤可能造成未授权数据访问、不可逆状态变更或级联故障，而安全研究社区尚未跟上这一变化。
Method: 采用 PRISMA 2020 指南在六个数据库中进行系统文献综述，筛选并保留 85 篇论文；基于综述结果构建四层漏洞分类法，将 13 种漏洞类型映射到感知、大脑、动作与交互四个层面，并归纳七个开放问题。
Result: 攻击研究数量为防御研究的 3.9 倍；感知层漏洞占 66%，动作层漏洞占 4.7%，代码执行安全占 3.5%，工具增强智能体占 12%；研究分布被指与实际风险错位。
Conclusion: 智能体 LLM 的不安全根源于架构耦合（architectural coupling），即薄弱的隔离使漏洞可在各层之间传播；综述强调需围绕遏制机制推进防御研究。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Robust Multi-Agent Bandits with Heavy-Tailed Rewards and Information Asymmetry
papers.abstract_en: The multi-armed bandit problem is a central framework in sequential decision-making, extensively studied under sub-Gaussian reward assumptions. However, real-world applications often involve heavy-tailed reward distributions and decentralized, information-asymmetric interactions. We study multi-agent multi-armed bandits with heavy-tailed rewards under three information-asymmetry regimes: unobserved actions with common rewards, observed actions with independent rewards, and unobserved actions with independent rewards. We develop robust decentralized algorithms for each setting and derive regret guarantees that nearly match centralized heavy-tailed rates. Experiments on a Pareto-distributed reward environment validate our theoretical findings and illustrate the trade-offs between synchronization, coordination, and exploration across the three regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究重尾奖励分布下的多智能体多臂老虎机（multi-agent multi-armed bandits）问题，考虑三种信息不对称机制：未观察动作且共享奖励、观察动作且独立奖励、未观察动作且独立奖励。作者为每种设置设计鲁棒的分散式算法，并推导出几乎匹配中心化重尾速率的遗憾界。在 Pareto 分布的奖励环境中进行实验，验证理论结果并展示三种机制在同步、协调与探索之间的权衡。
Motivation: 现实应用常涉及重尾奖励分布以及去中心化、信息不对称的交互，而现有 bandit 研究大多在次高斯（sub-Gaussian）奖励假设下进行，理论与实际需求存在差距。
Method: 针对三种信息不对称机制分别提出鲁棒的分散式算法，并给出相应的遗憾上界分析；实验采用 Pareto 分布奖励环境来验证理论。
Result: 摘要声称所提算法的遗憾界几乎匹配中心化重尾速率，实验验证了理论发现，并揭示了三种机制下同步、协调与探索的权衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为其分散式算法在重尾奖励与信息不对称条件下具有鲁棒性，且新能接近中心化设定，但摘要未讨论具体局限。
Relevance: 0
