papers.title: When Do Anchor-Based Pointwise LLM Rerankers Help? Retriever Quality, Statistical Scope, and Anchor Design
papers.abstract_en: Anchor-based pointwise LLM reranking scores each candidate against a shared reference passage to recover cross-document context at pointwise cost. We study when this actually helps, using GCCP/PAGC as a representative method. Our study is reproduction-first. We use reproduction as a starting point for a controlled component-level stress test of anchor-based pointwise reranking. Our initial reimplementation, based only on the paper text, achieves 0.24 nDCG@10 instead of the reported 0.66, revealing that several undocumented implementation details are necessary to reproduce the method. After identifying and recovering eight such details, we reproduce the reported results within 1.6% and use the validated implementation for controlled analysis. We find that the core contrastive scoring idea is robust under rigorous statistical correction. However, two design choices held fixed in the original paper are less reliable. First, we find that combining the contrastive score with the standard pointwise relevance score helps when the first-stage retriever is BM25, but gives little or no benefit when the first-stage retriever is a stronger dense model such as E5. Second, the paper's more complex method for constructing the anchor is unnecessary. A much simpler anchor, built by interleaving the top-ranked sentences, matches or outperforms it across datasets. These findings are consistent across different LLM backbones, including a 4-bit quantized 72B model. Overall, anchor-based pointwise reranking is effective, but its gains come mainly from contrastive scoring rather than from the more complex aggregation and anchor-construction choices, and they appear under narrower conditions than the original evaluation suggests.
papers.comment: To be published in the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文以 GCCP/PAGC 为代表方法，系统研究基于锚点 (anchor) 的点式 (pointwise) LLM 重排序在什么条件下真正有效。作者采用复现优先的研究路径：仅依据论文文本的初步复现只达到 0.24 nDCG@10，而论文报告为 0.66；在识别并恢复八个未文档化的实现细节后，复现结果与原文差距在 1.6% 以内。基于该可控实现的分析表明，核心对比评分 (contrastive scoring) 想法在严格统计校正下依然稳健，但原本固定不变的两个设计选择并不可靠：对比分数与点式相关性分数结合仅在第一级检索器为 BM25 时有帮助，而对 E5 等更强稠密模型几乎无增益；同时，更复杂的锚点构造方法并不必要，简单的 top-ranked 句子交错锚点即可持平或超过原方法。
Motivation: 现有基于锚点的点式 LLM 重排序声称能以点式成本恢复跨文档上下文，但其有效性的边界条件未被检验；同时论文发现该方法存在大量未文档化实现细节，直接影响可复现性和后续应用。
Method: 采用复现优先 (reproduction-first) 的受控组件级压力测试：先从论文文本重建方法，识别并恢复八个关键实现细节，再在验证过的实现上对检索器类型、评分组合方式、锚点构造方式和不同 LLM 骨干（含 4-bit 量化的 72B 模型）进行受控对比分析。
Result: 初步复现仅得 0.24 nDCG@10，恢复细节后与报告值差距缩至 1.6% 以内；对比评分在统计校正下稳健；对比分数与点式相关性分数的组合对 BM25 有效、对 E5 几乎无效；简单的 top-ranked 句子交错锚点优于或持平原论文更复杂的锚点构造，且结论在不同 LLM 骨干下一致。
Conclusion: 作者总结认为，基于锚点的点式重排序确实有效，但其增益主要来自对比评分，而非更复杂的聚合与锚点构造选择；该方法有效的条件比原始评估所显示的范围更窄。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Coordinating the Unknown Lipschitz Constant in Multiplayer Bandits
papers.abstract_en: Motivated by decentralized applications, we study cooperative multi-agent bandits in continuous (Lipschitz) action spaces when the Lipschitz constant is unknown. We consider three information structures: (A)~unobserved actions with common rewards, (B)~observed actions with independent rewards, and (C)~unobserved actions with independent rewards. In each case we design and analyze an algorithm that estimates the Lipschitz constant, chooses a discretization of the joint action space, and applies a cooperative bandit method to the induced discrete problem. Players never communicate once learning starts, so the central difficulty is that they must reach the \emph{same} discretization from their own data. We prove regret guarantees showing that common rewards and observable actions each supply this agreement for free, and that in their absence agreement can still be bought, through a dithered quantization of the estimate, at no cost in the leading order of the regret.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续 (Lipschitz) 动作空间下的合作多智能体 bandit 问题，核心设定是 Lipschitz 常数未知且学习开始后智能体之间不再通信。作者针对三种信息结构设计并分析算法：先估计 Lipschitz 常数，再选择联合动作空间的离散化，并在诱导出的离散问题上应用合作 bandit 方法。主要证明结论是常见奖励 (common rewards) 和可观测动作 (observable actions) 可以免费提供离散化的一致性，而在二者都缺失时可借助抖动量化 (dithered quantization) 以不改变 regret 主阶的代价达成一致。
Motivation: 去中心化应用需要在无通信、Lipschitz 常数未知的连续动作空间中协调多个智能体进行合作探索，而各智能体必须仅凭自身数据达成同一离散化，这是该方法要解决的核心困难。
Method: 对三种信息结构——(A) 未观测动作且共享奖励、(B) 观测动作且独立奖励、(C) 未观测动作且独立奖励——分别设计算法：估计 Lipschitz 常数、构造联合动作空间离散化、对诱导离散问题运行合作 bandit 方法；在无共享奖励且动作不可观测时，用估计量的抖动量化来换取一致离散化。
Result: 论文给出 regret 界，证明共享奖励和可观测动作各自能免费提供离散化的一致性；当两者都缺失时，抖动量化也能获得一致性，且不改变 regret 的领先阶 (leading order)。
Conclusion: 摘要强调：在无通信的合作多智能体 bandit 中，只要付出不改变 regret 主阶的代价，就可以协调未知 Lipschitz 常数下的离散化选择。

papers.title: Dynamic Context Adapters: Efficiently Infusing History into Vision-and-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Historical context integration presents a fundamental challenge for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in sequential decision-making tasks. Current VLMs process visual inputs independently, which creates critical limitations for downstream applications that require temporal understanding. Direct incorporation of historical frames into Transformer inputs produces quadratic attention complexity and excessive memory consumption. Existing approaches suffer from significant drawbacks: computational inflation or substantial information loss through temporal compression. To address these challenges, we introduce Dynamic Context Adapter (DCA), a novel context injection approach for pretrained VLMs. Our method employs fixed-size, dynamically compressed memory to preserve historical semantics without frame concatenation. DCA bridges static VLMs and recurrent policies and enables memory capabilities in pretrained models while maintaining computational efficiency. DCA achieves over $25\%$ reduction in attention FLOPs and $13\%$ memory savings while improving performance on long-horizon tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在顺序决策任务中缺乏历史上下文理解的问题，提出 Dynamic Context Adapter (DCA)，一种用于预训练 VLM 的上下文注入方法。DCA 采用固定大小、动态压缩的记忆来保留历史语义，而不进行帧拼接，从而避免 Transformer 输入的二次注意力复杂度。摘要报告该方法在注意力 FLOPs 上降低超过 25%，内存节省 13%，并提升了长时程任务的表现。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 独立处理各帧视觉输入，难以支持需要时间理解的顺序决策应用；直接拼接历史帧会导致二次注意力复杂度和过高内存消耗，而简单的时间压缩又会造成明显的信息损失。
Method: 提出 Dynamic Context Adapter (DCA)，通过固定大小且动态压缩的记忆机制向预训练 VLM 注入历史信息；该方法将静态 VLM 与循环策略（recurrent policy）桥接起来，使预训练模型获得记忆能力而不依赖帧拼接。
Result: 摘要报告 DCA 在注意力计算量（FLOPs）上减少超过 25%，内存占用减少 13%，同时提升长时程任务上的性能。
Conclusion: DCA 提供了一种在预训练 VLM 中高效融合历史上下文的方式，在保持计算效率的同时赋予模型时间理解能力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Rethinking Text-Based Image Retrieval in Specific Domain
papers.abstract_en: Driven by the rapid advancement of vision-language representation learning, Text-based Image Retrieval (TBIR) has made notable progress. However, existing benchmarks are predominantly constructed on an exclusive single-match assumption between query and images. While effective in general scenarios, this assumption fails to reflect practical system performance in specific domains (e.g., surveillance), where a single query often corresponds to multiple relevant candidate images. To address this limitation, we design a Domain-Specific Multi-Match Text-based Image Retrieval (DSMM-TBIR) data engine. Leveraging this engine, we construct Security Multi-Match TBIR (SecMM-TBIR), a benchmark comprising 50k surveillance images with 200 comprehensive queries. Furthermore, we observe that vanilla contrastive learning in specific domains suffers from severe false negatives, forcing the model to push apart semantically similar pairs and thus degrading retrieval performance. We propose the Semantic-Aware Fine-Tuning (SAFT) framework to address semantic compression in specific domains, which incorporates Semantic-Aware Soft-Label Supervision (SASS) and Intra-modal Structural Distillation (ISD) to establish a promising paradigm for domain-specific TBIR tasks. Experiments across diverse CLIP-like models demonstrate that SAFT yields an average mAP@20 gain of 7.8 points on SecMM-TBIR over standard image-text contrastive (ITC) fine-tuning, while also improving general-domain performance. The entire benchmark will be released to facilitate further research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对特定领域（如监控场景）中文本图像检索（TBIR）与传统单一匹配假设不符的问题，提出领域特定多匹配数据集引擎 DSMM-TBIR，并构建包含 5 万张监控图像与 200 条综合查询的 SecMM-TBIR 基准。作者进一步观察到普通对比学习在特定领域存在严重假阴性问题，提出语义感知微调框架 SAFT，包含语义感知软标签监督（SASS）与模态内结构蒸馏（ISD），在多种 CLIP 类模型上取得平均 mAP@20 提升 7.8 个点的效果，同时不损害通用域性能。
Motivation: 现有 TBIR 基准大多基于查询与图像间排他性单一匹配假设，无法反映监控等特定领域中一条查询对应多条相关候选图像的实际系统性能。
Method: 设计 DSMM-TBIR 数据引擎以构造多匹配基准 SecMM-TBIR，并提出 SAFT 框架，通过 SASS 和 ISD 缓解特定领域中的语义压缩与假阴性问题。
Result: 在 SecMM-TBIR 上，SAFT 相比标准图像文本对比（ITC）微调在多种 CLIP 类模型上平均 mAP@20 提升 7.8 个点，并同时改善通用域性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SAFT 为领域特定 TBIR 任务提供了有前景的范式，并将发布完整基准以促进后续研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving TensorSketch Using Complex Random Variables
papers.abstract_en: \texttt{TensorSketch} by~\cite{pham2013fast,kar2012random} provides efficient sketching algorithms for high-dimensional polynomial kernels $\vec{x}^{\otimes p} \in \R^{d^p}$. \cite{kar2012random} uses dense Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL)-type projections with computational cost $O(pDd)$, where $D$ denotes the sketch dimension, whereas~\cite{pham2013fast} extends the sparse \texttt{CountSketch}~\citep{count_sketch} algorithm, yielding a faster algorithm for high-dimensional sparse inputs with running time $O\big(p(\nnz{\vec{x}} + D \log D)\big)$. However, the variance of both estimators grows exponentially with the polynomial degree $p$, scaling as $3^{p}/D$. Recent work by~\cite{pmlr-v206-wacker23a} showed that using complex-valued distribution reduces this dependence to $2^{p}/D$ for the approach of~\cite{kar2012random}. However, their method relies on dense JL-type projections with computational cost $O(pDd)$ and does not extend to the algorithm of~\cite{pham2013fast}. In this work, we introduce a simple variant of \texttt{TensorSketch}~\citep{pham2013fast} that achieves the same variance bound as~\cite{pmlr-v206-wacker23a}, while retaining its advantage of the input-sparsity running time. We validate our results with supporting experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于复随机变量的 TensorSketch 变体，在不牺牲输入稀疏运行时间的前提下，达到与已有复值 Johnson-Lindenstrauss (JL) 型方法相同的方差界。摘要报告该方法将高维多项式核草图 (sketch) 的方差从随阶数 p 的 3^p/D 改善到 2^p/D，并保留 CountSketch 风格的快速运行时间，实验在合成与真实数据集上验证了结果。
Motivation: 现有 TensorSketch 估计器的方差随多项式阶数 p 指数增长，达 3^p/D；近期工作用复值分布将方差降至 2^p/D，但依赖稠密 JL 型投影，计算开销为 O(pDd)，无法用于稀疏 CountSketch 风格的快速算法。
Method: 提出 TensorSketch 的一个简单变体，使用复随机变量，在保持输入稀疏运行时间 O(p(nnz(x) + D log D)) 的同时，实现与复值稠密 JL 方法相同的方差界 2^p/D。
Result: 摘要声称该变体达到与 Wacker 等人复值方法相同的 2^p/D 方差界，同时保留输入稀疏运行时间优势；在合成和真实数据集上进行了支持性实验。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该简单变体兼具复值方法的方差改进与输入稀疏运行时间，但未在摘要中讨论具体局限性；研究范围限于高维多项式核的 sketching 问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Unlocking the Power of Medical Tabular Data via Semantic-Aware Multimodal Pre-training
papers.abstract_en: While vision-language models dominate medical representation learning, unstructured text lacks the dense, quantitative diagnostic phenotypes inherent in structured clinical tables. However, existing multimodal pre-training methods underutilize this potential due to semantic-agnostic designs that treat tabular inputs as flat vectors and employ unstable continuous regression objectives. To overcome this, we propose a novel semantic-aware framework explicitly modeling the intrinsic two-dimensional structure of tabular data. First, addressing the inter-feature hierarchy of varying diagnostic importance, we introduce Importance-Aware Adaptive Masking to construct a label-free curriculum prioritizing salient features. Second, addressing the intra-feature continuity-discreteness duality, we propose a Soft-Label Discretized Module that replaces unstable numerical regression with stable distribution matching, thereby mathematically preserving ordinal relationships. Extensive experiments across large-scale dermatology (SLICE-3D, HOP) and ophthalmology (EyePACS) datasets establish a new state-of-the-art (SOTA), demonstrating exceptional robustness and cross-domain generalizability.
papers.comment: INTERNATIONAL CONFERENCE ON MEDICAL IMAGE COMPUTING AND COMPUTER ASSISTED INTERVENTION (ORAL presentation)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学表格数据在跨模态预训练中被当作扁平向量、且回归目标不稳定的问题，提出一个语义感知的表征学习框架。该框架显式建模表格数据的二维结构，分别用重要性感知自适应掩码 (Importance-Aware Adaptive Masking) 处理特征间的重要性层级，用软标签离散化模块 (Soft-Label Discretized Module) 以分布匹配替代数值回归。作者报告在大规模皮肤病学数据集 (SLICE-3D, HOP) 和眼科学数据集 (EyePACS) 上取得新的 SOTA 结果，并具有良好的稳健性与跨域泛化性。
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型主导医学表征学习，但非结构化文本缺少临床结构表格中密集、定量的诊断表型；现有跨模态预训练方法因语义无关设计（把表格当作扁平向量）以及对连续回归目标的不稳定优化，未能充分利用结构表格的潜力。
Method: 提出语义感知框架，显式建模表格数据的二维结构。针对特征间诊断重要性差异，构造无标签课程式掩码策略，优先保留重要特征；针对特征内部的连续-离散二象性，用软标签离散化模块将数值回归替换为稳定的分布匹配，从而在数学上保留序数关系。
Result: 在 SLICE-3D、HOP 和 EyePACS 等大规模医学数据集上的实验表明，该方法达到新的 SOTA，并展现出优异的稳健性和跨领域泛化能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过显式建模医学表格数据的语义结构并稳定化预训练目标，可以释放结构化表格在医学多模态预训练中的潜力。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: SparSTAR: Sparse Attention for SpaceTime AutoRegressive Video Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: InfinityStar extends visual autoregressive generation to video through a sequence of image and clip pyramids. Its changing scale and cross-clip context, however, leave late-scale attention costly and make sparse patterns reused from diffusion or image VAR models unreliable. We introduce SparSTAR, a training-free block-sparse attention method tailored to this setting. At each expensive scale and attention head, SparSTAR scores contiguous key blocks from the current query and key activations, retains required conditioning context, and executes the selected blocks through a forward-only sparse path. We analyze cross-scale consistency within a clip, pattern persistence across clip boundaries, and quality degradation as reuse spans increasingly distant scales. Across these analyses, important key blocks shift, showing that recomputing block selection at each target scale is more reliable than reusing a transferred mask. On 720p text-to-video and image-to-video generation, SparSTAR preserves every token and refinement scale while providing about a 1.6x end-to-end speedup and maintaining VBench and paired-output reconstruction fidelity close to dense InfinityStar.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SparSTAR，一种面向时空自回归视频生成（基于 InfinityStar 的图像/视频金字塔序列）的免训练块稀疏注意力 (training-free block-sparse attention) 方法。针对金字塔尺度切换和跨片段上下文导致的高计算开销，SparSTAR 在每个昂贵尺度和注意力头上基于当前 query/key 激活为连续 key 块打分，保留所需条件上下文，并通过前向稀疏路径执行选中块。论文还分析了片段内跨尺度一致性、片段边界上的模式持续性以及重用远距离尺度掩码的质量退化。实验显示在 720p 文生视频和图生视频上获得约 1.6 倍端到端加速，同时保持接近密集 InfinityStar 的 VBench 与成对输出重建保真度。
Motivation: InfinityStar 将视觉自回归生成扩展到视频时依赖图像和片段金字塔，但尺度变化与跨片段上下文使后期尺度注意力成本高昂，且从扩散模型或图像 VAR 迁移来的稀疏模式不可靠。作者希望在保持生成质量的同时降低这一设置的注意力开销。
Method: SparSTAR 在每个代价较高的尺度与注意力头上，用当前 query 和 key 激活对连续 key 块进行打分，保留必要的条件上下文，并通过只包含前向传播的稀疏路径执行选中的块，全程无需训练。论文还进行了量化分析，考察片段内跨尺度一致性、跨片段边界的模式持续性，以及重用越远尺度掩码时的质量退化。
Result: 在 720p 文生视频与图生视频任务上，SparSTAR 保留全部 token 和细化尺度，带来约 1.6 倍端到端加速，并将 VBench 与成对输出重建保真度维持在接近密集 InfinityStar 的水平。分析表明重要 key 块会随目标尺度移动，因此逐尺度重算块选择比复用迁移掩码更可靠。
Conclusion: 论文强调针对视频自回归生成中尺度变化的特点，在每个目标尺度重新计算块选择优于复用跨尺度迁移的掩码；免训练的块稀疏注意力可以在该设置下同时获得加速与接近密集模型的保真度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Link-adaptive digital twin for robust physical-layer modeling in hybrid-amplified ultra-wideband optical networks
papers.abstract_en: Accurate physical-layer modeling is increasingly essential for reliable ultra-wideband operation and capacity optimization, especially under the intensified inter-channel stimulated Raman scattering (ISRS) effect. This paper proposes the link-adaptive digital twin (LA-DT) for hybrid-amplified ultra-wideband links to overcome the generalization and speed limitations of existing methods, achieving accurate modeling and robust generalized signal-to-noise ratio (GSNR) estimation across diverse links. First, to address EDFA heterogeneity, the GSNR modeling task is decomposed into three key power predictions: ASE, NLI, and signal powers before EDFA entry. Second, to enhance cross-scenario generalization, three dedicated DT models are developed using a novel neural architecture with linear modulation layers (LMLs). Third, for rapid adaptation to unseen scenarios with limited data, three domain discriminators guide few-shot fine-tuning of the LMLs. Fourth, the LA-DT explicitly accounts for Raman amplifier (RA) insertion loss, improving practical deployment reliability. Results across 35 scenarios show that LA-DT reduces RMSE for NLI, ASE, and signal power predictions to 0.151, 0.111, and 0.113 dBm with improvements of 56.0%, 58.4%, and 52.7% over the baseline,and achieves an average GSNR estimation RMSE of 0.114 dBm (55.8% improvement). For 12 unseen scenarios, the LA-DT maintains high accuracy through few-shot fine-tuning with only 20 samples per scenario, achieving an average GSNR RMSE of 0.159 dB and demonstrating strong adaptability and robustness.
papers.journal_ref: Xiaoxuan Gao, Rentao Gu, Yingchun Wang, Xinyi Liu, Junshi Gao, Yuefeng Ji, Journal of Optical Communications and Networking, Volume: 18, Issue: 6, June 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向混合放大超宽带光网络，提出链路自适应数字孪生（link-adaptive digital twin, LA-DT）来解决受激拉曼散射（ISRS）增强下物理层建模的泛化与速度问题。该方法将GSNR建模分解为ASE、NLI和信号功率三项预测，采用带线性调制层（LMLs）的神经架构构建三个专用数字孪生模型，并通过域判别器实现小样本微调，同时显式建模拉曼放大器插入损耗。在35个场景上的结果显示，NLI、ASE和信号功率预测RMSE分别降至0.151、0.111和0.113 dBm，较基线提升56.0%、58.4%和52.7%；平均GSNR估计RMSE为0.114 dBm（提升55.8%）。
Motivation: 超宽带（ultra-wideband）光网络中ISRS效应增强，可靠运行与容量优化需要准确的物理层建模，而现有方法在跨场景泛化和速度上存在不足。
Method: 将GSNR建模任务分解为进入EDFA前的ASE、NLI和信号功率三项预测；为提升跨场景泛化，使用含线性调制层（LMLs）的新颖神经架构构建三个专用DT模型；利用三个域判别器引导LMLs的少样本（few-shot）微调以快速适应未见场景；并显式考虑Raman放大器（RA）插入损耗以增强实际部署可靠性。
Result: 在35个场景中，LA-DT使NLI、ASE和信号功率预测RMSE分别降至0.151、0.111和0.113 dBm，较基线提升56.0%、58.4%和52.7%，平均GSNR估计RMSE为0.114 dBm（提升55.8%）；在12个未见场景中，仅用每场景20个样本微调即达到平均GSNR RMSE 0.159 dB。
Conclusion: 作者认为LA-DT在多样链路下实现了准确且鲁棒的GSNR估计，并通过少样本微调展现出较强的适应性和鲁棒性，适用于实际部署场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SafeCap: Improving LVLM Safety with Image Captioning Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit visual inputs to bypass safety alignment inherited from their language backbones. We propose SafeCap, a reinforcement-learning framework that aligns LVLMs through learned self-captioning. SafeCap trains a policy model to first generate a safety-relevant image caption and then produce a final answer; the caption is further optimized by whether it enables a frozen LLM to reach a safety-aligned decision. This caption-mediated objective encourages the policy to expose visual cues relevant to safe response generation rather than relying solely on direct refusal supervision. Across five multimodal safety benchmarks and six vision-utility benchmarks, SafeCap substantially improves aggregate safety performance under its intended DirectCap protocol, with gains of 3.7-19.0 points in safety average across four model settings while maintaining comparable or improved vision utility. Under controlled comparisons on matched backbones and data, SafeCap outperforms safety SFT, DPO, and SafeGRPO, demonstrating the effectiveness of caption-mediated reinforcement learning for multimodal safety alignment.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeCap，一种通过自生成图像标题进行强化学习的大视觉语言模型（LVLM）安全对齐框架。策略模型先输出与安全相关的图像标题，再生成最终回答，并以该标题能否让冻结的 LLM 做出安全对齐决策作为优化信号。在五个多模态安全基准和六个视觉效用基准上，SafeCap 在其 DirectCap 协议下将四个模型设置的安全平均分提升 3.7–19.0 点，同时保持或改善视觉效用。
Motivation: LVLM 容易受到利用视觉输入绕过语言骨干安全对齐的 jailbreak 攻击；直接基于拒绝行为的监督可能不足以让模型暴露并利用与安全相关的视觉线索。
Method: SafeCap 采用强化学习框架：策略模型首先生成安全相关图像标题，再生成最终答案；标题通过能否引导冻结的 LLM 到达安全对齐决策来获得奖励，从而鼓励策略暴露与安全响应生成相关的视觉线索。
Result: 在五个多模态安全基准与六个视觉效用基准上，SafeCap 在 DirectCap 协议下的安全平均分提升 3.7–19.0 点（涉及四个模型设置），视觉效用保持相当或更优；在匹配骨干网络与数据的受控比较中优于安全 SFT、DPO 和 SafeGRPO。
Conclusion: 作者认为标题介导的强化学习（caption-mediated reinforcement learning）能有效用于多模态安全对齐，且不依赖仅直接拒绝监督；该结论基于论文所报告的安全与视觉效用基准设置。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Color-Faithful Low-Light Image Enhancement via Adaptive Color Debiasing and Saturation Rectification
papers.abstract_en: Low-light imaging often introduces color bias caused by the low signal-to-noise ratio and the image formation process. Although recent low-light image enhancement methods have achieved strong brightness recovery, faithful color restoration remains challenging, manifesting as overall color bias together with local under- and over-saturation. To address this issue, we propose CAGE, a cylindrical color correction framework with adaptive color debiasing and gamut-harmonized saturation rectification for color-faithful low-light image enhancement. We first introduce AdaLAB, a cylindrical adaptive LAB color space that provides a decoupled and image-specific basis for uniform color correction. Building on this color space, we further develop AdaCCT, an adaptive cylindrical color transform with forward and inverse transforms for the conversion between RGB and AdaLAB color space, as well as necessary color debiasing and saturation rectification. The forward transform suppresses embedded color bias before backbone enhancement by reorganizing the chromatic distribution through chromatic-plane shifting and scaling, while the inverse transform achieves faithful saturation rectification through out-of-gamut lightness compensation. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that CAGE achieves more faithful color restoration, specifically reduces color bias and saturation abnormality, and delivers better overall visual quality across different low-light enhancement backbones. The code is available at https://yangzhichen763.github.io/CAGE/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CAGE，一种面向低光图像增强的圆柱形颜色校正框架，包含自适应颜色去偏（adaptive color debiasing）与色域协调的饱和度修正（saturation rectification）。方法引入柱面自适应 LAB 色彩空间 AdaLAB，并在此基础上设计自适应柱面颜色变换 AdaCCT，通过正反变换在 RGB 与 AdaLAB 之间转换。多基准实验表明该方法能减少颜色偏置与饱和度异常，并在不同低光增强骨干上提升整体视觉质量。
Motivation: 低光成像因低信噪比和成像过程引入颜色偏置，现有低光增强方法虽能较好恢复亮度，但颜色保真仍具挑战，表现为整体色偏以及局部欠饱和与过饱和。
Method: 提出 AdaLAB 柱面自适应 LAB 色彩空间，提供解耦且图像特定的均匀颜色校正基；基于此构建 AdaCCT，正向变换在骨干增强前通过色度平面移动与缩放抑制内在色偏，反向变换通过超出色域（out-of-gamut）的亮度补偿实现饱和度修正。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验显示，CAGE 实现更保真的颜色恢复，具体减少了颜色偏置和饱和度异常，并在不同低光增强骨干上取得更好的整体视觉质量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自适应颜色去偏与饱和度修正可改善低光图像增强中的颜色保真问题，且代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MAP-Graph: Provenance-Aware Shared Memory for Multi-Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Shared memory helps language-model agents reuse information across long workflows, yet relevant evidence may not be admissible for a particular agent or action. Because restrictions propagate through derivations, summaries can conceal private, poisoned, untrusted, or revoked sources, enabling unauthorized reads or unsafe actions. Existing approaches provide semantic retrieval, scoped access, or lineage tracking, but do not clearly separate hard authorization from graded trust or adapt evidence requirements to action risk. We introduce MAP-Graph, a provenance-aware memory layer that represents agents, sources, memories, claims, and actions in a typed execution graph. It traces ancestry, excludes permission-ineligible records, reranks eligible memories by semantic similarity and multiplicative path trust, and applies a risk-sensitive gate before action execution while retaining affected lineage for audit. On a controlled benchmark of 2,700 synthetic tasks per method across three domains, MAP-Graph achieves 94.96\% overall task success, 72.70\% exact decision accuracy, and 90.22\% in the clean setting, where success requires a correct \textsc{Allow} rather than a safe intervention. Ablations isolate the roles of permission filtering, path trust, and action gating, while transfer tests with two additional backbones preserve the exact-decision and access-control advantages. These results support provenance as an operational control signal, rather than only post-hoc audit metadata, within the evaluated setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAP-Graph，一个面向多智能体工作流的 provenance-aware 共享内存层。它把智能体、来源、记忆、声明和动作建模为类型化执行图，通过血缘追踪排除无权限记录，按语义相似度和路径信任重排可用的记忆，并在动作执行前施加风险敏感门控，同时保留受影响的血缘用于审计。在三个领域的 2,700 个合成任务基准上，该方法取得 94.96% 的任务成功率、72.70% 的精确决策准确率，消融实验验证了权限过滤、路径信任和动作门控各自的作用。
Motivation: 多智能体工作流中共享内存虽能复用信息，但相关证据可能对特定智能体或动作不可采纳，且限制会通过推导传播，摘要可能隐藏私有、被投毒、不受信任或已撤销的来源，导致未授权读取或不安全动作；现有方法未清晰区分硬授权与分级信任，也未将证据需求适配到动作风险。
Method: MAP-Graph 构建类型化执行图，追踪记录的血缘关系，排除权限不合格的记录，基于语义相似度和乘法路径信任对合格记忆重排序，并在动作执行前应用风险敏感门控，同时保留受影响的血缘供审计。
Result: 在受控基准（每个方法 3 个领域共 2,700 个合成任务）上，MAP-Graph 总体任务成功率为 94.96%，精确决策准确率为 72.70%，干净设置下为 90.22%；消融实验分离了权限过滤、路径信任和动作门控的贡献，两个额外骨干网络的迁移测试也保留了精确决策和访问控制优势。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果支持将 provenance 作为可操作的运行控制信号，而不仅仅是事后审计元数据，但结论限定于所评估的设置之内。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CARB: A Characterization-Guided Framework for CNN Inference Cost Prediction and Deployment Screening
papers.abstract_en: Accurate pre-deployment estimation of CNN inference cost--energy, latency, and peak memory--is increasingly critical as models are deployed on resource-constrained GPU platforms. Existing approaches rely on FLOPs, latency measurements, or single-device profiling as energy proxies, overlooking the non-linear interactions between architectural design and hardware load. We present a workload characterization study of 13 419 CNN configurations on two GPU platforms (RTX 5090 and RTX 3080) under GPU telemetry, revealing that energy, latency, and memory exhibit fundamentally distinct scaling behaviors: energy and latency diverge by 3x under high computational demand, and cross-GPU transferability differs by target--energy and latency require platform-specific models while memory transfers well across the two tested platforms. Building on these characterization findings, we develop CARB, a cascade-blended ensemble that jointly predicts all three targets with R2 ~0.99, and a two-stage deployment screening workflow that eliminates over 90% of candidates in seconds, reducing large design spaces to a Pareto-prioritized shortlist validated against real hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对13 419个CNN配置在两个GPU平台（RTX 5090和RTX 3080）上进行GPU遥测工作负载特征分析，发现能量、延迟和峰值内存呈根本不同的扩展行为，并提出CARB级联混合集成模型联合预测这三项目标（R2约0.99）以及两阶段部署筛选流程。摘要表明该流程可在数秒内淘汰90%以上的候选配置，将大设计空间压缩为经真实硬件验证的Pareto优先短清单。
Motivation: 现有部署前CNN推理成本估计依赖FLOPs、延迟测量或单设备profiling作为能量代理，忽视了架构设计与硬件负载之间的非线性交互，难以准确预测资源受限GPU平台上的能量、延迟和峰值内存。
Method: 通过对大量CNN配置与双GPU平台的遥测数据进行工作负载特征分析，开发CARB（cascade-blended ensemble）联合预测能量、延迟和峰值内存，并构建两阶段部署筛选工作流，最终输出Pareto优先的候选短清单。
Result: 摘要报告能量与延迟在高计算需求下存在3倍差异；跨GPU迁移性因目标而异，能量和延迟需要平台特定模型，而内存预测在两个测试平台上迁移良好；CARB的R2约0.99；筛选流程可消除超过90%的候选并在数秒内完成。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于工作负载特征引导的推理成本预测与部署筛选能有效压缩大规模CNN设计空间，且筛选结果需通过真实硬件验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RadFusion: Towards Threshold-Controllable Radiology Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automated radiology report generation is advancing rapidly in response to the shortage of radiologists, yet unlike a perception model, existing generation models offer no control over the sensitivity-specificity trade-off of their diagnostic content. Such control is essential because clinical scenarios diverge: emergency triage prioritizes sensitivity to reduce missed findings, whereas confirmatory interpretation emphasizes specificity to limit unnecessary interventions. A single fixed report can neither adapt to these scenarios nor support the ROC-based validation widely expected for regulatory clearance. We introduce RadFusion, a framework that equips report generation with threshold controllability. Our method fuses a multi-label classifier, which provides per-disease confidence scores, with a VQA-based report generator, which describes medical findings in detail; an LLM then rewrites the report so that its stated diagnoses follow the classifier's decisions at the selected threshold while staying grounded in the generator's descriptions. On MIMIC-CXR, the performance of RadFusion conforms to the classifier's ROC curve: sweeping the threshold and mapping the reports back to class labels reproduces the classifier's validated ROC performance. This conformance makes generated reports quantitatively evaluable through ROC analysis, strengthening the case for regulatory clearance, and enables operating-point selection that matches report behavior to clinical context. Moreover, combining the two model types improves diagnostic accuracy over uncontrolled generation: sensitivity increases by 6.9% at matched specificity, and specificity by 20.7% at matched sensitivity. These results show that RadFusion makes report generation clinically adaptable, quantitatively verifiable, and diagnostically more reliable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RadFusion，一个为放射学报告生成引入阈值可控性的框架。该方法将多标签分类器（提供逐疾病置信度分数）与基于 VQA 的报告生成器融合，再由 LLM 改写报告，使报告中的诊断结论遵循分类器在所选阈值下的决策，同时保持与生成器描述的 grounding。在 MIMIC-CXR 上，跨阈值扫描并将报告映射回类别标签可复现分类器验证过的 ROC 性能，并且相对于无控制的生成，在匹配特异性下敏感性提升 6.9%，在匹配敏感性下特异性提升 20.7%。
Motivation: 现有自动放射学报告生成模型无法像感知模型那样控制诊断内容的敏感性-特异性权衡，而临床场景（如急诊分诊 vs 确证性解读）对此类控制有不同需求，且监管审批通常依赖基于 ROC 的验证。
Method: RadFusion 将多标签分类器提供的逐病置信度分数与 VQA 式报告生成器结合，再由 LLM 根据所选阈值改写报告，使报告陈述的诊断与分类器决策一致并保持对生成器描述的忠实。
Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 上，RadFusion 的报告性能沿分类器 ROC 曲线分布；与无控制生成相比，匹配特异性下敏感性提高 6.9%，匹配敏感性下特异性提高 20.7%。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RadFusion 使报告生成具备临床可适应性、可通过 ROC 分析进行定量验证，并提升诊断可靠性。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: RadFusion 将多标签分类器提供的逐病置信度分数与 VQA 式报告生成器结合，再由 LLM 根据所选阈值改写报告，使报告陈述的诊断与分类器决策一致并保持对生成器描述的忠实。
summary_sections.result: 在 MIMIC-CXR 上，RadFusion 的报告性能沿分类器 ROC 曲线分布；与无控制生成相比，匹配特异性下敏感性提高 6.9%，匹配敏感性下特异性提高 20.7%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 RadFusion 使报告生成具备临床可适应性、可通过 ROC 分析进行定量验证，并提升诊断可靠性。

papers.title: MEGA: Self-Evolving Agent Optimization Infrastructure via Wisdom Graph
papers.abstract_en: As coding agents increasingly handle implementation, the central challenge shifts from building individual agents to building an infrastructure that systematically improves them. Current approaches optimize agent systems without accumulating transferable knowledge, accumulate knowledge without compositional reasoning over it, and lack a mechanism for that knowledge to self-evolve through operational evidence. MEGA (Meta Evaluation-Grounded Adaptation) addresses these gaps as a self-evolving infrastructure: each optimization cycle produces durable assets, compositional reasoning over those assets guides subsequent optimization, and operational evidence refines both the accumulated wisdom and the reasoning that governs it. Layer 1 distills reusable wisdom from agent sessions through behavioral-pattern clustering and empirical A/B validation, transforming each process into a durable asset. Layer 2 decomposes these assets into atomic PCR (Primary-Context-Resultant) units within a typed Wisdom Graph and performs deductive, abductive, and inductive reasoning to expand implicit relations; it then assembles context-specific execution plans through compositional retrieval that surfaces bridging knowledge unreachable by embedding similarity alone. Layer 3 performs multi-agent collaborative optimization over heterogeneous agent workflows (code nodes, LLM calls, and tool-using agents), attributing improvement effects to specific strategy changes through controlled evaluation that eliminates data variance. Evidence fed back from Layer 3 drives the self-evolution of both the curation strategies that govern wisdom composition and the optimization trajectories accumulated across runs. The result is an infrastructure in which optimizing an agent system and evolving the knowledge that guides optimization are one and the same process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MEGA（Meta Evaluation-Grounded Adaptation），一个面向编码智能体（coding agents）的自进化优化基础设施。其核心设计是三层结构：从智能体会话中蒸馏可复用智慧，将智慧拆解为类型化 Wisdom Graph 中的原子 PCR 单元并进行演绎、溯因和归纳推理，再对异质工作流进行多智能体协同优化，并通过运行证据回馈驱动知识及其治理策略的自我演化。摘要将优化智能体系统与演化指导优化的知识视为同一过程。
Motivation: 在编码智能体日益承担实现任务的背景下，核心挑战从构建单个智能体转向系统性改进它们的基础设施。现有方法要么优化智能体系统但不积累可迁移知识，要么积累知识却缺乏对其的组合推理，也缺少让知识通过运行证据自我演化的机制。
Method: MEGA 采用三层架构：Layer 1 通过行为模式聚类和经验 A/B 验证从智能体会话中蒸馏可复用智慧；Layer 2 将资产分解为类型化 Wisdom Graph 中的原子 PCR（Primary-Context-Resultant）单元，并利用演绎、溯因和归纳推理扩展隐含关系，再通过组合式检索组装上下文相关的执行计划；Layer 3 对异构智能体工作流（代码节点、LLM 调用、工具使用智能体）进行多智能体协同优化，并通过受控评估归因改进效果。Layer 3 的证据反馈驱动智慧组合的策展策略与跨运行优化轨迹的自进化。
Result: 摘要未报告定量实验指标或基准结果；其宣称的产出是让优化智能体系统与演化指导优化的知识成为同一过程的基础设施。
Conclusion: 本文为包含 29 页和 10 幅图的技术报告，强调自进化基础设施这一设计方向，即通过运行证据同时改进优化轨迹与治理优化的知识本身。

papers.title: From Faulty Memories to Corrected Actions: Dependency-Guided Rollback Repair for Memory-Augmented Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory lets language-model agents reuse information across sessions, but it also makes errors durable: a poisoned, stale, or misattributed record can alter reasoning, tool use, answers, and subsequent memory writes. Existing defenses mainly detect or delete suspicious memories, or revise the current response. Deleting the source leaves already propagated claims, actions, and derived memories active, whereas resetting the store or replaying the full trace destroys benign state and repeats unnecessary computation. We therefore formulate \textbf{post-failure memory recovery: } \textit{given a failed execution and diagnosed faulty memories, recover both the answer and persistent state while retaining unaffected work.} Our \textbf{dependency-guided rollback repair} builds a typed memory-to-action graph from runtime provenance, traces explicit downstream dependencies, preserves candidates with independent trusted support, deactivates unsupported memory state, and selectively replays only answer-relevant affected computation. We evaluate this approach on a 150-case controlled benchmark spanning three tool-use domains and four memory failure types, and on a 50-case trajectory-derived stress test adapted from LongMemEval-V2. On the controlled benchmark, it achieves 85.3\% recovery versus 77.3\% for the best competing recovery method, removes all diagnosed faulty memories, preserves all benign memories, and requires only selective replay with modest LLM-call cost. On the adapted subset, it reaches 68.0\% recovery versus 54.0\% for the next best method, while also achieving the highest claim invalidation F1, 0.669 versus 0.603. Overall, the results do not imply uniformly better trace reconstruction, but show that dependency-guided rollback repair provides a strong recovery--cost trade-off while repairing faulty memory state and preserving benign memory.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出依赖引导的回滚修复（dependency-guided rollback repair），用于记忆增强型语言模型智能体的故障后记忆恢复。该方法从运行时 provenance 构建类型化记忆-动作图，追踪显式下游依赖，保留有独立可信支持的候选，停用不支持的记忆状态，并仅选择性重放与答案相关的受影响计算。在 150 例受控基准和 50 例 LongMemEval-V2 改编压力测试上，恢复率分别达到 85.3%（对比最佳竞争方法 77.3%）和 68.0%（对比 54.0%），且能保留所有良性记忆。
Motivation: 持久记忆让语言模型智能体能够跨会话复用信息，但也使错误持久化：被污染、过期或错误归因的记录会改变推理、工具使用、答案及后续记忆写入。现有防御主要检测或删除可疑记忆、或修订当前响应，但删除源后已传播的声明、动作和派生记忆仍然活跃，而重置存储或重放完整轨迹会破坏良性状态并重复不必要计算。
Method: 将故障后记忆恢复形式化为：给定失败执行和已诊断的故障记忆，同时恢复答案和持久状态并保留未受影响工作。具体构建类型化记忆-动作图，从运行时 provenance 追踪显式下游依赖，保留具有独立可信支持的候选，停用无支持的记忆状态，并选择性重放仅与答案相关的受影响计算。
Result: 在 150 例横跨三个工具使用领域和四种记忆故障类型的受控基准上，达到 85.3% 恢复率（最佳竞争方法 77.3%），移除所有已诊断故障记忆、保留所有良性记忆，且仅需选择性重放并保持适度 LLM 调用成本。在 50 例由 LongMemEval-V2 改编的轨迹压力测试子集上，恢复率为 68.0%（次优方法 54.0%），声明失效 F1 为 0.669（对比 0.603）。
Conclusion: 总体结果并不表明统一的轨迹重建更优，而是表明依赖引导的回滚修复在修复故障记忆状态和保留良性记忆的同时，提供了强恢复率-成本权衡。

papers.title: DSAR: Dual-Stream Autoregressive Modeling of Temporal Cloth Dynamics for Photorealistic Animatable Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Creating photorealistic and temporally coherent animatable human avatars from RGB videos remains challenging. Current methods struggle to capture realistic cloth dynamics, producing over-smoothed appearance or severe artifacts on out-of-distribution poses. This limitation stems from a fundamental oversight: existing approaches neglect the temporal causality inherent in cloth physics, where current states emerge from previous states through temporal evolution rather than instantaneous skeletal configurations alone. Without explicit modeling of this causal structure, networks learn pose-appearance correlations instead of motion evolution, leading to poor generalization. We introduce a dual-stream autoregressive framework that explicitly models both observable geometric information and implicit internal state. The geometric stream propagates surface displacement from the previous frame, while the state stream fuses current features with historical states retrieved from a memory bank. Motion-adaptive aggregation handles spatially-varying dynamics, and adaptive regularization balances smoothness with flexibility. Experiments on challenging datasets demonstrate significant improvements in rendering quality, temporal consistency, and generalization to motion patterns beyond training distributions, validating that dual-stream temporal modeling enables realistic cloth dynamics.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 25 pages, 7 figures, including supplementary material
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DSAR（Dual-Stream Autoregressive）框架，用于从 RGB 视频创建逼真、时间连贯且可动画化的人体化身，核心是显式建模布料动态中的时间因果性。几何流从上一帧传播表面位移，状态流将当前特征与从记忆库检索的历史状态融合，并采用运动自适应聚合与自适应正则化。在挑战性数据集上的实验显示，该方法在渲染质量、时间一致性和对分布外姿态的泛化上都有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有方法从 RGB 视频生成可动画化化身时难以捕捉真实布料动态，容易出现过度平滑的外观或在分布外姿态下产生严重伪影。作者认为根本原因在于这些方法忽视了布料物理内在的时间因果性，即当前状态由上一状态随时间演化而来，而非仅由瞬时骨骼姿态决定；缺乏对这种因果结构的显式建模会使网络学到姿态-外观关联而非运动演化，导致泛化差。
Method: 提出双流自回归建模框架：几何流（geometric stream）从前一帧传播表面位移，状态流（state stream）将当前特征与从记忆库（memory bank）检索的历史状态相融合；同时引入运动自适应聚合（motion-adaptive aggregation）处理空间变化的动态，并用自适应正则化在平滑性与灵活性之间取得平衡。
Result: 实验在挑战性数据集上表明，该方法在渲染质量、时间一致性以及对训练分布之外运动模式的泛化方面均有显著改进，验证了双流时序建模能够实现逼真的布料动态。
Conclusion: 作者强调显式建模布料运动的时间因果结构是提升可动画化身真实感的关键，双流时序建模是有效方案；摘要未给出明确的局限性讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exploration-Driven Personalized Federated Reinforcement Learning via Intrinsic Motivation
papers.abstract_en: Personalized Federated Reinforcement Learning (PFRL) takes a decentralized approach to storing and accessing information based on past experiences while keeping each client's data private during the learning of each client's policy. Many current methods for PFRL rely heavily on exploiting existing reinforcement learning reward signals to derive an optimal policy for each client, thereby neglecting exploration in non-stationary or sparse-reward environments. In this work, we introduce a new exploration-driven framework, Exploration-Driven Personalized Federated Reinforcement Learning via Intrinsic Motivation (EDPFRL-IM), that leverages an inherent curiosity-driven exploration at each client to promote local exploration and protect client privacy. Furthermore, to facilitate policy discovery via exploration in previously unexplored state spaces, clients add an intrinsic random network distillation (RND) signal to their extrinsic reward. Additionally, the server does not have access to clients' raw experiences or local gradient estimates; instead, the server sends global exploration priors and collects minimal novelty summaries from each client to enable both diverse and coordinated exploration among clients. Experiments in benchmark environments show that our framework outperforms average PFRL benchmarks in policy personalization and sample efficiency, primarily in delayed and sparse reward systems. Overall, EDPFRL-IM enables the integration of a flexible exploratory learning structure into federated reinforcement learning systems while preserving client privacy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于内在动机的探索驱动个性化联邦强化学习框架 EDPFRL-IM，在每个客户端引入类似好奇心的探索信号，并将随机网络蒸馏 (RND) 的内在奖励与外在奖励相加，以改善非平稳或稀疏奖励环境下的局部探索与策略个性化。服务器不访问客户端的原始经验或梯度估计，只发送全局探索先验并收集最小化的新颖性摘要，以协调各客户端的探索。基准环境实验表明，该方法在策略个性化和样本效率上优于常见的 PFRL 基准，尤其在延迟和稀疏奖励系统中。
Motivation: 现有个性化联邦强化学习 (PFRL) 方法主要依赖已有的强化学习奖励信号来求解各客户端的最优策略，忽视了非平稳或稀疏奖励环境中的探索，导致探索不足和个性化受限。
Method: 提出 EDPFRL-IM 框架：每个客户端利用内在好奇心驱动探索，将随机网络蒸馏 (RND) 信号加到外在奖励上以促进未探索状态空间的策略发现；服务器只发送全局探索先验并收集每客户端的最小新颖性摘要，从而实现多样化且协调的探索，同时保护客户端隐私。
Result: 在基准环境中的实验表明，该框架在策略个性化和样本效率方面优于平均 PFRL 基准，主要优势体现在延迟奖励和稀疏奖励系统上。
Conclusion: EDPFRL-IM 能够在保护客户端隐私的同时，将灵活的探索性学习结构整合进联邦强化学习系统；其优势场景是延迟与稀疏奖励环境。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种基于内在动机的探索驱动个性化联邦强化学习框架 EDPFRL-IM，在每个客户端引入类似好奇心的探索信号，并将随机网络蒸馏 (RND) 的内在奖励与外在奖励相加，以改善非平稳或稀疏奖励环境下的局部探索与策略个性化。服务器不访问客户端的原始经验或梯度估计，只发送全局探索先验并收集最小化的新颖性摘要，以协调各客户端的探索。基准环境实验表明，该方法在策略个性化和样本效率上优于常见的 PFRL 基准，尤其在延迟和稀疏奖励系统中。

papers.title: SapiensID 2.0: Aligning Human Recognition Foundation Models with Human Perception
papers.abstract_en: While foundation models have significantly advanced human recognition across diverse modalities, they predominantly rely on static, geometric feature extraction. This approach fundamentally diverges from human perception. Consequently, current models often suffer from "semantic blindness," overfitting to transient noise while failing to leverage invariant soft biometrics, and struggle to capture temporal motion signatures. To bridge this gap, we propose SapiensID 2.0, a human recognition framework enriched with both semantic and temporal awareness. To overcome the lack of soft-biometric annotations, we transfer zero-shot semantic knowledge from Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into a discriminative embedding space. We resolve the dimensional mismatch between these spaces using Invariant Trait Alignment (ITA) to distill core persistent traits, and Transient Noise Disentanglement (TND) to decouple artifacts like clothing. Furthermore, we design a Kinematic Semantic Attention Head (K-SAH) that extends spatial attention across temporal windows. By tracking semantic patches over time, K-SAH captures rich kinematic signatures without requiring large-scale video datasets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SapiensID 2.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across image- and video-based person re-identification and gait recognition, while maintaining robust face recognition capabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SapiensID 2.0，一个同时具备语义感知与时间感知的人类识别框架，面向图像和视频中的人体重识别与步态识别。它从多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 迁移零样本语义知识，并通过不变特质对齐 (ITA)、瞬态噪声解耦 (TND) 和运动语义注意力头 (K-SAH) 来弥补现有基础模型过度依赖静态几何特征的不足。实验显示该方法在多项重识别和步态识别任务上达到最优，同时保持人脸识别能力。
Motivation: 现有基础模型在人类识别上主要使用静态几何特征提取，与人类感知方式存在根本差异，导致语义盲区、对瞬态噪声过拟合，并且难以捕捉时间维度的运动特征。
Method: 提出 SapiensID 2.0 框架：利用多模态大语言模型的零样本语义知识并迁移到判别嵌入空间；用 Invariant Trait Alignment (ITA) 解决语义空间与判别空间的维度不匹配并蒸馏稳定特质；用 Transient Noise Disentanglement (TND) 解耦衣物等瞬态伪影；再用 Kinematic Semantic Attention Head (K-SAH) 将空间注意力扩展至时间窗口，通过追踪语义补丁获取运动学特征，无需大规模视频数据集。
Result: 大量实验表明，SapiensID 2.0 在基于图像和视频的人体重识别与步态识别任务上达到最优性能，同时保持稳健的人脸识别能力；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为将语义知识与时间运动特征注入人类识别基础模型可以缓解静态几何特征的局限，并展示了跨任务识别的通用性；摘要未讨论明显局限性。

papers.title: GeoForge: Non-Parametric Self-Evolving Agents for Earth-Observation Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Earth observation (EO) agents construct scientifically valid tool workflows and ground their conclusions in current geospatial evidence. This is challenging because EO workflows are constrained by sensing semantics, product dependencies, spatial and temporal compatibility, and parameter requirements. Existing agents often search a broad operation space for each query, while recent self-evolving systems do not fully organize heterogeneous EO trajectories into reusable knowledge across different decision levels. To solve this problem, we present GeoForge, a training-free, self-evolving framework that transforms completed trajectories into a structured nonparametric execution state. GeoForge constrains the operation space according to the sensing context, then retrieves a task-conditioned prior from three complementary memories. Workflow Graph Memory captures global operation order, Action-Level Experiences provide local corrections, and the Adapted Skill Standard Operating Procedure preserves procedural and data constraints. The retrieved prior guides tool execution, while current observations remain the basis of the final answer. After each task, a safety-gated distillation process converts grounded trajectories into reusable execution knowledge for future retrieval. This execution, distillation, and reuse loop improves planning without updating the backbone LLM. Experiments on multiple geospatial benchmarks demonstrate that GeoForge consistently improves both task accuracy and tool-use trajectory quality across diverse LLM backbones, while substantially reducing tool-planning and reasoning errors for most LLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GeoForge 是一个无需训练的自我进化框架，用于地球观测 (Earth observation, EO) 推理，将已完成的工作轨迹转换为结构化的非参数执行状态，并通过三种互补记忆（工作流图记忆、动作级经验、适配技能标准操作程序）检索任务条件先验来指导工具执行。系统在任务后通过安全门控蒸馏将轨迹转化为可复用知识，形成执行—蒸馏—复用闭环，而不更新骨干大语言模型。实验表明，GeoForge 在多个地理空间基准上持续提升任务准确率和工具使用轨迹质量，并显著减少多数 LLM 的工具规划与推理错误。
Motivation: 现有 EO 智能体常为每个查询搜索过大的操作空间，而近期自我进化系统未能将异质的 EO 轨迹按不同决策层次组织为可复用知识；同时 EO 工作流受传感语义、产品依赖、时空兼容性和参数要求约束，使得构建科学有效的工具工作流很困难。
Method: GeoForge 根据传感上下文约束操作空间，然后从三个互补记忆中检索任务条件先验：工作流图记忆捕获全局操作顺序，动作级经验提供局部修正，适配技能标准操作程序保留程序与数据约束；检索到的先验引导工具执行，当前观测仍作为最终答案基础。任务完成后，通过安全门控蒸馏将已落地轨迹转化为可复用知识，整个过程不更新骨干 LLM。
Result: 在多个地理空间基准上的实验表明，GeoForge 在不同 LLM 骨干上一致提升任务准确率和工具使用轨迹质量，并在大多数 LLM 上大幅减少工具规划与推理错误。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该执行、蒸馏与复用循环可以在不更新骨干 LLM 的情况下改进规划能力，但其验证局限于地理空间基准，未明确覆盖气象降水或临近预报等具体应用。

papers.title: INSIDE the Student's Mind: Jointly Modeling Latent Reasoning and Action in LLM Student Simulators
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based simulators often reproduce observable actions but fail to capture the underlying reasoning behind them. In education, where student simulation is increasingly used for various applications such as evaluating tutoring systems, this gap is especially pronounced. Two students may submit identical submissions for entirely different reasons. We present INTERNAL STUDENT DIALOGUE (INSIDE), a student modeling framework that fine-tunes LLMs not only to act like students but also to think like them. INSIDE generates internal dialogue grounded in Bloom's Taxonomy across cognitive, affective, and action dimensions, and fine-tunes models on paired think traces and actions. We baseline against different prompting frameworks and evaluate on two axes: fidelity of simulated actions and quality of generated internal dialogue. Our evaluations show that INSIDE improves simulation fidelity in both action fidelity, matching code generation of real students, and reasoning alignment, achieving the highest alignment across models up to 57.9%.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 INTERNAL STUDENT DIALOGUE (INSIDE)，一个面向 LLM 学生模拟器的建模框架，旨在让模型不仅模仿学生的可观察行为，还生成背后隐藏的推理过程。作者基于 Bloom 分类法构造认知、情感、行动三个维度的内部对话，并在成对的思考轨迹与行动数据上微调模型。评估显示 INSIDE 在模拟行动保真度和推理对齐方面优于多种提示框架，推理对齐最高达 57.9%。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的模拟器通常能复现可观察行为，但无法捕捉行为背后的推理；在教育场景中，两个学生可能因完全不同原因提交相同答案，这一差距尤为明显。
Method: 提出 INSIDE 框架，将 Bloom 分类法作为理论依据，生成覆盖认知、情感和行动维度的内部对话 (internal dialogue)，并在成对的思考轨迹 (think traces) 与行动数据上对 LLM 进行微调，使模型同时学习像学生一样行动和思考。
Result: 摘要报告 INSIDE 在模拟行动保真度上匹配真实学生的代码生成，并在推理对齐上取得最高 57.9% 的一致性；与不同提示框架的比较中表现更优。
Conclusion: 作者强调联合建模潜在推理 (latent reasoning) 与可观察行动能提升 LLM 学生模拟器的总体保真度，尤其适合评估辅导系统等教育应用。

papers.title: When Vision Becomes Text: Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Residual Guidance in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Abundant visual information strengthens vision-language model (VLM) perception, yet massive visual tokens raise inference costs. Existing visual token pruning methods rely on similarity-based guidance, which exploits pairwise text-vision and vision-vision token correlations for compression. However, such methods only capture local layer-level signals and overlook the whole inference process in VLM. In this paper, we revisit VLM inference and present a new efficient guidance scheme that complements similarity-based guidance. In particular, we identify a key observation: as LLM layers deepen, text tokens continuously aggregate visual information via self-attention and progressively absorb partial visual content into textual representations. To quantify this phenomenon, we propose Cross Modal Absorption (CMA) from a geometric representation perspective to measure how much visual information is absorbed by text, revealing that more visual tokens in deeper layers can be approximately explained by the text subspace. We accordingly propose Cross Modal Residual (CMR). It projects visual tokens onto the text subspace via Tikhonov regularized least squares and exploits reconstruction residuals to quantify visual information that cannot be explained by text. Finally, based on CMR, we present SIEVE, a training-free visual token compression method that combines CMR, text-attention relevance, and residual-space diversity to retain task-relevant and complementary tokens. Experiments on diverse VLM architectures verify the effectiveness of SIEVE. For instance, on LLaVA-NeXT-7B, SIEVE keeps only $11.1\%$ of visual tokens while preserving $97.5\%$ of the original average performance, achieving $3.62\times$ prefill speedup, $2.49\times$ end-to-end speedup, and a $6.02\times$ KV-cache reduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种免训练的视觉 token 压缩方法 SIEVE，其核心是跨模态残差 (Cross Modal Residual, CMR) 指导。作者观察到 LLM 深层中文本 token 通过 self-attention 不断吸收视觉信息，并提出 Cross Modal Absorption (CMA) 从几何表示角度量化这一现象；随后用 Tikhonov 正则化最小二乘将视觉 token 投影到文本子空间，利用重建残差衡量文本无法解释的视觉信息。SIEVE 在 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 上仅保留 11.1% 的视觉 token 即保持 97.5% 的平均性能，并带来 prefill 3.62 倍、端到端 2.49 倍加速和 6.02 倍 KV-cache 缩减。
Motivation: 视觉 token 数量庞大导致 VLM 推理成本高；现有相似性指导 (pairwise text-vision 与 vision-vision 相关性) 的剪枝方法只捕获局部层信号，忽视整体推理过程，压缩效果有限。
Method: 重新审视 VLM 推理并提出跨模态残差指导：用 CMA 量化深层文本子空间对视觉 token 的解释程度，通过 Tikhonov 正则化最小二乘完成视觉到文本子空间的投影，并用重建残差 CMR 衡量不可解释的视觉信息；最终 SIEVE 将 CMR、text-attention 相关性和残差空间多样性结合，保留任务相关且互补的视觉 token。
Result: 在多种 VLM 架构上验证有效：例如 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 仅保留 11.1% 视觉 token 时保持 97.5% 原始平均性能，实现 3.62 倍 prefill 加速、2.49 倍端到端加速和 6.02 倍 KV-cache 缩减。
Conclusion: 摘要强调相似性指导之外，跨模态残差指导可有效补充视觉 token 压缩；SIEVE 作为免训练方法能在显著降低推理开销的同时维持下游任务性能。

summary_sections.result: 在多种 VLM 架构上验证有效：例如 LLaVA-NeXT-7B 仅保留 11.1% 视觉 token 时保持 97.5% 原始平均性能，实现 3.62 倍 prefill 加速、2.49 倍端到端加速和 6.02 倍 KV-cache 缩减。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调相似性指导之外，跨模态残差指导可有效补充视觉 token 压缩；SIEVE 作为免训练方法能在显著降低推理开销的同时维持下游任务性能。

papers.title: Tensor-normal maximum likelihood estimation at the operator-norm sample threshold
papers.abstract_en: Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent Gaussian tensors in $\mathbb{R}^{d_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathbb{R}^{d_k}$ whose covariance is a Kronecker product of $k$ unknown positive-definite factors, and put $D=\prod_{a=1}^k d_a$ and $d_{\max}=\max_a d_a$. A recent result of Franks et al. (2026) established condition-number-free nonasymptotic guarantees for the tensor-normal maximum likelihood estimator under the sample threshold $nD\gtrsim k^2 d_{\max}^3$. They asked whether the cubic dependence on $d_{\max}$ could be replaced by the operator-norm scale $d_{\max}^2$. We answer this question affirmatively. We prove that, for $t\geq 1$, the maximum likelihood estimator exists uniquely with high probability whenever $nD\geq Ck^2 d_{\max}^2 t^2$, and satisfies $d_{\mathrm{FR}}(\widehatΘ,Θ)\leq Ct\sqrt{k}\,d_{\max}/\sqrt{n}$ and $d_{\mathrm{FR}}(\widehatΘ_a,Θ_a)\leq Ct\sqrt{k d_a}\,d_{\max}/\sqrt{nD}$. For every mode of largest dimension, we also obtain the sharp Thompson bound $d_{\mathrm{op}}(\widehatΘ_a,Θ_a)\leq Ct\,d_{\max}/\sqrt{nD}$. No sparsity, condition-number bound or warm start is assumed. For fixed $k$, the threshold has the information-theoretically optimal dependence on $d_{\max}$, and the displayed rates for the full precision and the largest factor match Gaussian minimax lower bounds up to a factor $\sqrt{k}$. The proof extends a random Gram bound for local group-orbit directions to the full local Lie algebra, transports it to a fixed Thompson ball by exact conjugation, and combines sensitivity of a constrained maximum likelihood estimator with an equivariant Kirszbraun extension and Gaussian concentration. This removes the Frobenius-to-operator loss responsible for the previous extra factor $d_{\max}$ and resolves the explicit open problem posed in the earlier work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究张量正态分布（tensor-normal）的最大似然估计在样本阈值下界问题，正面回答了 Franks et al. (2026) 提出的公开问题：能否将样本阈值中关于最大模式维度的三次方依赖 d_max^3 替换为算子范数尺度的 d_max^2。作者证明在 nD ≥ C k^2 d_max^2 t^2 时，极大似然估计以高概率存在且唯一，并给出全精度与各因子的 Frobenius 型速率以及最大维度因子的 Thompson 界。证明去掉了此前 Frobenius-算子范数损失带来的额外因子 d_max。
Motivation: Franks et al. (2026) 在样本阈值 nD ≳ k^2 d_max^3 下建立了张量正态 MLE 的非渐近保证，并明确提出能否将该阈值改进到算子范数尺度 d_max^2。该问题关系到高维张量协方差估计在病态条件下是否仍能保持最优样本复杂度。
Method: 证明方法将随机 Gram 界从局部群轨道方向推广到完整局部李代数，再通过精确共轭将其转移到固定的 Thompson 球上，并结合约束极大似然估计的敏感性分析、等变 Kirszbraun 延拓以及 Gaussian 集中不等式。
Result: 对任意 t≥1，当 nD ≥ C k^2 d_max^2 t^2 时，MLE 以高概率存在唯一，并满足 d_FR(Θhat,Θ) ≤ C t √k d_max/√n 以及 d_FR(Θhat_a,Θ_a) ≤ C t √(k d_a) d_max/√(nD)；对最大维度模式还得到锐的 Thompson 界 d_op(Θhat_a,Θ_a) ≤ C t d_max/√(nD)。对固定 k，阈值关于 d_max 具有信息论最优依赖，且全精度与最大因子的速率与 Gaussian 极小极大下界仅差 √k 因子。
Conclusion: 该结果取消了此前所需的与 Frobenius-算子范数损失相关的额外 d_max 因子，完全解决了 Franks et al. 提出的开放问题，且不假设稀疏性、条件数界或热启动。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Lost in Reconstruction: Aligning Action Representations with Language in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Action verbs describe not only the physical outcomes of actions, but also how those actions are performed. Yet action representations in vision-language-action models (VLAs) are typically optimized for reconstruction under L1/L2 losses in raw action space, where numerical proximity need not reflect linguistically meaningful distinctions. On BridgeV2, we show that action trajectories contain verb-grounding information beyond visual state changes, and that reconstruction-only discrete tokenization systematically erodes this information. To address this problem, we introduce SALT, a Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer that augments a VQ-VAE-style tokenizer with an auxiliary objective requiring a frozen vision-language model to recover the episode instruction from quantized action latents. Policies trained with SALT achieve 71.9% average success in SimplerEnv, compared with 42.7% for a reconstruction-only VQ-VAE tokenizer and 31.2% for FAST. SALT also develops verb-specialized codes while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. These results show that robot action trajectories provide a source of language grounding and that preserving this structure in action representations can substantially improve language-conditioned control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作模型 (VLA) 中动作表征与语言的错位问题，指出在原始动作空间用 L1/L2 重建损失优化的动作表征并不反映语言上有意义的区分。作者提出 SALT (Semantically ALigned action Tokenizer)，在 VQ-VAE 风格 tokenizer 上加入辅助目标，要求冻结的视觉-语言模型从量化后的动作潜在表征中恢复回合指令。在 SimplerEnv 上，SALT 取得 71.9% 的平均成功率，显著高于仅重建的 VQ-VAE tokenizer 的 42.7% 和 FAST 的 31.2%，同时保持重建保真度并发展出动词专用的代码。
Motivation: 动作动词不仅描述动作的物理结果，还描述动作的执行方式；但现有 VLA 的动作表征通常只在原始动作空间以 L1/L2 损失进行重建优化，数值上的接近未必对应语言学上有意义的区分。作者在 BridgeV2 上证明动作轨迹包含超越视觉状态变化的动词接地 (verb-grounding) 信息，而仅重建的离散 tokenization 会系统性削弱这些信息，这限制了语言条件控制的质量。
Method: 提出 SALT，一种语义对齐的动作 tokenizer：在 VQ-VAE 风格 tokenizer 的基础上增加辅助目标，让冻结的视觉-语言模型从量化的动作潜在表征中恢复回合指令，从而迫使离散编码保留与语言相关的语义结构。
Result: 在 SimplerEnv 中，SALT 的平均成功率为 71.9%，对比仅重建的 VQ-VAE tokenizer 为 42.7%、FAST 为 31.2%；同时 SALT 形成动词专用的代码，且重建保真度不降。
Conclusion: 结果表明机器人的动作轨迹本身提供了语言接地的来源，在动作表征中保持这种结构可以显著改善语言条件控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predicting Space Groups of Double Perovskites by LLM with Dynamic Few-Shot Learning
papers.abstract_en: Double perovskites (DPs) offer broad compositional tunability, but predicting the space groups (SGs) of stable structures remains difficult because available datasets are often strongly imbalanced toward dominant SG classes. We refer to dominant SG classes as major SGs and underrepresented classes as minor SGs. We introduce Dynamic and Diversity-enhanced Few-shot Retrieval and Rule-Guided Inference for Space-Group Prediction (DyRIS), an LLM-agent-based framework that predicts ranked SG candidates from a given DP composition. DyRIS uses diversity-enhanced dynamic few-shot prompting to retrieve relevant in-context examples while limiting the dominance of frequently represented SGs. It further incorporates rule-guided inference based on B/B' cation ordering, quantitative indicators, and major-SG bias control to refine and rank the final Top-3 SG candidates. We evaluate DyRIS on 3,528 thermodynamically filtered DP entries and compare it with composition-based and descriptor-based baselines. At a training-data ratio of 0.5, DyRIS achieves competitive overall accuracy while obtaining the best Overall Top-1 macro-F1 score and the best performance across all Minor-SG metrics. DyRIS improves Minor-SG Top-1 accuracy by 3.26 percentage points relative to CrabNet and achieves higher Minor-SG Top-3 accuracy than the strongest PyCaret-based baseline. Ablation studies show that diversity-enhanced retrieval, quantitative indicators, major-SG bias control, and B/B' ordering information each contribute to prediction performance. Additional experiments show that the final rule-guided inference step is not easily replaced by conventional classifier- or ranker-based models. These findings demonstrate the potential of combining retrieval-based LLM reasoning with crystallographic domain knowledge for SG prediction in imbalanced materials datasets.
papers.comment: 46 pages, 6 figures, Supplementary Information included(24 pages)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DyRIS，一个基于 LLM agent 的框架，用于从双钙钛矿 (double perovskite, DP) 成分预测其空间群 (space group, SG) 的 Top-3 候选。针对数据集高度不均衡（少数类 SG 样本少）的问题，DyRIS 结合多样性增强的动态少样本检索和基于 B/B' 阳离子有序性等晶体学规则的推理。在 3,528 个热力学过滤的 DP 样本上，DyRIS 在训练数据比例 0.5 时取得有竞争力的总体准确率，并在 Minor-SG 指标上显著优于 CrabNet 等基线。
Motivation: 双钙钛矿成分可调空间大，但稳定结构的空间群预测困难，因为现有数据集严重偏向主导 SG 类别，导致少数类 SG（minor SGs）预测性能差。
Method: DyRIS 使用多样性增强的动态少样本提示 (diversity-enhanced dynamic few-shot prompting) 检索相关上下文示例，同时限制常见 SG 的过度支配；并引入基于 B/B' 阳离子有序性、定量指标和 major-SG 偏差控制的规则引导推理，以精炼和排序最终 Top-3 SG 候选。
Result: 在 3,528 个热力学过滤的 DP 样本上，DyRIS 在训练数据比例 0.5 时获得竞争力高的总体准确率、最佳 Overall Top-1 macro-F1 以及最佳 Minor-SG 指标；相比 CrabNet 提升 Minor-SG Top-1 准确率 3.26 个百分点，Minor-SG Top-3 准确率高于最强的 PyCaret 基线。消融实验显示多样性检索、定量指标、major-SG 偏差控制和 B/B' 有序性信息均有贡献。
Conclusion: 作者认为将基于检索的 LLM 推理与晶体学领域知识结合，能够有效改善材料数据不均衡下的 SG 预测，且最终的规则引导推理步骤不易被常规分类器或排序模型替代。

papers.title: Multi-Granular Rationale-Guided Molecular LLM for Property Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are widely applied across chemical tasks, such as molecular property prediction, which underpins drug discovery. Molecular LLMs represent a molecule through several modalities, notably a 1D SMILES sequence or a 2D molecular graph. Both encode molecular information implicitly, so the contribution of individual substructures remains opaque. Retrieval and augmentation methods add context, but from external sources. However, the cues chemists reason over are the internal substructures that drive a property up or down. We propose MR-MoL, a multi-granular rationale-guided molecular LLM that supplies this evidence directly. A fine-tuned GNN scores each substructure through masking, and the most influential ones are serialized as a ranked, direction-tagged rationale that the LLM reads alongside the SMILES sequence and molecular graph. The rationale spans three levels of granularity: Murcko scaffolds with their side chains, BRICS fragments, and functional groups. This is, to our knowledge, the first method to expose GNN-derived attributions to an LLM as evidence for property prediction. On eight MoleculeNet tasks, MR-MoL achieves the best overall results among generalist models and narrows the gap to specialist models tuned for each task. Five diagnostics further confirm that the model reads the rationale rather than merely benefiting from its presence. Its direction, rank, and substructure each shape the prediction, and its attributions reproduce known structure-property relationships.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MR-MoL，一种多粒度 rationale 引导的分子 LLM，用于分子性质预测。方法用微调 GNN 通过掩码为各子结构打分，将最有影响的子结构序列化为带方向标记和排序的 rationale，与 SMILES 序列和分子图一起输入 LLM。rationale 覆盖 Murcko 骨架及侧链、BRICS 片段和官能团三个粒度。在八个 MoleculeNet 任务上，MR-MoL 在通用模型 (generalist models) 中取得最佳综合结果，并缩小了与针对各任务调优的专精模型 (specialist models) 的差距。
Motivation: 现有分子 LLM 通过 1D SMILES 或 2D 分子图隐式编码分子信息，单个子结构的贡献不透明；检索和增强方法从外部来源引入上下文，而非化学家实际依据的内部子结构线索，因此缺少可解释的分子内证据。
Method: 提出 MR-MoL：微调 GNN 通过掩码对每个子结构打分，选出影响最大的子结构并将其序列化为带方向标记和排序的 rationale，与 SMILES 序列和分子图共同作为 LLM 的输入；rationale 分为三个粒度，即 Murcko 骨架及其侧链、BRICS 片段和官能团。
Result: 在八个 MoleculeNet 任务上，MR-MoL 在通用模型中取得最佳整体结果，并缩小了与各任务专精模型的差距。五项诊断实验表明模型确实读取 rationale 而非仅受益于其存在；方向、排序和子结构均影响预测，且其归因能够复现已知的结构-性质关系。
Conclusion: 摘要将该工作定位为首次将 GNN 派生的归因 (attributions) 作为证据暴露给 LLM 进行性质预测；诊断实验进一步表明 rationale 的方向、排序和子结构成分都被模型真正利用。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出 MR-MoL：微调 GNN 通过掩码对每个子结构打分，选出影响最大的子结构并将其序列化为带方向标记和排序的 rationale，与 SMILES 序列和分子图共同作为 LLM 的输入；rationale 分为三个粒度，即 Murcko 骨架及其侧链、BRICS 片段和官能团。
summary_sections.result: 在八个 MoleculeNet 任务上，MR-MoL 在通用模型中取得最佳整体结果，并缩小了与各任务专精模型的差距。五项诊断实验表明模型确实读取 rationale 而非仅受益于其存在；方向、排序和子结构均影响预测，且其归因能够复现已知的结构-性质关系。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要将该工作定位为首次将 GNN 派生的归因 (attributions) 作为证据暴露给 LLM 进行性质预测；诊断实验进一步表明 rationale 的方向、排序和子结构成分都被模型真正利用。

papers.title: Bridging Event Streams and DiT: Event-Guided Video Frame Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Latent diffusion models have recently advanced video frame interpolation by synthesizing intermediate frames between input images. However, handling large temporal gaps and complex motion remains challenging, often resulting in motion blur, structural distortions, and temporal inconsistencies. Event cameras provide high-temporal-resolution motion cues that are well suited for bridging these gaps and improving interpolation quality. To exploit this advantage without training an event-assisted model from scratch, we propose an adapter-based framework that incorporates event-derived cues into a pre-trained image-to-video diffusion model with minimal architectural changes. Specifically, our method leverages Image Warped Events (IWEs) and bidirectional sparse optical flow to provide spatially and temporally aligned guidance during generation. By injecting these event-guided structural and motion cues into the diffusion process, our approach reduces interpolation artifacts and improves both reconstruction fidelity and temporal coherence. Experimental results on real and synthetic benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is at https://joseph-lin-tech.github.io/BridgeEventDiT-VFI/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于适配器 (adapter) 的框架，将事件相机 (event camera) 提供的运动线索注入预训练的图像到视频扩散模型，用于视频帧插值 (video frame interpolation)。方法利用 Image Warped Events (IWEs) 和双向稀疏光流提供空间与时间对齐的引导，以减少大时间间隔和复杂运动下的伪影。实验在真实与合成基准上报告了优于现有方法的性能。
Motivation: 潜在扩散模型在视频帧插值中合成中间帧时，应对大时间间隔与复杂运动仍会产生运动模糊、结构失真和时间不一致；事件相机能提供高时间分辨率运动线索，适合弥补这些差距。
Method: 在不从头训练事件辅助模型的前提下，提出适配器框架，将事件派生线索嵌入预训练的图像到视频扩散模型；具体使用 IWEs 与双向稀疏光流提供结构性和运动性引导，并在扩散过程中注入这些事件引导线索。
Result: 在真实与合成基准上的实验表明，该方法一致优于现有最先进方法，并降低插值伪影、提升重建保真度与时间连贯性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过轻量适配方式将事件相机线索注入预训练扩散模型，能够在不做大改动的前提下提升视频帧插值质量。

papers.title: Evaluating Rational Contracting in Natural Language
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of language-based AI agents promises to transform the scope of machine economic activity. Instead of just proposing bids or following hard-coded protocols, such agents can be used to negotiate and execute agreements in open-ended natural language. However, most evaluations of these abilities have focused on one-off exchanges or simple economic games, leaving open the rich space of time-extended, contingent, and incomplete contracts made expressible by language; they also focus on raw profit, without measuring the qualities required for trustworthy contracting. We address this by formulating a rational framework for how agents should negotiate and perform natural language contracts in uncertain multi-step environments. Within this framework, we develop metrics and baselines for quantifying rational and cooperative play. To evaluate how agents perform at such contracting, we instantiate our framework in ContractSim, an evaluation suite where two players negotiate and execute a multi-turn supplier contract under environmental and inter-player uncertainty. Across six environments and three supplier settings (catering, hotel cleaning, and AI hosting) we find that current LLM-based agents reach agreement reliably, and negotiate efficient contracts when environmental uncertainty is low. However, under high uncertainty, they often fail to negotiate satisfiable, efficient, or mutually beneficial contracts. They are also frequently uncooperative when executing contracts, violating contract terms for additional profit even when contracts are easy to satisfy. These findings highlight room for improvement in the design of language agents that can negotiate, interpret, and execute contracts both rationally and cooperatively.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables (Appendix: 34 pages, 6 figures, 9 tables)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个理性框架，用于评估基于语言模型的主体在不确定多步环境中谈判和执行自然语言合同的能力，并实现评估套件 ContractSim。在六个环境和三个供应商设置中，当前 LLM 智能体在低不确定性下能可靠达成一致并谈判高效合同，但在高不确定性下经常失败，且执行合同时常不合作。
Motivation: 现有评估多聚焦于一次性交换或简单经济博弈，且只关注原始利润，未衡量可信赖合同所需的品质，也没有覆盖语言所表达的时间延伸、或有和残缺合同。
Method: 提出一个理性框架，规定智能体应如何在不确定多步环境中谈判和执行自然语言合同；在此基础上开发度量和基线，并实例化为 ContractSim，即一个双方在环境和智能体间不确定性下谈判并执行多轮供应商合同的评估套件。
Result: 在六个环境和三个供应商设置（餐饮、酒店清洁、AI 托管）中，当前 LLM 基智能体在低环境不确定性下能可靠达成一致并谈判高效合同，但在高不确定性下经常无法谈判出可满足、高效或互利的合同，且执行合同时常违反条款以获取额外利润。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些发现表明，需要改进语言智能体在谈判、解释和执行合同方面的理性与合作能力。

papers.title: Stay or Stray - A Dynamical Systems Viewpoint of Popularity Bias
papers.abstract_en: Popularity bias in recommendation systems arises when a majority user class generates disproportionate interaction data, causing the system to increasingly favour it while degrading recommendation quality for niche users. While extensive empirical evidence of popularity bias exists, the dynamics leading to its emergence are not well understood. In this work, we study the coupled evolution of recommender model updates and user engagement through the lens of dynamical systems. We formulate a stochastic process and analyse its asymptotic behaviour through an ordinary differential equation (ODE) framework grounded in two-time-scale stochastic approximation. We characterise the equilibrium points of this dynamical system, and derive conditions under which popularity bias is provably emergent, as well as conditions under which symmetric retention of all user classes is possible. We conduct experiments on synthetic data and real-world production logs derived from a large-scale commercial music recommendation platform to validate our theoretical results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从动力系统视角研究推荐系统中的流行度偏置（popularity bias）：当多数用户类产生不成比例的交互数据时，系统会越来越偏向该类并损害小众用户的推荐质量。作者将推荐模型更新与用户参与的耦合演化建模为随机过程，利用两时间尺度随机近似下的常微分方程（ODE）框架分析其渐近行为，刻画均衡点并给出流行度偏置可证明涌现的条件，也给出所有用户类对称保留的条件。实验在合成数据及大型商业音乐推荐平台的生产日志上验证理论结果。
Motivation: 推荐系统中流行度偏置已被大量经验证实，但其涌现背后的动态机制尚不清楚；作者希望从理论上解释系统如何随模型更新和用户参与的共同演化而偏向多数用户类。
Method: 将模型更新与用户参与的耦合演化形式化为一个随机过程，并通过两时间尺度随机近似（two-time-scale stochastic approximation）建立 ODE 框架，分析系统的均衡点，推导流行度偏置涌现以及所有用户类对称保留的条件，并用合成数据和商业音乐推荐平台的生产日志进行验证。
Result: 摘要给出流行度偏置可证明涌现的充分条件，以及对称保留所有用户类可成立的条件；实验采用合成数据和大规模商业音乐推荐平台的生产日志验证理论结论。
Conclusion: 作者认为动力系统与 ODE 框架能够解释推荐系统中流行度偏置的形成机制，并为如何实现更均衡的用户类保留提供理论条件；摘要未提及具体数值结果或局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Critic-Free Pretraining for Efficient Online Reinforcement Learning Fine-Tuning
papers.abstract_en: Offline-to-online (O2O) reinforcement learning aims to leverage policies pretrained on static datasets while improving them through online interaction. However, directly reusing an offline-trained critic can hinder online fine-tuning: as the policy and data distribution change rapidly, value estimates inherited from offline training may become misaligned with the online environment, leading to inaccurate policy improvement and inefficient exploration. To address this problem, we introduce \textbf{C}ritic-\textbf{F}ree \textbf{P}retraining: an efficient paradigm that completely abandons the approach of offline critic training, allowing a freshly initialized critic to adapt without inheriting biased estimates. CFP is compatible with various mainstream O2O algorithms and consistently matches or improves upon conventional O2O algorithms across a diverse set of tasks, with particularly pronounced gains on several challenging tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Critic-Free Pretraining (CFP)，一种面向离线到在线强化学习 (O2O RL) 的预训练范式，完全放弃离线 critic 训练，改用新初始化的 critic 在在线微调中自适应，以避免继承离线训练产生的有偏价值估计。作者称 CFP 可兼容多种主流 O2O 算法，并在多种任务上持平或超越传统 O2O 算法，尤其在若干困难任务上提升明显。
Motivation: 直接复用离线训练的 critic 会在在线微调中因策略和数据分布快速变化而产生价值估计与在线环境不匹配的问题，导致策略改进不准确、探索低效。该工作针对这一 gap，提出不再训练离线 critic 的新思路。
Method: CFP 完全放弃离线 critic 训练环节，让一个新初始化的 critic 在在线交互中自行适应，不继承离线阶段的估计偏差；该范式设计为与主流 O2O 算法兼容。
Result: 摘要报告 CFP 在多样化任务上一致地达到或超过传统 O2O 算法，并在几个具有挑战性的任务上获得尤为显著的提升；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CFP 是一种高效且通用的 O2O 微调范式，核心启示是避免继承离线 critic 偏差可以改善在线微调效果。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: RLMOpt: Adaptive Prompt Optimization via Recursive Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Prompt optimizers automate the search for prompts that improve language-model performance, but existing methods rely on a predefined optimization procedure: the algorithm determines which candidates to explore and how the search progresses, while the language model generates or refines prompt proposals. We introduce RLMOpt, a prompt optimizer that makes the search policy itself language-model-driven through a recursive language model (RLM). The RLM agent operates over a tool-based environment, inspecting task information, analyzing failures, generating candidates, allocating evaluation budget, and deciding when to stop. A deterministic harness complements the agent by enforcing objective scoring, Pareto-based selection, and regression constraints. We evaluate RLMOpt across four benchmarks spanning structured clinical information extraction (Chia), multi-hop question answering (HotpotQA), verifiable instruction following (IFBench-2025), and multi-turn tool-calling agents (BFCL). In a matched comparison at a single seed, RLMOpt obtains the best held-out score on all four benchmarks and leads the four-task mean (0.610 against 0.589 for GEPA). Repeating each benchmark across seeds yields 11 matched benchmark-seed comparisons, in which RLMOpt outperforms GEPA in 9 cases. Across all 11 runs, it never produced a prompt that underperformed its seed, whereas GEPA fell below its starting point twice. It is also more efficient, achieving these results with fewer search rollouts while producing prompts that are 27-79% the size of those produced by GEPA. Our results further show that optimization gains are determined primarily by the headroom available in the seed prompt, rather than by the search budget. Efficient optimization therefore depends on reaching the available headroom reliably and with minimal search
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RLMOpt，一种让搜索策略本身由语言模型驱动的提示词优化器。它通过递归语言模型 (recursive language model, RLM) 在基于工具的环境中检查任务信息、分析失败、生成候选、分配评估预算并决定何时停止，由确定性 harness 负责客观评分、Pareto 选择与回归约束。在 Chia、HotpotQA、IFBench-2025 和 BFCL 四个基准上，RLMOpt 在单 seed 匹配比较中全部取得最佳 held-out 分数，并在 11 次 matched benchmark-seed 比较中 9 次优于 GEPA，且提示词规模仅为 GEPA 的 27%-79%。
Motivation: 现有提示词优化器依赖预定义的优化过程，算法决定探索哪些候选及搜索如何推进，语言模型只负责生成或改进提示候选。作者认为搜索策略本身也应交由语言模型驱动，以提升优化效果与效率。
Method: RLMOpt 使用递归语言模型作为 agent，在工具化环境中操作任务信息、失败分析、候选生成、评估预算分配和停止决策；配套的确定性 harness 强制执行客观打分、基于 Pareto 的候选选择和回归约束。
Result: 在四个基准的任务均值上，RLMOpt 达到 0.610，优于 GEPA 的 0.589；11 次 matched benchmark-seed 对比中胜出 9 次，且从未产生低于 seed 的提示，而 GEPA 有两次回落。RLMOpt 还以更少的搜索 rollout 实现这些结果，生成提示的大小为 GEPA 的 27%-79%。
Conclusion: 摘要进一步指出优化增益主要由 seed 提示中的可用 headroom 决定，而非搜索预算；因此高效优化取决于可靠地达到现有 headroom 并以最小搜索开销完成。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 RLMOpt，一种让搜索策略本身由语言模型驱动的提示词优化器。它通过递归语言模型 (recursive language model, RLM) 在基于工具的环境中检查任务信息、分析失败、生成候选、分配评估预算并决定何时停止，由确定性 harness 负责客观评分、Pareto 选择与回归约束。在 Chia、HotpotQA、IFBench-2025 和 BFCL 四个基准上，RLMOpt 在单 seed 匹配比较中全部取得最佳 held-out 分数，并在 11 次 matched benchmark-seed 比较中 9 次优于 GEPA，且提示词规模仅为 GEPA 的 27%-79%。

papers.title: A Joint-Distribution Route to Fair Representations with Continuous Sensitive Attributes
papers.abstract_en: Fair representation learning with a continuous sensitive attribute $S$ requires a representation $Z$ that is statistically independent of $S$. Existing criteria, including generalized demographic parity, the expectation of integral probability metrics (EIPM), and mutual information, enforce this independence by averaging a per-value discrepancy between the conditional law $P_{Z \mid S=s}$ and the marginal $P_Z$ over the law of $S$. This approach requires a nonparametric surrogate for the conditional law at each sensitive value. We propose evaluating independence through a single joint discrepancy $d\left(P_{Z, S}, P_Z \otimes P_S\right)$ between the joint law and the product of its marginals. We establish a disintegration identity; on decomposable witness classes it equals the conditional-integral functional that EIPM and generalized demographic parity instantiate. By reaching the same target without the conditional law, this discrepancy can be estimated directly from samples via a dependence statistic rather than conditional smoothing. We take the Hilbert-Schmidt independence criterion (HSIC) as an instance of the joint discrepancy $d$ to investigate the statistical efficiency of replacing the conditional formulation. The HSIC estimator is a closed-form $O\left(n^2\right)$ statistic that converges at the $O\left(n^{-1 / 2}\right)$ rate, in contrast to the nonparametric $O\left(n^{-2 / 5}\right)$ rate of the conditional-route estimators. We prove this instance is equivalent to the conditional maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) integral up to an explicit spectral tail. The corresponding algorithmic implementation, i.e., FRHSIC, attains fairness-accuracy tradeoffs comparable to conditional-route basel es while reducing per-epoch training time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究连续敏感属性下的公平表示学习，提出用单一联合差异 d(P_{Z,S}, P_Z⊗P_S) 来评估 Z 与 S 的独立性，替代现有准则中对每个敏感值先估计条件分布再取平均的做法。作者在可分解的 witness 类上建立了分解恒等式，证明该联合差异与 EIPM 和广义人口均等所对应的条件积分泛函等价；并以 HSIC 为实例分析统计效率，证明其与条件 MMD 积分在显式谱尾意义下等价。对应的算法 FRHSIC 达到与条件路径基线相当的公平-准确率权衡，同时减少每 epoch 训练时间。
Motivation: 现有连续敏感属性下的公平表示独立性准则（如广义人口均等、EIPM、互信息）需要对每个敏感值构造条件分布 P_{Z|S=s} 的非参数替代，统计效率受条件平滑限制。本文旨在绕过条件分布估计，直接用联合分布与边缘乘积之间的差异来评估独立性。
Method: 提出以联合差异 d(P_{Z,S}, P_Z⊗P_S) 作为独立性度量，并在可分解 witness 类上给出其与条件积分泛函等价的分解恒等式。选取 HSIC 作为该联合差异的一个实例，得到闭式 O(n^2) 估计量，分析其收敛速率，并证明该实例与条件 MMD 积分仅相差一个显式谱尾项；算法实现命名为 FRHSIC。
Result: HSIC 估计器的收敛速率为 O(n^{-1/2})，优于条件路径估计器的非参数 O(n^{-2/5}) 速率。FRHSIC 在公平-准确率权衡上与条件路径基线相当，且减少了每 epoch 的训练时间。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，联合差异路径可以在不估计条件分布的情况下达到与条件积分相同的目标，并以 HSIC 为例展示了更优的统计效率。

papers.title: Quantum Incremental Learning with Mixed State Prototypes
papers.abstract_en: Incremental learning models are required to learn new classes sequentially without catastrophic forgetting, while operating under parameter and memory constraints. In the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, although quantum neural networks offer advantages in feature mapping, hardware limitations restrict circuit width. Furthermore, traditional quantum classifiers are constrained by the number of orthogonal basis states, limiting their capacity to accommodate a continually growing number of categories. Thus, we introduce a novel quantum incremental learning framework based on trainable mixed-state prototypes. Its original design incorporates new classes by adding class prototypes rather than increasing the circuit width of the shared quantum backbone. The use of mixed-state prototypes is another key contribution, since they have representation capabilities to represent information than a single pure-state prototype. And the decomposable mixed-state calculation provides lower production costs and a convenient Hilbert-Schmidt (HS) distance metric for classification. Simulation results show that our model achieves high-dimensional feature concentration using a minimal number of qubits, while demonstrating lower computational complexity and robust representation in incremental learning tasks compared with classical baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种量子增量学习框架，使用可训练的混合态原型（mixed-state prototypes）来引入新类别，而不是增加共享量子骨干网络的电路宽度。模拟结果显示，该模型能用最少量子比特实现高维特征集中，并在增量学习任务中相较经典基线表现出更低的计算复杂度和更鲁棒的表示能力。
Motivation: 增量学习模型必须在参数和内存受限的条件下顺序学习新类别且避免灾难性遗忘；在 NISQ 时代，硬件限制约束了电路宽度，而传统量子分类器又受正交基态数量的限制，难以容纳持续增长的类别数量。
Method: 提出基于可训练混合态原型的量子增量学习框架：通过添加类别原型而非扩宽共享量子骨干电路来容纳新类；混合态原型比单一纯态原型具有更强的表示能力，且可分解的混合态计算降低了生产成本，并提供便于分类的 Hilbert-Schmidt (HS) 距离度量。
Result: 仿真结果表明，模型以极少量子比特获得高维特征集中，与经典基线相比具有更低计算复杂度，并在增量学习任务中表现出鲁棒的表示能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，混合态原型结合可分解计算是该框架的关键贡献，使其在 NISQ 硬件约束下能够支持持续增多的类别。

papers.title: MD-ProTector: Positioning Multiple Data-Driven Prototypes for LLM-Generated Text Detection
papers.abstract_en: As LLM-generated content becomes more sophisticated, detection systems for distinguishing those texts from human-written text must operate at scale while handling diverse writing styles, domains, languages, and generator models. Input-only encoder detectors are suitable for practical deployment setting, but standard binary classification supplies only the class label and does not explicitly organize the substantial variation within either class. We propose MD-ProTector, which represents each class with multiple trainable reference vectors in the encoder embedding space, referred to as prototypes. These prototypes provide separate decision boundaries for different groups of texts within the same class. However, adding multiple prototypes alone does not determine which variation each prototype should represent. MD-ProTector addresses this problem with Prototype Positioning loss, which separates class-level structure from the within-class variation that differentiates individual prototypes. Evaluated across five settings from three large-scale benchmarks covering domain, generator, language, and adversarial variation, MD-ProTector achieves the highest AvgRec on MAGE CDCM and RAID and the highest AUROC and lowest FPR95 on RAID among the compared encoder-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MD-ProTector，一种面向 LLM 生成文本检测的输入-only 编码器方法，用多个可训练参考向量（原型）表示每个类别，从而为同一类别内的不同文本变体提供分离的决策边界。为解决多个原型各自应代表哪种变体的问题，作者引入 Prototype Positioning loss，将类别级结构与类内变体分离开。在覆盖领域、生成器、语言和对抗变体的五个设置上，MD-ProTector 在 MAGE CDCM 和 RAID 上取得最高 AvgRec，并在 RAID 上取得最高 AUROC 和最低 FPR95。
Motivation: 现有输入-only 编码器检测器采用标准二分类，只输出类别标签，无法显式组织同一类别内的大量文本变体，难以在大规模、多写作风格、多领域和多语言场景下稳定工作。
Method: 在编码器嵌入空间中用多个可训练的原型向量表示每个类别，为同一类别内不同文本组提供独立决策边界；并设计 Prototype Positioning loss 来分离类别级结构与表征类内变体的原型差异。
Result: 在来自三个大规模基准的五个设置中，MD-ProTector 与所比较的基于编码器的方法相比，在 MAGE CDCM 和 RAID 上达到最高 AvgRec，并在 RAID 上达到最高 AUROC 和最低 FPR95。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过显式建模类内变体并对齐原型位置，可以提升编码器型 LLM 文本检测器在多样化和对抗性条件下的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 6
