papers.title: Persistent Recursive Worlds Enable Autonomous Software Evolution
papers.abstract_en: Complex software systems develop over timescales that exceed the lifespan of any individual coding agent. Most agentic software systems preserve continuity through persistent sessions, memories, managers or shared context. We introduce EvoX Genesis (hereafter, Genesis), which instead makes the software project persistent while allowing local agents to remain finite-lived. Genesis represents software as a persistent recursive world: each local world is situated by an accepted version and a repository path, finite-lived agents propose local changes, recursive delegation moves work across paths, and only accepted consequences advance the persistent version history. We evaluate this organization across formation, continuation and redevelopment. Starting from a repository with no compiler implementation, Genesis used DeepSeek V4 Flash to build a Rust-based C compiler with about 250k tracked lines; the run lasted over 120 hours, archived over 1,000 agent episodes and incurred only US$44 in model-token charges. The compiler passed the complete c-testsuite and most LLVM and Csmith tests. In a separate compiler world generated with GLM 5.2, development continued after repeated agent replacement while retaining full test performance. Genesis also reimplemented 13 MESA modules with over 100k Fortran lines as a Rust workspace with nearly 90k Rust lines; across six numerical workloads, it achieved median speedups of 1.55--6.87x. These results show that long-horizon software development can be organized around a persistent project rather than a persistent agent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EvoX Genesis，将软件项目表示为持久递归世界（persistent recursive world），让本地编码 agent 有限存活而项目本身持续演化。摘要报告它用 DeepSeek V4 Flash 在超过 120 小时、约 1000 个 agent episode、仅 44 美元 token 费用的条件下，从零构建了一个约 25 万行 Rust 的 C 编译器，并通过完整 c-testsuite 及大部分 LLVM/Csmith 测试；在另一个用 GLM 5.2 生成的编译器世界中，反复替换 agent 后仍保持完整测试性能；还将 13 个 MESA 模块（超 10 万行 Fortran）重写为约 9 万行 Rust 的 Rust workspace，在六个数值负载上取得 1.55–6.87 倍的中位加速。
Motivation: 复杂软件系统的发展时间跨度超过任何单个编码 agent 的寿命，而现有 agentic 软件系统大多依靠持久会话、记忆、管理器或共享上下文来维持连续性。作者尝试改变组织方式：让项目持久化，而不是让 agent 持久化，从而支持跨 agent 的长期软件开发。
Method: Genesis 将软件表示为持久递归世界：每个局部世界由已接受的版本（accepted version）和仓库路径（repository path）定位，有限寿命的 agent 提出局部变更，递归委派（recursive delegation）在路径之间移动工作，只有被接受的后果才会推进持久版本历史。
Result: 摘要报告了三类实验：从无编译器实现的仓库出发构建约 25 万行 Rust 的 C 编译器，运行超 120 小时、归档超 1000 个 episode、token 费用 44 美元，通过完整 c-testsuite 和大多数 LLVM/Csmith 测试；在另一编译器世界中反复替换 agent 后保持完整测试性能；以及将 13 个 MESA 模块重写为约 9 万行 Rust，六个数值负载的中位数加速为 1.55–6.87 倍。
Conclusion: 作者认为，长期软件开发可以围绕持久项目而非持久 agent 来组织；持久递归世界配合有限寿命的局部 agent，足以支持软件工程的形成（formation）、延续（continuation）与再开发（redevelopment）三种场景。

papers.title: Rationale-Guided Learning for Multimodal Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal emotion recognition in conversation (MERC) requires understanding complex interactions between verbal and non-verbal cues. However, most existing approaches fundamentally treat this as a direct input-output (multimodal cues-emotion labels) mapping problem, overlooking the causal reasoning that humans use when interpreting emotions. We propose rationale-guided learning (RGL), a novel framework that transforms MERC into a cognitively-inspired reasoning task. Based on dual-process theory, we decompose emotional reasoning into three facets: Intuitive (immediate perception, System 1), Contextual (situational analysis, System 2), and Integrative (synthesis of both). We leverage an MLLM offline to generate structured rationales, which are encoded as memories to guide model training via aligning internal representations with human-like reasoning patterns. Our final model operates without any MLLM overheads at inference time. Experimental results show that RGL achieves state-of-the-art performance on the IEMOCAP and MELD benchmarks. Further, for interpretation, we demonstrate that the model's internal features effectively retrieve semantically correct rationales for unseen test samples, validating its rationale reasoning capabilities.
papers.journal_ref: S. Oh, J. U. Kim and S. Lee, "Rationale-Guided Learning for Multimodal Emotion Recognition," ICASSP 2026 - 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP), Barcelona, Spain, 2026, pp. 12577-12581
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 rationale-guided learning (RGL)，一个将多模态对话情感识别 (MERC) 重构为认知启发推理任务的框架。基于双过程理论 (dual-process theory)，方法把情感推理分解为 Intuitive、Contextual、Integrative 三个侧面，并离线用多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 生成结构化 rationale，编码为记忆来引导训练，推理时无需任何 MLLM 开销。实验在 IEMOCAP 和 MELD 上达到 state-of-the-art，并验证内部特征能为未见测试样本检索到语义正确的 rationale。
Motivation: 现有 MERC 方法大多把任务当作多模态线索到情感标签的直接输入-输出映射，忽略了人类解读情感时所使用的因果推理过程，作者希望引入认知层面的推理机制。
Method: 将情感推理分解为直觉感知 (System 1)、情境分析 (System 2) 以及两者整合三个侧面，离线使用 MLLM 生成结构化 rationale，并将其编码为记忆，通过对齐内部表示与类似人类的推理模式来指导模型训练。
Result: RGL 在 IEMOCAP 和 MELD 基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能；解释性实验表明模型内部特征能够为未见测试样本有效检索语义正确的 rationale，验证了其 rationale 推理能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为 RGL 通过将 MERC 转化为基于 rationale 的推理任务并借助双过程理论分解，可以在不引入推理期 MLLM 开销的情况下提升多模态情感识别性能与可解释性。

papers.title: Towards Efficient Reasoning in LLM-Based Recommender Systems via Model Merging
papers.abstract_en: Large language model-based recommender systems are increasingly adopting slow-thinking models that generate step-by-step reasoning before making predictions, often achieving higher accuracy than fast-thinking models that predict directly. However, their reasoning traces are often unnecessarily verbose, increasing inference costs without commensurate accuracy gains. Existing training-based approaches to reasoning compression often incur substantial adaptation costs, while inference-time methods are brittle and difficult to scale. These limitations motivate model merging as a promising training-free direction for transferring specialised behaviours between models in a shared parameter space. In particular, merging a slow-thinking model with a fast-thinking counterpart provides a natural mechanism for balancing recommendation accuracy and reasoning conciseness. To this end, we propose, to our knowledge, the first model merging framework for reasoning compression in recommender systems. Unlike conventional merging methods that apply uniform merge coefficients across model components, our method performs fine-grained merging at the level of individual attention heads, capturing heterogeneous patterns in recommendation reasoning. Each attention head is assigned a distinct merge coefficient according to its contribution to critical reasoning evidence and its sensitivity to parameter change, enabling selective injection of the concise behaviour of the fast-thinking model into the slow-thinking model and reducing reasoning verbosity without compromising recommendation quality. Experiments on three benchmark datasets show that our method reduces reasoning length by up to 24.3% while outperforming competitive model merging baselines in maintaining recommendation accuracy. The code is available at https://github.com/linhledieu/REAM.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向基于大语言模型的推荐系统的模型合并框架 REAM，目标是在保持推荐准确性的前提下压缩慢思考模型的推理长度。方法在注意力头级别进行细粒度合并，为每个头分配不同合并系数，将快思考模型的简洁行为选择性注入慢思考模型。在三个基准数据集上，推理长度最多减少 24.3%，且优于竞争性模型合并基线。
Motivation: 慢思考模型通过逐步推理获得更高准确率，但其推理痕迹往往冗长，增加推理成本却收益不成比例。现有基于训练的压缩方法适配成本高，推理时方法脆弱且难扩展，因此作者转向模型合并这一免训练方向，以平衡推荐准确性与推理简洁性。
Method: 提出据作者所知首个面向推荐系统推理压缩的模型合并框架，在注意力头级别执行细粒度合并，而非对所有组件使用统一合并系数。每个注意力头依据其对关键推理证据的贡献和对参数变化的敏感性获得独立合并系数，从而选择性注入快思考模型的简洁行为。
Result: 在三个基准数据集上，推理长度最多减少 24.3%，同时在保持推荐准确性方面优于竞争性模型合并基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为注意力头级别的细粒度合并能够在不牺牲推荐质量的前提下降低推理冗长度，并已开源代码。

papers.title: From Reasoning Depth to Reasoning Breadth: Evaluating Multi-Point Associative Reasoning in Large Language Models
authors: Ming Wu (1) ((1) Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have made substantial progress on reasoning tasks that require increasingly long and complex inferential chains. This progress primarily reflects reasoning depth. A complementary and comparatively unexamined capability is reasoning breadth: exploring multiple semantic directions in parallel and integrating the resulting clues into one coherent answer. We introduce MPAR-Bench, a bilingual English-Chinese benchmark that isolates reasoning breadth through multi-point associative reasoning. Inspired by the cooperative game Just One, each item asks a model to recover a hidden target from several independently generated, semantically diverse clues. We construct 1,000 items using a multi-agent clue-generation pipeline, embedding-based diversity filtering, and human verification. Only the answer space is drawn from public word lists, whereas every clue set is generated from scratch. Beyond exact-match accuracy, we evaluate models using accuracy, ANLS, embedding similarity, reasoning-trace verification, and four perturbations: clue masking, order shuffling, distractor injection, and multi-step clues. Across evaluated models, perturbations reduce accuracy by 9-18 percentage points in English and 5-12 percentage points in Chinese. Thinking mode improves standard-setting accuracy, especially in English, but does not consistently reduce sensitivity to perturbations. Case-level analysis also shows that extended reasoning can overturn an initially correct hypothesis. These results indicate that greater reasoning depth does not automatically confer robust reasoning breadth, and that reasoning breadth remains largely uncovered by current benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MPAR-Bench，一个中英双语基准，通过多点联想推理 (multi-point associative reasoning) 来评估大语言模型的推理广度 (reasoning breadth)，以补充对推理深度 (reasoning depth) 的既有研究。基准受合作游戏 Just One 启发，要求模型从多个独立生成的语义多样线索中恢复隐藏目标，共包含 1000 个条目，线索集完全从零生成。评测发现扰动会使准确率在英文上下降 9-18 个百分点、中文上下降 5-12 个百分点，且思考模式虽提升标准准确率却未稳定降低扰动敏感性。
Motivation: 现有推理研究主要关注越来越长和复杂的推理链，即推理深度，而推理广度——并行探索多个语义方向并整合线索——这一互补能力几乎未被考察，也未被现有基准覆盖。
Method: 构建 MPAR-Bench，采用多智能体线索生成管线、基于嵌入的多样性过滤和人工验证，生成中英双语 1000 个条目；评测除精确匹配外，还使用 ANLS、嵌入相似度、推理轨迹验证，并引入线索遮蔽、顺序打乱、干扰项注入和多步线索四种扰动。
Result: 在评估的模型中，扰动使英文准确率下降 9-18 个百分点、中文下降 5-12 个百分点；思考模式提升标准设定下的准确率，尤其在英文上，但不能一致地降低对扰动的敏感性；案例层面显示扩展推理可能推翻最初正确的假设。
Conclusion: 结果表明更大的推理深度并不会自动带来稳健的推理广度，推理广度在很大程度上仍未被现有基准覆盖。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FUSE: Frame-Unified Stress Estimation from Facial Video
papers.abstract_en: Automatic stress detection from facial video offers a practical path to non-intrusive affect monitoring, yet existing video-based approaches commonly decompose full recordings into short temporal windows before classification. This design introduces additional choices regarding window length, overlap, and aggregation, while limiting direct analysis of temporal information across the entire recording. In this study, we present FUSE (Frame-Unified Stress Estimation), a facial-video stress detection framework that processes complete recordings as a single input without temporal windowing or external segmentation. The name reflects the defining operation of the method: rather than dividing a recording into short clips, all frames are fused into one unified two-dimensional representation from which the stress state is estimated. This unification is realized by folding the temporal dimension into the channel dimension of the spatial representation, and the resulting high-dimensional input is processed using a unified asymmetric-attention architecture. At a temporal stride of t = 1, FUSE retains the full 120-second recording as one input, corresponding to 3,600 frames at 30 fps. Experiments on a 58-subject stress dataset using a stratified subject-level protocol evaluate seven temporal-stride configurations, ranging from full-frame input to sparse subsampling. FUSE achieves the highest test accuracy of 69.44% at t = 15, while the full-frame configuration remains competitive at 69.03%. Across the stride range, computational cost varies from 12.48 to 348.78 GFLOPs, showing the trade-off between temporal density and efficiency. These results demonstrate that temporal windowing is not required for effective facial-video stress detection in this setting, and that complete-recording inference can be achieved within a single unified architecture.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted at: IEEE | 2026 9th International Conference on Pattern Recognition and Artificial Intelligence (PRAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FUSE (Frame-Unified Stress Estimation)，一种直接从完整面部视频估计压力状态的方法，不做时间窗口切分或外部分段。该方法将整段录制的时序维度折叠到通道维度，形成统一的高维二维表示，并用统一的不对称注意力架构 (asymmetric-attention) 处理。在 58 名受试者的压力数据集上，按受试者分层协议评估七种时间步长配置，最高测试准确率为 69.44% (t=15)，全帧配置为 69.03%，计算量在 12.48 至 348.78 GFLOPs 之间。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的压力检测通常将完整录制分解为短时间窗口再进行分类，这引入了窗口长度、重叠和聚合方式的额外选择，并限制了跨整段录制的时序信息分析。作者希望论证时间窗口化并非必需，并实现整段录制的单输入推理。
Method: FUSE 将所有帧融合为单个统一的二维表示，具体方式是把时间维度折叠进空间表示的通道维度；随后用统一的不对称注意力架构处理该高维输入。实验评估 t=1 到稀疏子采样共七种时间步长配置，t=1 时完整保留 120 秒、30 fps 下共 3600 帧。
Result: 在 58 名受试者的压力数据集上，采用分层受试者级协议，FUSE 在 t=15 时达到最高测试准确率 69.44%，全帧配置 t=1 时为 69.03%；计算成本从 12.48 到 348.78 GFLOPs 变化，体现时间密度与效率的权衡。
Conclusion: 结果表明在该设置下，有效的人脸视频压力检测不需要时间窗口化，完整录制推理可以在单一统一架构内完成。

papers.title: Detecting an Effect Is Not Learning to Act on It: A Reward-SNR Floor for LLM Acquisition Agents
papers.abstract_en: Many pipelines can pay a per-example cost to acquire an auxiliary, model-derived observation -- an LLM's structured reasoning, a slow oracle, an expensive measurement -- and then must decide when the acquired signal is worth using. Our thesis is a distinction that is easy to miss: detecting that such a signal helps on average is not the same as learning to act on it per instance, and a reward-SNR floor governs when the second is even possible. Even when the signal is faithful and an in-sample oracle picking the top-b examples by realized reward shows a sizable apparent gain, no deployable policy can learn when to acquire it: across per-impression, cluster, regime, and uplift-tree granularities, learned routing never beats random, and a matched-moment noise placebo reproduces >=100% of the oracle's apparent gain -- the apparent "learnable structure" is order statistics of noise. We explain this with one distinction, detecting a mean effect vs. learning a per-instance acquisition policy, and a reward-SNR detectability floor: routing is estimable offline only if the reward SNR rho clears rho*(N) ~= 2.8/sqrt(N), with a positive control confirming a true low-SNR limit rather than a broken pipeline. As a concrete instantiation we introduce Structured Hypothesis Embeddings (SHE): a frozen LLM turns a user history into ranked, confidence-scored, evidence-grounded intent hypotheses, fused into a recommender. On three public datasets (MIND, REES46, Amazon-Beauty), SHE is faithful and calibratable, yet its value is backbone- and regime-conditional (significant over an ordered GRU, +0.0114, 95% CI [+0.0030, +0.0209], but a global redundancy gap indistinguishable from zero), and learned acquisition collapses at every granularity because all three datasets sit below the floor. The realizable unit is a design-time regime gate, not a per-instance policy. We release code and a one-command reproduction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文区分两种能力：在平均意义上检测某个辅助信号有效，与在逐个样本上学会何时获取该信号。作者提出一个奖励信噪比 (reward SNR) 检测下限，认为路由策略只有在该信噪比超过 ~2.8/sqrt(N) 时才可离线估计；即使 oracle 在样本内选中 top-b 样本显示可观的表观增益，学到的路由也不会优于随机。论文以结构化假设嵌入 (SHE) 为具体实例，将冻结 LLM 生成的有序、带置信度、有证据支撑的意图假设融合进推荐系统，并在 MIND、REES46、Amazon-Beauty 三个数据集上验证。
Motivation: 许多流水线可以按样本付费获取辅助的模型衍生观测（如 LLM 的结构化推理、慢速 oracle、昂贵测量），但需要决定何时值得使用该信号；现有做法容易混淆平均效应与逐样本行动策略，导致对可学习性的错误假设。
Method: 提出奖励信噪比可检测性下限 rho*(N) ≈ 2.8/sqrt(N)，并给出离线可估计性条件；同时引入 SHE：用冻结 LLM 把用户历史转成排序的、带置信度和证据支撑的意图假设，再融合进推荐器。作者在多个粒度（per-impression、cluster、regime、uplift-tree）上比较学习路由与随机路由，并用匹配矩的噪声安慰剂做对照。

papers.title: Stream Forcing: Constructing Unified Training Trajectory for Robust Streaming Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Streaming video generation holds strong potential for world modeling, where future frames must be inferred online sequentially to form a continuous video stream. However, streaming video diffusion models introduce a fundamental train-inference mismatch: inference follows a specialized denoising order, whereas advanced training strategies typically require diverse noise-level configurations. To address this trade-off between train-inference consistency and training coverage, we reformulate the video diffusion sampling as a frame-indexed stochastic process over noise levels. Within this stochastic process space, we construct a continuous training trajectory along which the sampling schedule progressively evolves from independent sampling to inference-consistent sampling. We further introduce a joint calibration algorithm and a temporal correlative sampling algorithm to ensure trajectory smoothness and cross-frame correlation. Building on these designs, we propose Stream Forcing, a unified training framework for streaming video generation that balances training sufficiency and inference efficiency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Stream Forcing significantly improves generation quality with a 36.6% FVD improvement on the UCF-101 benchmark. Furthermore, our method facilitates robust zero-shot extrapolation to long-horizon video generation with a 27.9% FVD improvement on the UCF-101 benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stream Forcing，一个面向流式视频生成的统一训练框架。作者将视频扩散采样重表述为噪声水平上的帧索引随机过程，在该过程空间内构造从独立采样渐进演化到推理一致采样的连续训练轨迹，并引入联合校准算法与时间相关采样算法。实验表明该方法在 UCF-101 上带来 36.6% 的 FVD 改进，并支持零样本长时程视频生成的稳健外推（FVD 改进 27.9%）。
Motivation: 流式视频扩散模型存在根本的训练-推理不匹配：推理过程遵循专门的去噪顺序，而先进训练策略通常需要多样的噪声水平配置，导致训练充分性与推理一致性之间存在权衡。
Method: 将视频扩散采样重表述为帧索引的随机过程，在该随机过程空间中构建连续训练轨迹，使采样调度从独立采样逐步过渡到推理一致的采样；同时提出联合校准算法和时序相关采样算法以保障轨迹平滑性与跨帧相关性，最终形成统一训练框架 Stream Forcing。
Result: 在 UCF-101 基准上，生成质量获得 36.6% 的 FVD 改进；在零样本长时程视频生成外推中进一步获得 27.9% 的 FVD 改进。
Conclusion: Stream Forcing 通过统一训练轨迹平衡了训练充分性与推理效率，显著提升流式视频生成质量并增强长时程外推的稳健性。

papers.title: Continuous Interaction Diffusion: A Diffusion-Native Runtime for Asynchronous Tool-Augmented Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models increasingly rely on external tools to access up-to-date information, perform computation, and interact with the outside world. For autoregressive models, tool use naturally fits the generation process: the model emits a tool call, waits for the result, and then continues generating. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), however, reason by repeatedly refining many parts of their output in parallel, making this stop-and-resume interaction pattern unnecessarily restrictive. It can force tool decisions before the model's reasoning has stabilized, delay useful observations until a discrete call finishes, and introduce redundant refinement and tool execution, potentially hurting both task accuracy and inference efficiency. We introduce Continuous Interaction Diffusion (CID), a diffusion-native model--runtime architecture that integrates tool interaction into iterative denoising. CID separates a model-read-only fact channel, a thought channel represented by a Typed Cognitive Tensor, and a display channel. Information needs can emerge before a textual or JSON call is fully serialized, allowing perceptual bindings to launch external reads while denoising continues. Returned results are projected into the evolving thought state and can revise earlier cognition and display regions. Persistent bindings reuse static results without repeated external execution and refresh changing sources when needed. CID is designed to expose evidence earlier, overlap tool latency with model computation, reduce duplicate external work, and preserve useful computation after new evidence arrives. We formalize the architecture, runtime, and training objectives, and define an evaluation protocol for task quality and end-to-end efficiency. This first paper focuses on read-only tools and makes no empirical performance claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Continuous Interaction Diffusion (CID)，一种扩散原生的模型-运行时架构，把工具调用集成进扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 的迭代去噪过程。CID 将状态划分为模型只读的事实通道、以 Typed Cognitive Tensor 表示的思维通道和显示通道，允许信息需求在文本或 JSON 调用完全序列化之前出现，从而让感知绑定 (perceptual bindings) 在去噪继续的同时触发外部读取。返回结果被投影回思维状态并可修正早期认知与显示区域，持久化绑定 (persistent bindings) 复用静态结果并刷新变化来源。论文形式化了架构、运行时和训练目标并定义评估协议，但明确不做经验性能声明。
Motivation: 自回归模型天然以发出工具调用、等待结果、继续生成的停止-恢复方式工作，而扩散语言模型并行精炼大量输出，使这种交互被不必要地限制：可能过早做出工具决策、延迟观察结果、引入冗余的精炼与工具执行，进而损害任务准确率与推理效率。
Method: CID 是一种扩散原生的模型-运行时架构，将工具交互嵌入迭代去噪：区分模型只读的事实通道、由 Typed Cognitive Tensor 表示的思维通道和显示通道；感知绑定可在调用尚未完全序列化时启动外部读取，返回结果投影进演化的思维状态并可修订早期认知与显示区域；持久化绑定复用静态结果、按需刷新变化中的来源。论文同时形式化了该架构、运行时与训练目标，并定义了任务质量与端到端效率的评估协议。
Result: 摘要未给出任何定量结果，明确说明本文聚焦只读工具且不做出经验性能声明。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CID 的设计目标是更早暴露证据、用模型计算重叠工具延迟、减少重复外部执行，并在新证据到达后保留有用计算；本文作为该方向的第一篇论文只覆盖只读工具，经验评估留待后续工作。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: MammoMix: Leveraging Mixture of Experts for Robust Mammogram Breast Detection
papers.abstract_en: Breast lesion detection in mammography remains a challenging task due to variations in image quality, lesion appearance, and population demographics across datasets. While current object detectors such as YOLO and DETR achieve strong results on individual datasets, their performance often degrades when trained on or applied across heterogeneous sources. To address this, we propose MammoMix, a novel framework based on Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) paradigm for robust and generalizable lesion detection. In MammoMix, each expert model is trained on a specific domain, allowing it to specialize in distinct characteristics of its source data. A gating mechanism adaptively weighs contributions from each expert based on input image, combining their outputs to enable domain-adaptive inference. To improve reliability, we further incorporate a calibration module, MoCAE, which adjusts confidence scores to reflect true predictive uncertainty. We evaluate MammoMix on 3 public mammography datasets: CSAW, DDSM, and DMID, covering diverse clinical settings. Results show that MammoMix outperforms baseline detectors in both average precision and reliability, particularly on datasets with greater variability. Our findings demonstrate that expert specialization and calibrated ensemble fusion significantly enhance model generalization and robustness. MammoMix offers a promising step toward dependable AI-assisted breast cancer screening across real-world clinical domains.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MammoMix，一种基于 Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) 的乳腺钼靶病灶检测框架，用于提升跨数据集的鲁棒性与泛化能力。每个专家模型在特定域上训练以学习数据特有特征，门控机制根据输入图像自适应地加权各专家输出，并引入校准模块 MoCAE 调整置信度以反映真实预测不确定性。在 CSAW、DDSM 和 DMID 三个公开乳腺钼靶数据集上的实验表明，MammoMix 在平均精度和可靠性上均优于基线检测器。
Motivation: 现有目标检测器如 YOLO 和 DETR 在单一数据集上表现良好，但面对图像质量、病灶外观和人群分布差异较大的异构乳腺钼靶数据时，性能容易下降，导致跨域泛化不足。
Method: 基于 MoE 范式构建框架：每个专家模型在特定临床域上训练以实现专化，门控机制按输入图像自适应融合各专家输出；另加入校准模块 MoCAE，对置信度分数进行校正，使其更贴近真实预测不确定性。
Result: 在 CSAW、DDSM 和 DMID 三个公开乳腺钼靶数据集上的评估显示，MammoMix 在平均精度 (average precision) 和可靠性指标上均超过基线检测器，尤其在变异性更大的数据集上提升更明显。
Conclusion: 作者认为专家专化和校准后的集成融合能显著增强模型的泛化性与鲁棒性，MammoMix 是迈向跨真实临床域可靠 AI 辅助乳腺癌筛查的一步。

papers.title: DynaPPI: A Large-scale Dynamic Protein Dataset for AI-driven Advances in Protein Interactomics
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have been widely explored in protein backbone generation due to their powerful generation capabilities.However, in today's AI-driven biological research, predicting the structure of unknown multi-chain protein aggregates (called "complexes" in biology) remains an unsolved challenge.This is because existing static or dynamic protein datasets focus solely on static snapshots or single-entity trajectories, neglecting the dynamic process of multiple monomers forming complexes.To alleviate this dilemma, we present DynaPPI, a dynamic protein dataset comprising molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories of protein complex formation from dissociated chains to the bound state, as a pivotal resource to bridge the gap between static structural biology and the inherently temporal nature of dynamic molecular interactions.Benefiting from this dataset, diffusion models can explicitly learn the dynamic binding trajectories of known complexes and accurately predict the structures of unknown complexes based on their diverse generative properties, thereby further catalyzing AI-driven structural biology and protein interactomics.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DynaPPI，一个包含蛋白质复合物形成过程的分子动力学 (MD) 轨迹数据集，轨迹覆盖从解离链到结合态的完整动态过程。作者认为该数据集可弥补现有静态或单实体动态数据集忽视多聚体组装动态的不足，使扩散模型能够学习已知复合物的动态结合轨迹并预测未知复合物结构。

papers.title: Conversational versus Dashboard Explainable AI for UAV Intrusion Detection: An Empirical Study of Operator Trust and Reliance
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) have demonstrated superior performance in securing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks. However, the 'black-box' nature of these models, combined with the high dimensionality of multimodal cyber-physical data, poses significant interpretability challenges. Static visualization dashboards may struggle to present complex relationships among multimodal cyber-physical features in a form that is easy for operators to inspect and interpret. To address this, we propose a Conversational XAI interface powered by Large Language Models (LLM) to facilitate on-demand investigation. In a controlled experiment with participants, we systematically evaluated the impact of this conversational interface versus a traditional XAI Dashboard on operator understanding, trust, and reliance during post-incident auditing tasks. Our results suggest that the conversational interface was perceived as more useful than the dashboard, potentially because it helped participants access and synthesize relevant information more easily. However, this benefit was accompanied by a lower level of appropriate self-reliance, indicating a potential risk of over-reliance. One possible interpretation is that the natural-language responses made the AI advice easier to accept, which may have reduced participants' tendency to verify the underlying evidence when the IDS was incorrect. These findings point to a potential trade-off in human-AI collaboration for UAV intrusion auditing: interaction mechanisms that improve perceived usability may also increase the risk of inappropriate reliance. We conclude by discussing design implications for future XAI systems that balance seamless interaction with cognitive forcing functions to foster appropriate reliance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对无人机网络入侵检测系统中机器学习模型的黑盒特性和多模态数据高维可解释性问题，提出一种由大语言模型驱动的对话式 XAI 界面，并与传统 XAI 仪表盘在后事件审计任务中进行受控实验对比。研究发现，对话式界面被认为比仪表盘更有用，但伴随更低水平的适当自我依赖，提示存在过度依赖的风险。
Motivation: 基于机器学习的入侵检测系统在无人机网络安全中表现优越，但模型的'黑盒'性质以及多模态信息物理数据的高维性带来显著可解释性挑战；静态可视化仪表盘可能难以以易于操作员检查和解释的形式呈现复杂特征关系。
Method: 提出基于大语言模型的对话式 XAI 界面以支持按需调查，并在受控实验中系统比较该界面与传统 XAI 仪表盘对操作员理解、信任和依赖的影响。
Result: 结果显示对话式界面在感知上有用性更高，可能是因为它帮助参与者更容易获取和综合相关信息；但该收益伴随更低水平的适当自我依赖，表明存在过度依赖的潜在风险。
Conclusion: 作者指出无人机入侵审计中的人类-AI 协作存在权衡：提升感知可用性的交互机制可能增加不适当依赖的风险，并讨论了未来 XAI 系统通过认知强制功能平衡无缝交互以培养适当依赖的设计启示。

papers.title: Do Time-Series Forecasters Use the Right History: Recoverability, Recovery, and Functional Use of Temporal Delays
papers.abstract_en: Forecast accuracy does not tell us which past inputs produced a prediction. We separate three questions for time-series models with known delay structure: can the true delay be recovered from the observed data, does the model report it, and does the forecast actually use the same history? We first derive input-conditioned recoverability measures that separate intrinsic ambiguity from model error. We then prove that a delay report can become arbitrarily reliable while forecast risk approaches the oracle even though the predictor still uses the wrong lag. This failure also appears in finite samples on the point-delay task: among forecasts with a correct delay report and normalized excess risk within 10\% of the oracle, the reported history is functionally unused under our matched masking test in 55.4\% of N-HiTS cases and 92.7\% of TCN cases. Finally, we show that routing the prediction through the reported history removes off-report bypass paths; a hard one-hot control achieves exact fixed-report alignment. The main conclusion is simple: a good forecast, even with a correct delay report, does not show that the model used the right history.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究时间序列预测模型是否真正使用了正确的历史输入（滞后），区分三个问题：能否从观测数据恢复真实延迟、模型是否报告该延迟、预测实际是否使用相同历史。作者提出输入条件化的可恢复性度量来分离内在模糊性与模型误差，并证明延迟报告可以任意可靠且预测风险接近 oracle，而预测器仍可能使用错误滞后。在点延迟任务的有限样本中，具有正确延迟报告且归一化超额风险在 oracle 10% 以内的预测，在匹配遮蔽测试下报告历史在 55.4% 的 N-HiTS 情况和 92.7% 的 TCN 情况下功能上未被使用。
Motivation: 预测精度无法告诉我们哪些过去输入产生了预测；即使模型报告了正确的延迟，其预测也可能并没有真正使用该历史，因此需要把内在模糊性、报告正确性与功能使用性三者分离。
Method: 提出输入条件化的可恢复性度量（input-conditioned recoverability measures）以区分内在模糊性与模型误差；通过证明构造说明延迟报告可靠性可与错误滞后共存；最后提出将预测路由到报告历史以移除 off-report 旁路路径，并用 hard one-hot control 实现精确的固定报告对齐（fixed-report alignment）。
Result: 在点延迟任务上，对延迟报告正确且归一化超额风险在 oracle 10% 以内的预测做匹配遮蔽测试，报告历史在 55.4% 的 N-HiTS 案例和 92.7% 的 TCN 案例中在功能上未被使用。
Conclusion: 主要结论是：一个良好甚至延迟报告正确的预测，并不能证明模型使用了正确的历史输入；通过报告历史路由预测可以消除旁路路径并实现固定报告对齐。

papers.title: What We Know about Responsible AI Practices in Industry: A Half Decade of Empirical Research
papers.abstract_en: Responsible AI (RAI) has become a central concern for technology companies, regulators, and the public. How industry practitioners interpret, implement, and sustain RAI work directly shapes the design and deployment of AI systems. As empirical scholarship examining RAI practices in industry has rapidly expanded, findings are dispersed across studies that focus on different roles, organizational contexts, and interventions. This work synthesizes current knowledge through a literature review of 161 empirical studies spanning six years, each engaging industry practitioners via interviews, surveys, workshops, ethnographies, and other methods. Our synthesis reveals both meaningful progress and persistent challenges in industry RAI practice. Practitioner awareness has increased, RAI activities have become more professionalized, and interventions such as toolkits and guidelines are more widely adopted. At the same time, practitioners continue to face substantial barriers, including limited training, uneven organizational support, and a lack of interventions tailored to day-to-day work practices. By consolidating and organizing these findings, we provide a more complete account of industry RAI than any single study to date. We conclude by discussing implications for RAI researchers, practitioners seeking to adopt effective practices, and policymakers aiming to ground governance efforts in the realities of industry contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对过去六年中 161 项涉及产业界从业者的实证研究进行了文献综述，综合了负责任 AI (Responsible AI, RAI) 在工业界的实践现状。综述发现从业者意识提升、RAI 活动更趋专业化、工具包和指南等干预措施得到更广泛采用，但同时存在培训不足、组织支持不均以及缺乏贴合日常工作实践的干预措施等持续障碍。作者旨在提供比任何单项研究都更完整的产业 RAI 图景，并讨论对研究者、实践者和政策制定者的启示。
Motivation: 产业界如何理解、实施和维持 RAI 工作直接塑造 AI 系统的设计与部署，但相关实证研究分散在不同角色、组织情境和干预方式中，缺乏系统的知识整合。
Method: 采用文献综述方法，筛选并综合了 161 项为期六年、通过访谈、调查、工作坊、民族志等方法与产业从业者互动的实证研究。
Result: 综述显示产业 RAI 实践取得了有意义的进展：从业者意识提升、活动专业化程度提高、工具包和指南等干预措施采用更广泛；同时从业者仍面临实质性障碍，包括培训有限、组织支持不均衡以及缺乏针对日常工作实践的干预。
Conclusion: 作者通过整合分散的实证发现，为 RAI 研究者、寻求有效实践的从业者以及希望基于产业现实制定治理政策的决策者提供了更完整的产业 RAI 全貌。

papers.title: Actionable Hallucination Detection: Translating Latent Uncertainty into Agentic Critique
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) deployed as AI agents frequently exhibit user specification-grounding failures, executing hallucinated, undesired actions to force a resolution rather than expressing uncertainty. Existing detection methods fail to provide actionable, real-time correction as they either do not localize the hallucinations, or incur prohibitive inference latency. We introduce the Latent Critic, a lightweight low-rank adapter (LoRA) that operates concurrently with a frozen base LLM's generation to actively restructure the transformer's residual stream---amplifying latent grounding signals and translating them into localized, natural language feedback within a single sequence. By refining the base model's native uncertainty signals, this manipulation of the latent space enables reliable, granular detection without the overhead of secondary inference loops. Mechanistic analysis via activation patching and layer-wise probing shows that this rank-invariant behavior restructures pre-existing uncertainty geometry into a linearly separable representation that transfers more reliably than base model representations alone. Using tool-calling as an instantiation of granular hallucinations, we validate the detection and downstream improvements enabled by the Latent Critic architecture across Qwen and Llama-based models. Demonstrating superior real-time efficacy, our approach significantly outperforms equivalent-scale fine-tuned external detectors, semantic entropy baselines, and passive internal probes in isolating hallucinations, achieving 0.966 AUROC and >80% accuracy in localization (e.g., ungrounded: date). When deployed in a closed-loop ReAct environment, the Critic acts as a negligible latency guardrail, intercepting hallucinations before execution to prevent undesired actions while simultaneously leveraging this specific localized feedback to enable efficient agent self-correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Latent Critic，一种与冻结基础 LLM 生成过程并发运行的轻量 LoRA 适配器，通过主动重构 transformer 的残差流，将潜在接地信号放大并转化为单序列内的局部自然语言批评。机制分析表明该方法把基础模型原有的不确定性几何重排成线性可分的表征。在工具调用幻觉检测上，该方法达到 0.966 AUROC 和超过 80% 的定位准确率，并在闭环 ReAct 环境中以可忽略的延迟拦截恶意动作。
Motivation: 部署为 AI 代理的 LLM 经常在用户规范接地失败时直接执行臆造的、不合期望的动作，而不是表达不确定性。现有检测方法要么不能定位幻觉，要么推理延迟过高，无法提供可操作、实时的纠正。
Method: Latent Critic 是一个轻量级 LoRA 适配器，与冻结基础 LLM 的生成同步运行；它在单序列内重构残差流，放大基础模型已有的潜在接地信号，并将它们翻译为局部化的自然语言反馈，避免了二次推理循环的开销。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在工具调用场景下达到 0.966 AUROC 和超过 80% 的定位准确率（例如定位到"无根据的日期"），在 Qwen 和 Llama-based 模型上优于同等规模的微调外部检测器、语义熵基线和被动内部探针；将其部署在闭环 ReAct 环境中可拦截幻觉且延迟开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，仅通过重构潜在空间来精炼基础模型固有的不确定性信号，就能获得无需独立推理循环、可定位且低延迟的检测器；该防线还能利用局部化反馈实现高效的智能体自我纠正。

papers.title: Lesion-Aware Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator for CT-to-PSMA PET Synthesis in Prostate Cancer
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning models that synthesize PET from CT or MRI can reduce patient dose and scanner demand, but are typically optimized with global losses such as L1 or mean squared error (MSE) that treat all voxels similarly. In whole-body PSMA-PET, tumor voxels occupy only a small fraction of the volume, yet carry the clinically relevant activity signal; as a result, models can achieve high structural similarity index measure (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) while still underestimating lesion activity or failing to preserve tumor-specific structure. Radiomics provides biologically meaningful descriptors of tumor intensity and texture, but direct radiomics conditioning is time-consuming because it requires feature extraction from delineated lesion regions. We propose LAFNO, a Lesion-Aware Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator for CT-to-PSMA-PET synthesis that replaces high-dimensional radiomics conditioning with two efficient CT-derived proxy channels. Motivated by radiomics analysis of PSMA-avid tumor core and peritumoral regions, LAFNO uses a contrast proxy for local density variation and a disorder proxy for local texture heterogeneity, both injected into the model bottleneck. LAFNO combines whole-volume reconstruction with lesion-level total lesion activity (TLA), tumor-core contrast, and peritumoral supervision. We evaluated LAFNO against four baseline architectures on the TCIA PSMA-PET-CT-Lesions dataset. LAFNO remained competitive on whole-volume image quality, achieving SSIM of 0.960 and 0.938 for 18F- and 68Ga-PSMA, respectively, while reducing per-patient TLA error to 48.3% and 64.0% for 18F- and 68Ga-PSMA, respectively, and achieving the highest tumor-core radiomics reproducibility across all feature classes for both tracers. Peritumoral reproducibility remained tracer-dependent, indicating that biological fidelity in synthetic PSMA-PET remains challenging.

papers.title: Causality Sum Rules in Conventional Scattering Matrices
papers.abstract_en: Scattering matrices are the standard experimental and computational description of photonic and electromagnetic devices. Passivity is explicit in the conventional incoming-outgoing matrix, whereas causality sum rules are usually formulated only after transforming the response into auxiliary variables. Here we show that these rules can be written directly in the conventional scattering matrix by removing the time advance introduced by the reference domain. Using the earliest-arrival delay of each channel, we define a domain-delayed matrix that preserves real-frequency passivity while restoring the causal time origin. Under explicit analyticity, transparency, and regularity assumptions, this matrix becomes a Schur function, enabling a Cayley-Herglotz construction. The resulting projected and determinant bounds constrain coherent channel superpositions and aggregate multichannel loss. The framework recovers Rozanov's absorber limit and spherical-multipole sum rules, while extending causality bounds to measurable quantities including insertion loss, suppressed singular-value channels, and conditional lossless delay-bandwidth trade-offs. Our work directly connects fundamental causality theory with experimentally accessible scattering data. The initial theoretical route is autonomously explored by Qiushi Engine, an AI research system for open-ended scientific discovery, and subsequently verified, refined, and developed by the authors, demonstrating a hybrid AI-human discovery workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在常规散射矩阵中直接表述因果性和(sum rules)：通过利用每个信道的最早到达延迟构造域延迟矩阵，去除参考域引入的时间提前，在保持实数频率无源性的同时恢复因果时间原点。在显式解析性、透明性和正则性假设下，该矩阵成为Schur函数，进而可用Cayley-Herglotz构造推导投影界与行列式界，覆盖Rozanov吸收体极限和球多极子求和规则。该框架将因果关系边界推广到插入损耗、被抑制奇异值信道和条件无损耗延迟-带宽权衡等可测量量，并展示了AI系统Qiushi Engine自主探索初始理论路线、再由作者验证发展的混合AI-人类科研流程。
Motivation: 传统散射矩阵虽显式体现无源性，但因果性和通常须将响应变换到辅助变量后才能表述，缺少直接在常规实验散射矩阵上成立的因果约束。本文旨在将基础因果性理论直接连接到实验可及的散射数据。
Method: 定义域延迟矩阵(domain-delayed matrix)，利用每个信道的最早到达延迟消除参考域引起的时间提前；在解析性、透明性和正则性假设下证明该矩阵为Schur函数，并采用Cayley-Herglotz构造导出投影界与行列式界，从而约束相干信道叠加与聚合多信道损耗。
Result: 该框架恢复Rozanov吸收体极限和球多极子求和规则，并将因果关系边界扩展到插入损耗、被抑制奇异值信道和条件无损耗延迟-带宽权衡等可测量量。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工作直接连通了基础因果性理论与实验可访问的散射数据，同时报告了一种混合AI-人类发现流程：初始理论路线由Qiushi Engine自主探索，随后由作者验证、细化和发展。

papers.title: GeoSeg-OV: Bridging Geospatial Gaps with Structural Guidance for Open-Vocabulary Remote Sensing Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary remote sensing segmentation has recently emerged as a promising paradigm that enables pixel-level recognition of arbitrary categories specified by natural language, including classes unseen during training. However, geospatial domain shifts caused by heterogeneous regions, spatial resolutions, and acquisition platforms weaken visual-text matching and limit cross-dataset generalization. Recent attempts have begun to incorporate auxiliary vision foundation models (VFMs), typically coupling their features with text embeddings as additional matching evidence. However, this strategy may introduce inconsistent matching signals while leaving the structure-sensitive representations of VFMs insufficiently exploited. We therefore propose GeoSeg-OV, which decouples auxiliary VFM features from visual-text matching and repurposes them as structural guidance for cost aggregation and decoding. GeoSeg-OV constructs an orientation-robust cost volume from multi-rotation CLIP features, while a frozen VFM extracts multi-scale structure-sensitive features in parallel. We propose Structure-Guided Aggregation (SGA), which integrates cost tokens and CLIP semantic guidance with VFM-derived pairwise structural biases for coherent spatial propagation, followed by text-conditioned class-wise reasoning. We further introduce Cost-Aware Decoding (CAD) to adaptively refine and fuse multi-scale semantic and structural guidance based on the current decoder context. On the global High-Resolution Land Cover (HRLC) benchmark spanning seven datasets across six continents, GeoSeg-OV outperforms the state-of-the-art by +2.5 and +2.7 average mIoU under two training settings. A large-scale zero-shot case study further demonstrates its generalization across geographic domains and category systems without target-domain annotations or retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GeoSeg-OV，一种面向开放词汇遥感分割的方法，将辅助视觉基础模型 (VFM) 的特征从视觉-文本匹配中解耦，并重新用作成本聚合与解码的结构引导。方法利用多旋转 CLIP 特征构造方向鲁棒的成本体，冻结的 VFM 并行提取多尺度结构敏感特征，并引入 Structure-Guided Aggregation (SGA) 与 Cost-Aware Decoding (CAD)。在涵盖六大洲七个数据集的 High-Resolution Land Cover (HRLC) benchmark 上，GeoSeg-OV 在两种训练设置下平均 mIoU 分别超过 SOTA +2.5 和 +2.7；大规模零样本案例研究也展示了跨地理域和类别系统的泛化能力。
Motivation: 遥感图像因异构区域、空间分辨率和采集平台差异存在显著地理域偏移，这会削弱视觉-文本匹配并限制跨数据集泛化。已有工作开始引入辅助视觉基础模型，但通常将其特征与文本嵌入耦合作为额外匹配证据，可能引入不一致的匹配信号，且未充分挖掘 VFM 中结构敏感的表征。
Method: GeoSeg-OV 将辅助 VFM 特征从视觉-文本匹配中解耦，改为成本聚合与解码阶段的结构引导。具体包括：由多旋转 CLIP 特征构造方向鲁棒的成本体 (cost volume)；冻结的 VFM 并行提取多尺度结构敏感特征；提出 Structure-Guided Aggregation (SGA)，将成本 token、CLIP 语义引导与 VFM 导出的成对结构偏置融合以进行空间传播，随后执行文本条件下的类级推理；再引入 Cost-Aware Decoding (CAD)，依据当前解码器上下文自适应细化并融合多尺度语义与结构引导。
Result: 在全球 High-Resolution Land Cover (HRLC) benchmark（涵盖六大洲七个数据集）上，GeoSeg-OV 在两种训练设置下的平均 mIoU 分别比现有 SOTA 高 +2.5 和 +2.7。大规模零样本案例研究进一步表明，无需目标域标注或重训练即可跨地理域和类别系统泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将辅助 VFM 特征解耦并作为结构引导用于成本聚合与解码，可以缓解地理域偏移导致的匹配不一致，从而提升跨数据集与跨域的泛化性能。代码与 benchmark 已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Recovering Wasted Compute in Autoresearch Agents
papers.abstract_en: A slew of recent works develop agents for solving research problems end-to-end, a paradigm increasingly referred to as autoresearch. Such agents have inspired large industry investment, motivated by their potential to automate time-consuming human labor and customize machine learning solutions for specialized applications. In this paper, we study the modeling pipeline at the core of these autoresearch systems and identify common failure modes when they are applied to tabular datasets: (1) they waste compute resolving the same bugs over and over again; (2) they often fail to tune hyperparameters even when they have a large remaining compute budget; (3) the tree-search algorithms that power them do not explore; and (4) they perform data analysis, mimicking the humans whose data they are trained on, but do not use that analysis to make downstream decisions. We explore targeted interventions and find that a global debug consultant that shares discovered runtime constraints across all branches of the search tree, prompt- and control-level enhancements, and refined tree-search algorithms successfully recover wasted compute. Our results show that large gains in autoresearch agent performance are achievable through agentic design alone, holding the underlying language model fixed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 autoresearch（自动化科研）智能体在表格数据集（tabular datasets）建模流水线上的计算浪费问题，归纳出四类常见失效模式：反复修复同一类 bug、剩余计算预算很大时仍不调超参数、树搜索算法缺乏探索、以及数据分析未用于下游决策。作者提出全局调试顾问（global debug consultant）在搜索树所有分支间共享运行时约束，并配合提示/控制层增强与改进的树搜索算法来回收浪费的计算。摘要报告在不改变底层语言模型的前提下，仅通过智能体设计即可获得显著的性能提升。
Motivation: 自动科研智能体有望自动化耗时的人工劳动并为特定应用定制机器学习解决方案，但其核心建模流水线在表格数据上存在系统性的计算浪费与失效模式，制约了实际效率与大规模投入的回报。
Method: 本文识别四类失效模式，并针对性地提出干预措施：全局调试顾问在搜索树各分支间共享发现的运行时约束；提示（prompt）与控制层增强；以及改进的树搜索算法。实验设计保持底层语言模型固定，仅改动智能体设计。
Result: 摘要报告这些干预成功回收了浪费的计算，并在固定语言模型的情况下带来 autoresearch 智能体性能的大幅提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为仅通过智能体设计即可实现大增益，无需更换底层语言模型；研究范围聚焦于表格数据集上的建模流水线。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为仅通过智能体设计即可实现大增益，无需更换底层语言模型；研究范围聚焦于表格数据集上的建模流水线。

papers.title: Reasoning Shortcuts and Value Symmetries: What Symmetry Permits, Architecture Realizes, and Optimization Selects
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning shortcuts are solutions of a neurosymbolic system's rules that produce correct predictions through unintended concepts. A recent framework of Takemura, Inoue, and Nishino analyzes them through an automorphism group of value relabelings and asks, as its central open question, when rules pin concepts down. We first show that the framework's key definition, one shared permutation applied at every position, does not apply as stated to any of the four heterogeneous benchmarks it was evaluated on, and that the most direct embedding, padding domains to a common size, produces confident false pathology: 90.91% of solution pairs reported unexplained on CLE4EVR, where every well-defined member of the hierarchy we introduce reports 0%, and the padded verdict's content rotates with configuration-file ordering. Re-measuring eleven rule families under fifteen pre-specified predictions (thirteen confirmed), unexplained-pair rates span 0% to 99.9999% and track provable structure: six theorems give sufficient conditions for transitivity and its failure, including a Free Slot Lemma certifying Kandinsky's pathology from syntax alone. For circuit-given rules, deciding symmetry-inertness of a coordinate is coNP-complete; nontrivial-automorphism existence is coNP-hard under randomized reductions, lies in $Σ_2^p$, is not $Σ_2^p$-complete unless PH collapses, and on monotone circuits is coNP-complete outright. In the Boolean case transitivity is classified exactly: automorphisms explain everything iff the solution set is an affine coset. Weakly supervised models place all 94 observed shortcuts at the one level the componentwise theory flags and none at the 48 it certifies transitive; twelve typed-ambiguous levels produce none, separating what symmetry permits from what optimization selects, and a dual-head control replicates the geography. All numbers trace to released artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对神经符号系统中推理捷径 (reasoning shortcuts) 的自动同构群分析框架进行批判性再检验。作者发现 Takemura 等人框架的核心定义（在每个位置施加同一置换）无法直接应用于其评估的四个异构基准，且最直接的 padding 嵌入会产生置信的假病态：在 CLE4EVR 上框架将 90.91% 的合法解对报告为无法解释，而作者引入的层级结构报告 0%。作者重新测量 11 个规则族，给出六个定理刻画传递性及其失效的充分条件，并证明电路规则下对称性判定问题的复杂度结果。
Motivation: 现有框架的中心开放问题是规则何时固定概念，但其关键定义在异构基准上不适用，直接嵌入还会产生系统性的假病态，因而需要更可靠的形式化工具来区分对称性允许什么与优化实际选择什么。
Method: 提出一个层级结构来重新定义并测量未解释率；通过六个定理（含 Free Slot Lemma）给出传递性及其失败的充分条件；对电路给定规则证明对称惰性判定为 coNP-complete、非平凡自同构存在性为 coNP-hard（随机归约下）且属于 Σ_2^p、不 Σ_2^p-complete 除非 PH 坍塌，单调电路上为 coNP-complete；布尔情形下给出精确分类：自同构解释一切当且仅当解集是仿射陪集 (affine coset)。
Result: CLE4EVR 上 padding 报告的未解释率 90.91% 与作者层级的 0% 形成对比；在 15 个预设预测中确认 13 个，11 个规则族的未解释率从 0% 到 99.9999% 不等；弱监督模型将全部 94 个观测捷径放在 componentwise 理论标记的层级，48 个被证明传递的层级无捷径，12 个类型歧义层级产生零捷径，双头控制实验复现了该地理分布。
Conclusion: 作者强调所有数字可追溯到已发布工件，并通过区分“对称性允许”与“优化选择”来阐明推理捷径的出现机制；其形式化结果同时给出传递性的充分条件与判定问题的复杂度边界。

papers.title: A lower bound for stepsize-based acceleration of gradient descent
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that, for smooth convex optimization, plain gradient descent can be accelerated from its textbook convergence rate of $O(T^{-1})$ (where $T$ denotes the number of iterations) to $O\big(T^{-\log_2(1+\sqrt{2})}\big)$ using carefully designed stepsize schedules alone, without resorting to momentum or other algorithmic modifications. Despite this progress, however, little was known about lower bounds for such methods beyond the classical $Ω(T^{-2})$ benchmark for general first-order methods. In this work, we present a new lower bound of $Ω(T^{-1.9319})$ for the last-iterate convergence rate of gradient descent with predetermined nonnegative stepsize schedules. This result provides rigorous evidence that stepsize schedules alone cannot accelerate plain GD to the optimal $O(T^{-2})$ convergence rate. The proof was developed by GPT-5.6 Sol Pro under the authors' guidance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅靠预定步长调度 (stepsize schedule) 加速梯度下降 (gradient descent) 的理论极限。作者证明，对于平滑凸优化，采用预定非负步长调度的梯度下降，其末次迭代收敛率存在 Ω(T^{-1.9319}) 的下界，从而严格说明仅凭步长调度无法把普通 GD 加速到一阶方法的最优 O(T^{-2}) 收敛率。
Motivation: 近期工作表明，仅通过精心设计的步长调度即可将平滑凸优化中梯度下降的收敛率从经典的 O(T^{-1}) 提升到 O(T^{-log_2(1+√2)})，无需动量或其它算法修改；但除了一般一阶方法的经典 Ω(T^{-2}) 基准外，这类方法的下界几乎无人研究。
Method: 作者构造了一个新的下界证明，针对具有预定非负步长调度的梯度下降，给出其末次迭代收敛率的下界 Ω(T^{-1.9319})。摘要注明该证明由 GPT-5.6 Sol Pro 在作者指导下完成。
Result: 得到末次迭代收敛率的 Ω(T^{-1.9319}) 下界，表明步长调度单独使用无法将普通梯度下降加速到最优的 O(T^{-2}) 收敛率。
Conclusion: 这一下界为“步长调度无法单独使普通 GD 达到一阶最优收敛率”提供了严格的理论证据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Riemann GeoResolver: A Non-Euclidean Attention Framework from Euclidean Resolver to Hyperbolic-Spherical Geometry
papers.abstract_en: We present a theoretical foundation for inverse-distance attention, from its Euclidean prototype (Resolver) to its non-Euclidean realization (Riemann GeoResolver). The Euclidean part establishes three core theorems: (1) circuit separation---IDA achieves exact retrieval with $\mathcal{O}(1)$ resources while softmax requires $Ω((\log n)^2)$ width; (2) a Polyak--Lojasiewicz inequality with $Ω(e^{Δ^2/\sqrt{d}}/Δ^2)$ stronger constant than softmax, implying linear convergence, $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$ Lipschitz scaling under a low-rank/clustering assumption, $Θ(1)$ Hessian spread, and absence of spurious local minima; (3) a width-independent effective rank bound that limits noise memorization---softmax memorizes arbitrary labels when $d_h\ge n$, while IDA limits test error to $\mathcal{O}(η^2)$. The non-Euclidean extension then builds upon this prototype, replacing Euclidean distance with hyperbolic geodesic distance for storage and spherical geodesic distance for routing. The Riemann GeoResolver framework comprises ten integrated modules: four HIDA operators spanning $Θ(n^2)$ to $Θ(1)$ per token; Hyperbolic Curvature Compression (HCC) with provable error bounds; HyperGate with gradient lower-bound theorem; Spherical Inverse Distance Attention (SIDA) with sphere-analog PL inequalities; Dynamic Memory Genesis (DMG) with $\mathcal{O}(\log T)$ regret bounds; and Geodesic Sparse Routing (GSR) with quality and communication bounds. The Euclidean theorems are proved in full; the non-Euclidean extension theorems are proved with analogous arguments. This work establishes a theoretical arc: from Euclidean attention as a special case, to hyperbolic memory, to spherical retrieval.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是纯理论论文，为逆距离注意力 (inverse-distance attention) 建立从欧氏原型 Resolver 到非欧氏 Riemann GeoResolver 的理论基础。欧氏部分证明三个核心定理：电路分离、Polyak–Lojasiewicz 不等式、与宽度无关的有效秩界；非欧氏扩展则用双曲测地线距离做存储、球面测地线距离做路由，构建由十个模块组成的 Riemann GeoResolver 框架。摘要指出欧氏定理有完整证明，非欧氏扩展定理用类比论证证明。
Motivation: 为逆距离注意力提供严格的理论基础，尤其针对 softmax 注意力在表达能力、收敛性和噪声记忆方面的局限，给出可证明的替代方案，并将理论从欧氏情形推广到双曲-球面几何。
Method: 先建立欧氏原型 Resolver 的三大理论定理，再将其扩展到非欧氏几何：用双曲测地线距离替代欧氏距离用于存储，用球面测地线距离用于路由。框架包含四个 HIDA 算子、Hyperbolic Curvature Compression (HCC)、HyperGate、Spherical Inverse Distance Attention (SIDA)、Dynamic Memory Genesis (DMG) 与 Geodesic Sparse Routing (GSR) 等十个集成模块。
Result: 欧氏定理声称：IDA 用 O(1) 资源即可精确检索而 softmax 需要 Ω((log n)^2) 宽度；IDA 满足 Polyak–Lojasiewicz 不等式且常数比 softmax 强 Ω(e^{Δ^2/√d}/Δ^2)，从而线性收敛并避免伪局部极小；IDA 的有效秩界使噪声记忆受限，softmax 在 d_h≥n 时可记忆任意标签而 IDA 将测试误差限制在 O(η^2)。非欧氏扩展部分给出 DMG 的 O(log T) 遗憾界以及 GSR 的质量与通信界等结果。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了从欧氏注意力作为特例、到双曲记忆、再到球面检索的理论脉络；属于理论论文，无实验验证，且非欧氏扩展部分依赖类比证明而非与欧氏部分完全相同的证明强度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: How Robust Are LLMs to Vietnamese Dialects?
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on standard written Vietnamese, yet everyday communication frequently involves regional dialects that preserve meaning but differ in surface form. Existing Vietnamese dialect work largely addresses this issue through dialect-to-standard normalization instead of measuring how the model fails under Vietnamese dialectal inputs. To address this gap, we present the first systematic evaluation of LLM robustness to Vietnamese dialect variation across multiple tasks, quantifying performance degradation and failure patterns. We introduce VialectBench (Vietnamese Dialects Benchmarking), a controlled benchmark for testing whether model decisions remain stable across six Vietnamese dialect groups. VialectBench contains 400 Standard Vietnamese source instances and 2,400 human-written dialectal rewrites spanning emotion recognition (ER), natural language inference (NLI), question answering (QA), and multiple-choice question answering (MCQA). Dataset evaluation with a fixed reference language model shows that the dialectal rewrites induce a measurable model-relative likelihood shift while remaining nearly equal in length to their Standard counterparts. Across ten instruction-tuned models, dialectal inputs reduce average performance by 2.82%, and no evaluated model is fully dialect-invariant. All four tasks are affected, with QA showing the largest average degradation. Robustness also varies substantially across dialect groups: PNT3 and PNT2 cause the largest average performance drops, at 6.17% and 4.73%, respectively, whereas PNB slightly improves average performance by 0.42%. The Central dialect group (PNT1-PNT4) also yields the highest average harmful-flip rate across all models, at 6.54%. These findings show that strong performance on Standard Vietnamese does not guarantee reliable behavior under meaning-preserving regional variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统评估大语言模型（LLM）对越南语方言变体的鲁棒性，并构建受控基准 VialectBench，包含 400 条标准越南语源实例和 2,400 条人工书写的方言改写，覆盖情感识别（ER）、自然语言推理（NLI）、问答（QA）和多项选择问答（MCQA）四项任务。固定参考语言模型评估显示，方言改写会带来可测量的模型相对似然偏移，同时与标准句长度几乎持平。在十个指令微调模型上，方言输入使平均性能下降 2.82%，且没有任何模型完全方言不变，其中 QA 任务退化最大，PNT3 与 PNT2 方言组分别造成 6.17% 和 4.73% 的平均下降，而 PNB 组反而平均提升 0.42%。
Motivation: 现有越南语方言研究主要采用方言到标准语归一的思路，而不是测量模型在方言输入下如何失败；但日常交流常使用保持语义而改变表层形式的区域性方言，因此需要系统性量化 LLM 在此类输入上的性能退化与失败模式。
Method: 提出 VialectBench，一个覆盖六个越南语方言组的受控基准，通过在情感识别、自然语言推理、问答和多项选择问答四个任务上使用人工编写的方言改写，并借助固定参考语言模型验证改写带来的模型相对似然偏移，随后在十个指令微调模型上测量决策稳定性。
Result: 方言输入使平均性能下降 2.82%，四个任务均受影响且问答任务退化最大；不同方言组鲁棒性差异显著，PNT3 和 PNT2 分别造成 6.17% 和 4.73% 的平均下降，而 PNB 平均提升 0.42%；中部方言组（PNT1-PNT4）在所有模型上的平均有害翻转率最高，为 6.54%。
Conclusion: 作者强调，模型在标准越南语上的强性能并不能保证其在保持语义的区域变体输入下仍表现可靠。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 方言输入使平均性能下降 2.82%，四个任务均受影响且问答任务退化最大；不同方言组鲁棒性差异显著，PNT3 和 PNT2 分别造成 6.17% 和 4.73% 的平均下降，而 PNB 平均提升 0.42%；中部方言组（PNT1-PNT4）在所有模型上的平均有害翻转率最高，为 6.54%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调，模型在标准越南语上的强性能并不能保证其在保持语义的区域变体输入下仍表现可靠。

papers.title: DriveVLA-M0: Failure-Aware Memory Augmentation for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by enabling unified reasoning across perception, language, and planning. However, existing approaches lack mechanisms to exploit past failures or adapt to distribution shifts, causing the model to persistently underperform on similar scenarios where it has previously failed. In this paper, we propose DriveVLA-M0, a retrieval-augmented VLA with failure-aware latent memory. We construct a latent memory pool that stores failure cases along with their structure scene representations and expert trajectory labels, and design a dedicated Retrieve Model that decouples static road structure and dynamic agent interactions to enable structurally grounded retrieval. At inference time, retrieved cases are injected into the model via a lightweight decoupled LoRA-based test-time training (TTT) mechanism, allowing targeted and scenario-specific correction without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments on NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmark demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 94.1 PDMS on Navtest and 47.0 EPDMS on Navhard with only 26.44 ms TTT backward latency overhead. Furthermore, we show that DriveVLA-M0 scales effectively with additional memory, enabling training-free performance gains through memory expansion. The code is available at https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DriveVLA-M0，一种带失败感知隐式记忆 (failure-aware latent memory) 的检索增强视觉-语言-动作 (Vision-Language-Action, VLA) 模型，用于端到端自动驾驶。方法构建存储失败案例及其结构场景表示与专家轨迹标签的隐式记忆池，并通过解耦静态道路结构与动态智能体交互的检索模块进行结构化检索；推理时用轻量级解耦 LoRA 的测试时训练 (test-time training, TTT) 注入检索结果。在 NAVSIMv1 和 NAVSIMv2 上，该方法以 26.44 ms 的 TTT 反向传播延迟开销取得 Navtest 94.1 PDMS 与 Navhard 47.0 EPDMS，并可通过扩充记忆获得免训练的性能提升。
Motivation: 现有 VLA 自动驾驶模型缺少利用历史失败经验或适应分布偏移的机制，导致在曾经失败的相似场景中持续表现不佳。
Method: 构建存储失败案例的隐式记忆池，每个案例包含结构化场景表示与专家轨迹标签；设计专用 Retrieve Model，将静态道路结构与动态智能体交互解耦以获得结构化的检索；推理时通过轻量级解耦 LoRA 的 TTT 机制将检索到的案例注入模型，实现针对性场景修正而不修改骨干网络。
Result: 在 NAVSIMv1 和 NAVSIMv2 基准上持续优于先前方法，取得 Navtest 94.1 PDMS、Navhard 47.0 EPDMS，仅引入 26.44 ms 的 TTT 反向传播延迟开销；额外增加记忆可带来免训练的性能增益。
Conclusion: 作者强调失败感知记忆与检索增强 TTT 能实现针对具体场景的修正，并支持通过扩展记忆池获得免训练的性能提升；代码已开源。

papers.title: A second-order theory of texture for depth from focus
papers.abstract_en: We present a theory of textured appearance of optically rough surfaces based on wave optics, emphasizing the role of texture for passive depth from focus. Our theory shows that even surfaces that traditional computer vision would consider textureless can produce textured appearance, due to subjective speckle from surface microgeometry. We analyze the properties of this second-order texture, and show that we can enhance its contrast under natural ambient lighting by simply using a narrowband spectral filter. Doing so results in dramatic improvements in passive depth reconstruction of seemingly textureless scenes, as we demonstrate through extensive theory, simulations, and real-world experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于波动光学的光学粗糙表面纹理外观理论，重点关注纹理对被动深度对焦 (depth from focus) 的作用。理论表明，即使是传统计算机视觉认为无纹理的表面，也会因表面微几何产生主观散斑 (subjective speckle) 而形成纹理。作者分析这种二阶纹理 (second-order texture) 的性质，并证明在自然环境下使用窄带光谱滤光片即可增强其对比度，从而显著改善看似无纹理场景的被动深度重建。
Motivation: 被动深度对焦依赖场景中的纹理线索，但许多粗糙表面在传统纹理模型下被视为无纹理，导致重建困难。论文旨在从波动光学角度解释这类表面的纹理来源，并为被动深度重建提供新途径。
Method: 从波动光学出发建立光学粗糙表面纹理外观理论，将表面微几何产生的主观散斑作为二阶纹理的核心来源，并分析其对比度性质；提出在自然环境光照下使用窄带光谱滤光片来增强该纹理对比度。
Result: 摘要报告，通过理论、仿真和真实世界实验，窄带滤光片使看似无纹理场景的被动深度重建效果得到大幅提升。
Conclusion: 论文强调二阶纹理及其与窄带滤光片的结合是改善被动深度重建的有效手段，其适用范围以光学粗糙表面和自然光照条件为背景。

papers.title: Post-Calibration Reliability Reranking of Relevance Decisions via Label-wise Monotone Projection
papers.abstract_en: Web search, product search, and question-answering retrieval systems often assign a relevance label and confidence score to each query-candidate pair. The relevance label describes how well a page, product, or passage matches the query, while the confidence often guides downstream use or fallback decisions. Post-hoc calibration is therefore needed because misaligned confidence can make systems over-trust wrong predictions or unnecessarily defer correct ones. However, calibration mainly aligns confidence with average correctness, and does not remove predicted-label-dependent reliability differences that remain within the same calibrated confidence level. We address this gap with Label-wise Monotone Reliability Projection (MRP), which learns label-wise monotone functions that map calibrated confidence to correctness reliability while preserving the original predicted labels and class probabilities. The resulting reliability score reranks fixed predictions according to residual risk. Across six information access relevance datasets and multiple post-hoc calibrators, MRP improves reliability reranking and average fallback utility while preserving full-coverage accuracy and ECE. Structural ablations show that the main gains come from label-wise residual reliability rather than from global confidence remapping. We further analyze when MRP reliability scores can be embedded back into top-label probability geometry, showing that this projection is useful as a compatibility analysis but is distinct from the main reliability-reranking objective. The implementation will be made publicly available.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Label-wise Monotone Reliability Projection (MRP)，用于检索系统中预测置信度的后验校准。MRP 学习按标签单调的函数，将校准后的置信度映射为正确性可靠性 (reliability)，同时保留原始预测标签和类别概率，并用所得可靠性分数对固定预测按残余风险重新排序。在六个信息访问相关性数据集和多种后验校准器上，MRP 提升了可靠性重排序和平均回退效用，同时保持全覆盖率准确率和 ECE。
Motivation: 现有校准主要让置信度与平均正确率对齐，但无法消除同一校准置信度水平内与预测标签相关的可靠性差异，这可能导致系统过度信任错误预测或不必要地放弃正确预测。论文针对这一 gap 提出按标签粒度的可靠性刻画。
Method: MRP 学习一批标签单调函数 (label-wise monotone functions)，把已校准置信度映射为正确性可靠性，并保持原始预测标签与类别概率不变；随后用可靠性分数对固定预测按残余风险进行重排序。作者还分析了将可靠性分数嵌入 top-label 概率几何的可行性，作为兼容性分析而非主目标。
Result: 在六个信息访问相关性数据集和多个后验校准器上，MRP 在保持全覆盖率准确率和 ECE 的同时，改善了可靠性重排序与平均回退效用。结构消融表明主要收益来自标签特定的残余可靠性，而非全局置信度重映射。
Conclusion: MRP 可作为检索系统中预测固定后的可靠性重排序方法；把可靠性分数嵌入 top-label 概率几何的投影被视为兼容性分析，与主重排序目标相区别。实现将公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Never Stop Speaking: a Denial-of-Service Attack on End-to-End Speech Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many studies have shown that specially crafted inputs can induce large language models (LLMs) to generate excessively long outputs, resulting in significant computational overhead and resource consumption. While most existing denial-of-service (DoS) attacks target text-only LLMs, end-to-end (E2E) speech LLMs are rapidly emerging. Existing text-based DoS attacks primarily rely on prompt engineering, such as adversarial suffixes or semantic inducement, which exploit the discrete nature of text inputs and therefore cannot be directly transferred to continuous speech inputs. Moreover, prior studies on speech model security mainly focus on ASR or TTS systems, leaving the DoS vulnerability of E2E speech LLMs largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose the perturbation-based DoS attack targeting E2E speech models. Instead of inducing long outputs through prompt manipulation, our method optimizes imperceptible acoustic perturbations to directly influence the model's autoregressive generation process while preserving the original input length. Specifically, we formulate the attack as a composite optimization objective that jointly suppresses EOS generation, encourages prolonged decoding, and largely preserves semantic consistency by integrating weighted EOS loss, top-k logit loss, length loss, and semantic alignment loss. To further improve stealthiness, we employ voice activity detection (VAD) to inject perturbations only into voiced regions. Extensive experiments on three open-source E2E speech LLMs demonstrate that our method achieves stable attack success rate while significantly increasing generation length and GPU resource consumption, revealing security risks in modern ALLMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出针对端到端（E2E）语音大模型（speech LLM）的基于扰动的拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。与依赖提示工程的文本 DoS 攻击不同，该方法优化不可感知的声学扰动，直接干预模型的自回归生成过程，同时保持输入长度不变。在三个开源 E2E 语音 LLM 上的实验表明，该方法能稳定提升攻击成功率并显著增加生成长度与 GPU 资源消耗，暴露了现代音频语言模型（ALLM）的安全风险。
Motivation: 现有 DoS 攻击大多针对纯文本 LLM，依赖对抗后缀或语义诱导等提示工程技术，难以迁移到连续语音输入；而针对语音模型安全的研究多集中于 ASR 或 TTS，E2E 语音 LLM 的 DoS 漏洞尚未得到充分探索。
Method: 将攻击形式化为复合优化目标，通过加权组合 EOS 损失（EOS loss）、top-k logit 损失、长度损失（length loss）和语义对齐损失（semantic alignment loss），联合抑制 EOS 生成、延长解码过程并尽量保持语义一致性；为进一步提升隐蔽性，使用语音活动检测（VAD）仅在浊音区域注入扰动。
Result: 在三个开源 E2E 语音 LLM 上的大量实验表明，该方法获得稳定的攻击成功率，并显著增加生成长度和 GPU 资源消耗。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作揭示了现代 E2E 语音 LLM（ALLM）中此前未被充分认识的 DoS 安全风险，为后续防御研究提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Threat-guided Policy-aware Scene Perturbation for Safe Autonomous Driving with Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promising performance in autonomous driving, yet ensuring the safety of online RL policies remains challenging due to insufficient exposure to safety-critical driving scenes. The long-tailed nature of real-world traffic situations makes dangerous and rare interactions difficult to encounter through conventional sampling, limiting the ability of RL policies to learn robust safety behaviors. Existing methods improve training diversity by synthesizing challenging scenes or adversarial situations. However, these approaches typically optimize scene generation objectives separately from the evolving policy, without explicitly modeling how generated perturbations relate to the current policy's weaknesses and learning needs. In this paper, we propose Threat-guided Policy-aware Scene Perturbation (TPSP) for safe autonomous driving with online RL. TPSP introduces a policy-aware scene encoder to capture the interaction between policy behaviors and surrounding environments, enabling scene perturbation aligned with the current policy. Based on this representation, TPSP selectively perturbs critical objects rather than applying uniform modifications across the scene. Furthermore, we develop a threat-guided optimization strategy that evaluates perturbed scenes through threat-level differences between policy rollouts on original and perturbed scenes, guiding the generation of safety-critical scenes with higher training value. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that TPSP improves safety learning efficiency, achieving strong safety performance on NAVSIM v2 with approximately 4 million kilometers of simulated driving data. Ablation studies verify that policy-aware targeted perturbations provide more informative safety-critical experiences than random or policy-unaware strategies, enabling safer driving under limited interaction budgets.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 在线 RL 策略因缺乏对安全关键场景的充分暴露而难以保证安全，真实交通的长尾分布使危险稀疏交互难以通过常规采样遇到。现有场景生成方法通常独立于当前策略优化场景目标，未显式建模扰动与策略弱点及学习需求的关系。
Method: TPSP 提出策略感知场景编码器以捕获策略行为与周围环境的交互，使场景扰动与当前策略对齐；在此表征基础上选择性扰动关键物体而非统一修改整个场景。进一步设计威胁引导优化策略，通过原始与扰动场景上策略 rollouts 的威胁级别差异评估扰动场景，生成训练价值更高的安全关键场景。
Result: 综合实验表明 TPSP 提高安全学习效率，在 NAVSIM v2 上约 400 万公里模拟驾驶数据中取得较强安全性能。消融实验验证策略感知的定向扰动比随机或策略无关策略提供更具信息量的安全关键经验，从而在有限交互预算下实现更安全的驾驶。
Conclusion: 作者强调策略感知的定向扰动能在有限交互预算下提供更有信息量的安全关键经验，进而提升自动驾驶在线 RL 的安全性。

papers.title: TideRL: Boosting Agentic RL Goodput with Readiness-Aware Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models is moving toward multi-turn agentic workloads, where rollout tasks repeatedly pause for external environments, resume with growing contexts, and finish at highly variable times. In this setting, RL training goodput, measured by training throughput, matters more than raw GPU occupancy: GPU waiting and repeated prefill recomputation are pure overhead. We present TideRL, a readiness-aware elastic RL system with Continuous Task Batching, Resource-Aware Ref-Actor Pipelining, and Elastic Resource Scaling. CTB preserves useful rollout state, $\textrm{RA}^2\textrm{P}$ selects between decoupled streaming and colocated aggregation from the ready backlog and arrival interval, and ERS moves ranks between rollout and training using the same readiness signals. Across text-only and multi-modal agentic workloads, TideRL improves RL training goodput by up to 5.6$\times$ over synchronous baselines and over 33% over asynchronous baselines, while reaching similar task performance. It also improves KV cache hit rate by 1.58$\times$, reduces per-step training time by up to 44.3%, and cuts total waiting time by up to 77.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TideRL，一个面向多轮 agentic RL 训练的弹性调度系统。其核心观察是，在 rollout 任务反复等待外部环境、上下文增长且完成时间高度可变的场景中，训练 goodput（以训练吞吐衡量）比裸 GPU 占用率更重要。TideRL 通过 Continuous Task Batching、Resource-Aware Ref-Actor Pipelining 和 Elastic Resource Scaling 三部分提升 RL 训练效率，并声称在文本与多模态 agentic 负载上显著优于同步和异步基线。
Motivation: 大语言模型的 RL 正转向多轮 agentic 工作负载，rollout 任务频繁暂停等待外部环境、以增长上下文恢复并在高度可变的时间完成，导致 GPU 等待与重复 prefill 重计算成为纯开销；现有系统以 GPU 占用率为优化目标，无法应对此类环境交互型负载。
Method: TideRL 包含三个组件：Continuous Task Batching (CTB) 保留有用的 rollout 状态；Resource-Aware Ref-Actor Pipelining (RA^2P) 根据就绪队列长度和到达间隔，在解耦流式与共置聚合（decoupled streaming 与 colocated aggregation）之间选择；Elastic Resource Scaling (ERS) 利用相同的就绪信号在 rollout 与训练之间迁移 ranks。
Result: 在纯文本与多模态 agentic 负载上，TideRL 相比同步基线将 RL 训练 goodput 提升最高 5.6 倍，相比异步基线提升超过 33%，同时任务性能相近；KV cache 命中率提升 1.58 倍，每步训练时间最多降低 44.3%，总等待时间最多降低 77.6%。
Conclusion: 作者认为，就绪感知（readiness-aware）的弹性调度能够有效减少 agentic RL 训练中的 GPU 等待与 prefill 重计算，从而提升训练 goodput。

papers.title: Automatic Field-of-View Adjustment for a View-Expansive Microscope via LSTM-Based Gaze and Pipette Motion Interpretation
papers.abstract_en: Intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) operators frequently adjust the field-of-view (FOV) during procedures, which interrupts workflow and increases procedure time. Conventional microscopes require manual objective lens switching and illumination adjustments to achieve different FOV sizes. We propose an AI-based automatic FOV adjustment method integrated with a view-expansive microscope. This microscope enables the simultaneous acquisition of a large FOV and high-resolution images using a single objective lens through multiview imaging with galvanometer mirrors and high-speed vision, thereby eliminating the need for physical lens exchanges. Our method utilizes a long short-term memory (LSTM) model to predict the appropriate FOV size based on real-time analysis of the pipette's position and velocity, combined with the operator's gaze position. The AI model is trained using ICSI procedure data from an expert with over five years of micromanipulation experience. Experimental evaluation with novice operators reveals that the proposed automatic FOV adjustment system significantly improves the ICSI procedure speed, reducing the average task completion time from 60.5 to 48.0 s (p < 0.001). The experiments also demonstrate that this improvement enables novice operators to achieve ICSI working speeds equivalent to those of expert operators.
papers.comment: This is the accepted version of an article published in IEEE Access 13, 182915-182923 (2025). DOI: 10.1109/ACCESS.2025.3624246. Open Access under CC BY 4.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向胞浆内单精子注射（ICSI）操作中频繁手动调整视野（FOV）打断工作流的问题，提出基于长短期记忆网络（LSTM）的自动FOV调整方法，并与可扩展视野显微镜（view-expansive microscope）集成。该显微镜通过振镜和高速视觉实现单物镜下的多视角成像，无需物理切换物镜；LSTM模型根据注射针位置、速度及操作者注视位置实时预测合适FOV大小。实验显示新手操作者平均任务完成时间从60.5秒降至48.0秒（p<0.001），达到接近专家的操作速度。
Motivation: ICSI操作者在手术过程中频繁调整FOV，传统显微镜需要手动切换物镜和调节照明，打断了操作流程并延长手术时间。
Method: 提出AI驱动的自动FOV调整系统，集成单物镜多视角成像的view-expansive显微镜；利用LSTM结合显微注射针的位置和速度以及操作者注视位置，实时预测合适的FOV尺寸。模型使用具有超过五年显微操作经验的专家的ICSI手术数据进行训练。
Result: 实验评估显示，新手操作者使用该自动FOV调整系统后，平均任务完成时间从60.5秒显著降低至48.0秒（p<0.001），可使新手达到与专家相当的工作速度。
Conclusion: 摘要强调自动FOV调整能显著提升ICSI流程效率，并让新手操作者获得接近专家的速度；该工作发表于IEEE Access，并采用开放获取许可。

papers.title: Do Judges Behave Like Algorithms?
papers.abstract_en: What if judges already behave like algorithms? As artificial intelligence and algorithms are deployed in many settings, including the judicial system, many have debated whether judges should be allowed to rely on them. Instead, we ask whether judges follow predictable, algorithmic-like rules already. If judges already follow consistent, formula-like rules based on discrete and static factors such as criminal history, age, and charge type, then judicial behavior may be improved. However, if judges rely on individualized information that cannot be identified through court data, then standards-based decision-making may be more challenging to understand or improve. This work explores these questions by studying judicial decision-making in misdemeanor bail hearings in Harris County, Texas. Using available court data, we investigate whether magistrate judges follow what resembles an algorithm; whether they consider the same variables in their decision-making; and whether they are consistent with themselves and with each other. To do this, we train machine learning models for each judge, measure variable importance metrics to determine important variables for each judge's decision-making, and analyze outcomes of similar cases for judges. Our results reveal that these judges generally behave algorithmically: their decisions can be captured by small, interpretable formulas. However, in some cases, judges differ substantially, leading to surprising inconsistency and unequal treatment across similar defendants. Identifying cases where algorithms do not explain judicial decision-making can improve the justice system by focusing attention on decisions where individualized standards, rather than rules, better explains outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究美国德州哈里斯县轻罪保释听证中治安法官的决策是否像算法一样可预测。作者为每位法官训练机器学习模型、测量变量重要性并分析相似案件的结果，发现法官决策大多能被小型可解释公式捕捉，但部分情形下法官之间差异显著，导致相似被告受到不一致对待。
Motivation: 围绕法官是否应依赖算法的争论很多，本文反过来追问法官是否已经在遵循可预测的算法式规则：若基于犯罪记录、年龄、指控类型等离散静态因素，则司法行为可能被改进；若依赖法院数据无法识别的个案信息，则基于标准的决策更难理解或改进。
Method: 利用哈里斯县轻罪保释听证的法院数据，对每位法官分别训练机器学习模型，通过变量重要性指标判断各法官决策中的关键变量，并分析相似案件在不同法官之间的结果一致性。
Result: 结果显示这些法官总体上表现出算法化行为，其决策可由小型可解释公式刻画；但在部分案件中法官之间存在实质性分歧，造成相似被告之间的不一致与不平等待遇。
Conclusion: 识别算法无法解释司法决策的案件，可以把注意力集中在个体化标准而非固定规则更能解释结果的决策上，从而改进司法系统。

papers.title: Observational Evidence Revises Presumed Large Ozone Worsening from Nitrogen Oxides Cuts
papers.abstract_en: Many air quality models indicate that rapid reductions in nitrogen oxides (NOx), without comparable controls on volatile organic compounds, have worsened summertime ozone pollution in urban China, producing a short-term strong ozone penalty. Other models, however, simulate the opposite response, suggesting that cutting down NOx has already helped mitigate ozone pollution. This contradiction obscures understanding of atmospheric chemistry and weakens guidance on control policy design. Here, we reconcile this disagreement and reveal the underestimated benefits of NOx emission reductions using a machine learning framework integrated with an observational constraint. We first constrain ozone responses under a 30% NOx reduction, comparable to the magnitude of NOx emission declines across major Chinese city clusters between 2015 and 2023. The constrained results indicate that ozone decreases prevail across urban China, with only small increases mainly in July 2015. This challenges the widespread ozone worsening that many models predict. We then extend the constraint across 10-60% NOx reductions, establishing its use for rapid ozone sensitivity diagnosis without exhaustive scenario modeling. This diagnosis shows that sustained NOx control increasingly favored ozone mitigation during 2015-2023, benefiting a growing share of China's population. These results underscore that continued NOx reductions can deliver larger ozone mitigation benefits than many models suggest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用机器学习框架结合观测约束，重新评估了中国城市氮氧化物（NOx）减排对夏季臭氧污染的影响。在30% NOx削减情景下，约束结果显示臭氧在中国城市区域总体下降，仅2015年7月出现小幅增加，这与许多模型预测的臭氧恶化相反。进一步将约束扩展到10–60%的削减范围，可用于快速臭氧敏感性诊断，并显示2015–2023年间持续减排越来越有利于臭氧缓解。
Motivation: 不同空气质量模型对NOx减排是否导致臭氧恶化存在矛盾预测，这模糊了对大气化学的理解，并削弱了对控制政策设计的指导。
Method: 提出一个集成观测约束的机器学习框架，先约束30% NOx削减（相当于2015–2023年中国主要城市群NOx排放下降幅度）下的臭氧响应，再将该约束扩展到10–60%削减范围，以实现无需穷举情景模拟的快速臭氧敏感性诊断。
Result: 约束结果表明臭氧下降在中国城市区域占主导，仅2015年7月有小幅增加；持续NOx控制越来越有利于臭氧缓解，并惠及越来越多中国人口。
Conclusion: 持续NOx减排能带来比许多模型预测更大的臭氧缓解效益，挑战了广泛预测的臭氧恶化现象。

summary_sections.method: 提出一个集成观测约束的机器学习框架，先约束30% NOx削减（相当于2015–2023年中国主要城市群NOx排放下降幅度）下的臭氧响应，再将该约束扩展到10–60%削减范围，以实现无需穷举情景模拟的快速臭氧敏感性诊断。
summary_sections.result: 约束结果表明臭氧下降在中国城市区域占主导，仅2015年7月有小幅增加；持续NOx控制越来越有利于臭氧缓解，并惠及越来越多中国人口。
summary_sections.conclusion: 持续NOx减排能带来比许多模型预测更大的臭氧缓解效益，挑战了广泛预测的臭氧恶化现象。

papers.title: ELVAE: Evidential Learning-Based Variational Autoencoder for Uncertainty-Aware Generation
papers.abstract_en: Variational autoencoders generate samples from probabilistic latent representations but do not distinguish uncertainty about the latent location from variability around it. We formulate ELVAE, an evidential learning-based VAE in which each latent coordinate is governed by an input-dependent normal-inverse-gamma posterior. This hierarchy yields an explicit latent-location uncertainty that can be used during generation, not merely reported after inference: low-uncertainty anchors support more reliable synthetic samples, while high-uncertainty anchors can be deliberately exploited for stress testing. The objective is an exact evidence lower bound, and we show that direct regularization of the full hierarchy is required, since the marginalized latent law alone cannot identify the uncertainty decomposition. In an MNIST generation pilot with a frozen external classifier, this uncertainty clearly stratified the semantic reliability of generated digits. A zero-displacement control revealed that most of the effect reflects how reliably an anchor can be re-generated, while a smaller but distinct component is attributable to uncertainty-scaled perturbation itself. The effect holds only under within-class uncertainty ranking, and its magnitude varies across seeds. These findings support the learned latent-location uncertainty as a practical control variable for uncertainty-aware generation, separating anchor reliability from perturbation-induced failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ELVAE，一种基于证据学习 (evidential learning) 的变分自编码器，为每个隐变量坐标赋予输入相关的正态-逆伽马后验，从而显式建模隐位置不确定性 (latent-location uncertainty)，并可在生成阶段使用这种不确定性。论文给出精确的 evidence lower bound，并指出直接正则化完整层级是必要的，因为仅边际化后的隐分布无法识别不确定性分解。在 MNIST 生成实验中，该不确定性能够分层刻画生成数字的语义可靠性，且效果仅在类内不确定性排序下成立。
Motivation: 标准变分自编码器从概率隐表示中采样生成，但无法区分隐位置本身的不确定性与围绕该位置的变异性，导致生成过程缺乏可用的不确定性控制变量。作者希望让不确定性在生成阶段发挥作用，而不只是推理后的报告值。
Method: 提出 ELVAE，每个隐坐标由输入相关的正态-逆伽马后验控制，形成层级结构；目标函数是精确的 evidence lower bound，并强调必须对整个层级做直接正则化，因为仅凭边际化隐规律无法识别不确定性分解。生成时可利用低不确定性锚点产生更可靠的样本，或利用高不确定性锚点进行压力测试 (stress testing)。
Result: 在 MNIST 生成实验（使用冻结的外部分类器）中，隐位置不确定性清晰地区分了生成数字的语义可靠性。零位移对照 (zero-displacement control) 显示大部分效果来自锚点可再生成的可靠性，另有一个较小但独立的分量来自不确定性缩放的扰动本身；效果仅在类内不确定性排序下成立，且幅度随随机种子变化。
Conclusion: 作者认为学习得到的隐位置不确定性可作为不确定性感知生成的实用控制变量，将锚点可靠性与扰动引起的失败分开。论文强调层级正则化的必要性，并指出实验范围仍限于 MNIST 上不确定性排序设定的验证。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: FormStruct-Bench:A Hierarchical and Diagnostic Benchmark for Table-Form Document Structure Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Transforming table-form documents into machine-processable records requires recovering not only their visible content but also the multilevel structure that organizes it. However, existing benchmarks evaluate either holistic document outputs or conventional table grids, and their aggregate scores provide little insight into where structural failures occur. We introduce FormStruct-Bench, a hierarchical and diagnostic benchmark that evaluates table-form document structure recognition at both the document level and progressively finer component levels, allowing aggregate performance to be traced back to specific structural failure modes. To construct auditable ground truth at scale, we annotate 70 reusable templates and expand them into 7,000 verified instances through a provenance-preserving Director--Artist--Verifier pipeline; all 1,100 instances in the template-disjoint test set additionally receive human review. Our evaluation protocol uses five primary metrics and three structure-specific diagnostics across page, schema, and component levels, together with slices over difficulty, structural constraints, and visual degradation. Across 14 API-hosted and locally deployable systems plus two SFT variants, the best document-level score reaches 83.85%, whereas the best reported fine-grained structural score remains below 18%. These results reveal a pronounced gap between reading document content and recovering the hierarchy and regional organization required for reliable table-form understanding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FormStruct-Bench，一个分层且可诊断的表格文档结构识别基准，在文档级与逐步更细的组件级同时评估，使聚合性能可回溯到具体结构失效模式。作者通过保留来源的 Director–Artist–Verifier 流程，将 70 个可复用模板扩展为 7,000 个验证实例，其中 1,100 个模板不重叠的测试实例经人工审查。评估协议包含五个主要指标和三个结构特异性诊断，并覆盖难度、结构约束和视觉退化等切片。在 14 个 API 托管/本地系统与两个 SFT 变体上，最佳文档级得分达 83.85%，而最佳细粒度结构得分仍低于 18%。
Motivation: 现有基准要么评估整体文档输出，要么评估传统表格网格，其聚合分数难以揭示结构失败发生在何处，无法为表格文档结构识别提供细粒度的诊断依据。
Method: 构建 FormStruct-Bench 基准：标注 70 个可复用模板并通过 Director–Artist–Verifier 流程扩展为 7,000 个经过验证的实例；测试集所有实例均通过模板不重叠设计并接受人工审查。评估协议使用五个主要指标和页面、模式、组件三个结构级别的特异性诊断，并附加难度、结构约束与视觉退化切片。
Result: 在 14 个 API 托管与本地可部署系统及两个 SFT 变体上，最佳文档级得分为 83.85%，而最佳细粒度结构得分低于 18%，显示出读取文档内容与恢复其层级和区域组织之间存在显著差距。
Conclusion: 作者强调，可靠的表格文档理解不仅需要读出可见内容，还需要恢复多层级结构与区域组织；当前系统在这一细粒度结构恢复任务上表现明显不足。
Relevance: 0
