papers.title: Improved cross-validated distances for multivariate pattern analysis
papers.abstract_en: Characterizing the dissimilarity of neural representations between experimental conditions, and tracking it across time, is a central goal of multivariate pattern analysis. Guggenmos et al. (2018) assessed the reliability of many of the measures that can be used for that purpose on MEG data and recommended the use of either the cross-validated Euclidean distance or the within-class-corrected Pearson distance. In this commentary, we show that we can improve upon these distances. First, we show that the cross-validated Euclidean distance is equivalent to a sum of between-partition distances and that this equivalence can be leveraged to obtain a generalized variant, with increased reliability and accuracy. Second, we use the relationship between Euclidean distance and Pearson correlation to define a cross-validated correlation distance in a similar way. The resulting distance is more accurate and interpretable than a formulation proposed by Guggenmos and colleagues. Finally, we discuss the relationship between our generalized cross-validation and within-class correction, another strategy often used to increase reliability, and we show that generalized cross-validation results in higher accuracy for the correlation distance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 Guggenmos et al. (2018) 在多元模式分析（multivariate pattern analysis）中推荐的距离度量的评论性研究。作者证明交叉验证欧氏距离（cross-validated Euclidean distance）等价于分区间距离之和，并据此构造广义变体以提升可靠性与准确性；同时利用欧氏距离与 Pearson 相关的联系，类似地定义交叉验证相关距离。摘要还讨论广义交叉验证与类内校正（within-class correction）的关系，并指出前者在相关距离上精度更高。
Motivation: 在 MEG 数据上可靠地刻画实验条件间神经表征的不相似性并追踪其随时间变化是多元模式分析的核心目标，而 Guggenmos 等人推荐的两类距离仍有改进空间。
Method: 利用交叉验证欧氏距离与分区间距离之和的等价性，构造广义交叉验证变体；借助欧氏距离与 Pearson 相关的数学关系，定义交叉验证相关距离；并与类内校正策略进行对比分析。
Result: 摘要报告改进后的距离在可靠性和准确性上均优于原有度量；交叉验证相关距离比 Guggenmos 等人的公式更准确且更可解释；对于相关距离，广义交叉验证相比类内校正能达到更高精度。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过广义交叉验证可以系统改进 MEG 多元模式分析中的距离度量，且该改进在相关距离上尤其有效。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Diffusion-Based Unrestricted Robotic Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in controlling robots across diverse manipulation tasks. However, their adversarial robustness remains largely underexplored, and exploiting this weakness can lead to physical-world harm. Existing attacks on VLA models often rely on pixel-space perturbations or white-box access, resulting in noticeable artifacts and limited deployability in real-world robotic systems. In this work, we propose DURA, a diffusion-based unrestricted robotic attack that generates visually natural adversarial patches for VLA models. DURA supports both white-box and black-box attack settings, where the black-box setting requires only the predicted actions of the victim model. By optimizing along the latent trajectory of a pretrained diffusion model, DURA generates visually natural patches while steering the robot toward attacker-specified target actions. Extensive experiments in both simulation and the real physical world show that DURA consistently outperforms existing methods. Our findings expose a safety risk for physically deployed VLA models and call for stronger defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DURA，一种基于扩散模型的非受限机器人攻击方法，为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型生成视觉上自然的对抗性补丁，并支持白盒与黑盒两种攻击设置，其中黑盒设置仅需受害模型输出的动作。仿真与真实物理世界的实验表明，DURA 持续优于现有攻击方法，揭示了实际部署 VLA 模型的安全风险。
Motivation: 现有针对 VLA 模型的攻击多依赖像素空间扰动或白盒访问，易产生明显伪影且难以在真实机器人系统中部署；而 VLA 模型在物理世界的对抗鲁棒性尚未被充分研究，其弱点可能造成现实危害。
Method: DURA 通过在预训练扩散模型的潜在轨迹（latent trajectory）上进行优化，生成视觉自然的对抗性补丁，同时将机器人行为导向攻击者指定的目标动作；该方法同时适用于白盒与黑盒攻击设置，黑盒场景只需获取模型预测的动作。
Result: 摘要报告在仿真环境和真实物理世界中的广泛实验均显示，DURA 在攻击效果上持续优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为该研究暴露了物理部署 VLA 模型的安全隐患，并呼吁发展更强的防御手段。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Share First, Route What Remains: A Unified Framework for Token-Adaptive MoE Computation
papers.abstract_en: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models have recently moved beyond routing a fixed number of complete experts. Shared-expert designs preserve reusable knowledge, fine-grained methods vary computation within experts, and dynamic routers adapt the number of active experts. Yet these decisions are usually made independently, overlooking a basic dependency: extracting reusable computation changes both what remains and how much expert capacity the remainder needs. We study this dependency by decomposing sparsely upcycled feed-forward experts into key-value channels. Co-activated experts align at a subset of value positions; removing these positions changes expert preference; and greater shared coverage is associated with lower residual expert demand. These observations lead to one principle: share first, then route what remains. We instantiate it in UniF-MoE, a unified framework for token-adaptive MoE computation. Each expert is partitioned into aligned blocks. A shared-demand score sets the shared block count and pathway weight, key prototypes select the shared content, and the complementary demand determines the residual expert count through cumulative routing mass. A Gram regularizer separates and normalizes router embeddings, promoting diverse routing directions, sparse expert overlap, and a simple routing geometry. Experiments on DomainBed and GLUE show that this unified design improves predictive performance over representative static and dynamic MoEs while reducing activated computation, inference latency, and memory. Code is available at https://github.com/existence0420/UniF-MoE.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, and 7 tables; includes supplementary material. Code is available at https://github.com/existence0420/UniF-MoE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 MoE 模型中共享专家与动态路由之间的依赖关系，提出统一的 token 自适应 MoE 计算框架 UniF-MoE。作者将稀疏 upcycled 的前馈专家分解为 key-value 通道，观察到共激活专家在部分 value 位置对齐、移除这些位置会改变专家偏好、更大的共享覆盖与更低的残差专家需求相关，由此提出“先共享、再路由剩余”的原则。在 DomainBed 和 GLUE 上的实验表明，该统一设计在降低激活计算量、推理延迟和内存的同时提升了预测性能。
Motivation: 现有 MoE 设计通常独立处理共享专家、专家内细粒度计算和动态路由，忽略了提取可复用计算会同时改变剩余专家需求这一基本依赖关系。
Method: 提出 UniF-MoE 框架：每个专家被划分为对齐的块，通过共享需求分数决定共享块数量与路径权重，用关键原型（key prototypes）选择共享内容，并通过累积路由质量由互补需求决定剩余专家数量；同时引入 Gram 正则化来分离和归一化路由嵌入，促进多样的路由方向、稀疏的专家重叠和简单的路由几何。
Result: 在 DomainBed 和 GLUE 基准上，UniF-MoE 相比代表性的静态与动态 MoE 方法提升了预测性能，同时减少了激活计算量、推理延迟和内存占用。
Conclusion: 作者强调“先共享、再路由剩余”这一原则可以统一 MoE 的共享与动态路由决策，并提供了开源代码；摘要未提及明显的局限性或额外讨论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Weak-Entropy PINN for Solving Hyperbolic Conservation Laws
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, neural networks have significantly advanced numerical solutions of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, solving PDEs with discontinuous solutions, such as hyperbolic conservation laws, remains challenging for neural network-based methods such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs). Existing methods often rely on strong prior assumptions such as knowledge of discontinuity locations, or they introduce artificial smoothing terms that degrade accuracy. However, accurately solving these conservation laws and predicting the formation and propagation of discontinuities in solutions is crucial in many practical applications, including gas dynamics and traffic flow modeling. In this paper, we introduce a novel Weak-Entropy PINN (WEPINN) framework for hyperbolic conservation laws with discontinuous solutions. The method enforces the governing equations in their weak (integral) formulation and incorporates the entropy condition to select the physically admissible solution, while employing the discrete fast Fourier transform (DFFT) for efficient numerical integration. Our method is tested through extensive numerical experiments on a variety of scalar conservation laws and systems of conservation laws in one and two dimensional spaces. These experiments demonstrate that our method can accurately resolve sharp discontinuities while effectively capturing interactions between multiple shock and rarefaction waves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Weak-Entropy PINN（WEPINN）框架，用于求解具有间断解的双曲守恒律方程。该方法在弱（积分）形式下施加控制方程，并结合熵条件挑选物理解，同时使用离散快速傅里叶变换（DFFT）实现高效数值积分。大量一维和二维标量守恒律及方程组数值实验表明，该方法能准确分辨尖锐间断，并有效捕捉多个激波与稀疏波之间的相互作用。
Motivation: 基于神经网络的数值方法（如 PINN）在求解具有间断解的双曲守恒律时仍面临挑战；现有方法往往依赖间断位置等强先验假设，或引入降低精度的人工光滑项。
Method: WEPINN 在方程的弱（积分）形式下强制满足守恒律，并加入熵条件来选择物理上可容许的解，同时采用离散快速傅里叶变换（DFFT）进行高效的数值积分。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在一维和二维的多种标量守恒律及守恒律方程组上均能准确分辨尖锐间断，并有效捕捉多个激波与稀疏波的相互作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为，弱形式约束结合熵条件可以在不依赖间断位置等先验信息的前提下选出物理解，为用神经网络求解间断 PDE 提供一种可行框架。

papers.title: Dreamer-SAC: Off-Policy Learning in Latent World Models for Sample-Efficient Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Sample-efficient reinforcement learning for autonomous driving is often limited by the trade-off between data efficiency and model bias. While world models reduce the reliance on costly environment interactions, policy optimization over learned dynamics remains sensitive to prediction errors. This paper proposes the Dreamer-SAC framework, which integrates a recurrent state-space world model with an off-policy soft actor-critic algorithm trained directly in latent space. The framework uses a combination of real interactions and short-horizon generated trajectories with n-step target estimation and multi-objective supervision. Evaluated in autonomous driving scenarios with objectives encompassing driving efficiency and safety, the proposed framework consistently outperforms representative reinforcement learning baselines, including DreamerV3, SAC, and PPO, while achieving improved performance with substantially fewer real environment interactions. Experiments reveal an inverted-U relationship between rollout horizon and policy performance, where short-horizon latent rollouts achieve the best trade-off between additional training signals and accumulated model bias. Furthermore, n-step target estimation demonstrates more effectiveness over one-step temporal-difference targets in exploiting predicted experience for value learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dreamer-SAC 框架，将循环状态空间世界模型 (recurrent state-space world model) 与 off-policy 的 soft actor-critic (SAC) 算法结合，直接在潜空间 (latent space) 中进行策略优化。框架结合真实交互与短视界生成的轨迹，使用 n 步目标估计和多目标监督。在自动驾驶场景中，该方法在驾驶效率与安全性目标上稳定优于 DreamerV3、SAC、PPO 等基线，并且所需真实环境交互显著减少。实验还发现 rollout 视界与策略性能呈倒 U 型关系，短视界潜空间 rollout 在额外训练信号与累积模型偏差之间达到最佳平衡。
Motivation: 世界模型虽能减少对真实环境交互的依赖，但基于学习到的动态进行策略优化对预测误差敏感，样本效率与模型偏差之间存在权衡；自动驾驶场景下这一权衡尤为突出。
Method: Dreamer-SAC 将循环状态空间世界模型与 off-policy SAC 结合，使用潜空间内短视界生成的轨迹作为额外训练信号，并采用 n 步目标估计与多目标监督，以改进利用预测经验进行价值学习的效果。
Result: 在包含驾驶效率与安全的自动驾驶场景中，该方法一致优于 DreamerV3、SAC、PPO 等基线，且用更少的真实环境交互获得更好性能。实验显示 rollout 视界与策略性能呈倒 U 型关系，短视界 rollout 效果最佳；n 步目标估计比一步 TD 目标更有效地利用预测经验。
Conclusion: 作者强调短视界潜空间 rollout 能在增加训练信号与减少累积模型偏差之间取得最佳折中，n 步目标估计更适合利用世界模型生成的预测经验；其适用场景为自动驾驶，摘要未讨论其他领域的推广。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Persona Conditioning as an Assessor-Sensitivity Probe for LLM-Based IR Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as relevance assessors in information retrieval (IR) evaluation, raising questions about how assessor framing affects judgment reliability and downstream system comparison. We study persona conditioning as a diagnostic mechanism for exposing LLM assessor sensitivity. Using task-oriented personas drawn from two complementary sources (PersonaHub and NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-USA), we instantiate five assessor roles emphasizing intent interpretation, domain expertise, contrastive judgment, evidence verification, and global search-quality assessment, compared with a standard UMBRELA baseline. Across six LLM backbones on TREC DL20 and RAG24, our analyses reveal structured rather than uniform assessor sensitivity. Judgments usually remain close to the baseline while shifting assessment strictness, evidential threshold, or interpretation emphasis rather than producing widespread relevance reversals. At the system level, high-capacity models preserve system-ranking agreement, while smaller models amplify persona-induced instability. Local rank-displacement analysis shows sensitivity concentrates on particular retrieval systems and system types, especially neural ranking/reranking systems on DL20 and RAG-oriented pipelines on RAG24. Persona source matters less than assessor role and model capacity. These findings position persona-conditioned judging as a controlled sensitivity probe for stress-testing LLM-based IR evaluation pipelines and identifying systems whose evaluation outcomes are sensitive to assessor framing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 作为信息检索 (IR) 相关性评估者时，角色提示 (persona conditioning) 如何影响判断可靠性与系统比较结果。作者利用 PersonaHub 和 NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas-USA 两种来源构造五种评估角色，在六个 LLM 主干上于 TREC DL20 和 RAG24 数据集上与 UMBRELA 基线对比。分析发现评估者敏感性是结构化的而非均匀的：判断通常接近基线，但严格度、证据阈值或解释侧重点会变化；高容量模型保持系统排名一致性，而较小模型放大角色引发的不稳定性。
Motivation: LLM 被越来越多地用作 IR 评估中的相关性评估者，但评估者设定 (assessor framing) 如何影响判断可靠性和下游系统比较尚不明确，需要一种诊断机制来暴露这种敏感性。
Method: 提出以角色条件化作为敏感性的受控探针：从两种互补来源构建五类任务导向评估角色，分别强调意图解释、领域专长、对比判断、证据验证和全局检索质量评估，并与 UMBRELA 基线比较；在六个 LLM 主干上、TREC DL20 与 RAG24 两个基准上进行系统分析。
Result: 评估者敏感性呈现结构化模式：判断大多靠近基线，但严格度、证据阈值或解释侧重发生偏移而非大规模相关性反转；高容量模型保持系统排名一致性，较小模型会放大角色引起的不稳定；局部排名位移分析表明敏感性集中在特定系统类型上（DL20 的神经排序/重排系统，RAG24 的 RAG 导向管线），且角色来源的影响弱于评估角色本身与模型容量。
Conclusion: 作者主张将角色条件化判断作为受控敏感性探针，用于压力测试基于 LLM 的 IR 评估管线，并识别其评估结果易受评估者设定影响的系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generator-Guided Inverse Sampling for Lévy-Driven Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies inverse sampling for Lévy-driven generative models from the perspective of Markov generators. Unlike conventional diffusion models, Lévy-driven dynamics involve infinite jump activities, which makes their reverse process nonlocal and difficult to characterize using score information alone. We address this challenge by analyzing the forward and reversed generators. It is derived that the reversed jump component generally becomes a state-dependent Markov jump process governed by a nonlocal density ratio. This observation motivates a structured reverse sampler that decomposes the dynamics into diffusion, small jump, and large jump components. Based on this characterization, we develop a computationally tractable sampler for a class of isotropic linear Lévy SDEs with symmetric $α$-stable jump components. For the jump component, the neural network is used only to amortize the rate of large jump activities, while jump amplitudes are generated from analytically derived conditional distributions, which improves interpretability and controllability. Efficient implementation techniques are further introduced under this setting to avoid expensive high-dimensional integration and sampling. The sampler is further adapted to approximate observation-guided sampling and applied to OFDM-SISO channel estimation under mixed Gaussian and impulsive noise. Simulations show robust estimation performance with a favorable tradeoff between complexity and performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从马尔可夫生成元 (Markov generator) 视角研究 Lévy 驱动生成模型的反向采样。作者推导出逆向跳跃分量是依赖状态的非局部马尔可夫跳跃过程，并将反向动力学分解为扩散、小跳跃和大跳跃三部分；针对各向同性线性 Lévy SDE（含对称 α-稳定跳跃）设计了可计算的采样器，其中神经网络仅用于摊销大跳跃速率，跳跃幅度由解析条件分布生成。仿真显示该方法在 OFDM-SISO 信道估计中表现稳健。
Motivation: 传统扩散模型的逆过程依赖 score 信息，而 Lévy 驱动动力学包含无限跳跃活动，其逆过程是非局部的，难以仅用 score 刻画，因此需要新的反向采样框架。
Method: 通过分析正反向生成元，推导出逆向跳跃部分为状态依赖的马尔可夫跳跃过程，受非局部密度比控制；据此提出将反向动力学分解为扩散、小跳跃和大跳跃三部分的采样器。对一类各向同性线性 Lévy SDE（对称 α-稳定跳跃）给出可实现版本：神经网络只负责摊销大跳跃强度，跳跃幅度从解析条件分布中采样，并引入高效实现技巧以避免高维积分与采样。
Result: 摘要报告在 OFDM-SISO 信道估计（混合高斯与脉冲噪声场景）上的仿真显示估计性能稳健，并在复杂度与性能之间取得良好权衡。
Conclusion: 该框架将 Lévy 驱动的反向采样转化为可分解的生成元表示，跳跃幅度的解析条件分布提升了可解释性和可控性，并扩展到观测引导采样；更广泛的适用范围和局限需参考原文。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文从马尔可夫生成元 (Markov generator) 视角研究 Lévy 驱动生成模型的反向采样。作者推导出逆向跳跃分量是依赖状态的非局部马尔可夫跳跃过程，并将反向动力学分解为扩散、小跳跃和大跳跃三部分；针对各向同性线性 Lévy SDE（含对称 α-稳定跳跃）设计了可计算的采样器，其中神经网络仅用于摊销大跳跃速率，跳跃幅度由解析条件分布生成。仿真显示该方法在 OFDM-SISO 信道估计中表现稳健。
summary_sections.motivation: 传统扩散模型的逆过程依赖 score 信息，而 Lévy 驱动动力学包含无限跳跃活动，其逆过程是非局部的，难以仅用 score 刻画，因此需要新的反向采样框架。
summary_sections.method: 通过分析正反向生成元，推导出逆向跳跃部分为状态依赖的马尔可夫跳跃过程，受非局部密度比控制；据此提出将反向动力学分解为扩散、小跳跃和大跳跃三部分的采样器。对一类各向同性线性 Lévy SDE（对称 α-稳定跳跃）给出可实现版本：神经网络只负责摊销大跳跃强度，跳跃幅度从解析条件分布中采样，并引入高效实现技巧以避免高维积分与采样。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在 OFDM-SISO 信道估计（混合高斯与脉冲噪声场景）上的仿真显示估计性能稳健，并在复杂度与性能之间取得良好权衡。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架将 Lévy 驱动的反向采样转化为可分解的生成元表示，跳跃幅度的解析条件分布提升了可解释性和可控性，并扩展到观测引导采样；更广泛的适用范围和局限需参考原文。

papers.title: A Single Atom in Front of a Mirror is a Universal Reservoir Computer
papers.abstract_en: Universal approximation in reservoir computing is typically associated with a class of reservoirs. We show that universality can be associated with a single reservoir, considering a minimal setup of a single atom in front of a mirror. In its linear-transducer limit, our reservoir is a universal approximator of fading-memory maps under an operating class of checkable conditions, with a rate constant measured at the operating point. A given reservoir can reach arbitrary accuracy by changing measurement settings. The proof gives an explicit recipe: for a target accuracy, it specifies the required physical resources and resonator modes. Enlarging the number of accessible modes increases the matchable kernel span without reducing capability. Beyond the linear limit, the atom's saturation replaces high-order polynomial readouts, and the device operates on real-world tasks alongside classical baselines. Our results highlight an example of universality with a minimal quantum setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究单个原子放置在镜子前方这一最小量子系统作为储层计算 (reservoir computing) 设备的通用逼近能力。作者证明在线性换能器极限下，该单储层在可检验的运行条件下是遗忘记忆映射 (fading-memory maps) 的通用逼近器，并在运行点给出了速率常数。证明还提供了显式构造方案：给定目标精度，可以指定所需的物理资源和谐振腔模式。
Motivation: 储层计算的通用逼近通常与一类储层相关，而非与单一储层相关。作者希望展示通用性可以与单个物理储层挂钩，并用极简的量子结构实现，从而以最小物理资源达到通用逼近。
Method: 考虑镜子前单原子的最小化设置，在线性换能器极限下将系统建模为通用逼近器；通过可检验操作条件给出逼近保证，并给出面向目标精度的显式构造，规定所需物理资源和谐振模式。在线性极限之外，利用原子的饱和效应替代高阶梯多项式读出，使装置能处理现实任务。
Result: 摘要报告该单原子储层可通过对测量设置进行调节达到任意精度，且速率常数在运行点测量；增加可访问模式数可扩大可匹配的核跨度而不降低能力。在非线性区，装置与经典基线一起在真实任务上运行。
Conclusion: 作者强调这是以最小量子设置实现通用逼近的一个例子；定理层面的保证适用于线性换能器极限，而现实任务表现依赖超出线性极限的原子饱和非线性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Forecasting: Recasting Volatility Control as a Routing Problem
papers.abstract_en: Volatility control converts risk estimates into portfolio exposure, yet existing approaches often rely on a fixed volatility estimator or a pre-defined control rule that may not adapt to changing market conditions. We propose VolRouter, a modular framework that formulates volatility control as state-conditioned routing over estimator-controller pairs. VolRouter first summarizes market conditions into a control-relevant state profile and then performs routing through three stages: state inference, switch review, and pair selection. The Router can be implemented using rule-based, learnable, or LLM-based decision modules, while portfolio actions remain generated by predefined control policies. We evaluate VolRouter across S&P 500, Multi-Asset, Bitcoin, and USDT volatility-control settings. VolRouter achieves the highest Sharpe ratio in three of four settings. On S&P 500, it improves Sharpe from 0.952 for RV + Naive Scaling to 1.222 while reducing maximum drawdown from 15.10% to 12.58% and daily CVaR from 1.76% to 1.32%. On Multi-Asset, it improves Sharpe from 1.498 to 1.540 and reduces CVaR from 1.56% to 1.18%. Bitcoin shows similar improvements in risk-adjusted performance, while USDT provides a boundary case where simpler state-aware selectors remain competitive. Ablation and sensitivity analyses show that the improvement comes from relative policy evaluation and selective persistent switching rather than simply expanding the policy library. These results suggest that volatility control can be viewed as a policy-selection problem when risk management requirements vary across market states.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VolRouter，一个将波动率控制 (volatility control) 重构为状态条件路由问题的模块化框架，在市场条件状态画像上对估计器-控制器对进行路由选择。框架包含状态推断、切换审查、配对选择三个阶段，路由器可用规则、可学习或基于 LLM 的决策模块实现，而组合操作仍由预定义控制策略生成。在 S&P 500、多资产、比特币和 USDT 四个波动率控制设置中，VolRouter 在三个设置取得最高 Sharpe 比率；消融与敏感性分析表明收益来自相对策略评估和选择性持久切换，而非单纯扩大策略库。
Motivation: 现有波动率控制方法通常依赖固定的波动率估计器或预定义控制规则，难以适应不断变化的市场条件，导致风险估计到组合敞口的转换不够灵活。
Method: 将波动率控制形式化为状态条件下的路由问题：先将市场条件总结为控制相关的状态画像，再通过状态推断、切换审查和配对选择三个阶段在估计器-控制器对之间进行路由；路由器支持规则式、可学习和 LLM 式模块，组合动作仍由预定义控制策略生成。
Result: 在四个设置中的三个取得最高 Sharpe：S&P 500 上 Sharpe 从 RV + Naive Scaling 的 0.952 提升至 1.222，最大回撤从 15.10% 降至 12.58%，日 CVaR 从 1.76% 降至 1.32%；多资产上 Sharpe 从 1.498 提升至 1.540，CVaR 从 1.56% 降至 1.18%；比特币也有类似风险调整收益提升，USDT 则作为边界情况表明简单的状态感知选择器仍有竞争力。
Conclusion: 当风险管理需求随市场状态变化时，波动率控制可被视作策略选择问题；收益主要来自相对策略评估与选择性持久切换，而非单纯扩展策略库。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Fisher8: Stabilizing Neural Heteroscedastic Regression via Output-Layer Fisher Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Training neural networks to jointly predict mean and uncertainty estimates from noisy observations can be unstable, prompting a series of independent stabilization efforts. We argue that these interventions highlight a common underlying issue where gradient steps are poorly aligned with the geometry of the loss landscape. To better align updates with local curvature, we derive Fisher8, an output-layer gradient correction that reorients and rescales updates using Fisher geometry rather than Euclidean geometry. Unlike past stabilizers, Fisher8 introduces no data-dependent hyperparameters beyond learning rate and admits an approximate KL trust radius between successive predictive distributions. We show that prior stabilizers converge on overlapping components of this geometric correction. Across multidimensional regression and representation-learning tasks, Fisher8 obtains superior likelihood--error tradeoffs, predicts calibrated uncertainty estimates, and learns rich uncertainty-aware feature spaces.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Fisher8，一种针对神经网络异方差回归的输出层梯度校正方法，利用 Fisher 几何而非欧氏几何来重定向和缩放梯度更新，以稳定同时预测均值与不确定性的训练过程。作者声称 Fisher8 不引入除学习率外的数据依赖超参数，并提供连续预测分布之间的近似 KL 信任半径。在多元回归和表示学习任务上，摘要报告其获得更优的似然-误差权衡、校准的不确定性估计，以及富含不确定性信息的特征空间。
Motivation: 神经网络在从含噪观测中联合预测均值和不确定性时训练不稳定，已有多种相互独立的稳定化尝试；作者认为这些干预措施背后有一个共同问题，即梯度步与损失景观的几何结构对齐不良。
Method: 推导 Fisher8 输出层梯度校正，利用 Fisher 几何而不是欧氏几何对更新进行重定向和缩放；该方法不引入除学习率之外的数据依赖超参数，并允许计算近似 KL 信任半径。
Result: 摘要报告在多元回归和表示学习任务上，Fisher8 取得更优的似然-误差权衡、校准的不确定性估计，并能学习富含不确定性感知的特征空间。
Conclusion: 作者指出先前的稳定化方法收敛于该几何校正的重叠组成部分，表明这些干预可统一理解为对 Fisher 几何梯度的部分修正。

papers.title: Invertible Logits Transformation for Accuracy-Preserving Post-Hoc Uncertainty Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Post-hoc calibration aligns a classifier's predicted confidences with its empirical accuracy without retraining. An ideal calibrator should correct nonlinear miscalibration, scale gracefully to large label spaces, and preserve the original predictions; existing methods typically violate at least one of these properties---temperature scaling lacks expressivity, more flexible parametric alternatives introduce parameters that grow with the number of classes $C$, and other expressive methods do not preserve the rank ordering of class scores and may alter the predicted class. We propose \textbf{Invertible Logits Transformation (InvLT)}, which applies a learned scalar MLP $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ element-wise to the pre-softmax logits. Sharing $f$ across all logit dimensions makes the parameter count independent of $C$. Monotonicity of $f$---and hence preservation of the argmax prediction---is softly encouraged via a paired inverse network rather than enforced through the numerical integration required by prior monotone calibrators; this avoids their computational overhead while empirically preserving the original classification accuracy in every setting we evaluate. Across standard image classification benchmarks and a range of architectures, InvLT consistently outperforms a broad set of post-hoc baselines on standard calibration metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出可逆 logits 变换 (Invertible Logits Transformation, InvLT)，用于事后概率校准 (post-hoc calibration)：对 pre-softmax logits 逐元素应用一个共享的学习标量 MLP f: R→R，使参数数量与类别数 C 无关，并通过配对逆网络 (paired inverse network) 软性地鼓励 f 的单调性，从而在不强制数值积分的情况下保留 argmax 预测。摘要称在标准图像分类基准和多种架构上，InvLT 在常用校准指标上持续优于多种事后校准基线，并在所有评估设置中保持原始分类准确率。
Motivation: 现有事后校准方法难以同时满足三点：能纠正非线性误校准、能扩展到大规模标签空间、且不改变原始预测。温度缩放表达力不足，灵活的参数化方法参数随类别数 C 增长，其他表达性方法可能破坏类别分数排序甚至改变预测类别。
Method: InvLT 将学到的标量 MLP 逐元素应用到 logits 上，所有 logit 维度共享同一函数 f，因此参数量与 C 无关；通过引入配对逆网络软性地鼓励 f 的单调性以避免先验单调校准器所需的数值积分开销，从而在保留 argmax 预测的同时降低计算成本。
Result: 在标准图像分类基准和多种架构上，InvLT 在标准校准指标上一致优于多种事后校准基线，并在评估的所有设置中保持原始分类准确率。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过共享标量变换加软单调约束，可以在保持预测不变的前提下以与类别数无关的参数规模实现灵活的校准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Outdoor 100-m-scale air waveguides
papers.abstract_en: Optical power densities for standoff spectroscopy, remote sensing, directed energy, and free-space optical communications are limited by diffraction and adverse atmospheric conditions such as turbulence, fog, and wind. Air waveguides, generated by ultrashort-pulsed laser filamentation, are a promising approach for transmission and collection of optical signals over long distances, overcoming beam diffraction and, for point-like sources, inverse square signal falloff with distance. In this work, we demonstrate outdoor guiding for the first time over a record length of ~100 m, exceeding the prior (indoor) record of 42 m. We correlate air waveguide performance to a range of real atmospheric conditions including turbulent refractive index structure parameter ($C_n^2$) values up to ~$2.5\times10^{-14} m^{-2/3}$, crosswind speeds up to ~2 m/s, as well as temperature, pressure, and humidity variations. Accompanying propagation simulations provide insight into the real effects of these environmental perturbations, particularly crosswind, on waveguide performance and lifetime. Our results pave the way for quasi-continuous air waveguiding with kHz-scale repetition rate filaments in challenging outdoor environments.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 自由空间光通信、遥感和定向能等应用的光功率密度受衍射以及湍流、雾和风等大气条件限制；空气波导被视为克服衍射和点源逆平方衰减的途径，但此前只在室内验证到42米，缺少室外真实环境下的表现数据。
Method: 利用超短脉冲激光成丝生成空气波导，开展室外约100米长度的导引实验；同步记录C_n^2、侧风速度、温度、压力和湿度等大气参数，并以传播模拟（propagation simulations）解释这些环境扰动对波导性能和寿命的影响。
Result: 实验首次实现室外约100米的空气波导导引，超过先前室内42米记录；在C_n^2达约2.5×10^-14 m^(-2/3)、侧风约2 m/s等条件下评估了波导性能，模拟结果揭示了侧风等扰动对波导性能和寿命的作用。

papers.title: DSAgentBench: Can Agents Automate End-to-End Data-Science Workflows in Real Computer Environments?
papers.abstract_en: Real-world data science involves long-horizon workflows that span data wrangling, exploration, modeling, visualization, and validation, and require coordinated use of tools such as notebooks, IDEs, terminals, browsers, and databases within real operating environments. Yet existing benchmarks lack real-computer interaction and do not evaluate whether agents can execute complete end-to-end data-science workflows in realistic computing environments, failing to capture the multi-stage, multi-tool nature of data-science practice. We introduce DSAgentBench, the first benchmark to evaluate whether agents can automate full data-science workflows inside real computer environments. DSAgentBench contains 275 diverse tasks covering the entire data-science life-cycle, reflecting the complexity and tool coordination required in practice. Each task requires grounding decisions in intermediate outputs and coordinated tool use, and includes a deterministic evaluator that verifies analytical correctness, visual outputs, and model performance rather than code-only execution. Our extensive experiments with 15 closed- and open-source models show that even the strongest agent, Claude-4.6-Sonnet, achieves only 56.70% task success, while all open-source agents remain below 1%, frequently failing at tool orchestration, OS grounding, and multi-step reasoning. These results reveal a substantial capability gap between current agentic systems and real data-science workflows, positioning DSAgentBench as a foundation for developing grounded, verifiable, autonomous data-science agents. We release DSAgentBench at https://github.com/vis-nlp/DSAgentBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DSAgentBench，据称是首个在真实计算机环境中评估智能体能否自动化完整数据科学工作流的基准。基准包含 275 个覆盖数据科学全生命周期（数据整理、探索、建模、可视化、验证）的多样化任务，并使用确定性评估器检验分析正确性、视觉输出和模型性能。作者对 15 个闭源与开源模型做了实验，最强模型 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 仅达到 56.70% 的任务成功率，而所有开源智能体成功率低于 1%。
Motivation: 现有数据科学基准缺乏真实计算机环境交互，无法评估智能体在现实计算环境中执行端到端、多阶段、多工具（notebook、IDE、终端、浏览器、数据库）数据科学工作流的能力，与真实实践存在差距。
Method: 构建 DSAgentBench 基准，包含 275 个覆盖完整数据科学生命周期的任务；每个任务要求智能体基于中间输出进行决策并协调使用多种工具，同时配备确定性评估器，从分析正确性、视觉输出和模型性能三个层面验证结果，而非仅检查代码执行。
Result: 在 15 个闭源和开源模型上的实验显示，最强模型 Claude-4.6-Sonnet 的任务成功率仅为 56.70%，开源智能体全部低于 1%，主要失败模式是工具编排、操作系统（OS）grounding 和多步推理。
Conclusion: 结果表明当前智能体系统与真实数据科学工作流之间存在显著能力差距；作者将该基准定位为开发具备 grounded、可验证能力的自主数据科学智能体的基础，并已发布基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Nutrition Data Infrastructure for the AI Era: Operationalizing FAIR for Agent-Mediated Research
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can accelerate nutrition research, but their analyses inherit the identity, semantic, and release ambiguities of the underlying data. We present Nutrition Data Service (NDS), source-preserving infrastructure that operationalizes FAIR for automated use: description resolution makes release-specific records findable; typed crosswalks connect independently released resources; machine-readable interfaces expose versioned sources and crosswalks, making analyses by AI agents replayable and auditable. On food-description benchmarks, NDS shows strong held-out accuracy and outperforms the best published language-model result on NutriBench. External and blinded crosswalk evaluations show that its typed contract favors defensible links and rejects unsupported mappings. In a person-level glycemic-index analysis, pinned NDS inputs produce identical outputs across models and repeated runs, while open-web reconstruction remains unstable. The central result is that agent-mediated nutrition research requires a new data infrastructure for data identity, search, and crosswalk.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Nutrition Data Service (NDS)，一个面向 AI 代理营养研究的数据基础设施，将 FAIR 原则操作化：通过描述解析使版本化记录可发现，通过类型化交叉映射连接独立发布的资源，并提供机器可读接口让分析可重放、可审计。在食物描述基准上，NDS 达到强留出准确率并超越 NutriBench 上最佳已发表语言模型结果；外部盲法交叉映射评估显示其类型化契约支持可辩护的映射并拒绝不支持的映射。核心结论是代理介导的营养研究需要针对数据身份、搜索和交叉映射的新数据基础设施。
Motivation: AI 代理可以加速营养研究，但其分析会继承底层数据的身份、语义和发布歧义；现有 FAIR 实践缺少面向自动化使用的可操作基础设施，导致代理分析难以保证可复现性与可审计性。
Method: 提出 NDS：采用描述解析（description resolution）使发布特定记录可发现；用类型化交叉映射（typed crosswalks）连接独立发布的资源；通过机器可读接口暴露版本化源与映射，使 AI 代理的分析可重放（replayable）且可审计（auditable）。
Result: 在食物描述基准上，NDS 显示强留出准确率并超越 NutriBench 上最佳已发表语言模型结果；外部和盲法交叉映射评估表明其类型化契约支持可辩护的链接并拒绝不支持的映射；在个人层面血糖指数分析中，固定的 NDS 输入跨模型和重复运行产生相同输出，而开放网络重建不稳定。
Conclusion: 作者强调，代理介导的营养研究需要新的数据基础设施来处理数据身份、搜索和交叉映射问题，NDS 是该方向的一种具体实现。摘要未明确讨论局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MemSpec: Memory-Aware Runtime for Adaptive Draft Scheduling in Speculative Decoding on Edge Devices
papers.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to speculate multiple tokens, reducing expensive target model decoding steps. Its effectiveness depends heavily on draft selection, motivating adaptive methods that exploit variation across inputs and generation stages. On memory-constrained edge devices, however, these methods often fail to improve end-to-end throughput due to the overhead of switching between draft models. We identify a key limitation in this setting: the mismatch between draft selection and draft availability under tight memory budgets. To address this challenge, we present MemSpec, a prediction-guided, memory-aware runtime for adaptive speculative decoding on edge devices. MemSpec decouples draft selection from execution through proactive resident working-set management. A lightweight predictor estimates draft effectiveness from prompt and generation context, while a memory-aware scheduler reduces reactive model loading overhead. Experiments on a Jetson Orin Nano show that MemSpec improves steady-state generation throughput by 40.7% on average over state-of-the-art bandit-based adaptive methods while closely approaching the oracle upper bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MemSpec，一个面向边缘设备上自适应推测解码 (speculative decoding) 的内存感知运行时。作者指出在内存受限设备上，草稿模型 (draft model) 的选择与可用性之间存在不匹配，并通过预测引导的工作集管理解耦选择与执行。在 Jetson Orin Nano 上，相比基于 bandit 的自适应方法，稳态生成吞吐量平均提升 40.7%，接近 oracle 上界。
Motivation: 推测解码在边缘设备上依赖自适应草稿模型选择，但切换草稿模型的开销在内存受限环境下常抵消端到端吞吐收益；草稿选择与草稿可用性不匹配是这一设置下的关键瓶颈。
Method: MemSpec 通过预测引导、内存感知的运行时解耦草稿选择与执行：轻量预测器从 prompt 和生成上下文估计草稿有效性，内存感知调度器减少反应式模型加载开销，并采用主动驻留工作集管理 (proactive resident working-set management)。
Result: 在 Jetson Orin Nano 上的实验显示，与 state-of-the-art 的基于 bandit 的自适应方法相比，稳态生成吞吐量平均提高 40.7%，且接近 oracle 上界。
Conclusion: 作者强调，内存感知的草稿调度能有效缓解边缘设备上自适应推测解码的切换开销，使自适应方法在内存受限环境中真正改善端到端吞吐。

papers.title: MazzikaAI: A knowledge-based performance-to-prompt compiler for real-time Arabic maqam accompaniment with a streaming text-to-music model
papers.abstract_en: Arabic maqam music microtonal, modal, and built on ornamented call and response is among the traditions most underserved by generative music models, whose training frameworks remain predominantly Western and equaltempered. Real time accompaniment sharpens this gap: an AI partner must listen, adapt dynamically, and respect idiomatic microtonal structures. Streaming text to music models provide strong generative capabilities but lack precise control interfaces. We present MazzikaAI, a knowledge based system that uses natural language as the actuator of a realtime control loop. By compiling live MIDI, gesture, and inferred harmony into continuously updated text prompts, MazzikaAI steers an unmodified streaming generator, Google Lyria RealTime, without requiring model finetuning. The system embeds expert knowledge of six core maqamat, characteristic ornaments, and ensemble dynamics, maintaining realtime responsiveness with subsecond keytoaudibleupdate latency. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that dynamic prompt compilation reliably grounds generation in microtonal scales, significantly increasing offgrid quartertone content over baseline generation. Beyond its core implementation, MazzikaAI illustrates how deterministic knowledgebased rules can effectively bridge expert, nonWestern musical traditions and unfinetuned foundation models. This architecture establishes a scalable paradigm for realtime humanAI cocreation, offering a generalizable blueprint for interactive accompaniment, adaptive music education, and culturally inclusive generative audio across diverse global idioms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MazzikaAI 是一个面向实时阿拉伯 maqam 音乐伴奏的知识驱动系统，将实时 MIDI、手势和推断和声编译为持续更新的文本提示，用于控制未微调的流式文本转音乐模型 Google Lyria RealTime。系统内嵌六种核心 maqamat、装饰音与合奏动态的专家知识，实现亚秒级按键到音频更新延迟，并在不微调模型的前提下显著增加离格四分之一音内容。
Motivation: 阿拉伯 maqam 音乐具有微音程、调式性和装饰性应答结构，但生成式音乐模型的训练框架以西方平均律为主，使其成为服务最不足的传统之一；实时伴奏进一步要求 AI 能边听边动态适应并遵循特定微音程结构。流式文本转音乐模型虽有强生成能力，却缺乏精确控制接口。
Method: 提出一种基于知识的系统，把自然语言作为实时控制回路的执行器：将实时 MIDI、手势和推断和声编译成持续更新的文本提示，驱动未修改的流式生成器 Google Lyria RealTime，无需模型微调；系统嵌入六种核心 maqamat、特征装饰音和合奏动态的领域知识。
Result: 实证评估表明，动态提示编译能可靠地将生成锚定在微音程音阶上，显著增加离格四分之一音内容，并保持亚秒级按键到音频更新延迟。
Conclusion: 作者认为，确定性知识驱动规则能有效连接非西方专业音乐传统与未微调的基础模型，该架构为实时人机共创、自适应音乐教育和跨文化包容性生成音频提供了可推广的蓝图。

summary_sections.motivation: 阿拉伯 maqam 音乐具有微音程、调式性和装饰性应答结构，但生成式音乐模型的训练框架以西方平均律为主，使其成为服务最不足的传统之一；实时伴奏进一步要求 AI 能边听边动态适应并遵循特定微音程结构。流式文本转音乐模型虽有强生成能力，却缺乏精确控制接口。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种基于知识的系统，把自然语言作为实时控制回路的执行器：将实时 MIDI、手势和推断和声编译成持续更新的文本提示，驱动未修改的流式生成器 Google Lyria RealTime，无需模型微调；系统嵌入六种核心 maqamat、特征装饰音和合奏动态的领域知识。
summary_sections.result: 实证评估表明，动态提示编译能可靠地将生成锚定在微音程音阶上，显著增加离格四分之一音内容，并保持亚秒级按键到音频更新延迟。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为，确定性知识驱动规则能有效连接非西方专业音乐传统与未微调的基础模型，该架构为实时人机共创、自适应音乐教育和跨文化包容性生成音频提供了可推广的蓝图。

papers.title: Efficient Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agentic Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tool-using agents must reason over user goals, domain policies, tool calls, simulator state, and delayed verifiable rewards. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a natural fit for this setting, but multi-turn on-policy rollouts create long contexts, while model-specific attention layers may require custom masks and learned sink normalization. We present SINKFLEX-RL, a modular training system for RL in dual-control tool-use environments. The system combines a Gymnasium-compatible environment wrapper, a VERL-style rollout dataflow, group-relative policy optimization without a separate value model, and a sink-aware FlexAttention path designed to preserve model-specific sink scaling under causal and sliding-window masks. In a preliminary Tau2Bench retail run, validation reward (mean@1) rises from 0.25 early in training to $0.44$ later in the observed training window, while training-score and trajectory-reward proxies also trend upward. In a fixed-configuration memory benchmark, the optimized attention path reduces peak VRAM from 28.06GB to 22.52GB at 4096 tokens, a $19.7\%$ reduction, and runs the measured 8192-token configuration using $25.53$~GB where the eager baseline runs out of memory. These results illustrate the value of integrating environment interfaces, RL dataflow, and attention-kernel design for memory-feasible long-horizon agent training.
papers.comment: Published at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SINKFLEX-RL，一个用于长视野工具使用智能体任务中强化学习训练（RL）的模块化系统，面向双控制工具使用环境。系统整合了 Gymnasium 兼容的环境包装器、VERL 风格的 rollout 数据流、不依赖独立价值模型的 group-relative policy optimization，以及 sink-aware FlexAttention 路径。初步实验显示，在 Tau2Bench 零售场景中验证奖励（mean@1）从训练早期的 0.25 升至观察窗口后期的 0.44；在固定配置的内存基准中，4096 token 下的峰值显存从 28.06GB 降至 22.52GB（降幅 19.7%），8192 token 配置以 25.53GB 运行而 eager 基线则内存不足。
Motivation: 长视野工具使用智能体需要对用户目标、领域策略、工具调用、模拟器状态和延迟的可验证奖励进行推理，RL 是自然的适配方案，但多轮 on-policy rollout 会产生长上下文，且模型专属的注意力层可能需要自定义掩码和学习到的 sink 归一化，导致训练在内存上不可行。
Method: SINKFLEX-RL 是一个模块化训练系统，组合了 Gymnasium 兼容的环境包装器、VERL 风格的 rollout 数据流、不使用独立价值模型的 group-relative policy optimization，以及 sink-aware FlexAttention 路径，用于在 causal 和 sliding-window 掩码下保持模型专属的 sink 缩放。
Result: 在 Tau2Bench 零售初步运行中，验证奖励（mean@1）从训练早期约 0.25 上升到观察窗口后期的 0.44，训练分数和轨迹奖励代理指标也呈上升趋势；固定配置内存基准中，优化后的注意力路径在 4096 token 下将峰值显存从 28.06GB 降至 22.52GB（19.7% 降幅），并在 8192 token 配置下以 25.53GB 运行，而 eager 基线在该配置下内存不足。

papers.title: Accelerated Learning of High Dimensional Functions with a Tensor-Featured Training Network
papers.abstract_en: In this work we present a method to accelerate the optimization of learning high dimensional functions using deep neural network (DNN). This optimization procedure introduces contextual features into the first layer of a DNN. The parameters of DNN are optimized via standard gradient descent while keeping the input-feature basis fixed. After optimization of the DNN parameters, the feature layer is provided a chance to update and change before DNN optimization resumes. The feature layer has two types of functions: those that can be evaluated quickly in a matrix-free way on the domain (i.e. rank-1 features) and more complex features that must first be decomposed using tensor network (TN) decomposition strategies (tensor features). In particular, we study the effect of adding features which distill pretrained DNN into TNs using a discretize and decompose strategy. To efficiently decompose high-dimensional functions constructed from discretized DNN, we leverage a randomized tensor decomposition strategy. Using randomization, we are able to reduce the storage cost of decomposing high dimensional functions by at least 8 orders of magnitude. Using this approach, we are able to efficiently train models between 5 and 40 dimensions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种加速高维函数深度学习优化的方法，在神经网络第一层引入上下文特征（contextual features），并交替优化网络参数与特征层。特征层包含可矩阵快速求值的 rank-1 特征和需经张量网络（tensor network, TN）分解的张量特征；作者用随机化张量分解将预处理 DNN 蒸馏为 TN，使存储成本降低至少 8 个数量级，并支持 5 至 40 维的高效训练。
Motivation: 高维函数的学习优化成本高昂，现有 DNN 方法在处理高维输入时训练效率受限。作者希望通过在输入层注入结构化的上下文特征，并利用张量网络分解来降低高维函数表示与存储的开销。
Method: 在 DNN 的第一层引入固定输入特征基（contextual features），先用标准梯度下降优化网络参数而保持特征层不变，之后允许特征层更新再继续优化。特征层由可矩阵快速求值的 rank-1 特征和需用 TN 分解的张量特征组成；对离散化 DNN 构造的高维函数，采用随机化张量分解策略以大幅降低存储成本。
Result: 摘要报告该方法可将高维函数分解的存储成本降低至少 8 个数量级，并能高效训练 5 到 40 维的模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为结合上下文特征与随机化张量分解可以加速高维函数的 DNN 学习；摘要未涉及具体应用场景或与其他方法的定量对比。

papers.title: Beyond Detection Accuracy: Measuring Explanation Cost, Stability, and Utility for Resource-Aware IoT Intrusion Detection
papers.abstract_en: Machine-learning intrusion-detection studies commonly emphasize predictive accuracy while treating explanation generation as a computationally free post-processing step. This study jointly evaluates predictive effectiveness, explanation cost, local explanation stability, and selective explanation for binary Internet of Things (IoT) intrusion detection. A leakage-safe CICIoT2023 corpus was constructed using exact 39-feature hashes, non-finite-value handling, exact-feature deduplication, conservative label-collision removal, and deterministic hash-level partitioning. Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost were evaluated on natural and balanced test distributions. TreeSHAP cost was measured, stability was assessed under prediction-preserving perturbations, and validation-calibrated policies were used to allocate explanation workload. XGBoost provided the strongest overall predictive profile, while Random Forest produced the lowest false-positive rate. At 5,000 samples, TreeSHAP required 700.759 s for Random Forest and 1.471 s for XGBoost. Random Forest showed the strongest overall base-level explanation stability; XGBoost retained high rank and directional consistency but showed greater top-feature turnover and attribution-magnitude drift. On the balanced test, about 90% false-negative explanation coverage permitted 28-32% compute savings, while about 95% coverage permitted 15-23% savings. Savings were much smaller under the attack-heavy natural prevalence. These results show that operationally useful explainable IoT intrusion detection depends on predictive quality, explanation cost, local stability, workload prevalence, and selective invocation rather than detection accuracy alone.
papers.comment: 43 pages, 3 figures, 15 tables. Submitted to Internet of Things. Reproducibility materials are publicly archived on Zenodo
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对物联网二进制入侵检测，联合评估预测有效性、解释代价 (explanation cost)、局部解释稳定性 (local explanation stability) 与选择性解释 (selective explanation)，而不是只关注检测精度。作者构建了防泄漏的 CICIoT2023 语料，比较 Logistic Regression、Decision Tree、Random Forest 和 XGBoost，并实测 TreeSHAP 耗时、在保持预测的扰动下的稳定性，以及用验证集校准的策略分配解释工作量。结果表明 XGBoost 综合预测表现最强，Random Forest 假阳性率最低，且操作中可用的可解释入侵检测取决于多因素权衡而非单一精度指标。
Motivation: 现有机器学习入侵检测研究普遍把解释生成当作计算免费的后期步骤，只重视预测精度，忽略了资源受限物联网场景下解释成本、稳定性和选择性调用的影响。
Method: 构建防泄漏 CICIoT2023 语料，使用精确 39 特征哈希、非有限值处理、精确特征去重、保守的标签冲突移除和确定性哈希级划分；在自然分布与平衡测试分布上评估四种分类器，测量 TreeSHAP 代价，在保预测扰动下评估稳定性，并用验证集校准的策略分配解释工作负载。
Result: XGBoost 提供最强的整体预测画像，Random Forest 假阳性率最低；在 5000 样本下 TreeSHAP 对 Random Forest 需 700.759 秒，对 XGBoost 仅需 1.471 秒。Random Forest 整体基础级解释稳定性最强，XGBoost 保留较高的排名与方向一致性但顶层特征更替和归因幅度漂移更大。在平衡测试集上，约 90% 假阴性解释覆盖可节省 28-32% 计算量，约 95% 覆盖可节省 15-23%；在攻击密集的自然流行率下节省大幅减少。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，操作上有用的可解释物联网入侵检测取决于预测质量、解释成本、局部稳定性、工作负载流行率和选择性调用，而非仅靠检测精度。

papers.title: Towards Unified Dynamic Face Landmark Detection
papers.abstract_en: Although advancements in face landmark detection (FLD) methods continue to push performance boundaries, they overlook two major functional limitations: (1) different network parameters need to be trained independently for each ``$N$-point'' benchmark dataset, and (2) a model trained on an ``$N$-point'' dataset reliably outputs only the $N$ landmarks. In our work, we first conceptualize Face Part-Anchored Landmark Positions (FPALPs), wherein each landmark is treated as a progression value between zero (start) and one (end) along a face part's contour. Every landmark can be expressed in the FPALP format, irrespective of its source dataset, hence unlocking the ability to unify all ``$N$-point'' datasets into a single dataset. Secondly, we represent each landmark with an FPALP-based query, refine it progressively with a cross-modality decoder, and predict its coordinates based on the final representation. Our approach, called Unified Dynamic FLD, embodies these two design choices and streamlines the landmark detection pipeline by enabling (1) a single model to learn on any number of ``$N$-point'' datasets, and (2) yield any number of specific landmark predictions by loading the designated landmark queries at runtime. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that our method delivers these benefits while remaining competitive with, and in several cases outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures in Main Paper. 13 pages, 3 figures in Appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Unified Dynamic FLD，一种统一的人脸关键点检测方法。作者将每个关键点表示为沿人脸部件轮廓的 FPALP（Face Part-Anchored Landmark Positions）进度值，从而把不同 N 点数据集统一为单一数据格式，并用基于 FPALP 的查询和跨模态解码器逐步精化坐标。实验表明该方法支持单模型在多数据集上训练、运行时按需输出任意数量关键点，且与现有 SOTA 方法相比具有竞争力甚至更优。
Motivation: 现有 FLD 方法存在两个功能限制：不同 N 点基准数据集需独立训练不同网络参数，且模型只能可靠输出固定的 N 个关键点，缺乏跨数据集通用性和运行时灵活性。
Method: 首先提出 FPALP 表示，将每个关键点视为人脸部件轮廓上从 0（起点）到 1（终点）的进度值，使所有数据集的关键点可统一表达；其次用 FPALP 查询表示每个关键点，通过跨模态解码器逐步精化，并基于最终表示预测坐标。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法在获得统一训练与动态预测能力的同时，与现有 SOTA 方法表现相当，并在若干情况下超越它们。
Conclusion: 作者认为 Unified Dynamic FLD 通过两种设计选择简化了关键点检测流程，允许单模型学习任意数量 N 点数据集，并在运行时加载指定查询即可输出任意数量关键点预测。

summary_sections.method: 首先提出 FPALP 表示，将每个关键点视为人脸部件轮廓上从 0（起点）到 1（终点）的进度值，使所有数据集的关键点可统一表达；其次用 FPALP 查询表示每个关键点，通过跨模态解码器逐步精化，并基于最终表示预测坐标。
summary_sections.result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验显示，该方法在获得统一训练与动态预测能力的同时，与现有 SOTA 方法表现相当，并在若干情况下超越它们。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 Unified Dynamic FLD 通过两种设计选择简化了关键点检测流程，允许单模型学习任意数量 N 点数据集，并在运行时加载指定查询即可输出任意数量关键点预测。

papers.title: CasDeblurGS: Cascaded 2D-to-3D Multi-View Consistency for 3D Gaussian Splatting from Two Blurry Images
papers.abstract_en: Free-viewpoint 3D scene media is increasingly important for immersive applications, yet practical capture often suffers from severe view sparsity and motion blur. Although neural rendering has advanced sparse-view synthesis, existing blur-aware methods typically require substantial multi-view redundancy, accurate camera poses, or costly per-scene optimization. We address a stringent yet practical setting: reconstructing a coherent 3D scene from only two motion-blurred images with known intrinsics, without input-view poses, auxiliary sharp images, or per-scene test-time optimization. To this end, we propose CasDeblurGS, a cascaded framework that progressively recovers reliable cross-view information from local 2D correspondences to global 3D guidance. Stage 1 constructs locally reliable guidance through occlusion-aware correspondence filtering, while Stage 2 aggregates the intermediate restorations into a provisional pose-free 3D Gaussian representation whose input-view re-renders provide dense global guidance for final restoration. The resulting views enable a more coherent 3D representation and higher-quality novel-view synthesis. Experiments on real-world and synthetic Deblur-NeRF scenes show consistent gains over strong baselines, improving PSNR by 1.19 dB and 2.11 dB, respectively. Progressive ablations, cross-view correspondence visualization, and camera reprojection analysis further demonstrate improvements in both rendering quality and multi-view geometric consistency.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ECCV 2026 MUSTCV Workshop. Project page: https://haeyun-choi.github.io/Cascaded2D3D_page/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CasDeblurGS，一个级联框架，仅用两张已知内参的运动模糊图像重建一致的 3D 场景，无需输入视图位姿、辅助清晰图像或逐场景测试时优化。框架分两阶段：先通过遮挡感知对应过滤构造局部 2D 引导，再将中间复原结果聚合为无位姿 3D 高斯表示，其输入视图重渲染提供全局 3D 引导。实验在真实与合成 Deblur-NeRF 场景上比强基线分别提升 PSNR 1.19 dB 和 2.11 dB。
Motivation: 现有模糊感知神经渲染方法通常需要多视图冗余、准确相机位姿或逐场景优化，而实际采集常面临视图稀疏与运动模糊，难以满足仅两张模糊图像这一严格但实用的设置。
Method: 采用级联 2D 到 3D 策略：Stage 1 通过遮挡感知对应过滤构建局部可靠引导，Stage 2 将中间复原结果聚合为无位姿的 3D 高斯表征（3D Gaussian Splatting），并用其输入视图重渲染提供密集全局引导以完成最终复原。
Result: 在真实世界和合成 Deblur-NeRF 场景上，相比强基线 PSNR 分别提高 1.19 dB 和 2.11 dB；渐进消融、跨视图对应可视化和相机重投影分析显示渲染质量与多视图几何一致性均有提升。
Conclusion: 作者认为级联地从局部 2D 对应到全局 3D 指导可以仅凭两张模糊图像获得更一致的 3D 表示和更高质量的新视图合成。

papers.title: On the Importance of Geometric Nonlinearity and Temperature-Dependent Properties in Multi-Material Thermo-Mechanical Topology Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Thermo-mechanical compliant devices are commonly designed with small-strain linear elasticity and temperature-independent material properties, even though they might operate hundreds of kelvin above ambient where both assumptions are questionable. In this work, we quantify the effect and cost of each assumption in multi-material topology optimization of thermally actuated compliant devices. To this end, we introduce a physics-informed, simultaneous analysis-and-design framework with (i) a finite-strain quadratic-Hencky (logarithmic-strain) constitutive model whose isotropic thermal eigenstrain admits an exact additive split in log-strain space, and (ii) temperature-dependent conductivity, thermal expansion, and elastic moduli for a titanium--copper--steel material system. We optimize a thermal actuator and a thermal gripper at three design temperatures under both a baseline model and the full physics, subject to mass and manufacturability constraints. Every converged design is re-evaluated by verified nonlinear finite element solvers in the full factorial of constitutive law and property model. The comparison between the two factors reveals that the constitutive law is the decisive modeling choice: These devices work as linkages where linear kinematics mistakes rotation for compressive strain; its error therefore grows with the design temperature and concentrates on the very layouts that exploit rotation best. Because a linear optimizer also steers away from the rotation-rich mechanisms that would expose this bias, the model can deceptively appear trustworthy when validated against its own designs. Designing with the full physics yields consistently stronger and more temperature-robust devices at a modest increase in design-time cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文量化了热机械柔顺机构多材料拓扑优化中两个常见假设（小应变线弹性、材料属性与温度无关）的效应与代价。作者提出一个物理信息的同时分析与设计框架，采用有限应变二次 Hencky（对数应变）本构模型以及温度相关的导热、热膨胀和弹性模量，用于钛-铜-钢材料系统的热执行器和热夹持器优化。结果表明本构模型的选择是决定性因素：线性运动学会把旋转误判为压缩应变，且误差随设计温度增大。
Motivation: 热机械柔顺器件通常基于小应变线弹性和温度无关材料属性进行设计，但这些器件可能在高于环境数百开尔文下运行，两种假设的适用性存疑。作者希望量化每种假设对多材料拓扑优化结果的影响和计算代价。
Method: 提出同时分析与设计的物理信息框架，包括有限应变二次 Hencky（对数应变）本构模型，其各向同性热特征应变在对数应变空间可精确加法分解；同时引入温度相关的导热系数、热膨胀系数和弹性模量。在质量与可制造性约束下，作者用基线模型和全物理模型在三个设计温度下优化热执行器和热夹持器，并用非线性有限元求解器在完整因子组合中重新评估所有收敛设计。
Result: 全物理模型设计出的器件更强且对温度更稳健，设计时间成本仅适度增加。对比表明本构模型是决定性建模选择：线性运动学将旋转误认为压缩应变，误差随设计温度增大，并集中于最充分利用旋转的布局；同时，线性优化器会避开这些富含旋转的机构，使其模型在自己设计上的验证显得可信。
Conclusion: 作者强调在多材料热机械拓扑优化中应当考虑有限应变和温度相关材料属性，并指出线性模型的自验证可能造成误导。研究范围限定于热执行器和热夹持器以及钛-铜-钢材料系统，设计温度覆盖三个水平。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ENCORE: Efficient Noise Context-Aware Representation for Low-Dose CT Denoising
papers.abstract_en: While deep learning-based denoising has become widely adopted in low-dose CT, conventional models use generic architectures designed for natural images, failing to account for non-stationary and spatially correlated CT noise characteristics. To address this, we propose an Efficient Noise COntext-aware REpresentation (ENCORE) framework that explicitly leverages CT noise characteristics and anatomical features. First, we reformulate the noise synthesis procedure based on a realistic noise distribution beyond the conventional Gaussian approximation, establishing a rigorous foundation for training pair generation. Next, we extract local noise power and correlation contexts to guide the denoising process. To fully leverage the potential of noise context, we propose a FlyingConv module, which adaptively changes convolution weights for each local image region. Notably, our approach demonstrates substantial gains in both denoising quality and computational efficiency. Furthermore, manipulating the intensity of the noise context maps at inference time enables zero-shot conditional denoising, allowing for dynamic control over the output image texture. The entire pipeline is available at https://github.com/minwoo-yu/ENCORE.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出高效噪声上下文感知表示（ENCORE）框架用于低剂量CT去噪，显式利用CT噪声的非平稳特性和空间相关性，并整合解剖特征。作者先基于超越传统高斯近似的真实噪声分布重构噪声合成流程，再提取局部噪声功率与相关性上下文来引导去噪，并提出FlyingConv模块，使卷积权重随局部图像区域自适应变化。摘要报告该方法在去噪质量和计算效率上均有显著提升，并支持推理时通过调节噪声上下文图强度实现零样本条件去噪。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的低剂量CT去噪大多沿用为自然图像设计的通用架构，未考虑CT噪声的非平稳性和空间相关性，导致去噪效果受限。
Method: 重构噪声合成过程以贴近真实噪声分布，提取局部噪声功率和相关性上下文作为去噪引导，并设计FlyingConv模块按图像局部区域自适应调整卷积权重。
Result: 摘要称该方法在去噪质量和计算效率上均有实质性提升；推理时对噪声上下文图强度进行调节可实现零样本条件去噪，动态控制输出图像纹理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调显式建模CT噪声特征和解剖特征能够同时提升去噪性能与计算效率，并为输出纹理提供可调节的条件控制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Expert-Guided g-computation with Large Language Models for Estimating Causal Effects on Timings: Applications to Hospital Quality Improvement
papers.abstract_en: Hospital quality improvement (QI) programs routinely face multiple candidate interventions to optimize hospital flow, but existing methods struggle to estimate and rank the causal effects of such interventions. This work focuses on one of the most standard hospital metrics, the average length of stay (LOS), and its causal estimand, the average time saved. To characterize this causal effect, qualitative approaches rely on expert judgment to map patient trajectories, making them susceptible to cognitive biases; quantitative approaches rely on data-driven models, which fail when interventions are hypothetical with no historical data or have complex causal mechanisms that require clinical reasoning rather than data alone. We propose expert-guided g-computation, or egg-computation, which combines the complementary strengths of both approaches by connecting the Gantt charts commonly used to map patient trajectories with the causal DAG literature. We introduce a causal model over Gantt charts and establish identification using a variant of g-computation that seeks expert input only for components unidentifiable from data. To make egg-computation practical, we develop an LLM-assisted pipeline that reliably scales up expert reasoning. In simulations, egg-computation outperforms conventional causal inference methods when patients have diverse causal structures and intervention mechanisms. In a study of eleven candidate QI interventions at an urban safety-net hospital, the LLM pipeline generated graphs and time-saving estimates highly concordant with those of human experts. Beyond healthcare, egg-computation is a broadly applicable framework for estimating the average time saved for candidate interventions whose causal mechanisms can be represented using Gantt charts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医院质量改进（QI）中多个候选干预措施的因果效应估计与排序问题，提出专家引导的 g-computation（egg-computation）框架。该方法将常用于患者轨迹建模的甘特图（Gantt chart）与因果 DAG 文献结合，建立甘特图上的因果模型，并仅对数据中不可识别的成分请求专家输入。为实用化，作者开发了以 LLM 辅助的流水线来扩展专家推理；模拟实验显示其在患者因果结构多样时优于传统因果推断方法，在一家城市安全网医院的十一项 QI 干预研究中，LLM 生成的图与时间节省估计与人类专家高度一致。
Motivation: 医院 QI 项目通常面临多个候选干预措施，但现有方法难以估计和排序其因果效应，尤其是对平均住院时长（LOS）及平均节省时间这一因果估计量。定性方法依赖专家判断来映射患者轨迹，易受认知偏差影响；定量数据驱动方法则在干预是假设性的、缺乏历史数据、或需临床推理而非纯数据建模时失效。
Method: 提出 egg-computation，将专家判断与数据驱动估计互补结合：先建立甘特图上的因果模型，再用 g-computation 的变体进行识别，仅对数据不可识别的部分寻求专家输入；同时开发 LLM 辅助流水线，以可靠地扩展专家推理的规模。
Result: 模拟中，当患者具有多样因果结构和干预机制时，egg-computation 优于常规因果推断方法；在包含十一项候选 QI 干预的城市安全网医院研究中，LLM 流水线生成的因果图和时间节省估计与人类专家高度一致。
Conclusion: 作者指出，对于任何因果机制可用甘特图表示的候选干预，egg-computation 都是估计平均节省时间的通用框架，适用范围不限于医疗场景。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者指出，对于任何因果机制可用甘特图表示的候选干预，egg-computation 都是估计平均节省时间的通用框架，适用范围不限于医疗场景。

papers.title: Narrative Keyframing for Generative Creative Writing
papers.abstract_en: We introduce narrative keyframing, an interaction technique for AI-assisted creative writing that lets writers specify different types of narrative constraints at selected moments in a story, then use AI to generate intervening prose. Inspired by the use of keyframing in animation, narrative keyframing offers a flexible way to connect story planning with adaptive control over generated text. We explore three types of keyframes: plot keyframes define significant events in a story, character keyframes represent how individual characters change over the narrative, and perspective keyframes capture how individual characters experience different events through first-person narratives. Plot and character keyframes offer a flexible way to adapt the type of high-level conditioning explored in previous AI writing tools to more customizable, iterative, and fine-scale control, while perspective keyframes add a new way to control characterization and focalization by using first-person narratives as an intermediary. Through a user study, we show that narrative keyframing supports a more controllable, transparent, and engaging way to use generative AI in creative writing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出叙事关键帧（narrative keyframing），一种面向生成式创意写作的人机交互技术：作者在故事选定时刻指定叙事约束，由 AI 生成中间散文。抽象区分三类关键帧——情节关键帧（plot keyframes）、角色关键帧（character keyframes）和视角关键帧（perspective keyframes），其中视角关键帧通过第一人称叙述控制人物刻画与聚焦。用户研究显示该方法让生成式 AI 在创意写作中更可控、更透明、更具参与感。
Motivation: 现有 AI 写作工具通常只提供粗粒度的高层条件控制（high-level conditioning），难以在故事规划与生成文本之间建立灵活、可迭代的精细控制。作者借鉴动画中的关键帧思想，希望在选定时刻施加约束并让 AI 补全中间内容。
Method: 提出叙事关键帧交互技术，允许作者在故事的不同时刻放置三种关键帧：情节关键帧定义重要事件，角色关键帧描述角色随叙事的演变，视角关键帧用第一人称叙述表示角色对事件的体验；系统据此生成关键帧之间的散文。
Result: 通过用户研究（user study）表明，叙事关键帧支持更可控、更透明、更具参与感的生成式 AI 创意写作体验。摘要未给出具体的量化指标。
Conclusion: 作者认为，情节与角色关键帧把已有的高层条件控制改造成更可定制、可迭代、细粒度的控制，而视角关键帧以第一人称叙述为中介，新增了对人物刻画（characterization）与聚焦（focalization）的控制方式。摘要未提及明确的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: MERA: Model Evolution and Routing with Skill Adaptation for Agentic Systems at Scale
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents execute heterogeneous sequences of model calls within a single task: some invocations require careful reasoning, while others are structured steps such as formatting or tool-argument construction. Prior routing methods exploit this asymmetry by assigning easy invocations to a cheaper small model and difficult ones to a large model. Such policies reduce inference cost, but they leave the small model's capability unchanged, so attainable savings remain bounded by the work the student can already solve. MERA instead improves the small model itself, using a single model invocation as the unit of adaptation. In each cycle, MERA replays failed student invocations to obtain execution-verified teacher demonstrations, distills recurring procedures into an iteratively updated SkillBook, and fine-tunes a student LoRA adapter via supervised learning and optional GRPO. Routing serves as supporting machinery for deployment: the improved student is served behind a cost-calibrated router with verifier-backed fallback, and a candidate SkillBook, adapter, or router is admitted only when joint replay preserves task quality. Empirically, four-cycle adaptation raises Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B from 28.7% to 49.7% pass on held-out HumanEval+MBPP. Under verifier-backed fallback, the deployed policy retains 88.3% pass at 60.8% of always-Luna cost. On TAU-2, a fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B improves from 14/35 to 18/35 and matches an unadapted 4B model. These results indicate that verifier-backed multi-cycle adaptation can increase small-model capability, rather than only routing around a fixed student.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MERA，一种面向大规模 LLM agent 系统的模型演化与路由框架，以单个模型调用为适应单元。每轮循环中，MERA 回放失败的学生调用以获得执行验证的教师示范，将重复过程蒸馏进可迭代更新的 SkillBook，并通过监督学习和可选 GRPO 微调学生 LoRA 适配器。部署时使用成本校准的路由器与验证器回退，且只有联合回放保持任务质量时才会接纳新的 SkillBook、适配器或路由器。
Motivation: 现有路由方法将容易的调用分给廉价小模型、困难调用分给大模型，但小模型能力保持不变，因而节省成本受限于学生模型原本能求解的任务范围。作者认为需要提升小模型本身，而不是只绕开一个固定能力的学生。
Method: 以单次模型调用为适应单元：回放失败的学生调用获取执行验证的教师示范，蒸馏重复流程到迭代更新的 SkillBook，并对学生 LoRA 适配器做监督学习与可选 GRPO 训练。部署侧用成本校准路由器和验证器回退，候选 SkillBook、适配器或路由器仅在联合回放保持任务质量时被接纳。
Result: 四轮适应将 Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B 在保留的 HumanEval+MBPP 上从 28.7% 提升到 49.7% pass；在验证器回退下，部署策略保留 88.3% pass，同时成本为 always-Luna 的 60.8%。在 TAU-2 上，微调的 Qwen3.5-2B 从 14/35 提升到 18/35，并匹配未适应的 4B 模型。
Conclusion: 结果表明，验证器支持的多轮适应能够增强小模型能力，而非仅仅围绕固定学生进行路由；论文标注为 CAIS RL-Eval 的初步版本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topological Feasibility Guarantees for Differentiable Predictive Control
papers.abstract_en: Differentiable predictive control (DPC), a self-supervised learning approach for approximating explicit model predictive control (MPC) policies, offers significant computational advantages over online optimization-based MPC. However, feasibility guarantees, a core requirement for safe control, are currently provided either probabilistically or via online safety filters. The lack of rigorous feasibility guarantees for offline policy optimization remains an open problem. This paper establishes deterministic feasibility guarantees for DPC using a novel topological analysis of the induced reachable safe set, without requiring online safety filters. By exploiting the inherent model-based nature of DPC, in which differentiable system dynamics are embedded directly into the computational graph, we analyze the properties of the learned control policies and the corresponding system states from topological and geometric perspectives. Inspired by our theoretical analysis, we propose a novel self-supervised offline policy learning strategy that utilizes a proxy loss with Control Barrier Functions (CBFs). Crucially, these properties not only significantly improve policy training but also enable the derivation of strict, deterministic feasibility guarantees from a finite number of training samples. Extensive closed-loop simulations validate our theoretical findings, demonstrating that the empirical constraint violations monotonically decrease to zero as the training sample size increases. Ultimately, this work illustrates that DPC policy optimization yields formal safety certificates that are structurally unattainable with conventional black-box methods, e.g., reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised learning-based approximate MPC, thereby providing a new perspective on feasibility guarantees in learning-based control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对可微预测控制 (differentiable predictive control, DPC) 的可行性保证问题，提出一种基于拓扑分析的确定性离线可行性保证方法。作者利用 DPC 中将可微系统动力学嵌入计算图的特点，从拓扑与几何角度分析学习策略与状态的性质，并据此提出带控制障碍函数 (Control Barrier Functions, CBF) 代理损失的离线自监督训练策略。闭环仿真显示经验约束违反随训练样本量增加单调趋于零。
Motivation: DPC 相比在线优化 MPC 具有显著计算优势，但其可行性保证目前只能以概率形式或依赖在线安全滤波器给出，离线策略优化缺少严格的可行性保证，这构成安全控制中的一个未解决问题。
Method: 对诱导的可达安全集进行拓扑分析，利用 DPC 中可微系统动力学内嵌于计算图这一模型驱动特性，提出基于 CBF 代理损失的自监督离线策略学习方法，从有限训练样本推导严格的确定性可行性保证。
Result: 大量闭环仿真验证了理论结果，经验约束违反量随训练样本规模增大单调下降至零；作者还指出该方法能产生形式化安全证书，而传统黑箱方法（如 RL 或有监督近似 MPC）在结构上无法获得。
Conclusion: 该工作说明 DPC 策略优化能够获得形式化安全证书，为学习控制中的可行性保证提供了新视角。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hierarchical Compositionality for An Assistive AI Agent
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are increasingly being developed to assist humans in various applications, and Large Language Models and other deep network architectures are considered to be state of the art for such agents. These methods are impressive stochastic predictors, but they are resource-hungry, opaque, and known to make arbitrary decisions in novel situations due to the narrow set of underlying representation and processing choices. Our work seeks to explore the design of architectures for such AI agents based on core principles that can be traced back to the early pioneers of AI but are not fully utilized in modern AI methods. We do so in this paper in the context of the core problem of AI agents addressing ambiguity in the objects being referred to by the human participants. Humans address such ambiguity by heuristically leveraging compositional knowledge of domain context and the preferences of the other human participants. Drawing inspiration from this observation, we describe an architecture that embeds the principle of hierarchical compositionality and uses simple heuristics to achieve the desired disambiguation. Specifically, domain objects are represented in terms of primitive attributes drawn from human-validated semantic feature norms, and a hierarchical combination of attributes and concepts automatically identified from a limited observed history of interactions of an assistive agent with specific users. The assistive agent then achieves the desired disambiguation by reasoning with knowledge of this compositional hierarchy; axioms governing domain dynamics; and models of semantic compatibility, session salience, and user-specific thematic preference, requesting human clarification when necessary. Experiments show that our approach consistently outperforms state of the art data-driven baselines, supporting adaptation to specific user profiles.
papers.comment: 25 pages, 9 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://tianyi-fu.github.io/HCAA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于层次组合性 (hierarchical compositionality) 的辅助 AI 智能体架构，用于消解人类所指对象中的歧义。对象用人类验证的语义特征规范 (semantic feature norms) 中的原始属性表示，并从与特定用户的有限交互历史中自动识别属性-概念的层次组合。智能体结合领域动态公理、语义兼容性、会话显著性和用户主题偏好模型进行推理，必要时请求人类澄清。实验表明该方法在适应特定用户画像上一致优于数据驱动基线。
Motivation: 现有以大语言模型和深度网络为代表的智能体是资源消耗大、不透明且在陌生情境下可能做出任意决策的随机预测器，因为其底层表示和处理选择范围狭窄。论文针对辅助智能体消解人类所指对象歧义这一核心问题，借鉴人类利用领域上下文和他人偏好组合知识进行启发式消歧的观察，探索基于早期 AI 核心原则的架构设计。
Method: 描述一种嵌入层次组合性原理的架构：领域对象用人类验证的语义特征规范中的原始属性表示，并从智能体与特定用户的有限交互历史中自动识别属性和概念的层次组合。智能体利用该组合层次知识、领域动态公理以及语义兼容性、会话显著性和用户特定主题偏好模型进行推理消歧，必要时请求人类澄清。
Result: 摘要报告实验显示，该方法在消歧任务上一致优于现有数据驱动基线，并且能够支持对特定用户画像的适应。
Conclusion: 摘要强调基于早期 AI 先驱提出的核心原则来构建智能体架构的价值，并认为层次组合性与简单启发式相结合可在消歧中取得稳定表现。摘要未详细讨论局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SimWAM: A Simple World Action Model for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: World-Action Models (WAMs) improve end-to-end autonomous driving by transferring video dynamics priors to action prediction, but existing methods incur costly test-time future imagination. We present SimWAM, a simple yet effective WAM that leverages future-video prediction as a training-time supervision signal. It co-trains a pretrained video expert and a lightweight action expert with joint flow matching. An isolated attention mask keeps action prediction independent of future frames, allowing trajectory prediction without explicit future-frame generation at inference. Since the two experts share no parameters and interact only through a unified attention interface, the video backbone could be replaced and the action expert scaled independently without modifying the learning objective or inference pipeline. We further apply reinforcement learning to optimize a compositional driving reward beyond trajectory imitation. Our SimWAM achieves 91.5 PDMS on NAVSIM, surpasses state-of-the-art WAM-based planners with substantially lower latency, and transfers zero-shot to nuScenes. These results position SimWAM as a simple yet solid baseline that could readily benefit from advances in video generation for efficient autonomous driving. The code and model weights are available at https://github.com/H-EmbodVis/SimWAM/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SimWAM 提出一种简单有效的世界动作模型 (World-Action Model)，将未来视频预测作为训练期监督信号，而推理时不生成未来帧。它联合训练预训练视频专家和轻量动作专家，通过共享注意力接口交互，并用隔离注意力掩码保证动作预测不依赖未来帧。在 NAVSIM 上达到 91.5 PDMS，超越已有基于 WAM 的规划器且延迟更低，并可零样本迁移到 nuScenes。
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型通过将视频动力学先验迁移到动作预测来提升端到端自动驾驶，但测试时未来想象 (future imagination) 代价高昂。作者希望保留视频先验收益的同时消除推理阶段的显式未来帧生成开销。
Method: 将未来视频预测作为训练期监督信号，联合训练预训练视频专家与轻量动作专家，使用联合流匹配 (joint flow matching)；通过隔离注意力掩码使动作预测独立于未来帧，推理时无需生成未来帧。两个专家不共享参数，仅通过统一注意力接口交互，因此视频骨干可替换、动作专家可独立缩放；此外用强化学习优化组合式驾驶奖励。
Result: SimWAM 在 NAVSIM 上取得 91.5 PDMS，超过现有最先进的基于 WAM 的规划器，并显著降低延迟；在 nuScenes 上实现零样本迁移。代码和模型权重已开源。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SimWAM 是一个简单而扎实的基线，能够直接受益于视频生成技术的进步，从而提升高效自动驾驶性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Blast Radius
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding faces growing problems of affordability and wasted tokens. We introduce Blast Radius, a predictive memory management layer that estimates an incoming prompt's reach through coupled context and code channels. NECROPHORESIS enables reversible eviction by archiving dead context verbatim, while Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) identifies and buries repeatedly occurring transcripts. We formulate reversible context eviction over a Polish context space, providing a measurable foundation for retention, recurrence, and eviction while connecting context entropy to resurrection probability. Across seven OpenAI models, Blast Radius reduced token consumption by 17-26%, achieved the lowest overflow rate among tested policies, and remained byte exact reversible. Of 450 buried bodies, 378 were recurring dead matter and zero were recalled. Blast Radius operates beneath HCRC, determining which records to bury and how far an incoming prompt may reach into the codebase. This work contributes to the broader goal of Algosophy: making large language models and agentic coding more reusable and sustainable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Blast Radius，一个面向智能体编码 (agentic coding) 的预测性内存管理层，用于估算输入提示在上下文与代码通道中的影响范围，并通过 NECROPHORESIS 与 Recurring Dead Matter (RDM) 实现可逆的上下文驱逐。作者在 Polish 上下文空间上形式化了可逆驱逐，并在七个 OpenAI 模型上测得 token 消耗降低 17-26%、溢出率最低且保持字节级可逆。
Motivation: 智能体编码面临成本上升和 token 浪费的问题，现有上下文管理缺乏可预测、可逆的驱逐机制，难以支撑大规模编码代理的可持续运行。
Method: 引入预测性内存管理层 Blast Radius，估计输入提示在上下文与代码双通道中的可达范围；NECROPHORESIS 将死上下文逐字归档以实现可逆驱逐，RDM 识别并埋葬重复出现的对话记录；在 Polish 上下文空间上形式化可逆驱逐，并把上下文熵与复活概率联系起来。
Result: 在七个 OpenAI 模型上，Blast Radius 将 token 消耗降低 17-26%，在测试策略中获得最低溢出率，且保持字节级可逆；450 个被埋葬记录中有 378 个属于重复死内容，零个被重新召回。
Conclusion: Blast Radius 运行在 HCRC 之下，决定埋葬哪些记录以及输入提示能触及代码库多远，服务于让大语言模型和智能体编码更可复用、更可持续的 Algosophy 目标。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: EliSeg: Verified Target Construction for Report-Grounded Abnormality Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Radiology reports describe clinical observations but do not specify executable segmentation targets. They may contain present, negated, prior,uncertain, or irrelevant findings, while multiple valid abnormalities may coexist. Existing segmentation methods largely bypass this ambiguity by receiving a target identity or spatial prompt before inference, which acts as a hidden target oracle. We study report-grounded abnormality segmentation, where a model must determine target eligibility, cardinality, and finding-to-mask correspondence directly from an unfiltered report before delineating the corresponding regions. We propose \textbf{EliSeg}, an atcor--verify--revise framework that integrates target construction with mask generation. A grammar-constrained Actor proposes target slots and masks, an independent text-only Verifier reconstructs the eligible finding inventory, and Revision selectively re-executes the shared Actor when their target structures disagree. EliSeg requires no predefined target identity, finding prompt, point, or bounding box. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR-ILS show that EliSeg consistently outperforms direct segmentation methods and extract-then-segment cascades across findings, while effectively suppressing masks for ineligible report mentions. Ablation studies confirm the complementary roles of verification and revision, and evaluation on CheXlocalize demonstrates effective transfer of the EliSeg to an external dataset.Code is available at https://github.com/Maybach-dream/EliSeg.
papers.comment: Minor revision: fixed author metadata rendering in the arXiv HTML version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究报告驱动的异常分割任务（report-grounded abnormality segmentation）：模型需直接从未过滤的放射报告中判定目标资格、数量并建立发现与掩码的对应关系，再生成分割区域。作者提出 EliSeg，一个由 atcor—verify—revise 组成的框架，将目标构造与掩码生成结合，无需预定义目标身份、提示词、点或边界框。实验在 MIMIC-CXR-ILS 上显示其优于直接分割方法和先抽取再分割的级联方法，并能有效抑制不合格报告提及的掩码，在 CheXlocalize 上验证了跨数据集迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有分割方法通常在推理前接收目标身份或空间提示，相当于隐式的目标预言机（target oracle），绕过了放射报告中存在的肯定、否定、既往、不确定或不相关发现之间的歧义，以及多个有效异常共存的情况。
Method: 提出 EliSeg 的 atcor—verify—revise 框架：语法约束的 Actor 先提出目标槽位和掩码，独立的纯文本 Verifier 重构符合条件的发现清单，当两者的目标结构不一致时，Revision 选择性重新执行共享的 Actor。
Result: 在 MIMIC-CXR-ILS 上，EliSeg 一致优于直接分割方法和抽取—分割级联方法，并能有效抑制对不合格报告提及的掩码；消融实验验证了验证与修订的互补作用，CheXlocalize 上的评估表明方法可迁移至外部数据集。
Conclusion: 作者认为将目标构造与掩码生成结合、并用文本验证与修订纠正结构不一致，是解决报告驱动分割中歧义问题的有效途径；代码已开源。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Recent advances in weakly supervised learning: New supervision paradigms, assumption relaxations, and practical solutions
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has achieved great success in recent years thanks to the availability of high-quality, well-annotated training data. However, this requirement is often not met in real-world applications. Weakly supervised learning aims to train an accurate model with incomplete, inexact, or inaccurate supervision. In this chapter, we will discuss recent advances in this field, including new supervision paradigms, relaxed assumptions, and practical solutions. First, we introduce a new weakly supervised binary classification problem called confidence-difference classification and propose consistent approaches to solve it. Next, we investigate complementary-label learning, a weakly supervised multi-class classification problem. Our proposed approaches are based on more relaxed assumptions about the data generation process than existing consistent approaches. Lastly, we present an evaluation framework for partial-label learning, another popular multi-class weakly supervised learning problem, in order to promote fair and realistic evaluation of algorithms in this field.
papers.comment: Preprint of an invited review article. In Neural Networks, Handbook of Statistics, vol. 55, pp. 289-320, Elsevier, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是受邀综述章节（发表于 Neural Networks, Handbook of Statistics, vol. 55, pp. 289-320, Elsevier, 2026），围绕弱监督学习 (weakly supervised learning) 的近期进展展开，主题包括新监督范式、假设松弛和实用方案。摘要提到三项具体贡献：提出新的弱监督二分类问题置信差分类 (confidence-difference classification) 并给出一致估计方法；对补充标签学习 (complementary-label learning) 提出比现有一致方法更宽松的数据生成假设；为部分标签学习 (partial-label learning) 设计评估框架以促进公平、现实的算法评测。文章以方法学贡献为主，摘要未报告具体实验数值。
Motivation: 现实应用常常缺乏高质量、良好标注的训练数据，弱监督学习旨在用不完整、不精确或不准确的监督信号训练准确模型。作者指出现有一致方法对数据生成过程假设较强，且部分标签学习领域缺少统一、公平的评测方式。
Method: 文章包含三部分：提出置信差分类问题并构造一致方法；在补充标签学习中放宽数据生成过程假设；为部分标签学习设计评估框架，以统一评测并贴近真实应用场景。
Result: 摘要层面的结果是：置信差分类获得一致方法，补充标签学习在更宽松假设下仍可保持一致性，部分标签学习获得更公平现实的评估框架；摘要未提供定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 作者将弱监督学习的最新进展概括为新的监督范式、更松弛的假设和实用的评测方案；作为综述章节，其主要价值在于梳理问题设定并提出统一视角，而非报告具体基准结果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: DAEP: Difficulty-Aware Evidence Planning for Medical Video Corpus Temporal Answer Grounding
papers.abstract_en: We describe DAEP, team BIGC's submission to NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 1 Track 3: Difficulty-Aware Temporal Answer Grounding in Video Corpus (DA-TAGVC). The task requires retrieving the target video from 50 candidates and localizing the answer-supporting span. DAEP ranks videos with subtitle, visual, and procedural-context evidence, expands high-scoring anchors into temporal spans, and reranks spans for final output. Its main design is to convert the task-provided simple/complex input label into an inference-time evidence plan controlling modality weights, Top-K aggregation, boundary threshold, expansion length, and reranking strength. In the official evaluation, BIGC ranks first among ten systems with an Average score of 0.2728. Validation ablations show that visual evidence, procedural context, and difficulty-aware planning improve ranking quality, with the largest gain on complex questions.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables, accepted by NLPCC 2026 Shared Task Track 3
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文描述 DAEP，即 BIGC 团队对 NLPCC 2026 Shared Task 1 Track 3（DA-TAGVC）的参赛方案。该任务要求从 50 个候选视频中检索目标视频并定位答案支撑的时间跨度；DAEP 利用字幕、视觉和程序性上下文证据对视频排序，将高置信锚点扩展为时间跨度并重排序。其核心设计是把任务提供的简单/复杂输入标签转化为推理时的证据规划，用于控制模态权重、Top-K 聚合、边界阈值、扩展长度和重排序强度。官方评测中该系统在十个参赛系统中排名第一，Average 分数为 0.2728。
Motivation: DA-TAGVC 任务需要同时完成视频检索与时序定位，而问题复杂度（简单/复杂）会影响证据选择的策略；现有方法未显式利用该标签，因此作者提出难度感知的证据规划来提升检索与定位质量。
Method: DAEP 先以字幕、视觉和程序性上下文证据对候选视频排序，再将高分锚点扩展为时间跨度并做最终重排序。其关键设计是将任务提供的简单/复杂标签转换为推理阶段的证据计划，动态控制模态权重、Top-K 聚合、边界阈值、扩展长度和重排序强度。
Result: 官方评测中 BIGC 团队排名第一，十套系统中 Average 分数为 0.2728；验证消融显示视觉证据、程序性上下文和难度感知规划均能改善排序质量，其中难度感知对复杂问题的提升最大。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，结合多模态证据并显式利用问题难度标签进行推理时规划，能有效提升视频语料中的时序答案定位表现，尤其在复杂问题上收益显著；该工作为共享任务系统描述，未涉及超出摘要范围的通用性结论。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: DAEP 先以字幕、视觉和程序性上下文证据对候选视频排序，再将高分锚点扩展为时间跨度并做最终重排序。其关键设计是将任务提供的简单/复杂标签转换为推理阶段的证据计划，动态控制模态权重、Top-K 聚合、边界阈值、扩展长度和重排序强度。
summary_sections.result: 官方评测中 BIGC 团队排名第一，十套系统中 Average 分数为 0.2728；验证消融显示视觉证据、程序性上下文和难度感知规划均能改善排序质量，其中难度感知对复杂问题的提升最大。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要表明，结合多模态证据并显式利用问题难度标签进行推理时规划，能有效提升视频语料中的时序答案定位表现，尤其在复杂问题上收益显著；该工作为共享任务系统描述，未涉及超出摘要范围的通用性结论。

papers.title: Policy-Masked Private Experts: Auditable and Reversible Capability Access Control in Sparse MoE Models
papers.abstract_en: Most language-model access controls regulate behavior while leaving the same computation available to every request. We study a different systems question: can trusted authorization determine which newly trained parameters are reachable by the forward pass? Policy-Masked Private Experts freezes a pretrained sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model, trains a disjoint expert branch, and selects the public or private pool before top-k routing. The resulting claim is narrow but testable: under the declared trusted computing base (TCB), an unauthorized request executes no private expert. It does not imply that the public model lacks the same semantic capability. We test this separation between execution control and task utility in Qwen3-30B-A3B and DeepSeek-V2-Lite. Three Qwen BF16 seeds update all 32 private experts while the public fingerprint remains unchanged. Across 64 adversarial scenarios and 96 deny/fail-closed events, unauthorized private execution is zero; independent hooks exactly match 11,616 routed private rows and allow-deny-allow recovery is exact. On two prospectively frozen Qwen benchmarks, the private branch improves exact tool use by 5.0 percentage points (pp) (five versus zero discordances; one-sided Holm p = 0.03125, corresponding two-sided exact p = 0.0625) and 21.3 pp (percentile-bootstrap 95% CI [13.3, 29.3], Holm p = 0.000031). Three arm-blinded model evaluators retain a positive external effect of 18.7 pp (95% CI [9.3, 28.0]). A parameter-matched Lora has similar external utility, but a post-hoc request gate leaves 1,225 adapter calls under deny; the disjoint expert branch leaves none. DeepSeek reproduces the route invariant and gains 27.0 pp. A valid sealed evaluation is near-neutral. These results support auditable, reversible control over a trained parameter path, while showing that useful transfer remains distribution dependent.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables. Corrected the DeepSeek decoding and evaluation results and updated the corresponding analysis; corrected the mathematical statement of the frozen-parameter guarantee; clarified paired statistical inference; expanded related work and corrected references
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Policy-Masked Private Experts，一种面向稀疏 MoE 模型的能力访问控制机制：冻结预训练 MoE，训练不相交的私有专家分支，并在 top-k 路由前选择公共或私有参数池。作者在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 与 DeepSeek-V2-Lite 上验证，声明在声明的可信计算基 (TCB) 下未授权请求不会执行任何私有专家，同时公共模型指纹保持不变；多组去重与对抗性场景中未授权私有执行为零，且私有分支带来明显的工具使用准确率提升。该机制支持对已训练参数路径的可审计、可逆控制，但作者明确表示这不意味着公共模型不具备相同的语义能力。
Motivation: 现有语言模型访问控制大多只约束行为，而每次请求仍可访问相同的计算；本文研究一个不同的系统问题：受信授权能否决定前向传播实际可达哪些新训练参数。
Method: 冻结预训练稀疏 MoE 模型，训练一个不相交的专家分支，在 top-k 路由之前根据授权策略选择公共或私有专家池，从而在参数路径层面实现可审计、可逆的访问控制。
Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上，三个 BF16 种子更新全部 32 个私有专家而公共指纹不变；64 个对抗场景与 96 个 deny/fail-closed 事件中未授权私有执行为零，独立 hook 精确匹配 11,616 条路由私有记录，allow-deny-allow 恢复精确。私有分支在两个冻结 Qwen 基准上将精确工具使用分别提高 5.0 pp 与 21.3 pp，外部评审效应为 18.7 pp；DeepSeek 复现路由不变式并提升 27.0 pp。参数匹配的 LoRA 在 deny 下仍有 1,225 次适配器调用，而分离专家分支为零。
Conclusion: 作者认为结果支持对已训练参数路径的可审计、可逆控制，但指出这种控制不保证公共模型缺乏相同语义能力，且有用迁移仍是分布依赖的；有效封印评估的结果接近中性，说明该主张范围较窄。
Relevance: 0
