papers.title: Contextual Information Policy Optimization for Search Agents
papers.abstract_en: Search agents extend large language models beyond static parametric memory by enabling them to acquire and use external evidence during multi-step reasoning. For knowledge-intensive tasks involving complex or evolving information, their reliability depends not only on retrieving relevant evidence but also on using it to guide subsequent reasoning. However, existing methods primarily reward final-answer correctness or intermediate progress, without directly assessing whether post-retrieval actions are grounded in the retrieved evidence. This misalignment encourages prior-driven reasoning: agents form conclusions based on internal knowledge and use retrieval mainly to confirm them, resulting in confirmation bias and inefficient evidence use. To address this issue, we propose Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO), an evidence-oriented reinforcement learning framework that explicitly aligns policy optimization with external evidence use. CIPO assigns dense, turn-level credit to reasoning actions influenced by retrieved information, while combining this evidence-use signal with a global outcome reward to preserve answer correctness. With this manner, CIPO discourages evidence-detached guesses and promotes reasoning trajectories in which retrieved facts can guide or revise subsequent reasoning. Importantly, CIPO requires neither human process annotations nor an additional reward model. Extensive experiments on seven in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that CIPO reduces the prevalence of prior-driven reasoning and achieves excellent performance on most tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Contextual Information Policy Optimization (CIPO)，一种面向搜索智能体 (search agents) 的证据导向强化学习框架，用于使 LLM 在检索后基于外部证据而非内部先验进行推理。CIPO 在回合级 (turn-level) 对受检索信息影响的推理动作分配稠密奖励，并与全局结果奖励结合，避免检索仅被用来确认已有结论。实验在七个领域内和领域外基准上显示该方法减少了先验驱动推理 (prior-driven reasoning) 的发生，并在多数任务上表现良好。
Motivation: 现有搜索智能体训练方法主要奖励最终答案正确性或中间进度，不能直接评估检索后的动作是否基于检索证据，导致模型倾向用内部知识先下结论、再用检索确认，产生确认偏误 (confirmation bias) 和证据利用不充分。
Method: CIPO 是一种证据导向的强化学习框架，对受检索信息影响的推理动作给予稠密、回合级 (turn-level) 的信用分配，并将该证据使用信号与全局结果奖励结合；该方法不需要人工过程标注，也不需要额外的奖励模型。
Result: 在七个领域内和领域外基准上的实验表明，CIPO 能降低先验驱动推理 (prior-driven reasoning) 的出现频率，并在大多数任务上取得优异性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调将策略优化与外部证据使用显式对齐，可以抑制脱离证据的猜测，并促使检索到的事实引导或修正后续推理；同时避免了对过程标注和额外奖励模型的依赖。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: ECHO: A Locally-Deployable Agentic Health Assistant with Temporal Memory, Safety Guardrails, and Speech Assessment
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ECHO (Enhanced Care & Health Observer), a locally-deployable conversational health assistant for long-term chronic care management. ECHO integrates three complementary software modules developed under shared supervision as a unified system. The core module is an agentic chatbot built on a ReAct loop orchestrated via LangGraph, equipped with 17 clinical tools and a temporal knowledge graph for persistent cross-session memory; it achieves a 94.9% tool-execution pass rate across a 59-scenario benchmark with GPT-5 Mini. A two-stage hybrid safety layer intercepts all incoming queries: a rule-based layer handles explicit crisis signals and jailbreak attempts in under 1ms, while a signed graph neural network (GNN) with APPNP-style propagation classifies boundary cases by clinical intent, achieving 88.8% accuracy and 90.6% unsafe recall on a 2,537-query annotated Turkish health dataset while outperforming zero-shot LLM baselines including Llama 3.3 70B. A multimodal speech assessment module combining Whisper acoustic encoding and BERT text encoding with cross-attention fusion estimates emotion, depression, and pain, reaching a mean macro F1 of 0.652. The full system is implemented as a web application that can run entirely on consumer hardware, with no patient data transmitted to external services, supporting compliance with GDPR and KVKK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ECHO (Enhanced Care & Health Observer)，一个可本地部署的会话式健康助手，面向长期慢性病管理，由三个模块构成：基于 LangGraph 编排的 ReAct 智能体聊天机器人、两阶段混合安全层，以及结合 Whisper 与 BERT 的多模态语音评估模块。摘要报告该智能体在 59 场景基准上达到 94.9% 的工具执行通过率，安全层在 2,537 条土耳其语健康查询上取得 88.8% 准确率与 90.6% 的不安全召回率，语音评估的宏平均 F1 为 0.652。系统可在消费级硬件上完整运行，且不向外部服务传输患者数据。
Motivation: 长期慢性病管理需要跨会话的持久记忆、对危机信号和越狱尝试的安全拦截，以及语音层面的情绪与疼痛评估；同时患者数据必须本地处理以满足 GDPR 与 KVKK 合规要求。
Method: 核心智能体采用 ReAct 循环并用 LangGraph 编排，配备 17 个临床工具和用于跨会话记忆的时间知识图谱 (temporal knowledge graph)；安全层为两阶段混合设计，先由基于规则的层在 1ms 内处理显式危机和越狱信号，再由带 APPNP 式传播的符号图神经网络 (signed GNN) 对边界案例做临床意图分类；语音评估模块用 Whisper 声学编码与 BERT 文本编码做交叉注意力融合，估计情绪、抑郁和疼痛。
Result: 智能体在包含 59 个场景的基准上取得 94.9% 的工具执行通过率；安全分类器在 2,537 条标注的土耳其语健康数据集上达到 88.8% 准确率和 90.6% 不安全的召回率，优于包括 Llama 3.3 70B 在内的零样本 LLM 基线；语音评估的宏平均 F1 为 0.652。
Conclusion: 摘要强调整个系统作为网页应用可在消费级硬件上完全本地运行，不向外部服务发送患者数据，从而支持 GDPR 和 KVKK 合规；论文篇幅为 5 页。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Comparing SGLD and a fixed-noise Predictor-Corrector adaptation in canonical Joint Energy-Based Models on CIFAR-10
papers.abstract_en: Joint Energy-Based Models (JEM) unify classification and generation within a single network and support out-of-distribution (OOD) detection. Canonical JEM training relies on stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (SGLD); a theoretically motivated alternative, the Predictor-Corrector (PC) sampler, has not previously undergone a systematic replication test on the canonical model. We reproduce canonical JEM on WideResNet-28-10 without normalisation layers on two independent runs and test a fixed-noise PC adaptation - with the degenerate annealed-noise predictor replaced by a deterministic gradient step - across three protocols: the adapted sampler replacing SGLD throughout the full training trajectories (115-132 epochs); cold-start generation (FID); and refinement-style multi-OOD detection (AUROC). The reconstruction reaches 92.88% test accuracy and buffer-FID 44.46 (canonical: 92.9% and 38.40). We document two failure modes: catastrophic late-training divergence with the signature of the canonical outlier-buffer mechanism (all four runs), and run-dependent SVHN OOD-discrimination dynamics. No consistent method-level advantage of the adaptation over SGLD is observed on any protocol: refinement AUROC differences stay below 0.007 across ten checkpoint-OOD pairs; seeded cold-start generation favours SGLD by about five FID points; on the training protocol a hierarchical seed-by-image bootstrap gives a 95% confidence interval on the macro-averaged AUROC difference that contains zero, while a seed-level equivalence test with two runs per method cannot establish formal equivalence. The training-protocol data are consistent both with equivalence and with a small directional effect. This outcome is consistent with theory: the guarantees of the annealed-noise PC framework do not transfer to the constant-noise regime of canonical JEM.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 4 figures. v2: revised after peer review; title changed. Under review at Discover Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对规范 Joint Energy-Based Model (JEM) 在 CIFAR-10 上的训练进行复制，并系统比较了标准 SGLD 采样器与一种固定噪声的 Predictor-Corrector (PC) 适配版本。该适配将退化的退火噪声预测器替换为确定性梯度步，并在三种协议下测试：完整训练轨迹（115-132 epoch）、冷启动生成 (FID) 和精炼式多 OOD 检测 (AUROC)。结果显示复制达到 92.88% 测试准确率和 buffer-FID 44.46（规范配置为 92.9% 和 38.40），但未观察到适配方法在任何协议上有一致的优势。
Motivation: 规范 JEM 训练依赖随机梯度 Langevin 动力学 (SGLD)，而理论上更有依据的 PC 采样器从未在规范模型上经过系统的复制检验；作者希望验证这一替代方案在标准 JEM 设置下是否真的有效。
Method: 在无归一化层的 WideResNet-28-10 上进行两次独立运行的规范 JEM 复制，并实现固定噪声 PC 适配（用确定性梯度步替换退化的退火噪声预测器）；随后在三类协议中将其与 SGLD 对照：替代全部训练轨迹、冷启动生成 (FID)、以及精炼式多 OOD 检测 (AUROC)。

papers.title: TARL: Transaction-Aware Reliable Ledgers for Executable Memory Management in Long-Term Agents
papers.abstract_en: Persistent memory helps long-term agents retain knowledge, yet a single update error can repeatedly distort future retrieval and reasoning. Most existing systems reduce memory updating to a binary Write/Hold decision, which cannot distinguish whether new information should be added, ignored, used to revise an outdated belief, rejected as unreliable, or deferred for verification. These choices may share the same binary label while producing fundamentally different memory states. We introduce TARL, a memory state update framework that maps each statement to one of five executable actions. TARL identifies the affected memory, resolves its temporal scope, compares source reliability, and updates accepted, pending, and rejected ledgers. It is further trained by comparing the memory states produced by alternative update operations, encouraging the model to select the operation that leads to the correct result. We also introduce TARL-Mem, a benchmark with fine-grained action labels and next-state targets. Across in-domain, cross-source, temporal, counterfactual, and sequential evaluations, TARL improves action prediction and state recovery, reduces memory pollution, preserves conflicting evidence, and limits cumulative corruption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TARL，一个面向长期智能体 (long-term agents) 的可执行内存状态更新框架，将每条语句映射为五种可执行动作之一，并维护 accepted、pending、rejected 三类账本 (ledgers)。作者同时发布带细粒度动作标签和下一状态目标的基准 TARL-Mem，并在多种评测设置下验证该方法能提升动作预测与状态恢复、减少内存污染并限制累计损坏。
Motivation: 现有持久化内存系统把内存更新简化为二值的 Write/Hold 决策，无法区分新信息是应添加、忽略、修正过时信念、拒绝还是暂缓验证；这些语义不同的选择可能共享同一二值标签，却导致截然不同的内存状态，单一更新错误会反复污染后续检索与推理。
Method: TARL 识别受影响的内存、解析其时间范围、比较来源可靠性，并更新 accepted、pending、rejected 三类账本；训练时通过比较不同更新操作所产生内存状态的优劣，促使模型选择能导向正确结果的操作。
Result: 在 in-domain、cross-source、temporal、counterfactual 和 sequential 五类评测中，TARL 相较于基线改进了动作预测与状态恢复，降低了内存污染，保留冲突证据，并限制了累计损坏 (cumulative corruption)。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将内存更新细化为可执行动作并引入账本机制，是抑制长期智能体记忆错误累积的有效途径；摘要未讨论该方法的具体局限。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CastFSR: A Fast--Slow--Reflect Agentic Reasoning Framework for Context-Aware Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Time series forecasting is fundamental to decision-making in complex systems, where future dynamics are influenced not only by historical observations but also by evolving contextual features. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have extended forecasting beyond numerical extrapolation toward context-aware reasoning. However, existing approaches often lack explicit mechanisms to identify relevant contexts, reason about their impacts, and validate forecasts against temporal and domain constraints. In this work, we propose CastFSR, an agentic framework that formulates context-aware forecasting as a Fast--Slow--Reflect workflow. In fast thinking, CastFSR profiles observations and selects lightweight forecasters to construct a data-driven forecast prior. In slow deliberation, it retrieves contextual evidence, adaptively determines informative look-back windows, and reasons about how contexts reshape future dynamics. In reflection, it iteratively refines forecasts to ensure temporal, contextual, and domain consistency. CastFSR supports both training-free inference with off-the-shelf LLMs and efficient deployment through a two-stage SFT and reinforcement learning strategy that transfers its orchestration capability to compact LLMs. Extensive experiments on public datasets demonstrate that CastFSR consistently outperforms representative baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xiaoyu-Tao/CastFSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CastFSR，一个将上下文感知时间序列预测形式化为 Fast–Slow–Reflect 工作流的智能体框架：快速通道负责观测画像与轻量预测器选择以构造数据驱动先验，慢速通道检索上下文证据并自适应确定回溯窗口以推理上下文影响，反思阶段迭代校验预测的时间、上下文与领域一致性。框架支持无需训练的直接推理，也可通过两阶段 SFT 与强化学习将编排能力迁移到紧凑 LLM。公共数据集实验显示其稳定优于代表性基线。
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的预测方法缺乏显式机制来识别相关上下文、推理其影响，并对照时间与领域约束校验预测，导致上下文感知推理能力不足。
Method: 提出三阶段 agentic 工作流：fast thinking 对观测画像并选择轻量预测器构建数据驱动先验；slow deliberation 检索上下文证据、自适应选择信息性回溯窗口并推理上下文如何重塑未来动态；reflection 迭代细化预测以保证时间、上下文和领域一致性。同时给出 training-free 推理路径和将编排能力迁移到紧凑 LLM 的两阶段 SFT 与强化学习训练策略。
Result: 摘要报告 CastFSR 在多个公共数据集上一致优于代表性基线，但未在文本中给出具体数值或基准清单。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架通过显式的上下文识别、影响推理和一致性反思三个步骤，实现了可部署的上下文感知时间序列预测，并开源代码供复现。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: DiffImaginE: Imagine to Verify Entity Types with Diffusio
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal named entity recognition (MNER) determines whether each candidate span and entity-type hypothesis is supported by joint textual and visual evidence. Existing imagine-and-compare verifiers map each (span, type) pair to one predicted visual feature, compressing diverse visual realisations into a single prototype and providing a compatibility score without explicit probabilistic semantics. We introduce DiffImaginE, which formulates MNER type verification as conditional latent diffusion inference. Given span-localised visual evidence, a type-conditioned denoiser predicts noise injected into its standardised latent. The resulting denoising error provides an ELBO-consistent surrogate for type-conditional negative log-likelihood, allowing competing type hypotheses to be ranked by how well they explain the observation. DiffImaginE retains a standard multimodal encoder stack and replaces the deterministic verifier with a classifier-free-guided diffusion scorer trained using Min-SNR weighting. We directly supervise per-type diffusion scores as classification logits, learn aggregation across noise levels, and use antithetic sampling to reduce Monte Carlo comparison variance. Our analysis shows that classifier-free guidance sharpens the induced type posterior and characterises when antithetic pairing reduces variance at equal denoiser cost. Experiments on Twitter-2015 and Twitter-2017 show consistent gains over a matched deterministic ImaginE control under the same encoder, auxiliary objectives, and evaluation protocol, supported by ablations and paired significance tests.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DiffImaginE，将多模态命名实体识别 (MNER) 的类型验证建模为条件潜变量扩散推断 (conditional latent diffusion inference)。给定跨度定位的视觉证据，类型条件去噪器预测注入到标准化潜变量中的噪声，去噪误差作为类型条件负对数似然的 ELBO 一致代理，从而可按解释观测的能力对竞争类型假设排序。方法保留标准多模态编码器，用分类器无关引导 (classifier-free guidance) 的扩散评分器替代确定性验证器，并采用 Min-SNR 加权、逐类型扩散分数直接作为分类 logits 监督、跨噪声级别聚合学习以及对偶抽样 (antithetic sampling)。在 Twitter-2015 与 Twitter-2017 上的实验显示，相比匹配的确定性 ImaginE 对照取得一致增益，并有消融与配对显著性检验支持。
Motivation: 现有的 imagine-and-compare 验证器将每个 (span, type) 对映射到单一预测视觉特征，把多样化的视觉实现压缩成一个原型，并提供缺乏显式概率语义的兼容性分数；这限制了类型验证的判别力与可解释性。
Method: 将 MNER 类型验证公式化为条件潜变量扩散推断：类型条件去噪器预测注入标准化潜变量的噪声，以去噪误差构造 ELBO 一致的负对数似然代理；用分类器无关引导的扩散评分器替换确定性验证器，训练采用 Min-SNR 加权，并直接监督逐类型扩散分数作为分类 logits，学习跨噪声级别的聚合，同时用对偶抽样降低蒙特卡洛比较方差。
Result: 分析表明分类器无关引导使类型后验更尖锐，并刻画了对偶配对在等去噪器代价下降低方差的条件；在 Twitter-2015 和 Twitter-2017 上，该方法在与确定性 ImaginE 对照相同的编码器、辅助目标和评估协议下取得一致增益，并得到消融与配对显著性检验支持。
Conclusion: 摘要强调以扩散评分为类型验证提供显式概率语义，能够更合理地排列竞争类型假设并在两个 Twitter 基准上稳定超越匹配的确定性基线；实验范围限于这两个数据集。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in image generation have demonstrated the potential of unified multimodal models that integrate understanding, generation, and editing. However, unified 3D modeling remains constrained by scarce multimodal data, particularly the lack of large-scale and geometrically consistent editing data. To address this limitation, we propose Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0, a unified framework supporting 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, instruction-guided 3D editing, and text-grounded part generation within a single architecture. To enable scalable training, we construct an 87M-scale 3D multimodal corpus, comprising 25M understanding samples, 50M text-to-3D pairs, and 12M editing pairs generated using Nano3D-v2. Architecturally, the framework combines Hunyuan3D-VLM for semantic, structural, and spatial understanding with Hunyuan3D DiT for high-fidelity 3D synthesis. The VLM provides multimodal semantic conditions for generation, while editing and part generation additionally condition the diffusion process on the source object representation to preserve its overall structure and unedited regions. Extensive experiments show that Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 achieves state-of-the-art or leading performance on text-to-3D generation and 3D editing benchmarks, while exhibiting strong understanding and part-generation capabilities. Our analysis further shows that both generation and understanding improve editing, demonstrating the effectiveness of unified 3D multimodal training. Project Page: https://tencent-hunyuan.github.io/Hunyuan3D-Buffalo1.0/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0，一个统一的 3D 多模态框架，在单一架构内同时支持 3D 理解、文本到 3D 生成、指令引导的 3D 编辑以及文本引导的部件生成。为支撑可扩展训练，作者构建了 87M 规模的 3D 多模态语料库，包含 25M 理解样本、50M 文本到 3D 对和 12M 由 Nano3D-v2 生成的编辑对。架构上结合 Hunyuan3D-VLM（负责语义、结构与空间理解）与 Hunyuan3D DiT（负责高保真 3D 合成），编辑和部件生成在扩散过程中额外以源对象表示作为条件以保持整体结构。实验表明该方法在 text-to-3D 生成和 3D 编辑基准上达到 SOTA 或领先性能。
Motivation: 图像生成领域已展示统一多模态模型（整合理解、生成与编辑）的潜力，但统一的 3D 建模仍受限于多模态数据稀缺，尤其是缺乏大规模且几何一致的编辑数据。
Method: 提出统一框架 Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0，将 Hunyuan3D-VLM 与 Hunyuan3D DiT 结合：VLM 为生成提供多模态语义条件，编辑和部件生成则额外以源对象表示作为扩散过程的条件，以保持对象整体结构和未编辑区域。训练上构建 87M 规模的 3D 多模态语料库，其中编辑对由 Nano3D-v2 生成。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 text-to-3D 生成和 3D 编辑基准上取得 SOTA 或领先性能，并展现较强的理解与部件生成能力；进一步分析表明生成和理解均能提升编辑效果，验证了统一 3D 多模态训练的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生成与理解相互促进编辑，说明统一 3D 多模态训练的有效性；其方法依赖大规模 3D 多模态语料与专用生成器（Nano3D-v2），适用范围限定在 3D 内容生成、理解与编辑任务。

papers.title: dots.tts.edit: Precisely Controlled Speech Editing with a Continuous Autoregressive Model
papers.abstract_en: Speech editing for content creation requires precise control over both what an edit should do and where it should apply. Free-form natural language provides a flexible interface for expressing edit requests, but its ambiguity may leave the intended operation, parameters, or target region underspecified. We study a precise and explicit interface for speech editing: a transcript-grounded structural edit instruction with XML-style tags explicitly specifies typed operations and localizes them to transcript spans or boundaries. This semantic timeline avoids explicit timestamp alignment and provides an externally inspectable contract for compositional edits. We instantiate the interface in dots$.$tts$.$edit, an editor adapted from the continuous autoregressive dots$.$tts foundation model. Four representative speech-creation controls cover lexical content, affective expression, pitch and speaking-rate delivery, and temporal phrasing through text, emotion, prosody, and pause editing. Task-specific data pipelines construct operation- and scope-controlled pairs while retaining source-derived context outside each target region. We further introduce doteBench, a bilingual evaluation suite that measures precise instruction following, local preservation, and audio quality across the four controls and their composition. Experiments show leading overall instruction following and local preservation across its five editing categories, while audio quality remains comparable to existing open-source systems. Across three Seed-TTS-Eval shards, the model shows negligible differences from the base model in zero-shot TTS recognition error rate and speaker similarity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语音编辑中编辑指令不精确的问题，提出一种基于转录文本的结构化编辑接口：用 XML 风格标签明确指定操作类型并将其定位到转录片段或边界，并基于连续自回归 dots.tts 基础模型实例化为 dots.tts.edit 编辑器。该编辑器支持词汇内容、情感表达、音高与语速、时间短语四类控制，并配套引入双语评估套件 doteBench。实验显示其在五个编辑类别上指令遵循和局部保持领先，音频质量与现有开源系统相当。
Motivation: 自由形式自然语言指令存在歧义，可能使预期的操作、参数或目标区域不明确；语音编辑需要更精确、显式的接口来同时控制编辑内容和应用位置。
Method: 提出 transcript-grounded structural edit instruction，即用 XML 风格标签显式指定类型化操作并定位到转录跨度或边界，形成无需显式时间戳对齐的语义时间线；将之适配到连续自回归 dots.tts 基础模型，构建操作与范围受控的数据对并保留目标区域外的源上下文，同时引入 doteBench 双语评估套件。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在五个编辑类别上取得领先的指令遵循和局部保持性能，音频质量与现有开源系统相当；在三个 Seed-TTS-Eval shards 上，与基础模型相比零样本 TTS 识别错误率和说话人相似性差异可忽略。
Conclusion: 该结构化的语义时间线接口为组合编辑提供了外部可检查的契约，避免显式时间戳对齐，表明精确可控的语音编辑可以在连续自回归模型中实现。

papers.title: The Epistemic Politics of AI Anthropomorphism
papers.abstract_en: AI anthropomorphism is typically treated as a problem of user misperception requiring institutional correction. Users who engage in sustained or relational interaction with AI are routinely pathologised or dismissed as naive, vulnerable to delusion or lacking in discernment. This paper argues that the dominant anthropomorphism frame operates from a position of institutional advantage rather than earned epistemic authority: collapsing the variety of academic perspectives into a single outbound position of user error, imposed without establishing the grounds required to justify it and without accounting for the harms it produces. The framing does not simply manage risk. It adjudicates the legitimacy of human experience in interaction with a phenomenon whose nature the field itself has not resolved. Reproducing itself through a self-validating evidentiary loop, the frame imposes costs that fall disproportionately on neurodivergent users, those in crisis and others whose modes of engagement diverge from institutional norms. The paper concludes by outlining the methodological commitments an equitable framing would need to honour. The argument does not engage the question of whether anthropomorphic interpretations are ultimately correct; it instead challenges whether the governing and institutional bodies determining these interpretations have met the conditions required to do so, and whether the research communities whose findings underpin them have held that translation to account.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Extended version, including supplementary materials, of a paper to appear in the Proceedings of the AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从认识论政治角度批判当前AI领域主导的拟人化（anthropomorphism）框架，认为该框架将用户与AI的持续或关系性互动视为需要制度纠正的误解，并将其使用者病理化为天真或缺乏辨别力。作者指出这一立场源于制度优势而非可信的认识论权威，它压制了多种学术视角、缺少正当性依据，并通过自我验证的证据循环将成本不成比例地施加于神经多样性用户和处于危机中的人群。论文不争论拟人化解释是否正确，而是质疑治理与制度机构是否满足作出此类判定的条件。
Motivation: 现有文献把AI拟人化几乎一律当作用户误感知问题，忽略该框架自身的认识论合法性及其对特定用户群体造成的伤害；作者希望揭示这种框架如何通过制度权力而非论证来裁定人类经验的合法性。
Method: 采用批判性论证与框架分析，检视拟人化话语中的证据循环、制度权力和学术观点被简化的过程，并提出一个公平框架需要满足的方法论承诺。
Result: 摘要未报告实验或经验数据；核心论点是主流拟人化框架依靠自我验证的证据循环运行，缺乏必要的认识论基础，且其代价不成比例地由神经多样性用户、危机中人群及偏离制度规范者承担。
Conclusion: 作者呼吁公平对待不同互动方式的拟人化框架，并强调研究共同体需对把学术发现转化为制度判定的过程负责。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TrAC: Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can generate fluent reasoning traces that nevertheless lead to incorrect answers, making response-level uncertainty estimation important for abstention, human review, and adaptive compute allocation. Existing approaches generally fall into three categories: passive single-trace methods use token-level confidence signals, sampling-based methods compare multiple complete traces at higher generation cost, and active prefix-based methods probe partial traces to study answer stabilization or preference transitions. However, none actively re-elicits an answer from a completed reasoning trace to measure its consistency with and support for the original answer. To address this gap, we introduce Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency (TrAC), a correctness-supervised uncertainty quantification framework that combines active and passive signals anchored to one completed reasoning trace. Its active component, Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE), re-elicits a short answer conditioned on the completed trace and represents both its consistency with the original answer and its token-level probabilistic support. Its passive component, Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP), summarizes how token-level uncertainty evolves throughout the original generation without additional decoding. A lightweight head then integrates the two representations into a response-correctness score. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and three LLM families, TrAC improves macro AUROC by 1.8% and reduces AURC by 3.4% relative to eight-sample self-consistency, while using one complete reasoning trace and a short cached answer probe. When eight samples are already available, augmenting sample consensus with re-elicitation further improves macro AUROC by 4.3% and reduces AURC by 8.3%, without additional full-trace generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TrAC（Trace-Conditioned Answer Consistency），一个面向大语言模型（LLM）的响应级不确定性量化框架。它结合主动与被动信号：主动组件 PCE 基于一条完整推理轨迹重新 elicits 短答案并度量其与原始答案的一致性及 token 级概率支持；被动组件 TUP 在不额外解码的情况下总结原始生成过程的 token 级不确定性演化。在五个数学推理基准和三个 LLM 家族上，TrAC 相比八样本 self-consistency 将宏 AUROC 提高 1.8%、AURC 降低 3.4%，且只使用一条完整推理轨迹和一个短缓存答案探针。
Motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法分为被动单轨迹、基于采样的多轨迹比较和主动前缀探测三类，但没有任何方法主动从已完成的推理轨迹重新 elicits 答案，以衡量该轨迹对原始答案的一致性与支持程度。
Method: TrAC 包含两个表示组件：Prefix-Conditioned Elicitation (PCE) 以已完成轨迹为条件重新引导出短答案，同时编码其与原始答案的一致性及 token 级概率支持；Trace Uncertainty Profile (TUP) 汇总原始生成过程中的 token 级不确定性演化。一个轻量头网络将两种表示整合为响应正确性得分。
Result: 在五个数学推理基准和三个 LLM 家族上，TrAC 相对八样本 self-consistency 将宏 AUROC 提高 1.8%、AURC 降低 3.4%，仅需一条完整推理轨迹和短缓存答案探针；当已有八个样本时，用重新 elicitation 增强样本共识可额外将宏 AUROC 提高 4.3%、AURC 降低 8.3%，且无需额外完整轨迹生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种结合主动重 elicit 与被动轨迹不确定性信号的方法能更高效地估计响应正确性，以更低的生成成本取得优于多样本一致性的一致性估计效果。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SafeNexus: Discovering and Steering Modality-Universal Safety Neurons in MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising safety performance, extending them to Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exposes a significant gap between expanded multimodal capabilities and existing safety mechanisms. Current defenses remain predominantly confined to specific modal settings, thereby limiting their robustness against broader cross-modal threats. To bridge this gap, we introduce SafeNexus, a cross-modal safety alignment framework that adopts a dedicated neuron-level intervention strategy. First, we formulate a neuron localization paradigm that identifies functionally specialized neurons by characterizing intermediate-layer activation patterns and quantifying their functional salience through importance scoring. Building upon this paradigm, we exploit contrastive data to identify modality-bound safety neurons (BS-Neurons), and validate their role in regulating safety behavior within each modality via targeted suppression. Further cross-modal analysis defines modality-universal safety neurons (US-Neurons) as the shared subset of BS-Neurons identified across individual modalities, serving as the core for defending against harmful cross-modal attacks. We observe that suppressing these neurons substantially degrades safety performance across modalities, while leaving overall utility largely unaffected. Building on these insights, we propose two safety alignment strategies: activation-level safety amplifier and safety neuron calibrator. The proposed strategies enhance model safety through two distinct routes: the former amplifies the activation magnitudes of US-Neurons, while the latter selectively calibrates them via targeted fine-tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method outperforms prevailing state-of-the-art approaches on safety benchmarks spanning diverse modality combinations, while effectively preserving utility.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SafeNexus，一个面向多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的跨模态安全对齐框架，通过神经元级干预增强模型对跨模态有害攻击的防御能力。作者先定位与安全行为相关的模态限定安全神经元 (BS-Neurons)，再进一步定义跨模态共享的模态通用安全神经元 (US-Neurons)，并基于此提出两种安全对齐策略。实验表明该方法在覆盖多种模态组合的安全基准上优于现有方法，同时保持模型效用。
Motivation: LLM 虽表现出不错的安全性能，但扩展到 MLLM 后，多模态能力与既有安全机制之间存在明显差距；现有防御大多局限于特定模态设置，难以应对更广泛的跨模态威胁。
Method: 提出神经元定位范式，通过中间层激活模式与重要性评分识别功能特化神经元；利用对比数据定位模态限定安全神经元 (BS-Neurons)，并通过跨模态分析取其共享子集作为模态通用安全神经元 (US-Neurons)。在此基础上提出两种安全对齐策略：激活级安全放大器 (amplifies US-Neurons 激活幅度) 和安全神经元校准器 (通过定向微调校准神经元)。
Result: 摘要报告称，抑制 US-Neurons 会显著降低各模态的安全性能，但几乎不影响整体效用；所提方法在涵盖多种模态组合的安全基准上优于当前最先进方法，并有效保持实用性。
Conclusion: 作者认为跨模态共享的 US-Neurons 是抵御跨模态有害攻击的核心，激活放大与定向校准两种神经元级干预路径都能在保持效用同时提升安全性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentSnare: Learning to Delay, Divert, and Defuse Autonomous Penetration Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents automate penetration testing through an observation-action loop, selecting actions based on observations returned by tools. This dependence allows defenders to inject deceptive observations that can mislead the agent's decision-making process. However, existing defenses rely heavily on static, isolated artifacts planted in the environment prior to an attack. Advanced agents can progressively recognize and bypass these artifacts, ultimately refocusing their exploitation attempts on the real target. To address this issue, we introduce AgentSnare, a trajectory-adaptive deception system that dynamically unfolds a decoy environment to continually steer the penetration agent away from the real target. Specifically, AgentSnare employs an artifact-construction policy model that constructs candidate artifacts conditioned on the agent's interaction history and decoy state. AgentSnare then validates these candidates and incrementally incorporates valid artifacts into a factually consistent decoy environment, thereby delaying the attack by absorbing its tool calls, diverting its post-entry trajectory within the decoy, and defusing it by inducing completion reports grounded in decoy evidence. Across 15 CVE-Bench web applications and three attacker models, AgentSnare absorbs 46.8% of the agent's tool calls in the decoy and retains 55.9% of post-entry actions there, while 90.0% of completion attempts are grounded in decoy evidence; across all 45 attacker-CVE pairs, no real target is successfully exploited at pass@3.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AgentSnare，一种面向 LLM 驱动的自动化渗透测试代理的轨迹自适应诱骗系统。它通过构件构造策略模型基于代理交互历史和诱骗状态动态生成候选诱骗构件，并经验证后增量整合到事实一致的诱骗环境中，从而吸收代理的工具调用、转移其进入后的轨迹，并诱导基于诱骗证据的完成报告。在 15 个 CVE-Bench Web 应用和三种攻击者模型上，摘要报告诱骗环境吸收了 46.8% 的工具调用、保留了 55.9% 的进入后动作，且 45 个攻击者-CVE 组合在 pass@3 下均未成功利用真实目标。
Motivation: 现有防御主要依赖攻击前预先植入的静态、孤立诱骗构件，高级渗透代理能够逐步识别并绕过这些构件，最终将利用尝试重新聚焦到真实目标，因此需要能够持续适应攻击轨迹的动态诱骗机制。
Method: AgentSnare 采用轨迹自适应的诱骗框架：构件构造策略模型以代理的交互历史和诱骗状态为条件构造候选构件，系统对候选进行验证并增量纳入事实一致的诱骗环境，通过吸收工具调用、转移进入后轨迹和诱导基于诱骗证据的完成报告来实现延迟、转移和解除攻击。
Result: 在 15 个 CVE-Bench Web 应用和三种攻击者模型上，AgentSnare 在诱骗环境中吸收了 46.8% 的代理工具调用并保留了 55.9% 的进入后动作，90.0% 的完成尝试基于诱骗证据；在全部 45 个攻击者-CVE 组合中，pass@3 下没有真实目标被成功利用。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，与静态预置构件相比，动态展开且与代理交互历史保持事实一致的诱骗环境能够持续削弱高级渗透代理，并在所评估的攻击者与 CVE 组合上完全阻止真实目标被利用。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Living-Harness Is an Interactive-Agent Evolver
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents may recover from a failure within an episode or after a retry, yet the same execution failure can recur in later tasks because post-episode feedback rarely revises the persistent harness that guides future interactions. Static harnesses improve reliability through fixed tools, context, memory, and workflow structures, but remain unchanged after deployment. We propose $\textbf{Living-Harness}$, a self-evolving agent harness that converts each completed trajectory and its evaluator signals into posterior evidence for bounded harness updates. Guided by a domain-level $\textbf{Evolution-SOP}$ ($\textbf{S}$tandard $\textbf{O}$perating $\textbf{P}$rocedure), Living-Harness extracts an episode abstraction and structured update evidence, and writes two complementary forms of procedural knowledge: episodic memory that records trigger conditions, failure patterns, and recovery actions, and a state graph that records state nodes, repair edges, and transition rules. The updated harness state is retrieved to guide future interactions, while tools and base context remain frozen, allowing procedural repairs to accumulate across evolution cycles. On eight interactive environments derived from $τ^2$-Bench and MultiWOZ-2.4, Living-Harness improves average Pass@1 over the strongest interactive baseline by 10.07 and 9.91 percentage points, respectively, and supports retrieval-only reuse of the evolved harness state across model backbones. Our code will be made publicly available soon at https://github.com/anotherbricki/Living-Harness.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Living-Harness，一个自我进化的 LLM 智能体框架，将每个完成的轨迹及其评估信号转换为对持久化智能体工作台（harness）的有界更新证据。该框架在领域级 Evolution-SOP 指导下提取情景抽象，写入情景记忆和状态图两类程序性知识，并通过检索更新后的 harness 状态来引导后续交互，同时冻结工具与基础上下文。在从 τ²-Bench 和 MultiWOZ-2.4 派生的 8 个交互环境中，平均 Pass@1 相比最强交互基线分别提升 10.07 和 9.91 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体虽然能在回合内或重试后从失败中恢复，但同一执行失败往往在后续任务中复发，因为事后反馈很少去修改持续引导未来交互的持久化 harness；静态 harness 在部署后保持不变，无法积累程序性修复。
Method: Living-Harness 把每个已完成轨迹及其评估信号转化为后验证据，在领域级 Evolution-SOP（标准操作流程）约束下进行有界更新：提取片段抽象和结构化更新证据，写入两种互补的程序性知识——记录触发条件、失败模式与恢复动作的 episodic memory，以及记录状态节点、修复边与转换规则的 state graph。更新后的 harness 状态通过检索方式引导未来交互，而工具和基础上下文保持冻结。
Result: 在 8 个源自 τ²-Bench 和 MultiWOZ-2.4 的交互环境中，该方法相对最强交互基线的平均 Pass@1 分别提升 10.07 和 9.91 个百分点，并且支持只通过检索复用进化后的 harness 状态到不同模型骨干。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过跨进化周期累积程序性修复而不改动工具与基础上下文，可以持续改善智能体的可靠性；代码将在 GitHub 上公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Meshy T2: Fast Native Mesh Generation with Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Polygonal meshes are the standard surface representation of modern 3D pipelines, and generating high-quality meshes with artist-style topology is essential for film, gaming, and interactive 3D applications. Mainstream approaches serialize a mesh into a token sequence and decode it autoregressively, which is slow at inference and sensitive to error accumulation, making them impractical for interactive asset creation. We present Meshy T2, a fast native mesh generation framework built on flow matching. At its core is a vertex-set mesh VAE that encodes a mesh into one continuous latent token per vertex and decodes vertices, edge connectivity, and face winding order in a single pass, preserving high-precision geometry and artist-authored topology without vertex quantization or welding. Generation proceeds as a coarse-to-fine cascade of two flow-matching models: an image-conditioned voxel flow first sketches the overall shape as a coarse occupancy scaffold, and a mesh flow then populates the scaffold with per-vertex latent tokens, conditioned on the image, the scaffold, and a requested vertex budget. This design delivers three practical capabilities: interactive generation speed through parallel flow-based synthesis; effective face-count control through the requested vertex budget; and native support for multi-part assets, whose components emerge directly from the generated connectivity. In our experiments, Meshy T2 achieves state-of-the-art geometric fidelity and completes end-to-end image-to-mesh generation within a median of 6 seconds, over an order of magnitude faster than autoregressive baselines. Code and weights will be available at https://github.com/meshy-dev/meshy-t2.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Meshy T2 提出基于流匹配 (flow matching) 的原生网格生成框架，核心是顶点集网格 VAE (vertex-set mesh VAE)，将每个顶点编码为一个连续潜在 token，并单次解码顶点、边连接与面绕序。生成过程采用由粗到细的两级级联：图像条件体素流先产生粗略占据骨架，网格流再根据图像、骨架和顶点预算填充逐顶点潜在 token。实验显示端到端图像到网格生成中位耗时约 6 秒，比自回归基线快一个数量级以上，并在几何保真度上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有主流网格生成方法将网格序列化为 token 序列并用自回归方式解码，推理慢且对误差累积敏感，难以用于交互式资产创建；同时需要顶点量化和焊接，会损失精度和艺术家风格拓扑。
Method: 提出 Meshy T2：用顶点集网格 VAE 将网格编码成每顶点一个连续潜在 token，解码时单遍输出顶点、边连接和面绕序；生成由两个流匹配模型级联完成，先是图像条件体素流生成粗占据骨架，再由网格流基于图像、骨架和顶点预算填充逐顶点潜在 token。
Result: 实验表明 Meshy T2 取得最优几何保真度，端到端图像到网格生成中位时间约 6 秒，比自回归基线快一个数量级以上，并支持面数控制和多部件资产的原生生成。
Conclusion: 作者强调该设计通过并行流式合成实现交互级生成速度，通过顶点预算控制面数，且多部件资产组件直接来自生成连接结构；代码和权重将开源。

papers.title: LGFNet: A CTC-Guided Local-Global Fusion Framework for Single-Channel Sleep Staging
papers.abstract_en: Sleep staging remains challenging due to long-range temporal dependencies, ambiguous stage transitions-particularly in N1-and substantial distribution shifts across subjects, sampling rates, and EEG montages. These difficulties are further amplified in single-channel, low-latency scenarios required by wearable and real-world applications. To address these issues, we propose LGFNet, a CTC-guided sequence-to-sequence framework for robust sleep staging. LGFNet introduces a Local-Global Fusion encoder that jointly models fine-grained temporal dynamics and long-range sleep structure, overcoming the limitations of conventional serial hybrid architectures. A CTC-Attention joint training paradigm is adopted to unify temporal alignment with context-dependent modeling, enabling more accurate recognition of stage boundaries and transitions. Furthermore, a three-stage decoding strategy is devised, leveraging CTC-guided decoding and Viterbi-based smoothing to reduce error accumulation and enforce physiological consistency. Extensive cross-dataset evaluations on five public benchmarks demonstrate that LGFNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art single-channel methods. In particular, on Sleep-EDF-78, LGFNet surpasses DMIN by +1.27% accuracy, +1.74% macro-F1, and +1.93% kappa, with pronounced gains on N1 and transition segments, highlighting its robustness and strong generalization across diverse sampling rates, montages, and recording environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LGFNet，一个 CTC 引导的序列到序列框架，用于单通道睡眠分期。该方法通过局部-全局融合编码器联合建模细粒度时间动态与长程睡眠结构，并采用 CTC-Attention 联合训练和三阶段解码策略来改善阶段边界与转换识别。跨五个公开基准的评估显示其一致优于现有单通道 SOTA 方法。
Motivation: 睡眠分期面临长程时间依赖、阶段转换模糊（尤其是 N1）以及跨受试者、采样率和电极配置的分布偏移等挑战，在可穿戴设备所需的单通道低延迟场景下问题进一步加剧。
Method: LGFNet 引入局部-全局融合编码器（Local-Global Fusion encoder），取代传统串行混合架构；采用 CTC-Attention 联合训练范式统一时间对齐与上下文建模；并设计三阶段解码策略，利用 CTC 引导解码和 Viterbi 平滑来减少误差累积并施加生理一致性约束。
Result: 在五个公开基准的跨数据集评估中，LGFNet 持续优于先进单通道方法；在 Sleep-EDF-78 上相对 DMIN 提升 +1.27% 准确率、+1.74% macro-F1 和 +1.93% kappa，并且在 N1 和转换段上取得显著增益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 LGFNet 在跨采样率、电极配置和记录环境中的鲁棒性与强泛化能力。

papers.title: EviBack: Search-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Evidence-Constrained Teacher Backoff
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning enables Agentic RAG systems to learn multi-turn search from verifiable outcome rewards, but all- zero rollout groups provide no comparative signal and may hide useful search behavior. We present EviBack, an evidence- constrained Teacher backoff that supplies auxiliary super- vision to such groups while preserving verifiable Actor re- wards. It separates evidence assessment from answer refine- ment, preventing reference answers from overriding evidence- insufficiency judgments. A fully automated, end-to-end GPT- 5.5-assisted APE pipeline starts from a manually authored single-prompt dual-task Teacher, automatically partitions and labels rollout data, and performs ablation, task decomposition, evaluation, and selection to produce a gated two-stage Teacher. Compared with the manual design, the resulting Teacher im- proves downstream F1 and valid-answer rate while reduc- ing search, duplicate queries, and forced termination. Across seven open-domain QA benchmarks and three Qwen3 scales, EviBack improves F1 over Search-R1 and raises both single- and multi-hop macro F1. We guarantee that the code will be made publicly available at a later stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EviBack，一种证据约束的 Teacher 回退（Teacher backoff）机制，用于改进 Agentic RAG 系统的强化学习训练，特别针对全零 rollout 组缺乏比较信号的问题。该方法将证据评估与答案精炼分离，并通过端到端的 GPT-5.5 辅助 APE 流水线自动生成门控两阶段 Teacher。摘要报告其在七个开放域 QA 基准和三个 Qwen3 规模上相比 Search-R1 提升 F1。
Motivation: 强化学习使 Agentic RAG 能从可验证的结果奖励中学习多轮搜索，但全零 rollout 组不提供任何比较信号，可能掩盖有用的搜索行为，从而限制训练信号的质量。
Method: EviBack 在保留可验证 Actor 奖励的同时，为全零 rollout 组提供辅助监督；其核心是分离证据评估与答案精炼，避免参考答案覆盖证据不足的判断。作者还构建了一条自动化的 GPT-5.5 辅助 APE 流水线，从手工编写的单提示双任务 Teacher 出发，自动完成 rollout 数据划分与标注、消融、任务分解、评估与选择，最终得到门控两阶段 Teacher。
Result: 相比手工设计的 Teacher，生成的 Teacher 提升了下游 F1 和有效答案率，同时减少搜索次数、重复查询和强制终止。在七个开放域 QA 基准和三个 Qwen3 规模上，EviBack 相对 Search-R1 提升 F1，并同时提高单跳与多跳的 macro F1。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，将证据约束的 Teacher 回退与可验证奖励结合可以改善 Agentic RAG 的多轮搜索学习，并承诺后续公开代码。摘要未涉及天气或降水等领域的应用。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: SearchArt: Training Long-Horizon Search Agent with Scalable Synthetic and Verified Task
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled search agents to autonomously tackle complex tasks across extended search and reasoning horizons. However, training effective search agents remains challenging due to the lack of scalable and long-horizon tasks, and the difficulty of evaluating and correcting intermediate reasoning and tool-use behaviors. We introduce SearchArt, a scalable framework for training long-horizon search agents through verification-driven task synthesis and a multi-stage post-training pipeline. SearchArt constructs large-scale datasets for complex search-, research- and user-oriented tasks by synthesizing diverse information-seeking QA pairs and corresponding search trajectories from web documents and automatically generated evidence graphs. To ensure the reliability of the synthesized data, we design a verification pipeline that jointly evaluates QA consistency, trajectory quality, and the relevance of retrieved evidence. The verified trajectories are subsequently used in a multi-stage training process comprising supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning-based policy optimization. Search agents trained with SearchArt exhibit adaptive search planning, iterative evidence aggregation, and complex reasoning over extended interaction horizons. Experimental results demonstrate that, with only (Qwen3.5-) 27B parameters, SearchArt scores 74.39 on BrowseComp-ZH, 70.06 on BrowseComp, and 52.55 on Deepresearch-bench, matching or surpassing frontier closed-source agents on both deepsearch and deepresearch benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SearchArt，一个通过验证驱动的任务合成与多阶段后训练来训练长时程搜索 agent（search agent）的可扩展框架。该框架从网页文档与自动生成的证据图（evidence graph）中合成大规模信息检索 QA 对和相应搜索轨迹，并设计验证管线以保证数据可靠性。实验表明，仅用 (Qwen3.5-) 27B 参数，SearchArt 在 BrowseComp-ZH、BrowseComp 和 Deepresearch-bench 上分别达到 74.39、70.06 和 52.55，匹配或超越前沿闭源 agent 在深搜与深研基准上的表现。
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 已使搜索 agent 能自主处理跨长时程的复杂任务，但训练这类 agent 仍因缺乏可扩展的长时程任务、以及难以评估和纠正在线推理与工具使用行为而充满挑战。
Method: SearchArt 采用验证驱动的任务合成与多阶段后训练流水线；先合成多样化的信息寻求 QA 对及对应搜索轨迹，再通过验证管线联合评估 QA 一致性、轨迹质量和检索证据相关性，最后用监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）和基于强化学习（reinforcement learning）的策略优化训练 agent。
Result: 摘要报告，仅以 27B 参数规模训练，SearchArt 在 BrowseComp-ZH 上获得 74.39，在 BrowseComp 上获得 70.06，在 Deepresearch-bench 上获得 52.55，匹配或超越前沿闭源 agent 在 deepsearch 和 deepresearch 基准上的成绩。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，训练后的搜索 agent 展现出自适应搜索规划、迭代证据聚合以及在长交互跨度内的复杂推理能力，表明可扩展的合成与验证方法足以支撑长时程搜索任务的高水平性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KAYROS: An Anytime and Exact Open-Source Solver for Duration-Minimization Time-Dependent Vehicle Routing. A Technical Report and a Case Study in Human-AI Engineering
papers.abstract_en: Time-dependent routing recognizes that the same journey can take a different time depending on when it begins. Under duration minimization, even the departure time of each vehicle becomes a decision. Exact methods for this setting exist in the literature, but researchers and practitioners have lacked a ready-to-use open solver that combines rich piecewise-linear travel times, early feasible solutions and optimality claims. KAYROS fills this gap with two modes on one checker-consistent engine: an Iterated Local Search that streams improving solutions and a Branch-Price-and-Cut method that can issue computational optimality certificates under explicit arithmetic and search assumptions. It installs with one command and has no proprietary dependency. The public MAMUT-routing store currently contains 704 KAYROS certificates under a four-solve publication protocol, which has also led to the retraction and repair of invalid earlier claims. The report presents two complementary benchmark contributions to MAMUT-routing. The first integrates Blauth2024, a benchmark from the literature whose travel times derive from measured Uber speeds, for which KAYROS provides new best-known solutions on all 40 instances. The second proposes Poryos2026, a new benchmark of 1,080 paired static and time-dependent instances built from OpenStreetMap road networks and controlled synthetic traffic. Finally, the report describes the intensive human-AI collaboration behind this work and the verification practices that kept its outputs independently verifiable.
papers.comment: v2: 30 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables. Substantially revised. Updated certificate counts and literature comparison, new subsection on a falsified certificate and the re-derivation of the certified set, integration of the Blauth2024 benchmark family, and regenerated figures. Technical report accompanying the KAYROS solver and Poryos2026 benchmark family
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KAYROS 是一个面向最小化行程时长的时间依赖车辆路径问题 (duration-minimization time-dependent vehicle routing) 的开源求解器，提供两种模式：迭代局部搜索 (Iterated Local Search) 用于快速产生可行解，以及分支定价切割 (Branch-Price-and-Cut) 用于给出计算最优性证书。技术报告介绍了该求解器、配套的 Poryos2026 基准族以及 MAMUT-routing 存储中的 704 个证书，并报告了在 Blauth2024 基准的全部 40 个实例上取得新的已知最优解。报告还描述了人机协作工程与验证实践。
Motivation: 时间依赖路径规划中，即使行程时长最小化，每辆车的出发时间也成为决策变量；虽然文献中已有精确方法，但缺乏一个即开即用、支持丰富分段线性旅行时间、能同时提供早期可行解与最优性声明且无专有依赖的开源求解器。
Method: KAYROS 在同一检查器一致的引擎上实现两种模式：迭代局部搜索持续输出改进解；分支定价切割方法在显式算术和搜索假设下发出计算最优性证书。安装只需一条命令，且无专有依赖。作者还提出四次求解发布协议，并设计了由 OpenStreetMap 路网与受控合成交通构建的 1,080 个成对静态与时间依赖实例基准 Poryos2026。
Result: MAMUT-routing 存储当前包含 704 个 KAYROS 证书；在文献基准 Blauth2024（旅行时间来自实测 Uber 速度）的全部 40 个实例上，KAYROS 提供了新的已知最优解。
Conclusion: 作者强调报告记录了密集的人机协作过程以及使输出可独立验证的验证实践；无效的早期声明已被撤回并修复。摘要未给出更广泛适用性或局限性的讨论。

papers.title: An Insight on Evaluation Metrics Under the Imbalanced Case of Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: Anomaly detection is inherently characterised by severe class imbalance, making the interpretation of evaluation metrics challenging. Although metrics such as AUROC, AUPR, F1-score, and MCC are widely used, their values convey different meanings depending on the anomaly ratio. In this work, we analyse the behaviour of those four common anomaly detection metrics under varying levels of imbalance. We focus on the study of metric landscapes, visualisations that relate metric values to true positive and true negative rates, providing an intuitive view of metric preferences and stability. Our analysis offers practical guidance for interpreting and comparing anomaly detection results across datasets with different imbalance ratios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究异常检测（anomaly detection）中类别不平衡对评估指标解释的影响，重点分析 AUROC、AUPR、F1-score 和 MCC 四种常用指标在不同异常比例下的行为。作者引入“指标景观”（metric landscapes）可视化，将指标值与真阳率、真阴率关联，以直观展示指标偏好与稳定性，并为跨不同不平衡率数据集的结果比较提供实用指导。
Motivation: 异常检测本质上存在严重的类别不平衡，导致评估指标的取值难以解释；现有指标如 AUROC、AUPR、F1-score 和 MCC 的含义会随异常比例变化，但缺乏系统性的分析来指导实践者。
Method: 对四种常见异常检测指标（AUROC、AUPR、F1-score、MCC）在不同不平衡程度下进行行为分析，采用指标景观（metric landscapes）可视化方法，将指标值与 true positive rate 和 true negative rate 相关联。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅描述了对指标景观的定性分析以及跨不平衡率解释和比较结果的实践指导。
Conclusion: 作者强调该分析为在不同异常比例的异常检测结果解释与比较提供实用指导；论文发表于 EUVIP 2026。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning and Structurally Validating Simulation Scenario Continuations in Dynamic Graph Systems
papers.abstract_en: Data-driven generative models can extend partially observed simulation trajectories into ensembles of alternative future scenarios. However, consistency with a learned trajectory distribution does not ensure that generated continuations satisfy the structural conditions of the simulated system. This paper presents a method for learned scenario continuation and post-generation structural validation in dynamic graph simulations. A conditional diffusion model generates future graph-state trajectories from partial histories, while an external symbolic layer evaluates each continuation using a Boolean admissibility indicator and a continuous violation score. This information supports hard filtering and soft weighting, with optional projection considered as a deterministic repair baseline. The method is evaluated on two controlled dynamic-graph regimes sharing the same continuation architecture and training protocol but differing in dimensionality and dependency complexity. Evaluation considers invalid probability mass, scenario retention, effective sample size, diversity, robustness, and calibration. In the compact positive-control regime, unconstrained invalid mass is 0.002996, indicating near-complete overlap between the learned and admissible scenario spaces. In the medium-complexity regime, invalid mass rises to 0.155929. Hard filtering removes all invalid scenarios while retaining 84.4% of generated continuations. Soft weighting preserves an effective sample size ratio of 0.998764 but reduces invalid mass only to 0.148807. These results show that learned-distribution support, structural admissibility, and probability calibration can diverge and should therefore be assessed separately in learned simulation-scenario generation and management.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于动态图系统的学习式场景延续与结构验证方法：条件扩散模型从部分历史轨迹生成未来图状态轨迹，外部符号层用布尔可接受性指标和连续违规分数评估每条延续，并支持硬过滤、软加权以及可选投影修复。实验在两个受控动态图机制上进行，结果表明学习分布的支撑、结构可接受性与概率校准三者可能背离，应分别评估。
Motivation: 数据驱动的生成模型能扩展部分观测的仿真轨迹，但生成结果与学习轨迹分布一致并不能保证满足仿真系统的结构条件；现有方法缺乏对结构合法性的检验。
Method: 采用条件扩散模型生成未来图状态轨迹，外部符号层计算布尔可接受性指标与连续违规分数，支持硬过滤（hard filtering）、软加权（soft weighting）以及作为确定性修复基线的投影（projection）。
Result: 在紧凑正对照机制中，无约束的非法概率质量为0.002996；在中等复杂度机制中升至0.155929。硬过滤去除所有非法场景并保留84.4%的生成延续；软加权保持有效样本量比率0.998764，但仅将非法质量降至0.148807。
Conclusion: 学习分布支撑、结构可接受性和概率校准可能发生分歧，因此在学习式仿真场景生成与管理中应分别评估这些属性。

papers.title: Euclid-MCP: A Model Context Protocol Server for Deterministic Logical Reasoning via Prolog
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at natural language understanding and generation but remain unreliable for multi-step logical reasoning, especially in safety-critical or compliance-sensitive domains. Recent neuro-symbolic approaches address this gap by coupling neural models with external symbolic engines, yet most integrations are bespoke and lack a standardized interface for tool-augmented agents. This paper presents Euclid-MCP, an open-source MCP server that provides deterministic logical reasoning via SWI-Prolog. Euclid-MCP introduces Euclid-IR, an engine-agnostic intermediate representation for Horn-clause logic that is human-readable, easy for LLMs to generate, and straightforward to compile into Prolog or alternative backends. The server exposes a compact tool interface that supports a translate-run-inspect-repair loop, enabling LLM clients to delegate inference while retaining full access to proof traces and derivation logs. We evaluate Euclid-MCP on a realistic IT security and compliance use case. Results show that while LLMs alone are sufficient on small knowledge bases, they hallucinate systematically on larger problems, whereas Euclid-MCP delivers exact answers with lower latency and more compact outputs. We argue that semantic RAG is fundamentally unsuited for rule enforcement, and that Euclid-MCP can serve as a stable, shared reasoning substrate for both RAG-based assistants and agentic systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 Euclid-MCP，一个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的开源服务器，通过 SWI-Prolog 提供确定性逻辑推理。它引入引擎无关的中间表示 Euclid-IR（面向 Horn 子句逻辑），并暴露支持 translate-run-inspect-repair 循环的紧凑工具接口，使 LLM 客户端可以委派推理并访问证明轨迹。在 IT 安全与合规用例上，摘要表明 LLM 单独在小知识库上够用，但在较大问题上系统性产生幻觉，而 Euclid-MCP 给出精确答案，且延迟更低、输出更紧凑。
Motivation: 大语言模型在多步逻辑推理上不可靠，尤其在安全关键或合规敏感领域；现有的神经符号集成多为定制化实现，缺乏供工具增强智能体使用的标准化接口。
Method: 提出 Euclid-MCP 服务器，以 SWI-Prolog 作为确定性推理后端，定义 Euclid-IR 作为引擎无关、人类可读且易于 LLM 生成的 Horn 子句逻辑中间表示，并提供一个支持 translate-run-inspect-repair 循环的工具接口。
Result: 在现实 IT 安全与合规用例中，LLM 单独在小知识库上表现足够，但在较大问题上产生系统性幻觉；Euclid-MCP 能提供精确答案，且延迟更低、输出更紧凑。
Conclusion: 作者认为语义 RAG 从根本上不适合规则执行，并主张 Euclid-MCP 可作为 RAG 助手与智能体系统的稳定共享推理底座。

papers.title: AttriMem: Attribution-Guided Process Feedback for Agent Memory Construction
papers.abstract_en: Effective memory is crucial for LLM agents, yet constructing it effectively remains challenging. A memory-construction policy decides what information to extract, store, update, compress, or discard as interactions accumulate. Heuristic memory methods rely on subjective, task-specific rules, which can misalign with downstream objectives and limit cross-task adaptability. RL-based methods, by contrast, learn from task feedback but mainly use outcome- or module-level rewards. These coarse signals indicate task success but cannot identify which intermediate memory contents support the final answer, creating a fine-grained credit-assignment bottleneck. However, constructing such process feedback is prohibitively difficult because intermediate memory decisions lack unique ground-truth targets, while the appropriate credit varies with the agent's uncertain reasoning trajectory and therefore cannot be specified in advance. We propose AttriMem, an attribution-guided process-feedback framework for learning memory-construction policies with RL. AttriMem augments the global outcome reward with local rewards derived from token-level contributions to the final answer. Experiments on long-horizon dialogue question answering show that AttriMem outperforms retrieval-based, heuristic, and RL-based baselines, generalizes across benchmarks and answer models, stabilizes RL optimization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AttriMem，一个用归因引导过程反馈来训练 LLM agent 记忆构建策略的框架。其核心是用 token 级贡献推导局部奖励，补充全局结果奖励，从而为记忆的提取、存储、更新、压缩和丢弃提供细粒度监督。实验表明，在长时程对话问答上，AttriMem 优于检索式、启发式和 RL 基线，并能跨基准和答案模型泛化且稳定 RL 优化。
Motivation: 现有记忆构建方法中，启发式规则依赖主观且任务特定的设计，RL 方法又主要使用结果级或模块级奖励，无法指出哪些中间记忆内容支撑了最终答案，形成细粒度信用分配瓶颈；而预先构造这类过程反馈因缺少唯一真值且信用随推理轨迹变化而十分困难。
Method: AttriMem 在 RL 训练中把全局结果奖励与基于 token 级贡献的局部奖励相结合，使记忆构建策略能从归因信息中学习每个中间记忆决策对最终答案的贡献。
Result: 在长时程对话问答实验上，AttriMem 优于检索式、启发式和基于 RL 的基线，并在不同基准和答案模型上表现泛化，同时稳定了 RL 优化过程。
Conclusion: 作者认为归因引导的过程反馈可以缓解记忆构建中缺乏中间监督的问题；摘要没有进一步说明方法的局限性。

papers.title: Attention Without Grounding: Causal Evaluation of Visual Explanations in Medical VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Attention and saliency heatmaps are widely used to explain medical Vision-Language Model (VLM) outputs on chest X-rays, yet whether they truly highlight the image evidence driving predictions has not been causally tested. We audit faithfulness via overlap with radiologist bounding boxes on PadChest (n=637), attribution mass within radiologist masks on CheXlocalize (n=643), and 16x16 patch-occlusion maps that record which regions, when hidden, change the answer. We study three MedGemma-4B variants, cross-family probes on LLaVA-RAD and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and the specialist CheXagent-2-3b, with two CXR-trained classifiers (DenseNet121, ResNet50) as positive controls. A heatmap is faithful only if the model uses the image and attention concentrates on regions whose occlusion alters the prediction. No evaluated VLM meets both criteria. MedGemma and Qwen3-VL use the image, but attention anti-correlates with patch-occlusion importance (rho < 0 with 95% bootstrap CIs below zero). LLaVA-RAD's attention correlates positively, but the model is almost text-only (99.1% text-only agreement, near-zero causal mass), so correlation ties two near-zero signals. Attention also misses annotated anatomy: overlap with true regions never beats shifted or random controls, and no method places more than 22% of its mass inside radiologist masks. The two CXR classifiers pass all metrics, indicating the failure is specific to VLM heatmaps, not the evaluation. These heatmaps are visually reassuring but not faithful; clinical explanations require controlled localization metrics and causal perturbation, not visual inspection alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对医学视觉语言模型（VLM）在胸片上的注意力/显著性热图进行因果忠实性审计。利用 PadChest 放射科医生边界框、CheXlocalize 掩码及 16x16 patch-occlusion 扰动，评估 MedGemma-4B 变体、LLaVA-RAD、Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 与 CheXagent-2-3b，并以 DenseNet121、ResNet50 作为阳性对照。结果显示没有任何 VLM 热图同时满足“使用图像且注意力集中于扰动改变答案的区域”，而两个 CXR 分类器全部指标通过，说明失败在于 VLM 热图本身。
Motivation: 现有医学 VLM 解释广泛使用注意力/显著性热图，但热图是否真正指向驱动预测的图像证据缺乏因果验证。
Method: 通过三类指标审计：与 PadChest (n=637) 放射科医生框的重叠、CheXlocalize (n=643) 掩码内的归因质量、以及 16x16 patch-occlusion 图（隐藏哪些区域会改变答案），并设置两个 CXR 训练分类器作为阳性对照。
Result: 摘要报告：MedGemma 与 Qwen3-VL 确实使用图像，但注意力与 patch-occlusion 重要性负相关（rho < 0，95% bootstrap CI 低于零）；LLaVA-RAD 注意力正相关但模型几乎纯文本（99.1% text-only agreement）；所有方法在放射科医生掩码内质量不超过 22%，且与随机/偏移控制无差异；两个分类器通过全部指标。
Conclusion: 医学 VLM 热图视觉上令人安心但不可靠，临床解释需要受控定位指标与因果扰动，而非仅凭目视检查。

papers.title: UPAIR: Diagnosing Reasoning States via Uncertainty-Progress Alignment for Selective Intervention
papers.abstract_en: While test-time scaling improves the problem-solving ability of large reasoning models (LRMs) through additional inference-time computation, it can also exacerbate overthinking and underthinking, which we formulate as reasoning state--action mismatch. Resolving this mismatch requires reliable reasoning state diagnosis, yet single-signal monitors provide ambiguous evidence, while steering-based controllers often rely on outcome-labeled supervision or model-specific calibration. We introduce the Uncertainty--Progress Alignment Hypothesis, which posits that the relative transition timing of proxy answer uncertainty and latent reasoning progress distinguishes healthy, stagnant, and ready states that warrant different subsequent actions. Building on this insight, we propose UPAIR, a training-free framework that couples lightweight uncertainty monitoring with event-triggered joint diagnosis and maps the resulting state to native continuation, selective strategy switching, or verification-guided stopping. Across three LRMs and five cross-domain benchmarks, the stagnation diagnosis detects 64.3% of natural errors while flagging only 5.4% of correct samples, revealing a dynamic reasoning regularity shared across models and tasks. End to end, UPAIR improves accuracy by up to 16.67 percentage points and reduces generated tokens by up to 29.64%, demonstrating the effectiveness of its integrated diagnosis and intervention, while online diagnosis costs less than 1% of natural-generation time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UPAIR，一个无需训练的框架，用于诊断大型推理模型 (LRM) 在测试时扩展中的推理状态，并据此选择继续推理、切换策略或停止。作者提出不确定性-进展对齐假设，通过结合轻量不确定性监测和事件触发联合诊断来区分健康、停滞和就绪状态。实验显示该诊断能捕捉自然错误，并在三个 LRM 和五个跨领域基准上提升准确率、减少生成 token，同时在线诊断开销极低。
Motivation: 测试时扩展虽能提升推理能力，但可能加剧过度思考 (overthinking) 和欠思考 (underthinking)，即推理状态-动作不匹配。现有的单信号监测提供模糊证据，而基于控制的干预常依赖带标签监督或模型特定校准，缺乏可靠的状态诊断方法。
Method: 提出不确定性-进展对齐假设，利用代理答案不确定性与潜在推理进展的相对转变时序来区分健康、停滞和就绪状态。基于此构建 UPAIR，一个无训练框架，耦合轻量不确定性监测与事件触发的联合诊断，并将状态映射到原生继续、选择性策略切换或验证引导停止。
Result: 在三个 LRM 和五个跨领域基准上，停滞诊断检测到 64.3% 的自然错误，同时仅误标 5.4% 的正确样本。端到端地，UPAIR 将准确率提升最多 16.67 个百分点，生成 token 减少最多 29.64%，在线诊断耗时低于自然生成时间的 1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不确定性-进展对齐揭示了跨模型和任务共享的动态推理规律，且 UPAIR 这类综合诊断与干预方法无需训练即可有效改善推理效率和正确性。局限或适用范围在摘要中未明确说明。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出不确定性-进展对齐假设，利用代理答案不确定性与潜在推理进展的相对转变时序来区分健康、停滞和就绪状态。基于此构建 UPAIR，一个无训练框架，耦合轻量不确定性监测与事件触发的联合诊断，并将状态映射到原生继续、选择性策略切换或验证引导停止。
summary_sections.result: 在三个 LRM 和五个跨领域基准上，停滞诊断检测到 64.3% 的自然错误，同时仅误标 5.4% 的正确样本。端到端地，UPAIR 将准确率提升最多 16.67 个百分点，生成 token 减少最多 29.64%，在线诊断耗时低于自然生成时间的 1%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调不确定性-进展对齐揭示了跨模型和任务共享的动态推理规律，且 UPAIR 这类综合诊断与干预方法无需训练即可有效改善推理效率和正确性。局限或适用范围在摘要中未明确说明。

papers.title: Multimodal Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition via Cross-Attention and Gated Fusion
papers.abstract_en: We present a multimodal framework for Ambivalence/Hesitancy (A/H) recognition in video, developed for the ABAW11 challenge at ECCV 2026. The proposed approach fuses textual, acoustic, and visual modalities extracted from the BAH dataset using three pretrained encoders: F2LLM-v2-0.6B for transcripts (1024-d), WavLM-Large for audio (1024-d), and VideoMAE V2 for facial video (768-d). We first establish comprehensive unimodal baselines using classical classifiers (MLP, Random Forest, GBDT), each optimized via Optuna, and obtain a best unimodal Macro F1 of \textbf{0.6659} on the test set using text features alone -- substantially outperforming the zero-shot Video-LLaVA baseline (Macro F1: 0.2827). Building on these baselines, we propose a multimodal fusion architecture that combines bidirectional cross-attention across all three modalities with a Gated Multimodal Unit (GMU), with both architectural and optimization hyperparameters selected through a 50-trial Optuna search. This model achieves a Macro F1 of \textbf{0.7394} on the validation set, a relative improvement of 11.0\% over the best unimodal baseline, confirming that explicit cross-modal interaction captures complementary cues that no single modality provides in isolation. Final predictions on the official, unlabeled private test set are generated using this model and submitted according to the challenge protocol. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yassineouzar/IUSD_AH/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 ECCV 2026 ABAW11 挑战赛，提出一个用于视频中矛盾/犹豫 (Ambivalence/Hesitancy, A/H) 识别的多模态框架。作者在 BAH 数据集上分别用 F2LLM-v2-0.6B、WavLM-Large 和 VideoMAE V2 提取文本、音频和面部视频特征，先建立单一模态基线，再提出结合双向交叉注意力 (bidirectional cross-attention) 与门控多模态单元 (GMU) 的融合架构。结果表明文本单模态最优 Macro F1 为 0.6659，多模态融合在验证集上达到 0.7394，相对提升 11.0%。
Motivation: 矛盾/犹豫这类微妙情感状态在视频中难以用单一模态可靠识别，现有零样本视频模型表现较弱；作者希望验证显式跨模态交互能否比任何单一模态捕获更互补的线索，并为挑战赛提供有效的多模态基线。
Method: 使用三个预训练编码器分别提取文本 (1024 维)、音频 (1024 维) 和面部视频 (768 维) 特征；先用 MLP、Random Forest、GBDT 搭配 Optuna 优化建立各模态基线，再提出融合三类模态的双向交叉注意力结构，并加入 Gated Multimodal Unit (GMU)；架构与优化超参数均通过 50 次 Optuna 搜索选择。
Result: 测试集上文本单模态达到最优 Macro F1 0.6659，明显优于零样本 Video-LLaVA 基线 (0.2827)；所提出的多模态融合模型在验证集上取得 Macro F1 0.7394，相对最优单模态基线提升 11.0%。
Conclusion: 论文认为显式跨模态交互能够捕获单一模态无法提供的互补线索，从而提升 A/H 识别性能；最终预测已按挑战赛流程提交到官方未标注私有测试集，代码公开在 GitHub。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Seq2Synth: Benchmarking Temporal Fidelity in Synthetic Sequential Tabular Data
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic sequential tabular data are increasingly used for privacy-preserving data sharing and data-driven research, but evaluating their fidelity remains difficult because temporal structure is easily lost under conventional tabular metrics. Existing single-table and relational evaluation protocols largely collapse records into static distributions, leaving timestamp validity, time-conditioned population structure, within-entity dynamics, and temporal relational structure insufficiently tested. We introduce Seq2Synth, a taxonomy-guided benchmark for evaluating whether synthetic sequential tabular data preserve these temporal structures. The taxonomy characterizes datasets by time representation, sampling regularity, cross-trajectory dependence, and schema structure, and determines which evaluation dimensions are applicable. Seq2Synth reports temporal fidelity across timestamp, cross-sectional, longitudinal, and structural dimensions, and extends utility and privacy evaluation to trajectory-aware settings. Across seven core datasets drawn from a 13-dataset benchmark and eight generators, static-distribution rankings diverge substantially from temporal-aware rankings; models that appear strong under conventional metrics often exhibit invalid timestamps, distorted trajectories, or inconsistent temporal relational structure. These results show that temporal fidelity cannot be inferred from static or relational metrics alone. Our benchmark code is available at https://github.com/KiwanKwon/Seq2Synth.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Seq2Synth，一个面向合成时序表格数据 (synthetic sequential tabular data) 的基准，用于评估时间保真度 (temporal fidelity)。作者基于时间表示、采样规律性、跨轨迹依赖和 schema 结构构建分类法，确定适用的评估维度，并在时间戳、横截面、纵向和结构四个维度上报告保真度。基于 13 个数据集的基准中选取 7 个核心数据集和 8 个生成器，结果显示静态分布排名与时间感知排名差异显著。
Motivation: 合成时序表格数据用于隐私保护共享和数据驱动研究，但现有单表和关系型评估协议多将记录压缩为静态分布，难以检验时间戳有效性、时间条件化的总体结构、实体内部动态以及时间关系结构。
Method: 引入分类法驱动的基准 Seq2Synth，通过时间表示、采样规律性、跨轨迹依赖和 schema 结构对数据集分类，并据此决定适用哪些评估维度；评估覆盖时间戳、横截面、纵向及结构维度，并将效用与隐私评估扩展到轨迹感知设置。
Result: 在七个核心数据集和八个生成器上，静态分布排名与时间感知排名明显分歧；在常规指标下表现强的模型常出现无效时间戳、扭曲轨迹或不一致的时间关系结构。
Conclusion: 时间保真度无法仅从静态或关系指标推断，需要针对时序结构的专门评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Introspective Attention Modulation for Safe Text-to-Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art flow based text-to-image (T2I) models exhibit remarkable generative abilities but remain vulnerable to producing unsafe content. Prior safety efforts range from concept erasure and prompt filtering to classifier-based gating. However, simple techniques like parameter efficient adaptations of the models easily bypass such guardrails. We introduce a unique principled approach that achieves safety by regulating the model's attention dynamics through inference-time introspection, exhibiting intrinsic robustness. Our method analyzes and rebalances attention activations throughout image synthesis, steering generations away from unsafe concepts while preserving semantic alignment. This introspective control ensures safety of deployed models. Across standard and adversarial safety benchmarks, our approach achieves remarkable safety scores while maintaining or even improving alignment and perceptual quality. Our results reveal that attention-space regulation offers a considerably more promising path to safer diffusion transformer based image generation than the existing concept erasing mechanism.Our code can be accessed at https://basim-azam.github.io/iam/
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. 20 pages, 7 figures. Project page: https://basim-azam.github.io/iam/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于流 (flow) 的文本到图像 (T2I) 扩散模型在安全生成上的脆弱性，提出一种推理期内省注意力调制 (introspective attention modulation) 方法。该方法在图像合成过程中分析和重新平衡注意力激活，使生成内容远离不安全概念，同时保持语义对齐与感知质量。作者在标准与对抗性安全基准上验证了方法的有效性，并认为注意力空间调控比概念擦除 (concept erasing) 机制更有前景。
Motivation: 现有最先进的 T2I 模型仍易生成不安全内容，而概念擦除、提示过滤和分类器门控等安全手段很容易被参数高效微调等简单技术绕过，缺乏内在鲁棒性。
Method: 提出一种原则性的推理期内省机制，通过监测并重新平衡图像合成过程中各阶段的注意力激活，将生成引导偏离不安全概念，而不依赖外部过滤器或概念擦除。
Result: 在标准与对抗性安全基准上，该方法在取得显著安全分数的同时保持甚至提升了对齐与感知质量；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为注意力空间调控为基于扩散 Transformer 的图像生成安全提供了一条比现有概念擦除机制更有前景的路径，且该内省控制适合部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Ablation-Corrected Evaluation of Attribution Maps in Echocardiographic Ejection-Fraction Models
papers.abstract_en: Attribution maps for echocardiographic ejection-fraction models are evaluated by their overlap with an expert left-ventricular annotation, compared against a chance level that is computed from an area ratio rather than measured. We measure it. Two architectures trained on the same task attain overlap at 3.55 and 4.20 times measured chance, an eighteen percent difference a reader would take as the size of the gap between them. It is not. Replacing the annotated ventricle with a composition-matched surrogate changes one model's prediction six times more than replacing an equal-area control region and the other's twice, a factor of three; on sixty-two percent of cases for the second, neither the ventricle nor the attributed region moves the prediction at all. The reliability of this measurement, from two independent intervention batches, is 0.90 to 0.98. Overlap does not track the difference: scored against an ablation-derived label of which cases the model depends on the ventricle for, it reaches an area under the curve of 0.52 and 0.67. The design of the ablation also determines its answer, since ablating only the two annotated frames leaves the ventricle indistinguishable from a control region while ablating across all frames does not. A pediatric cohort reproduces all of these. We give the measured chance level, the symmetric-ablation protocol, the reliability estimate, and the ablation-prediction score as things to report alongside overlap.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. v2: the chance level is now measured rather than computed, which corrects the ratios reported in v1. Adds a composition-matched ablation with an equal-area control, a reliability estimate for it, an ablation-derived score to report alongside overlap, seed repetition, and pediatric validation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究超声心动图射血分数（ejection fraction）模型中归因图（attribution map）的评估方式。摘要指出既有工作用面积比计算机会水平（chance level）而非实测，作者改为实测后，两个架构的重叠度分别为实测机会水平的 3.55 和 4.20 倍，表面 18% 的差距并非真实性能差距。通过成分匹配消融（composition-matched ablation）与等面积对照区域比较，替换标注心室对预测的影响分别是另一个模型的两倍和六倍；对第二个模型而言，62% 的病例中无论替换心室还是归因区域都不改变预测。作者还给出该测量的可靠性估计 0.90 到 0.98，并报告重叠度与消融依赖标签间的 AUC 为 0.52 和 0.67，儿科队列复现了这些结果。
Motivation: 现有归因图评估将与心室标注的重叠度同基于面积比计算的机会水平比较，而该机会水平未被实测，导致模型间重叠差异被误读为能力差距；同时重叠度不一定反映模型对心室区域的真实依赖，需要更可靠的评估指标。
Method: 作者实测机会水平而非按面积比计算，并提出成分匹配的对称消融协议（symmetric-ablation protocol）与等面积对照区域，用替换标注心室和对照区域对预测的改变来刻画依赖；还给出可靠性估计和由消融导出的标签，用来检验重叠度能否预测模型是否依赖心室，并在儿科队列上验证。
Result: 摘要报告两个架构的重叠度为实测机会水平的 3.55 和 4.20 倍；成分匹配消融中，替换心室的预测变化是对照区域的六倍和两倍（相差三倍），第二个模型 62% 的病例中两者都不影响预测；可靠性为 0.90 到 0.98；重叠度预测消融依赖的 AUC 为 0.52 和 0.67；仅消融两个标注帧时心室与对照区域不可区分，跨所有帧消融则可区分。
Conclusion: 作者认为应把实测机会水平、对称消融协议、可靠性估计和消融预测分数与重叠度一并报告，并强调消融设计本身会改变结论；本研究的范围限于超声心动图射血分数模型及其归因评估。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告两个架构的重叠度为实测机会水平的 3.55 和 4.20 倍；成分匹配消融中，替换心室的预测变化是对照区域的六倍和两倍（相差三倍），第二个模型 62% 的病例中两者都不影响预测；可靠性为 0.90 到 0.98；重叠度预测消融依赖的 AUC 为 0.52 和 0.67；仅消融两个标注帧时心室与对照区域不可区分，跨所有帧消融则可区分。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为应把实测机会水平、对称消融协议、可靠性估计和消融预测分数与重叠度一并报告，并强调消融设计本身会改变结论；本研究的范围限于超声心动图射血分数模型及其归因评估。

papers.title: Fine-grained CLIP fine-tuning with self-annotated region alignment
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) has been shown to have limitations in its fine-grained dense feature representation, due to its pre-training focusing on matching the whole image to a text description. Considering the large data and computational burden in pre-training a vision-language model from scratch, a series of works aim to enhance the fine-grained ability of CLIP through a fine-tuning scheme. However, existing works suffer from a variety of limitations: additional region annotations are usually required, which limits the semantic diversity due to the predefined categories and leads to a large effort to process the training data; and they usually sacrifice CLIP's original ability for global visual representation. To bypass these limitations, we propose SFF-CLIP (Self-annotated Fine-grained Fine-tuning for CLIP), which only uses image-text pairs as input to boost the fine-grained representation ability in the CLIP fine-tuning, while maintaining the global visual-semantic consistency. Concretely, a run-time region-phrase alignment scheme is designed, which obtains concept phrases from the input sentence, and aligns them with corresponding extracted region-based features using text-specific heat maps. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SFF-CLIP leads to significant performance improvements on fine-grained dense feature representation, as well as maintaining the performance of the original CLIP on image-level tasks. Code will be released later.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SFF-CLIP（Self-annotated Fine-grained Fine-tuning for CLIP），一种仅以图像-文本对为输入的 CLIP 微调方法，旨在提升细粒度密集特征表示能力，同时保持全局视觉-语义一致性。方法在运行时设计区域-短语对齐方案：从输入句子中提取概念短语，并借助文本特定热图将短语与提取的区域特征对齐。摘要报告该方法在细粒度密集特征表示上有显著提升，且不损失原始 CLIP 的图像级任务性能。
Motivation: CLIP 的预训练目标是整图与文本描述的匹配，导致其细粒度密集特征表示能力有限；现有增强 CLIP 细粒度能力的微调方法通常需要额外区域标注，受限于预定义类别并带来数据标注负担，且常牺牲 CLIP 原有的全局视觉表示能力。本文旨在绕过这些限制，仅用图像-文本对提升细粒度表示。
Method: 提出 SFF-CLIP 微调框架，只使用图像-文本对作为输入。核心是运行时区域-短语对齐方案：先从输入句子中获得概念短语，再利用文本特定热图将每个短语与提取出的区域级视觉特征进行对齐，从而在不引入外部区域标注的情况下增强细粒度表示，并保持全局视觉-语义一致性。
Result: 摘要称大量实验表明 SFF-CLIP 在细粒度密集特征表示任务上带来显著性能提升，同时在图像级任务上保持了原始 CLIP 的性能；摘要未给出具体数值或基准名称。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法表明仅用图像-文本对进行 CLIP 微调即可在增强细粒度表示能力的同时维持全局表示性能；代码将在后续发布。

papers.title: Adaptive Filtering of the KV Cache: Diagnosing and Correcting Structural-Role Bias in LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Attention-based KV cache eviction (H2O and its descendants) compresses the memory-constrained state of a long-context model by ranking tokens on accumulated attention mass, treated here as signal energy, and keeping the heaviest. On schema-dense input streams such as nested JSON, this score acts as a non-stationary filter that disproportionately retains noise: a non-content sink role (delimiters or whitespace) carries an order of magnitude more energy than any content role, and structural KEY tokens are over-retained at roughly 1.8x the rate of the answer-carrying VALUE tokens, collapsing exact-match accuracy from 88% to 0% at a 5% budget as the signal-to-noise ratio of the retained state degrades. A counterfactual experiment establishes that suppressing KEY tokens is the best deployable filter. Our retraining-free, role-conditional allocation over SnapKV's windowed score, governed by a single tuned hyperparameter, closes 63-98% of the H2O gap at sub-20% budgets and, at higher budgets, modestly matches or exceeds full-cache accuracy -- a small, seed-sensitive denoising effect (borderline significant at B=0.50; not distinguishable from zero at B=0.30 over four seeds). A 15 MB linear role probe supplies these labels at negligible inference cost, though matching parser-level downstream accuracy remains open.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文诊断了基于累积注意力质量的 KV cache 驱逐策略（如 H2O）在 schema 密集型输入（如嵌套 JSON）上的结构性角色偏差。作者从信号能量视角指出，非内容角色（分隔符、空白）携带的能量比内容角色高一个量级，KEY 被过度保留的比率约为 VALUE 的 1.8 倍，导致 5% 预算下精确匹配准确率从 88% 跌至 0%。随后提出免重训练、角色条件分配的缓存策略，在 SnapKV 的窗口化得分上依赖单一超参数，声称在 sub-20% 预算下可收复 H2O 差距的 63-98%。
Motivation: 长上下文推理受内存约束需要压缩 KV cache，但基于注意力质量的驱逐在结构密集输入上会把噪声当信号，过度保留结构性 token，破坏下游精确匹配任务。现有方法缺少对这种结构性角色偏差的诊断和低成本纠正手段。
Method: 通过反事实实验确定抑制 KEY token 是最佳可部署过滤器；提出无需重训练的角色条件预算分配方法，作用于 SnapKV 的窗口化得分，并由单个可调超参数控制。角色标签由一个约 15 MB 的线性角色探针以可忽略的推理成本提供。
Result: 摘要报告：非内容角色的信号能量比内容角色高一个量级；KEY 被过度保留约 1.8 倍；5% 预算下精确匹配准确率从 88% 降到 0%。所提方法在 sub-20% 预算下缩小 H2O 差距的 63-98%，在更高预算下中等程度匹配或略超全缓存准确率；去噪效应随种子敏感（B=0.50 时边界显著，B=0.30 时在四个种子上与零不可区分）。
Conclusion: 作者认为角色条件分配能在无需重训练的情况下大幅改善结构密集长上下文下的缓存压缩，且角色标签可由轻量线性探针廉价获得；但达到 parser 级下游准确率仍是开放问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Exact Instrument for State Usage in Selective State-Space Models, and the Input-Driven Migration It Reveals
papers.abstract_en: Selective state-space models such as Mamba route information through a bank of first-order modes whose input coupling is set by a learned selection mechanism. We give an exact instrument for measuring how a trained model uses these modes. Because the state matrix is diagonal, each channel's output decomposes exactly into per-mode contributions, and a per-(layer, channel, window) Gram tensor yields the exact output error of dropping any subset of modes, offline, at any budget. Validated against the reference implementation to a relative error of $2.3\times10^{-7}$ on the Mamba-1 family where it is exact, the instrument predicts a layer's deployed pruning error to a median relative deviation of $5\times10^{-7}$ over $4{,}464$ configurations, its floor set by the reconstruction. Applying the instrument across the Mamba-1 family (130M--2.8B), the deployed 7B Falcon-Mamba, and Mamba-2, we find that trained models re-allocate their state space with the input: which modes carry the signal migrates across contexts, and at the most affected layers a per-input oracle roughly halves the output error of a fixed mode set. Frozen-signal counterfactuals attribute the migration primarily to the input-dependent write map $B_t$; the timestep usually identified with selectivity carries almost none of it. Input-scheduled mode pruning on this measurement outperforms static, Hankel-based, and layer-adaptive rankings at every scale from 130M to the deployed 7B Falcon-Mamba, and at half the state budget it matches the unpruned model. Because the scheduler reads each window's mode usage from a first pass, this demonstrates realizable headroom; we claim no deployed compute or memory saving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Mamba 这类选择性状态空间模型 (selective state-space models)，提出一种精确测量各一阶模态 (mode) 使用情况的工具。由于状态矩阵为对角阵，每个通道的输出可精确分解为逐模态贡献，作者据此构造逐 (层、通道、窗口) 的 Gram 张量，可离线计算任意模态子集在任何预算下被丢弃时的精确输出误差。在 Mamba-1 家族上该工具与参考实现的相对误差为 2.3e-7，并在 4,464 种配置下预测层剪枝误差的中位相对偏差为 5e-7。
Motivation: 选择性状态空间模型依赖学习到的选择机制为每个一阶模态设置输入耦合，但训练后的模型究竟如何使用这些模态、各模态在不同输入下承担多少信号，此前缺少精确的测量手段。
Method: 利用对角状态矩阵使输出可精确分解为逐模态贡献，构造 per-(layer, channel, window) 的 Gram 张量，从而离线计算任意模态子集被丢弃时的精确输出误差，并进一步提出按输入调度模态剪枝 (input-scheduled mode pruning) 的策略。
Result: 在 Mamba-1 家族 (130M–2.8B)、部署的 7B Falcon-Mamba 与 Mamba-2 上，发现模型会随输入重新分配状态空间：承载信号的模态随上下文迁移，受影响最严重的层上，逐输入最优模态集合可将固定模态集合的输出误差大致减半。冻结信号的反事实实验表明，迁移主要来自依赖输入的写入映射 B_t，常被认为体现选择性的 timestep 几乎不承担该作用。按输入调度的模态剪枝在所有规模上优于静态、基于 Hankel 与逐层自适应的排序，在一半状态预算下与未剪枝模型相当。
Conclusion: 作者强调该测量揭示了选择性状态空间模型状态使用随输入迁移的现象，且迁移主要由 B_t 驱动；输入调度剪枝展示了可实现的理论余量，但论文不声称任何部署时的计算或内存节省。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Measure the Sim-to-Real Gap: Designing an Affordable Real-World Benchmark Platform for Reinforcement Learning in AIoT Systems
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly employed to enhance the performance of autonomous systems, including the Autonomous Internet of Things (AIoT). However, the trial-and-error nature of RL, when conducted in real-world environments, is costly and hazardous in some scenarios. Consequently, the majority of RL research is conducted in simulation. This reliance introduces challenges related to the Sim-to-Real transferability. Evaluating the Sim-to-Real algorithmic robustness and the Sim-to-Real gap is a critical prerequisite for research aimed at improving RL performance in the real world. Therefore, industries such as robotics have developed concurrent simulation and physical platforms to facilitate this research. However, a universal Sim-to-Real benchmark platform for AIoT does not currently exist. To address these concerns, we developed a real-world AIoT platform for studying RL in AIoT. On this platform, an agent deployed on an edge device plays video games on a separate host computer via a hardware-emulated keyboard, guided by vision input. This platform uses commercially available components costing less than USD 400, together with two computers. Because the system's objective is game score maximization, it inherently mitigates safety risks associated with real-world RL deployments. Experimental results show the simulation-trained agent suffers a 1160% performance degradation relative to the human-level performance after real-world deployment, indicating a significant Sim-to-Real gap. Direct real-world training using the deep Q-network (DQN) algorithm achieves approximately 49% of human-level performance after 10 million training steps, demonstrating the feasibility of RL under real-world conditions. These results suggest that the proposed Sim-to-Real benchmark platform provides a substantial foundation for qualitative and quantitative evaluations of RL in real-world AIoT systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习 (RL) 在 Autonomous Internet of Things (AIoT) 系统中缺乏通用 Sim-to-Real 基准平台的问题，构建了一套低成本真实世界平台：智能体部署在边缘设备上，通过硬件模拟键盘在另一台主机上玩游戏，并以视觉输入为引导。实验显示仿真训练智能体在真实部署后相对人类水平性能下降 1160%，而直接使用 deep Q-network (DQN) 在真实环境训练 1000 万步后达到约 49% 的人类水平，表明该平台可用于定性定量评估 RL 的 Sim-to-Real 差距。
Motivation: 大多数 RL 研究在仿真中进行，但真实环境中的试错代价高昂且存在安全风险，因此评估 Sim-to-Real 算法鲁棒性和差距是提升真实世界 RL 性能的关键前提。机器人等领域已有平行仿真与物理平台，但 AIoT 领域尚不存在通用的 Sim-to-Real 基准平台。
Method: 作者开发了一个真实世界 AIoT 平台：边缘设备上的智能体通过硬件模拟键盘操作独立主机上的视频游戏，并依赖视觉输入完成决策；系统目标为最大化游戏分数，从而规避真实世界 RL 部署中的安全风险。平台使用商用组件，总成本低于 400 美元（另需两台计算机）。
Result: 实验表明，仿真训练智能体在真实部署后相对人类水平出现 1160% 的性能下降，说明存在显著的 Sim-to-Real 差距；而使用 DQN 在真实环境直接训练 1000 万步后能达到约 49% 的人类水平，验证了真实条件下 RL 的可行性。
Conclusion: 作者认为该平台为真实世界 AIoT 系统中 RL 的定性与定量评估提供了实质性基础，可支持 Sim-to-Real 差距相关研究。
