papers.title: MultiView-Bench: A Diagnostic Benchmark for World-Centric Multi-View Integration in VLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent benchmarks for VLMs largely assess single- or limited-view perception, leaving untested the core cognitive ability to integrate observations across viewpoints into a coherent, world-centric (allocentric) 3D mental model. We introduce MultiView-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark expressly designed to evaluate multi-view integration for holistic 3D scene comprehension. Unlike existing datasets that focus on pixel-level mapping or camera-relative navigation, MultiView-Bench requires models to decouple object positioning from transient perspectives and ground them in a fixed global coordinate system. This capability serves as a prerequisite for VLMs before being deployed for downstream tasks such as mechanical part assembly. Our systematic evaluation of frontier VLMs reveals consistent failure modes: strong performance on 2D planar relations from a single image, but marked difficulty with 3D spatial relations and with aggregating information across views. We further identify biases in VLMs, such as struggles with unconventional axis directions and sensitivity to object colorways and texture variations. Acknowledging these limitations, we propose ViewNavigator, which uses active viewpoint selection and evidence fusion to improve four base models by 12.3--20.0 percentage points under a six-image cap matching the fixed-view baseline; budget-extended gains are model-dependent and reach 27 percentage points for GPT-5.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MultiView-Bench，一个专门用于诊断视觉大模型 (VLM) 多视角整合能力的基准，要求模型将来自不同视角的观测整合为固定全局坐标系下的世界中心 (allocentric) 3D 心智模型。系统评测前沿 VLM 后发现一致的失败模式：单图 2D 平面关系表现强，但 3D 空间关系与跨视角信息聚合明显困难，且存在对非常规轴方向和物体颜色/纹理变化的偏见。作者进一步提出 ViewNavigator，通过主动视角选择与证据融合，在六图上限下将四个基础模型提升 12.3–20.0 个百分点，预算扩展后对 GPT-5 最高提升 27 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 基准大多只评测单视角或有限视角感知，未检验跨视角整合成连贯世界中心 3D 心智模型这一核心认知能力，而该能力是 VLM 部署到机械零件装配等下流任务的前提条件。
Method: 构建诊断基准 MultiView-Bench，使模型必须将物体定位与瞬态视角解耦并锚定到固定全局坐标系；同时提出 ViewNavigator，利用主动视角选择 (active viewpoint selection) 与证据融合来改进模型的多视角整合。
Result: 系统评测显示前沿 VLM 在单图 2D 平面关系上表现强，但在 3D 空间关系和跨视角聚合上困难明显，并暴露对非常规轴方向及物体色系/纹理变化的偏见；ViewNavigator 在六图上限下使四个基础模型提升 12.3–20.0 个百分点，预算扩展收益依赖模型，对 GPT-5 达 27 个百分点。
Conclusion: 论文承认当前前沿 VLM 缺乏稳健的多视角 3D 整合能力，并表明主动视角选择与证据融合可显著缓解这一缺陷。

papers.title: Cardiac MRI Through-Plane Super-Resolution Guided by Reference and Memory
authors: Meng Ye (1) ((1) University of Texas at Arlington
(2) New York University Grossman School of Medicine)
papers.abstract_en: Clinical cardiac MRI is commonly acquired with high in-plane resolution but coarse through-plane resolution to reduce scan time and accommodate breath-hold and cardiac-motion constraints, which limits 3D analysis and diagnostic accuracy. We propose STRMSR, a reference- and memory-guided through-plane super-resolution (SR) framework that reconstructs high-resolution (HR) cardiac volumes by leveraging HR reference views acquired from the same subject and intermediate SR results as the memory. Our method uses coarse-to-fine contextual matching to establish robust correspondence between low-resolution target and reference/memory images under spatial misalignment. A learnable patch-wise dynamic feature aggregation module predicts content-adaptive mixture weights for each local patch, effectively fusing dynamic information while suppressing unreliable feature transfers. The intermediate SR results stored in the memory bank ensure slice-to-slice consistency for the super-resolved 3D volume. Experiments on the WHS cardiac MRI dataset under two reference protocols, orthogonal-plane views and long-axis chamber views, demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines at 4x and 8x upsampling factors.Code is available at https://github.com/030108ming/STRMSR
papers.comment: 8 pages, 3 figures 2 tables (accepted In International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI) Workshop STACOM, 2026 (oral))
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STRMSR，一个参考与记忆引导的穿平面超分辨率框架，用于重建高分辨率心脏 MRI 体积。它利用同一受试者的高分辨率参考视图以及中间 SR 结果作为记忆，通过粗到细的上下文匹配应对空间错位，并用可学习的逐补丁动态特征聚合模块融合信息。在 WHS 心脏 MRI 数据集上的两种参考协议下，4x 和 8x 上采样均一致优于基线。
Motivation: 临床心脏 MRI 通常平面内分辨率高但穿平面分辨率粗，以缩短扫描时间并适应呼吸和心脏运动限制，这限制了 3D 分析和诊断准确性。
Method: 提出参考和记忆引导的穿平面超分辨率框架：使用同一受试者的高分辨率参考视图和中间 SR 结果作为记忆；采用粗到细上下文匹配建立低分辨率目标与参考/记忆图像之间的鲁棒对应；可学习的逐补丁动态特征聚合模块为每个局部补丁预测内容自适应的混合权重，抑制不可靠特征传递；记忆库中的中间 SR 结果保证超分辨 3D 体积的切片间一致性。
Result: 在 WHS 心脏 MRI 数据集上，分别使用正交平面视图和长轴腔室视图两种参考协议，在 4x 和 8x 上采样因子下均一致优于基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架能有效重建高分辨率心脏体积，并公开了代码；未提及明显局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EventCoT: Event-centric Video Chain-of-thought for Reasoning Temporal Localization
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning temporal localization (RTL) requires a model to generate an answer that itself contains the time interval supporting it, coupling high-level reasoning with temporal grounding in a single response. To tackle this challenge, we propose the first event-centric video chain-of-thought framework, dubbed EventCoT. EventCoT first performs event-centric tokenization, converting the video into compact event tokens that enable efficient identification of question-relevant events. It then reasons within these events to generate the answer, grounding the time interval via embedding matching that aligns placeholder tokens with visual embeddings. EventCoT achieves state-of-the-art results on ActivityNet-RTL while using substantially fewer visual tokens than previous work, and attains strong zero-shot results on the grounded video question answering benchmark ReXTime. Our code will be released for research purposes.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 11 figures, 19 tables. Co-corresponding authors: Dongkeun Kim and Suha Kwak
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出事件中心化的视频思维链框架 EventCoT，用于推理式时间定位 (reasoning temporal localization, RTL) 任务。EventCoT 先将视频转换为紧凑的事件令牌，再在事件层面推理答案，并通过嵌入匹配将占位令牌与视觉嵌入对齐来给出时间区间。方法在 ActivityNet-RTL 上达到最先进结果，同时使用的视觉令牌显著减少，并在视频问答基准 ReXTime 上取得强零样本结果。
Motivation: 推理式时间定位要求模型在生成答案的同时给出支撑答案的时间区间，这需要将高层推理与时间定位耦合在同一响应中，现有方法难以高效兼顾两者。
Method: EventCoT 包含两个阶段：事件中心化令牌化 (event-centric tokenization)，将视频转为紧凑的事件令牌以高效识别与问题相关的事件；随后在这些事件内进行推理生成答案，并通过嵌入匹配将占位令牌 (placeholder tokens) 与视觉嵌入对齐来定位时间区间。
Result: 摘要报告 EventCoT 在 ActivityNet-RTL 上取得最先进结果，且相比先前工作使用显著更少的视觉令牌；在接地视频问答基准 ReXTime 上获得强零样本结果。
Conclusion: 摘要强调事件中心化的视频链式推理能同时提升推理时间定位的效果与视觉令牌效率，代码将面向研究用途发布。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Foundations of Equivariant Deep Learning: Unifying Graph and Sheaf Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry is everywhere in nature and society. Geometric deep learning builds architectures respecting group symmetries, whereas topological deep learning organizes computation through cells, incidence relations, and local-to-global structure. In this paper, we extend geometric deep learning beyond simple group actions and unify it with topological deep learning. Specifically, we develop order-equivariant neural networks (OENN), which generalize standard graph message passing and sheaf neural networks via the theory of equivariant vector bundles over face posets (or face categories). We (i) characterize all linear order-equivariant maps, (ii) build OENN layers, and (iii) prove universal approximation theorems (UATs) for continuous order-equivariant maps, which are new results even when restricted to sheaf neural networks. We illustrate the framework on graph and sheaf models. Our results can also be seen as extending the known UAT for graph neural networks to a more general setting that subsumes sheaf neural networks as well. In the appendix, we show that OENN can be connected, via the action groupoid Grothendieck construction, to CENN (category-equivariant neural network), which gives the categorical general form of equivariant neural networks, allowing us to leverage categorical symmetry in data and extending geometric deep learning from groups of symmetries to categories of transformations.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 as a spotlight paper with oral presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出阶等变神经网络（order-equivariant neural networks, OENN），通过面偏序集（face posets）上的等变向量丛理论，将几何深度学习与拓扑深度学习统一起来，并推广标准图消息传递与 sheaf 神经网络。作者刻画了所有线性阶等变映射，构造了 OENN 层，并证明了连续阶等变映射的通用逼近定理（UAT），该结果即使限定在 sheaf 神经网络上也是新的。附录进一步通过 action groupoid Grothendieck 构造将 OENN 与 CENN（category-equivariant neural network）联系起来。
Motivation: 几何深度学习局限于群对称作用的架构，而拓扑深度学习通过胞腔、关联关系和局部到整体结构组织计算，两者缺乏统一的理论框架；已有的图神经网络 UAT 并不能覆盖 sheaf 神经网络等更一般的模型。
Method: 利用等变向量丛理论在面偏序集（或面范畴）上建立框架，定义阶等变神经网络层，完整表征线性阶等变映射，并证明连续阶等变映射的通用逼近定理；在附录中通过 action groupoid Grothendieck 构造将 OENN 连接到 CENN。
Result: 摘要报告了三个理论结果：所有线性阶等变映射的完整刻画、OENN 层的构造、以及连续阶等变映射的通用逼近定理；其中 UAT 对 sheaf 神经网络而言也是新结果，并将已知的 GNN UAT 推广到包含 sheaf 神经网络的更一般设定。
Conclusion: OENN 将几何深度学习从对称群推广到变换范畴，从而能够利用数据中的范畴对称性，并统一了图神经网络与 sheaf 神经网络这两类模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Native Multi-Dimensional Subquadratic Operators via Input Dependent Long Convolutions
papers.abstract_en: Subquadratic alternatives to attention require compromises when applied to multi-dimensional data: standard convolutions lack global receptive fields and input dependency, while recurrent models require rasterizing data such as images, volumes, and partial differential equation (PDE) into an ad-hoc $1\rm D$ scan order that violates their spatial structure. We introduce \textit{HyenaND}, a subquadratic, global, input-dependent operator that acts directly on the native geometry of multidimensional data through convolutions with implicitly parametrized global, input-dependent multi-dimensional convolutional kernels. Our CUDA implementation, \texttt{nSubQ}, fuses the FFT-convolution path to turn HyenaND's $\mathcal{O}(L \log L)$ scaling into wall-clock speedups. Across long-context genomics, computer vision, medical imaging, and PDE modeling, pure HyenaND stacks match the accuracy of strong attention baselines, while hybrid configurations that interleave HyenaND and attention layers outperform both pure attention and strong recurrence-based hybrids.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyenaND，一种直接作用于多维数据原生几何结构的次二次、全局且输入依赖的算子，通过隐式参数化的全局多维卷积核实现卷积；其 CUDA 实现 nSubQ 融合 FFT 卷积路径，将 O(L log L) 复杂度转化为实际墙钟加速。在长上下文基因组学、计算机视觉、医学影像和 PDE 建模等任务上，纯 HyenaND 堆叠的精度匹配强 attention 基线，而 HyenaND 与 attention 交错的混合结构优于纯 attention 和基于循环的强混合基线。
Motivation: 次二次的 attention 替代方案在应用到多维数据时存在妥协：标准卷积缺少全局感受野和输入依赖，而循环模型需要把图像、体数据和偏微分方程 (PDE) 等数据栅格化成临时的一维扫描顺序，破坏其空间结构。本文针对这一多维数据处理中的结构缺失问题。
Method: 引入 HyenaND，通过对隐式参数化的全局、输入依赖的多维卷积核做卷积，直接作用于数据的原生几何维度；并实现 CUDA 库 nSubQ，融合 FFT 卷积路径以将 O(L log L) 缩放转化为墙钟时间加速。
Result: 在长上下文基因组学、计算机视觉、医学影像和 PDE 建模任务上，纯 HyenaND 堆叠匹配了强 attention 基线的精度；交错排列 HyenaND 与 attention 层的混合配置同时优于纯 attention 和基于循环的强混合基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，以原生多维几何实现全局且输入依赖的次二次算子可以替代 attention，并在多个长上下文应用领域中达到相当或更优的精度表现。

papers.title: Position: The Inevitable Transition to Machine Learning in Quantum Chemistry
papers.abstract_en: Finding exact solutions to the quantum many-body problem is computationally intractable (QMA-hard). Traditional approximations for electrons in an atom or molecule -- density functional theory and wavefunction methods -- have been indispensable, but their development shows signs of saturation: DFT functionals have proliferated without converging toward the exact functional, and strong correlation remains largely unsolved after decades of effort. This position paper argues that machine learning represents the most promising path forward -- not as a proof of logical necessity, but as a decision-theoretic argument: ML succeeds whether the underlying problems are truly hard or merely lack simple analytical solutions. We reframe recent traditional method development as ``hand-crafted machine learning'' that has exhausted the hypothesis space accessible to human intuition. Significant challenges remain, but these have clear research paths forward, unlike the fundamental barriers facing traditional approaches. ML-based approaches merit strategic priority in quantum chemistry's next phase.
papers.comment: Accepted as a position paper at ICML 2026. OpenReview forum: https://openreview.net/forum?id=Mq1oTEIwp4
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是 ICML 2026 立场论文，主张机器学习在量子化学中具有战略优先地位。作者从决策论而非逻辑必然性的角度论证：量子多体问题计算上不可解（QMA-hard），而 DFT 泛函与波函数方法的传统发展已呈现饱和迹象。文章将近年传统方法的发展重新诠释为“手工制作的机器学习”，认为其已耗尽人类直觉可达的假设空间。
Motivation: 量子化学中精确求解多体问题在计算上不可解，传统近似方法（DFT 和波函数方法）虽不可或缺但发展趋于饱和，强关联问题数十年未获解决。作者希望为量子化学下一阶段的研究方向提供一个决策层面的论证，而非逻辑上严格的证明。
Method: 作为立场论文，方法上采取论证与重新诠释：将传统方法发展视为“手工制作的机器学习”，指出其已穷尽人类直觉可及的假设空间，并认为无论底层问题真正困难还是仅缺乏简单解析解，机器学习都能成功。文章还列出机器学习面临的显著挑战，并指出其具备清晰的研究路径。
Result: 摘要未报告实验或数值结果；核心论断是传统方法面临根本性障碍，而机器学习方法所面临的挑战有清晰的解决路径，因此值得在量子化学中优先投入。
Conclusion: 作者强调机器学习是实现量子化学下一阶段突破的最有希望路径，应给予战略优先级；该主张基于决策论而非逻辑必要性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score (CDTS): Competence-Coupled Trust Degradation Across Deepfake Detectors
papers.abstract_en: In moderation, provenance, and verification pipelines a deepfake detector's output probability is read as a degree of trust, so its calibration matters as much as raw accuracy. We reframe deepfake detection as a calibrated, self-auditing trust instrument, the Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score (CDTS), and identify what governs its trustworthiness. Our central finding is a competence-trust coupling with a sharp division: the raw score's miscalibration tracks discriminative competence almost perfectly (r = -0.98, -0.98, -0.95 across two convolutional networks and a CLIP vision transformer), and a calibrator deployed without target labels fails with competence just as tightly (r = -0.98 on the primary detector, for isotonic, Platt, and beta calibrators alike). Given target labels, by contrast, any well-specified calibrator repairs any detector, including inverted ones: in-domain calibratability is not competence-limited, and the trust failure is a distribution-shift phenomenon concentrated exactly on the low-competence generators that motivate deployment. Explanation faithfulness rises and falls on the same competence axis. We reach this conclusion after uncovering, and correcting, a tie-handling degeneracy in the standard equal-mass expected-calibration-error (ECE) estimator that fabricates strong spurious competence-calibration coupling on tie-heavy calibrated scores; the same degeneracy invalidates calibration-equity gaps we previously reported, a caution for fairness auditing. Competence is trackable without labels: batch predictive entropy flags generators with high deployed calibration error at ROC-AUC 0.99, and routing source-batches on label-free competence beats confidence-based routing precisely in the low-competence regimes the coupling identifies, while confidence regains the advantage where competence is high. Trust scoring must be competence-aware; CDTS is the mechanism.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 13 figures, 12 tables. v2: substantial correction. v1's central negative claim was an artifact of a tie-handling degeneracy in stable-sort equal-mass ECE (cf. Pernot, arXiv:2306.05180). Corrected: raw and transferred competence-trust coupling r ~ -0.98; in-domain calibratability is not competence-limited; equity gaps do not survive
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将深度伪造检测重新表述为可校准、可自审计的信任仪器（Calibrated Deepfake Trust Score, CDTS），核心发现是校准与判别能力之间存在强耦合：原始分数误校准随判别能力几乎完全变化（两个卷积网络与一个 CLIP ViT 上 r 分别为 -0.98、-0.98、-0.95），无标签部署的校准器同样受能力限制；给定目标标签后，任何良设定校准器都能修复检测器，故域内可校准性不受能力限制，信任失败本质上是集中在低能力生成器上的分布漂移。作者还修正了等质量 ECE 估计器中由 tie 处理退化引起的虚假耦合，并提出基于批预测熵的无标签能力追踪。
Motivation: 在审核、溯源与验证流水线中，检测器输出概率被当作信任程度，校准与原始精度同等重要；现有检测器在低判别能力生成器上的信任失效机理尚不清晰，且标准 ECE 估计存在 tie-handling 退化问题，可能被误读为能力-校准耦合。
Method: 提出 CDTS 框架，把检测器输出重构为校准化的信任评分；通过跨网络与多种校准器分析能力-信任耦合，修正等质量 ECE 在 tie-heavy 校准分数上的 tie 处理退化，并用批预测熵在无标签条件下估计生成器的部署校准误差，据此做数据批路由。
Result: 原始分数误校准与判别能力的相关系数在多个检测器上约达 -0.98，isotonic、Platt 和 beta 校准器无标签部署时同样受能力限制；给定目标标签后任意良设定校准器可修复包括倒置检测器在内的任意检测器；无标签批预测熵识别高部署校准误差生成器的 ROC-AUC 为 0.99，且标签无关能力路由在低能力区间优于置信度路由。
Conclusion: 信任评分必须能力感知，CDTS 是具体机制；作者同时提醒 tie 处理退化会制造虚假的能力-校准耦合并使校准公平性差距失效，对公平性审计是一则警示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Forecasting With LLMs: Improved Generalization Through Feature Steering
papers.abstract_en: Successful forecasting involves identifying patterns between historical and future states of the world which generalize to future observations. We apply LLMs to a variety of forecasting tasks and inspect their internal states using sparse autoencoders to understand whether they appear to rely on time-specific pieces of knowledge versus generalizable patterns. Our analyses identify features associated with both time-aware reasoning and look-ahead-biased reasoning. We then apply the LLMs to an entirely different domain and intervene on these features. We find that amplifying time-awareness features substantially reduces look-ahead bias on forecasting prompts while preserving general reasoning performance. In contrast, steering the candidate look-ahead-bias features does not produce an effect. These results suggest that interpretable temporal features can be used to causally shift LLMs toward more historically grounded reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM 在预测任务中是否依赖时间特定知识还是可泛化模式，使用稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoders）检查内部状态，识别出与时间感知推理和前瞻偏差推理相关的特征。通过特征干预，放大时间感知特征能显著降低预测提示上的前视偏差（look-ahead bias），同时保持通用推理性能；而干预候选的前瞻偏差特征则无效。结果表明可解释的时间特征可用于因果性地推动 LLM 更依赖历史依据进行推理。
Motivation: 成功的预测需要识别历史与未来状态之间能泛化到未来观测的模式，但 LLM 可能依赖时间特定的知识或产生前视偏差。作者希望理解这些内部机制，并检验能否通过干预特征来改善预测的泛化性。
Method: 将 LLM 应用于多种预测任务，用稀疏自编码器分析内部状态以定位时间感知与前瞻偏差相关的特征；随后在完全不同的领域应用 LLM，并对这些特征进行干预（放大或引导）。
Result: 放大时间感知特征显著减少了预测提示上的前视偏差，同时保持通用推理性能；而引导候选的前瞻偏差特征没有产生效果。
Conclusion: 结果提示可解释的时间特征可以被用来因果性地使 LLM 更偏向基于历史的推理，但作者并未声称干预前瞻偏差特征有效。

papers.title: ReMMD: Realistic Multilingual Multi-Image Agentic Verification for Multimodal Misinformation Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal misinformation detection is increasingly important because viral posts now combine long multilingual narratives, several images, mixed provenance, and subtle cross-modal framing errors. Existing benchmarks and methods remain poorly matched to this setting: they usually isolate short captions, single images, binary labels, or one manipulation source, while agentic verification remains costly under realistic evidence search. We present ReMMD, a realistic multilingual multi-image agentic verification framework for multimodal misinformation detection. ReMMD includes ReMMDBench, a real-world multimodal misinformation detection benchmark with 500 samples, 2,756 images, five monolingual evaluations, two cross-lingual settings, three text-length tiers, multi-image posts, five-way veracity labels, eight distortion labels, evidence provenance, and rationales. It also includes ReMMD-Agent, a persistent-memory verifier that decomposes posts into atomic points, builds a reusable evidence set, and predicts structured veracity verdicts, fine-grained distortion diagnoses, and explanatory rationales. Across proprietary systems, open LVLMs, MMD-Agent, and T$^2$-Agent, ReMMD-Agent obtains the best five-way veracity performance, with 41.80% accuracy and 39.12% macro-F1 using GPT-5.2, while reducing cost by 17.5% relative to MMD-Agent and 79.9% relative to T$^2$-Agent. The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD.
papers.comment: The project is available at https://dang-ai.github.io/ReMMD
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReMMD，一个面向现实多语言、多图像场景的多模态错误信息检测智能体验证框架，包含基准 ReMMDBench 和验证器 ReMMD-Agent。基准包含 500 个样本、2,756 张图像、五种单语评测、两种跨语言设置、三档文本长度、多图像帖子、五类真实性标签、八类扭曲标签、证据来源与理由；验证器将帖子分解为原子要点，构建可复用证据集，并输出结构化的真实性判决、细粒度扭曲诊断和解释性理由。实验显示 ReMMD-Agent 在多个对照系统上取得最佳五类真实性性能，并显著降低成本。
Motivation: 现有多模态错误信息检测基准与方法通常只处理短标题、单张图像、二元标签或单一操纵来源，难以覆盖现实中对长多语言叙事、多图像、混合来源和跨模态框架错误的验证需求，且智能体验证在真实证据搜索下成本高昂。
Method: 提出 ReMMD 框架，包含 ReMMDBench 基准和 ReMMD-Agent 验证器。ReMMD-Agent 采用持久记忆机制，将帖子分解为原子要点，建立可复用的证据集，并生成五类真实性判决、细粒度扭曲诊断和解释性理由。
Result: 在专有系统、开放 LVLM、MMD-Agent 和 T^2-Agent 的对比中，ReMMD-Agent 取得最佳五类真实性性能，使用 GPT-5.2 时准确率为 41.80%、宏 F1 为 39.12%，并相对 MMD-Agent 降低 17.5% 成本、相对 T^2-Agent 降低 79.9% 成本。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ReMMD 通过更现实的基准与持久记忆的智能体验证，在多语言多图像错误信息检测上同时改善性能与成本效率。

papers.title: When Agent Automation Becomes Profitable: Quantifying and Insuring Autonomous AI Risk through Trace-Economic Underwriting
papers.abstract_en: AI agents can now take irreversible actions in operational systems, but agent-caused losses are still not clearly assigned, priced, or transferred. Providers often disclaim consequential damages, users are left with uncompensated losses, and default human review limits the efficiency gains of automation. We ask when autonomous AI deployment can become economically acceptable despite failure risk. Our answer is to quantify risk at the customer-task-trace episode level and transfer it through insurance. Automation is acceptable when its expected benefit exceeds the premium, control cost, and remaining risk. This requires a defined role with bounded permissions and comparable traces. We introduce trace-economic underwriting, which maps tool-use traces to customer exposure and claimable loss, then uses this representation for pricing, control, and risk transfer. It uses deterministic economic labels rather than an LLM judge. In our trace-to-loss testbed, trace-economic pricing reduces pricing MAE from $17.7K to $569 and removes regressive cross-subsidy. A 300-trace expert audit accepts 295 labels unchanged. On 1,000 real SWE-smith traces, trace-conditioned controls reduce CVaR95 by 72%. Theorem~1 gives a finite-sample scope condition. We release code, labels, and audit sheets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自主AI智能体在运营系统中采取不可逆行动时的风险量化与转移问题。作者提出痕迹经济核保 (trace-economic underwriting) 方法，在客户-任务-痕迹 (customer-task-trace) 片段层面度量风险，并用确定性经济标签而非LLM评判进行定价、控制和保险转移。摘要报告该方法在痕迹到损失测试平台上将定价MAE从17.7K美元降至569美元，并在1000条真实SWE-smith痕迹上将CVaR95降低72%。
Motivation: AI智能体可能造成不可逆损失，但智能体引发的损失目前未被清晰分配、定价或转移：提供商通常免责、用户承担未获补偿的损失，而默认人工审核限制了自动化的效率收益。需要回答自主AI部署在何种条件下即使存在失败风险也能在经济上被接受。
Method: 提出痕迹经济核保：将工具使用痕迹 (tool-use traces) 映射为客户风险暴露和可索赔损失，再基于该表示进行定价、控制和风险转移。自动化可接受的条件是期望收益超过保费、控制成本和剩余风险，并需要明确角色、有界权限和可比痕迹；使用确定性经济标签而非LLM评判。
Result: 痕迹经济定价将定价MAE从17.7K美元降至569美元，并消除回归性交叉补贴；300条痕迹的专家审计接受295条标签不变；在1000条真实SWE-smith痕迹上，痕迹条件控制使CVaR95降低72%；定理1给出有限样本范围条件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法将风险转移到保险层面，使自主AI部署在经济上可接受，并发布了代码、标签和审计表。

papers.title: TEASR: Training-Efficient Any-Step Diffusion Transformer for Real-World Image Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models excel in Real-World Image Super-Resolution (Real-ISR) due to their powerful generative priors but suffer from slow iterative sampling. Although existing one-step distillation methods accelerate inference, they typically require auxiliary teacher models that inflate training memory and restrict scalability to large-scale architectures. Furthermore, these fixed-step models lack the flexibility to trade off speed for quality. In this paper, we propose TEASR, a training-efficient any-step diffusion framework for Real-ISR that enables both one-step and multi-step restoration within a unified model. Our key idea is to perform self-adversarial distillation within a single diffusion model, eliminating the need for auxiliary teachers or discriminators. Specifically, we propose a timestep-aware rectification strategy that stabilizes one-step generation across noise levels. These two designs further enables the distillation of 20B-parameter diffusion models on a single GPU, significantly improving training efficiency. Moreover, we introduce a dual-branch diffusion transformer with decoupled timestep condition to separate the current noise state and the denoising target to enhance sampling quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TEASR supports seamless any-step sampling and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TEASR，一个面向真实图像超分辨率 (Real-ISR) 的训练高效任意步扩散框架，在同一个模型中同时支持一步和多步复原。核心是利用单个扩散模型内的自对抗蒸馏 (self-adversarial distillation)，不再需要辅助教师模型或判别器，并引入时间步感知修正策略 (timestep-aware rectification) 与解耦时间步条件的双分支扩散 Transformer。摘要报告该方法支持无缝任意步采样，并在多个数据集上持续优于现有方法。
Motivation: 扩散模型在 Real-ISR 中生成质量高但迭代采样慢；现有一步蒸馏方法通常需要辅助教师模型，增大了训练内存并限制了向大规模架构扩展，而且固定步数模型无法在速度与质量之间灵活权衡。
Method: 提出在单个扩散模型内进行自对抗蒸馏以消除辅助教师或判别器；设计时间步感知修正策略来稳定不同噪声水平下的一步生成，并引入具有解耦时间步条件的双分支扩散 Transformer，将当前噪声状态与去噪目标分离以提升采样质量。
Result: 摘要报告 TEASR 支持任意步采样，在多个数据集上持续优于现有最先进方法，并且能够在单张 GPU 上蒸馏 200 亿 (20B) 参数的扩散模型，显著提升训练效率。
Conclusion: 作者认为统一模型内的自对抗蒸馏与时间步感知设计能够以高训练效率实现灵活的一步/多步真实图像超分修复。

papers.title: The Truth Stays in the Family: Enhancing Contextual Grounding via Inherited Truthful Heads in Model Lineages
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have produced many specialized multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) that share common foundational LLMs, forming distinct model lineages. It remains unclear whether a fundamental behavioral link exists between the foundational LLMs and downstream variants. We investigate this question by quantifying head-level context-truthfulness scores. Across diverse LLM and MLLM lineages, including Vicuna-, Qwen2.5-, LLaMA2-, and Mistral-based models, we find that Truth Scores are strongly preserved within model families, even after instruction tuning or multimodal adaptation. We further show that this inheritance is consistent with attention-head weight preservation, and that context-truthful heads attend to query-relevant evidence. Building on this finding, we propose TruthProbe, a soft-gating strategy that amplifies context-truthful heads while preserving other head contributions. TruthProbe improves contextual truthfulness on HaluEval and reduces multimodal hallucination on POPE and CHAIR, with base-LLM Truth Scores transferring effectively to their fine-tuned LLM and MLLM descendants. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/TruthProbe.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基础大语言模型（LLM）与其微调/多模态变体（MLLM）之间在注意力头层面的真实性行为是否延续。作者在 Vicuna、Qwen2.5、LLaMA2、Mistral 等模型谱系中量化头级上下文真实性得分，发现 Truth Score 在模型家族内高度保留，即使在指令微调或多模态适配后依然如此。基于该发现，作者提出 TruthProbe，一种软门控（soft-gating）策略，放大上下文真实头（context-truthful heads）的贡献，同时保留其他头的输出，从而提升真实性与减少幻觉。摘要报告 TruthProbe 在 HaluEval、POPE 和 CHAIR 基准上改善上下文真实性与多模态幻觉。
Motivation: 当前大量专用多模态 LLM 共享相同的基础 LLM，形成不同的模型谱系（model lineages），但基础模型与下游变体之间是否存在根本性的行为联系尚不清楚。这种不确定性使人们难以判断真实性问题在模型衍生过程中如何传播或缓解，因此需要通过头级分析来刻画这一继承关系。
Method: 作者首先提出头级上下文真实性评分（head-level context-truthfulness scores），在多个 LLM/MLLM 谱系中衡量 Truth Score 的保留情况，并验证这种继承与注意力头权重保留（attention-head weight preservation）一致，且真实头会关注查询相关证据。随后提出 TruthProbe，一种软门控策略，通过放大上下文真实头的贡献并保持其余头的贡献来增强输出真实性。
Result: 实验表明 Truth Score 在模型家族内部被强保留，即使经过指令调优或多模态适配也不受影响；TruthProbe 在 HaluEval 上提升了上下文真实性（contextual truthfulness），并在 POPE 和 CHAIR 上减少了多模态幻觉（multimodal hallucination）。基础 LLM 的 Truth Score 可有效迁移到其微调的 LLM 与 MLLM 后代上。
Conclusion: 作者认为基础 LLM 的真实性头会通过权重保留传递给下游变体，这一继承现象可用于设计轻量干预（TruthProbe）来提升真实性和抑制幻觉。摘要未明确讨论该方法在多语言、不同训练范式或更大规模模型上的局限。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: A Fixed-Point Neural Operator for Size- and Functional-Transferable Hamiltonian Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting the Kohn-Sham Hamiltonian with machine learning can accelerate density functional theory while retaining access to molecular orbitals, energy levels, and electronic-structure observables that energy-only surrogates cannot resolve. Yet element-wise agreement with the converged Hamiltonian, an implicit fixed point of the self-consistent field iteration, does not determine the occupied subspace that governs orbital energies and densities. Here we present HamEvo, a neural operator that learns the single-step self-consistent update and returns the converged Hamiltonian as its fixed point. HamEvo is pre-trained on intermediate self-consistent trajectories and calibrated at equilibrium with density-matrix supervision. Across benchmarks from MD17 to drug-like QMugs, HamEvo lowers Hamiltonian errors by 35-49% over direct-regression and deep-equilibrium baselines, and predicts QMugs HOMO and LUMO energies with mean absolute errors of 0.036 and 0.053 eV, near the 1 kcal/mol chemical-accuracy scale. Few-shot fine-tuning with only 20 reference conformations extends HamEvo to molecules of up to 122 atoms, well beyond the size range covered by pre-training. With thermal molecular-dynamics sampling, HamEvo captures temperature-dependent HOMO-LUMO gap renormalization beyond the harmonic approximation. Inference is up to 242 times faster than conventional DFT.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HamEvo 是一种用于预测 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量的神经算子，将自洽场迭代的单步更新学习为算子的不动点，从而直接得到收敛哈密顿量。模型在中间自洽轨迹上预训练，并用平衡态密度矩阵监督校准。在 MD17 到 QMugs 基准上，哈密顿量误差相对直接回归和 deep-equilibrium 基线降低 35-49%，QMugs HOMO/LUMO 能量 MAE 分别为 0.036 和 0.053 eV；仅用 20 个参考构象微调即可外推到最多 122 个原子的分子，推理速度比常规 DFT 快最多 242 倍。
Motivation: 机器学习预测 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量可加速密度泛函理论并保留分子轨道、能级等能量-only 代理无法给出的电子结构信息，但逐元素匹配收敛哈密顿量（自洽场迭代的隐式不动点）并不能唯一确定决定轨道能量和密度的占据子空间，这是该工作要解决的核心问题。
Method: 提出 HamEvo 神经算子，学习单步自洽更新并以其不动点作为收敛哈密顿量；在中间自洽轨迹上预训练，并在平衡态用密度矩阵监督进行校准。
Result: 在 MD17 至 QMugs 基准上，HamEvo 将哈密顿量误差较直接回归和 deep-equilibrium 基线降低 35-49%；QMugs 的 HOMO/LUMO 能量 MAE 为 0.036/0.053 eV，接近 1 kcal/mol 化学精度；20 个构象的少样本微调即可扩展到 122 个原子的分子；热分子动力学采样下能捕获谐波近似之外随温度变化的 HOMO-LUMO 间隙重正化，推理速度比常规 DFT 快最高 242 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将神经算子构造为自洽场迭代不动点、并用密度矩阵监督校准，能够提升哈密顿量预测的占据子空间准确性；题目所称的 size- 与 functional-transferable 能力源于少样本微调与热采样扩展，但摘要未讨论对更广泛泛化边界的限制。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DIMOS: Disentangling Instance-level Moving Object Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Moving instance segmentation (MIS) attracts increasing attention due to its broad applications in traffic surveillance, autonomous driving, and animal tracking. Event cameras record asynchronous brightness changes, providing high temporal resolution and dynamic range, which makes them highly sensitive to motion information. By fusing event and image features, motion cues from events can complement spatial details from images, enhancing the performance of MIS. However, current multimodal MIS methods still struggle to segment small moving instances, as event cameras often yield sparse features under limited resolution. Moreover, event features entangle appearance attributes with motion cues, which further restricts effective cross-modal fusion. To address these challenges, we first propose a dual-disentangling feature extraction framework that separates and extracts appearance and motion information within both image and event modalities, thereby improving feature density. Subsequently, a multi-granularity cross-modal alignment is introduced to align distributionally and semantically consistent features across modalities, enabling more effective fusion with rich spatial and temporal details. The experiment results demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in multimodal MIS, especially for small instances under challenging conditions such as fast motion and low-light settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DIMOS，一种面向事件相机与普通图像融合的移动实例分割 (moving instance segmentation, MIS) 方法。针对小移动实例分割难、事件特征稀疏以及外观与运动信息耦合的问题，提出双解耦特征提取框架，将图像和事件模态中的外观与运动信息分离以提升特征密度，再通过多粒度跨模态对齐实现分布与语义一致的特征融合。摘要报告该方法在多模态 MIS 上达到最优性能，尤其在快速运动和低光照条件下的小实例分割中表现突出。
Motivation: 现有多模态 MIS 方法在分割小移动实例时仍存在困难，因为事件相机在有限分辨率下常产生稀疏特征，且事件特征将外观属性与运动线索纠缠在一起，限制了跨模态融合的有效性。
Method: 提出双解耦特征提取框架，在图像和事件两种模态内分别分离并提取外观与运动信息，从而提高特征密度；随后引入多粒度跨模态对齐，对跨模态间分布和语义一致的特征进行对齐，实现包含丰富空间与时间细节的融合。
Result: 实验结果表明该方法在多模态 MIS 任务上达到当前最优性能，尤其在快速运动、低光照等挑战条件下的小实例分割上表现突出。
Conclusion: 作者认为将事件特征中的外观与运动信息解耦，并结合多粒度跨模态对齐，能够有效缓解小实例分割与跨模态融合中的问题。摘要未提供具体量化指标或消融实验细节。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Masked Neural Detection for Run-Length-Limited Channel Coding in Molecular Communication
papers.abstract_en: Molecular communication (MC) suffers from severe diffusion memory because molecules released for one symbol may arrive during later symbol intervals. Neural sequence detectors, especially sliding bidirectional recurrent neural networks (SBRNNs), substantially outperform threshold detection in such channels. This raises a central question for MC channel coding: does a code whose superiority was established under threshold detection retain it when both coded and uncoded transmission are evaluated with neural detection? This letter answers this question for run-length-limited ISI-mitigation (RLIM) codes by proposing a decoder-aware training mask that removes the positions the RLIM decoder has a high probability of deterministically overwriting, steering compact-SBRNN capacity toward the information-bearing positions. The masked RLIM$_2$-SBRNN beats the best uncoded receiver (threshold or SBRNN) at 40 of 57 operating points; gains peak at 43$\times$ under favorable channels, while losses, confined to the most adverse, never exceed 2.7$\times$. Masking improves the unmasked RLIM$_2$-SBRNN in 56 of 57 matched comparisons. Finally, with storage counted equally in SBRNN weights and MLSE table entries, the masked RLIM$_2$-SBRNN is the more accurate receiver up to a few thousand stored values despite using no channel knowledge; channel-state-aware uncoded MLSE moves ahead only beyond tens of thousands.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分子通信 (molecular communication, MC) 中游程受限 ISI 缓解 (RLIM) 码在神经检测下的表现，并针对滑动双向循环神经网络 (SBRNN) 提出解码器感知的训练掩码。掩码移除 RLIM 解码器大概率确定性覆盖的位置，使紧凑 SBRNN 的能力集中于信息承载位置。结果表明，带掩码的 RLIM2-SBRNN 在 57 个工作点中的 40 个优于最佳未编码接收机，且在不使用信道知识的情况下，其准确度在数千存储值以内优于信道状态感知的未编码 MLSE。
Motivation: 分子通信存在严重扩散记忆，神经序列检测器（尤其 SBRNN）在阈值检测之外大幅提升性能；这引发一个核心问题：在阈值检测下被证明优越的信道编码，当编码与未编码传输都用神经检测评估时，其优势是否仍然成立。本文针对 RLIM 码回答这一问题。
Method: 提出一种解码器感知的训练掩码方法：先识别 RLIM 解码器有高概率确定性覆写的位置并在训练中移除它们，从而把紧凑 SBRNN 的容量导向信息承载位置；评估采用编码 RLIM 与未编码传输在相同神经检测条件下的对比。
Result: 掩码 RLIM2-SBRNN 在 57 个工作点中的 40 个超过最佳未编码接收机（阈值或 SBRNN）；有利信道下增益峰值达 43 倍，不利信道下损失不超过 2.7 倍。掩码在 56/57 个匹配比较中优于未掩码 RLIM2-SBRNN；在将存储同等计入 SBRNN 权重和 MLSE 表项后，掩码 RLIM2-SBRNN 在数千存储值以内是更精确的接收机，而信道状态感知的未编码 MLSE 仅在数万存储值之后才领先。
Conclusion: 摘要表明编码在阈值检测下的优势在神经检测下可以保持，且解码器感知训练掩码能进一步提升 RLIM-SBRNN 的准确率；作者同时通过存储复杂度对比指出掩码 RLIM2-SBRNN 在无信道知识时的竞争力。

papers.title: Market Design for AI: Beyond the Copyright Binary
papers.abstract_en: How can we design a market of human-generated content for use in training AI models that both enables technological progress and preserves individual incentives for high-quality content creation? Existing approaches take polar positions: a "free-for-all" model based on fair use and a "strong intellectual property rights" model. We show that both fail: Free-for-all does not compensate creators, and---by modeling as a static Stackelberg game---strong intellectual property rights also underpower creative incentives. We find this especially true for more innovative creators, a phenomenon we term the "originality penalty." Extending this insight to a dynamic model, we find another market failure undermining AI model performance, even for an initially good model: Such a model induces greater reliance by humans on AI-assisted creation, resulting in homogenized content feeding back into training, which degrades the model performance---a "curse of precision." We further propose a market design with a data intermediary negotiating collectively with the AI firm and subsidizing innovative contributions, thus restoring efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从经济学与博弈论角度研究 AI 训练数据市场的设计问题，指出“自由使用”（free-for-all）与“强知识产权”（strong intellectual property rights）两种极端版权机制都会失败：前者不补偿创作者，后者在静态 Stackelberg 博弈中同样削弱创作激励，且对更具创新性的创作者伤害更大，作者称之为“originality penalty”。进一步在动态模型中，作者发现即使初始良好的模型也会因人类过度依赖 AI 辅助创作而产生同质化内容反馈，导致模型性能退化，即“curse of precision”。最后作者提出由数据中介（data intermediary）与 AI 公司集体谈判并补贴创新性贡献的市场设计，以恢复效率。
Motivation: 现有版权争论在自由使用与强知识产权之间采取二元立场，但两种机制都未能兼顾技术进步与个人高质量内容创作的激励，作者试图设计更好的数据市场机制。
Method: 通过静态 Stackelberg 博弈建模创作者激励，再将其扩展为动态模型以刻画人类创作与 AI 模型训练之间的反馈循环，并据此提出数据中介集体谈判与补贴创新性贡献的市场设计方案。
Result: 摘要报告两种极端版权模型均会失败：free-for-all 不给创作者补偿，强知识产权也削弱激励尤其损害更具创新性的创作者；动态模型中还出现模型性能因同质化内容反馈而退化的“curse of precision”。
Conclusion: 作者主张引入数据中介与 AI 公司集体谈判并补贴创新性贡献，可恢复市场效率，意味着版权讨论应超越二元选择、转向数据市场的制度设计。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Time-Series Foundation Model Embeddings for Remaining Useful Life Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction is essential for industrial predictive maintenance, yet many learning-based approaches rely on extensive feature engineering or large labeled datasets to train task-specific sequence models. In this work, we introduce a lightweight learning approach, in which we leverage a frozen pretrained time-series foundation model (TSFM) and combine it with a small regression head for RUL estimation from multivariate sensor streams. More specifically, we use Chronos-2 as a frozen backbone to extract context window features and train a lightweight regression neural network for RUL prediction. Experiments on real-world industrial sensor data from two device types show that Chronos-2 features consistently improve over recurrent, convolutional, Transformer-based, and gradient-boosting baselines under the same preprocessing and evaluation protocol. We further analyze the impact of context length and find that performance improves significantly with longer histories, indicating that TSFM representation offer a practical and data-efficient alternative for RUL estimation in industrial settings.
papers.comment: Accepted to EUSIPCO 2026, 4 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种轻量级的剩余使用寿命（RUL）预测方法，将冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型（TSFM）Chronos-2 作为骨干网络提取上下文窗口特征，并搭配一个轻量回归头进行预测。在两种设备类型的真实工业传感器数据上，Chronos-2 特征在相同预处理与评估协议下一致优于递归、卷积、Transformer 和梯度提升基线。作者还发现更长的上下文历史能显著提升性能，说明 TSFM 表征为工业 RUL 估计提供了实用且数据高效的替代方案。
Motivation: RUL 预测对工业预测性维护至关重要，但许多基于学习的方法依赖大量特征工程或大规模标注数据集来训练任务专用序列模型，限制了实际工业场景中的可用性。
Method: 利用冻结的预训练时间序列基础模型 Chronos-2 作为骨干提取多变量传感器流上下文窗口特征，再训练一个小型回归神经网络完成 RUL 预测。
Result: 在两种设备类型的真实工业传感器数据上，Chronos-2 特征始终优于递归、卷积、Transformer 和梯度提升基线；上下文长度越长，性能提升越显著。
Conclusion: 作者认为 TSFM 表征为工业环境中的 RUL 估计提供了实用且数据高效的替代方案；实验范围限于两种设备类型。

summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为 TSFM 表征为工业环境中的 RUL 估计提供了实用且数据高效的替代方案；实验范围限于两种设备类型。

papers.title: Population-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Particle Flow for Robust Spacecraft Bayesian Navigation
papers.abstract_en: Spacecraft navigation often requires Bayesian inference from sparse nonlinear measurements that produce curved, multimodal, or geometrically constrained posterior distributions. Physics-informed neural particle flow (PINPF) addresses such problems by learning a deterministic prior-to-posterior transport field from the governing probability evolution equation, but its particle-wise architecture does not explicitly account for the empirical particle population. This paper introduces population-aware PINPF (PA-PINPF), which conditions each particle velocity on a permutation-invariant Deep Sets representation of the complete particle set. PA-PINPF-State summarizes particle positions, whereas PA-PINPF-Feature summarizes the local physics-informed features, including likelihood and score information. Both retain the unsupervised PINPF residual and require neither posterior samples nor labeled transport trajectories. The methods are evaluated over 100 randomized time-difference-of-arrival tasks representative of RF cross-link and ground-station localization and 100 range-measurement tasks with an onboard sensor field-of-view constraint. Results demonstrate that population-level Bayesian features provide useful global information for learned particle transport in nonlinear spacecraft-navigation problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 population-aware PINPF (PA-PINPF)，在物理信息神经粒子流 (PINPF) 基础上，将完整粒子集的 permutation-invariant Deep Sets 表示作为粒子速度的条件输入，用于航天器导航中的贝叶斯推断。两种变体分别汇总粒子位置 (PA-PINPF-State) 和局部物理信息特征 (PA-PINPF-Feature)，均保留无监督 PINPF 残差，无需后验样本或标注传输轨迹。摘要报告在 100 个随机 TDOA 任务和 100 个带传感器视场约束的测距任务上验证，种群级贝叶斯特征为非线性问题中的学习粒子传输提供了有用的全局信息。
Motivation: 现有 PINPF 以粒子为单位学习先验到后验的确定性传输场，没有显式利用经验粒子群的整体分布信息，因而难以应对稀疏非线性测量产生的弯曲、多模态或几何约束后验。
Method: 引入 population-aware 机制，用 permutation-invariant Deep Sets 对完整粒子集构造摘要表示，并以此条件化每个粒子的速度；PA-PINPF-State 汇总粒子位置，PA-PINPF-Feature 汇总似然与 score 等局部物理信息特征，训练仍保持无监督的 PINPF 残差形式。
Result: 在 100 个随机时间差到达 (TDOA) 任务（代表 RF 交叉链路与地面站定位）和 100 个带有星载传感器视场约束的测距任务上进行评估，结果表明种群级贝叶斯特征能提供对非线性航天器导航问题中学习粒子传输有用的全局信息。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是人口层面的概率特征有助于改善非线性航天器导航中的学习式粒子传输；其验证范围限定于所报告的定位与测距任务，未给出具体数值幅度。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Dissect and Prune: Enhancing Robustness in AI-Generated Image Detection
papers.abstract_en: While existing AI-generated image detectors report high performance, we identify that this is largely driven by a critical prediction asymmetry: a bias toward the real class that severely limits sensitivity to generated content, especially under standard post-processing operations such as compression and resizing. We hypothesize that this stems from the model's reliance on spurious features, distracting signals that obscure true generative artifacts. To address this, we propose DEAR (Dissect and Prune), which leverages inpainted images to identify and prune these interfering components. Specifically, we find that features strongly aligned to either inpainted or non-inpainted regions are less robust to post-processing. By measuring the alignment between channel activations and inpaint masks, DEAR removes features at both extremes, retaining only those that capture genuine generative artifacts. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach significantly enhances robustness against unseen generators and post-processing, effectively mitigating the prediction asymmetry. Our code is available at https://github.com/dahyedahye/dear.
papers.comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. 26 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Includes appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出现有 AI 生成图像检测器的高性能主要来自预测不对称性（prediction asymmetry），即对真实类别的偏向，导致在压缩、缩放等常见后处理下对生成内容的敏感性严重下降。作者提出 DEAR（Dissect and Prune），利用修复图像（inpainted images）识别并剪除干扰特征，只保留捕获真实生成伪影的成分，从而提升对未知生成器和后处理的鲁棒性。实验表明该方法能有效缓解预测不对称性，代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成图像检测器报告的性能很大程度上源于对真实类别的偏向，这一预测不对称性严重限制了其对生成内容的敏感度，尤其是在标准后处理操作下。作者假设模型依赖虚假特征（spurious features），这些干扰信号掩盖了真正的生成伪影。
Method: DEAR 利用修复图像，通过测量通道激活与修复掩码（inpaint masks）之间的对齐程度来识别特征。与修复区域或非修复区域强对齐的特征对后处理鲁棒性较差，因此 DEAR 移除这两类极端特征，仅保留能够捕获真实生成伪影的特征。
Result: 实验结果显示，该方法显著增强了对未见生成器和后处理操作的鲁棒性，并有效缓解了预测不对称性。摘要未报告具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法通过剪除与修复掩码强对齐的干扰特征来提升鲁棒性和缓解预测偏差，并提供了开源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SAE-StatSteer: Statistical Consensus Feature Selection for Optimization-Free Activation Steering of Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Activation steering adds a residual-stream direction at inference time, providing lightweight behavioral control without fine-tuning. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) can make such interventions auditable by decomposing dense activations into an approximately monosemantic feature basis. We introduce SAE-StatSteer, a transparent, optimization-free pipeline. It first filters features through six reliability conditions, then ranks the survivors by an unweighted Borda consensus over three statistics, an $F$-test, KSG mutual information, and Cohen's $d$, and finally combines the selected SAE decoder rows using Cohen's-$d$ weights. We evaluate three Gemma-family models across four behavioral domains against seven dense or SAE-based baselines. Our quality-conditioned protocol requires attribute movement while preserving relevance, richness, and coherence. Raw success systematically overstates usable control because strong shifts often degrade generation quality, and effective steering is not governed by a universal layer or strength. SAE-StatSteer remains competitive with optimization-based methods while exposing every selection and weighting decision for audit. These results motivate reporting quality-conditioned success alongside raw behavioral shift. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/Oshayer-Siddique/LLM-Steering-Using-SAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SAE-StatSteer，一种无需优化的激活引导 (activation steering) 流水线，利用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 将稠密激活分解为近似单语义特征，并通过六项可靠性条件筛选特征，再用 Borda 共识聚合 F 检验、KSG 互信息和 Cohen's d 三种统计量排序，最后按 Cohen's d 权重组合 SAE 解码器行。在三个 Gemma 系列模型、四个行为域上与七种稠密或 SAE 基线对比，提出质量约束协议，要求同时保持相关性、丰富性与连贯性。结果显示原始成功率会高估可用控制，有效引导不受单一层或强度支配。
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法虽然无需微调即可控制模型行为，但缺乏透明性，且原始行为偏移的成功率常伴随生成质量下降；需要一种可审计、无需优化的特征选择方案，并重新审视评价协议。
Method: 提出 SAE-StatSteer：先通过六个可靠性条件过滤 SAE 特征，再对幸存特征用 F 检验、KSG 互信息与 Cohen's d 进行无权重 Borda 共识排序，最后用 Cohen's d 权重组合所选 SAE 解码器行，实现完全透明、无优化的引导。
Result: 在 Gemma 系列三个模型、四个行为域上与七种基线比较，SAE-StatSteer 与基于优化的方法竞争力相当，同时所有选择与加权决策均可审计；摘要强调原始成功率会系统性高估可用控制，因为强偏移常伴随生成质量下降。
Conclusion: 作者主张在评估激活引导时应同时报告质量约束成功率和原始行为偏移，并指出有效引导并不存在通用层或通用强度；代码与数据已公开。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Where Flow Matching Leaks: Characterising Membership Signals Along the Interpolation Path
papers.abstract_en: Understanding memorization in generative models remains challenging, with implications for copyright and privacy. Beyond verbatim reproduction, models can encode subtler traces of their training data that never surface in their outputs yet remain exploitable. We refer to these measurable asymmetries as the \emph{membership signal}, and we study this regime for Flow Matching, which are increasingly used in deployed generative systems. We analyze the linear interpolation path $X_λ= (1-λ)X_0 + λX_1$ that defines standard Flow Matching training. We show that a gap exists between the reconstruction of train and test data that follows a bell-shaped curve over $λ$, which accumulates during training, while the validation metrics remain stable. The signal has a maximum whose location we derive in closed form under Gaussian assumptions. We validate these predictions on both audio and images and show that the bell-shaped structure is universal, while the peak prediction holds when our assumptions are satisfied. As a proof of concept, we exploit this specific $λ$-resolved structure to perform a Membership Inference Attack, distinguishing members of the training set from non-members.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 article, 9 main pages and 25 with annexes, 11 figures
papers.journal_ref: 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Flow Matching 生成模型在训练数据上留下的成员信号 (membership signal)，沿线性插值路径 $X_λ=(1-λ)X_0 + λX_1$ 分析训练与测试数据重建之间的可测量不对称。作者证明该差异沿 λ 呈钟形曲线，并随训练累积而验证指标保持稳定；在 Gaussian 假设下给出信号峰值位置的闭式解，并在音频和图像上验证。最后将该 λ 分辨结构用于成员推理攻击 (Membership Inference Attack)，以区分训练集成员与非成员。
Motivation: 生成模型对训练数据的记忆不仅表现为逐字复述，还包含不会出现在输出中但仍可被利用的细微痕迹；理解并刻画这些成员信号对版权与隐私防护具有重要意义。
Method: 分析标准 Flow Matching 训练所定义的线性插值路径，考察训练与测试数据重建误差随插值参数 λ 的变化；在 Gaussian 假设下推导信号峰值位置的闭式表达，并在音频和图像数据集上验证预测，最终利用该 λ-resolved 结构构造成员推理攻击。
Result: 摘要报告训练与测试数据重建之间存在沿 λ 的钟形差距，该差距在训练过程中累积而验证指标保持稳定；钟形结构具有普遍性，峰值位置预测在假设满足时成立，并能用于区分训练集成员与非成员。
Conclusion: 作者表明 Flow Matching 沿插值路径存在可量化的成员信号，并可作为成员推理攻击的基础；其峰值预测依赖于 Gaussian 等假设的满足。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exploring Adversarial Robustness and Safety Alignment in Multilingual Multi-Modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models integrate visual perception into language reasoning, introducing a continuous attack surface susceptible to adversarial attacks. Prior work on MLLM robustness has focused largely on English-centric tasks, leaving multilingual behaviour unexplored. We address this gap through a systematic study of adversarial robustness and multimodal safety across 12 diverse languages, evaluating open-source MLLMs that acquire multilingual capability through instruction tuning. Gradient-based attacks reveal a transferable multilingual vulnerability: adversarial images optimized in one language continue to induce failure in others, demonstrating strong cross-lingual transferability. Multilingual safety further varies with how effectively a model retrieves or interprets harmful instructions. When harmful intent is issued through text, languages with stronger linguistic grounding more often elicit misuse-enabling responses, while weaker languages produce fewer unsafe outputs. When embedded in the image as typographic content, English scripts are reliably recognised and followed, whereas non-English scripts are rarely parsed by the vision encoder. Lower-resource languages may therefore appear safer, but this is an artefact of comprehension and visual-grounding failures rather than genuine alignment, a phenomenon we term safety-by-failure. In contrast, MLLMs that build multilingual capability throughout their training stages rather than only at instruction tuning, such as Qwen3-VL, exhibit genuine cross-lingual safety, maintaining active refusal across languages rather than masking comprehension failure. Shallow multilingual adaptation, such as fine-tuning on translated instruction data, may produce surface-level understanding that creates illusory safety in low-resource languages; deeper integration across training stages leads to genuine multilingual safety alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了多语言多模态大模型（MLLM）在对抗鲁棒性与多模态安全对齐上的表现，覆盖12种语言，评估通过指令微调获得多语言能力的开源MLLM。基于梯度的攻击显示对抗图像具有强跨语言迁移性；安全方面，文本中的有害指令在语言能力更强的语言中更易诱发不安全响应，而图像中的非英文排版内容难以被视觉编码器解析，导致低资源语言出现“safety-by-failure”的虚假安全现象。相比之下，在多阶段训练中构建多语言能力的模型（如Qwen3-VL）表现出真正的跨语言安全对齐。
Motivation: 已有MLLM对抗鲁棒性研究大多聚焦英语任务，多语言场景下的对抗鲁棒性和安全对齐行为尚未被系统探索，而多语言能力正越来越多地通过指令微调引入开源MLLM。
Method: 对12种不同语言进行对抗鲁棒性与多模态安全的系统研究：使用基于梯度的攻击构造跨语言对抗图像，并考察文本与图像排版两种有害指令呈现方式下的模型响应，对比仅指令微调与多阶段训练获得多语言能力的模型。
Result: 摘要报告对抗图像在单一语言上优化后可迁移至其他语言引发失败；文本有害指令在语言基础更强的语言中更易产生能助长滥用的响应，而弱语言产生较少不安全输出。图像排版内容中英文脚本能被可靠识别执行，非英文脚本几乎不被视觉编码器解析，低资源语言因此看似更安全，实为安全失败；多阶段构建多语言能力的Qwen3-VL则维持主动拒答而非掩盖理解失败。
Conclusion: 作者认为在翻译指令数据上微调等浅层多语言适应会带来表面理解并造成低资源语言中的虚假安全，而跨训练阶段的深层整合才能实现真正的多语言安全对齐。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Beyond False Stability: High-Noise Drift Gating for Test-Time Adversarial Defenses in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP show strong zero-shot generalization but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. Adversarial training improves robustness but is computationally expensive, motivating test-time defenses. Recent approaches exploit how CLIP's visual representations respond to stochastic perturbations: aggregating predictions across noisy views, constructing Gaussian noise-averaged anchors and interpolating features toward them, or applying counter-perturbations. These strategies improve robustness but often degrade clean accuracy, yielding an unfavorable clean-robust trade-off. We revisit stochastic test-time defenses and identify an underexplored noise-regime transition in CLIP's representation space. Prior work explored perturbations mainly in the weak-noise regime, where adversarial examples can appear unusually stable (false stability). Our analysis shows this reverses as perturbation strength grows: beyond the weak-noise regime, adversarial representations become markedly more unstable than clean ones, giving a clearer separation signal. The transition is consistent across uniform and Gaussian noise, photometric and geometric transforms, datasets, and diverse attacks. It largely disappears in adversarially trained models, suggesting it is tied to the fragile local-basin geometry of adversarial representations in non-robust CLIP. We propose a training-free, plug-in drift-gated mechanism that uses high-noise feature drift as a lightweight gating signal to trigger existing test-time defenses only when adversarial-like instability is detected. Across 13 datasets it consistently improves the clean-robust trade-off. On eight fine-grained datasets, mean clean+adversarial accuracy rises from 65.7% to 71.4% for counterattack defenses and 68.4% to 73.2% for noise-anchoring; on ImageNet and four shifted variants, from 56.1% to 66.2% and 62.1% to 67.6%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视基于随机扰动的测试时防御 (test-time defenses)，发现 CLIP 视觉表征中存在一个被忽视的噪声区间转变：在弱噪声区对抗样本呈现“假稳定性” (false stability)，而超过弱噪声区后，对抗表征比干净表征明显更不稳定，形成更清晰的分离信号。作者据此提出一个无训练、即插即用的漂移门控 (drift-gated) 机制，仅在检测到对抗式不稳定时触发已有的测试时防御，并在 13 个数据集上改善干净-鲁棒权衡。
Motivation: 对抗训练成本高，测试时防御成为替代方案，但现有方法往往以牺牲干净准确率为代价，干净-鲁棒权衡不理想。先前工作主要在弱噪声区探索随机扰动，而该区间中对抗样本表现出的稳定性是“假稳定”，不利于可靠检测。
Method: 通过分析 CLIP 表征空间在不同扰动强度下的表现，识别出弱噪声区之外的强噪声区间，其中对抗表征比干净表征更不稳定。基于此提出训练免费的漂移门控机制，用高噪声下的特征漂移作为轻量门控信号，仅在检测到类似对抗的不稳定时才触发既有的测试时防御（如反扰动或噪声锚定）。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 13 个数据集上持续改善干净-鲁棒权衡。在八个细粒度数据集上，反扰动防御的平均干净+对抗准确率从 65.7% 升至 71.4%，噪声锚定防御从 68.4% 升至 73.2%；在 ImageNet 及四个偏移变体上，两者分别从 56.1% 升至 66.2% 和从 62.1% 升至 67.6%。该噪声区间转变在对抗训练模型 (adversarially trained models) 中基本消失。
Conclusion: 作者将高噪声不稳定信号归因于非鲁棒 CLIP 中对抗表征的脆弱局部盆地几何 (fragile local-basin geometry)，并指出漂移门控是一种无需训练的即插即用方案，可改善测试时防御的干净-鲁棒权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating Adversarial Robustness of Multi-modal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on vision-language tasks, but incorporating visual inputs through a vision encoder (e.g., CLIP) substantially expands the attack surface, making these models vulnerable to visual adversarial perturbations. Prior defenses typically preserve compatibility with pretrained MLLMs by enforcing strict alignment to CLIP's original embedding space during adversarial fine-tuning; while practical, this constraint fundamentally limits achievable robustness. We present a systematic investigation of adversarial robustness in MLLMs. We first introduce a diagnostic CLIP-alignment protocol that predicts, prior to full MLLM training, which robust vision encoders will transfer effectively to the multimodal setting, revealing that large-scale multimodal adversarial pretraining, rather than unimodal scale alone, is the critical factor for strong robustness transfer. Integrating such encoders into MLLMs via end-to-end multimodal training yields average gains of 28 CIDEr points on captioning and 11.7% VQA accuracy under strong adversarial attacks compared to constrained plug-and-play baselines. We further show that adversarial training applied directly to a standard non-robust MLLM degrades both clean and adversarial performance, establishing robust visual representations as a strict prerequisite, while end-to-end adversarial training from a robust backbone delivers additional gains of 1.9 CIDEr points and 4.3% VQA accuracy. Beyond training-time defenses, lightweight test-time visual stochastic transformations serve as an effective black-box defense for non-robust MLLMs, elevating adversarial performance from near-zero to levels comparable with robust models. Finally, we show that our robust models substantially reduce toxic generation under white-box visual jailbreak attacks. Code and pretrained weights will be released publicly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的对抗鲁棒性。作者提出一种诊断性 CLIP 对齐协议，可在大规模训练前预测哪些鲁棒视觉编码器能有效迁移到多模态设置，并发现大规模多模态对抗预训练（而非单模态规模）是鲁棒性迁移的关键因素。将这类编码器通过端到端多模态训练集成后，在强对抗攻击下图像描述平均提升 28 CIDEr 点、VQA 准确率提升 11.7%。
Motivation: MLLM 通过视觉编码器（如 CLIP）引入视觉输入，显著扩大了攻击面，易受视觉对抗扰动。先前防御通常通过强制与 CLIP 原始嵌入空间严格对齐来保持与预训练模型的兼容性，但这种约束从根本上限制了可实现的鲁棒性。
Method: 提出诊断性 CLIP 对齐协议，用于预先筛选能有效迁移到多模态设置的鲁棒视觉编码器；随后通过端到端多模态对抗训练集成所选编码器；此外还评估了轻量级测试时视觉随机变换（stochastic transformations）作为黑盒防御的有效性。
Result: 相比受限的即插即用基线，集成鲁棒编码器的模型在强对抗攻击下平均提升 28 CIDEr 点（图像描述）和 11.7% VQA 准确率；从鲁棒骨干进行端到端对抗训练额外获得 1.9 CIDEr 点和 4.3% VQA 准确率增益。测试时随机变换可将非鲁棒 MLLM 的对抗性能从接近零提升到与鲁棒模型相当的水平；鲁棒模型还显著减少了白盒视觉越狱攻击下的有毒生成。
Conclusion: 大规模多模态对抗预训练是强鲁棒性迁移的关键，鲁棒视觉表示是端到端对抗训练的先决条件；直接对标准非鲁棒 MLLM 进行对抗训练会同时损害干净与对抗性能。测试时防御可作为非鲁棒模型的轻量级黑盒补充。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Model Multiplicity and Predictive Arbitrariness in Recidivism Risk Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Prediction tasks over individual futures, which are inherently noisy, often admit multiple similarly accurate models. When these models produce different predictions for the same individual, they raise concerns of arbitrariness in decision-making. How severe can this arbitrariness be, in theory and in practice? How can it be resolved to support high-stakes risk assessment? We address these questions through a study of a machine learning-based decision support system for recidivism risk assessment that has been in use for over 15 years. By translating complex legal rules into an algorithm for labeling post release outcomes (recidivist or non-recidivist), we first construct a dataset of thousands of inmate releases. Using this dataset, we learn interpretable models that improve predictive performance, reduce error-rate disparities between groups, and ensure that rehabilitative progress lowers risk scores. Next, we study predictive multiplicity, by first deriving a tight lower bound on the expected predictive agreement of any finite set of models over a dataset, and then by evaluating the extent to which structural diversity (e.g., different model coefficients) within this set translates to predictive multiplicity (i.e., different predictions for the same individual). Our experiments indicate that the existence of many similarly accurate models with comparable error-rate disparities does not necessarily translate into severe predictive multiplicity. Empirically, similarly performant models can exhibit substantially higher predictive agreement than worst-case theoretical guarantees suggest. We find that a simple policy that assigns each inmate the lowest risk among these models is effective for addressing predictive arbitrariness.
papers.comment: 17 pages, 12 figures; This version is equivalent to the one that will appear at AIES 2026, except that it includes appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究累犯风险评估中的预测多重性 (predictive multiplicity) 与预测任意性问题。作者将复杂法律规则转化为标注释放后结果的算法，构建了数千名囚犯释放的数据集，并学习可解释模型以提升预测性能、降低群体间错误率差异并保证康复进展降低风险分数。理论上推导了有限模型集在数据集上期望预测一致性的紧下界，实验表明结构多样性并不必然转化为严重的预测多重性。
Motivation: 针对个体未来的预测任务本质嘈杂，通常存在多个精度相当的模型；当这些模型对同一人给出不同预测时，会引发高风险决策中任意性 (arbitrariness) 的担忧。
Method: 先将法律规则转化为对释放后结果 (recidivist/non-recidivist) 的标注算法并构造数据集，再学习可解释模型；随后推导任意有限模型集期望预测一致性的紧下界，并评估模型集内结构多样性 (如不同模型系数) 在多大程度上转化为预测多重性。
Result: 实验表明，存在许多精度相当且错误率差异可比模型，并不必然导致严重的预测多重性；经验上性能相近的模型之间预测一致性显著高于最坏情况理论保证。作者发现给每名囚犯分配这些模型中最低风险分数的简单策略能有效应对预测任意性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预测任意性在实践中可通过简单策略缓解，且理论上界比实际严重；研究场景为已使用超过 15 年的累犯风险评估决策支持系统。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调预测任意性在实践中可通过简单策略缓解，且理论上界比实际严重；研究场景为已使用超过 15 年的累犯风险评估决策支持系统。

papers.title: AXIOM: A Trust-First Neuro-Symbolic Execution Architecture for Self-Explaining Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present AXIOM, a trust-first neuro-symbolic architecture for natural-language mathematical reasoning. Its language model is strictly a canonicalizer: it rewrites informal problem text into a narrow schema consumed by a deterministic Computer-Algebra-System (CAS) pipeline, which derives and verifies the answer or abstains as a first-class output. Routing follows a 1:1:1 alignment between problem-shape regex, schema-specific prompt, and closed-form CAS handler, with 4,783 such routes shipped, 71% of which answer without invoking the language model, and zero LOST_CORRECT regressions as a standing release gate. Because the answer is derived rather than generated, so is its explanation: every handler emits a step trace of the computation it performed, rendered as prose by a layer covering all 4,785 tasks that cannot narrate a step the handler did not take. We report two numbers and never fuse them. On the full 7-category MATH test split, designed against, AXIOM answers 90.2% correctly (4,510/5,000) with one confident-wrong answer (99.98% trust on parseable). On held-out MATH-500, never designed against, it answers 89.2% correctly (446/500) with zero confident-wrong answers. The 1.0 pp gap is the substantive result: a registry that had merely memorized problem shapes would collapse on held-out data, and this one does not. The rule-only path answers the 20,000-record lm-eval arithmetic benchmark at 100% in 1 ms per record; the system has served ~30,000 public queries. What we emphasize is not an accuracy figure but the forward dynamic: every logged abstain is a candidate correct after one ship cycle, since new tasks compose without regressing the registry. The discipline behind it (math-template bucketing, LOST_CORRECT scan as regression oracle, parseable-first onboarding, abstain as first-class output) transfers to trustworthy neuro-symbolic systems beyond mathematics.
papers.comment: Preprint. 15 pages, 2 figures. Live interactive demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Squagghy/axiom-solver. Paper artifact and dataset on Zenodo (concept-DOI): 10.5281/zenodo.21877245
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AXIOM，一种以信任为先的神经符号 (neuro-symbolic) 数学推理架构，其中语言模型仅充当 canonicalizer，把非正式问题改写为狭窄 schema，再由确定性计算机代数系统 (CAS) 管线推导并验证答案，或把 abstain 作为一等输出。系统内置 4,783 条 1:1:1 路由（问题形状正则、schema 专用 prompt、闭式 CAS handler），其中 71% 不调用语言模型即可回答。在全 7 类 MATH 测试集上正确率 90.2%（4,510/5,000），仅一个 confident-wrong 答案；在未参与设计的 held-out MATH-500 上正确率 89.2%（446/500）且零 confident-wrong。
Motivation: 现有用于数学推理的神经符号系统往往把语言模型当作答案生成器，导致答案与解释不可信、难以验证。AXIOM 针对这一缺陷，提出让答案由确定性管线推导而非生成，从而把 abstain 作为一等输出，追求可审计的信任而非单纯追求准确率。
Method: 系统采用严格分层的架构：语言模型只做问题重写（canonicalizer），产生狭窄 schema 后交给确定性 CAS 管线；路由采用问题形状 regex、schema 专用 prompt 与闭式 CAS handler 的 1:1:1 对齐。每个 handler 输出计算步骤 trace，再由解释层渲染为自然语言，且该解释层无法叙述 handler 未执行的步骤。开发纪律包括 math-template bucketing、LOST_CORRECT 扫描作为回归 oracle、parseable-first onboarding，以及 abstain 作为一等输出。
Result: 在全 7 类 MATH 测试集上正确回答 90.2%（4,510/5,000），仅一个 confident-wrong 答案（parseable 上的信任度为 99.98%）；在未参与设计的 held-out MATH-500 上正确回答 89.2%（446/500），零 confident-wrong。规则-only 路径在 lm-eval 算术基准的 20,000 条记录上达到 100% 正确率，每条 1 ms；系统已服务约 30,000 次公开查询。1.0 pp 的差距被作者视为实质性结果，说明 registry 没有退化为记忆问题形状。
Conclusion: 作者强调的不是准确率数字本身，而是前向动态（forward dynamic）：每次记录的 abstain 在经历一个发布周期后都可能成为正确回答，因为新任务可在不回归 registry 的情况下组合。此纪律可迁移到数学之外的可信神经符号系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Taming the Loss Landscape of PINNs with Noisy Feynman-Kac Supervision: Operator Preconditioning and Non-Asymptotic Error Bounds
papers.abstract_en: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) often train slowly or fail to converge on challenging partial differential equations (PDEs), a behavior recently linked to severely ill-conditioned loss landscapes inherited from the underlying differential operator. We study PINNs augmented with a pointwise data-fidelity term, added at a few points in the domain to the standard residual and boundary losses. We show that this supervision term acts as an operator-level preconditioner: for suitable weights, our comparison bounds guarantee a substantially smaller condition number than under the standard PINN loss, independently of how the pointwise labels are obtained. For a broad class of PDEs admitting a Feynman-Kac (FK) representation, we generate such labels by Monte Carlo averages of the FK functional, resulting in what we call ``FK-PINNs", and using the excess risk decomposition approach, we derive non-asymptotic $L^2(Ω)$-error bounds for FK-PINNs with $\tanh$ activation trained by finitely many steps of gradient descent. Along the way, we establish pseudo-dimension bounds for first- and second-order derivatives of $\tanh$ neural networks, which are of independent interest and, to the best of our knowledge, new. Numerical experiments on Poisson, Schrödinger, mean exit time, and committor problems corroborate the theory, and show that FK-PINNs can successfully solve PDEs for which standard PINNs exhibit severe failure modes.
papers.comment: v2: discusses additional related works; final version accepted at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带点态数据保真项（pointwise data-fidelity term）的物理信息神经网络（PINNs），证明该监督项相当于算子级预条件子（operator-level preconditioner），可在合适权重下显著降低损失函数的条件数。对具有 Feynman-Kac（FK）表示的 PDE，作者用 FK 泛函的蒙特卡洛平均生成标签，构造 FK-PINNs，并利用超额风险分解（excess risk decomposition）给出有限步梯度下降训练下 tanh 激活网络在 L²(Ω) 上的非渐近误差界。数值实验在 Poisson、Schrödinger、平均退出时间与 committor 问题上验证了理论，表明 FK-PINNs 能求解标准 PINNs 严重失效的 PDE。
Motivation: PINNs 在困难 PDE 上常训练缓慢或无法收敛，近期工作将其归因于底层微分算子导致的严重病态损失景观；现有理解尚未充分刻画点态监督项在算子层面的作用。
Method: 在标准残差与边界损失之外加入少量域内点上的点态数据保真项，并证明其起到算子级预条件作用；对具有 FK 表示的 PDE，用 FK 泛函的蒙特卡洛均值生成标签形成 FK-PINNs。理论部分采用超额风险分解推导非渐近误差界，同时建立了 tanh 神经网络一阶与二阶导数的伪维数界（pseudo-dimension bounds）。
Result: 比较界（comparison bounds）保证在合适权重下该监督项能使条件数显著小于标准 PINN 损失，且与标签获取方式无关；Poisson、Schrödinger、平均退出时间和 committor 问题的数值实验与理论一致，FK-PINNs 可解决标准 PINNs 出现严重失败模式的 PDE。
Conclusion: 作者认为点态监督项可作为算子级预条件手段驯服 PINNs 的损失景观，并为 FK-PINNs 在有限步梯度下降下的泛化误差提供理论保证，其中 tanh 网络导数伪维数界是独立有价值的新结果。摘要未涉及天气或降水相关应用。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LVCG: Learning ECG Representations in the Latent Vectorcardiogram Space
papers.abstract_en: Electrocardiography (ECG) is a cornerstone of cardiac assessment, making the learning of informative ECG representations fundamental to tasks ranging from disease diagnosis to clinical report generation. However, existing methods operate almost exclusively in the observable ECG signal space. In practice, the standard twelve-lead ECG represents multiple projections of the same underlying cardiac electrical activity from different spatial orientations. Therefore, representation learning in the ECG space inevitably introduces substantial redundancy, which may lead to spurious correlations and increased risk of overfitting. To address this and motivated by the Frank vectorcardiogram (VCG) model, we propose learning a unified latent representation of cardiac electrical activity directly in the VCG space. We introduce LVCG, the first general self-supervised representation learning framework designed to operate in this physically grounded latent space. By learning view-invariant latent VCG representations rather than lead-specific artifacts, VCG minimizes redundancy and improves generalization. LVCG generally outperforms ECG-space baselines across tasks, demonstrating enhanced robustness and generalization, especially in domain shift settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LVCG，声称是第一个在 Frank 向量心电图 (VCG) 空间中进行自监督心电图表征学习的通用框架。作者认为标准十二导联 ECG 是同一心电活动的多个空间投影，直接在 ECG 信号空间学习会引入冗余、虚假相关和过拟合风险；LVCG 学习视图不变的潜在 VCG 表征，在多个任务上优于 ECG 空间基线，尤其在域偏移场景下鲁棒性和泛化更强。
Motivation: 现有 ECG 表征学习方法几乎都在可观测的 ECG 信号空间操作，而十二导联 ECG 本质上是同一心电活动在不同空间方向的投影，导致冗余并可能带来虚假相关与过拟合风险。
Method: 受 Frank VCG 模型启发，提出直接在 VCG 空间中学习统一的心电活动潜在表征；通过学习视图不变 (view-invariant) 的潜在 VCG 表征来替代对各导联特有伪影的表征，以降低冗余并改善泛化。
Result: 摘要报告 LVCG 在多个任务上普遍优于 ECG 空间基线，表现出更强的鲁棒性和泛化能力，尤其在域偏移 (domain shift) 场景下优势明显。
Conclusion: 作者强调在物理上有依据的 VCG 潜在空间中进行自监督表征学习，比 ECG 空间学习更能减少冗余并提升泛化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: HoloQ-VLA: Uniform W4A4 Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models unify perception, reasoning, and control in a single policy, but their multi-billion-parameter backbones and diffusion-based action heads make on-device deployment prohibitively expensive. Low-bit post-training quantization (PTQ) is the natural remedy, yet the diffusion action head that emits continuous control signals is highly sensitive to it: a few weight and activation outliers are enough to destabilize the head, so prior work leaves it at full precision or falls back to mixed-precision schemes, and uniformly quantizing the whole model to low bit-width remains an open challenge. We present HoloQ-VLA, the first training-free PTQ framework that compresses both the language backbone and the entire diffusion action head to uniform W4A4 precision without mixed-precision allocation. Instead of trading weight quality against activation quality, HoloQ-VLA targets the two outlier sources with complementary transforms: a weight-adapted rotation composed with an activation-dispersing Hadamard transform, together with per-step scaling that absorbs the dynamic-range drift exhibited by the action head across denoising steps. On LIBERO, HoloQ-VLA compresses Pi-0.5 and GR00T-N1.5 to W4A4 with 98.0% and 87.8% task success rates, matching or exceeding their FP16 references of 97.1% and 87.0%, while reducing the static memory footprint by 74.2%. Real-world manipulation experiments further demonstrate that HoloQ-VLA maintains smooth and accurate control across diverse real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HoloQ-VLA，一个无需训练的 PTQ 框架，首次将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的语言主干与完整扩散动作头统一压缩到 W4A4 精度，无需混合精度分配。方法通过权重自适应旋转、激活分散 Hadamard 变换以及按去噪步骤缩放来消除两类 outlier 源。在 LIBERO 上，Pi-0.5 与 GR00T-N1.5 压缩到 W4A4 后任务成功率分别为 98.0% 和 87.8%，匹配或超过 FP16 参考值（97.1% 和 87.0%），静态显存占用降低 74.2%。
Motivation: VLA 模型拥有数十亿参数主干和基于扩散的动作头，端侧部署成本过高；低比特训练后量化（PTQ）是自然方案，但扩散动作头对量化高度敏感，少数权重和激活 outlier 就能破坏稳定性，因此此前工作要么保留全精度要么使用混合精度，将整个模型统一量化到低比特仍是开放问题。
Method: 提出 HoloQ-VLA，一种 training-free 的 PTQ 框架，将权重自适应旋转与激活分散 Hadamard 变换组合，并引入按去噪步骤（per-step）的缩放来吸收动作头在不同去噪步间表现出的动态范围漂移，从而在不做混合精度分配的情况下实现语言主干和整个扩散动作头的统一 W4A4 量化。
Result: 在 LIBERO 基准上，HoloQ-VLA 将 Pi-0.5 和 GR00T-N1.5 压缩至 W4A4，任务成功率分别达到 98.0% 和 87.8%，相比 FP16 参考（97.1% 和 87.0%）持平或更好，静态显存占用减少 74.2%；真实世界操作实验也表明该方法在多种场景下能保持平滑、准确的控制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，通过对权重和激活两类 outlier 源采用互补变换并对动作头做逐去噪步缩放，可以避免在权重质量与激活质量之间取舍，使整个 VLA 模型在无训练条件下达到统一 W4A4 精度，同时维持甚至超过 FP16 的任务成功率。

summary_sections.motivation: VLA 模型拥有数十亿参数主干和基于扩散的动作头，端侧部署成本过高；低比特训练后量化（PTQ）是自然方案，但扩散动作头对量化高度敏感，少数权重和激活 outlier 就能破坏稳定性，因此此前工作要么保留全精度要么使用混合精度，将整个模型统一量化到低比特仍是开放问题。
summary_sections.method: 提出 HoloQ-VLA，一种 training-free 的 PTQ 框架，将权重自适应旋转与激活分散 Hadamard 变换组合，并引入按去噪步骤（per-step）的缩放来吸收动作头在不同去噪步间表现出的动态范围漂移，从而在不做混合精度分配的情况下实现语言主干和整个扩散动作头的统一 W4A4 量化。

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，通过对权重和激活两类 outlier 源采用互补变换并对动作头做逐去噪步缩放，可以避免在权重质量与激活质量之间取舍，使整个 VLA 模型在无训练条件下达到统一 W4A4 精度，同时维持甚至超过 FP16 的任务成功率。

papers.title: From Talking to Singing: A New Challenge for Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection
papers.abstract_en: With rapid advances in audio-visual generative models, reliable forgery detection becomes increasingly critical. Existing methods for audio-visual deepfake detection typically rely on cross-modal inconsistencies. In singing, rhythmic vocalization weakens this coupling and introduces a nontrivial domain shift, substantially degrading detection performance. We construct the Singing Head DeepFake (SHDF) dataset using rhythm-aware generative models to fill the gap in singing benchmarks. To cope with cross-scenario domain shifts, we propose a Text-guided Audio-Visual Forgery Detection (T-AVFD) framework that generalizes across both talking and singing scenarios. T-AVFD comprises a facial authenticity pattern learner and a multi-modal differential weight learning module. The pattern learner aligns facial features with multi-granularity textual descriptions to learn generalizable authenticity patterns. The weight learning module preserves intrinsic audio-visual consistency and adaptively integrates it with authenticity patterns via differential weighting. Extensive experiments on multiple talking head deepfake datasets and SHDF show consistent improvements over existing baselines and strong robustness under diverse perturbations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对歌唱场景下的音视频深度伪造检测问题，指出现有方法依赖跨模态不一致性，而歌唱的节奏化发声会削弱这种耦合并引入明显的域偏移，导致检测性能显著下降。作者构建了基于节奏感知生成模型的 Singing Head DeepFake (SHDF) 数据集，并提出 Text-guided Audio-Visual Forgery Detection (T-AVFD) 框架，以同时泛化到说话和歌唱场景。实验在多个 talking head 深度伪造数据集和 SHDF 上显示出一致的性能提升，并在多种扰动下表现鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有音视频深度伪造检测方法通常依赖跨模态不一致性；歌唱会减弱这种音视频耦合并引入跨场景域偏移，使检测性能大幅下降，且缺乏对应的歌唱伪造基准数据集。
Method: 构建 SHDF 数据集，使用节奏感知生成模型生成歌唱场景伪造数据；提出 T-AVFD 框架，包含面部真实性模式学习器（将面部特征与多粒度文本描述对齐以学习可泛化的真实性模式）和多模态差分权重学习模块（保留内在音视频一致性并通过差分权重自适应融合）。
Result: 在多个 talking head 深度伪造数据集及 SHDF 上，T-AVFD 相对现有基线取得一致的改进，并在多种扰动下表现出较强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调通过文本引导的真实性模式与差分权重融合，可以在说话和歌唱两种场景之间实现更通用的音视频伪造检测，并指出歌唱是当前检测方法面临的新挑战。

papers.title: Flow-Based Generative Modeling for Optimizing Sampling Policies in Compressed Sensing Applications
papers.abstract_en: Numerous modern applications in signal processing and medical imaging necessitate acquiring high-dimensional signals under tight resource constraints. Traditional sampling theory suggests that accurate signal reconstruction requires a number of measurements proportional to the signal's ambient dimension, a requirement often too expensive or impractical. Compressed sensing challenges this notion by demonstrating that sparse signals can be recovered with fewer measurements, provided the measurement operator meets certain conditions. This proof-of-concept study presents a task-aware flow-based generative framework -- a reformulation of the conventional Flow Matching training paradigm with a flow model trained to optimize subsampling in compressed sensing applications. We establish the fundamental feasibility of the proposed framework of learning subsampling masks that substantially enhance the performance of compressed sensing for image classification, image reconstruction, and MRI acceleration. For the image reconstruction task, our method demonstrated state-of-the-art performance, achieving Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio of 25.17 dB at the subsampling rate of 5\% on the CelebA dataset and 29.24 dB when reconstructing $8\times$ accelerated MRI measurements (fastMRI dataset) with the minimal computational overhead. These results highlight the effectiveness of task-conditioning within generative flow models and reveal a promising direction for representation learning strategies. Overall, the proposed framework offers a unified, flexible approach to designing data- and task-driven sensing schemes that can be potentially adapted to a broad range of inverse problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种任务感知的流式生成框架，将 Flow Matching 训练范式重新表述为用流模型优化压缩感知中的子采样掩码 (subsampling masks)。作为概念验证，该方法在图像分类、图像重建和 MRI 加速任务上提升了压缩感知性能，其中图像重建达到最高水准：CelebA 上 5% 子采样率下的 PSNR 为 25.17 dB，fastMRI 上 8 倍加速重建的 PSNR 为 29.24 dB，且计算开销很小。作者认为任务条件化 (task-conditioning) 在生成流模型中有效，并指出该框架可作为数据与任务驱动的统一传感方案。
Motivation: 传统采样理论要求测量数正比于信号环境维度，在高维信号获取中代价过高；压缩感知虽可用更少测量恢复稀疏信号，但测量算子的设计仍关键且缺乏任务感知。
Method: 提出任务感知的流式生成框架，将 Flow Matching 训练范式改造为让流模型学习优化子采样策略，从而在压缩感知任务中生成或学习有效的采样掩码。
Result: 摘要报告在图像重建任务上达到当前最优：CelebA 数据集 5% 子采样率下 PSNR 25.17 dB，fastMRI 数据集 8 倍加速 MRI 重建下 PSNR 29.24 dB，并具有极小的计算开销。
Conclusion: 该概念验证表明学习子采样掩码是可行的，能显著改善压缩感知在图像分类、重建和 MRI 加速中的表现；任务条件化生成流模型为此提供了统一灵活的设计途径，可能推广到更广泛的反问题。

papers.title: Infra-Bayesian Reinforcement Learning Agents Outperform Classical RL For Worst-Case Robustness
papers.abstract_en: Classical reinforcement learning assumes the agent interacts with a fixed environment whose behavior does not depend on the agent's policy. This assumption breaks down in non-realizable settings where other actors might anticipate the agent's behavior, including environments crucial to AI safety, where the agent interacts with predictors, humans, other AI agents, and institutions. In such settings, the agent's model class fails to capture the world in which it operates. Under such misspecification, classical Bayesian methods can produce confidently wrong posteriors, unreliable decisions, and unbounded regret, as realizability fails to obtain. Infra-Bayesianism is a decision-theoretic framework that addresses these failures by distinguishing ordinary probabilistic uncertainty, where priors can be reasonably chosen, from Knightian uncertainty, where no grounds exist for the construction of such a prior. It does so by evaluating actions on their worst-case outcomes, rather than from posterior expectations or weighted averaging. We present the first proof-of-concept implementation of an infra-Bayesian reinforcement learning architecture for finite-outcome stateless decision problems. Our agent maintains a set of imprecise hypotheses, updates them using infra-Bayesian conditioning, and selects actions by maximizing worst-case expected value. We apply this implementation of the infra-Bayesian maximin decision process to an environment with Knightian uncertainty, and demonstrate a lower worst-case regret as compared to classical reinforcement learning agents. We also investigate Newcomb's problem and show that the infra-Bayesian agent picks the optimal strategy, outperforming classical decision theory agents. Our results provide a step towards reinforcement learning agents that remain robust under model misspecification and policy-dependent uncertainty.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文给出 Infra-Bayesian 强化学习的首个概念验证实现，适用于有限结果 (finite-outcome) 无状态决策问题。智能体维护一组不精确假设 (imprecise hypotheses)，通过 infra-Bayesian conditioning 更新，并按最坏情形期望值 (maximin) 选择动作。在 Knightian 不确定性环境下，该智能体比经典 RL 智能体有更低的最坏情形遗憾 (worst-case regret)，并在 Newcomb 问题中选择最优策略，优于经典决策论智能体。
Motivation: 经典 RL 假设环境固定且不依赖智能体策略，该假设在不可实现 (non-realizable) 设定中失效，例如 AI 安全相关的场景中，预测者、人类、其他 AI 与机构会预期智能体的行为。模型误设 (misspecification) 下经典贝叶斯方法会产生自信但错误的 posterior、不可靠决策和无界遗憾；Infra-Bayesianism 通过区分概率不确定性与 Knightian 不确定性来应对这一问题。
Method: 提出首个 Infra-Bayesian 强化学习架构的概念验证实现，面向有限结果的无状态决策问题。智能体维护一组不精确假设，用 infra-Bayesian conditioning 更新，并通过最大化最坏情形期望值来选择动作。
Result: 在带有 Knightian 不确定性的环境中，该实现相比经典 RL 智能体展示出更低的最坏情形遗憾；在 Newcomb 问题上，Infra-Bayesian 智能体选择了最优策略，表现优于经典决策论智能体。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这是迈向在模型误设和策略依赖不确定性下保持稳健的强化学习智能体的一步；目前范围限于有限结果无状态决策问题。

papers.title: AgForce Enables Antigen-conditioned Generative Antibody Design
papers.abstract_en: Antibody design methods condition on antigen structure to generate complementarity-determining regions (CDR), yet a systematic evaluation of baseline methods reveals that they largely ignore the antigen input. We identify three failure modes that explain this behavior. Antigen blindness arises because models derive predictions from antibody framework context rather than antigen information, producing nearly identical CDRs regardless of the target. Vocabulary collapse reduces predicted amino acids to three to five per position, far below the ground truth distribution in native sequences. The argmax bottleneck on the cross-entropy loss via greedy decoding acts as a null predictor that sees only position and loop length and recovers almost all the residues irrespective of the model architecture and the target antigen. We propose a novel encoder-decoder architecture called AgForce that uses a graph neural network (GNN) as the encoder and specialized decoders for sequence-structure co-design. Specifically, we apply framework dropout, gated bottlenecks, and hyperbolic cross attention that prevent the antibody shortcut path. In the decoder, a Mixture Density Network (MDN) sequence head with Potts-like pairwise coupling and annealed Multiple Choice Learning (aMCL) replaces the cross-entropy objective with a multi-component distribution. An antigen cycle consistency head routes gradients through the sequence decoder, forcing predicted distributions to encode antigen identity. On the ChiMERa-Bench dataset, AgForce leads the baselines on every interface metric on all three splits (fnat, iRMSD, DockQ, and epitope F1) together with structure and sequence, while achieving roughly a 2x larger effective vocabulary compared to the GNN baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对抗体设计（antibody design）中基线方法普遍忽略抗原输入的问题，提出新的编码器-解码器架构 AgForce。作者系统评估基线后归纳出抗原失明（antigen blindness）、词汇坍缩（vocabulary collapse）和 argmax 瓶颈三类失败模式，并通过 GNN 编码器、MDN 序列头与抗原循环一致性头实现序列-结构协同设计。在 ChiMERa-Bench 数据集上，AgForce 在三个划分上的所有界面指标（fnat、iRMSD、DockQ、epitope F1）均领先基线，且有效词表约为 GNN 基线的两倍。
Motivation: 抗体设计方法需要基于抗原结构生成互补决定区（CDR），但基线方法的系统评估显示它们大多忽略抗原输入，几乎不随目标抗原变化而改变输出。作者定位到三类失败模式，说明现有交叉熵加贪心解码的建模方式无法真正利用抗原信息。
Method: 提出 AgForce，一种以图神经网络（GNN）为编码器、配备专用解码器的 encoder-decoder 架构。编码器端采用 framework dropout、门控瓶颈（gated bottlenecks）和双曲交叉注意力（hyperbolic cross attention）以阻断抗体捷径路径；解码器端用带 Potts 型成对耦合的混合密度网络（MDN）序列头与退火多重选择学习（aMCL）替代交叉熵目标，并以抗原循环一致性头迫使预测分布编码抗原身份。
Result: 在 ChiMERa-Bench 数据集上，AgForce 在全部三个划分上的所有界面指标（fnat、iRMSD、DockQ 和 epitope F1）上均优于基线，同时结构与序列指标也领先；相比 GNN 基线，有效词表大约扩大一倍。
Conclusion: 作者表明，通过结构性约束阻断抗体捷径路径并引入多分量生成分布，可以迫使模型真正利用抗原条件进行 CDR 设计，从而克服基线方法对抗原输入的忽略。
