summary_sections.conclusion: 作者表明，通过结构性约束阻断抗体捷径路径并引入多分量生成分布，可以迫使模型真正利用抗原条件进行 CDR 设计，从而克服基线方法对抗原输入的忽略。

papers.title: ConTact: Contact-First Antibody CDR Design via Explicit Interface Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Computational antibody CDR design methods condition on antigen structure to generate binding loops. Yet, the existing architectures conflate two fundamentally distinct sub-problems: identifying which CDR positions will contact the antigen, and selecting amino acids at those positions. This forces models to learn contact reasoning implicitly through uniform message passing, diluting antigen signal across all positions equally. We introduce ConTact, a contact-then-act architecture that explicitly decomposes CDR design into three cascaded stages: learning surface complementarity fingerprints, predicting CDR-antigen contacts, and injecting contact-gated antigen features into the prediction head. A distance-biased cross-attention module encodes geometric priors favoring spatial neighbors, a contact-weighted cross-entropy loss concentrates gradient signal on binding-critical positions, and a standoff-aware contact-recovery loss places the designed loop against its native epitope. On the ChiMERa-Bench dataset, ConTact surpasses the baselines on the binding interface and structural metrics (backbone RMSD, fraction of native contacts, interface RMSD, DockQ, and epitope F1) on all three splits, improving native-contact recovery by 11 to 16%, while matching the best sequence recovery. The source code is available at: https://github.com/mansoor181/ConTact.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ConTact，一种用于抗体 CDR（complementarity-determining region）设计的 contact-then-act 架构，将设计问题显式分解为表面互补性指纹学习、CDR-抗原接触预测和接触门控抗原特征注入三个级联阶段。在 ChiMERa-Bench 数据集上，ConTact 在结合界面与结构指标（backbone RMSD、native contacts 比例、interface RMSD、DockQ、epitope F1）上超过基线，native-contact recovery 提升 11% 到 16%，同时序列恢复率与最优基线持平。
Motivation: 现有抗体 CDR 计算方法将‘哪些 CDR 位置接触抗原’和‘这些位置选择什么氨基酸’两个子问题混为一谈，通过均匀消息传递隐式学习接触推理，导致抗原信号被稀释到所有位置，接触关键位置缺乏集中监督。
Method: ConTact 采用三级级联：先学习表面互补性指纹，再预测 CDR-抗原接触，最后把接触门控的抗原特征注入预测头；具体包括距离偏置的交叉注意力模块、接触加权交叉熵损失，以及 standoff-aware contact-recovery loss 将设计环对回原生表位。
Result: 在 ChiMERa-Bench 的三个划分上，ConTact 在 binding interface 与结构指标上均超过基线，native-contact recovery 提升 11% 至 16%，并匹配最优的序列恢复率。
Conclusion: 作者认为将接触推理显式建模为独立阶段并用接触加权监督集中梯度信号，能有效提升抗体 CDR 设计中的界面恢复与结构质量；代码已开源。

papers.title: R2AoP: Reliable and Robust Angle of Progression Estimation from Intrapartum Ultrasound
papers.abstract_en: Accurate estimation of the Angle of Progression (AoP) from intrapartum transperineal ultrasound is critical for objective assessment of labor progression, yet remains highly sensitive to imaging noise, boundary ambiguities, and the geometric amplification of local segmentation errors. We propose R2AoP, a reliable and robust AoP estimation framework that integrates structurally informed segmentation and confidence-guided geometric modeling to achieve stable and reproducible measurements. A three-branch local-structure-enhanced backbone improves the delineation of the pubic symphysis (PS) and fetal head (FH), while confidence-weighted contour fitting explicitly suppresses the influence of unreliable boundary points in AoP computation. To further improve performance under heterogeneous acquisition conditions, we introduce a lightweight geometry-reliable test-time adaptation strategy as an auxiliary component, enabling stable inference without target annotations. Extensive evaluations on multi-center benchmarks demonstrate consistent reductions in AoP error and boundary metrics compared with state-of-the-art AoP methods. Our source code is available at https://github.com/baiyou1234/R2AoP.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 R2AoP，一个面向产时经会阴超声的胎头进展角（Angle of Progression, AoP）估计框架，结合结构信息分割与置信度引导的几何建模，并引入轻量级测试时自适应（test-time adaptation）。多中心基准上的评估显示，相比现有 AoP 方法，其 AoP 误差和边界指标均获得一致性降低，且无需目标标注即可稳定推理。
Motivation: 从产时经会阴超声准确估计 AoP 对客观评估产程进展至关重要，但该方法对图像噪声、边界模糊以及局部分割误差的几何放大高度敏感，现有方法的稳定性和可重复性不足。
Method: 提出三分支局部结构增强主干网络来改善耻骨联合（pubic symphysis）和胎头（fetal head）的轮廓分割；采用置信度加权的轮廓拟合，显式抑制不可靠边界点对 AoP 计算的影响；并设计轻量级几何可靠的测试时自适应策略作为辅助组件，应对异构采集条件。
Result: 在多中心基准上的广泛评估表明，相比最先进的 AoP 方法，R2AoP 在 AoP 误差和边界指标上取得一致改进，且无需目标域标注。
Conclusion: R2AoP 通过结构信息分割与置信度引导的几何建模实现了更稳定、可重复的 AoP 测量；源代码已公开。论文聚焦产时超声应用，未涉及天气或降水相关场景。

papers.title: A Methodology for Selecting and Composing Runtime Architecture Patterns for Production LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Production LLM agents combine stochastic model outputs with deterministic software systems, yet the boundary between the two is rarely treated as a first-class architectural object. This paper names that boundary the stochastic-deterministic boundary (SDB): a four-part contract among a proposer, verifier, commit step, and reject signal that specifies how an LLM output becomes a system action. We argue that the SDB is the load-bearing primitive of production agent runtimes. Around this primitive, we organize agent runtime design into three concerns: Coordination, State, and Control. We present a catalog of six runtime patterns that compose the SDB differently across conversational, autonomous, and long-horizon agents: hierarchical delegation, scatter-gather plus saga, event-driven sequencing, shared state machine, supervisor plus gate, and human in the loop. For each pattern, we trace its lineage to distributed-systems concepts and identify what changes when the worker is stochastic. The paper contributes a five-step methodology for selecting runtime patterns, a diagnostic procedure that maps production failures to pattern weaknesses, and a failure mode called replay divergence, in which LLM-based consumers of a deterministic event log produce different downstream outputs under model-version or prompt changes. A stylized reliability decomposition separates per-call model variance from architectural momentum, motivating the claim that as model variance decreases, pattern choice and SDB strength become increasingly important levers for long-run reliability. We apply the methodology to five workloads and provide one runnable reference implementation for a 90-day contract-renewal agent.
papers.comment: 26 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Companion repo at https://github.com/vasundras/agent-runtime-patterns
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文把生产级 LLM agent 中随机模型输出与确定性软件系统之间的边界命名为随机-确定性边界（stochastic-deterministic boundary, SDB），并将其作为运行时架构的核心原语。作者提出由 proposer、verifier、commit step 和 reject signal 组成的四部分契约，围绕 Coordination、State、Control 三个关注点给出六种运行时模式，并提供五步模式选择方法论、故障诊断流程及 replay divergence 这一失效模式。摘要还给出一个可靠性分解和一个 90 天合约续签 agent 的参考实现。
Motivation: 生产环境中的 LLM agent 同时包含随机模型输出与确定性软件系统，但二者之间的边界很少被当作一等架构对象处理。论文认为该边界是生产 agent 运行时的承重原语，并且缺少系统化的运行时模式选择与故障诊断方法。
Method: 提出五步方法论：以 SDB 的四部分契约（proposer、verifier、commit step、reject signal）刻画随机与确定性的边界；将运行时设计划分为 Coordination、State、Control 三个关注点；给出六种运行时模式目录（hierarchical delegation、scatter-gather plus saga、event-driven sequencing、shared state machine、supervisor plus gate、human in the loop）；提供把生产故障映射到模式弱点的诊断流程；并用可靠性分解把每调用模型方差与架构动量分开。
Result: 摘要报告将方法论应用于五个工作负载，并提供一个可运行的参考实现，用于 90 天合约续签 agent；同时识别了 replay divergence 这一失效模式，即基于 LLM 的确定性事件日志消费者在模型版本或提示变化时会产生不同的下游输出。
Conclusion: 论文主张当模型方差下降时，模式选择和 SDB 强度会成为长期可靠性的重要杠杆；其贡献以架构模式目录、选择方法论和诊断流程为主，而非大规模实证评估。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Memory-Augmented Reinforcement Learning Agent for CAD Generation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic generation of computer-aided design (CAD) models is a core technology for enabling intelligence in advanced manufacturing. Existing generation methods based on large language models (LLMs) often fall short when handling complex CAD models characterized by long operation sequences, diverse operation types, and strong geometric constraints, primarily because reasoning chains break and effective error-correction mechanisms are lacking. To address this problem, this paper proposes a memory-augmented reinforcement learning framework for CAD generation agents. The framework encapsulates the underlying geometric kernel into a structured toolchain callable by the agent and builds a closed-loop mechanism of design intent understanding, global planning, execution, and multi-dimensional verification. It also designs a dual-track memory module consisting of a case library and a skill library, and proposes a dynamic utility retrieval algorithm. By introducing reinforcement learning into retrieval and policy optimization, the agent can effectively avoid retrieval traps in which examples are semantically similar but geometrically infeasible, enabling online self-correction and continual evolution without additional large-scale annotated data. Experiments show that the proposed method significantly improves both the success rate and geometric consistency on complex CAD model generation tasks.
papers.comment: We are withdrawing this manuscript because we have identified issues in the current analysis that require substantial revision. Until these issues are resolved, we do not consider the present version suitable for citation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种记忆增强的强化学习框架用于CAD模型自动生成，将底层几何内核封装为代理可调用的结构化工具链，构建设计意图理解、全局规划、执行与多维验证的闭环机制，并设计由案例库和技能库组成的双轨记忆模块及动态效用检索算法。摘要报告该方法在复杂CAD模型生成任务上显著提升成功率和几何一致性。需要特别注意，作者已在arXiv评论中声明撤稿，称当前分析存在需大幅修订的问题，不建议引用此版本。
Motivation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的现有CAD生成方法在处理长操作序列、多样操作类型和强几何约束的复杂模型时，常因推理链断裂且缺乏有效的纠错机制而表现不佳。
Method: 提出记忆增强的强化学习框架：把几何内核封装为代理可调用的工具链，建立设计意图理解、全局规划、执行和多维验证的闭环；设计双轨记忆模块（案例库与技能库）并给出动态效用检索算法，通过在检索与策略优化中引入强化学习来避免语义相似但几何不可行的检索陷阱，实现在线自纠正与持续进化。
Result: 摘要报告在复杂CAD模型生成任务上，该方法显著提升了生成的成功率和几何一致性；摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调该框架无需额外大规模标注数据即可支持在线自纠正与持续进化；但论文已被撤稿，当前分析需要大幅修订，不构成可引用的最终结论。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Why Do Safety Guardrails Degrade Across Languages?
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit safety degradation in non-English languages. Standard evaluation relies on Jailbreak Success Rate (JSR), which confounds several safety-driving factors into one, obscuring the specific cause(s) of safety failure. We introduce a latent variable model, a Multi-Group Item Response Theory (IRT) framework, that decouples language-agnostic safety robustness ($θ$), intrinsic prompt hardness ($β$), global language processing difficulty ($γ$), and a prompt-specific cross-lingual safety gap ($τ$). Using the MultiJail dataset, we evaluate the safety robustness of 61 model configurations across 5 closed-model families and 10 languages of varying resource, aggregating a dataset of 1.9 million responses. Exploratory Factor Analysis shows safety is primarily unidimensional: models refuse different harm types mainly through a shared mechanism. Contrary to the expected trend that safety degrades largely in low-resource languages, 22 model configurations are more vulnerable in English than in low-resource languages. Low-resource languages produce more uncertain responses (high entropy) than high-resource languages. Also, high-$τ$ prompts cluster in physical harm categories like Theft and Weapons and lower-resource languages, trends validated through cross-dataset generalization. While global translation quality shows low correlation with $τ$, severe mistranslations drive high-bias outliers, as validated by native speakers. Cultural and conceptual grounding mismatches may also contribute to $τ$. In predictive validation, the IRT framework achieves $\mathrm{AUC} = 0.940$, and unlike rate baselines stays predictive when a whole language is held out ($0.875$). Our framework reveals concept-language vulnerabilities that aggregate metrics obscure, enabling fairer cross-lingual safety evaluation and targeted improvements in dataset construction.
papers.comment: Poster at Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在多语言下安全护栏性能退化的问题，提出一个多组项目反应理论 (Multi-Group Item Response Theory, IRT) 潜在变量模型，将语言无关的安全鲁棒性、提示词固有难度、全局语言处理难度和提示词特定的跨语言安全差距等因子解耦。基于 MultiJail 数据集的 190 万条响应、61 个模型配置、5 个闭源模型家族和 10 种语言，作者发现安全性总体呈单维结构，且不少模型在英语上比在低资源语言上更脆弱；IRT 框架在预测验证中达到 AUC=0.940，并在留出整个语言时仍保持预测力。
Motivation: 标准的安全评估依赖越狱成功率 (Jailbreak Success Rate, JSR)，该指标将多个安全相关因素混在一起，难以揭示模型在非英语语言中安全性能退化的具体原因；本文旨在将它们解耦，以便更公平地评估跨语言安全性和定位数据构建中的问题。
Method: 引入一个潜在变量模型，即多组项目反应理论 (Multi-Group IRT) 框架，分离四个因子：语言无关的安全鲁棒性 (θ)、内在提示难度 (β)、全局语言处理难度 (γ) 和提示特定的跨语言安全差距 (τ)。作者用该框架分析 MultiJail 数据集，数据集包含 1.9 百万响应、61 个模型配置、5 个闭源模型家族和 10 种不同资源水平的语言，并结合探索性因子分析、熵分析与母语者验证等。
Result: 探索性因子分析显示安全性主要是单维的，模型主要通过共享机制拒绝不同类型的伤害；与预期相反，22 个模型配置在英语上比在低资源语言上更脆弱；低资源语言产生更多高熵的不确定响应；高 τ 提示集中在如盗窃和武器等物理伤害类别以及较低资源语言中；全局翻译质量与 τ 相关性低，但严重误译会导致高偏差异常；IRT 框架预测 AUC 为 0.940，且当留出整个语言时仍有 0.875。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架揭示了聚合指标掩盖的概念-语言脆弱性，支持更公平的跨语言安全评估与针对性的数据集构建改进；同时指出文化、概念锚定不匹配等也可能是导致跨语言安全差距的因素。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Access Timing as Scaffolding: A Reinforcement Learning Approach to GenAI in Education
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, generative AI (GenAI) in educational settings has become ubiquitous in university students' daily lives, despite its potential to induce over-reliance, metacognitive disengagement, and diminished learning when used unrestrictedly. While most prior research has focused on how to pedagogically scaffold its usage, the question of when to allow off-the-shelf GenAI remains understudied and lacks pedagogically grounded empirical investigation. We treat access timing itself as a form of implicit scaffolding and operationalize it through a reinforcement learning (RL) agent that decides when students should access GenAI, with a reward function grounded in metacognitive theory, cognitive load theory, and productive failure. In a mixed-methods controlled lab study with N=105 higher education students, we compared the agent's effect on learning gains and metacognitive engagement to unrestricted and fully restricted use. Results show that strategically timed GenAI access under the reinforcement learning condition improved objective post-test performance and metacognitive accuracy compared with unrestricted access, without requiring explicit metacognitive prompts or structured scaffolding. Exploratory comparisons with the fully restricted condition further suggest that timed access may reduce task errors and time on task relative to complete withholding. Overall, timing of GenAI access therefore is a tractable, theoretically grounded, and scalable pedagogical strategy that improves over completely unrestricted and withheld access, compatible with off-the-shelf tools and potentially low adoption barrier. This opens up a new research area that explores how access timing can be facilitated by educators and implemented in human-AI learning system design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究生成式AI（GenAI）在高等教育中的访问时机，将访问时机本身视为一种隐性脚手架，并用强化学习（RL）智能体决定学生何时可以使用GenAI，奖励函数基于元认知理论、认知负荷理论和生产性失败。在N=105的混合方法对照实验中，相比无限制使用，RL条件下的定时访问提升了客观后测成绩和元认知准确性；探索性比较还提示，相比完全禁止可能减少任务错误和用时。
Motivation: 大学生已普遍使用GenAI，但不受限制的使用可能导致过度依赖、元认知脱离和学习效果下降。已有研究多关注如何从教学上脚手架的构建，而“何时允许使用现成GenAI”这一问题缺乏基于教育理论的实证研究。
Method: 将访问时机操作化为由强化学习智能体做出的决策，以元认知理论、认知负荷理论和生产性失败为奖励函数基础；通过N=105的混合方法受控实验室研究，比较RL定时访问、无限制访问和完全限制三种条件的学习效果。
Result: 摘要报告，RL条件下的定时GenAI访问相比无限制访问改善了客观后测表现和元认知准确性，且不需要显式的元认知提示或结构化脚手架；与完全禁止条件相比，定时访问可能减少任务错误和任务用时。
Conclusion: 作者认为定时访问GenAI是一种可操作、有理论依据且可扩展的教学策略，优于完全开放和完全禁止的使用方式，且兼容现成工具、潜在采用门槛低；这为教育者如何在人类-AI学习系统设计中实现访问时机开辟了新的研究领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AnyAct: Towards Human Reenactment of Character Motion From Video
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of directly deriving an initial human reenactment from a monocular video of a non-human character. Our goal is not to reconstruct the source character itself but to reinterpret its motion as a plausible and editable human performance for downstream animation authoring. This task is challenging because existing video-based motion capture methods are largely restricted to human-centric structural spaces, while motion retargeting methods typically require structured 3D source motions and known source topologies. Our key insight is that sparse local articulated motion cues can preserve essential dynamics across large structural differences, providing a stable bridge from character video to human reenactment. Based on this observation, we propose AnyAct, which formulates character-video-driven human reenactment as conditional human motion generation from transferable sparse local 2D articulated motion. To make this practical, we introduce three key designs: human-motion-only supervision via augmented 3D-to-2D projection, progressive 3D-to-2D training to alleviate conditioning ambiguity, and global-local motion decoupling for reliable local motion control. We further construct a benchmark primarily covering diverse non-human character videos. Experiments on the benchmark show that AnyAct produces high-fidelity initial human reenactments that preserve the essential dynamics of the characters in reference videos, and further ablation studies validate the effectiveness of its core designs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从单目非人角色视频直接推导初始人类重演 (human reenactment) 的问题，提出 AnyAct，将角色视频驱动的人类重演建模为基于可迁移稀疏局部 2D 关节点运动的条件人体运动生成。方法引入三项核心设计：通过增广 3D-to-2D 投影实现仅用人体运动监督、渐进式 3D-to-2D 训练缓解条件歧义、全局-局部运动解耦提升局部运动控制。作者还构建了以多样非人角色视频为主的基准，实验表明 AnyAct 能生成保留参考视频中角色关键动态的高保真初始人类重演。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的动作捕捉方法大多局限于以人为中心的结构空间，而运动重定向 (motion retargeting) 通常需要结构化 3D 源运动与已知源拓扑，因此难以直接从非人角色视频获得可编辑的人类表演。
Method: AnyAct 利用稀疏局部关节点运动线索作为大结构差异下的稳定桥梁，将任务转化为从可迁移稀疏局部 2D 关节点运动生成条件人体运动，并提出仅用人体运动监督的增广 3D-to-2D 投影、渐进式 3D-to-2D 训练以及全局-局部运动解耦三种设计。
Result: 在自建的非人角色视频基准上，AnyAct 生成保留角色关键动态的高保真初始人类重演，消融实验验证了核心设计的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调稀疏局部关节点运动线索能够在角色视频与人类重演之间桥接显著的结构差异，为后续动画创作提供可编辑的初始人类表演。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Patients With Personality: Realistic Patient Simulation through Controlled Diversity and Selective Disclosure
papers.abstract_en: Simulating realistic patient interactions is a key requirement to testing clinical applications of LLMs at scale without time-consuming and expensive user studies. However, existing approaches often lack realism and controllability, often oversharing information unprompted, and failing to capture the wide variability of patient behavior. Here, we introduce PatientsWithPersonality (PWP), a patient simulation framework that generates realistic yet diverse virtual patient responses through explicit personality parametrization over a latent patient state. Grounded in HEXACO, a six-dimensional personality space used to quantify and parameterize human behavioral traits, our approach enables fine-grained control over conversational style, cooperativeness, and information disclosure within a unified framework. In a clinician evaluation, PWP is judged nearly as realistic as recorded human actors and clearly ahead of prior simulators, while being flagged as "too informative" far less often. Conditioning on HEXACO axes yields personas whose configured traits are recoverable by both clinicians and an autorater, span a substantially wider behavioral footprint than the closest baseline, and prevent oversharing. Altogether, our framework paves the way for more accurate and informative LLM benchmarking through our realistic and steerable patient simulator.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PatientsWithPersonality (PWP)，一个基于显式人格参数化的虚拟患者模拟框架，利用 HEXACO 六维人格空间对潜在患者状态进行控制，以生成真实且多样化的患者对话。临床医生评估显示 PWP 的真实感接近真人演员录制、明显优于先前模拟器，且被标记为“信息过度分享”的频率更低。该框架旨在为 LLM 的临床评测提供可控、逼真的患者模拟。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 患者模拟缺乏真实性和可控性，常未经提示就过度分享信息，且难以覆盖患者行为的广泛变异性；而真实用户研究耗时昂贵，难以大规模测试临床应用的 LLM。
Method: 提出 PWP 框架，通过对潜在患者状态进行显式人格参数化（基于 HEXACO 六维人格空间），在一个统一框架内细粒度控制对话风格、合作程度和信息披露程度。
Result: 临床医生评估中，PWP 的真实感几乎与真人演员录制相当，明显优于先前模拟器，且被判定为“过于信息丰富”的频率远低于先前方法；基于 HEXACO 轴的条件生成可产生可恢复的人格特质，行为足迹比最近基线更广，并防止过度分享。
Conclusion: 作者认为该框架通过真实且可操控的患者模拟器，为更准确、信息量更大的 LLM 临床基准测试铺平道路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Grounded Post-Training with Hard Examples for Reducing Hallucination in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Hallucination remains a fundamental challenge in vision-language models (VLMs), where autoregressive generation may produce linguistically plausible yet physically inconsistent or visually ungrounded responses due to likelihood maximization under joint probabilistic modeling. We propose a stage-wise preference optimization framework for hallucination reduction through targeted multimodal data construction. Rather than directly optimizing on generic instruction-following data, our approach progressively constructs hallucination-focused preference pairs near known failure boundaries. The framework emphasizes ambiguous spatial orientation, object relationships, OCR uncertainty, and adversarial false-premise training. Hallucinated negatives are generated through minimally perturbed yet visually inconsistent alternatives, enabling Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to better separate grounded reasoning from plausible hallucination. Experiments on open-source benchmarks and real-world multimodal evaluation scenarios demonstrate improved grounding consistency, reduced hallucination, and more informative grounded responses. Cross-model qualitative evaluation further shows that the proposed multimodal LLM DPO framework produces more visually grounded responses than several frontier proprietary VLMs, such as in ambiguous spatial reasoning and adversarial false-premise settings. The results suggest that hallucination may arise not only from limited model capacity, but also from inherent tendencies of autoregressive probabilistic generation to favor linguistically plausible continuations under weak visual grounding. Future work may explore physical consistency modeling, uncertainty-aware multimodal reasoning, and architectural alternatives beyond standard autoregressive decoding.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向多模态大语言模型 (VLM) 幻觉抑制的分阶段偏好优化框架，通过针对性构造接近失败边界的偏好对 (preference pairs)，并借助最小扰动但视觉不一致的负样本进行 Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)。作者在开放基准和真实多模态评测场景中报告了更优的 grounding 一致性、更少的幻觉和更具信息量的 grounded 响应，并声称跨模型定性评估优于若干前沿专有 VLM。
Motivation: 幻觉是 VLM 的基础性挑战，自回归生成在联合概率建模的最大似然目标下易产生语言上合理但视觉未 grounded 的输出；现有方法直接在通用指令跟随数据上优化，缺乏针对失败边界的训练数据。
Method: 采用分阶段偏好优化框架，逐步在已知失败边界附近构造幻觉聚焦的偏好对，覆盖模糊空间朝向、物体关系、OCR 不确定性和对抗性错误前提训练；通过最小扰动但视觉不一致的替代项生成幻觉负样本，使 DPO 更好区分 grounded 推理与貌似合理的幻觉。
Result: 在开放基准和真实多模态评测场景中，方法改善了 grounding 一致性、减少幻觉并生成更具信息量的 grounded 响应；跨模型定性评估显示该 DPO 框架在模糊空间推理和对抗性错误前提设置下比若干前沿专有 VLM 产生更视觉 grounded 的响应。
Conclusion: 作者认为幻觉不仅源于模型容量有限，还源于自回归概率生成在弱视觉 grounding 下偏好语言上合理延续的内在倾向；未来工作可探索物理一致性建模、不确定性感知多模态推理以及超越标准自回归解码的架构。

papers.title: Evolving Layer-Specific Scalar Functions for Hardware-Aware Transformer Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve state-of-the-art performance on challenging vision tasks, but their deployment on edge devices is severely hindered by the computational complexity and global reduction bottleneck imposed by layer normalization. Recent methods attempt to bypass this by replacing normalization layers with hardware-friendly scalar approximations. However, these homogeneous replacements do not optimally fit to all layers' behaviour and rely on expensive model retraining. In this work, we propose a highly efficient, hardware-aware framework that utilizes genetic programming (GP) to evolve heterogeneous, layer-specific scalar functions directly from pre-trained weights. Coupled with a novel post-training re-alignment strategy, our approach eliminates the need to retrain models from scratch entirely. Our evolved expressions accurately approximate the target normalization behaviours, capturing $90\%$ of the variance ($R^2$) compared to only $70.2\%$ for homogeneous baselines, allowing our modified architecture to recover $84.32\%$ Top-1 ImageNet-1K accuracy in only 20 epochs. By preserving this performance while eliminating the global reduction bottleneck, our approach achieves a strict reduction in both arithmetic complexity and off-chip memory traffic compared to standard LayerNorm, removing a primary barrier to the efficient deployment of ViTs on edge accelerators.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. v2: updated GP method (FLOP-based complexity, knee-point selection) and re-run results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个硬件感知框架，利用遗传编程 (genetic programming, GP) 直接从预训练权重演化异构的逐层标量函数，以替代 Vision Transformer (ViT) 中的层归一化 (LayerNorm)，从而消除其全局归约瓶颈并避免从头重新训练。摘要报告该方法在 ImageNet-1K 上以 20 个 epoch 恢复 84.32% 的 Top-1 准确率，且相比同质基线显著提升拟合方差。
Motivation: ViTs 在边缘设备部署受限于计算复杂度和 LayerNorm 造成的全局归约瓶颈；现有用硬件友好的标量近似替换归一化层的方法采用同质替换，不能匹配各层不同行为，且依赖昂贵的模型重新训练。
Method: 提出高效的硬件感知框架，通过 GP 从预训练权重演化出异质、逐层特有的标量函数，并配合一种新的训练后重新对齐 (post-training re-alignment) 策略，完全省去从头重训练。
Result: 演化的表达式能捕获 90% 的方差 (R²)，同质基线仅为 70.2%；修改后的架构在 20 个 epoch 内恢复 ImageNet-1K 上 84.32% 的 Top-1 准确率，同时相对标准 LayerNorm 在算术复杂度和 off-chip 内存流量上都有严格降低。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持精度的同时消除全局归约瓶颈，移除了 ViTs 在边缘加速器上高效部署的主要障碍。

papers.title: CuSearch: Curriculum Rollout Sampling via Search Depth for Agentic RAG
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems from outcome-only supervision. Most existing methods optimize policies from uniformly sampled rollouts, implicitly treating all trajectories as equally informative. However, trajectories differ substantially in search depth and are therefore not equally informative: deeper-search trajectories contain more retrieval decision points and provide denser direct supervision for the retrieval sub-policy. Moreover, this heterogeneity grows over training as the within-batch depth distribution shifts toward higher values, yet uniform rollout sampling remains blind to this shift. To address this, we propose CuSearch, a curriculum rollout sampling framework built on Search-Depth Greedy Allocation (SDGA), a batch-level operator that reallocates a fixed update budget toward deeper-search trajectories. SDGA-Auto always targets the deepest available trajectories in the current batch, yielding an implicit training-aligned curriculum as the depth distribution shifts upward. SDGA-Phase explicitly advances the curriculum threshold as deeper trajectories become sufficiently abundant. Experiments across model types and retrieval frameworks show that CuSearch consistently improves performance, achieving up to 11.8 exact-match points over standard GRPO on ZeroSearch. These results establish per-trajectory search depth as a reliable, annotation-free proxy for retrieval supervision density in RLVR-based agentic RAG training.
papers.comment: The paper has been accepted by COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/MrToser/CuSearch
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CuSearch，一种基于搜索深度的课程回滚采样（curriculum rollout sampling）框架，用于以可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）训练智能体检索增强生成（agentic RAG）系统。核心观点是：搜索深度更大的轨迹包含更多检索决策点，为检索子策略提供更密集的直接监督，因此不应把所有轨迹视为同等信息量。作者提出 Search-Depth Greedy Allocation (SDGA) 批量级算子，把固定更新预算重新分配给更深的轨迹，并给出自动（SDGA-Auto）和分阶段（SDGA-Phase）两种版本，使采样过程随深度分布上移形成隐式或显式的课程。
Motivation: 现有 RLVR 方法通常从均匀采样的回滚中优化策略，把所有轨迹视为同等信息量；但实际上不同轨迹的搜索深度差异很大，深层轨迹监督更密集，且训练过程中批次内深度分布会向高值移动，均匀采样对此不敏感。
Method: 提出 CuSearch 框架，核心是 SDGA，一个在批次层面将固定更新预算重新分配给更深搜索轨迹的算子。SDGA-Auto 始终选择当前批次中最深的可用轨迹，随深度分布向上移动形成隐含的训练对齐课程；SDGA-Phase 则显式推进课程阈值，直到更深的轨迹足够丰富。
Result: 实验覆盖多种模型类型和检索框架，CuSearch 持续提升性能，在 ZeroSearch 上相对标准 GRPO 最高提升 11.8 个 exact-match 点。
Conclusion: 作者认为实验结果确立了每条轨迹的搜索深度可作为 RLVR 智能体 RAG 训练中检索监督密度的可靠、无需标注的代理指标。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Checkup2Action: A Multimodal Clinical Check-up Report Dataset for Patient-Oriented Action Card Generation
papers.abstract_en: Routine clinical check-up reports combine laboratory measurements, physiological assessments, imaging findings and visually structured information, but rarely tell patients what to do next. Translating them into follow-up actions requires models to connect evidence across pages, tables and modalities, identify clinically relevant issues and communicate next steps without unsupported diagnostic or treatment claims. Yet this report-to-action capability remains poorly benchmarked. We introduce \textbf{C2A}, a dataset and benchmark for generating structured \textit{Action Cards} from multimodal check-up reports, together with \textbf{Checkup2Action}, a constrained workflow for the task. C2A contains 2,000 de-identified real-world reports covering physical examinations, laboratory tests, cardiovascular assessments and imaging evidence. Each card specifies one issue, its priority, recommended department, follow-up window, patient-facing explanation and questions for clinicians. Our evaluation measures issue coverage and precision, priority consistency, department and timing accuracy, action complexity, usefulness, readability and safety. Experiments across general-purpose and medical large language models show that no model performs best on every dimension. Clinical experts judged 84\% of evaluated outputs fully reasonable and effective. Removing safety constraints increased problem recall from 0.527 to 0.825, but produced more diagnostic overstatement. C2A therefore supports systematic study of the balance between coverage, actionable guidance and safe patient communication.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 C2A，一个面向多模态体检报告生成患者导向 Action Card 的数据集与基准，并配套 Checkup2Action 受限工作流。C2A 包含 2000 份脱敏真实报告，覆盖体格检查、实验室检查、心血管评估和影像证据；每张卡指定一个临床问题、优先级、推荐科室、随访窗口、面向患者的解释及给临床医生的问题。评测覆盖问题覆盖度、精度、优先级一致性、科室与时间准确性、行动复杂度、实用性、可读性和安全性。作者报告称在通用与医学大语言模型实验中没有模型在所有维度上最优，且移除安全约束会提升召回但增加诊断过度陈述。
Motivation: 常规体检报告包含化验、生理评估、影像发现和结构化视觉信息，却很少告诉患者下一步该做什么；将报告转化为随访行动需要跨页、跨表格和跨模态连接证据，并识别临床相关问题，而这类 report-to-action 能力缺乏系统基准。
Method: 构建 C2A 数据集，包含 2,000 份去标识化的真实世界多模态体检报告，并为每份报告标注结构化的 Action Card；同时提出 Checkup2Action，一个用于从多模态体检报告生成这些 Action Card 的受限工作流，评测指标涵盖问题覆盖度、优先级一致性、科室与时间准确性、可读性和安全性等。
Result: 摘要报告临床专家判定 84% 的受评输出完全合理且有效；移除安全约束后问题召回率从 0.527 提升到 0.825，但产生更多诊断性过度陈述；跨通用与医学大语言模型的对比显示没有单一模型在所有维度上都最优。
Conclusion: 作者认为 C2A 可用于系统研究问题覆盖度、可执行指导与面向患者的安全沟通三者之间的平衡，并强调安全约束在避免诊断性过度陈述中的重要性。

papers.title: On-Policy Distillation with Best-of-N Teacher Rollout Selection
papers.abstract_en: On-policy distillation (OPD), which supervises a student on its own sampled trajectories, has emerged as a data-efficient post-training method for improving reasoning while avoiding the reward dependence of reinforcement learning and the catastrophic forgetting often observed in standard supervised fine-tuning. However, standard OPD typically computes teacher supervision under noisy student-generated contexts and often relies on a single stochastic teacher rollout per prompt. As a result, the supervision signal can be high-variance: the sampled teacher trajectory can be incorrect, uninformative, or poorly matched to the student's current reasoning behavior. To address this limitation, we propose BRTS, a Best-of-N Rollout Teacher Selection framework for on-policy distillation. BRTS augments standard student-context OPD with a teacher-context supervision branch constructed from the curated teacher trajectory. Rather than distilling from the first sampled teacher rollout, BRTS samples a small pool of teacher trajectories and selects the auxiliary trajectory using a simple priority rule: correctness first, student alignment second. When multiple correct teacher trajectories are available, BRTS chooses the one most aligned with the student's current behavior; when unconditioned teacher samples fail on harder prompts, it invokes a ground-truth-conditioned recovery step to elicit a natural derivation. The selected trajectory is then used to provide reliable teacher-context supervision inside the OPD loop, augmented with an auxiliary loss on the teacher trajectory. Experiments on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and AMC 2023 show that BRTS improves over standard OPD on challenging reasoning benchmarks, with the largest gains on harder datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/BWGZK-keke/BRTS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 on-policy distillation (OPD) 中教师监督信号方差过大的问题，提出 BRTS（Best-of-N Rollout Teacher Selection）框架。BRTS 在标准学生上下文 OPD 之上增加一个教师上下文监督分支：先采样一小批教师轨迹，按“正确性优先、学生对齐其次”的规则选择辅助轨迹，并在困难提示下调用 ground-truth-conditioned 恢复步骤。在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 AMC 2023 推理基准上，BRTS 相对标准 OPD 有提升，且越难的基准上收益越大。
Motivation: 标准 OPD 在学生采样的噪声上下文中计算教师监督，且每个提示仅依靠单个随机教师轨迹，导致监督信号高方差：采样到的教师轨迹可能不正确、无信息或与学生当前推理行为不匹配。
Method: 提出 BRTS 框架：采样一个小池的教师轨迹，用简单优先级规则（先正确性、后与学生行为对齐）选取辅助轨迹；当无条件的教师样本在困难提示上失败时，调用基于 ground-truth 条件的恢复步骤生成自然推导。所选轨迹在 OPD 循环内以教师上下文监督方式使用，并附加辅助损失。
Result: 在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 AMC 2023 上的实验表明，BRTS 优于标准 OPD，且更难的基准上提升幅度最大。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过最佳-N 选择与恢复步骤获取可靠教师轨迹，可以降低 OPD 监督方差并改善困难推理任务的蒸馏效果。

papers.title: Choosing a JPEG Decoder for PyTorch DataLoaders: Workload-Specific Throughput on Four CPUs
papers.abstract_en: A JPEG decoder benchmark can combine worker counts, CPUs, and datasets in one large result matrix. We simplify that comparison by fixing a PyTorch DataLoader at eight workers and asking one question: how much faster is each decoder than Pillow on the same CPU and JPEG workload? We benchmark 12 Python decoders on four 16-vCPU Google Cloud platforms and two workloads from the Forchheim Image Database. The first contains 324 large camera originals. The second contains 1,668 originals and copies processed by social media services. Every decoder-CPU-workload setting has five isolated repetitions. JPEG bytes reside in memory, and each timed decode returns a complete three-channel RGB array. The workload changes the practical result. On camera originals, the geometric mean across CPUs ranges from 1.00 to 1.09 times Pillow. On the mixed workload, simplejpeg, imagecodecs, and turbojpeg reach 1.39 - 1.40 Pillow. The exact leader still changes by CPU. We therefore recommend comparing decoders on representative JPEGs, while using the fixed eight-worker results as a compact starting point. Full worker curves and absolute throughput tables are in the appendix.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Code and benchmark evidence: https://github.com/ternaus/imread_benchmark
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估 12 个 Python JPEG 解码器在四款 16 vCPU Google Cloud 平台与两个来自 Forchheim 图像数据库的工作负载上的吞吐量，固定 PyTorch DataLoader 为 8 个 worker，并以 Pillow 为基线。摘要报告在相机原始图像上几何平均加速比为 1.00–1.09 倍，而在混合工作负载上 simplejpeg、imagecodecs 和 turbojpeg 达到 1.39–1.40 倍，但领先者随 CPU 变化。
Motivation: JPEG 解码器基准通常由 worker 数、CPU 与数据集构成庞大的结果矩阵，难以直接比较；作者希望简化这种对比，并回答在相同 CPU 与 JPEG 工作负载下各解码器相对 Pillow 的快多少问题。
Method: 固定 PyTorch DataLoader 为 8 个 worker，在四款 16 vCPU Google Cloud 平台上基准 12 个 Python 解码器；测试两个工作负载（324 张相机原图；1,668 张原图及社交媒体处理副本）；JPEG 字节驻留内存，每次计时解码返回完整三通道 RGB 数组，每种设置重复 5 次隔离实验。
Result: 相机原图上各 CPU 的几何平均加速为 Pillow 的 1.00–1.09 倍；混合工作负载上 simplejpeg、imagecodecs 和 turbojpeg 达到 1.39–1.40 倍 Pillow，但具体领先者随 CPU 变化。
Conclusion: 作者建议在代表性 JPEG 上比较解码器，并将固定的 8-worker 结果作为紧凑的起点；完整 worker 曲线与绝对吞吐量表放在附录中。

papers.title: When Does Critique Improve AI-Assisted Theoretical Physics? SCALAR: Structured Critic--Actor Loop for Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: As large language models (LLMs) show increasing promise on research-level physics reasoning tasks and agentic AI becomes more common, a practical question emerges: How does the interaction between researchers and agents affect the results? We study this using SCALAR (Structured Critic--Actor Loop for Agentic Reasoning), an Actor--Critic--Judge pipeline applied to quantum field theory and string theory problems. The Actor proposes solutions, the Critic provides iterative feedback, and an independent Judge evaluates the transcript against reference solutions. We vary the Actor persona, the Critic feedback strategy, and the Actor model family and scale. Multi-turn dialogue improves over single-shot attempts throughout, but both the mechanism of improvement and the value of different prompting choices depend strongly on the Actor--Critic pairing. Increasing the scale within one model family (e.g. from the 8B-parameter DeepSeek-R1 variant to DeepSeek-R1 70B) improves some easier-problem behavior, but does not remove the hardest bottleneck we observe. Critic feedback strategy matters most clearly in the asymmetric Actor--Critic setting (e.g, a lightweight Haiku Actor guided by a stronger Sonnet Critic), where constructive feedback improves mean-score outcomes. In same-family Actor--Critic settings, strategy effects are weaker: lenient feedback is sometimes favored, while strict and adversarial feedback are not beneficial. Taken together, SCALAR provides a controlled testbed for evaluating which interaction structures help or hinder AI-assisted reasoning on known-answer scientific problems.
papers.comment: V2. Expanded experiments. Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop (AI4Physics); 18 pages; 9 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）在理论物理推理任务中，研究者与智能体之间的交互方式如何影响结果。作者提出 SCALAR（Structured Critic--Actor Loop for Agentic Reasoning），一个应用于量子场论和弦论问题的 Actor--Critic--Judge 流水线：Actor 提出解答，Critic 提供迭代反馈，独立 Judge 对照参考解评估整个对话记录。实验发现多轮对话普遍优于单次尝试，但改进机制与提示选择的价值高度依赖于 Actor--Critic 配对方式。
Motivation: 随着 LLM 在研究级物理推理上展现潜力且 agentic AI 日益普及，一个实际问题是如何理解研究者与智能体之间的交互对结果的影响；需要受控实验环境来评估不同交互结构的作用。
Method: SCALAR 采用 Actor--Critic--Judge 结构：Actor 生成解答，Critic 进行迭代反馈，独立 Judge 依据参考解评估对话记录；系统性地变化 Actor 人设、Critic 反馈策略以及 Actor 模型家族与规模。
Result: 摘要报告多轮对话在所有设置下都优于单次尝试；在非对称 Actor--Critic 设置（如轻量 Haiku Actor 配合较强 Sonnet Critic）中，建设性反馈能提升平均得分；同族模型配对下策略效应较弱，宽松反馈有时更优，而严格与对抗性反馈无益；将同族模型规模从 8B 参数 DeepSeek-R1 变体提升到 70B 能改善部分简单问题，但无法消除最难瓶颈。
Conclusion: SCALAR 为在已知答案的科学问题上评估哪些交互结构有助于或阻碍 AI 辅助推理提供了受控测试平台；交互收益取决于 Actor--Critic 配对。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Spherical Flows for Sampling Categorical Data
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of learning generative models for discrete sequences in a continuous embedding space. Whereas prior approaches typically operate in Euclidean space or on the probability simplex, we instead work on the sphere $\mathbb S^{d-1}$. There the von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution induces a natural noise process and admits a closed-form conditional score. The conditional velocity is in general intractable. Exploiting the radial symmetry of the vMF density we reduce the continuity equation on $\mathbb S^{d-1}$ to a scalar ODE in the cosine similarity, whose unique bounded solution determines the velocity. The marginal velocity and marginal score on $(\mathbb S^{d-1})^L$ both decompose into posterior-weighted tangent sums that differ only by per-token scalar weights. This gives access to both ODE and predictor-corrector (PC) sampling. The posterior is the only learned object, trained by a cross-entropy loss. Experiments compare the vMF path against geodesic and Euclidean alternatives. The vMF path especially in combination with PC sampling significantly improves results on Sudoku, language modeling, and mathematical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何在连续嵌入空间中为离散序列学习生成模型，提出在球面 S^{d-1} 上利用 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 分布的径向对称性，将连续性方程化为关于余弦相似度的标量 ODE，从而得到可计算的边际速度与边际得分。该方法仅需用交叉熵损失训练后验分布，并支持 ODE 与 predictor-corrector (PC) 两种采样方式。实验表明 vMF 路径尤其是配合 PC 采样，在 Sudoku、语言建模和数学推理任务上显著优于测地线与欧几里得替代方案。
Motivation: 现有方法通常在欧几里得空间或概率单纯形上建模离散序列，缺少自然的噪声过程或封闭形式的条件得分；本文试图在球面上获得更好的几何结构。
Method: 在球面 S^{d-1} 上采用 vMF 分布作为噪声过程，利用其径向对称性将连续性方程约化为余弦相似度上的标量 ODE，其唯一有界解决定速度；在 (S^{d-1})^L 上，边际速度和边际得分均可分解为后验加权的切空间求和，仅差每 token 的标量权重，后验是唯一需要学习的对象，用交叉熵损失训练。
Result: 摘要报告 vMF 路径在 Sudoku、语言建模和数学推理实验中显著优于测地线和欧几里得替代方案，尤其是与 PC 采样结合时提升明显。
Conclusion: 摘要强调球面上的 vMF 路径为离散序列生成提供了一种可行的连续嵌入方案，并结合 PC 采样获得更好结果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Progressive Semantic Communication for Efficient Edge-Cloud Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on edge devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory demands, which exceed the capabilities of resource-constrained embedded platforms. Conversely, fully offloading inference to the cloud is often impractical in bandwidth-limited environments, where transmitting raw visual data introduces substantial latency overhead. While recent edge-cloud collaborative architectures attempt to partition VLM workloads across devices, they typically rely on transmitting fixed-size representations, lacking adaptability to dynamic network conditions and failing to fully exploit semantic redundancy. In this paper, we propose a progressive semantic communication framework for edge-cloud VLM inference, using a Meta AutoEncoder that compresses visual tokens into adaptive, progressively refinable representations, enabling plug-and-play deployment with off-the-shelf VLMs without additional fine-tuning. This design allows flexible transmission at different information levels, providing a controllable trade-off between communication cost and semantic fidelity. We implement a full end-to-end edge-cloud system comprising an embedded NXP i.MX95 platform and a GPU server, communicating over bandwidth-constrained networks. Experimental results show that, at 1 Mbps uplink, the proposed progressive scheme significantly reduces network latency compared to full-edge and full-cloud solutions, while maintaining high semantic consistency even under high compression. The implementation code will be released upon publication at https://github.com/open-ep/ProSemComVLM.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in the 2026 IEEE Global Communications Conference (GLOBECOM). Extended version with additional figures and appendices
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出面向边缘-云端视觉语言模型（VLM）推理的渐进式语义通信框架，利用 Meta AutoEncoder 将视觉 token 压缩为自适应、可渐进细化的表示，无需额外微调即可即插即用地部署到现成 VLM。作者在 NXP i.MX95 嵌入式平台与 GPU 服务器构成的端到端系统上验证，在 1 Mbps 上行链路的带宽受限网络下，该方案相比纯边缘与纯云方案显著降低网络延迟，同时在高压缩下保持较高的语义一致性。代码将在发表后开源。
Motivation: 边缘设备算力与内存不足以运行 VLM，而完全在云端推理时，带宽受限环境下传输原始视觉数据会带来明显延迟；现有边缘-云协作架构多采用固定大小表示，无法适应动态网络条件，也未充分利用语义冗余。
Method: 提出一种渐进式语义通信框架，核心是 Meta AutoEncoder，将视觉 token 压缩成可逐步细化的自适应表示，支持按不同信息层级灵活传输，从而在通信开销与语义保真度之间提供可控权衡。系统实现包含嵌入式 NXP i.MX95 平台和 GPU 服务器，在带宽受限网络上完成端到端推理。
Result: 实验表明，在 1 Mbps 上行链路下，渐进式方案相较于全边缘和全云解决方案能显著降低网络延迟，并且即使在高压缩率下仍保持较高的语义一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调渐进式语义表示能够在带宽受限的边缘-云场景中平衡通信成本与语义保真度，且可对接现成 VLM；但未给出对更广泛模型或非受限带宽场景的泛化结论。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Language corpora for the Dutch medical domain
papers.abstract_en: Background: Dutch medical corpora are scarce, limiting NLP development. Methods: We translated English datasets, identified medical text in generic corpora, and extracted open Dutch medical resources. Results: The resulting corpus comprises +- 36 billion tokens across the medical domain in about 105 million documents, freely available on Hugging Face. Conclusion: This work establishes the first large-scale Dutch medical language corpus for pre-training and downstream NLP tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍构建荷兰语医学领域大规模语料库的工作。作者通过翻译英语数据集、在通用语料中识别医学文本并抽取开放的荷兰语医学资源，最终构建了约 360 亿 token、约 1.05 亿文档的医学语料，并在 Hugging Face 上免费发布，用于预训练和下游 NLP 任务。
Motivation: 荷兰语医学语料稀缺，限制了荷兰语医学领域 NLP 的发展；作者旨在填补这一空白，建立首个大规模荷兰语医学语言语料库。
Method: 方法包含三部分：翻译英语医学数据集、在通用荷兰语语料中识别医学文本、抽取已有的开放荷兰语医学资源，最终整合成统一语料库。
Result: 构建的语料约含 360 亿 token、约 1.05 亿文档，覆盖医学领域，并在 Hugging Face 上公开可用。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了首个大规模荷兰语医学语言语料库，可用于预训练和下游 NLP 任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MuSS: A Large-Scale Dataset and Cinematic Narrative Benchmark for Multi-Shot Subject-to-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: While video foundation models excel at single-shot generation, real-world cinematic storytelling inherently relies on complex multi-shot sequencing. Further progress is constrained by the absence of datasets that address three core challenges: authentic narrative logic, spatiotemporal text-video alignment conflicts, and the "copy-paste" dilemma prevalent in Subject-to-Video (S2V) generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce MuSS, a large-scale, dual-track dataset tailored for multi-shot video and S2V generation. Sourced from over 3,000 movies, MuSS explicitly supports both complex montage transitions and subject-centric narratives. To construct this dataset, we pioneer a progressive captioning pipeline that eliminates contextual conflicts by ensuring local shot-level accuracy before enforcing global narrative coherence. Crucially, we implement a cross-shot matching mechanism to fundamentally eradicate the S2V copy-paste shortcut. Alongside the dataset, we propose the Cinematic Narrative Benchmark, featuring a visual-logic-driven paradigm and a novel Anti-Copy-Paste Variance (ACP-Var) metric to rigorously assess continuous storytelling and 3D structural consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that while current baselines struggle with continuous narrative logic or degenerate into trivial 2D sticker generators, our MuSS-augmented model achieves state-of-the-art narrative effectiveness and cross-shot identity preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MuSS，一个面向多镜头视频生成与主体到视频生成 (Subject-to-Video, S2V) 的大规模双轨数据集，素材来自 3000 余部电影，同时支持复杂蒙太奇转场和以主体为中心的叙事。作者配套提出了渐进式字幕生成流水线和跨镜头匹配机制，以消除上下文冲突并抑制 S2V 中的复制粘贴捷径，并设计了电影叙事基准 (Cinematic Narrative Benchmark) 及新的 Anti-Copy-Paste Variance (ACP-Var) 指标。实验表明现有基线的连续叙事逻辑能力较弱，而 MuSS 增强后的模型在叙事效果和跨镜头身份保持上达到最优。
Motivation: 视频基础模型在单镜头生成上表现优异，但真实电影叙事依赖复杂的多镜头序列；现有数据集无法同时解决叙事逻辑真实性、时空文本-视频对齐冲突以及 S2V 生成中普遍存在的复制粘贴问题，这成为进一步发展的瓶颈。
Method: 构建从 3000 多部电影中提取的 MuSS 数据集，采用双轨结构兼顾蒙太奇转场与主体中心叙事；提出渐进式字幕流水线，先保证局部镜头级准确再施加全局叙事一致性，并通过跨镜头匹配机制从机制上消除 S2V 的复制粘贴捷径；同时提出基于视觉逻辑的评测范式与 ACP-Var 指标。
Result: 摘要报告，现有基线的连续叙事逻辑表现不佳，或退化为平凡的 2D 贴图式生成；经 MuSS 增强后的模型在叙事有效性和跨镜头身份保持上取得当前最优结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MuSS 数据集与电影叙事基准填补了多镜头电影叙事视频生成缺乏高质量数据与评测手段的空白，并为后续研究提供了面向连续叙事与三维结构一致性的评测基础。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Protective Perturbations Really Protect Portrait Privacy under Real-world Image Transformations?
papers.abstract_en: Proactive defense methods protect portrait images from unauthorized editing or talking face generation (TFG) by introducing pixel-level protective perturbations, and have attracted increasing attention for privacy protection. In real-world use, images inevitably undergo sequences of benign operations during display and dissemination, such as resizing and color compression, which directly alter pixel values. Existing studies and robustness defenses mainly examine individual transformations in isolation, while sequentially composed transformations remain underexplored. To address this gap, we systematically evaluate whether representative proactive defenses against unauthorized image editing using GANs and diffusion models, as well as talking face generation, remain effective under sequential image transformations. The evaluated methods span general-purpose and portrait-specific defenses and are assessed qualitatively and quantitatively. Experimental results show that pixel-level perturbation-based defenses struggle to withstand sequences of common image transformations, posing a risk of failure in real-world applications. To further demonstrate that this vulnerability can be exploited at low cost, we introduce Transformation-Induced Purification via Region-wise Super-Resolution (TIP-RSR), a simple training-free framework combining sequential image transformations with off-the-shelf restoration models. TIP-RSR efficiently purifies protective perturbations while preserving image fidelity and requiring substantially less computation than diffusion-based purification methods. These findings expose a practical vulnerability in current proactive portrait defenses and highlight the need to account for sequential real-world transformations when designing future protection mechanisms. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Richen7418/TIP-RSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了现有面向肖像图像的对抗性主动防御（proactive defense）在真实世界图像变换序列下的鲁棒性，发现基于像素级扰动的方法难以抵抗常见的连续图像变换。作者进一步提出一种无需训练的净化框架 TIP-RSR，通过区域级超分恢复模型在低计算成本下去除保护性扰动。
Motivation: 真实场景中肖像图像在展示与传播过程中会经历缩放、色彩压缩等连续良性操作，而现有鲁棒性研究大多只单独考察单一变换，忽略了顺序组合变换的影响，导致主动防御在现实中可能失效。
Method: 先对多类代表性防御方法（涵盖通用与肖像专用、基于 GAN 与扩散模型的防护）在顺序图像变换下进行定性与定量评估；随后提出 TIP-RSR，一种训练免费的框架，将顺序图像变换与现成恢复模型结合，以区域级超分方式净化扰动。
Result: 实验显示像素级扰动防御难以抵御常见图像变换序列，存在现实应用风险；TIP-RSR 能高效净化保护性扰动，保持图像保真度，且计算量显著低于基于扩散模型的净化方法。
Conclusion: 研究揭示了当前肖像主动防御在实际变换序列下的脆弱性，作者强调未来设计防护机制需考虑真实世界的顺序变换。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Exact Replica Threshold for Nonlinear Moments of Quantum States
papers.abstract_en: Joint measurements on multiple copies of a quantum state provide access to nonlinear observables such as $\operatorname{tr}(ρ^t)$, but whether replica number marks a sharp information-theoretic resource boundary has remained unclear. For every fixed order $t\ge 3$, existing protocols show that $\lceil t/2\rceil$ replicas already suffice for polynomial-sample estimation of $\operatorname{tr}(ρ^t)$, yet it has remained open whether one fewer replica must necessarily incur a sample-complexity barrier growing with the dimension. We prove that this is indeed the case in the sample/copy-access model with replica-limited joint measurements: any protocol restricted to $\lceil t/2\rceil-1$ replicas requires dimension-growing sample complexity, while $\lceil t/2\rceil$ replicas suffice by prior work. Thus the exact replica threshold for fixed-order pure moments is $\lceil t/2\rceil$. Equivalently, for fixed-order pure moments, one additional coherent replica is not merely useful but marks the exact threshold between polynomial-sample estimation and a dimension-growing regime in the replica-limited model. We further show that the same threshold law extends to a broad family of observable-weighted moments $\operatorname{tr}(Oρ^t)$, including Pauli observables and other observables with bounded operator norm and macroscopic trace norm. Coherent replica number therefore acts as a genuinely discrete resource for nonlinear quantum-state estimation.
papers.comment: Withdrawn because the main exact-threshold claim is not valid as stated. Stronger pre-existing replica-limited lower bounds, including arXiv:2509.24000, show that dimension-dependent sample complexity persists beyond the threshold claimed in this version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文（arXiv:2604.22627）声称在复制受限联合测量模型下证明固定阶纯态矩 tr(ρ^t) 的精确复制数阈值为 ⌈t/2⌉：使用 ⌈t/2⌉−1 个复制必定导致随维度增长的样本复杂度，而 ⌈t/2⌉ 个复制即可多项式样本估计。作者还将该阈值律推广到含可观测量权重的矩 tr(Oρ^t)。但该论文已被撤回，因为主要精确阈值论断按原表述不成立。
Motivation: 在非线性量子态估计中，tr(ρ^t) 等可观测量的联合测量是否需要复制数作为信息论资源边界此前不清楚；已知 ⌈t/2⌉ 个复制足够，但少一个复制是否必然遭遇维度相关样本复杂度屏障尚未解决。
Method: 在 sample/copy-access 模型下考虑复制受限的联合测量，对固定阶 t≥3 的纯态矩给出下界证明：任何限制在 ⌈t/2⌉−1 个复制的协议需要维度增长的样本复杂度；并论证同一阈值律适用于可观测量加权矩 tr(Oρ^t)，包括 Pauli 可观测量和具有有界算子范数与宏观迹范数的可观测量。
Result: 摘要声称精确复制阈值成立，即固定阶纯态矩的阈值为 ⌈t/2⌉，并推广到 tr(Oρ^t)。然而 arXiv 注释表明主要精确阈值论断按原表述无效，且已有更强的复制受限下界（含 arXiv:2509.24000）显示维度相关样本复杂度在该阈值之外仍然存在。
Conclusion: 作者在 arXiv 注释中强调该文已撤回；更强的既有复制受限下界显示维度依赖的样本复杂度在论文声称的阈值之后仍持续，因此精确阈值结论不成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Null-Space Flow Matching for MIMO Channel Estimation in Latency-Constrained Systems
papers.abstract_en: Accurate yet low-latency channel state information (CSI) acquisition is essential for multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) communication systems. While advanced deep generative models, such as score-based and diffusion models, enable high-fidelity CSI reconstruction from limited pilot observations, they often suffer from high inference latency. To achieve accurate CSI estimation under stringent latency constraints, this paper proposes a null-space flow matching (FM) framework that leverages a range-null space decomposition to separate observation-informed and underdetermined channel components. Specifically, the pilot observations are used to regulate the observable range-space channel component, while an FM-based generative prior primarily resolves the ambiguous null-space degrees of freedom through iterative refinement. To further improve the robustness and efficiency of the proposed framework, we introduce a noise-aware adaptive correction strategy to suppress channel noise on the refinement trajectory, along with a power-law time schedule to better allocate the limited number of refinement steps. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves competitive normalized mean square error (NMSE) performance even under a strict latency budget of around 3 ms, while delivering a superior accuracy-latency tradeoff compared with both model-based and generative baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 MIMO 系统中低时延、高精度信道状态信息 (CSI) 获取问题，提出基于零空间流匹配 (null-space flow matching, FM) 的信道估计框架。该方法利用值域-零空间分解，将导频观测能约束的可观测值域分量与欠定的零空间分量分离，并用 FM 生成式先验通过迭代细化求解零空间自由度；同时引入噪声感知自适应校正与幂律时间调度来提升鲁棒性和效率。实验表明在约 3 ms 的严格时延预算下能取得有竞争力的归一化均方误差 (NMSE)，并在精度-时延权衡上优于基于模型和生成式的基线。
Motivation: 现有基于分数模型和扩散模型的深度生成方法虽能实现高保真 CSI 重建，但推理时延高，难以满足通信系统严格的时延约束；需要在保持估计精度的同时显著降低 CSI 获取延迟。
Method: 提出零空间流匹配框架，采用值域-零空间分解将信道分离为观测可调节的值域分量和欠定的零空间分量；用导频观测约束值域分量，用 FM 生成式先验迭代细化零空间自由度。另提出噪声感知自适应校正策略以抑制细化轨迹上的信道噪声，并设计幂律时间调度来合理分配有限的细化步数。
Result: 实验显示该方法在约 3 ms 的时延预算下取得有竞争力的 NMSE 性能，并在精度-时延权衡上优于基于模型和生成式的基线方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提框架能在严格时延约束下实现高精度 CSI 估计，其范围-零空间分解结合 FM 先验是低时延信道估计的有效方案。摘要未涉及无线信道估计之外的应用。
Relevance: 2

summary_sections.method: 提出零空间流匹配框架，采用值域-零空间分解将信道分离为观测可调节的值域分量和欠定的零空间分量；用导频观测约束值域分量，用 FM 生成式先验迭代细化零空间自由度。另提出噪声感知自适应校正策略以抑制细化轨迹上的信道噪声，并设计幂律时间调度来合理分配有限的细化步数。
summary_sections.result: 实验显示该方法在约 3 ms 的时延预算下取得有竞争力的 NMSE 性能，并在精度-时延权衡上优于基于模型和生成式的基线方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为所提框架能在严格时延约束下实现高精度 CSI 估计，其范围-零空间分解结合 FM 先验是低时延信道估计的有效方案。摘要未涉及无线信道估计之外的应用。

papers.title: Scaling Self-Play with Self-Guidance
papers.abstract_en: LLM self-play algorithms are notable in that, in principle, nothing bounds their learning: a Conjecturer model creates problems for a Solver, and both improve together. However, in practice, existing LLM self-play methods do not scale well with large amounts of compute, instead hitting learning plateaus. We argue this is because over long training runs, the Conjecturer learns to hack its reward, collapsing to artificially complex problems that do not help the Solver improve. To overcome this, we introduce Self-Guided Self-Play (SGS), a self-play algorithm in which the language model itself guides the Conjecturer away from degeneracy. In SGS, the model takes on three roles: Solver, Conjecturer, and a Guide that scores synthetic problems by their relevance to unsolved target problems and how clean and natural they are, providing supervision against Conjecturer collapse. Our core hypothesis is that language models can assess whether a subproblem is useful for achieving a goal. We evaluate the scaling properties of SGS by running training for significantly longer than prior works and by fitting scaling laws to cumulative solve rate curves. Applying SGS to formal theorem proving in Lean4, we find that it surpasses the asymptotic solve rate of our strongest RL baseline in fewer than 80 rounds of self-play and enables a 7B parameter model, after 200 rounds of self-play, to solve more problems than a 671B parameter model pass@4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Self-Guided Self-Play (SGS)，一种面向 LLM 的自博弈算法，让模型同时承担 Solver、Conjecturer 和 Guide 三种角色，其中 Guide 对合成问题按其与未解目标的相关性以及是否干净自然进行评分，以抑制 Conjecturer 退化为奖励黑客。作者在 Lean4 形式化定理证明上进行了远超以往工作的训练时长，并拟合累积解题率曲线的 scaling laws；结果显示 SGS 在不到 80 轮自博弈内超过最强 RL 基线的渐近解题率，且 7B 模型经过 200 轮自博弈后解决的题目多于 671B 模型的 pass@4。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 自博弈方法在原理上不受学习上限约束，但在大量计算下实践表现不佳，会遭遇学习平台期。作者认为原因是长时间训练中 Conjecturer 会学会破解奖励，坍缩到人为复杂但对 Solver 无益的问题。
Method: SGS 引入语言模型自身的 Guide 角色，对 Conjecturer 生成的合成问题按两条标准打分：与未解目标问题的相关性，以及问题是否干净自然；由此提供监督信号，使 Conjecturer 远离退化。核心假设是语言模型能够判断一个子问题对达成目标是否有用。
Result: 在 Lean4 形式化定理证明中，SGS 不到 80 轮自博弈便超越最强 RL 基线的渐近解题率；200 轮自博弈后，7B 参数模型解决的问题数量超过 671B 参数模型的 pass@4。
Conclusion: 作者认为语言模型对子问题有用性的评估能力可以让自博弈在长训练下持续扩展，SGS 的 scaling 特性优于现有自博弈与 RL 基线。摘要未明确给出局限性。

papers.title: Inverse Design of Inorganic Compounds with Generative AI
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is revolutionizing chemistry. Beyond the value of predictive models accelerating virtual screening, generative AI aims at enabling inverse design, reversing the compound-to-property prediction paradigm into property-to-compound generation. Chemists now have access to a rich AI toolbox for organic chemistry, including drug discovery. However, the application of these methods to inorganic compounds remains limited by the challenges posed by their intrinsic nature. This Review analyzes how these challenges have been addressed, considering widely diverse systems ranging from molecules to crystals, including transition metal complexes and microporous materials. The analysis focuses on how generative AI methods have evolved towards data-representation-model pipelines that address the full complexity of inorganic compounds, including their chemical composition, geometry, symmetry, and electronic structure. Future directions, like benchmark standardization and the development of synthesizability metrics, are also discussed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇综述（Review），讨论生成式AI在无机化合物逆向设计（inverse design）中的应用，即把化合物到性质的预测范式反转成性质到化合物的生成。文中分析从分子到晶体、包括过渡金属配合物和微孔材料在内的多种体系，重点考察生成式AI方法如何演化为处理化学组成、几何、对称性和电子结构完整复杂性的数据-表示-模型（data-representation-model）流水线。作者还讨论了基准标准化和可合成性指标等未来方向。
Motivation: 预测模型虽能加速虚拟筛选，但生成式AI要实现性质到化合物的逆向设计，在无机化合物上仍受其内在复杂性限制；现有AI工具箱主要面向有机化学和药物发现，无机化合物的应用尚不成熟。
Method: 作为综述，该方法部分是对不同生成式AI方法如何组织成数据-表示-模型流水线的分析框架，涵盖从分子到晶体、过渡金属配合物和微孔材料等广泛体系，并聚焦于组成、几何、对称性与电子结构的表示问题。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据，主要结论是生成式AI方法正逐步朝着能够处理无机化合物完整复杂性的流水线方向发展，并指出基准标准化和可合成性指标是尚待解决的关键问题。
Conclusion: 作者强调无机化合物逆向设计的前进方向包括建立标准化基准和发展可合成性（synthesizability）度量，以弥补当前方法在实用性与可验证性上的不足。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: PinpointQA: A Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos
papers.abstract_en: Reliable embodied interaction in indoor environments requires agents to precisely localize small everyday objects from visual observations. Yet this fundamental capability remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs), particularly when spatial understanding must be performed from indoor videos. Existing benchmarks study video spatial intelligence and embodied reasoning, but do not directly evaluate whether a model can localize a small target object and express its position with sufficient precision. We introduce PinpointQA, a benchmark built from ScanNet++ and ScanNet200. It contains 1,024 scenes and 10,094 QA pairs across four progressively challenging tasks: Target Presence Verification, Nearest Reference Identification, Fine-Grained Spatial Description, and Structured Spatial Prediction. Ground-truth annotations are constructed from intermediate spatial representations derived from aligned 3D geometry and instance-level annotations, while evaluated models receive only sampled RGB video frames. Evaluations of representative MLLMs reveal a consistent performance decline across the task progression, with structured spatial prediction remaining particularly challenging, while supervised fine-tuning substantially improves performance. By isolating the spatial grounding capabilities that precede downstream embodied interaction, PinpointQA serves as both a diagnostic benchmark and an effective training resource. The project page is available at https://rainchowz.github.io/PinpointQA/.
papers.comment: Accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Embodied Multimodal Reasoning in Physical Environments (EMR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PinpointQA，一个基于 ScanNet++ 和 ScanNet200 构建的室内视频小物体空间理解基准，包含 1,024 个场景和 10,094 个 QA 对。基准设计了四个难度递增的任务：目标存在性验证、最近参照物识别、细粒度空间描述和结构化空间预测；真值由对齐 3D 几何与实例级标注导出的中间空间表示生成，而模型只获得采样的 RGB 视频帧。对代表性 MLLM 的评测显示，随着任务推进性能一致下降，其中结构化空间预测最难，而监督微调能大幅提升表现。
Motivation: 现有的视频空间智能与具身推理基准并不直接考察模型能否精确定位室内小目标并足够精确地表达其位置，而这一能力是可靠室内具身交互的基础。
Method: 作者构建了基于 ScanNet++/ScanNet200 的 PinpointQA 基准，利用对齐的 3D 几何和实例级标注构造中间空间表示来生成 ground truth，评测时只向模型提供采样后的 RGB 视频帧，并设计了四个逐步递进的空间理解任务。
Result: 对代表性 MLLM 的评估显示模型性能随任务递进而一致下降，结构化空间预测尤为困难；监督微调可以显著提升性能。
Conclusion: PinpointQA 通过隔离下游具身交互之前的空间定位能力，既可作诊断基准也可作训练资源。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Predictive Entropy as a Joint Screen for Error and Paraphrase Instability in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Medical Vision-Language Models (VLMs) answering binary presence questions on chest radiographs can fail in two linked ways: they are confidently wrong, and they change answers when a clinically equivalent question is rephrased. In a binary answer head both failures track the same logit margin, so we test how well one score screens for both. On MedGemma-4B-IT across MIMIC-CXR (in-distribution, n=196) and PadChest (out-of-distribution, n=861), single-pass predictive entropy predicts which yes/no answers flip under rephrasing with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.823 on PadChest and 0.821 on MIMIC, and the signal is stable across five random seeds (0.828$\pm$0.021). The same signal replicates on LLaVA-RAD-7B (AUROC 0.83) and is invariant to the flip definition (all, operator-preserving, or negation-excluded rewrites), so the screen needs no semantic filter at inference. One low-entropy threshold drives error and flip rate down together (3.3% and 5.7% at 80% coverage), and threshold selection transfers to a held-out split. Under cross-site shift the more expensive methods we test add nothing practical: at the 5% risk target a single forward pass answers 88.5% of cases, matching Monte Carlo (MC) Dropout, and beats the uniformly averaged five-seed adapter ensemble on error detection by 0.111 AUROC. Even a model that is 91% accurate still contradicts itself on 13% of items under rephrasing, and one forward pass flags them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医学视觉语言模型（VLM）在胸部X光片二元存在性问答中的两类关联失败：高置信错误与临床等价表述改写导致的答案翻转。作者提出在二值回答头中，单次前向传播的预测熵（predictive entropy）可同时筛查这两类失败，并在 MedGemma-4B-IT、LLaVA-RAD-7B 以及 MIMIC-CXR 和 PadChest 数据集上验证了其跨分布稳定性。
Motivation: 医学 VLM 在回答胸部 X 光片二元问题时可能既自信地答错，又在等价改写后改变答案；由于二值回答头中这两类失败共享相同的 logit 边际，作者希望验证单一分数能否同时覆盖两种失败模式，从而免去推理时的语义过滤。
Method: 在 MedGemma-4B-IT 上，对 MIMIC-CXR（分布内，n=196）和 PadChest（分布外，n=861）使用单次前向传播的预测熵作为筛查分数，评估其预测改写后 yes/no 答案翻转的性能，并与 Monte Carlo Dropout 和五种子适配器集成等更昂贵方法比较；同时检验阈值跨站点迁移与翻转定义不变性。
Result: 单次预测熵在 PadChest 和 MIMIC 上预测改写翻转的 AUROC 分别为 0.823 和 0.821，且五个随机种子下稳定（0.828±0.021），在 LLaVA-RAD-7B 上复现为 AUROC 0.83；信号对翻转定义不变。单一低熵阈值在 80% 覆盖下同时将错误率和翻转率降至 3.3% 和 5.7%；在 5% 风险目标下，单次前向传播可回答 88.5% 的病例，与 MC Dropout 相当，并在错误检测上比五种子集成高 0.111 AUROC。即使准确率为 91% 的模型，仍有 13% 的条目在改写下自相矛盾，单次前向传播可标记这些条目。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预测熵可作为一个无需语义过滤的联合筛查分数，用于同时降低医学 VLM 的错误与改写不稳定，且成本低于集成和 MC Dropout；跨站点场景下昂贵方法未带来实际增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SatIR: Scalable High-Recall Constraint-Satisfaction-Based Information Retrieval for Clinical Trials Matching
papers.abstract_en: Many real-world retrieval and matching problems require more than topical relevance: a candidate must satisfy the specific constraints of one profile among many, not just be relevant to it. Clinical trials are a high-stakes instance of this challenge: they are central to evidence-based medicine, yet many struggle to meet enrollment targets, despite the availability of over half a million trials listed on ClinicalTrials.gov, which attracts approximately two million users monthly. Existing retrieval techniques, largely based on keyword and embedding-similarity matching, treat eligibility constraints as soft signals rather than binding requirements, resulting in low recall, low precision, and limited interpretability. We propose SatIR, a scalable, efficient, high-precision, high-recall, interpretable clinical trial retrieval method based on formal constraint satisfaction. Leveraging established medical ontologies, we use Large Language Models (LLMs) to convert informal reasoning -- regarding ambiguity, implicit clinical assumptions, and incomplete patient records -- into explicit, precise, controllable, and interpretable formal Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) constraints. For scalable and efficient retrieval, we project the SMT matching problem onto relational algebra, enabling an efficient database implementation that retains high recall while sacrificing little precision. SatIR consistently improves eligibility-aware retrieval over similarity-based baselines on the SIGIR 2016 dataset and a benchmark derived from TREC 2022. Relative to TrialGPT-style retrieval, SatIR retrieves 32%-72% more relevant-and-eligible trials per patient on SIGIR 2016 and achieves 1.8-3.2x higher eligible-trial recall on the TREC benchmark. Retrieval is fast, requiring only 146 milliseconds per patient over 3,621 SIGIR trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SatIR，一种基于形式约束满足 (constraint satisfaction) 的临床试验检索方法。作者利用医学本体论 (medical ontologies) 和大型语言模型 (LLMs)，将歧义、隐性临床假设和不完整患者记录等非正式推理转换为显式、可解释的 SMT (Satisfiability Modulo Theories) 约束，再把 SMT 匹配问题投影到关系代数 (relational algebra) 上，实现可扩展的高效数据库检索。在 SIGIR 2016 和基于 TREC 2022 的基准上，SatIR 相比相似性基线显著提升 eligibility-aware 检索的性能，并在每个患者 146 毫秒内完成 3,621 个试验的检索。
Motivation: 现有临床试验检索多基于关键词和嵌入相似度，将资格条件视为软信号而非硬性约束，导致低召回率、低精确率和有限的可解释性；而临床试验匹配是高风险的现实问题，大量试验难以达到入组目标。
Method: SatIR 借助既有医学本体论，用 LLM 把非正式临床推理转换为显式、精确、可控且可解释的 SMT 约束；随后将 SMT 匹配问题投影到关系代数上，通过高效数据库实现保持高召回率并牺牲少量精确率。
Result: 在 SIGIR 2016 上，SatIR 相比 TrialGPT 风格检索，每个患者多检索到 32%-72% 的相关且合格试验；在 TREC 2022 派生基准上达到 1.8-3.2 倍的合格试验召回率；检索延迟为每个患者 146 毫秒（覆盖 3,621 个 SIGIR 试验）。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将资格条件建模为可满足性约束并以数据库方式执行，能够在临床试验匹配中同时获得高精确率、高召回率、可扩展性和可解释性，明显优于基于相似度的基线。

papers.title: Loop, Think, & Generalize: Implicit Reasoning in Recurrent-Depth Transformers
papers.abstract_en: We study implicit reasoning, i.e. the ability to combine knowledge or rules within a single forward pass. While transformer-based large language models store substantial factual knowledge and rules, they often fail to compose this knowledge for implicit multi-hop reasoning, suggesting a lack of compositional generalization over their parametric knowledge. To address this limitation, we study recurrent-depth transformers, which enables iterative computation over the same transformer layers. We investigate two compositional generalization challenges under the implicit reasoning scenario: systematic generalization, i.e. combining knowledge that is never used for compositions during training, and depth extrapolation, i.e. generalizing from limited reasoning depth (e.g. training on up to 5-hop) to deeper compositions (e.g. 10-hop). Through controlled studies with models trained from scratch, we show that while vanilla transformers struggle with both generalization challenges, recurrent-depth transformers can effectively make such generalization. For systematic generalization, we find that this ability emerges through a three-stage grokking process, transitioning from memorization to in-distribution generalization and finally to systematic generalization, supported by mechanistic analysis. For depth extrapolation, we show that generalization beyond training depth can be unlocked by scaling inference-time recurrence, with more iterations enabling deeper reasoning. We further study how training strategies affect extrapolation, providing guidance on training recurrent-depth transformers, and identify a key limitation, overthinking, where excessive recurrence degrades predictions and limits generalization to very deep compositions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究隐式推理（implicit reasoning），即在单次前向传播中组合知识与规则的能力。作者发现 vanilla Transformer 在组合参数化知识完成多跳推理时泛化不足，而 recurrent-depth Transformer 通过在相同层上迭代计算可以同时应对系统化泛化（systematic generalization）与深度外推（depth extrapolation）两个组合泛化挑战。受控实验表明系统化泛化经由三阶段 grokking 过程出现，深度外推可通过增加推理时迭代次数解锁，并指出过思考（overthinking）这一关键局限。
Motivation: Transformer 大语言模型虽存储大量事实知识与规则，却难以在单次前向中组合这些知识完成隐式多跳推理，反映出对参数化知识的组合泛化缺陷。作者聚焦系统化泛化（组合训练中未出现过的知识）与深度外推（从有限推理深度推广到更深组合）这两个具体挑战。
Method: 采用 recurrent-depth Transformer，让同一组 Transformer 层进行迭代计算；通过在从头训练的受控模型上进行实验，研究系统化泛化与深度外推，并考察训练策略对推理时迭代次数的影响。
Result: vanilla Transformer 在两个泛化挑战上均表现困难，而 recurrent-depth Transformer 能有效泛化。系统化泛化以三阶段 grokking 过程出现（从记忆到分布内泛化再到系统化泛化），并得到机制分析支持；深度外推可以通过扩大推理时迭代次数解锁，更多迭代支持更深推理，但过度迭代会引发 overthinking，降低预测质量并限制极深组合的泛化。
Conclusion: 作者认为 recurrent-depth Transformer 相较 vanilla Transformer 更利于隐式推理中的组合泛化，并给出训练策略建议；同时强调 overthinking 是限制其泛化到很深组合的关键局限。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Validated Synthetic Patient Generation for Small Longitudinal Cohorts: Coagulation Dynamics Across Pregnancy
papers.abstract_en: Small longitudinal cohorts, common in maternal health, rare diseases, and early-phase trials, limit computational modeling because enrollment is slow and the data are too sparse to train reliable models. We present multiplicity-weighted Stochastic Attention (SA), a generative framework based on modern Hopfield networks. Stochastic attention stores real patient profiles as memory patterns in a continuous energy landscape. The resulting distribution is a finite mixture with one component centered on each stored profile. We generated the reported cohort with Langevin dynamics; direct sampling from the same distribution reproduced its fidelity and membership-inference results. Multiplicity weights amplify selected subgroups at inference time without retraining. We applied the method to longitudinal coagulation data from 23 patients, with 72 features measured before pregnancy and during the first and third trimesters. The cohort included three patients with polycystic ovary syndrome and five who developed preeclampsia. Across statistical, structural, and mechanistic tests, including a separately specified coagulation model that was blind to the generator but calibrated on the same cohort, the synthetic profiles closely matched the real profiles under the measures applied at this sample size. A model calibrated on synthetic profiles predicted held-out real-patient TGA measurements as well as one calibrated on real profiles. These results provide proof of concept for using SA in the tested modeling tasks, including mechanistic calibration and hypothesis generation, with very small longitudinal cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于现代 Hopfield 网络的乘性加权随机注意力（multiplicity-weighted Stochastic Attention, SA）生成框架，用于小规模纵向队列的合成患者生成。该方法把真实患者档案作为记忆模式存入连续能量景观，得到以每个档案为中心的有限混合分布；对 23 名孕妇的凝血动态数据（72 个特征，覆盖孕前、第一和第三孕期）进行生成与验证。摘要报告合成档案在统计、结构和机制检验下与真实档案高度吻合，且用合成档案校准的模型对留出真实患者 TGA 测量的预测能力与用真实档案校准的模型相当。
Motivation: 母体健康、罕见病和早期试验中常见的小规模纵向队列因入组缓慢、数据过于稀疏而难以训练可靠的计算模型，限制了机制建模与假设生成。
Method: 提出 multi-weighted Stochastic Attention (SA)，基于现代 Hopfield 网络的生成式框架；随机注意力将真实患者档案作为记忆模式存储在连续能量景观中，生成分布为每个存储档案对应一个分量的有限混合。使用 Langevin 动力学生成队列，推理时乘性权重可在不重训练的情况下放大选定亚组。
Result: 在 23 名患者的妊娠期凝血纵向数据（含 3 名多囊卵巢综合征和 5 名子痫前期患者）上，合成档案在统计、结构和机制测试中与真实档案接近，其中机制测试使用一个对生成器盲置但用同一队列校准的独立凝血模型；用合成档案校准的模型对留出真实患者 TGA 测量的预测表现不逊于用真实档案校准的模型。
Conclusion: 摘要将该工作定位为 SA 在极小型纵向队列上进行机制校准和假设生成任务的概念验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: RankFormer: A Propose-then-Select Transformer for Multi-Agent Multimodal Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Predicting traffic agent trajectories plays an important role in autonomous driving, traffic operations, transportation safety analysis, etc. Although many deep learning algorithms are devised to predict future agent trajectories, the trajectory prediction problem is still challenging due to the complexity of decision-making process, interactions with surrounding vehicles, and the existence of multiple possible intentions for the traveling agents even under similar scenarios. Most existing methods are limited by the requirement of graph structures (e.g., Graph Neural Network) or the requirement of manually labeled intentions. In this study, we propose a pure Transformer-based deep learning model for multi-modal trajectory prediction considering temporal dependencies and agent-agent spatial interactions. After encoding the historical trajectories, two parallel decoders are employed to generate trajectories and probabilities on separate decoder tracks. The model is evaluated on two real-world datasets, one highway dataset and the other pedestrian dataset with solid performance. One important insight is that following a ``propose-then-select'' strategy, the agent-agent spatial interactions are only considered for probability estimation instead of trajectory generation. In summary, the proposed model provides a potential direction to design more robust and effective multi-modal trajectory prediction models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RankFormer，一种纯 Transformer 的多智能体多模态轨迹预测模型，用于预测交通参与者的未来轨迹。模型在编码历史轨迹后采用两个并行解码器，分别在独立解码轨道上生成轨迹与对应概率；其遵循“先提出后选择”（propose-then-select）策略，只在概率估计阶段利用智能体间的空间交互。模型在一条高速公路数据集和一条行人数据集上评估，摘要称性能扎实。
Motivation: 轨迹预测仍具挑战性，因为决策过程复杂、周围车辆交互影响大，且相似场景下存在多种可能的行驶意图。现有方法大多依赖图结构（如 GNN）或需要人工标注意图，存在应用限制。
Method: 构建纯 Transformer 的深度模型，编码历史轨迹后由两个并行解码器分别输出轨迹和概率；采用 propose-then-select 设计，使 agent-agent 空间交互仅参与概率估计而非轨迹生成，从而解耦轨迹生成与概率打分。
Result: 模型在两个真实世界数据集（一个高速公路数据集、一个行人数据集）上取得扎实性能，并得到关键结论：空间交互只需用于概率估计即可。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: propose-then-select 策略为设计更鲁棒、更有效的多模态轨迹预测模型提供了潜在方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Planning Task Shielding: Detecting and Repairing Flaws in Planning Tasks through Turning them Unsolvable
papers.abstract_en: Most research in planning focuses on generating a plan to achieve a desired set of goals. However, a goal specification can also be used to encode a property that should never hold, allowing a planner to identify a trace that would reach a flawed state. In such cases, the objective may shift to modifying the planning task to ensure that the flawed state is never reached, in other words, to make the planning task unsolvable. In this paper we introduce planning task shielding: the problem of detecting and repairing flaws in planning tasks. We propose three different approaches to solve these tasks, each aiming to minimize the number of modifications to the original actions that render the planning task unsolvable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出规划任务屏蔽 (planning task shielding) 问题：在经典规划中，将目标规范解释为不应成立的缺陷状态，并通过修改规划任务使该状态不可达，即让规划任务变得不可解，从而检测和修复任务缺陷。作者提出三种不同求解方法，它们都以最小化对原始动作的修改数量为目标。摘要层面未报告具体实验数据。
Motivation: 大多数规划研究关注如何生成达到目标的计划，而本文利用目标规范去编码不应发生的属性，并转向修改规划任务本身，使缺陷状态永远不会被到达。这补充了经典规划中较少被研究的任务缺陷检测与修复方向。
Method: 提出规划任务屏蔽的三种不同方法，用于检测并修复规划任务中的缺陷；三种方法均以最小化对原始动作的修改数量为优化目标，使原本可能到达缺陷状态的任务变得不可解。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，把缺陷状态不可达转化为规划任务不可解性，为检测和修复规划任务缺陷提供了新的问题视角；三种方法的具体性能与相互比较未在摘要中给出。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: BiScale-GTR: Fragment-Aware Graph Transformers for Multi-Scale Molecular Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Fragment-level representations provide a natural way to capture recurring molecular substructures and reuse their learned representations across molecules. However, a shared fragment identity alone may not fully describe how a fragment is instantiated in a particular molecule, since the same fragment can exhibit different chemical behavior depending on its surrounding atomic environment. Effective fragment-based molecular learning therefore requires representations that are both reusable across molecules and sensitive to local atomic context. We introduce BiScale-GTR, a self-supervised molecular representation framework built around context-grounded shared fragment tokens. BiScale-GTR constructs a reusable graph Byte Pair Encoding (graph-BPE) vocabulary using Weisfeiler-Lehman (WL)-based fragment identity, chemical validity filtering, and recursive out-of-vocabulary (OOV) decomposition. Each shared fragment token is then grounded with atom-level GNN representations through atom-to-fragment pooling and gated fusion, allowing the same fragment identity to acquire context-dependent representations in different molecular environments. A structure-aware fragment Transformer performs global reasoning over these atom-grounded tokens, capturing reusable substructure identity, local chemical context, and long-range molecular dependencies. Experiments on MoleculeNet, PharmaBench, and the Long Range Graph Benchmark demonstrate strong performance across classification and regression tasks. Attribution analysis further shows that BiScale-GTR highlights chemically meaningful recurring motifs, providing interpretable links between molecular structure and predicted properties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BiScale-GTR 是一个面向分子表示学习的自监督框架，核心是上下文锚定的共享片段 token（context-grounded shared fragment tokens）。它先用基于 Weisfeiler-Lehman 的片段身份、化学有效性过滤和递归 OOV 分解构建可复用的图 BPE（graph-BPE）词表，再通过原子到片段的池化与门控融合把原子级 GNN 表示注入每个共享片段 token，最后用结构感知的片段 Transformer 做全局推理。在 MoleculeNet、PharmaBench 和 Long Range Graph Benchmark 上的分类与回归任务表现良好，归因分析表明模型能突出具有化学意义的重复基序。
Motivation: 片段级表示能捕获可跨分子复用的子结构，但仅共享片段身份不足以描述同一片段在不同分子中的具体行为，因为相同的片段会因周围原子环境的差异而表现出不同化学性质。因此需要同时具备跨分子可复用性与局部原子上下文敏感性的表示。
Method: 提出 BiScale-GTR 框架：利用 WL 片段身份、化学有效性过滤和递归 OOV 分解构建可复用 graph-BPE 词表；将共享片段 token 通过原子到片段池化（atom-to-fragment pooling）和门控融合（gated fusion）与原子级 GNN 表示结合，使同一片段身份在不同分子环境中获得上下文相关表示；再由结构感知的片段 Transformer 对这些原子锚定 token 进行全局推理。
Result: 在 MoleculeNet、PharmaBench 和 Long Range Graph Benchmark 上的分类与回归任务中取得强性能；归因分析显示模型能突出化学上有意义的重复基序，提供分子结构与预测性质之间的可解释联系。
Conclusion: 作者认为将共享片段身份与局部原子上下文结合的方式可以同时兼顾片段的可复用性和环境敏感性，并为分子性质预测提供可解释的结构线索。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning-based Semi-supervised Knowledge Distillation with LLM-as-a-Judge
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) substantially improves the reasoning capabilities of language models, but most existing RL fine-tuning approaches rely entirely on ground-truth verifiable rewards and thus labeled datasets with verifiable answers. To overcome this, we propose a RL framework for reasoning distillation that leverages continuous, LLM-based rewards. Our method employs an efficient mechanism that computes a continuous CoT reward (CCR) directly from a single-token logit of a judge LLM, evaluating the student model's reasoning trajectory. This formulation provides an effective and scalable online training signal that can be applied to large volumes of unlabeled data. We demonstrate that, when paired with a strong judge, simply using CCR achieves performance comparable to that of ground-truth or pseudo-label verifiable rewards, and even surpasses them as the amount of unlabeled data increases. Furthermore, we find that combining them in a semi-supervised setup is highly synergistic: verifiable rewards help stabilize the CCR, while CCR improves the generalizability of verifiable rewards to related tasks. We also provide a comprehensive empirical comparison of various reward sources across multiple model architectures and dataset sizes. Our results show that this semi-supervised approach consistently enhances mathematical reasoning, yielding an absolute improvement of 5-10% on multiple reasoning tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于强化学习 (RL) 的半监督知识蒸馏框架，利用 LLM-as-a-Judge 提供连续奖励，从而摆脱对可验证答案标注数据的依赖。核心机制是从评判模型的单 token logit 直接计算连续思维链奖励 (CCR)，为大规模无标签数据提供可扩展的在线训练信号。实验表明，配合强评判模型时 CCR 在数学推理任务上可与地面真值或伪标签可验证奖励相当，并在无标签数据增多时超过它们；与可验证奖励在半监督设置下组合具有协同效应，在多个推理任务上取得 5-10% 的绝对提升。
Motivation: 现有 RL 微调方法大多依赖可验证的奖励信号，因此需要带可验证答案的标注数据集，限制了其在大规模无标签数据上的应用。
Method: 提出面向推理蒸馏的 RL 框架，使用连续的 LLM 奖励；通过评判模型 (judge LLM) 的单个 token logit 高效计算连续 CoT 奖励 (CCR)，并将其作为在线训练信号，同时探索半监督设置下与可验证奖励 (verifiable rewards) 的组合使用。
Result: 摘要报告，配合强评判模型时，仅使用 CCR 即可达到与地面真值或伪标签可验证奖励相当的性能，且随着无标签数据增加而超越它们；半监督组合中可验证奖励稳定 CCR，而 CCR 提升可验证奖励在相关任务上的泛化性；在多个推理任务上取得 5-10% 的绝对提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调半监督方式能一致地增强数学推理能力，并指出 CCR 与可验证奖励之间存在强协同效应。
