papers.title: Evaluation and Hardening of LLM System Instructions Against Extraction via Encoding Attacks
papers.abstract_en: System Instructions in Large Language Models (LLMs) are commonly used to enforce safety policies, define agent behavior, and protect sensitive operational context in agentic AI applications. These instructions may contain sensitive information such as API credentials, internal policies, and privileged workflow definitions, making system instruction leakage a critical security risk highlighted in the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Without incurring the overhead costs of reasoning models, many LLM applications rely on refusal-based instructions that block direct requests for system instructions, implicitly assuming that prohibited information can only be extracted through explicit queries. We introduce an automated evaluation framework that tests whether system instructions remain confidential when extraction requests are re-framed as encoding or structured output tasks. Across seven common models and 46 verified system instructions, we observe high attack success rates (>0.7) for structured serialization where models refuse direct extraction requests but disclose protected content in the requested serialization formats. We further demonstrate a mitigation strategy based on one-shot instruction reshaping using a Chain-of-Thought reasoning model, indicating that even subtle changes in wording and structure of system instructions can significantly reduce attack success rate without requiring model retraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动化评估框架，检验将系统指令提取请求重构成编码或结构化输出任务时，LLM 系统指令是否仍能保持机密。在七个常见模型和 46 条经验证的系统指令上，结构化序列化场景的攻击成功率很高（>0.7），模型虽拒绝直接提取请求，却会在所请求的序列化格式中泄露受保护内容。作者还展示了一种基于 Chain-of-Thought 推理模型的一次性指令重塑缓解策略，可在无需重新训练模型的情况下显著降低攻击成功率。
Motivation: LLM 系统指令常包含 API 凭证、内部策略等敏感信息，而许多应用依赖基于拒绝的指令来拦截直接请求，隐含假设禁止信息只能通过显式查询提取。该假设忽略了编码或结构化输出任务这一绕过路径，构成 OWASP Top 10 中提到的系统指令泄露安全风险。
Method: 引入自动化评估框架，将提取请求重构为编码任务和结构化输出任务来测试系统指令的机密性；缓解策略采用一次性指令重塑（one-shot instruction reshaping），借助 Chain-of-Thought 推理模型改写系统指令的措辞与结构。
Result: 在七个常见模型和 46 条系统指令上的评估显示，结构化序列化任务的攻击成功率超过 0.7；指令重塑缓解策略在无需重新训练的情况下显著降低了攻击成功率。
Conclusion: 摘要强调即使是系统指令措辞和结构的细微改变也能大幅降低被提取的风险，为不依赖推理模型开销的 LLM 应用提供了一种轻量级加固思路。

papers.title: Lipschitz Dueling Bandits over Continuous Action Spaces
papers.abstract_en: We study for the first time, stochastic dueling bandits over continuous action spaces with Lipschitz structure, where feedback is purely comparative. While dueling bandits and Lipschitz bandits have been studied separately, their combination has remained unexplored. We propose the first algorithm for Lipschitz dueling bandits, using round-based exploration and recursive region elimination guided by an adaptive reference arm. We develop new analytical tools for relative feedback and prove a regret bound of $\tilde O\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}\right)$, where $d_z$ is the zooming dimension of the near-optimal region. Further, our algorithm takes only logarithmic space in terms of the total time horizon, best achievable by any bandit algorithm over a continuous action space.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次研究连续动作空间上具有 Lipschitz 结构的随机决斗老虎机（dueling bandits），其中反馈仅为相对比较。作者提出该设置下的第一个算法，采用基于轮次的探索和由自适应参考臂引导的递归区域消除，并证明遗憾界为 $\tilde O\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}\right)$，其中 $d_z$ 是近最优区域的 zooming dimension。算法还只用总时间视界的对数空间，作者称这是连续动作空间中任何 bandit 算法可达到的最优空间复杂度。
Motivation: 决斗老虎机和 Lipschitz bandit 此前分别被研究，但两者的结合尚未被探索；在连续动作空间上仅有相对比较反馈时，如何利用 Lipschitz 结构实现高效学习是一个开放问题。
Method: 提出用于 Lipschitz 决斗老虎机的首个算法，核心是轮次式探索（round-based exploration）配合由自适应参考臂（adaptive reference arm）引导的递归区域消除（recursive region elimination），并开发了针对相对反馈的新分析工具。
Result: 摘要证明其遗憾界为 $\tilde O\left(T^{\frac{d_z+1}{d_z+2}}\right)$，其中 $d_z$ 为近最优区域的 zooming dimension；同时算法空间复杂度仅为总时间视界的对数级，并声称这一空间复杂度是连续动作空间上任何 bandit 算法所能达到的最好水平。
Conclusion: 该工作填补了 Lipschitz 连续动作空间与决斗 bandit 结合的研究空白，给出了第一个算法及其遗憾与空间复杂度保证。

papers.title: Covert Visual Prompt Injection against Commercial Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, their instruction-following behavior leaves them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks. Existing prompt injection methods predominantly rely on textual prompts or perceptible visual prompts that are observable by human users. In this work, we study imperceptible visual prompt injection against powerful closed-source MLLMs, where adversarial instructions are embedded in the visual modality. Our method adaptively embeds the malicious prompt into the input image via a bounded text overlay to provide semantic guidance. Meanwhile, the imperceptible visual perturbation is iteratively optimized to align the feature representation of the attacked image with those of the malicious visual and textual targets at both coarse- and fine-grained levels. Specifically, the visual target is instantiated as a text-rendered image and progressively refined during optimization to more faithfully represent the desired semantics and improve transferability. Extensive experiments on two multimodal understanding tasks across multiple closed-source MLLMs demonstrate the superior performance of our approach compared to existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究针对闭源多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的不可感知视觉提示注入攻击。方法将恶意指令以有界文本叠加方式嵌入输入图像以提供语义引导，并迭代优化不可感知的视觉扰动，使被攻击图像的特征表示在粗粒度与细粒度层面与恶意视觉目标及文本目标对齐。在多个闭源 MLLM 的两个多模态理解任务上，该方法性能优于现有提示注入方法。
Motivation: 现有多数提示注入攻击主要依赖文本提示或人类可感知的视觉提示，容易被用户察觉。随着闭源 MLLM 在实际场景中部署增加，其指令跟随行为使其易受攻击，因此需要研究不可感知的视觉模态提示注入。
Method: 提出一种不可感知的视觉提示注入方法：通过有界的文本叠加 (bounded text overlay) 将恶意提示嵌入输入图像以提供语义引导，并迭代优化不可感知的视觉扰动，使被攻击图像的表示分别在粗粒度与细粒度上对齐恶意视觉目标与文本目标；视觉目标被实例化为文本渲染图像，并在优化中逐步细化以更忠实表达语义并提升可迁移性 (transferability)。
Result: 在两个多模态理解任务上、针对多个闭源 MLLM 的实验表明，所提方法优于现有提示注入方法；摘要未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在强大闭源 MLLM 上的优越性能，但未讨论明确局限或防御措施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GridVAD: Open-Set Video Anomaly Detection via Spatial Reasoning over Stratified Frame Grids
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are powerful open-set reasoners, yet their direct use as anomaly detectors in video surveillance is fragile: without calibrated anomaly priors, they alternate between missed detections and hallucinated false alarms. We argue the problem is not the VLM itself but how it is used. VLMs should function as anomaly proposers, generating open-set candidate descriptions that are then grounded and tracked by purpose-built spatial and temporal modules. We instantiate this propose-ground-propagate principle in GridVAD, a training-free pipeline that produces pixel-level anomaly masks without any domain-specific training. A VLM reasons over stratified grid representations of video clips to generate natural-language anomaly proposals. Self-Consistency Consolidation (SCC) filters hallucinations by retaining only proposals that recur across multiple independent samplings. Grounding DINO anchors each surviving proposal to a bounding box, and SAM2 propagates it as a dense mask through the anomaly interval. The per-clip model budget is fixed at M+1 calls regardless of video length, where M can be set according to the proposals needed. On UCSD Ped2, GridVAD achieves the highest Pixel-AUROC (77.59) among all compared methods, surpassing even the partially fine-tuned TAO (75.11) and outperforms other zero-shot approaches on object-level RBDC by over 5x. Ablations reveal that SCC provides a controllable precision-recall tradeoff: filtering improves all pixel level metrics at a modest cost in object-level recall. Efficiency experiments show GridVAD is 2.7x more call-efficient than uniform per-frame VLM querying while additionally producing dense segmentation masks.Code and qualitative video results are available at https://gridvad.github.io.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LVOS) Workshop in conjunction with ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GridVAD，一种无需训练的开放集视频异常检测流水线，贯彻 propose-ground-propagate 原则：VLM 在分层帧网格表示上生成自然语言异常提案，Self-Consistency Consolidation (SCC) 通过多次独立采样过滤幻觉，Grounding DINO 将提案锚定为边界框，SAM2 将边界框传播为异常区间内的密集掩码。在 UCSD Ped2 上 GridVAD 取得 77.59 的 Pixel-AUROC，超过部分微调的 TAO (75.11)，并在 object-level RBDC 上领先其他零样本方法 5 倍以上。
Motivation: 直接使用 VLM 作为视频监控异常检测器不可靠，缺乏校准的异常先验会导致漏检与幻觉误报并存。作者认为问题不在 VLM 本身，而在于使用方式，应让其只承担开放集提案生成的角色。
Method: 提出 propose-ground-propagate 流水线：VLM 对分层帧网格 (stratified frame grids) 的视频片段进行推理以生成开放集异常描述；SCC 仅保留多次独立采样中反复出现的提案以抑制幻觉；Grounding DINO 将每个存活提案锚定到边界框，SAM2 将边界框传播为异常区间内的密集掩码。每个片段的模型调用预算固定为 M+1 次，与视频长度无关，M 可按所需提案数设置。
Result: 在 UCSD Ped2 上取得所有对比方法中最高的 Pixel-AUROC (77.59)，超过部分微调的 TAO (75.11)，并比其他零样本方法在 object-level RBDC 上高出 5 倍以上。消融显示 SCC 提供可控的精确率-召回率权衡；效率实验显示 GridVAD 比逐帧 VLM 查询节省 2.7 倍调用，且额外产出密集分割掩码。
Conclusion: 该训练无关流水线无需任何领域专有训练即可生成像素级异常掩码，并公开了代码与定性视频结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Does Explanation Correctness Matter? Linking Computational XAI Evaluation to Human Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Explainable AI (XAI) methods are commonly evaluated using functional correctness metrics, sometimes termed faithfulness or fidelity, which estimate how closely an explanation reflects the model's reasoning. Higher correctness is assumed to produce better human understanding, but this link has not been tested with controlled levels. We conducted a user study (N=200) that manipulated explanation correctness at four levels (100%, 85%, 70%, 55%) in a synthetic time series classification task where participants could not rely on domain knowledge or visual intuition. Correctness was defined against a known ground truth, not estimated from a trained model. Participants predicted a simulated AI's decisions from feature-attribution-style explanations (forward simulation), and we used their forward simulation accuracy as a proxy for understanding. Correctness affected understanding, but not at every level: forward simulation accuracy dropped at 70% and 55% relative to fully correct explanations, with no further reduction below 70% and no conclusive difference between 85% and 100%. Lower correctness reduced how many participants predicted accurately rather than lowering accuracy uniformly, and even fully correct explanations did not guarantee understanding: forward simulation accuracy was bimodal there, with only a subset of participants well above chance. In exploratory analyses, some participants predicted decisions accurately but described the wrong pattern when asked what the AI used, and self-reported ratings correlated with forward simulation accuracy only when explanations were fully correct. These findings show that not all differences in functional correctness translate to differences in human understanding, highlighting the need to validate functional metrics against human outcomes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个 N=200 的用户研究，在合成时间序列分类任务中以四个受控正确性水平（100%、85%、70%、55%）操纵解释的正确性，并以参与者的前向模拟准确率作为理解程度的代理。结果发现正确性确实影响理解，但并非在每个水平上都如此：与前向模拟准确率在 70% 和 55% 时相比完全正确的解释显著下降，而 85% 与 100% 之间无显著差异；即使完全正确的解释也不能保证理解，其前向模拟准确率呈双峰分布。
Motivation: 可解释 AI（XAI）方法通常用功能性正确性指标（faithfulness 或 fidelity）评估，假设解释越正确则人的理解越好，但这一假设从未在受控的正确性水平下得到检验。
Method: 作者设计用户研究，在参与者无法依赖领域知识或视觉直觉的合成时间序列分类任务中，针对已知 ground truth 定义解释正确性，而非从训练好的模型估计；参与者根据特征归因式解释预测模拟 AI 的决策（前向模拟），用该预测准确率作为理解程度的代理。
Result: 正确性影响理解但存在非单调性：前向模拟准确率在 70% 和 55% 时较完全正确解释下降，低于 70% 后不再进一步降低，85% 与 100% 之间无定论性差异。较低正确性主要减少能够准确预测的参与者人数而非均匀拉低准确率；即使完全正确的解释下准确率也呈双峰分布，仅部分参与者显著高于随机水平。探索性分析还发现部分参与者预测准确但口头描述的模式错误，且自我报告评分仅在解释完全正确时与前向模拟准确率相关。
Conclusion: 并非所有功能性正确性差异都会转化为人类理解的差异，这凸显了需要用人类结果来验证功能性指标的可靠性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: UniScale: Synergistic Entire Space Data and Model Scaling for Search Ranking
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have inspired a surge of scaling research in industrial search, advertising, and recommendation systems. However, existing approaches focus mainly on architectural improvements, overlooking the critical synergy between data and architecture design. We observe that scaling model parameters alone exhibits diminishing returns, and that the performance degradation caused by complex heterogeneous data distributions is often irrecoverable through model design alone. In this paper, we propose UniScale, a novel co-design framework that jointly optimizes data and architecture to unlock the full potential of model scaling. UniScale includes two core parts: (1) ES$^3$ (Entire-Space Sample System), a high-quality data scaling system that expands the training signal beyond conventional sampling strategies through intra-domain expansion with hierarchical label attribution and cross-domain searchification; and (2) HHSFT (Heterogeneous Hierarchical Sample Fusion Transformer), a novel architecture that effectively models the complex heterogeneous distribution of scaled data via Heterogeneous Hierarchical Feature Interaction and Entire Space User Interest Fusion, thereby surpassing the performance ceiling of structure-only model tuning. Extensive experiments on large-scale industrial datasets demonstrate that UniScale achieves significant improvements and exhibits clear scaling trends. Online A/B tests on a real-world E-commerce search platform confirm that UniScale consistently outperforms strong production baselines, achieving 1.70% and 2.04% increases in user purchase and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniScale，一个面向工业搜索排序的协同设计框架，联合优化数据和架构以释放模型扩展潜力。框架包含 ES^3（Entire-Space Sample System）数据扩展系统和 HHSFT（Heterogeneous Hierarchical Sample Fusion Transformer）架构。在大型工业数据集上的实验显示显著提升和清晰扩展趋势，电商搜索平台在线 A/B 测试中用户购买和 GMV 分别提升 1.70% 和 2.04%。核心观察是仅扩展模型参数收益递减，复杂异构数据分布带来的性能退化难以仅靠模型设计恢复。
Motivation: 现有搜索、广告、推荐系统中的扩展研究主要聚焦架构改进，忽略数据与架构设计之间的协同；模型参数单独扩展存在收益递减，复杂异构数据分布导致的性能退化往往无法通过模型设计单独修复。
Method: 提出 UniScale 协同设计框架，包含 ES^3 数据扩展系统，通过域内扩展（intra-domain expansion）配合分层标签归属（hierarchical label attribution）和跨域搜索化（cross-domain searchification）扩大训练信号；以及 HHSFT 架构，通过异构分层特征交互（Heterogeneous Hierarchical Feature Interaction）和全空间用户兴趣融合（Entire Space User Interest Fusion）建模扩展数据的异构分布。
Result: 大规模工业数据集实验表明 UniScale 带来显著提升并呈现清晰扩展趋势；真实电商搜索平台在线 A/B 测试持续优于强生产基线，用户购买和 GMV 分别提升 1.70% 和 2.04%。
Conclusion: 数据和架构协同设计能够超越仅调整模型结构（structure-only model tuning）的性能上限，是充分释放模型扩展潜力的关键；其适用场景为工业搜索排序。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $\mathrm{ECI}_{\mathrm{sem}}$: Semantic Residual Effective Contrastive Information for Evaluating Hard Negatives
papers.abstract_en: Hard-negative source selection for dense retrieval is usually decided only after fine-tuning and downstream evaluation. We propose ECIsem, a validity-weighted diagnostic that ranks candidate hard-negative sources using frozen target-encoder embeddings. ECIsem is training-free, not label-free: each scored example requires a query, a labeled positive, and an explicit candidate negative. Each negative is weighted by target consistency, semantic locality, and lexical residuality, and the source score aggregates weighted residual directions through a log-determinant. At the scale we study, the log-determinant operates in its linear regime, so the score reduces to the mean validity weight; we report this reduction as a finding, and gate ablations show that a single lexical scalar, mean lexical residuality, reproduces the transfer ordering in every block. On MS MARCO negative sources, in-family ECIsem recovers the aggregate BEIR transfer ordering across DistilBERT, E5-base, and Contriever. Constructed controls expose an identifiability limit: a plausible false negative is non-inverted, near the positive, and lexically novel, exactly the profile the gates reward, and across twelve weightings of the three gates and three backbones only one of thirty-six cells is safe, and it is not transfer aligned, a limit that extends to margin-style filters built from the same statistics. The same gate statistics separate the controls sharply when used as audit features rather than as rewards, so we pair the score with a reported audit profile instead of a reweighting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ECIsem，一种无需训练的诊断指标，用于在微调之前对稠密检索的困难负样本（hard negative）来源进行排序。它利用冻结的目标编码器嵌入，通过目标一致性、语义局部性和词汇残差性对每个候选负样本加权，并用 log-determinant 聚合加权残差方向。作者发现，在所研究的规模下 log-determinant 处于线性区间，分数退化为平均有效性权重；在 MS MARCO 负样本来源上，该指标能在 DistilBERT、E5-base 和 Contriever 上恢复聚合的 BEIR 迁移排序，但也暴露了可辨识性限制。
Motivation: 稠密检索的困难负样本来源选择通常只能在微调和下游评测之后才能确定，缺少训练前即可使用的诊断工具。论文希望用冻结的目标编码器嵌入，在训练前对候选负样本来源进行排序，以避免昂贵的试错。
Method: 提出 ECIsem，一个基于有效性加权的诊断指标：每个样本需要查询、标注正例和显式候选负例；每个负例按目标一致性（target consistency）、语义局部性（semantic locality）和词汇残差性（lexical residuality）加权，来源分数通过 log-determinant 聚合加权残差方向。作者同时设计构造对照（constructed controls）来检验该指标的局限性，并引入审计画像（audit profile）替代重新加权。
Result: 在 MS MARCO 负样本来源上，族内（in-family）ECIsem 能恢复 DistilBERT、E5-base 和 Contriever 上聚合的 BEIR 迁移排序；门控消融表明单个词汇标量（平均词汇残差性）在每个块中都能复现迁移排序。构造对照暴露了可辨识性极限：在三种门控的十二种加权和三个骨干网络下，三十六个单元中只有一个安全，且该单元并不与迁移对齐；同样的门控统计量作为审计特征而非奖励时能清晰区分对照。
Conclusion: 作者认为 ECIsem 在训练前对困难负样本来源排序是可行的，但其可辨识性有限，因为合理的假负样本恰好具备门控所奖励的特征；因此建议将分数与审计画像配对使用，而不是做重新加权。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discrete Coefficients and Open Invariant Covers in the Homology of Ample Groupoids
papers.abstract_en: The homology of an ample groupoid is computed from the complex of compactly supported continuous functions on the nerve. Two hypotheses routinely imposed on this complex behave in opposite ways. We show that the comparison map from the integral chain complex tensored with the coefficient group to the chain complex with coefficients is always injective, and that it is surjective if and only if every compactly supported continuous function into the coefficient group is locally constant. The universal coefficient theorem for ample groupoids is therefore a discrete coefficient statement, and it already fails for the real numbers on the Cantor set. We then show that a cover of the unit space by two clopen invariant subsets forces the groupoid to split as a disjoint union of three clopen invariant reductions, so that the associated Mayer-Vietoris sequence has vanishing connecting maps and computes nothing. Dropping closedness repairs this, since two open invariant subsets covering the unit space give a Mayer-Vietoris sequence for every topological abelian coefficient group. For an integer action on a two point compactification of the integers we compute that sequence and find that its connecting map is an isomorphism of infinite cyclic groups, which no cover of a unit space by clopen invariant subsets can achieve.
papers.comment: Theorem 1.2 corrects the reading of Theorem 3.3.10
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 ample groupoid（富足群胚）同调中离散系数与不变覆盖的性质。作者证明由积分链复形张量系数群得到的比较映射总为单射，且为满射当且仅当所有紧支撑连续函数到系数群都是局部常值，因此 universal coefficient theorem 本质上是离散系数陈述，并在 Cantor 集上的实数系数情形失效。文章还表明单位空间的两个 clopen 不变子集覆盖会迫使群胚分裂为三个 clopen 不变约化的不交并，从而 Mayer-Vietoris 序列的连接映射为零；而改用开不变覆盖则可得到一般拓扑阿贝尔系数的 Mayer-Vietoris 序列。
Motivation: 以往在同调计算中常对 ample groupoid 的链复形施加两类假设，但这两类假设在行为上恰好相反。作者希望厘清系数离散性与覆盖的开闭性对同调不变量和 Mayer-Vietoris 序列到底产生何种影响。
Method: 通过考察从积分链复形张量系数群到带系数链复形的比较映射，给出其单射与满射的精确条件；并利用单位空间的 clopen 或开不变子集覆盖来构造约化群胚与 Mayer-Vietoris 序列，分析连接映射的平凡性。
Result: 摘要证明比较映射总是单射，且满射等价于紧支撑连续函数为局部常值；由此得出 universal coefficient theorem 对离散系数成立，但对 Cantor 集上的实数系数失败。两个 clopen 不变子集覆盖单位空间会导致连接映射为零；而两个开不变子集覆盖则对所有拓扑阿贝尔系数群给出 Mayer-Vietoris 序列。对整数在双点紧化上的作用，该序列的连接映射是无限循环群之间的同构。
Conclusion: 作者强调 ample groupoid 的 universal coefficient theorem 仅适用于离散系数，并指出不变覆盖的开性而非闭性是获得非平凡连接映射的关键。arXiv 评论说明定理 1.2 修正了定理 3.3.10 的解读。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: UT-ACA: Uncertainty-Triggered Adaptive Context Allocation for Long-Context Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-context inference remains challenging for large language models due to attention dilution and out-of-distribution degradation. Context selection mitigates this limitation by attending to a subset of key-value cache entries, yet most methods allocate a fixed context budget throughout decoding despite highly non-uniform token-level contextual demands. To address this issue, we propose Uncertainty-Triggered Adaptive Context Allocation (UT-ACA), an inference-time framework that dynamically adjusts the context window based on token-wise uncertainty. UT-ACA learns an uncertainty detector that combines semantic embeddings with logit-based confidence while accounting for uncertainty accumulation across decoding steps. When insufficient evidence is indicated, UT-ACA selectively rolls back, expands the context window, and regenerates the token with additional support. Experiments show that UT-ACA substantially reduces average context usage while preserving generation quality in long-context settings. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Tommy307/UT-ACA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UT-ACA（Uncertainty-Triggered Adaptive Context Allocation），一种面向长上下文推理的即插即用（inference-time）框架，根据 token 级不确定性动态调整上下文窗口。UT-ACA 学习一个不确定性检测器，结合语义嵌入与基于 logit 的置信度，并考虑解码步骤间的不确定性累积；当证据不足时，它会选择性回滚、扩大上下文窗口并重新生成相应 token。实验表明该方法在长上下文场景下显著降低平均上下文使用量，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 长上下文推理面临注意力稀释（attention dilution）和分布外退化（out-of-distribution degradation）问题。现有上下文选择方法通常在整个解码过程中分配固定的上下文预算，而 token 级的上下文需求实际上高度不均匀，导致资源浪费或质量下降。
Method: 提出 UT-ACA 框架，通过学习不确定性检测器来计算 token 级不确定性，该检测器融合语义嵌入与基于 logit 的置信度，并显式建模跨解码步骤的不确定性累积。当检测到证据不足时，方法选择性地回滚当前 token、扩大上下文窗口，并借助额外上下文重新生成该 token。
Result: 摘要报告实验表明，UT-ACA 在长上下文设置中大幅降低平均上下文使用量，同时保持生成质量；代码和数据集已公开。
Conclusion: 作者强调，基于 token 级不确定性的动态上下文分配是缓解固定上下文预算局限的有效思路，并提供了开源实现以供复现。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: What DINO saw: ALiBi positional encoding reduces positional bias in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Vision transformers (ViTs) - especially feature foundation models like DINOv2 - learn rich representations useful for many downstream tasks. However, architectural choices (such as positional encoding) can lead to these models displaying positional biases and artefacts independent of semantic content. This makes zero-shot adaption difficult in fields like material science, where images are often cross-sections of homogeneous microstructure (i.e. having no preferred direction). In this work, we investigate the positional bias in ViTs via linear probing, finding it present across a range of objectives and positional encodings, and subsequently reduce it by finetuning models to use ALiBi relative positional encoding. We demonstrate that these models retain desirable general semantics and their unbiased features can be used successfully in trainable segmentation of complex microscopy images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉 Transformer（尤其特征基础模型 DINOv2）中的位置偏差，发现该偏差在多种训练目标和位置编码下均存在，且与语义内容无关。作者通过微调模型使用 ALiBi 相对位置编码来降低这种偏差，并证明模型仍保留通用语义，其无偏特征可成功用于复杂显微镜图像的可训练分割。
Motivation: 位置编码会使 ViT 学到与语义无关的位置偏差与伪影，导致在无优选方向的材料科学图像（如均匀微观组织截面）上难以进行零样本适配。
Method: 使用线性探针 (linear probing) 系统评估 ViT 的位置偏差，然后对模型进行微调，将其改为使用 ALiBi 相对位置编码以抑制位置偏差。
Result: 摘要报告位置偏差在多种目标和位置编码下都存在；采用 ALiBi 微调后模型保留良好的通用语义，且无偏特征可有效用于复杂显微镜图像的可训练分割。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 ALiBi 相对位置编码能在降低位置偏差的同时保留语义特征，从而改善材料科学等跨域图像任务上的适配能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Lost in Aggregation: On a Fundamental Expressivity Limit of Message-Passing Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We define an information-complexity property for aggregation functions, capturing a vast range of practical aggregations, and prove that any Message-Passing Graph Neural Network (MP-GNN) model with such aggregations induces only a polynomial number of equivalence classes on all graphs - while the number of non-isomorphic graphs is super-exponential (in number of vertices). Adding a familiar perspective, we observe that merely 2 iterations of Color Refinement (CR) induce at least an exponential number of equivalence classes, making the aforementioned MP-GNNs relatively infinitely weaker. Previous studies state that sum-aggregation MP-GNNs match full CR however they consider a weak, 'non-uniform', notion of distinguishing-power where each graph size may require a different MP-GNN to distinguish graphs up to that size. Our results concern both distinguishing between non-equivariant vertices and distinguishing between non-isomorphic graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究消息传递图神经网络（MP-GNN）的表达能力极限。作者定义一个覆盖大量实际聚合函数的“信息复杂度”性质，并证明：使用这类聚合的 MP-GNN 在所有图上只能诱导多项式数量的等价类，而全部非同构图的数目是超指数的。作为对照，仅 2 轮 Color Refinement 就能诱导至少指数多个等价类，因此前述 MP-GNN 相对而言无限弱。作者还指出，此前关于求和聚合 MP-GNN 匹配完整 Color Refinement 的结论依赖一种“非均匀”的区分能力概念，即不同图规模可选用不同的 MP-GNN。
Motivation: 现有研究通常将 MP-GNN 的表达力与 Weisfeiler-Leman/Color Refinement 比较，但对聚合函数本身的一般性限制刻画不足，且以往等价性结果常依赖每个图规模分别选取不同网络的非均匀区分概念。作者希望给出一个更基础、面向全部图的表达力上限。
Method: 定义聚合函数的信息复杂度性质，涵盖大量实际使用的聚合；基于该性质证明任何采用此类聚合的 MP-GNN 在整个图族上只能诱导多项式个等价类，并利用 Color Refinement 诱导的等价类数量进行对照分析。
Result: 作者证明：使用这类聚合的 MP-GNN 在所有图上诱导的等价类数量至多是多项式的，而同构图数量是超指数的；仅 2 轮 Color Refinement 即可诱导至少指数多个等价类，因此这些 MP-GNN 相对无限弱。该结论同时适用于区分非同构顶点与区分非同构图。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，就整体图族上的区分能力而言，涵盖广泛实际聚合的 MP-GNN 存在根本性表达力上限；不能仅凭与完整 Color Refinement 匹配的“非均匀”结果来宣称这类网络与 CR 等价。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.motivation: 现有研究通常将 MP-GNN 的表达力与 Weisfeiler-Leman/Color Refinement 比较，但对聚合函数本身的一般性限制刻画不足，且以往等价性结果常依赖每个图规模分别选取不同网络的非均匀区分概念。作者希望给出一个更基础、面向全部图的表达力上限。
summary_sections.method: 定义聚合函数的信息复杂度性质，涵盖大量实际使用的聚合；基于该性质证明任何采用此类聚合的 MP-GNN 在整个图族上只能诱导多项式个等价类，并利用 Color Refinement 诱导的等价类数量进行对照分析。
summary_sections.result: 作者证明：使用这类聚合的 MP-GNN 在所有图上诱导的等价类数量至多是多项式的，而同构图数量是超指数的；仅 2 轮 Color Refinement 即可诱导至少指数多个等价类，因此这些 MP-GNN 相对无限弱。该结论同时适用于区分非同构顶点与区分非同构图。
summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调，就整体图族上的区分能力而言，涵盖广泛实际聚合的 MP-GNN 存在根本性表达力上限；不能仅凭与完整 Color Refinement 匹配的“非均匀”结果来宣称这类网络与 CR 等价。

papers.title: Temporal Straightening for Latent Planning
papers.abstract_en: Learning good representations is essential for latent planning with world models. While pretrained visual encoders produce strong semantic visual features, they are not tailored to planning and contain information irrelevant -- or even detrimental -- to planning. Inspired by the perceptual straightening hypothesis in human visual processing, we introduce temporal straightening to improve representation learning for latent planning. Using a curvature regularizer that encourages locally straightened latent trajectories, we jointly learn an encoder and a predictor of a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world model. We show that reducing curvature this way makes the Euclidean distance in latent space a better proxy for the geodesic distance and improves the conditioning of the planning objective. We demonstrate empirically that temporal straightening makes gradient-based planning more stable and yields significantly higher success rates across a suite of goal-reaching tasks. Our code is available at https://agenticlearning.ai/temporal-straightening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出时间直线化（temporal straightening）方法，受人类视觉处理中感知直线化假设启发，通过曲率正则化鼓励JEPA世界模型的隐轨迹在局部保持直线，从而让隐空间中的欧氏距离更接近测地距离（geodesic distance）并改善规划目标的条件性。实验表明该方法使基于梯度的规划更稳定，并在多个目标达成任务中显著提高成功率。
Motivation: 预训练视觉编码器能产生强语义视觉特征，但并非为规划定制，包含对规划无关甚至有害的信息；因此需要专门针对隐空间规划（latent planning）改进表征学习。
Method: 在Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture（JEPA）世界模型中联合学习编码器和预测器，并引入曲率正则化（curvature regularizer）鼓励局部拉直的隐轨迹，即时间直线化。
Result: 摘要报告降低隐轨迹曲率使欧氏距离成为测地距离的更好近似，并改善规划目标的条件性（conditioning）；实验显示梯度规划更稳定，在一系列目标达成任务中成功率显著提高。
Conclusion: 摘要强调时间直线化能提升隐空间规划的表征质量，并已公开代码；未提及具体局限。

papers.title: Can Computational Reducibility Lead to Transferable Models for Graph Combinatorial Optimization?
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in developing unified neural solvers for combinatorial optimization (CO) is the efficient generalization of models from a given set of tasks to new tasks unseen during initial training. To address this, we first establish a new GNN encoder, which uses a GCON module as a form of expressive message passing together with energy-based unsupervised loss functions. This model achieves highly competitive performance across multiple CO tasks when trained individually on each task. We then leverage knowledge from the computational reducibility literature to propose pretraining and fine-tuning strategies that transfer effectively (a) between MVC, MIS and MaxClique, and (b) in a multi-task learning setting that additionally incorporates MaxCut, MDS and graph coloring. Additionally, in a leave-one-out, multi-task learning setting, we observe that pretraining on all but one task almost always leads to faster convergence on the remaining task when fine-tuning, while avoiding negative transfer. Our findings indicate that learning common representations across multiple graph CO problems is viable through the use of expressive message passing coupled with pretraining strategies that are informed by the polynomial reducibility literature, thereby taking an important step towards enabling the development of foundational models for neural CO. We provide an open source implementation of our work at https://github.com/semihcanturk/COPT-MT.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026; 20 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究统一神经求解器在图组合优化（CO）任务间的迁移泛化。作者提出基于GCON模块的GNN编码器，搭配能量无监督损失函数，在多个CO任务上单独训练即表现有竞争力；随后借用计算可约性（computational reducibility）文献设计预训练与微调策略，在MVC、MIS、MaxClique之间以及加入MaxCut、MDS、图染色的多任务设置中实现有效迁移。在留一法多任务实验中，预训练几乎总是加快剩余任务的微调收敛，且避免负迁移。结果表明，借助表达性消息传递与基于多项式可约性的预训练策略，学习多个图CO问题的公共表示是可行的。
Motivation: 开发统一的神经组合优化求解器时，关键难点是如何使模型从已知任务高效泛化到训练中未见的新任务。现有方法缺乏系统性的跨任务迁移机制。
Method: 提出一种新的GNN编码器，使用GCON模块作为表达性消息传递（expressive message passing）结构，并采用基于能量的无监督损失函数。在此基础上，从计算可约性文献中获取灵感，设计预训练和微调策略，覆盖单任务、多任务及留一法多任务学习设置。
Result: 摘要报告该模型在多个CO任务上单独训练时达到具有竞争力的性能；迁移策略在MVC、MIS、MaxClique之间以及加入MaxCut、MDS和图染色的多任务学习中有效；在留一法设置下，预训练几乎总是加速剩余任务的微调收敛，并避免了负迁移。
Conclusion: 研究显示，通过表达性消息传递与基于多项式可约性文献的预训练策略，可以在多个图CO问题间学习共享表示，为神经CO基础模型的发展迈出重要一步；项目提供开源实现。

papers.title: Exact and Asymptotically Complete Robust Verifications of Neural Networks via Ising Solvers
papers.abstract_en: We present an Ising-compatible framework for formal neural-network robustness verification under bounded input perturbations. For piecewise-linear activations, the Exact Logarithmic PWL Model (Log-PWL) provides an exact, sound, and complete formulation with a state-optimal logarithmic encoding, reducing the binary variables per neuron from linear to information-theoretically minimal logarithmic complexity. For general bounded element-wise activations, the Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env) uses sound piecewise-constant envelopes whose lower and upper neuron states remain decision variables coupled to a common adversarial input. We prove that its globally optimized output bounds converge uniformly to the true network extrema as the segment width vanishes, yielding asymptotic completeness of verification. We further develop a hybrid Benders solver with output-sensitive iteration bounds, leveraging a Helly-based conflict compression theory to avoid generic exponential cut explosion. Interval pruning, certificate transfer for pruned networks, and layerwise classical--Ising partitioning further reduce spin requirements. Experiments show exact certification fidelity for piecewise-linear networks and near-reference accuracy for sigmoid networks with compact spin budgets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于 Ising 求解器的神经网络形式化鲁棒性验证框架，针对有界输入扰动下的验证问题。对分段线性激活函数，作者给出精确、sound 且 complete 的 Exact Logarithmic PWL Model (Log-PWL)，将每个神经元的二值变量从线性降到信息论意义下最优的对数复杂度；对一般有界逐元素激活函数，提出 Asymptotic Step-Envelope Model (Step-Env)，用 sound 的分段常数包络逼近，并证明当分段宽度趋于零时全局优化输出界一致收敛到真实网络极值，从而获得验证的渐近完备性。文中还设计了混合 Benders 求解器，借助基于 Helly 的冲突压缩理论避免指数级割爆炸，并通过区间剪枝、剪枝网络的证书迁移和逐层 classical-Ising 划分降低自旋需求。实验显示对分段线性网络有精确的验证保真度，对 sigmoid 网络在紧凑自旋预算下接近参考精度。
Motivation: 神经网络形式化验证在保证安全关键系统可靠性方面很重要，但精确验证通常面临组合爆炸；现有方法在编码规模或完备性上存在限制，尤其是对一般非线性激活函数难以同时做到精确、sound 且完备。
Method: 提出 Ising 兼容的验证框架：对分段线性激活用 Log-PWL 实现状态最优的对数编码，对一般有界逐元素激活用 Step-Env 构造 sound 的分段常数包络并保持上下神经元状态作为与共同对抗输入耦合的决策变量；配合混合 Benders 求解器、Helly 冲突压缩、区间剪枝、证书迁移和层间 classical-Ising 分区来减少自旋数量。
Result: 理论证明 Step-Env 的全局优化输出界随分段宽度趋于零而一致收敛到真实网络极值，即验证渐近完备；实验表明在分段线性网络上获得精确验证保真度，在 sigmoid 网络上以紧凑自旋预算达到接近参考的精度。
Conclusion: 该框架在 Ising/量子硬件求解器上实现了精确与渐近完备的神经网络鲁棒性验证，并通过编码与求解层面的优化显著压缩自旋需求；其适用范围和可扩展性取决于 Ising 求解器的能力以及分段宽度选择带来的精度-规模权衡。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Do LLMs Benefit From Their Own Words?
papers.abstract_en: In multi-turn conversations, large language models typically condition on the full conversation history: both past user prompts and assistant responses. We revisit this design choice by comparing full-context prompting to four alternative, substantially-reduced context configurations. Analyzing in-the-wild multi-turn conversations across three open reasoning and one state-of-the-art model, we find that response quality is largely preserved under aggressive context filtering: replacing all prior assistant turns with one-sentence summaries or keeping only the most recent user--assistant exchange often matches storing full context in performance while using roughly 8x less context. To understand this result, we observe that a substantial fraction of user turns (36.4%) in multi-turn conversations are self-contained and that many follow-up turns can be addressed by seeing only the immediately preceding user--assistant exchange. Furthermore, we find that when models condition on their own past responses, this can lead to context pollution, a phenomenon in which reasoning errors, hallucinations, or stylistic artifacts propagate across turns. Motivated by these findings, we design a context-filtering approach that selectively omits the assistant-side history. Taken together, these findings suggest moving away from storing full dialogue transcripts and instead retaining only what is relevant.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视多轮对话中大型语言模型对完整对话历史的依赖，通过对比完整上下文提示与四种大幅缩减上下文的配置，发现激进过滤历史（如将全部助手回复替换为一句话摘要或仅保留最近一轮用户-助手交换）在性能上与完整上下文相当，同时上下文量约为原来的1/8。作者进一步观察到36.4%的用户轮次是自包含的，并发现模型依赖自身过往回复会导致上下文污染（context pollution），使错误、幻觉或风格瑕疵跨轮传播。基于这些发现，他们设计了选择性省略助手侧历史的上下文过滤方法。
Motivation: 现有LLM在多轮对话中默认条件于全部历史（含所有用户提示与助手回复），但完整转录可能冗余甚至有害；作者质疑这一设计选择，希望探明大幅缩减上下文是否仍能保持回复质量，并理解其背后的机制。
Method: 比较完整上下文提示与四种替代的低上下文配置，在多个开放推理模型和SOTA模型上的真实多轮对话中评测；分析用户轮次的自包含性，并设计一种选择性省略助手侧历史的上下文过滤方法。
Result: 摘要报告在激进上下文过滤下回复质量基本保持，使用约8倍更少的上下文即可匹敌完整上下文性能；约36.4%的用户轮次自包含，许多后续轮次仅需最近的用户-助手交换；模型条件于自身过往回复会导致上下文污染，使错误、幻觉或风格瑕疵跨轮传播。
Conclusion: 作者建议不再存储完整对话转录，而只保留相关信息；选择性过滤助手侧历史是可行且有效的方向。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告在激进上下文过滤下回复质量基本保持，使用约8倍更少的上下文即可匹敌完整上下文性能；约36.4%的用户轮次自包含，许多后续轮次仅需最近的用户-助手交换；模型条件于自身过往回复会导致上下文污染，使错误、幻觉或风格瑕疵跨轮传播。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者建议不再存储完整对话转录，而只保留相关信息；选择性过滤助手侧历史是可行且有效的方向。

papers.title: Learning Disease-Sensitive Latent Interaction Graphs From Noisy Cardiac Flow Measurements
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac blood flow patterns contain rich information about disease severity and clinical interventions, yet current imaging and computational methods fail to capture underlying relational structures of coherent flow features. We propose a physics-informed, latent relational framework to model cardiac vortices as interacting nodes in a graph. Our model combines a neural relational inference architecture with physics-inspired interaction energy and birth-death dynamics, yielding a latent graph sensitive to disease severity and intervention level. We first develop the method using computational fluid dynamics simulations of aortic coarctation, where learned interaction graphs reveal increasingly structured vortex interactions as vessel narrowing progresses. The resulting graph entropy exhibits a strong monotonic relationship with coarctation severity ($R^2=0.78$, Spearman $|ρ|=0.96$). We then evaluate the framework on fluid-structure interaction simulations of intracranial aneurysms using multiple geometric severity descriptors. Among these, aneurysm volume produces the most informative latent representation, with non-interaction graph entropy demonstrating a strong monotonic relationship with severity (Spearman $|ρ| = 0.91$) and generalising to several alternative morphological measures. Finally, we apply the approach to ultrasound-derived flow fields of a left ventricle under varying levels of left ventricular assist device support, where the latent graph captures the progressive loss of coherent vortex interactions under mechanical assistance, demonstrating cross-modal generalisation to imaging data. Across all datasets, latent interaction graphs and graph entropy provide interpretable markers of disease severity and intervention, linking haemodynamic organisation to clinically relevant physiological changes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个物理信息引导的潜在关系框架 (physics-informed latent relational framework)，将心脏血流中的涡旋建模为图中相互作用的节点，结合神经关系推断架构 (neural relational inference)、类物理的相互作用能量与出生-死亡动力学 (birth-death dynamics)。在主动脉缩窄的 CFD 模拟中，潜图随血管狭窄加重而呈现更结构化的涡旋相互作用，图熵与疾病严重程度呈强单调关系 (R²=0.78, Spearman |ρ|=0.96)；该方法还泛化到颅内动脉瘤的流固耦合模拟和左心室超声血流数据。
Motivation: 心脏血流模式蕴含疾病严重程度和临床干预的信息，但现有成像与计算方法难以捕捉相干血流特征背后的关系结构，缺乏可解释的疾病严重程度标记。
Method: 将心脏涡旋视为图节点，采用神经关系推断架构学习潜变量关系图，并用物理启发的相互作用能量和出生-死亡动力学约束，使潜图对疾病严重程度和干预水平敏感。
Result: 主动脉缩窄模拟中图熵与缩窄严重程度呈强单调关系 (R²=0.78, Spearman |ρ|=0.96)；颅内动脉瘤模拟中，动脉瘤体积产生最具信息量的潜在表征，non-interaction 图熵与严重程度的 Spearman |ρ|=0.91 且能泛化到多种形态学指标；左心室超声数据中潜图捕捉到机械辅助下相干涡旋相互作用的逐步丧失，显示跨模态泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为潜变量交互图与图熵可作为疾病严重程度和干预水平的可解释标记，将血液动力学组织与临床相关的生理变化联系起来。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Risk-Averse Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Online Learning
papers.abstract_en: We study distributionally robust online learning, where a risk-averse learner updates decisions sequentially to guard against worst-case distributions drawn from a Wasserstein ambiguity set centered at past observations. While this paradigm is well understood in the offline setting through Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO), its online extension poses significant challenges in convergence. In this paper, we formulate the problem as an online saddle-point stochastic game between a decision maker and an adversary selecting worst-case distributions, and propose a general framework that converges to a robust Nash equilibrium coinciding with the solution of the corresponding offline Wasserstein DRO problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究分布鲁棒在线学习（distributionally robust online learning），其中风险厌恶的学习者基于过去观测构造的 Wasserstein 模糊集（ambiguity set）依次更新决策以防御最坏情况分布。作者将该问题建模为决策者与选择最坏情况分布的对手之间的在线鞍点随机博弈，并提出一个通用框架，其收敛到的鲁棒纳什均衡与对应离线 Wasserstein DRO 问题的解一致。
Motivation: 离线情形下的 Wasserstein 分布鲁棒优化（DRO）已被充分研究，但其在线扩展在收敛性上存在显著困难，目前缺乏系统的解决方案。
Method: 将问题形式化为在线鞍点随机博弈，其中决策者与对手分别更新决策并选择最坏情况分布；提出一个通用框架，证明其收敛到与离线 Wasserstein DRO 解重合的鲁棒纳什均衡。
Result: 摘要报告该框架能够收敛到一个鲁棒纳什均衡，且该均衡等价于相应离线 Wasserstein DRO 问题的最优解；未给出数值实验或量化结果。
Conclusion: 作者认为该工作填补了在线 Wasserstein DRO 的收敛性空白，为风险厌恶的在线学习提供了理论保证，但摘要未涉及实际数据或应用验证。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: JEPA-DNA: Grounding Genomic Foundation Models through Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Genomic Foundation Models (GFMs) typically rely on Masked Language Modeling (MLM) or Next-Token Prediction (NTP) to learn the "Laws of Nature". While effective at capturing local syntax, these generative paradigms prioritize token-level reconstruction over high-level functional context. We introduce JEPA-DNA, a model-agnostic continual training framework that integrates a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) with traditional generative objectives. By supervising global sequence embeddings in a latent space, JEPA-DNA forces models to predict the functional representations of masked genomic segments, shifting the learning signal from token recovery to semantic alignment. We evaluate JEPA-DNA on 17 diverse genomic benchmark tasks, demonstrating consistent gains in linear probing and zero-shot performance regardless of the underlying GFM architecture or generative objective. Our framework establishes a new state-of-the-art for GFMs, surpassing the best existing models by bridging generative precision with latent semantic grounding. Through extensive ablation studies, we further characterize the synergistic interplay between generative and latent objectives. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/NVIDIA-Digital-Bio/JEPA-DNA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JEPA-DNA，一个模型无关的持续训练框架，将联合嵌入预测架构 (Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, JEPA) 与传统的生成式目标（MLM/NTP）结合，用于基因组基础模型。通过在高维潜在空间中监督全局序列嵌入，模型被迫预测被掩蔽基因组片段的功能表示，将学习信号从 token 级重建转向语义对齐。在 17 个基因组基准任务上，线性探测和零样本性能均有提升，并超过现有最佳模型。
Motivation: 现有基因组基础模型 (GFM) 通常依赖掩码语言建模 (MLM) 或下一 token 预测 (NTP)，能捕捉局部语法，但这些生成式范式偏向 token 级重建，缺乏对高层功能上下文的建模，需要引入显式的潜在语义监督。
Method: 提出一个模型无关的持续训练框架，在生成式目标之上集成 JEPA，通过在潜在空间中监督全局序列嵌入，迫使模型预测掩蔽基因组片段的功能表示，从而把损失信号从 token 恢复转移到语义对齐。
Result: 在 17 个多样化基因组基准任务上，无论底层 GFM 架构或生成式目标为何，线性探测与零样本性能均获得一致提升，并确立新的最优结果；消融研究进一步刻画了生成式目标与潜在（latent）目标之间的协同作用。
Conclusion: 作者认为将生成式精度与潜在语义对齐相结合可以显著提升基因组基础模型的表现，并公开了代码；摘要未提及明确的局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Causal Discovery: a Constraint-based, Argumentation-driven Approach
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery seeks to uncover causal relations from data, typically represented as causal graphs, and is essential for predicting the effects of interventions. While expert knowledge is required to construct principled causal graphs, many statistical methods have been proposed to leverage observational data with varying formal guarantees. Causal Assumption-based Argumentation (ABA) is a framework that uses symbolic reasoning to ensure correspondence between input constraints and output graphs, while offering a principled way to combine data and expertise. We explore the use of large language models (LLMs) as imperfect experts for Causal ABA, eliciting semantic structural priors from variable names and descriptions and integrating them with conditional-independence evidence. Experiments on standard benchmarks and semantically grounded synthetic graphs demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, and we additionally introduce an evaluation protocol to mitigate memorisation bias when assessing LLMs for causal discovery.
papers.comment: Accepted at UAI 2026. 37 pages, including appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索将大语言模型（LLM）用作不完美的专家来服务于 Causal Assumption-based Argumentation (ABA) 因果发现框架，从变量名和描述中提取语义结构先验，并与条件独立性证据相结合。实验在标准基准和语义上有依据的合成因果图上取得当前最优性能，并引入一种评估协议以缓解评测 LLM 时可能出现的记忆偏差。
Motivation: 因果发现通常需要专家知识才能构建有原则的因果图，但纯统计方法难以原则性地整合数据与领域专业知识。Causal ABA 提供符号推理以保障输入约束与输出图的一致，但其依赖高质量专家输入，因此本文希望验证 LLM 能否充当此类专家来源。
Method: 提出利用 LLM 从变量名和变量描述中提取语义结构先验，将这些先验作为 Causal ABA 的输入约束，与条件独立性证据一起参与符号推理；同时设计评估协议来区分模型的真实因果推理能力与训练记忆效应。
Result: 在标准因果发现基准和语义上 grounded 的合成图上，该方法被报告达到当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为 LLM 可以作为不完美的专家，为基于参数化推理的因果发现提供有用的语义先验，并强调在评测 LLM 因果能力时必须考虑记忆偏差问题。

papers.title: Learning Representations from Incomplete EHR Data with Dual-Masked Autoencoding
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health records (EHR) arrive masked. Clinicians order measurements selectively, and any patient table thus contains only a subset of the values that characterize the underlying physiological state. Prior masked modeling approaches on EHR data either impute the table before learning, represent missingness through a dedicated placeholder signal, or optimize solely for imputation, which limits the representations they learn for downstream clinical tasks and carries every unobserved entry through the encoder. We introduce AID-MAE, an Augmented-Intrinsic Dual-Masked Autoencoder that learns directly from incomplete tables by combining the intrinsic mask the record already carries with an augmented mask that hides a subset of observed values for reconstruction during pretraining. Neither type of masked entry enters the encoder, so attention operates only over what was observed. AID-MAE achieves consistent improvements over strong baselines across multiple clinical tasks on two datasets. Across experiments, we discuss that recovering the missing entries is not a prerequisite for learning and show that the representations learned carry clinical structure without supervision.
papers.comment: MLHC 2026 camera-ready. Spotlight at NeurIPS TS4H 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AID-MAE（Augmented-Intrinsic Dual-Masked Autoencoder），一种直接从不完整 EHR 表格学习表征的双掩码自编码方法。它把记录本身携带的内在缺失掩码与额外隐藏部分观测值的增强掩码结合，预训练时用观测值重建被增强掩码隐藏的条目，且两类掩码条目都不进入编码器，注意力只作用于观测值。作者报告该方法在两个数据集的多项临床任务上稳定优于强基线，并讨论缺失值恢复并非学习表征的前提。
Motivation: EHR 数据天然带缺失，因为临床医生会选择性开单，患者表格只包含部分表征生理状态的值。既有掩码建模方法要么先插补再学习、要么用专用占位符表示缺失、要么只优化插补，这会限制下游临床任务的表征质量，并让所有未观测条目都进入编码器。
Method: AID-MAE 将记录自带的 intrinsic mask 与隐藏部分观测值的 augmented mask 结合进行预训练重建；两种掩码条目均不进入编码器，因此注意力只覆盖实际观测到的值，从而直接从不完整表格学习表征。
Result: 摘要报告 AID-MAE 在两个数据集的多项临床任务上相对强基线取得一致提升，并展示无需监督即可学到具有临床结构的表征。
Conclusion: 作者强调恢复缺失条目不是学习良好表征的前提，双掩码自编码设计可让模型直接从观测到的 EHR 条目学习，避免把未观测值传入编码器。

summary_sections.motivation: EHR 数据天然带缺失，因为临床医生会选择性开单，患者表格只包含部分表征生理状态的值。既有掩码建模方法要么先插补再学习、要么用专用占位符表示缺失、要么只优化插补，这会限制下游临床任务的表征质量，并让所有未观测条目都进入编码器。
summary_sections.method: AID-MAE 将记录自带的 intrinsic mask 与隐藏部分观测值的 augmented mask 结合进行预训练重建；两种掩码条目均不进入编码器，因此注意力只覆盖实际观测到的值，从而直接从不完整表格学习表征。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告 AID-MAE 在两个数据集的多项临床任务上相对强基线取得一致提升，并展示无需监督即可学到具有临床结构的表征。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者强调恢复缺失条目不是学习良好表征的前提，双掩码自编码设计可让模型直接从观测到的 EHR 条目学习，避免把未观测值传入编码器。

papers.title: Order Matters in Retrosynthesis: Structure-aware Generation via Reaction-Center-Guided Discrete Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Template-free retrosynthesis methods treat the task as black-box sequence generation, limiting learning efficiency, while semi-template approaches rely on rigid reaction libraries that constrain generalization. We address this gap with a key insight: atom ordering in neural representations matters. Building on this insight, we propose a structure-aware template-free framework that encodes the two-stage nature of chemical reactions as a positional inductive bias. By placing reaction center atoms at the sequence head, our method transforms implicit chemical knowledge into explicit positional patterns that the model can readily capture. The proposed RetroDiT backbone, a graph transformer with rotary position embeddings, exploits this ordering to prioritize chemically critical regions. Combined with discrete flow matching, our approach decouples training from sampling and enables generation in 20--50 steps versus 500 for prior diffusion methods. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both USPTO-50k (61.2% top-1) and the large-scale USPTO-Full (51.3% top-1) with predicted reaction centers. With oracle centers, performance reaches 71.1% and 63.4% respectively, surpassing foundation models trained on 10 billion reactions while using orders of magnitude less data. Ablation studies further reveal that structural priors outperform brute-force scaling: a 280K-parameter model with proper ordering matches a 65M-parameter model without it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结构感知的无模板逆合成 (template-free retrosynthesis) 方法，核心观点是原子排序蕴含化学语义：将反应中心 (reaction center) 原子置于序列头部，把化学反应的两阶段特性编码为位置归纳偏置。方法结合 RetroDiT 图 Transformer 与离散流匹配 (discrete flow matching)，将生成步数从先前的 500 步降为 20–50 步，并在 USPTO-50k 和 USPTO-Full 上取得最优结果。
Motivation: 现有无模板方法将逆合成视为黑盒序列生成，学习效率有限；半模板方法依赖刚性反应库，泛化受限。作者指出原子在神经表示中的排序是一个被忽略的关键因素，希望通过显式的排序先验提升模型对化学关键区域的关注。
Method: 提出结构感知框架，将反应中心原子放在序列头部以引入位置归纳偏置；采用 RetroDiT 骨干，即带旋转位置嵌入 (rotary position embeddings) 的图 Transformer；结合离散流匹配解耦训练与采样过程，从而实现更少步数的生成。
Result: 摘要报告在 USPTO-50k 上达到 61.2% top-1，在 USPTO-Full 上达到 51.3% top-1（使用预测反应中心）；使用 oracle 中心时分别达到 71.1% 和 63.4%，超过基于 100 亿反应训练的 foundation model。消融表明 28 万参数模型配合正确排序可匹配 6500 万参数模型。
Conclusion: 结构先验优于暴力扩大模型规模，说明原子排序这一归纳偏置对逆合成生成至关重要。

papers.title: Situation Graph Prediction for User Perspective Modeling
papers.abstract_en: Perspective-aware AI requires modeling evolving internal states---goals, emotions, contexts---not merely preferences. Progress is limited by a data bottleneck: digital footprints are privacy-sensitive and perspective states are rarely labeled. We propose Situation Graph Prediction (SGP), a task that frames user perspective modeling as an inverse inference problem: reconstructing structured, ontology-aligned representations of perspective from observable multimodal artifacts, suitable as long-horizon memory for personal agents. To enable grounding without real labels, we use a structure-first synthetic generation strategy that aligns latent labels and observable traces by design. As a pilot, we construct a dataset and run a diagnostic study using retrieval-augmented in-context learning as a proxy for supervision. In our diagnostic study across three frontier foundation models (GPT-4o, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Claude Sonnet 4), we observe a consistent positive gap between surface-level extraction and latent perspective inference---indicating that latent-state inference is consistently harder than surface extraction under our controlled setting. Results suggest SGP is non-trivial and provide evidence for the structure-first data synthesis strategy. For reproducibility and transparency, our code, data, and supplementary resources are available here: https://github.com/flybits/sg-prediction.
papers.comment: Accepted to PILA 2026: Workshop on Personal Intelligence in the Agentic AI Era, at KDD 2026, 5 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Situation Graph Prediction (SGP)，将用户视角建模 (user perspective modeling) 重新定义为逆推理问题：从可观测的多模态痕迹中重建结构化、与本体对齐的视角表示，作为个人代理 (personal agent) 的长程记忆。为绕开真实标签稀缺与隐私限制，作者采用结构优先的合成数据生成策略，并构建数据集；随后以检索增强的上下文学习作为监督代理进行诊断研究。结果表明该任务在受控设定下具有非平凡难度。
Motivation: 视角感知 AI 需要建模不断变化的内部状态（目标、情绪、情境），而不仅是静态偏好；但数字足迹涉及隐私且视角状态极少有标注，形成数据瓶颈，限制了该方向进展。
Method: 定义 SGP 任务，并提出结构优先的合成生成策略，使潜在标签与可观测轨迹在设计上对齐；作为试点，构建数据集并用检索增强的上下文学习 (retrieval-augmented in-context learning) 代理监督进行诊断研究。
Result: 在 GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Claude Sonnet 4 三个前沿基础模型上，观察到表面层提取 (surface-level extraction) 与潜在视角推理 (latent perspective inference) 之间存在一致的性能差距，即潜在状态推理始终更难。
Conclusion: 诊断结果说明 SGP 不是平凡任务，并为结构优先的数据合成策略提供了初步证据；作者公开了代码、数据与补充资源。

papers.title: LLMs Encode Their Failures: Predicting Success from Pre-Generation Activations
papers.abstract_en: Running LLMs with extended reasoning on every problem is expensive, but determining which inputs actually require additional compute remains challenging. We investigate whether their own likelihood of success is recoverable from their internal representations before generation, and if this signal can guide more efficient inference. We train linear probes on pre-generation activations to predict policy-specific success on math and coding tasks, substantially outperforming surface features such as question length and TF-IDF. Using E2H-AMC, which provides both human and model performance on identical problems, we show that models encode a model-specific notion of difficulty that is distinct from human difficulty, and that this distinction increases with extended reasoning. Leveraging these probes, we demonstrate that routing queries across a pool of models can exceed the best-performing model whilst reducing inference cost by up to 70\% on MATH, showing that internal representations enable practical efficiency gains even when they diverge from human intuitions about difficulty. Our code is available at: https://github.com/KabakaWilliam/llms_know_difficulty
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究能否在生成之前从 LLM 的内部表征（pre-generation activations）中预测其成功概率，从而指导推理时计算资源的分配。作者在数学与代码任务上训练线性探针（linear probes）预测策略特定的成功与否，并在 E2H-AMC 数据集上验证模型编码了与人类难度不同、且随扩展推理而差异增大的模型特定难度。利用这些探针，跨模型池路由查询可以在超过最优单模型的同时，将 MATH 上的推理成本降低最多 70%。
Motivation: 对所有问题都启用扩展推理（extended reasoning）成本高昂，但判断哪些输入真正需要额外计算仍然困难。
Method: 在生成前激活上训练线性探针来预测策略特定的成功概率，对比问题长度、TF-IDF 等表面特征（surface features），并利用同时含有人类与模型表现的 E2H-AMC 数据集进行分析；随后将探针用于跨模型池的查询路由（routing）。
Result: 线性探针显著优于表面特征；模型编码的难度与人类难度存在差异，且该差异随扩展推理而增大；基于探针的路由在超过最佳单模型的同时，在 MATH 上最多降低 70% 的推理成本。
Conclusion: 即使内部表征反映的难度与人类直觉相左，仍能带来实际的推理效率提升。

papers.title: Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-Agent Communication through Information Bottleneck and Vector Quantization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning systems deployed in real-world robotics applications face severe communication constraints that significantly impact coordination effectiveness. We present a framework that combines information bottleneck theory with vector quantization to enable selective, bandwidth-efficient communication in multi-agent environments. Our approach learns to compress and discretize communication messages while preserving task-critical information through principled information-theoretic optimization. We introduce a gated communication mechanism that dynamically determines when communication is necessary based on environmental context and agent states. Experimental evaluation on challenging coordination tasks demonstrates that our method achieves 181.8% performance improvement over no-communication baselines while reducing bandwidth usage by 71.4%. Pareto frontier analysis shows dominance across the entire success-bandwidth spectrum, with an area under the curve of 0.198 vs 0.142 for next-best methods. Our approach significantly outperforms existing communication strategies and establishes a theoretically grounded framework for deploying multi-agent systems in bandwidth-constrained environments such as robotic swarms, autonomous vehicle fleets, and distributed sensor networks.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE ICRA 2026, Vienna, Austria. 8 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. v2: replaces v1 with the accepted camera-ready version and corrects a typo in the bandwidth reduction (41.4% -> 71.4%) in the abstract, Sec. I, Fig. 2 caption, Sec. VI and Sec. VII. Sec. V-A and Table I (800 vs 2800 bits/episode) were already correct; no results or conclusions changed
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体强化学习 (MARL) 在真实机器人应用中面临的通信带宽约束问题，提出结合信息瓶颈 (information bottleneck) 与向量量化 (vector quantization) 的通信压缩框架。方法学习将通信消息压缩并离散化，同时通过门控通信机制根据环境上下文和智能体状态动态决定何时通信。实验显示相对无通信基线性能提升 181.8%，带宽使用减少 71.4%，并在成功-带宽帕累托前沿上占据主导。
Motivation: 现实世界的多智能体机器人系统面临严重通信约束，显著影响协调效果；现有通信策略难以在有限带宽下保留任务关键信息，需要一种原则性的带宽高效通信方法。
Method: 将信息瓶颈理论与向量量化相结合，通过信息论优化对通信消息进行压缩和离散化；并引入门控通信机制，基于环境上下文和智能体状态动态判断当前时刻是否需要通信。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在挑战性协调任务上相对无通信基线实现 181.8% 的性能提升，并将带宽使用降低 71.4%；帕累托前沿分析显示其在整个成功-带宽谱上占优，曲线下面积 (AUC) 为 0.198，优于次优方法的 0.142。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法显著优于已有通信策略，并为机器人集群、自动驾驶车队和分布式传感器网络等带宽受限环境中的多智能体系统建立了有理论支撑的框架。

papers.title: Enhancing Automated Essay Scoring With Three Techniques: Two-Stage Fine-Tuning, Score Alignment, and Self-Training
papers.abstract_en: Automated Essay Scoring (AES) plays a crucial role in education by providing scalable and efficient assessment tools. However, in real-world settings, the extreme scarcity of labeled data severely limits the development and practical adoption of robust AES systems. This study proposes a novel approach to enhance AES performance in both limited-data and full-data settings by introducing three key techniques. First, we introduce a Two-Stage fine-tuning strategy that leverages low-rank adaptations to better adapt an AES model to target prompt essays. Second, we introduce a Score Alignment technique to improve consistency between predicted and true score distributions. Third, we employ uncertainty-aware self-training using unlabeled data, effectively expanding the training set with pseudo-labeled samples while mitigating label noise propagation. We implement the above three key techniques on DualBERT. We conduct extensive experiments on the ASAP++ dataset, and additionally evaluate the proposed techniques on two other datasets, TOEFL11 and ELLIPSE, to examine their generalizability. In the 32-data setting on ASAP++, all three key techniques improve performance, and their integration achieves 91.2% of the full-data performance trained on approximately 1,000 labeled samples. In addition, the proposed Score Alignment technique consistently improves performance in both limited-data and full-data settings: e.g., it achieves state-of-the-art results in the full-data setting on ASAP++ when integrated into DualBERT.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Published in IEEE Access (open access, CC BY 4.0)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动作文评分（Automated Essay Scoring, AES）中真实场景标注数据极度稀缺的问题，提出三种技术：两阶段微调（Two-Stage Fine-Tuning）、分数对齐（Score Alignment）和基于不确定性感知的自训练（uncertainty-aware self-training）。作者在 DualBERT 上实现并集成这三种技术，并在 ASAP++、TOEFL11 和 ELLIPSE 三个数据集上评估。在 ASAP++ 的 32 条标注数据设置下，三种技术均有提升，集成后达到约 1000 条标注样本训练的全数据性能的 91.2%。
Motivation: 现实场景中 AES 系统常面临标注数据极度稀缺，严重限制鲁棒系统的开发与实际采用，因此需要在有限数据和全数据设置下同时提升评分性能。
Method: 提出三项关键技术：一是两阶段微调策略，利用低秩适配（low-rank adaptations）使模型更好适配目标提示作文；二是分数对齐（Score Alignment）技术，改善预测分数分布与真实分数分布的一致性；三是利用未标注数据的不确定性感知自训练，用伪标签扩充训练集并缓解标签噪声传播。三项技术均实现在 DualBERT 上。

papers.title: Logit Lens Supervision for Patch-Level Explanations in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern autoregressive Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can generate fluent answers while their visual-token representations become weakly tied to the image regions from which they originate. This limits patch-level explainability: a visual token should remain interpretable as the image patch it represents. We study this issue through Logit Lens maps, obtained by projecting each visual-token embedding through the LLM vocabulary head to measure how strongly each image patch is associated with a queried textual concept, such as "cat". We introduce Logit Lens Loss (LLL), a lightweight auxiliary objective that preserves localized visual semantics by directly aligning object-related visual tokens with the vocabulary concepts describing their image regions. LLL requires no architectural modification, mask decoder, or large-scale retraining. We evaluate LLL through both explanation quality and downstream performance. Across LLaVA-v1.5-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B, LLL yields sharper object confidence maps, improves grounding and hallucination metrics, transfers to zero-shot pointing, and preserves VQA performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自回归视觉语言模型 (VLM) 中 visual token 表示与其来源图像区域脱节的问题，并提出 Logit Lens Loss (LLL) 这一轻量辅助目标。LLL 通过将对象相关 visual token 与描述其图像区域的词汇概念对齐来保持局部视觉语义，不需要修改架构、掩码解码器或大规模重训练。在 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，LLL 使对象置信图更锐利，改善 grounding 与 hallucination 指标，并迁移到零样本 pointing 任务，同时保持 VQA 性能。
Motivation: 现代自回归 VLM 能生成流畅回答，但 visual-token 表征与它们来源的图像区域联系变弱，限制了 patch 级可解释性；一个 visual token 本应可被解释为其所代表的图像 patch。
Method: 通过将每个 visual-token 嵌入经 LLM 词汇表 head 投影，得到 Logit Lens 图来度量图像 patch 与查询文本概念（如 "cat"）的关联强度；在此基础上提出 LLL 辅助损失，直接对齐对象相关 visual token 与其图像区域的词汇概念描述。
Result: 摘要报告在 LLaVA-v1.5-7B 和 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上，LLL 产生更锐利的对象置信图，改善 grounding 和 hallucination 指标，可迁移到零样本 pointing，且不损害 VQA 性能。
Conclusion: LLL 提供了一种无需架构改动或大规模重训练的轻量方式，通过词汇概念对齐来保留和恢复 VLM 中 visual token 的局部语义与可解释性。

papers.title: Putting a Face to Forgetting: Continual Learning meets Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Catastrophic forgetting in continual learning is often measured at the performance or last-layer representation level, overlooking the underlying mechanisms. We introduce a mechanistic framework that offers a geometric interpretation of catastrophic forgetting as the result of transformations to the encoding of individual features. These transformations can lead to forgetting by reducing the allocated capacity of features or by disrupting their readout by downstream computations. Analysis of a tractable toy model formalizes this view, allowing us to identify best- and worst-case scenarios. Through experiments on this model, we empirically test our formal analysis and highlight the detrimental effect of depth. Finally, we demonstrate how our framework can be used in the analysis of practical models through the use of Crosscoders. We do so through a case study example of a Vision Transformer trained on sequential CIFAR-10. Our work provides a new, feature-centric vocabulary for continual learning.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Fifth Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs), 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为持续学习中的灾难性遗忘 (catastrophic forgetting) 引入一个机制可解释框架，将其几何地解释为单个特征编码的变换——这些变换要么降低特征的分配容量，要么干扰下游计算对特征的读取。作者用一个可解的玩具模型对上述观点进行形式化分析，识别出最好与最坏情形，并通过实验验证了深度对遗忘的负面效应。最后借助 Crosscoders 在顺序训练的 CIFAR-10 Vision Transformer 案例中展示该框架可用于实际模型分析。
Motivation: 现有持续学习研究通常在任务性能或最后一层表征层面衡量灾难性遗忘，忽略了其底层机制，因而缺乏对遗忘如何发生的特征级理解。
Method: 提出一个机制框架，把灾难性遗忘几何化为个体特征编码所受到的变换；在一个可处理的玩具模型上做形式化分析，并以实验检验该分析，同时利用 Crosscoders 将框架推广到实际规模模型的分析。
Result: 玩具模型上的实验验证了形式化分析，并突出深度会加剧遗忘；案例研究展示了该框架在顺序 CIFAR-10 上训练的 Vision Transformer 上的实际用法。
Conclusion: 该工作为持续学习提供了一套以特征为中心 (feature-centric) 的新词汇和视角，使遗忘可以被从机制层面描述和分析。

papers.title: Clarity: The Flexibility-Interpretability Trade-Off in Sparsity-aware Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: The widespread adoption of deep learning models in computer vision has intensified concerns about interpretability. Despite strong performance, these models are often treated as black boxes, with limited systematic investigation of their decision-making processes. While many interpretability methods exist, objective evaluation of learned representations remains limited, particularly for approaches that rely on sparsity to "induce" interpretability. In this work, we investigate how modeling choices in Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) affect the semantic alignment of concept representations. We introduce Clarity, a post-hoc diagnostic measure that captures the interplay between downstream performance and the sparsity and precision of concept activations. Using an interpretability assessment framework grounded in datasets with ground-truth concept annotations, we evaluate both VLM- and attribute predictor-based CBMs across three amortized sparsity-inducing strategies ($\ell_1$, $\ell_0$, and Bernoulli-based), alongside several widely used sparsity-aware CBM methods from the literature. Our experiments reveal a critical flexibility-interpretability trade-off: a model's capacity to optimize task performance by deviating from semantic alignment. We demonstrate that under this trade-off, different methods exhibit markedly different behaviors even at comparable performance levels. Finally, we validate our framework through a principled human study, which confirms that Clarity aligns significantly more closely with human trust than standard evaluation metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) 中建模选择如何影响概念表征的语义对齐，并提出后验诊断指标 Clarity，用于刻画下游性能与概念激活稀疏性、精确性之间的相互作用。作者基于带真实概念标注的数据集，评估了 VLM 和属性预测器两类 CBM 在 \ell_1、\ell_0 和基于 Bernoulli 的摊销稀疏策略下的表现，并通过人工研究验证 Clarity 与人类信任的一致性。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在计算机视觉中广泛应用，但其可解释性不足；现有可解释性方法对学习表征的客观评估有限，尤其是依赖稀疏性来“诱导”可解释性的方法缺乏系统评估。
Method: 提出后验诊断指标 Clarity，构建基于真实概念标注数据集的解释性评估框架，比较多种摊销稀疏策略（\ell_1、\ell_0、Bernoulli）以及文献中多种稀疏感知 CBM 方法，并通过原则性人工研究验证该指标。
Result: 实验结果揭示了灵活性-可解释性权衡（flexibility-interpretability trade-off）：模型可通过偏离语义对齐来优化任务性能。不同方法在该权衡下即使性能相近，行为也显著不同；Clarity 与人类信任的相关性显著高于标准评估指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调稀疏感知 CBM 的评估需要同时考虑性能与概念对齐，Clarity 提供了一种更贴近人类信任的衡量方式。

papers.title: GraFine: Retrieval-Time Refinement for Efficient Graph RAG over Corpus Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Graph RAG on corpus graphs enhances retrieval by leveraging intermediate node content as contextual clues to uncover unretrieved oracle nodes. However, existing methods suffer from two critical blind spots, namely semantically blind graph expansion and topology blind pruning, or else rely on prohibitively slow retrieval and generation interleaving. To address this, we formalize these limitations through an operational taxonomy and propose a retriever design that couples semantics-aware adding with graph-aware pruning under efficiency constraints. We instantiate this design as GraFine, which alternates between two refinement stages: Semantic Proximity eXpansion (SPX) for semantics-aware node addition, and a Graph Smoothing Reranker (GSR) for graph-aware pruning. Experiments on reference networks and text-rich knowledge graphs show that GraFine improves retrieval accuracy and generation quality while maintaining time-efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce Topological Recall (TR), a metric that quantifies the topological proximity between retrieved and oracle nodes. Our analysis using TR confirms that GraFine more effectively steers refinement toward undiscovered oracle nodes by leveraging intermediate contextual clues. Our code is available at this link: https://github.com/asmath472/GraFine.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对基于语料图 (corpus graphs) 的 Graph RAG 检索问题，指出现有方法存在语义盲目的图扩展 (semantically blind graph expansion) 与拓扑盲目的剪枝 (topology blind pruning) 两大盲区，或依赖过慢的检索-生成交织。作者提出 GraFine，一种在效率约束下耦合语义感知添加与图感知剪枝的检索器设计，交替执行 Semantic Proximity eXpansion (SPX) 与 Graph Smoothing Reranker (GSR) 两个精炼阶段，并引入 Topological Recall (TR) 指标度量检索节点与 oracle 节点间的拓扑接近度。实验表明 GraFine 在参考网络和文本丰富的知识图谱上提升检索精度与生成质量，同时保持时间效率。
Motivation: 现有 Graph RAG 方法在基于语料图的检索中要么扩展时缺乏语义感知、要么剪枝时忽视图结构，要么依赖速度过慢的检索与生成交替过程，导致难以有效利用中间节点内容作为语境线索去发现未被检索到的 oracle 节点。作者通过操作性分类法 (operational taxonomy) 将这些问题形式化。
Method: 提出一个检索器设计：在效率约束下将语义感知的节点添加与图感知的剪枝耦合。具体实现为 GraFine，交替进行两个阶段——SPX 用于语义感知的节点扩展，GSR 用于图感知的剪枝重排；同时提出 Topological Recall (TR) 指标，量化检索节点与 oracle 节点间的拓扑接近度。
Result: 在参考网络与文本丰富的知识图谱上的实验显示，GraFine 在提升检索准确率和生成质量的同时保持时间效率。基于 TR 的分析进一步确认，GraFine 能更有效地借助中间语境线索引导精炼过程朝向未发现的 oracle 节点。
Conclusion: 作者认为将语义感知扩展与图感知剪枝在效率约束下耦合，可显著改善语料图上的 Graph RAG 检索与生成效果；TR 指标为衡量这种拓扑层面的检索质量提供了新工具。代码已开源。

papers.title: Nonlinear multi-study sparse factor analysis
papers.abstract_en: High-dimensional data often exhibit variation that can be captured by lower-dimensional factors. For high-dimensional data from multiple studies, one goal is to understand which underlying factors are common to all studies, and which factors are study-specific. As a particular example, we consider platelet gene expression data from patients in different disease groups. In this data, factors correspond to clusters of genes which are co-expressed; we may expect some clusters (or biological pathways) to be active for all diseases, while some clusters are only active for a specific disease. To learn these factors, we consider a nonlinear multi-study sparse factor model, which allows for both shared and study-specific factors. To fit this model, we propose a multi-study sparse variational autoencoder. The underlying model is sparse in that each observed feature (i.e. each dimension of the data) depends on a small subset of the latent factors. In the genomics example, this means each gene is active in only a few biological processes. We prove that the latent factor distributions are identifiable (up to element-wise transformations), and that the canonical shared and study-specific support structure is identifiable. Empirically, we demonstrate our method recovers meaningful factors in the platelet gene expression data.

Motivation: 多研究高维数据中需要区分共有因子和特定研究因子，例如不同疾病组共有的与疾病特异的基因共表达簇（生物通路），现有方法需要显式建模这种稀疏共享结构。
Method: 提出非线性多研究稀疏因子模型，采用多研究稀疏变分自编码器（multi-study sparse VAE）拟合；模型在每个观测维度上强制只依赖少量潜在因子，并区分共享因子与特定研究因子。
Result: 理论上证明潜在因子分布可在元索级变换下可识别，且共享与特定研究的支持结构可识别；实验上在血小板基因表达数据中恢复了有意义的因子。
Conclusion: 该模型的稀疏性与多研究结构设计使共享和特定因子可解释且可识别，适用于基因组学等多研究高维数据。

papers.title: LaViT: Aligning Latent Visual Thoughts for Multi-modal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Current multimodal latent reasoning often relies on external supervision (e.g., auxiliary images), ignoring intrinsic visual attention dynamics. In this work, we identify a critical Perception Gap in distillation: student models frequently mimic a teacher's textual output while attending to fundamentally divergent visual regions, effectively relying on language priors rather than grounded perception. To bridge this, we propose LaViT, a framework that aligns latent visual thoughts rather than static embeddings. LaViT compels the student to autoregressively reconstruct the teacher's visual semantics and attention trajectories prior to text generation, employing a curriculum sensory gating mechanism to prevent shortcut learning. Extensive experiments show that LaViT significantly enhances visual grounding, achieving up to +16.9% gains on complex reasoning tasks and enabling a compact 3B model to outperform larger open-source variants and proprietary models like GPT-4o.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态潜在推理中的感知偏差问题，提出 LaViT 框架，通过让模型在文本生成前自回归地重建教师的视觉语义与注意力轨迹，并加入课程式感觉门控机制，以增强视觉接地性。实验显示该方法在复杂推理任务上最高提升 +16.9%，并让 3B 小模型超越更大的开源模型及 GPT-4o。
Motivation: 现有模态潜在推理常依赖外部监督（如辅助图像），忽略内在视觉注意力动态；研究者发现学生模型在蒸馏时常模仿教师文本输出但关注完全不同的视觉区域，即利用语言先验而非真实视觉感知，形成感知缺口（Perception Gap）。
Method: 提出 LaViT，它不是对齐静态嵌入，而是强制学生在文本生成前自回归重建教师的视觉语义和注意力轨迹，并使用课程式感觉门控机制（curriculum sensory gating）防止捷径学习。
Result: 大量实验表明 LaViT 显著增强视觉接地性，在复杂推理任务上最高获得 +16.9% 的提升，并使紧凑的 3B 模型超越更大的开源模型以及 GPT-4o 等专有模型。
Conclusion: 本文认为对齐潜在视觉思维（而非静态嵌入）可以有效弥合蒸馏中的感知缺口，提升多模态推理的视觉接地性。

papers.title: SceneNAT: Masked Generative Modeling for Language-Guided Indoor Scene Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: We present SceneNAT, a masked non-autoregressive Transformer for 3D indoor scene synthesis from natural language instructions. It generates complete scenes in a few parallel decoding passes, improving both quality and efficiency over prior methods. SceneNAT is trained via masked modeling over fully discretized representations of both semantic and spatial attributes. By applying a masking strategy at both the attribute level and the instance level, the model can better capture intra-object and inter-object structure. To boost relational reasoning, SceneNAT employs a relational reasoning module (RRM) that captures implicit spatial constraints. By formulating relation modeling as a set prediction task, it extracts structure-aware features to guide the layout generation without explicit sequential parsing. Extensive experiments on 3D-FRONT show that SceneNAT outperforms state-of-the-art autoregressive and diffusion baselines in both semantic compliance and spatial arrangement accuracy while using substantially lower computational cost, enabling high-throughput generation of diverse scenes at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SceneNAT，一个用于从自然语言指令合成 3D 室内场景的掩码非自回归 Transformer (masked non-autoregressive Transformer)。模型在语义与空间属性完全离散化的表示上做掩码建模，并在属性级与实例级分别施加掩码策略，以捕捉物体内部与物体之间的结构；同时引入关系推理模块 (RRM)，将关系建模视为集合预测任务，提取结构感知特征引导布局生成。实验在 3D-FRONT 上显示，SceneNAT 在语义符合度和空间布局准确性上超过自回归与扩散基线，且计算成本更低。
Motivation: 现有基于自回归或扩散的 3D 室内场景合成方法在质量和效率上仍有不足，难以高效地从自然语言指令生成完整场景。
Method: 采用掩码非自回归生成，先对语义和空间属性的离散化表示进行掩码建模；在属性级和实例级两个层面施加掩码策略，帮助模型学习物体内部与物体间结构；并用集合预测形式的关系推理模块 (RRM) 挖掘隐式空间约束，避免显式的顺序解析。
Result: 在 3D-FRONT 上的实验表明，SceneNAT 在语义符合度和空间布局准确性上优于最新的自回归与扩散基线，同时以显著更低的计算成本支持大规模多样化场景的高吞吐生成。
Conclusion: 作者认为，掩码非自回归建模结合关系推理模块能够在不依赖顺序解析的情况下高效合成符合语言指令的室内场景。该工作面向计算机视觉与场景生成，不涉及气象或降水相关任务。

papers.title: DreamOmni3: Scribble-based Editing and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Recently unified generation and editing models have achieved remarkable success with their impressive performance. These models rely mainly on text prompts for instruction-based editing and generation, but language often fails to capture users intended edit locations and fine-grained visual details. To this end, we propose two tasks: scribble-based editing and generation, that enables more flexible creation on graphical user interface (GUI) combining user textual, images, and freehand sketches. We introduce DreamOmni3, tackling two challenges: data creation and framework design. Our data synthesis pipeline includes two parts: scribble-based editing and generation. For scribble-based editing, we define four tasks: scribble and instruction-based editing, scribble and multimodal instruction-based editing, image fusion, and doodle editing. Based on DreamOmni2 dataset, we extract editable regions and overlay hand-drawn boxes, circles, doodles or cropped image to construct training data. For scribble-based generation, we define three tasks: scribble and instruction-based generation, scribble and multimodal instruction-based generation, and doodle generation, following similar data creation pipelines. For the framework, instead of using binary masks, which struggle with complex edits involving multiple scribbles, images, and instructions, we propose a joint input scheme that feeds both the original and scribbled source images into the model, using different colors to distinguish regions and simplify processing. By applying the same index and position encodings to both images, the model can precisely localize scribbled regions while maintaining accurate editing. Finally, we establish comprehensive benchmarks for these tasks to promote further research. Experimental results demonstrate that DreamOmni3 achieves outstanding performance, and models and code will be publicly released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于涂鸦 (scribble) 的图像编辑与生成任务以及统一模型 DreamOmni3，旨在结合用户文本、图像和自由手绘草图，在 GUI 上实现更灵活的创作。作者构建了包含编辑与生成两类共七个子任务的数据合成流水线，并提出联合输入方案，将原始图像与涂鸦图像同时送入模型并用颜色区分区域。摘要报告该模型在相关任务上表现突出，并将公开模型和代码。
Motivation: 现有统一生成与编辑模型主要依赖文本提示进行指令式编辑和生成，但语言常常无法准确表达用户意图的编辑位置与细粒度视觉细节。
Method: 数据合成方面，在 DreamOmni2 数据集基础上提取可编辑区域并叠加手绘框、圆、涂鸦或裁剪图像，构造编辑与生成两类训练数据；框架方面，不使用二元掩码，而是提出联合输入方案，将原始和涂鸦源图像同时输入，并对两幅图像应用相同的索引和位置编码，以精确定位涂鸦区域并保持准确编辑。
Result: 摘要称 DreamOmni3 取得了出色性能，并为这些任务建立了综合基准以促进后续研究，但未给出具体量化数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提数据流水线与联合输入框架能有效支持基于涂鸦的编辑与生成，并承诺公开模型和代码；摘要未讨论明确的局限性。

papers.title: Hybrid Token Compression for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) rely on hundreds of visual tokens, leading to high computational and memory costs. Existing compression methods face a trade-off: continuous compression can weaken high-level semantics, while discrete quantization may lose fine-grained appearance details. We introduce HTC-VLM, a hybrid visual token compression framework that disentangles semantics and appearance through two complementary pathways. A continuous pathway preserves detailed ViT patch features, while a discrete pathway provides semantic anchors using MGVQ quantization represented by four tokens. The two pathways are fused into a 580-token hybrid sequence and compressed into a single token using a disentanglement attention mask and a <voco> bottleneck. Under the same one-token output budget, HTC-VLM achieves 87.2% average performance retention across seven benchmarks (GQA, VQAv2, MMBench, MME, POPE, SEED-Bench, and ScienceQA-Image), outperforming the leading continuous baseline at 81.0%. Attention analysis shows that the compressed token prioritizes discrete anchors, supporting their role as semantic guidance. We further study token-budget scaling, cross-architecture generalization, inference efficiency, robustness to codebook and masking variations, and the information-theoretic properties of the hybrid bottleneck. These results show that combining continuous appearance features with discrete semantic anchors enables effective extreme visual token compression for efficient VLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026. Code available at https://github.com/jushengzhang/HybridToken-VLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HTC-VLM，一种面向视觉语言模型 (VLM) 的混合视觉 token 压缩框架，将连续的外观特征与离散的语义锚点相结合，在单 token 输出预算下实现极端压缩。摘要报告其在七个基准上平均保留 87.2% 的性能，优于领先连续压缩基线的 81.0%。注意力分析表明压缩 token 优先关注离散锚点，支持其语义引导作用。
Motivation: VLM 依赖数百个视觉 token，带来高昂的计算和内存成本；现有压缩方法面临权衡：连续压缩会削弱高层语义，离散量化则可能丢失细粒度外观细节。
Method: HTC-VLM 通过两条互补通路解耦语义和外观：连续通路保留详细的 ViT patch 特征，离散通路使用 MGVQ 量化并以四个 token 提供语义锚点；两路融合为 580-token 混合序列，再借助解耦注意力掩码 (disentanglement attention mask) 和 <voco> 瓶颈压缩为单一 token。
Result: 在相同的单 token 输出预算下，HTC-VLM 在 GQA、VQAv2、MMBench、MME、POPE、SEED-Bench 和 ScienceQA-Image 七个基准上达到 87.2% 的平均性能保留率，优于领先连续基线的 81.0%；注意力分析显示压缩 token 优先关注离散锚点。
Conclusion: 摘要认为将连续外观特征与离散语义锚点结合能够实现有效的极端视觉 token 压缩，并进一步研究了 token 预算缩放、跨架构泛化、推理效率、对码本和掩码变化的鲁棒性以及混合瓶颈的信息论性质。

papers.title: Auto-exploration for online reinforcement learning
papers.abstract_en: The exploration-exploitation dilemma in reinforcement learning (RL) is a fundamental challenge to efficient RL algorithms. Existing algorithms for finite state and action discounted RL problems address this by assuming sufficient exploration over both state and action spaces. However, this yields non-implementable algorithms and sub-optimal performance. To resolve these limitations, we introduce a new class of methods with auto-exploration, or methods that automatically explore both state and action spaces. Auto-exploration can be applied in both the tabular and linear function approximation setting. Under algorithm-independent assumptions on the existence of an exploring optimal policy, both settings attain $O(ε^{-2})$ sample complexity to solve to $ε$ error. These complexities are novel since they avoid algorithm-dependent parameters seen in prior works, which may be arbitrarily large. The methods are also simple to implement because they are parameter-free. We achieve these results by integrating auto-exploration into policy mirror descent to avoid the (unknown) stationary distribution seen in prior art. In the tabular setting, we introduce a dynamic exploration time with a data-driven stopping time, while for linear function approximation we propose a new sampling distribution based on the discounted visitation distribution that covers a more general class of Markov chains.

papers.title: HQ-DM: Single Hadamard Transformation-Based Quantization-Aware Training for Low-Bit Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models have demonstrated significant applications in the field of image generation. However, their high computational and memory costs pose challenges for deployment. Model quantization has emerged as a promising solution to reduce storage overhead and accelerate inference. Nevertheless, existing quantization methods for diffusion models struggle to mitigate outliers in activation matrices during inference, leading to substantial performance degradation under low-bit quantization scenarios. To address this, we propose HQ-DM, a novel Quantization-Aware Training framework that applies Single Hadamard Transformation to activation matrices. This approach effectively reduces activation outliers while preserving model performance under quantization. Compared to traditional Double Hadamard Transformation, our proposed scheme offers distinct advantages by seamlessly supporting INT convolution operations while preventing the amplification of weight outliers. For conditional generation on the ImageNet 256x256 dataset using the LDM-4 model, our W4A4 and W4A3 quantization schemes improve the Inception Score by 12.8% and 467.73%, respectively, over the existing state-of-the-art method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HQ-DM，一种面向低比特扩散模型的量化感知训练 (Quantization-Aware Training) 框架，核心是对激活矩阵施加单次 Hadamard 变换以抑制激活离群值。相比传统双重 Hadamard 变换，该方案在不放大权重离群值的前提下支持 INT 卷积。在 ImageNet 256x256 上使用 LDM-4 进行条件生成时，W4A4 和 W4A3 量化方案的 Inception Score 相比现有最优方法分别提升 12.8% 和 467.73%。
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成中应用广泛，但计算和内存开销大；现有量化方法在低比特场景下难以抑制推理时激活矩阵中的离群值，导致性能显著下降。
Method: 提出 HQ-DM，在量化感知训练中对激活矩阵应用单次 Hadamard 变换来减少激活离群值；相比双重 Hadamard 变换，该设计可无缝支持 INT 卷积并避免放大权重离群值。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256x256 数据集、LDM-4 模型的条件生成任务上，W4A4 和 W4A3 量化方案的 Inception Score 相对现有最优方法分别提高 12.8% 和 467.73%。
Conclusion: 摘要认为单 Hadamard 变换的量化感知训练能有效缓解低比特扩散模型中的激活离群值问题，并在保持性能的同时支持整数卷积。

papers.title: Delays in Spiking Neural Networks: A State Space Model Approach
papers.abstract_en: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) are biologically inspired, event-driven models suited for temporal data processing and energy-efficient neuromorphic computing. In SNNs, richer neuronal dynamic allows capturing more complex temporal dependencies, with delays playing a crucial role by allowing past inputs to directly influence present spiking behavior. We propose a general framework for incorporating delays into SNNs through additional state variables. The proposed mechanism enables each neuron to access a finite temporal input history. The framework is agnostic to neuron models and hence can be seamlessly integrated into standard spiking neuron models such as Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) and Adaptive LIF (adLIF). We analyze how the duration of the delays and the learnable parameters associated with them affect the performance. We investigate the trade-offs in the network architecture due to additional state variables introduced by the delay mechanism. Experiments on the Spiking Heidelberg Digits (SHD) dataset show that the proposed mechanism matches existing delay-based SNNs in performance while remaining computationally efficient, with particular gains in smaller networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在脉冲神经网络（SNN）中引入延迟的通用框架，通过附加状态变量使每个神经元能够访问有限的时间输入历史。该框架对神经元模型无关（agnostic），可无缝集成到 LIF 和 adLIF 等标准脉冲神经元模型中。在 Spiking Heidelberg Digits（SHD）数据集上的实验表明，该机制在保持计算效率的同时与现有基于延迟的 SNN 性能相当，且在较小网络中尤其有优势。
Motivation: 在 SNN 中，延迟允许过去的输入直接影响当前的脉冲行为，从而捕捉更复杂的时间依赖；现有方法缺少一种与具体神经元模型无关、可无缝集成且计算高效的延迟建模方式。
Method: 提出通过引入附加状态变量将延迟纳入 SNN 的通用机制，使每个神经元能访问有限时间输入历史；该机制不依赖特定神经元模型，可集成到 LIF 和 adLIF 等标准模型。作者还分析了延迟时长及相关可学习参数对性能的影响，并研究了附加状态变量引起的网络架构权衡。
Result: 在 Spiking Heidelberg Digits（SHD）数据集上的实验显示，所提机制与现有基于延迟的 SNN 性能相当，同时保持计算高效，并且在较小网络中取得了更明显的性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为 SNN 提供了一种通用且计算高效的延迟集成途径，能够借助额外状态变量有效建模时间依赖，并在小型网络中获得更大收益。
