papers.title: On the Condition Number Dependency in Bilevel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Bilevel optimization minimizes an objective function, defined by an upper-level problem whose feasible region is the solution of a lower-level problem. We study the oracle complexity of finding an $ε$-stationary point with first-order methods when the upper-level problem is nonconvex, and the lower-level problem is strongly convex. Recent works achieve a $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\bar κ_y^{7/2} ε^{-2})$ upper bound that is near-optimal in $ε$. In this work, we establish a new $Ω(κ_y^{5/2} ε^{-2})$ lower bound, where $κ_y \le \bar κ_y$ is the lower-level condition number. Our lower bound establishes the first provable gap {in terms of condition number dependency} between bilevel problems and minimax problems in this setup, and \textit{is tight up to logarithmic factors when the lower-level function is quadratic.} Our lower bounds can be extended to various settings. (1) For second-order and arbitrarily smooth problems, we show lower bounds of $Ω(κ_y^{9/4} ε^{-7/4})$ and $Ω(κ_y^{13/6} ε^{-5/3})$, respectively. (2) For convex--strongly-convex problems, we improve the previously best lower bound (Ji and Liang, JMLR 2022) from $Ω(κ_y /\sqrtε)$ to $Ω(κ_y^{3/2} / \sqrtε)$. (3) For stochastic nonconvex--strongly-convex problems, we also show the lower bounds of $Ω(κ_y^4 ε^{-4})$ and $Ω(κ_y^{9/2} ε^{-4})$ for stochastic Hessian-vector-product and stochastic first-order methods, respectively.
papers.comment: v4 is a merge with v3 (Chen and Zhang) and https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.19656 (Ji, ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双层优化 (bilevel optimization) 中一阶方法寻找 ε-平稳点的 oracle 复杂度，聚焦于下层级强凸、上层级非凸的设定。作者建立了新的 Ω(κ_y^{5/2} ε^{-2}) 下界，其中 κ_y 是下层级条件数，这是首次证明该设定下双层问题与极小极大问题在条件数依赖上存在可证明的差距，并在下层级函数为二次时与已知上界在 log 因子内紧。
Motivation: 近期工作给出 ~O(κ̄_y^{7/2} ε^{-2}) 的近似最优上界，但下界研究不足，无法判断条件数依赖是否本质，也无法区分双层优化与 minimax 问题的复杂度差异。
Method: 通过构造特定问题实例，建立一阶方法在非凸-强凸双层优化中的条件数依赖下界；并扩展到二阶梯度和任意光滑、凸-强凸以及随机设定，分别给出相应下界。
Result: 得到 Ω(κ_y^{5/2} ε^{-2}) 下界；二阶与任意光滑问题下界为 Ω(κ_y^{9/4} ε^{-7/4}) 和 Ω(κ_y^{13/6} ε^{-5/3})；凸-强凸问题下界从 Ω(κ_y/√ε) 改进到 Ω(κ_y^{3/2}/√ε)；随机设定下随机 Hessian-vector-product 与随机一阶方法分别有 Ω(κ_y^4 ε^{-4}) 和 Ω(κ_y^{9/2} ε^{-4}) 下界。
Conclusion: 该下界建立了双层优化与极小极大问题在条件数依赖上的首个可证明差距，且在二次下层级情形下紧于对数因子；结论仅适用于摘要中明确覆盖的各类设定。

papers.title: VDC-Agent: When Video Detailed Captioners Evolve Themselves via Agentic Self-Reflection
papers.abstract_en: Existing Video Detailed Captioning (VDC) methods predominantly rely on costly human annotations or distillation from powerful proprietary models, creating a dependency on external supervision. In this paper, we propose VDC-Agent, an autonomous self-evolving framework that empowers a single Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to generate and refine high-quality captions through principle-guided self-reflection. To overcome the inference latency inherent in iterative refinement, we further propose to internalize this reflective capability into the model. Specifically, we construct VDC-Agent-19K, a preference dataset derived from the agent's self-scored trajectories, and introduce a Curriculum Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) strategy. This strategy leverages the quality gap between generated candidates to progressively align the model from easy to hard samples. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VDC-Agent achieves state-of-the-art performance on VDC and DREAM-1K benchmarks, generating captions with superior detail and faithfulness. Crucially, our internalization strategy retains the inference efficiency of the base model while significantly enhancing its generalization capabilities, as validated by both quantitative metrics and human evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://vdcagent.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VDC-Agent，一个让单个多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 通过原则引导的自我反思自主生成和细化视频详细描述 (Video Detailed Captioning, VDC) 的自进化框架。为克服迭代细化的推理延迟，作者将反思能力内化到模型中，构造 VDC-Agent-19K 偏好数据集，并提出课程直接偏好优化 (Curriculum DPO) 策略。实验表明该方法在 VDC 和 DREAM-1K 基准上达到 SOTA，同时保持基础模型的推理效率并提升泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有视频详细描述方法依赖昂贵的人工标注或从专有模型蒸馏，形成对外部监督的依赖。作者希望让单一模型无需外部监督即可自主生成并改进高质量描述。
Method: 提出 VDC-Agent 自主进化框架，通过原则引导的自我反思生成和细化字幕；构建从智能体自评分轨迹得到的偏好数据集，并设计课程 DPO 策略，利用候选字幕间的质量差距从易到难对齐模型，同时将反思能力内化以降低推理延迟。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在 VDC 和 DREAM-1K 基准上取得 SOTA，生成的字幕细节更丰富、忠实度更高；内化策略在保持基础模型推理效率的同时显著增强泛化，该结论同时由定量指标和人工评估支持。
Conclusion: 作者强调将自我反思能力内化进模型可以在不牺牲推理效率的前提下提升泛化，并减轻对外部监督的依赖。

papers.title: TimePre: Bridging Accuracy, Efficiency, and Stability in Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: We propose TimePre, a simple framework that unifies the efficiency of Multilayer Perceptron (MLP)-based models with the distributional flexibility of Multiple Choice Learning (MCL) for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting (PTSF). Stabilized Instance Normalization (SIN), the core of TimePre, is a normalization layer that explicitly addresses the trade-off among accuracy, efficiency, and stability. SIN stabilizes the hybrid architecture by correcting channel-wise statistical shifts, thereby resolving the catastrophic hypothesis collapse. Extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets demonstrate that TimePre achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy on key probabilistic metrics. Critically, TimePre achieves inference speeds that are orders of magnitude faster than sampling-based models, and is more stable than prior MCL approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TimePre，一个将 MLP 类模型的效率与多候选学习 (Multiple Choice Learning, MCL) 的分布灵活性统一起来的概率时间序列预测框架。其核心是稳定化实例归一化 (Stabilized Instance Normalization, SIN)，通过修正通道级统计偏移来稳定混合架构，从而解决灾难性假设坍缩 (catastrophic hypothesis collapse)。在六个基准数据集上，TimePre 在关键概率指标上达到 SOTA 精度，推理速度比基于采样的模型快数个数量级，且比先前的 MCL 方法更稳定。
Motivation: 概率时间序列预测需要在精度、效率和稳定性之间权衡；采样式概率模型推理昂贵，而 MLP 类模型效率高但分布灵活性不足，MCL 方法又存在假设坍缩带来的不稳定问题。
Method: 提出 TimePre 框架，结合 MLP 骨干与 MCL 输出分布；核心组件 SIN 归一化层显式处理通道维度的统计偏移，稳定混合架构并避免灾难性假设坍缩。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上，TimePre 在关键概率指标上达到 SOTA 精度；推理速度比基于采样的模型快数个数量级，且稳定性优于此前 MCL 方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 SIN 通过在 MLP-MCL 混合架构中纠正通道级统计偏移，能够同时兼顾精度、效率与稳定性，为概率时间序列预测提供简单而有效的框架。

papers.title: SuperQuadricOcc: Real-Time Self-Supervised Semantic Occupancy Estimation with Superquadric Volume Rendering
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervision for semantic occupancy estimation is appealing as it removes the labour-intensive manual annotation, thus allowing one to scale to larger autonomous driving datasets. Superquadrics offer an expressive shape family very suitable for this task, yet their deployment in a self-supervised setting has been hindered by the lack of efficient rendering methods to bridge the 3D scene representation with 2D training pseudo-labels. To address this, we introduce SuperQuadricOcc, the first self-supervised occupancy model to leverage superquadrics for scene representation. To overcome the rendering limitation, we propose a real-time volume renderer that preserves the fidelity of the superquadric shape during rendering. It relies on spatial superquadric-voxel indexing, restricting each ray sample to query only nearby superquadrics, thereby greatly reducing memory usage and computational cost. Using drastically fewer primitives than prior Gaussian-based methods, SuperQuadricOcc achieves state-of-the-art RayIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes with real-time inference and a substantially reduced memory footprint, while also outperforming Gaussian-based baselines on downstream occupancy forecasting and trajectory estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SuperQuadricOcc，首个利用超二次曲面 (superquadrics) 进行场景表示的自监督语义占据估计模型，并配套提出一个实时体渲染器。渲染器通过空间超二次曲面-体素索引，让每条射线的采样只查询附近的超二次曲面，从而大幅降低内存和计算开销。摘要报告该方法在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上取得最优 RayIoU，支持实时推理，内存占用显著低于基于高斯 (Gaussian) 的先前方法，并在占据预测和轨迹估计等下游任务上超过高斯基线。
Motivation: 自监督语义占据估计可免去繁重的人工标注，便于扩展到更大规模的自动驾驶数据集。超二次曲面提供了适合该任务的表达能力强的形状族，但缺少高效渲染方法来连接 3D 场景表示与 2D 训练伪标签，阻碍了其在自监督场景下的部署。
Method: 提出一个实时的体渲染器，在渲染过程中保持超二次曲面形状的保真度，并采用空间超二次曲面-体素索引，使每个射线样本只查询附近的超二次曲面，从而显著减少内存使用和计算成本。
Result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 上取得最优 RayIoU，实现实时推理并大幅降低内存占用；同时在下游的占据预测和轨迹估计任务上优于基于高斯的基线方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调用远少于高斯方法的基元即可获得实时、低内存且最先进的自监督占据估计，展示了超二次曲面在该任务中的潜力。

papers.title: Gradient Boosted Mixed Models: Flexible Estimation of Mean and Variance Components for Clustered Data
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel way to combine gradient boosting with mixed effects models, whereby the mean and variance components are learned jointly as functions of covariates via likelihood-based gradients. Gradient Boosted Mixed Models (GBMixed) estimates a nonparametric fixed effects function characterizing the overall mean of the response, while also allowing the random effects covariance matrix along with the residual variance to depend on covariates in a flexible manner. We demonstrate how GBMixed facilitates covariate-dependent random effect predictions, and subsequently point predictions and prediction intervals for individual treatment effects, that can adapt between population-level and cluster-level information. Experiments and applications to two real-world datasets show that GBMixed can accurately recover complex nonlinear fixed effect functions and covariate-dependent covariances in a linear mixed model, while also improving point and probabilistic predictive performance compared with several existing approaches such as parametric linear mixed models, Natural Gradient Boosting, and Gaussian Process Boosting. In simulations where the variance components are designed to vary as a function of covariates, GBMixed reduces the mean squared error in recovering the random effects variance function by a factor of eight relative to linear mixed models and Gaussian Process Boosting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出梯度提升混合模型 (Gradient Boosted Mixed Models, GBMixed)，将梯度提升与混合效应模型结合，通过基于似然的梯度联合学习作为协变量函数的均值与方差成分。摘要显示该方法能恢复复杂非线性固定效应函数和随协变量变化的随机效应协方差，并在点预测与概率预测上优于参数线性混合模型、Natural Gradient Boosting 和高斯过程提升。该方法面向聚类数据，可生成协变量依赖的随机效应预测以及个体处理效应的点预测和预测区间。
Motivation: 现有混合效应模型通常假设随机效应协方差矩阵和残差方差为常数或仅由少量参数控制，难以灵活刻画随协变量变化的方差成分；同时聚类数据中的均值函数往往呈复杂非线性，传统参数化方法拟合能力有限。
Method: 提出 GBMixed，利用似然梯度同时估计非参数固定效应函数、随机效应协方差矩阵以及残差方差作为协变量的函数；基于估计结果实现协变量依赖的随机效应预测，进而构建个体处理效应的点预测与预测区间。
Result: 仿真实验和两个真实数据集表明，GBMixed 能准确恢复线性混合模型中的复杂非线性固定效应和协变量依赖协方差；在方差成分随协变量变化的模拟中，恢复随机效应方差函数的均方误差相比线性混合模型和高斯过程提升 (Gaussian Process Boosting) 降低约八倍，并改善了点预测和概率预测性能。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合学习均值与方差成分是性能提升的关键，并表明该方法在聚类数据的点预测和概率预测上优于多种现有方法。摘要未明确讨论局限性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Concept Labels Are Not Enough: Rethinking Concept Bottleneck Models through Representation Integrity
papers.abstract_en: Although deep neural networks achieve strong predictive performance, their internal reasoning often remains difficult to inspect and control. Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) address this opacity by factoring predictions through human-understandable concepts, thereby enabling concept-level inspection and intervention. However, CBMs remain vulnerable to concept shift and information leakage, while existing evaluations neither reveal how the internal features supporting each concept are organized nor identify the representation-level deficiency associated with these failures. We argue that this missing property is concept integrity: concept support should form a semantically coherent and non-fragmented functional group. To characterize this property, we propose group coherence (GC) and concept coverage (CC) as integrity components and aggregate them into the concept integrity score (CIS). We further introduce Concept Integrity Regularization (CIR) to encourage coherent and separated groups of concept-supporting filters. Our latent decoupled concept bottleneck model (LDCBM) applies CIR without requiring region annotations. Across three datasets, CIS rankings differ from rankings by concept and task accuracy, supporting concept integrity as a complementary representation-level criterion. Moreover, with only 10\% of concept labels, LDCBM retains approximately 93\% of its full-label task performance. Background-masking and concept-intervention further associate stronger integrity profiles with lower sensitivity to nuisance context and more responsive concept correction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对概念瓶颈模型（CBM）的可解释性缺陷，提出“概念完整性”（concept integrity）作为表征层面的新评价属性，并用群体一致性（group coherence）与概念覆盖率（concept coverage）聚合为概念完整性评分（CIS）。作者进一步提出概念完整性正则化（CIR）并构建潜在解耦概念瓶颈模型（LDCBM），无需区域标注即可应用。跨三个数据集的结果显示CIS排序不同于概念与任务准确率排序；仅用10%概念标签时LDCBM保留约93%的全标签任务性能，更强的完整性与更低的背景敏感度和更灵敏的概念干预响应相关。
Motivation: CBM虽然通过人可理解的概念实现可检查与可干预，但仍易受概念偏移（concept shift）和信息泄漏影响；现有评测既未揭示支持每个概念的内部特征如何组织，也无法定位与此类失败相关的表征层级缺陷。作者认为缺失的属性正是概念完整性：概念支持应构成语义连贯且非碎片化的功能组。
Method: 将概念完整性分解为群体一致性（GC）和概念覆盖率（CC）两个分量，并聚合为概念完整性评分（CIS）；提出概念完整性正则化（CIR），促使概念支持滤波器形成连贯且分离的组；构建潜在解耦概念瓶颈模型（LDCBM），在不依赖区域标注的条件下应用CIR。
Result: 在三个数据集上，CIS排名与概念准确率及任务准确率的排名不一致，说明概念完整性是互补于任务性能的表征级标准；仅使用10%的概念标签时，LDCBM仍保持约93%的全标签任务性能；背景掩蔽与概念干预实验表明，更强的完整性profile对应更低的干扰背景敏感度以及更有效的概念纠正响应。
Conclusion: 概念完整性可作为一种互补的表征级评价标准，用于诊断CBM中的概念偏移与信息泄漏问题；在极少概念标注下，LDCBM仍能保持接近全标注性能，显示出该正则化方向的实用性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: HyWA: Architecture-Preserving Personalized Voice Activity Detection for Full-Duplex Voice Assistants
papers.abstract_en: Voice activity detection (VAD) serves as an early gate in voice-assistant pipelines for smart devices. Because conventional VADs respond to speech from any speaker, nearby conversations and residual assistant playback lead to unwanted triggers, degrade the user experience, and waste computational resources. Personalized voice activity detection (PVAD) addresses this limitation by detecting speech only from an enrolled target speaker. Existing PVAD methods typically incorporate speaker information into model inputs or hidden representations. These approaches require VAD architectural changes that increase engineering and requalification costs in deployment. We present HyWA, a hypernetwork-based weight-adaptation method that converts an established VAD into a PVAD, while preserving its acoustic interface and inference topology. HyWA generates speaker-conditioned weights once at enrollment and requires no per-user optimization. We apply HyWA to pretrained Alibaba's FSMN and NVIDIA's MarbleNet VAD models. Evaluations on synthetic and real-user test data show consistent improvements in target-speaker discrimination and false-positive suppression. In an integrated full-duplex barge-in pipeline, replacing generic VAD with HyWA-based PVAD reduces observed false-interruption detections from 88.9% to only 9.9%.
papers.comment: Submitted to AAAI/IAAI 2027. Hamed, Amin, and Mahsa contributed equally to this work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HyWA，一种基于超网络 (hypernetwork) 的权重适配方法，将已有的通用 VAD 转换为个性化语音活动检测 (PVAD)，同时保持其声学接口与推理拓扑不变。HyWA 在注册 (enrollment) 时一次性生成说话人条件化的权重，无需逐用户优化。作者将该方法应用于预训练的阿里 FSMN 与 NVIDIA MarbleNet VAD 模型，并在合成与真实用户测试数据上验证了目标说话人判别与误触发抑制的提升。在集成全双工 barge-in 管线中，HyWA 将误打断检测率从 88.9% 降至 9.9%。
Motivation: 传统 VAD 会响应任意说话人的语音，导致附近对话或助手播放残余引发误触发，损害用户体验并浪费计算资源；现有 PVAD 方法需要将说话人信息引入模型输入或隐表示，带来 VAD 架构改动，增加部署中的工程与重新认证成本。
Method: HyWA 利用超网络为已训练的 VAD 生成说话人条件化权重，注册阶段一次性完成，保持模型声学接口和推理拓扑不变，无需逐用户优化。作者将该方法应用于预训练的 FSMN 与 MarbleNet 两个 VAD 模型。
Result: 在合成与真实用户测试数据上，HyWA 一致提升目标说话人判别能力并抑制误报；在集成全双工 barge-in 管线中，用 HyWA 替换通用 VAD 后，误打断检测从 88.9% 降至 9.9%。
Conclusion: 本文表明，通过超网络权重适配可以在不改动原 VAD 架构的前提下将通用 VAD 升级为 PVAD，从而显著减少全双工助手场景中的误打断并降低部署成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On The Statistical Limits of Self-Improving Agents
papers.abstract_en: We develop a learning-theoretic framework for analyzing self-improving agents by decomposing self-modification into five axes. Within this framework, we prove a sharp boundary: under standard i.i.d. assumptions, distribution-free PAC learnability is preserved if and only if the policy-reachable family remains uniformly capacity-bounded. If reachable capacity can grow without bound, utility-rational self-changes can make learnable tasks unlearnable. We further introduce a simple Two-Gate guardrail -- a validation-improvement requirement plus a capacity cap -- that preserves this boundary and yields standard VC-rate guarantees. The broader implication is that self-modification must be constrained not only by objectives, but also by structural conditions that preserve the statistical prerequisites for learning. As AI systems become increasingly intelligent and autonomous, this framework provides a foundation for the statistical theory of self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于分析自我改进智能体（self-improving agents）的学习理论框架，将自我修改分解为五个轴。在标准 i.i.d. 假设下，作者证明了分布无关 PAC 可学习性保持当且仅当策略可达族均匀容量有界（uniformly capacity-bounded）；若可达容量可无界增长，效用理性的自我修改会使原本可学习的任务变得不可学习。文章另提出简单的 Two-Gate 防护机制，可保持该边界并给出标准 VC 率保证。论文发表于 TMLR 2026。
Motivation: 随着 AI 系统越来越智能和自主，自我修改可能破坏学习所需的统计前提；现有讨论多聚焦目标约束，缺少对自我改进统计边界的理论刻画。
Method: 将自我修改分解为五个轴，建立学习理论框架，证明 PAC 可学习性的充分必要条件；随后引入 Two-Gate 防护，即验证-改进要求（validation-improvement requirement）加容量上限（capacity cap）。
Result: 核心理论结果是：在标准 i.i.d. 假设下，分布无关 PAC 可学习性当且仅当策略可达族保持均匀容量有界；一旦可达容量无界增长，可学习任务可变得不可学习；Two-Gate 防护下可恢复标准 VC 率保证。
Conclusion: 作者认为自我修改不仅需要目标约束，还须满足保持学习统计前提的结构条件；该框架为自我改进的统计理论提供基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Easy3D-Labels: Supervising Semantic Occupancy Estimation with 3D Pseudo-Labels for Automotive Perception
papers.abstract_en: In perception for automated vehicles, safety is critical not only for the driver but also for other agents in the scene, particularly vulnerable road users such as pedestrians and cyclists. Previous representation methods, such as Bird's Eye View, collapse vertical information, leading to ambiguity in 3D object localisation and limiting accurate understanding of the environment for downstream tasks such as motion planning and scene forecasting. In contrast, semantic occupancy provides a full 3D representation of the surroundings, addressing these limitations. Unlike supervised methods that rely on manually annotated data, self-supervised approaches use 2D pseudo-labels, improving scalability by reducing the need for labour-intensive annotation. Consequently, such models employ techniques such as novel view synthesis, cross-view rendering, and depth estimation to allow for model supervision against the 2D labels. However, such approaches often incur high computational and memory costs during training, especially for novel view synthesis. To address these issues, we propose Easy3D-Labels, which are 3D pseudo-ground-truth labels generated using Grounded-SAM and Metric3Dv2, with temporal aggregation for densification, permitting supervision directly in 3D space. Easy3D-Labels can be readily integrated into existing models to provide model supervision, yielding substantial performance gains, with mIoU increasing by 45% and RayIoU by 49% when applied to OccNeRF on the Occ3D-nuScenes dataset. Additionally, we introduce EasyOcc, a streamlined model trained solely on these 3D pseudo-labels, avoiding the need for complex rendering strategies and achieving 15.7 mIoU on Occ3D-nuScenes. Easy3D-Labels improve scene understanding by reducing object duplication and enhancing depth estimation accuracy, as reflected by improvements in the RayIoU metric.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Easy3D-Labels，一种用于自动驾驶语义占用估计的 3D 伪标签生成方法，利用 Grounded-SAM 和 Metric3Dv2 直接生成 3D 伪真值，并通过时间聚合（temporal aggregation）进行增密，从而允许模型在 3D 空间直接受到监督。作者将该方法集成到 OccNeRF，在 Occ3D-nuScenes 数据集上 mIoU 提升 45%、RayIoU 提升 49%；同时提出简化模型 EasyOcc，仅用这些 3D 伪标签训练，无需复杂渲染策略，达到 15.7 mIoU。
Motivation: 传统 Bird's Eye View 表示会丢失垂直信息，导致 3D 目标定位模糊；语义占用（semantic occupancy）提供完整 3D 表示，但有监督方法依赖人工标注，自监督方法用 2D 伪标签又常伴随新颖视图合成（novel view synthesis）等高计算和内存成本。
Method: 提出 Easy3D-Labels：使用 Grounded-SAM 与 Metric3Dv2 生成 3D 伪真值标签，并采用时间聚合进行稠密化，使模型可直接在 3D 空间获得监督。另提出 EasyOcc，一个仅在此类 3D 伪标签上训练的精简模型，避免复杂渲染策略。
Result: 在 Occ3D-nuScenes 数据集上，将 Easy3D-Labels 应用于 OccNeRF 使 mIoU 提高 45%、RayIoU 提高 49%；EasyOcc 达到 15.7 mIoU。摘要还指出该标签改善了场景理解，减少物体重复并提升深度估计精度，反映在 RayIoU 指标上。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 Easy3D-Labels 可便捷集成到现有模型以提供监督，并在减少物体重复与提升深度估计方面带来收益，是一种替代高成本 2D 伪标签监督策略的可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FoR-SALE: Frame of Reference-guided Spatial Adjustment in LLM-based Diffusion Editing
papers.abstract_en: Current text-to-image generation models, even state-of-the-art models, exhibit a significant performance gap when spatial expressions are described from non-camera perspectives. To address this limitation, we propose Frame of Reference-guided Spatial Adjustment in LLM-based Diffusion Editing (FoR-SALE), an extension of the Self-correcting LLM-controlled Diffusion (SLD). FoR-SALE first evaluates the alignment between a given text and an initially generated image, and then refines the image based on the expressed FoR in the spatial description. It employs vision modules to extract the spatial configuration of the generated image and simultaneously maps the spatial expression to a corresponding camera perspective. This unified perspective enables direct evaluation of alignment between language and vision. When misalignment is detected, the required editing operations are generated and applied. FoR-SALE introduces novel latent-space operations to adjust the facing direction and depth of generated images. We evaluate FoR-SALE on three benchmarks designed to assess spatial understanding with FoR: FoR-LMD, FoREST, and FoREST-G, with the latter providing diagnostic subsets covering multi-object scenes, expanded relation types, and naturalized prompts to test the generality of our framework. Our framework improves the performance of SOTA T2I models by up to 7.0 pp using only a single round of correction.
papers.comment: Published in COLM 2026. 10 main pages, 4 tables, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FoR-SALE（Frame of Reference-guided Spatial Adjustment in LLM-based Diffusion Editing），用于解决文本到图像生成模型在处理非相机视角空间表达时的性能缺陷。FoR-SALE 是 Self-correcting LLM-controlled Diffusion (SLD) 的扩展，先评估文本与初始生成图像的对齐程度，再根据空间描述中的参照系 (FoR) 精炼图像。它结合视觉模块提取图像的空间配置，并将空间表达映射到对应的相机视角，在统一视角下进行语言与视觉的对齐评估和编辑操作生成。
Motivation: 现有最先进的 text-to-image 模型在描述来自非相机视角的空间表达时存在明显的性能差距，这种空间理解不足限制了模型对复杂空间指令的响应能力。
Method: FoR-SALE 首先利用视觉模块提取生成图像的空间配置，同时将文本中的空间表达映射到相机视角，从而统一视角评估语言与视觉的对齐程度；一旦检测到不对齐，就生成并应用所需的编辑操作。该方法引入了用于调整生成图像朝向和深度的新型潜空间操作 (latent-space operations)。
Result: 在 FoR-LMD、FoREST 和 FoREST-G 三个基准上，FoR-SALE 仅用单轮校正就能将 SOTA T2I 模型的性能提升至多 7.0 个百分点 (pp)；FoREST-G 还提供多物体场景、扩展关系类型和自然化提示的诊断性子集用于检验框架的通用性。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过显式建模参照系并将语言空间表达映射到相机视角，可以在单轮校正内显著改善非相机视角下的空间编辑能力；诊断性子集的结果表明框架具有一定通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: URS: A Unified Neural Routing Solver for Cross-Problem Zero-Shot Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task neural routing solvers have emerged as a promising paradigm for their ability to solve multiple vehicle routing problems (VRPs) using a single model. However, existing neural solvers typically rely on predefined problem constraints or require per-problem fine-tuning, which substantially limits their zero-shot generalization ability to unseen VRP variants. To address this critical bottleneck, we propose URS, a unified neural routing solver that achieves zero-shot generalization across a wide range of unseen VRPs with a single model. We propose a unified data representation (UDR) that replaces problem enumeration with data unification, thereby broadening the problem coverage and reducing reliance on domain expertise. In addition, we introduce a mixed bias module (MBM) during encoding to improve node embeddings, which efficiently captures multiple priors inherent to various problems. On top of the UDR, we develop a problem-conditioned parameter generator to further improve zero-shot generalization. Extensive experiments show that URS consistently produces high-quality solutions for 110 VRP variants (including 99 unseen variants) while demonstrating impressive scalability to large-scale instances with up to 7000 nodes. To the best of our knowledge, URS is the first neural solver to handle over 100 VRP variants with a single model. Our code is available at https://github.com/CIAM-Group/URS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 URS，一个统一的神经路径求解器，通过统一数据表示（UDR）与混合偏差模块（MBM）实现跨未见车辆路径问题（VRP）变体的零样本泛化，仅用单一模型即可处理 110 种 VRP 变体（其中 99 种为未见变体），并扩展到最多 7000 节点的大规模实例。
Motivation: 现有神经路由求解器通常依赖预定义的问题约束或需要逐问题微调，这严重限制了其对未见 VRP 变体的零样本泛化能力。
Method: 提出用数据统一化替代问题枚举的统一数据表示（UDR），以扩大问题覆盖并减少对领域知识的依赖；在编码阶段引入混合偏差模块（MBM）以捕捉多种问题先验、改进节点嵌入；并在此基础上设计问题条件参数生成器以进一步增强零样本泛化。
Result: 实验表明 URS 在 110 种 VRP 变体（包括 99 种未见变体）上持续产生高质量解，并能扩展到多达 7000 节点的大规模实例；据作者所知，这是首个用单一模型处理超过 100 种 VRP 变体的神经求解器。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法有效扩展了问题覆盖范围并降低了对领域专家知识的依赖，代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 摘要强调该方法有效扩展了问题覆盖范围并降低了对领域专家知识的依赖，代码已公开。

papers.title: Towards Geometry-Grounded Dense Semantic Matching with VGGT Priors
papers.abstract_en: Semantic matching aims to establish pixel-level correspondences between instances of the same category and represents a fundamental task in computer vision. Existing approaches suffer from two limitations: (i) Geometric Ambiguity: Their reliance on 2D foundation model features (e.g., Stable Diffusion, DINO) often fails to disambiguate symmetric structures, requiring extra fine-tuning yet lacking generalization; (ii) Nearest-Neighbor Rule: Their pixel-wise matching ignores cross-image invisibility and neglects manifold preservation. These challenges call for geometry-aware pixel descriptors and holistic dense correspondence mechanisms. Inspired by recent advances in 3D geometric foundation models, we turn to VGGT, which provides geometry-grounded features and holistic dense matching capabilities well aligned with these needs. However, directly transferring VGGT is challenging, as it was originally designed for geometry matching within cross views of a single instance, misaligned with cross-instance semantic matching, and further hindered by the scarcity of dense semantic annotations. To address this, we propose an approach that (i) retains VGGT's intrinsic strengths by reusing early feature stages, fine-tuning later ones, and adding a semantic head for bidirectional correspondences; and (ii) adapts VGGT to the semantic matching scenario under data scarcity through cycle-consistent training strategy, synthetic data augmentation, and progressive training recipe with aliasing artifact mitigation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves superior geometry awareness, matching reliability, and manifold preservation, outperforming previous baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 3D 几何基础模型 VGGT 的先验来改进稠密语义匹配 (dense semantic matching)。作者指出现有方法依赖 2D 基础模型特征，存在几何歧义（如对称结构难以区分）和最近邻匹配忽略跨图像可见性与流形保持的问题；其方法保留 VGGT 早期特征阶段、微调后期阶段并新增语义头以预测双向对应关系，通过循环一致性训练、合成数据增强和渐进式训练缓解语义标注稀缺。实验表明该方法在几何感知、匹配可靠性和流形保持上优于以往基线。
Motivation: 现有语义匹配方法依赖 Stable Diffusion、DINO 等 2D 基础模型特征，难以消除对称结构等场景下的几何歧义，且需要额外微调却泛化不足；逐像素最近邻匹配忽略跨图像不可见性，也未保持流形结构。这些局限性促使作者引入具备几何感知特征和整体稠密匹配能力的 3D 几何基础模型 VGGT。
Method: 作者保留 VGGT 早期特征阶段并微调后期阶段，额外添加语义头 (semantic head) 以输出双向对应关系；为将 VGGT 从单实例跨视角几何匹配适配到跨实例语义匹配，并应对稠密语义标注稀缺，采用循环一致性训练策略、合成数据增强和渐进式训练配方，同时缓解混叠伪影 (aliasing artifact)。
Result: 摘要称广泛实验表明该方法在几何感知、匹配可靠性和流形保持等维度上优于以往基线，但未在摘要中给出具体数值或数据集名称。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将几何基础模型先验与循环一致性、数据增强相结合，可以在标注稀缺条件下实现几何匹配到语义匹配的迁移，从而同时改善几何感知与整体稠密对应能力；摘要未详细说明局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Diffusion-Based Impedance Learning for Contact-Rich Manipulation Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Learning-based methods excel at robot motion generation but remain limited in contact-rich physical interaction. Impedance control provides stable and safe contact behavior but requires task-specific tuning of stiffness and damping parameters. We present Diffusion-Based Impedance Learning, a framework that bridges these paradigms by combining generative modeling with energy-consistent impedance control. A Transformer-based Diffusion Model, conditioned via cross-attention on measured external wrenches, reconstructs simulated Zero-Force Trajectories (sZFTs) that represent contact-consistent equilibrium behavior. A SLERP-based quaternion noise scheduler preserves geometric consistency for rotations on the unit sphere. The reconstructed sZFT is used by an energy-based estimator to adapt impedance online through directional stiffness and damping modulation. Trained on parkour and robot-assisted therapy demonstrations collected via Apple Vision Pro teleoperation, the model achieves sub-millimeter positional and sub-degree rotational accuracy using only tens of thousands of samples. Deployed in real-time torque control on a KUKA LBR iiwa, the approach enables smooth obstacle traversal and generalizes to unseen tasks, achieving 100% success in multi-geometry peg-in-hole insertion. The code for all experiments is publicly available on GitHub and videos of the experiments are available on the project website.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于扩散模型的阻抗学习框架（Diffusion-Based Impedance Learning），将生成建模与能量一致的阻抗控制相结合，用于富含接触的机器人操作任务。利用 Transformer 扩散模型重建模拟零力轨迹（simulated Zero-Force Trajectories, sZFT），并据此在线调节刚度与阻尼；在 KUKA LBR iiwa 上实时控制，实现平滑障碍穿越及多几何 peg-in-hole 插入，成功率 100%。
Motivation: 现有学习型方法擅长机器人运动生成，但在接触丰富的物理交互中表现受限；阻抗控制虽能提供稳定安全的接触行为，却需要针对具体任务手工调节刚度和阻尼参数。
Method: 提出一个框架，用通过交叉注意力（cross-attention）以外部力测量为条件的 Transformer 扩散模型重建 sZFT，并采用基于 SLERP 的四元数噪声调度器保持旋转几何一致性；能量估计器利用重建的 sZFT 在线进行方向性刚度与阻尼调制。训练数据来自 Apple Vision Pro 遥操作采集的跑酷和机器人辅助治疗示范。
Result: 仅用数万样本即可达到亚毫米级位置精度和亚度级旋转精度；在 KUKA LBR iiwa 上实时力矩控制中实现平滑障碍穿越并泛化到未见任务，多几何 peg-in-hole 插入成功率达 100%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架桥接了生成建模与能量一致的阻抗控制，从而在接触丰富任务中同时获得稳定与安全的行为；实验代码和视频均已公开。

papers.title: GLAM: Efficient Continual Learning at Scale via Grouped LoRA Adapter Merging
papers.abstract_en: The ability to learn continuously over time remains a major challenge for modern machine learning systems, even in the era of Foundation Models. While the rich representations learned by large pre-trained models can partially mitigate catastrophic forgetting, they still struggle to adapt efficiently to evolving data distributions. A key challenge remains, how to continually add new knowledge to a large pretrained model in a way that is scalable and computationally efficient over long task sequences. In this work, we introduce GLAM, a simple and effective framework for class-incremental continual learning based on LoRA adapters merging. For each task, GLAM trains a lightweight low-rank adapter with an importance scalar, incurring minimal computational overhead. Adapters are then pruned, rescaled, and sequentially grouped to enable structured knowledge reuse and limit parameter growth. At inference, all groups are combined into a single module, ensuring constant computational cost regardless of the number of tasks. We evaluate GLAM on vision benchmarks with sequences of up to 50 tasks, significantly extending beyond standard protocols. GLAM achieves the highest accuracy across the evaluated benchmarks. Compared with the baseline attaining the highest average accuracy across benchmarks, it uses 16--19\% of the trainable parameters and reduces training time by approximately 63--74\%, demonstrating efficient and scalable continual learning. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/atlas-luiss/GLAM.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GLAM，一个基于 LoRA adapter 合并的类增量持续学习框架。每个任务训练一个带重要性标量的轻量低秩 adapter，随后进行剪枝、重缩放和顺序分组，以支持结构化知识复用并控制参数增长；推理时所有组合并为单一模块，计算成本不随任务数增加。在最多 50 个任务的视觉基准序列上，GLAM 取得最高准确率，并且相比平均准确率最高的基线仅使用其 16–19% 的可训练参数，训练时间减少约 63–74%。
Motivation: 即使在大模型时代，持续学习仍难以高效适应不断变化的数据分布；需要一种可扩展且计算高效的方式，在长时间任务序列中向大型预训练模型持续添加新知识。
Method: GLAM 为每个任务训练带重要性标量的轻量低秩 adapter，然后对 adapter 进行剪枝、重缩放并按顺序分组，实现结构化知识复用并限制参数增长；推理时将全部分组合并为单一模块，保证计算成本恒定。
Result: 在包含多达 50 个任务的视觉基准上，GLAM 取得最高平均准确率；与平均准确率最高的基线相比，仅使用 16–19% 的可训练参数，并将训练时间减少约 63–74%。
Conclusion: GLAM 展示了基于 LoRA adapter 合并的简单框架即可实现高效且可扩展的持续学习，并公开了源代码。

papers.title: Learning in ImaginationLand: Omnidirectional Policies through 3D Generative Models (OP-Gen)
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D generative models, which are capable of generating full object shapes from just a few images, now open up new opportunities in robotics. In this work, we show that 3D generative models can be used to augment a dataset from a single real-world demonstration, after which an omnidirectional policy can be learned within this imagined dataset. We found that this enables a robot to perform a task when initialised from states very far from those observed during the demonstration, including starting from the opposite side of the object relative to the real-world demonstration, significantly reducing the number of demonstrations required for policy learning. Through several real-world experiments across tasks such as grasping objects, opening a drawer, and placing trash into a bin, we study these omnidirectional policies by investigating the effect of various design choices on policy behaviour, and we show superior performance to recent baselines which use alternative methods for data augmentation.
papers.comment: Project webpage with robot videos: https://www.robot-learning.uk/op-gen
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OP-Gen，利用近年来可从少量图像生成完整物体形状的 3D 生成模型，从单次真实演示扩增出想象数据集，并在该数据集上学习全方位策略 (omnidirectional policy)。摘要显示该方法使机器人在远离演示观测的初始状态下也能执行任务，包括从物体相对演示的另一侧启动，并显著减少策略学习所需的演示数量。
Motivation: 真实世界演示往往只覆盖有限初始状态，导致策略难以泛化到全新位形；3D 生成模型能从少量输入生成完整物体形状，为机器人数据增强提供了新的可能性。
Method: 基于单个真实演示的图像或观测构建 3D 生成模型，生成大量想象数据来扩增原始数据集，然后在此扩增数据上训练 omnidirectional policy；文中通过多个真实实验考察不同设计选择对策略行为的影响。
Result: 在抓取物体、打开抽屉、将垃圾放入垃圾桶等真实任务中，策略可从远离演示的初始状态（包括物体对面）成功执行，显著降低所需演示数量，并优于采用其他数据增强方式的近期基线。
Conclusion: 作者认为 3D 生成模型驱动的数据增强能够赋予策略全方位的初始状态泛化能力；结论基于若干真实机器人操作任务的实验，未超出摘要所描述的任务范围。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Behavioral Inference at Scale: The Fundamental Asymmetry Between Motivations and Belief Systems
papers.abstract_en: How much information about an agent's underlying values can be recovered from its observable behavior? This question matters for any approach that infers agent properties from action sequences, yet remains empirically open at scale. We address it through controlled experiments: LLM-based agents (Llama 3.1-8B) assigned one of 36 behavioral profiles (9 belief systems x 4 motivations) generate over 1.5 million behavioral sequences in grid-world environments, providing ground truth unavailable in human behavioral studies. After filtering, classifiers train and evaluate on a shared canonical dataset of 10,338 episodes and 1,200,834 sequences. A fundamental asymmetry emerges in both magnitude and structure. Motivations achieve 98-100% accuracy and recover 97% of available mutual information across all architectures. Belief systems plateau at 24% for LSTMs regardless of capacity, and even transformers reach only 34.0%, recovering 16.3% of available information, a 6.1x asymmetry in extraction efficiency. Per-alignment accuracy ranges from 23.2% (Lawful Neutral) to 59.4% (Chaotic Evil). Confusion analysis maps the failure structure: a neutral zone of behavioral ambiguity centers on True Neutral, absorbing misclassified samples from adjacent Neutral and Good alignments whose prosocial or balance-keeping behavior lacks distinctive signal. Combined inference yields 12.2x improvement over random baseline for full 36-class profile classification, with the bottleneck located entirely in belief system inference. Signal enhancement and explanatory queries yield only marginal LSTM gains (+3.8%), confirming the recurrent ceiling is architectural rather than data-limited. Whether the transformer's 34.0% ceiling reflects a similar architectural-class limit or a more fundamental bound remains open. These results characterize what behavioral observation can and cannot reveal about LLM agent values.
papers.comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (2026). OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=aDMDqtw63H
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research, ISSN 2835-8856 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过受控实验研究从可观察行为中恢复 LLM 智能体内在价值的极限：为 Llama 3.1-8B 智能体分配 36 种行为画像（9 种信念系统 × 4 种动机），在网格世界环境中生成超过 150 万条行为序列，并在过滤后的共享规范数据集（10,338 个回合、1,200,834 条序列）上训练分类器。结果显示动机与信念系统存在根本不对称：动机识别准确率达 98-100% 并恢复 97% 的可用互信息，而信念系统在 LSTM 上停滞于 24%、在 Transformer 上也仅达 34.0%，只恢复 16.3% 的可用信息，提取效率相差 6.1 倍。混淆分析表明失败结构集中于以 True Neutral 为中心的中性模糊区。
Motivation: 从行为序列推断智能体属性（如价值观）的方法很多，但关于能从可观测行为中恢复多少关于智能体底层价值观的信息，在大规模条件下仍缺乏实证结论；该问题对任何从行为推断智能体属性的方法都至关重要。
Method: 采用受控实验范式：给 LLM 智能体（Llama 3.1-8B）分配 1/36 种行为画像，在网格世界环境中生成带真实标签的大规模行为序列；过滤后在不同架构的分类器上训练与评测，并补充信号增强与解释性查询（explanatory queries）实验以检验数据是否受限。
Result: 动机识别在所有架构上达到 98-100% 准确率并恢复 97% 可用互信息；信念系统分类 LSTM 上限为 24%，Transformer 最高 34.0%、恢复 16.3% 可用信息，形成 6.1 倍提取效率不对称。单对齐准确率从 Lawful Neutral 的 23.2% 到 Chaotic Evil 的 59.4%；完整 36 类画像的联合推断相比随机基线提升 12.2 倍，瓶颈完全在信念系统推断。信号增强与解释性查询仅给 LSTM 带来 +3.8% 的边际提升。
Conclusion: 摘要认为循环模型在信念系统推断上的瓶颈是架构性的而非数据限制；Transformer 34.0% 的上限究竟属于同类架构限制还是更根本的界限仍属开放问题。整体结果刻画了行为观察能揭示与不能揭示 LLM 智能体价值观的边界。

papers.title: Token-Based Detection of Spurious Correlations in Vision Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Due to their powerful feature association capabilities, neural network-based computer vision models have the ability to detect and exploit unintended patterns within the data, potentially leading to correct predictions based on incorrect or unintended but statistically relevant signals. These clues may vary from simple color aberrations to small pieces of text within the image. In situations where these unintended signals align with the predictive task, models can mistakenly link these features with the task and rely on them for making predictions. This phenomenon is referred to as spurious correlations, where patterns appear to be associated with the task but are actually coincidental. As a result, detection and mitigation of spurious correlations have become crucial tasks for building trustworthy, reliable, and generalizable machine learning models. In this work, we present a token-based diagnostic pipeline that applies leave-one-out token removal to detect spurious correlations in vision transformers. The proposed approach quantifies a model's reliance on non-core visual cues through complementary measures that capture both aggregate and localized spurious effects at the token level. Using both supervised and self-supervised trained models, we present large-scale experiments on the ImageNet dataset demonstrating the ability of the proposed method to identify spurious correlations. We also find that, even if the same architecture is used, the training methodology has a substantial impact on the model's reliance on spurious correlations. Furthermore, we show that for certain ImageNet classes, many images exhibit strong reliance on non-core visual cues across multiple models, and we discuss common sources of such signals (e.g., watermarks and background artifacts). Lastly, we present a case study investigating spurious signals in invasive breast mass classification.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于 token 的诊断流程，通过对 Vision Transformer 进行留一 token 移除 (leave-one-out token removal) 来检测虚假相关 (spurious correlations)。作者在 ImageNet 上对监督和自监督训练模型开展大规模实验，证明该方法能识别模型对非核心视觉线索的依赖，并发现即便架构相同，训练方式也会显著影响模型对虚假相关的依赖。文章还指出部分 ImageNet 类别中多个模型都对水印、背景伪影等非核心线索表现出强依赖，并对浸润性乳腺肿块分类做了案例研究。
Motivation: 神经网络视觉模型会利用数据中非预期但统计相关的信号（如颜色偏差、图像内小段文字）做出看似正确的预测，这种虚假相关会损害模型的可靠性、可信度与泛化能力，因此检测和缓解虚假相关是构建可信模型的关键任务。
Method: 提出 token 级诊断流程，对 Vision Transformer 施加留一 token 移除操作，并通过同时刻画整体与局部虚假效应的互补指标，在 token 级别量化模型对非核心视觉线索的依赖。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上的大规模实验表明该方法能够识别虚假相关；相同架构下训练方式对虚假相关依赖有显著影响；某些 ImageNet 类别中多个模型都对非核心视觉线索表现出强依赖，常见来源包括水印和背景伪影；此外还展示了浸润性乳腺肿块分类的案例研究。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于 token 移除的诊断方法能够有效暴露视觉 Transformer 对虚假相关的依赖，并强调训练方式的影响以及水印、背景伪影等常见信号来源；论文已被 TMLR 接收。

papers.title: Reconfiguration of pivoting cube ensembles under local sensing constraints using geometric deep learning
papers.abstract_en: We demonstrate that local sensing is sufficient for effective global reconfiguration of homogeneous pivoting cube modular robots in two dimensions. While cube selection (i.e., which cube executes a movement) is assumed to be globally coordinated, each cube in the ensemble is controlled by a neural network that only gains information from other cubes in its local neighbourhood, trained using reinforcement learning. Furthermore, we study the effect of including grid symmetries of the cube ensemble (rotation and mirroring) in the neural network architecture. We find that even the most localised versions succeed in reconfiguring to the target shape, although reconfiguration happens faster the more information about the whole ensemble is available to individual cubes. Near-optimal reconfiguration is achieved with only nearest neighbour interactions by using multiple information passing between cubes, allowing them to accumulate more global information about the ensemble. Compared to standard neural network architectures, including grid symmetries provides only minor benefits during training, but allows for reduced model sizes. The presented approach is transferable to other space-relevant systems with different action spaces, such as sliding cube modular robots and CubeSat swarms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究二维同质转轴立方体机器人 (pivoting cube modular robots) 的全局重配置问题，证明在立方体选择由全局协调、但每个立方体仅依赖局部邻域信息的条件下，局部传感足以完成目标形状重构。作者用强化学习训练神经网络控制器，并考察在架构中加入网格对称性（旋转与镜像）的效果。最局部的版本也能成功重构，但信息交流轮次更多时接近最优性能。
Motivation: 模块化机器人大规模重配置常依赖全局通信或集中式规划，本文想验证局部感知约束下能否实现有效全局重构，以降低通信和感知负担。
Method: 每个立方体由仅接收局部邻域信息的神经网络控制，训练使用强化学习；立方体选择假设为全局协调。作者还对比了是否在网络架构中编码二维网格的旋转与镜像对称性，并研究了多轮信息传递（即多次局部信息交换以累积全局信息）的影响。
Result: 摘要报告即使最局部的版本也能成功重构到目标形状；重构速度随单个立方体可获得更多全局信息而加快；仅靠最近邻交互并通过多次信息传递即可达到接近最优的重构性能。相比标准网络架构，纳入网格对称性只在训练中带来微小收益，但允许更小的模型尺寸。
Conclusion: 作者强调该方法的局部感知策略可迁移到其他空间相关系统，如滑动立方体模块化机器人和CubeSat星群，且只要动作空间不同即可适配。

papers.title: Selective Prediction Reduces the Negative Effects of Automation Bias Overall but Increases False Negatives
papers.abstract_en: AI has the potential to augment human decision making. However, even high-performing models can produce inaccurate predictions when deployed. These inaccuracies, combined with automation bias, where humans overrely on AI predictions, can result in worse decisions. Selective prediction, in which potentially unreliable model predictions are hidden from users, has been proposed as a solution. This approach assumes that when AI abstains and informs the user so, humans make decisions as they would without AI involvement. To test this assumption, we study the effects of selective prediction on human decisions in a clinical context. We conducted a user study of 259 clinicians tasked with diagnosing and treating hospitalized patients. We compared their baseline performance without any AI involvement to their AI-assisted accuracy with and without selective prediction. Our findings indicate that selective prediction mitigates the negative effects of inaccurate AI in terms of decision accuracy. Compared to no AI assistance, clinician accuracy declined when shown inaccurate AI predictions (66% [95% CI: 56%-75%] vs. 56% [95% CI: 46%-66%]), but recovered under selective prediction (64% [95% CI: 54%-73%]). However, while selective prediction nearly maintains overall accuracy, our results suggest that it alters patterns of mistakes: when informed the AI abstains, clinicians underdiagnose (18% increase in missed diagnoses) and undertreat (35% increase in missed treatments) compared to no AI input at all. Our findings underscore the importance of empirically validating assumptions about how humans engage with AI within human-AI systems.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. v2: Revised results and analysis; title updated. Previously circulated as "On the Limits of Selective AI Prediction: A Case Study in Clinical Decision Making."
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究选择性预测（selective prediction）在临床决策中的实际效果，通过 259 名临床医生对住院患者进行诊断和治疗的用户实验，比较无 AI 辅助、AI 辅助（含不准确预测）以及选择性预测三种条件下的决策准确率。结果显示选择性预测能抵消不准确 AI 带来的准确率下降，但会改变错误模式，显著增加漏诊和漏治。
Motivation: 即使高性能 AI 在部署时也可能产生不准确预测，结合自动化偏差（automation bias）会导致人类决策变差。选择性预测作为解决方案的前提假设是：当 AI 弃权并告知用户时，人类会像完全没有 AI 参与一样做决策，但这一假设缺乏实证验证。
Method: 作者在临床情境下开展用户研究，招募 259 名临床医生，任务为诊断和治疗住院患者；对比条件包括无 AI 参与的基线、显示不准确 AI 预测、以及选择性预测（隐藏不可靠预测并告知用户弃权），以检验选择性预测对决策准确率和错误模式的影响。
Result: 与无 AI 辅助相比，临床医生看到不准确 AI 预测时准确率从 66%（95% CI: 56%-75%）下降到 56%（95% CI: 46%-66%），而在选择性预测下恢复至 64%（95% CI: 54%-73%）。但选择性预测相比无 AI 输入，使漏诊增加 18%、漏治增加 35%。
Conclusion: 选择性预测虽能大致维持总体准确率，却改变了错误分布，导致假阴性增多；作者强调在人类-AI 系统中必须实证检验关于人类如何与 AI 互动的假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Astrolabe: Balancing Load in LLM Serving with Randomized Prediction-Guided Scheduling
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents Astrolabe, a randomized prediction-guided scheduler for one-shot request dispatch in multi-instance large language model (LLM) serving. Astrolabe improves load balancing without relying on migration-based rebalancing, whose KV-cache transfers can introduce substantial overhead and network contention under high load. It combines response-length estimation, per-instance simulation-based latency prediction, and a power-of-two-choices dispatch policy to balance load while avoiding request herding. On the default Llama-2-7B/ShareGPT setup, Astrolabe matches the SLO capacity of the best load-aware baseline (31.6 versus 31.5 QPS), while reducing mean time-to-first-token (TTFT) by 8 to 36 percent, P99 TTFT by 16 to 77 percent, and mean end-to-end (E2E) latency by up to 5.6 percent, with approximately six times fewer preemptions once capacity is reached. Under configuration shifts, Astrolabe improves SLO capacity by up to 6 percent on Qwen2-7B and 7.1 percent under tight batching, reduces mean E2E latency by 6 to 9 percent under bursty arrivals, and achieves an approximately 2.8-fold reduction in per-predictor CPU usage relative to full fanout. With migration enabled on A100 GPUs, Astrolabe outperforms Llumnix by up to 2.6 times in throughput while achieving orders-of-magnitude lower per-token latency at saturation.
papers.comment: 16 pages. Accepted at SYSTOR 2026. Camera-ready version with expanded evaluation and revisions. Previously circulated as "Block"; renamed "Astrolabe" to match the SYSTOR publication title
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Astrolabe，一种用于多实例大语言模型 (LLM) 服务的随机预测引导调度器，面向一次性请求分发。它结合响应长度估计、基于模拟的每实例延迟预测和 power-of-two-choices 分发策略，在不依赖基于迁移的再平衡的情况下改善负载均衡。在默认 Llama-2-7B/ShareGPT 设定下，Astrolabe 匹配最佳负载感知基线的 SLO 容量，并显著降低 TTFT 与 E2E 延迟，同时减少抢占次数；在配置变化和突发流量下也保持稳健收益。
Motivation: 多实例 LLM 服务中负载不均衡问题突出，而基于迁移的再平衡会因 KV-cache 迁移带来可观的额外开销和网络争用，尤其是在高负载下。
Method: 提出一种随机预测引导的调度机制，融合响应长度估计、每实例模拟式延迟预测以及 power-of-two-choices 分发策略，在平衡负载的同时避免请求羊群效应 (herding)。
Result: 在默认 Llama-2-7B/ShareGPT 设定下，Astrolabe 达到与最佳负载感知基线相当的 SLO 容量（31.6 对 31.5 QPS），同时平均 TTFT 降低 8% 至 36%，P99 TTFT 降低 16% 至 77%，平均端到端延迟最多降低 5.6%，达到容量后抢占次数约减少 6 倍。配置变化下，在 Qwen2-7B 上 SLO 容量提升至多 6%，紧批处理下提升 7.1%，突发到达时平均 E2E 延迟降低 6% 至 9%，单预测器 CPU 使用率相对全扇出降低约 2.8 倍。A100 GPU 上启用迁移时，吞吐量最高达 Llumnix 的 2.6 倍，饱和时每 token 延迟低数个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，通过预测引导的随机分发，Astrolabe 可以在无需迁移式再平衡的情况下实现高 SLO 容量和低延迟，并在配置变化、突发流量等场景下保持稳健；启用迁移时也能显著优于现有迁移式系统。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Exploring Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Consistency Learning and Self-Prompting Evolution for Self-Supervised Tracking
papers.abstract_en: The success of visual tracking has been largely driven by datasets with manual box annotations. However, these box annotations require tremendous human effort, limiting the scale and diversity of existing tracking datasets. In this work, we present a novel high-performance Self-Supervised Tracking model named SSTrack++, designed to eliminate the need of box annotations. Specifically, we design an effective weak-to-strong self-supervised training framework that aims to narrow the feature distribution gap between labeled and unlabeled frames. Building upon this framework, a decoupled spatio-temporal consistency training strategy is introduced to capture rich target information across timestamps by leveraging global spatial localization and local temporal association. Then, a self-prompting evolution module is designed to jointly mine the target appearance evolution at both the feature and decision levels, enabling more robust adaptation to complex and diverse unlabeled tracking scenarios. Furthermore, an instance contrastive loss is formulated to learn instance-level correspondences from a multi-view perspective, providing robust instance-level supervision without any additional annotations. This new design paradigm enables SSTrack++ to not only learn a generalizable tracking representation in a low-annotation self-supervised manner, but also makes it possible to simulate realistic appearance and motion variations of target instances in real-world scenarios. Extensive experiments on ten benchmark datasets demonstrate that SSTrack++ surpasses SOTA self-supervised tracking methods, achieving an improvement of more than 25.8%, 21.4%, and 15.8% in AUC (AO) score on the GOT10K, LaSOT, TrackingNet datasets, respectively, thereby significantly narrowing the performance gap with fully supervised trackers. Code is available at https://github.com/GXNU-ZhongLab/SSTrack.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出名为 SSTrack++ 的自监督视觉跟踪模型，目标是在无需人工框标注的情况下训练高性能跟踪器。作者设计弱到强（weak-to-strong）自监督训练框架以缩小有标签与无标签帧之间的特征分布差距，并引入解耦时空一致性训练、自提示演化模块和实例对比损失，以捕获目标外观与运动的演化。在十个基准数据集上，SSTrack++ 超越现有自监督跟踪方法，并在 GOT10K、LaSOT、TrackingNet 上分别相对提升超过 25.8%、21.4%、15.8% 的 AUC(AO) 分数，显著缩小了与全监督跟踪器的差距。
Motivation: 现有多数视觉跟踪模型的成功依赖大量人工框标注，标注成本高昂，限制了跟踪数据集的规模与多样性。
Method: 提出 SSTrack++ 自监督跟踪框架，包含弱到强自监督训练框架、利用全局空间定位与局部时间关联的解耦时空一致性训练策略、在特征层与决策层联合挖掘目标外观演化的自提示演化模块，以及从多视角学习实例级对应关系的实例对比损失。
Result: 在 GOT10K、LaSOT、TrackingNet 等十个基准上，SSTrack++ 相比 SOTA 自监督跟踪方法分别提升超过 25.8%、21.4%、15.8% 的 AUC(AO) 分数，显著缩小与全监督跟踪器的性能差距。
Conclusion: 该设计使跟踪模型能够以低标注的自监督方式学习可泛化的跟踪表示，并模拟真实场景中目标实例的外观与运动变化，从而消除对框标注的依赖。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: OpenDPDv2: A Unified Learning and Optimization Framework for Neural Network Digital Predistortion
papers.abstract_en: Neural network (NN)-based Digital Predistortion (DPD) improves linearization for wideband radio frequency (RF) power amplifiers (PAs) but often increases the complexity of the digital back-end. This paper presents OpenDPDv2, an open-source end-to-end framework that unifies PA modeling, NN-DPD learning, and deployment-oriented optimization. OpenDPDv2 introduces temporal residual (TRes)-Delta Gated Recurrent Unit (DeltaGRU), a delta-RNN DPD architecture with a lightweight temporal residual path for robust operation under aggressive temporal sparsity, and supports joint optimization with fixed-point quantization. On a 3.5 GHz GaN Doherty PA driven by a TM3.1a 200 MHz 256-QAM OFDM signal, the FP32 TRes-DeltaGRU model achieves -59.9 dBc Adjacent Channel Power Ratio (ACPR) and -42.1 dB Error Vector Magnitude (EVM). With 56% temporal sparsity and W12A12 quantization, the model uses 450 active parameters while maintaining -51.8 dBc ACPR and -35.2 dB EVM. Timing-accurate Gem5-based evaluation further indicates a 4.5x reduction in forward-pass energy for this deployment-oriented operating point. Code, datasets, and documentation are publicly available at https://github.com/lab-emi/OpenDPD.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE Conference on Global Communications (GLOBECOM)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenDPDv2，一个开源端到端框架，统一了功率放大器建模、神经网络数字预失真 (NN-DPD) 学习和面向部署的优化。其中引入 TRes-DeltaGRU 架构，这是一种带轻量时间残差路径的 delta-RNN DPD 结构，并支持与定点量化 (fixed-point quantization) 的联合优化。在 3.5 GHz GaN Doherty PA 上以 TM3.1a 200 MHz 256-QAM OFDM 信号评估，FP32 模型达到 ACPR -59.9 dBc、EVM -42.1 dB；在 56% 时间稀疏度和 W12A12 量化下用 450 个有效参数维持 -51.8 dBc ACPR、-35.2 dB EVM，Gem5 评估显示前向能量降低 4.5 倍。
Motivation: 基于神经网络的数字预失真可以改善宽带射频功率放大器的线性化，但往往增加数字后端复杂度；缺少一个同时覆盖 PA 建模、NN-DPD 学习和部署优化的一体化框架。
Method: 提出 OpenDPDv2 框架，并设计 TRes-DeltaGRU 架构：在 delta-RNN 上增加轻量时间残差路径 (temporal residual path)，以在激进时间稀疏 (temporal sparsity) 条件下保持稳健，同时支持与定点量化联合优化。
Result: 摘要报告在 3.5 GHz GaN Doherty PA 和 200 MHz 256-QAM OFDM 信号下，FP32 TRes-DeltaGRU 的 ACPR 为 -59.9 dBc、EVM 为 -42.1 dB；56% 时间稀疏度和 W12A12 量化下仅用 450 个有效参数即可保持 -51.8 dBc ACPR 与 -35.2 dB EVM，Gem5 时序准确评估显示该部署点前向能量减少 4.5 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能在保持良好线性化性能的同时大幅降低部署开销与能耗，并公开了代码、数据集和文档。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SynBoost: A Synergistic Framework for Fast Sampling of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in visual generation. However, their iterative sampling mechanism results in slow inference speeds. While reducing sampling steps offers an intuitive acceleration strategy, it introduces significant discretization error. Existing fast samplers have made substantial progress in mitigating this error through high-order solvers, yet further optimization appears constrained. This limitation prompts a critical question: can sampling efficiency be advanced beyond current paradigms? In this work, we re-examine the composition of sampling errors and identify two distinct components: the well-studied discretization error and the under-explored approximation error. By implementing a dual-error disentanglement strategy, we elucidate the dynamic interplay between these error types across sampling steps. Building on this empirical analysis, we propose SynBoost, a unified and training-free acceleration framework that simultaneously addresses both error sources to minimize total sampling error. Concretely, it mitigates approximation error by blending the current noise estimation with a more accurate prediction from a larger timestep. SynBoost seamlessly integrates with existing samplers, substantially enhancing their speed and output quality, particularly in regimes with extremely few steps. We validate our framework through extensive experiments across unconditional and conditional generation tasks, encompassing both pixel-space and latent-space DPMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文重新审视扩散模型采样误差的构成，将总误差拆分为已被充分研究的离散化误差 (discretization error) 与较少被探索的近似误差 (approximation error)，并提出名为 SynBoost 的统一、免训练加速框架，通过将当前噪声估计与更大时间步的预测混合来同时抑制两类误差。该方法可与现有采样器无缝集成，在极少量步数下明显提升推理速度与生成质量，并在像素空间与隐空间、无条件与条件生成任务上得到验证。
Motivation: 扩散模型迭代采样导致推理缓慢，减少采样步数会引入显著离散化误差；现有高阶求解器已缓解该误差，但进一步优化空间受限，作者因此追问采样效率能否超越当前范式。
Method: 提出双误差解耦策略 (dual-error disentanglement)，分析各采样步上两类误差的动态相互作用；在此基础上构建 SynBoost，通过将当前噪声估计与来自更大时间步的更准确预测混合来降低近似误差，并以训练免费的方式集成到已有采样器中。
Result: 摘要报告该框架在极少数步数区间显著提升现有采样器的速度与输出质量，并在无条件/条件生成、像素空间与隐空间扩散模型的广泛实验中验证了有效性，但未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为同时针对两类误差来源的免训练统一框架能够突破现有快采样器在极少步数下的性能瓶颈，并且 SynBoost 可以与既有采样器无缝结合。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: FARCLUSS: Fuzzy Adaptive Rebalancing and Contrastive Uncertainty Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised semantic segmentation (SSSS) faces persistent challenges in effectively leveraging unlabeled data, such as ineffective utilization of pseudo-labels, exacerbation of class imbalance biases, and neglect of prediction uncertainty. Current approaches often discard uncertain regions through strict thresholding favouring dominant classes. To address these limitations, we introduce a holistic framework that transforms uncertainty into a learning asset through four principal components: (1) fuzzy pseudo-labeling, which preserves soft class distributions from top-K predictions to enrich supervision; (2) uncertainty-aware dynamic weighting, that modulate pixel-wise contributions via entropy-based reliability scores; (3) adaptive class rebalancing, which dynamically adjust losses to counteract long-tailed class distributions; and (4) lightweight contrastive regularization, that encourage compact and discriminative feature embeddings. Extensive experiments on benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches, achieving significant improvements in the segmentation of under-represented classes and ambiguous regions.
papers.comment: Accepted in Neural Networks (Elsevier), article 109494. 15 pages, 7 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FARCLUSS，一个面向半监督语义分割 (SSSS) 的完整框架，将预测不确定性转化为学习信号。框架包含四个组件：模糊伪标签 (fuzzy pseudo-labeling)、基于熵的逐像素不确定性动态加权、自适应类别再平衡 (adaptive class rebalancing) 以及轻量对比正则化。实验表明该方法在分割少数类与模糊区域上优于现有最先进方法。
Motivation: 半监督语义分割在利用无标签数据时面临三大问题：伪标签利用不充分、类别不平衡偏差被加剧、预测不确定性被忽视。现有方法常通过严格阈值丢弃不确定区域，偏向主导类别，导致少数类分割效果差。
Method: 提出四组件框架：使用 top-K 预测保留软类别分布以构造模糊伪标签；通过熵可靠性分数调制逐像素贡献；动态调整损失以缓解长尾类别分布；引入轻量对比正则化以学习紧凑且有判别性的特征嵌入。
Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，FARCLUSS 在分割欠代表类别和模糊区域方面优于当前最先进方法，取得显著改进。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将不确定性转化为学习资产、而非丢弃的策略可以有效提升半监督语义分割中困难区域与少数类的性能；该方法以期用于需要精细分割的应用场景。

papers.title: HSSBench: Benchmarking Humanities and Social Sciences Ability for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential to advance a broad range of domains. However, current benchmarks for evaluating MLLMs primarily emphasize general knowledge and vertical step-by-step reasoning typical of STEM disciplines, while overlooking the distinct needs and potential of the Humanities and Social Sciences (HSS). Tasks in the HSS domain require more horizontal, interdisciplinary thinking and a deep integration of knowledge across related fields, which presents unique challenges for MLLMs, particularly in linking abstract concepts with corresponding visual representations. Addressing this gap, we present HSSBench, a dedicated benchmark designed to assess the capabilities of MLLMs on HSS tasks in multiple languages, including the six official languages of the United Nations. We also introduce a novel data generation pipeline tailored for HSS scenarios, in which multiple domain experts and automated agents collaborate to generate and iteratively refine each sample. HSSBench contains over 13,000 meticulously designed samples, covering six key categories. We benchmark more than 20 mainstream MLLMs on HSSBench and demonstrate that it poses significant challenges even for state-of-the-art models. We hope that this benchmark will inspire further research into enhancing the cross-disciplinary reasoning abilities of MLLMs, especially their capacity to internalize and connect knowledge across fields.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HSSBench，一个专门评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在人文社科 (Humanities and Social Sciences, HSS) 任务上能力的基准，覆盖联合国六种官方语言，包含超过 13,000 个样本和六个关键类别。作者还引入一套面向 HSS 场景的数据生成流水线，由多个领域专家与自动化 agent 协作生成并迭代精炼每个样本。对 20 多个主流 MLLM 的评测显示，即使是当前最先进的模型在该基准上也面临显著挑战。
Motivation: 现有 MLLM 基准主要侧重 STEM 学科中的通用知识与垂直逐步推理，忽略了人文社科领域的独特需求。HSS 任务需要更横向的跨学科思维以及对相关领域知识的深度整合，特别是将抽象概念与对应视觉表征联系起来，这给 MLLM 带来了独特挑战。
Method: 构建 HSSBench 基准并提出一个针对 HSS 场景的新型数据生成流水线，其中多个领域专家与自动化 agent 协作，对每个样本进行生成和迭代式精炼。基准覆盖多语言（联合国六种官方语言）和六个关键类别。
Result: HSSBench 包含超过 13,000 个精心设计的样本。作者在 20 多个主流 MLLM 上进行了基准测试，结果表明该基准对最先进的模型也构成了显著挑战。
Conclusion: 作者希望该基准能激励未来研究提升 MLLM 的跨学科推理能力，尤其是跨领域知识的内化与连接能力。

papers.title: Generalized Linear Markov Decision Process
papers.abstract_en: Offline reinforcement learning for longitudinal studies often faces two linked challenges: rewards may be binary or bounded, and reward observations may be available only for a subset of trajectories or time points even when the corresponding state-action-next-state histories are available. Linear Markov decision process methods are tractable because Bellman backups remain linear, but they require linear rewards and do not indicate how transition-only observations should be used. We introduce GRASP-MDP, Generalized Reward And Semi-supervised Pessimism for Markov Decision Processes, a reward-transition separated framework addressing both issues through one Bellman decomposition. It preserves linear transition dynamics while modeling reward means through generalized linear models. Although this breaks the usual linear Bellman form, the backup remains explicit as a nonlinear reward component plus a linear continuation component, yielding a nonlinear-plus-linear Bellman-complete class. In the resulting recursion, observed rewards estimate the generalized reward component, while all available transitions estimate the continuation component. The resulting pessimistic value iteration controls the two estimation errors separately without reward imputation. Finite-sample guarantees show that transition-only observations reduce transition-estimation error while reward uncertainty remains governed by observed rewards. Simulations and a multiple sclerosis electronic health record application illustrate the empirical benefit of retaining transition-only observations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GRASP-MDP，一个面向纵向研究离线强化学习的奖励-转移分离框架，同时处理二元/有界奖励以及仅部分轨迹或时间点有奖励观测的情形。它在线性转移动态下用广义线性模型建模奖励均值，将 Bellman 备份分解为非线性奖励项加线性延续项，并采用悲观值迭代分别控制两类估计误差。有限样本保证显示，仅有转移的观测可以降低转移估计误差，而奖励不确定性仍由已观测奖励决定。
Motivation: 离线强化学习用于纵向研究时，奖励可能是二元或有界的，且奖励观测可能只覆盖部分轨迹或时间点；线性 MDP 方法虽然可处理，但要求奖励线性，也没有说明如何利用仅有转移的观测。
Method: 引入 GRASP-MDP，通过一种 Bellman 分解将奖励与转移建模分开：保留线性转移动态，用广义线性模型（GLM）建模奖励均值；得到的备份是显式的非线性奖励分量加线性延续分量，形成非线性加线性的 Bellman-complete 类。估计时用已观测奖励估计广义奖励分量，用所有可用转移估计延续分量，并通过悲观值迭代分别控制两种误差，无需奖励插补（imputation）。
Result: 有限样本保证表明，利用仅有转移的观测可以降低转移估计误差，同时奖励不确定性仍由实际观测到的奖励决定；模拟实验和多发性硬化症电子健康记录应用展示了保留仅有转移观测的实证收益。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，将奖励估计与转移估计分离并分别施加悲观控制，可以在奖励缺失或非线性的纵向离线强化学习中有效利用转移数据。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GAM-Agent: Game-Theoretic and Uncertainty-Aware Collaboration for Complex Visual Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose GAM-Agent, a game-theoretic multi-agent framework for enhancing vision-language reasoning. Unlike prior single-agent or monolithic models, GAM-Agent formulates the reasoning process as a non-zero-sum game between base agents--each specializing in visual perception subtasks--and a critical agent that verifies logic consistency and factual correctness. Agents communicate via structured claims, evidence, and uncertainty estimates. The framework introduces an uncertainty-aware controller to dynamically adjust agent collaboration, triggering multi-round debates when disagreement or ambiguity is detected. This process yields more robust and interpretable predictions. Experiments on four challenging benchmarks--MMMU, MMBench, MVBench, and V*Bench--demonstrate that GAM-Agent significantly improves performance across various VLM backbones. Notably, GAM-Agent boosts the accuracy of small-to-mid scale models (e.g., Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-14B) by 5--6\%, and still enhances strong models like GPT-4o by up to 2--3\%. Our approach is modular, scalable, and generalizable, offering a path toward reliable and explainable multi-agent multimodal reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025. Code available at https://github.com/jushengzhang/Gam-Agent
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GAM-Agent，一个基于博弈论的多智能体框架，用于增强视觉-语言推理。该框架将推理过程建模为视觉感知子任务智能体与负责逻辑和事实校验的批判智能体之间的非零和博弈，并通过不确定性感知控制器动态调整协作、在检测到分歧时触发多轮辩论。在 MMMU、MMBench、MVBench 和 V*Bench 四个基准上，该方法在不同 VLM 主干上显著提升性能。
Motivation: 现有单智能体或单体模型在复杂视觉推理中缺乏多角度校验，容易出现逻辑不一致或事实错误，且对不确定性缺乏显式建模。
Method: 提出博弈论多智能体框架，将推理建模为非零和博弈：基础智能体各自负责视觉感知子任务，批判智能体验证逻辑与事实；智能体之间通过结构化声明、证据和不确定性估计通信，并由不确定性感知控制器动态调整协作，在发现分歧或模糊时触发多轮辩论。
Result: 在 MMMU、MMBench、MVBench 和 V*Bench 上的实验表明，GAM-Agent 显著提升各 VLM 主干性能，其中小到中等规模模型（如 Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-14B）准确率提升 5–6%，强模型如 GPT-4o 也提升 2–3%。
Conclusion: 该方法模块化、可扩展且可泛化，为可靠且可解释的多智能体多模态推理提供了一条路径。

papers.title: Demystifying Adversarial Robustness in Diffusion Models: Compression, Randomness, and Geometry
papers.abstract_en: Recent studies suggest that diffusion models significantly improve the empirical adversarial robustness of deep neural network models. While intuitive explanations have been proposed, the mechanisms underlying diffusion-based robustness remain largely unclear. This work aims to demystify how diffusion models improve adversarial robustness. We observe that diffusion models surprisingly increase the $\ell_p$ distance to clean samples, thus rejecting the hypothesis that purification denoises perturbed images closer to the clean ones. Next, we provide a unifying account of the robustness improvement in diffusion-based purification by decomposing it into two sources: (i) gradient masking induced by randomness; (ii) compression of the image space. First, we find that the purified images are heavily influenced by the internal randomness of diffusion models. This randomness leads to gradient masking that cannot be removed by the previously proposed remedy, i.e., expectation-over-transformation (EOT). The improvement in robustness due to randomness is determined by the cosine similarity of the optimal vs. empirical attack directions, as predicted by a hyperspherical cap model of the adversarial regions. Second, we find that, when fixing the randomness, diffusion models substantially compress the image space. Importantly, we discover a lawful relationship between the model's ability to compress the image space and the genuine adversarial robustness gain. Further theoretical analyses show that convergent score fields encoded in diffusion models explain these compression effects. Our findings reveal new insights into the mechanisms underlying diffusion-based purification, and offer guidance for developing more effective and principled adversarial purification systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文旨在解释扩散模型（diffusion models）如何提升深度神经网络的对抗鲁棒性。作者观察发现扩散净化（diffusion-based purification）反而增加了扰动样本与干净样本的ℓp距离，从而否定了“净化会把扰动样本移回干净样本”的假设。他们将鲁棒性提升分解为两个来源：扩散模型内部随机性导致的梯度掩盖（gradient masking），以及扩散模型对图像空间的压缩；并用超球冠模型和收敛得分场（score fields）分别解释随机性与压缩的作用。
Motivation: 已有研究表明扩散模型能显著提升经验对抗鲁棒性，但其背后的机制尚不清楚；直觉性解释缺乏验证，需要一个统一的、可量化的理论框架来理解鲁棒性从何而来。
Method: 通过实证观察排除“净化使扰动样本接近干净样本”的假设；将扩散净化的鲁棒性分解为随机性引起的梯度掩盖与图像空间压缩两个来源。用期望变换（EOT）检验随机性导致的梯度掩盖，用超球冠模型刻画最优与经验攻击方向的余弦相似度，并建立压缩能力与真实鲁棒性增益之间的定量关系，最后用扩散模型编码的收敛得分场解释压缩效应。
Result: 摘要报告两个主要发现：其一，净化图像受扩散模型内部随机性的强烈影响，这种随机性导致的梯度掩盖无法通过EOT移除，其鲁棒性提升由最优与经验攻击方向的余弦相似度决定；其二，固定随机性后扩散模型显著压缩图像空间，且压缩能力与真实对抗鲁棒性增益之间存在规律性关系。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些发现揭示了扩散净化机制的新见解，可为开发更有效、更有原则的对抗净化系统提供指导。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告两个主要发现：其一，净化图像受扩散模型内部随机性的强烈影响，这种随机性导致的梯度掩盖无法通过EOT移除，其鲁棒性提升由最优与经验攻击方向的余弦相似度决定；其二，固定随机性后扩散模型显著压缩图像空间，且压缩能力与真实对抗鲁棒性增益之间存在规律性关系。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为这些发现揭示了扩散净化机制的新见解，可为开发更有效、更有原则的对抗净化系统提供指导。

papers.title: High-Dimensional Calibration from Swap Regret
papers.abstract_en: We study online calibration of multi-dimensional forecasts over an arbitrary convex set $P \subset \mathbb{R}^d$ relative to an arbitrary norm $|\cdot|$. We connect this to external regret minimization for online linear optimization (OLO): if one can guarantee $O(\sqrt{ρT})$ worst-case regret after $T$ rounds when actions are drawn from $P$ and losses from the dual $|\cdot|_*$ unit norm ball, then one can obtain $ε$-calibrated forecasts after $T = \exp(\tilde O(ρ/ε^2))$ rounds. When $P$ is the $d$-dimensional simplex and $|\cdot|$ is the $\ell_1$-norm, the $O(\sqrt{T\log d})$ experts regret bound yields $ε$-calibrated forecasts after $T = \exp(\tilde O(\log d/ε^2)) = d^{\tilde O(1/ε^2)}$ rounds, recovering a recent result of Peng (2025). Interestingly, our algorithm obtains this guarantee without requiring access to any online linear optimization subroutine or knowledge of the optimal rate $ρ$ -- in fact, our algorithm is identical for every setting of $P$ and $|\cdot|$. Instead, we show that the optimal regularizer for the above OLO problem can be used to upper bound the above calibration error by a swap regret, which we then minimize by running the recent TreeSwap algorithm (Dagan et al., 2024; Peng and Rubinstein, 2024) with Follow-The-Leader as a subroutine. The resulting algorithm is highly efficient and plays a distribution over simple averages of past observations in each round. Finally, we prove that any online calibration algorithm that guarantees $εT$ $\ell_1$-calibration error over the $d$-dimensional simplex requires $T \geq \exp(\mathrm{poly}(1/ε))$ (assuming $d \geq \mathrm{poly}(1/ε)$). This strengthens the corresponding $d^{Ω(\log(1/ε))}$ lower bound of Peng (2025), and shows that an exponential dependence on $1/ε$ is necessary.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多维预测的在线标定（online calibration）问题，预测值取自任意凸集 P 且误差用任意范数度量。作者将标定误差与在线线性优化（OLO）的外部 regret 联系起来：若存在 O(√(ρT)) 的最坏情况 regret 界，则可在 T = exp(Õ(ρ/ε²)) 轮后得到 ε-标定预测。算法不依赖任何 OLO 黑盒或对最优速率 ρ 的估计，对任意 P 和范数都是同一套流程，通过将标定误差上界化为 swap regret 并用 TreeSwap 算法最小化；此外还证明了对单纯形上 ℓ1 标定误差的指数下界。
Motivation: 现有多维标定算法通常依赖在线线性优化子程序或对问题特定参数（如最优 regret 速率 ρ）的显式知识，且高维单纯形情形下的下界不够强。本文试图给出统一、自适应的标定算法，并证明指数依赖 1/ε 的必要性。
Method: 作者证明最优 OLO 正则子可用于将标定误差上界化为 swap regret，然后直接运行 TreeSwap 算法（以 Follow-The-Leader 为子程序）来最小化该 swap regret；算法每轮在简单历史观测均值上给出分布，且对所有 P 和范数设置完全相同。
Result: 在 d 维单纯形和 ℓ1 范数下，结合专家的 O(√(T log d)) regret 界，算法在 T = d^{Õ(1/ε²)} 轮后达到 ε-标定，复现了 Peng (2025) 的结果；同时证明任何保证 εT ℓ1-标定误差的算法在 d ≥ poly(1/ε) 时需要 T ≥ exp(poly(1/ε))，强化了 Peng 的 d^{Ω(log(1/ε))} 下界。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该算法无需在线线性优化子程序或参数知识即可恢复已知上界，并证明对 1/ε 的指数依赖在高维单纯形标定中是必要的。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Music Interpretation and Emotion Perception: A Computational and Neurophysiological Investigation
papers.abstract_en: This study investigates emotional expression and perception in music performance using computational and neurophysiological methods. The influence of different performance settings, such as repertoire, diatonic modal etudes, and improvisation, as well as levels of expressiveness, on performers' emotional communication and listeners' reactions is explored. Professional musicians performed various tasks, and emotional annotations were provided by both performers and the audience. Audio analysis revealed that expressive and improvisational performances exhibited unique acoustic features, while emotion analysis showed stronger emotional responses. Neurophysiological measurements indicated greater relaxation in improvisational performances. This multimodal study highlights the significance of expressivity in enhancing emotional communication and audience engagement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文结合计算与神经生理学方法研究音乐表演中的情感表达与感知，比较不同曲目、教会调式练习曲与即兴演奏以及表达强度对表演者情感传达和听众反应的影响。音频分析显示富有表达力和即兴的表演具有独特声学特征并引发更强情绪反应，神经生理测量则表明即兴演奏中表演者更放松。
Motivation: 现有研究较少从多模态角度比较不同表演设置（如曲目类型、表达水平）如何影响表演者与听众之间的情感沟通，本文旨在填补这一空白。
Method: 专业音乐家完成多种表演任务，表演者与听众均提供情感标注，结合音频分析（acoustic features）和神经生理测量（如放松程度）进行多模态研究。
Result: 音频分析显示表达性与即兴表演具有独特声学特征，情绪分析显示这类表演引发更强情绪反应；神经生理测量表明即兴演奏中表演者放松程度更高。
Conclusion: 摘要强调表达性（expressivity）对增强情感沟通与听众参与的重要性，并展示计算与神经生理方法结合用于音乐情感研究的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Fréchet functional regression in manifolds from time-correlated bivariate curve data
papers.abstract_en: Under mild conditions, a least-squares local linear Fréchet curve predictor is derived for a response and a regressor evaluated in a separable Hilbert space. The conditions that allow the implementation of the local linear Fréchet functional predictor in the ambient L2-space of vector functions, with values in the time-varying tangent space of a compact Riemannian manifold, are established. An intrinsic local linear Fréchet curve predictor on such a manifold is then proposed, based on a weighted Fréchet mean approach. Its asymptotic optimality is proved. Simulations and a real-data application are considered to analyze the finite-sample performance of the empirical versions of both predictors, compared with a geodesic Nadaraya-Watson-type curve predictor. In the real-data application, the functional prediction of the time-varying spherical coordinates of the Earth's magnetic field is addressed usingobservations through time of the geocentric latitude and longitude of the NASA MAGSAT spacecraft.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在可分希尔伯特空间中推导了响应与回归量的最小二乘局部线性 Fréchet 曲线预测器，并建立了在紧黎曼流形切空间实施该预测器的充分条件；随后基于加权 Fréchet 均值提出了流形上的内蕴局部线性 Fréchet 曲线预测器，并证明了其渐近最优性。模拟和真实数据应用（基于 NASA MAGSAT 航天器地心经纬度观测预测地球磁场时变球坐标）检验了两种经验预测器的有限样本性能，并与测地 Nadaraya-Watson 型曲线预测器进行了比较。
Motivation: 现有函数回归方法在处理取值于流形的时间相关双变量曲线数据时，缺少局部线性 Fréchet 预测理论；本文目标是在温和条件下给出可行的预测器并建立其理论最优性。
Method: 先在 L2 空间中构建局部线性 Fréchet 函数预测器，并给出内蕴版本在紧黎曼流形上实施的充分条件；随后利用加权 Fréchet 均值提出流形上的内蕴局部线性 Fréchet 曲线预测器，并推导其渐近性质。
Result: 摘要报告所提出的预测器具有渐近最优性；模拟与真实数据实验表明，其有限样本性能优于测地 Nadaraya-Watson 型曲线预测器。摘要未提供具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者强调在温和条件下，基于加权 Fréchet 均值的局部线性 Fréchet 曲线预测器可以推广到紧黎曼流形场景，适用于函数型数据的预测问题。

papers.title: Bayesian Federated Cause-of-Death Classification and Quantification Under Distribution Shift
papers.abstract_en: In regions lacking medically certified causes of death, verbal autopsy (VA) is a widely used tool to ascertain the cause of death through interviews with caregivers. Data collected by VAs are often analyzed using probabilistic algorithms. The performance of these algorithms often degrades due to distribution shift across populations. Most existing VA algorithms rely on centralized training, requiring full access to training data for joint modeling. This can be infeasible due to privacy and logistical constraints. In this paper, we propose a novel Bayesian Federated Learning (BFL) framework that avoids data sharing across multiple training sources. Our method supports individual-level cause-of-death classification and population-level quantification of cause-specific mortality fractions in a target domain with limited or no local labeled data. The proposed framework is modular, computationally efficient, and compatible with a wide range of existing VA algorithms as base models, facilitating flexible deployment in real-world mortality surveillance systems. We validate the performance of BFL through extensive experiments on two real-world VA datasets under varying levels of distribution shift scenarios. Our results show that BFL significantly outperforms single-domain base models and performs comparably to or better than joint modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯联邦学习（Bayesian Federated Learning, BFL）框架，用于口头尸检（verbal autopsy, VA）数据中的死因分类与死因构成比估计，在无需共享多来源训练数据的前提下应对跨群体分布偏移。方法支持个体层面死因分类和群体层面死因构成比量化，并与多种现有VA算法兼容。在两个真实VA数据集、多种分布偏移场景下，BFL显著优于单域基模型，性能与联合建模相当或更好。
Motivation: 现有VA算法通常依赖集中式训练，需要完整访问训练数据进行联合建模，而隐私和物流约束使多来源数据共享难以实现；同时跨群体的分布偏移会导致算法性能下降。
Method: 提出模块化的BFL框架，避免多训练源之间的数据共享，兼容多种VA基模型作为基础算法；在目标域只有少量或没有本地标注数据时，仍能支持个体级死因分类和群体级死因构成比估计。
Result: 在两个真实VA数据集上，针对不同程度分布偏移的实验表明，BFL显著优于单域基模型，且与联合建模性能相当或更好。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架模块化、计算高效，可灵活部署于实际死亡监测系统；但未明确指出方法局限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: WaveInst: A Frequency-Domain Enhanced Network for Fine-Grained Thin Tree Trunk Extraction in Forest Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Analyzing tree morphology, particularly trunk and branch extraction, is valuable for genetic breeding and forestry management. Existing image-based deep learning methods tend to misidentify overlapping trunks as a single trunk when structural discontinuities occur due to front-back overlap, while low contrast between trunk textures and the background further complicates segmentation. Moreover, limited juvenile tree data, coupled with substantial variations in trunk diameter across growth stages, restricts model performance in extracting thin trunks and branches. Based on this, we propose an instance segmentation network leveraging frequency-domain features, WaveInst. Its core is a Frequency-domain Feature Compensation branch, consisting of Discrete Wavelet Transform block and High-Frequency Enhancement block. The former performs high- and low-frequency decomposition and aggregates high-frequency responses along multiple directions, while the latter further refines the high-frequency features through multi-path processing. An Adaptive Gated Fusion Module is then applied to effectively integrate spatial-domain convolutional features with frequency-domain representations, allowing the decoder to utilize embedded frequency-domain features to enhance its fine-grained detail representation. We conduct experiments on public datasets including SynthTree43k, CaneTree100, and UrbanStreet, as well as PoplarDataset, which contains both mature and juvenile poplar trees. On the public datasets, WaveInst demonstrates strong performance and stable robustness across diverse scenarios. On PoplarDataset, it achieves a mean average precision of 53.1 for mature and 29.1 for juvenile, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods on juvenile by 6.6 points, demonstrating its effectiveness in extracting thin tree trunk.

papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing, vol. 64, pp. 4409718-4409718, 2026, Art no. 4409718
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WaveInst，一种利用频域特征增强的实例分割网络，用于森林场景中细粒度细树干提取。其核心是频域特征补偿分支，由离散小波变换块和高频增强块组成，并通过自适应门控融合模块将空间域卷积特征与频域表示集成。在包含成熟和幼龄杨树的 PoplarDataset 上，该方法对成熟和幼龄树分别达到 53.1 和 29.1 的平均精度，在幼龄树上比现有最优方法高 6.6 个点。
Motivation: 现有基于图像的深度学习方法在前景背景重叠导致结构不连续时，容易将重叠树干误识别为单根树干；树干纹理与背景对比度低进一步增加分割难度。此外，幼树数据有限且不同生长阶段树干直径差异大，限制了模型对细树干和枝条的提取性能。
Method: 提出基于频域特征的实例分割网络 WaveInst，核心是频域特征补偿分支，包含离散小波变换块（对高低频分解并沿多方向聚合高频响应）和高频增强块（通过多路径处理进一步细化高频特征）。自适应门控融合模块将空间域卷积特征与频域表示有效集成，使解码器利用嵌入的频域特征增强细粒度细节表示。
Result: 在公开数据集 SynthTree43k、CaneTree100、UrbanStreet 以及包含成熟和幼龄杨树的 PoplarDataset 上，WaveInst 表现出较强的性能和跨场景的稳定鲁棒性。在 PoplarDataset 上，成熟树平均精度为 53.1，幼龄树为 29.1，在幼龄树上超越现有最优方法 6.6 个点。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法在提取细树干方面有效，适用于森林场景中的树干形态分析，但摘要未明确讨论方法在其他场景或类别上的泛化局限。

papers.title: TransitReID: Transit OD Data Collection with Occlusion-Resistant Dynamic Passenger Re-Identification
papers.abstract_en: Transit Origin-Destination (OD) data are fundamental for optimizing public transit services, yet current collection methods, such as manual surveys, Bluetooth/WiFi tracking, and Automated Passenger Counters, are often costly, device-dependent, or unable to support individual-level matching. Meanwhile, onboard surveillance cameras already deployed on most transit vehicles provide an underutilized opportunity for automated OD data collection. Leveraging this, we present TransitReID, a framework for individual-level and occlusion-resistant passenger re-identification (ReID) tailored to transit environments. TransitReID introduces three key components: (1) an occlusion- and viewpoint-robust ReID algorithm that integrates a variational autoencoder-guided region-attention mechanism with selective feature pooling to emphasize visible and discriminative body regions; (2) a Hierarchical Storage and Dynamic Matching (HSDM) mechanism that adapts static ReID matching to dynamic bus operations while balancing accuracy, memory, and speed; and (3) a multi-threaded edge implementation that enables near real-time OD estimation while preserving privacy through local data processing. We also construct a new Transit ReID dataset with over 17,000 images captured from real bus front/rear cameras under diverse occlusion and viewpoint conditions. Experimental results show that TransitReID achieves state-of-the-art ReID performance, attaining 88.3% R-1 accuracy on the proposed transit ReID dataset and sustaining 80-90% OD estimation accuracy in both simulations and real-world operation, with deployment supported on NVIDIA Jetson edge devices. This work provides an algorithmic and system-level foundation for scalable, privacy-preserving automated transit OD collection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TransitReID，一个面向公交环境的遮挡鲁棒行人重识别框架，利用已部署的车载监控摄像头进行个体级 Origin-Destination (OD) 数据自动采集。框架包含遮挡与视角鲁棒的 ReID 算法（变分自编码器引导的区域注意力与选择性特征池化）、分层存储与动态匹配机制（HSDM）以及多线程边缘实现。在自建的真实公交前后摄像头数据集（超过 17,000 张图像）上达到 88.3% R-1，并在仿真与实际运行中维持 80-90% 的 OD 估计准确率。
Motivation: 现有公交 OD 数据采集方法如人工调查、蓝牙/WiFi 追踪和自动乘客计数器成本高、依赖设备或无法支持个体级匹配；而大多数公交车辆已部署的车载监控摄像头未被充分利用。
Method: 提出三部分框架：一是集成变分自编码器引导的区域注意力机制与选择性特征池化的 ReID 算法，强调可见且有判别力的身体区域；二是将静态 ReID 匹配适配为动态公交运营的分层存储与动态匹配（HSDM）机制，在准确率、内存和速度间平衡；三是多线程边缘实现，通过本地数据处理保护隐私并支持准实时 OD 估计。
Result: 在新建的 Transit ReID 数据集上达到 88.3% R-1 的 ReID 准确率；在仿真和实际运营中 OD 估计准确率为 80-90%，并支持在 NVIDIA Jetson 边缘设备上部署。
Conclusion: 本文为可扩展、保护隐私的自动化公交 OD 数据收集提供了算法与系统级基础。
Relevance: 3
