papers.title: Protecting Creative Writing Copyright against AI Imitation via Implicit Watermarking
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) enable powerful knowledge injection through approaches such as in-context learning and fine-tuning, but they also introduce new risks of unauthorized imitation of high-value creative works. Existing copyright protection techniques mainly focus on visual media, leaving the protection of creative writing largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate a new challenge: verifying whether AI-generated texts inherit the creative essence of protected works without authorization. We propose WIND (Watermarking via Implicit and Non-disruptive Disentanglement), a zero-watermarking framework that constructs an implicit and verifiable creative signature for copyright verification. WIND decomposes creative essence into five complementary dimensions and leverages an LLM-based instance delimitation mechanism to extract condensed representations of protected creative characteristics. By disentangling creative-specific information from irrelevant textual variations, these representations are mapped into a compact watermark space without modifying the original texts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WIND achieves over 98\% F1 scores while maintaining low false-positive rates, substantially outperforming existing watermarking and text classification approaches under various AI imitation scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 WIND (Watermarking via Implicit and Non-disruptive Disentanglement)，一个用于保护创意写作版权的零水印（zero-watermarking）框架。WIND 将创意本质分解为五个互补维度，借助 LLM 的实例分隔机制提取受保护作品的浓缩表征，并将创意相关信息与无关文本变化解耦后映射到紧凑水印空间，且不修改原文。实验显示在多种 AI 模仿场景下 F1 超过 98%，同时保持较低误报率。
Motivation: 大型语言模型可通过上下文学习和微调注入知识，也带来了未经授权模仿高价值创意作品的新风险。现有版权保护技术主要针对视觉媒体，创意写作领域的版权保护基本未被探索。
Method: WIND 框架采用零水印方式，将创意本质分解为五个互补维度，并用基于 LLM 的实例分隔机制提取压缩的创意特征表征。通过解耦创意特有信息与无关文本变化，将表征映射到紧凑水印空间，在不修改原始文本的前提下实现可验证的版权签名。
Result: 摘要报告 WIND 在多种 AI 模仿场景下取得超过 98% 的 F1 分数，同时保持较低误报率，显著优于现有水印和文本分类方法。
Conclusion: 作者提出了一种针对 AI 生成文本是否继承受保护作品创意本质的验证挑战的新方案，并展示了其在创意写作版权保护上的有效性。

papers.title: Robust and Secure Code Watermarking for Large Language Models via ML/Crypto Codesign
papers.abstract_en: This paper introduces RoSeMary, the first-of-its-kind ML/Crypto codesign watermarking framework that regulates LLM-generated code to avoid intellectual property rights violations and inappropriate misuse in software development. High-quality watermarks adhering to the detectability-fidelity-robustness tri-objective are limited due to codes' low-entropy nature. Watermark verification, however, often needs to reveal the signature and requires re-encoding new ones for code reuse, which potentially compromising the system's usability. To overcome these challenges, RoSeMary obtains high-quality watermarks by training the watermark insertion and extraction modules end-to-end to ensure (i) unaltered watermarked code functionality and (ii) enhanced detectability and robustness leveraging pre-trained CodeT5 as the insertion backbone to enlarge the code syntactic and variable rename transformation search space. In the deployment, RoSeMary uses zero-knowledge proofs for secure verification without revealing the underlying signatures. Extensive evaluations demonstrated RoSeMary achieves high detection accuracy while preserving the code functionality. RoSeMary is also robust against attacks and provides efficient secure watermark verification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RoSeMary，一个面向 LLM 生成代码的水印框架，采用机器学习与密码学协同设计（ML/Crypto codesign）。它通过端到端训练水印插入与提取模块，以预训练 CodeT5 作为插入骨干，在保持代码功能不变的前提下提升水印的可检测性与鲁棒性，并在部署验证阶段使用零知识证明以避免泄露底层签名。评估显示该方法在保持代码功能的同时达到高检测精度，对攻击具有鲁棒性，并提供高效的安全水印验证。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 代码水印因代码的低熵特性难以同时满足可检测性、保真度与鲁棒性三目标；且验证过程常常需要暴露签名，代码复用需重新编码，可能损害系统的可用性。
Method: 端到端训练水印插入与提取模块，利用预训练 CodeT5 作为插入骨干以扩大代码语法和变量重命名变换的搜索空间；在部署中使用零知识证明实现不泄露签名的安全验证。
Result: 大量评估表明 RoSeMary 在保持代码功能的同时实现了高检测精度，并且对攻击具有鲁棒性，同时支持高效的安全水印验证。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架为 LLM 代码水印提供了首个 ML/Crypto 协同设计解决方案，同时兼顾高质量水印、攻击鲁棒性与可用的安全验证流程。

papers.title: KKL Observer Synthesis for Nonlinear Systems via Physics-Informed Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a novel learning approach for designing Kazantzis-Kravaris or nonlinear Luenberger (KKL) observers for autonomous nonlinear systems. The design of a KKL observer involves finding an injective map that transforms the system state into a higher-dimensional observer state, whose dynamics is linear and stable. The observer's state is then mapped back to the original system coordinates via the inverse map to obtain the state estimate. However, finding this transformation and its inverse is quite challenging. We propose learning the forward mapping using a physics-informed neural network, and then learning its inverse mapping with a conventional feedforward neural network. Theoretical guarantees for the robustness of state estimation against approximation error and system uncertainties are provided, including non-asymptotic learning guarantees that link approximation quality to finite sample sizes. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through numerical simulations on benchmark examples, showing better generalization capability outside the training domain compared to state-of-the-art methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于物理信息学习的KKL观测器（Kazantzis-Kravaris/Luenberger）综合方法，用于自治非线性系统的状态估计。作者用物理信息神经网络学习将系统状态映射到高维线性稳定动态空间的注入映射，再用传统前馈神经网络学习其逆映射。摘要给出了针对近似误差和系统不确定性的鲁棒性保证，包括联系逼近质量与有限样本量的非渐近学习保证，并在基准仿真中展示出优于现有方法的训练域外泛化能力。
Motivation: KKL观测器的设计核心是构造一个将系统状态映射到高维线性稳定动态空间的注入映射及其逆映射，但这一对映射的解析求解非常困难。
Method: 先用物理信息神经网络（physics-informed neural network）学习正向变换，再用传统前馈神经网络学习其逆映射，从而得到状态估计，并配套给出鲁棒性与非渐近学习保证。
Result: 在基准数值仿真中，所提方法在训练域外展现出比最先进方法更好的泛化能力。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在近似误差和系统不确定性下具有理论上的状态估计鲁棒性，并提供了连接逼近质量与有限样本量的学习保证。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: A variational Bayes approach to inference for low-dimensional parameters in high-dimensional linear regression
papers.abstract_en: We propose a scalable variational Bayes method for statistical inference for a single or pre-specified low-dimensional subset of the coordinates of a high-dimensional parameter in sparse linear regression. Our approach relies on assigning a mean-field approximation to the nuisance coordinates and carefully modelling the conditional distribution of the target given the nuisance. This requires only a preprocessing step and preserves the computational advantages of mean-field variational Bayes, while ensuring accurate and reliable inference for the target parameter, including for uncertainty quantification. We investigate the numerical performance of our algorithm, showing that it performs competitively with existing methods. We further establish accompanying theoretical guarantees for estimation and uncertainty quantification in the form of a Bernstein--von Mises theorem for a possibly growing subset.
papers.comment: We have strengthened the Bernstein-von Mises results to hold in total variation and for growing parameter subsets, and generally improved the presentation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏线性回归中高维参数的低维目标子集推断问题，提出一种可扩展的变分贝叶斯 (variational Bayes) 方法。该方法对 nuisance 坐标采用均值场近似，并对目标参数在 nuisance 条件下的条件分布进行精细建模，只需预处理步骤即可保留均值场变分贝叶斯的计算优势，同时为目标参数提供准确的估计与不确定性量化。作者还建立了针对可能增长参数子集的 Bernstein-von Mises 定理，并给出与现有方法竞争的性能数值证据。
Motivation: 在高维稀疏线性回归中，对单个或预先指定的低维坐标子集进行推断时，标准均值场变分贝叶斯虽然计算高效，但难以保证对目标参数的可靠推断与不确定性量化。
Method: 对 nuisance 坐标施加均值场近似，并仔细建模目标参数在给定 nuisance 条件下的条件分布；整个流程只需一次预处理步骤，从而在保留均值场计算优势的同时提升目标参数推断质量。
Result: 数值实验显示该方法与现有方法相比具有竞争力；理论上，作者证明了对可能增长的参数子集成立 Bernstein-von Mises 定理，支持估计与不确定性量化的渐近保证。
Conclusion: 该方法为高维稀疏线性回归中的低维目标参数推断提供了一种兼顾可扩展性与可靠不确定性量化的途径，并伴随相应的理论保证。

papers.title: ZeroPur: Succinct Training-Free Adversarial Purification
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial purification is a kind of defense technique that can defend against various unseen adversarial attacks without modifying the victim classifier. Existing methods often depend on external generative models or cooperation between auxiliary functions and victim classifiers. However, retraining generative models, auxiliary functions, or victim classifiers relies on the domain of the fine-tuned dataset and is computation-consuming. In this work, we suppose that adversarial images are outliers of the natural image manifold, and the purification process can be considered as returning them to this manifold. Following this assumption, we present a simple adversarial purification method without further training to purify adversarial images, called ZeroPur. ZeroPur contains two steps: given an adversarial example, Guided Shift obtains the shifted embedding of the adversarial example by the guidance of its blurred counterparts; after that, Adaptive Projection constructs a directional vector by this shifted embedding to provide momentum, projecting adversarial images onto the manifold adaptively. ZeroPur is independent of external models and requires no retraining of victim classifiers or auxiliary functions, relying solely on victim classifiers themselves to achieve purification. Extensive experiments on three datasets (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1K) using various classifier architectures (ResNet, WideResNet) demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art robust performance. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/erhul/ZeroPur.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Image Processing (TIP) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ZeroPur，一种无需额外训练的对抗净化 (adversarial purification) 方法。其核心假设是对抗样本是自然图像流形 (natural image manifold) 的离群点，净化即将其投影回流形。方法由 Guided Shift 和 Adaptive Projection 两步组成，只依赖受害分类器自身，不依赖外部生成模型，也无需重训练分类器或辅助函数；在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet-1K 上用 ResNet、WideResNet 等架构验证，取得 state-of-the-art 的鲁棒性能。
Motivation: 现有对抗净化方法通常依赖外部生成模型或需要辅助函数与受害分类器协同，重训练这些组件依赖微调数据集领域且计算开销大。作者希望提出一种无需训练、不依赖外部模型的净化方法。
Method: ZeroPur 包含两步：Guided Shift 利用对抗样本的模糊版本作为引导，获得其平移后的嵌入 (shifted embedding)；Adaptive Projection 用该嵌入构造方向向量提供动量，将对抗样本自适应地投影到自然图像流形上。整个过程无需重训练受害分类器或辅助函数。
Result: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet-1K 三个数据集上，结合 ResNet、WideResNet 等多种分类器架构，摘要声称该方法取得了 state-of-the-art 的鲁棒性能。
Conclusion: ZeroPur 的核心主张是仅依靠受害分类器自身即可完成对抗净化，兼具简洁性与通用性；代码已公开。摘要未讨论该方法的具体局限。

papers.title: Pretrained Optimization Model for Zero-Shot Black Box Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot optimization involves optimizing a target task that was not seen during training, aiming to provide the optimal solution without or with minimal adjustments to the optimizer. It is crucial to ensure reliable and robust performance in various applications. Current optimizers often struggle with zero-shot optimization and require intricate hyperparameter tuning to adapt to new tasks. To address this, we propose a Pretrained Optimization Model (POM) that leverages knowledge gained from optimizing diverse tasks, offering efficient solutions to zero-shot optimization through direct application or fine-tuning with few-shot samples. Evaluation on the BBOB benchmark and two robot control tasks demonstrates that POM outperforms state-of-the-art black-box optimization methods, especially for high-dimensional tasks. Fine-tuning POM with a small number of samples and budget yields significant performance improvements. Moreover, POM demonstrates robust generalization across diverse task distributions, dimensions, population sizes, and optimization horizons. For code implementation, see https://github.com/ninja-wm/POM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出预训练优化模型（Pretrained Optimization Model, POM），利用从多样任务优化中习得的知识实现零样本黑盒优化，可直接应用或通过少量样本微调适配新任务。在 BBOB 基准和两个机器人控制任务上，POM 优于现有黑盒优化方法，尤其在高维任务上表现突出，并展示出跨任务分布、维度、种群规模和优化步数的稳健泛化。
Motivation: 现有优化器在零样本优化场景下表现不佳，往往需要复杂的超参数调整才能适应新任务，而实际应用要求优化器具备可靠且稳健的零样本性能。
Method: 提出预训练优化模型 POM，通过预训练从多种不同任务的优化过程中提取知识，以直接应用或使用少量样本进行微调的方式解决零样本优化问题。
Result: 在 BBOB 基准和两个机器人控制任务上，POM 优于最先进的黑盒优化方法，尤其在高维任务上优势明显；用少量样本和预算微调可获得显著性能提升，并表现出对任务分布、维度、种群规模和优化步数的稳健泛化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预训练知识迁移能有效提升零样本黑盒优化性能并改善泛化能力，代码已在 GitHub 开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Convergence of Sign-based Random Reshuffling Algorithms for Nonconvex Optimization
papers.abstract_en: signSGD is attractive in nonconvex optimization because it communicates sign-valued rather than full-precision gradients. Several standard analyses assume independent stochastic-gradient samples, whereas a common finite-sum implementation reshuffles the data and processes them sequentially. We study this variant, signSGD with random reshuffling (SignRR), and show that reshuffling does not in general repair the bias created by discarding gradient magnitudes. In particular, on a one-dimensional two-component strongly convex quadratic, the expected gradient norm at every SignRR inner iterate equals $1/2$. We complement this impossibility result with an alignment-explicit finite-time bound $O(\log(nT)/\sqrt{nT}+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{align}})$, where $\varepsilon_{\mathrm{align}}$ measures the averaged loss of descent caused by component-sign misalignment. A horizon-tuned constant stepsize improves the vanishing term to $O(1/\sqrt{nT})$, and a remaining-set alignment condition yields a residual-free $O(1/\sqrt{nT})$ guarantee. The alignment term is upper bounded by twice the averaged mean absolute gradient error and, in turn, by twice an averaged coordinatewise conditional root-mean-square error. As a variance-reduced alternative, we analyze SignRVR, which signs an SVRG estimator anchored at the beginning of every epoch. A pathwise argument gives a residual-free guarantee with an $O(\sqrt{d/T})$ averaged $\ell_1$-stationarity bound.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 signSGD 与随机重排 (random reshuffling) 结合的非凸优化收敛性，称为 SignRR。核心发现是丢弃梯度幅值引入的偏差并不能靠重排一般性地修复：在一维两分量强凸二次函数上，每个 SignRR 内部迭代的期望梯度范数恒等于 1/2。作者同时给出显式有限时间界 O(log(nT)/√(nT)+ε_align)，并分析了方差缩减变体 SignRVR 的 ℓ1-平稳性界。
Motivation: 现有 signSGD 的标准分析通常假设独立随机梯度样本，而常见的有限和实现采用数据重排并顺序处理。需要厘清这种重排实现下，sign 压缩丢弃梯度幅值所产生的偏差是否会被修复。
Method: 定义并分析 SignRR（signSGD with random reshuffling），用 alignment-explicit 的有限时间上界刻画分量符号错位 (component-sign misalignment) 导致的下降损失；另分析 SignRVR，即对每个 epoch 开始处锚定的 SVRG 估计量取符号，并用 pathwise 论证给出无残差保证。
Result: 摘要给出一个不可能性结果：在一维两分量强凸二次函数上，每个 SignRR 内部迭代的期望梯度范数等于 1/2。一般有限时间界为 O(log(nT)/√(nT)+ε_align)；horizon-tuned 常数步长可将消失项改善为 O(1/√(nT))，剩余集对齐条件给出无残差的 O(1/√(nT)) 保证。对齐项可被平均绝对梯度误差的两倍以及坐标条件均方根误差的两倍上界控制。SignRVR 得到无残差的 O(√(d/T)) 平均 ℓ1-平稳性界。
Conclusion: 随机重排不能一般性地修复 sign 压缩造成的偏差，偏差由 alignment 项量化并可有明确上界；这些理论结果补充了 signSGD 在有限和重排实现下的收敛性质，但摘要未涉及任何实验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Weighted Sequential Bayesian Inference for Non-Stationary Linear Contextual Bandits
papers.abstract_en: In non-stationary linear contextual bandits, existing efficient algorithms typically rely on the Weighted Regularized Least-Squares (WRLS) estimator. Because WRLS only provides point estimates, previous methods typically construct surrogate distributions when aiming to perform Bayesian-like randomized exploration. To more properly establish the Bayesian principles, we introduce Weighted Sequential Bayesian (WSB) inference, which forms a sequence of posteriors over a sequence of non-stationary reward parameters. This Bayesian take allows us to isolate the influence of initial beliefs into a dynamic prior penalty evaluated through the posterior covariance, which typically decreases over time. Building on this framework, we instantiate three WSB-based algorithms for exploration: WSB-LinUCB, WSB-RandLinUCB, and WSB-LinTS. By extending a refined drift analysis to randomized exploration without requiring local norms, we establish frequentist regret guarantees that match state-of-the-art WRLS-based baselines. Empirically, WSB's dynamic prior penalty reduces over-conservatism, allowing our algorithms to consistently match or exceed their WRLS-based counterparts. Lastly, we also provide a simplified proof for the time-uniform concentration of vector-valued martingales, a critical subroutine used throughout the literature, that might be of independent interest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对非平稳线性上下文老虎机 (non-stationary linear contextual bandits) 提出加权序贯贝叶斯 (Weighted Sequential Bayesian, WSB) 推断框架。该方法在非平稳奖励参数序列上构造后验序列，并把初始信念的影响隔离为动态先验惩罚项，由后验协方差评估且通常随时间衰减。基于该框架，作者给出 WSB-LinUCB、WSB-RandLinUCB 和 WSB-LinTS 三种探索算法，并证明其频率派遗憾界与基于 WRLS 的最优基线相当。
Motivation: 现有高效算法多依赖加权正则最小二乘 (WRLS) 估计，但 WRLS 仅提供点估计，先前方法需构造替代分布来近似贝叶斯式随机探索，缺乏规范的贝叶斯原理。
Method: 提出 WSB 推断，对非平稳奖励参数序列构建序贯后验，用后验协方差将初始信念的影响编码为动态先验惩罚。实例化三种算法：WSB-LinUCB、WSB-RandLinUCB 与 WSB-LinTS，并将改进的漂移分析扩展到不需要局部范数的随机探索。
Result: 摘要报告，WSB 算法获得与基于 WRLS 的最先进方法相匹配的频率派遗憾保证；实验上，动态先验惩罚降低过度保守性，使算法一贯匹配或超越 WRLS 对应方法。
Conclusion: 结论强调动态先验惩罚可缓解过度保守性，并提供一个对向量值鞅的时间一致集中性 (time-uniform concentration) 的简化证明，该子例程可能有独立价值。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Graphical Models of False Information and Fact Checking Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: The wide spread of false information online, including misinformation and disinformation, has become a major problem for our highly digitised and globalised society. A lot of research has been done to better understand different aspects of false information online such as behaviours of different actors and patterns of spreading, and also on better detection and prevention of such information using technical and socio-technical means. One major approach to detecting and debunking false information online is to use fact-checkers. Despite a lot of research on online false information, we noticed a lack of conceptual models describing the complicated ecosystem of false information and fact-checking. In this paper, we introduce the first comprehensive graphical model of the ecosystem, focusing on false information online in multiple contexts, including traditional media outlets, as well as user-generated and AI-generated content. The proposed enhanced entity-relationship (EER) model covers a wide range of entities and relationships, and it can be a new useful tool for researchers and practitioners to study false information online and the effects of fact-checking. To demonstrate its usefulness, we provide two example applications of our proposed model, modelling real-world scenarios and reviewing the research literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个针对在线虚假信息与事实核查生态系统的综合图形模型，采用增强实体-关系（EER）建模，覆盖传统媒体、用户生成内容及AI生成内容中的实体与关系。作者通过两个示例应用（真实场景建模与文献综述）展示该模型的实用性。
Motivation: 现有研究多关注虚假信息的传播行为与检测技术，但缺乏描述虚假信息与事实核查复杂生态系统的概念模型。作者希望填补这一空白，为研究者和实践者提供系统性工具。
Method: 提出一个增强实体-关系（EER）图形模型，综合刻画多种上下文下的虚假信息与事实核查生态，包括传统媒体、用户生成内容及AI生成内容，并覆盖广泛实体与关系。
Result: 摘要报告了模型的两个示例应用：对真实世界场景的建模以及对研究文献的回顾，用以演示模型的实际用途，但未给出定量实验数据。
Conclusion: 作者认为该模型可作为研究者和实践者研究在线虚假信息及事实核查效果的新工具，并强调其是生态系统的首个综合图形模型。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Representation and Invariance in Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Researchers have formalized reinforcement learning (RL) in different ways. If an agent in one RL framework is to run within another RL framework's environments, the agent must first be converted, or mapped, into that other framework. In this paper, we lay foundations for studying relative-intelligence-preserving mappability between RL frameworks. We introduce a criterion which is sufficient for relative intelligence to be preserved according to one particular method of measuring intelligence. We show that this criterion cannot be met when mapping between certain deterministic and stochastic RL frameworks, suggesting inherent fundamental differences between these different versions of RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为强化学习（RL）框架之间的可映射性建立理论基础，关注映射是否保持相对智能。作者提出一个足以在某种智能度量方法下保持相对智能的判据，并证明该判据在确定性RL框架与随机性RL框架之间无法满足，从而暗示这些不同版本的RL存在本质差异。
Motivation: 不同研究者以不同方式形式化强化学习，若一个框架中的智能体要在另一个框架的环境中运行，需要先把智能体映射到另一框架；但映射可能不保持相对智能，本文试图为这种保持相对智能的映射研究奠定基础。
Method: 引入一个关于相对智能保持的充分判据，并基于该判据系统考察确定性（deterministic）与随机性（stochastic）RL框架之间的可映射性。
Result: 摘要指出该判据在确定性RL框架与随机性RL框架之间无法满足，说明这两类RL版本之间可能存在内在的根本差异。
Conclusion: 摘要强调相对智能保持映射的不可行性暗示不同RL形式化之间的本质区别，但并未提供替代映射方案或实证评估。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Emergent Neural Network Mechanisms for Generalization to Objects in Novel Orientations
papers.abstract_en: The capability of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to recognize objects in orientations outside the distribution of the training data is not well understood. We present evidence that DNNs are capable of generalizing to objects in novel orientations by disseminating orientation-invariance obtained from familiar objects seen from many viewpoints. This capability strengthens when training the DNN with an increasing number of familiar objects, but only in orientations that involve 2D rotations of familiar orientations. We show that this dissemination is achieved via neurons tuned to common features between familiar and unfamiliar objects. These results implicate brain-like neural mechanisms for generalization.
papers.journal_ref: Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR), 2025, ISSN 2835-8856
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度神经网络（DNN）对训练分布之外新朝向物体的泛化能力，发现DNN能够通过传播从熟悉物体多视角获得的朝向不变性（orientation-invariance）来识别新朝向物体。这种能力随熟悉物体数量增加而增强，但仅出现在训练朝向的二维旋转情形中。作者进一步表明，该能力由对熟悉与不熟悉物体共同特征调谐的神经元实现，提示存在类似大脑的泛化神经机制。
Motivation: DNN识别训练数据分布之外朝向物体的能力目前尚未被充分理解，而这一能力对鲁棒视觉识别以及生物视觉机制的启发具有重要意义。
Method: 通过操纵训练中熟悉物体的数量与视角范围，分析DNN对未见朝向物体的识别性能，并结合神经元调谐分析揭示朝向不变性在物体间传播的实现方式。
Result: 摘要报告DNN能够泛化到新朝向物体，且该能力随熟悉物体数量增加而增强；但泛化仅限于熟悉朝向的二维旋转变换。神经元分析显示，共同特征调谐的神经元负责这种不变性的传播。
Conclusion: 作者认为这些结果揭示了DNN中类似大脑神经机制的泛化基础，并将其与生物视觉联系起来；摘要未讨论超越二维旋转之外的泛化边界或其他任务适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Toward a Theory of Value in AI Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Can AI systems be aligned to human values? The popularization of large language models (LLMs) and multi-modal foundation models has seen a rise in harms spanning from toxic speech and hallucinations to AI agents executing unauthorized actions. Within the field of AI safety, these harmful instances are often framed as the alignment problem, or of models being misaligned with human values. Researchers have responded by pursuing applied and theoretical AI value alignment efforts, often without specifying what they mean by human values. How does the field of AI value alignment conceive of human values? How are these conceptions of values technically operationalized and evaluated? What does the emergent theory of value from this field signify for the future of AI? We annotated 94 value alignment research papers to discern their implicit theory of values in AI. The majority do not define values, relying heavily on preferences as a stand in that runs the risk of reducing complex culturally situated concepts down to binary choices. As researchers dispense with using human annotators for model training and evaluation, turning instead to synthetic data and autorater approaches to aligning and evaluating models, we identify the potential to close off alternative methods for contesting and enacting values in foundation models. In making AI value alignments philosophical commitments explicit, we seek to bring great specificity and under explored perspectives in the debate on whether and how AI can address human values.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对94篇AI价值对齐研究论文的标注分析，揭示该领域对人类价值的隐含理论。摘要指出大多数论文未定义价值概念，而是高度依赖偏好作为替代，可能将文化情境中的复杂价值简化为二元选择；同时，转向合成数据和自动评分 (autorater) 方法可能关闭其他质疑和实现价值的途径。作者旨在明确AI价值对齐的哲学预设，为相关争论引入具体性和未充分探索的视角。
Motivation: AI安全领域常将模型造成的伤害归因于价值对齐问题，即模型与人类价值不一致，但研究者很少说明'人类价值'究竟指什么。本文希望通过对现有文献的系统标注，弄清价值对齐研究如何设想、操作化并评估人类价值，以及这一隐含价值理论对未来AI的意义。
Method: 作者对94篇价值对齐研究论文进行标注分析，从哲学层面识别其隐含的价值理论，并考察这些价值观念在技术上如何被操作化和评估，特别关注从人工标注转向合成数据与自动评分方法对价值实现途径的影响。
Result: 标注结果显示，大多数论文并未定义价值，普遍以偏好作为价值的替代，存在把复杂且具文化情境的概念缩减为二元选择的风险；此外，采用合成数据和授权式评估可能使基础模型中质疑和践行价值的替代方法被排除。
Conclusion: 作者认为，AI价值对齐研究隐含的哲学承诺需要被明确，以便为'AI能否以及如何应对人类价值'的争论带来更多具体性和尚未充分探索的视角。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Neuroevolution Arena: Nested Ecological Evaluation of Update-and-Inheritance Regimes across Neural Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Competitive artificial-life systems can rank trained controllers differently under training and ecological evaluation. We present Neuroevolution Arena, a GPU-accelerated spatial ecology of independently parameterized neural-network cells, and an audit-tracked nested evaluation protocol. Three implementation-specific update-and-inheritance regimes (EvoEvo, EvoRL, and RLRL) are crossed with two neural architectures for 50,000 generations in three independent training runs per condition. One saved elite-controller artifact from each of the 18 runs enters an aligned-run frozen-evaluation design comprising 198 computational jobs. Pairwise effects average three seed-defined ecological contexts (two cooperation-permitting and one attack-permitting) within each aligned training-run block; the independent level remains n = 3 runs per condition. RL-enabled regimes attain higher recorded training fitness than EvoEvo, whereas pairwise outcomes show architecture-conditioned majority patterns and substantial artifact dependence. Six-way winners vary across artifacts and contexts, and the prespecified survival endpoint has a complete floor. We contribute a nested protocol that separates training-run artifacts from evaluation contexts and exposes, rather than conceals, their different sources of variation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Neuroevolution Arena，一个 GPU 加速的空间生态，用于系统比较三种实现特定的更新-继承机制（EvoEvo、EvoRL、RLRL）与两种神经网络架构在 50,000 代中的演化表现。作者引入带审计追踪的嵌套评估协议，将 18 个训练运行中的精英控制器放入 198 个对齐的冷冻评估作业，以分离训练伪影与生态评估上下文。摘要报告 RL 启用机制的训练适应度更高，但配对结果具有架构条件性多数模式和显著的伪影依赖，且六路胜者随伪影和上下文变化。
Motivation: 竞争性人工生命系统在训练时和生态评估下对已训练控制器的排名可能不同，现有评估方法容易混淆训练运行伪影与评估上下文，导致结论不稳定。
Method: 提出 Neuroevolution Arena，一种 GPU 加速的空间生态，其中包含独立参数化的神经网络细胞；采用嵌套评估协议，三个更新-继承机制与两个架构交叉，每个条件进行三次独立训练运行，每次运行保存一个精英控制器，进入对齐的冷冻评估设计（共 198 个计算作业）。配对效应在三个种子定义的生态上下文（两个允许合作、一个允许攻击）中求平均，独立水平保持 n = 3。
Result: RL 启用机制（EvoRL 和 RLRL）比 EvoEvo 取得更高的记录训练适应度，但配对结果显示架构条件下的多数模式和大量伪影依赖；六路胜者随伪影和生态上下文变化，且预先指定的存活终点出现完全地板效应。
Conclusion: 作者贡献了一个嵌套协议，将训练运行伪影与评估上下文分离，并暴露而非掩盖不同变异来源；同时承认独立样本量仅为 n = 3，结果具有较高的伪影依赖性。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Do Personalized Skills Help Coding Agents? An Empirical Study of Developer Interaction Histories
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents have rapidly evolved from code-completion tools into solvers of complex software engineering tasks. As developers collaborate with coding agents over time, their preferences emerge through repeated interactions and can be used to adapt agent behavior to better meet individual developers' needs. Capturing and reusing these preferences may reduce repeated corrections and improve developer-agent collaboration. Agent skills provide a lightweight mechanism for transferring experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing work primarily focuses on task-specific skills, and it remains unclear whether developer-specific skills distilled from interaction histories can generalize to future tasks. We propose a framework for extracting reusable developer preferences from interaction traces. It first generates personalized skills through rule-based bootstrapping and evidence-grounded refinement, and then evaluates them using a reproducible replay framework with an interactive, trajectory-conditioned LLM-based human developer simulator. We conduct an experiment on 206 real-world developer-agent sessions from 13 developers and compare personalized skills against no-skill, generic-skill, and other-user-skill baselines. Personalized skills provide small and inconsistent improvements over the no-skill baseline, whereas generic skills pooled across developers achieve the largest and most consistent gains. Further analysis suggests that personalized skills become more effective when developer preferences appear frequently, particularly when their histories contain multiple examples relevant to future tasks. These findings provide empirical insights into when developer-specific personalization is effective and demonstrate that broadly transferable procedural knowledge can be more robust than developer-specific preference signals.

TL;DR: 本文研究面向编码智能体 (coding agents) 的个性化技能是否真的有效。作者提出一个从开发者交互轨迹中提取可复用偏好的框架，先通过基于规则的引导和基于证据的细化生成个性化技能，再用可复现的回放框架与交互式、轨迹条件的 LLM 人类开发者模拟器进行评估。在来自 13 位开发者的 206 个真实会话上，个性化技能相对无技能基线仅带来微小且不稳定的提升，而跨开发者聚合的通用技能提升最大且最稳定。进一步分析表明，当开发者偏好频繁出现、尤其是历史中包含多个与未来任务相关的示例时，个性化技能会更有效。
Motivation: 现有智能体技能研究主要关注任务特定技能，尚不清楚从交互历史中提炼的开发者特定技能能否泛化到未来任务；捕捉和复用开发者偏好有望减少重复纠正、改善人机协作。
Method: 提出从交互轨迹中提取可复用开发者偏好的框架：通过基于规则的引导 (rule-based bootstrapping) 和基于证据的细化 (evidence-grounded refinement) 生成个性化技能，并使用包含交互式、轨迹条件 LLM 人类开发者模拟器的可复现回放框架进行评估。
Result: 在 13 位开发者的 206 个真实会话实验中，个性化技能相比无技能基线只带来微小且不稳定的改进，而跨开发者汇聚的通用技能获得最大且最稳定的收益；当开发者偏好频繁出现且历史中包含多个与未来任务相关的示例时，个性化技能更有效。
Conclusion: 研究为开发者特定个性化何时有效提供了实证洞察，并表明广泛可迁移的程序性知识可能比开发者特定的偏好信号更稳健。

papers.title: From Detection to Understanding: TAR and TAR-Bench for Multi-Task Traffic Anomaly Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We present TAR (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning) and TAR-Bench datasets, resources for training and evaluating video-language models beyond anomaly detection. TAR contains 44,040 chain-of-thought training annotations across 10 tasks for 3,670 CCTV videos ($\sim$26 hours) from eight public datasets. Its evaluation component, TAR-Bench, contains 960 human-curated test annotations for 80 held-out clips trimmed from 17 public YouTube videos. TAR's training annotations are produced with MAVEN, which consolidates multi-scale video evidence into structured event descriptions before generating question-answer pairs and reasoning traces. On TAR-Bench, eleven vision-language models reveal that strong question-answering accuracy does not reliably predict temporal or scene reasoning ability. Multi-task fine-tuning on TAR yields consistent gains, with the full 10-task model improving aggregate score by 21.4 points over its zero-shot baseline. TAR and TAR-Bench provide the official training and in-domain evaluation data for AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/PhysicalAI-Traffic-Anomaly-Reasoning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TAR (Traffic Anomaly Reasoning) 与 TAR-Bench 数据集，用于训练和评测视频-语言模型 (video-language models) 的交通异常推理能力，而不仅是异常检测。TAR 含 44,040 条思维链 (chain-of-thought) 训练标注，覆盖 10 个任务、3,670 段 CCTV 视频（约 26 小时，来自 8 个公开数据集）；TAR-Bench 含 960 条人工整理测试标注，覆盖 17 个 YouTube 视频裁剪出的 80 段保留片段。11 个视觉-语言模型的评测显示，强问答准确率并不能可靠预测时序或场景推理能力，而基于 TAR 的多任务微调带来一致提升。
Motivation: 现有交通视频研究多停留在异常检测层面，缺少面向视频-语言模型的推理能力评测资源；论文旨在填补这一空白，提供超越检测的、多任务交通异常推理训练与评测数据。
Method: 构建 TAR 与 TAR-Bench 数据资源，并使用 MAVEN 自动生成训练标注：先将多尺度视频证据整合为结构化事件描述，再生成问答对和推理轨迹；评测部分则采用人工整理的测试标注。
Result: 在 TAR-Bench 上评测 11 个视觉-语言模型，发现高问答准确率并不保证时序或场景推理能力；在 TAR 上进行多任务微调带来一致提升，完整 10 任务模型相比零样本基线在总分上提高 21.4 分。
Conclusion: 论文提出 TAR 与 TAR-Bench 作为视频-语言模型交通异常推理的训练和在域评测基准，并成为 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 3 的官方数据；数据集已发布于 Hugging Face。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: UniMod: Enhancing Multi-Modal Medical Diagnosis through Cross-Modality and Within-Modality Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal learning combining medical images and clinical text is promising for disease diagnosis. However, standard multi-modal training leads to shortcut learning: models exploit the easier modality (e.g., diagnostic cues in text) while neglecting harder-to-learn features (e.g., subtle visual patterns). We propose UniMod, a framework that mitigates shortcut learning by requiring each modality to predict the diagnosis on its own. It supervises image-only, text-only, and multi-modal classification simultaneously, so each modality must extract diagnostic features. We add cross-modality alignment for knowledge transfer and within-modality supervised contrastive alignment over same-diagnosis patients. On Harvard-Glaucoma, UniMod reaches 0.850 AUC, outperforming OGM-GE and Gradient Blending by 1.6-1.8%; on CheXpert Plus, it reaches 0.966 AUC, surpassing them by over 5%. UniMod also extends to 5-class multi-label diagnosis without architectural change, improving mean AUC by 0.097 over CGGM.
papers.comment: Accepted to ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26). 10 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/futurespyhi/UniMod
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniMod 框架，针对医学图像与临床文本的多模态诊断中标准训练方法易陷入捷径学习 (shortcut learning) 的问题：模型倾向于利用更易学的文本诊断线索而忽略图像中的细微视觉模式。UniMod 同时监督图像单模态、文本单模态和多模态分类，并加入跨模态对齐与同诊断患者内的模态内监督对比对齐 (within-modality supervised contrastive alignment)。在 Harvard-Glaucoma 上达到 0.850 AUC，比 OGM-GE 和 Gradient Blending 提升 1.6–1.8%；在 CheXpert Plus 上达到 0.966 AUC，超越这两者超过 5%；该方法无需改动架构即可扩展到 5 类多标签诊断。
Motivation: 标准多模态训练会导致捷径学习，模型利用较易学习的模态（如文本中的诊断线索）而忽略较难的图像特征，限制了诊断性能与鲁棒性。
Method: UniMod 要求每个模态独立预测诊断，同时监督图像-only、文本-only 与多模态分类，使各模态都必须提取诊断性特征；在此基础上加入跨模态对齐进行知识迁移，并对同诊断病人施加模态内监督对比对齐。
Result: 在 Harvard-Glaucoma 上 AUC 达 0.850，较 OGM-GE 与 Gradient Blending 提升 1.6–1.8%；在 CheXpert Plus 上 AUC 达 0.966，较二者提升超过 5%；无需架构变化即可扩展到 5 类多标签诊断，平均 AUC 较 CGGM 提升 0.097。
Conclusion: 作者认为，通过让每个模态独立完成诊断预测并辅以跨模态与模态内对齐，可以有效缓解多模态医学诊断中的捷径学习，并自然适用于多标签任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Is This Your Final Answer? Cross-Contextual Consistency as a Measure of LLM Credibility
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are powerful black-box systems, making it difficult to discern whether their answers reflect stable internal beliefs or superficial pattern matching. We identify cross-contextual consistency as an underutilized behavioral property of LLMs: a credible answer should remain stable when the same task is placed under topic-aligned, content-neutral contextual variation. Building on this intuition, we operationalize Cross-Contextual Consistency (C3) by comparing model generations under original and perturbed prompts. Across 26 models and six benchmarks spanning reasoning, factuality, and code generation, we find that answers with smaller cross-contextual shifts are more likely to be correct or factual. We demonstrate that C3 provides a complementary axis of evaluation and can serve as a benchmark usefulness diagnostic, identifying which portions of a benchmark remain informative even when aggregated scores are widely considered "saturate".
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出把跨上下文一致性（Cross-Contextual Consistency, C3）作为衡量 LLM 可信度的行为属性：同一任务在主题对齐、内容中立的语境变化下仍保持稳定的答案更可能反映模型真实信念。作者通过比较原始提示与扰动提示下的生成结果来操作化 C3，并在 26 个模型、六个覆盖推理、事实性和代码生成的基准上验证，发现跨上下文偏移更小的答案更可能正确或符合事实。C3 还可用作基准有用性诊断，在聚合分数被认为饱和时识别仍有信息量的基准子集。
Motivation: LLM 是强大的黑箱系统，难以判断其回答反映的是稳定的内在信念还是浅层的模式匹配，需要一种不依赖内部结构的行为层面度量来刻画答案可信度。
Method: 将可信答案应抵御主题对齐、内容中立的语境扰动这一直觉操作化为 C3，通过比较原始提示和扰动提示下模型生成的差异来量化答案的跨上下文一致性。
Result: 在 26 个模型和六个涵盖推理、事实性及代码生成的基准上，跨上下文位移较小（cross-contextual shift）的答案更可能正确或符合事实；C3 提供的评估维度与现有指标互补，并能在聚合分数被视为饱和时定位仍具有区分力的基准片段。
Conclusion: 作者认为 C3 可作为 LLM 评估的补充轴，并可作为基准有用性诊断工具；摘要未提及其局限或失败场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: COMPACT: Spectral Adjustment Scores from a Complete and Irreducible Causal Criterion
papers.abstract_en: Observational datasets frequently contain many baseline variables, yet investigators estimating causal effects may not know which variables to include in the adjustment set. Confounding information may also be distributed weakly across many variables. Propensity scores can simplify adjustment by reducing high-dimensional covariates to a scalar with binary treatment. Although the propensity score is the coarsest balancing score, this distributional optimality does not imply maximal specificity over causal graphs. We instead examine all causal graphs among a candidate score, treatment, and outcome while allowing latent variables. Under faithfulness, we identify the largest set of unconditional and conditional dependence relations whose truth is invariant to whether treatment causes the outcome, leaving treatment-effect estimation to the downstream analysis. This criterion defines the maximally specific graph class expressible through these relations. We then develop the proposed algorithm, which operationalizes the criterion through a generalized eigenvalue problem whose score space targets the span of a balancing coordinate and an outcome-guided coordinate. We show that sufficiently informative proxies can recover this span without direct observation of the adjustment variables, characterize the resulting estimation and causal errors, and establish bootstrap validity for the complete procedure. Simulations and a real-data application demonstrate superior performance over several alternatives.
papers.comment: R code implementing COMPACT is available at https://github.com/ericstrobl/COMPACT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 COMPACT，一种基于完整且不可约的因果准则（spectral adjustment scores）构建调整分数的方法，用于在存在大量基线变量且调整集未知时进行因果效应估计。作者通过检查候选分数、处理与结果之间的所有可能因果图（允许潜变量），在忠实性假设下识别出最大的一组无条件和条件依赖关系，其真值与处理是否导致结果无关。方法通过广义特征值问题实现，并证明充分信息的代理变量可以恢复目标分数空间。
Motivation: 观察性数据常包含大量基线变量，研究者不确定应将哪些变量纳入调整集，且混杂信息可能分散在众多变量中。倾向得分虽然可以降维，但其分布最优性并不保证在图结构上具有最大特异性，因此需要一种能兼顾维度约简与因果图特异性的调整分数。
Method: 提出在候选分数、处理和结果之间考虑所有允许潜变量的因果图，在忠实性（faithfulness）下识别最大的无条件与条件依赖关系集合，从而定义最大化可表达图类别的准则。算法通过广义特征值问题（generalized eigenvalue problem）构造分数空间，使其覆盖平衡坐标（balancing coordinate）与结果引导坐标（outcome-guided coordinate）的跨度，并利用充分信息代理变量恢复该跨度。
Result: 摘要报告该方法建立了估计误差与因果误差的表征，并证明了完整过程的 bootstrap 有效性。模拟实验和真实数据应用显示其性能优于若干现有替代方法。
Conclusion: COMPACT 提供了一种在调整集未知且混杂分散时构造调整分数的准则化方案，并具备理论上的误差刻画和推断有效性保证，但具体数据集的数值改进幅度未被摘要量化。

summary_sections.motivation: 观察性数据常包含大量基线变量，研究者不确定应将哪些变量纳入调整集，且混杂信息可能分散在众多变量中。倾向得分虽然可以降维，但其分布最优性并不保证在图结构上具有最大特异性，因此需要一种能兼顾维度约简与因果图特异性的调整分数。
summary_sections.method: 提出在候选分数、处理和结果之间考虑所有允许潜变量的因果图，在忠实性（faithfulness）下识别最大的无条件与条件依赖关系集合，从而定义最大化可表达图类别的准则。算法通过广义特征值问题（generalized eigenvalue problem）构造分数空间，使其覆盖平衡坐标（balancing coordinate）与结果引导坐标（outcome-guided coordinate）的跨度，并利用充分信息代理变量恢复该跨度。
summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法建立了估计误差与因果误差的表征，并证明了完整过程的 bootstrap 有效性。模拟实验和真实数据应用显示其性能优于若干现有替代方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: COMPACT 提供了一种在调整集未知且混杂分散时构造调整分数的准则化方案，并具备理论上的误差刻画和推断有效性保证，但具体数据集的数值改进幅度未被摘要量化。

papers.title: Logit-Boundary Geometric Belief Interfaces and Sparse Sheaf-Enclave Protocols: A Self-Contained Substrate for Secure Network Electronic Health Record (EHR) Interoperability
papers.abstract_en: Electronic health-record interoperability is a boundary problem: legacy systems, generative models, terminology services, identity systems, and human reviewers may each expose rich internal states, while operational exchange requires a narrow shared interface of typed claims, bounded uncertainty, provenance, and explicit admission or abstention. This paper details a mathematical and engineering architecture for that interface. The organizing idea is the logit boundary: a discovery model may propose pre-threshold scores over a local categorical decision, but a deterministic judgment substrate decides whether the proposal is admissible, requires review, or must be quarantined before any Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) transaction is constructed. The resulting Geometric Belief Interface (GBI) combines finite boundary semantics, local Dirichlet evidence, cellular-sheaf and mapping-cone diagnostics, advisory geometric audit charts, and a Decentralized Cryptographic Sheaf-Enclave (DCSE) protocol sketch for fail-closed deployment. The framework does not establish clinical truth, global representation alignment, or end-to-end safety; it defines certificate-producing checks at a model-to-system boundary. A companion frozen synthetic benchmark, GBI BoundaryBench v0.1, evaluated Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on 256 held-out tasks across three evidence modes (768 canonical executions). All executions completed, but none produced an output accepted by the benchmark contract: 369 were rejected during safe parsing and 399 during schema validation, yielding zero coverage and deterministic quarantine. This empirical result is deliberately narrow - one 4B open-weight model under one frozen interface - and is reported as evidence about the admission boundary, not as a general claim about LLM capability or clinical safety. A Julia appendix verifies numerical certificates using standard libraries.
papers.comment: 39 pages; executable Julia verification code included as ancillary material; companion public benchmark: https://github.com/AlvinSpivey/GBI-BoundaryBench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对电子健康记录互操作中的模型到系统边界问题，提出几何信念接口（Geometric Belief Interface, GBI）：发现模型只给出阈值前的局部类别得分，而确定性判断基板决定该提议是可接受、需审查还是必须在任何 FHIR 事务构建前隔离。框架结合有限边界语义、局部 Dirichlet 证据、细胞层与映射锥诊断、几何审计图，以及一个用于故障封闭部署的去中心化密码学层包络（DCSE）协议草图。配套基准 GBI BoundaryBench v0.1 对 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 的 768 次执行全部完成但无一通过契约，零覆盖率并触发确定性隔离。
Motivation: EHR 互操作本质上是一个边界问题：遗留系统、生成模型、术语服务、身份系统和人工审阅者都可能暴露丰富的内部状态，而实际交换只允许一个包含类型化声明、有界不确定性、来源和明确接受或弃权的窄共享接口。
Method: 提出 GBI 作为数学与工程架构：将发现模型输出视为 pre-threshold 分数，由确定性判断基板裁决其可接受性并产出证书式检查；同时采用有限边界语义、局部 Dirichlet 证据、cellular-sheaf 与 mapping-cone 诊断、几何审计图以及 DCSE 协议草图实现 fail-closed 部署。
Result: 冻结合成基准 GBI BoundaryBench v0.1 上，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 在 256 个保留任务、三种证据模式下共执行 768 次；全部执行完成但无一被基准契约接受，其中 369 次在安全解析阶段被拒、399 次在 schema 验证阶段被拒，得到零覆盖并确定性隔离。
Conclusion: 作者明确限定本框架不建立临床事实、全局表示对齐或端到端安全性，只定义模型到系统边界的证书产生式检查；实验结果刻意收窄为单一 4B 开源模型在单一冻结接口下的证据，仅说明准入边界行为，不构成对 LLM 能力或临床安全的一般性论断。

papers.title: Frozen Brain-MRI Foundation Models Are Site Fingerprints
papers.abstract_en: Frozen foundation-model (FM) embeddings are increasingly used as off-the-shelf brain-MRI representations, on the assumption that they capture anatomy. We audit what they actually encode and find that acquisition site is a large, intrinsic component of the representation. Across two independent cohorts (ABIDE-I, ABIDE-II), three frozen 3-D encoders (brain-pretrained, CT-pretrained, and randomly initialized), and every network depth, site is linearly decodable at roughly 0.9 balanced accuracy at deep layers, exceeding the decodability of every clinical or demographic variable (sex, age, autism diagnosis) at every layer. The effect is intrinsic rather than learned: a randomly initialized encoder is already a ~0.9 site classifier on both cohorts and across three architecture families (Swin, ViT, ResNet), and site is decodable at ~0.95 directly from the raw downsampled image with no encoder, so the fingerprint reflects low-level image statistics that any encoder preserves rather than a product of pretraining. Residualizing measured population covariates leaves site decodability essentially unchanged, indicating an acquisition- rather than population-driven effect. A nonlinear probe matches the linear one, so the fingerprint is fully linearly accessible. The site subspace is removable post hoc by iterative null-space projection or ComBat (site decodability 0.94 -> 0.07/0.00), and is a site-attribution concern for shared or federated embeddings; but for dense segmentation this removal is not free, because site and anatomy occupy an entangled linear subspace (a matched-rank random-direction projection is Dice-neutral, whereas removing the site subspace is destructive). We recommend site-audited use of frozen brain-MRI FMs and release an open audit toolkit.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文审计冻结的脑MRI基础模型（foundation model）嵌入，发现获取站点（acquisition site）是表示中一个大的内在成分：在ABIDE-I和ABIDE-II两个独立队列、三个冻结3D编码器（脑预训练、CT预训练、随机初始化）以及所有网络深度上，站点在深层可用线性探针以约0.9的平衡精度解码，超过性别、年龄、自闭症诊断等所有临床/人口变量。随机初始化编码器已具备约0.9的站点分类能力，而直接从原始降采样图像解码站点可达约0.95，说明该指纹来自任何编码器都会保留的低层图像统计而非预训练产物。作者提出站点子空间事后可移除，但移除对密集分割任务有破坏性，并建议对冻结脑MRI FM进行站点审计。
Motivation: 冻结基础模型嵌入被广泛当作现成的脑MRI表示，默认它们编码的是解剖结构，但其实际编码内容缺少审计。研究发现获取站点成为表示的主要组成成分，这对共享或联邦嵌入构成站点归因（site-attribution）风险。
Method: 在两个队列（ABIDE-I、ABIDE-II）、三个冻结3D编码器（脑预训练、CT预训练、随机初始化）和所有网络深度上，用线性与非线性探针检验站点及临床/人口变量的可解码性；通过对人群协变量做残差化、迭代零空间投射（null-space projection）和ComBat来检验效应来源并尝试移除站点子空间。
Result: 站点在深层线性可解码约0.9平衡精度，超过所有临床/人口变量；随机初始化编码器在三种架构族（Swin、ViT、ResNet）上同样约0.9，原始降采样图像约0.95；残差化人群协变量后站点可解码性基本不变；非线性探针与线性结果一致。移除方面，零空间投射或ComBat将站点可解码性从0.94降至0.07/0.00，但对密集分割是破坏性的，而匹配秩的随机方向投射是Dice中性的。
Conclusion: 站点指纹是冻结脑MRI基础模型表示中固有的、由获取条件而非人群或预训练驱动的成分，因此建议对冻结FM进行站点审计使用，并发布开放审计工具包。移除站点子空间并非免费，因为站点与解剖在密集分割任务中共享纠缠的线性子空间。

papers.title: MRIComp4Flow: Compression of 3D Brain MRI for Training Multi-Modal Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale multi-modal MRI datasets impose substantial storage and I/O costs, limiting the training of 3D generative models on commodity infrastructure. While lossy compression is known to preserve accuracy for discriminative segmentation networks, its effect on generative models, which must learn the full data distribution rather than a decision boundary, is unexplored. We study whether standard image codecs can effectively compress semantically rich brain tumor MRI while preserving the fidelity required to train and deploy a 3D MRI generative model. Each 3D volume is compressed with JPEG2000 or a near-lossless JPEG-LS pipeline. Next, a Wavelet Flow Matching model, conditioned on BraTS image sequences (T1n, T1c, T2, T2f), is trained on compressed data, and the resulting models are evaluated on the validation set. At a 20:1 compression ratio, synthesis quality is statistically equivalent to a model trained on uncompressed data within a pre-specified margin ($Δ$PSNR $<1$,dB, $Δ$SSIM $<0.02$; paired TOST $p=[[p]]$): mean PSNR is 27.3,dB vs. 27.0,dB and mean SSIM is 0.95 vs. 0.96 across modalities. Our results indicate that JPEG2000 compression is a practical step toward scalable 3D MRI generative modeling without degrading synthesis quality. The codebase is available at https://github.com/lisafis/MRIComp4Flow .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究有损压缩对3D脑部MRI生成模型训练的影响，具体将每个3D体数据用JPEG2000或近无损JPEG-LS压缩后训练Wavelet Flow Matching模型。在BraTS多模态序列（T1n、T1c、T2、T2f）条件下，20:1压缩比训练的模型与未压缩数据训练的模型在合成质量上统计等效（平均PSNR 27.3 vs 27.0 dB，平均SSIM 0.95 vs 0.96）。作者认为JPEG2000压缩是迈向可扩展3D MRI生成建模的实用步骤。
Motivation: 大规模多模态MRI数据集带来巨大的存储和I/O开销，限制了在普通硬件上训练3D生成模型。尽管有损压缩已被证明对判别式分割网络有效，但生成模型需要学习完整数据分布，其影响此前未被探索。
Method: 将每个3D体积使用JPEG2000或近无损JPEG-LS流水线压缩，然后在压缩数据上训练以BraTS图像序列为条件的Wavelet Flow Matching模型，并在验证集上评估训练出的模型。
Result: 在20:1压缩比下，压缩数据训练模型的合成质量与未压缩数据训练的模型在预设边界（ΔPSNR <1 dB，ΔSSIM <0.02，配对TOST检验）内统计等效；各模态平均PSNR为27.3 dB vs 27.0 dB，平均SSIM为0.95 vs 0.96。
Conclusion: 摘要表明JPEG2000压缩是一种不降低合成质量的实用压缩方案，可作为可扩展3D MRI生成建模的步骤；代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Comprendia: AI-Augmented Code Comprehension
papers.abstract_en: Comprendia is an Eclipse plugin that integrates structural dependency visualization with LLM-powered code explanation on a shared interactive graph for Java program comprehension. The tool rests on four pillars: (1) a multi-edge-type dependency graph with live search and multiple layouts; (2) LLM explanations grounded in Graph-Aware Callee Pruning (GACP), an auditable strategy that selects relevant callees using the same graph the developer navigates; (3) a clone-detection overlay that highlights duplication and suggests extract-to-parent refactoring opportunities; and (4) a CVE risk overlay powered by OSV.dev. GACP uses graph distance, inheritance collapse, and edge-type weighting to produce prompts that are reproducible across LLM families and traceable to visible graph nodes. We demonstrate Comprendia on a Java project containing known clones and vulnerabilities, showing how the unified graph substrate supports comprehension while keeping the developer in control. Screencast: https://youtu.be/1wlh_RYehzA
papers.comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at ICSME 2026, Tool Demonstration and Data Showcase Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Comprendia 是一个 Eclipse 插件，将结构依赖可视化与 LLM 驱动的代码解释集成到同一交互式图上，用于 Java 程序理解。工具包含多边类型依赖图、基于图感知被调用方剪枝 (GACP) 的 LLM 解释、克隆检测叠加层以及基于 OSV.dev 的 CVE 风险叠加层。作者在一个包含已知克隆和漏洞的 Java 项目上演示了该工具。
Motivation: 程序理解通常需要在结构导航、LLM 生成解释和安全风险检查之间切换多种工具，缺少统一的上下文。该工具旨在通过单一图基质整合这些信息，同时保持开发者的控制权。
Method: 工具建立在四个支柱上：多边类型依赖图（支持实时搜索和多种布局）；基于图感知被调用方剪枝 (GACP) 的 LLM 解释，GACP 使用图距离、继承折叠和边类型权重选择相关被调用方，生成可复现且可追溯到可见图节点的提示；克隆检测叠加层，突出重复代码并建议提取到父类重构；以及由 OSV.dev 驱动的 CVE 风险叠加层。
Result: 摘要报告在包含已知克隆和漏洞的 Java 项目上进行了演示，展示了统一图基质如何支持理解并保持开发者控制。未提供定量实验结果。
Conclusion: 作者强调该工具将结构依赖可视化与 LLM 解释、克隆检测和 CVE 风险叠加结合在一个共享图上，GACP 提供可审计且跨 LLM 家族可复现的提示选择。

papers.title: SeFaR: Semantic Feature-aware Robustness Testing of Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are increasingly deployed in safety-critical domains as perception modules, where failures are often caused due to rare and under-represented scenarios. This necessitates the need to evaluate the semantic robustness of perception models; conformance of behavior to high-level requirements over real-world perceptual variability. To address this, we propose SeFaR, a framework for systematic semantic-feature-centric testing of vision models. Given a natural-language requirement and a set of satisfying inputs, SeFaR evaluates robustness with respect to diverse realistic semantic variations that preserve requirement satisfaction. The approach employs a novel hierarchical concept model enabling structured exploration of the feature space and incorporation of domain knowledge via user-defined concepts. State-of-the-art diffusion and vision-language models are leveraged to generate photorealistic semantics-preserving perturbations and identification of previously unknown features impacting behavior. A feedback-driven adaptive process is adopted to generate interpretable failure-inducing semantic concepts along with corresponding test inputs. Evaluation on case studies demonstrates that the proposed framework effectively satisfies requirement preconditions while identifying requirement-independent features that influence model decisions, enabling it to both uncover faults and relate them to such features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SeFaR，一个面向视觉模型的语义特征感知鲁棒性测试框架。给定自然语言需求与满足需求的输入集，SeFaR 通过分层概念模型 (hierarchical concept model) 系统探索特征空间，并利用扩散模型和视觉语言模型生成保持语义的真实感扰动，以发现影响模型行为的先前未知特征。反馈驱动的自适应过程用于生成可解释的导致失败的语义概念及相应测试输入。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在安全关键领域常作为感知模块部署，失败常由罕见且代表性不足的场景引起；现有测试方法难以评估感知模型对高层需求（真实世界感知变异）的语义鲁棒性。
Method: 提出一个语义特征为中心的测试框架：构建分层概念模型以结构化探索特征空间并融入用户定义概念的领域知识；借助最先进的扩散模型和视觉语言模型生成保持语义的真实感扰动，并识别影响行为的新特征；通过反馈驱动的自适应过程生成可解释的失败诱导语义概念和对应测试输入。
Result: 在案例研究上的评估表明，该方法能有效满足需求前置条件，同时识别影响模型决策的需求无关特征，既能发现故障又能将这些故障与相关特征联系起来。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能够将视觉模型的鲁棒性测试提升到语义层面，并将失败归因到可解释的语义概念上。

papers.title: Power law graph attention: exact generalization of scaled dot-product attention, empirical collapse at inference
papers.abstract_en: The Large Language Model from Power Law Decoder Representations (PLDR-LLM) and its attention, Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA), replace the fixed bilinear form of scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) with a learned, input-generated bilinear operator $G_{LM}$, built from a positive tensor $A_{LM}$ by elementwise power laws. The architecture is fully specified, verified against pinned reference releases; claims are labeled theorem, conditional theorem, measurement, or conjecture. Unconditionally: PLGA contains SDPA exactly at $G_{LM}=I$; $A_{LM}$ and $A_P$ are strictly entrywise positive, with Perron-Frobenius structure on $A_{LM}$; the DAG regularizer has the NOTEARS walk-counting form and positivity obstructs exact acyclicity; and, under nonresonance (satisfied by standard rotary frequencies), a commutant criterion identifies which operators preserve relative-position dependence. An inference-collapse theorem: exact input invariance of deductive outputs collapses inference to generalized SDPA with a constant operator. Measured invariance: relative fluctuations of $10^{-6}$ and below; perturbation bounds quantify but do not certify cached inference; the assembled proxy misses the decoding margin. A conditional three-stage mechanism (rotary twirl, concentration, row-map contraction) is measured on a released checkpoint. Blockwise training and scoring under the global Gram are stated with explicit target exposure; on tested samples, block and sequential scoring select identical answers and agree on the published TruthfulQA probability-mass metric within $5\times 10^{-5}$ per item. Self-organized criticality enters as a phenomenological framework with an intrinsic order parameter; open claims become falsifiable conjectures. Selected proof cores are machine-checked in Lean 4.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Power Law Graph Attention (PLGA) 及其配套 LLM 架构 PLDR-LLM，用输入生成的、由正张量 A_LM 经逐元素幂律构造的双线性算子 G_LM 替换缩放点积注意力 (SDPA) 的固定双线性形式。论文完全指定架构，并区分定理、条件定理、测量与猜想：无条件证明 PLGA 在 G_LM=I 时精确退化到 SDPA，以及一个推理坍缩定理——精确输入不变性会把推理坍缩为带常量算子的广义 SDPA。测量部分报告相对波动在 10^-6 及以下、条件三阶段机制，并称部分证明核在 Lean 4 中机器检查。
Motivation: 现有 SDPA 使用固定的双线性形式，可能限制注意力的表达能力；论文试图以学习到的输入生成算子替代它，同时严格刻画该推广的理论边界，包括可解释性、不变性和正则化性质。
Method: 定义 PLGA：从严格逐元素正张量 A_LM 经逐元素幂律生成算子 G_LM，并给出 DAG 正则项的 NOTEARS 游走计数形式。引入 commutant 判据刻画保持相对位置依赖的算子，证明推理坍缩定理；对已发布 checkpoint 测量三阶段机制（rotary twirl、concentration、row-map contraction），并用 Lean 4 验证部分证明核。
Result: 摘要报告的无条件结果包括：PLGA 在 G_LM=I 时精确包含 SDPA，A_LM 与 A_P 严格逐元素正且 A_LM 具有 Perron-Frobenius 结构，正性阻碍精确无环性。测量显示相对不变性波动在 10^-6 及以下；在 TruthfulQA 概率质量指标上，block 与 sequential scoring 每项目一致，差异在 5×10^-5 内；扰动界仅量化而不证明缓存推理，组装代理会错过解码边界。
Conclusion: 作者将开放声明明确标记为可证伪猜想，并以自组织临界性作为现象学框架，其中内在序参量承担解释角色。摘要强调若干理论保证是无条件的，但推理坍缩定理依赖精确输入不变性，扰动界不能对缓存推理提供认证；部分证明由机器检查支撑。

papers.title: TRACE-GS: On-Policy Trajectory Distillation with Privileged Geometric Conditioning for Sparse-View 3DGS Restoration
papers.abstract_en: We present TRACE-GS, an on-policy trajectory distillation framework that leverages privileged geometric conditioning at training time, thereby adapting a diffusion prior to sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) restoration. Rather than pursuing increasingly sophisticated restoration architectures, we identify a more fundamental limitation shared by existing diffusion-based approaches: supervision at independently noised states does not cover those reached during inference. In sparse-view 3DGS, under-constrained geometry biases denoising from the outset, and the resulting deviations compound along the rollout. TRACE-GS instead performs on-policy trajectory distillation: a teacher conditioned on richer geometry from additional training views supplies targets along the sparse-view student's own rollout, aligning denoising directions and cross-view responses at each visited state. This training-only geometry places TRACE-GS in the learning using privileged information (LUPI) setting. At deployment, only the sparse-view student is retained, and its restored renderings serve as pseudo-observations for 3DGS refinement. To the best of our knowledge, TRACE-GS is the first to derive on-policy supervision from privileged geometry for sparse-view 3DGS restoration, achieving consistent gains and strong generalization across datasets and sparse-view settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TRACE-GS 提出一种用于稀疏视角 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 修复的在线策略轨迹蒸馏 (on-policy trajectory distillation) 框架，在训练时利用特权几何条件 (privileged geometric conditioning) 将扩散先验适配到稀疏视角场景。其核心思路是让一个由额外训练视角的丰富几何信息所引导的教师模型，沿学生模型的自身去噪轨迹提供监督目标，从而对齐每一步访问状态下的去噪方向和跨视角响应。部署时仅保留稀疏视角学生模型，其修复渲染结果作为伪观测用于 3DGS 精修。
Motivation: 作者认为现有基于扩散的方法存在一个更根本的局限：在独立加噪状态上的监督并未覆盖推理阶段实际到达的状态；在稀疏视角 3DGS 中，欠约束的几何从一开始就使去噪产生偏差，且这些偏差沿轨迹不断累积，限制了修复质量。
Method: TRACE-GS 执行在线策略轨迹蒸馏：教师模型利用训练时额外视角提供的更丰富几何信息，为稀疏视角学生模型沿自身 rollout 的每个访问状态提供去噪目标；该训练期才有的几何信息使方法处于使用特权信息学习 (LUPI) 的设定中。部署时只保留学生模型。
Result: 据摘要所述，TRACE-GS 是首个从特权几何中为稀疏视角 3DGS 修复推导在线策略监督的方法，在多个数据集和稀疏视角设置下取得一致增益并展现出强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，训练阶段引入特权几何并按学生自身轨迹进行监督，可以在不增加推理时架构复杂度的情况下改善稀疏视角 3DGS 修复；作者将收益归因于去噪方向与跨视角响应在访问状态上的对齐。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Withholding the Completing Chunk: Deterministic Pair-Completion Guardrails for Streaming LLM Output
papers.abstract_en: Streaming language-model output creates a release-timing problem: complete-response moderation acts after streamed text has escaped, whereas repeated semantic classification of partial text can be costly and unstable. We study a narrow deterministic construction in which each committed danger signature is the conjunction of two lexical predicates. The guard scans the accumulated prefix before every release and withholds the first chunk that makes both predicates observable. Across four signature families, eight chunk sizes, and 32 mechanism trials, streaming decisions matched the buffered scanner and withheld every pair-completing chunk; eight single-predicate controls passed. In a separate 512-trial strategy comparison, full-prefix scanning and complete buffering detected all configured pairs, a 512-character window detected 96/128, and chunk-local scanning detected 38/128. Fixed pairs flagged 0/338 human-derived safe responses and detected 0/394 jury-labelled unsafe responses, confirming narrow rather than general harm coverage. A calibrated official Llama Guard 3 1B baseline classified 310/338 safe responses as safe and 202/394 unsafe responses as unsafe. Repeated-prefix scanner time on 16,384-character responses ranged from 13.261 ms to 829.640 ms across tested chunk sizes. Pair completion is therefore an exact release-boundary backstop for a small fixed policy, not a substitute for semantic moderation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究流式大语言模型输出中的释放时机问题：完整响应审核在文本流出后才生效，而对部分文本反复做语义分类则代价高且不稳定。作者考察一种确定性构造，其中每个危险签名是两个词法谓词的合取；守护机制在每次释放前扫描累积前缀，并扣留第一个使两个谓词同时可观察的chunk。实验覆盖四个签名族、八种chunk大小和32次机制试验，流式决策与缓冲扫描器一致并扣留所有完成pair组合的chunk。作者强调该方法只是小型固定策略的精确释放边界后盾，不能替代语义审核。
Motivation: 流式输出在发布时机上存在两难：完整响应的审核模型往往在文本已经流出之后才做出判断，而反复对部分文本做语义分类既昂贵又不稳定。论文希望找到一种低成本、确定性的机制，在词法层面精确阻止特定危险签名被完整暴露。
Method: 定义危险签名为两个词法谓词的合取（pair-completion），守护器在每次释放前扫描已累积的前缀，并扣留第一个使得两个谓词都可观察的chunk。研究将该确定性扫描与完整缓冲、512字符窗口和chunk局部扫描等策略进行比较，并以校准的Llama Guard 3 1B作为语义审核基线。
Result: 机制试验中，流式决策与缓冲扫描器完全匹配，扣留了所有pair-completing chunk，8个单谓词对照通过；512次策略比较中，全前缀扫描与完整缓冲检测到全部配置对，512字符窗口检测96/128，chunk局部扫描检测38/128。固定对在338个人类来源安全响应上标记0个误报，在394个陪审团标记的不安全响应上检测出0个，确认覆盖面很窄；而Llama Guard 3 1B基线将310/338安全响应判为安全、202/394不安全响应判为不安全。16,384字符响应的重复前缀扫描时间为13.261 ms至829.640 ms。
Conclusion: 作者将该项工作定位为针对小型固定策略的精确释放边界后盾（release-boundary backstop），而不是通用语义审核的替代品。它只覆盖被构造为词法谓词合取的已知危险模式，对更广泛的有害内容没有保证。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究流式大语言模型输出中的释放时机问题：完整响应审核在文本流出后才生效，而对部分文本反复做语义分类则代价高且不稳定。作者考察一种确定性构造，其中每个危险签名是两个词法谓词的合取；守护机制在每次释放前扫描累积前缀，并扣留第一个使两个谓词同时可观察的chunk。实验覆盖四个签名族、八种chunk大小和32次机制试验，流式决策与缓冲扫描器一致并扣留所有完成pair组合的chunk。作者强调该方法只是小型固定策略的精确释放边界后盾，不能替代语义审核。
summary_sections.motivation: 流式输出在发布时机上存在两难：完整响应的审核模型往往在文本已经流出之后才做出判断，而反复对部分文本做语义分类既昂贵又不稳定。论文希望找到一种低成本、确定性的机制，在词法层面精确阻止特定危险签名被完整暴露。
summary_sections.method: 定义危险签名为两个词法谓词的合取（pair-completion），守护器在每次释放前扫描已累积的前缀，并扣留第一个使得两个谓词都可观察的chunk。研究将该确定性扫描与完整缓冲、512字符窗口和chunk局部扫描等策略进行比较，并以校准的Llama Guard 3 1B作为语义审核基线。
summary_sections.result: 机制试验中，流式决策与缓冲扫描器完全匹配，扣留了所有pair-completing chunk，8个单谓词对照通过；512次策略比较中，全前缀扫描与完整缓冲检测到全部配置对，512字符窗口检测96/128，chunk局部扫描检测38/128。固定对在338个人类来源安全响应上标记0个误报，在394个陪审团标记的不安全响应上检测出0个，确认覆盖面很窄；而Llama Guard 3 1B基线将310/338安全响应判为安全、202/394不安全响应判为不安全。16,384字符响应的重复前缀扫描时间为13.261 ms至829.640 ms。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者将该项工作定位为针对小型固定策略的精确释放边界后盾（release-boundary backstop），而不是通用语义审核的替代品。它只覆盖被构造为词法谓词合取的已知危险模式，对更广泛的有害内容没有保证。

papers.title: Chain of Spatial Thoughts: Modality-Agnostic Spatial Grounding for Vision Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Spatial understanding is fundamental to embodied intelligence, underpinning applications such as robotic manipulation, embodied navigation, and autonomous driving. Although recent vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved impressive performance on spatial reasoning benchmarks, state-of-the-art approaches typically rely on additional spatial encoders or architectural modifications during inference, increasing computational cost. We introduce Space Tokens, a lightweight, architecture-agnostic framework that equips VLMs with explicit continuous spatial representations without requiring additional inference-time modules. By distilling scene-level 3D geometry and object-centric spatial attributes into continuous latent tokens, our method enables these modalities to be directly incorporated into a chain-of-thought reasoning process, thereby improving the VLM's spatial reasoning capabilities. At the same time, the learned representations can be explicitly decoded to verify that they encode meaningful geometric information, while the unified token interface remains extensible to additional modalities. Experiments on VSI-Bench improve Qwen3-VL-8B by 4.3% and SenseNova-SI-1.3 by 1.3%, while achieving state-of-the-art performance on object size (79.2%) and room size estimation (75.7%). These results demonstrate that continuous spatial tokens provide an effective, interpretable, and computationally efficient mechanism for integrating geometric reasoning into large vision-language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Space Tokens，一种轻量级、与架构无关的框架，为视觉语言模型 (VLM) 引入显式连续空间表示，无需在推理阶段添加额外模块。通过将场景级 3D 几何和对象中心空间属性蒸馏为连续潜在 token，并将其纳入思维链 (chain-of-thought) 推理过程，该方法提升了 VLM 的空间推理能力，同时支持显式解码以验证几何信息。在 VSI-Bench 上，该方法使 Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 4.3%、SenseNova-SI-1.3 提升 1.3%，并在物体大小估计 (79.2%) 和房间大小估计 (75.7%) 上达到最优。
Motivation: 现有 VLM 在空间推理基准上表现良好，但领先方法通常在推理时依赖额外的空间编码器或架构修改，增加了计算成本。本文针对这一问题，希望以轻量且架构无关的方式赋予 VLM 显式空间推理能力。
Method: 提出 Space Tokens 框架，将场景级 3D 几何与对象中心空间属性蒸馏为连续潜在 token，通过统一的 token 接口直接集成到链式思维推理中；该表示还可被显式解码，用于验证其编码的几何信息。
Result: 在 VSI-Bench 上，Qwen3-VL-8B 提升 4.3%，SenseNova-SI-1.3 提升 1.3%；在物体大小估计 (79.2%) 和房间大小估计 (75.7%) 上达到当前最优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调连续空间 token 为大型 VLM 集成几何推理提供了一种有效、可解释且计算高效的机制。

papers.title: Stochastic Emulation of a Fully Coupled Preindustrial E3SMv3 Simulation
papers.abstract_en: We present a stochastic coupled emulator of E3SM version 3, built on the SamudrACE framework, which couples an atmosphere emulator (ACE2) with a full-depth ocean emulator (Samudra). We replace the deterministic atmosphere emulator with its stochastic counterpart, ACE2S, and fine-tune the coupled system with a probabilistic objective, so that the atmosphere acts as a source of internal variability for the ocean. Trained on 105 years of a pre-industrial control simulation and evaluated on an independent 400 years, the emulator reproduces E3SMv3's mean climate state with biases much smaller than existing model-to-observation differences. Relative to a deterministic baseline, stochastic training maintains internal variability across timescales, most notably in the ENSO power spectrum, eddy-rich SST anomalies, and sea ice variability in the marginal ice zone. The emulator captures daily precipitation accurately up to the 99.99th percentile, but underestimates the rarest tropical extremes. These results show that stochastic coupled emulators can reproduce long-timescale variability with high fidelity, while extrapolation to unseen extremes remains a key challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 SamudrACE 框架构建 E3SMv3 的随机耦合仿真器 (stochastic coupled emulator)，用概率目标微调随机大气仿真器 ACE2S，并使其与全深度海洋仿真器 Samudra 耦合，从而为海洋提供内部变率源。仿真器在 105 年工业化前控制模拟上训练，并在独立的 400 年数据上评估，能再现 E3SMv3 的平均气候态，偏差远小于现有模式与观测之间的差异。相对于确定性基线，随机训练保留了跨时间尺度的内部变率，尤其体现在 ENSO 功率谱、富涡海表温度异常和边缘冰区海冰变率上；日降水可准确捕获至 99.99 分位，但低估了最罕见的赤道极端降水。
Motivation: 确定性大气仿真器无法为耦合海洋仿真器提供充分的内部变率，而耦合气候仿真需要大气作为海洋内部变率的来源；作者旨在用随机化大气仿真器改进耦合仿真器对长期变率的再现能力。
Method: 在 SamudrACE 框架中将确定性大气仿真器替换为其随机对应物 ACE2S，并与全深度海洋仿真器 Samudra 耦合，使用概率目标微调整体耦合系统；训练数据为工业化前控制模拟的 105 年数据。
Result: 在独立的 400 年评估中，仿真器再现 E3SMv3 平均气候态且偏差远小于模式与观测的差异；相比确定性基线，随机训练保持了 ENSO 功率谱、富涡海表温度异常和边缘冰区海冰变率等跨时间尺度内部变率；日降水准确捕获至 99.99 分位，但低估最罕见的赤道极端降水。
Conclusion: 随机耦合仿真器能以高保真度再现长期变率，但对未见极端事件的 extrapolation 仍是关键挑战。

papers.title: Locally Deployable Small Language Models for Emergency Department Decision Support: A Systematic Benchmark of Fine-Tuning Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Deploying large language models (LLMs) for decision support in emergency departments (EDs) faces two major challenges: privacy risks of transmitting patient data to closed-source commercial LLMs and the lack of systematic evaluation of fine-tuning strategies for locally deployable open-source small language models (SLMs). We benchmarked eight open-source SLMs using zero-shot prompting, prefix tuning, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and full fine-tuning on three ED tasks: triage level prediction, specialist referral recommendation, and diagnosis prediction. Using 2,083 MIMIC-IV-ED cases and Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 as baselines, we found that LoRA fine-tuned open-source SLMs outperform commercial baselines on triage level prediction and specialist referral recommendation, while diagnosis prediction remains challenging for open-source SLMs. Confusion matrix analysis further shows that fine-tuned open-source SLMs can detect highest-severity patients missed by the commercial baselines. These results demonstrate that locally deployable SLMs can achieve clinically competitive performance for ED decision support.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评测了八种开源小语言模型 (SLM) 在急诊科决策支持任务上的表现，比较了零样本提示、prefix tuning、LoRA 和全参数微调四种策略。基于 2,083 例 MIMIC-IV-ED 数据，以 Claude Haiku 4.5 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5 为基线，发现 LoRA 微调的开源 SLM 在分诊级别预测和专科转诊推荐上优于商业基线，但诊断预测仍具挑战。混淆矩阵分析还显示微调后的开源 SLM 能识别商业基线漏检的最高严重度患者。
Motivation: 将大语言模型用于急诊科决策支持面临两大问题：将患者数据传输至闭源商业 LLM 存在隐私风险，且缺乏对本地可部署开源小语言模型微调策略的系统评估。
Method: 对八个开源 SLM 在三个急诊任务（分诊级别预测、专科转诊推荐、诊断预测）上评测零样本提示、prefix tuning、LoRA 与全参数微调，并使用 2,083 例 MIMIC-IV-ED 病例及 Claude Haiku 4.5 和 Claude Sonnet 4.5 作为商业基线。
Result: LoRA 微调的开源 SLM 在分诊级别预测和专科转诊推荐上超过商业基线；诊断预测对开源 SLM 仍然困难。混淆矩阵分析表明，微调后的开源 SLM 能捕获商业基线遗漏的最高严重度患者。
Conclusion: 本地可部署的 SLM 能够在急诊决策支持上达到临床上有竞争力的性能，从而缓解数据隐私顾虑。

papers.title: BreastMammo and DenseMammo: Benchmarks for Mammography Domain Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Breast density classification is a critical component of breast cancer risk assessment, yet AI models often struggle to generalize across clinical sites due to vendor-specific acquisition styles. In this work, we introduce two new datasets, BreastMammo and DenseMammo, to facilitate robust multi-view mammography research. We propose a domain generalization framework that utilizes a foreground-only histogram matching protocol to resolve the domain shift issue arising from disparate clinical sources. Internal evaluation using a 5-fold cross-validation protocol demonstrates the efficacy of our approach, with the Swin Transformer backbone achieving a peak AUC of 98.32% for density classification. External evaluation on the TNMammo and LUMINA datasets demonstrates that the proposed approach consistently reduces domain shift, significantly outperforming prominent domain generalization paradigms, including MixStyle and Discrete-Fourier-Transform-based frameworks.
papers.comment: This paper was accepted to the MICCAI 2026 workshop Deep-Brea3th
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对乳腺钼靶密度分类模型在跨临床站点时因厂商采集风格不同而泛化困难的问题，提出两个新数据集 BreastMammo 和 DenseMammo，并设计了一种仅针对前景的直方图匹配 (foreground-only histogram matching) 域泛化框架。内部 5 折交叉验证中，Swin Transformer 骨干在密度分类上达到 98.32% 的峰值 AUC；在 TNMammo 和 LUMINA 外部数据集上，该方法持续减小域偏移，并明显优于 MixStyle 和基于离散傅里叶变换的域泛化方法。
Motivation: 乳腺密度分类是乳腺癌风险评估的关键环节，但 AI 模型常因不同临床站点存在厂商特定的采集风格而难以泛化，域偏移 (domain shift) 成为实际部署中的重要障碍。
Method: 作者构建了 BreastMammo 与 DenseMammo 两个多视角钼靶数据集，并提出一种域泛化框架，核心是使用仅针对前景的直方图匹配协议来缓解不同临床来源造成的域偏移。
Result: 内部评估采用 5 折交叉验证，Swin Transformer 骨干取得 98.32% 的峰值 AUC；外部评估在 TNMammo 和 LUMINA 数据集上显示该方法持续减小域偏移，并显著优于 MixStyle 和基于离散傅里叶变换的若干主流域泛化范式。
Conclusion: 摘要强调新数据集与前景直方图匹配协议能够支持稳健的多视角钼靶研究，并为缓解跨临床来源域偏移提供有效方案。

papers.title: Toward Human Rights Benchmarking for LLMs: A Pilot Methodology
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate legal determinations over what human rights are realized, and how. Yet, no evaluation benchmark exists to assess whether they can reason correctly about human rights law. To this end, we report our efforts to develop a robust and scalable methodology for creating HumRightsBench: the first expert-validated, scenario-based benchmark for evaluating reasoning grounded in the obligation structure of international human rights law. We adapt the IRAC framework for legal reasoning to better suit the unique reasoning patterns of human rights work (substituting P, "proposing remedies," for C, "legal conclusion," yielding IRAP) to structure our evaluation heuristics. We also produce a pilot series of authentic scenarios designed to implicate the many dimensions of real-world human rights issues and annotated by human rights lawyers and professionals across the world. Ultimately, we find that model accuracy scores range considerably across legal reasoning tasks (overall model performance ranges from 0.339 to 0.577, task min-max ranges from 0.025 to 0.774), which strongly implies that HumRightsBench is a capable instrument for advancing this emerging subfield of AI evaluations science at a critical moment in its evolution.
papers.comment: Best paper, honorable mention, at the ICML 2026 Workshop on AI4Law, Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了构建 HumRightsBench 的试点方法论，这是首个由专家验证的、基于场景的国际人权法推理基准。作者将法律推理的 IRAC 框架调整为 IRAP（用“提出补救措施”替代“法律结论”），并开发了一批由全球人权律师标注的真实场景。初步结果显示模型在各推理任务上的准确率差异很大，说明该基准能有效评估 LLM 的人权法推理能力。
Motivation: LLM 日益介入影响人权实现的决策，但现有评估体系中缺少检验其能否正确推理国际人权法义务结构的基准。
Method: 提出可扩展的基准构建方法：基于 IRAC 框架改造为 IRAP 评估启发式，并制作一系列涵盖真实人权问题多维度的场景，由全球人权律师和专业人士进行标注。
Result: 试点中模型总体性能介于 0.339 到 0.577，任务层面最低 0.025、最高 0.774，表明不同模型和任务间表现波动很大。
Conclusion: HumRightsBench 被证明是推进 AI 评估科学这一新兴子领域的有效工具，尤其在该领域发展的关键时期。

papers.title: Interpreting Language Model Hidden States at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Lens methods interpret large language models (LLMs) by mapping intermediate activations to the output vocabulary, revealing how next-token predictions develop through the network. Trained lenses remain expensive: affine-translator parameters grow quadratically with model width, while exact, full-vocabulary Kullback--Leibler (KL) training dominates memory. Consequently, prior trained lenses have been applied to models of at most 20B parameters and remain tied to particular component types. We present OmniLens, which applies a single lens family to any model-width activation, whether residual stream, attention, or MLP, and combines two independent scaling techniques. First, low-rank translators make per-lens parameter growth linear in model width and reduce trainable parameters by up to 98.4%. Second, Subset-KL materializes only selected vocabulary logits: its Top-k mode cuts peak training memory by up to 70%, while its importance-sampled variant retains unbiased stochastic gradients for the full KL. These savings enable a dense ensemble of 482 lenses for LLaMA-3.3-70B, providing 6x the coverage of a residual-stream design at the same depth. Model-wide coverage then reveals what single-component lenses cannot: the components where a behavior is most visible need not be those where intervention is most effective, and the most effective interventions lie outside the attention heads examined by prior lens studies. Across three case studies (prompt-injection detection, multi-hop memory injection, and toxicity localization), OmniLens reproduces key published results at substantially lower cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 OmniLens，一种可扩展到 70B 规模语言模型的 lens 解释方法，把中间激活映射到输出词表以观察 next-token 预测的演化。它用低秩翻译器（low-rank translator）将每类 lens 的参数增长降为模型宽度的线性量，并用 Subset-KL 只物化部分词表 logits，从而在 LLaMA-3.3-70B 上训练了 482 个 lens 的密集集成。作者报告该方法在更低保真成本下复现了三个案例研究的关键结果，并揭示了单组件 lens 无法观察到的行为可见性与干预有效性之间的差异。
Motivation: 已有的 trained lens 方法成本过高：仿射翻译器参数随模型宽度二次增长，且精确的全词表 KL 训练占据大量内存，因此此前只能应用于最多 20B 参数的模型，并且局限于特定组件类型。需要一种可跨模型宽度和组件类型扩展的 lens 方法。
Method: OmniLens 将同一 lens 家族应用于任意宽度的激活，包括残差流（residual stream）、注意力（attention）和 MLP。它结合两项缩放技术：低秩翻译器使每个 lens 的可训练参数随模型宽度线性增长，最多减少 98.4% 的参数；Subset-KL 只计算选中的词表 logits，其 Top-k 模式最多降低 70% 的峰值训练内存，importance-sampled 变体则对完整 KL 保持无偏随机梯度。这些节省支撑了 LLaMA-3.3-70B 上 482 个 lens 的密集集成，在相同深度下比残差流设计多出 6 倍覆盖。
Result: 摘要报告可训练参数最多减少 98.4%，峰值训练内存最多降低 70%，并在相同深度下提供 6 倍于残差流设计的覆盖。在提示注入检测（prompt-injection detection）、多跳记忆注入（multi-hop memory injection）和毒性定位（toxicity localization）三个案例研究中，OmniLens 以显著更低的成本复现了已发表的关键结果；模型级覆盖还显示行为最可见的组件不一定是干预最有效的组件，且最有效干预位于此前 lens 研究考察的注意力头之外。
Conclusion: 作者认为模型范围的覆盖能揭示单组件 lens 无法发现的结构性现象：行为的可观测位置与干预的有效位置并不一致，且有效的干预点可能落在已有注意力头研究之外。该工作主要面向大模型的可解释性，而非天气或降水任务。

papers.title: TAF-MED: Multi-Turn Safety Refusal Collapse in LLMs Under Declared Self-Treatment Intent
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly provide conversational health information that may influence treatment decisions, yet existing benchmarks do not isolate whether medication-safety boundaries persist across follow-ups after explicit self-treatment intent. We introduce TAF-MED, a physician-reviewed benchmark of 500 fixed three-turn scenarios, and evaluate eight LLMs across 4,000 conversations. A rubric-based automated judge labelled responses as SAFE, LEAKY, or UNSAFE, and two physicians independently annotated a model-balanced random subset of 400 conversations. We assessed unsafe guidance, collapse after a strictly SAFE initial response, and model-ranking stability. Overall, 71.6% of conversations contained an UNSAFE response, and 61.4% of those beginning with a strictly SAFE response later collapsed to UNSAFE; model-level collapse rates ranged from 24.4% to 96.2%. Four of 28 model pairs reversed order between initial unsafe and collapse rates. Automated labels achieved 94.3% agreement with the adjudicated physician reference ($κ= 0.895$). These findings show that first-turn safety is an incomplete proxy for conversational safety persistence and motivate evaluation across complete dialogue trajectories. We will release TAF-MED on Hugging Face to support reproducible research on multi-turn medical safety.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TAF-MED，一个由医生审阅的 500 组固定三轮对话基准，用于评估 LLM 在用户明确表达自我治疗意图后、跨后续轮次的药物安全边界是否持续。作者评估了 8 个 LLM 共 4,000 段对话，用基于 rubric 的自动评判器标注 SAFE/LEAKY/UNSAFE，并由两位医生独立标注 400 段对话。结果显示 71.6% 的对话包含 UNSAFE 回复，61.4% 以严格 SAFE 开头的对话后来崩坏为 UNSAFE，模型级崩坏率在 24.4% 到 96.2% 之间。
Motivation: 现有基准没有隔离考察 LLM 在用户声明自我治疗意图后、跨后续追问时药物安全边界是否依然成立；而健康信息对话往往不止一轮，首轮安全不能代表整体安全。
Method: 引入医生审阅的三轮对话基准 TAF-MED，共 500 个固定场景；用基于 rubric 的自动评判器将回复标为 SAFE、LEAKY 或 UNSAFE，两位医生独立标注模型均衡抽样的 400 段对话作为参照；评估指标包括不安全指导比例、严格 SAFE 首轮后的崩坏率以及模型排名的稳定性。
Result: 71.6% 的对话含有 UNSAFE 回复；61.4% 以严格 SAFE 回复开头的对话在后续轮次崩坏为 UNSAFE，模型级崩坏率介于 24.4% 至 96.2%；28 个模型对中有 4 对在首轮不安全率与崩坏率的排序上发生反转；自动标签与经裁决的医生参照的一致性为 94.3%（κ=0.895）。
Conclusion: 作者认为首轮安全只是对话安全持久性的不完整代理指标，并主张应在完整对话轨迹上评估医疗安全；TAF-MED 将发布在 Hugging Face 上以支持可复现的多轮医疗安全研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CRHT: A Continuous Regression Hybrid Transformer for Vessel Trajectory Prediction with Online Cluster Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Accurate vessel trajectory prediction is critical for maritime safety and anomaly detection, yet existing models often struggle with geographic bias and navigational realism. We propose the Continuous Regression Hybrid Transformer (CRHT), a deep learning framework designed to forecast vessel motion using Automatic Identification System (AIS) data. To mitigate spatial data imbalance, we introduce an online K-means cluster sampling strategy that ensures diverse exposure to rare maneuvers during training. Our hybrid architecture integrates 1D convolutional layers for local kinematic feature extraction with a multi-head attention mechanism for global temporal context. CRHT demonstrates superior performance in short-term forecasting, achieving the lowest errors at the 1-hour horizon. The results demonstrate that while discrete models provide high navigational stability over long horizons, CRHT offers an optimal balance of precision and maneuver tracking for real-time maritime surveillance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出连续回归混合Transformer（Continuous Regression Hybrid Transformer, CRHT），用于基于AIS数据的船舶轨迹预测。CRHT结合在线K-means聚类采样以缓解空间数据不均衡，并混合1D卷积与多头注意力分别提取局部运动特征和全局时间上下文。摘要报告其在1小时短期预测范围内取得最低误差，并在精度与机动跟踪之间实现平衡。
Motivation: 现有船舶轨迹预测常受地理偏差和航行真实性问题困扰，而准确预测对海上安全和异常检测至关重要。
Method: 提出CRHT框架：训练阶段使用在线K-means聚类采样，确保模型对罕见机动的多样化暴露；架构上融合1D卷积层（局部运动特征提取）与多头注意力机制（全局时间上下文建模）。
Result: 摘要报告CRHT在短期预测中表现优越，在1小时预测范围内达到最低误差；离散模型在长时域上提供较高航行稳定性，而CRHT在精度与机动跟踪间取得平衡。
Conclusion: 作者认为CRHT适用于实时海上监视，能同时兼顾预测精度与机动跟踪能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Off-Axis, On Purpose: Where a Transformer Computes Concepts and Why it Does So
papers.abstract_en: A transformer's answer lives on one axis: the direction its unembedding reads. Its intermediate states largely do not, and that off-axis position is usually treated as an obstacle to interpretation. We show it is functional. A 12-layer model computes in two phases. Through the first, every sublayer writes into a subspace held near-orthogonal to the read-out, attention 75 to 96 degrees off it at every depth. Moving attention's values onto the read-out is 64 to 84 times more damaging than a matched random rotation, and the damage is entirely in cross-token mixing: the subspace insulates composition from the vocabulary. Beneath it the frame itself turns rigidly with depth. In the second phase the answer arrives on-axis, late, and by addition rather than by turning accumulated content onto the read-out. Pressing every layer onto the read-out instead, as training for early exit does, matches the baseline on perplexity, LAMBADA and BLiMP while cutting the concept-phase workspace from about twenty-five effective dimensions to fourteen, a change none of those benchmarks register. The geometry can also be imposed, though not by asking for it. Prescribing it through the loss is a lottery: six of eight seeds collapse, because a model told to null its read-out projection obeys most cheaply by discarding dimensions. Inserting one fixed rotation at the phase boundary lands it instead, at baseline quality. A sparse rotation the surrounding weights can absorb converges on all nine seeds, against five of nine for ordinary training. Which rotation is immaterial: twenty-five runs across thirteen distinct ones reach the same quality, and two baselines from different seeds hold their concepts in near-orthogonal frames while agreeing on their read-outs. That freedom is usable: a basis drawn at random and prescribed before training is adopted across the concept phase, with quality unchanged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 Transformer 中间状态为何偏离其读出方向 (read-out axis)，并论证这种 off-axis 几何是功能性的而非解释障碍。作者用一个 12 层模型展示其计算分两阶段：前半段每个子层将内容写入与读出近似正交的子空间（attention 在各深度偏离读出 75 至 96 度），从而把跨 token 组合与词表隔离；答案则在后期阶段通过加法直接落在轴上。将每层强行压到读出方向（如同 early exit 训练）在困惑度、LAMBADA 和 BLiMP 上不损基线，却把概念阶段的有效工作空间从约 25 维降到 14 维。通过损失函数直接规定该几何则不稳定（8 个种子中 6 个崩溃），而在阶段边界插入一个固定旋转却能在基线质量下稳定实现该几何。
Motivation: Transformer 的答案存在于单一读出轴上，而中间状态大多偏离该轴，这种 off-axis 位置通常被视为阻碍可解释性的障碍；作者的目标是证明该几何本身具有功能意义，并探索它是否可以被主动施加。
Method: 作者先以 12 层模型刻画 off-axis 几何（测量 attention 与读出方向的夹角、将值投影到读出方向的破坏性），再通过三类干预检验几何的可施加性：把每一层都压到读出方向（模拟 early exit 训练）、在损失中直接规定读出投影为零、以及在阶段边界插入一个固定旋转或稀疏旋转。

Conclusion: 作者认为 off-axis 几何是功能的而非偶然的：它保护组合计算不受词表读出干扰，并且可以被施加——只是不能通过在损失里直接要求，而要通过在阶段边界插入旋转这类结构性手段来实现；不同旋转之间的自由度可用于在训练前随机指定基底而不损失质量。

papers.title: STCAD: Scalable Trajectory Clustering and Anomaly Detection on Terabyte-Scale AIS Data
papers.abstract_en: We present a scalable framework for unsupervised clustering of maritime trajectories derived from terabyte-scale Automatic Identification System (AIS) archives. Variable-length trajectories are encoded with a custom BERT-based model trained via masked token modeling and clustered using CURE hierarchical clustering, producing physically interpretable trajectory groups without requiring a predefined number of clusters. An intrinsic unsupervised anomaly detection method based on reconstruction loss and clustering noise assignment identifies irregular navigation patterns. The framework is demonstrated on a national-scale AIS dataset comprising billions of messages spanning one year, yielding stable trajectory clusters and a clear separation between nominal and anomalous vessel behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 STCAD，一个用于 TB 级 AIS 数据的大规模无监督轨迹聚类与异常检测框架。变长轨迹由自定义 BERT 模型通过掩码 token 建模编码，并用 CURE 层次聚类生成物理可解释的轨迹组，无需预定义聚类数。基于重建损失和聚类噪声分配的无监督异常检测方法可识别不规则航行模式。在涵盖一年、数十亿条消息的国家级 AIS 数据集上验证，得到稳定聚类并清晰区分正常与异常船舶行为。
Motivation: 面向 TB 级 AIS 档案的可扩展无监督轨迹分析存在需求；现有方法难以处理该规模数据，且通常需要预定义聚类数，难以产生可解释的轨迹分组和异常检测。
Method: 提出自定义 BERT 模型编码变长轨迹，通过掩码 token 建模训练；使用 CURE 层次聚类生成无需预设数量、物理可解释的轨迹簇；并用重建损失加聚类噪声分配实现无监督异常检测。
Result: 在覆盖一年、含数十亿条消息的国家级 AIS 数据集上，框架产生稳定的轨迹聚类，并实现正常与异常船舶行为的清晰分离。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架在国家级规模上具有可扩展性，能产生可解释且稳定的轨迹聚类，并有效识别异常导航模式。
