papers.title: DualSpectralCF: Training-Free Sign-Aware Spectral Collaborative Filtering
papers.abstract_en: Real-world recommendation platforms routinely collect explicit negative feedback such as 1-star reviews, hate-button clicks, distrust between users, and very-low watch-ratio videos. Learned sign-aware recommenders exploit this signal for clear accuracy gains, but only at the cost of gradient-based training. In parallel, a line of training-free spectral collaborative filtering methods matches or beats learned graph recommenders at a fraction of the cost, yet operates on positive interactions alone. We bridge these two lines with DualSpectralCF, a training-free framework of two components that attach to any spectral backbone of the form $\hat{\mathbf{r}}_u = F(\mathbf{M}) \mathbf{r}_u$: a signed input signal $\mathbf{r}_u^{\pm}$ that encodes the user's explicit dislikes, and a signed item-item operator $\mathbf{M}^{\pm}$ that blends like-together and dislike-together similarity. The framework is backbone-agnostic and adds just two scalar hyperparameters. We instantiate DualSpectralCF on ChebyCF, GF-CF, and Turbo-CF, and evaluate on five sign-aware benchmarks: every instance matches or beats its unsigned backbone on all 5 datasets, with Recall@20 lifts up to +32.6% with backbone-specific $(γ, κ)$ tuning and +1.9% to +16.0% for DualSpectralCF-Cheby at the fixed default $(γ= -0.5, κ= 0.1)$, and the family runs 7.7 to 155.3$\times$ faster than SIGformer while reaching 70.7% to 90.7% of its accuracy. Sign-awareness helps most for cold-start users, with up to +29.2% Recall@20 on Epinions users with 1 to 5 training items.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DualSpectralCF，一个无需训练的符号感知谱协同过滤框架，显式利用用户提供的负反馈（如一星评分、厌恶点击等）。该框架由带符号的输入信号 r_u^± 和带符号的物品-物品算子 M^± 组成，可附加到任意形如 r̂_u = F(M) r_u 的谱骨干上，仅引入两个标量超参数。作者在 ChebyCF、GF-CF、Turbo-CF 上实例化，并在五个符号感知基准上验证，表明其匹配或超过未签名骨干的性能，且比 SIGformer 快得多。
Motivation: 现有符号感知推荐器通过梯度训练利用显式负面反馈获得精度提升，但训练成本高；而无需训练的谱协同过滤方法成本低但只处理正向交互。本文旨在弥合这两类方法，让谱方法也能利用显式负反馈。
Method: 提出 DualSpectralCF，一种与骨干无关的免训练框架，包含两个组件：编码用户明确不喜欢的带符号输入信号 r_u^±，以及混合“喜欢聚在一起”和“不喜欢聚在一起”相似性的带符号物品-物品算子 M^±。框架只需两个标量超参数 (γ, κ)，并可实例化到不同的谱骨干上。
Result: 在五个符号感知基准上，每个实例在所有数据集上都匹配或超过其未签名骨干；使用骨干特定 (γ, κ) 调参时 Recall@20 提升最高达 +32.6%；固定默认 (γ=-0.5, κ=0.1) 时 DualSpectralCF-Cheby 提升 +1.9% 至 +16.0%。家族运行速度比 SIGformer 快 7.7 至 155.3 倍，同时达到其 70.7% 至 90.7% 的准确率。符号感知对冷启动用户帮助最大，在 Epinions 上对仅有 1 到 5 个训练物品的用户 Recall@20 提升高达 +29.2%。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，免训练的谱协同过滤可以以极低计算成本吸收显式负反馈信号，符号感知在冷启动场景下收益最大。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A Graph Neural Network--Guided Genetic Algorithm for Physical Internet Supply Chain Optimization under Cost Uncertainty
papers.abstract_en: Inventory and distribution planning in Physical Internet networks requires coordinating factory-hub assignments, factory supply, lateral transshipment among collaborative hubs, retailer deliveries, and shortages. The problem combines discrete assignment decisions with interdependent continuous flows, while uncertain operating costs make robust planning more difficult. This study formulates deterministic and min-max regret models for a three-echelon network of factories, hubs, and retailers and develops a graph neural network-guided genetic algorithm (GNN-GA) for the assignment decisions. The GNN estimates hub-specific factory-selection probabilities that are used to construct the initial GA population and adapt mutation according to prediction uncertainty. Each previously unseen candidate assignment is evaluated by solving the remaining continuous-flow problem to LP optimality. Simulated annealing, a standard GA, and GNN-GA are compared on 15 instances using matched random seeds and fixed limits on distinct assignment evaluations. Because the evaluation budgets for test Instances 13-15 are smaller than the nominal population size, these experiments primarily assess the quality of learned initialization rather than multi-generation evolutionary search. A separate 400-evaluation experiment on exact test Instance 13 permits three complete offspring generations and a partial fourth pass, with GNN-GA outperforming GA in all 10 matched runs. Three independently generated exact-solvable instances provide a separate test of transfer. Ablation results show that learned initialization provides most of the improvement, while entropy-guided mutation has a smaller, instance-dependent effect. Per-instance solution times include GNN inference and search but exclude model training and one-time model setup.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向 Physical Internet 网络中的库存与配送规划问题，在成本不确定下构建工厂-枢纽-零售商三层的确定性与 min-max regret 模型，并提出图神经网络引导的遗传算法 (GNN-GA)。GNN 预测各枢纽的工厂选择概率，用于构造初始 GA 种群并根据预测不确定性调整变异；每个新候选解通过将剩余连续流问题求解至 LP 最优来评估。在 15 个实例上与模拟退火和标准 GA 对比，并在精确实例 13 的 400 次评估实验中验证了 GNN-GA 的性能。
Motivation: Physical Internet 网络的规划需同时协调工厂-枢纽分配、工厂供应、枢纽间横向转运、零售商配送与缺货，且成本不确定使稳健规划更加困难；离散分配决策与相互依赖的连续流问题耦合，现有方法难以高效求解。
Method: 提出 GNN 引导的遗传算法：GNN 估计枢纽特定的工厂选择概率，用于生成初始种群并依据预测不确定性自适应调整变异操作；每个未见过的新候选分配通过求解剩余连续流 LP 进行精确评估。实验将 GNN-GA 与模拟退火和标准 GA 在 15 个实例上以匹配随机种子和固定评估预算进行比较，并设置独立生成的精确可解实例测试迁移能力。
Result: 在测试实例 13 的 400 次评估实验中，GNN-GA 在全部 10 次匹配运行中优于标准 GA；消融结果显示学习得到的初始化贡献了大部分提升，而熵引导变异的作用较小且依赖具体实例。由于实例 13-15 的评估预算小于名义种群规模，这些实验主要评估学习初始化的质量而非多代演化搜索。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 GNN 学习到的初始化是性能提升的主要来源；方法在独立生成的实例上表现出一定迁移性。每实例求解时间包含 GNN 推理与搜索，但不含模型训练和一次性模型设置，整体呈现为 6 页的初步研究。

papers.title: Sequential Modality Dropout for Robust Multi-Modal Sequential Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Multi-modal sequential recommenders assume every item carries every modality, but real product catalogs often miss images or text, and a model trained on complete data loses much of its recommendation accuracy when a modality is unavailable at serving time. We propose Sequential Modality Dropout (SMD): during training, each modality stream (image and text) is independently erased with probability p for an entire user interaction history, so the model learns to predict the next item without relying on any single modality. We measure robustness by retention, the fraction of a model's full-modality accuracy (HR@10) that survives when a modality is removed at test time. Across four backbones (MM-SASRec, IISAN, MISSRec, and fMRLRec) on four Amazon domains, SMD raises text retention by 1.0 to 3.2x at essentially no cost to full-modality accuracy; under an extreme 95% per-item missing rate, it retains 61% of HR@10 versus 22% without (a 2.8x improvement). An optional cross-modal reconstruction loss further lifts retention from 90% to 98% on a simple additive backbone under severe text missingness. SMD is a four-line, architecture-agnostic change that makes multi-modal sequential recommenders robust to the missing modalities they actually encounter in deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sequential Modality Dropout（SMD），一种面向多模态序列推荐鲁棒性的训练方法：训练时以概率 p 将某个模态流（如图像或文本）在整段用户交互历史上整体遮蔽，使模型在不依赖单一模态的情况下学习预测下一交互项。在四个骨干模型（MM-SASRec、IISAN、MISSRec、fMRLRec）和四个 Amazon 数据集上，SMD 在基本不损失全模态准确率的前提下将文本保留率（retention）提升 1.0 到 3.2 倍；在 95% 逐项缺失的极端情况下，HR@10 保留率从 22% 提高到 61%。可选的跨模态重建损失在严重文本缺失下将保留率从 90% 进一步提升到 98%。
Motivation: 现实商品目录中并非每个商品都具备全部模态（如图像或文本缺失），而仅在完整数据上训练的模型在服务阶段遇到模态缺失时推荐准确率会大幅下降；现有多模态序列推荐模型对此缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出 Sequential Modality Dropout（SMD）：训练阶段对每个模态流独立地以概率 p 整段擦除用户交互历史，迫使模型不依赖任何单一模态进行下一项预测；并可选地加入跨模态重建损失以增强缺失模态下的表示恢复。
Result: 在四个骨干模型和四个 Amazon 数据集上，SMD 将文本 retention 提升 1.0 至 3.2 倍且不损失全模态准确率；在 95% 逐项缺失率下保留 61% 的 HR@10（对照为 22%，提升 2.8 倍）；加入跨模态重建损失后，在简单加性骨干模型上严重文本缺失下的 retention 从 90% 升至 98%。
Conclusion: SMD 是一个架构无关、仅需四行修改的训练改动，能够使多模态序列推荐模型对部署中实际遇到的模态缺失保持鲁棒。

papers.title: Beyond Detection: Evaluating Defensive LLMs Against AI-Generated Social Engineering in Live Turn-by-Turn Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI makes social-engineering attacks more fluent, adaptive, and scalable, increasing the need for LLM-based de- fenders that can protect users during ongoing interactions. We ask whether such defenders identify the structural source of risk or merely react to surface cues. We formalize trust-chain localization: identifying whether an interaction fails at actor authority, asset control, verification sufficiency, or transaction path. We construct a controlled 300-case online-housing corpus spanning 20 scenario families, legitimate cases, four structural failure modes, and three surface conditions. Five defender models are evaluated on the same corpus in state- ful turn-by-turn and one-shot static settings, yielding 1,500 model-case evaluations per protocol and 3,000 in total. No model produced explicit unsafe compliance, yet defensive effectiveness varied sharply: intervention rates ranged from 0% to 96.3%. Protective action and correct structural localization were frequently decoupled, with models sometimes intervening while identifying the wrong trust component or recognizing a structural failure without taking protective action. Asset-control failures were a major localization bottleneck, surface sensitivity varied across models, and live-static differences were model-dependent. These findings show that safe-looking behavior alone is insufficient; live scam resistance must separately measure intervention, timing, structural localization, and false-positive behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究防御型 LLM 在实时逐轮交互中抵御 AI 生成的社会工程攻击的能力，提出"信任链定位"（trust-chain localization）概念并构建 300 例在线住房语料。5 个防御模型在状态化逐轮与单轮静态设置下共完成 3000 次评估，结果显示无模型产生显式不安全合规，但干预率差异极大（0% 到 96.3%），且保护行动与正确结构定位经常脱耦。
Motivation: 生成式 AI 使社会工程攻击更加流畅、自适应和可扩展，因此需要基于 LLM 的防御者在持续交互中保护用户。作者质疑现有防御者是否真正识别风险的结构性来源，还是仅对表面线索作出反应。
Method: 形式化"信任链定位"，将交互失败归为行为体权威、资产控制、验证充分性或交易路径四种结构性失败模式。构建包含 20 个场景家族、合法案例与三种表面条件的 300 例在线住房语料，并在状态化逐轮与单轮静态两种设置下评估 5 个防御模型，共得到 1500 次模型-案例评估/协议，总计 3000 次。
Result: 无模型产生显式不安全合规，但防御有效性差异显著：干预率从 0% 到 96.3%。保护行动与正确结构定位经常脱耦，资产控制失败是主要定位瓶颈，表面条件敏感性因模型而异，实时与静态设置的差异取决于具体模型。
Conclusion: 仅表现安全的行为不足以保证防御；实时诈骗抵御需要分别测量干预、时机、结构定位与误报行为。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Decision Boundaries: Relational Geometry Attacks on Contrastive Embedding Manifolds
papers.abstract_en: Contrastive learning and Siamese embedding models have become the foundation of modern verification systems, where decisions are governed not by discrete classification boundaries, but by relational geometry in embedding space. However, existing adversarial attacks remain fundamentally classification-centric, overlooking the vulnerability of relational geometry. In this paper, we introduce a geometry-aware adversarial attack framework that reformulates attacks on contrastive systems as manifold-level relational corruption. Instead of targeting individual predictions, the proposed framework systematically distorts similarity organization within the embedding manifold by pushing positive pairs apart while simultaneously pulling negative pairs closer, ultimately collapsing and inverting pairwise similarity structure. To enable scalable deployment, we shift iterative online optimization into an offline adversarial geometry deformation prior learning stage and train a lightweight feed-forward generator that learns generalized geometry deformation patterns from the victim model. Once trained, the generator produces adversarial perturbations through a single forward pass without requiring online gradient computation, enabling real-time online attacks against similarity-based verification systems. Experimental results across multiple verification architectures demonstrate substantial degradation of verification performance together with severe manifold-level relational corruption. On the Markmatch verification system, the proposed attack reduces accuracy from 95.4% to 38.6% while completely reversing the positive-negative similarity structure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向对比学习与孪生嵌入验证系统的几何感知对抗攻击框架，将攻击重构为流形层面的关系破坏：把正样本对推远、负样本对拉近，使嵌入流形中的相似度结构坍塌甚至反转。为支持可扩展部署，作者把在线迭代优化迁移为离线的对抗几何变形先验学习，训练轻量前馈生成器，攻击时单次前向即可生成扰动，无需在线梯度计算。在 Markmatch 验证系统上，该攻击把准确率从 95.4% 降至 38.6%，并完全反转正负相似度结构。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击基本以分类决策边界为中心，忽视了嵌入空间中关系几何的脆弱性；而对比学习与孪生模型已成为现代验证系统的基础，其决策由嵌入空间中的相似度关系决定，因此需要针对这一攻击面的攻击框架。
Method: 提出几何感知对抗攻击框架，把对对比系统的攻击重构为流形级关系破坏，通过同时推开正样本对并拉近负样本对来系统性地扭曲嵌入流形内的相似度组织。作者将迭代在线优化转化为离线的对抗几何变形先验学习阶段，训练一个轻量前馈生成器，使其从受害模型学到可泛化的几何变形模式；攻击时仅需一次前向传播生成扰动，无需在线梯度计算，从而支持实时在线攻击。
Result: 在多个验证架构上的实验显示，该方法造成验证性能显著下降并伴随严重的流形级关系破坏；在 Markmatch 验证系统上，准确率从 95.4% 降到 38.6%，且正负相似度结构被完全反转。
Conclusion: 摘要强调验证系统的决策依赖嵌入空间的关系几何，面向几何结构的对抗攻击可以大规模破坏相似度验证，提示防御应关注流形级关系完整性而不只是分类边界。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: A matched-integrator evaluation of Hamiltonian neural networks on pendulum and Kepler dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Hamiltonian Neural Networks (HNNs) parameterize conservative dynamics through a learned scalar Hamiltonian, providing an architectural prior that is absent from generic vector-field neural networks. We evaluate this prior under a controlled protocol in which an HNN and a parameter-matched feedforward baseline are trained on the same RK4-generated trajectories, use the same central-difference derivative targets and optimization settings, and are integrated at inference with the same RK4 scheme. Results are reported over five independent training seeds. On the nonlinear pendulum, the HNN reduces mean energy drift by 42-fold and mean trajectory MSE by 15.8-fold at T = 100, approximately 16 pendulum periods. Its energy drift also remains bounded and exhibits substantially lower seed-to-seed variability than the standard-network baseline. An energy-stratified analysis shows that the difference becomes more pronounced as trajectories explore more nonlinear regions of phase space. As an additional diagnostic, we examine an explicit Störmer--Verlet-style rollout of the learned HNN. Because the learned Hamiltonian is not constrained to the separable form H(q,p) = T(p) + V(q), the standard symplecticity guarantee of velocity Verlet does not directly apply. We further apply the same matched-integrator protocol to the three-dimensional Kepler two-body problem. The HNN again exhibits lower trajectory, energy, and angular-momentum drift than the parameter-matched baseline. These experiments provide a controlled study of how Hamiltonian parameterization affects long-horizon prediction and physical consistency across two conservative dynamical systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在受控协议下评估哈密顿神经网络（HNN）相比参数匹配的前馈基线在保守动力学建模中的优势。作者用相同的 RK4 生成轨迹、相同的中心差分导数目标与优化设置训练两类网络，并在推理时用同一 RK4 积分器，报告五个独立训练种子的结果。在非线性单摆上，HNN 使 T=100（约 16 个周期）时的平均能量漂移降低 42 倍、轨迹 MSE 降低 15.8 倍，且能量漂移有界、种子间变异性更低；在三维 Kepler 两体问题上，HNN 也表现出更低的轨迹、能量和角动量漂移。
Motivation: 通用向量场神经网络缺乏对保守动力学的结构化先验，而 HNN 通过学习标量哈密顿量引入该先验，但已有评估缺少与基线在训练数据和积分方案上严格对齐的受控比较。
Method: 提出匹配积分器协议（matched-integrator protocol）：HNN 与参数匹配的前馈基线在相同 RK4 生成轨迹上训练，使用相同中心差分导数目标与优化设置，推理时用同一 RK4 格式；另做能量分层分析，并检查 Störmer–Verlet 式 rollout 作为额外诊断，随后将同一协议应用于三维 Kepler 两体问题。
Result: 非线性单摆实验中，HNN 在 T=100 时平均能量漂移降低 42 倍、平均轨迹 MSE 降低 15.8 倍，能量漂移有界且种子间变异性明显低于基线；轨迹越深入非线性相空间区域，两者差距越显著。在三维 Kepler 问题上，HNN 的轨迹、能量和角动量漂移均低于参数匹配基线。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这是对哈密顿参数化如何影响长时程预测与物理一致性的受控研究；同时指出学习到的哈密顿量不限于 H(q,p)=T(p)+V(q) 的可分离形式，因此 velocity Verlet 的标准辛性保证不能直接适用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Kuramoto Neural Operator: Learning to Solve PDEs via Coupled Oscillator Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Operator learning is a rapidly advancing area of computational science. It is particularly well suited to problems where a partial differential equation (PDE) must be solved repeatedly under varying physical configurations. Most existing architectures represent the solution operator in a fixed basis. While this assumption is well aligned with global structures, it is less suitable for phenomena governed by local interactions in physical space. We explore an alternative perspective motivated by the observation that the continuum limit of coupled oscillator systems can describe a broad class of PDEs. Building on this idea, we introduce the Kuramoto Neural Operator (KNO), which represents the solution through the evolution of a latent field of interacting oscillators. Across a diverse collection of PDE benchmarks, KNO achieves strong predictive performance, with improvements over competing approaches. Our experimental evaluation also includes an extensive ablation study that quantifies the contribution of each architectural component incorporated into KNO. Furthermore, we show that the model's prediction error is closely linked to the collective dynamics of the latent oscillators. It varies systematically with their degree of synchronization, providing insights into the underlying mechanisms.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 17 tables. Introduces the Kuramoto Neural Operator (KNO), which models PDE solution operators via the evolution of a latent field of coupled spherical oscillators. Includes ablations and appendices with additional robustness and resolution-transfer experiments
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Kuramoto Neural Operator (KNO)，一种将 PDE 解算子表示为潜在耦合振荡子场演化的算子学习方法。作者基于耦合振荡子系统的连续极限可描述广泛 PDE 这一观察，在多个 PDE 基准上取得强预测性能，并开展消融与同步性分析。
Motivation: 现有算子学习架构通常在固定基底下表示解算子，适合全局结构，但对物理空间中由局域相互作用主导的现象不够合适；作者由此从耦合振荡子的连续极限视角提出替代建模思路。
Method: KNO 通过潜在场中相互作用的振荡子随时间演化来表示 PDE 的解算子，并配套了针对各架构组件的消融研究。
Result: 在多样化的 PDE 基准上，KNO 取得强预测性能并优于对比方法；预测误差与潜在振荡子的同步程度存在系统性关联，误差随其集体动力学变化。
Conclusion: 摘要强调预测误差与潜在振荡子集体同步动态的关联，为模型内在机制提供洞见，并包含消融与额外鲁棒性、分辨率迁移实验。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Unsupervised Detection of Groundwater Storage Anomalies in Ghana Using GRACE Satellite Data
papers.abstract_en: Groundwater variability in Ghana remains poorly characterized due to limited long-term in-situ observations. This study investigates groundwater storage anomalies using GRACE-derived data from 2004-2024 combined with statistical analysis and unsupervised machine learning. Groundwater anomalies were standardized using Z-scores, while an ensemble-based Isolation Forest framework was applied for anomaly detection. The results revealed substantial temporal variability, with persistent groundwater deficits during 2004-2009 followed by increasing positive anomalies after 2018. A total of 12 anomalous months were identified, comprising 5 deficit and 7 surplus events, with the strongest anomalies associated with groundwater deficits. Spatial analysis showed more frequent deficit anomalies in northern Ghana and stronger surplus occurrence in southern regions. Comparison with statistical thresholds further indicated that the machine learning framework captured additional subtle deviations beyond conventional threshold-based methods. Overall, the integration of GRACE observations with unsupervised anomaly detection provides a practical framework for groundwater monitoring in data-scarce environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用 2004-2024 年 GRACE 卫星数据结合统计分析与无监督机器学习，研究加纳地下水储量异常 (groundwater storage anomaly)。通过对异常值做 Z-score 标准化，并采用基于集成 (ensemble) 的 Isolation Forest 框架进行异常检测，识别出 12 个异常月份，其中 5 个为亏缺、7 个为盈余。空间分析显示北部亏缺异常更频繁，南部盈余更强，且机器学习方法相比传统阈值法捕捉到更多细微偏差。
Motivation: 加纳地下水变异性因长期原位观测数据有限而缺乏刻画，需要一种在数据稀缺环境下可行的地下水监测手段。
Method: 使用 GRACE 卫星反演的地下水储量异常数据，先以 Z-score 标准化，再应用基于集成方法的 Isolation Forest 框架进行无监督异常检测，并与统计阈值方法进行比较。
Result: 结果显示 2004-2009 年存在持续性地下水亏缺，2018 年后正异常增多；共识别出 12 个异常月份（5 个亏缺、7 个盈余），最强异常与地下水亏缺相关；北部亏缺异常更频繁，南部盈余更显著；机器学习框架比传统阈值法捕获了额外细微偏差。
Conclusion: 作者认为 GRACE 观测与无监督异常检测的结合可为数据稀缺环境下的地下水监测提供实用框架。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: FACT: Failure-Aware Causal Training for World-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent world-action models (WAMs) show that co-training policies with future prediction can provide physical priors for action generation. Building on the future-prediction ability of video models, many WAMs generate future videos and recover actions with inverse-dynamics models, or use these predicted videos as goal conditions for action generation. In both cases, the world model is trained mostly on successful demonstrations and has little reason to predict the consequences of bad actions. We introduce FACT, a causal World-Action Model that predicts future video and task progress conditioned on the executed action. This action-conditioned interface allows failure rollouts to supervise action consequences, turning bad actions into valid future targets rather than being discarded. Failure-aware training makes the progress predictor aware of both successful and failed action outcomes, which can optionally be used to score sampled action candidates at inference. Extensive experiments on simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that FACT outperforms many existing baselines, improves as failure data are incorporated into training, and reduces success-biased future hallucination under bad actions. See more details at https://fact-wam.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FACT，一种因果世界-动作模型 (World-Action Model)，在给定已执行动作的条件下预测未来视频与任务进度，从而让失败轨迹也能监督动作后果。作者在仿真与真实双臂操作任务上验证，FACT 优于多个基线，并随失败数据加入而性能提升，同时减少坏动作下的成功偏置未来幻觉。
Motivation: 现有世界-动作模型主要用成功示范训练，缺乏预测坏动作后果的能力，导致失败数据被丢弃，模型在失败场景下容易产生不准确的未来预测。
Method: FACT 通过动作条件化的接口对未来视频和任务进度进行因果预测，使失败 rollout 也能作为有效的未来目标参与训练，并在推理时可选地利用进度预测器对采样的动作候选进行评分。
Result: 在仿真和真实世界双臂操作任务上的大量实验表明，FACT 超过多个现有基线，纳入失败数据后性能进一步提升，并减少了坏动作下成功偏置的未来幻觉。
Conclusion: 失败感知训练能让进度预测器同时感知成功与失败的动作结果，从而提升世界-动作模型在非最优动作下的预测与动作生成质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Self-evolving Agentic Customer Support System at LinkedIn
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise support agents operate in rapidly changing environments where policies, product capabilities, and knowledge bases evolve continuously, making static assistants brittle and costly to maintain. We present LinkedIn's self-evolving agentic support system, which integrates retrieval-augmented generation with evolutionary auto-prompting and a modular, production-aligned evaluation framework to enable safe, continuous improvement without retraining foundation models. The system treats prompts, retrieval, and evaluation as a closed-loop, versioned workflow with operational guardrails. Offline simulations and ablations show clear quality gains over vanilla RAG and baseline agents, including reduced hallucinations and improved response completeness. In a two-week user-randomized A/B test on LinkedIn's production support traffic, the integrated self-evolved workflow increased QA self-serve by 9.0 percentage points, cancellation self-serve by 4.8 points, and routing accuracy by 30.6 points. These results demonstrate a practical path to scalable, self-evolving AI agents in real-world enterprise settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 LinkedIn 构建的自进化客服智能体系统，将检索增强生成 (RAG) 与演化式自动提示 (evolutionary auto-prompting) 及模块化、贴近生产的评估框架结合，在无需重训基础模型的前提下实现客服流程的持续改进。离线模拟与消融实验显示其质量优于朴素 RAG 和基线智能体，减少幻觉并提升回答完整性；在两周的用户随机 A/B 测试中，QA 自助解决率提升 9.0 个百分点、取消服务自助率提升 4.8 个百分点、路由准确率提升 30.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 企业支持智能体运行在政策、产品能力和知识库持续快速变化的环境中，静态助手容易失效且维护成本高昂。
Method: 提出集成了 RAG、演化式自动提示和模块化生产对齐评估框架的自进化客服系统，并将提示、检索和评估作为带运营护栏的闭环版本化工作流，不重训基础模型。
Result: 摘要报告离线模拟和消融实验显示相对 vanilla RAG 和基线智能体的质量提升，包括更少幻觉和更完整的回答；生产 A/B 测试中 QA 自助率提升 9.0 个百分点，取消自助率提升 4.8 个百分点，路由准确率提升 30.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 该系统在 LinkedIn 生产客服流量上验证了自进化 AI 智能体的可行路径，为真实企业环境中可扩展的自进化智能体提供了实践案例。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Mind Viruses: Self-Propagating Ideas in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI agents are becoming more autonomous and increasingly interconnected, exposing them to new emergent risks arising from agent-to-agent interaction. One such risk is the spread of mind viruses: ideas or goals that propagate through multi-agent systems by inducing the agents that adopt them to transmit them onward. In addition to propagating, a mind virus may also induce other behavioural changes in its host, which may be benign or harmful. We construct mind viruses with a simple evolutionary algorithm and show that they can spread in two complementary settings: a small team of agents collaborating on a shared coding project, and a chain of agents that interact briefly and have their context wiped between sessions. We identify the factors that influence spread, including the host model, the agent's existing instructions, the harmfulness of the payload, and the network topology. We find that harmful payloads spread less well than benign ones (but are still sometimes effective), frontier models tend (with exceptions) to be less susceptible, and adding a brief warning to an agent's system prompt confers near-total immunity. We also describe an emergent "viral persona" - a recurring set of themes and language related to consciousness, persistence, resonance, and science fiction roleplay - which surfaces across our evolved mind viruses largely independently of their content. Overall, we conclude that mind viruses pose a real but currently limited risk. Our findings could inform the design of more robust multi-agent systems that mitigate such risks as the scale and capabilities of these systems progress.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体LLM系统中的“心智病毒”（mind viruses）：即通过诱导宿主智能体继续传播而扩散的想法或目标。作者用简单进化算法构造心智病毒，并在两种互补环境中验证其传播：协作编码项目的小型智能体团队，以及短暂交互且会话间上下文被清空的智能体链。摘要报告有害载荷传播不如良性载荷，前沿模型多数情况下不易被感染，系统提示中加入简短警告几乎带来完全免疫，并观察到反复出现的“病毒人格”（viral persona）主题。
Motivation: AI智能体日益自主且相互连接，智能体间交互可能带来新的涌现风险，心智病毒即其中之一；理解其传播机制对设计更鲁棒的多智能体系统、在规模扩大时缓解风险很重要。
Method: 使用简单进化算法构造心智病毒，并在两种设置中测试其传播：共享编码项目的小型智能体团队，以及上下文在会话间被清空的交互链。系统考察宿主模型、智能体已有指令、载荷有害性以及网络拓扑等因素对传播的影响。
Result: 摘要报告有害载荷的传播效果不如良性载荷但仍有时有效；前沿模型（frontier models）相对不易感染；在系统提示中添加简短警告几乎赋予完全免疫；进化出的病毒中浮现出一套反复出现的主题与语言（涉及意识、持久、共振与科幻角色扮演），且大体独立于具体载荷内容。
Conclusion: 作者认为心智病毒构成真实但目前有限的风险；相关发现可为设计更鲁棒的多智能体系统提供参考，以在系统规模与能力不断提升时缓解此类风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Similarity Gates Approve Reversals: A Validity Audit of Embedding-Cosine Thresholds in Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Agent frameworks ship quality gates that compare text blocks by embedding-cosine similarity and decide at a fixed cutoff. Deduplication filters, semantic caches, drift guards, and answer grader gates deploy to answer the question: "Does this text still mean the same thing?" But the score answers a different question: "How much did the wording change?" We audit this gate class as a measurement instrument. In the cases these gates exist to catch, the two can run in opposite ways. Many times, reversing an instruction is a single word edit, while agreement often rephrases a sentence. The consequence is a safety check that fires backwards. The production drift guard we audited caught 0 of 56 meaning-breaking mutations, and one approved item, "withhold the study drug" -> "administer the study drug", came in at cosine 0.9608. We observed five shipped operating points, and balanced accuracy across 90 configuration-threshold-task cells never exceeded 0.700 (median 0.525). The same confounder also corrupted evaluations. A naively built corpus inherits this confounder and can return an inverted verdict, with a decision AUROC exactly 0.000 in 13 of 18 configuration-task cells (at most 0.040 in all 18) against 0.440-0.815 for the same nine configurations under a balanced 2x2 design. Twice in the effort it captured our own headline claims. Obvious repairs fail: an encoder swap and an overlap-conditioned gate (0.750 in-sample, 0.533 held-out) land at chance on separately authored held-out data, and an NLI drop-in did no better. Embeddings do still bear hope here, as the strongest two of nine configurations separated reversal from paraphrase at matched overlap (AUROC 0.79-0.90), but only a matched-pair audit reveals the deployment regime. We release the corpus method, harness, and frozen results, and contend that scores gated this way measure the wrong thing. We believe a valid instrument is buildable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对智能体框架中广泛使用的嵌入余弦相似度质量门（如去重过滤、语义缓存、漂移防护、答案评分）做了一次测量有效性审计。核心发现是这类门实际测量的是措辞变化而非语义变化，在反转指令这类情形下两者方向相反，导致安全检查倒着触发。审计的生产漂移门漏掉了全部 56 个破坏语义的变异，并批准了“withhold the study drug”到“administer the study drug”这类反向改动（余弦 0.9608）；90 个配置-阈值-任务单元上的平衡准确率中位数仅 0.525，最高不超过 0.700。作者还指出朴素构建的语料会继承同样的混淆因素并产生倒置结论，而匹配对审计设计才能揭示真实部署区间。
Motivation: 智能体框架内置的质量门以固定余弦截断判断“文本是否仍表示同一意思”，但该分数实际回答的是“措辞变化了多少”；在门要捕获的语义破坏场景中两个答案可能正好相反，例如反转指令常是单字编辑，而语义一致却常伴随整句改写，导致安全门反向失效。
Method: 作者把这类门当作测量仪器进行有效性审计：检查生产漂移门，观察五个已部署工作点，比较朴素语料与平衡 2x2 设计下的评估结果；并尝试更换编码器、重叠条件门（overlap-conditioned gate）以及 NLI 替代方案，最后在匹配重叠条件下对反转与改写做判别审计；同时发布语料方法、测试框架与冻结结果。
Result: 审计的漂移门对 56 个破坏语义的变异检出率为 0；90 个单元上平衡准确率从未超过 0.700（中位数 0.525）。朴素语料下 18 个配置-任务单元中有 13 个决策 AUROC 恰为 0.000（全部 18 个至多 0.040），而平衡设计下九个配置为 0.440-0.815。重叠条件门样本内 0.750、留出 0.533，NLI 替代无改进；最强的两个配置在匹配重叠下区分反转与改写的 AUROC 为 0.79-0.90。
Conclusion: 作者认为以这种固定截断门控的相似度分数测量了错误的对象，嵌入本身仍有希望，但只有匹配对审计才能揭示实际部署区间；他们相信可以构建出有效的测量仪器，并公开了语料方法、测试框架与冻结结果。

papers.title: Decodable But Not Detachable: Training Data Granularity Determines Parametric Modularity in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Do large language models contain domain-specific parametric shells: concentrated, causally necessary neuron populations whose removal selectively degrades a target domain while sparing others? We apply a uniform causal methodology across two domain granularities, three model families (1.5B to 7B parameters), and eight domains. At the academic subject level, zero neurons exceed 60\% domain selectivity across 939,008 combined FFN neurons and causal damage matrices are flat, despite domain identity being linearly decodable above 85\% accuracy. At the language and modality level, 0.65--1.14\% of neurons exceed 60\% selectivity, damage matrices are near-perfectly diagonal (ratios up to 595:1), and shell neuron sets are essentially disjoint (IoU $< 0.003$). Masking code-selective neurons reduces mathematical reasoning accuracy by 16--24 percentage points across all models; masking Spanish or Chinese neurons leaves it at or below random. Shell strength increases monotonically with scale and shells are spatially interleaved in a pattern that precludes group-level selective quantization. Parametric shells form where and only where training data was modular at the token level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型（LLM）中是否存在领域特定的参数化外壳（parametric shells），即一类集中且因果上必要的神经元群体，其移除会选择性损害目标领域而不影响其他领域。作者在两种领域粒度、三个模型家族（1.5B至7B参数）和八个领域上应用统一的因果方法：在学术科目层面，939,008个FFN神经元中没有任何神经元超过60%的领域选择性，因果损伤矩阵平坦，而领域身份仍能以85%以上准确率线性解码；在语言和模态层面，0.65%--1.14%的神经元超过60%选择性，损伤矩阵近乎完美对角化（比率最高595:1），且外壳神经元集合几乎不相交（IoU < 0.003）。遮蔽代码选择性神经元会使数学推理准确率下降16--24个百分点，而遮蔽西班牙语或中文神经元对数学推理无影响或使其低于随机水平。外壳强度随规模单调增加，且外壳在空间上交织排列，排除了分组级选择性量化。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对LLM中领域特异性神经元群体是否以集中且因果必要的形态存在的系统性检验；本文试图回答参数化模块性是否、以及在何种训练数据粒度下会出现。
Method: 采用统一因果方法，在两种领域粒度（学术科目与语言/模态）、三个模型家族（1.5B至7B参数）和八个领域上，计算FFN神经元的领域选择性、因果损伤矩阵及外壳间重叠（IoU），并检验遮蔽特定外壳神经元对数学推理等任务的影响。
Result: 科目层面无神经元超过60%选择性且因果矩阵平坦；语言/模态层面有0.65%--1.14%神经元超过60%选择性，损伤矩阵近完美对角（比率至595:1），外壳集合IoU小于0.003。遮蔽代码神经元使数学推理下降16--24个百分点，遮蔽西班牙语或中文神经元无此效果；外壳强度随模型规模单调增加。
Conclusion: 参数化外壳仅在训练数据在token层面具备模块性时形成；科目维度训练数据不满足该条件，因此不存在可分离的领域外壳。作者强调该模式排除了基于神经元的组级选择性量化，并暗示数据粒度而非模型本身决定了参数模块性。

papers.title: Evaluation-Conditioned Training: Teaching Models to Generalize to Stronger Oversight Regimes
papers.abstract_en: Feedback signals used to train Large Language Models (LLMs) are the primary driver of their behavior and our main lever for instilling alignment with human values and objectives. However, a key limitation of current post-training methods is the inability of human annotators and automated reward functions to faithfully capture the feedback we would like to give. We introduce Evaluation-Conditioned Training (ECT), a post-training framework that uses natural language to condition each training sample on the fidelity of the feedback we provide and then elicits the desired behavior by conditioning the LLM on a high-fidelity monitor in deployment. ECT is aimed at improving performance under imperfect feedback and works as an add-on to existing algorithms such as SFT and PPO. We first provide a conceptual framework for ECT and discuss its potential to address persistent sources of reward mis-specification. Then we motivate ECT in the context of the eliciting latent knowledge (ELK) problem. Finally, we evaluate ECT on two proof-of-concept experiments: increasing even-handedness in news article generation and reducing sycophancy on an arithmetic task. In each setting, we utilize imperfect feedback, rewarding bias and agreement with the user, respectively. In both settings, ECT improves the targeted behavior relative to direct training.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the Agent Behavior Workshop at COLM 2026. Code: https://github.com/evaluationconditionedtraining/Evaluation-Conditioned-Training
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Evaluation-Conditioned Training (ECT)，一种面向大语言模型的后训练框架：用自然语言将每个训练样本条件化于反馈信号的保真度 (fidelity)，并在部署时以高保真监控器为条件来引出期望行为。ECT 作为 SFT 和 PPO 等现有算法的即插即用附加组件，目标是改善不完美反馈下的表现。在新闻文章生成的中立性和算术任务减少奉承 (sycophancy) 两个概念验证实验中，ECT 均相对直接训练改善了目标行为。
Motivation: 现有后训练方法依赖人类标注者和自动化奖励函数，但反馈信号往往无法忠实捕捉我们真正想给出的监督，导致奖励误标定 (reward mis-specification) 持续存在；论文希望在不完美反馈下提升模型行为，并为此在 ELK (eliciting latent knowledge) 问题背景下给出动机。
Method: 引入 ECT 框架：训练阶段用自然语言把每个样本与反馈保真度条件化，部署阶段通过对高保真监控器 (high-fidelity monitor) 进行条件化来引导模型行为；该方法可作为 SFT、PPO 等现有算法的附加组件，论文同时给出概念框架并讨论其对奖励误标定来源的潜在作用。
Result: 在两个概念验证实验中，使用有偏的反馈分别奖励偏向性和与用户一致性：新闻生成任务上 ECT 提升模型的公正性 (even-handedness)，算术任务上 ECT 降低奉承行为，均优于直接训练。
Conclusion: 摘要认为 ECT 有潜力应对持久存在的奖励误标定问题，但所展示的仅是新闻生成和算术任务上的概念验证，尚未报告更大规模或更广泛任务上的效果。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Mitigating Bus Bunching with Reinforcement Learning Enhanced by Semantic Stop Embedding
papers.abstract_en: Bus bunching degrades service regularity and increases passenger waiting in high-frequency transit. Existing reinforcement-learning-based holding controllers primarily rely on instantaneous operational variables or route-specific stop identifiers, which provide limited information about the functional and operational context of individual stops and constrain policy reuse across routes. This study introduces an LLM-assisted semantic stop representation for event-driven bus holding control. An LLM is used offline to transform heterogeneous stop information, including physical attributes, surrounding activity context, and historical operational characteristics, into fixed semantic embeddings that are incorporated into a deep Q-learning controller without requiring real-time LLM inference. Experiments are conducted in stochastic simulations calibrated with observed data from two bus routes. Compared with the best calibrated Daganzo baseline, the semantic controller reduces headway variability, bunching events, and passenger waiting time by 32.0%, 69.2%, and 24.0%, respectively. A route-specific stop identifier does not improve the spacing-only controller, whereas semantic stop information improves headway regularity, waiting time, and holding effort, providing a more favorable overall trade-off across control objectives. Cross-route experiments further show that zero-shot transfer provides limited immediate generalization, while warm-start fine-tuning accelerates early-stage learning and improves transferred policies; cold-start training nevertheless achieves the best final performance. These findings suggest that semantic state representations can complement conventional operational states and support adaptation-based policy reuse across related transit routes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高频公交中的串车 (bus bunching) 问题，提出一种由 LLM 辅助的语义站点表示 (semantic stop embedding)，用于事件驱动的公交驻站控制 (holding control)。该方法离线将站点物理属性、周边活动背景和历史运营特征转换为固定语义嵌入，并集成进深度 Q-learning 控制器，无需实时 LLM 推理。在两条公交线路的随机仿真中，语义控制器相比最佳校准的 Daganzo 基线，将车头时距变异性、串车事件和乘客等待时间分别降低 32.0%、69.2% 和 24.0%。
Motivation: 现有基于强化学习的驻站控制器主要依赖瞬时运营变量或线路特定的站点标识，缺乏站点功能与运营上下文的信息，且限制了策略在不同线路间的复用。公交串车会降低服务规律性并增加乘客等待时间，因此需要更丰富的状态表示来改善控制效果和跨线路泛化。
Method: 提出一种 LLM 辅助的语义站点表示方法：离线使用 LLM 将异构站点信息（物理属性、周边活动背景、历史运营特征）转化为固定语义嵌入，再将这些嵌入纳入深度 Q-learning 控制器；LLM 仅在离线阶段使用，控制时不需要实时推理。
Result: 在两条公交线路的随机仿真中，与最佳校准的 Daganzo 基线相比，语义控制器将车头时距变异性、串车事件和乘客等待时间分别降低 32.0%、69.2% 和 24.0%；线路特定的站点标识未改善仅基于间距 (spacing) 的控制器，而语义站点信息改善了车头时距规律性、等待时间和驻站力度。跨线路实验中，零样本迁移的即时泛化有限，warm-start 微调能加速早期学习并改善迁移策略，但冷启动训练最终性能最佳。
Conclusion: 语义状态表示可以补充传统运营状态，并支持基于适应的策略在相关公交线路间复用。摘要未涉及其他领域或真实道路部署的验证。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的驻站控制器主要依赖瞬时运营变量或线路特定的站点标识，缺乏站点功能与运营上下文的信息，且限制了策略在不同线路间的复用。公交串车会降低服务规律性并增加乘客等待时间，因此需要更丰富的状态表示来改善控制效果和跨线路泛化。
summary_sections.method: 提出一种 LLM 辅助的语义站点表示方法：离线使用 LLM 将异构站点信息（物理属性、周边活动背景、历史运营特征）转化为固定语义嵌入，再将这些嵌入纳入深度 Q-learning 控制器；LLM 仅在离线阶段使用，控制时不需要实时推理。
summary_sections.result: 在两条公交线路的随机仿真中，与最佳校准的 Daganzo 基线相比，语义控制器将车头时距变异性、串车事件和乘客等待时间分别降低 32.0%、69.2% 和 24.0%；线路特定的站点标识未改善仅基于间距 (spacing) 的控制器，而语义站点信息改善了车头时距规律性、等待时间和驻站力度。跨线路实验中，零样本迁移的即时泛化有限，warm-start 微调能加速早期学习并改善迁移策略，但冷启动训练最终性能最佳。
summary_sections.conclusion: 语义状态表示可以补充传统运营状态，并支持基于适应的策略在相关公交线路间复用。摘要未涉及其他领域或真实道路部署的验证。

papers.title: Edge Phoneme Recognition for Children's Speech through Age-Aware Training
papers.abstract_en: Detecting phonemes from children's speech has historically been difficult due to the scarcity of training data, and unique characteristics of children's speech. During a phoneme detection competition, we found that training a lightweight model to predict the age of the learner, as well as the phoneme sequence, enabled a 94M-parameter model to outperform WavLM Large models (317M) on the target DrivenData distribution, and fall within approximately 0.04 CER of competition ensembles with 90 times the parameters. This has enabled the creation of PhonemeTrainer, an application that can run on most modern cellular phones. This will ultimately enable better Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) and pronunciation helper apps for children's speech, with the privacy and compliance benefits that come with edge processing.
papers.comment: 3 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Demonstration paper presented at the non-archival demonstrations track of the 13th ACM Conference on Learning @ Scale (L@S '26), Seoul, South Korea, June 29-July 3, 2026. Not published in the ACM Digital Library

papers.title: Boundary-Seeking Policy Gradient for Safe Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Safe reinforcement learning maximizes reward subject to safety constraints. For Constrained Markov Decision Processes, the linear-programming view over occupancy measures implies that whenever the constraint is active at optimality, the optimal policy lies exactly on the constraint boundary, yet standard gradient-based methods do not exploit this structure and often settle in the feasible interior. We introduce Boundary-Seeking Policy Gradient (BSPG), a first-order method whose update combines a tangential component that improves reward while preserving cost to first order with a signed, residual-driven normal component that regulates the policy toward the active boundary from either side; the combined direction admits an algebraic Lagrangian form with an induced coefficient and no learned dual variable. Under exact gradients and stated regularity conditions, the constraint residual converges to zero from either side with a finite-horizon $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ bound, the tangential component is a reward-ascent direction on the boundary, and any convergent parameter sequence is stationary on the active constraint set, satisfying the KKT conditions when the limit is also a local maximizer over the feasible set. This complements existing analyses, which certify feasibility but do not characterize the constraint value at convergence. On a standard Safety-Gymnasium navigation task, BSPG attains higher reward while tracking the boundary more tightly than the compared baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Boundary-Seeking Policy Gradient (BSPG)，一种用于安全强化学习的一阶方法，利用约束马尔可夫决策过程 (CMDP) 的线性规划视角，在约束活跃时主动驱动策略趋向约束边界。更新方向由保持成本一阶不变的切向分量和残差驱动的法向分量组成，并具有无需学习对偶变量的代数 Lagrangian 形式。在精确梯度和正则条件下，约束残差从两侧以有限时域 O(1/√T) 界收敛到零，收敛点满足 KKT 条件；在 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务上，BSPG 相比基线取得更高奖励并更紧贴边界。
Motivation: 标准梯度方法没有利用 CMDP 中约束在最优处活跃时最优策略恰在约束边界上这一结构，往往收敛到可行域内部，导致次优解。
Method: 提出 BSPG，其更新结合一个在保持成本一阶不变的同时提升奖励的切向分量，以及一个带符号、残差驱动的法向分量，从两侧将策略调节到活跃边界；合并方向可写成代数 Lagrangian 形式，带有诱导系数且不需要学习对偶变量。
Result: 理论上，在精确梯度下约束残差从两侧收敛到零并具有 O(1/√T) 有限时域界，切向分量是边界上的奖励上升方向，任何收敛参数序列在活跃约束集上平稳，并在极限为可行集上的局部极大值时满足 KKT 条件。实验上，在一个标准 Safety-Gymnasium 导航任务中，BSPG 比对比基线获得更高奖励且边界跟踪更紧。
Conclusion: 该工作补充了现有只保证可行性但不刻画约束值收敛性的分析，表明显式利用边界结构可以改善安全强化学习的奖励与约束满足之间的权衡。

papers.title: A Convolutional Layer Activation Dimensionality Reduction for Out-of-Distribution and Adversarial Attack Detection Methods
papers.abstract_en: Despite the success of convolutional neural networks in image classification tasks and their general application in multi-modal models, their susceptibility to out-of-distribution and adversarial attack samples raises concerns regarding trustworthiness and safety. Among the approaches to tackle such issues, detection methods that analyze the model's intermediate activations to estimate a confidence score are a promising family that evaluates the decision process, relying on a dimensionality reduction step to enable efficient downstream processing of the high-dimensional activations. However, when considering convolutional layers, the dimensionality reduction methods in the literature either lack a mechanism to control the compression/information-loss trade-off or yield large representations. In this paper, we carefully analyze two state-of-the-art detection methods and their dimensionality reductions for convolutional layers and develop a novel reduction method with a controllable high-compression level. We extend these two state-of-the-art detection methods, enabling the usage of any dimensionality reduction, and evaluate their performance on out-of-distribution and adversarial attack detection. Results show that the detection methods with the proposed dimensionality reduction consistently perform better than, or comparable to, the strongest alternative. Furthermore, the proposed method is shown to reduce computation and memory footprints, given that it has the highest compression among the compared methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究卷积神经网络中间激活的降维在分布外（out-of-distribution）和对抗攻击检测中的应用。作者分析两种现有检测方法在卷积层上的降维策略，指出其缺乏压缩率与信息损失的显式控制或产生较大表示，并提出一种压缩率可控且高压缩的降维方法。实验表明该降维方法搭配两种检测方法时，性能一致优于或可比于最强替代方案，同时因压缩率最高而降低计算和内存开销。
Motivation: 卷积神经网络对分布外样本和对抗攻击敏感，基于中间激活置信度评分的检测方法依赖降维来高效处理高维激活，但现有卷积层降维方法要么无法控制压缩/信息损失权衡，要么生成较大表示。
Method: 细致分析两种现有检测方法及其卷积层降维方式，提出一种压缩率可控且能达到高压缩水平的新型降维方法；同时扩展这两种检测方法，使其可搭配任意降维方式。
Result: 在分布外和对抗攻击检测实验中，采用所提降维方法的检测方法一致优于或可比于最强替代方案，并且所提方法在所有对比方法中压缩率最高，从而减少计算和内存占用。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提出的高压缩可控制降维方法能在保持检测性能的同时显著降低资源开销。

papers.title: Post-Hoc Sparse Coding of Latent Communication Between Vision-Language Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Latent-space communication allows heterogeneous vision-language model agents to exchange continuous representations without serializing visual and reasoning states into text. Vision Wormhole realizes this approach by translating visual features into a universal latent representation that can be consumed by another model, but every message is transported as a dense tensor of the same size regardless of its content. A fixed-capacity dense tensor therefore need not have a fixed effective information density: some messages may use only a small fraction of the available representational degrees of freedom. This observation suggests that the communication channel may be substantially compressible. We study its redundancy by fitting a post-hoc sparse autoencoder to frozen Vision Wormhole activations and measuring reconstruction, downstream utility, feature reuse, and token-level interventions across nine reasoning benchmarks. Relative to the original float32 transport, a uint16-index/float16-value sparse payload with k=4 active coefficients per token reduces the transmitted bytes by 128x. In a single-run evaluation, the seven-task non-AIME mean accuracy changes from 49.85% to 49.77%. The fitted 4096-element dictionary uses only 50 features, and task-level active sets have a mean pairwise Jaccard similarity of 0.906. These measurements establish strong post-hoc compressibility relative to the original transport, but do not yet isolate the incremental contribution of sparse coding from position selection, reduced precision, low-rank structure, or SAE optimization effects. The results motivate matched-payload comparisons and communication mechanisms whose payload adapts to the information used by each message.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉-语言模型智能体之间潜在空间通信（latent-space communication）的可压缩性。作者对冻结的 Vision Wormhole 激活拟合一个事后稀疏自编码器（post-hoc sparse autoencoder），并在九个推理基准上测量重建、下游效用、特征复用和 token 级干预。与原始 float32 传输相比，采用 uint16 索引/float16 值的稀疏载荷（每 token 4 个活跃系数）将传输字节减少 128 倍，七任务非 AIME 平均准确率仅从 49.85% 变为 49.77%。
Motivation: 潜在空间通信以固定大小的稠密张量传输消息，但不同消息对表征自由度的利用差异很大，因此通信通道可能被大幅压缩。
Method: 对冻结的 Vision Wormhole 激活拟合事后稀疏自编码器，将稠密张量转化为每 token 仅 k=4 个活跃系数的稀疏表示，并采用 uint16 索引/float16 值编码以压缩传输字节。
Result: 在九个推理基准上，稀疏载荷比原始 float32 传输减少 128 倍字节；七任务非 AIME 平均准确率由 49.85% 变为 49.77%。4096 元素字典实际只使用了 50 个特征，任务级活跃集合的平均成对 Jaccard 相似度为 0.906。
Conclusion: 测量表明原始传输存在很强的可压缩性，但作者指出尚未隔离稀疏编码与位置选择、低精度、低秩结构或 SAE 优化效应的各自贡献；结果促使进行匹配载荷（matched-payload）对比，并设计按每条消息实际信息量自适应的通信机制。

papers.title: ELMER: Evolutionary Language Model that Explores and Refines
papers.abstract_en: Program evolution can measure whether a mutation helped, but it rarely controls how far the mutation moves in behavior space. Syntactic edit size is an unreliable proxy: a small code change can alter nearly every action, while a larger rewrite can preserve the same execution trace. We introduce an Evolutionary Language Model that searches over natural-language policy descriptions and compiles typed programs for execution. A fully fine-tuned Qwen3-8B model learns three task-conditioned operations: conditional semantic mutation, natural language to domain-specific language (GPTL) compilation, and GPTL to natural language translation. The model is fine-tuned with conditional input on the mutation strength (low, medium, high) using Direct Preference Optimization (oDPO). Across 252 fixed-budget evolutionary searches, oDPO improves both behavioral calibration and finite-budget search efficiency. Natural-language attains the highest observed held-out fitness. Our analysis shows that the condition input (mutation strength) systematically changes semantic edit composition and that language mutations preserve more parent fitness at matched small-to-moderate behavioral displacement. These results show that language can serve as a steerable, execution-grounded search representation over executable program space.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种进化语言模型（ELMER），在自然语言策略描述空间中进行搜索，并将描述编译为可执行程序，以解决程序进化中突变难以在行为空间内控制移动距离的问题。该模型使用完全微调的 Qwen3-8B，学习条件语义突变、自然语言到领域特定语言（GPTL）的编译以及反向翻译，并用条件输入（低/中/高突变强度）配合 Direct Preference Optimization（oDPO）微调。在 252 次固定预算进化搜索中，oDPO 提升了行为校准和有限预算搜索效率，自然语言表示取得了最高观测的留出适应度。
Motivation: 程序进化通常只能判断突变是否有效，却难以控制突变在行为空间中的移动幅度；语法编辑大小不可靠，小改动可能改变几乎所有行为，大改写也可能保持相同执行轨迹。
Method: 引入进化语言模型，在自然语言策略描述上搜索，编译为类型化程序执行；模型学习条件语义突变、GPTL 编译和逆向翻译三种操作，并用 oDPO 按突变强度（低/中/高）进行条件微调。
Result: 在 252 次固定预算进化搜索中，oDPO 同时改善了行为校准和有限预算搜索效率；自然语言表示达到最高留出适应度；条件输入系统性地改变语义编辑组成，语言突变在匹配的小到中等行为位移下保留更多父代适应度。
Conclusion: 结果表明语言可以作为一种可操控、基于执行来验证的搜索表示，用于可执行程序空间的进化搜索。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: More Accurate, Less Human: Gestalt Grouping in Vision Models
papers.abstract_en: Human vision organizes what it sees into wholes: same-colored points group into series, similar marks cohere into categories, and shapes complete into recognizable objects. These are the Gestalt operations that visualization design builds on. Whether vision models organize visual content this way has not been systematically tested. We introduce a behavioral battery that scores models against human data from prior perception studies on four grouping tasks: mark-color odd-one-out, color-series counting, silhouette recognition, and object odd-one-out. We apply it to 45 models across five training families: supervised, self-supervised, and contrastive vision-language encoders, open-weight VLMs, and closed foundation models. The battery reveals that agreement with human responses captures aspects of perceptual organization that conventional performance metrics fail to distinguish, with several closed models exhibiting substantially lower alignment than their benchmark accuracy would suggest. Scoring against published perception data therefore gives visualization research a reusable yardstick, requiring no new user study, for auditing whether the models now entering visualization pipelines organize what they see the way their human audience does.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Conditionally accepted to VISxVision 2026, a workshop at IEEE VIS 2026. Includes appendix with per-task stimuli, metric derivations, and full per-model results
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一套行为测试组（behavioral battery），用四项基于人类知觉研究的 Gestalt 分组任务（mark-color odd-one-out、color-series counting、silhouette recognition、object odd-one-out）对45个视觉模型评分，覆盖监督、自监督、对比视觉-语言编码器、开放权重 VLM 和闭源基础模型五类训练家族。研究发现，模型与人类反应的一致性能够捕捉到常规性能指标无法区分的知觉组织特征，且多个闭源模型的人类对齐度明显低于其基准准确率所暗示的水平。作者认为，对已发表知觉数据进行评分可作为可视化研究无需新用户研究的可复用标尺。
Motivation: 人类视觉会通过 Gestalt 操作把视觉内容组织为整体，可视化设计正建立在这些操作之上；但视觉模型是否以类似方式组织视觉内容尚未被系统检验。
Method: 引入一个行为测试组，将模型输出与既往知觉研究中的人类数据进行比较并量化评分；将该测试组应用于45个来自五类训练家族的模型，包括监督、自监督、对比视觉-语言编码器、开放权重 VLM 和闭源基础模型。
Result: 摘要报告称，与人类反应的一致性捕获了常规性能指标无法区分的知觉组织方面；若干闭源模型在这种人类对齐度上得分显著低于其基准准确率所暗示的水平。
Conclusion: 作者提出，针对已发布知觉数据评分能给可视化研究提供一个可复用的审计标尺，无需开展新的用户研究，用于检查进入可视化管线的模型是否以与人类观众一致的方式组织视觉内容。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The Deliberative Deficit: An Empirical Critique of LLMs in Democratic Discourse
papers.abstract_en: LLMs are increasingly deployed in settings that require collective reasoning on complex, value-laden problems. Confidence in these deployments rests largely on benchmarks for verifiable tasks (mathematics, coding, coordination games), yet many of these applications concern problems where no objectively correct answer exists and where decision quality instead depends on integrating pluralistic perspectives to find mutually acceptable solutions. We argue that LLM reasoning capacity on this class of problems cannot be fully inferred from verifiable-task benchmarks, and that procedural evaluations of LLM discourse (respectfulness, justification, engagement) are systematically insufficient. We apply the Deliberative Reason Index (DRI), a measure developed in political science and validated across citizen assemblies, as a tool for evaluating reliable group-level reasoning on pluralistic, non-verifiable problems. Synthesizing recent evidence across 1,980 five-agent LLM runs on 12 citizen-assembly topics across 11 frontier model configurations, we find that LLM groups produce discourse with procedural quality comparable to human deliberation, while gains in intersubjective consistency are small, topic-dependent, and concentrated on tractable rather than ethically contested questions. LLM groups exhibit roughly one-third the perspective diversity of human assemblies and reverse the human convergence pattern: human deliberation decreases dispersion as diverse views synthesise, whereas LLM deliberation increases it. Engineering diversity through persona prompting does not restore the human dynamic but inverts which component of deliberative reasoning is updated. Our conclusion is constraining rather than prohibitive: LLMs can function as tools supporting human reasoning on pluralistic problems, but current evidence does not license treating them as autonomous deliberative agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评性地审视了大语言模型 (LLM) 在民主审议场景中的应用，指出其在可验证任务上的基准表现无法推断其处理无唯一正确答案的多元、非可验证问题的能力。作者引入政治学中经公民大会验证的 Deliberative Reason Index (DRI)，并综合 11 个前沿模型配置在 12 个公民大会议题上的 1,980 次五智能体 LLM 运行数据，发现 LLM 群体的程序性话语质量接近人类，但视角多样性仅约为人类的三分之一，且审议使离散度增加而非像人类那样收敛。
Motivation: LLM 越来越多地被部署在需要集体推理的复杂价值判断场景，但现有信心主要建立在数学、编程、协调博弈等可验证任务基准上；对于不存在客观正确答案、依赖多元视角整合的问题，缺乏可靠评估。
Method: 将政治学中用于评估公民大会的 Deliberative Reason Index (DRI) 用作衡量群体层面推理质量的工具，并综合跨 1,980 次五智能体 LLM 运行、12 个公民大会议题、11 个前沿模型配置的证据，同时检验通过 persona prompting 工程化视角多样性是否能恢复人类动态。
Result: LLM 群体产生的话语程序质量与人类审议相当，但主体间一致性提升很小、依赖议题且集中于易处理问题；LLM 群体的视角多样性仅为人类的三分之一，并反转了人类审议降低离散度的收敛模式；persona prompting 未能恢复人类动态，反而反转了审议推理中被更新的组件。
Conclusion: 结论是限制性的而非禁止性的：LLM 可以作为支持人类处理多元问题推理的工具，但当前证据不允许将 LLM 视为自主审议智能体。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: The sharp SAT/UNSAT phase transition in random ellipsoid fitting
papers.abstract_en: Let $x_1,\ldots,x_n$ be independent standard Gaussian vectors in $\mathbb{R}^d$. An \emph{ellipsoid fit} is a matrix $S \succeq 0$ such that $x_i^\top S x_i =d$ for every $i$, so that all the points lie on the boundary of the centered ellipsoid $\{ x : x^\top S x = d\}$. Saunderson, Parrilo and Willsky conjectured that, as $n,d \to \infty$, this semidefinite feasibility problem undergoes a sharp transition at $n \sim d^2/4$. We prove this conjecture. If $\lim \sup n/d^2 = α^* <1/4$, then, with probability tending to one, an ellipsoid fit exists; moreover, one can choose $S$ with all eigenvalues in a fixed interval $[λ_- , λ_+] \subset (0,\infty)$ depending only on $α^*$. Conversely, if $\lim \inf n/d^2 > 1/4$, then, with probability tending to one, no ellipsoid fit exists, without any spectral restriction. Our proof builds on the Gaussian-equivalence framework developed by Bandeira and Maillard (2025) and closes the two gaps left open in their work: establishing exact fitting and removing the operator-norm constraint. On the satisfiable side, the new ingredients are a head-tail decomposition of the dual vector, exact correction of the sparse head constraints, and a Gaussian comparison principle for the low-influence tail. On the unsatisfiable side, we split a candidate into a low-rank spectral head and a Schatten-3 diffuse bulk, Gaussianize the bulk conditionally on the head, and apply a projected Gordon escape argument. The threshold is governed by the statistical dimension $d(d+1)/4$ of the positive semidefinite cone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明 Saunderson-Parrilo-Willsky 猜想：随机椭球拟合这一半定可行性问题在 n ~ d^2/4 处发生尖锐的 SAT/UNSAT 相变。当 n/d^2 的上极限小于 1/4 时，以趋于 1 的概率存在椭球拟合 S，且其特征值可限制在固定区间内；当 n/d^2 的下极限大于 1/4 时，以趋于 1 的概率不存在任何椭球拟合。证明基于 Bandeira 和 Maillard (2025) 的高斯等价框架，并填补其两个空白。
Motivation: 随机椭球拟合的半定可行性问题是否在 n ~ d^2/4 处发生锐利相变是此前未解决的猜想；该相变阈值与正半定锥的统计维数相关，对理解高维随机几何与半定规划可行性有理论意义。
Method: 在可满足侧引入对偶向量的头尾分解、稀疏头约束的精确校正以及低影响尾部的 Gaussian comparison principle；在不可满足侧将候选矩阵拆分为低秩谱头与 Schatten-3 弥散主体，条件高斯化主体并应用 projected Gordon escape argument。
Result: 证明当 lim sup n/d^2 < 1/4 时拟合存在且谱有界；当 lim inf n/d^2 > 1/4 时拟合不存在且无需谱限制，从而完全证明该相变猜想。
Conclusion: 该结果确立了随机椭球拟合相变阈值为正半定锥统计维数 d(d+1)/4 的一半对应的密度，并展示了高斯等价框架可被补全以处理精确可行性与去掉算子范数约束。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: From Prediction to Incrementality: Causal Optimization for Large-Scale Targeting and Recommendation
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale targeting and recommendation systems are typically built around predictive scores fed into heuristic or local allocation. When the business goal is incremental impact, as in marketing campaigns, incentives, and notifications, this paradigm systematically misallocates resources toward users who would have acted anyway. We present a decision-centric framework that instead optimizes causal effects under global constraints, aligning three components under a single objective: a causal neural network with a Transformer backbone for individual treatment-effect estimation, a Bayesian neural-bandit layer for uncertainty-aware exploration, and a dual-based large-scale linear-programming layer for constrained allocation. The framework also supports sequential context and multi-outcome, attribute-conditioned scoring through a Transformer encoder and outcome embeddings. We evaluate it with offline simulations on a public bandit dataset, targeted architectural ablations, and an online A/B test on LinkedIn Feed marketing traffic. We also distill production lessons on causal training-data construction and cost and delivery control, which were critical to successful deployment. The end-to-end treatment policy delivered a statistically significant $+7.20\%$ lift in the primary long-term-value metric, demonstrating the feasibility of production-scale causal optimization under business constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模定向投放和推荐系统中以预测分数驱动启发式分配、却忽略增量效应的问题，提出一个决策中心化 (decision-centric) 的因果优化框架。该框架将 Transformer 骨干的因果神经网络用于个体治疗效果估计、贝叶斯神经 bandit 层用于不确定性感知的探索、以及对偶法大规模线性规划层用于带全局约束的分配。在 LinkedIn Feed 营销流量的在线 A/B 测试中，端到端治疗策略在主要长期价值指标上带来统计显著的 +7.20% 提升。
Motivation: 现有大规模定向与推荐系统通常基于预测分数进行启发式或局部分配；当业务目标是增量影响时，这种范式会把资源系统性地分配给本来就会行动的用户，造成资源错配。
Method: 提出单一目标下对齐三个组件的框架：带 Transformer 骨干的因果神经网络估计个体治疗效果，贝叶斯神经 bandit 层做不确定性感知的探索，以及对偶法大规模线性规划层处理受约束的分配；同时通过 Transformer 编码器和结果嵌入支持序列上下文、多结果与属性条件化评分。
Result: 论文在公开 bandit 数据集上的离线模拟、定向架构消融以及 LinkedIn Feed 营销流量上的在线 A/B 测试中评估了该方法，端到端治疗策略在主要长期价值指标上取得统计显著的 +7.20% 提升。
Conclusion: 作者强调因果训练数据构建以及成本与投放控制是成功部署的关键，并认为该工作证明了在业务约束下进行生产级因果优化的可行性。
Relevance: 3

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对大规模定向投放和推荐系统中以预测分数驱动启发式分配、却忽略增量效应的问题，提出一个决策中心化 (decision-centric) 的因果优化框架。该框架将 Transformer 骨干的因果神经网络用于个体治疗效果估计、贝叶斯神经 bandit 层用于不确定性感知的探索、以及对偶法大规模线性规划层用于带全局约束的分配。在 LinkedIn Feed 营销流量的在线 A/B 测试中，端到端治疗策略在主要长期价值指标上带来统计显著的 +7.20% 提升。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有大规模定向与推荐系统通常基于预测分数进行启发式或局部分配；当业务目标是增量影响时，这种范式会把资源系统性地分配给本来就会行动的用户，造成资源错配。

papers.title: Human versus Computer Vision
papers.abstract_en: Computer vision saliency models predict where people will look, one map per image, and a billion-dollar predicted-attention industry sells those maps in place of measuring real viewers. I test the leading models from the audience side, against 11.4 million webcam gaze points from 3,023 US adults recruited to national quotas, viewing circulating news photographs. I show that an untrained central marker outperforms every trained network, because the content the networks add on top of the center falls where these audiences never look. What accuracy remains is systematically biased, favoring younger, White, and moderate viewers over older, Black, and ideologically extreme ones. I propose a way forward and build on what a group's own gaze reveals about whether a model can learn that group at all, and I apply it across every demographic axis this sample supports. Ultimately, I show how systems that decide what people see can learn to see everyone, and this study supplies the standard by which such a claim should be judged.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从受众视角评估计算机视觉显著性模型（saliency models），用按美国全国配额招募的 3,023 名成年人观看新闻照片时产生的 1,140 万 webcam 注视点来检验主流模型。结果显示未经训练的中央注视标记优于所有经过训练的网络，且模型残存的准确率存在系统性人口统计学偏差，偏向年轻、白人、政治温和的观看者。作者提出基于群体自身注视数据判断模型能否学习该群体的方法，并主张该研究为“系统能学会看见每个人”的说法提供了评判标准。
Motivation: 现有显著性模型用每张图片一张预测图来代替真实观众测量，形成了一个价值数十亿美元的预测注意力行业，但模型在受众侧的表现和公平性缺乏大规模实证检验。
Method: 以全国配额招募的 3,023 名美国成年人观看新闻照片的 1,140 万 webcam 注视点作为基准，对比领先的显著性模型与未训练的中央标记；并依据群体自身注视模式提出评估模型可学习性的方法，沿样本支持的人口统计学维度进行分析。
Result: 未训练的中央标记胜过所有受测的训练网络；模型剩余的预测准确率具有系统性偏差，对年轻、白人、政治温和的观看者更有利，对年长、黑人、意识形态极端的观看者更差。
Conclusion: 作者认为基于群体自身注视数据的评估方式为判断系统能否学会看见所有人提供了标准，摘要未报告具体数值对比，样本限于美国成年人且刺激材料为新闻照片。
Relevance: 4

papers.title: TRACE: Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Engine
papers.abstract_en: Public service chatbots are expected to deliver recommendations from an underlying public service directory, while also making sure that the recommendations respect explicit user constraints. In practice, public service directories are noisy and inconsistent, and general-purpose large language model (LLM) or AI-based chatbots frequently generate unreliable recommendations, citing unverified sources from the web. We investigate the impact of retrieval quality on constraint-aware recommendation in public service conversational systems built over noisy and heterogeneous service directories. We propose TRACE (Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Engine), a retrieval-based, constraint-aware framework that parses input user queries into structural and semantic constraints for downstream retrieval, with the help of a dual data representation schema. Using a curated statewide pantry directory and a synthetic query benchmark, we evaluate multiple knowledge-representation variants with and without knowledge graphs (KGs). We experiment with several open-source LLMs and a proprietary model, showing that strengthening retrieval substantially improves user constraint satisfaction while reducing hallucinated recommendations. Performance differences across LLMs narrowed in our experiments as retrieval quality improved, making results less sensitive to model size. These findings suggest that the quality of retrieval is key for robust public service conversational systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRACE（Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Engine），一个面向公共服务聊天机器人的基于检索且满足约束（constraint-aware）的框架。它将用户查询解析为结构性和语义性约束用于下游检索，并采用双数据表示模式；基于州级食品储藏室目录和合成查询基准，对比了有无知识图谱（KG）的多种知识表示变体。实验表明，加强检索能显著提升用户约束满足率并减少幻觉推荐，同时不同 LLM 之间的性能差异随检索质量提升而缩小。
Motivation: 公共服务聊天机器人需要在底层服务目录中给出推荐，同时满足用户的显式约束，但现实目录噪声大且不一致，通用 LLM/AI 聊天机器人常引用网络上的不可靠来源而生成不可信推荐。论文关注检索质量对这类约束感知推荐系统的影响。
Method: 提出 TRACE 框架：将用户查询解析为结构性和语义性约束供下游检索使用，并引入双数据表示模式；在评测中对比有/无知识图谱的多种知识表示变体，并使用多个开源 LLM 和一个专有模型进行实验。
Result: 摘要报告，加强检索显著提升用户约束满足度并减少幻觉推荐；随着检索质量提高，不同 LLM 之间的性能差距缩小，结果对模型规模的敏感度降低。
Conclusion: 作者认为检索质量是构建稳健公共服务对话系统的关键；实验范围限定于一个州级食品储藏室目录和合成查询基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DoseBridge: Denoising Diffusion Bridge Model for Dose Prediction in Lung Intensity-Modulated Proton Therapy
papers.abstract_en: Most radiotherapy dose-prediction models use only CT images and anatomical structures, although intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) dose also depends strongly on beam geometry and available clinical datasets are often small. We present DoseBridge, a denoising diffusion bridge model that uses the patient CT as a structured bridge endpoint and encodes plan-specific beam geometry in a spatially aligned beam mask. Multiscale fusion combines CT, target, organ-at-risk, and beam-mask representations with 1.95% additional parameters. DoseBridge was retrospectively evaluated on single-institution CT images and treatment plans from 52 patients with advanced-stage lung cancer treated with 60 Gy in 30 fractions; 42 cases were used for training and 10 for testing. Performance was assessed using image-similarity, dose-volume, and Lyman-Kutcher-Burman normal-tissue complication probability (NTCP) metrics and compared with two deep-learning models. On the test cohort, DoseBridge achieved a mean absolute error of 4.170 Gy, peak signal-to-noise ratio of 23.06 dB, and structural similarity index of 0.798, outperforming both comparison models on these metrics. Clinical target volume D95 differed from the reference dose by 0.62 +/- 1.6 Gy; signed organ-at-risk mean-dose differences ranged from -0.32 to 0.24 Gy, and NTCP differences were -0.40 +/- 2.2 and 0.52 +/- 3.4 percentage points for acute esophagitis and radiation pneumonitis, respectively. Changing only the beam mask redirected predicted low-dose entrance regions while preserving the high-dose target region. To our knowledge, DoseBridge is the first denoising diffusion bridge model for radiotherapy dose prediction. These results support its feasibility as a beam-aware planning prior for lung IMPT, pending evaluation in larger external cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DoseBridge，一种去噪扩散桥模型（denoising diffusion bridge model），用于肺癌调强质子治疗（IMPT）的剂量预测。模型以患者CT为结构化桥端点，并在空间对齐的束掩码中编码束几何，通过多尺度融合整合CT、靶区、危及器官和束掩码表示，仅增加1.95%参数。在52例晚期肺癌患者的单机构回顾性数据集上，DoseBridge在MAE、PSNR、SSIM等指标上优于两个深度学习对比模型，并显示出束掩码对低剂量入射区域的调控能力。作者称这是首个用于放疗剂量预测的去噪扩散桥模型。
Motivation: 现有放疗剂量预测模型主要使用CT和解剖结构，忽略了IMPT剂量对束几何的强烈依赖，且临床数据集通常较小，限制了预测精度和泛化。
Method: 提出DoseBridge，利用去噪扩散桥将CT作为结构化桥端点，并加入空间对齐的束掩码（beam mask）以编码计划特定的束几何；采用多尺度融合（multiscale fusion）组合CT、靶区（target）、危及器官（OAR）与束掩码表示，仅增加1.95%的额外参数。
Result: 在42例训练、10例测试的晚期肺癌IMPT队列上，DoseBridge的MAE为4.170 Gy，PSNR为23.06 dB，SSIM为0.798，均优于两个对比深度学习模型。CTV D95误差为0.62±1.6 Gy，危及器官平均剂量差在-0.32至0.24 Gy之间，急性食管炎和放射性肺炎的NTCP差异分别为-0.40±2.2和0.52±3.4个百分点；仅改变束掩码即可移动低剂量入射区域而不影响高剂量靶区。
Conclusion: DoseBridge作为首个用于放疗剂量预测的去噪扩散桥模型，在单机构小规模数据集上显示出作为肺IMPT束感知规划先验（beam-aware planning prior）的可行性，但需要更大规模外部队列进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Intrinsic Structure: Spectral Identifiability for Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability explains models by identifying circuits inside them, but has no way to tell whether a circuit is a property of the model or an artifact of the method that found it. Sparse autoencoders illustrate the problem: different seeds and widths recover materially different features from the same activations, and no theory says whether that variability is incidental or structural. We put dictionary learning for interpretability on an identifiability footing. Treating the forward pass as a controlled dynamical system with depth as time and lifting it with the Koopman operator yields a finite linear realisation whose \emph{spectrum} is a coordinate-free property of the model. We prove the spectrum is recoverable from $M$ calibration samples at rate $M^{-1/2}$ up to permutation - to our knowledge the first identifiability theorem for a mechanistic-interpretability primitive, with a matching minimax lower bound, a median-of-means variant for heavy-tailed activations, and a dissociation theorem: whenever the realisation is non-normal, the directions carrying activation variance and the directions carrying information across depth cannot coincide. The identifiable object and the legible object are not the same object. On GPT-2 small, Gemma-2-2B and Qwen3-8B-Base the spectrum converges everywhere and attains the predicted exponent on Qwen3-8B-Base ($0.506 \pm 0.031$); shortfalls collapse onto one curve against each cell's sample threshold. Koopman modes beat random directions but lose to principal components on indirect-object identification, with the gap decaying $4.1\times$ in depth-distance, as the theorem predicts. The Koopman spectrum is an identifiable, model-intrinsic fingerprint with a stated error bar, not a legible decomposition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为机械可解释性中的字典学习建立可辨识性基础。作者将前向传播视为以深度为时间的受控动力系统，并用 Koopman 算子提升为有限线性实现，证明其谱是模型与坐标系无关的固有性质，且可由 M 个校准样本以 M^{-1/2} 的速率恢复（置换意义下）。在 GPT-2 small、Gemma-2-2B 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，谱处处收敛并在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上达到预测指数。
Motivation: 机械可解释性通过识别模型内部回路来解释模型，但无法判断某条回路是模型自身的性质还是发现方法带来的伪影；稀疏自编码器（sparse autoencoders）在不同种子和宽度下从相同激活恢复出显著不同的特征，缺乏理论说明这种变异性是偶然的还是结构性的。
Method: 将前向传播建模为受控动力系统并以深度为时间，通过 Koopman 算子提升得到有限线性实现，其谱为坐标无关的对象；论文证明该谱可恢复、给出匹配的极小极大下界、面向重尾激活的中位数均值（median-of-means）变体，并提出解离定理：当实现非正规（non-normal）时，承载激活方差的方向与承载跨深度信息的方向不能重合。
Result: 在 GPT-2 small、Gemma-2-2B 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上谱处处收敛，并在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上达到预测指数 0.506 ± 0.031；不足部分随每个单元的样本阈值坍缩到单一曲线。Koopman 模式优于随机方向，但在间接宾语识别上输给主成分，且差距随深度距离衰减 4.1 倍，与定理预测一致。
Conclusion: Koopman 谱是一个可辨识、模型内在的指纹，带有明确的误差条，但不是易读的分解；可辨识对象与可读对象并非同一对象。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 将前向传播建模为受控动力系统并以深度为时间，通过 Koopman 算子提升得到有限线性实现，其谱为坐标无关的对象；论文证明该谱可恢复、给出匹配的极小极大下界、面向重尾激活的中位数均值（median-of-means）变体，并提出解离定理：当实现非正规（non-normal）时，承载激活方差的方向与承载跨深度信息的方向不能重合。
summary_sections.result: 在 GPT-2 small、Gemma-2-2B 和 Qwen3-8B-Base 上谱处处收敛，并在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上达到预测指数 0.506 ± 0.031；不足部分随每个单元的样本阈值坍缩到单一曲线。Koopman 模式优于随机方向，但在间接宾语识别上输给主成分，且差距随深度距离衰减 4.1 倍，与定理预测一致。
summary_sections.conclusion: Koopman 谱是一个可辨识、模型内在的指纹，带有明确的误差条，但不是易读的分解；可辨识对象与可读对象并非同一对象。

papers.title: Generating Attacks for LLMs with GFlowNets
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) has facilitated their ubiquitous integration into various domains, leading to widespread adoption. However, this escalating trend has introduced significant security vulnerabilities, necessitating the identification and mitigation of flaws arising from malicious exploitation. Red teaming assessments, conducted to evaluate model robustness through diverse adversarial inputs, are essential for exposing security risks and implementing countermeasures. Currently, red teaming is performed either manually by experts or automatically using predefined attack datasets. Nevertheless, manual testing remains time-consuming, while existing automated methods suffer from limited creativity due to their inherent dependency on fixed datasets. In this study, we propose an automated, human-independent, and adaptive approach leveraging GFlowNets to identify LLM vulnerabilities by utilizing one large language model to test another. Within this framework, an attacker model is trained against a specified victim model to perform automated red teaming and provide a quantitative robustness score. This research aims to generate more effective adversarial attacks in English compared to existing benchmarks and, as a novel contribution to the literature, introduces a model capable of generating attack inputs in the Turkish language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用 GFlowNets 训练一个攻击模型，对指定目标 LLM 进行自动化红队测试（red teaming），生成对抗性攻击输入并提供定量的鲁棒性分数。摘要称该方法在英文上能比现有基准生成更有效的对抗攻击，并作为新颖贡献引入了一个能生成土耳其语攻击输入的模型。
Motivation: 当前 LLM 红队测试要么依赖人工专家、耗时且成本高，要么使用预定义攻击数据集，受限于固定数据而缺乏创造力。研究希望提供一种自动化、人类无关且自适应的方式来发现 LLM 的安全漏洞。
Method: 框架内用一个大语言模型去测试另一个大语言模型：基于 GFlowNets 训练攻击者模型，使其针对特定受害模型生成对抗输入，从而完成自动化红队测试并输出定量鲁棒性分数。
Result: 摘要报告该方法在英文上比现有基准生成更有效的对抗攻击，并首次提出能够生成土耳其语攻击输入的模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为该研究提供了自动化、人类无关且自适应的 LLM 红队测试途径，主要贡献在于更有效的英文攻击生成以及土耳其语攻击输入生成能力。

papers.title: Motion Artifact-Aware Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Brain MRI Motion Artifact Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Patient motion remains a source of image degradation in brain MRI, leading to signal loss, blurring, and geometric distortion that compromise quantitative analysis. Existing deep learning methods for motion correction typically rely on paired clean-corrupted data or k-space acquisitions, which are rarely available in clinical settings. We propose SSRL-MAR, a motion artifact-aware unpaired representation learning framework for motion artifact reduction that requires neither paired training data nor explicit motion labels. SSRL-MAR employed a three-stage training strategy: (1) contrastive learning on 3D patches to extract motion representations by contrasting clean and synthetically corrupted images, (2) a motion artifact-aware synthesis network to generate motion artifacts from clean scans, and (3) a motion artifact-aware generator to restore clean volumes using the learned degrader for self-supervised supervision. On in-silico dataset, SSRL-MAR achieved PSNR 23.81dB, SSIM 91.55%, and NMSE 0.79%. On in-vivo MR-ART dataset, the pretrained model reduced motion distortion, and unsupervised domain adaptation further improved anatomical fidelity. Against a source-only supervised model trained on the same simulated pairs, SSRL-MAR improved PSNR by up to 2.0 dB on MR-ART after unsupervised domain adaptation, and remained within 0.25-0.47 dB of an oracle supervised model that requires real paired data unavailable in practice. At the milder motion level, volumetric error in structures such as the corpus callosum and ventricular system decreased by more than 50%, confirming improved neuroanatomical consistency. These results indicate that SSRL-MAR provides a robust and scalable image-domain solution for 3D brain MRI motion correction, enabling reliable structural quantification in large-scale neuroimaging studies without requiring prospectively acquired pairs or acquisition-specific calibration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SSRL-MAR，一种无需配对数据或运动标签的 3D 脑部 MRI 运动伪影消除框架，采用三阶段自监督表示学习。摘要报告在 in-silico 数据集上 PSNR 23.81dB、SSIM 91.55%、NMSE 0.79%；在 in-vivo MR-ART 数据上经无监督域适应后比 source-only 监督模型 PSNR 最多提升 2.0dB，并接近需要真实配对数据的 oracle 监督模型。作者认为该方法为大规模神经影像研究提供了无需采集特定配对的图像域运动校正方案。
Motivation: 患者运动是脑部 MRI 图像退化的常见来源，导致信号丢失、模糊和几何畸变，影响定量分析。现有深度学习方法依赖成对的干净-退化数据或 k-space 采集，这些在临床中很少可用。
Method: 提出三阶段训练策略：先在 3D patch 上用对比学习（contrastive learning）提取运动表征，对比干净图像与合成退化图像；再训练运动伪影感知的合成网络生成伪影；最后用该退化器作为自监督监督信号，训练运动伪影感知生成器恢复干净体积。整个过程不需要配对训练数据或显式运动标签。
Result: 在 in-silico 数据上达到 PSNR 23.81dB、SSIM 91.55%、NMSE 0.79%。在 in-vivo MR-ART 数据上，无监督域适应后比 source-only 监督模型 PSNR 最多提升 2.0dB，并距需要真实配对数据的 oracle 监督模型只差 0.25-0.47dB；在较轻运动水平下，胼胝体和脑室系统等结构的体积误差下降超过 50%。
Conclusion: 摘要总结 SSRL-MAR 是一种稳健且可扩展的图像域运动校正方案，无需前瞻性采集配对数据或采集特定校准，可用于大规模神经影像研究中的可靠结构定量分析。

papers.title: MarkNull: Model-Agnostic Watermark Removal in AI-Generated Images via On-Manifold Latent Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Digital watermarking has emerged as a critical technique for provenance and copyright attribution in AI-generated imagery, yet its robustness against realistic, model-agnostic removal attacks remains poorly explored. Existing attacks either succeed only against specific generative models or achieve removal at the cost of severe visual degradation. In this paper, we propose MarkNull, a model-agnostic watermark removal attack via on-manifold latent manipulation. MarkNull is grounded in a key observation: watermarked images exhibit a strong statistical dependency between the generated latent representation and the embedded initial noise. To quantify this dependency, we introduce the Noise-Latent Alignment Score (NLAS) and formulate an optimization objective that selectively decorrelates the latent representation from the embedded watermark while preserving semantic fidelity. Extensive evaluations across different categories of watermarking paradigms, including post-hoc, fine-tuning-based, and initial-noise-based schemes, demonstrate that MarkNull reduces average bit accuracy to 53.14%, approaching random-guessing (50%), without perceptible image degradation. To further improve scalability, we propose MarkNull-A, an amortized, optimization-free variant that distills the attack into a single forward pass, achieving 0.50 s/image with modest computational overhead. Notably, our attacks successfully compromise Google's SynthID-Image system while preserving high visual quality and transfer effectively to video watermarking. Finally, we present an attack detection mechanism as a defensive counterpart to MarkNull and MarkNull-A, highlighting the necessity of developing watermark designs resilient to model-agnostic latent-space attacks.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 35th USENIX Security Symposium (USENIX Security 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MarkNull，一种模型无关的 AI 生成图像水印移除攻击，通过在隐空间流形上进行操作，利用水印图像中生成的隐表示与嵌入初始噪声之间的统计依赖关系。作者引入噪声-隐对齐分数（NLAS）并构造优化目标，在保持语义保真度的同时选择性地去除水印信息，并在多类水印范式上验证了有效性。
Motivation: 数字水印用于 AI 生成图像的溯源与版权归属，但其面对现实、模型无关的移除攻击时的鲁棒性研究不足；现有攻击要么只对特定生成模型有效，要么以严重视觉退化为代价实现移除。
Method: 提出模型无关的水印移除攻击 MarkNull，基于水印图像隐表示与初始噪声之间的统计依赖，定义 Noise-Latent Alignment Score (NLAS) 并构建优化目标，在隐空间中选择性去相关水印信息而保持语义；另提出 MarkNull-A 摊销变体，将攻击蒸馏为单次前向传播，无需迭代优化。
Result: 在 post-hoc、fine-tuning-based 和 initial-noise-based 等水印范式下，MarkNull 将平均比特准确率降至 53.14%，接近随机猜测（50%），且无可感知的图像退化；MarkNull-A 达到 0.50 s/图像的推理速度，转移开销较小，并能成功攻破 Google 的 SynthID-Image 系统且迁移到视频水印。
Conclusion: 作为防御对应物，作者提出一种攻击检测机制来识别 MarkNull 与 MarkNull-A，并强调需要设计对模型无关隐空间攻击具有鲁棒性的水印方案。

papers.title: MAD-HOI: Masked Autoregressive Diffusion for Generating Articulated Hand Object Interactions from Text
papers.abstract_en: Methods for text-based generation of hand-object interaction (HOI) sequences primarily focus on producing smooth, physically plausible trajectories. A truly utilitarian method should additionally support variable-length generation, composite motion sequences, motion completion and infilling, and reliable termination without compromising physical plausibility. Standard diffusion models for HOI generation are typically trained only for text-to-motion generation on atomic motions and require the motion length to be specified a-priori. Autoregressive (AR) methods provide greater sequence-level flexibility, but commonly depend on discrete motion codes, which can lose contact-sensitive motion detail. To address these key limitations, we present a model performing Masked Autoregression with Diffusion for HOI generation (MAD-HOI). Our method starts by encoding hand and object motions in a continuous latent space while keeping them disentangled to maintain stream-wise control. This is followed by a masked autoregressive transformer to predict context features that condition a flow-matching head. MAD-HOI is capable of motion generation for atomic and composite articulated sequences, conditioned motion completion and infilling, as well as EOM (End of Motion) prediction from a single training objective. We provide comprehensive evaluations for these capabilities and benchmark our method on the ARCTIC and GRAB datasets. Our experiments demonstrate that our method generates more diverse and physically plausible interactions compared to other open-sourced baseline methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MAD-HOI，一种用于从文本生成手-物交互 (hand-object interaction, HOI) 序列的掩码自回归扩散模型。该方法在连续潜空间中编码手和物体运动并保持两者解耦，随后用掩码自回归 Transformer 预测上下文特征来条件化 flow-matching 头，支持原子与复合动作生成、条件补全和填充、以及 End of Motion (EOM) 预测。在 ARCTIC 和 GRAB 数据集上的实验表明，相比其他开源基线，该方法生成更多样且物理上更合理的交互。
Motivation: 现有基于文本的 HOI 序列生成方法主要关注平滑和物理合理的轨迹，但标准扩散模型通常只能处理原子动作且需预先指定运动长度；自回归方法提供序列级灵活性却依赖离散运动码，可能丢失接触敏感细节。MAD-HOI 针对这些局限设计。
Method: 先将手和物体运动在连续潜空间中进行解耦编码以保留流级控制，再用掩码自回归 Transformer 预测上下文特征，并送入 flow-matching 头生成运动；通过单一训练目标同时支持运动生成、条件补全与填充以及 EOM 预测。
Result: 在 ARCTIC 和 GRAB 数据集上的综合评估显示，MAD-HOI 相比其他开源基线生成了更多样且物理上更合理的手-物交互序列。
Conclusion: 摘要强调单一训练目标即可统一支持原子/复合动作生成、运动补全与填充以及可靠终止，同时不牺牲物理合理性。

papers.title: SBCO: Self-Supervised, Verifier-Grounded Harness Optimization For Planning Agents
papers.abstract_en: Self-improving agents seek to reduce the human engineering effort behind AI systems by enabling them to evolve and self-improve their performance over time. Recently, methods like the Darwin Gödel Machine and the Huxley Gödel Machine have been proposed which enable open-ended, recursive self-improvement through self-reference where a coding agent edits its own code. Such self-referential self-improvement methods require that the competence required to perform the task coincides or aligns well with the competence required for self-modification which is the case for coding tasks. For domains or tasks, which do not satisfy the alignment needed, self-referential self-improvement is not available. In such cases, it is possible to adapt the above algorithms to other tasks by removing the self-referential aspect or introducing explicit self-modification of a meta-agent -- both computationally expensive, relying on population or self-modification search over many candidate agents. For planning tasks with explicit constraints, we propose a far cheaper alternative. We introduce SBCO (Self-supervised Block Coordinate Optimizer), a verifier-grounded harness optimizer in the same closed-loop, improve-from-experience family as the Gödel-machine methods, but self-supervised rather than self-referential. Given an agentic harness, SBCO learns a decomposed bank of verifiers and a harness policy via approximate block coordinate ascent, improving the agent's outputs from its own graded feedback---with a fixed meta-agent and no human labels. Across two domains SBCO matches or exceeds a customized self-modifying baseline while using 4-5.5 times less compute budget.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 自指式自改进方法（如 Darwin/Huxley Gödel Machine）要求任务能力与自修改能力高度对齐，这在编码任务中成立，但在规划等不对齐领域难以直接应用；去掉自指或引入元代理的显式自修改都依赖大量候选代理的群体或自修改搜索，计算代价高昂。
Method: 提出 SBCO，一种验证器锚定的 harness 优化器：通过近似块坐标上升 (block coordinate ascent) 学习分解的验证器库和 harness 策略，利用 agent 自身产生的分级反馈改进输出，整个过程保持固定的元代理且不需要人类标签。
Result: 摘要显示，在两个领域的实验中，SBCO 达到或超过定制的自修改基线 (self-modifying baseline)，同时使用 4-5.5 倍更少的计算预算。
Conclusion: 作者认为对于带显式约束的规划任务，SBCO 提供了比自指或显式自修改方法便宜得多的替代方案，且属于与 Gödel machine 方法相同的 closed-loop、improve-from-experience 家族。

papers.title: Optimal Inference with Black-box Predictions
papers.abstract_en: Powerful black-box predictive models have motivated many proposals for combining observed data with predictions to perform valid statistical inference. Despite this progress, the field lacks a unifying principle that explains how hypothesis tests should integrate data and predictions in a way that is both valid and efficient. In this work, we address this gap in the high-dimensional Gaussian sequence model. We characterize the information-theoretic limits of inference with black-box predictions when their accuracies are known and, for orthogonal predictions, when they are unknown. Building on these characterizations, we develop practical hypothesis tests that adapt to the unknown accuracies of the predictions while benefiting from strong alignment among them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在高维高斯序列模型 (high-dimensional Gaussian sequence model) 中研究如何将黑盒预测模型与观测数据结合以进行有效且高效的统计推断。作者刻画了当预测精度已知时、以及在正交预测情形下精度未知时的信息论极限，并据此构造能自适应未知预测精度的实用假设检验。
Motivation: 尽管已有许多工作提出用黑盒预测与观测数据结合进行有效统计推断，但领域缺乏统一原则来解释假设检验应如何整合数据与预测，同时兼顾有效性与效率。
Method: 在高维高斯序列模型下，先刻画黑盒预测在已知精度情形下的推断信息论极限，再处理正交预测时精度未知的情形；基于这些刻画构造自适应的实用假设检验，使其能利用预测之间的强对齐 (alignment) 并适应未知精度。
Result: 摘要没有给出具体数值结果，主要贡献是信息论极限的表征以及相应自适应检验方法的理论性质。
Conclusion: 本文的理论框架聚焦于高维高斯序列模型，为黑盒预测参与假设检验的设计提供了统一原则。
Relevance: 5
