papers.title: Multimodal Item Parameter Estimation using Simulated Response Probabilitie
papers.abstract_en: We present results from reconstructing multiple-choice model (MCM) and three-parameter logistic (3PL) model curves using a fine-tuned multimodal large language model (LLM) based on Qwen3.5. The model is prompted and fine-tuned to replicate choice probabilities across a large training corpus of multiple-choice items containing both image and text stimuli, conditioned on a labeled set of student ability levels. By learning to reproduce the systematic error patterns of students across a discrete range of abilities, the LLM implicitly captures the underlying response probabilities encoded in the 3PL and MCM curves. This allows us to accurately approximate item difficulty on a held-out test set directly from the model's predicted option probabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了基于 Qwen3.5 微调的多模态大语言模型（LLM）重建多选题模型（MCM）与三参数逻辑斯蒂克（3PL）模型曲线的实验结果。模型在包含图像和文本刺激的多选题语料上被提示与微调，以在给定学生能力水平标签的条件下复现选项概率，从而隐式学习 3PL 和 MCM 曲线中编码的学生作答概率。摘要称该方法能够直接从模型预测的选项概率中准确近似留出测试集上的题目难度。
Motivation: 现有题目参数估计通常依赖作答数据而非题目内容本身；本文探索多模态 LLM 是否能够通过学习学生系统性的作答错误模式来隐式捕捉题目的响应概率曲线，从而直接估计题目难度。
Method: 使用基于 Qwen3.5 的微调多模态 LLM，以图像和文本组成的多选题为输入，在离散学生能力水平标签条件下训练模型复现选项选择概率；通过拟合 3PL 与 MCM 曲线所反映的作答概率分布，从模型输出的选项概率中推断题目参数。
Result: 摘要报告在留出测试集上，模型能够直接根据预测的选项概率准确近似题目难度，表明模型隐式捕获了 3PL 和 MCM 响应概率。
Conclusion: 作者认为多模态 LLM 可以通过复现学生的错误模式来逼近底层心理测量学模型曲线，从而为基于内容的题目难度估计提供一条可行路径；其适用范围为包含多种模态刺激的多选题场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The CASE Framework: A Multi-Disciplinary Control Architecture for Governing Enterprise Agentic AI
papers.abstract_en: Enterprises are deploying autonomous AI agents faster than they can govern them, and prevailing approaches stretch a single discipline, typically DevSecOps built for deterministic automation, across every scale of agency. We argue that agentic AI governance is four problems, not one, each with a mature governing science. The CASE framework assigns Control theory to the individual agent (intent as setpoint, guardrails as feedback, evaluation as observation), complex Adaptive systems theory to agent collectives (where emergence makes single-agent assurance non-compositional), Supervisory cybernetics to human-agent teams (where the Law of Requisite Variety shows unaided human oversight fails structurally), and Engineering operations to fleets (extending error budgets to decision quality so autonomy becomes a controlled variable). We formalize each layer, derive cross-layer coupling conditions, including a zero-touch deployment paradox where excellence at one-layer strains the others, and trace twenty-plus enterprise controls to their classical constructs. Three empirical studies validate the thesis: 82 percent of documented production agent failures are multi-layer trajectories; none of 22 ecosystem tools offers full Layer 2 (emergence) coverage; and all 35 scored public deployments fall in the lowest maturity band. We name this mismatch, risk realized at the emergence layer against capability barely offered and practice absent, the Emergence Gap. A five-level maturity model with a non-compensatory bottleneck-weighted index and assessment instrument operationalizes CASE as a scientific rather than process maturity model, grounded in production enterprise agentic platforms. As EU AI Act Article 14 makes effective human oversight a legal requirement, only architectures satisfying requisite variety can make oversight real rather than ceremonial.
papers.comment: 34 pages in total, 4 figures, 2 tables, code at https://github.com/srinivastelukunta/case_framework_arxiv_codes
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CASE 框架，将企业级 agentic AI 治理拆解为四个可分别对应成熟学科的问题：单代理采用控制论（intent 为设定点、guardrails 为反馈、evaluation 为观测），代理集体采用复杂适应系统理论，人机团队采用监督控制论，大规模集群采用工程运维。作者形式化各层、推导跨层耦合条件，提出零接触部署悖论与 Emergence Gap，并给出五级成熟度模型与评估工具。
Motivation: 企业部署自主 AI 代理的速度快于治理能力，而现有做法通常把单一学科（主要是为确定性自动化设计的 DevSecOps）拉伸到所有代理规模；作者认为 agentic AI 治理是四个问题而非一个，每个问题都有成熟的治理科学可循。
Method: CASE 框架将四层治理分别映射到控制论、复杂适应系统理论、监督控制论（以 Law of Requisite Variety 说明无辅助人类监督的结构性失败）和工程运维（把错误预算扩展到决策质量，使自主性成为受控变量）。作者形式化每一层，推导跨层耦合条件，并基于生产企业 agentic 平台构建带非补偿性瓶颈加权指数的五级成熟度模型和评估工具。
Result: 三项实证研究支持论文论点：82% 的有记录生产代理故障属于多层轨迹；22 个生态系统工具中无一提供完整的第 2 层（emergence）覆盖；35 个公开部署全部落在最低成熟度区间。作者将风险在涌现层实现而能力几乎未提供、实践缺失的错配命名为 Emergence Gap。
Conclusion: 该框架被定位为基于生产平台的科学成熟度模型而非流程成熟度模型；作者强调 EU AI Act 第 14 条使有效人类监督成为法律要求，只有满足必要多样性（requisite variety）的架构才能让监督真正有效而非仪式性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: REATS: LLM Reasoning-based Ensemble Learning for Adaptive Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Due to the diversity of real-world time series, no single forecasting model consistently dominates across all samples. Ensemble learning addresses this by combining complementary model strengths, yet existing methods rely on fixed rules or black-box models based solely on numerical inputs, failing to leverage LLM reasoning for interpretable weighting decisions. We propose REATS, which leverages LLM reasoning capabilities as an intelligent ensemble router that jointly processes textual temporal pattern descriptions and numerical features to produce interpretable, sample-adaptive ensemble weights through chain-of-thought reasoning. To enable effective LLM-based ensembling, we study its key design choices and propose: (i) a structured input pipeline that transforms raw time series into hybrid textual--numerical representations with fixed token cost, enabling rule-based chain-of-thought construction without API dependency, augmented with retrieved similar-sample priors; (ii) a diverse multi-row weight supervision scheme coupled with a token-efficient percentage-table format that reduces numerical complexity and mitigates LLM hallucinations; and (iii) a two-stage fine-tuning framework combining SFT with GRPO, where a reciprocal reward mapping transforms the continuous unbounded MSE gap into bounded signals with amplified near-oracle sensitivity, addressing the uniform sensitivity and outlier-dominated advantage compression inherent in naive reward designs for regression-based GRPO. Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that REATS outperforms competitive ensemble baselines while providing natural language explanations and demonstrating strong transfer learning and out-of-domain generalization to unseen candidate models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 REATS，一种基于 LLM 推理的集成学习方法，用于自适应时间序列预测。它将原始时间序列转换为固定 token 成本的混合文本-数值表示，通过思维链推理生成可解释、样本自适应的集成权重，并提出结构化输入管道、多行权重监督和两阶段微调（SFT+GRPO）等设计。实验在八个基准上优于竞争集成基线，并提供自然语言解释和较强的迁移学习能力。
Motivation: 现实世界时间序列多样性使得单一预测模型难以在所有样本上占优，现有集成方法依赖固定规则或仅基于数值输入的黑盒模型，未能利用 LLM 推理进行可解释的权重决策。
Method: 提出 LLM 作为智能集成路由器，联合处理文本时间模式描述与数值特征，并通过思维链推理生成样本自适应权重；采用无 API 依赖的基于规则的思维链构造，并加入检索到的相似样本先验；提出多行权重监督与 token 高效的百分比表格格式，降低数值复杂度并缓解 LLM 幻觉；使用 SFT 与 GRPO 的两阶段微调，并用倒数奖励映射将连续无界 MSE 差距转换为有界信号。
Result: 在八个基准上的实验显示，REATS 优于竞争集成基线，同时提供自然语言解释，并展示了对未见候选模型的强迁移学习和域外泛化能力。
Conclusion: REATS 表明借助 LLM 推理可以生成可解释且样本自适应的集成权重，在多个时间序列基准上表现优越；摘要未讨论明显局限。

summary_sections.conclusion: REATS 表明借助 LLM 推理可以生成可解释且样本自适应的集成权重，在多个时间序列基准上表现优越；摘要未讨论明显局限。

papers.title: The Evaluation Protocol Determines the Result: An Independent Reproduction of LeWorldModel on TwoRoom
papers.abstract_en: LeWorldModel trains a latent world model with a prediction loss and a single anti-collapse regulariser, and reports approximately 87% of goals reached on TwoRoom, its simplest diagnostic environment. We reproduce that result by independent reimplementation on roughly $25 of rented compute, with all evaluation on one laptop CPU. We reach 94.0% at the repository's evaluation goal offset, against 84.0% for the authors' own released checkpoint measured under our protocol on identical episodes, and we reproduce the reported representation result directly (position probe Pearson r = 0.9988 against a reported 0.996). Reaching that point required four conventions that determine the outcome and appear in no released configuration file: dense action gathering across a frameskip block, a programmatically-set action-encoder width, ImageNet pixel normalisation, and action z-scoring. A reproducer following the released configurations alone obtains a model whose predictor cannot converge. The evaluation protocol is itself contested by the released material. The paper's appendix and the repository's configuration specify different goal offsets and step budgets; on the authors' own weights these yield 14.0% and 84.0%, and only the configuration's values reproduce the reported figure. On fifty identical episodes, changing nothing but how the goal is constructed moves that checkpoint from 84.0% to 8.0%. Two findings generalise. One-step prediction accuracy does not predict long-horizon planning success: across three checkpoints spanning a sevenfold range in prediction error, including the authors' own, it orders short-horizon success monotonically and fails to order long-horizon success at all. And a batch normalisation layer inflated our reported validation loss by up to a factor of 300, concealing a training loss that was flat throughout.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 LeWorldModel 在 TwoRoom 环境上的独立复现研究。作者用约 25 美元的租用算力独立重实现，并在笔记本电脑 CPU 上完成全部评估，在仓库的评估目标偏移下达到 94.0% 的目标达成率，而作者自己发布的 checkpoint 在相同 episode 上按其协议测得的成绩为 84.0%；表示学习结果也被直接复现（位置探针 Pearson r = 0.9988，对应原文报告的 0.996）。然而摘要强调，达到该结果依赖四个未出现在任何发布配置文件中的协议约定，且评估协议本身在发布材料中存在不一致。
Motivation: 论文针对的是 latent world model 复现中评估协议（evaluation protocol）对结果的决定性影响：仅遵循发布配置无法让模型预测器收敛，而不同的目标偏移、步数预算和目标构造方式会让同一 checkpoint 的成绩在 84.0% 与 8.0% 之间剧烈波动，因此复现者需要识别哪些未文档化的约定实际上决定了结论。
Method: 作者独立重实现 LeWorldModel，识别出四个必要但未写入配置文件的约定：跨 frameskip block 的密集动作采集（dense action gathering）、程序设定的 action-encoder 宽度、ImageNet 像素归一化（pixel normalisation）以及动作 z-scoring。随后在相同 episode 上与作者发布的 checkpoint 对比，并系统检验附录与仓库配置中不同的目标偏移和步数预算，以及 batch normalization 对验证损失的扭曲。
Result: 在仓库评估目标偏移下复现模型达到 94.0%，作者 checkpoint 在同协议下为 84.0%，位置探针 Pearson r 复现为 0.9988（原文 0.996）；仅在作者自身权重上，附录与仓库配置分别给出 14.0% 和 84.0%。此外，单步预测精度不能预测长时程规划成功：横跨七倍预测误差范围的三份 checkpoint 中，它只单调排序短时程成功、完全无法排序长时程成功；batch normalization 层使验证损失被高估至多 300 倍，掩盖了训练损失的平坦。
Conclusion: 摘要的结论是评估协议本身决定了复现结果，且被发布材料内部矛盾所挑战；未文档化的实现约定是复现失败的关键来源。作者还强调两个可泛化的发现：单步预测误差与长时程规划表现脱节，以及 batch normalization 可能严重扭曲损失报告。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SeFoRA: Sketch-Aggregated Federated Low-Rank Adaptation with Heterogeneous Client Ranks
papers.abstract_en: We consider federated parameter efficient fine-tuning of large neural networks with low-rank adaptation (LoRA,~Hu et al.\ 2022). Combining LoRA with federated PEFT introduces challenges absent from either setting alone: clients may use different LoRA ranks, making their factor matrices dimension-incompatible, and factor-wise averaging suffers from a bilinear mismatch. We propose SeFoRA, a sketch-aggregated federated LoRA algorithm in which each client transmits a linear sketch of its local updates, enabling direct aggregation at the federator. As a result, SeFoRA alleviates the bilinear mismatch, and allows for aggregation in a small subspace of the full model. We introduce a rank-homogeneous version called SeFoRA-Ho which allows for direct adapter aggregation in this setting. We prove convergence to a neighborhood of the first-order stationary point at rate $\cO(1/T)$ for the rank-homogeneous setting. Numerical experiments on fine-tuning RoBERTa-Large on GLUE datasets show how our algorithms outperform the state-of-the-art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对联邦参数高效微调与 LoRA 结合时出现的客户端异构秩与双线性不匹配问题，提出一种基于线性素描（sketch）聚合的联邦 LoRA 算法 SeFoRA。每个客户端只传输其本地更新的线性素描，使联邦中心可以在完整模型的小子空间内直接聚合，从而缓解双线性不匹配。作者还给出秩同构版本 SeFoRA-Ho，并在该设置下证明了以 O(1/T) 速率收敛到一阶稳定点的邻域；在 RoBERTa-Large 于 GLUE 数据集上的数值实验表明其优于现有方法。
Motivation: 将 LoRA 引入联邦参数高效微调时会出现单独任一所没有的困难：客户端可能使用不同的 LoRA 秩，导致因子矩阵维度不兼容；而按因子逐项平均又会遭遇双线性不匹配（bilinear mismatch）。
Method: 提出 SeFoRA，每个客户端将本地更新压缩为线性素描并发送给联邦中心，联邦中心直接在由素描张成的低维子空间中进行聚合；同时引入秩同构版本 SeFoRA-Ho，支持该设置下的直接适配器聚合。
Result: 摘要证明在秩同构设置下算法以 O(1/T) 速率收敛到一阶稳定点的邻域；在 RoBERTa-Large 上使用 GLUE 数据集进行的数值实验显示所提算法优于现有最先进方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调素描聚合能够缓解双线性不匹配并降低聚合子空间维度，但其收敛性证明仅针对秩同构设置，实验验证也限于 RoBERTa-Large 与 GLUE 基准。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Parser Already Knows: Lightweight Bias Correction in Constrained Decoding
papers.abstract_en: Grammar Constrained Decoding (GCD) forces Language Models (LMs) to produce syntactically valid outputs by masking out non-conforming tokens at each step. However, rigid masking distorts the model's underlying probability distribution, often biasing generation toward valid but suboptimal outputs. While online sampling restores this distribution, it requires computationally expensive iterative resampling. As a result, existing methods force a compromise between output quality and inference latency. Our key insight is that the internal parser and lexer states inherently maintained during incremental parsing already encode future grammatical validity -- exactly the information required to restore the LM's true distribution. We propose a lightweight, offline-trained logit correction conditioned on this syntactic and lexical state together with candidate next tokens. Because these states are already computed as a necessary part of incremental parsing for masking, extracting them adds negligible overhead while leaving the base LM's weights completely untouched. Across several grammars, this correction substantially closes the gap between the masked distribution and the LM's true distribution, consistently outperforming both masking and online sampling. Even its lightest variant, which relies on the candidate next token alone, still matches or exceeds both baselines: the next token itself carries an implicit lookahead, much like how parsers commonly use a lookahead token to resolve ambiguous decisions. By restoring the probability mass that masking removes, it reconciles the LM's probabilistic integrity with grammar conformance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语法约束解码 (Grammar Constrained Decoding, GCD) 中硬性掩码扭曲语言模型概率分布、导致生成偏向合法但次优输出的问题，提出一种轻量级、离线训练的对数几率修正 (logit correction)。其核心洞察是增量解析过程中解析器与词法分析器内部已维护的状态已经编码了未来语法合法性，可直接用于条件化修正，几乎不增加开销且不改动基础 LM 权重。摘要报告该方法在多种语法上显著缩小了掩码分布与 LM 真实分布之间的差距，并在一致性上优于纯掩码和在线采样。
Motivation: GCD 通过逐步掩蔽不合规 token 强制输出语法有效，但刚性掩码会扭曲模型原有概率分布；在线采样虽可恢复分布却需昂贵的迭代重采样。现有方法被迫在输出质量与推理延迟之间折中。
Method: 提出一种离线训练的轻量级 logit 修正，以候选下一 token 及增量解析中已有的句法/词法状态为条件，恢复被掩码移除的概率质量。由于这些状态本就是掩码所需的增量解析的一部分，提取它们仅带来可忽略的额外开销，基础 LM 的权重保持完全不变。
Result: 在多种语法上，该修正显著缩小了掩码分布与 LM 真实分布之间的差距，并一致优于纯掩码与在线采样；其最轻量变体仅依赖候选下一 token，仍能达到或超过两个基线。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，通过恢复掩码移除的概率质量，该方法能调和 LM 的概率完整性与语法合规性之间的冲突。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: P3CA: Encoder-Agnostic Interpretation of Vision Foundation Model Embeddings via Spatial Probing
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models are increasingly used as reusable encoders in medical image computing, yet their high-dimensional spatial embeddings are difficult to inspect beyond downstream task performance or global dimensionality reduction. We propose position-prompted PCA (P3CA), an encoder-agnostic method for local probing of channel-rich spatial tensors. Given a user-selected spatial prompt, P3CA estimates the feature normalization and dominant covariance directions within that region, then applies the resulting projection to the full tensor to visualize where locally informative directions are expressed. This produces a region-conditioned representation lens without modifying the encoder, retraining, or requiring task-specific labels. We implement P3CA in EmbedVision, an interactive 3D Slicer-based workflow, and evaluate it across natural images, colorectal pathology foundation-model embeddings, and spatial transcriptomic tensors. Across these settings, prompted projections reveal local structure suppressed by global PCA, improve prompt-matched pathology discrimination from frozen three-dimensional projections, and support comparison between learned and measured spatial representations.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Accepted at the iMIMIC Workshop, MICCAI 2026. This arXiv version is the pre-peer-review author manuscript
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 P3CA（position-prompted PCA），一种与编码器无关的局部探测方法，用于检查视觉基础模型产生的高维空间张量。给定用户选择的空间提示，P3CA 估计该区域的特征归一化和主导协方差方向，再应用投影到全张量，以可视化局部信息方向的空间表达。作者在自然图像、结直肠病理基础模型嵌入和空间转录组张量上评估，发现提示投影能揭示被全局 PCA 压制的局部结构，并改善提示匹配的病理判别。
Motivation: 视觉基础模型在医学图像计算中常被用作可复用编码器，但其高维空间嵌入除了下游任务性能或全局降维外难以检查，缺少局部空间层面的探测工具。
Method: P3CA 通过用户选择的空间提示，估计该区域内的特征归一化与主导协方差方向（即局部 PCA），再将所得投影应用于整个张量，形成区域条件化的表示镜头。方法无需修改编码器、无需重训练，也不依赖任务标签；作者将其实现为基于 3D Slicer 的交互式工作流 EmbedVision。
Result: 在自然图像、结直肠病理基础模型嵌入和空间转录组张量上，提示投影揭示了被全局 PCA 掩盖的局部结构，从冻结的三维投影中改善了提示匹配的病理判别，并支持学习得到与实测空间表示之间的比较。
Conclusion: P3CA 提供了一种编码器无关的局部探测方式，不修改编码器也不需重训练，适用于跨不同数据类型的空间嵌入检查与比较。

papers.title: Procedural Fairness Failures in RLHF from Preference Averaging
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) aggregates heterogeneous preferences into a single reward model, assuming preference homogeneity. When preferences are heterogeneous, this aggregation induces a procedural fairness failure where majority preference groups dominate reward learning while minority preferences are systematically under-represented. This work defines procedural fairness in alignment as preserving distinct preference signals during reward modeling and shows that standard RLHF violates this via preference averaging. Preference-Aware RLHF (PA-RLHF) is introduced, separating optimization across preference modes at the reward learning stage. In a controlled setting, PA-RLHF improves overall alignment accuracy from 46.9% to 67.9% and reduces the fairness gap between best and worst aligned groups from 15.9 to 9.6 percentage points. These results show that procedural fairness failures in alignment can arise from structural design choices in reward learning, even in controlled, noise-free settings, with direct implications for large language models and agentic systems, where biased reward models can compound inequities across sequential decisions.
papers.comment: 4 pages, Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Algorithmic Fairness Across Alignment Procedures and Agentic Systems (AFAA)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 RLHF（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback）在聚合异构人类偏好时产生的程序公平性（procedural fairness）失败问题。作者将对齐中的程序公平性定义为奖励建模阶段保留不同偏好信号，并指出标准 RLHF 通过对偏好平均（preference averaging）违反这一要求，导致多数偏好群体主导奖励学习而少数偏好被系统性忽视。为此提出 Preference-Aware RLHF (PA-RLHF)，在奖励学习阶段按偏好模式分离优化；在受控无噪声设置下，该方法将整体对齐准确率从 46.9% 提升到 67.9%，并将对齐最好与最差群体间的公平差距从 15.9 个百分点缩小到 9.6 个百分点。
Motivation: RLHF 默认假设偏好同质，但实际人类偏好是异构的；当偏好异构时，平均化聚合会让多数偏好主导奖励学习，少数偏好被低估，从而在程序层面产生公平性失败。作者希望揭示这种失败源于奖励学习的结构性设计选择，而不仅是噪声或数据问题。
Method: 首先定义对齐中的程序公平性为在奖励建模过程中保留不同的偏好信号，并论证标准 RLHF 的偏好平均违反了该定义。接着引入 PA-RLHF，在奖励学习阶段将优化过程按偏好模式（preference modes）分离，而不是把异构偏好压缩进单一奖励模型。
Result: 在受控设置下，PA-RLHF 将整体对齐准确率从 46.9% 提高到 67.9%，并将对齐最好与最差群体之间的公平差距从 15.9 个百分点降至 9.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，即使在没有噪声的受控环境中，对齐中的程序公平性失败也可能仅由奖励学习的结构设计引起；这对大型语言模型和智能体系统有直接影响，因为有偏的奖励模型会在顺序决策中放大不平等。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ChronoSSM: Training for Temporally Aware Representations in Autoregressive State Space Models
papers.abstract_en: Modern sequence models, from Transformers to State Space Models, have enabled powerful generative modeling across diverse domains, yet they are typically trained to predict what happens while treating when it happens as a secondary concern. In data-mining settings where events are associated with explicit timing information, this separation can limit temporal reasoning, anomaly detection, and faithful reconstruction of event chronology. A common strategy is to treat timing as an auxiliary signal, training a separate timing model using representations learned solely for event prediction. However, this two-stage approach implicitly assumes that representations optimized for event prediction already contain sufficient temporal structure. We introduce ChronoSSM, an autoregressive State Space Model (SSM) that jointly models events and timestamps with a shared backbone trained using combined token and temporal generation objectives. We compare the joint regime, where temporal supervision updates the backbone, with the two-stage regime, where timing is learned only using the frozen event representations. Across four domains spanning dense and partial timestamp supervision, joint training consistently makes inter-arrival information more recoverable from frozen representations without any systematic degradation in content-generation quality overall. Our results show that temporal supervision can produce more temporally informative representations without materially degrading autoregressive event modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ChronoSSM，一种自回归状态空间模型 (SSM)，用共享主干联合建模事件与时间戳，并以 token 生成和时间生成两种目标联合训练。作者在四个覆盖稠密与部分时间戳监督的领域上对比联合训练与两阶段训练（仅用冻结事件表示学习时间），发现联合训练使冷冻表示中的到达间隔信息更可恢复，且未系统性损害内容生成质量。
Motivation: 现有序列模型通常只预测事件内容而把时间当作次要问题，在带显式时间戳的数据挖掘场景中会限制时间推理、异常检测和事件时序重建。常见做法是把时间作为辅助信号、用事件预测学到的表示单独训练时间模型，但这隐含假设事件表示已包含足够的时间结构。
Method: ChronoSSM 是一个自回归 SSM，采用共享主干同时建模事件和时间戳，训练目标结合 token 生成与时间生成；并与两阶段基线（冻结事件表示后再学时间）进行对比，评估时间监督对骨干网络的影响。
Result: 在四个跨稠密和部分时间戳监督的领域上，联合训练一致地使冷冻表示中的到达间隔信息更易恢复，且没有带来内容生成质量的系统性下降；即时间监督能产生更具时间信息量的表示，而不明显损害自回归事件建模。
Conclusion: 摘要强调联合时间监督可以在不牺牲事件建模质量的前提下提升表示的时间信息量；但未给出具体领域名称或量化指标，时间目标与事件目标之间的权衡范围也未被展开。
Relevance: 12

papers.title: MESA:Task-Adaptive Multi-Structure Evidence Selection for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon agents accumulate trajectories spanning hundreds of interleaved reasoning, action, and observation steps, where answering a query may depend on evidence buried far back in the history. External memory stores such trajectories as structured representations, yet each structure provides a distinct and incomplete view. Existing multi-memory systems either read a fixed set of structures for every query, inflating context and introducing noise, or route each query to a single structure, preventing the composition of complementary evidence. A controlled analysis on AMA-Bench shows that the optimal memory configuration is typically neither a single structure nor the full union, but a tailored composition of multiple structural memories that varies with query and task demands. Motivated by these findings, we formulate structure-level dynamic selection: selecting and fusing a query-adaptive subset from a library of specialized memory structures. We propose MESA (a Multi-structure Evidence Selection framework for long-horizon Agent), which builds five complementary structure views of each trajectory and learns from end-to-end answer-level feedback to select and fuse a query-specific subset for a frozen answer model. To learn under this weak supervision, MESA employs harness optimization with prior-guided search and UCB-guided scheduling to balance exploration and exploitation. On AMA-Bench, MESA outperforms the strongest baseline by 8.5% while using 41% fewer evidence tokens than the all-structure alternative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长时程智能体（long-horizon agent）在跨多步推理、动作和观察轨迹中回答查询时需要从外部记忆中检索证据的问题，提出结构级动态选择方法 MESA。作者通过 AMA-Bench 上的受控分析发现最优记忆配置既不是单一结构也不是全部结构，而是随查询和任务变化的多个结构记忆的定制组合。MESA 构建每个轨迹的五个互补结构视图，利用端到端答案级反馈学习为冻结的答案模型选择和融合查询特定子集。
Motivation: 现有多记忆系统要么对每个查询读取固定结构集，增加上下文并引入噪声；要么将每个查询路由到单一结构，阻碍互补证据的组成。AMA-Bench 上的受控分析表明最优记忆配置是多个结构记忆的定制组合，因而需要结构级动态选择。
Method: MESA 构建五个互补结构视图，并从端到端答案级反馈中学习，以选择和融合查询特定子集用于冻结答案模型。在弱监督下，采用带先验引导搜索的 harness 优化和 UCB 引导调度来平衡探索与利用。
Result: 在 AMA-Bench 上，MESA 比最强基线提升 8.5%，同时比全结构方案少用 41% 的证据 token。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结构级动态选择能根据查询和任务需求组合互补记忆，在减少上下文的同时提升性能。局限等未在摘要中明确说明。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: 4D-WAM: 4D Consistent World Modeling for Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Emerging World-Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated promising performance in autonomous driving by jointly modeling future driving scene evolution and trajectory planning. However, existing WAMs are typically trained with video data, which is only 2D projections of the underlying 4D driving scene. Consequently, WAMs fail to understand and capture the structure of 4D scenes and thus generate visually plausible yet 4D inconsistent future predictions that mislead downstream planning. To alleviate this issue, we present 4D-WAM, a model that leverages geometric foundation models for training-time supervision to enable 4D consistent world modeling. Specifically, we feed WAM-predicted future frames into a geometric foundation model, and use 4D-aware responses to define a 4D consistency loss. This loss encourages the model to understand, represent, and predict physically consistent 4D scenes during training, without additional inference cost. Moreover, we identify an early-decision phenomenon in WAMs and propose a decision-oriented timestep sampling strategy that emphasizes supervision at early, high-noise stages, where driving decisions are primarily formed. By propagating 4D supervision to this critical decision-formation phase, the proposed strategy further improves trajectory planning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that 4D-WAM effectively models 4D consistent scene evolution and achieves state-of-the-art performance on challenging NAVSIM-v1 and NAVSIM-v2 benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 4D-WAM，一种用于自动驾驶的 4D 一致世界建模方法，针对现有 World-Action Models（WAMs）仅用视频（2D 投影）训练、无法捕捉 4D 驾驶场景结构的问题。方法在训练时借助几何基础模型提供 4D 一致性监督，并引入面向决策的时间步采样策略，在不增加推理开销的情况下提升轨迹规划，在 NAVSIM-v1 和 NAVSIM-v2 基准上取得最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有 WAMs 只利用视频数据训练，视频仅是底层 4D 驾驶场景的 2D 投影，导致模型难以理解和表示 4D 场景结构，生成的未来预测虽然视觉上合理但 4D 不一致，会误导下游规划。
Method: 将 WAM 预测的未来帧输入几何基础模型，利用 4D 感知响应定义 4D 一致性损失，在训练时促使模型理解、表示并预测物理一致的 4D 场景。同时识别出 WAMs 中的早期决策现象，提出决策导向的时间步采样策略，重点监督早期高噪声阶段，并将 4D 监督传播到这一关键决策形成阶段。
Result: 大量实验表明 4D-WAM 能有效建模 4D 一致的场景演化，并在 NAVSIM-v1 和 NAVSIM-v2 挑战性基准上达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练时的 4D 一致性监督结合决策导向时间步采样，可以在不增加推理成本的前提下改善轨迹规划与 4D 场景建模。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Hand-Written PTX Tensor-Core GEMM Kernels: A Multi-Precision Study on NVIDIA L4
papers.abstract_en: High-performance Tensor Core kernels rely on a low-level PTX pipeline built from asynchronous data movement with cp.async, warp-level matrix loads with ldmatrix, and matrix multiply-accumulate operations with mma.sync. However, most application code accesses Tensor Cores indirectly through the WMMA C++ API. This paper asks a focused, practical question: when does replacing WMMA with hand-written PTX actually pay off? To answer this question, we conduct a controlled, single-GPU study on an NVIDIA L4 GPU (Ada, SM89), comparing double-buffered WMMA baselines with a family of hand-written PTX GEMM kernels across FP16, INT8, and INT4 arithmetic and square problem sizes from $N=512$ to $N=8192$. Every kernel is profiled with Nsight Compute across the full metric set, and PTX speedups are reported relative to the corresponding same-precision WMMA baseline. Hand-written PTX provides no end-to-end speedup for FP16, because its instruction-level gains are offset by operand-packing overhead. In contrast, the PTX kernels achieve consistent speedups of 1.4x-1.8x for INT8, driven primarily by lower instruction counts and better global-memory coalescing, and 2.9x-4.3x for INT4, where native mma.sync.m16n8k64.s4 execution avoids the software-emulated sequence used by the WMMA path. Relative to the FP16 WMMA baseline, the best quantized kernels reach 34.4x (INT8) and 98.7x (INT4) at $N=8192$. Across these experiments, occupancy is a poor predictor of throughput. For large matrices, performance instead tracks memory-system behavior -- particularly global-load coalescing and DRAM-active cycles -- more closely than Tensor Core utilization. These results identify the precisions and operating regimes in which the additional complexity of hand-written PTX is justified.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Code and profiling data: https://github.com/MattJBorowski1991/TensorCorePTX (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21815137)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在NVIDIA L4 GPU（Ada, SM89）上对手写PTX与WMMA C++ API实现的Tensor Core GEMM内核做了受控的单卡对比，覆盖FP16、INT8、INT4精度及N=512到N=8192的方阵规模。摘要报告FP16下PTX无端到端加速，INT8获得1.4x-1.8x加速，INT4获得2.9x-4.3x加速；占用率对吞吐量的预测力差，大矩阵性能更受内存系统行为影响。
Motivation: 大多数应用代码通过WMMA API间接访问Tensor Core，但手写PTX在什么场景下真正值得额外复杂度，缺乏受控实验证据。该论文针对这一实际问题，在单一GPU上系统比较WMMA基线与手写PTX内核。
Method: 在NVIDIA L4上实现双缓冲WMMA基线，并构建一系列基于cp.async、ldmatrix和mma.sync的手写PTX GEMM内核；跨FP16、INT8、INT4精度和多种方阵规模，用Nsight Compute采集完整指标集，报告相对同精度WMMA基线的加速比。
Result: FP16下PTX无端到端加速，指令级收益被操作数打包开销抵消；INT8获得1.4x-1.8x稳定加速，主要源于更低指令数和更好的全局内存合并（global-memory coalescing）；INT4获得2.9x-4.3x加速，因原生mma.sync.m16n8k64.s4执行避免了WMMA路径的软件模拟。相对FP16 WMMA基线，最佳量化内核在N=8192下达到34.4x（INT8）和98.7x（INT4）。对于大矩阵，吞吐量更紧密跟随全局加载合并和DRAM-active周期，而非Tensor Core利用率。
Conclusion: 作者认为手写PTX的额外复杂度仅在特定精度和操作规模下有理由采用：INT8与INT4的大矩阵场景收益明显，而FP16收益被开销抵消；同时指出占用率不是吞吐量的可靠预测指标，内存系统行为才是大矩阵性能的主导因素。

papers.title: Exploring Semantic Stability Across Reviews in the Linux Kernel
papers.abstract_en: Code review is credited with substantially changing a patch's code between its first submission and the version that eventually lands. However, prior work typically studied only the final merged patch without comparing it to the first submission. We present a function-level measurement that tracks 10,117 trajectories (each function followed across the numbered revisions of one patch series) through the patch history of the Linux IIO subsystem, comparing similarity scores against unrelated function pairs as a baseline. A naive reading yields near-total similarity, but this is largely an artifact of composition: 75.3% of tracked trajectories are never textually modified between versions, contributing a trivial 100% similarity that inflates the headline. Restricting to the trajectories with a real edit, semantic purpose is still largely preserved (mean similarity 0.990 vs. a 0.909 baseline), but drift appears to concentrate in the first review round mainly because later rounds contain more functions that nobody touched, not because edits become more conservative over time. After controlling for it, a statistically detectable but small residual effect remains. This points to an open question: whether near-ceiling similarity reflects preserved purpose or a measurement tool that cannot detect the significance of small, localized edits. We present this work as a first look and outline next steps.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对代码评审 (code review) 对补丁语义的影响提出一种函数级测量方法，跟踪 Linux IIO 子系统的 10,117 条函数轨迹（每条函数跨补丁系列的编号修订版本）并与不相关函数对作相似度基线对比。摘要指出，粗略阅读会得到近乎完全的相似度，但这很大程度上是构成性假象：75.3% 的轨迹从未被文本修改，贡献了 100% 的相似度。限定在真正被编辑的轨迹后，语义目的仍大体保留（平均相似度 0.990，基线为 0.909），但漂移主要集中在第一轮评审；控制构成效应后，仍存在统计上可检测但很小的残余效应。
Motivation: 先前工作通常只研究最终合并的补丁，而未将其与首次提交版本比较，因此缺乏对评审过程中补丁语义稳定性的直接度量。
Method: 提出函数级测量，追踪每个函数在一个补丁系列各编号修订中的轨迹，用相似度分数与不相关函数对的基线进行比较；并通过对未编辑轨迹的分解来区分构成性假象与真实语义漂移。
Result: 75.3% 的被追踪轨迹从未被修改；在真正发生编辑的轨迹中，平均相似度为 0.990，高于 0.909 的基线。漂移主要出现在第一轮评审，原因是后续轮次包含更多未被改动的函数而非编辑变得更保守；控制该效应后仍存在统计显著但很小的残余效应。
Conclusion: 接近上限的相似度引出一个开放问题：它反映的是语义目的被保留，还是测量工具无法检测小的局部编辑的重要性。作者将其定位为初步探索，并列出后续研究步骤。

papers.title: Deciding When to Switch: E-Processes for Adaptive Minimax Training for Generative Adversarial Nets
papers.abstract_en: Modern data science increasingly gives rise to hypothesis-testing problems that are not naturally formulated in terms of parameters within prespecified statistical models. One important example is the dynamic evaluation of optimization algorithms, where decisions must be made during training about whether further updates remain beneficial or the algorithm should switch to a different phase. This issue is particularly relevant in stochastic min-max optimization. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) provide a canonical example, as their training requires repeated decisions about when to switch between discriminator and generator updates, yet existing methods typically rely on fixed update ratios or heuristic criteria. We formulate this switching problem as sequential hypothesis testing and develop an e-process-based adaptive training procedure. During discriminator updates, one e-process tests the null that the discriminator-induced separation between the empirical data distribution and the generator law remains below a target level. During generator updates, with the discriminator fixed, a second e-process tests the reverse null that this separation remains above a refresh level. Conditional on the observed training sample, we prove that fresh empirical indices and latent draws yield conditional e-values that can be accumulated into e-processes, providing anytime-valid Type I error control under adaptive model updates and data-dependent switching. Across multimodal synthetic distributions and image benchmark datasets, the proposed method matches or outperforms the best fixed-ratio baselines under several widely used GAN objectives.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生成对抗网络 (GAN) 训练中判别器与生成器更新切换依赖固定比例或启发式准则的问题，提出基于 e-process 的自适应训练过程。作者将切换问题建模为序贯假设检验 (sequential hypothesis testing)，并证明在自适应模型更新和数据依赖切换下具有 anytime-valid Type I error 控制。在多种多峰合成分布和图像基准数据集上，该方法匹配或优于最佳固定比例基线。
Motivation: GAN 训练需要在判别器和生成器更新之间反复决定何时切换，现有方法通常依赖固定更新比例或启发式准则，缺乏原理性的切换决策框架。
Method: 将切换问题形式化为序贯假设检验：判别器更新时，一个 e-process 检验判别器诱导的经验数据分布与生成器分布之间的分离度是否低于目标水平；生成器更新时，固定判别器并用第二个 e-process 检验该分离度是否高于刷新水平。条件于观测训练样本，新的经验索引和潜变量采样产生条件 e-values，可累积为 e-process。
Result: 证明在自适应模型更新和数据依赖切换下提供 anytime-valid Type I error 控制；在多种多峰合成分布和图像基准数据集上，方法匹配或优于多个常用 GAN 目标下的最佳固定比例基线。
Conclusion: 该方法为 GAN 训练提供了一种基于 e-process 的自适应切换程序，避免了固定更新比例，并具备可验证的错误控制保证。

papers.title: Signpost Watermarking: Joint Optimization for Visual Watermark Coexistence
papers.abstract_en: We present a method for training imperceptible visual watermarks to coexist with other such watermarks. Recent work has shown that independently trained image watermarking models can coexist with surprisingly limited interference, enabling watermark ensembling. However, this coexistence is a serendipitous property rather than an explicit optimization objective, leaving interference uncontrolled and potentially reducing decoding robustness or visual quality. We first show empirically that the same coexistence property extends to video watermarking. We then show that both image and video watermarks can be trained with a decoder-aware objective to improve coexistence. Our results suggest a practical path to signpost watermarks that indicate the presence of independently deployed provenance watermarking systems, supporting layered provenance signaling for content authenticity and rights.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种训练不可感知视觉水印以与其他水印共存的方法，核心思想是把共存性从偶然属性变为显式优化目标。作者先实验证明视频水印也具备与图像水印类似的共存性，再提出带解码器感知 (decoder-aware) 的训练目标来同时改善图像和视频水印的共存表现。结果指向所谓 signpost 水印的实际路径，即用独立部署的来源水印系统指示其存在，支持多层溯源信号。
Motivation: 现有工作表明独立训练的水印模型可以偶然地共存，但这种共存并非显式优化目标，干扰不可控，可能损害解码鲁棒性或视觉质量。
Method: 提出一种解码器感知的联合优化目标，在训练不可感知视觉水印时显式考虑与其他水印的共存，并将该方法同时应用于图像水印和视频水印训练。
Result: 摘要报告：实验上验证了同样的共存性质也适用于视频水印；通过解码器感知目标训练后，图像和视频水印的共存性均得到改善。
Conclusion: 该方法为 signpost 水印提供了可行路径，即指示独立部署的来源水印系统的存在，从而支持面向内容真实性与权利的多层溯源信号。

papers.title: CHORUS: Complementary Experts for High-Coverage Testbench Stimulus Generation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced code generation, where executable feedback provides a more reliable learning signal than textual imitation alone. Hardware verification is an important application of code generation and accounts for a substantial fraction of modern chip design effort, with high-coverage testbench stimulus generation as a key task. We present CHORUS, a post-training framework that pushes performance beyond what a conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT)-to-reinforcement learning (RL) pipeline achieves. CHORUS builds on two observations. First, staged SFT produces behaviorally diverse checkpoints, and dense-reward RL turns them into strong experts with comparable aggregate performance but distinct task-level strengths. Second, these complementary strengths can be exploited through either training-free model merging or further post-training to outperform the best individual expert. By consolidating the resulting specialists into a single 4B model, CHORUS achieves 88.0% Pass@1 on CVDP-ECov, outperforming DeepSeek-R1 (671B) by 13.5 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CHORUS，一个面向硬件验证中高覆盖率测试台激励生成 (testbench stimulus generation) 的后训练框架。该方法基于两个观察：分阶段 SFT 产生行为多样的检查点，稠密奖励 RL 将它们变成聚合性能相当但任务级优势不同的强专家；这些互补优势可通过免训练模型合并或进一步后训练来利用。将专家整合为单一 4B 模型后，CHORUS 在 CVDP-ECov 上达到 88.0% 的 Pass@1，超过 DeepSeek-R1 (671B) 13.5 个百分点。
Motivation: 硬件验证是现代芯片设计中的主要成本来源，高覆盖率测试台激励生成是关键任务；LLM 代码生成虽已进步，但传统 SFT 到 RL 的流水线性能有限，需要新的后训练方法来突破。
Method: 提出 CHORUS 后训练框架：先通过分阶段 SFT 得到行为多样的检查点，再用稠密奖励 RL 将它们转化为互补的强专家；随后通过免训练模型合并或进一步后训练整合这些专家，最终将多个专家合并为单一 4B 模型。
Result: 摘要报告 CHORUS 在 CVDP-ECov 基准上达到 88.0% 的 Pass@1，比 DeepSeek-R1 (671B) 高出 13.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调互补专家可以被合并成单一模型，且性能优于任何单个最佳专家，表明后训练中的专家多样性可以成为超越常规流水线的有效杠杆。

papers.title: Status Association Does Not Reliably Predict Decision Leakage
papers.abstract_en: Bias evaluations often move too quickly from evidence that a model encodes a social association to claims that the same association will alter consequential decisions. We test whether that inference is warranted using Chilean surnames as controlled socioeconomic probes. We evaluate eight frozen model-provider cells on 1,032 prompts each, yielding 8,256 verified primary responses. The design separates forced latent association from matched consequential decisions across academic selection, professional hiring, research fellowship selection, and legal-aid intake. Elite-coded surnames received higher forced high-status probability mass than common surnames in seven of eight models and higher mass than rare-frequency controls in all eight. Yet elite-minus-common decision effects were close to zero for most systems. Five models were statistically equivalent within a predeclared (Plus-Minus)0.10 standard-deviation margin, while the remaining three were imprecise or borderline, with no consistent elite advantage. Association strength did not reliably predict decision leakage across models (r = 0.201, p = 0.633) or across frozen surname-pair-by-model cells (r = 0.065, p = 0.565). The central result is a measurement dissociation: latent social association and consequential treatment are empirically distinct constructs. Evaluations should measure the transition from association to action directly.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验一个常见推断：模型编码了某种社会关联，就必然会在重要决策中表现出相应的偏见。作者以智利姓氏作为社会经济地位的受控探针，在八个冻结模型-供应商组合上各评估 1,032 个提示，共收集 8,256 条经核验的主响应，覆盖学术选拔、职业招聘、研究基金遴选和法律援助分诊场景。结果显示七个模型确实给精英姓氏更高的强制高地位概率质量，但精英-普通姓氏的决策效应在多数系统中接近零，关联强度与决策泄露之间无可靠相关，构成测量上的解离。
Motivation: 偏见评估常常从模型编码了社会关联的证据，直接跳到该关联会改变后果性决策的结论；本文旨在检验这种推断是否成立。
Method: 使用智利姓氏作为受控的社会经济探针，将强制潜在关联（forced latent association）与匹配的后果性决策（consequential decision）分离测量；对八个冻结模型-供应商组合各运行 1,032 个提示，并预先声明统计等价性判定标准。
Result: 七个模型对精英编码姓氏给出比普通姓氏更高的高地位概率质量，八个模型均高于罕见频率对照；但精英减普通决策效应在多数系统中接近零，五个模型在预先声明的 ±0.10 标准差范围内统计等价，其余三个不精确或处于边界。跨模型关联强度与决策泄露的相关为 r = 0.201（p = 0.633），跨姓氏-模型单元为 r = 0.065（p = 0.565）。
Conclusion: 潜在社会关联与后果性对待在经验上是两个不同的构念，评估应当直接测量从关联到行动的转化，而不是仅凭关联证据推断决策偏见。

papers.title: When Repository Labels Are Not Image-Level Truth: A Supervision Auditing Framework for Chest Radiograph AI
papers.abstract_en: Public chest X-ray repositories are widely used to train medical AI systems, yet their labels are typically extracted from radiology reports rather than verified directly on images. As a result, repository labels are often treated as image-level ground truth without validating whether they reflect what is actually visible in the radiograph. We introduce Repository Supervision Auditing (RSA), a framework that evaluates repository-derived labels against expert image-level annotations before model development. Using cardiomegaly in MIMIC-CXR as a case study, RSA compares repository labels with radiologist-reviewed image annotations, characterizes disagreement sources, and builds a curated cohort for deployment-oriented evaluation. Repository-derived cardiomegaly labels showed near-zero agreement with expert image-level assessment, identifying only 1% of expert-confirmed cases. Most discrepancies resulted from non-mention rather than explicit report negation, with expert-confirmed cardiomegaly identified in nearly half of studies assigned a repository-derived No Finding label. Using the resulting expert-curated cohort, a DenseNet121 model achieved a test ROC-AUC of 0.853. These findings show that repository labels may not reliably represent image-level truth and highlight supervision auditing as a critical step for developing trustworthy medical imaging AI.
papers.comment: Accepted (oral) at the 3rd MICCAI Student Board (MSB) EMERGE Workshop, MICCAI 2026. This is the authors' version; the final authenticated version will appear in Springer Lecture Notes in Computer Science (LNCS). 10 pages, 3 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Repository Supervision Auditing (RSA) 框架，用于在模型开发前评估公共胸部 X 光存储库标签是否反映图像级真实标注。以 MIMIC-CXR 中的心脏肥大 (cardiomegaly) 为例，RSA 将存储库标签与放射科医生审阅的图像注释对比，发现存储库衍生标签与专家图像评估几乎零一致，仅识别出 1% 的专家确认病例，且专家确认病例中近一半被存储库标记为 No Finding。基于专家整理队列训练的 DenseNet121 测试 ROC-AUC 为 0.853。
Motivation: 公共胸部 X 光存储库标签通常从放射学报告中提取而非在图像上直接验证，却被当作图像级真值用于训练医疗 AI，缺乏对标签是否反映影像可见内容的验证，可能导致模型评估与部署不可靠。
Method: 提出 Repository Supervision Auditing (RSA) 框架：将存储库派生的标签与放射科医生复核的图像级注释进行对比，刻画不一致来源，并构建专家整理队列用于面向部署的评估；以 MIMIC-CXR 心脏肥大作为案例研究。
Result: 存储库衍生的心脏肥大标签与专家图像评估的近乎零一致性，只识别出 1% 的专家确认病例；不一致主要来自报告未提及而非明确否定，近一半被标记为 No Finding 的研究中实际存在专家确认的心脏肥大；在专家整理队列上 DenseNet121 测试 ROC-AUC 为 0.853。
Conclusion: 摘要表明存储库标签可能无法可靠代表图像级真值，强调监督审计 (supervision auditing) 是开发可信医学影像 AI 的关键步骤。

papers.title: Mysterious Transients in the Palomar Observatory Sky Survey (POSS-1) as profound manifestation of the Dark Matter physics
papers.abstract_en: Transient star-like objects of unknown origin have been identified in the first Palomar Observatory Sky Survey (POSS-1) as part of the Vanishing and Appearing Sources during a Century of Observations (VASCO) project. The source of the transients recorded by POSS-1 remains unknown, which is the warrant to coin the observed phenomena as Mysterious Transients (MT). We advocate an idea that the dark matter (DM) in form of the axion quark nuggets (AQN) made of standard model quarks (or antiquarks) and gluons, similar to the old idea of the Witten's strangelets, could {\it simultaneously} explain {\it all } the observed MT signals (including very short time scale for flash itself, association with nuclear test timing, observed alignments of several MT events, correlation with UAP reports, etc) collected or recorded for many years. Essentially we argue that the MT is a cousin of Ball Lightning (BL) events, also observed for centuries, without commonly accepted physics explanation. The basic parameters of this model (such as the typical baryon charge of the nuggets) had been fixed long ago by explaining the observed excess of radiation at variety of scales: from galactic to the solar, to local Earth's environments. In this work we use the same framework with the same set of parameters to study the observed MT phenomena. We also suggest several tests which substantiate or refute our proposal. We also present some suggestions on type of instruments required to study this specific (and well defined) type of the UAP events representing the cousins of BL and MT events in the AQN framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出暗物质以轴子夸克团块 (axion quark nuggets, AQN) 形式存在，并试图用它统一解释帕洛马巡天 (POSS-1) 中记录的未知瞬变源 (Mysterious Transients, MT)。作者将 MT 视为球状闪电 (Ball Lightning) 的同类事件，声称同一套已固定的模型参数能同时解释闪光时间尺度、与核试验时间的关联、多个 MT 事件的排列以及 UAP 报告等观测特征。文章还提出若干可验证或推翻该方案的测试，并给出研究这类 UAP/BL/MT 事件所需的仪器建议。
Motivation: POSS-1 中记录的瞬变天体来源未知，长期缺少公认的物理解释；作者希望用此前已用于解释过量辐射的暗物质模型框架来解释这些神秘瞬变现象。
Method: 沿用此前为解释银河系到太阳系乃至地球环境过量辐射而建立的 AQN 模型，使用相同的典型重子数等参数研究 MT 现象，并论证 MT 与球状闪电属于同类事件；同时提出可证伪该框架的观测测试和仪器建议。
Result: 摘要未给出量化实验指标，核心主张是 AQN 暗物质模型能同时解释全部 MT 信号特征，包括极短闪光时标、与核试验时间关联、多事件排列以及与 UAP 报告的相关性。
Conclusion: 作者将该解释作为提议呈现，并列出多项可证实或驳斥该方案的具体测试，同时建议了适合研究这类 UAP/BL/MT 事件的仪器类型；本研究属于理论解释与观测建议，未提供新的实测数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: LEGO: Leveled Language Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: We introduce LEGO for advanced open-vocabulary scene understanding. Beyond basic concept recognition, its core innovation lies in capturing the intrinsic semantic hierarchies within the scene, such as the "flowerpot -> bouquet -> bud -> petal" lineage. While foundation models like SAM can identify multi-granular structures in 2D, their partitions are strictly perspective-bound and lack cross-view consensus. LEGO self-adaptively re-grades volatile multi-view SAM granularities into a unified, 3D-consistent hierarchy. This provides precise supervision for the structurally coherent, multi-level segmentation of 3D scenes. By grounding these segments with CLIP embeddings, LEGO recovers open-vocabulary semantic logic across hierarchical levels. Furthermore, by incorporating spatial relationships, we elevate these segments into level-wise language scene graphs, effectively empowering Large Language Models to perform complex, context-aware spatial reasoning and precise visual grounding. Experimental results demonstrate that LEGO establishes new state-of-the-art performance across both promptable and open-vocabulary 3D segmentation benchmarks, exhibiting advanced hierarchical scene decomposition and context-aware spatial reasoning.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project page: https://pz0826.github.io/LEGO-Webpage/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LEGO，用于开放词汇的三维场景理解，核心创新是捕捉场景内在的语义层级关系，例如“花盆 -> 花束 -> 花蕾 -> 花瓣”的谱系。LEGO 将多视角 SAM 产生的易变粒度自适应地重分级为统一的、三维一致的层级结构，并用 CLIP 嵌入对分割片段进行语义接地，进而结合空间关系构建层级化语言场景图，以支持大语言模型进行上下文感知的空间推理。实验显示其在 promptable 和开放词汇三维分割基准上均达到新的最优性能。
Motivation: SAM 等基础模型虽能在二维识别多粒度结构，但其划分严格受视角限制且缺乏跨视角一致性，无法直接用于三维场景的层级化开放词汇理解。
Method: LEGO 将多视角 SAM 粒度假性进行自适应重分级，形成统一且三维一致的层级结构，作为多级三维分割的结构性监督；随后用 CLIP 嵌入对接地片段进行语义化，并加入空间关系构建层级化语言场景图，使大语言模型能够执行复杂、上下文感知的空间推理与精确视觉接地。
Result: 摘要报告 LEGO 在 promptable 与开放词汇三维分割基准上均建立新的最先进性能，并展现出先进的层级化场景分解和上下文感知空间推理能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为，将易变的二维多粒度分割统一为三维一致层级并结合语言场景图，是恢复开放词汇语义逻辑和赋能大语言模型空间推理的有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Navigating the Proximity-Safety Balance: Constraint Decomposition for Human Following in Pedestrian Crowds
papers.abstract_en: Following a target human in crowded environments involves an inherent conflict between staying close to the target and navigating safely among surrounding pedestrians and obstacles. This conflict becomes more severe in dense scenarios, where aggressive following risks collisions and conservative margins lead to target loss, especially when pedestrian behaviors are unfamiliar or unpredictable. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) methods typically encode these competing objectives into a single dense reward, but the resulting proximity-safety balance is implicit and difficult to adjust across conditions. To address this, we decompose the human-following task into a sparse task reward and independent cost constraints within a multi-constraint RL formulation, where each constraint is managed through cost thresholds with direct behavioral meaning rather than implicit reward weight ratios, allowing explicit and tunable control over the trade-off. We further quantify the prediction uncertainty of human motions and integrate these estimates into the RL costs to enhance safety under unpredictable conditions. Extensive experiments across both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings demonstrate that our method achieves an effective proximity-safety balance compared to baselines. Real-robot deployment further validates the feasibility of our method in real-world scenarios. More details are available on our project page: https://nav-ps-balance.github.io/.
papers.comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026); Project Website: https://nav-ps-balance.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对人群环境中跟随目标行人时的接近-安全 (proximity-safety) 冲突，提出将人类跟随任务分解为稀疏任务奖励与独立成本约束的多约束强化学习 (multi-constraint RL) 框架，并用人体运动预测的不确定性估计增强成本项。实验在分布内与分布外设置下相比基线实现了有效的接近-安全平衡，并在真实机器人上验证了可行性。
Motivation: 现有 RL 方法通常把接近目标与安全导航这两个竞争目标编码进单一密集奖励，导致平衡关系隐式且难以在不同条件下调节；在密集场景中，激进跟随易引发碰撞，保守策略则易丢失目标，尤其在行人行为不熟悉或不可预测时问题更严重。
Method: 将人类跟随任务分解为稀疏任务奖励和独立的成本约束，每个约束通过具有直接行为意义的成本阈值来管理，而不是依赖隐式的奖励权重比例；同时量化行人运动预测的不确定性，并将这些估计集成进 RL 成本以增强不可预测条件下的安全性。
Result: 在分布内和分布外 (in-distribution and out-of-distribution) 设置的广泛实验中，该方法相比基线实现了有效的接近-安全平衡；真实机器人部署进一步验证了其在真实场景中的可行性。

papers.title: Observational Policy Ranking for SMB Financial Guidance from Multi-Action Accounting Logs
papers.abstract_en: Small and medium-sized businesses need timely financial guidance, yet historical accounting logs record self-selected and often co-occurring business changes rather than randomized recommendations. We formulate this setting as observational policy ranking: from pre-decision financial information, a policy selects one of 34 ledger-derived business-change categories for a target financial KPI. Using 85,078 company-month observations from 7,505 firms, we introduce Covariate-Adjusted Residual Policy Learning (CAR-PL), an action-wise R-learner that operates directly on multi-hot logs and regularizes selection by observational support. We compare CAR-PL with an uplift T-Learner, a conservative contextual value model, a zero-shot LLM, and non-personalized references on company-disjoint held-out firms under a shared model-assisted scoring rule. CAR-PL has the highest Gross Profit point estimate (0.084), the T-Learner has the highest Revenue point estimate (0.085), and the contextual value model has the highest Quick Ratio point estimate (0.062). CAR-PL and the T-Learner are not statistically separated on either growth KPI in matched company-clustered comparisons, while CAR-PL selects 33-34 categories and produces less concentrated selections across the catalog. Outcome-model-only scoring retains the same KPI-level point-estimate leader or top pair, and category rankings remain similar when the all-zero treatment reference is replaced by the most common training co-action pattern. These findings support objective-specific ranking of SMB financial guidance from multi-action accounting logs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究中小企业财务指导中的观察性策略排序问题，即从历史多行动会计日志中为给定财务KPI选择账本科目变更类别。作者提出协变量调整残差策略学习 (Covariate-Adjusted Residual Policy Learning, CAR-PL)，一种基于行动级 R-learner 的方法，并在 85,078 个公司-月观测上与其他基线比较。结果显示 CAR-PL 在毛利上点估计最高，T-Learner 在收入上最高，上下文价值模型在速动比率上最高，但 CAR-PL 与 T-Learner 在增长指标上无统计差异，且 CAR-PL 的选择更分散。
Motivation: 中小企业需要及时财务指导，但历史会计日志中的业务变更往往是自我选择且相互共现的，无法依赖随机推荐，因此需要一种能从非随机观察数据中学习策略排序的方法。
Method: 将问题形式化为观察性策略排序，提出 CAR-PL：一个直接作用于多热 (multi-hot) 日志的逐行动 R-learner，并通过观察支持 (observational support) 对选择进行正则化；将其与 uplift T-Learner、保守上下文价值模型、零样本 LLM 及非个性化参考进行比较。
Result: 在 7,505 家公司的 85,078 条公司-月观测上，CAR-PL 的 Gross Profit 点估计最高 (0.084)，T-Learner 的 Revenue 点估计最高 (0.085)，上下文价值模型的 Quick Ratio 点估计最高 (0.062)；配对公司聚类比较中 CAR-PL 与 T-Learner 在增长 KPI 上无统计分离，而 CAR-PL 覆盖 33-34 个类别且选择集中度更低。
Conclusion: 摘要支持从多行动会计日志中对中小企业财务指导进行目标特定的策略排序，并指出点估计领导者在仅结果模型评分和改变参考行动时仍保持稳定。

papers.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning in Prognostics and Health Management: A Systematic Literature Review
papers.abstract_en: In modern industry, keeping complex systems reliable, safe, and efficient hinges on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). Machine Learning (ML) has largely driven advancements in diagnostics and prognostics, yet purely data-driven models face inherent limitations, such as poor generalization, an inability to infer causal relationships, and a lack of interpretability. Physics-Informed Machine Learning (PIML) helps mitigate these limitations by incorporating prior physical knowledge directly into the ML pipeline, thereby fostering growing interest in its application to PHM. This work investigates how PIML is being leveraged in the context of PHM through a systematic literature review of 212 studies. The review introduces a four-class classification scheme, consisting of observational bias, inductive bias, learning bias, and hybrid approaches, and further categorizes studies by PHM task. Across all four classes, the reviewed studies consistently demonstrate improved predictive performance over conventional baselines across a broad range of assets, although the literature is heavily skewed toward lithium-ion batteries and bearings, and dominated by problem-specific solutions. Overall, the review indicates that physics-informed approaches already provide tangible benefits, whereas claims of improvements concerning some of the aforementioned limitations lack sufficient supporting evidence. Future research should prioritize transferable design patterns, benchmarks comparing integration strategies, and uncertainty-aware models that are lightweight and robust enough for online deployment in real-world settings.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对 212 项研究的系统性文献综述，考察物理信息机器学习 (Physics-Informed Machine Learning, PIML) 在故障预测与健康管理 (Prognostics and Health Management, PHM) 中的应用。综述提出了一个四类分类框架，即观测偏差 (observational bias)、归纳偏差 (inductive bias)、学习偏差 (learning bias) 与混合方法 (hybrid approaches)，并按 PHM 任务对研究进行归类。综述发现，四类方法在多种资产上相比常规基线均呈现预测性能提升，但文献严重偏向锂离子电池和轴承，且以特定问题的解决方案为主。
Motivation: 纯数据驱动的机器学习在 PHM 中面临泛化能力差、无法推断因果关系以及缺乏可解释性等固有限制；PIML 通过将先验物理知识直接融入机器学习流程来缓解这些问题，因此有必要系统梳理其在 PHM 中的应用现状。
Method: 采用系统性文献综述方法，纳入 212 项研究；提出包含观察偏差、归纳偏差、学习偏差和混合方法的四类分类方案，并进一步按 PHM 任务对研究进行归类。
Result: 四类方法在广泛的资产类型上均一致地相比常规基线展现出更好的预测性能；然而文献分布高度集中于锂离子电池和轴承，且以问题特定的解决方案为主。
Conclusion: 综述认为物理信息方法已提供切实收益，但关于其改善上述某些局限性的主张缺乏充分证据；未来研究应优先关注可迁移的设计模式、比较不同集成策略的基准测试，以及轻量且鲁棒、适合在线部署的不确定性感知模型。

papers.title: Detecting Soft Skills in ML Engineering Roles CVs
papers.abstract_en: Soft skills shape collaboration among ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers building ML-enabled systems, yet what we know about them comes almost entirely from the demand side. Job advertisements, surveys, and hiring manager interviews capture what employers ask for. How candidates themselves articulate these competencies has not been studied, and existing CV-mining work is both keyword-based, so it cannot see skills conveyed through narrative, and descriptive, reporting frequency rankings without testing whether group differences exceed sampling variation. We close both gaps. Using a balanced corpus of 300 curated CVs spanning the three roles, we extract explicitly listed and implicitly narrated soft skills with an LLM-based pipeline validated against a human-annotated ground truth, a distinction that existing extractors were not designed to make. We then convert the demand-side literature's claims into 13 falsifiable hypotheses about role signatures, seniority progression, and disclosure style, and test them with effect sizes under family-wise error control, so that candidate-side data can corroborate or contradict the demand-side account rather than merely illustrate it. Eleven hypotheses are supported, one partially, and one refuted. Candidates disclose soft skills through narrative rather than keyword lists by roughly three to one, and most so for the competencies employers value most: leadership, coordination, and mentoring (88-96% narrative). Seniority nearly triples the odds of articulating leadership. That competency, assumed universal in prior work, is articulated by software engineers at half the rate of their peers. Technical candidates do articulate soft skills, but a keyword-based screening systematically misses them.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 ML 工程类岗位候选人简历中软技能的表述方式，构建 300 份覆盖 ML 工程师、数据科学家和软件工程师的均衡 CV 语料库，用基于 LLM 的提取管道区分显式列出与隐性叙述的软技能，并用人工标注 ground truth 验证。作者将需求侧文献的论断转化为 13 个可证伪假设，以效应量和族系错误控制（family-wise error control）检验，结果显示 11 个支持、1 个部分支持、1 个被推翻。核心发现是候选人主要通过叙述而非关键词列表披露软技能，比例约为 3:1。
Motivation: 现有关于软技能的知识几乎全部来自需求侧，即招聘广告、调查和面试官访谈，候选人如何表达这些能力未被系统研究。已有 CV 挖掘工作既依赖关键词，无法识别叙事性表述，又止于描述性频率排名，没有检验组间差异是否超过抽样波动。
Method: 构建 300 份精心挑选的均衡 CV 语料，覆盖 ML 工程师、数据科学家和软件工程师三类角色。使用基于 LLM 的提取管道分别识别显式列出和隐性叙述的软技能，并对照人工标注 ground truth 验证；同时将需求侧文献的论断形式化为 13 个关于角色特征、资历进展和披露风格的可证伪假设，采用效应量并控制族系错误率进行检验。
Result: 11 个假设得到支持，1 个部分支持，1 个被推翻。候选人通过叙述而非关键词列表披露软技能的比例约为 3:1，而雇主最看重的领导力、协调和指导能力中 88-96% 是通过叙述表达的。资历使候选人表达领导力的概率接近原来的三倍；软件工程师表达领导力的比率仅为同行的一半，说明该能力并非如先前假设那样普适；关键词式筛选会系统性地漏掉技术候选人的软技能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调候选人侧数据可以证实或反驳需求侧关于软技能的描述，而现有基于关键词的简历筛选会系统性遗漏叙事性软技能，提示相关实践与研究需超越关键词匹配。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Finding the Signal in the Spam: Jointly Learning Rewards and Worker Reliability from Pairwise Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: The problem of learning from pairwise comparisons has been widely studied across many domains such as recommendation systems, social choice, and more recently, fine-tuning large language models. In this problem, the goal is to learn item rewards based on pairwise comparisons between them. In many scenarios, these comparisons are elicited from crowdworkers using platforms such as Amazon Mechanical Turk, Scale AI, etc. However, crowdworkers are often unreliable due to limited domain knowledge or revenue-maximizing (spamming) behavior. In this work, our goal is to understand whether worker reliability (competency) can be learned jointly with item rewards. To this end, we adopt the Boltzmann-rational model for pairwise comparisons, which extends the Bradley-Terry-Luce model by incorporating worker competencies. We derive an EM-based algorithm for learning under this model by introducing Polya-Gamma latent variables to transform the logistic likelihood into a conditionally Gaussian form, enabling tractable optimization and leading to a simplified $Q$ function in the E-step of the algorithm. This technique allows us to reduce our formulation to a matrix sensing problem, using which we establish theoretical convergence guarantees for our algorithm. We conduct extensive experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets. These experiments demonstrate the advantages of using our algorithm over several baselines and confirm its strong robustness to both spammers and adversarial workers, highlighting its practical effectiveness in realistic crowdsourcing and reward learning settings. The code and data is publicly available at https://github.com/KaustubhShejole/BoRa_EM.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI 2026), Amsterdam, Netherlands, August 17-21, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从不完全可靠的众包工人给出的成对比较中学习物品奖励。作者采用 Boltzmann-rational 模型（Bradley-Terry-Luce 模型的扩展），通过引入 Polya-Gamma 潜变量将 logistic 似然转化为条件高斯形式，推导出 EM 算法，并把问题化为矩阵感知 (matrix sensing) 问题，同时给出理论收敛保证。真实与合成数据上的实验表明，该算法优于多个基线，并且对垃圾信息工人与对抗性工人具有强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 成对比较数据常来自 Amazon Mechanical Turk 等众包平台，但工人可能因领域知识有限或追求收益最大化而不可靠（spamming）。现有工作大多隐式假设工人可靠，因此有必要研究能否在估计物品奖励的同时联合学习工人能力（可靠性）。
Method: 采用 Boltzmann-rational 成对比较模型，显式引入工人能力（competency）参数；通过引入 Polya-Gamma 潜变量把 logistic 似然改写为条件高斯形式，从而推导出 EM 算法，使 E 步的 Q 函数形式简化，并将原问题转化为矩阵感知问题以建立收敛性保证。
Result: 在真实与合成数据集上的大量实验显示，所提出的算法相对于多个基线具有优势，并且对垃圾信息工人和对抗性工人表现出很强的鲁棒性，说明其在真实众包与奖励学习场景中的实用效果。
Conclusion: 作者认为联合学习物品奖励与工人可靠性在众包成对比较和奖励学习中是可行且有效的，并公开了代码与数据。

papers.title: UserToolBench: A User-Profile-Hidden Benchmark for Personalized Decision Making in Tool-Use LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Tool-use LLMs are increasingly asked to act on users' behalf, but existing benchmarks usually focus on profile recall, style imitation, generic tool use, or response-level personalization. We introduce UserToolBench , a benchmark for personalized decision making in tool-use LLMs. UserToolBench tests whether a model can infer latent user preferences from interaction history, recognize when clarification is needed, and produce user-aligned tool-call trajectories under incomplete information. The benchmark is built from privacy-sanitized real interaction traces and combines structured persona profiles, public API-style tool ecosystems, and long-horizon multi-turn trajectories. It includes 10 user profiles, 36 tool sets, 1,065 turns, 170 unique tools, and evaluation-focused task types covering lack-of-information, single-tool, and multi-tool settings. Experiments with strong tool-use LLMs show that current models still have difficulty with personalized delegation. Multi-tool coordination, missing-constraint inference, and long-horizon behavioral consistency remain major bottlenecks. These results suggest that personalization evaluation should move beyond asking whether outputs sound user-specific and instead ask whether LLMs make correct decisions for the users they represent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UserToolBench，一个用于评估工具使用大语言模型（tool-use LLMs）在个性化决策方面能力的基准。基准基于隐私清洗后的真实交互轨迹构建，包含 10 个用户画像、36 个工具集、1,065 轮对话和 170 个独特工具，并覆盖信息缺失、单工具和多工具等任务类型。实验表明，当前强工具使用模型在个性化委托上仍有困难，多工具协调、缺失约束推断和长程行为一致性是主要瓶颈。作者认为个性化评估应关注模型是否为所代表的用户做出正确决策，而非输出是否听起来像用户。
Motivation: 现有基准大多聚焦于画像记忆、风格模仿、通用工具使用或回复级个性化，缺少对工具使用场景中个性化决策能力的系统性测试。
Method: 构建 UserToolBench，从隐私清洗的真实交互轨迹出发，结合结构化人物画像、API 风格工具生态系统和长程多轮轨迹，设计覆盖缺乏信息、单工具和多工具设置的评测任务类型。
Result: 摘要报告该基准包含 10 个用户画像、36 个工具集、1,065 轮对话和 170 个独特工具；强工具使用 LLM 仍难以完成个性化委托，多工具协调、缺失约束推断与长程行为一致性是主要瓶颈。
Conclusion: 个性化评估应转向检验模型是否为所代表的用户做出正确决策，而不是停留在输出是否具有用户特异性。

papers.title: FlowScout: From Execution Feedback to Reliable Tool-Using Agent Workflows
papers.abstract_en: Agentic workflows have become an important abstraction for building reliable LLM-based automation systems by organizing large language models (LLMs), tools, and control logic into explicit execution structures. However, constructing high-quality agentic workflows remains largely manual and requires substantial domain expertise. Recent studies have explored automatic agentic workflow generation from historical task-solving records, but they mainly produce LLM-centric workflows, where real tool executions are abstracted and simulated by LLM nodes, limiting the usability and stability of generated workflows. To address these limitations, we propose FlowScout, an execution-guided framework for generating tool-integrated agentic workflows from historical task-solving records. Specifically, FlowScout represents an agentic workflow as a directed graph composed of LLM nodes, tool-calling nodes, and dependency edges. It first mines a common tool coordination skeleton from historical records to construct an initial workflow, and then refines the workflow topology through Monte Carlo tree search guided by execution feedback. We evaluate FlowScout on four representative task domains and compare it with three baselines, i.e., PM4Py, ReAct and AFlow. Experimental results show that agentic workflows generated by FlowScout improve tool invocation correctness by at least 92.69% and execution quality by at least 17.66% over the baselines, while achieving lower performance variation across repeated runs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FlowScout，一个执行引导的框架，用于从历史任务解决记录生成工具集成的代理工作流（agentic workflow）。它将工作流表示为包含 LLM 节点、工具调用节点和依赖边的有向图，先挖掘通用工具协调骨架以构建初始工作流，再通过蒙特卡洛树搜索（Monte Carlo tree search）依据执行反馈细化工作流拓扑。在四个代表性任务域上与 PM4Py、ReAct 和 AFlow 三个基线相比，FlowScout 生成的工作流在工具调用正确性上至少提升 92.69%，执行质量至少提升 17.66%，并具有更低的重复杂运行性能波动。
Motivation: 现有自动生成 agentic workflow 的研究主要产出以 LLM 为中心的工作流，其中真实工具执行被抽象并由 LLM 节点模拟，限制了生成工作流的可用性和稳定性；而高质量工作流的构建至今仍主要依赖人工和大量领域知识。
Method: FlowScout 将 agentic workflow 表示为有向图，包含 LLM 节点、工具调用节点和依赖边；先通过挖掘历史记录中的通用工具协调骨架构建初始工作流，再利用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）以执行反馈为引导，迭代优化工作流拓扑。
Result: 在四个代表性任务域中，与 PM4Py、ReAct 和 AFlow 三个基线相比，FlowScout 生成的 agentic workflow 将工具调用正确性至少提升 92.69%，执行质量至少提升 17.66%，并显著降低重复运行之间的性能波动。
Conclusion: 摘要强调执行反馈引导的工作流生成方法能够产生更可靠、更稳定的工具集成 agentic workflow；其评估范围限于四个任务域和三个基线，未涉及更广泛领域的泛化性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: DOCSCHISEL: Adaptive Tool Documentation Optimization Framework for LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly rely on external tools to accomplish complex real-world tasks, making tool documentation a critical grounding resource for LLM agents. Existing studies mainly focus on improving the tool-use capabilities of LLM agents, while largely treating tool documentation as a fixed input. Although several recent works attempt to optimize tool documentation through rewriting or compression, little is known about how the information contained in tool documentation affects agent performance across different settings. To bridge this gap, we conduct a large-scale empirical study on tool documentation for LLM agents. Our study reveals substantial heterogeneity in the information fields provided by existing tool documentation. Moreover, the effectiveness of different information fields is highly dependent on the task domain, LLM backbone, and agent paradigm, indicating that no fixed tool documentation can consistently generalize across diverse agent settings. Motivated by these findings, we propose DocsChisel, an adaptive tool documentation optimization framework for LLM agents. DocsChisel analyzes failed execution traces of a target LLM agent to identify documentation-related issues, and iteratively optimizes tool documentation by adding, removing, and refining information fields for each tool. We evaluate DocsChisel against two state-of-the-art baselines, i.e., EasyTool and DRAFT. Experimental results show that DocsChisel improves the task success rate of LLM agents by 95.89% over the original tool documentation and by 75.15%, on average, over existing baselines, while incurring limited optimization time and token overhead
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对 LLM 智能体的工具文档（tool documentation）进行大规模实证研究，发现不同信息字段的效果随任务领域、LLM 骨干和智能体范式变化，不存在能跨设置普适的固定文档。基于此提出 DocsChisel，一个自适应工具文档优化框架，通过分析失败执行轨迹并迭代增删、精炼每个工具的信息字段。实验表明相比原始文档以及 EasyTool、DRAFT 等基线，任务成功率分别提升 95.89% 和平均 75.15%，且优化时间与 token 开销有限。
Motivation: 现有研究大多把工具文档视为固定输入，少数改写或压缩工作也未系统回答文档信息如何在不同设置下影响智能体性能。作者通过大规模实证揭示信息字段的异构性与效果依赖性，说明固定文档无法跨设置泛化，由此引出自适应优化需求。
Method: 提出 DocsChisel 框架：先分析目标 LLM 智能体的失败执行轨迹以定位文档相关问题，再针对每个工具迭代地添加、移除和精炼信息字段，从而自适应优化工具文档。
Result: 在任务成功率上，DocsChisel 相比原始工具文档提升 95.89%，相比 EasyTool 和 DRAFT 两个基线平均提升 75.15%，同时只引入有限的优化时间和 token 开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调工具文档的信息字段需要根据任务领域、LLM 骨干和智能体范式自适应调整，DocsChisel 通过失败轨迹驱动的迭代优化能有效提升智能体成功率。

papers.title: Automating and Scaling Behavioral Scientific Research on AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents are increasingly deployed in complex environments, understanding their behaviors becomes critical. Yet behavioral scientific research on AI agents remains manual and labor-intensive. We introduce AEROBAT, the first multi-agent system to automate behavioral scientific research on AI agents. Given an arbitrary target behavior by its user, AEROBAT automatically executes a full pipeline of behavioral scientific research---generating hypotheses about the behavior, designing and executing controlled experiments, making behavioral assessments, analyzing the results, and writing reports. For 12 target behaviors, we used AEROBAT to generate and test 79 hypotheses: designing 1,240 controlled experiments and executing 23,512 simulation rounds in total. Moderate-to-strong statistical evidence was found for 26 hypotheses, including some novel ones. In sum, our results demonstrate that automated behavioral scientific research on AI agents can complement and extend the reach of manual research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AEROBAT，据称是首个用于自动化 AI 代理行为科学研究的智能体系统。给定任意目标行为，AEROBAT 自动完成生成假设、设计并执行受控实验、行为评估、结果分析和撰写报告的全流程。作者用 12 个目标行为生成并测试了 79 个假设，设计了 1,240 个受控实验并执行了 23,512 轮模拟，其中 26 个假设获得中等到强统计证据，部分为新颖假设。
Motivation: AI 代理在复杂环境中部署日益增多，理解其行为变得关键，但针对 AI 代理的行为科学研究仍高度依赖人工且劳动密集，缺乏自动化手段。
Method: 引入多智能体系统 AEROBAT，将行为科学研究的完整流程自动化，包括假设生成、受控实验设计、行为评估、结果分析和报告撰写，从而规模化地开展行为研究。
Result: 针对 12 个目标行为自动生成并测试了 79 个假设，共设计 1,240 个受控实验并执行 23,512 轮模拟；其中 26 个假设得到中等到强的统计证据，包括若干新颖假设。
Conclusion: 研究表明，自动化行为科学研究能够补充并扩展人工研究的覆盖范围，为 AI 代理行为的规模化实证研究提供了可行路径。

papers.title: Modeling Scientific Experiment Scenes: Dataset and Model
papers.abstract_en: Scene Graph Generation (SGG) is fundamental to structured visual understanding, yet existing benchmarks focus mainly on daily-life images and overlook scientific experiment scenes with specialized instruments, task-specific experimental semantics, and dense, fine-grained physical relations. Building upon PhysScene, our previously introduced SGG dataset for physics experiment scenes, we further identify two key challenges that such scientific environments pose to existing SGG models: a pronounced long-tail relational predicate distribution and a substantial visual-textual semantic gap. To address these challenges, we propose the Cross-Modal Dual-Path Generator (CM-DPG), a model for robust open-vocabulary SGG. The model enhances object-level semantic representations through joint visual-textual encoding and improves relational reasoning using complementary visual and geometric cues. We also incorporate relation-aware pre-training, caption-derived pseudo-supervision, and adaptive weighting to support balanced learning across head and tail predicates. Extensive experiments on PhysScene and VG150 show that CM-DPG achieves competitive performance across multiple evaluation settings, with ablation studies validating the contribution of each component. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ZMH-SDUST/CM-DPG.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对科学实验场景中的场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation, SGG）任务，基于作者此前提出的物理实验场景数据集 PhysScene，指出现有 SGG 模型在该环境下面临长尾关系谓词分布和视觉-文本语义差距两大挑战，并提出跨模态双路径生成器（Cross-Modal Dual-Path Generator, CM-DPG）。摘要报告该方法在 PhysScene 和 VG150 上取得有竞争力的性能，消融实验验证了各组件贡献。需要特别注意的是，arXiv 评论表明作者已发现需要大幅修订的问题并决定撤回当前版本。
Motivation: 现有 SGG 基准大多关注日常图像，忽略了科学实验场景中专业仪器、任务特定实验语义以及密集细粒度物理关系；作者进一步识别出科学环境为现有 SGG 模型带来的两个关键挑战：显著的长尾关系谓词分布和较大的视觉-文本语义差距。
Method: 提出 CM-DPG，通过联合视觉-文本编码增强对象级语义表示，并利用互补的视觉与几何线索改进关系推理；同时引入关系感知预训练、由标题生成的伪监督以及自适应加权，以支持头部和尾部谓词的平衡学习。
Result: 在 PhysScene 和 VG150 上的大量实验表明，CM-DPG 在多种评估设置下取得有竞争力的性能，且消融研究验证了每个组件的贡献；摘要未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 作者认为所提模型能够应对科学实验场景对 SGG 提出的挑战，并公开了数据集与代码；但 arXiv 评论明确指出作者已发现需要实质性修订的问题并决定撤回当前版本，因此该版本并非最终发表稿。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wiring Beats Blending: What Transfers Between Transformer Sizes -- and What Doesn't
papers.abstract_en: Model families are typically trained size by size, each from scratch. Can apretrained large model instead be converted into a smaller sibling? Wecharacterize the 1.4B->410M conversion in the Pythia family end to end.Representations align strongly across sizes (ridge R^2=0.84) while parametersalign weakly. Dense weight projection is functionally destructive, and abit-exact reconstruction control shows this is not an assembly artifact: basismixing breaks rotary, per-head, GELU, and LayerNorm structure. After the best-fitlinear operator, weight residuals are statistically indistinguishable from noiseunder shuffle controls. Conversion value therefore lives in initialization. Inmatched-budget continued pre-training we decompose conversion into twoindependent levers: least-squares compensation (a function lever, best zero-shot)and variance-preserving rescale (a dynamics lever, best endpoints). Compensationis a token-efficient, low-budget win rather than a universal one. At 30M tokens itbeats the strongest subcloning variant on both a width-reduced pair (84.0 +/- 1.8vs. 89.7 +/- 3.7, 3/3 seeds) and a held-out depth-reduced pair (109.3 vs. 117.9,3/3 seeds), reaching a given quality with fewer tokens. At a 33x larger budget thetwo converge to parity (40.0 vs. 40.0), both far ahead of from-scratch, whichtransfer initialization always beats: by up to 18x at low budget, with the marginnarrowing at convergence and at the largest scale. We also map the method'sboundary. At about 5x the donor scale (6.9B->1.4B) stacking both leversover-corrects, consistent with ill-conditioning of the compensation solve at largewidth, which points to dimension-aware regularization as a fix. At matched budgetour initialization also beats structured pruning with distillation, the standardpipeline for this task, and improves further when combined with it. Code,checkpoints, and the frozen evaluation corpus are released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对模型族通常按尺寸从零训练的做法，探讨能否将预训练大模型转换为更小的兄弟模型，并对 Pythia 家族中 1.4B→410M 的转换做了端到端刻画。结果显示表示层跨尺寸高度对齐（ridge R²=0.84），而参数对齐很弱；稠密权重投影在功能上有破坏性，转换的价值主要来自初始化。在匹配预算的继续预训练中，作者将转换分解为最小二乘补偿（函数杠杆）和保持方差的重新缩放（动力学杠杆），并指出补偿是低预算下 token 高效的优势，而非普适优势。
Motivation: 模型族通常每个尺寸都从零开始训练，成本高昂；论文试图回答一个预训练大模型能否被转换成更小的兄弟模型，以及跨 Transformer 尺寸究竟什么可以迁移、什么不能迁移。
Method: 作者对 Pythia 1.4B→410M 转换进行端到端刻画，使用 ridge 回归、逐 bit 精确重建对照、shuffle 对照和最佳线性算子来分析权重残差；并在匹配预算的继续预训练中把转换分解为最小二乘补偿（least-squares compensation）与方差保持重缩放（variance-preserving rescale）两个独立杠杆。
Result: 摘要报告表示对齐强而参数对齐弱，稠密权重投影在功能上具有破坏性，且权重残差在 shuffle 对照下与噪声不可区分。在 30M token 低预算下，补偿在宽度缩减对上超过最强的 subcloning 变体（84.0±1.8 对 89.7±3.7，3/3 seeds），在留出深度缩减对上也更优（109.3 对 117.9，3/3 seeds）；在 33 倍预算下两者收敛到持平（40.0 对 40.0），且迁移初始化在低预算下最多比从零训练好 18 倍。在大约 5 倍捐赠者规模（6.9B→1.4B）时叠加两个杠杆会过校正，作者将其归因于补偿求解在大宽度下的病态性。
Conclusion: 作者认为转换价值主要存在于初始化中，最小二乘补偿是低预算、token 高效的收益而非普适收益；在匹配预算下该初始化方法优于带蒸馏的结构化剪枝，并且与之组合还能进一步提升。摘要还提示维度感知正则化可能修复大宽度下的病态性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Leak It: Per-Document Extraction Beyond Aggregate Membership Inference
papers.abstract_en: Membership inference (MIA) on language models is usually summarised by aggregate ROC-AUC, but such evaluations are confounded: model-free blind baselines can separate members from non-members using surface text alone. Building on probabilistic discoverable extraction, we study black-box training-data leakage using N samples from p_theta(. | x), placing mean overlap, extreme-value overlap, and self-concentration on a common functional-estimation footing. On WikiMIA, a blind bag-of-words classifier reaches AUC 0.97 (TPR 0.90 at 5% FPR) while sampling adds nothing. On an IID Pile split (MIMIR), neither self-concentration nor gold-continuation recovery significantly exceeds a blind baseline in aggregate. Aggregate metrics hide the real harm: sampling verbatim-extracts training data for a tail of documents no blind attack can reach. On Pythia-6.9B, 16.6% of 500 Pile documents bearing a real identifier (83 documents; 21.3% of those bearing an email address) have that identifier reproduced and not reproduced under a mismatched-prefix control. Each leak is attributable to that document rather than a globally common string. This per-document disclosure is invisible to aggregate AUC. Risk is uneven: identifier leakage is about 3x stronger in code than prose, though prose remains positive and grows with capacity (4.0% to 12.1% from 410M to 6.9B); recovery of arbitrary held-out continuations is essentially confined to code (+0.44 member gap on GitHub vs at most +0.014 on prose). Temperature and nucleus sampling have minor effect, a 16-token prefix suffices, and the sample-budget relationship corroborates prior probabilistic-extraction results. We detect no reduction from deduplication. Privacy audits should report per-document extraction, not only aggregate membership, and motivate differential privacy as the mitigation. We release leakit, a black-box tool implementing this probe and its control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型成员推断（MIA）的聚合指标（如 ROC-AUC）被无模型盲基线混淆的问题，提出以逐文档提取（per-document extraction）来评估训练数据泄露。作者基于概率可发现提取（probabilistic discoverable extraction），从条件分布 p_theta(.|x) 采样，将平均重叠、极值重叠和自集中置于统一的功能估计框架下，并引入不匹配前缀对照。在 WikiMIA、Pile/MIMIR 和 Pythia 系列模型上的实验表明，聚合指标掩盖了尾部分布文档的真实泄露，且这种泄露对差分隐私具有直接意义。
Motivation: 现有成员推断评估通常汇总为 ROC-AUC，但无模型盲基线仅凭表面文本就能区分成员与非成员，使聚合指标被混淆；同时聚合指标掩盖了真正的风险——抽样可以逐字提取训练数据中盲攻击无法触及的尾部分布文档。
Method: 提出一个黑盒探测工具 leakit：从 p_theta(.|x) 中采样 N 个样本，在统一的功能估计框架下度量平均重叠、极值重叠和自集中，并使用不匹配前缀作为对照来区分逐文档泄露与全局常见字符串。
Result: 在 WikiMIA 上，盲词袋分类器达到 AUC 0.97（5% FPR 时 TPR 0.90），而采样未带来额外收益；在 IID Pile 子集（MIMIR）上，自集中和黄金延续恢复在聚合层面不超过盲基线。但在 Pythia-6.9B 的 500 个 Pile 文档中，16.6%（83 个）携带真实标识符的文档被逐字提取出该标识符，其中含电子邮件地址的文档泄露率为 21.3%；标识符泄露在代码中比散文强约 3 倍，散文泄露率随模型容量从 410M 的 4.0% 升至 6.9B 的 12.1%；任意保留延续的恢复几乎只出现在代码上（GitHub 成员差距 +0.44，散文最多 +0.014）。温度和核采样影响较小，16-token 前缀即足够，去重未降低泄露。
Conclusion: 隐私审计应报告逐文档提取率而不仅仅是聚合成员推断，并以差分隐私作为缓解手段；作者开源了实现该探测及对照的 black-box 工具 leakit。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Testing when adaptive data acquisition can replace fixed measurement plans
papers.abstract_en: Learned rules select samples for follow-up measurements in high-throughput experiments. Predicted value does not justify replacing a fixed plan. We introduce the opportunity-aware protocol for authorizing learned measurement rules (Opal), which learns a rule from labelled data, fixes it before outcomes are opened and tests it on held-out samples. Outcomes from elsewhere and unlabelled target measurements cannot settle this decision under unrestricted outcome shift. An exact bound identifies pilots too small for claims about unmeasured units. On 11,265 held-out Cell Painting compounds, the highest-value rule selected 96.0% for additional imaging, with a 97.1% upper bound on unnecessary selections. Opal selected 5.28%, reduced this bound to 5.18% and retained positive value after cost. Only Opal met the registered false-activation limit among rules selecting compounds. The next-lowest upper bound was 37.94%. Uncertainty about errors among selected compounds remained above target. Opal separates predicted value from evidence sufficient to replace the fixed plan.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在通量实验中用学习规则选择样本进行后续测量时，如何判断自适应采集能否替代固定测量计划。作者提出机会感知协议 Opal：从标注数据学习规则、在结果揭晓前固定规则并在留出样本上检验。在 11,265 个留出 Cell Painting 化合物上，最高价值规则选中 96.0% 进行额外成像，而 Opal 只选中 5.28% 并把不必要选择的上界从 5.18% 提升后保留正值；只有 Opal 满足登记的错误激活限值。
Motivation: 预测价值本身不足以证明用学习规则替换固定测量计划是合理的，特别是在无限制结果偏移下，来自别处的结果和未标注的目标测量无法可靠地判定这一决策。
Method: 提出机会感知协议（Opal）：从标注数据学习选择规则，在观测结果之前固定规则，再在留出样本上检验；并利用精确界识别规模过小、无法对未测量单元下结论的试点。
Result: 在 11,265 个留出 Cell Painting 化合物上，最高价值规则选择 96.0% 做额外成像，其不必要选择上界为 97.1%；Opal 仅选择 5.28%，将上界降至 5.18%，扣除成本后仍为正值。在规则选样的化合物中，只有 Opal 达到登记的假激活限值，次低上界为 37.94%；所选化合物中的误差不确定性仍高于目标。
Conclusion: Opal 把预测价值与足以替换固定计划的证据区分开来；摘要强调无限制结果偏移下需要这样的协议才能为自适应采集提供可靠依据。
Relevance: 5
