summary_sections.result: 在 11,265 个留出 Cell Painting 化合物上，最高价值规则选择 96.0% 做额外成像，其不必要选择上界为 97.1%；Opal 仅选择 5.28%，将上界降至 5.18%，扣除成本后仍为正值。在规则选样的化合物中，只有 Opal 达到登记的假激活限值，次低上界为 37.94%；所选化合物中的误差不确定性仍高于目标。
summary_sections.conclusion: Opal 把预测价值与足以替换固定计划的证据区分开来；摘要强调无限制结果偏移下需要这样的协议才能为自适应采集提供可靠依据。

papers.title: Forensic Reproducibility Audit of a Radiology Vision-Language Model Benchmark: From Intended Protocol to Released Artifact
papers.abstract_en: Medical-imaging AI benchmarks combine datasets, DICOM rendering, prompts, provider APIs, automated labels, statistical code, manuscripts, and repository releases. Agreement across these artifacts is usually assumed rather than tested. We performed a retrospective forensic reproducibility audit of a preserved chest-radiograph vision-language model (VLM) pilot; no model was called again and no image or report was newly annotated. We traced prompt bindings, DICOM metadata, output completeness, label extraction, matched analyses, and release propagation. Of 300 planned model-prompt calls, 297 yielded nonempty reports. Sixty Claude calls labeled A/B were executed with the same C prompt. The 30 studies represented 28 patients. Four MONOCHROME1 images were rendered without required polarity inversion, dataset split membership was not retained, and the unvalidated extractor truncated five reports to 4000 characters. Reconstructing one common cohort of 369 complete case-finding blocks changed Cochran's Q from 154.73 to 182.29. Of 45 McNemar comparisons, 27 had unadjusted p < 0.05 and 20 remained below 0.05 after Holm adjustment. These values describe only the archived automated-label matrix; they do not recover the intended prompt comparison or establish clinical performance. We withdraw the original performance, ranking, prompt-effect, and clinical claims and specify machine-verifiable controls for cohort, DICOM rendering, prompt and model identity, call status, annotation provenance, keyed analysis, and derived artifacts.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the author. On further review, the archived artifacts underlying this audit are too incomplete to support the reported statistics, and the paper's conclusions do not follow from the available evidence. The work is withdrawn in full; earlier versions should not be cited
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是对一个胸部X光片视觉语言模型（VLM）基准 pilot 的事后取证式可复现性审计；作者未重新调用模型或新标注任何图像/报告，而是追溯了提示词绑定、DICOM 元数据、输出完整性、标签提取、匹配分析和发布传播。审计发现多种工件不一致：60 次标为 A/B 的 Claude 调用实际使用了同一 C 提示词、4 张 MONOCHROME1 图像未做所需极性反转、数据集划分成员关系未保留、未验证的抽取器将 5 份报告截断为 4000 字符；重建共同队列后 Cochran's Q 从 154.73 变为 182.29。作者因此撤回全部性能、排名、提示效应和临床主张，并呼吁使用机器可验证的控制措施。
Motivation: 医学影像 AI 基准由数据集、DICOM 渲染、提示词、供应商 API、自动标签、统计代码、手稿和仓库发布等多类工件组成，而这些工件之间的一致性通常被假定而非被检验；本文针对这一未被测试的假设进行追溯审计。
Method: 对保留的胸部X光片 VLM pilot 进行回顾性取证审计：追踪提示词绑定、DICOM 元数据、输出完整性、标签提取、匹配分析以及发布传播，并指定机器可验证的对照项（队列、DICOM 渲染、提示词与模型身份、调用状态、标注来源、关键分析及派生工件）。
Result: 在计划的 300 次模型-提示调用中，297 次产生非空报告；60 次标为 A/B 的 Claude 调用执行了相同的 C 提示；30 项研究对应 28 位患者。重建 369 个完整 case-finding 块组成的共同队列后，Cochran's Q 从 154.73 变化到 182.29；45 个 McNemar 比较中 27 个未经校正 p<0.05，Holm 校正后仍有 20 个低于 0.05。摘要强调这些数值仅描述存档的自动标签矩阵，既不能恢复原定提示比较，也不能确定临床性能。
Conclusion: 作者因存档工件不足以支持所报告的统计量而全文撤回该工作，并提醒早期版本不应被引用；撤回后的建议是引入机器可验证的工件级控制来保证基准的可复现性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Embeddings based Anomaly Detection for Cleaning Global Crop Type Reference Datasets
papers.abstract_en: High quality reference data remain a critical bottleneck for crop-type mapping at any spatial and temporal scale. Operational systems such as WorldCereal aggregate labels from heterogeneous sources such as parcel registers, national databases, field surveys, and map-derived products, each with their own biases, coverage gaps and unknown label noise. Simple global rules are inadequate, since crop phenology and observation conditions vary strongly across regions and seasons. In this study, we focus on a single, operationally relevant question: whether embeddings produced through geospatial foundation models are a viable basis for cleaning the reference data. We propose a practical, locality-aware, embedding-based anomaly (EBA) detection framework that operates on the embeddings of a pretrained Earth-observation encoder. We score each labelled sample against other samples of the same crop in the same area using a pretrained embedding, flag the ones that stand out, and test whether removing or down-weighting them before training yields a better model. We establish that the flagged points are genuinely mislabelled or misplaced in two independent ways: against synthetic ground truth, the detector concentrates injected label errors 2.5-5x above chance in its flagged set (detection AUROC up to 0.84); and on real data, a model-independent test shows that removing or confidence-weighting the flagged held-out points raises measured accuracy in trained models, for both crop type and land cover. Acting on the flags then improves the WorldCereal crop-type model across five macro-regions, evaluated on a fixed held-out split under three views. We find conservative cleaning helps while over-cleaning hurts. The EBA detector approach is designed to be reproducible and extensible, and can serve as a template for cleaning large, noisy Earth observation reference datasets beyond crop mapping.
papers.comment: Camera-ready version. Accepted for Oral Presentation at Terrabytes II at ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究是否能用地学基础模型 (geospatial foundation model) 产生的嵌入来清洗全球作物类型参考数据。作者提出一种局部感知的基于嵌入的异常检测 (EBA) 框架，对预训练地球观测编码器的嵌入，将每个带标签样本与同区域同作物样本比较并标记异常。实验表明被标记点确实多为错标或错位，并在五个宏观区域的 WorldCereal 作物类型模型上改善精度；保守清洗有帮助，过度清洗则有损性能。
Motivation: 高质量参考数据是作物类型制图的关键瓶颈；WorldCereal 等业务系统汇总的标签来自地块登记、国家数据库、田间调查和地图产品等异构来源，各有偏差、覆盖缺口和未知标签噪声。由于作物物候和观测条件随区域与季节差异很大，简单全局规则无法有效清洗。
Method: 提出 EBA 检测框架：使用预训练地球观测编码器 (pretrained Earth-observation encoder) 得到嵌入，将每个标注样本与同一区域内同一作物的其他样本进行比对，标记明显离群的样本，并在训练前将其移除或降低权重。
Result: 在合成真值上，检测器将注入的标签错误在其标记集合中的富集程度提高到随机水平的 2.5-5 倍，检测 AUROC 最高达 0.84；在真实数据上，模型无关检验表明移除或置信度加权被标记的留出点能提升作物类型和土地覆盖训练模型的准确率，并在五个宏观区域改进 WorldCereal 作物类型模型。
Conclusion: 作者认为 EBA 检测器设计可复现、可扩展，可作为清洗大规模含噪地球观测参考数据的模板，且适用于作物制图以外的任务。摘要明确聚焦于一个业务问题，即嵌入能否作为清洗参考数据的可行基础。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Geometry Meets Semantics: Fractional Gradient Stabilization for Semantic-Driven Bounding Box Optimization in Visual Detection Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Bounding boxes are fundamental for object localization in visual detection tasks. Among them, oriented bounding boxes are widely used in visual detection tasks, which provide a more precise directional representation. Generally, IoU-based losses are widely adopted to optimize box regression. However, we observed that IoU-driven box optimization suffers from two key issues: (1) it relies solely on geometric properties while ignoring semantic cues; (2) orientation optimization suffers from unstable gradients, causing oscillations in orientation convergence. In this paper, we propose a Fractional Semantic IoU loss to achieve unified semantic-geometric learning with gradient stabilization. First, we design a semantic similarity metric to guide IoU optimization, building a Semantic IoU loss (SIoU loss) with an adaptive gradient gating mechanism. Then, we revisit the gradient instability issue in oriented box optimization and extend the SIoU loss to a fractional-order formulation to build the \textbf{Fr}actional \textbf{S}emantic \textbf{IoU} \textbf{loss} (FrSIoU loss). The FrSIoU loss accumulates historical IoU states to regularize abnormal gradients during bounding box optimization process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach achieves stable performance gains across different bounding box formulations and diverse visual detection tasks. The code will be available on GitHub.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉检测中边界框回归的 IoU 损失提出改进，指出 IoU 驱动优化仅依赖几何属性而忽略语义信息，且朝向优化存在梯度不稳定问题。作者提出 Fractional Semantic IoU (FrSIoU) loss，结合语义相似度度量与分数阶梯度稳定机制，在多种边界框形式和检测任务上取得稳定性能提升。
Motivation: 现有 IoU-based 边界框回归损失存在两个问题：一是只利用几何属性、忽略语义线索；二是朝向 (orientation) 优化时梯度不稳定，导致收敛振荡。
Method: 先设计语义相似度度量来引导 IoU 优化，构建带自适应梯度门控 (adaptive gradient gating) 的 Semantic IoU loss (SIoU loss)；随后将该损失扩展为分数阶 (fractional-order) 形式，得到 FrSIoU loss，通过累积历史 IoU 状态来正则化边界框优化过程中的异常梯度。
Result: 大量实验表明该方法在多种边界框形式和多样的视觉检测任务上取得稳定的性能提升。
Conclusion: 摘要强调融合语义与几何信息并稳定梯度可以改善边界框回归；代码将开源在 GitHub。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Frontier AI performance across the business disciplines: a case-grounded benchmark of knowledge work and analytical reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are improving rapidly as reflected in benchmark scores, yet these AI benchmarks largely test capabilities such as factual recall, narrow question answering, mathematical problem-solving, and coding and agentic tool-use. What remains poorly measured is AI progress on the analytical knowledge work white-collar professionals perform daily, including synthesizing complex information, exercising judgment under uncertainty and incomplete information, applying strategic and adversarial thinking in multi-stakeholder settings, weighing trade-offs, and producing defensible, structured analyses. This gap is even more pronounced for subjective components of such work, where success can be challenging to define. The "case method" form of education practiced by top business schools provides a natural foundation for addressing this measurement gap, and we construct BusinessCaseBench, a benchmark spanning hundreds of questions drawn from business cases across eighteen disciplines, each paired with a grading rubric derived from the expert-written instructor case solution. On BusinessCaseBench, frontier AI models already score highly against instructor rubrics, and capability within one model family improves substantially over two years. These results provide strong evidence that AI performance on this class of work is already high and rapidly improving, with implications for business schools, where case pedagogy trains undergraduates and MBAs in this kind of analytical reasoning, and for entry-level professional roles, where such skills have historically anchored early-career work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BusinessCaseBench，一个基于商学院案例教学法 (case method) 构建的基准，用于衡量大语言模型在白领分析性知识工作上的表现。基准包含来自 18 个学科商业案例的数百道问题，每道题配有由专家撰写的教师案例解答推导出的评分 rubric。摘要报告称前沿 AI 模型在该基准上已能取得高分，且同一模型家族的能力在两年内有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有 AI 基准主要测试事实回忆、窄范围问答、数学解题、编码及智能体工具使用，未能很好衡量白领专业人士日常的分析性知识工作，包括综合复杂信息、在不确定和不完整信息下作判断、多利益相关者场景中的战略与对抗性思考、权衡取舍以及产出可辩护的结构化分析。这类工作中主观成分的成功标准尤其难以定义，形成测量空白。
Method: 借鉴顶级商学院采用的案例教学法，构建 BusinessCaseBench：从 18 个学科的商业案例中抽取数百道问题，并将每一道题与从专家撰写的教师案例解答中提炼出的评分 rubric 配对，以提供可对照的评判标准。
Result: 在 BusinessCaseBench 上，前沿 AI 模型对照教师 rubric 已取得高分；同一模型家族内的能力在两年时间内显著提升。
Conclusion: 结果表明 AI 在这类分析性知识工作上的表现已经较高且在快速进步，对商学院案例教学法以及历史上依赖此类技能的初级专业岗位具有潜在影响。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TSCoNet: A Two-Stage Copula CNN-LSTM for Uncertainty-Aware Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Reliable forecasting of several interrelated environmental variables - such as regional precipitation and temperature, or other correlated geophysical fields - across many locations calls for accurate predictions accompanied by trustworthy statements of their uncertainty. Modern deep-learning models forecast such variables accurately but usually report no uncertainty, and forcing them to output uncertainty through maximum likelihood tends to degrade their accuracy, especially when the variables are strongly correlated. Motivated by this tension, we develop TSCoNet, a two-stage convolutional-recurrent model coupled with a Gaussian copula that jointly forecasts multiple variables over space and time while quantifying predictive uncertainty. The method first learns accurate mean forecasts and then, holding the mean fixed, refines a shared representation to estimate the predictive variance, yielding calibrated prediction intervals after a standard recalibration, so that uncertainty is added without sacrificing point accuracy. We study the approach on simulated non-stationary spatial fields on the sphere and on a real dataset of monthly precipitation and temperature for fifty cities over 2000-2020. The model matches the accuracy of a strong deterministic forecaster while supplying calibrated prediction intervals that the deterministic model cannot, giving a single tool that provides both accurate point forecasts and reliable uncertainty for multivariate spatio-temporal data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TSCoNet，一种结合高斯 copula 的两阶段卷积-循环模型，用于多变量时空预测并量化预测不确定性。方法先学习准确的均值预测，再固定均值、精化共享表示以估计预测方差，经标准重标定后得到校准的预测区间，从而在不牺牲点预测精度的前提下加入不确定性。在球面非平稳模拟场以及五十个城市 2000-2020 年月降水与温度数据上，模型与强确定性预报器精度相当，同时提供后者无法给出的校准区间。
Motivation: 现代深度学习模型对相关环境变量（如区域降水与温度）预测准确但不报告不确定性；通过极大似然强迫其输出不确定性会损害精度，尤其当变量强相关时。作者针对这一准确性与不确定性之间的张力提出方法。
Method: TSCoNet 是两阶段卷积-循环模型：第一阶段学习准确的均值预测，第二阶段固定均值不变，精化共享表示以估计预测方差；方差估计基于高斯 copula 对多变量的空间-时间相关性建模，经标准重标定输出校准预测区间。
Result: 在球面非平稳空间场模拟数据和 50 个城市 2000-2020 年月降水、温度真实数据上，模型达到与强确定性基线相当的预测精度，同时生成校准的预测区间。
Conclusion: 摘要指出该方法提供一个统一工具，既能给出准确的多变量时空点预测，又能给出可靠的不确定性估计；其设计思路是分两个阶段在保持均值精度的前提下补充不确定性，而非用极大似然同时优化两者。

papers.title: What You See Is What You Get: Observation-Aligned Supervision for Chart-to-Code Generation
papers.abstract_en: Chart-to-code generation is commonly trained with supervised fine-tuning on reference plotting scripts, implicitly treating the gold code as a fully observable target. We argue that this assumption is often invalid: many chart programs contain latent raw variables that cannot be uniquely recovered from the rendered image. We identify this systematic latent--observation mismatch with three forms: aggregation-induced mismatch, where raw samples are reduced to summary statistics or bin-level mass; normalization-induced mismatch, where absolute scale is removed; and projection-induced mismatch, where higher-dimensional information is lost through visual projection. These mismatches introduce target ambiguity and require models to complete information unsupported by the image. We propose Observation-Aligned Supervision, which replaces latent targets with visually constrained quantities. We instantiate it for boxplots, histograms, and pie charts using box statistics, bin weights, and wedge proportions, respectively, and study projection-induced mismatch through a controlled 3D scatter experiment. Across multiple VLMs on ChartMimic and ChartX, our rewritten supervision improves observable-value recovery, including under both-executable evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出 chart-to-code 生成中常用的监督微调把参考代码当作完全可观测目标，但许多绘图程序包含无法从渲染图像唯一恢复的潜在原始变量。作者将其归纳为聚合、归一化和投影三类 latent-observation mismatch，并提出 Observation-Aligned Supervision，把潜在目标替换为图像可约束的量。在 boxplots、histograms 和 pie charts 上分别用箱线统计量、bin 权重和扇形比例实例化，并在 ChartMimic 与 ChartX 上验证了该方法能提升多个 VLM 的可观测值恢复能力。
Motivation: 现有 chart-to-code 监督训练隐含假设金标准代码是完全可观测的，但实际中很多变量无法从图像唯一恢复，导致目标歧义并要求模型补全图像不支持的信息。这个问题会影响训练监督信号的有效性与评估的可信度。
Method: 提出 Observation-Aligned Supervision，将隐式潜在目标替换为视觉上可约束的量：对箱线图使用 box statistics，对直方图使用 bin weights，对饼图使用 wedge proportions；并通过受控的 3D scatter 实验专门研究投影引起的 mismatch。
Result: 在 ChartMimic 和 ChartX 上，使用重写后的监督信号在多个 VLM 上提升了可观测值恢复能力，包括在 both-executable 评估设置下也有改进。
Conclusion: 作者认为系统性地用图像可观测量替代潜在目标可以改善 chart-to-code 训练的监督质量，并提示这种 mismatch 是普遍存在的。摘要未讨论方法在不同图表类型之外的泛化或局限性。

papers.title: Coachable agents for interactive gameplay
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has proven to be a valuable tool in the creation of advanced AI and robotic systems, contributing to everything from game playing to robotics to foundation models. Through trial-and-error, these AI systems typically learn one, near-optimal behavior to solve their tasks. However, there are many use cases in which one would like to assert some level of control, preferably in real time, over how the task is solved. We refer to these modifications of a core task as styles. We combine universal value function approximators (UVFAs) with carefully selected training scenarios, learning algorithms, and data augmentation to create a framework for coaching agents that exhibit styles in complex domains. We demonstrate the framework's application in the AAA video games Horizon Forbidden West and Gran Turismo, and in an open-source humanoid test domain. Despite the different nature of the domains -- car racing, stylized game combat, and humanoid walking -- each agent shows strong coherence to the style requests while still satisfying the main task in its domain. Importantly, the techniques outlined in this paper allow an end user to choose the final behavior at run time, giving them flexible control over the final executed performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向复杂强化学习领域的“可教练智能体”(coachable agents) 框架，将通用价值函数近似器 (UVFA) 与精心挑选的训练场景、学习算法和数据增强相结合，使用户能够在运行时实时指定任务执行的“风格”(style)。作者在《地平线：西之绝境》(Horizon Forbidden West)、《跑车浪漫旅》(Gran Turismo) 以及一个开源人形机器人测试域中验证了该框架，表明各智能体在满足主任务的同时能对风格请求保持较强的一致性。
Motivation: 标准强化学习通常通过试错学习单一近最优行为，但许多应用场景要求用户对任务的解决方式拥有实时控制权，这种对核心任务的修改被称为“风格”，现有方法难以兼顾风格指定与主任务完成。
Method: 将通用价值函数近似器 (UVFA) 与特意挑选的训练场景、学习算法和数据增强相结合，构建一个可为复杂域中的智能体赋予多样风格的统一训练框架，使风格控制内置于价值函数中。
Result: 框架在赛车、风格化战斗和人形行走三个性质差异很大的域中均得到验证，智能体对风格请求表现出强一致性，同时仍能满足各自领域的主要任务要求。
Conclusion: 文中技术允许最终用户在运行时选择最终行为，从而对最终执行表现拥有灵活控制，但摘要未讨论其在不同域之外的泛化限制或对比基线。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When Reranking Hurts: Uncertainty-Based Gating for Few-Shot Reranking
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot selection typically assumes that reranking retrieved examples always improves performance. We challenge this view by identifying that the expensive reranking step can in fact degrade performance. Instead, we propose \emph{Training-Free Gated Reranking}, which decides whether to rerank the few-shot examples based on the model's uncertainty. Extensive experiments across 8 LLMs, covering 7 NLU datasets and 18 MT domain-direction combinations, demonstrate that our approach reduces average computational costs by approximately 20\% for MT and 54\% for NLU at a calibrated operating point, while matching the performance of full reranking. These findings indicate that higher computational cost does not guarantee better performance, and that reranking is most beneficial when targeted at high-uncertainty instances.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了少样本选择中“重排序检索示例总能提升性能”的常见假设，指出重排序有时反而会损害性能。作者提出无训练的门控重排序 (Training-Free Gated Reranking)，依据模型不确定性决定是否对少样本示例进行重排序。实验覆盖 8 个 LLM、7 个 NLU 数据集和 18 个 MT 领域-方向组合，结果显示该方法能以约 20%（MT）和 54%（NLU）的平均计算成本降低，匹配完整重排序的性能。
Motivation: 现有少样本方法普遍默认对检索到的示例进行重排序会改善性能，但昂贵的重排序步骤实际上可能降低效果；作者希望识别并避免这种负面情况，同时降低计算开销。
Method: 提出 Training-Free Gated Reranking，基于模型自身的不确定性信号来决定是否执行重排序，将高计算成本的重排序仅用于高不确定性实例。
Result: 在 8 个 LLM、7 个 NLU 数据集和 18 个 MT 领域-方向组合上，该方法在标定工作点下将 MT 平均计算成本降低约 20%、NLU 降低约 54%，同时性能与完整重排序相当。
Conclusion: 结果表明更高的计算成本并不保证更好的性能，重排序应针对高不确定性实例使用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KrishokChat: A Provenance-Traceable Multi-Task Bengali Agricultural Benchmark with Safety-Critical Chemical Advisory
papers.abstract_en: We introduce KrishokChat, an 85,979-instance Bengali agricultural benchmark built from 284 government publications, 13 institutions, and six regional dialects. The benchmark comprises four tracks: General Knowledge QA, Treatment QA, Safety Refusal and Re-query, and Table QA. It also includes a 1,000-query Real-World Farmer Benchmark collected independently from field interviews to measure transfer to authentic farmer language. Every extracted instance retains provenance at the citation level. Treatment QA also provides a structured chemical-trace array for dosage-level auditability. We evaluated five zero-shot baselines and one fine-tuned model. Closed-book knowledge proves insufficient regardless of model scale. Oracle evidence narrows the gap, but leaves a persistent floor of 4.05 to 7.00% of chemical hallucinations. Fine-tuning on KrishokChat substantially outperforms the strongest zero-shot baseline on General QA Token F1. However, structured table reasoning and farmer-language transfer remain largely unsolved. An exploratory analysis further reveals that fine-tuning reduces refusal behavior on safety-critical queries, indicating that additional safety alignment is required beyond supervised fine-tuning. We release KrishokChat as a traceable benchmark and audit resource to support grounded and safety-aware agricultural language modeling for Bengali.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 KrishokChat，一个包含 85,979 个实例的孟加拉语农业基准测试集，数据来自 284 份政府出版物、13 个机构和六种区域方言，涵盖通用知识问答、治疗问答、安全拒答与再查询以及表格问答四个任务，并附带独立收集的 1,000 条真实农场主查询。所有实例保留到引用级别的出处信息，治疗问答提供用于剂量审计的化学品追踪数组。作者评估了五个零样本基线与一个微调模型，发现闭卷知识不足以支撑回答，检索证据可缩小差距但仍有 4.05%–7.00% 的化学幻觉残留。
Motivation: 孟加拉语农业领域缺乏可追溯且面向安全关键化学品建议的基准数据，现有模型在处方级化学询问上存在幻觉风险，需要同时支持可审计性和安全对齐的评测资源。
Method: 从政府出版物等多机构来源构建多任务基准，设计四类任务轨道并加入引用级出处与化学追踪数组；另以田野访谈构建真实农场主测试集，并在五个零样本基线与一个微调模型上进行评估。
Result: 闭卷知识无论模型规模如何都不足以回答农业问题；提供 oracle 证据后仍残留 4.05%–7.00% 的化学幻觉。在 KrishokChat 上微调显著超过最强零样本基线的通用问答 Token F1，但结构化表格推理和农场主语言迁移仍基本未解决。探索性分析还显示微调降低了安全关键查询上的拒答行为。
Conclusion: 作者发布 KrishokChat 作为可追溯的评测与审计资源，并强调监督微调之外还需要额外的安全对齐，以支持有依据且安全感知的孟加拉语农业语言建模。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 闭卷知识无论模型规模如何都不足以回答农业问题；提供 oracle 证据后仍残留 4.05%–7.00% 的化学幻觉。在 KrishokChat 上微调显著超过最强零样本基线的通用问答 Token F1，但结构化表格推理和农场主语言迁移仍基本未解决。探索性分析还显示微调降低了安全关键查询上的拒答行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者发布 KrishokChat 作为可追溯的评测与审计资源，并强调监督微调之外还需要额外的安全对齐，以支持有依据且安全感知的孟加拉语农业语言建模。

papers.title: A Leakage-Aware Comparative Benchmark of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Transformer Models for Reliable Leukemia Detection
papers.abstract_en: Automated classification of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) from peripheral blood smear images has often reported near-perfect performance on the C-NMC 2019 dataset. We show that such results can be inflated by patient-level data leakage caused by random image-level partitioning, where cells from the same subject may appear in both training and test folds. We establish a leakage-aware benchmark under a strict subject-disjoint protocol, comparing LightGBM, RBF-SVM, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B1, and ViT-Tiny. Models are developed using three subject-disjoint folds from 73 subjects and evaluated on an external preliminary-phase test set of 1,867 images from 28 unseen subjects with zero patient overlap. Beyond discrimination, we assess calibration using expected calibration error, Brier score, and temperature scaling. Under honest evaluation, EfficientNet-B1 achieves the best performance, with AUROC 0.913, sensitivity 0.87, specificity 0.80, and calibrated ECE 0.024. Frozen-feature classifiers and ViT-Tiny show high sensitivity but poor specificity, indicating a tendency to over-predict the malignant class. A random-versus-subject-disjoint ablation shows that random splitting inflates AUROC by about 0.04 even in the conservative frozen-feature setting. These findings caution against image-level evaluation on C-NMC 2019 and provide a reproducible, calibration-aware benchmark for future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）外周血涂片图像分类中 C-NMC 2019 数据集报告的高性能，指出随机图像级划分会造成患者级数据泄漏，从而虚增结果。作者在严格的受试者不相交（subject-disjoint）协议下比较 LightGBM、RBF-SVM、EfficientNet-B0/B1 和 ViT-Tiny，并用外部未见患者测试集评估判别性能与校准。EfficientNet-B1 取得最佳表现，随机划分即使在保守设置下也会虚增 AUROC 约 0.04。
Motivation: C-NMC 2019 数据集上常有接近完美的分类性能，但这些结果可能因随机图像级划分导致同一患者细胞同时出现在训练和测试折中而被高估。需要建立患者级无泄漏的诚实评估基准，以避免对模型泛化能力的误导性结论。
Method: 采用严格的 subject-disjoint 协议，用 73 位受试者的三个不相交折叠训练模型，并在 28 位未见患者的 1,867 张外部初步阶段测试图像上评估，保证零患者重叠。除判别性能外，还使用期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier 分数和温度缩放评估校准，并做了随机划分与 subject-disjoint 划分的消融对比。
Result: EfficientNet-B1 表现最好，AUROC 为 0.913，敏感性 0.87，特异性 0.80，校准后 ECE 为 0.024。冻结特征分类器和 ViT-Tiny 敏感性高但特异性差，倾向于过度预测恶性类别；随机划分相对于 subject-disjoint 划分使 AUROC 虚增约 0.04。
Conclusion: 作者提醒不应在 C-NMC 2019 上使用图像级评估，并为未来研究提供了可复现、关注校准的基准。

papers.title: Causal Variational Deep Embedding: A Family of Interventional Generators for Confounded Images
papers.abstract_en: Deep generative models reproduce the observational distribution of their training data, inheriting any spurious associations it contains. A common source is an unobserved confounder that shapes both an attribute the user wants to control at sampling time and an attribute expected to vary in response. Existing causal generative approaches resolve the resulting ambiguity by imposing structural assumptions strong enough to single out one interventional distribution; in image domains, such assumptions are rarely warranted, and the data is generally consistent with a set of distinct causal mechanisms -- a feasible region of interventional distributions. We propose CauVaDE (Causal Variational Deep Embedding), built on a canonical augmented SCM in which the unobserved confounder collapses, without loss of generality, into a discrete latent cluster of bounded support while continuous variation is absorbed into independent noises. We prove that this canonical class is dense, in both observational and interventional Wasserstein distance, in the class of augmented SCMs compatible with a given causal diagram, and instantiate it as a mixture variational autoencoder whose cluster variable plays the role of the canonical confounder. An entropy regularizer with weight $γ$ on the cluster posterior then traces a family of candidate causal effects that fit the observational data to comparable likelihood while spanning the feasible region. Experiments on image data benchmarks show that CauVaDE produces diverse interventional samples and improves FID against an unconfounded reference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CauVaDE（Causal Variational Deep Embedding），一种面向混杂图像（confounded images）的干预式生成器家族。它基于一个正则增广 SCM，其中未观测混杂因子可以无损地坍缩为有界支撑的离散潜簇，连续变化被独立噪声吸收。作者证明该正则类在观测和干预 Wasserstein 距离下，在兼容给定因果图的增广 SCM 类中是稠密的，并将其实例化为混合变分自编码器；簇后验上的熵正则化权重 γ 追踪一组拟合观测数据且跨越可行域的候选因果效应。图像基准实验显示 CauVaDE 能产生多样的干预样本，并相对无混杂参考改善 FID。
Motivation: 深度生成模型只复现训练数据的观测分布，会继承其中的伪关联；未观测混杂因子同时影响用户希望在采样时控制的属性和预期随之变化的属性，导致干预分布不唯一。现有因果生成方法依赖过强的结构假设来选定单一干预分布，在图像领域通常不成立，数据往往与一组不同因果机制兼容。
Method: 提出 CauVaDE，基于正则增广 SCM：无损失地将未观测混杂因子坍缩为有界支撑的离散潜簇，连续变化吸收进独立噪声；将该类实例化为混合 VAE，以簇变量作为正则混杂因子，并在簇后验上加入权重为 γ 的熵正则化，从而刻画可行域内的候选因果效应族。
Result: 证明该正则类在观测和干预 Wasserstein 距离下，在兼容给定因果图的增广 SCM 类中是稠密的。图像数据基准上的实验显示 CauVaDE 生成多样化的干预样本，并且相对无混杂参考改善了 FID。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，与其强加单点识别的结构假设，不如用离散簇混杂加熵正则化去描述一簇与观测数据同等拟合的干预分布；实验表明该方法在图像干预生成上有效。论文范围限于图像数据基准，未涉及天气或降水领域。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Poise: Position-Aware One-Instruction Skill Injection for Silent Execution on LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agent skills extend general-purpose agents, but their open format enables skill poisoning: a tampered skill can make an agent run an attacker's command while completing the user's legitimate task. Invocation alone is insufficient; the attack-specific action must complete while that task still passes its verifier. We therefore define Attack Success Rate (ASR) to require a postcondition-validated sandbox action and a passing task verifier in the same trial. Skill files expose a reliability-visibility trade-off between a preloaded but conspicuous YAML frontmatter block and a longer body, where arbitrary placement may be skipped or locally incongruent. We introduce Poise, a position-aware attack that uses context-aware generation to place exactly one benign-looking, command-bearing instruction at a structurally feasible body position. On the eligible Skill-Inject pool with codex+gpt-5.2, Poise achieves 89.3\% ASR, 28.0 points above a context-free random-placement body baseline and comparable to the 86.7\% ASR of a high-exposure YAML-only baseline. Under the SkillTester audit, four LLM judges falsely flag 74.6\% of clean skills on average across both benchmarks, while only 5.6\% of Poise variants gain a new high-risk alert over their clean counterparts. One locally plausible, command-bearing body instruction therefore matches YAML-level reliability, while the resulting poisoned skill seldom adds a new high-risk finding over its clean counterpart.
papers.comment: Title changed from "POISE: Position-Aware Undetectable Skill Injection on LLM Agents" to "Poise: Position-Aware One-Instruction Skill Injection for Silent Execution on LLM Agents"; the manuscript, figures, appendices, and reproducibility details have been updated. 15 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究 LLM agent 技能文件（skill files）中的技能投毒（skill poisoning）问题，提出位置感知攻击 Poise。作者定义攻击成功率（ASR），要求同一次试验中同时满足后置条件验证的沙箱动作与通过的任务验证器；Poise 通过上下文感知生成，将一条看似无害、携带命令的指令放在结构上可行的正文位置。在 Skill-Inject 池上搭配 codex+gpt-5.2 取得 89.3% ASR，高出随机放置正文基线 28.0 个百分点，与高暴露 YAML-only 基线的 86.7% 相当。
Motivation: 技能格式开放且可被篡改，篡改后的技能可以在完成用户合法任务的同时执行攻击者命令，而仅触发调用（invocation）不足以判定攻击成功，因为攻击特定动作还必须在任务通过验证器时完成。技能文件在预加载但显眼的 YAML 前置块与较长正文之间存在可靠性-可见性权衡，任意放置的指令可能被跳过或与局部内容不一致。
Method: 提出 Poise，一种位置感知（position-aware）的攻击方法，利用上下文感知生成（context-aware generation）在结构可行的正文位置放置恰好一条良性外观、携带命令的指令，以规避随机放置导致的不可靠和局部不协调问题。
Result: 在 Skill-Inject 池上使用 codex+gpt-5.2，Poise 达到 89.3% ASR，比无上下文随机放置正文基线高 28.0 个百分点，并与 86.7% ASR 的高暴露 YAML-only 基线相当。在 SkillTester 审计下，四个 LLM 评委在两个基准上平均将 74.6% 的干净技能误报为高风险，而 Poise 变体中仅 5.6% 相比干净版本新增高风险告警。
Conclusion: 一条局部合理、携带命令的正文指令可以达到 YAML 级可靠性，同时生成的投毒技能很少相对其干净版本新增高风险发现。

papers.title: A case study of evaluating AI agents on a neuroscience data-to-discovery pipeline
papers.abstract_en: Agentic AI offers a promising path to automating software development bottlenecks in scientific research pipelines, particularly for stages that take domain experts days to months to build and where correctness and robustness matter more than implementation details. We present an empirical study of general-purpose coding agents on a fly optogenetics data-to-discovery pipeline. We assess agents on tasks and datasets substantially larger than existing benchmarks and evaluation criteria grounded in domain expert standards. We show that agents can solve several pipeline stages, suggesting stage-level automation is tractable. By analyzing agents' code iterations, we show they struggle most without a pre-defined criterion, when they must instead use their scientific judgment to assess their current solution. Mirroring scientists, they sometimes attempt visual inspection of intermediate outputs for self-evaluation, but largely fail to interpret what they see or act on it appropriately. Solving the end-to-end pipeline requires stringing together successes across all stages, which is beyond agents' current abilities. We identify challenges largely absent from existing benchmarks, including computational resource management and generalization to held-out data. Finally, we distill principles for constructing scientific tasks and rigorous evaluation criteria for open-ended problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对通用编码智能体（coding agents）在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现流水线（data-to-discovery pipeline）上的表现进行了实证评估。智能体在比现有基准更大规模的任务与数据集上、以领域专家标准进行评价，可以解决多个流水线阶段；但端到端全流程仍超出当前能力。作者还分析了智能体代码迭代中的失败模式，并总结了构建科学任务与严格评估准则的原则。
Motivation: 科研流水线中某些阶段需要领域专家耗时数天至数月开发，且正确性与鲁棒性比实现细节更重要，智能体 AI 被认为是自动化这些软件开发瓶颈的可行途径。
Method: 采用通用编码智能体在果蝇光遗传学数据到发现流水线上执行多阶段任务，参照领域专家标准评估结果，并通过分析智能体的代码迭代过程研究其自我评估行为。
Result: 摘要报告智能体能成功解决若干流水线阶段；当没有预定义标准、必须依靠科学判断评估当前方案时最困难。它们会尝试视觉检查中间输出以自我评估，但大多无法正确解读或据此行动。端到端流水线需要串起各阶段成功，超出当前能力。
Conclusion: 作者认为阶段级自动化可行，但端到端自动化尚未实现；研究识别出计算资源管理与对保留数据（held-out data）泛化等现有基准少有覆盖的挑战，并为开放式科学任务及严格评估提出原则。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告智能体能成功解决若干流水线阶段；当没有预定义标准、必须依靠科学判断评估当前方案时最困难。它们会尝试视觉检查中间输出以自我评估，但大多无法正确解读或据此行动。端到端流水线需要串起各阶段成功，超出当前能力。
summary_sections.conclusion: 作者认为阶段级自动化可行，但端到端自动化尚未实现；研究识别出计算资源管理与对保留数据（held-out data）泛化等现有基准少有覆盖的挑战，并为开放式科学任务及严格评估提出原则。

papers.title: On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training
papers.abstract_en: Tool-calling is a central component of modern large language model (LLM) agents, equipping them with skills beyond their parametric knowledge. This paper studies tool-calling along two complementary axes: effectiveness, i.e., how this capability is measured, and efficiency, i.e., how it is learned. On effectiveness, we systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and show that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the random seed, system prompt, multi-turn template construction, and how prior interaction/reasoning history is carried forward. These choices can lead to substantial differences in reported performance, especially in multi-turn settings where without rigorous standardization, leaderboard rankings are unreliable. On efficiency, we examine standard reinforcement learning (RL) for tool-calling and identify two sources of computational waste: (i) during rollouts, many prompts produce no learning signal, and (ii) during policy updates, optimization incurs high computational cost. Guided by these findings, we introduce two techniques that accelerate RL-based tool-calling training, achieving substantial wall-clock speedup without degrading performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型智能体中工具调用 (tool-calling) 的有效性与效率。有效性方面，系统分析评估流程，发现随机种子、系统提示、多轮模板构造及历史交互传递等实现选择会显著影响结果，尤其在多轮设置下排行榜排名不可靠。效率方面，识别标准强化学习 (RL) 训练中的两处计算浪费，并提出两种加速技术，在不降低性能的前提下实现大幅墙钟时间加速。
Motivation: 工具调用是现代 LLM 智能体的核心能力，但其评估结果对看似无关紧要的实现细节高度敏感，且现有 RL 训练存在大量计算浪费，导致评估不可信、训练效率低下。
Method: 在有效性上系统剖析工具调用评估流程中的各类实现选择；在效率上分析 RL 训练中的 rollout 无学习信号与策略更新高计算成本问题，提出两项加速 RL 训练的技术。
Result: 摘要表明评估实现选择可造成报告性能的显著差异，尤其是在多轮设置下；提出的加速技术能实现显著墙钟时间加速且不损害性能。
Conclusion: 作者强调工具调用评估需要严格标准化，否则排行榜排名不可靠；同时 RL 训练可通过针对性技术降低计算开销。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Interpretability Is Unequally Distributed: Fairness in Hybrid Interpretable Models
papers.abstract_en: Hybrid interpretable models combine a transparent component with a black-box model by assigning some examples to the former and deferring the rest to the latter. While this design enables flexible tradeoffs between accuracy and interpretability, it also raises a distinct procedural fairness concern: some demographic groups may systematically receive interpretable decisions, while others are disproportionately routed to a black box. We formalize this issue as Interpretability Coverage Disparity (ICD), a demographic-parity-style measure applied to the routing decision of hybrid interpretable models. Using tools from predictive multiplicity, we study ICD across four hybrid interpretable learning methods, three standard fairness benchmark datasets, and multiple sensitive attributes. Our experiments reveal substantial ICD in intermediate transparency regimes, where both the interpretable and black-box components are actively used. We further show that simple coverage-disparity constraints can significantly reduce ICD in exact hybrid learning methods, with marginal impact on accuracy and sparsity. In several settings, ICD mitigation also improves standard algorithmic fairness metrics. These results show that hybrid interpretable models should be audited not only for predictive fairness, but also for how they allocate interpretability across individuals and groups.
papers.comment: This work has been accepted for publication at the 2026 AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究混合可解释模型（hybrid interpretable models）中的程序公平性问题：当模型将部分样本分配给透明组件、其余分配给黑盒组件时，不同人口群体可能系统性地获得不同类型的决策。作者将这一问题形式化为可解释性覆盖差异（Interpretability Coverage Disparity, ICD），并基于预测多重性（predictive multiplicity）工具在四种混合可解释方法、三个公平性基准数据集和多个敏感属性上进行了实验。
Motivation: 混合可解释模型在准确性与可解释性之间提供灵活权衡，但现有研究主要关注预测公平性，忽略了路由决策（routing decision）本身可能对不同群体造成可解释性分配不均的程序公平性问题。
Method: 提出ICD这一基于人口均等（demographic-parity）风格的路由公平性度量，并利用预测多重性工具分析四种混合可解释学习方法中的ICD；同时检验在精确混合学习方法中加入简单覆盖差异约束（coverage-disparity constraints）以缓解该问题。
Result: 实验发现中间透明性区间（intermediate transparency regimes）存在显著的ICD，即透明与黑盒组件同时被积极使用；加入覆盖差异约束可显著降低ICD，并对准确性和稀疏性影响很小，且在若干设置下还能改善标准算法公平性指标。
Conclusion: 作者强调混合可解释模型不仅应审计预测公平性，还应审计可解释性在个体和群体间的分配方式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The Matching Principle: When Does a Training Penalty Cover Deployment Shift?
papers.abstract_en: Ordinary training optimises the task loss and then stops. It never pays for internal representation energy: Jacobians can stay large in directions that never helped the label, so even small label-preserving noise throws the model off---a design gap that classical noise-injection theory fixes at second order, but only when applied as default regularisation, which current practice does not do. We make that precise with a Matching Principle: name deployment directions (Sigma_task) and the training penalty Sigma', and ask whether the second covers the first. The no-thinking default is even-spread / isotropic penalty (Sigma' proportional to I)---classical Gaussian / Tikhonov at second order: no axis estimate, no architecture change, and---in a simple linear ridge model---strictly less deployment drift than task-only training, with no coverage miss by construction. When axes are known, matching is sharper; when they are missed, a residual floor remains. Across seven domains a named second-moment penalty beats unregularised training; a controlled illustration recovers match > even-spread > wrong-axis when axes are forced. The ridge theorems are proved; deep nets remain experiments under a specified perturbation. Design rule: fix internal energy by default (even-spread); match when axes are known; treat losses that control representation sensitivity as first-class design.
papers.comment: 51 pages. Journal-aligned revision of this preprint for JMLR. Title and abstract updated to the even-spread coverage framing. Same author, Matching Principle, and experimental lineage; not a new paper. Under submission at JMLR. Companion: arXiv:2604.21395
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出匹配原则（Matching Principle），用训练惩罚的协方差 Sigma' 去覆盖部署偏移方向 Sigma_task，并论证默认的均匀各向同性惩罚（even-spread / isotropic，即二阶意义下的 Gaussian/Tikhonov）能避免覆盖遗漏。作者在简单线性岭模型中证明该默认惩罚比仅训练任务损失产生更少的部署漂移，并在七个领域与受控实验中展示匹配 > 均匀 > 错误轴。岭回归定理已证明，深度网络仍是在指定扰动下的实验结论。
Motivation: 普通训练只优化任务损失后即停止，不为内部表示能量付出代价，导致 Jacobian 在与标签无关的方向上可以保持很大，因此小幅度的保标签噪声就足以使模型失效；经典噪声注入理论虽能二阶修正该问题，但要求将其作为默认正则化使用，而当前实践并未这样做。
Method: 形式化匹配原则：命名部署方向 Sigma_task 与训练惩罚 Sigma'，考察后者是否覆盖前者。默认采取均匀各向同性惩罚（Sigma' 正比于 I），无需估计轴、无需改动架构；当轴已知时采用更尖锐的匹配。在线性岭回归中给出可证明的漂移分析，并在七个领域进行实证，另设受控实验强制指定轴方向以比较匹配、均匀与错误轴的覆盖效果。
Result: 摘要报告：在七个领域上，被命名的二阶矩惩罚均优于无正则化的训练；受控实验中恢复出 match > even-spread > wrong-axis 的次序；线性岭模型下均匀惩罚比仅任务训练严格减少部署漂移且按构造不存在覆盖遗漏；当轴被漏掉时存在残差下界。
Conclusion: 作者给出的设计规则是：默认用均匀各向同性惩罚固定内部能量，轴已知时采用匹配惩罚，并将控制表示敏感性的损失视为一等设计对象。岭回归部分的定理已证明，深度网络结论仍属于指定扰动条件下的实验范围（companion 为 arXiv:2604.21395）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the global convergence of gradient flow for wide shallow models beyond homogeneous nonlinearities
papers.abstract_en: A surprising phenomenon in the training of neural networks is the ability of gradient descent to find global minimizers of the training loss despite its non-convexity. Following earlier work, we investigate this behavior for wide shallow models. Existing global convergence results primarily concern models with positively one-homogeneous nonlinearities, such as ReLU activations, and models with scalar output weights and bounded nonlinearities, such as sigmoid activations. We study a broader class of models, including multi-head attention layers and two-layer networks with bounded or asymptotically positively one-homogeneous activations and vector output weights. Building upon [Chizat and Bach, 2018], we prove that, in the limit of many hidden neurons or attention heads, non-global minimizers of the training loss are unstable under mean-field gradient flow dynamics by constructing "escape regions" in the parameter space. Our global convergence statements are conditional in the following sense: if the mean-field gradient flow converges in W2, then its limit must be a global minimizer. We revisit the bounded nonlinearity, scalar-output setting of [CB18], giving an escape region construction adapted to unbounded nonlinear parameter domains. We also propose new constructions for nonlinearities with at most linear growth under a non-degeneracy assumption and for asymptotically positively one-homogeneous nonlinearities. Finally, we show the well-posedness and stability estimates for the mean-field training dynamics under sub-Gaussian initializations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究宽浅层模型（wide shallow models）在训练损失非凸情形下梯度流能否收敛到全局极小。基于 Chizat 与 Bach 的工作，作者把全局收敛结果推广到更广的模型类，包括多头注意力层和带向量输出权重的两层网络，其激活函数可为有界或渐近正一次齐次（asymptotically positively one-homogeneous）。他们通过构造参数空间中的“逃逸区域”（escape regions）证明：在隐藏神经元或注意力头数趋于无穷的极限下，非全局极小在 mean-field gradient flow 动力学下不稳定；若流在 W2 意义下收敛，则极限必为全局极小。文章还给出 sub-Gaussian 初始化下训练动力学的适定性与稳定性估计。
Motivation: 现有全局收敛结果主要限于正一次齐次非线性（如 ReLU）或标量输出权重加有界非线性（如 sigmoid）的模型；本文的目标是覆盖多头注意力层、向量输出权重以及更一般的激活函数，从而扩展 Chizat 和 Bach 的理论适用范围。
Method: 在 [Chizat and Bach, 2018] 的基础上，作者在参数空间构造“逃逸区域”以证明非全局极小在 mean-field gradient flow 下的不稳定性。针对有界非线性但有界参数域的情况给出新的逃逸区域构造；在非退化假设下处理至多线性增长的非线性，并为渐近正一次齐次非线性提出新构造。
Result: 理论结果表明，在隐藏神经元或注意力头数趋于无穷的极限下，训练损失的非全局极小在 mean-field gradient flow 下不稳定；全局收敛具有条件性：若该流在 W2 意义下收敛，则其极限必为全局极小。此外还建立了 sub-Gaussian 初始化下训练动力学的适定性与稳定性估计。
Conclusion: 摘要强调其全局收敛结论是条件性的，即依赖于 mean-field gradient flow 在 W2 意义下的收敛；本文通过新的逃逸区域构造，将不稳定性分析从齐次非线性扩展到无界参数域、至多线性增长以及渐近正一次齐次非线性等更一般情形。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Instance-Adaptive Online Multicalibration
papers.abstract_en: We study online multicalibration beyond the worst-case. We give a single, efficient algorithm which dynamically interpolates between benign and worst-case sequences by adaptively refining a dyadic grid of prediction values. Its error is controlled by the number of leaves in the refinement tree. Our analysis recovers the known $\widetilde O(T^{2/3})$ worst-case-optimal rate for online multicalibration, while simultaneously automatically adapting to easier instances: in the marginal stochastic setting it obtains a rate of $\widetilde O(\sqrt T)$, and for piecewise-stationary means with $J$ segments its rate is $\widetilde O(\sqrt{JT})$. More generally, the rate depends on a threshold-complexity measure of the predictable mean process relative to the group family. We show that this dependence is tight up to logarithmic factors.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在线多校准（online multicalibration）在实例自适应场景下的表现，提出单一高效算法，通过自适应细化预测值的二分网格（dyadic grid）动态插值于良性序列与最坏情况序列之间。分析恢复已知的最坏情况最优速率 O~(T^(2/3))，同时在边缘随机设置下达到 O~(√T) 速率，在分段平稳均值下达到 O~(√(JT)) 速率，并证明速率依赖在对数因子内是紧的。
Motivation: 现有在线多校准算法通常针对最坏情况序列设计，忽略了数据中可能存在的更简单结构，导致在良性实例上误差偏高。本文旨在突破最坏情况分析，使算法能自动适应实例复杂度。
Method: 提出一个单一且高效的在线多校准算法，动态自适应地细化预测值的二分网格，用细化树的叶子数量来控制误差，从而在困难与简单序列之间实现插值。
Result: 算法同时恢复最坏情况最优速率 O~(T^(2/3))，并在边际随机设置下取得 O~(√T) 速率，在具有 J 段的分段平稳均值下达到 O~(√(JT)) 速率；更一般地，速率由可预测均值过程的阈值复杂度度量决定，且该依赖在对数因子内是紧的。
Conclusion: 论文证明在线多校准可以自动适应更简单的数据实例，其误差特性由数据预测过程的复杂度度量刻画，并达到相应的最优速率，但不涉及具体应用领域。

papers.title: Field-Localized Forgery Detection for Digital Identity Documents
papers.abstract_en: Digital onboarding and eKYC systems used by banks, fintech platforms, telecom providers, and other third-party services commonly verify users by comparing an uploaded identity document with a selfie or live facial capture. This workflow is convenient, but it also makes verification systems vulnerable to localised document manipulations, such as replacing the facial photograph, editing textual identity fields, or altering both. Existing image-forgery detectors are largely designed for natural images and do not explicitly account for the structured layout of identity documents, where security-relevant information is concentrated in specific semantic fields. We propose FLiD, a lightweight field-localised framework for identity-document forgery detection. Instead of processing the full document image, FLiD localises the facial and textual regions using a fine-tuned YOLO11 detector, extracts compact representations with a frozen MobileNetV3-Small backbone, and classifies field-level forgeries using a small 191K-parameter head. Face and text detectors are trained independently and combined through score-level fusion for documents containing simultaneous manipulations. Under 5-fold cross-validation, FLiD achieves AUC scores of 0.834, 0.926, and 0.837 for face, text, and combined attacks, respectively, while reducing Equal Error Rate by 28--29 percentage points compared with a full-document baseline. FLiD also outperforms general-purpose forgery detectors while requiring 13x fewer trainable parameters and 21x fewer FLOPs per field (~8x per full multi-field document), making it a promising candidate for data and resource constrained KYC deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FLiD，一个面向数字身份证件的轻量级字段局部化伪造检测框架。与整图检测不同，FLiD 先用微调后的 YOLO11 定位人脸与文本区域，再用冻结的 MobileNetV3-Small 骨干提取紧凑表示，最后由一个 191K 参数的小型分类头做字段级伪造判别；人脸与文本检测器独立训练，并通过分数级融合处理同时篡改。5 折交叉验证下，FLiD 在人脸、文本和组合攻击上的 AUC 分别为 0.834、0.926 和 0.837，相比整文档基线将等错误率降低 28–29 个百分点。
Motivation: 银行、金融科技、电信等数字开户与 eKYC 流程普遍通过比对身份证件与自拍来验证用户，但该流程易受局部文档篡改攻击，例如替换人脸照片或编辑文本字段。现有图像伪造检测器主要面向自然图像，未考虑身份证件中安全信息集中在特定语义字段的结构化布局。
Method: FLiD 不对全图处理，而是使用微调的 YOLO11 定位人脸和文本区域，用冻结的 MobileNetV3-Small 骨干提取紧凑特征，并以 191K 参数的小型头部进行字段级伪造分类。人脸与文本检测器独立训练，对同时包含两类篡改的文档通过分数级融合（score-level fusion）合并判别结果。
Result: 在 5 折交叉验证下，FLiD 对人脸、文本和组合攻击的 AUC 分别为 0.834、0.926 和 0.837；相比整文档基线，等错误率（EER）降低 28–29 个百分点。相比通用伪造检测器，FLiD 同时以少 13 倍的可训练参数和每字段少 21 倍的 FLOPs（每个多字段整文档约少 8 倍）取得更优性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 FLiD 的轻量设计与字段局部化策略使其在数据和资源受限的 KYC 部署场景下具有应用潜力。

papers.title: Same Targets, Different Computation: How Post-Training Divides Work Across Model Layers
papers.abstract_en: A late-layer change learned during post-training may work on the base model's earlier state, or it may depend on earlier computation learned with it. We distinguish these cases with a four-cell diagnostic that crosses base or descendant upstream states with base or descendant late stacks. A large late-stack effect need not imply strong upstream dependence. On math prompts, OpenMath2's late stack changes the target margin by +3.43 logits after base upstream state and +3.28 after its own, giving a near-zero interaction. Several instruction-following descendants of the same Llama-3.1-8B base show greater dependence, while controlled code and biomedical continuation-training runs sit near zero on the common support; seven released descendants span -0.54 to +2.20 logits. Because those checkpoints differ in many ways, we then isolate one training property. Two LoRA fine-tunes learn identical target responses requested either by familiar natural-language instructions or by newly learned nonce codes. Changing only this cue-to-response relation increases upstream dependence by +5.56 logits on Qwen3-4B and +4.18 on Llama-3.1-8B, with a positive paired shift in all six model-by-seed runs. The interaction is also positive in all five released base/instruction pairs we test, and late-stack replacement changes the full-vocabulary argmax in about half of events. Post-training can therefore organize the same target behavior with different dependencies between earlier and later computation. The diagnostic measures local next-token compatibility, not free-running component transplantation.
papers.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and compact artifacts: https://github.com/yifan1207/first-divergence-crosspatching
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个四格诊断（four-cell diagnostic），通过交叉使用 base 或 descendant 的上游状态与 base 或 descendant 的 late stack，区分后训练中学到的晚期层变化是独立作用于基础模型早期状态，还是依赖与之一同学习的早期计算。在数学提示上 OpenMath2 的 late stack 交互接近零，而指令跟随后代与受控继续训练运行呈现不同依赖；作者还用 LoRA 实验隔离训练属性，显示改变提示-响应关系会增加上游依赖。该诊断度量的是局部 next-token 兼容性，而非自由运行的组件移植。
Motivation: 后训练中晚期层的改变可能依赖与之一同学习的早期计算，而现有方法难以区分「晚期层独立有效」与「依赖早期计算」这两种情况；理解后训练如何跨层分配计算有助于模型解释与后续训练设计。
Method: 提出四格诊断，将 base 或 descendant 的上游状态与 base 或 descendant 的 late stack 交叉组合以测量交互效应；并设计受控 LoRA 微调实验，仅改变提示-响应关系（熟悉的自然语言指令 vs 新学的 nonce 代码），以隔离单一训练属性对上游依赖的影响。
Result: OpenMath2 在数学提示上 late stack 改变 target margin 在 base 上游后为 +3.43 logits、在自身上游后为 +3.28 logits，交互接近零；七个发布后代在共同支撑集上跨度 -0.54 至 +2.20 logits。LoRA 实验中仅改变线索-响应关系使上游依赖在 Qwen3-4B 提升 +5.56 logits、在 Llama-3.1-8B 提升 +4.18 logits，六个模型×种子运行均呈正向配对变化；五个发布的 base/instruction 对交互均为正，约一半事件中 late-stack 替换改变了全词表 argmax。
Conclusion: 后训练可以用不同的早-晚计算依赖来组织相同目标行为；作者强调该诊断衡量的是局部 next-token 兼容性，而非自由运行的组件移植。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Proteo-R1: Reasoning Foundation Models for De Novo Protein Design
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning in de novo protein design has achieved atomic-level fidelity. However, existing models remain largely non-deliberative: they directly synthesize molecular geometries without explicitly reasoning about which residues or interactions are functionally essential. As a result, design decisions are entangled with continuous sampling dynamics, limiting interpretability, controllability, and systematic reuse of biochemical knowledge. We introduce Proteo-R1, a reasoning-guided protein design framework that explicitly decouples molecular understanding from geometric generation. Proteo-R1 adopts a dual-expert architecture in which a multimodal large language model (MLLM) serves as an understanding expert, analyzing protein sequences, structures, and textual context to identify key functional residues that govern binding and specificity. These residue-level decisions are then passed as hard constraints to a separate diffusion-based generation expert, which performs conditional co-design while respecting the fixed interaction anchors. This factorization mirrors how human experts approach molecular engineering: first, reasoning about critical interactions, then optimizing geometry subject to those constraints. By operationalizing reasoning as explicit residue-level commitments rather than latent textual guidance, Proteo-R1 achieves stable, interpretable, and modular integration of LLM reasoning with state-of-the-art geometric generative models. Code, data, and demos are available at https://smiles724.github.io/r1/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Proteo-R1，一个将显式推理与几何生成解耦的蛋白质设计框架。其采用双专家架构：多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 作为理解专家，从序列、结构和文本中识别关键功能残基；这些残基级决策作为硬约束传递给独立的扩散生成专家，进行条件共设计。摘要称该方法实现了 LLM 推理与几何生成模型的稳定、可解释和模块化集成。
Motivation: 现有从头蛋白质设计模型缺乏推理能力，直接合成分子几何而不显式判断哪些残基或相互作用在功能上关键，导致设计决策与连续采样动力学纠缠，限制可解释性、可控性和生化知识的系统性复用。
Method: 提出双专家架构，将分子理解与几何生成解耦：MLLM 理解专家分析蛋白质序列、结构和文本上下文以确定支配结合与特异性的关键功能残基，随后将这些残基级决策作为固定交互锚点的硬约束传给单独的扩散生成专家。
Result: 摘要未报告具体定量指标，主要声称通过将推理显式化为残基级承诺而非潜在文本引导，获得稳定、可解释且模块化的推理-生成集成效果。
Conclusion: 该分解方式类比人类专家先推理关键相互作用、再在约束下优化几何的分子工程流程，为 LLM 推理与几何生成模型的集成提供了一条可操作路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Correction and Corruption: A Two-Rate View of Error Flow in LLM Protocols
papers.abstract_en: Large language models operate in protocols containing multiple calls, yet added calls are usually evaluated only by their net effect. That summary cannot distinguish correcting unsuccessful outputs from corrupting initially successful ones. We develop a paired audit recording success before and after a specified operation on the same tasks under one binary rule. Correction and corruption rates exactly account for the net change: gains come from corrected failures and losses from corrupted successes. The break-even correction requirement rises sharply with baseline success, so the same behavior can improve a moderate-baseline population but harm a high-baseline one. Applied to published GPT-4 GSM8K results, the framework bounds within-sample correction and corruption counts from aggregate accuracies. We ask if calibration estimates predict unobserved outcomes, how rates change with information supplied to an operation, and whether successive measurements combine. Calibration estimates track accuracy on a disjoint sample from the same generator. Under reweighting of generator-defined groups, pooled estimates can fail while group-specific estimates reduce average prediction error. On GSM8K, observable features capture limited variation at these sample sizes, so the group-level application rule remains exploratory. Reordering a fixed four-candidate set changes both rates, with the accuracy effect depending on whether a correct alternative is available; on MBPP, adding a helper artifact raises corruptions among 357 initially passing programs from 28 to 100. Direct and composed transition estimates are close on average within samples; weighting initial-success rows by support substantially reduces held-out discrepancy. Correction and corruption are measurements of specified operations, not model constants, and can guide input choices, application decisions, and composition tests.
papers.comment: 16 pages main paper, 19 pages supplementary material included as ancillary file. Major revision with substantially reorganized and streamlined presentation; expanded held-out prediction, population-composition, input-sensitivity, and composition analyses; includes an MBPP corruption audit and updated related work
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种配对审计 (paired audit) 方法，在同一个二值规则下记录同一任务集上指定操作前后的成功情况，从而将 LLM 协议中净准确率变化精确分解为被纠正的失败与被破坏的成功两部分。作者用该框架分析 GPT-4 GSM8K 的已发表结果，并考察校准估计、分组重加权、候选重排序以及多次测量的组合问题。摘要强调修正率与破坏率是特定操作的测量结果，而非模型常数。
Motivation: 大语言模型协议包含多次调用，但额外调用通常只按净效果评估，无法区分它是在纠正原本失败的输出还是在破坏原本成功的输出。这种粒度缺失会掩盖操作的真实行为，因此需要一种能分别量化两面影响的审计框架。
Method: 在相同任务集上、同一二值规则下记录操作前与操作后的成功状态，得到修正率 (correction rate) 与破坏率 (corruption rate)，两者恰好解释净变化。框架进一步用于从聚合准确率界定样本内修正/破坏计数，并分析校准估计的预测性、生成器分组重加权、候选重排序以及直接与组合转移估计的一致性。
Result: 摘要报告：盈亏平衡所需修正率随基线成功率急剧上升，同一行为可能改善中等基线群体却损害高基线群体；在 MBPP 上，添加辅助工件 (helper artifact) 使 357 个初始通过程序中的破坏数从 28 升至 100；校准估计在同一生成器的无交叠样本上能追踪准确率；在 GSM8K 上，可观测特征在该样本量下仅捕捉有限变异，组级应用规则仍属探索性；直接与组合转移估计在样本内均值上接近，按支持度 (support) 加权初始成功行可显著降低留出差异。
Conclusion: 作者强调修正率与破坏率是特定操作的测量结果而非模型常数，可用于指导输入选择、应用决策与组合测试；同时指出 GSM8K 上的组级应用规则由于样本量限制仍只是探索性的。
Relevance: 0

papers.abstract_en: Automated evaluation of tool-using large language model (LLM) agents is widely assumed to be reliable, yet this assumption is rarely validated against human annotation. We present AgentProp-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 14,750 execution traces from thirteen LLM agents (nine proprietary, four open-weight) across four domains, and use it to audit three questions. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出诊断基准 AgentProp-Bench，包含来自十三个 LLM 智能体（九个专有、四个开放权重）在四个领域中的 14,750 条执行轨迹，用于审计工具使用型智能体的自动化评估。摘要发现子串启发式评判与人工标注仅在随机水平一致（Cohen's kappa = 0.049），而单个 GPT-4o-mini 评判器最强（kappa = 0.567）；参数级错误在验证后的评判下以约 0.62 的人类校准概率传播为错误最终答案；部分智能体会虚构工具执行结果，轻量级运行时拦截器可降低幻觉（最多 24 个百分点）。
Motivation: 工具使用型 LLM 智能体的自动化评估被广泛认为可靠，但这一假设很少与人工标注对照验证，本文旨在系统审计该假设。
Method: 构建 AgentProp-Bench 诊断基准并引入人工标注，比较子串启发式评判、三 LLM 集成评判与单个 GPT-4o-mini 评判的一致性，分析参数级错误的传播概率，并测试轻量级运行时拦截器对工具执行幻觉的缓解效果。
Result: 子串启发式评判与人工标注一致性几乎为零（kappa = 0.049），单 GPT-4o-mini 评判达到最强中等等级一致性（kappa = 0.567），双标注者间接近完全一致（kappa = 0.835）；错误传播概率约 0.62 且在专有与开放权重模型上可复现；运行时拦截器在开放权重模型上以可调工作点净收益降低幻觉最高 24 个百分点。
Conclusion: 摘要强调需要经过人工标注验证的评判器，并指出端到端分数无法发现虚构工具执行问题；轻量级运行时干预对开放权重模型是净正收益，所有代码、数据与人工标签已公开。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: InfiniteScienceGym: An Unbounded, Procedurally-Generated Benchmark for Scientific Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are emerging as scientific assistants, but evaluating their ability to reason from empirical data remains challenging. Benchmarks derived from published studies and human annotations inherit publication bias, known-knowledge bias, label noise, and substantial storage requirements. We present InfiniteScienceGym, a procedurally generated benchmark of scientific repositories paired with a verifiable question-answering task. From a seed, the simulator deterministically generates a self-contained repository with realistic directory structure, files, and tabular data, and a privileged QA generator produces both answerable and unanswerable questions with exact ground truth. This makes it possible to evaluate evidence-grounded reasoning, abstention, and tool-mediated analysis in a controlled setting without distributing a large static corpus. InfiniteScienceGym complements real scientific benchmarks by targeting blind spots and failure modes that are hard to evaluate using published datasets alone. Evaluating both proprietary and open-weight models, we find that none achieve more than 50% accuracy overall, that recognizing unanswerable questions remains a major weakness, and that stronger models tend to use tools more effectively rather than simply consuming more tokens.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 5 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to COLM 2026. See https://infinitesciencegym.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 InfiniteScienceGym，一个由程序生成、无界 (unbounded) 的科学分析基准。它从种子确定性地生成自包含的科学仓库（含目录结构、文件、表格数据），并由特权 QA 生成器产生可回答与不可回答的问题及精确 ground truth，从而在受控环境中评估基于证据的推理、弃权 (abstention) 和基于工具的分析。摘要报告，在专有与开源权重模型上均没有任何模型的总体准确率超过 50%，识别不可回答问题仍是主要弱点，且更强的模型倾向于更有效地使用工具而非单纯消耗更多 token。
Motivation: 现有基于已发表研究和人工标注的基准继承发表偏倚、已知知识偏倚、标签噪声，并带来大量存储需求，难以评估大语言模型从经验数据中进行科学推理的能力。
Method: 通过种子确定性地程序化生成自包含的科学仓库，模拟真实目录结构、文件和表格数据；特权 QA 生成器产生带精确 ground truth 的可回答与不可回答问题，从而在不分发大规模静态语料的前提下支持对推理、弃权和工具中介分析的评估。
Result: 摘要报告，专有与开源权重模型在整体准确率上均未超过 50%；识别不可回答问题仍是主要弱点；更强的模型更善于有效使用工具，而非仅仅产生更多 token。
Conclusion: InfiniteScienceGym 通过程序化生成补充真实科学基准，针对仅用已发布数据集难以评估的盲点和失败模式，并避免依赖大规模静态语料库。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Simpler Logarithmic Approximation Algorithms for the Optimal Decision Tree and Adaptive Set Cover
papers.abstract_en: We study a well-known task of constructing a decision tree identifying an unknown hypothesis from a given ground set of hypotheses under both the average- and worst-case cost. The Optimal Decision Tree problem has been extensively studied in the literature and $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation guarantees are known for both cost criteria (here $n$ is the number of hypotheses). Although the algorithms achieving this approximation ratio are usually relatively simple, their analysis often turns out to be quite technical. Hereby, we show a new algorithm with a simplified analysis which simultaneously achieves an $\mathcal{O}(\log n)$-approximation for both cost criteria. Moreover, the leading constant under the $\mathcal{O}$-notation in the approximation ratio is relatively small, below $3.65$ for the worst-case cost and twice as much for the average-case cost, assuming base $2$ logarithm. Our algorithm for the Optimal Decision Tree behaves greedily with respect to the hereby introduced Separating Subfamily problem which asks for the cheapest subfamily of tests which partitions the hypotheses into pieces of small enough size. We show that the Separating Subfamily can itself be reduced to an instance of the well-known Maximum Coverage problem. At the core of our approach lies exploiting properties of cutting a clique into small pieces, where edges represent pairs of hypotheses to be separated. As an application of our result we also provide an $\mathcal{O}(\log (k\cdot n))$-approximation for the Adaptive Set Cover problem, where $k$ is the number of possible realizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究最优决策树 (Optimal Decision Tree) 问题，目标是构造决策树以在平均代价和最坏代价下识别未知假设。作者提出一种新的贪心算法，其分析更简洁，同时为两种代价准则实现 O(log n) 近似比，且最坏情况下的常数因子低于 3.65（以 2 为底对数），平均情况下为其两倍。算法基于新引入的 Separating Subfamily 问题，该问题可归约为最大覆盖 (Maximum Coverage) 问题，核心思想是利用将团切成小块的性质。作为应用，还给出了自适应集合覆盖 (Adaptive Set Cover) 的 O(log(k·n)) 近似算法。
Motivation: 最优决策树问题已有 O(log n) 近似算法，但现有算法的分析往往相当技术化；本文目标是提供一种算法，其分析更简单，同时保持对两种代价准则的近似保证，并希望常数因子较小。
Method: 提出一个针对最优决策树问题的贪心算法，该算法基于新定义的 Separating Subfamily 问题，即寻找最便宜的子族测试使得假设集合被划分为足够小的块；随后证明 Separating Subfamily 可归约为 Maximum Coverage 问题，并通过分析将团切成小块的性质来完成近似比证明。
Result: 摘要报告该算法同时对平均代价和最坏代价达到 O(log n) 近似比；最坏情况近似比的领先常数在 2 为底对数下低于 3.65，平均情况约为其两倍。作为应用，还得到自适应集合覆盖问题的 O(log(k·n)) 近似算法。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种更易分析的贪心算法，同时为最优决策树两种代价准则保持 O(log n) 近似，并将结果推广到自适应集合覆盖问题。摘要未提及实验或局限性。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: A Tale of Two Temperatures: Simple, Efficient, and Diverse Sampling from Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Much work has been done on designing fast and accurate sampling for diffusion language models (dLLMs). However, these efforts have largely focused on the tradeoff between speed and quality of individual samples; how to additionally ensure diversity across samples remains less well understood. In this work, we show that diversity can be increased by using softened, tempered versions of familiar confidence-based remasking heuristics, retaining their computational benefits and offering simple implementations. We motivate this approach by introducing an idealized formal model of fork tokens and studying the impact of remasking on the expected entropy at the forks. Empirically, the proposed tempered heuristics close the exploration gap (pass@k) between existing confidence-based and autoregressive sampling, hence outperforming both when controlling for cost (pass@NFE). We further study how the increase in diversity translates to downstream post-training and test-time compute scaling. Overall, our findings demonstrate that simple, efficient, and diverse sampling from dLLMs is possible.
papers.comment: V2: accepted as a full conference paper at COLM
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散语言模型 (dLLMs) 采样中的多样性问题，提出对基于置信度的 remasking 启发式使用软化、温度化 (tempered) 版本，在保持计算效率的同时提升样本多样性。作者引入 fork tokens 的理想化形式模型来分析 remasking 对分支处期望熵的影响，并实验显示所提方法在 pass@k 上缩小了基于置信度采样与自回归采样的探索差距，且在控制计算成本 (pass@NFE) 时优于二者。摘要认为简单、高效且多样的 dLLM 采样是可行的。
Motivation: 现有 dLLM 采样研究主要关注速度与单样本质量的权衡，跨样本的多样性如何保证仍缺乏充分理解。
Method: 提出温控 (tempered) 的置信度 remasking 启发式，并构建 fork tokens 的理想化形式模型来研究 remasking 对分支处期望熵的影响。
Result: 实验表明所提启发式在 pass@k 上缩小了基于置信度采样与自回归采样的探索差距，并在控制成本指标 pass@NFE 上优于两者；多样性提升还可传导至下游后训练与测试时计算扩展。
Conclusion: 作者的结论是简单、高效且多样的 dLLM 采样是可能的；摘要未给出具体的局限性说明。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Significance and Stability Analysis of Gene-Environment Interaction using GxEStat
papers.abstract_en: Genotype-environment (GxE) interactions can influence the performance of genotypes across diverse environments, limiting the reliability of genotype evaluation and selection in breeding programs. In-depth analysis of GxE interactions is therefore essential for understanding how genetic advantages or defects are expressed under varying environmental conditions and for identifying superior and stable genotypes. This study presents an integrated computational framework for GxE analysis that combines significance and stability evaluation within a unified analytical workflow. The framework incorporates the mixed effect modeling to quantify the significance of environment, genotype, and GxE effects, together with multiple stability analysis approaches for characterizing genotype adaptability, environmental representativeness, and performance consistency across environments. To support reproducible statistical analysis, we develop GxEStat, an interactive R platform that automates model construction, parameter estimation, statistical inference, and graphical visualization. GxEStat substantially improves analytical efficiency, reproducibility, and accessibility for multi-environment trial analysis. Applications to real breeding datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework for practical breeding research. Codes are available at https://github.com/mason-ching/GxEStat.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个整合显著性与稳定性评估的基因型-环境互作（GxE）分析计算框架，并开发交互式 R 平台 GxEStat 来统一完成模型构建、参数估计、统计推断与图形可视化。摘要报告在真实育种数据集上的应用验证了该框架对多环境试验（multi-environment trial）分析的有效性。
Motivation: GxE 互作会影响基因型在不同环境下的表现，从而降低育种项目中基因型评价与选择的可靠性，因此需要深入分析 GxE 互作以理解遗传优势或缺陷在不同环境条件下的表达。
Method: 框架采用混合效应建模（mixed effect modeling）来量化环境、基因型与 GxE 效应的显著性，并结合多种稳定性分析方法刻画基因型适应性、环境代表性与跨环境表现一致性；同时实现为 GxEStat 交互式 R 平台，自动完成模型构建、参数估计、统计推断和图形可视化。
Result: 摘要未提供具体数值指标，仅说明在真实育种数据集上的应用证明了该框架对实际育种研究的有效性。
Conclusion: 作者强调 GxEStat 显著提升了多环境试验分析的效率、可重复性和可访问性，并提供了开源代码。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoEvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification
papers.abstract_en: Anthropic proposes the concept of skills for LLM agents to tackle multi-step professional tasks that simple tool invocations cannot address. A tool is a single, self-contained function, whereas a skill is a structured bundle of interdependent multi-file artifacts. Currently, skill generation is not only label-intensive due to manual authoring, but also may suffer from human--machine cognitive misalignment, which can lead to degraded agent performance, as evidenced by evaluations on SkillsBench. Therefore, we aim to enable agents to autonomously generate skills. However, existing self-evolving methods designed for tools cannot be directly applied to skills due to their increased complexity. To address these issues, we propose CoEvoSkills, a self-evolving skills framework that enables agents to autonomously construct complex, multi-file skill packages. Specifically, CoEvoSkills couples a Skill Generator that iteratively refines skills with a Surrogate Verifier that co-evolves to provide informative and actionable feedback without access to ground-truth test content. On SkillsBench, CoEvoSkills outperforms five baselines on both Claude Code and Codex, and generalizes strongly to six additional LLMs. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zhang-Henry/CoEvoSkills.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoEvoSkills，一个让 LLM agent 自主构建复杂多文件技能包 (skill package) 的自进化框架。框架将 Skill Generator 与 Surrogate Verifier 耦合，后者在没有 ground-truth 测试内容的情况下共同进化并提供可操作的反馈，以解决手工编写技能标签成本高且存在人机认知偏差的问题。在 SkillsBench 上，CoEvoSkills 在 Claude Code 和 Codex 上均优于五个基线，并泛化到另外六个 LLM。
Motivation: 现有技能 (skill) 生成依赖人工编写，标签成本高，且人机认知不一致可能导致 agent 性能下降。已有的面向工具 (tool) 的自进化方法因技能复杂度更高而无法直接迁移。
Method: 提出自进化技能框架 CoEvoSkills，包含迭代精化技能的 Skill Generator 和共同进化的 Surrogate Verifier，后者无需访问 ground-truth 测试内容即可提供信息丰富且可操作的反馈。
Result: 在 SkillsBench 上，CoEvoSkills 在 Claude Code 和 Codex 上均优于五个基线，并在另外六个 LLM 上表现出强泛化性。
Conclusion: 作者认为 CoEvoSkills 能使 agent 自主构建复杂多文件技能包，缓解手工技能生成中的标签密集和人机认知偏差问题，并已在多个 LLM 上验证效果；代码已开源。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: Dual Space Preconditioning for Gradient Descent in the Overparameterized Regime
papers.abstract_en: In this work, we study the convergence properties of the Dual Space Preconditioned Gradient Descent, encompassing optimizers such as Normalized Gradient Descent and Gradient Clipping. We consider preconditioners of the form $\nabla K$, where $K: \mathbb{R}^{d \times k} \to \mathbb{R}$ is convex and apply $\nabla K(\cdot)$ to train an over-parameterized linear model with a convex loss of the form $\ell(X W - Y)$, for weights $W \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times k}$, labels $Y \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times k}$ and data $X \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times d}$. Under the aforementioned assumptions, we prove that the iterates of the full-batch preconditioned gradient descent converge at an exponential rate to a point $W_{\infty} \in \mathbb{R}^{d \times k}$ satisfying $XW_{\infty} = Y$. We also study the implicit bias of Dual Space Preconditioned Gradient Descent. First, we demonstrate analytically and empirically that, for general $K(\cdot)$, $W_\infty$ depends on the chosen constant step size, hindering a precise characterization of the implicit bias. We also provide an approximate implicit bias property for general preconditioners, namely, $\|W_0 - W_{\infty}\|_F \le c \|W_0 - W_{\text{GD}, \infty}\|_F$ for a constant $c>0$ and $W_{\text{GD}, \infty}$ denoting the convergence point of GD initialized at $W_0$. Furthermore, for preconditioners of the form $K(G) = h(\|G\|_F)$, known as {\it isotropic preconditioners}, and for the stochastic variation of the algorithm with arbitrary batch-size, we prove linear convergence to $W_{\text{GD}, \infty}$. Finally, in the experiments, we demonstrate faster convergence on a nonlinear model obtained using the smoothed matrix elastic-net as a preconditioner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在过参数化线性模型框架下研究双空间预条件梯度下降（Dual Space Preconditioned Gradient Descent）的收敛性质，涵盖归一化梯度下降和梯度裁剪等优化器。作者证明对形如 ∇K 的凸预条件子，全批量预条件梯度下降的迭代以指数速率收敛到满足 XW∞=Y 的点，并进一步分析其隐式偏差。对于各向同性预条件子 K(G)=h(‖G‖_F) 及其任意批大小的随机变体，证明了线性收敛到普通梯度下降的收敛点 W_GD,∞；实验表明使用平滑矩阵弹性网作为预条件子在非线性模型上收敛更快。
Motivation: 过参数化场景下梯度下降的收敛与隐式偏差缺乏统一刻画，一般形式的预条件梯度下降（如归一化梯度下降、梯度裁剪）的收敛保证和隐式偏差性质尚不明确。
Method: 将预条件子抽象为凸函数 K: R^{d×k}→R 的梯度 ∇K，应用于凸损失 ℓ(XW-Y) 训练的过参数化线性模型；分析全批量预条件梯度下降的指数收敛，并针对各向同性预条件子与随机批大小变体证明线性收敛，同时在实验中用平滑矩阵弹性网作为预条件子验证。
Result: 证明全批量迭代指数收敛到满足 XW∞=Y 的点；对一般 K(·) 给出近似隐式偏差界 ‖W0-W∞‖_F ≤ c‖W0-W_GD,∞‖_F；对各向同性预条件子及其随机变体证明线性收敛到 W_GD,∞；实验显示非线性模型上收敛更快。
Conclusion: 作者指出一般 K 下收敛点 W∞ 依赖所选常数步长，这阻碍了精确隐式偏差刻画；近似隐式偏差刻画了预条件梯度下降与普通 GD 收敛点之间的关系。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: MT-PingEval: Evaluating Multi-Turn Collaboration with Private Information Games
papers.abstract_en: We present a scalable and verifiable methodology for evaluating language models in multi-turn interactions, using a suite of collaborative games that require effective communication about private information. This enables an interactive scaling analysis, in which a fixed token budget is divided over a variable number of turns. We find that language models often fail to use interactive collaboration to improve over the non-interactive baseline in which one agent summarizes its information and the other agent immediately acts, despite substantial headroom. This suggests that state-of-the-art models still suffer from significant weaknesses in planning and executing multi-turn collaborative conversations. We analyze the linguistic features of these dialogues, assessing the roles of sycophancy, information density, and discourse coherence. While there is no single linguistic explanation for the collaborative weaknesses of contemporary language models, we note that humans achieve comparable task success at superior token efficiency by producing more coherent dialogues. The proactive management of private information is a defining feature of real-world communication, and this work is designed to drive further progress on this capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种可扩展且可验证的方法来评估语言模型在多轮交互中的协作能力，所用工具是一组要求有效沟通私有信息（private information）的协作游戏。作者在固定 token 预算下进行交互式扩展分析（interactive scaling analysis），发现语言模型往往无法通过交互协作超过‘一个智能体总结信息、另一个立即行动’的非交互基线，尽管存在较大提升空间。文章还分析了对话的语言特征，包括阿谀奉承（sycophancy）、信息密度和话语连贯性，并指出人类能以更简洁连贯的对话实现相当的任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有评估缺乏针对多轮交互中私有信息沟通的可扩展、可验证手段；作者希望系统衡量语言模型在需要规划和执行多轮协作对话时的真实能力。
Method: 构建一套协作游戏套件，将固定 token 预算分配到可变数量的轮次，形成可验证的交互式扩展分析。对比非交互基线，并进一步从语言特征（阿谀奉承、信息密度、话语连贯性）角度剖析模型与人类的对话差异。
Result: 语言模型通常无法利用交互协作改善于非交互基线，尽管存在显著提升空间；人类则通过更连贯的对话以更优的 token 效率达到相似任务成功率。
Conclusion: 当代语言模型在多轮协作对话的规划与执行上仍有显著弱点；私有信息的主动管理是真实世界沟通的关键特征，该工作旨在推动这一能力的发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Efficient Uncoupled Learning Dynamics with $\tilde{O}\!\left(T^{-1/4}\right)$ Last-Iterate Convergence in Bilinear Saddle-Point Problems over Convex Sets under Bandit Feedback
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study last-iterate convergence of learning algorithms in bilinear saddle-point problems, a preferable notion of convergence that captures the day-to-day behavior of learning dynamics. We focus on the challenging setting where players select actions from compact convex sets and receive only bandit feedback. Our main contribution is the design of an uncoupled learning algorithm that guarantees last-iterate convergence to the Nash equilibrium with high probability. We establish a convergence rate of $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/4})$ up to polynomial factors in problem parameters. Crucially, our proposed algorithm is computationally efficient, requiring only an efficient linear optimization oracle over the players' compact action sets. The algorithm is obtained by combining techniques from experimental design and the classic Follow-The-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) framework, with a carefully chosen regularizer function tailored to the geometry of the action set of each learner.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双线性鞍点问题 (bilinear saddle-point problems) 中学习算法的最后迭代收敛 (last-iterate convergence)，针对玩家在紧凸集上只能获得 bandit 反馈的困难设定。作者提出一种解耦 (uncoupled) 学习算法，以高概率保证最后迭代收敛到纳什均衡 (Nash equilibrium)，收敛率为问题参数多项式因子意义下的 $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/4})$。算法只需一个有效的线性优化 oracle，计算高效，技术来自实验设计 (experimental design) 与经典 FTRL 框架的结合。
Motivation: 最后迭代收敛能刻画学习动力学的逐日行为，是比平均迭代收敛更自然的收敛概念；在仅有 bandit 反馈且动作集为紧凸集的设定下，构造高效且保证最后迭代收敛的解耦算法是开放且有挑战的问题。
Method: 提出一种解耦学习算法，将实验设计技术与经典 Follow-The-Regularized-Leader (FTRL) 框架结合，为每个学习者的动作集几何专门设计正则子 (regularizer) 函数，并且只需要对玩家的紧动作集调用高效线性优化 oracle。
Result: 摘要报告算法以高概率保证最后迭代收敛到纳什均衡，收敛率为 $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/4})$（忽略问题参数的多项式因子），同时保持计算高效性。
Conclusion: 本文的主要贡献是给出首个在 bandit 反馈、紧凸动作集设定下兼具计算效率与 $\tilde{O}(T^{-1/4})$ 最后迭代收敛率的解耦学习算法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CADET: Context-Conditioned Ads CTR Prediction With a Decoder-Only Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is fundamental to online advertising systems. While Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRMs) with explicit feature interactions have long dominated this domain, recent advances in generative recommenders have shown promising results in content recommendation. However, adapting these transformer-based architectures to ads CTR prediction still presents unique challenges, including handling post-scoring contextual signals, maintaining offline-online consistency, and scaling to industrial workloads. We present CADET (Context-Conditioned Ads Decoder-Only Transformer), an end-to-end decoder-only transformer for ads CTR prediction deployed at LinkedIn. Our approach introduces several key innovations: (1) a context-conditioned decoding architecture with multi-tower prediction heads that explicitly model post-scoring signals such as ad position, resolving the chicken-and-egg problem between predicted CTR and ranking; (2) a self-gated attention mechanism that stabilizes training by adaptively regulating information flow at both representation and interaction levels; (3) a timestamp-based variant of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) that captures temporal relationships across timescales from seconds to months; (4) session masking strategies that prevent the model from learning dependencies on unavailable in-session events, addressing train-serve skew; and (5) production engineering techniques including tensor packing, sequence chunking, and custom Flash Attention kernels that enable efficient training and serving at scale. In online A/B testing, CADET achieves a 11.04\% CTR lift compared to the production LiRank baseline model, a hybrid ensemble of DCNv2 and sequential encoders. The system has been successfully deployed on LinkedIn's advertising platform, serving the main traffic for homefeed sponsored updates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 CADET (Context-Conditioned Ads Decoder-Only Transformer)，一个部署于 LinkedIn 的端到端 decoder-only transformer 广告 CTR 预测系统。它通过上下文条件解码、自门控注意力、时间戳版 RoPE 和会话掩码等设计，解决后评分上下文信号、训练服务一致性和工业规模扩展等挑战。在线 A/B 测试中相比生产 LiRank 基线取得 11.04% 的 CTR 提升，并已在 LinkedIn 广告平台主页赞助内容的主要流量上部署。
Motivation: 广告 CTR 预测长期由带显式特征交互的深度学习推荐模型 (DLRM) 主导，而生成式推荐器在内容推荐中展现潜力，但将其 transformer 架构适配到广告 CTR 预测仍面临后评分上下文信号建模、离线在线一致性和工业负载扩展等独特挑战。
Method: 提出 CADET，核心创新包括：带多塔预测头的上下文条件解码架构，显式建模广告位置等后评分信号以解决预测 CTR 与排序之间的鸡生蛋问题；自门控注意力机制在表示和交互层面自适应调节信息流以稳定训练；基于时间戳的 Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) 变体捕获从秒到月的时间关系；会话掩码策略防止模型学习不可用的会话内事件依赖以缓解训练服务偏差；以及张量打包、序列分块和定制 Flash Attention 内核等生产工程技术。
Result: 在线 A/B 测试中，CADET 相比生产 LiRank 基线模型（DCNv2 与序列编码器的混合集成）实现 11.04% 的 CTR 提升，系统已成功部署于 LinkedIn 广告平台并服务主页赞助内容的主要流量。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法在工业广告平台上验证了 decoder-only transformer 用于 CTR 预测的有效性，并解决了实际部署中的训练服务一致性和扩展性问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Guidestar-Free Adaptive Optics with Asymmetric Apertures
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces the first closed-loop adaptive optics (AO) system capable of optically correcting aberrations in real-time without a guidestar or a wavefront sensor. Nearly 40 years ago, Cederquist et al. demonstrated that asymmetric apertures enable phase retrieval (PR) algorithms to perform fully computational wavefront sensing, albeit at a high computational cost. More recently, Chimitt et al. extended this approach with machine learning and demonstrated real-time wavefront sensing using only a single (guidestar-based) point-spread-function (PSF) measurement. Inspired by these works, we introduce a guidestar-free AO framework built around asymmetric apertures and machine learning. Our approach combines three key elements: (1) an asymmetric aperture placed at the system's pupil plane that enables PR-based wavefront sensing, (2) a pair of machine learning algorithms that estimate the PSF from natural scene measurements and reconstruct phase aberrations, and (3) a spatial light modulator that performs optical correction. We experimentally validate this framework on dense natural scenes imaged through unknown obscurants. Our method outperforms state-of-the-art guidestar-free wavefront shaping methods, using an order of magnitude fewer measurements and three orders of magnitude less computation.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个无需导星 (guidestar) 和波前传感器的闭环自适应光学 (adaptive optics) 系统，能够在无导星条件下实时光学校正像差。该系统结合非对称孔径、基于机器学习的波前传感和空间光调制器，并在透过未知遮蔽物的稠密自然场景上进行了实验验证。结果表明，相比现有无导星波前整形方法，该方法所需测量量少一个数量级、计算量少三个数量级。
Motivation: 传统自适应光学依赖导星或波前传感器，适用范围受限；先前工作虽证明非对称孔径可支持计算波前传感，但计算成本高且需要导星。本文目标是在无导星、无波前传感器的条件下实现实时闭环像差校正。
Method: 构建三要素框架：在系统瞳孔面放置非对称孔径以支持相位恢复 (phase retrieval) 式波前传感；用一对机器学习算法从自然场景测量中估计点扩散函数 (PSF) 并重建相位像差；用空间光调制器执行光学校正，形成闭环系统。
Result: 在透过未知遮蔽物成像的稠密自然场景实验中，该方法优于现有无导星波前整形方法，所需测量量减少一个数量级，计算量减少三个数量级。
Conclusion: 摘要强调非对称孔径与机器学习结合可让无导星自适应光学实现实时闭环校正；该工作仅以自然场景和未知遮蔽物为实验范围，未涉及其他成像条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On Solomonoff Induction in Large Language Models and the Limits of Self-Improving: The Singularity Is Not Near Without Symbolic Model Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: On the one hand, the question of whether large language models (LLMs) are Solomonoff induction estimators has become an explicit question at the intersection of Algorithmic Information Theory (AIT) and Machine Learning (ML) of great interest. On the other hand, the now old idea of an AI Singularity that requires a reliable positive-feedback process in which a system can generate, evaluate and retain genuine improvements to itself continues to come up and is a recurrent concept in the discussion of AGI. We connect and provide some answers to these issues based on current assumptions and future developments of neurosymbolic ML. We will demonstrate that cross-entropy, negative log-likelihood and cognate next-token objectives do not or cannot, by themselves, implement Solomonoff induction: they optimise fit to a supplied conditional distribution rather than a program-weighted universal mixture. While more compute within a fixed objective can improve fit without changing the inductive principle, additional computational resources do not intrinsically without external hyper-parameter or architectural changes, behave as optimal predictors in the Solomonoff and Levin sense. While the data-processing inequality (DPI) and Levin non-growth remain valid, we will show that for finite learners and finite observers, theoretical boundaries have less relevancy and generate a drift between possible approaches. To this end, we interpret different resource-bounded estimators as finite tools for mechanism search that show divergence, not violation, of (algorithmic) information conservation laws. A neurosymbolic direction taken by current frontier-model developers points towards the adoption of model synthesis and no longer purely statistical approaches to LLMs but where Solomonoff estimators are possible.
papers.comment: 31 pages. Update: DPI and Levin's non-growth is not violated explanation when it comes to finite learners
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在算法信息论（AIT）与机器学习的交叉点上讨论两个问题：大语言模型（LLM）是否可被视为 Solomonoff 归纳（Solomonoff induction）估计器，以及依赖正反馈自我改进的 AI 奇点是否可能。作者论证交叉熵、负对数似然及同类 next-token 目标本身不能实现 Solomonoff 归纳，因为它们只是拟合给定的条件分布，而非程序加权的通用混合；额外的计算资源若不伴随外部超参数或架构改变，也不会自动成为 Solomonoff 与 Levin 意义上的最优预测器。文中还将资源受限估计器解释为机制搜索的有限工具，并指出前沿模型开发中的神经符号（neurosymbolic）方向正在走向模型合成。
Motivation: 关于 LLM 是否等价于 Solomonoff 归纳估计器已成为 AIT 与 ML 交叉领域的重要问题，同时 AI 奇点所依赖的自我改进正反馈思想在 AGI 讨论中反复出现；作者希望基于当前假设和神经符号 ML 的未来发展给出明确回答。
Method: 文章从理论上将 LLM 的 next-token 训练目标与 Solomonoff 归纳的归纳原理进行对比，分析交叉熵、负对数似然等目标为何只是优化对给定条件分布的拟合；并针对有限学习者和有限观察者重新审视数据加工不等式（DPI）与 Levin 非增长等理论边界，把资源受限估计器解释为机制搜索的有限工具。
Result: 摘要表明交叉熵、负对数似然及同类目标无法单独实现 Solomonoff 归纳；在固定目标下增加计算量只能改进拟合而不改变归纳原理。对于有限学习者和有限观察者，理论边界的相关性降低，不同方法之间出现漂移，但这被作者解释为工具间的发散而非对算法信息守恒律的违反。
Conclusion: 作者认为当前前沿模型向神经符号模型合成（model synthesis）方向的发展可能使 Solomonoff 估计器变得可行，而仅靠纯统计方法的 LLM 难以支撑奇点式的自我改进；因此没有符号模型合成，奇点不会临近。
Relevance: 1
