papers.title: Automated Data Enrichment using Confidence-Aware Fine-Grained Debate among Open-Source LLMs for Mental Health and Online Safety
papers.abstract_en: Real-world indicators play an important role in many Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications, such as life events for mental health analysis and risky behaviours for online safety, yet labelling such information is often costly and/or difficult due to its multi-label and dynamic nature. Large Language Models (LLMs) show promising potential for automated annotation, but the multi-label setting remains challenging. In this work, we propose a Confidence-Aware Fine-Grained Debate (CFD) framework that simulates human collaborative annotation using fine-grained communication to better support automated multi-label enrichment. We introduce two expert-annotated resources: life-event and symptom annotation for a mental health well-being dataset, and a new online safety sharenting dataset. Experiments show that CFD achieves the most robust enrichment performance across tasks, and that the benefit of fine-grained confidence is influenced by its quality and variability. We further evaluate training-free strategies for incorporating enrichment indicators into downstream tasks and show that automated enrichment consistently improves performance, by up to 9.9 Macro-F1 points, with the most effective integration format depending on how the indicator relates to the downstream objective.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Confidence-Aware Fine-Grained Debate (CFD) 框架，利用开源 LLM 的细粒度通信来模拟人工协作标注，以支持多标签场景下的自动数据富集 (automated enrichment)。作者引入两个专家标注资源：心理健康幸福感数据集的生活事件与症状标注，以及一个新的在线安全 sharenting 数据集。实验表明 CFD 在任务上取得最稳健的富集性能，且自动富集指标能一致提升下游任务表现，最高达 9.9 Macro-F1。
Motivation: 现实世界指标（如心理健康分析中的生活事件、在线安全中的风险行为）对 NLP 应用很重要，但其多标签和动态特性使标注成本高且困难。LLM 有潜力实现自动标注，但多标签设置仍具挑战。
Method: 提出 Confidence-Aware Fine-Grained Debate (CFD) 框架，通过细粒度的多轮沟通模拟人类协作标注过程；同时构建了心理健康和在线安全两个专家标注数据集。

Conclusion: 摘要强调自动化富集指标能稳定改善下游任务，且整合方式需要根据指标与下游目标的关系来选择。

papers.title: A Streaming Sparse Cholesky Method for Derivative-Informed Gaussian Process Surrogates Within Digital Twin Applications
papers.abstract_en: Digital twins are developed to model the behavior of a specific physical asset (or twin), and they can consist of high-fidelity physics-based models or surrogates. A highly accurate surrogate is often preferred over multi-physics models as they enable forecasting the physical twin future state in real-time. To adapt to a specific physical twin, the digital twin model must be updated using in-service data from that physical twin. In this paper, we combine and extend several previous surrogate-related advancements with the goal of demonstrating an end-to-end digital twin (DT) solution for predicting performance of an aircraft structure (the physical asset). To this end, we extend Gaussian process (GP) models to include derivative data, for improved accuracy, with dynamic updating to ingest physical twin data during service. Including derivative data, however, comes at a prohibitive cost of increased covariance matrix dimension. We circumvent this issue through our modified dynamic sparse Cholesky linear system solver. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the prediction accuracy of the derivative-enhanced sparse Cholesky GP method produces improved models upon dynamic data additions. Lastly, we demonstrate the developed algorithm within a DT framework to model fatigue crack growth in an aerospace vehicle, thereby exhibiting through our assembled engineered system how digital twin technologies can be combined in practice.
papers.journal_ref: Vashishtha et al., Journal of Computational Physics, 115268 (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向数字孪生 (digital twin) 场景，提出一种结合导数信息的高斯过程 (Gaussian process, GP) 替代模型，并通过改进的动态稀疏 Cholesky 线性系统求解器解决引入导数数据导致的协方差矩阵维度过高问题。作者将该算法嵌入端到端数字孪生框架，用于飞机结构疲劳裂纹扩展的性能预测，数值实验表明在动态数据加入时导数增强型稀疏 Cholesky GP 能持续提升预测精度。
Motivation: 数字孪生模型需要根据物理资产的在役数据动态更新，而高精度替代模型优于多物理场模型。引入导数数据能提高 GP 精度，但会显著增大协方差矩阵维度，带来高昂计算成本。
Method: 作者将高斯过程扩展为包含导数数据的形式，并支持在服务期间动态吸收物理孪生数据；为规避协方差矩阵维度膨胀，提出改进的动态稀疏 Cholesky 线性系统求解器，并将其与前述模型组合成端到端数字孪生系统。
Result: 数值实验表明，在动态数据加入的过程中，导数增强的稀疏 Cholesky GP 方法能产生预测精度更高的模型；作者还在数字孪生框架中演示了航空航天飞行器疲劳裂纹扩展的建模。
Conclusion: 摘要强调这些先前替代模型与求解器技术可以整合为可用的端到端数字孪生方案，用于在役飞机结构性能预测；其价值在于展示数字孪生技术在实际工程系统中的组合方式。

papers.title: Pricing Access to Dynamic Information Services
papers.abstract_en: A provider sells a \emph{dynamic information service}---a real-time, capacity-constrained process that resolves a customer's uncertainty---to customers who differ privately in urgency. I characterize the revenue-optimal mechanism: deploy a \emph{single}, undistorted information process---the one a customer with unlimited access would most prefer---and screen entirely through a one-dimensional menu of service caps. The provider leaves the product itself undistorted, unlike a Mussa--Rosen monopolist; all screening is absorbed into the cap. The mechanism rationalizes a recurring contractual form---a flat fee for capped access to a common process---spanning AI service tiers, expert-network consultations, and analyst-inquiry retainers. I identify the economic force behind the result, a convexity-preservation property of urgency screening, and give conditions under which the per-unit price declines in the cap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在机制设计框架下研究动态信息服务的收入最优定价。提供者向私人紧急性不同的客户出售容量受限的实时信息服务，最优机制是部署单一且不失真的信息过程，并仅通过一维服务上限菜单进行客户筛选。摘要将该机制与固定费用加封顶访问的常见契约形式联系起来，并识别了紧急性筛选的凸性保持性质这一关键经济力。
Motivation: 现有定价理论（如Mussa–Rosen垄断者）通常涉及产品本身的扭曲，而动态信息服务中的最优筛选机制尚未被刻画；作者旨在解释实践中常见的封顶访问固定费用契约。
Method: 作者刻画收入最优机制：提供者部署一个有无限访问权客户最偏好的单一信息过程，不扭曲产品本身，而是通过一维服务上限（cap）菜单来筛选不同紧急程度的客户。
Result: 摘要报告最优机制中所有筛选都吸收到服务上限中；识别了凸性保持性质，并给出每单位价格随上限递减的条件。
Conclusion: 该机制为AI服务层级、专家网络咨询和分析师查询等封顶访问服务提供了理论依据；结论仅限于这类动态信息服务的机制设计设定。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TemMed-Bench: Evaluating Temporal Medical Image Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Existing medical reasoning benchmarks for vision-language models primarily focus on analyzing a patient's condition based on an image from a single visit. However, this setting deviates significantly from real-world clinical practice, where doctors typically refer to a patient's historical conditions to provide a comprehensive assessment by tracking their changes over time. In this paper, we introduce TEMMED-BENCH, a multi-task benchmark designed for analyzing changes in patients' conditions between different clinical visits, which challenges large vision-language models (LVLMs) to reason over temporal medical images. TEMMED-BENCH consists of a test set comprising three tasks - visual question-answering (VQA), report generation, and image-pair selection - and a supplementary knowledge corpus of over 17,000 instances. With TEMMED-BENCH, we conduct an evaluation of twelve LVLMs, comprising six proprietary and six open-source models. Our results show that most LVLMs lack the ability to analyze patients' condition changes over temporal medical images, and a large proportion perform only at a random-guessing level in the closed-book setting. To enhance the tracking of condition changes, we explore augmenting the input with both retrieved visual and textual modalities in the medical domain. We also show that multi-modal retrieval augmentation yields notably higher performance gains than no retrieval and textual retrieval alone across most models on our benchmark, with the VQA task showing an average improvement of 2.59%. Overall, we compose a benchmark grounded on real-world clinical practice, and it reveals LVLMs' limitations in temporal medical image reasoning, as well as highlighting the use of multi-modal retrieval augmentation as a potentially promising direction worth exploring to address this challenge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TEMMED-BENCH 是一个面向时间序列医学影像推理的多任务基准，包含 VQA、报告生成和图像对选择三个任务，并附带超过 17,000 个实例的知识语料。作者对 12 个大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）进行评估，发现多数模型在闭卷设置下仅达到随机猜测水平，难以分析患者跨就诊的条件变化。进一步实验表明，多模态检索增强（同时检索视觉与文本模态）相比无检索或仅文本检索在多数模型上带来更高性能提升，VQA 任务平均提升 2.59%。
Motivation: 现有医学推理基准大多基于单次就诊的影像进行条件分析，与真实临床实践中医生追踪患者历史状况变化的工作方式不符，缺乏对时间维度医学影像推理能力的评测。
Method: 构建包含 VQA、报告生成和图像对选择三个任务的多任务基准 TEMMED-BENCH，并提供大规模知识语料；评估六种专有和六种开源 LVLMs，并探索在医疗领域中对输入进行检索的视觉与文本多模态增强。
Result: 大多数 LVLMs 缺乏对时间医学影像中病情变化进行分析的能力，很大比例模型在闭卷设置下仅达到随机猜测水平；多模态检索增强在多数模型上优于无检索和仅文本检索，VQA 任务平均提升 2.59%。
Conclusion: 该基准基于真实临床实践构建，揭示了 LVLMs 在时间医学影像推理上的局限性，并指出多模态检索增强是值得探索的潜在改进方向。

papers.title: Multiplayer Nash Preference Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) has emerged as the standard paradigm for aligning large language models with human preferences. However, reward-based methods grounded in the Bradley-Terry assumption struggle to capture the nontransitivity and heterogeneity of real-world preferences. To address this, recent studies have reframed alignment as a two-player Nash game, giving rise to Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF). While this perspective has inspired algorithms such as INPO, ONPO, and EGPO that offer strong theoretical and empirical guarantees, they remain fundamentally restricted to two-player interactions, introducing a single-opponent bias that fails to capture the full complexity of realistic preference structures. This work introduces Multiplayer Nash Preference Optimization (MNPO), a novel framework that generalizes NLHF to the multiplayer regime. It formulates alignment as an n-player game, where each policy competes against a population of opponents while being regularized toward a reference model. We demonstrate that MNPO inherits the equilibrium guarantees of two-player methods while enabling richer competitive dynamics and improved coverage of diverse preference structures. Comprehensive empirical evaluation shows that MNPO consistently outperforms existing NLHF baselines on instruction-following benchmarks, achieving superior alignment quality under heterogeneous annotator conditions and mixed-policy evaluation scenarios. Together, these results establish MNPO as a principled and scalable framework for aligning LLMs with complex, non-transitive human preferences. Code is available at: https://github.com/smiles724/MNPO
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Multiplayer Nash Preference Optimization (MNPO)，将 RLHF 对齐问题从两人 Nash 博弈推广到 n 人博弈，使每个策略与一个对手群体竞争，同时向参考模型正则化。摘要称 MNPO 继承两人方法的均衡保证，并在指令跟随基准上持续优于 INPO、ONPO、EGPO 等 NLHF 基线，尤其在异构标注者与混合策略评估场景下对齐质量更好。代码已开源。
Motivation: 基于 Bradley-Terry 假设的奖励方法难以刻画真实偏好的非传递性与异质性；现有 NLHF 方法（INPO、ONPO、EGPO）仅支持两人交互，存在单一对手偏差，无法覆盖复杂偏好结构的全部复杂性。
Method: 将 LLM 对齐形式化为 n 人博弈：每条策略与一个对手群体竞争，同时被向参考模型正则化，从而把 NLHF 推广到多人博弈场景。
Result: 综合实验表明 MNPO 在指令跟随基准上一致优于现有 NLHF 基线，并在异构标注者条件和混合策略评估场景下取得更优的对齐质量。
Conclusion: MNPO 为对齐复杂且非传递的人类偏好提供了一个有原则且可扩展的框架；摘要未提及明显局限。

papers.title: Faster Results from a Smarter Schedule: Reframing Collegiate Cross Country through Analysis of the National Running Club Database
papers.abstract_en: Collegiate cross country teams often build their season schedules on intuition rather than evidence, partly because large-scale performance datasets were not publicly accessible prior to the National Running Club Database (NRCD). We analyze the comprehensive-era Cross Country subset of NRCD, 23,355 results from 7,083 athletes (2023-2025; >97% course/weather coverage). Under leakage control and temporal validation, race-result features do not support out-of-year forecasting of individual improvement (best men's R^2=0.043; women's -0.029), capturing only a small fraction of the outcome's reliability ceiling (~0.23-0.28). Against this null, team race frequency associates with nationals placement (pooled RR =2.09; GEE OR =2.56/SD). Program-wide opportunity (roster depth; Effective Racing Opportunity) outranks a single workhorse's max race count cross-sectionally, but overall team depth for race count is controlled. `Converted Only' times (not adjusted for weather and elevation) overstate mean first-to-last gains by 15-21 seconds relative to `Standardized'. These results challenge coaching practices that treat schedule design as purely anecdotal and show how NRCD enables evidence-based decision-making in collegiate cross country.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于 National Running Club Database (NRCD) 的 Cross Country 子集，对 23,355 条成绩记录（7,083 名运动员，2023-2025 年，赛道/天气覆盖超过 97%）进行泄漏控制与时序验证分析。结果发现比赛成绩特征无法对个体跨年进步做出有效预测（男子 R²=0.043，女子为 -0.029），而团队参赛频率与全国赛名次相关；未做天气和海拔修正的 Converted Only 时间会将首尾选手平均进步幅度高估 15-21 秒。
Motivation: 高校越野跑队的赛季赛程安排多依赖直觉而非证据，原因是此前缺乏可供公开访问的大规模成绩数据集；NRCD 的出现使基于证据的赛程决策成为可能。
Method: 对 NRCD 的 Cross Country 子集进行泄漏控制与时间划分验证（temporal validation），比较 Converted Only 与 Standardized 时间，并使用回归、合并相对风险 (pooled RR) 与广义估计方程 (GEE) 分析参赛频率、阵容深度等变量与全国赛名次的关系。
Result: 比赛成绩特征对个体跨年进步的预测力很弱（男子 R²=0.043，女子 -0.029），远低于约 0.23-0.28 的信度上限；团队参赛频率与全国赛名次相关（pooled RR=2.09，GEE OR=2.56/标准差）；相较单个主力运动员的最高参赛次数，项目层面的阵容深度和 Effective Racing Opportunity 在横截面分析中更重要；Converted Only 时间比 Standardized 时间平均高估首末位进步 15-21 秒。

papers.title: DQS: A Low-Budget Query Strategy for Enhancing Unsupervised Data-driven Anomaly Detection Approaches
papers.abstract_en: Truly unsupervised approaches for time series anomaly detection are rare in the literature. Those that exist suffer from a poorly set threshold, which hampers detection performance, while others, despite claiming to be unsupervised, need to be calibrated using a labelled data subset, which is often not available in the real world. This work integrates active learning with an existing unsupervised anomaly detection method by selectively querying the labels of multivariate time series, which are then used to refine the threshold selection process. To achieve this, we introduce a novel query strategy called the dissimilarity-based query strategy (DQS). DQS aims to maximise the diversity of queried samples by evaluating the similarity between anomaly scores using dynamic time warping. We assess the detection performance of DQS in comparison to other query strategies and explore the impact of mislabelling, a topic that is underexplored in the literature. Our findings indicate that DQS performs best in small-budget scenarios, though the others appear to be more robust when faced with mislabelling. Therefore, in the real world, the choice of query strategy depends on the expertise of the oracle and the number of samples they are willing to label. Regardless, all query strategies outperform the unsupervised threshold even in the presence of mislabelling. Thus, whenever it is feasible to query an oracle, employing an active learning-based threshold is recommended.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种低标注预算的查询策略 DQS（dissimilarity-based query strategy），用于改进无监督时间序列异常检测方法的阈值选择。该方法通过与已有无监督异常检测方法结合，选择性查询多变量时间序列的标签，并利用动态时间规整（dynamic time warping）评估异常分数的相似性以最大化查询样本的多样性。实验表明 DQS 在小预算场景下表现最佳，但其他策略在面对误标注时更稳健。
Motivation: 真正的无监督时间序列异常检测方法很少，现有方法要么阈值设置不当，要么实际需要带标注的子集来校准，而这在现实世界中往往不可用。本文旨在通过主动学习（active learning）有选择地查询标签来改进阈值选择，并探讨误标注的影响这一较少被研究的问题。
Method: 将主动学习与现有无监督异常检测方法集成，提出 DQS 查询策略：通过动态时间规整比较异常分数之间的相似性，从而优先选择多样性最高的样本进行标签查询，用于细化阈值选择过程。
Result: 摘要报告 DQS 在小预算场景下表现最佳，而其他查询策略在面对误标注时更稳健；所有查询策略即使存在误标注，也优于无监督阈值。
Conclusion: 现实世界中查询策略的选择取决于标注者（oracle）的专业水平以及愿意标注的样本数量；只要可以查询标注者，采用基于主动学习的阈值方法都是推荐的。

papers.title: Smooth Flow Matching for Synthesizing Functional Data
papers.abstract_en: Functional data, i.e., random functions observed over a continuous domain, are increasingly available in areas such as biomedical research, health informatics, and epidemiology. However, effective statistical analysis for functional data is often hindered by challenges such as privacy constraints, sparse and irregular sampling, infinite-dimensionality, and non-Gaussian structures. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel framework named Smooth Flow Matching (SFM), tailored for generative modeling of functional data that enables statistical analysis without exposing sensitive real data. Under a copula framework, SFM constructs a semiparametric smooth flow to generate infinite-dimensional functional data, free of Gaussianity and low-rank assumptions. It is computationally efficient, handles irregular observations, and guarantees the smoothness of the generated functions, offering a practical and flexible solution in scenarios where existing deep generative methods are not applicable. Through extensive simulation studies, we demonstrate the advantages of SFM in terms of both synthetic data quality and computational efficiency. We then apply SFM to generate clinical trajectory data from the MIMIC-IV patient electronic health records (EHR) longitudinal database. Our analysis showcases the ability of SFM to produce high-quality surrogate data for downstream tasks, highlighting its potential to boost the utility of EHR data for clinical applications.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in The Annals of Statistics
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Smooth Flow Matching (SFM)，一个面向函数型数据 (functional data) 的生成建模框架，可在不暴露敏感原始数据的情况下支持统计分析。SFM 在 copula 框架下构造半参数光滑流来生成无限维函数型数据，不依赖高斯性或低秩假设，并能处理不规则观测、保证生成函数的光滑性。模拟研究显示其在合成数据质量和计算效率上具有优势；在 MIMIC-IV 患者电子健康记录临床轨迹数据上的应用表明它能生成高质量替代数据用于下游任务。
Motivation: 函数型数据在生物医学、健康信息学和流行病学等领域日益常见，但隐私约束、稀疏/不规则采样、无限维度和非高斯结构等问题阻碍了有效统计分析，且现有深度生成方法在这些场景下往往不适用。
Method: 提出 Smooth Flow Matching (SFM) 框架：在 copula 框架下构造半参数光滑流以生成无限维函数型数据，无需高斯性或低秩假设；该框架计算高效、可处理不规则观测，并保证生成函数的光滑性。
Result: 摘要报告 extensive simulation studies 显示 SFM 在合成数据质量和计算效率方面优于现有方法；在 MIMIC-IV 患者电子健康记录纵向数据上的应用表明其能生成高质量替代数据，提升 EHR 数据在临床下游任务中的效用。
Conclusion: 作者将 SFM 定位为在隐私约束、不规则采样等场景下现有深度生成方法不可用时的一种实用且灵活的解决方案，并强调其提升 EHR 数据临床效用的潜力。

papers.title: Closing a 17-Year Gap: Algorithmic Detection and Empirical Prevalence of Rank Reversal in Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Rank Reversal, where the relative order of alternatives changes in ways that violate axioms of rational decision-making, is a well-documented threat to the reliability of Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) methods. Wang and Triantaphyllou (2008) proposed three systematic test criteria to detect this phenomenon, but despite more than 700 citations, no validated, open-source implementation has closed the gap between theory and practice, a 17-year absence we trace to the non-trivial algorithmic challenges of operationalizing these tests for real-world pipelines. We present an algorithmic framework, implemented in the open-source Scikit-Criteria library, that translates Wang and Triantaphyllou (2008)'s three criteria into concrete, pipeline-compatible procedures: a controlled degradation strategy with hierarchical tie-breaking and graceful handling of preprocessing filters (RRT1), and a dominance-graph construction with exact condensation and transitive reduction for detecting transitivity violations and recomposition inconsistencies (RRT2/RRT3). We demonstrate the framework through two case studies: an application to a cryptocurrency evaluation problem (Van Heerden et al., 2021), and a large-scale audit of 27 pipeline/dataset combinations reproduced from 20 published MCDM methods. The audit shows top-alternative stability (RRT1) is nearly universal (96.3%), but transitivity (RRT2) fails for 14.8% and recomposition consistency (RRT3), the strictest criterion, fails for nearly half (48.1%) of published examples-evidence that rank reversal is a pervasive, measurable feature of the current MCDM literature, not a marginal or adversarial concern.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对 Wang 和 Triantaphyllou (2008) 提出的三类秩反转 (rank reversal) 检测准则一直缺乏验证过的开源实现这一长达 17 年的理论与应用缺口，给出了一套算法化框架，并实现于开源库 Scikit-Criteria。作者通过一个加密货币评估案例以及对 20 种已发表 MCDM 方法、27 个流水线/数据集组合的大规模审计展示该框架。审计结果显示：顶层备选方案稳定性 (RRT1) 几乎普遍成立 (96.3%)，而传递性 (RRT2) 在 14.8% 的案例中失败，重组一致性 (RRT3) 在约 48.1% 的案例中失败。
Motivation: 秩反转会违反理性决策公理并威胁多准则决策分析 (MCDA) 方法的可靠性；尽管原始准则论文被引用超过 700 次，但一直没有可验证的开源实现来填补理论与实践之间的 17 年空白，原因在于将这些测试落地到真实流水线面临算法上的非平凡挑战。
Method: 提出一个将 Wang 和 Triantaphyllou (2008) 三个准则转化为可嵌入流水线流程的算法框架：RRT1 采用带层次化打破平局 (hierarchical tie-breaking) 的受控退化策略，并优雅处理预处理过滤器；RRT2/RRT3 构建支配图 (dominance graph)，通过精确凝聚 (exact condensation) 与传递约简 (transitive reduction) 检测传递性违背与重组不一致。
Result: 对 20 种已发表 MCDM 方法复现出的 27 个流水线/数据集组合进行审计，显示 RRT1 顶层方案稳定性达到 96.3%，RRT2 传递性在 14.8% 的案例中失败，RRT3 重组一致性在最严格准则下约有 48.1% 的已发表案例失败；此外还通过一个加密货币评估案例（Van Heerden et al., 2021）展示了框架的应用。
Conclusion: 作者认为秩反转是当前 MCDM 文献中普遍存在且可度量的问题，而非边缘或对抗性情况；该开源实现结束了 17 年来理论准则缺乏可用工具的局面。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: The dynamic generalized covariance measure for conditional independence testing with nonstationary time series
papers.abstract_en: Identifying relationships among stochastic processes is a core objective in many fields, such as economics. While the standard toolkit for multivariate time series analysis has many advantages, it can be difficult to capture nonlinear dynamics using linear vector autoregressive models. This difficulty has motivated the development of methods for causal discovery and variable selection for nonlinear time series, which routinely employ tests for conditional independence. In this paper, we introduce the first framework for conditional independence testing that works with a single realization of a nonstationary nonlinear process. The proposed test is designed to have power against alternatives in which the expected conditional covariance is non-zero for at least some times. We also discuss an approach for gaining power against a broader range of alternatives. The key technical ingredients of our framework are time-varying nonlinear regression, estimation of local long-run covariance matrices of products of error processes, and a distribution-uniform strong Gaussian approximation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个适用于单条非平稳非线性时间序列实现的条件独立性检验框架。检验对期望条件协方差在部分时刻非零的备择假设具有功效，并讨论了扩展功效范围的方法。核心技术包括时变非线性回归、误差过程乘积的局部长期协方差矩阵估计，以及分布一致的强高斯近似。
Motivation: 标准多元时间序列工具箱依赖线性向量自回归模型，难以捕捉非线性动力学；现有条件独立性检验通常假设平稳性或需要多条实现，而实际中常常只有单一非平稳非线性过程的观测。
Method: 提出一个基于时变非线性回归、局部长期协方差矩阵估计和分布一致强高斯近似的条件独立性检验框架，并进一步讨论如何对更广泛的备择假设提高功效。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值实验，只声称该检验对期望条件协方差非零的备择具有功效，并给出扩展功效范围的方法。
Conclusion: 该框架是首个能处理单个非平稳非线性过程实现的条件独立性检验方法，主要面向经济等领域的非线性时间序列因果发现与变量选择。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Regression and Classification with Single-Qubit Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: The literature reflects a mutually beneficial relationship between machine learning and quantum computing, where progress in one field frequently drives improvements in the other. Motivated by the rich connection between these areas, we use a resource-efficient and scalable Single-Qubit Quantum Neural Network (SQQNN) for both regression and classification tasks using a new data uploading technique. The SQQNN leverages parameterized single-qubit unitary operators and quantum measurements to achieve efficient learning. To train the model, we use gradient descent for regression tasks. For classification, we introduce a novel training method inspired by polynomial regression, which can efficiently find a global minimizer of the transformed least-squares objective in a single step. This approach significantly accelerates training compared to iterative methods. Evaluated across various applications, the SQQNN exhibits virtually error-free and strong performance in regression and classification tasks, including Wisconsin Breast Cancer and MNIST datasets. These results demonstrate the versatility, scalability, and suitability of the SQQNN for deployment on near-term quantum devices.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种资源高效、可扩展的单量子比特量子神经网络（Single-Qubit Quantum Neural Network, SQQNN），用于回归和分类任务，并引入新的数据上传技术。模型基于参数化单量子比特酉算子和量子测量实现学习；回归使用梯度下降训练，分类则采用受多项式回归启发的新训练方法，可在单步内找到变换后最小二乘目标的全局极小值，从而显著加速训练。在包括 Wisconsin Breast Cancer 和 MNIST 在内的多个应用中，SQQNN 表现出接近无错误且稳定的性能。
Motivation: 机器学习与量子计算之间存在相互促进的关系，作者希望利用这种联系，构建资源高效、可扩展且适合在近期量子设备上部署的量子神经网络模型。
Method: 提出 SQQNN，使用参数化单量子比特酉算子和量子测量进行学习；回归任务采用梯度下降训练，分类任务引入基于多项式回归思想的新训练方法，通过单步求解变换后的最小二乘目标来获得全局极小值，从而避免迭代式训练开销。
Result: 摘要报告 SQQNN 在回归与分类任务上几乎无错误，并在 Wisconsin Breast Cancer 和 MNIST 数据集上表现出色，体现了模型的通用性和可扩展性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调结果表明 SQQNN 在近期量子设备上具有部署潜力，能够胜任多种机器学习任务。

papers.title: Protection Levels for Vision-Based Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based navigation complements Global Navigation Satellite Systems, but certification demands integrity guarantees that account for faulty measurements. Previous work presented a probabilistic computer vision pipeline for runway-based pose estimation with fault detection inspired by Receiver Autonomous Integrity Monitoring. This work extends that framework by deriving protection levels, which provide probabilistic bounds on pose error that remain valid under undetected faults. We present an algorithm for computing protection levels for the nonlinear Perspective-$n$-Point problem applied to an aviation setting. The algorithm covers all six degrees of freedom of the aircraft pose (position and orientation) directly. We analyze the effect of measurement redundancy, pixel-level prediction uncertainty, and runway distance on the resulting protection levels. To make the results tangible, we demonstrate tradeoffs in the protection levels on an illustrative runway example.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 5 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 AIAA DATC/IEEE 45th Digital Avionics Systems Conference (DASC). O. Beyer Bruvik and R. Valentin contributed equally
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在基于视觉的跑道位姿估计框架中引入保护级别 (protection levels)，为未检测故障下的位姿误差提供概率界，以满足航空电子认证对完整性的要求。作者提出针对非线性 Perspective-n-Point (PnP) 问题、直接覆盖飞机六自由度位姿的保护级别计算算法，并在说明性跑道算例上分析测量冗余、像素级预测不确定性和跑道距离的影响。
Motivation: 视觉导航作为卫星导航 (GNSS) 的补充需要认证层面的完整性保证，而此前的工作仅提供故障检测框架，没有给出未检测故障下位姿误差成立的概率界。
Method: 该工作扩展了受接收机自主完整性监测 (RAIM) 启发的概率计算机视觉框架，提出计算非线性 PnP 问题保护级别的算法，直接处理飞机位姿的全部六个自由度（位置与姿态）。
Result: 摘要报告所提算法可计算六自由度位姿的保护级别，并量化测量冗余、像素级预测不确定性和跑道距离对保护级别的影响；在说明性跑道算例上展示了相关权衡。
Conclusion: 该工作将完整性监控扩展到视觉位姿估计，使保护级别在未检测故障下依然有效；摘要未给出具体误差数值或数据集实验结果，以说明性算例为主要验证方式。

papers.title: Deep Learning-Based Statistical Downscaling of Sea Surface Temperature Using a Residual Corrective Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: The large-scale oceanic and atmospheric forecasts provided by global climate models typically lack sufficient resolution to accurately capture the response of the coastal ocean to atmospheric forcing and coastal circulation that drive fine-scale SST variability. Dynamical downscaling is computationally prohibitive, when applied to extensive coastlines, predictive ensembles, or long time periods. Therefore, this work presents a statistical downscaling of sea surface temperature (SST) from the seasonal coupled ocean-atmosphere forecast system (ACCESS-S2) using machine learning techniques. This study proposes a novel deep learning framework that uses a U-Net to generate an initial high-resolution SST estimate, which is subsequently refined using a residual corrective approach. The target SST fields are derived from the Regional Ocean Modeling System (ROMS). This two step approach called Residual Corrective Neural Network (RCNN) progressively refines initial U-Net predictions by incorporating dynamically scaled residuals at each step, enabling accurate capture of broad patterns and fine-grained features such as eddies and fronts. We also introduce a custom loss-assisted RCNN variant to improve performance during extreme events, which may be absent from training data due to climate-driven shifts in SST extremes. The framework efficiently downscales SST along the west coast of Australia. A 2011 marine heatwave case study shows that the RCNN improves ACCESS-S2 SST predictions by increasing horizontal resolution from 25 km to 2 km, enabling identification of fine-scale anomalies unresolved in the ACCESS-S2 dataset. This balance between computational efficiency and accuracy supports applications in coastal impact assessment and marine ecosystem studies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种深度学习的海表温度 (SST) 统计降尺度框架，称为残差校正神经网络 (Residual Corrective Neural Network, RCNN)。该方法先用 U-Net 生成初始高分辨率 SST 估计，再通过逐步加入动态缩放的残差进行细化，以捕捉大尺度模式以及涡旋和锋面等细尺度特征。作者在西澳大利亚沿岸将 ACCESS-S2 的 SST 从 25 km 降尺度到 2 km，并以 2011 年海洋热浪为例展示其能识别 ACCESS-S2 中无法分辨的细尺度异常。
Motivation: 全球气候模型的大尺度预报分辨率不足，难以准确刻画沿岸海洋对大气强迫的响应及驱动细尺度 SST 变化的沿岸环流；动力降尺度在大范围海岸线、集合预报或长时间跨度下计算代价过高。因此需要一种计算高效且能保留细尺度特征的统计降尺度方法。
Method: 提出两步式 RCNN 框架：先用 U-Net 生成初始高分辨率 SST 估计，之后采用残差校正方式逐步细化 U-Net 预测，每一步结合动态缩放的残差。还引入一个带定制损失 (custom loss) 的 RCNN 变体，以改善训练数据中可能因气候驱动 SST 极端值偏移而缺失的极端事件表现。
Result: 摘要报告该框架可高效降尺度西澳大利亚沿岸的 SST；2011 年海洋热浪案例显示，RCNN 将 ACCESS-S2 SST 预测的水平分辨率从 25 km 提升到 2 km，并能识别 ACCESS-S2 数据中未解析的细尺度异常。
Conclusion: 作者认为该方法在计算效率与精度之间取得平衡，可支持沿海影响评估和海洋生态系统研究。摘要未明确讨论方法在其他区域或其他变量的泛化性。
Relevance: 35

papers.title: Sheaf-Based Federated Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Heterogeneous federated systems require agents to learn and exchange informative representations despite differences in data distributions, sensing modalities, model architectures, latent dimensionalities, and local learning objectives. To address this challenge, we propose Sheaf-based Federated Representation Learning (SFRL), a general framework that jointly optimizes local objectives with a manifold-constrained geometric alignment regularizer based on learnable sheaf restriction maps. Unlike most existing approaches, SFRL does not assume a shared global latent space. Instead, global consistency emerges from the alignment of neighboring latent representations through orthogonal transformations and isometric embeddings. This alignment is enforced by a quadratic gluing regularizer induced by the sheaf Laplacian, whose learnable restriction maps adapt the geometry to the observed data. The penalty is evaluated on a small set of shared pilot samples, ensuring scalability and communication efficiency. We develop a decentralized algorithm for solving SFRL, termed Sheaf-FRL, which alternates between gradient updates of the local models and closed-form Procrustes updates of the edge-wise restriction maps. We further establish convergence of Sheaf-FRL to first-order stationary points in both deterministic and stochastic settings. As an application, we consider a cooperative classification task in the context of semantic communication, under model and data heterogeneity. Our results show that Sheaf-FRL outperforms baseline approaches in terms of local and post-communication classification accuracy across different levels of local distribution shift and exhibits greater robustness to latent-space dimensionality compression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Sheaf-based Federated Representation Learning (SFRL)，一个面向异构联邦系统的表示学习框架，通过可学习的 sheaf restriction maps 构造受流形约束的几何对齐正则项，不假设共享全局潜在空间。作者进一步给出分散式求解算法 Sheaf-FRL，交替执行本地模型梯度更新与 edge-wise restriction maps 的闭式 Procrustes 更新，并证明其在确定性和随机设定下收敛到一阶稳定点。在语义通信中的协作分类任务上，Sheaf-FRL 在本地分布偏移和潜在空间维度压缩下均优于基线方法。
Motivation: 异构联邦系统中，各智能体在数据分布、感知模态、模型架构、潜在维度和本地学习目标上存在差异，但仍需学习并交换有信息量的表示。现有方法大多假设存在共享的全局潜在空间，这一假设在高度异构场景下过于严格。
Method: SFRL 将本地目标与基于可学习 sheaf restriction maps 的流形约束几何对齐正则项联合优化；全局一致性通过正交变换和等距嵌入对齐相邻潜在表示来涌现，并由 sheaf Laplacian 诱导的二次粘合正则项实施。为避免共享潜在空间假设，惩罚项只在少量共享 pilot samples 上计算以保证可扩展性和通信效率；Sheaf-FRL 算法交替进行本地模型梯度更新和 edge-wise restriction maps 的闭式 Procrustes 更新。
Result: 在模型与数据异构下的语义通信协作分类任务中，Sheaf-FRL 在不同程度的本地分布偏移下均提升了本地及通信后分类准确率，并且对潜在空间维度压缩表现出更强的鲁棒性。论文还建立了 Sheaf-FRL 在确定性和随机环境下收敛到一阶稳定点的理论保证。
Conclusion: 作者将 SFRL 定位为无需共享全局潜在空间即可实现全局一致的通用联邦表示学习框架，其几何对齐正则项通过少量 pilot samples 实现可扩展的分散式训练。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: HIPNO: Symmetry-Aware Physics-Informed Neural Operators for Noninvasive Hemodynamic Inference
papers.abstract_en: Continuous hemodynamic monitoring guides treatment decisions in surgery and intensive care. However, gold-standard signals are only measured in severe cases due to risks associated with invasive measurement. In this work, we introduce HIPNO (Hemodynamic Inference via Physics-informed Neural Operators) to recover hemodynamic state from ubiquitous, non-invasive signals and expand access to advanced monitoring. HIPNO addresses a problem of scale symmetry in physics-informed hemodynamic inference, where different combinations of flow, resistance, and compliance can generate the same observed pressure. We identify the symmetry group of the observation model and parameterize the network in its quotient space. For the 3-element Windkessel model, the quotient coordinates are the compliance-normalized flow $U=Q/C$, the decay time constant $τ_{WK}=R_2 C$, and the characteristic-impedance coordinate $κ=R_1 C$. Across 945499 intraoperative windows from 2562 patients, HIPNO predicts $τ_{wave}$, a proxy for vascular decay derived from pressure, with 32% lower error on the log scale than a population baseline while preserving mean arterial pressure accuracy. Because vascular decay and flow drive occupy separate coordinates, counterfactual perturbations produce the expected directional responses in at least 90% of windows in almost all prespecified scenarios, a separation unavailable to pressure-only baselines. The coordinates are also used as inputs to a calibration model for monitored cardiac output. Finally, the formulation identifies the external compliance or flow reference required to recover absolute physical scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HIPNO (Hemodynamic Inference via Physics-informed Neural Operators)，用于从无创信号推断血流动力学状态。作者识别了物理信息血流动力学推断中的尺度对称性 (scale symmetry)，并将网络参数化到该对称群的商空间中；对三元件 Windkessel 模型，商坐标取为顺应性归一化流量 U=Q/C、衰减时间常数 τ_WK=R2·C 和特征阻抗坐标 κ=R1·C。在 2562 名患者的 945499 个术中窗口上，HIPNO 预测压力导出的血管衰减代理 τ_wave 时，对数尺度的误差比人群基线低 32%，同时保持平均动脉压精度。作者还说明该坐标可输入校准模型用于监测心输出量，且需要外部顺应性或流量参考才能恢复绝对物理尺度。
Motivation: 手术和重症监护中连续血流动力学监测指导治疗决策，但金标准信号因有创测量风险仅在重症患者中使用。作者希望扩充这类监测的可用性，并且指出物理信息推断中存在尺度对称性问题：不同的流量、阻力和顺应性组合可能产生相同的观测压力。
Method: HIPNO 采用物理信息神经算子 (physics-informed neural operators) 进行血流动力学推断。作者先识别观测模型的对称群，并在其商空间中参数化网络；对三元件 Windkessel 模型，使用 U=Q/C、τ_WK=R2·C 与 κ=R1·C 作为商坐标。此外，用这些坐标作为校准模型输入来估计监测心输出量，并说明如何通过外部顺应性或流量参考恢复绝对物理尺度。
Result: 在来自 2562 名患者的 945499 个术中窗口上，HIPNO 对 τ_wave（由压力导出的血管衰减代理）的预测在 log 尺度上比人群基线误差低 32%，并且平均动脉压精度得以保持。由于血管衰减与流量驱动处于分离坐标，预先设定的大多数反事实扰动场景中，至少 90% 的窗口产生符合预期的方向性响应。
Conclusion: 商空间参数化能够消除观测模型中的尺度对称性，使无创血流动力学推断和反事实分离成为可能；要恢复绝对物理尺度仍需额外参考（外部顺应性或流量）。
Relevance: 3

papers.title: CurveFP: Rational-Radix Logarithmic Datatypes with Closed Products for Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Low-precision datatypes reduce language-model cost, but most formats optimize scalar fidelity while leaving the arithmetic induced by their products unchanged. We introduce CurveFP, a closed-product codebook family that distributes quantized magnitudes across interleaved logarithmic curves under compact block scales. A rational radix tunes dynamic range against local resolution, while uniform curve indices make every nonzero product algebraically closed. Product formation becomes an exact sign XOR and integer-index update, and a derived finite phase count determines the accumulation schedule. We instantiate this algebra as CurveFP eight E4C3/E5C2 for training and CurveFP seven E3C3 for compact deployment. In evaluation, CurveFP seven beats tensor-wise FP8 perplexity on four 7B--9B models with one fewer element bit and stays within 1.32\% of native quality. CurveFP eight lowers operand NMSE in all 36 paired forward and backward GEMM comparisons. Across three matched 128.3M-parameter triplets, every mode completes 3B-token pretraining per seed; CurveFP eight reaches mean BF16-inference perplexity 22.5366 versus 22.5407 for FP8 and incurs a lower format-induced penalty in all three seeds. A 36-cell downstream matrix finds lower WikiText-103 perplexity for the CurveFP eight-trained checkpoints in all 12 seed-format comparisons, with mixed PG-19 and task deltas. Together, these results establish CurveFP as an arithmetic co-design that combines FP8-class numerical behavior, seven-bit inference, and a substantially simpler product path.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CurveFP，一种封闭乘积 (closed-product) 的低精度数值格式族，面向语言模型训练与推理。该格式将量化幅值分布到交错对数曲线上，并以整数索引更新实现精确的符号异或与索引运算，使非零乘积在代数上封闭。作者给出 CurveFP eight (E4C3/E5C2) 与 CurveFP seven (E3C3) 两种实例，并在 7B–9B 模型及 128.3M 参数预训练实验中报告了困惑度、NMSE 与格式惩罚等对比结果。
Motivation: 低精度数据类型可降低语言模型成本，但多数格式只优化标量保真度，乘积所诱导的算术仍然不封闭，导致数值行为或硬件路径复杂。本文针对乘积运算的代数封闭性这一缺口，设计同时兼顾动态范围与局部分辨率的数值格式。
Method: CurveFP 是封闭乘积码本族，在紧凑块尺度 (compact block scales) 下将量化幅值分布到交错对数曲线上；有理基数 (rational radix) 调节动态范围与局部分辨率，统一曲线索引使每个非零乘积代数封闭。乘积计算简化为符号异或与整数索引更新，并由导出的有限相位计数决定累加调度。文中实例化为用于训练的 CurveFP eight (E4C3/E5C2) 和用于紧凑部署的 CurveFP seven (E3C3)。
Result: 摘要报告：CurveFP seven 在四个 7B–9B 模型上以少一个元素位 (one fewer element bit) 的代价在困惑度上超过张量级 FP8，并保持在本机质量的 1.32% 以内；CurveFP eight 在全部 36 组前向与反向 GEMM 对比中降低操作数 NMSE；在三个匹配的 128.3M 参数三元组中，每个模式都完成每种子 3B-token 预训练，CurveFP eight 的 BF16 推理平均困惑度为 22.5366，优于 FP8 的 22.5407，且三种子下格式引入的惩罚均更低；在 36 格下游矩阵中，CurveFP eight 训练的检查点在全部 12 个种子-格式比较中取得更低 WikiText-103 困惑度。
Conclusion: 摘要认为这些结果确立 CurveFP 为一种算术协同设计 (arithmetic co-design)，兼具 FP8 级别的数值行为、七位推理和显著更简单的乘积路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Do LLM Recommenders Know When They're Hallucinating? Auditing Confidence Calibration in Catalog Faithfulness
papers.abstract_en: LLM recommenders for top-$K$ item suggestion regularly emit titles outside the target catalog. Prior audits measure this as a binary out-of-domain rate; none ask whether the model knew it was hallucinating. We jointly audit hallucination rate (OOD@10) and verbalized-confidence calibration (ECE, Brier, reliability) for four zero-shot LLM recommenders from four independent vendors (Mistral Large, Llama-3.3-70B, GPT-OSS-120B, Claude Sonnet 4.6), not grounded or fine-tuned systems, across three catalogs (MovieLens-25M, Amazon Reviews 2023 Toys, Yelp Open Dataset), stratified by item popularity. Hallucination is catalog-dependent (0--0.2\% on MovieLens, 4.5--8.3\% on Amazon, 2.2--8.4\% on Yelp), but verbalized confidence is materially miscalibrated even when hallucination is zero (ECE up to 0.223 on MovieLens despite 0\% OOD). All four LLMs are systematically \emph{under}-confident across all twelve cells, verbalizing a mean of 67--86 on items they recommend with 92--100\% accuracy. This is the opposite of the over-confidence usually emphasized in LLM-hallucination work. The under-confidence is best read as an \emph{elicitation mismatch}: ``Just Ask'' elicits a generic recommendation-quality rating, not a catalog-membership probability. A conformal abstention threshold over verbalized confidence reduces hallucination by at most 0.7\,pp across $α\in \{.05, .10, .15, .20\}$, at 4--21\,pp of coverage cost: the under-confident channel cannot separate correct items from hallucinations, so the threshold mostly removes correct items. We recommend that audits of LLM recommenders report calibration alongside OOD, and use catalog-anchored elicitation rather than generic confidence prompts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对四个零样本 LLM 推荐系统（Mistral Large、Llama-3.3-70B、GPT-OSS-120B、Claude Sonnet 4.6）在三个商品目录上同时审计幻觉率（OOD@10）与口头置信度校准（ECE、Brier、reliability）。摘要发现幻觉率随目录变化（MovieLens 上 0–0.2%、Amazon 上 4.5–8.3%、Yelp 上 2.2–8.4%），但在幻觉为 0 时置信度仍严重失准（MovieLens 上 ECE 高达 0.223）。所有模型在全部十二个单元中系统性欠自信，这不同于通常强调的过度自信。
Motivation: 现有审计只把 LLM 推荐系统的越界输出当成二值 out-of-domain 率，没有追问模型是否知道自己正在幻觉，因此缺少对信心校准与目录忠实度之间关系的系统度量。
Method: 对四个独立供应商的零样本 LLM 推荐器在三个目录上按物品流行度分层，联合审计幻觉率与口头化置信度的校准指标，并测试基于置信度的 conformal abstention 阈值（α ∈ {.05,.10,.15,.20}）能否过滤幻觉。
Result: 摘要报告模型在推荐准确率为 92–100% 的物品上平均只口头给出 67–86 的置信分，呈系统性欠自信；幻觉率在各目录差异很大。conformal 弃权阈值最多只能将幻觉降低 0.7 个百分点，却付出 4–21 个百分点的覆盖率代价，说明欠自信通道无法区分正确物品与幻觉。
Conclusion: 作者认为这种欠自信最好理解为 elicitation mismatch：'Just Ask' 得到的是通用推荐质量评分而非目录成员概率，因此建议 LLM 推荐器审计在报告 OOD 的同时报告校准指标，并使用目录锚定的 elicitation 方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Uncertainty-Aware Ensemble Deep Randomized Neural Networks for Classification
papers.abstract_en: The current state-of-the-art (SOTA) deep randomized neural networks, such as deep Random Vector Functional Link (dRVFL) and ensemble deep RVFL (edRVFL), treat all training samples uniformly, which limits their robustness and effectiveness when applied to real-world datasets containing noise and outliers. Furthermore, the propagation of contaminated features across hidden layers negatively influences the decision-making capability of these models. To overcome these limitations, we propose intuitionistic fuzzy dRVFL (IF-dRVFL) and intuitionistic fuzzy edRVFL (IF-edRVFL) frameworks that enhance model robustness. The proposed models unify intuitionistic fuzzy theory to exploit sample neighborhood information in the kernel space by jointly considering membership and non-membership degrees for each sample. Membership degrees are computed based on the distance of samples from their respective class centroids, while non-membership degrees quantify sample heterogeneity within local neighborhoods. These measures are employed to assign adaptive weights to training samples, enabling effective discrimination among clean, noisy, and outlier data points. Extensive experiments conducted on UCI and KEEL benchmark datasets, with and without the presence of Gaussian noise, demonstrate the superiority of the proposed IF-dRVFL and IF-edRVFL models over existing SOTA fuzzy and non-fuzzy approaches. The source code is available at https://github.com/mtanveer1/IF-edRVFL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对深度随机神经网络（如 dRVFL 与 edRVFL）对所有训练样本一视同仁、在含噪声和离群点数据上鲁棒性不足的问题，提出直觉模糊 dRVFL（IF-dRVFL）与直觉模糊 edRVFL（IF-edRVFL）框架。方法在核空间中利用样本邻域信息，联合隶属度与非隶属度对训练样本赋予自适应权重，从而区分干净、噪声与离群样本。在 UCI 与 KEEL 基准数据集上，无论是否加入高斯噪声，所提模型均优于现有 SOTA 的模糊与非模糊方法，源代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有 SOTA 深度随机神经网络（deep randomized neural networks）如 dRVFL 和 edRVFL 将训练样本同等对待，面对真实数据中的噪声与离群点鲁棒性有限；同时，污染特征在隐藏层间的传播会损害模型决策能力。
Method: 提出 IF-dRVFL 与 IF-edRVFL 框架，将直觉模糊理论（intuitionistic fuzzy theory）与深度随机向量功能链接网络结合：依据样本到类中心的距离计算隶属度（membership degree），依据局部邻域内样本异质性计算非隶属度（non-membership degree），进而在核空间中利用邻域信息为训练样本分配自适应权重。
Result: 在 UCI 和 KEEL 基准数据集上的大量实验表明，无论是否加入高斯噪声，IF-dRVFL 和 IF-edRVFL 均优于现有 SOTA 模糊与非模糊方法。
Conclusion: 摘要强调统一直觉模糊理论并联合考虑隶属与非隶属度可以有效提升深度随机神经网络对噪声和离群点的鲁棒性；代码已公开在 GitHub。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: ReCBM: Uncertainty-Gated Relational Reasoning for Concept Bottleneck Models
papers.abstract_en: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) provide an interpretable framework by grounding predictions in human-understandable concepts, enabling semantic inspection and test-time intervention. Recent variants have improved CBMs through richer concept representations, uncertainty estimation, and dependency modeling. However, robust reasoning under unreliable concept states remains underexplored. Without such reasoning, misleading semantic evidence can propagate through the bottleneck, compromising both explanations and downstream predictions. To address this issue, we propose ReCBM, an uncertainty-gated relational reasoning framework for CBMs. ReCBM introduces semantically defined concept relations into the bottleneck and uses uncertainty to guide their refinement. By modeling co-occurrence, implication, and exclusion, ReCBM specifies how evidence is exchanged across concepts, while uncertainty modulates the contribution of each concept during this process. Experiments across diverse datasets showed that ReCBM improved concept and task recovery under missing and flipped concepts, supported uncertainty-aware intervention, and extracted compact task-relevant concept subsets without degrading downstream performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReCBM，一种面向概念瓶颈模型 (Concept Bottleneck Models, CBMs) 的不确定性门控关系推理框架。该框架在瓶颈层引入语义定义的概念关系（共现、蕴含、互斥），并用不确定性来调节概念间证据交换的贡献。实验表明 ReCBM 在概念缺失和翻转场景下提升了概念与任务恢复能力，支持不确定性感知干预，并能提取不影响下游性能的紧凑概念子集。
Motivation: 现有 CBM 变体通过更丰富的概念表示、不确定性估计和依赖建模改进模型，但针对不可靠概念状态下的稳健推理仍未被充分探索；误导性的语义证据可能在瓶颈中传播，损害解释和下游预测。
Method: ReCBM 在瓶颈层中建模概念间的语义关系（共现 co-occurrence、蕴含 implication、互斥 exclusion），利用不确定性指导关系细化，并在证据跨概念交换时用不确定性调制每个概念的贡献。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验显示，ReCBM 在概念缺失 (missing) 和翻转 (flipped) 条件下改善了概念与任务恢复，支持不确定性感知干预 (uncertainty-aware intervention)，并提取紧凑且任务相关的概念子集，且不降低下游性能。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不确定性门控的关系推理可以增强概念瓶颈模型对不可靠概念证据的稳健性，从而改善解释质量和下游预测。

papers.title: LoRCA: LoRA Cycle Adaptation for Histology to HiP-CT Translation with DINOv3
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Phase-Contrast Tomography (HiP-CT) is a synchrotron based X-ray imaging technique that enables non-destructive, volumetric imaging of intact organs with multi-resolutions bridging 20 $μm$/voxel for whole organs to near-cellular resolution ($\sim$0.8 $μm$/voxel) in local regions. This offers the opportunity to bring volumetric whole-organ context to histology. However, nonlinear registration between H\&E histology and HiP-CT volumes is challenging due to the differences in feature representations of different colour spaces. Synthesis-before-registration methods have shown strong results in histology-to-MRI and histology-to-CT alignment. However, existing approaches either rely on manual anatomical contours or are trained from scratch without semantic constraints, limiting their generalisability to soft tissue organs and novel modalities. We propose LoRCA (LoRA Cycle Adaptation), a cycle consistent style translation framework built on a shared frozen DINOv3 with modality-specific LoRA adapters, learning modality-specific representations that are decoded and adversarially trained. LoRCA enables structure-preserving translation without requiring paired training data. The frozen backbone is intended to be a structural anchor that prevents content drift by preserving pretrained semantic-extraction capability. We evaluate translation quality using Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and structural fidelity via mutual information and Canny edge preservation. LoRCA outperforms CycleGAN in both translation quality and structural consistency. As a preliminary indicator of downstream registration utility, we find that style-translated images yield increased feature correspondences under MatchAnything on manually aligned HiP-CT and histology test pairs, suggesting that LoRCA-style translation is a promising step towards 2D histological sections to 3D HiP-CT volumes registration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LoRCA（LoRA Cycle Adaptation），一个基于共享冻结 DINOv3 骨干与模态特定 LoRA 适配器的循环一致风格翻译框架，用于 H&E 组织学图像与 HiP-CT 体数据之间的结构保持翻译，且不需要配对训练数据。冻结骨干作为结构锚点，保留预训练语义提取能力以防止内容漂移。摘要报告其在 FID、互信息和 Canny 边缘保持上优于 CycleGAN，并初步显示风格翻译图像在手动对齐测试对上增加了 MatchAnything 的特征对应。
Motivation: HiP-CT 能以多分辨率无破坏性成像完整器官，但 H&E 组织学与 HiP-CT 体数据之间的非线性配准因色彩空间特征表示差异而困难。现有合成先配准方法要么依赖手动解剖轮廓，要么从头训练缺少语义约束，限制了对软组织器官和新模态的泛化能力。
Method: 提出 LoRCA，一种循环一致风格翻译框架：共享冻结的 DINOv3 骨干，配以模态特定的 LoRA 适配器学习各模态表示，再经解码器和对抗训练完成翻译。该方法无需配对数据，且利用冻结骨干作为结构锚点维持语义与结构一致性。
Result: 在翻译质量上以 Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) 衡量，在结构保真度上以互信息和 Canny 边缘保持衡量，LoRCA 均优于 CycleGAN。作为配准效用的初步指标，风格翻译后的图像在手动对齐的 HiP-CT 与组织学测试对上产生了更多的 MatchAnything 特征对应。
Conclusion: 摘要将 LoRCA 风格翻译视为从 2D 组织学切片到 3D HiP-CT 体积配准的有前景一步；目前证据仍是初步的配准前翻译质量评估，未报告完整下游配准任务的定量结果。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Implicit representations are dead. Long live explicit primitives!
papers.abstract_en: Continuous parameterization of medical data has emerged as a powerful paradigm for resolution-independent image representation. While Implicit Neural Representations offer high fidelity and compact storage, their reliance on global Multi-Layer Perceptrons incurs sizeable computational costs, large memory requirements, and extensive optimization times. As medical imaging trends towards ever-more detailed, high-resolution volumes, these costs impose significant bottlenecks in the applicability of implicit approaches. Recently, explicit Gaussian-based primitives have revolutionized the representation learning paradigm by trading deep network evaluations for localized, rasterization-friendly primitives. In this paper, we present a comprehensive, cross-dimensional evaluation of Gaussian representations against implicit approaches for medical imaging applications. First, we outline a theoretical overview on the mathematical properties offered by explicit primitives beyond what is capable under the implicit neural paradigm. Subsequently, we benchmark the computational performance on two demanding image datasets: 2D microscopy histology and 3D lung Computed Tomography (CT). Our experiments demonstrate that Gaussian representations consistently match or surpass reconstruction metrics compared to implicit methods across all compression factors, while displaying significantly lower optimization times, and memory requirements. Together with the compelling mathematical properties offered by explicit primitives, these findings motivate the wider adoption of Gaussian representations and position them as an attractive direction for future research in medical imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统比较了显式高斯基元 (Gaussian primitives) 与隐式神经表示 (implicit neural representations) 在医学成像中的表现。作者先给出显式基元数学性质的理论概述，再在 2D 显微镜组织学和 3D 肺 CT 两个数据集上进行基准测试，结果显示高斯表示在所有压缩因子下一致持平或超越隐式方法的重建指标，同时优化时间和内存需求显著更低。
Motivation: 隐式神经表示虽具备高保真度和紧凑存储，但依赖全局多层感知机，带来可观的计算成本、大内存需求和漫长的优化时间；随着医学成像趋向更高分辨率体积数据，这些成本成为隐式方法实际应用的瓶颈。
Method: 作者从理论上概述显式基元相比隐式神经范式所具备的数学性质，随后在 2D 显微组织学和 3D 肺 CT 两个数据集上，对高斯表示与隐式方法进行跨维度 (cross-dimensional) 的计算性能基准评测。
Result: 实验显示，高斯表示在所有压缩因子下的重建指标均持平或超越隐式方法，并表现出显著更低的优化时间和内存需求。
Conclusion: 作者认为，结合显式基元的数学性质与实验优势，这些发现支持医学成像中更广泛采用高斯表示，并为其未来研究指明有吸引力的方向。
Relevance: 2

papers.title: Pre- to Post-Contrast Synthesis of Breast DCE-MRI using Latent Bridge Matching
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI) is central to breast cancer imaging, but gadolinium administration increases scan burden and motivates contrast-reduced alternatives, including synthetic contrast generation. We propose a latent bridge matching (LBM) framework for synthesizing peak-enhanced breast DCE-MRI from pre-contrast images in the MAMA-SYNTH challenge setting. Instead of starting from Gaussian noise as in conventional latent diffusion models (LDMs), the proposed model learns a conditional bridge between paired pre-contrast and peak-enhanced VAE latents. A latent UNet predicts the remaining correction from intermediate bridge states to the peak-enhanced latent, enabling iterative refinement while keeping the trajectory anchored to patient-specific anatomy. We evaluated two LBM conditioning variants on 91 DUKE validation cases. For the tumor-conditioned variant, tumor masks were used as conditioning inputs. Tumor-conditioning improved performance compared with pre-contrast conditioning, reducing MSE from 1.023 to 0.940 and FRD from 7.523 to 4.716, while increasing tumor SSIM from 0.355 to 0.429. The tumor-conditioned LBM also outperformed the evaluated LDM baseline on this validation cohort. These results suggest that latent bridge matching is a promising pre-contrast-anchored formulation for virtual contrast enhancement, while further work is needed to validate generalization and remove dependence on ground-truth tumor masks at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文面向乳腺癌 DCE-MRI 的虚拟对比增强任务，提出一种潜在桥匹配 (latent bridge matching, LBM) 框架，在 MAMA-SYNTH 挑战设置中从平扫 (pre-contrast) 图像合成峰强化 (peak-enhanced) 影像。与从高斯噪声出发的潜在扩散模型 (latent diffusion model, LDM) 不同，该方法在配对平扫与峰强化 VAE 潜在表示之间学习条件桥，并用潜在 UNet 预测中间桥状态到峰强化潜在表示的校正量，从而实现迭代细化并保持轨迹锚定于患者特定解剖结构。在 91 例 DUKE 验证集上，肿瘤条件化的变体优于平扫条件化变体，并将肿瘤 SSIM 从 0.355 提升到 0.429。
Motivation: DCE-MRI 是乳腺癌影像的关键手段，但钆对比剂注射增加了扫描负担，因此需要对比剂减量乃至合成对比增强的替代方案。
Method: 提出潜在桥匹配框架，不采用高斯噪声起点，而是学习平扫与峰强化 VAE 潜在表示之间的条件桥；潜在 UNet 预测剩余校正量以实现迭代细化，并对比了以平扫图像条件和以肿瘤掩膜作为条件的两种变体。
Result: 在 91 例 DUKE 验证病例上，肿瘤条件化相比平扫条件化将 MSE 从 1.023 降至 0.940、FRD 从 7.523 降至 4.716、肿瘤 SSIM 从 0.355 提升至 0.429；肿瘤条件化 LBM 也优于所评估的 LDM 基线。
Conclusion: 结果表明潜在桥匹配是一种有前景的、以平扫为锚点的虚拟对比增强方案，但作者指出仍需进一步工作来验证泛化性，并在推理时摆脱对真实肿瘤掩膜的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robustness of transferability estimation metrics for medical imaging
papers.abstract_en: In transfer learning, the choice of source model largely influences the performance on a target dataset. Still, selecting a fitting source remains a challenging task, especially in medical imaging where one has to decide between models pre-trained on off-the-shelf options, such as ImageNet, and domain specific datasets. Transferability estimation (TE) metrics address this problem by aiming to predict the best performing source model in a computationally cost effective way. However, previous work has reported conflicting TE metric performances due to differences in experimental setups. Moreover, most TE metrics are designed for and evaluated on natural images, while being optimized for accuracy, whereas in medical imaging metrics that are more robust to class imbalance are typically used. We study the impact of varying the target dataset as an isolated factor, by constructing miniature populations of different sample sizes and random seeds. In addition, we investigate the influence of the evaluation metric used to obtain the reference ranking. We find that small modifications to the target dataset change the rankings. Furthermore, we show that the choice of evaluation metric affects the reference rankings and therefore the evaluation of TE metrics. Overall, we observe a low agreement between rankings from TE metrics and reference. The code, model checkpoints and data splits used in this work are available through https://github.com/niclasclassen/robustness-of-transferability-estimation-metrics-for-medical-imaging.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医学成像中迁移学习源模型选择的可靠性问题，系统评估可迁移性估计（TE）指标在不同目标数据集与评估指标下的稳定性。作者通过构建不同样本量和随机种子的微型数据集种群，发现目标数据集的小幅改动会导致排名变化，且评估指标的选择会影响参考排名及TE指标的评价结果。总体而言，TE指标与参考排名之间的一致性较低。
Motivation: 迁移学习中，源模型的选择对目标数据集性能影响很大，但医学成像中在ImageNet预训练与领域特定预训练之间选择合适源模型仍然困难。已有TE指标性能报告相互矛盾，且多数TE指标针对自然图像设计、以准确率为优化目标，而医学成像通常更关注对类别不平衡稳健的指标。
Method: 将目标数据集作为单一变量进行控制，构造不同样本量与随机种子的微型数据集种群；同时改变用来计算参考排名的评估指标，研究这些因素对TE指标评价结果的影响，并与参考排名做一致性分析。
Result: 摘要报告：目标数据集的微小改动即会改变源模型的排名；评估指标的选择会改变参考排名，从而影响TE指标的评测；总体上TE指标与参考排名的一致性较低。
Conclusion: TE指标在医学成像场景下的鲁棒性不足，评测结论对实验设置（目标数据集细节和评估指标）高度敏感。作者公开了代码、模型检查点和数据划分以支持复现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Artificial Intelligence: A Comprehensive Review and Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Models' Carbon Footprint
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) have become powerful tools for supporting and automating complex human tasks. Despite their benefits, growing attention has been directed toward their environmental implications, primarily due to their high energy demands and associated carbon emissions. This concern is particularly relevant in light of the increasing deployment of large-scale models, especially Deep Learning (DL) architectures, which provide advanced predictive capabilities but require substantial computational resources. This paper presents a systematic review of research on Green AI, Green DL, and optimization techniques aimed at reducing the environmental impact of AI models. In addition, we examine and compare several carbon measurement tools for estimating emissions generated by AI algorithms. To complement the review, we conducted an empirical evaluation using a CPU-based experimental setup, in which six DL models were implemented for a multi-label classification task. The objective was to quantify and compare their overall carbon emissions and to determine which stages of the DL lifecycle contribute most significantly to the total footprint. The results show that the training phase is the primary source of emissions. Moreover, the findings reveal that increased architectural complexity does not systematically translate into proportional accuracy gains, highlighting the importance of carefully balancing predictive performance and environmental cost. These results reinforce the need to integrate sustainability considerations into model selection and AI system design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了 Green AI、Green DL 以及旨在降低 AI 模型环境影响的优化技术，并比较了多种碳排放测量工具。作者在基于 CPU 的实验环境中实现了六个深度学习模型完成多标签分类任务，量化并比较其碳排放，结果发现训练阶段是碳排放的主要来源，且架构复杂度的增加并不系统性地带来成比例的精度提升。
Motivation: AI/ML 尤其是大规模深度学习模型虽然能力强大，但其高能耗和碳排放引发了日益增长的环境担忧，现有研究中缺乏对模型选择与设计过程中可持续性因素的系统性审视。
Method: 采用系统文献综述与实证评估相结合的方式：综述 Green AI、Green DL 和减排优化技术，并在 CPU 实验环境下实现六个深度学习模型进行多标签分类任务，利用碳测量工具估算和对比其整体碳排放以及 DL 生命周期各阶段的贡献。
Result: 结果显示训练阶段是碳排放的主要来源；同时发现增加架构复杂度并不总能换来相应的精度提升，提示预测性能与环境成本之间存在需要权衡的关系。
Conclusion: 作者强调在模型选择和 AI 系统设计中应整合可持续性考量，以实现预测性能与环境影响的平衡。

papers.title: Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-IV: Developmental Topology Observatory
papers.abstract_en: Transformers have had a profound impact on the world of language processing and computer vision. As efforts to answer the million-dollar question of ``How does a Transformer learn?" have been increasing, existing interpretability studies primarily analyze representations at isolated layers or the network as a whole, while the developmental evolution of individual representations and its manifolds across transformer layers remains underexplored. With this work, we aim at providing a comprehensive analysis of the evolution of representations as the representation point cloud transforms across the layers; thereby attempting to isolate layers or establish a trend which comes closer to justifying how and when raw input representations evolve into task-relevant feature representations. Thus, Transformer Geometry Observatory-TGO-IV introduces a topological framework for analysing the evolution of Transformer representations through the lens of Persistent Homology. Rather than studying local geometric properties alone, TGO-IV constructs Vietoris--Rips simplicial complexes from token-level representation point clouds and investigates the evolution of their persistent topological signatures across Transformer layers. The proposed framework comprises complementary topological observatories including Persistence Diagrams, Barcode Diagrams, Betti Curves, Persistence Landscapes, Bottleneck Distance, and Wasserstein Distance, enabling a comprehensive analysis of how the global topology of representation point clouds develops throughout the forward pass.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Transformer Geometry Observatory TGO-IV，利用持续同调 (Persistent Homology) 分析 Transformer 表示在层间的演化过程。作者对 token 级表示点云构造 Vietoris–Rips 复形，观察其拓扑签名（如持久图、Betti 曲线等）在各层的变换，目标是判断原始输入何时以及如何演化为任务相关特征。该工作属于解释性研究，而非提出新的预测或分类模型。
Motivation: 现有 Transformer 可解释性研究大多分析单层表示或整个网络，较少关注单个表示及其流形跨层的发育演化。作者希望用拓扑工具建立表示点云在层间变换的趋势，从而更好回答 Transformer 如何学习的问题。
Method: TGO-IV 从每一层的 token 级表示点云构造 Vietoris–Rips 单纯复形，并观察跨层的持久拓扑特征。框架包含持久图、条形图、Betti 曲线、持久景观、Bottleneck 距离和 Wasserstein 距离等多种互补的拓扑观测手段。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数值或基准结果，主要贡献是提出一套用于追踪表示点云全局拓扑在前向传播中如何发展的分析框架。
Conclusion: 作者认为通过持续同调观察表示点云跨层拓扑演化，有助于定位关键层并解释任务相关特征的形成过程；该工作是面向表示发育过程的分析性框架。

papers.title: Energy and Performance Benchmarking of Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Detection
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in machine learning have greatly improved breast cancer detection, enabling more accurate and timely diagnosis. Deep learning (DL) models show strong potential for medical image analysis; however, as their architectural complexity increases, their environmental impacts are becoming a growing concern. In this paper, we present a comparative analysis of seven DL models for breast cancer detection on two medical datasets: Breast Ultrasound and BreakHis 400X. The evaluated architectures range from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and transformers to hybrid models. In addition to performance metrics, we assess CO2 emissions during both training and inference. Our results show that EfficientNet and ResNet consistently deliver strong performance, although with higher CO2 emissions. The selected transformers, such as DeiT-Tiny, perform competitively on both datasets, whereas DenseNet121 achieves lower accuracy. On the Breast Ultrasound Dataset, DeiT provides the most favourable balance between accuracy and energy consumption, whereas on the BreakHis dataset, the ViT and Swin models achieve the best results. Overall, our findings indicate that no single architecture category from the evaluated ones consistently dominates across the two selected datasets. Our results highlight the importance of jointly considering performance, emissions, and dataset characteristics when selecting models for medical applications.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICMLA 2026 (IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications). Camera-ready version submitted
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对七个深度学习模型在乳腺癌检测任务上的性能与能耗进行基准测评，使用 Breast Ultrasound 和 BreakHis 400X 两个医学数据集，并评估训练与推理阶段的 CO2 排放。结果显示 EfficientNet 和 ResNet 性能稳定但碳排放较高，DeiT-Tiny 在两个数据集上表现有竞争力，DenseNet121 精度较低；没有单一架构类别在两个数据集上持续占优。
Motivation: 深度学习模型在医学图像分析中展现出潜力，但架构复杂度上升带来的环境影响日益受到关注；现有研究多只关注性能，缺少对能耗与碳排放的系统比较。
Method: 对从 CNN、Transformer 到混合模型的七个深度学习模型进行统一基准测试，在两个医学数据集上比较分类性能，同时测量训练和推理阶段的 CO2 排放，以评估精度与能耗的权衡。
Result: EfficientNet 和 ResNet 性能强但碳排放高；DeiT-Tiny 在两个数据集上表现有竞争力；DenseNet121 精度较低。在 Breast Ultrasound 数据集上 DeiT 的精度与能耗平衡最佳，在 BreakHis 数据集上 ViT 和 Swin 表现最好。
Conclusion: 摘要指出没有任何单一架构类别在两个数据集上持续占优，强调在医学应用中选择模型时应同时考虑性能、碳排放和数据集特性。

papers.title: Structural Guidance for Unified Joint Demosaicing and Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Joint demosaicing and denoising is a fundamental step in camera image signal processing, yet remains challenging because different Bayer-like color filter arrays (CFAs) and sensor noise jointly corrupt both color sampling and image content. Existing unified restoration networks explicitly model CFA geometry but are still driven primarily by pixel-level supervision, making them prone to structural degradation around edges, repetitive textures, and moiré patterns where local evidence is unreliable. We attribute this limitation partly to the absence of explicit structural guidance beyond pixel-level reconstruction supervision. Motivated by this observation, we propose a structural-guided unified restoration framework that injects pretrained structural knowledge into CFA-aware image restoration. Our model receives a unified five-channel observation consisting of the raw mosaic, CFA masks, and a noise-level map. A SwinIR restoration branch reconstructs pixel details under CFA-conditioned modulation, while a parallel structural reasoning branch extracts complementary structural cues from a sparse pseudo-RGB observation. To bridge the substantial domain gap between sparse noisy sensor data and the natural-image pretraining domain of the structural encoder, we introduce a lightweight trainable adapter before residually fusing structural and restoration features. A shared decoder jointly predicts the restored RGB image and an auxiliary clean mosaic, providing supervision in both image and sensor domains. Extensive experiments across multiple CFA patterns and noise levels demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art unified and CFA-specific methods, indicating that adapted structural priors can enhance robust camera image restoration. The source codes and dataset are provided in the supplementary material.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个结构引导的统一去马赛克与去噪框架，将预训练的结构先验注入CFA感知的图像恢复。模型接收包含原始马赛克、CFA掩码和噪声水平图的五通道观测，由SwinIR恢复分支和并行结构推理分支共同处理，并通过轻量适配器弥合稀疏传感器数据与自然图像预训练域之间的差距。实验表明该方法在多种CFA模式和噪声水平下一致优于现有统一方法和CFA特定方法。
Motivation: 现有统一恢复网络主要依赖像素级监督，缺少显式结构引导，导致边缘、重复纹理和摩尔纹等局部证据不可靠的区域出现结构退化。
Method: 提出结构引导的统一恢复框架：输入为原始马赛克、CFA掩码和噪声水平图组成的五通道观测；SwinIR分支在CFA条件调制下重建像素细节，并行结构推理分支从稀疏伪RGB观测中提取互补结构线索；引入轻量可训练适配器桥接域差距，并采用共享解码器联合预测恢复后的RGB图像和辅助干净马赛克，在图像域和传感器域都提供监督。
Result: 摘要报告在多种CFA模式和多噪声水平下，该方法一致优于最先进的统一方法和CFA特定方法，表明适配的结构先验能增强鲁棒的相机图像恢复。
Conclusion: 作者认为将适配后的结构先验注入CFA感知恢复可显著提升统一去马赛克与去噪的性能，并已在补充材料中提供源代码和数据集。

papers.title: SpecF2M: A Spectral-Aware Multi-task Network Estimating Axial Length and Refractive Error from Pediatric Fundus Photographs
papers.abstract_en: Spherical Equivalent Refraction (SER) and Axial Length (AL) are core indicators for pediatric myopia screening, yet their measurements require dedicated biometry and cycloplegic refraction. Fundus photography offers an accessible imaging modality, as myopia-related posterior-pole changes are visible in 45$^\circ$ fundus images. However, these cues are often low-contrast, spatially diffuse, and multi-scale. Moreover, AL, Sphere (SPH), and Cylinder (CYL) share partially overlapping but non-identical anatomical correlates. We propose SpecF2M, a spectral-aware multi-task network for estimating AL and SER components from pediatric fundus photographs. SpecF2M integrates a deterministic anatomy-guided enhancement module, a hybrid spatial--spectral backbone combining MixCNN and Hybrid Spectral Learning (HSL) blocks, and an expert-routing head for component-level estimation of AL, SPH, and CYL. On a pediatric cohort of 4,359 eligible child visits and 6,966 fundus images, SpecF2M outperforms controlled CNN/ViT baselines for AL and SPH estimation, achieving MAEs of 0.5347 mm and 0.7062 D, respectively. Component-level analysis further reveals asymmetric task coupling, where CYL exhibits weaker association with fundus-derived myopic patterns than AL/SPH. These results support fundus-based, screening-oriented estimation of pediatric myopia indicators, while external validation remains necessary before deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 SpecF2M，一种从儿科眼底照片估计眼轴长度（AL）和等效球镜（SER）分量的多任务网络，核心是结合解剖引导增强模块（anatomy-guided enhancement）、混合空间-频谱骨干（MixCNN 与 Hybrid Spectral Learning 块）和专家路由头（expert-routing head），分别估计 AL、SPH 和 CYL。在一个包含 4,359 次儿童就诊、6,966 张眼底图像的队列中，SpecF2M 在 AL 和 SPH 估计上优于受控的 CNN/ViT 基线，MAE 分别为 0.5347 mm 和 0.7062 D。分量级分析显示任务耦合不对称：CYL 与眼底近视模式的关联弱于 AL/SPH。
Motivation: 儿科近视筛查中，SER 和 AL 是核心指标，但测量需要专用生物测量和睫状肌麻痹验光；眼底照相作为可及性更高的模态，其近视相关后极变化却具有低对比度、空间弥散和多尺度等特征。
Method: SpecF2M 集成一个确定性的解剖引导增强模块以突出眼底近视相关区域，采用 MixCNN 与 Hybrid Spectral Learning（HSL）块组成的混合空间-频谱骨干网络，并使用专家路由头对 AL、SPH、CYL 进行分量级估计，以建模它们部分重叠但非完全一致的解剖相关性。

papers.title: APCReg: Anatomical-Prior-Guided Coarse-to-Fine CBCT--IOS Registration via Multi-View Projection and Reliability-Controlled Residual Correction
papers.abstract_en: Registration between cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) and intraoral scans (IOS) is essential for patient-specific surgical planning. However, disparate imaging modalities, limited overlap, and large pose offsets make automated registration unreliable. Consequently, clinical registration remains dependent on conventional geometry pipelines and manual clinician adjustment. To address these challenges, we propose APCReg, an anatomical-prior-guided coarse-to-fine framework for global registration and reliability-controlled residual correction. Specifically, multi-view anatomical coarse registration (MACR) performs ordered orthogonal projection alignment (buccal, proximal, and occlusal) to decompose the six-degree-of-freedom search before three-dimensional refinement. Overlap-aware residual registration (OARR) combines shared KPConv features, a folded arch-length cue, overlap-gated cross-attention, and Sinkhorn matching. Finally, dental-arch-structured hypothesis selection evaluates diverse poses on held-out reliable correspondences, while a ground-truth-free coarse-retention guard conditionally retains a geometrically reliable coarse pose. On 60 held-out jaw pairs, APCReg achieves a submillimeter mean Chamfer distance of 0.87 mm and a Hausdorff distance of 2.92 mm under this evaluation protocol, and ranks first across the six reported metrics among the evaluated open-source baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 APCReg，一个解剖先验引导的粗到细框架，用于 CBCT 与口内扫描 (IOS) 的全局配准和可靠性控制的残差校正。方法将六自由度搜索分解为多视角解剖粗配准 (MACR) 的有序正交投影对齐，并引入重叠感知残差配准 (OARR) 进行三维精化。在 60 个留出颌骨对上，平均 Chamfer 距离为 0.87 mm，Hausdorff 距离为 2.92 mm，在评估的开源基线中六个报告指标排名第一。
Motivation: CBCT 与 IOS 配准对患者特异性手术规划至关重要，但不同成像模态、有限重叠和较大姿态偏移使自动配准不可靠，临床仍需依赖传统几何流程和手动调整。
Method: APCReg 包括多视角解剖粗配准 (MACR)，通过颊侧、近中和咬合方向的有序正交投影对齐分解六自由度搜索，再进行三维精化；重叠感知残差配准 (OARR) 结合共享 KPConv 特征、折叠弓长线索、重叠门控交叉注意力和 Sinkhorn 匹配；最后用牙弓结构假设选择评估候选姿态，并通过无真值粗保留守卫条件条件性保留几何可靠的粗姿态。
Result: 在 60 个留出颌骨对上，该方法取得平均 Chamfer 距离 0.87 mm、Hausdorff 距离 2.92 mm，并在所报告的六个指标中优于评估的开源基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明该框架有效应对模态差异、有限重叠和大姿态偏移下的自动配准问题，但未讨论明确的局限性。

papers.title: Knowledge-Guided 3D CT Generation: A Conditioning-Centric Taxonomy
papers.abstract_en: Controllable generation guided by external knowledge is a key requirement in modern generative deep learning applications, enabling the synthesis of samples with explicit constraints on semantic content, structural properties, and variability. In 3D Computed Tomography (CT), such control is essential for clinical applications, including data augmentation, privacy-preserving data sharing, and the simulation of specific anatomical or pathological scenarios. While research on conditional 3D CT generation has expanded rapidly, the diversity of existing approaches makes systematic comparison difficult and obscures fundamental design choices. In this survey, we propose a conditioning-centric taxonomy that organizes the literature along three orthogonal dimensions: the type of external knowledge (K), the knowledge integration paradigm (I), and the generative architecture (A). This factorization defines an explicit design space (K x I x A) that provides a unified perspective on prior work. Using this framework, we systematize existing methods, identify dominant trends and recurring design patterns, and highlight underexplored regions of the design space that point toward promising directions for future research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇关于条件式 3D CT 生成的综述，提出以条件信息为中心的分类框架，将文献按外部知识类型 (K)、知识整合范式 (I) 和生成架构 (A) 三个正交维度组织，形成 K × I × A 设计空间。基于该框架，作者系统化梳理现有方法，总结主流趋势与重复出现的设计模式，并指出设计空间中尚未充分探索的区域。
Motivation: 在现代生成式深度学习中，由外部知识引导的可控生成是关键需求；在 3D CT 中，这种控制对数据增强、隐私保护的数据共享以及特定解剖或病理场景的模拟至关重要。但由于条件式 3D CT 生成研究快速增长且方法多样，难以进行系统比较，基本设计选择被掩盖。
Method: 提出一个以条件为中心的 taxonomy，沿三个正交维度对文献分类：外部知识类型 (K)、知识整合范式 (I) 和生成架构 (A)，以此定义一个显式的设计空间 (K × I × A)。
Result: 利用该框架系统化现有方法，识别出主流趋势和重复出现的设计模式，并突出设计空间中未充分探索的区域。
Conclusion: 该框架为既往工作提供了统一视角，并据此指出有前景的未来研究方向。论文为 IJCAI-ECAI 2026 Survey Track 录用。

papers.title: Longitudinal 3D Foundation Modeling for Neoadjuvant Breast Cancer Response Prediction from Serial DCE-MRI
papers.abstract_en: Pathologic complete response (pCR) is an important endpoint in neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) for breast cancer, and predicting pCR from imaging during treatment could support treatment response assessment. Many existing imaging-based approaches rely on a single static timepoint, which fails to capture changes that occur during treatment. In this work, we present a longitudinal framework that combines a frozen 3D foundation encoder (Pillar-0) with our Temporal Dynamics Network (TDN) to predict treatment response from serial Dynamic Contrast-Enhanced (DCE) MRI acquired across four clinical timepoints from pre-treatment to pre-surgery. The TDN combines time-aware volumetric embeddings with clinical and treatment data to predict pCR. Evaluated on 982 patients from the combined I-SPY2 and ACRIN-6698 cohort, the proposed model achieves strong performance across all reported metrics when longitudinal 3D imaging is fused with clinical data (test AUROC: 73.6%, balanced accuracy: 69.1%). While clinical variables provide the strongest individual predictive signal, longitudinal 3D imaging contributes complementary information when fused with clinical data, improving pCR prediction. Our source code is available at: https://github.com/omarftt/longitudinal_temporal_pillar.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Applications of Medical AI (AMAI) Workshop at MICCAI 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个纵向预测框架，将冻结的3D基础编码器 Pillar-0 与 Temporal Dynamics Network (TDN) 结合，利用新辅助化疗（NAC）期间四个临床时间点（从治疗前到术前）采集的连续 DCE-MRI 预测乳腺癌病理完全缓解（pCR）。在 I-SPY2 与 ACRIN-6698 联合队列的 982 例患者上，融合纵向3D影像与临床数据后取得 test AUROC 73.6%、balanced accuracy 69.1%。作者强调临床变量单独是最强预测信号，而纵向3D影像在融合时提供互补信息。
Motivation: pCR 是乳腺癌新辅助化疗中的重要疗效终点，但许多现有影像学方法只使用单一静态时间点，无法捕捉治疗过程中的动态变化，难以支持治疗反应评估。
Method: 提出纵向框架：使用冻结的3D基础编码器 Pillar-0 提取影像特征，再由 Temporal Dynamics Network 将时间感知的体素嵌入（time-aware volumetric embeddings）与临床及治疗数据结合，共同预测 pCR。
Result: 在 982 例 I-SPY2 与 ACRIN-6698 联合队列上，纵向3D影像与临床数据融合时达到 test AUROC 73.6%、balanced accuracy 69.1%；临床变量单独预测信号最强，纵向3D影像提供互补信息并改善 pCR 预测。
Conclusion: 摘要强调纵向3D影像与临床数据融合可提升乳腺癌新辅助化疗 pCR 预测性能，并已公开源代码；未在摘要中提及明确的局限性。

papers.title: MaskFlow: Precise, Consistent and Seamless Regional Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: Regional image editing has attracted considerable attention for its spatial controllability. Although instruction-based and mask-reference-based editing methods can achieve strong semantic alignment, reliable regional control remains challenging, where an edit must be accurately localized and naturally integrated with the preserved context. We propose \textbf{MaskFlow}, a training framework for precise localization, consistent background preservation, and seamless boundary transitions. MaskFlow incorporates the mask into the probability path and flow-matching objective, coordinating generation within the editable region with source preservation outside it. The proposed Soft-Poisson de-seaming module further refines the predicted vector field during both training and sampling to improve the smooth integration of the edited foreground with the preserved background. We also design a data synthesis pipeline to construct MEData, a mask-based image editing dataset for training regional image editing models and facilitating further research. Experiments on natural scenes and infographic images demonstrate consistent improvements over competing methods in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MaskFlow，一个用于区域图像编辑 (regional image editing) 的训练框架，目标是实现精确的编辑定位、一致的背景保留和无缝的边界过渡。MaskFlow 将掩码纳入概率路径和 flow-matching 目标，在可编辑区域内协调生成、在区域外保持源图像；同时提出 Soft-Poisson 去接缝模块，在训练和采样阶段优化预测向量场。作者还设计了数据合成管道，构建了掩码图像编辑数据集 MEData，并在自然场景和信息图图像上的定量与定性实验中取得一致改进。
Motivation: 区域图像编辑虽具备空间可控性，但可靠的区域控制仍有挑战：编辑必须被精确定位，并与保留的上下文自然融合。现有基于指令和掩码参考的方法虽能实现强语义对齐，但准确局部化与无缝集成仍不足。
Method: MaskFlow 将掩码直接整合进概率路径和 flow-matching 目标，使生成过程在可编辑区域内进行、在外部保持源内容；新增的 Soft-Poisson 去接缝模块在训练和采样时细化预测向量场，改善编辑前景与保留背景之间的平滑集成；此外构建了合成数据管道生成掩码编辑数据集 MEData。
Result: 在自然场景图像和信息图 (infographic) 图像上的实验显示，MaskFlow 在定量和定性评估中均一致优于对比方法。
Conclusion: 作者认为 MaskFlow 实现了精确局部化、一致背景保留和无缝边界过渡，并发布 MEData 数据集以促进后续区域图像编辑研究。

papers.title: Resolving Emergent Beat Patterns Through Hybrid Bayesian Learning of Multilayered Stochastic Hierarchical Delay Models
papers.abstract_en: Modeling emergent, multiscale patterns in complex systems remains a persistent interdisciplinary challenge, particularly when deciphering transient, highly coupled dynamics from severely limited data. To overcome the inherent spectral sparsity of standard finite-dimensional stochastic models, we introduce Multilayered Stochastic Hierarchical Delay Models (MSHDMs). By embedding dynamics within a hierarchical delay structure, MSHDMs leverage an infinite-dimensional phase space to engineer the high spectral density required for generating complex Amplitude-Frequency Modulation (AM-FM) dynamics, avoiding data-heavy neural network parameterizations. To reliably calibrate these sensitive structures from short observational records, we deploy a hybrid offline-online Bayesian optimization framework. Bypassing the failure points of traditional trajectory matching, our algorithm autonomously learns optimal latent coordinates and continuous fractional delays by strictly enforcing spectral consistency against the empirical Global Wavelet Spectrum. Applying this methodology to high-resolution satellite observations of continental cloud fields, the resulting stochastic emulator captures the full spatiotemporal coherence of the turbulent system using just 6 hyperparameters. The wavelet scalograms demonstrate how the model natively generates emergent wave-packet dynamics and cross-scale energy cascades, recovering semidiurnal, mesoscale, and individual cloud timescales. Supported by rigorous mathematical foundations and robust data-driven calibrations, MSHDMs thus provide a highly compressible, general-purpose tool for resolving latent AM-FM beat patterns across diverse disciplines.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多层随机层次延迟模型 (MSHDMs)，通过将动力学嵌入层次化延迟结构以利用无限维相空间，获得高谱密度来生成复杂的调幅-调频 (AM-FM) 动力学，从而规避有限维随机模型固有的谱稀疏问题和数据密集的神经网络参数化。作者采用混合离线和在线贝叶斯优化框架，通过严格强制经验全局小波谱 (Global Wavelet Spectrum) 的谱一致性来自动学习潜在坐标和连续分数延迟。将该方法应用于大陆云场的高分辨率卫星观测后，仅用 6 个超参数即可重建湍流系统的完整时空相干性，并自然地生成小波包动力学和跨尺度能量级联，恢复半日、中尺度和单个云的时间尺度。
Motivation: 复杂系统中涌现的多尺度模式建模是一个跨学科难题，尤其是在从严重受限的数据中解读瞬态、强耦合动力学时；标准有限维随机模型的谱稀疏性使其难以刻画这类现象。
Method: 引入多层随机层次延迟模型 (MSHDMs)，利用层次化延迟结构在无限维相空间中实现高谱密度；校准采用混合离线-在线贝叶斯优化框架，避免传统轨迹匹配的失败点，通过严格强制经验全局小波谱的谱一致性自动学习最优潜在坐标和连续分数延迟。
Result: 对大陆云场高分辨率卫星观测的应用表明，该随机仿真器仅凭 6 个超参数即可捕捉湍流系统完整的时空相干性；小波尺度图显示模型能原生生成涌现的波包动力学和跨尺度能量级联，并恢复半日、中尺度和单个云的时间尺度。
Conclusion: 在严谨数学基础和稳健数据驱动校准支持下，MSHDMs 为在不同学科中解析潜在 AM-FM 节拍模式提供了一种高度可压缩、通用的工具。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: The iSTORM Instrument for Airborne Measurements of Gamma-Ray Emissions from Thunderstorms
papers.abstract_en: The in-Situ Thunderstorm Observer for Radiation Mechanisms (iSTORM) is a gamma-ray spectrometer to study gamma-ray transients originating from thunderstorms, such as glows and terrestrial gamma-ray flashes (TGFs). It is designed and built by the U.S. Naval Research Laboratory for deployment aboard a NASA ER-2 aircraft. Using an array of 32 one-inch-diameter $\mathrm{CeBr}_3$ scintillators read out with silicon photomultipliers (SiPMs), the instrument achieves an energy range of $\sim 250 \ \mathrm{keV}$ to $5 \ \mathrm{MeV}$ under flight conditions, with a total geometrical area of $157 \ \mathrm{cm^2}$. One of two gamma-ray instruments in the ALOFT campaign, iSTORM recorded glows, terrestrial gamma-ray flashes (TGFs), and the newly discovered flickering gamma-ray flashes (FGFs).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍美国海军研究实验室为 NASA ER-2 飞机设计的伽马射线谱仪 iSTORM，用于观测雷暴产生的伽马射线瞬变现象，包括辉光 (glows)、地球伽马射线闪 (TGFs) 和新发现的闪烁伽马射线闪 (FGFs)。仪器由 32 个一英寸 CeBr3 闪烁体配合硅光电倍增管 (SiPMs) 读出，飞行条件下能量范围约 250 keV 至 5 MeV，总几何面积 157 cm²，是 ALOFT 观测计划中两台伽马射线仪器之一。
Motivation: 雷暴过程中的伽马射线瞬变现象（如 TGFs 和 glows）对理解闪电与高能辐射机制很重要，但缺乏适合高空飞机平台、能覆盖相关能量范围的专用探测仪器。
Method: 设计并建造了基于 32 个 CeBr3 闪烁体阵列与硅光电倍增管读出的伽马射线谱仪，部署在 NASA ER-2 高空飞机上，用于对雷暴伽马射线事件进行机载原位测量。
Result: 摘要报告仪器在飞行条件下实现约 250 keV 至 5 MeV 的能量范围和 157 cm² 的总几何面积，并在 ALOFT 任务中成功记录到 glows、TGFs 以及新发现的 FGFs。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了 iSTORM 作为雷暴伽马射线观测平台的性能，强调其在高空机载环境中对多种雷暴伽马射线瞬变现象的探测能力，并指出 FGFs 是近期新发现的成像现象。

papers.title: Algorithmic statistics of retinal images
papers.abstract_en: There has been a tremendous amount of image processing and machine learning research to measure and classify disease progression from live optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging of the retina. The images considered here are large, complex, three-dimensional (3-D) and difficult to visualize effectively. Many current supervised machine learning approaches, \emph{e.g.} neural networks, are non-metric meaning that any features or measurements generated can introduce systematic distortion that may be correlated with underlying non-meaningful physiological differences. Here we present a metric learning approach using the normalized compression distance (NCD) combined with anisotropic structure-enhancing filters to quantify and visualize the principal differences among a collection of 3-D retinal images. We validate the NCD-measured structural differences between pairs of images against the physician-measured change in visual field function, achieving a prediction error of $\sim$ 0.5 dB, more accurate than non-metric deep learning approaches. The normalized compression vectors (NCV) are proposed as a feature set measuring visual differences among a collection of 3-D microscopy images. The utility of the NCV for visualizing and measuring patterns of change is demonstrated for a human with moderate non-progressing glaucoma and for a non-human primate model using intraocular pressure setting manipulation. We conclude with a brief simulation of non-metric embedding features, \emph{e.g.} from neural networks, introducing class-correlated statistical distortion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）三维图像提出一种度量学习方法，将归一化压缩距离（NCD）与各向异性结构增强滤波结合，用于量化并可视化一组三维视网膜图像之间的主要差异。作者用医生测量的视野功能变化来验证 NCD 结构差异，得到约 0.5 dB 的预测误差，并声称优于非度量深度学习方法。文中还提出归一化压缩向量（NCV）作为特征集，并在人类青光眼和非人灵长类眼压操控模型中展示其可视化变化模式的能力。
Motivation: 现有监督学习方法（如神经网络）是非度量的，可能引入与无意义的生理差异相关的系统性失真，而视网膜 OCT 图像大、复杂、三维且难以有效可视化，因此需要一种能避免这类失真的度量学习方法。
Method: 提出使用归一化压缩距离（NCD）结合各向异性结构增强滤波器来量化图像对之间的结构差异；引入归一化压缩向量（NCV）作为衡量三维显微镜图像集合中视觉差异的特征集，并通过对非度量嵌入特征的模拟来展示其引入类别相关统计失真的问题。
Result: NCD 测得的图像对结构差异与医生测量的视野功能变化对照，预测误差约为 0.5 dB，比非度量深度学习方法更准确；NCV 可视化与测量变化模式的能力在人类中度非进展性青光眼和非人灵长类眼压操控模型上得到验证。
Conclusion: 作者认为度量化的 NCD 方法可以避免神经网络等非度量嵌入带来的类别相关统计失真，NCV 可用于可视化三维图像集合中的模式变化；该方法针对视网膜 OCT 图像的分级与疾病进展量化任务。
Relevance: 2
